Sigh... They've completely lost control. I have to put them down.
But why are they like this? Did that Fallen Saintess pour her magic into them?
Huh? There are puppets that can repair themselves too...
I don't think anyone would just throw away puppets this rare...
No. This is taking too long. I'm worried about the prisoner cart.
I'll use the monster traps to take them out and hurry back.
That's strange... There are too many puppets. But the Fallen Saintess is still locked in the cart...
She shouldn't be able to set all this up.
Hmm... Could someone else be behind this?
Or maybe it's an ambush by the Fallen Saintess's allies...
If so, these puppets are just a distraction. The real target is ... the prisoner cart!
All right, then. I'll expose whoever's behind this!

strings.text: You and Amber team up for a commission, but soon discover that things are trickier than expected.
Slow and steady...==W== Perfect, the target hasn't spotted us.
Amber, how's it going on your end?
The commission brief says that our target's both nimble and cunning
So we gotta be extra careful
So I won't let anything stop me
After all this time—tracking, luring, and setting up the ambush...==W== We're finally here.
Next, we just need to catch the target off guard and launch the ambush...
Not far ahead, our target fiddles with the tiles on the roof and stretches out in a long, lazy yawn.
No, no... Judging by its previous patterns, it's about to move again!
Who stomped me on my head?
The smoke's too thick. Not a good idea to just rush in.
Let's wait for the smoke to disperse.
When I saw that huge cloud of smoke, it really freaked me out. I thought it was another case.
Ahaha... Thank the stars it's just a harmless accident of the Artifact aging.
Good to hear. There have been several cases of theft around here recently. Please be careful.
Ahem... Good thing we managed to cover that up.
Did you throw it, Amber? Why?
My plan was to use it to block the target's vision
So it wouldn't know which way to run
That way we could catch the cat more easily and finish the commission faster
I know I messed up. I'm already reflecting on my mistake.
Now I know a smoke bomb isn't the best choice for a situation like that
In a wide open area, the smoke also blocks our vision
so it actually ends up affecting us more
… Is that what you mean by reflecting?
Tear gas, flashbangs, tranquilizer bombs, and Iris's custom-made freeze grenades...
I need to pick the most suitable one out of all these options
Next time, I won't mess up!
So that's what you meant when you said "I won't let anything stop me..."
It's... Uh, it's good that you're so motivated. But maybe next time, we can go for a less ... drastic approach?
How should I explain to Amber that we don't need all these dangerous weapons when we're just trying to catch a cat?
But she's looking at me with such innocence that I can't bring myself to say anything.
Wh-what's going on? Why are you getting so close all of a sudden?
Your forehead... There's a red paw print...
The cat jumped onto my face and used my head as a stepping stone to escape just now.
I'm... I'm alright. I'm not injured and it doesn't hurt that much now.
Well, since the target got away, let's start over.
The target is highly alert and has some counter-surveillance skills
After what happened, it won't be coming near this area again
It'll probably go hide in a more secluded spot
Looks like we'll have to expand the search perimeter
Let's split up, more effective that way
Let's wrap this up so we can all eat pudding together

strings.text: Motivated by pudding, you and Amber embark on your kitten searching adventure once more.
Spotted a kitten by the square
It has some totally legit moves that I'm gonna steal
But it's not the one we're looking for
There are tons of interesting stalls in the market
One of them has handmade cat toys
Saw a black cat inside an alley just now
It was fighting with another cat
I tried to intervene and they both ran off
But that black cat looked really similar to our target
I'll look some more around here
It's going to get dark soon, be careful
This must be the spot Amber mentioned.
It looks like some kind of warehouse...
I'm ready! You pull and I'll climb.
Whew... The next step's crucial. Let's move in close, nice and slow.
It's scared but it's not trying to run away.
That's true... Last time, when it sensed danger, it run off right away.
Let's move in a little closer. It's too far to make anything out from here.
Someone's talking in the warehouse below?
Hey, scumbags! The goods are here!
Don't be so impatient, Thomas. We haven't even inspected the goods yet.
Of course I'm impatient, Jacklyn, you moron!
There are hundreds of Soul Stones here. If the word gets out, we're all screwed!
Did it occur to you why we chose this spot? Because it's safe.
Unless your big mouth told somebody, not even a mouse can get through.
Hahaha... You hear this fool? She just said, "not even a mouse can get through."
When we got here, there was a cat sleeping here like it owned the place. I had to kick it out.
You and your gang can't even get that right, and you're acting like you're all that?
I don't know what our leader was thinking when he decided to do business with you...
Looks like this is the only thing we can agree on. I'm not thrilled about the compromise, either.
Listen to you bark now. Not so tough when we ran you off the streets like the mangy curs you are, eh?
Just the thought of working with you turns my stomach.
One more word, and I'll smash your head in!
Do you really think I'm scared of you?
Keep an eye on them, guys. If these idiots make a move, take them out right away!
Looks like we walked into something big...
Best to pull back to a safe spot first and then notify the Imperial Guard.
It got hurt by the people down there. It's in too much pain to run away.
Yeah... Target or not, we can't just leave an injured cat here.
We'll give you some dried fish and you go back home with us, okay?
Oh, no. The roof is too weak to support anyone standing on it.
Who is it?! Who's up there?!
Amber, come back! They're gonna see us.
In the same instant, Amber leaps forward, pulling the struggling cat into her arms.
With a loud crack, the roof beneath Amber's feet gives way as decaying beams collapse. Clutching the black cat, she plummets...
Luckily I managed to grab Amber's strap in time and prevent them from falling. But now, we have another situation...
You guys hear that? We're not alone!
Fat chance! More like you set us up!
I guess we are totally exposed.
We can't keep this up. The roof over here will collapse, too. We need to figure out a way to get out of this situation fast...
Plus tear gas, tranquilizer bombs, and Iris's custom-made freeze grenades.
Man down! … They got one of us!
It's a trap! A trap! They want to take the goods and money for themselves!
What the hell are you talking about?! You started it!
Screw it! If I'm going down, you're going down with me!
Moving as if she were a real cat, Amber descends along the beams of the building and hops into the warehouse, making a crisp landing.
Gotcha. I'll guide you from above. Take the cat and find a way around!
Someone's in the way, can I take him down
As for the rest, just handle it however you see fit...
The chaos in the warehouse gradually subsides, eventually returning to calm.
Members of the Ground Viper and Eta gangs lie sprawled everywhere—hard to tell if they fell to Amber's bombs or fists.
Meanwhile, Amber is holding the black cat, waving its paw at me.

The kitten's alright, just a little hungry
I picked up a few things to feed it

Do you want to hold it? It's very soft and cuddly.
It won't try to run away, will it?
Don't worry. Once a cat likes someone, it won't just run off.
Has it recovered from that kick?
I had it checked. No broken bones, and no signs of internal bleeding either.
Cats are tough little creatures... With a bit of care, this one will bounce back in no time.

I wouldn't be able to get the commission done so quickly

strings.text: Crisis Awaits! The Tempest Never Fades
It's early morning. I'm making my way through the Ash District in Emor, hunting for a legendary drama rental shop.
Heard they've got rare Stella Dramas, and even some vintage Flavio flicks. Hmm ... what to watch?
Huh?==W== What's going on here? The whole street is blocked.
<size=52>Hey!</size>==W== I'm on a tight schedule! What's the holdup?
Who knows?==W== This road's always jammed. No one gives an inch. Probably a wreck.
At the front of the traffic snaking down the road, a blue scooter sits right in the middle. Someone even strung up a "caution line" with some cloth.
That scooter looks familiar. Wait, could it be?
Sorry for the delay, drivers!==W== Just one more moment! If you're crossing, please hurry up!
This road's impossible to cross in the morning! Thanks to you, I might actually get to work on time!
Seriously! I thought the Imperial Guards were useless, but hey, here's one who's actually doing her job.
Hmph. What's her problem? The Guard never used to do this stuff.
She's wasting our time. Got nothing better to do?
Oh, so it's not a wreck. An Imperial Guard's directing traffic.
Thanks for your patience! Traffic can get moving now!==W== Sorry for the trouble, everyone!
The knight apologizes and pushes her scooter aside.
Instantly, engines roar. The stone road vanishes under a wave of vehicles, leaving no space for pedestrians.
Hey! If it isn't the Boss!
Oww, ow... Tripped on a rock. This helmet really blocks my view.
Ah, never mind.==W== Mornin'! Out for a walk?
Nah, looking for a shop. You on duty?
Sort of...==W== As you can see, the morning traffic here is crazy, and people are desperate to get across.
You hear what happened? Some Imperial Guard knight just went and blocked off the whole area.
Huh? But I heard she's the reason those people could even get across the street.
No way. An Imperial Guard actually lifting a finger for us common folk? As if.
Probably spotted a Senator in the crowd.==W== Those Guards only care about kissing up to the powerful.
Don't listen to them. They spew nonsense.==W== Plenty of the people you helped across were grateful==W==.
Anyway, Tilia, let's get moving. How did that knight qualification test go the other day?
Great. Way to bring up a sore subject.
But I can probably guess why.
It just means I wasn't good enough. I failed to grasp the true spirit of a knight. I just have to push myself even harder on the path to justice!
I think you're plenty hardworking as it is.
No, that's not it... I ...==W== I always mess things up and annoy everyone.
See how all those drivers thought I was wasting their time just now? Just wish I'd handled it better.
Looks like what those people said really got to her.
Tilia, why do you want to join the Imperial Guard? Uphold justice?
Because ...==W== because that's what they did in Masked Knights!
All the Masked Knights would show up when someone's in trouble, drop an awesome one-liner, beat the bad guys, and save the day!
And their finishing move lines were the absolute coolest!
Huh? You watch Masked Knights too, Boss?==W== But... I don't recognize any of those lines. Which knight says them?
Ahaha, just some lines I saw in the Monoliths. They kinda just popped into my head.
Huh? Barbecue?==W== I'd love to, but what does that have to do with Masked Knights?
Oh, uh, nothing. Just got a sudden craving for it.
Guess Tilia hasn't seen that particular Stella Drama.
My all-time favorite line is from an episode of Masked Knights that I watched as a kid.
Knight Justus couldn't use fancy magic and his weapon was nothing special, but he never quit. Whenever his enemies would laugh at him, he'd just say—
"Exactly! I will become an ally of justice!"
I just think that's the best line ever.
S-Sorry... Lost myself a little there. That's so embarrassing.
Anyway! No matter what happens, I'll always be an ally of justice!
So even if I fail the exam, I'm not gonna lose heart!
She's already bounced back. That's a relief.
Well, I should get moving. Still gotta find that shop.
Boss, what shop are you looking for? I know this area like the back of my hand. Let me help you out.
Oh, I wouldn't want to bother you. Aren't you on duty?
No, no, it's no bother at all! I'm actually off today... I'm just, uh, doing some voluntary patrols.
I... I've always heard that the slow bird has to start flying early.==W== I'm not naturally talented, so if I want to pass the knight's exam, I just have to work harder than anyone else.
Do more things, more good deeds that help others! I'll win through sheer numbers!
Wow. She's so single-minded and positive. It's almost blinding.
A Masked Knight once said, "No good deed is too small"!
So please, Boss, let me help you. Helping someone in need is what justice is all about!
Did a Masked Knight really say that? I'm pretty sure it was some hero with two swords...==W== But, ah well.
She's so fired up, I can't really say no.
The shop I'm looking for is one with a lot of...
K-Knight ... you're a knight, aren't you?
I ... I'm not a full knight yet. Just a squire.
I-I don't know the difference, but please, you have to help us!
What is it? Slow down, what happened?
The farm! Our farm is being attacked by giants!

strings.text: Justice Stirs! The Knight Who Slays Giants
Hang on tight, Boss! We're almost there!
Tilia's Lapis Eagle tears across the countryside outside Emor, while I try to stay on its back.
Whoa, she's fast! So this is what the Lapis Eagle can really do?
Hey Tilia, how come the scooters the Imperial Guard uses in the city are so slow?
The Lapis Eagle is one of a kind! The standard-issue ones are ...==W== just cheap knock-offs from failed wishes, though they still cost a fortune.
So, I had a friend help me soup it up and unlock its real power!
We could actually go even faster if I just open 'er up a little—
... Phew. That was a close one.
Nice dodge. You swerved just in time.
Ah, sorry about that, Boss! Did I scare you? You're not hurt, are you?
I'm fine. A little more excitement than I was ready for.==W== Just try to watch where you're going next time, okay?
By the way, are you sure it's cool for you to tag along, Boss? I thought you had a shop to find.
It's no problem, my errand can wait.==W== Besides, you'll be up against "giants," right? Sounds like you could use the backup.
The farm! Our farm is being attacked by giants!
Don't worry, I'll handle this! Tilia, defender of justice, will take down those evil giants!
I've never even heard of a monster called a "giant." You don't even know what the enemy is, how can you just take her word for it?
What if she's just a kid who got things mixed up?
"Intuition of justice," right. But what about you? Does the Imperial Guard's jurisdiction even cover the area outside the city?
Uh, well, the Imperial Guard is just a security firm. We only patrol districts that have paid their fees, but...
I'm off the clock! So I'm out here as a defender of justice. It's like Knight Justus always says: "Justice strikes anywhere, anytime!"
I guess she has a point, but I've got a bad feeling about this.
Anyway, we gotta get there fast!==W== C'mon, Lapis Eagle, let's move!
We're here! What a beautiful field of wheat!
It's peaceful out here. I don't see any "giants."
Well now, Miss Knight. What wind blew you out to these parts?
I'm not a knight, I'm a squire! Oh, wait, that's not it either. I'm not here as a squire today.
Let me reintroduce myself!==W== I'm Tilia, a Masked-Knight-in-Training, here to defeat the evil giants!
Giants? What in the world are those? We ain't got any strange critters like that 'round here.
Knew it. No way a creature from a fairy tale actually exists.
So ... has anything unusual been happening on your farm?
The farm, let me think...==W== Oh! That's right! Those blasted giants are gonna wreck the whole place! And there's not just one, there are three of 'em!
There really are giants? And three of them?!
Then take us to them, quickly!
Ugh, what a racket. Are the gears rusted out?
Those are Giant #1, Giant #2, and Giant #3. They're United Harvest property. Been sitting here for ages, and not one person's come by for maintenance.
So those are the girl's "giants." Heh. They're certainly giant, alright.
See for yourself. With those things hanging over our heads, you never know when one might come crashing down. We can't even harvest our wheat...
For months! It's always the same excuse: "We're looking into it," "Filing a report," "It's in process." But they never send anyone to fix it!
Hey! What are you doing with those sickles?
What does it look like? We're harvesting wheat.
For God of Grace's sake, you can't! That's too dangerous!
Chief, look at those clouds.==W== Rain's coming in a day or two. We can't just let the whole harvest rot.
We'll be careful. We just need to get the wheat out from under them before they collapse.
Ugh, they're all going in... Please, just hold together for a little longer...
This is dangerous! I have to help them.
Tilia nimbly vaults onto the Lapis Eagle, but she pauses as she reaches for her helmet.
What's wrong? Not putting on your helmet?
... If I shatter those blades ... am I just going to cause more problems for the villagers?
No way. An Imperial Guard actually lifting a finger for us common folk? As if.
Probably spotted a Senator in the crowd.==W== Those Guards only care about kissing up to the powerful.
And it's still United Harvest's property. If they want someone to blame and couldn't find me, they'll take it out on the villagers.
That company has a terrible reputation... Or ... should we just stand here and pray the blades don't fall? Is that the better choice?
Guess justice is never simple. In a situation like this, every option feels like a betrayal of what's truly right.
Think, but don't overthink, Tilia. That impulse you have to help people? That's never wrong.
Don't sweat it, I'm here. If anything happens after, I'll fix it. My way.
But if we actually cause trouble for the villagers, doesn't that make us the bad guys?
Perfect! As the Boss, I'm born to play the villain in a Masked Knight story. The clever, sneaky type.
Well ... true. But there are cool villains too.
It's precisely because some villains are sneaky that they can pull moves a hero wouldn't dream of, or wouldn't dare to try. Trust me.
Hey, even a Boss wants to back up an "ally of justice" sometimes.
Oh no! The windmill blade—it's gonna fall!
Everyone, run! Get out of the wheat field!
After all that talk... When danger hits, she's still the first one to charge in.
<color=black>In the golden wheat,==RT==Tilia raises her lance,==RT==a mirror image of the knights in stories charging toward a giant.</color>

Miss Knight! Thank you for protecting us from the giants!

Now we can finally harvest the wheat. Once the new grain's sold, we'll swing by with fresh bread and a gift to thank you properly.
Hey you, she's not one of those awful Imperial Knights, so stop shouting nonsense.==W== Forgotten already? Today's hero is—
Oh, sorry, almost forgot! You were a huge help, Masked Knight Tilia!
I-I-I hear a cry for help in the distance! I have to go!
C'mon, Boss, let's get back to the Lapis Eagle!
Whoa! What's the sudden rush?!==W== Don't pull so hard, you'll make us crash!
I can feel her blushing all the way through that helmet. Is it the heat, or is she just flustered?
I did it! I upheld justice!
And they called me "Miss Knight"...==W== Hehe, hehehe...
Just now, Tilia, you were a true "ally of justice," no doubt about it.
Really? Hearing you say that makes me feel like I can take on the world!

strings.text: Lost Lucky Charm? That's a Disaster!
Good, the decoys in Zone A worked. They've already burned through a ton of ammo.
The enemy's already limited magic bullets have been completely used up, so Zone A is definitely secure now.
The second squad just sent a report: after successfully luring the Stellaroid, they've retreated to the rendezvous point as planned and are currently resupplying.
Hah, they totally fell for it.
With my delaying tactics, Red Team should run out of ammo soon. For the next half hour, we just need to hold the line with superior firepower.
Waaaahhh! Could it be that... We're finally going to beat the captain—==W=="Kasimira the Undefeated"—just this once?!
It's true, if we keep holding like this, victory is ours to take... ==W==But don't you think things are going just a little too well?
No matter how brilliant you are in combat, it can't make up for a strategic flaw. Even Kasimira is just a defanged beast once she's out of ammo.
Today, by Kasimira's request, I joined the Blue Team in the White Cat Troupe's combat exercise.
Given Kasimira's combat style, I designed this "ammo trap" to burn through their ammunition with obstacles and decoys, then hold our line with overwhelming firepower.
According to the exercise rules, Red Team only has thirty minutes of attack time left. As long as we hold out through that—
Boss, someone just came out of the lift. It's Captain Kasimira and the Red Team.
Boss, no more hiding! Let's settle this right here, right now!
Not a chance. We're falling back to the final defense line, just like we planned.
Captain, the Blue Team keeps running. Let's chase them down and finish them off!
So many Stellaroids... ==W==Why are they all blocking our path?
Boss led us here on purpose.
So what? We'll break through! A few shots and those Stellaroids are done for.
How many magic bullets do you have left?
T-Ten rounds... ==W==Ah, I get it now. Boss is trying to drain our ammo with these Stellaroids! Hey, Cap, isn't this against the rules?!
Victory is the only rule in war. A real enemy won't wait for you to be ready before coming at you.
Hmph, interesting. Listen up. Forget about conserving ammo. Take down those Stellaroids with everything you've got!
Huh? But wouldn't that mean we're walking right into the trap ==SEX== set for us?
Hmph, that depends on whether those traps are big enough to hold me.
I believe luck's on my side. Fire at will!
Judging by the gunfire... ==W==They're probably out of ammo.
Everyone, move into position. Victory is within reach!
You are right. I can already taste our victory.
Kasimira, give it up! I'll admit, you are breaking through fast. But how many bullets do you have left? Five? Three?
Just one, thanks to good luck.
But you're all carrying plenty, aren't you?
Then that's more than enough. Once I pull the trigger, I'll have dozens more.
Crap! She's trying to drag us into close combat!
On the battlefield, picking up the enemy's weapons is only natural.
Dammit! So you were planning to get ammo from us all along?!
No. I only came up with this when I saw the Stellaroids.
You really are a tough opponent. If I don't go all out, it won't be a proper respect.
Good. Beyond ten paces, the gun still wins.
Well then, everyone. Learned a few things today, haven't we?
I invited ==PLAYER_NAME== here today so you could see that battle isn't just about guts and brute force. Strategy matters too.
Yeah... We may have lost, but this is the first time we've pushed Captain Kasimira this far. Boss's tactics and way of thinking were really effective.
Yeah, charging in headfirst isn't all there is to a fight.
Ahem, courage in battle and knowing when to charge are important too!==RT==But what I really want to say is... ==W==You need to work on building up your luck, every day!
True. when Kasimira charged at me in the end, if that bullet hadn't been a dud, it would've been Red Team losing instead.
Her lecture on the importance of luck.
She can keep going for a whole hour.
Like today, my opponent missed the one critical shot because I was carrying...
Huh? Where'd it go? That's weird... ==W==It's not in my pocket, ==W==not on my cloak either... ==W==Oh no, no no no no no!
You guys... ==W==How many coins do you each have on you right now?
Let me see... ==W==Two, four, six... ==W==Eight. I have eight.
Yup. I need you because you have a lucky number.
Hey! Wait! Where are we going?!
Alright, around here should be good.
Isn't this just an ordinary patch of grass? What are we even doing here?
Now this is a commission ... ==W==that only you can handle. I'll pay triple the usual combat exercise rate—no, considering the difficulty, make that ten.
Eh...? ==W==You want me to command ten squads? Or are you handing me a whole army now?
I want you to help me find... ==W==A four-leaf clover.
Got it. A four-leaf clover, I'll do it right aw... ==W==Wait, what? You're paying me ten times the usual rate just to find a four-leaf clover?

strings.text: Where to Find a Lucky Charm? In the Woods, or in a Cookie?
You're paying me ten times the usual rate just to find a four-leaf clover?
That's right. I've got something really important to do today. And without a good luck charm... ==W==I just don't feel confident.
Whoa, whoa, ten times the pay for a lucky charm? You're a battle-hardened White Cat mercenary! You seriously believe in that stuff?
Today's lucky charm is the wishbone I got a month ago when I played the wishbone game with Chaton.
I carefully cleaned it and kept it safe in a hidden pocket, but now it's gone.
You probably lost it during the simulation battle.
No, no. It just got used up.
Got used up? What do you mean?
You know how people "build up good karma"? I think luck works kind of like that. The luck you save up over time gets spent when something lucky happens.
I won just now because of a dud. I think ... that wishbone fulfilled its purpose by balancing that out. That's why it vanished.
Hmm... ==W==I kind of get it... But also kind of don't...
Anyway, forget the tenfold commission. I'll do my best to help you find one. As for whether we actually can... ==W==Well, that's up to fate.
I'm sure you can. You're the one with the lucky number 8, aren't you?
What lucky number...? ==W==If the shopkeeper had given me different change yesterday, it wouldn't have been 8 coins at all.
Wait a sec... So the change plus the coins I already had made exactly eight... Could that actually be some kind of lucky sign?
No way I'm letting you snatch that four-leaf clover after all that effort! Gotcha, you little thief!
What is it, Boss? Did you run into a monster?
Oh, it's a wild rabbit. So cute.
It suddenly leapt out and ate the four-leaf clover I just found.
Uh... Why'd you suddenly pull out a combat knife?
I've heard that a rabbit's left foot can be used as a good luck charm, too.
I don't really buy that, though.
As she speaks, Kasimira pulls out some herbs from her cloak, carefully chops them up, and starts applying them to the rabbit's left foot as an emergency salve.
Look, this rabbit's left foot is injured.
If it really holds good luck, no way it would get hurt so easily.
A fierce mercenary, but surprisingly gentle about things like this.
All right, all done. Go hide out in your burrow for a few days. The wound will heal in no time.
I didn't expect to see such a gentle side of you, Kasimira.
W-What do you mean gentle...?! ==W==T-Those herbs would've wilted anyway if I didn't use them... Gotta replace them regularly, that's all...
Alright, I see now. So Kasimira, it's not really about WHAT the charm is, right? You just want a charm, any kind would do.
I know a place where you can get a charm really easily.
Smells so good... ==W==Is this a dessert shop?
On that table over there are the shop's limited-edition treats—==W==fortune cookies. Each one has a little slip of paper inside with a different prediction written on it.
Huh?! No way! They're not supposed to put fortunes like that in a fortune cookie...
Excuse me, miss, you picked the wrong one. The fortune cookies are on a different table. What you have is one of our "Divine Omen Cookies."
W-Wrong one...? ==W==No—this must be a sign from the God of Grace... ==W==A warning that today's not the right day for that important task.
Don't get so down! There are tons of ways to boost your luck—
—like the lucky koi in front of Fenghuang Diner, or the beckoning cat at Goodwind Homecare...
Whoa, I've never seen Kasimira this down before. I've gotta think of a way to cheer her up!
Excuse me, do you have any super lucky desserts here?
Super lucky, huh? Then how about trying our newest product, ==W==the Horseshoe Fortune Cookie?
It's a cookie based on a good-luck legend Trekkers got from inside the Monolith.
Legend says a devil forced a blacksmith to make him shoes, but the smith nailed red-hot horseshoes to his feet, driving him off. So horseshoes came to symbolize protection and luck.
I see... ==W==The devil, horseshoe, and shoes... ==W==I get it now. I'll take one, please.
Not bad at all... ==W==So, what's the fortune inside the cookie?
"Ichi-go ichi-e," meaning "once in a lifetime"... ==W==Just as I thought.
Boss, would you stay with me a little longer? I think ... I'm finally ready to do that important thing.
Of course I will. But... ==W==you still haven't found your lucky charm, have you? "Ichi-go ichi-e"... ==W==Doesn't exactly sound like a good-luck kind of fortune.
No, no—the God of Grace has already given me a sign. I've got my answer now.
Boss, what I'm about to do... I want you to be there as a witness.
Alright. Since we've come this far, I'll stick with you to the very end.

All right, all done. Go hide out in your burrow for a few days. The wound will heal in no time.
I didn't expect to see such a gentle side of you, Kasimira.
W-What do you mean gentle...?! ==W==T-Those herbs would've wilted anyway if I didn't use them... Gotta replace them regularly, that's all...
Alright, I see now. So Kasimira, it's not really about WHAT the charm is, right? You just want a charm, any kind would do.
I know a place where you can get a charm really easily.
Smells so good... ==W==Is this a dessert shop?
On that table over there are the shop's limited-edition treats—==W==fortune cookies. Each one has a little slip of paper inside with a different prediction written on it.
Huh?! No way! They're not supposed to put fortunes like that in a fortune cookie...
Excuse me, miss, you picked the wrong one. The fortune cookies are on a different table. What you have is one of our "Divine Omen Cookies."
W-Wrong one...? ==W==No—this must be a sign from the God of Grace... ==W==A warning that today's not the right day for that important task.
Don't get so down! There are tons of ways to boost your luck—
—like the lucky koi in front of Fenghuang Diner, or the beckoning cat at Goodwind Homecare...
Whoa, I've never seen Kasimira this down before. I've gotta think of a way to cheer her up!
Excuse me, do you have any super lucky desserts here?
Super lucky, huh? Then how about trying our newest product, ==W==the Horseshoe Fortune Cookie?
It's a cookie based on a good-luck legend Trekkers got from inside the Monolith.
Legend says a devil forced a blacksmith to make him shoes, but the smith nailed red-hot horseshoes to his feet, driving him off. So horseshoes came to symbolize protection and luck.
I see... ==W==The devil, horseshoe, and shoes... ==W==I get it now. I'll take one, please.
Not bad at all... ==W==So, what's the fortune inside the cookie?
"Ichi-go ichi-e," meaning "once in a lifetime"... ==W==Just as I thought.
Boss, would you stay with me a little longer? I think ... I'm finally ready to do that important thing.
Of course I will. But... ==W==you still haven't found your lucky charm, have you? "Ichi-go ichi-e"... ==W==Doesn't exactly sound like a good-luck kind of fortune.
No, no—the God of Grace has already given me a sign. I've got my answer now.
Boss, what I'm about to do... I want you to be there as a witness.
Alright. Since we've come this far, I'll stick with you to the very end.

strings.text: Run, Boss! For the Sake of Your Shoes!
Last stretch coming up. Throwing everything I've got at it!
Kasimira brings me back into the Monolith, to an arcade room that the White Cat Troupe uses as a training ground.
Why the sigh? You were perfect. All your turns were spot on.
Thanks. But it's far from enough.
Kasimira's score flashes on the screen—second place, an impressive high score, but still a ways off from the top spot she was aiming to beat.
So the important thing you had to do today was trying to beat that score? Yeah, that would take a bit of luck.
Yeah. I've hit the top score on every other training machine in this place. This is the only one where I haven't made it to the very top.
I don't know which former member left that top score, but I feel like... ==W==Until I beat it, I don't stand a chance at truly reviving the White Cat Troupe.
Still, you're right, this driving sim does take some luck. There are parts where I just can't seem to get the points no matter how well I drive.
Weird... I did bring my lucky charm with me.
Maybe it's because I'm not wearing it. I used to keep all my lucky charms on my person.
Boss, can I borrow you for a minute?
Eh? Ehhhh? What are you doing?
Kasimira pulls me into her arms and sits me down in front of her.
Sorry, Boss, but I'm gonna need to borrow a bit of your luck.
A soft warmth presses against my back. Before I can say a word, Kasimira wraps me in her arms and starts the next game.
She says she wants me to share some of my luck with her, but how exactly do you share something like that?
Hold on tight. We're gonna start!
This is way more intense than I expected. Sitting in the driver's seat feels completely different.
Especially during the turns, my body keeps getting thrown to the side...!==W====RT==I feel like ... ==W==I'm about to lose consciousness!
Hold on tight, Boss. We're gonna take off here.
I can't take it anymore! Let me off!
I-it finally stopped... ==W==With acceleration that crazy, we've got to have taken first place—
Unfortunately, still quite a ways off.
Weird... ==W==The score still won't go up. Could I be using the lucky charm the wrong way?
I think maybe it's the timing of the item use that's off.
Items? You mean those dozen or so buttons next to the steering wheel? I just pressed them all at once.
The track is already complicated enough, so hitting them all at once and focusing on driving makes sense. But ... ==W==now you've got me, don't you?
A few minutes later, once again sitting in Kasimira's lap, I place my hands over the maze of item buttons.
I'm counting on you, Boss. I trust your tactical instincts. Ready?
In Kasimira's arms, I gradually get used to the bumpy mountain course, timing each item release perfectly to block the rival cars. Every successful hit adds to our score.
Banana peels, octopuses, turtle shells—Let's mess with the other racers one wave at a time!
Boss, not bad at all. Is this really your first time playing this game?
Hmmm... ==W==No idea. I lost my memory, after all.
But once you focus and think it through, it's not that hard to find the right time to use these items.
How can you calm down with all this shaking?
I know you won't let me get thrown off.
Hmph, you are not wrong, but just that won't get us first place. Look at our score.
We're almost at the finish line, but we're still 100,000 points behind... ==W==How did the leader manage that?!
Stop overthinking it and focus on the race.
To boost our speed even more, I threw out the last item—==W==the Invincible Cross Star.
Boss, we're going way too fast—I can't control the steering. At this rate, we're going to fly off the track.
There's a slowdown item here—whoa, it's too shaky, I can't hit the button...
Oh no, did I accidentally hit—==W==the brake?
We don't have enough speed! We won't make it over the broken bridge ahead!
There—There's a hidden shortcut under the bridge! We are crossing the finish line—
Heh,==W== even I find it hard to believe.==W== You surely are my most reliable lucky charm.
Yeah,==W== do you remember that fortune cookie?==W== The words inside reminded me.
Yeah,==W== the note inside that fortune cookie reminded me.
Our meeting today==W== may be the only one in our lives.==W== That's what it meant.
—Our meeting today==W== may be the only one in our lives...==W== This, ==W==is what it meant.
I'm suddenly feeling a huge sense of responsibility...
Right?==W== That's why==W== we must cherish people around us,==W== and never let our luck slip away.
Looking back,==W== this whole day was full of "luck"—==W==found a four-leaf clover,==W== had a delicious fortune cookie,==W== and also, got "ammo supply" during the exercise.
Looking back,==W== this whole day was full of "luck"—==W==found a four-leaf clover,==W== had a delicious fortune cookie,==W== and also,==W== got a lucky dud during the exercise.

Hehe,==W== sorry.==W== But thanks to all of this, I finally realized==W== that the luck I’ve been chasing …==W== has already been brought to me,==W== by you.==W== And that gives me the confidence to break the record.

Hehe,==W== sorry.==W== But thanks to all of this, I finally realized==W== that the luck I’ve been chasing …==W== has already been brought to me by you==W== from the very beginning.==W== And that gives me==W== the confidence to break the record.
Thank you,==W== you’re an irreplaceable friend,==W== and there must be more peaks await us to climb together in the future.
Thank you, Boss.==W== To me==W==, you’re an irreplaceable friend.
By the way, how did you figure out that was a shortcut? I've driven this track so many times and never noticed it.
Actually, it wasn't that I discovered it... ==W==I just accidentally drove over it.
Hey, why are you staring at my shoes like that?
That legend, the one about the "Lucky Horseshoe."
The devil in that legend wanted shoes, but ended up with horseshoes instead. So basically, the horseshoes are the devil's shoes, which then became lucky charms.
Your thoughts jumps around a bit, but I guess it makes sense. So what's the point?
You are the Boss, so I'm sure your shoes are even luckier!
Wait... ==W==It's not like I'm the devil's boss...
But today's "ichi-go ichi-e" with you truly brought me the greatest luck ever.
I'm sure that cookie, no, that all shop is all according to the God of Grace's will.
So, please sell me your shoes, Boss.
I'll pay ten times—no, a hundred times the original price!
There's no amount of Dorra that you can pay me!
I'll cherish them, carry them daily, rub them before important tasks, and hang them by my bedside at night.
Ugh, I can't take it anymore...==W== Well, you got first place, so the commission's over, right? See you later...
Don't go! Boss, give me your shoes!
And so, Kasimira chased me through the Monolith for a long time.
In the end, I agreed to share my luck with Kasimira before every important mission, in person. That's how I barely held onto my shoes.

strings.text: Her other side, never seen before.
The quiet inside the office was broken only by the steady sound of a pen moving across paper.
Lady Firenze, these are the materials for tomorrow's meeting.
According to the schedule, today is supposed to be your day off. You skipped dinner again yesterday, right? I'm afraid that you're pushing yourself too hard.
I know. But the company is in the middle of a transition. I can't just let the work pile up.
Then at least let Ruby and me help carry some of the load...
It's fine. Today's an off day, anyway. You and Ruby should not be here. Go home and rest.
Sigh, same as always. She does not want us working overtime, but she herself...
She has been at it for almost two weeks nonstop. This cannot continue.
We cannot talk her into taking a break, so we need someone who can.
Well, in that case, there's only one person we can turn to...
So that is why you dragged me here?
Please, Boss. At this point, you are the only one we can count on!
Hmm. From what you told me, it does sound dire.
Thank you. We only want her to take one day off to relax and unlode her burdens.
But even if I were to help, knowing Firenze, she would not rest if she had unfinished work.
We cannot force her to leave, right?
You don't have to worry about that. Sapphire and I will take care of her work while she's away.
The bigger problem is the other employees who aren't in on the plan. While you are walking her out of the building, someone will almost certainly stop her to report something.
Please use this secret weapon we prepared when the occasion calls for it.
In this bag? So what is inside?
T-that is classified!==W==<size=80%> Unless you have absolutely no alternative, please try not to unleash it...</size>
All right...==W== I will do it your way.
Her office is as neat as ever, and it smells like lemons...==W== So refreshing.
I have something important to discuss with you. I hope I can borrow a moment.
Hmm...==W== Not here. Could we talk outside?
The thing is, I still have some unfinished work. If you do not mind waiting for a bit...
I told you two to go home. Why are you still here?
We <size=120%>happened to</size> run into Boss on the way out.
Given how important our work relationship is, we feel like we have to prioritize what Boss wants!
Please do not worry about the paperwork. I can handle them.
And I will take care of the errands!
You two ran into ==SEX4==? That is quite a coincidence.
<size=80%>Wah, that look of hers. The pressure is so intense...</size>
Ahem...==W== Anyway, since the work is handled, you can come with me, right?
I will leave the rest to you two then.
Feels like they already gave themselves away...
<size=80%>Make sure she doesn't come back today, Boss!</size>
What is it? Is something wrong in Production?
No, just a proposal for process improvements. We need your input...
Ruby and Sapphire are delegating now, aren't they? And Production is their responsibility...
Sorry, could you leave the proposal in my office? Someone will review it.
The company is going through major changes, and the new procedures haven't been formalized yet. Everyone is used to coming straight to me.
But you were right. I should not keep undermining the procedure of things.
Ruby and Sapphire can handle it.
Although, Boss... If too many people stop us on the way, I might end up going back to my office. Heh. What do you plan to do about that?
Not a problem. All I need is this "secret weapon"...
Ruby and Sapphire prepared it. They said to use it if things get difficult.
Firenze checked the contents of the bag and smiled with a quiet, amused expression.
Nothing. Please wait here, I'll be right back.
Phew, good thing it still fits. How does it look?
Looks great on you...==W== This is a school uniform?
It's from the Philaen Academy where I studied.
So this is the secret weapon...==W== But why?
I assume Ruby or Sapphire found it in my closet and decided it would work as a disguise.

Because there is nothing else. To avoid wasting time choosing clothes every morning, my wardrobe contains thirty identical work outfits. Other than those, the only clothing I kept was this uniform as a memento.
I shall take it as a compliment. Now that I have changed, let us go.
Once Firenze put on the uniform, no one approached her with work.
Some employees glanced at us curiously, but none made the connection that the "schoolgirl" was their boss.
A flimsy excuse to get me out of the office, and you even had me wear a school uniform...
Heh. Boss, don't tell me that you're trying to take me==W== on a date?

strings.text: Heh. Boss, don't tell me that you're trying to take me==W== on a date?
No way! This is a partner inspection! I want to visit United Harvest's stores with you and see how things look on the ground.
When you stay in the office every day, all you see are numbers. What happens on the front line matters too, right?
Your reaction is a bit boring. But you've made a point. I have been busy lately and have not had the chance to see things for myself.
Here are your fruits. Thank you.
The fruit has been much fresher than before. Did you change suppliers?
No, no. It is still from United Harvest's greenhouses. But we improved the storage process during picking, so the fruit stays fresh longer.
I see. You really put a lot of thought into this...==W== I will be coming back for sure!
Looks like the improvements are working. Even a small change in the process can raise the quality of the products.
Come to think of it, Boss, what kind of fruits do you like?
There is a saying, "An apple a day keeps the doctor away."
Getting sick in the Wilds is the worst. There are no doctors, and you become a burden to your squad.
True. Then starting today, I will eat an apple every day. If I collapse, I cannot work.
I like oranges as well. When I was little, I always ran to the shop to buy them as soon as they became available in winter.
That sweet-tart taste is impossible to resist.
But after growing up...==W== I would not say I dislike them, but I haven't had many chances to eat them.
Same here.==W== You noticed the lemon scent in my office, yes?
Yes. That scent keeps one's head clear. I like it, too.
It feels unexpectedly nice when someone shares my preferences.
So, Boss, where are we going next for this inspection tour of yours?
Another shop? But if I keep stalling like this, it will end up being the same as her working.
When the goal was to have her get some rest at last...
Then, to further our understanding of each other and discuss future strategies...
Would you like to ...==W== have afternoon tea with me?
That expression again. She really makes me feel like she can see right through me.
You mean the "inspection" is over and now it's date time?
Why do you keep using that word!
Simple. Your reactions are more entertaining this way.
Okay, fine. Have it your way.
Then please, Boss. Lead the way.
I brought Firenze to a well-known Philae dessert shop and ordered the afternoon tea set.
Their afternoon tea is famous. I have always wanted to try it. You have fine tastes, Boss.
Thanks. I am glad you like it.
Truth is, I just happened to see the shop...
Before I realized it, a group of students had already surrounded our table.
S-sorry for interrupting. We are students from Grace Light Academy, here in Philae on a study trip.
Judging from your uniform, do you go to Philaen Academy?
Firenze glanced at me before a playful smile came to her lips. She set down her tea with elegant composure.
Yes, I am. May I help you?
I look to her in shock, but she just presses a finger to her lips in a quiet "shh."
I hope you don't find this question too intrusive, but...==W== Once you graduate, would you consider studying at Grace Light?
Sounds like a fine choice. I've always wanted to see the world outside of Philae and expand my horizons.
That's great. Perhaps one day we will meet on campus. Running into you here... It feels like fate!
They are unbelievably enthusiastic...==W== Firenze's charm really is something else.
Wow, just imagine...==W== If we can see you around every day...
Wait, I want to talk to her, too!
Hey, look at the girl over there...==W== She totally slays...==W== A model, you think?
And so elegant...==W== I feel like I'm falling in love...
This feels like an idol meet-and-greet. When did the mob appear?
Wait a minute! What do you mean, she's yours?!
The crowd is getting a bit noisy.==W== I hope it's not gonna become a problem...
Everyone, please keep your voices down. Let's not disturb the other customers.
With that kind of presence, I really should not have worried.
Although... If she is relaxed enough to chat with strangers, maybe my goal of giving her a break has already been achieved.
Ah, I forgot. I rushed out this morning and have not eaten anything since.
Um, well... We were planning to walk around the city after this. Could we ask you to act as our guide?
Come with us! We are curious about Philaen Academy, too.
Thank you for the invitation, but I already have plans today.
That is a shame...==W== Who's the lucky person?
They really only have eyes for Firenze. I mean, I am sitting right here.
Sorry. I may have gone a bit overboard.
No, I underestimated your magnetic charm. I should have chosen a quieter place.
All that hoopla, though...==W== Were you that popular back then, too?
"Back then?" You're making me sound old. I am still a student at Grace Light Academy, you know.
Did I not tell you? That year, because of my father's fall, I hurried back to Philae and never went back to Grace Light.
Before leaving, I filed for long-term leave, so technically I am still a student,==W== just on leave.
And I was not popular at all.
Who would like someone who buried herself in books all day and never bothered with her appearance?
See, the problem was that we just hadn't met yet at the time. If we had, I would've had a reason to make myself look nicer.
Come on, don't put it like that!
Heh. That was a good reaction.
Thank you for such an entertaining afternoon tea experience. Now let me take the lead.
That's fine, but...==W== Where do you want to go?
A favorite restaurant of mine. Let's go together.
These cakes are lovely to look at, but they aren't exactly filling.
Without waiting for me to respond, Firenze took my hand and led me deeper into the city.

param: Heh. Boss, don't tell me that you're trying to take me==W== on a date?
No way! This is a partner inspection! I want to visit United Harvest's stores with you and see how things look on the ground.
When you stay in the office every day, all you see are numbers. What happens on the front line matters too, right?
Your reaction is a bit boring. But you've made a point. I have been busy lately and have not had the chance to see things for myself.
Here are your fruits. Thank you.
The fruit has been much fresher than before. Did you change suppliers?
No, no. It is still from United Harvest's greenhouses. But we improved the storage process during picking, so the fruit stays fresh longer.
I see. You really put a lot of thought into this...==W== I will be coming back for sure!
Looks like the improvements are working. Even a small change in the process can raise the quality of the products.
Come to think of it, Boss, what kind of fruits do you like?
There is a saying, "An apple a day keeps the doctor away."
Getting sick in the Wilds is the worst. There are no doctors, and you become a burden to your squad.
True. Then starting today, I will eat an apple every day. If I collapse, I cannot work.
I like oranges as well. When I was little, I always ran to the shop to buy them as soon as they became available in winter.
That sweet-tart taste is impossible to resist.
But after growing up...==W== I would not say I dislike them, but I haven't had many chances to eat them.
Same here.==W== You noticed the lemon scent in my office, yes?
Yes. That scent keeps one's head clear. I like it, too.
It feels unexpectedly nice when someone shares my preferences.
So, Boss, where are we going next for this inspection tour of yours?
Another shop? But if I keep stalling like this, it will end up being the same as her working.
When the goal was to have her get some rest at last...
Then, to further our understanding of each other and discuss future strategies...
Would you like to ...==W== have afternoon tea with me?
That expression again. She really makes me feel like she can see right through me.
You mean the "inspection" is over and now it's date time?
Why do you keep using that word!
Simple. Your reactions are more entertaining this way.
Okay, fine. Have it your way.
Then please, Boss. Lead the way.
I brought Firenze to a well-known Philae dessert shop and ordered the afternoon tea set.
Their afternoon tea is famous. I have always wanted to try it. You have fine tastes, Boss.
Thanks. I am glad you like it.
Truth is, I just happened to see the shop...
Before I realized it, a group of students had already surrounded our table.
S-sorry for interrupting. We are students from Grace Light Academy, here in Philae on a study trip.
Judging from your uniform, do you go to Philaen Academy?
Firenze glanced at me before a playful smile came to her lips. She set down her tea with elegant composure.
Yes, I am. May I help you?
I look to her in shock, but she just presses a finger to her lips in a quiet "shh."
I hope you don't find this question too intrusive, but...==W== Once you graduate, would you consider studying at Grace Light?
Sounds like a fine choice. I've always wanted to see the world outside of Philae and expand my horizons.
That's great. Perhaps one day we will meet on campus. Running into you here... It feels like fate!
They are unbelievably enthusiastic...==W== Firenze's charm really is something else.
Wow, just imagine...==W== If we can see you around every day...
Wait, I want to talk to her, too!

strings.text: I want to share this flavor with you, for it was once tied to my memories.
It was a small, unassuming place that offered some version of Monolith-style food. No flashy interior at all. The kind of place where one would expect to find nothing but simple burgers and fries.
I never expected you to bring me somewhere like this...
Let me guess. In your mind, you pictured an upper class restaurant lit by crystal chandeliers that were wished from the Monolith, and reservations needed to be made months in advance.
After all, you are the COO of United Harvest's Philaen branch. I expected a place befitting of that title.
It's only natural you would think that way. This is a little place I visit only for special occasions.
When I was studying at Philaen Academy, I came here often. It was the only place where I could calm down and enjoy food without any distractions.
And the portions fill you up. Perfect for an empty stomach, right?
So you did hear my stomach growling...
Hehe, I have no idea what you're talking about. Please, order whatever you like.
Boss, please allow me to thank you properly. So, thank you for getting me out of the office for the day.
Firenze smiled gently at the food placed in front of her.
Ruby and Sapphire are not good at hiding things...==W== And neither are you.
But that is part of the charm.
You are not angry at us? Since we tricked you into coming out today.
You're looking out for me. How could I possibly be angry?
And you were right. I really have been too impatient lately.
I thought that pouring in more time and effort would make up for my past mistakes, but a healthy organization cannot operate around a single person.
Only when everyone does their part can this company get back on track.
In other words, you will give up the whole workaholic thing?
Mm. From now on, I am going to start letting go bit by bit.==W== As a leader, if I keep doing my subordinates' work, I will only take away their chances to grow.
That is great. Then everyone who cares about you can finally relax.
That was a very direct answer.
You are the one who said I am not good at hiding things.
Hehe...==W== All right, eat while it is still hot.
You should eat more too. Sapphire said you have not been eating properly these past few days.
Sigh, Sapphire and her big mouth...==W== By the looks of it, though, you seem more tired than I am.
I spent the whole day yesterday running around out in the Wilds. I still have not recovered.
And even so, you still came all the way here to help...==W== Do not push yourself too hard, too.
I am fine. I only agreed to help Ruby and Sapphire because I had been wanting to see you.
Let me give you something that will get rid of your fatigue. Close your eyes.
Fresh lemon.==W== What do you think?
It's delicious alright, but it did startle me a bit.
But it's precisely the surprise that perks you up,==W== no?
But I believe it's the surprise==W== that perks you up.
Don't forget,==W== your time afterward==W== belongs to me too.
Your time afterward==W== belongs to me too, right?
By doing this,==W== won't it cheer you up, so that we can spend some ...==W== truly enjoyable time together?
So I wanted==W== to cheer you up,==W== so that we can spend some truly enjoyable time together.
Besides...==W== I wanted to share this taste with you.
Seriously though,==W== I also wanted to…==W== share this taste with you.
As I told you before,==W== I used to come here all the time when I was a student,==W== and the lemon's taste here==W== is unique as well...==W== A taste that's connected to my memory.
As I told you before,==W== I used to come here all the time when I was a student,==W== and the lemon's taste here==W== is a taste that's connected to my memory.
Those school days weren't all smooth sailing...==W== But that's also the reason why==W== I don't want to forget them.==W== Even now on my office desk,==W== I always put a lemon there.
Those school days weren't all smooth sailing...==W== But that's why==W== I don't want to forget them.==W== Even now, I always put a lemon on my office desk.
Whether it was the heartbreak==W== or the bitterness back then,==W== they're irreplaceable memories to me...
Sour or bitter,==W== they're irreplaceable memories to me...
Let's add this moment to the memories too.
A lemon doesn't have to be sour and bitter. It can carry happy moments too.
Heh,==W== thank you.==W== Always so perceptive.
Ah…==W== Heh,==W== thank you,==W== Boss.==W== Always so perceptive.
Since you insist...==W== Let's finish every last lemon here~
Well then...==W== Shall we finish every last lemon here?
Just kidding.==W== But you could finish all these lemons==W== on the table, right?
Just kidding.==W== But speaking of which…==W== You could finish all these lemons==W== on the table, right?
After I had fully savored the taste of Firenze's memories, we left the restaurant.
I did not expect you to actually finish them all.
Once you get used to it, they are pretty good. And I am completely awake now.
Good. Now we can keep going with our date.
Next, we'll head to a place that's just a teeny—tiny bit exciting.
And excitement is tied with danger.
I just want to take you to see the places where I used to live and reminisce for a bit.
The way there is a bit long. Are you up for it?
I knew you would say that. Let us go.
Firenze moved ahead with an easy, springy stride.
Seeing that contented look on her face, it felt like I'd done exactly what I set out to do.
And our day together was still far from over...

strings.text: It's time to let the delights of butter and sugar sweep away all bad moods!There's a war to be fought, with coupons and discounts. The reward? Iris's sanity!
A piece of golden brown toast, fluffy and soft.
A sunny side up egg, crispy around the edges, a few slices of savory ham, lots of smoked bacon and sausages.
Paired with cookies and a cup of hot black tea.==W== Ah … my dream breakfast—simple, but plentiful.
How could you be eating in bed!?
A wail shatters this beautiful moment, pulling me out of my pleasant dream.
Come on, don't be such a stickler for rules... If you only eat at the table, you'll miss out on a lot of fun.
As long as I tidy it up, where's the harm?
See? I shook out the sheets nice and clean. Not a single breadcrumb left.
Food crumbs will get stuck in all kinds of little gaps, then go bad and start to smell...
Over time, more crumbs lead to more bugs...
While we're sleeping, the bugs will crawl into bed and start nibbling on our toes...
Before you know it, the Lucky Oasis will be taken over and driven off by bugs—==W==ugh!
And with nothing left, we'd be out on the streets—ragged, starving, with nowhere to go...
It's okay. Worst case, we can just eat the bugs.
I don't want to end up having to survive on bugs,==W== no way. Never!
Uh-oh. Once Iris starts spiraling, it's really hard to pull her back.
Leave it to me! I've got a secret move just for moments like this.
Iris! <size=45>Wake up—</size>==W==<size=50>There's a flash sale going on today!</size>
Hehe. What did I tell you? Worked, didn't it?
The commission, we're going to be late.
I'll be ready in no time!
Let me double-check the details of this commission for you... Ah, Noya, your shirt collar's not buttoned properly.
While adjusting Noya's collar, Iris reaches over and picks up her thick notebook.
What's going on, Iris? What's real?
There really IS a flash sale going on today!
Maybe all those late nights are starting to affect my memory... No point in saying that now.
It's all over! Missing a flash sale is like missing out on... Everything!
I can give you a ride in Loxy.
Today's commission is really important, you can't be late. Plus, we're not even on the way, so we can't waste Grace on something like this...
If we go now, we can make it in time.
Noya and Amber, you stick to today's plan. I'll go with Iris to the flash sale.
Wow... Never seen Iris that fast before.
The pressure is making her show her true skills.
No! We can't go any slower!
Even with the best route calculated and going at full speed, we can barely make it...
If we don't speed up, we're gonna miss the store opening!
The event lasts all day, right? Getting there a little late shouldn't be a big deal...?
A minute late, and there'll be a hundred more people ahead of us. If we don't rush in the moment the doors open, we'll be stuck outside with an endless crowd!
All we can do then is watch as the best deals get scooped up. All that money we could've saved will slip through our fingers.
If we can't save money, we'll have less of it. And with less money, we'll have to climb the Monolith while hungry, and in tattered gear...

If we can't afford food, we won't have the energy for commissions. Without proper gear, we won't be able to reach the top floor to find the wishing box. If we can't make money, we can't eat, and if we can't eat, we can't make money...
In the end, we'd have to sell Loxy to pay debts, then we'd all be homeless and sleeping under a bridge!
How is she crying and somehow running even faster at the same time?
Huff … wheeze... I'm about to … pass out...
We made it... Thank goodness, we made it...!
Yay...==W== So, can you let go of me now...?
Being dragged along the whole way... My arm feels like it's going to pop off.
Ah … s-sorry! I was so focused on running, I just acted on instinct...
There are so many people... Are they all waiting for the store to open?
Probably. This kind of mega sale only happens a few times a year, if that.
Look at the sale ad over there.
"Flash sale: Get 70% Off Via Price Slash Events! Get Your Free Products Today!"
Up to 100% off... No wonder Iris is so pumped.
The doors are about to open ... ==PLAYER_NAME==, get ready!
When the door opens, we rush in! You get the shopping cart, I get the goods!
Buy whatever we need, whatever is cheap!
And whatever is on discount, the higher the better!
Take as much as we can! Save as much as possible!
When we check out, I'll slash the price down as much as I can!
The doors are opening! The doors are opening!
Grab a cart and head to the food section, then the household goods section.==W== Finally, we'll do a quick check to make sure we didn't miss anything...
With Iris charging ahead like a general and the crowd behind me surging like a flood, ==RT==I'm stuck in the middle feeling like a nervous rookie soldier on their first day of battle.

strings.text: It's time to let the delights of butter and sugar sweep away all bad moods!In a war, time means everything. Grab first, think later, and fill that cart up!
New rice from Eaze Village, limited-time sale, three for the price of two! Into the cart!
Smoked bacon, 500 off 3,000? Into the cart!
Half-price Tawny Nightingale bread... ==W==That's basically free. Into the cart!
I think Noya said something about getting instant noodles... Let's just grab this one that's 30% off.
It's really pricey to begin with and it's smaller than the other brands. Even with 30% off, it's really not worth it.
Let's get these close to expiration date ones instead. We eat a lot of these; I'm sure we'll finish them before they go bad.
Picking the best-value discounted item from the shelf with precision, then calmly laying out her reasons for buying it...
Most importantly, all these are split-second decisions.
When you shop, Iris, you're scary good...
I honed these skills through countless flash sales and shopping battles.
Back when the Guild was first starting out, it was tough to make enough Dorra.==RT==To keep our supplies stocked, we had to chase discounts all over the place.
In the beginning, we often couldn't get what we wanted,==RT==or ended up buying a bunch of things that weren't worth it.
But it's like doing the same practice test way too many times—you eventually figure out the patterns.
Now I've got a pretty good grasp of the rules for surviving flash sales.
Iris leads me through the aisles like a pro. Before I know it, our cart is stacked sky-high.
Noya and Amber love this flavor, and we're still within budget.==W== Into the cart.
Energy bars... You always have much to ponder. This would be a quick energy booster for you.
And you said the bars tasted good last time... Into the cart.
I follow her gaze upward … butter cookies?
It's not a worthy buy. Best leave it.
But isn't this a big sale today?
It's fine to grab a box.
No, we should not waste money on things we don't need. Even during a sale.
Come on, we've still got a lot to grab. Gotta snag everything before the place gets picked clean!
Squeezing my way here sure took longer than I thought...
Alright, we've got enough food stocked up; all the essential supplies and meds are covered, too.
Thanks.==W== With these, we won't have to resupply for the next two months.
I also picked up some motor oil for Noya...
And that hammock Amber's been wanting.
Let's check out and put our trophies in the bag.
It sure is rare to see Iris smile like this.
She must be thrilled with how much we saved.
Did we buy too much? What if we go over budget?
I took on a freelance gig not too long ago, helping some schools test their new exam questions. Ended up saving quite a bit of extra money.
Might as well stock up while the discounts are good. Preparation is key!
No wonder Iris went through over a hundred sets of questions recently.
We thought she was just stressed out and needed to do exam papers to cope...
Plus, remember the ad we saw outside the store earlier?
"Flash sale: Get 70% Off Via Price Slash Events! Get Your Free Products Today!"
Today's flash sale consists of two rounds of discounts. The first discount is already listed on the price tags.
The second discount stacks on top of the first. After checkout, if you complete the store's "Price Slash" task, you can get the item for just 30% of the price paid, and they'll refund the difference!
Hmmm... So, what's this price slash about?
Simply put, we have three hours to tell people about this flash sale event and bring them back here to register.
We get to slash the price once for each person we bring, all the way down to 70% off.
Or if we're lucky, we might even get the instant full price slash.
Look over there. Spin the discount wheel==W== and slash the price down... Literally...
I look in the direction she points, and see a burly guy swinging a knife down hard at a spinning wheel.
The full price slash is extremely rare, so I'm not really counting on that,==W== 70% off is already enough to save plenty!
This rule leaves a lot of space for interpretation, for instance, how many people do we need for the discount, and what happens when time runs out?
Better keep these questions in mind and see what happens.
As we inch our way to the checkout counter, we witness a heated argument at a nearby registration counter.
I had been waiting in queue since early this morning, and I brought forty people to the Sale in three hours' time. Why can't I get my 70% discount?
But you only managed to cut the price down by 0.01% in each spin. You spun those numbers yourself, and they simply don't add up to 70%, ma'am.
On top of the registration counter sits a large lucky draw wheel. The wheel is divided into several sections, each marked with a number.
So, the discount of each slash is determined by the spin.
I assure you that we have several customers who have enjoyed the benefits, and the luckiest one even got their purchases for free. But it seems you are not favored by lady luck.
Seems like Iris noticed it, too.
Let's go talk to the manager first.
Hello, how can I assist you?
I have a question about the price slash event. We believe there are some flaws in the rules.
How can that be? Our event rules are fully transparent and publicly available. We guarantee everything is fair and square.
I know not all customers will get their discounts, but that's just luck and there's nothing we can do about it.
Well...==W== I just did some calculation. The median of the odds ratio is only 0.2% for each spin.
That means, we need to recruit around 350 people within three hours to secure a 70% off.
Sure, someone might get a 70% discount after just five or six spins,==W== but that’s one lucky customer out of hundreds—if not a thousand—each day.
According to your rules, customers only get the price slash discount when they hit 70%. So if they fail, all previous attempts are essentially wasted.
In other words, the vast majority of customers won't get the second discount.
I believe these true odds should be made clear to all customers in advance.
Miss, our event rules are clearly stated, and participation is entirely voluntary.
As for disclosing the odds... That's against our policy, and we find it unnecessary.
Tell you what. As an apology, we'll comp everything you bought today.
Yes. I'll issue a letter for you. You just have to present it at the checkout counter.
However, we kindly ask that you two leave quietly. If other customers find out about the special discount we offer you, they might be unhappy.
Running a business isn't easy these days, and we hope that you can understand.
This is a bribe, hush money.

strings.text: It's time to let the delights of butter and sugar sweep away all bad moods!
Let's put the extra stuff back.
Let's keep the chips and instant noodles.
Even if we buy too much of these, if everyone wants some, we can still finish them in no time.
But for rice and noodles. If we can't finish them in time, they'll go bad. Let's put some back.
Same for these. We don't need that many.
I feel the same way you do, Iris.
So don't worry, just follow your heart.
I can't accept those conditions just for a free handout.
Let's just go through regular checkout and forget about the whole comp thing.
Iris and I go through the items in the cart, keeping only the essentials.
I'll go check out now. As for you, Iris, just do what you feel is right.
Yeah. I've thought about it, and...
Even though the participation is entirely voluntary, I don't think anyone here realizes how difficult it is to get 70% off.
I'm not trying to interfere or stop them.
Making sure both sides are equally informed is essential in a fair trade.
… So, I'm going to tell everyone the truth.
Iris hunches down and squeezes her way to the registration counter.
Everyone, attention, please listen to me...
Oh well, guess I'll have to resort to...
The "70% off discount" is a scam! Don't fall for it!
The crowd immediately quiets down. Many gazes fall upon Iris.
Sorry, had to say that to get your attention... Everyone needs to know the true odds of actually getting the discount.
The discount wheel has a median of 0.2%. That means, within three hours, you'd need to bring in 350 people if you want to get the discount.
Factor in the time spent on looking for people and talking to them. It is safe to say, getting this 70% off is a lot more difficult than you would expect.
That makes sense. Three hours seems like a lot of time, but there's no way you can get 350 people.
I know some of you have many friends and it's just a piece of cake for you to complete the challenge. And some of you may have insanely good luck, so you hit the highest discount every single spin.
Stop! What's wrong with you? I'll sue you for defamation!
But for ordinary people, like you and me, this game isn't for us.
We want to know the truth behind the price slash discount!
The customers gather to form a human barrier to protect Iris.
Iris, hop in. We gotta go!
With the help of other customers, we finally slip past the security and leave the mall in one piece.
Huh? Did that blanket lump just move...
Are you okay? You seem a bit down, and you barely touched your dinner.
I'm just feeling tired from shopping and want to go to bed early.
Do you always sleep with your notebook in your hand?
I was going to sleep early, but...
Although I don't regret today's decision, I can't help but wonder...
Did I really make the best choice?
If I had done more research beforehand and made a more thorough plan, would I have been able to spot the issues with that fake sale and go to another store that actually had real discounts...?
The more I think about it, the harder it is to sleep. I end up book keeping.
I have calculated our spending today, ==W==checked how much money we had left,==W== and reviewed our future expenditure plan...
Iris opens the ledger and goes through her detailed plan for the next six months.
You did really well today, Iris. Not only did you buy the supplies we needed, you also exposed that store's scam.
So instead of going over what went wrong, what you need right now is rewarding yourself a little.
I took out the one item I bought earlier while checking out alone—the only one that wasn't on sale.
These are … butter cookies...==W== But why?
Because you looked like you really wanted them.
I thought you'd be sad if you couldn't eat these cookies in the end.
And I just checked the accounts. Today's shopping budget was more than enough to buy a few boxes of cookies on top of the other stuff.
You are always holding back because you think cookies aren't essential and you shouldn't indulge yourself.
You're always taking care of us and buying us what we want, but you've been neglecting your own feelings.
Since you've gone through all that trouble...
How long has it been since I last had one?
==W==I nagged at No<r=Seina></r>ya ==W==for eating in bed this morning,==W== and now I'm doing the same...==W====W== Boss,==W== please help me keep this a secret!
==W==I nagged at No<r=Seina></r>ya ==W==for eating in bed this morning,==W== and now I'm doing the same...==W== Boss,==W== please help me keep this a secret!
I must look weird now, ==W==don't I?==W== Not only did you catch me secretly book keeping under my blanket,==W== I'm now eating cookies in bed...
Sigh...==W== There's so much going on in my head now ...==W== even the cookies ==W==that I rarely get to enjoy taste bland...
Did I overstep with the cookie?
Actually,==W== when you gave me the cookies ...==W== I was so happy...
But,==W== the thought that only I got the cookies==W== makes me feel that ==W====W==I don't deserve to be this happy...==W==
You deserve to be treated well
But,==W== hearing it from you...==W== It makes me feel less anxious.==W==
Honestly,==W== I think...==W== I’m starting to rely on you more and more.
If I can't have cookies again in the future,==W== I-I'll be very upset.
I see many cookies in your future.
You, me, Noya, Amber. If we all work hard together, I'm sure...
All the frustration and bad moods will, like the cookie crumbs...

strings.text: Noya is done fixing Loxy and invites you to go for a spin.
Clear skies and a gentle breeze.==W== With no commission lined up this weekend, the warm sunlight lulls you into a pleasant drowsiness.
It's quiet all around,==W== except for the occasional clinking sounds coming from Loxy.
Noya,==W== you've been tinkering with Loxy since early morning. Is there a problem?
Nah, nothing serious.==W== Just swapping out her shock absorbers.
The temporary one was pretty worn out. She hasn't been running as smooth lately, and the rides have been a bit bumpy.
When it comes to Loxy and anything driving-related, Noya always thinks of everything.
Boss, I'm gonna head out with Amber in a bit. Please keep an eye on Noya and Loxy.
There's just one thing that you gotta watch out for.
If Noya offers to take you for a spin in Loxy...==W== Best to just say no if you value your life.
Yeah. Even though she promised me she'd never drive recklessly again...==W== Well, better safe than sorry.
Iris sounded serious,==W== and she didn't seem at ease until I gave her a nod. Only then did she relax a little and say goodbye.
What exactly happened==W== to make Iris treat Noya's driving like a disaster waiting to happen?
Ugh,==W== the more I ponder it, the more curious I get...
Uh...==W== It doesn't look all that different from before...
Because it's the suspension parts I swapped out.==W== You can only feel the difference once you're actually riding her.
How about it, ==PLAYER_NAME==? Would you … like a spin in Loxy?
Would you...==W== Like a spin...==W== In Loxy? My dear Boss~~
Swayed by Noya's enthusiasm, I brush off Iris's warning.
Even in the back seat, make sure you buckle up and hang on tight!
If you don't want to fly out of your seat.
… Wait, why is Loxy making that noise?
What do you mean? That's just the engine starting up.
No, I mean, it's way too loud!
Because...==W== I want you to see Loxy at her full speed~
Nononono, we're gonna crash!==W== We won't make that turn! We're totally gonna go off the cliff!
Hold on tight.==W== This is where we can go even faster!
At this speed... If we hit an oncoming car, we'd be totally done for!!!
Nah, we're good! I take Loxy out here all the time.==W== The road’s usually empty around now, and I know it like the back of my hand.
That combined with my flawless driving skills... Hehe!
Look at this cup of water!
I've been meaning to ask—why is there a cup of water next to the driver's seat?
It's from a movie I watched.
After years of practice, the hero could take sharp turns at high speed without spilling a drop.==W== Only then did his dad finally approve him as a true tofu delivery driver.
So I started doing the same thing. Every time I take Loxy out for a test run, I always place a cup of water next to me. It's a little reminder for me to drive safely.
Noya, so this is what you think is ...==W== <size=50>"driving safely?"</size>
"Best to just say no if you value your life."
So that's what they mean when they say==W== "curiosity kills the cat."
I should have listened to you, ==W==Iris...
Boss! Here comes the famous five consecutive hairpins up ahead.==W== Time to show you what Loxy and I can really do!
… Now, after the five hairpin turns, there's a spot ahead...==W== It has great views...
Haha,==W== what do you think?==W== Am I a great driver or what...
What happened? Why aren't you talking?
Huh?! ==W==You didn't pass out like Iris did that day, did you?
Come on, snap out of it, ==PLAYER_NAME==?
