Noya, so this is what you think is ...==W== <size=50>"driving safely?"</size>
"Best to just say no if you value your life."
So that's what they mean when they say==W== "curiosity kills the cat."
I should have listened to you, ==W==Iris...
Boss! Here comes the famous five consecutive hairpins up ahead.==W== Time to show you what Loxy and I can really do!
… Now, after the five hairpin turns, there's a spot ahead...==W== It has great views...
Haha,==W== what do you think?==W== Am I a great driver or what...
What happened? Why aren't you talking?
Huh?! ==W==You didn't pass out like Iris did that day, did you?
Come on, snap out of it, ==PLAYER_NAME==?

strings.text: Noya's driving style has you worried. Sure enough, an accident occurs, just not in the way you expected.
You're finally awake. I was so worried...
I guess you weren't used to Loxy's top speed and passed out...
So I slowed down to our normal speed...
Oh right, before I passed out, didn't you mention a spot with a great view?
There's no "destination" if you're out for a spin.==W== It's all about just going wherever the road takes you. Every view along the road is beautiful.
Especially like this, when I'm with you.==W== Even this road I've driven a thousand times feels … different.
Oh right! And there's that unfamiliar sound.
It's not Loxy's engine, and it's not the birds chirping along the road either.
Thump thump...==W== It's coming from my heart, like it's about to leap right out of my chest...
Noya stops talking,==W== and the sounds around us seem to gradually fade into the background.
I look out the window, where the green fields stretch on, merging with the azure sky.
Yeah, the view is beautiful here.
It feels good taking a drive with you.
Hehe. In that case, could you...
What happened? That bump from behind...
From behind, a car zooms past, narrowly missing the door I've opened.
My pet turtle can go faster! You call this driving?==W==
Noya, I've got a good look at the driver and the car.
That car has a small dent in the front. It's the one that just hit us.
Never mind that! Are you okay?!
I'll contact the Imperial Guard right away and have them track down that car.
That jerk... Hurting Loxy and putting you in danger like that...
The Imperial Guard won't make it in time. Loxy and I will go after him.
...==W== That's true, it'll take the Guard some time to get here...
If he keeps driving like this, it's dangerous for the other cars on the road, too.
Noya, I'm ready.==W== Full speed ahead, let's catch that car! I trust your driving skills.
Alright!==W== I'll catch him for sure.
That big turn up ahead—we can take a shortcut, but ...==W== we'll have to smash through the trees along the way.
Hang in there, Loxy.==W== After this, I promise to treat you to an upgrade with stronger parts and a premium lubricant service!
Don't worry about me!==W== I'll protect my head! It's fine, really.
==PLAYER_NAME==, please keep an eye on the water cup and remind me to drive safely.
I'm not skilled enough to crash into trees without spilling the water, so...
I'll have to catch up to him without being reckless.
As promised, Noya catches up to the target without spilling any water.
No way?! You caught up with me?!
You think you can get away with hitting Loxy?
Is this the best you can do, turtle boy?==W== Why don't you just pull over and admit defeat?
Hah! Eat my fumes at the next turn!==W==
The roar of the engine fills my ears==W== as the car next to us suddenly speeds up again.
Wow... That sounds like it really hurts...
I'll contact the Imperial Guard, Noya, check if the driver's alright.
Whoa?!==W== He—he crawled out of the car?!
The driver rushes toward us, his face flushed with anger.==W== Seeing this, Noya swiftly steps in front of me.
Hey you, blondie, are you the driver of this junk car?
It's not junk! And that's right, I'm the driver.
This guy... He's not pissed off and looking for a fight, is he?!
Anyway... Better be ready to settle this with force if it comes to that.
Noya, if it comes to a fight, go easy on him.
Gotcha! ==W==Just hide in the car! I don't want you hurt.
All that's left is the soft rustling of the wind.
Until the sound of a heavy object hitting the ground breaks the silence.

strings.text: Noya learns to drive safely, but not without paying the price.
The angry driver in front of us suddenly drops his tough guy act==W== and kneels to the ground with a loud "thud."
Master, ==W==<size=50>Master!!</size>==W== Please, take me as your disciple!!
That drift and stop you just did... That was epic!
I was a fool to think I could race against you.==W== Only a true master like you has that calm,==W== effortless vibe!
Ahaha... Drift and stop, you say? Is it really that hard?
Of course!! Very few people can pull it off. Master, how did you manage it??
I just treat Loxy like a partner in sync with me.==W== That way, she becomes like an extension of my body and those moves just come naturally.
Treating the car like it's an extension of your body...
Is this what it means to be a true master? That's incredible...
Please! Take me in as your disciple!!
Don't get ahead of yourself.==W== You purposely crashed into our RV. That was really dangerous.==W== You have to own up to that.
Of course! Of course! I nearly crashed into Master's companion!==W== I'm sorry!!
Anyway, from now on, no matter what, you can't drive recklessly.
Soon after, the Imperial Guard arrived at the scene.==W== They towed away the damaged car.==W== Amidst the shouts of "Master!," they also took the car owner away.
Didn't realize it's already this late.
Before we go back, there's another place I wanna go.
With these,==W== and the parts in my toolbox,==W== I'll have Loxy fixed up in no time!
During the chase, I thought you might take a risk, just like with the Spellbound Golem situation in Emor,==W== and crash through the trees... That was your plan, right?
Yeah.==W== But this time it was different.
Sure, ==W==I could have forced it to stop... ==W==But I didn't want to risk you getting injured.==W==
Forget about me for a second... Aren't you afraid of getting hurt, No<r=Seina></r>ya?
I've got Hyper Heal in my pocket! ==W==If it's just a scratch, ==W==one good night's sleep and I'm good as new. ♪
But an injury is still an injury.
So … what if I get injured?
Well ...==W== that'd be harder to deal with, ==W==if I'm honest.
It might sound weird, ==W==but the first time I saw you in the desert, ==W==I felt this buzz like something clicked.
==W==I don't know why, but… I just thought, ==W=="This person is going to be really important to me."
If you ever got hurt because of me...==W== Ahhh, I don't think I'd be able to forgive myself.
If you ever got hurt because of me...==W== Ahhh, I don't think I'd be able to forgive myself.==W==
And I feel the same way.
Seeing you injured makes me sad and worried, too.
Okay. So that's how you feel. Thanks. ♪
Ehehe. ==W==I can't believe I got you to admit that. ==W==Guess I'll try not to worry you so much from now on.
Ehehe. ==W==I can't believe I got you to admit that. ==W==Guess I'll try not to worry you so much from now on.==W==
It's a promise, then. No take backs!
Well, ==W==I don't like to make promises I can't keep.
But don't worry! ==W==From now on, I'll take better care of myself ==W==so I can protect you when it really counts!
By the way...==W== What happened today...==W== Let it stay our little secret, please?
You're scared that Iris will nag you, aren't you?
If she finds out,==W== I won't be allowed to sit behind Loxy's steering wheel for the next two months!
Eh? Why did you agree so easily?!
Because you've already promised me you'll take good care of yourself from now on, right?
But you know, one thing the Imperial Guard knight said was really on point.==W== Always drive at a safe speed, regardless of skill.
So I specifically asked them for this.
"First rule of safe driving: the driver must have safety awareness, knowledge of traffic laws, and be physically and mentally fit..."
This tape's pretty good, isn't it?
Next time we go for a spin and you start thinking "full speed ahead," I'll play this for you.
I'm sure it'll make you rethink that idea. Hehe.
Waah! I-I get it now!==W== Please make it stop!
And so, ==W==under the fading sunset,==W== Loxy cruises smoothly down the road we came from.

strings.text: Shimiao asks you to investigate a case. …Wait, why does this sound dangerous?
This is such a happening place.
Cangwu, a Loong city known all across Nova for its delicious cuisine.
I stand on a busy street, looking at the rows of storefronts and just taking in the laid-back, lively vibe all around me.
All the energy and delicious smells in the air put me in a great mood without me even noticing.
Maybe today's commission will go well, too~
An uncomfortable dampness suddenly sets in. Vapor clings onto me, turning into a stream of water that envelopes the thief and I.
Gotcha! Robbery is a serious crime!
Eh? Boss?! Sorry! I didn't mean to get you, too!
As the water recedes, the dizzying world around me slowly returns to normal.
A thunderous applause drags me back to reality. I turn to look and see the thief trapped inside a sphere that's like a watery prison.
Bravo! That's some nice Aqua Xuan art!
Oh look, it's Shimiao's Miaovelous Water! She's a Xuan Shi from the Baize Bureau, don't you know?
No, no, I'm not a Xuan Shi. I just work for the Bureau.
After handing the captured thief over to the Loong Guards who have finally arrived on the scene, a blushing Shimiao starts explaining to the crowd.
Only those who are skilled in Xuan art, adept at warding off evil, and have passed the proper certification exam can be called a Xuan Shi.
You're being way too modest! If you take that exam, you'd definitely pass with flying colors~
Hey, don't give her ideas! If she really goes to do the whole Xuan Shi thing, we'll lose the most reliable person in the community.
Yeah, and last time, she went around checking fire safety for every store on the block.==B== Shimiao, it's because of you that we don't have to worry about fires all the time!
Thank you for all your kind words, everyone. But I'm here for something else today—
During the Xuan Shi Tournament, several members of the Yunji Studio team from the Chixia group started feeling unwell.
The main symptoms were vomiting and diarrhea ... The Bureau suspect it might be a food safety issue.
And given the tournament ...==B== We can't rule out deliberate poisoning, either.
So you want me to help you with the investigation...
Yes, Boss, can you partner up with me so I can pick your brain—
It may be called an "investigation," but all we really have to do is sample what they ate yesterday and check for any problems. So should be a easy job...
Shimiao asked me to partner up just to get a bigger sample size, since everyone's body reacts differently. Pretty thorough of her.
Even if there really is a shady place ... As long as we spot it before eating anything, it should be fine!
Excuse me, has anyone seen Yunji Studio's Xuan Shi team yesterday? Their leader is a girl with red hair.
Hey, Chou, that sounds like those kids who were making a ruckus right in front of your sugar painting stall?
Oh yeah, now that you mention it...
There was a red-haired girlie who insisted on doing the painting herself.
Said she wanted to show everyone what a soaring dragon looks like.
She walked off holding a sugar painting that looked more like a loach than a dragon.
Did they look sick at all at the time?
Nothing unusual. Oh, by the way—
The redhead girlie tried to get everybody to say she'd drawn a dragon.
Wow, sweet. This sugar painting is actually pretty tasty~
Yeah, you ate the leftover sugar paintings from yesterday. This place is fine.
The vendor said one of the Xuan Shi in the group was clamoring to buy cooking ingredients for a late-night snack.
Let's go ask around at the market ...==B== But with so many stalls, it might be a bit tricky.
Um ... When I caught the thief, my spell accidentally hit you, too.
I've felt bad about it ever since ... I'm really sorry.==B== Please consider this my apology and accept it...
I take the bubble tea from her outstretched hand.
This is the most popular drink in Cangwu right now. Will you try it, Boss?
Better not. Don't want people seeing me snacking on the job.
Her colleagues say that even when she's supposed to be on break, Shimiao always stays in work mode.
She's the most diligent one out of the entire Bureau.
Um, excuse me, but can I ask you something?
Why did Shimiao pick me as her partner? This seems like it ought to be handled in-house by the Bureau...
Hehe, well ... To tell you the truth, we'd all love to partner up with Shimiao, but...
We always end up slowing her down. Sometimes she even has to look after us while working.
After all, Shimiao's always on top of everything! W-we just don't want to be a burden to her...
Yeah. After all, she's the Bureau's model employee.
Sometimes we wonder ... If maybe, for her, that's become a burden, too.
But it's not as if she would tell us. Sigh...
Hmm, Shimiao's way too hard on herself. I wish she could let herself relax a little...

strings.text: Just as the truth of the case comes to light… a new request suddenly appears?! The first step to cracking the case: retrace Xuan Shi's movements!
There's a crowd gathered at the market entrance, watching some kind of argument.
He was yelling about a special deal—980 Dorra a pound.
The stuff looked good, so I grabbed a few. Can you believe he's asking me for 9,000 Dorra?!
What you've got here comes to nine and a half pounds—I even rounded it down for you.
No way there's nine and half pounds here.
Please calm down, both of you.
Ma'am, you believe the weight he gave you is wrong?
Very well. There's no point arguing any further. Let me settle this.
She twists the hilt of her sword like a lid, splitting the blade cleanly in two.
Amazingly, after Shimiao gives the blade a shake, a slender, old-fashioned ... scale?—slides right out from its hollow interior.
There it is!!! Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword! Capable of summoning anything and everything!
Wowow ... Is that the legendary "Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword" that can summon anything...!?==B== I can't believe I'm seeing it in person...!
Please ... Please don't call it that...! It's so embarrassing!==B== This is my Sword-Shaped Multifunction Storage Box!
Okay, but it's Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword.
Anything you say, owner of Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword.
So Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword is actually a storage box. I learn something new everyday.
Anyway! I'll use this scale to get to the bottom of this!
My weight stone is four jin, the Baize Bureau standard. Feel free to check.
If the seller's scale is accurate, we should get the same weight when we measure it now.
M-maybe ... There is something wrong with my scale ... Sorry, ma'am, I'll do it over!
Sigh. I figured as much. Mister, you can't conduct your business like this.
According to Baize Bureau regulations, this counts as shortchanging customers, which is a form of fraud.
If you claim your scale is accurate, the weight stone should stop on the correct mark after weighing.
Y-yeah, I get it ... I'll pay up, right now ... I won't do it again.
Somehow I get the feeling you might do it again. By the way, did a group of Xuan Shi come by here yesterday?
Yeah, yeah, they bought a huge pile. Didn't care about the price at all, either, real easy marks—==W==uh, I didn't say that.
You'd better come clean about what you did yesterday too! And I want to buy the same meat they got—and don't try to cheat me!
Meat, seasonings, apples ... More than twenty bags' worth? What late-night snack did they have in mind?

Iss like==W== I'm always da one takin' care of people…==W== But get praised like dis…==W== I'm truly,==W== incredibly happy~
Maybe it's sheer exhaustion, or maybe it's just spice from the hot pot hits like a few too many drinks ... But Shimiao falls fast asleep right on the table.
She wakes up only twenty minutes later.
Oh no ... I totally lost my composure in front of you, Boss, ugh...
It's fine. I'm just glad I got to see this secret side of you, Shimiao.
Don't worry, it's not some big secret.
She's always so tense in public. Letting her true self slipping out is just the kind of break she needs.
Besides, it's not a bad secret at all ...==B== It just makes you more approachable.
Approachable ... Since it's you who said it, I'll buy it.
You sound even cuter after eating spicy food. If it's alright with you...
I'd like to see more of this side of you.
R-really...?==B== There's nothing special about seeing me like this, though...
You're hardworking, earnest ... A little awkward, but really kind. And getting to know this adorable side of you is such a treat.
I think maybe your colleagues notice how tightly wound you are, too.==B== So why not relax a little at work and let more of your real self show?
I always thought my coworkers and everyone else treated me so well because they saw me as a "perfect" employee...
But knowing there's someone—like you, Boss—who feels this way about me ... Even if it's just one person ... that actually feels pretty nice—
Sorry for intruding, but here's your second serving of "Heaven-and-Hell Ultimate Spicy Hot Pot!"
What!!! Why's there another one of these?! Are you sure you got the right table...?
I am sure. The Xuan Shi group yesterday thought one hot pot wasn't enough, so they ordered another one plus a whole bunch of extra dishes.

Staring at the mountain of food in front of us, both Shimiao and I fall silent. Still, we can't let any of it go to waste. So after eating as much as we possibly can, we pack up what's left to take home.
Phew ... After checking everywhere yesterday, we found that all the food from each shop was fine, no hygiene issues at all.
But ... Whew ...==B== After eating that hot pot, I think I know what happened.
Of the sheer volume of food. All of them ate at least double portions.
Then they went home and cooked up some late-night snack with all those groceries. Just how much did they end up eating in one night?
So much food, and so spicy—no wonder they got sick ... We barely ate any compared to them, and we're still feeling it the next day...
And with that, the commission wrapped up perfectly. But also...
Boss, I have a long-term commission I'd like you to take on for me.
Yeah? No need to beat around the bush, hit me.
Could you ... help me train how to handle spicy food?
I know you said that I'm kind of cute when I eat spicy food ... But I can't just get "drunk" on it every time. I really want to get better at handling it...!
I get what you mean, Boss, when you say that I don't have to push myself too hard...
But even so, as the "model employee," I still want to do my best.==B== Besides, you said it yourself, I sound pretty cute after eating spicy food.
I see. If this is your way of relaxing, I'm happy to join you.==B== But are you sure I'm the person for it? My spice tolerance is...
Yeah. In fact ... You're the only one I'd want to do this with, because, Boss—
—You also look really cute with your cheeks all red after eating spicy food!

strings.text: Ready to unlock your true power? Chaton is inviting you to a new commission.
Do I get this, or not...
Easy for you to say, Amber.==W== We're in Emor...==W== Meaning prices are insane!
Supplies matter, but we can't blow our budget. We need to be smart about this...
But we'll need it eventually. Might as well stock up while we're here.
Noya's right. Money comes and goes.
While everyone's getting prepared, I'll hit the Trekker Association for a commission. You handle the shopping, Iris!
Is there anything suited for me...==W== Huh?

No, no, no!==W== That's all wrong. How do I put this...==W== I want a commission that elicits emotions! Something that plunges the soul into pitch-black night, like offering a golden sacrifice on the shores of endless agony!==W== You feel me?!
Um...==W== Could you maybe put that in simpler terms?
How do you not get that?!==W== Look, give me a commission that pays a fortune. The harder, the better!
That unique flair...==W== Yep, it's Chaton. The White Cat Troupe's been working in Emor lately too.==W== She never runs out of steam.
Alright, focus. I need to find my own commission!
Oh...==W== Hey, Chaton. What a coincidence...
Crap, she spotted me...==W== Now she's going to—
Even oceans apart, the Tyrant and I, Chaton of the dark power, are inexplicably drawn together!==W== This is destiny!
Meeting again in the City of a Thousand Monoliths is absolute proof of our shared, dark fa<r=karma></r>te!
The time is now!==W== Walk with me on this blood-soaked path to awaken the Tyrant!==W== Let us throw open the gates to the dark power that devours gods!
Which means we'll work commissions together to unlock the Tyrant's true power!
Her heart's in the right place, but she's stubborn.
Chaton, I've told you before. I'm not your Tyrant,==W== and I have no hidden power.
Who knows? The amnesia may have made you forget! That's why I—==W==the great Chaton—will awaken the Tyrant's slumbering dark power!==W== Nyahahaha!
Ugh...==W== Blame the amnesia, and I've got no comeback.
Miss Chaton! Found the perfect commission! High risk, massive payout—it's everything you wanted!
Awesome!==W== Tyrant and I will take it!
Wait, don't volunteer me!==W== On a job this hard, I'll only drag you down...
Relax!==W== With me here, you won't hold anyone back!
Sigh... You're impossible.==W== What's the job, anyway?
Don't rush me, I'm reading it now!
This is going to end badly...
Hey!==W== Where's my coffee?! It's been ten minutes!
What the hell?! You spilled it everywhere! Can you even afford to replace this carpet?!
I am so sorry! We'll clean this up and brew a fresh cup immediately!
Chaton, clean up the mess. I'll handle the coffee.
You two. This dress has to go out. The addresses are on this list.
You've gotta be kidding! We have to deliver this entire wardrobe?!
Yes, every last piece.==W== I hired you for grunt work.==W== Got a problem with that?
No, no problem.==W== Quick question though: is there a priority sequence for these?
Sharp, aren't you?==W== Hold on, I'll tag them.
This isn't what I signed up for at all!
Shouldn't a high-difficulty, high-reward job mean we're out slaying dangerous monsters?!
Assisting a top fashion designer in Gold District definitely counts as high-difficulty and high-reward...
B-But still!==W== The mighty Tyrant and the great Chaton, reduced to running errands? This is way beneath us!
You're the one who took the job, remember?
I mean...==W== Yeah, you've got a point...
If you didn't like the details, you should've checked before signing us up.
But you're the Tyrant!==W== Doesn't it bug you getting bossed around like some lowly minion?
Shouldn't the Tyrant take jobs that show the world ==SEX3== absolute greatness and terror?
That might be the Tyrant in your head, Chaton, but that's not me.
Honestly, I feel like I'm getting the hang of this.
But aren't you mad?==W== Bowing your head and apologizing even though you've done nothing wrong
Especially since that whole mess this morning was entirely my fault...
What, are you actually owning up to it?
N-not exactly!==W== But for the great Chaton's blunder to tarnish the Tyrant's reputation... That feels a bit...
Looks like she's actually feeling pretty guilty.
Then let me ask you something. In your eyes, what does the Tyrant's majesty actually look like?
As the Tyrant, you must wield the dark power to command the world's chaos, guiding all who bask in your glory into your own paradise!
Transcendent, flawless, and utterly peerless—that's what you have to be!
... In other words,==W== the embodiment of perfection, right?
Then if I do everything in my power to do this job perfectly, doesn't that match your vision of the Tyrant as well?
Our job was to assist that designer. Making sure the client can focus on her work without a hitch—that's our responsibility, isn't it?
I have no problem giving my all to make that happen.
But the Tyrant shouldn't have to bow and scrape like that...
Doesn't really concern me, as long as the work gets done.
Ruining a job over petty pride, or swallowing your ego to execute it flawlessly...==W== Which of those sounds more like the true Tyrant to you, Chaton?
The word failure doesn't exist in the Tyrant's dictionary!
Then you know what comes next, right?
But...==W== But! I still can't accept it!==W== Why should you have to apologize for my mistakes?!
You didn't have to do that!==W== You did nothing wrong...
Because we needed to finish the commission perfectly. We took this job as a team, after all.
Alright, let's head back. If we're late again, the client's going to chew us out.
Finally! What took so long to make a simple delivery?!
I'm sorry! We're late because I got us lost!
What do you need next? I swear I'll make up for the lost time!
Glad you're reflecting on it. The fabric is dyed. Go hang it out to dry.
Three,==W== four,==W== five...==W== Look at all those zeros!==W== I can't believe it pays this much!
That gives our budget plenty of breathing room. A hassle, but it paid off.
Here you go, Chaton. Your cut.
No.==W== You keep it all, Tyrant.
Huh? We took this job together.==W== I can't pocket everything...
I was dead weight today. I messed up this morning, and screwed up even more this afternoon...==W== I can't take that money.
Plus, this whole job felt wrong!==W== The Tyrant is supposed to be a fearsome,==W== awe-inspiring entity. Getting bossed around like a servant? That ruins the image!
So the Dorra is yours, but you have to show up tomorrow!==W== I swear I'll find a commission that unleashes the Tyrant's true power—a quest that will shake every soul on earth!
Hey! Don't volunteer me for things...
Oh, one more thing.==W== It doesn't exactly fit my Tyrant vision, but seeing you nail that job...==W== Well...
I thought it was awesome! Later, Tyrant! See you tomorrow!
Sigh...==W== I'd feel a lot better about this if you'd taken your cut.

param: Ready to unlock your true power? Chaton is inviting you to a new commission.
Do I get this, or not...
Easy for you to say, Amber.==W== We're in Emor...==W== Meaning prices are insane!
Supplies matter, but we can't blow our budget. We need to be smart about this...
But we'll need it eventually. Might as well stock up while we're here.
Noya's right. Money comes and goes.
While everyone's getting prepared, I'll hit the Trekker Association for a commission. You handle the shopping, Iris!
Is there anything suited for me...==W== Huh?

No, no, no!==W== That's all wrong. How do I put this...==W== I want a commission that elicits emotions! Something that plunges the soul into pitch-black night, like offering a golden sacrifice on the shores of endless agony!==W== You feel me?!
Um...==W== Could you maybe put that in simpler terms?
How do you not get that?!==W== Look, give me a commission that pays a fortune. The harder, the better!
That unique flair...==W== Yep, it's Chaton. The White Cat Troupe's been working in Emor lately too.==W== She never runs out of steam.
Alright, focus. I need to find my own commission!
Oh...==W== Hey, Chaton. What a coincidence...
Crap, she spotted me...==W== Now she's going to—
Even oceans apart, the Tyrant and I, Chaton of the dark power, are inexplicably drawn together!==W== This is destiny!
Meeting again in the City of a Thousand Monoliths is absolute proof of our shared, dark fa<r=karma></r>te!
The time is now!==W== Walk with me on this blood-soaked path to awaken the Tyrant!==W== Let us throw open the gates to the dark power that devours gods!
Which means we'll work commissions together to unlock the Tyrant's true power!
Her heart's in the right place, but she's stubborn.
Chaton, I've told you before. I'm not your Tyrant,==W== and I have no hidden power.
Who knows? The amnesia may have made you forget! That's why I—==W==the great Chaton—will awaken the Tyrant's slumbering dark power!==W== Nyahahaha!
Ugh...==W== Blame the amnesia, and I've got no comeback.
Miss Chaton! Found the perfect commission! High risk, massive payout—it's everything you wanted!
Awesome!==W== Tyrant and I will take it!
Wait, don't volunteer me!==W== On a job this hard, I'll only drag you down...
Relax!==W== With me here, you won't hold anyone back!
Sigh... You're impossible.==W== What's the job, anyway?
Don't rush me, I'm reading it now!
This is going to end badly...
Hey!==W== Where's my coffee?! It's been ten minutes!
What the hell?! You spilled it everywhere! Can you even afford to replace this carpet?!
I am so sorry! We'll clean this up and brew a fresh cup immediately!
Chaton, clean up the mess. I'll handle the coffee.
You two. This dress has to go out. The addresses are on this list.
You've gotta be kidding! We have to deliver this entire wardrobe?!
Yes, every last piece.==W== I hired you for grunt work.==W== Got a problem with that?
No, no problem.==W== Quick question though: is there a priority sequence for these?
Sharp, aren't you?==W== Hold on, I'll tag them.
This isn't what I signed up for at all!
Shouldn't a high-difficulty, high-reward job mean we're out slaying dangerous monsters?!
Assisting a top fashion designer in Gold District definitely counts as high-difficulty and high-reward...
B-But still!==W== The mighty Tyrant and the great Chaton, reduced to running errands? This is way beneath us!
You're the one who took the job, remember?
I mean...==W== Yeah, you've got a point...
If you didn't like the details, you should've checked before signing us up.
But you're the Tyrant!==W== Doesn't it bug you getting bossed around like some lowly minion?
Shouldn't the Tyrant take jobs that show the world ==SEX3== absolute greatness and terror?
That might be the Tyrant in your head, Chaton, but that's not me.
Honestly, I feel like I'm getting the hang of this.
But aren't you mad?==W== Bowing your head and apologizing even though you've done nothing wrong
Especially since that whole mess this morning was entirely my fault...
What, are you actually owning up to it?
N-not exactly!==W== But for the great Chaton's blunder to tarnish the Tyrant's reputation... That feels a bit...
Looks like she's actually feeling pretty guilty.
Then let me ask you something. In your eyes, what does the Tyrant's majesty actually look like?
As the Tyrant, you must wield the dark power to command the world's chaos, guiding all who bask in your glory into your own paradise!
Transcendent, flawless, and utterly peerless—that's what you have to be!
... In other words,==W== the embodiment of perfection, right?
Then if I do everything in my power to do this job perfectly, doesn't that match your vision of the Tyrant as well?
Our job was to assist that designer. Making sure the client can focus on her work without a hitch—that's our responsibility, isn't it?
I have no problem giving my all to make that happen.
But the Tyrant shouldn't have to bow and scrape like that...
Doesn't really concern me, as long as the work gets done.
Ruining a job over petty pride, or swallowing your ego to execute it flawlessly...==W== Which of those sounds more like the true Tyrant to you, Chaton?
The word failure doesn't exist in the Tyrant's dictionary!
Then you know what comes next, right?
But...==W== But! I still can't accept it!==W== Why should you have to apologize for my mistakes?!
You didn't have to do that!==W== You did nothing wrong...
Because we needed to finish the commission perfectly. We took this job as a team, after all.
Alright, let's head back. If we're late again, the client's going to chew us out.
Finally! What took so long to make a simple delivery?!
I'm sorry! We're late because I got us lost!
What do you need next? I swear I'll make up for the lost time!
Glad you're reflecting on it. The fabric is dyed. Go hang it out to dry.
Three,==W== four,==W== five...==W== Look at all those zeros!==W== I can't believe it pays this much!
That gives our budget plenty of breathing room. A hassle, but it paid off.
Here you go, Chaton. Your cut.
No.==W== You keep it all, Tyrant.
Huh? We took this job together.==W== I can't pocket everything...
I was dead weight today. I messed up this morning, and screwed up even more this afternoon...==W== I can't take that money.
Plus, this whole job felt wrong!==W== The Tyrant is supposed to be a fearsome,==W== awe-inspiring entity. Getting bossed around like a servant? That ruins the image!
So the Dorra is yours, but you have to show up tomorrow!==W== I swear I'll find a commission that unleashes the Tyrant's true power—a quest that will shake every soul on earth!
Hey! Don't volunteer me for things...
Oh, one more thing.==W== It doesn't exactly fit my Tyrant vision, but seeing you nail that job...==W== Well...
I thought it was awesome! Later, Tyrant! See you tomorrow!
Sigh...==W== I'd feel a lot better about this if you'd taken your cut.

strings.text: Building a Tyrant's army means starting them young.
I can't just leave her hanging. Might as well show up...
Is Chaton here already? She was hyping up some soul-shaking job. What on earth is she up to...==W== Huh?
Someone's carrying a literal mountain of paperwork...==W== Is that Chaton?
I'll just pretend I didn't see that...
Ahaha, morning, Chaton...==W== How'd you even spot me behind that giant stack?
Heh...==W== Because Tyrant and the great Chaton are linked by the dark powers! It's destiny!
Here!==W== Just as promised, I've handpicked the commissions most worthy of the Tyrant!
Don't tell me you accepted all of those...
Of course! Today I'll help you reclaim your rightful majesty and unleash your true power, Tyrant!
Rightful majesty, my foot...==W== Let's see what these commissions actually are...
Wait a sec, why are these all about kids?
Exactly! If you want to brainwash—==W==ahem, cultivate your followers—you gotta start 'em young!
Whoa, whoa, whoa, back up.==W== Did you just casually say something incredibly dangerous?
Isn't it obvious?! The Tyrant is a being who can bewitch the masses!
Your words shall be the gospel of their awakening! They will gladly offer their souls to become the foundation of darkness's rule!==W== That is essential for restoring the Tyrant's era!
Which is why we must teach them your greatness from a young age!
Uh...==W== I want absolutely no part of that.
You're only saying that because you lost your memories, right?==W== Anyway, we're gonna be late for our first job. Let's move!
Whoa! Don't yank me so hard, Chaton!
[Commission 1]==RT==Chat with a kid who's been all study and no play.
Sigh...==W== It's great that she loves learning, but I really wish she'd try her hand at other things.==W== She doesn't seem to have many friends, either. It worries me.
Alright...==W== We'll give it a shot.
That said...==W== How do we even start this conversation?
It's almost lunchtime, and the weather's pretty nice today. Wanna grab a bite outside? Change of scenery?
Whatever works. I can just study while I eat.
This is going nowhere! She's way tougher than I thought. What now...?
How dare you reject the Tyrant's goodwill!==W== Such insolence! You must atone with your life!
Eh? What are you talking about?
Heheh. I suppose I can't blame you for failing to grasp the great Chaton's words.==W== After all, you do nothing but bury yourself in your studies, trapping your mind in those puny books!
So... What exactly is your point?
My point is, there's way too much in this world you'll never understand just from a book!
And so...==W== Maiden, the hour of awakening is upon you!==W== Step into this vast world and unleash your true power!
I still don't really get it...==W== But that sounded kinda cool. What do I have to do to be like you?
Heheh.==W== If you wish to take your first step toward awakening, you must engrave the Tyrant's words into your very soul!==W== Do that, and the gates of truth shall swing open!
Alright, Tyrant, you're up!==W== Hit her with some earth-shattering wisdom!
Way to put me on the spot here!
My son must be hitting his rebellious phase. He refuses to greet anyone.==W== Won't listen to his mom either. We don't know what to do with him.
Say no more! Leave this to the Tyrant and the great Chaton—masters of the dark arts!
Huh? The dark tarts? Are you bakers?
Probably best to let it slide...
Because saying hello is a pain! And it's not like I have to, so what's the big deal?
Okay, but why is it a pain?
Zero logic.==W== Where do I even start...
How about this. The great Chaton will teach you a super cool way to say hello. Listen up!
Super cool? You can make saying hello cool?
Chaton, don't tell me you're gonna...
O brethren who thirst for the dark powers!==W== With your unyielding will and shadowed souls, go forth and drown this world in eternal night!
Awakening...==W== So that just means "Good morning"?
Exactly!==W== Wait—are your memories coming back?!
No, I just guessed.==W== But saying all that just to say hi is honestly a bit—
I have no idea what it meant, but those words sound insanely cool!
Say it again!==W== I'm gonna memorize it and use it every day!
Of course! I am the inheritor of the dark power—==W==Sent to this realm to spread the greetings of the shadow world!
Ready? Repeat after me!==W== O brethren who thirst for the dark powers!
O brethren who thirst for the dark powers!
... Is this really a good idea?
Ahaha... Well, I guess it beats him ignoring everyone...
Every==W== last==W== commission==W==—done!==W== Nice work, Tyrant!
... It's nothing.==W== I'm just wondering if this is a good idea.
Dusk fades...==W== The hour of parting is upon us.
Back to our rightful domain, before the shadows fall!
It's only been one day, and the kids are already talking like you...
Yep! Just as planned! Now we've got plenty of recruits for the future Tyrant's army!
Plus, we solved those parents' problems. Win-win, right?
I mean... Yeah, you've got a point...
Still, if we just leave them alone, they'll probably get bored with it eventually.==W== Probably...
Didn't expect you to be so good with kids, Chaton.
Really?==W== I was just copying the one who awakened my dark power!
Wait, someone else talks like you?
What do you mean, "talks like me"?!==W== This is the ancient language of the White Cat Troupe!
Seriously...?==W== The White Cat Troupe has that kind of history?
Plus, I don't actually know how to deal with kids. I just talked to them like we did back in the Troupe.
Put yourself in their shoes when you talk to them...==W== Benito says that all the time.
She can be stubborn, but she really is kind at heart.
Guess that's why the kids opened up to her so easily.
You know, Kasimira only recently acknowledged the true extent of my dark power.
Anyway, enough talk! We gotta move, Tyrant!
Huh? Move where? I thought we were done.
What do you mean? There's still one left!==W== The most important one for unlocking your true power!
Hey!?==W== Wait a sec, Chaton! You never mentioned this!==W== At least tell me where we're going—!

strings.text: Feeling energized and on a roll! It's the perfect time to beat that record!
Oh no, I was too slow—
Incoming?!==W== I've told you, I'm the brains in combat!
That's exactly why you lost and got sealed! You never train!
I told you, I'm not that legendary Tyrant...
Maybe you forgot! They say shock therapy works for amnesia.
Keep fighting, get stronger, and maybe your memories will follow!
I thought we were just visiting the Monolith—==W==not getting hunted by Stellaroids!
If that were enough to restore my memory, I wouldn't be going through all this trouble…
Naturally!==W== My ultimate strike, powered by the Eye of the Meowth God!
No one escapes the Uncompleted Codex Entry MK I!
Point is, I've got you, Tyrant! Train all you want. I'll cover you!==W== Nyahahaha!
Insane setup, but her cover's flawless.
Keep fighting to get stronger...==W== Huh.
She's right. I can't hide behind others forever.==W== Time to step up.
Alright, I'll give it a shot!
Tyrant! Drive it to three o'clock!
No time to aim!==W== Tyrant, run!
I'm toast if it catches me!==W== Wait...==W== Is that...?
Lure it close...==W== Then hard right!
Tyrant, awesome!==W== See, you can do it!
Barely made it. That was close.
Let's keep this momentum and train on! <size=60>♪</size>
That last one was already too much!
That was the last Stellaroid on this floor, right?==W== Clearing out monsters... Simple, brutal. I love commissions like this!
Through the scope, my mind becomes razor-sharp!==W== And there's this dormant power inside me... Stirring, waking up.==W== It's intoxicating...!==W== I knew it, I was born for this kind of work!
You feel it too, right, Tyrant?!
Huh? Already out of breath? You're the Tyrant, you can't be looking this wiped out!
And I wonder whose fault that is...
Whew...==W== I didn't sign up for this much running.
Well, you still managed to take down a few Stellaroids today! Did it jog any of your memories?
I see...==W== Well, can't be helped then.
Alright, break's over! On to the next floor!
So much for letting me off the hook...==W== Here we go again...
You bet! And I can feel it. I'm totally smashing my high score today!
I'm pumped up and I'm in the zone!==W== Plus, I've got the Tyrant right beside me, buffing me with dark power!
What's that got to do with me?
Everything!==W== I can feel the dark energy radiating off you, resonating with my very soul! The great Chaton's power is surging!
The trial begins! Descend!==W== Rhapsody of Worldly Suffering!
And she's off. But what is she even playing?
Looks like she's slapping the door of a washing Artifact...
Hmph...==W== I've played this song a thousand times!
Don't let the slow start fool you. The climax is the real challenge!
Song? Oh—==W==she's pressing buttons to the beat.
Hm hm hm... Catchy beat. Makes me want to tap along.
Oh! Almost there!==W== Here comes the ultimate challenge!
Tyrant! Lend me your dark power!
Very well! You crave the Tyrant's power?==W== Then I, sovereign of darkness, shall lend it to you!
Not sure what did it—the beat or her energy—but I ended up playing along.
But ...==W== hope I didn't mess it up.
Hmph...==W== Looks like that fight woke up a bit of your old self!
As the sole inheritor of the dark power in the White Cat Troupe, I accept your aid!==W== The melody of the final trial! Face my attack!
Whoa! This is the climax?==W== It's so fast I can barely read the screen!
But Chaton's unfazed,==W== nailing every note.
The beat's winding down.==W== Looks like it's almost over.
Amazing! I did it!==W== Did you see that, Tyrant?!==W== Not only did I break my personal high score,==W== but I also Full Combo-ed an entire track on Hell difficulty!
Amaaaaaazing!==W== Tyrant! Did you see that?!==W== Not only did I break my personal high score,==W== but I also Full Combo-ed an entire track on Hell difficulty!
Let me tell you, this track is super tough—==W==the layout is complex and the timing is brutal!==W== I kept messing up at the exact same spot before…
I kept messing up at the exact same spot before.==W== The timing is brutal…!
I can't believe I Full Combo-ed it on the first try today…==W== It must be because you were by my side, amplifying my power!
I can't believe I Full Combo-ed it on the first try today!==W== It must be==W== because you were by my side,==W== right?!
That was all your own power, Chaton.
My own power?==W== You mean ...==W== the power sleeping inside me has been completely unleashed?!
My own power?==W== Eh?==W== You mean my true power has finally been completely unleashed?!
That's so cool!==W== If that’s the case,==W== it's even more because you were by my side!
That's so cool!==W== If that's the case, it's even more because you were by my side!
Heh heh…==W== It's time to cast off this fake persona.==W== Darkness, inhabit my body!==W== Let this power of annihilation ring out as the prelude to the Tyrant's return!
Uh... I wouldn't go that far...
Why not?!==W== It's precisely because the great Tyrant exists that I,==W== the great Chaton, could acquire such immense power~
Why? Why?!==W== It's precisely because the Tyrant exists that ==SEX3== minions do, too!
Tyrant, you should be more confident!==W== Even without your memories, you’re still the strongest!
Sigh,==W== you should be more confident, Tyrant!==W== Even without your memories, you're still the strongest!
Exactly!==W== I can feel it...==W== The dark power hidden within you, Tyrant, a power capable of devouring everything!
Exactly!==W== I can feel it…==W== The dark power is hidden within you!
That power can awaken souls==W== and guide the summoned toward even greater peaks!==W== Just like how==W== it awakened the slumbering power within me!
That power can awaken souls==W== and guide the summoned toward even greater peaks!==W== Just like how it awakened the slumbering power within me!
I've been curious about this for a while...
What is this dark power anyway?
Why, it's the supreme, unparalleled power that you possess, Tyrant!
Speaking of dark power,==W== surely it must be the power of the Tyrant, right?
It paints everything in the world in darkness.==W== Even the gods who rule over all things==W== would be struck down by it!
It paints everything in the world in darkness.==W== Even the gods who rule over all things would be struck down by it!
But that power was sealed away along with your memories!==W== What a waste, right?
Heh heh,==W== but you don't need to worry.==W== As the sole heir to the dark power,==W== I will definitely help you get all your memories and power back!
Heh heh,==W== don't worry.==W== As a model minion to the Tyrant,==W== I will definitely help you get all your memories and power back!
So,==W== feel free to rely on the great Chaton!==W== My dear Tyrant~
So feel free to rely on the great Chaton!==W== My dear Tyrant~
I appreciate the help, but ...==W== what's the actual game plan here?
Hmmm... Well,==W== medically speaking, I'm sure shock therapy and scenario recreation treat amnesia.
Meaning we keep taking on trials fit for the Tyrant!==W== We fight, we grind, and we obliterate every obstacle in our path! It's foolproof!
The ultimate boot camp to forge the strongest Tyrant! Heh heh...==W== The great Chaton is getting fired up!
Just you wait, Tyrant! You'll love it when your true power awakens!
Ah...==W== Guess I have no choice but to look forward to it.
That might be the first time ...==W== I've felt a genuine rush to get my memories back...
From that day on, right until the New Star Guild left Emor, Chaton and I kept taking on commissions under the guise of the "Tyrant's Trials"...

That was the last Stellaroid on this floor, right?==W== Clearing out monsters... Simple, brutal. I love commissions like this!
Through the scope, my mind becomes razor-sharp!==W== And there's this dormant power inside me... Stirring, waking up.==W== It's intoxicating...!==W== I knew it, I was born for this kind of work!
You feel it too, right, Tyrant?!
Huh? Already out of breath? You're the Tyrant, you can't be looking this wiped out!
And I wonder whose fault that is...
Whew...==W== I didn't sign up for this much running.
Well, you still managed to take down a few Stellaroids today! Did it jog any of your memories?
I see...==W== Well, can't be helped then.
Alright, break's over! On to the next floor!
So much for letting me off the hook...==W== Here we go again...
You bet! And I can feel it. I'm totally smashing my high score today!
I'm pumped up and I'm in the zone!==W== Plus, I've got the Tyrant right beside me, buffing me with dark power!
What's that got to do with me?
Everything!==W== I can feel the dark energy radiating off you, resonating with my very soul! The great Chaton's power is surging!
The trial begins! Descend!==W== Rhapsody of Worldly Suffering!
And she's off. But what is she even playing?
Looks like she's slapping the door of a washing Artifact...
Hmph...==W== I've played this song a thousand times!
Don't let the slow start fool you. The climax is the real challenge!
Song? Oh—==W==she's pressing buttons to the beat.
Hm hm hm... Catchy beat. Makes me want to tap along.
Oh! Almost there!==W== Here comes the ultimate challenge!
Tyrant! Lend me your dark power!
Very well! You crave the Tyrant's power?==W== Then I, sovereign of darkness, shall lend it to you!
Not sure what did it—the beat or her energy—but I ended up playing along.
But ...==W== hope I didn't mess it up.
Hmph...==W== Looks like that fight woke up a bit of your old self!
As the sole inheritor of the dark power in the White Cat Troupe, I accept your aid!==W== The melody of the final trial! Face my attack!
Whoa! This is the climax?==W== It's so fast I can barely read the screen!
But Chaton's unfazed,==W== nailing every note.
The beat's winding down.==W== Looks like it's almost over.
Amazing! I did it!==W== Did you see that, Tyrant?!==W== Not only did I break my personal high score,==W== but I also Full Combo-ed an entire track on Hell difficulty!
Amaaaaaazing!==W== Tyrant! Did you see that?!==W== Not only did I break my personal high score,==W== but I also Full Combo-ed an entire track on Hell difficulty!
Let me tell you, this track is super tough—==W==the layout is complex and the timing is brutal!==W== I kept messing up at the exact same spot before…
I kept messing up at the exact same spot before.==W== The timing is brutal…!
I can't believe I Full Combo-ed it on the first try today…==W== It must be because you were by my side, amplifying my power!
I can't believe I Full Combo-ed it on the first try today!==W== It must be==W== because you were by my side,==W== right?!
That was all your own power, Chaton.
That was all your own power, Chaton.
My own power?==W== You mean ...==W== the power sleeping inside me has been completely unleashed?!
My own power?==W== Eh?==W== You mean my true power has finally been completely unleashed?!
That's so cool!==W== If that’s the case,==W== it's even more because you were by my side!
That's so cool!==W== If that's the case, it's even more because you were by my side!
Heh heh…==W== It's time to cast off this fake persona.==W== Darkness, inhabit my body!==W== Let this power of annihilation ring out as the prelude to the Tyrant's return!
Heh heh…==W== It's time to cast off this fake persona.==W== Darkness, inhabit my body!==W== Let this power of annihilation ring out as the prelude to the Tyrant's return!
Uh... I wouldn't go that far...
Uh... I wouldn't go that far...
Why not?!==W== It's precisely because the great Tyrant exists that I,==W== the great Chaton, could acquire such immense power~
Why? Why?!==W== It's precisely because the Tyrant exists that ==SEX3== minions do, too!
Tyrant, you should be more confident!==W== Even without your memories, you’re still the strongest!
Sigh,==W== you should be more confident, Tyrant!==W== Even without your memories, you're still the strongest!
Exactly!==W== I can feel it...==W== The dark power hidden within you, Tyrant, a power capable of devouring everything!
Exactly!==W== I can feel it…==W== The dark power is hidden within you!
That power can awaken souls==W== and guide the summoned toward even greater peaks!==W== Just like how==W== it awakened the slumbering power within me!
That power can awaken souls==W== and guide the summoned toward even greater peaks!==W== Just like how it awakened the slumbering power within me!
I've been curious about this for a while...
I've been curious about this for a while...
What is this dark power anyway?
What is this dark power anyway?
Why, it's the supreme, unparalleled power that you possess, Tyrant!
Speaking of dark power,==W== surely it must be the power of the Tyrant, right?
It paints everything in the world in darkness.==W== Even the gods who rule over all things==W== would be struck down by it!
It paints everything in the world in darkness.==W== Even the gods who rule over all things would be struck down by it!
But that power was sealed away along with your memories!==W== What a waste, right?
But that power was sealed away along with your memories!==W== What a waste, right?
Heh heh,==W== but you don't need to worry.==W== As the sole heir to the dark power,==W== I will definitely help you get all your memories and power back!
Heh heh,==W== don't worry.==W== As a model minion to the Tyrant,==W== I will definitely help you get all your memories and power back!
So,==W== feel free to rely on the great Chaton!==W== My dear Tyrant~
So feel free to rely on the great Chaton!==W== My dear Tyrant~
I appreciate the help, but ...==W== what's the actual game plan here?
Hmmm... Well,==W== medically speaking, I'm sure shock therapy and scenario recreation treat amnesia.
Meaning we keep taking on trials fit for the Tyrant!==W== We fight, we grind, and we obliterate every obstacle in our path! It's foolproof!
The ultimate boot camp to forge the strongest Tyrant! Heh heh...==W== The great Chaton is getting fired up!
Just you wait, Tyrant! You'll love it when your true power awakens!
Ah...==W== Guess I have no choice but to look forward to it.
That might be the first time ...==W== I've felt a genuine rush to get my memories back...
From that day on, right until the New Star Guild left Emor, Chaton and I kept taking on commissions under the guise of the "Tyrant's Trials"...

strings.text: Searching, Searching for a Friend (Part I)
You decide to help Firefly make a new friend.
If I don't take this seriously, I'm gonna get caught in an instant...!
Ready or not, here I come—
Wait, we're going way too fast!!
I won again.==B====W== Tyrant, were you going easy on me?
It's just that you're too strong...==W== And you even used Avalanche... Doesn't that count as cheating?
That is a lot, Tyrant, what is this cheating that you speak of?
I didn't hit you with Avalanche just now, so it doesn't count as cheating.
Now, it's your turn to be the seeker, Tyrant.
Firefly is the wielder chosen for Avalanche, a weapon created==RT==by the Grace Imperium.
She herself was abducted by the Eye of Grace when she was==RT==very young, and underwent special training for many years.
She is currently under Canace's protection and attends==RT==Grace Light Academy as a specially admitted student.
At the same time, she is learning how to be an ordinary girl.
I like playing with you, Tyrant. Being with you makes me happy.
Although I never expected her to get this attached to me...
I feel like this aroused some kind of caregiving instinct in me... Still, chilling around feels good.
But... Tyrant, playing with you is getting a little dull.
Huh? What were you saying, Firefly?
Tyrant, playing with you is getting a little dull.
W-wait... Does that mean... You find me boring now?
Because you play with me, Tyrant. So you are my best friend. ==B====W==Being with you is always fun.
So when you aren't around, it gets boring. Because then there's no one else to play with me.
No one else... Right, I think I get it now.
So even though playing with me makes her happy, she also wants other playmates. That's what she means, right?
If I can have fun even when you are not here, Tyrant, I'd be even happier.
... In other words, you want to make some new friends, yes?==W==
I see. But don't you go to school? You don't have any friends there to play with?
At school, I'm always by myself.==B====W== I don't know what other people talk about, and nobody comes up to talk to me either.
I'm always watching other people talk from far away.==W== And it gives me this strange stinging feeling.
Firefly grew up in a very unusual environment... She's missing some basic common sense.
On top of that, the college students around are all above her age... Making friends really would be hard.
How do you make friends, Tyrant?
You are always surrounded by cute girls.==B====W== Tyrant, you are a master at making friends.
Cough, cough... I should probably correct her, but I'll let it slide for now...
I want to know how you would define a friend.

Does simply knowing each other make you friends...==B====W== Or do you only count as friends after there's some sort of exchange...==B====W== Or do you have to hang out all the time to count as friends?
And if you don't open your heart to each other, can you really call that friendship?
A lot of so-called friendships are built on appearances and self-interest. If that's all it is, I'd rather not bother...
Even if we think of someone as a friend, they might not feel the same way. Exactly how close do you have to be before you can call someone a friend? That's a question worth discussing—
This topic is probably way too complicated for her...
What you are saying is really hard to understand, Tyrant. It's making me sleepy...
To sum it up—if someone doesn't know enough about you, they can't become your friend. So if you want to find new friends, Firefly, first you have to let people get to know you better.
That's right. What do you think you should do to let people know more about you?
Yep, that's an important first step. And then?
How did we go from saying hi to this?!
That's how I've always done it when I run into toys.
If you were dealing with Stellaroids, maybe... But humans don't attack each other the moment they meet. If you do that... You'd scare people.
Maybe you can ...==W== just try talking to them first?
You're actually a gentle, nice kid. If people can just come to understand that, I'm sure they'll want to be friends with you.
Yeah. Have more confidence in yourself.
Then ... who should I talk to first?
Strangers... No, that might be setting the bar a little high. Even I'd get nervous...
How about trying to talk to your classmates at Grace Light Academy first?
Then Firefly gently wrapped her small hand around mine.
You come with me to school, Tyrant.
I'm worried I won't do it right.==W== But with you, Tyrant, I'd feel safe.
But I'm not affiliated with the university at all...==W== I should let Canace know first.
All right. Let's give this making-friends thing a try together.
Mm. With Tyrant helping me, it'll be easy.==W==
But what if I end up making a hundred friends... Then I won't have any time left for you, Tyrant.
You set your expectations a bit too high!!

strings.text: Searching, Searching for a Friend (Part II)
You find a new candidate for a friend! But... Something's not right?
Tyrant, that person over there is just spacing out by herself. Does she not have any friends?
Maybe she has something on her mind. But this could be a good opportunity to make a friend.
Listening to other people's troubles is a common way to make friends.
I see. I'll go with the common way.==W==
You've been sighing. Is something wrong?
I'm not a student here. Canace asked me to look after this girl.
Canace...==W== Wait, are you...==W== Are you that <size=50>special-admissions student</size> everyone's been talking about!?
Nice to meet you. My name is Misha. I major in Monolith Studies.
My goal is to become a Trekker...==W== I told my family about it yesterday, and they wouldn't hear it. It all blew up,==W== haha...
Why do you want to become a Trekker?
I want to keep researching Monoliths after graduation, and I want to focus more on field research and practice...==B====W== If I could do fieldwork like Professor Canace, that would be amazing.
If I become a Trekker, then I'll be able to explore Monoliths whenever I want, right?==W== But there are Stellaroids inside the Monoliths, not to mention other dangers...
I don't understand. Why would the Stellaroids prevent you from becoming a Trekker?
Lots of toys inside the Monolith. Very fun. Want to go every day.
Every day... Wait, are you a Trekker, too!?==W== Could it be... Have you actually fought Stellaroids before?
Yes. Playing with Stellaroids is very fun.
No way... Even a little teenager girl can climb a Monolith...?
Don't tell me you've defeated lots of Stellaroids already.
Is this okay? I feel like this line of conversation is going to lead to trouble...
Please, Master! Take me to a Monolith with you!==W==
I want to see it with my own eyes, no matter what!==W== The grown-ups... They're telling me to give up before I've even tried—how am I supposed to accept that!?

Well, your enthusiasm is admirable, but in principle, we are not allowed to take a regular person into a Monolith.==B====W== If a non-combatant gets caught in the battle, the whole team could end up in danger trying to look after them...
S-sorry. I really wasn't thinking that through. You're right...
I'm not a "mast." I'm Firefly.==B====W== I'm going to the Wishing Box to wish for camera film. If you want to come, just follow me.
Wait, Firefly. Hang on a sec.
Ever since she was an experimental subject, she's been treating Stellaroids like toys...==W== To her, the Monolith itself is probably just a playground...
But Misha is different. She's an ordinary student.==W== It's not enough to rely on Firefly's instincts to keep her safe once they're inside the Monolith.
That being said, if I put my foot down right now and stop them... There is a high chance that they sneak off behind my back...
All right. First, you'll have to fight a monster. I'll judge from your performance whether we can take you along.
Yeah. With that as a baseline, I can talk to Canace and try to get the school's approval.
But all of that depends on one thing... You have to defeat the monster on your own.
I understand. If you're willing to give me this chance, then I'd like to try!
Monster! Monster!==W== Where can we find a monster?
When you run into a monster, first aim for the eyes... Then attack the legs so it can't move...
W-wait! If you just jump out like that, you'll alert—
Eek!? N-no... Don't come any closer!!
She split the monster in two with a single blow... That's Firefly for you.
There are more monsters coming! Firefly, can you protect Misha and wipe them all out at the same time!?
Amazing... So this is ... what a real Trekker looks like.
The way I am now... I'm not qualified to climb a Monolith.==W== That's what you were trying to tell me, right, Master?
Misha... What are you talking about? I just wanted to protect you.
Thank you all the same, Master.==W==
It's only natural. Having seen such a vast gap in ability with her own eyes... To her, Trekkers probably feel even more unreachable now.

strings.text: Searching, Searching for a Friend (Part III)
Teasing, sulking, and making up in a flash.
Let's see...==W== Yeah, these are nice.
It's already been a week since what happened with Misha... Looks like Firefly's back to normal.
Only you would play with me...
… Is that so?==W== Then, do you want to try making new friends again?
But I'm bad at it. Didn't work with Misha, either.
Don't worry about it. Not everyone succeeds on the first fry...==W== Besides, that time—
I've been looking all over for you. Finally...
Misha.==W== How are you feeling? The injuries, are they serious?
Yeah, I'm completely fine now! Just a few days of rest and I've fully recovered!
Angry? Me? Why would you think that?
I couldn't protect Misha. Misha got hurt. All my fault.
Misha... You don't want to go to the Monolith with me anymore, right?
Maybe my suggestion back then was too thoughtless and ended up backfiring...
Firefly's power level borders on supernatural... And Misha saw all of it firsthand...

Crack!==W== Whoosh whoosh—! You cut down the monsters in an instant!!==W== Debris flying everywhere, monsters dropping one after another!==W== And when the dust cleared, you just stood there like that, completely composed!
Why would I be angry?==W== If anything, I'm frustrated at myself for being so useless!
I'm sorry! I wasn't taking it seriously enough!==W== Or rather, I got the most important thing wrong, right from the start—
If I really want to become a Trekker, first I have to become as strong as you, Master!==W==
So, Master! Would you be willing to guide someone as inexperienced and unskilled as me?!
Don't call me that. Just Firefly.
Misha, calm down. And Firefly, stop tugging on my clothes. You'll stretch them out.
S-sorry! I got too excited and just ran with it...
Mm... A second thought, asking for help right off the bat is a bit too sudden...==B====W== In that case, Firefly, could I first ask you to ... BE MY FRIEND?==W==
You want to ... be friends with me?
Tyrant. At a time like this, what should I say?
... Just say what you're feeling right now. Whatever you're thinking, say it honestly.
I feel happy when I'm with you, Misha.==W== My heart goes thump-thump. I feel excited.==W== So yes, I'll be your friend.
Firefly...! Thank you!==W== I'll work hard to get stronger—when we can fight side by side, let's climb the Monolith together!
Great! You made a new friend.
I... Made a new friend, Tyrant.
You made a new friend, so you're really happy?==W==
Not just happy... But also a bit embarrassed?
Tyrant, so annoying.==W== I'm not embarrassed.==W== Silly goose.==W== Meanie.==W== Me no talking to you anymore.
Firefly dashes straight into Canace's office. I have no choice==RT==but to steel myself, knock, and go in after her.
In the most inconspicuous corner of the office, a small curtain==RT==sectioned off a space—with a sign that read "Firefly's Room."
Firefly? I'm coming in, okay?==W== Huh? Where is she? ==W==I definitely saw her run in here... Was I mistaken...?==W== Well, I'll check other places.
This place is full of Sherlock plushies...==B====W== Where did Firefly go?
Huh?! Firefly! So you were here!==W== When you're dressed like this, I can't tell you from all the other Sherlocks!
Me no Firefly now. Me Sherlock.
No, no, no, you're still Firefly...==W== Anyway, I'm really sorry about earlier. I won't tease you anymore. Can you forgive me?
Don't want to listen to Tyrant. Go.==W== Ignoring Tyrant. Ignore, ignore—
Come on, don't be like that... Just listen to me, please?
When she was locked up in the Eye of Grace for years, she used to be so stiff when expressing emotions.==W== And now she can even sulk...
Even if it's just a little, something inside Firefly might be starting to change for the better...
I'll apologize properly—so let's make up, okay?
No.==W== Tyrant==W== picked on Firefly.==W== Is bad.==W== Sob.
No.==W== Tyrant==W== picked on Firefly.==W== Firefly==W== is sobbing.
Misha==W== is already my friend.==W== Meanie Tyrant,==W== I'm not playing with you==W== for a bit.
Misha==W== is already my friend.==W== Meanie Tyrant,==W== I'm not playing with you for a bit.
An angry face doesn't suit you, Firefly, because you're so cute.
I know.==W== Tyrant saying that==W== is just trying to butter me up,==W== is polite talk.
But... If you don't play with me anymore...

strings.text: Invited to Ridge's greenhouse... Wait—can this really be called a greenhouse?
Hey Ridge. I'm here. Where are you?
She should be in this greenhouse right now. Anyway, let me go in and take a look first.
This place ...==W== why does it feel like a maze...
And the plants here look different from the ones in the other greenhouses...
There are no strange plants ...==W== it's all just ordinary vegetables.
Rather than a United Harvest greenhouse, it looks more like a giant vegetable garden...
Got you! You're definitely getting a threshing today!==B== Get ready, veggie thief!
Haha...==W== It's all right, we all make mistakes sometimes. Anyway, please put the shovel down for now...
Oh...==W== Sure. I'm really, really sorry...
I was just pruning the apple tree and totally lost track of time.
Sorry to keep you waiting! Here, I made you this special mixed salad as an apology—for the misunderstanding earlier, and for making you wait.
It's made with the veggies and fruit I grew myself, super fresh and really tasty! Go ahead, try some!
Oh, wow...!==W== Well, I'm gonna dig in, then...
Ever since I got to know Ridge, she's been piling me up with food every time we meet...
It's hard to say no. With her watching me so expectantly, I did my best to finish everything she shared.
As expected, Boss, you really enjoy the food～==B== Do you like it? Do you have enough? I can go get you some more if you want.
It was really delicious, I loved it. But there's no need, I'm already full... Let's talk about the commission instead.
Come with me, then. Watch your steps.
Um, Ridge...==W== Is it just me,==W== or is there something a little off about this greenhouse...?
Really? Everything seems totally normal to me...
Ah! Boss, don't go over there!
I-I almost fell in… I can't believe there are traps in a place like this...
Why are there so many traps in the United Harvest greenhouse? Did someone ask you to set them up?
It's because there are always thieves coming to steal my supplies. Sometimes they even vandalize my test plots.
So I set up some security measures in the important areas.
And...==W== I might've gone a little overboard with them~
Let's not worry about that for now...==W== Here we are. This is my test plot.
My commission is about the corn I'm growing here.
Even though I planted only certified high-yield varieties, there are always noticeable differences in yield out in the field.
Boss, could you help me figure something out?
Hmm...==W== I'd love to help, but...==W== I don't really know anything about farming...
But I figure there's nothing that you can't do, Boss! I just know you'll be able to help me with this!
She's looking at me so expectantly that I can't bring myself to say anything but yes...
All right, let's go over the situation.
You mean, even though you picked all high-yield seeds, the corn harvest still turns out different every time?
Yeah, that's right! Boss, you really catch on fast!
Ways to increase yield, huh...==W== Thinking back, I'm pretty sure I read something about this in a book inside the Monolith... What was it again...?
Right, I think it was about a "pea experiment."
Going off what I could vaguely remember, I gave Ridge a quick rundown of the "pea experiment."
Uh-huh, I get it! So basically, you just need to crossbreed the high-yield varieties, right?
You could re-evaluate how each variety performs in different environments.==W== Make sure the fertilizer matches... If you maximize all that, then I'm sure it would work...!
Boss, you're amazing! Those suggestions sound just like something an expert would say. They really help me a lot!
Is it really all that? Well, as long as it helps, I'm glad.
I'll try planting a batch of peas just like you suggested, right this minute~
Yeah. Jumping straight to corn might be a bit risky. Since it's called the "pea experiment," I'll try it with peas first.
Once I get the hang of this breeding method, I'll use it for other crops too.
Wow~ That means the commission is complete right?
—All right then! You can have all of this—==W==every last bit!
Oh, wow... Once again, there's so much... Anyway, thanks.
A whole cart full of fruits and veggies... By the looks of it, the New Star Guild shouldn't have to worry about food for a while.
If you ever need more, just let me know, don't be shy~
Haha...==W== If I take any more, I won't be able to carry it all back... But thank you, I really appreciate it.

strings.text: Along with Ridge, I caught the food thief—wait, what? Turns out the thief had their own troubles.
Phew...==W== No luck finding trace here... Ridge, how's it going on your end?
I've been digging around in the bushes here forever. Haven't seen a single Shrubshrew, not even a whisker...
It all started a few hours ago...
And they even took the pea seeds for my experiment!
What do I do, what do I do...! Help me, Boss!
They took the peas too...?!==W== This won't do! I'll come help right away...!
Are you sure it was Shrubshrews that took your seeds? Do you have any evidence?
Shrubshrews are always sneaking in to steal my veggies. They're the only ones that leave those tiny claw prints and gnaw marks. I recognize those instantly.
I followed the tracks all the way here, but ...==W== they just suddenly disappeared.
What should I do, Boss! If they took the veggies and hid them in their burrow...==W== We might never find them again...
You're right, we could miss the best chance...==W== In that case, our best bet is to lure them out and catch them all at once.
Something actually does come to mind, Ridge...==W== Wanna hear?
Um ... uh...==W== Wait, are we really going to do that...?
Um ...==W== it does feel a bit much...
But all right, if it's what we need to catch the culprit, it's worth it! I trust you, Boss. Let's give it a try!
I grabbed a bunch of Shrubshrews' favorite veggies...==W== Should I just set them out here?
Yeah, let's put some in all the spots they might be hiding. I'll help you.
Ridge and I set out the veggies as bait, then hide nearby to wait.
<size=50>Yes...! You aren't getting away this time, you horrible veggie thief!</size>
Give it up! Hand over the seeds and all the veggies, right now!
Just as Ridge is about to tie up the Shrubshrew with a rope, several more Shrubshrews suddenly dart out from the woods.
Whoa...==W== Did we just stir up a whole nest of Shrubshrews? Ridge... Did you notice too...?
Huh? We finally caught a Shrubshrew, why did Ridge put the rope down?
You mean ...==W== it stole for its family?
I see, I see. Uh-huh, I get it now.
Boss, they were driven out of their home by some bad monsters. They stole because they didn't have enough food.
They said they took the seeds so they could grow their own and not go hungry anymore...
I'm honestly amazed you can understand what they're saying...
They said they'd give back the veggies and seeds if I let their leader go.
That's great, this way we can get the seeds and veggies back.
I'm thinking we should just let them off the hook.==W== And let them have these veggies as well.
Even though ... even though they did terrible things, like stealing my crops and messing up my test plots. And I felt that was unforgivable...
But they were just trying to survive because they didn't have enough to eat...==W== I know what it feels like to go hungry better than anyone...
Of ... of course, I put so much effort into growing these crops. They're really important to me...
Giving them away==W== is honestly...==W== Really, really hard...!
...==W== Half! If I only give them half, I think I can live with that!
That's not a bad idea...==W== But if you only give them half, it might not be enough for the whole pack...
Ugh...==W== Then I guess I'll give it all to them...!==W== Ugh...!
All right,==W== you can have it all!
But this is my most precious produce,==W== so you have to finish every bit of it. No waste allowed!
The Shrubshrews nod eagerly at Ridge's words, then turn and head back into the forest. Ridge watches them go, still looking a bit reluctant.
Are you really okay with it?
You really hate having your food stolen, and you seemed super reluctant just now. So why did you give it all to those "thieves" in the end?
Because...==W== They don't have enough to eat. I just felt so sorry for them...
I know what it's like to be hungry. Every day you have no energy, you feel miserable, and you can't look forward to the next day at all...==W== I never want to feel that way again.
Because I've been through that myself. So when I think about them suffering too, I just...
I grow all these veggies and store up so much food precisely because I don't want anyone to go hungry. If they're short on food, maybe this will help them get through a tough time.
Oh, I know! How about we teach the Shrubshrews how to farm?
That way, they'll always have something to eat and won't ever have to go hungry again!
I think that's a great idea...==W== But teaching them how to farm won't be easy. Looks like you'll be busy for a while.
Really? I'm sure it'll go okay!
Seeing how confident Ridge looks, I suddenly feel like she might actually turn those Shrubshrews into farming experts.

strings.text: Thanks to Ridge's efforts, the peas are thriving—but aren’t they getting a bit too big? Oh no, the pea shoots are going to eat us!
Hey, Boss! Over here, this way!
Look, these are the peas I planted before! They've already grown this much!
I've been carefully watching how they grow, and I've even been studying how the environment affects the yield. Thanks to you, Boss, the crossbreeding is going really well!
Looking around, I see Ridge's test plot is divided into sections, each growing a different kind of pea. Some are just tiny sprouts, while others are already tall.
I never expected that story about the "pea experiment" would end up being so fruitful...
And that's not even the best part! Recently, I started using some special nutrients to help them grow faster!
Depending on how you use these nutrients, you can get totally different results.==W== The peas have grown in all kinds of ways—you'll be surprised how much they vary!
And the most impressive one...==W== Hehe...
Boss, come with me and take a look~
W-whoa, it's humongous! Wait, can peas even grow this big? It's taller than a tree!
Pretty amazing, right? I used the latest growth booster developed by the research department on this one.
But this growth booster does have a downside. It makes the plant grow really fast in a short time, but it also reduces the number of pods...
Yeah, the stem is massive, but there's barely anything growing on it...
