strings.text: Candy Hidden within the Promise (Part I)
"The place in front of you is the most popular restaurant in all of Philae!"==RT==—says the little manager proudly, her tail wagging.
On this bustling street, the crowd have formed an orderly, winding line in front of a tiny restaurant.
Jing's Bistro. This must be it. Jinglin's place.
I heard it was popular, but this line is way longer than I expected...
Wahhh...==W== My legs hurt! I wanna go hoooome...
Eh? We're almost there. Just hang in a little bit longer! Okay?
Didn't you say you really wanted to try the signature Plum Rolls?
Wahhh... But I'm sooo tired. I don't want it anymore! I wanna go home!
Don't be so difficult!==W== You can't always have your way!
How much longer do we have to wait? Should we go to another place instead?
If it doesn’t live up to the hype, I’m gonna tell everyone—"eating at Jing's Bistro is just a waste of money!"
Everyone's in such a bad mood. Even the most delicious food wouldn't taste good like this...
Sorry! Sorry! Thanks for waiting, everyone!
The restaurant is super crowded right now. So sorry for all the inconvenience, everyone!
Is that ...==W== a giant tea bucket?
We've prepared free tea and snacks for everyone in line!
Plus, we're offering free desserts for each table based on your wait time.
Now that's more like it! A little snack to hold us over until the feast!
Now that's clever.==W== What about that dad and the daughter duo? Hope they're feeling better.
Oh no, there's nothing here that you like?
No, it's not that... I had a fight with my dad. I don't wanna eat what he picked.
Okay, okay, have something else then.
Look, I've got a mini pastry and some malt candy.
I...==W== I want both of them!
Maybe start with the pastry. The candy's pretty sweet—save it for dessert.
Alright~! Nom nom... Mmm, it's delicious!
By the time you finish eating the pastry, there probably will be a table available. Which dish do you want to try the most?
What a coincidence! Your dad actually has our new snack, Peach Rolls, and it's every bit as good as the Plum Rolls.
Maybe smooth things over with your dad then, yeah?
Actually, it was your dad who told me you love Plum Rolls and asked me to save a Peach Roll for you.
I ... I wanna try this Peach Roll.
Sure. I'm sorry, sweetie. I shouldn't have snapped at you like that.
Alright, you two enjoy. See you soon~
I can see why this place is so popular.==W== She handles these things so well—hmm?
Before I even get to the door, I see a big group leaving the restaurant. Right after that, the line starts moving quickly.
After getting the line under control, Jinglin glances around furtively, as if worried someone might see her. Then she quickly gets out a piece of candy and pops it into her mouth.
Whew... Nothing beats this when you're tired~~ Sweet malt candy~
Hmm... ? Hmmm... ? It tastes even sweeter and better than before~ Did Grandpa Qin improve his recipe again?
Mmm~~ Ugh ... Gotta hold back! Can't eat too many... Or I'll definitely get cavities...
Hehehe. Sneaking sweets and looking so happy about it... Owner or not, she's still got her kid side.
Bo-boss?! Wh-when did you get here?!
I got a commission in this neck of the woods and figured I'd get some food.
Hehe, then you've come to the right place~
Our Jing's Bistro is the most popular spot in all of Philae!
Wow, this place is packed.==W== Guess that "most popular spot" line might have some truth behind it.
Hehe~ Here you go, this is our menu.
Each of our dishes comes in both a traditional version and a Novian twist.
The traditional versions are more suited to Loong taste buds.==RT==For our first-time Nova guests like you, Boss, I recommend going with the Novian versions.
The traditional versions are sweeter than the Novian ones. Many Loong dishes are strongly seasoned.
We used to only do the traditional style, but after moving to Philae, we found that most people here didn't take to our sweet flavors...
So you came up with the Novian versions?
Yep! With Mom's help, I gathered feedback from our customers and teamed up with Grandpa Qin—he's our head chef—to tweak the flavors of our dishes.
So it was a team effort, huh.
You could call it that~ But for the Loong people living in Philae, we have kept the traditional versions as well.
This place is as successful as it is today thanks to all the hard work of Jinglin, her family, and the staff.
Wowowow, is somebody actually ordering the traditional version?
No way... ==SEX1== doesn't even look like a Loong. There's no way you could handle that kind of flavor. Order something else!
Huh, I feel like people are underestimating me.
Jinglin! Lay the traditional dishes on me! Honey-glazed Ribs and Luofu Shrimp Balls.
Of course, my words are my bond. Besides, I'm here already, it'd be a shame not to give it a try!
Oh~ That's the spirit, Boss! So fearless!
We have a new customer wanting to try our authentic Loong cuisine today! ==SEX1=='s not a Loong, but don't hold back! Give ==SEX4== the full treatment!
Alright!!! Sit back and prepare to be wowed!
Oh?! Now this is going to be interesting! Can't wait to see how this plays out!
It's been a while since I've met a customer with such a taste for adventure...
Eh? I've got a bad feeling about this...
Thanks for waiting, Boss! Here are the dishes that you ordered.
Honey-glazed Ribs and Luofu Shrimp Balls, both in the traditional style!
<size=50>One</size>==W==<size=50> pot of</size>==W==<size=50> Loong Tea,</size>==W==<size=50> served raw.</size>
The glossy, sticky syrup coats the meat and shrimp cakes, releasing a rich, sweet aroma that rises with the steam.
Oh, the food's served! Let the challenge begin!
Why is everyone crowding around me?
That family at the next table—they finished their meal but are still there. Are they waiting to see me fail?
Well, there's no way to back out of it now...
Everyone's really excited! Go for it, Boss!
But start with small bites, okay?
Whew... Here goes! Down the whole thing in one bite!

So sweet...==W== Ugh, so, so sweet...
Here, have some tea.==W== A cup of tea will help!
It's just that my taste buds took a beating.

Loong taste buds are just built different. Don't force yourself.
Here, why don't you try the Novian version instead~
Hehe, I knew this would happen so I had the Novian version at the ready. Here you go, Luofu Shrimp Balls, Novian style!
Jinglin hands me the dish adapted to Novian taste buds. This time, not only do the shrimp balls come with way less sugary sauce...
With the sweetness toned down, the natural umami of the shrimp itself becomes more prominent.
So tasty!!==W== I've never had shrimps this tasty before...!==W== Nom nom nom...
Ahaha! If you like it, have some more~==W== Seeing you enjoy it so much makes me really happy, too!
Are these dishes still too sweet?!
Cough, cough... No, it's not that...
I... I ate too fast 'cause these taste so good...
Ahahaha! I see! One sec, I'll bring you some tea!
Take care, Uncle Feng. See you next time!
Uncle Lizi, the total comes to 810 Dorra.
Eight hundred ... and ten. Here you go.
Also, Aunty Langlang told me to remind you to drink less!
Haha, don't worry. This hardly even counts as drinking.
Oh right, she asked me to check with you. Did you sign up for next month's Mahjong Tournament?
Hmm… I’d love to go, but maybe next time!==W== The restaurant’s been packed lately, thanks to everyone’s support—we’ve hardly had a moment to catch our breath.<size=60>♪</size>

What a shame. Back before you took the manager role, you used to always ask her to play mahjong with you.
Hehe, next time, for sure. Take care, Uncle Lizi~ Please say hi to auntie for me.
Aunty Lan, you're saying today's sweet taro isn't sweet enough?
The other day, Uncle Jian told me that you need to cut back on sugar, so I asked Grandpa Qin to use less brown sugar.
Jinglin can run the numbers while shooting the breeze with her customers. Impressive!
I'd heard Loong were good at math. Looks like it's true.
Aww, I guess it wasn't sweet enough after all. Sorry, but you know, he's just looking out for you!
The way they talk, it's like old friends catching up with each other.
I've never felt this kind of vibe in any other restaurant.
Before I know it, the lights flicker on. Under the calm moonlight, Jing's Bistro is still lively and full of laughter.
Take care, you two! See you next time!
Whew... Everyone, the guests are gone. Time to start cleaning up!
Then I can finally get started on today's commission too.
Yeah. Remember I mentioned taking on a commission here? Actually, I was asked by your staff.
Huh?! Don't tell me they think I'm doing a bad job...
You have been hustling non-stop for the restaurant for so long. And all this time, you haven't had a real break.
We want you to be able to have some fun once in a while!

I know next to nothing about the game...

Only beginners can keep up with her.

Um, just to fill in the numbers so that her opponent will advance to the next round.

Anyway, as long as she has a good time today, we'll be happy, too~

strings.text: Fearing you might be terminally ill, the girls rush you to Coronis's clinic. Despite their best attempt to hide it, their expression says it all...
The smell of the disinfectant is so sharp.
This room ...==W== feels kind of familiar.
Why are my hands ...==W== strapped to the bed?
Dammit, can't get out of these.
Why are you struggling all of a sudden? You really are a naughty one.
Hehe, it's going to hurt a little, but just bear with it.
Woah ...==W== Who are you...?==W== And what ...==W== are you doing...?
Drawing blood is an essential part of a medical checkup.
Did you really think I was going to inject you with something weird? Come on, have more trust in your doctors.
Oh ...==W== It's you, Coronis. I thought it was some shady kidnap attempt. You really gave me a scare...
It all goes back to a few days ago, when I suddenly lost consciousness while exploring.
Although I regained my consciousness soon after, what followed were several days of low fever, coughing, and muscle pain.
Even now, despite the guildies caring for me, I still haven't fully bounced back.
Wah ... Wah ... ==PLAYER_NAME== ...==W== I can't believe this...
Is it really a terminal illness?
That’s what it says in the pamphlet I just got.
B-But, but…!==W== There's gotta be another way!
Oh! Do you remember Coronis? She seems really skilled. Maybe she could fix you?
Coronis…==W== She's the mysterious doctor who saved us in Emor, right…?
I'm not sure if she can cure something terminal ...==W== But maybe she has a way!==W== Let's go ask her!
Oh yeah, I remember everything now.
I see ...==W== After that, I passed out again, then Noya and the others brought me to your clinic.
Your three companions asked me to give you a thorough checkup.
That's true...==W== But a regular checkup wouldn't require strapping the patient to the bed!
After all, almost every patient I treat tries to run away as soon as I start.
Run away? If they came for treatment, why would they try to run away?
Exactly, I find it strange, too. As soon as people see my bone shears and the surgical saw, they start panicking and try to get away.
What are bone shears? That sounds terrifying. Are those actually part of the treatment process?
Really hope that I won't need those...
I kept my eyes on Coronis as she wrote intently in the medical file, cold sweat running down my back while I waited for the "final verdict."
Doctor, don't worry about sparing my feelings—just tell me straight ...==W== Do you think you can cure me?
Well ...==W== the human body has so many unknowns. It's full of mysteries, like the deep sea.
Even with the most advanced medical Artifacts, there are still so many illnesses we know so little about.
In other words, hard to say at this juncture.
In other words ...==W== I'm a goner?
I need you to stay here with me for observation for a while first.
Being able to study a case like yours, with such a unique constitution...
For a doctor—==W==or rather, for someone researching the mysteries of the human body ... ==W==Just thinking about it gets me excited. Makes me want to go dissect a frog right now.
Uh ...==W== I get the feeling I might not get out of here with all my limbs intact...
Don't make that face. Didn't I say you should have more trust in doctors?
Don't worry. I'll do everything I can to help you get better.
There are two patients to visit today. I'm counting on you to carry the first aid kit and tool bag for me.
The kit and bag are turning out much heavier than I thought...
Hehe, are you regretting agreeing to be my assistant?
I can't just take handouts. We agreed I'd work as your assistant to cover the treatment costs, so I'll see this through!
The doctor told you to stay home and rest, didn't she?
I've been stuck at home for so long. If I don't show my face out there, they're gonna forget who runs this district!
B-but ... Didn't that doctor say that==W== bad patients who don't listen will get punished...
Heh, I'm not afraid of her! If she tries anything, I'll just send her packing—
Hurry up and hide! The "Devil in White" is here!
Oh, no...!==W== Crap!==W== She's got a sidekick with her today!
N-no way...!==W== She actually showed up...!
Quick, let's get out of here! This isn't running away! This is a tactical retreat—wahhh!!
Yeah, I remember that I told you last time you needed a week of rest, and it's just been a few days. ==W== What are you doing outside?
Ugh…==W== I'm the one in charge of this!
I see... If you won't behave...==W== Then I’ll have no choice but to punish you.
Restraints, sedation, or solitary... ==W== Which one do you want?
Then be a good boy and GO HOME!
The kids on the street scatter all at once. The "Cap" boy runs off, but I can still hear his sobs.
The "Devil in White" really lives up to her name.
Not a bad moniker, is it? Alright, my assistant, don't forget what we're here for~
Time to see my first patient for the day.

I see ...==W== After that, I passed out again, then Noya and the others brought me to your clinic.
Your three companions asked me to give you a thorough checkup.
That's true...==W== But a regular checkup wouldn't require strapping the patient to the bed!
After all, almost every patient I treat tries to run away as soon as I start.
Run away? If they came for treatment, why would they try to run away?
Exactly, I find it strange, too. As soon as people see my bone shears and the surgical saw, they start panicking and try to get away.
What are bone shears? That sounds terrifying. Are those actually part of the treatment process?
Really hope that I won't need those...
I kept my eyes on Coronis as she wrote intently in the medical file, cold sweat running down my back while I waited for the "final verdict."
Doctor, don't worry about sparing my feelings—just tell me straight ...==W== Do you think you can cure me?
Well ...==W== the human body has so many unknowns. It's full of mysteries, like the deep sea.
Even with the most advanced medical Artifacts, there are still so many illnesses we know so little about.
In other words, hard to say at this juncture.
In other words ...==W== I'm a goner?
I need you to stay here with me for observation for a while first.
Being able to study a case like yours, with such a unique constitution...
For a doctor—==W==or rather, for someone researching the mysteries of the human body ... ==W==Just thinking about it gets me excited. Makes me want to go dissect a frog right now.
Uh ...==W== I get the feeling I might not get out of here with all my limbs intact...
Don't make that face. Didn't I say you should have more trust in doctors?
Don't worry. I'll do everything I can to help you get better.
There are two patients to visit today. I'm counting on you to carry the first aid kit and tool bag for me.
The kit and bag are turning out much heavier than I thought...
Hehe, are you regretting agreeing to be my assistant?
I can't just take handouts. We agreed I'd work as your assistant to cover the treatment costs, so I'll see this through!
The doctor told you to stay home and rest, didn't she?
I've been stuck at home for so long. If I don't show my face out there, they're gonna forget who runs this district!
B-but ... Didn't that doctor say that==W== bad patients who don't listen will get punished...
Heh, I'm not afraid of her! If she tries anything, I'll just send her packing—
Hurry up and hide! The "Devil in White" is here!
Oh, no...!==W== Crap!==W== She's got a sidekick with her today!
N-no way...!==W== She actually showed up...!
Quick, let's get out of here! This isn't running away! This is a tactical retreat—wahhh!!
Yeah, I remember that I told you last time you needed a week of rest, and it's just been a few days. ==W== What are you doing outside?
Ugh…==W== I'm the one in charge of this!
I see... If you won't behave...==W== Then I’ll have no choice but to punish you.
Restraints, sedation, or solitary... ==W== Which one do you want?
Then be a good boy and GO HOME!
The kids on the street scatter all at once. The "Cap" boy runs off, but I can still hear his sobs.
The "Devil in White" really lives up to her name.
Not a bad moniker, is it? Alright, my assistant, don't forget what we're here for~
Time to see my first patient for the day.

strings.text: You stay at the clinic for treatment and witness Coronis's remarkable skills. Will it be enough to heal you...?
Doc, doc, this must be something serious, right?
So you're feeling tired and have no appetite. How did you figure out from just that there's something wrong with your brain?
Well, a few days ago, I had a headache all day and a low fever.
On top of that, I couldn't sleep and felt totally drained...
Doctor, stop fudging and just tell me the truth...! ==W==Do I have some kind of brain disease? I've asked around!
Hmph ... ==W==Sounds like you went to see some "famous specialist," huh?
Aside from the brain stuff, I think it might also be a mental disorder.
Uh ... Doc ... Is there ...==W== any hope for me at all...?
Hmm, I've got the special cure right here. Hold on.
Ah! So I can be cured! I'm saved! Thank you, Doc!
Assistant, hand me those red-capped vials.
Is this even a proper diagnosis? Seems way too simple...
While I'm hesitating, Coronis gives me a look that says, "It's fine, go ahead and give him the medicine." Questions notwithstanding, I do as she says and take out the vials from the box.
Take one in the morning and one at night for a week. Stick to light food, no meat.
My assistant will check in with you in a week.
Doc, you want me to do the follow-up?
No way! I don't have a lick of medical knowledge!
A patient who isn't actually sick is perfect for an assistant who doesn't have any medical knowledge.
The medicine I gave him is just plain water with a bit of bitter flavor added. Once his anxiety eases, he'll get better on his own.
That was just literally playing doctor for him. Getting a real doctor to do that, though, is a bit much.
Now prepare yourself.==W== Our real challenge for today is Patient No. 68. Hehe~
He has a rare case of tremor syndrome.
Hehe ... At first I thought his symptoms were just temporary withdrawal effects from quitting alcohol.
But during my last I found out he had relatives with the same problem.
So I suspect he might have hereditary tremor syndrome.
If that's really the case ...==W== He'd make a fascinating research specimen ... Hehe. Ah, I'm getting excited just thinking about it. Makes me want to dissect a frog right now.
And she's even talking about dissections and stuff ...==W== Could she really mean it...?
I told you, I've been feeling a lot better! I don't need to go see you!
So you started drinking again, huh?
Even more than before, it looks like.
One day, when your symptoms flared up, you realized that drinking actually stopped the shaking.
So, you had a reason to start drinking again.
But over time, you realized that you need more and more alcohol to keep the tremors at bay.
But the truth is, it just felt like you stopped shaking because you were drunk ...==W== You really are a handful, you know that?
Whatever! I'm not going to your clinic!
Of course, I won't force a patient to undergo treatment. If anything, if you just give up, it will be a boon for me~
If the patient refuses treatment while alive, I have a better chance of doing a pathological autopsy on the body later—maybe even turning it into a specimen for further study, hehe~
If you want to know ... ==W==How I dissect and prepare those specimens...
W-wait! I-I want to get treatment! I don't want to know anything about that!!
But ... If you don't want to end up getting dissected or turned into a specimen,==W== better cooperate.
Hehehe ...==W== Finally, the moment I've been waiting for ...
The happy opportunity to dissect you and do whatever I want with you.
Wait, what? Dissect me? What are you...?!
See these bone shears? They let me cut through the ribs after separating the muscles to remove organs like the heart and lungs.
Hehe ... Just imagining the feeling of snipping through your bones—snap, snap—is enough to get me excited ... Hehehe.
This surgical saw is brand new, too. See how it's covered in tiny teeth, so small you can barely see them with the naked eye?
But rest assured, I'll be extra careful. I'll remove the brain completely intact.

As long as I preserve your brain and organs in fixative and change the solution regularly ... You will have to stay by my side forever, till the day that I die. Hehe ... hehehe. Isn't that kind of romantic?
Oh, of course, I'd take good care of your bones too. I will turn them into a proper skeleton display. Let me think ... I'd keep them by my bedside, right next to my favorite specimens.
That way ...==W== Neither of us will be lonely.
Hehehe ...==W== Just thinking about it gets me feeling all warm and fuzzy. You feel it too, right?
This is nothing like warm fuzzy! It's pure cold sweat! Stop, Coronis! You don't know what you're doing!
I know perfectly what I am doing, hehe, hehehe~~
No! NOOOOOOO—!!!==W== Huff ... Huff ... I'm so glad it was just a dream...
It was way too vivid for comfort though ...==W== Maybe it's because of all those morbid things I heard during her house calls today...
It's still the middle of the night. Hm...?==W== The light is still on in Coronis' room...?
A soft, warm light spilled from the room. Maybe it was that light that chased away the shadow of the nightmare I just had.
I peek quietly into the room, and the person from my dream is sitting right there.
She has a gentle expression on her face as she flips through a thick stack of papers on the desk.
Coro ... nis...? You are still up?

strings.text: As you parted ways, Coronis entrusted you with a specimen she had long cherished.
Oh, it's you. It's late. Is something wrong? Did you have a nightmare?
Yeah ... ==W==In my dream, you were planning to turn me into a skeleton specimen...
Hmm ...==W== Maybe deep down, you actually want to be a specimen. So, what do you say? Want me to make that dream a reality?
Heh, what a shame. Well, this isn't the time for a patient to be chatting. You should get some sleep.
I'm going, but what about you? Why aren't you getting some rest?
It's still work hours. I need to keep a close watch on the patient through the night.
So, even when the patient is asleep at night, you still have to keep an eye on them? Wait—don’t tell me I’ve been…?
Of course. If you want, I can even show you notes I took on the embarrassing things you said in your sleep.
I am a proper doctor, you know. I keep detailed notes on everything about my patients.
That's enough chatting, though. If you don't go to sleep soon, I'm going to have to give you a dose of sleeping medicine.
As it happens, I have a special medicine on hand—a powerful sleeping pill so bitter it could knock out even a Stellaroid.
Her gentle expression belies the threatening words.
She's still in her signature "Devil in White" outfit, with a faint scent of medicine lingering around her. But in this moment, to me, she looks more like a ...==W== guardian angel.
Thank you, Coronis ...==W== Because you, my condition has really been improving...
Mr. Hal is doing much better now.
Patient No. 68 ...==W== The one with tremor syndrome.
Ah, the one who refused treatment ...==W== It's just a matter of time before he recovers. Hehe, my pathological analysis of the tremor syndrome is almost done~
It went easier than I expected, which is a little disappointing. Still, there are a few interesting things...
By the way, that ... Mr. Hal, yes? For people like him, who have basically recovered, I'll leave the follow-up to you~
Me? It should be okay since they have mostly recovered,==W== but they probably want to thank the doctor in person.
That’s not necessary. I'm not researching diseases to cure the patients.
All I really want is to unravel the mysteries of the human body. Treating patients is merely a part of that process. Getting thanked would in fact makes me uncomfortable.
Even so, many people in the Ash District are grateful to you. Just like when you helped me back in Emor, I’m sure you’ve helped many others too.
Ah, you're giving me way too much credit~
...Really? Well, fine—let me handle it today.
But in exchange, why don't you go back to the clinic and get some rest? You've barely slept these past few days, taking care of all us inpatients.
Heh, you're quite observant. With that kind of attention to detail, maybe you were born to be a doctor, or at least an assistant.
With that, Coronis turns around and waves goodbye before heading back to the clinic.
A few hours later, I have wrapped up the follow-up visit, I come back to the clinic to find the lights in her office is still on.
Another new patient? She's so busy. Clinics are few in Ash District.
They are expensive to run and Coronis has no fee schedule. She barely has time to sleep but still works so well ... So amazing.
Since I'm her assistant after all, I should go help...
I hurry toward the clinic's office. Coronis is sitting at the desk, holding something that seems important and muttering to herself.
What a beautiful skull. It's so hard to part with it...
What's that you are holding, Coronis?
Oh, you're back. Perfect timing. I was just getting your discharge gift ready~
Look at these beautiful contours.==W== It's one of my favorite skulls.==W== ==W==
Look at these beautiful contours.==W== It's one of my favorite skulls.==W==
Maybe you can appreciate==W== the wild beauty of these fangs too?==W== And the sphenoid==W== is so well preserved.==W== It's a very delicate bone, so that's hard to find.
Maybe you can appreciate==W== the wild beauty of these fangs too?==W== And the sphenoid==W== is so well preserved.==W== It's a very delicate bone,==W== so that's hard to find.
I guess it does have a certain kind of beauty.
Right? Doesn't it?==W== Bones are evidence that an organism was once alive.
Right? Doesn't it?==W== Bones are evidence==W== that an organism was once alive.==W==
Flesh and blood==W== pass away with time...==W== Memories are consumed by Monoliths...==W== Even the soul==W== eventually==W== fades away==W== with time.==W==
Flesh and blood pass away with time...==W== Memories are consumed by Monoliths...==W== Even the soul==W== eventually fades away==W== with time.
So, all that remains are bones.
Correct.==W== The only proof that someone once lived is ==W==its bones, its frame.
Correct.==W== The only proof that someone once lived is ==W==its bones,==W== its frame.
I can see a certain appeal to that.
Hehe...==W== I'm glad you understand the beauty of life in its eternal splendor.==W== And your bones...==W== How brightly and beautifully will they shine?
Hehe...==W== I'm glad you understand the beauty of life in its eternal splendor.
Will we find golden ratio contours?==W== Or will we find long, straight lines that go on and on...?
Ooh, just thinking about it...==W== Hehe.==W== It almost makes me shudder in ecstasy.
Ooh, just thinking about it...==W== Hehe.==W== It almost makes me shudder in ecstasy...==W== Hehehehe.
... I guess I'll take that as a compliment.
Those mysteries hidden within your body...==W== I can't wait to reveal them one day.==W==
Those mysteries hidden within your body...==W== I can't wait to reveal them==W== one day.
You're keeping me here, waiting for me to breathe my last ...==W== So you can turn me into one of your specimens?!
By the way, you called this a "discharge gift" just now ...==W== How does that work with a terminal illness...?
I suppose that’s true as well. But...==W== You haven't figured it out yet?
Nothing terminal in your case. It's just exhaustion and malnutrition, heh.
Iris got duped by one of those street pamphlets. And you too.
Then... ==W==Then why did you make me stay?
You need a chance to reset your body. Besides, opportunities to observe the Boss up close like this don't come around often~
Hehehe ...==W== I could've told you sooner, but making house calls with you turned out to be more fun than I expected, so I just kept putting it off.
Hahaha, sorry about that. Next time you get sick, I’ll give you a discount—let’s call it even, okay?
Well then, congrats on your recovery. You're officially discharged.
Coronis hands me her parting gift—a heavy skull.
Its jawbone is slightly ajar, almost like it's smiling at me.

If you come into my clinic again with some boring condition like this ...==W== I might be unable to resist turning you into a specimen and keeping it somewhere no one will ever find ...==W== To study you slowly.
You've got a long wait ahead then. Right now I'm feeling great. Not gonna drop dead anytime soon.
Who knows? The reaper always shows up when you least expect it. But ...==W== I believe you. However long it takes, I will be waiting~

strings.text: Nanoha commissioned me to play the role of her employer and accompany her to a dessert expo.==B== We agreed to meet at the entrance of Goodwind Homecare on the day of the commission.
After crossing the intersection, turn right, then left, then go straight.==W== After passing six trees, it's the first courtyard on the right...
On the surface, Goodwind Homecare looks like an ordinary housekeeping company; but it's in fact a tightly knit organization of ninjas.
I'm guessing this commission from Nanoha is really about some secret mission, and asking me to play her "employer" is just a cover.
Good morning, Master. Terribly sorry for keeping you waiting!
I guess she's already gotten into character.
I'm so sorry. A little bug just flew into the courtyard a moment ago.
I was going to invite you in for a cup of tea, but unfortunately, the place is still being cleaned...
"A little bug..." Did she mean an intruder?
Looks like she's already handled it.
No worries, as long as the problem's taken care of. Shall we go?
Please follow me. I'll lead the way.
Come take a look! Fresh scones, just out of the oven! Free tasting!
Hey, box these cakes for me, please!
Wow, there are even more people here than I expected.
Master, here's a booth guide Nanoha prepared for this dessert expo. Please have a look.
I have marked the specialties of each booth so you can easily choose what to sample.
Aside from the dessert area, the expo also has a game zone. Please feel free to check it out if you're interested.
This is very detailed...==W== Let's read this along the way.

And the handmade cookies from this stall...
I... I'm so full... I can't eat anymore...

strings.text: Mission No. 2: Win the Grand Prize.
After we finish exploring the dessert area, Nanoha and I head over to the game zone.
Would you like to give it a go?
There are three mini-games in total: ring toss, ball throw, and the bell obstacle course.
If you clear all of them in one go, you'll win an extra—==W==delicious grand prize!
It's an all-you-can-eat voucher from Frees Patisserie. Pick any dessert you like!
I think I've heard of that name before. Is it a famous place?
Indeed. Their desserts are top-notch, both in looks and taste.
I see. Then of course we'll have to play.
Alright! Here are your game passes. Make sure you don't lose them!
After a bit of waiting in line, it's finally our turn.
Due to the large number of attendees at this expo, we are asking each group to choose only one player to participate in the games.
Of course, if your representative clears all the games, everyone in the group gets the grand prize.
You go ahead. I'm really full from all that eating.
I'll cheer you on from the sidelines.
Nanoha will not let you down.
Toss the plastic rings onto the blocks of matching colors?==W== I see.
She, she got all of them!
Hit those moving dolls with the balls from the basket...==W== Is that … all?
You got all of them at the same time?!
The final challenge...==W== The bell obstacle course.
Oh? This looks a bit difficult.
The challenger has to make it through a maze of overlapping ropes with bells tied to them, all the while without making a sound.
The staff told me that even if we fail this one, since we cleared the first two games, we'll still get a small gift.
I promised you the grand prize.
I'll wait for you at the finish line.
As Nanoha gracefully slips past the final rope, the game is over.
Woah, you are the best challenger we have had so far today.
While Nanoha was playing, quite a few people gathered around to watch.
I hope it won't cause her any trouble for her mission...
Here is the all-you-can-eat voucher, Master.
Thank you for all your hard work.
Say … got any plan for what comes next?
We are just about done with this expo.
If you've got other things to take care of, Nanoha, go ahead. Don't worry about me.
If you still need me as a cover, we can keep going.
I have nothing else planned for today.
Ah, I shouldn't have asked so directly. I'm sure she's under orders to keep whatever it is secret.
Oh, right—the all-you-can-eat vouchers from the patisserie. Want to go use it together?
Oh wait. She needs to stay here to complete her mission.
Let me think of something else...
The Frees is extremely popular, so there's usually a long queue. I messaged the owner just now and she saved us a spot.
Now we can head over, Master.

strings.text: I follow Nanoha and we head over to Frees Patisserie.
When Nanoha asked me to pose as her employer, I assumed it was for her cover at the expo.
But if she was really on a mission, how could she just leave the expo and come to the patisserie with me?
Please take a look at their menu.
It's hard to choose from all these options!==W== How about you just pick for me, Nanoha?
Understood. One moment, please. I will place the order at the counter.
...==W== Wow, the line keeps getting longer and longer. Business is booming for them.
Terribly sorry for keeping you waiting.
There are quite a few more customers than usual today.
It's a rest day after all.
But you sure have it tough, having to work on weekends.
You hired me as a part of a Goodwind Homecare mission, didn't you?
To be honest, I'm a little worried. Did I mess up your original plans?
After all, it was me who suggested coming to this patisserie out of the blue.
I'm sorry. I have deceived you.
This commission was a personal one. There is no Goodwind mission.
I'm so sorry I didn't get you anything. But I definitely will make it up to you.
You really don't have to, Master.
Just being able to spend the day with you makes me happy.
A few days ago, I noticed on the calendar that the dessert expo was today...==W== So I used the commission as an excuse to invite you.
Why didn't you just tell me it's your birthday?
Commission or not, I would have come with you.
I didn't want to put any pressure on you.
I hesitated for a long time about whether I should just invite you.
I was afraid I might lose my composure in front of you.
Because you see, I really love ...==W== desserts...
Ah... No wonder you know them all like the back of your hand.
Wait, so you've been holding back this whole time? That must have been tough!
We visited all those booths and you didn't take a single bite.
A maid must have self-restraint in service.
Now that it's all out in the open, you don't have to play the maid anymore.
You should enjoy the rest of the day with me.
Let's celebrate your birthday together!==W== You sit here and wait for me!
I go to the counter and pick out a birthday cake for Nanoha.
There's a cake and candle. I even borrowed a lighter from the owner.
Now we are ready to go.
Are these ...==W== what people use to celebrate birthdays?
Eh? You've never celebrated your birthday before, Nanoha?
Never. This is the first time.
Goodwind ninjas don't usually celebrate birthdays. I found out my own birth date only recently.
No worries. I'll teach you. It's easy.
First, eating a birthday cake is a must.
Now that we have the cake, the next step is lighting the candle.
It is not yet night time. Why are we lighting the candle?
Place the lit candle on the cake, close your eyes, and pray with your hands together. Then blow out the candle to seal your wish.
Imagine the scene, Nanoha. Doesn't it feel a lot like making a wish to a Monolith?
The long candle represents the sky-reaching Monolith...==W== Oh, I get it now—what an interesting tradition!
I've had plenty of cakes before, but this is my first time having a birthday cake.
Thank you so much, Boss. Now I know how to do birthdays.
Alright, let's begin. Think about the wish you are going to make.
I've never blown out birthday candles before.  ==W==It's kind of ... ==W==strange.
Aw! ==W==I was so nervous, I forgot... ==W==I guess I can do it now, ==W==right?
Aw! ==W==I was so nervous, I forgot... ==W==I guess I can do it now, right?
My wish is... ==W====W==I hope every birthday ==W==can be just like today...
If you tell me, maybe I can help
Oh, ==W==you've done more than enough to make me happy today. ==W====W==I couldn't possibly ask for more.
Please, don't worry about me. ==W==I'm going to work hard ==W==to make my own wishes come true.==W==
Please, don't worry about me. ==W==I'm going to work hard ==W==to make my own wishes come true.
Nanoha shares her birthday cake with you—it's the sweetest thing you've had all day.

strings.text: No one mentioned that a Freelance Trekker also has to write papers!
Grace Light Academy in Emor is the largest and most prestigious school in Nova.
It's a true breeding ground for the elite and has produced countless famous figures across every industry.
Guess what? I got into Professor Canace's class.
Seriously? That Monolith Studies course everyone's dying to get into—the one with the lottery system?==W== Take me with you, I'm totally sitting in!
Don't you have another class during that time? If you skip and get caught, there goes your participation grade.
Yeah, you're right... Sigh, where's the luck?
Canace sure is popular with the students. Her commission for me...
Sorry to bother you out of the blue, ==PLAYER_NAME==. I'm working on a new paper about the Monolith.
Could you come to campus tomorrow so we could have a chat? I could really use your help.
Can I really be of any help? When I don't even remember who I am?
<size=50>Huh?! You seriously expect me to buy that?</size>
Whether you "buy" it or not, an F is still an F, even if you miss the passing line by just one point.
Yeah, one lousy point! Can't you just let it slide? Having to retake the exam because of one lousy point is just a waste of my time!
Let it slide?==W== If we started bending the rules for things like this, the whole world would've fallen apart by now.
Listen up. The clothes you wear, the customized Artifact vehicle you ride, even the luxury villa you live in...==B== Every one of those was built with strict numerical precision.
Do you really think it is just about adjusting a number? It changes everything here and there.
Who... Who cares about any of that!
Sigh... If you still don't get it after all that, then you're never going to make any progress.
What...!? Do you have any idea who my father is? How dare you talk to me like that!?
Galerius Licinius, a senior manager for Deepsea Finance in Philae.
Though born into a lesser branch of an old family, he built up immense wealth and a reputation to match.
Your father's all the way in Philae and arranged for you to study back home. If he saw you acting like this...
How do you know all that!? You're just a professor—how dare you investigate...!
I know everything about my students, from their daily routines to their family backgrounds. That's what you get from "just a professor."
Besides, you're just a kid who doesn't even know who your own professor is, and you try to throw your family name around to scare people.==W== Such a disgrace to your family name.
She doesn't even need to raise her voice. Her talk has its own strength... So intimidating.
Some people really are a lost cause. Looks like this branch of the Licinius family won't be making a comeback anytime soon...==W== Hmm?
Canace got surrounded by a mob of students!
Could it be that kid from earlier came back for retaliation?==W== I'd better go help—
P-Professor Canace! I'm your biggest, biggest, biggest fan—!!
I can't believe I ran into you here! I didn't get into your course. Would it be possible for you to offer a few more?
Professor Canace! Could I ... have lunch with you?
Professor! I have a question about the Monolith studies. Do you have a minute?
No need to rush~ I'll answer everyone's questions patiently. Please line up first.
Professor! We're freshmen and it's our first time meeting you! Can we get your autograph? Sign our uniforms, please!
Hmm... Sorry, uniform is a no-go, but something like notebooks would be alright...
Yeah, we have notebooks! Here, please!
Ah... And here I thought they came to retaliate. How silly of me.
But with so many people crowding around, there's no way to get close... Guess I'll just have to wait until Canace is done.
Alright, everyone, the next class is about to start. Make sure you make it on time.
With that, all the students start to disperse.
Whew... Even the freshmen showed up this time. Really was a bit too much.
And that's why they call you the most popular professor of Grace Light Academy.
Honestly... teasing others like that isn't very nice, you know?==W== But never mind. Since you're here, let's head to my office and get down to business.
I'll try to make it short.
I asked for you because I wanted your help with writing this—
"An Investigation and Theoretical Model of Magic Flow inside the Monolith"?
Yes, I'm studying the flow of magic inside the Monolith, hoping to build a basic model. But there are some data that are difficult to obtain, so all I have right now is a draft.
"When a Trekker uses magic inside the Monolith, does the total amount of magic in the world actually decrease"...? I don't really get it.
You know me—I'm insulated from all magic effects. I know nothing about it.
And that is exactly what I need from you. I've designed a magic circle to measure magic flow inside the Monolith, but my own magic always interferes in the measurement process.
So, if you come with me to the Monolith and activate the circle using this magic scroll, it'll keep other people's magic, including my own, from interfering with the results.
Hmm... That's fine but... I can't handle Stellaroids on my own.
Don't worry, I'll clear out all the Stellaroids on that floor ahead of time.==W== With me there, nothing will touch you.
I may be just a professor, but I do know several powerful attack spells. I regularly take dozens of students into the Monolith for fieldwork.
So dependable. No wonder all your students love you.
Hehehe... I wouldn't go as far as that...
Although... I don't think I've ever heard you mention that you can do attack spells?
Well... How should I put it? Some things are better left off the record. That's why it doesn't show up in any official documents.
Anyway, it's not that I can't fight. And I've got plenty of experience tackling the Monolith.
So put your mind at ease and just stay behind me.
The magic scroll is ready and the circle is set.
So, Canace... I'm counting on you.
Roger that. I'll go deal with the Stellaroids.
HEY, HEY, HEY! You can't sleep here! What about the Stellaroids up ahead?!

Oh... Yeah, now that you mention it...

No, no, I don't blame you at all. Nothing bad happened in the end.
But... Why did you fall asleep like that? Are you not feeling well?
Ahem... Probably just from a serious lack of sleep. I was up all night working on experiments both yesterday and the day before.
Normally, I'd squeeze in a nap whenever I had a chance... But things have been so hectic lately I haven't had a chance.
Now I'm all worried for you...
No matter how busy, you still gotta rest.
Collapsing like that would scare anyone. You could've gotten hurt, especially inside the Monolith with all those Stellaroids around.
Yes, I'll be more careful from now on...==W== B-By the way, you didn't run into any trouble inside the Monolith, did you?
Don't worry. Even without magic, I'm still a capable Trekker. Dodging Stellaroids is no big deal for me.
I see... Sorry for the trouble. Anyway, I'm feeling much better now. Shall we get going?
Hold hold, Canace—where are you going? I think you should get some more rest.
No need, I feel well-rested already. Let's get ready and head back to the Monolith—we can't waste any more time.
Why are you in such a hurry? Is your paper's deadline coming up?
No, this is my personal research. There's no deadline involved.
I really think we should stop for today. You say you're rested, but as far as I can tell, you only slept for two hours.
Speaking from experience, it's not a good idea to head into the Monolith when you're not in good shape. It tends to not end up well.
<size=30>But... I don't want to waste precious time.</size>
Besides, I've already got all the data you wanted.
==PLAYER_NAME==, how did you manage this? With that many Stellaroids in there...

Amazing. Only a truly experienced Trekker could've pulled that off. Thank you so much, ==W====PLAYER_NAME==! Whatever reward you want, just name it—
I don't need any reward, but in exchange, I hope you could tell me...
Why are you in such a hurry with your Monolith research?
Huh? Is it a top secret?
You cannot tell another soul about this. The reason I'm in such a hurry is because...
I don't think the God of Grace exists.==W== Or to be precise, if the God of Grace does exist, it's nothing like what everyone imagines.
Shh, keep your voice down. If anyone else hears it, I'm done for.
Canace quickly covers my mouth with her hand.
Hey now, covering my mouth is one thing, but don't lean your whole body over! I can barely breathe...
Whew, I get it now. That's a pretty heretical idea you've got there.
Hmm, you call yourself "Boss," which used to be "Tyrant," yet you believe in the God of Grace?
I dunno. I never thought about it.
Now that you've got your data, you can catch up on sleep.
Eh?==W== When did you move in front of the desk?
Now that I've got the data, I have to hurry and analyze it. You know, given what I do, the Dusk Arbiters might come at my door any day—
Who could be calling me now...
Hey, this is Canace...==W== Huh? Wow, it's been a while. Yes... That's right...
Canace sounds so different from usual... Who could be calling? It can't be the Dusk Arbiters... Right?
Okay... Okay... I'll see you soon then.
What happened, Canace? You don't look so good. Don't tell me it's really the Dusk Arbiters.
No, not them. I'm fine. I'm... I'm totally calm right now...
Someone who's truly calm never has to say how calm they are... That call wasn't anything bad, was it?
Just old acquaintances coming to visit. So, um, can we wrap up today's commission for now? I'll pay you another day...

Canace ignores me and heads to a corner of the room, quickly throwing together a makeshift changing area with the curtains and a cabinet.
Oh no... Oh no... I'm not gonna make it...!

I won't peek, but can you explain? What's going on exactly—

strings.text: Does anyone still remember we're here to write a paper?
Canace, psyching herself up as she heads out, seems to be talking to someone just outside the door.
Mother... Father... My apologies for making you wait.
I was just discussing important matters with an executive from a certain company. Oh ho ho ho...==W== A thousand apologies for not greeting you sooner...
No, that voice is Canace's, but the tone sounds like someone else entirely. So... She's talking to her parents?
Regardless, the fact is you kept me and your father waiting at the door for six minutes and twenty-one seconds. Your time management leaves much to be desired. Do you understand the value of time?
On top of that, you spent about twenty seconds making excuses for your misbehavior. If you don't have a good reason, this isn't going to end here.
Well...==W== The report on my teaching work was already submitted to the estate three weeks ago.
As for joining the Grace Light Academy Council, there's still no vacancy, but I won't miss any opportunity when it arises.
You think you can get away with an oral report such as this? You're a Metonia. You're always expected to deliver results three times above standard.
Of course, that's assuming you still regard yourself as a Metonia.
Alright, alright love, Canace is an adult now. Let her do what she wants.
After all, you came here just to make sure she's doing well, didn't you?
Looks like Canace's got some family issues. That must be why she was so flustered earlier. Since there's no immediate danger, I should probably head out.
I quietly open the office door, planning to slip out behind Canace.
It's not the best place to talk. Come, Canace, let's go inside your office.
Canace, could it be that you are hiding something from us?
Canace's mother pushes the door wide open with unexpected speed.
Hmm? Did something slam into the door...?
Ouch ouch...==W== H-hello, It's a pleasure to meet you...
Hmph, so Canace's strange behavior today was because of this...==W== Hmm, pardon me, how should I address you? And what exactly is your relationship with my daughter?
That tone... she's definitely taking this the wrong way...
Uh, well... I'm Canace's student. I just came to ask her some questions, I swear—nothing suspicious going on!
A student...?==W== You're not wearing a uniform, and your shoes are covered in mud.
You didn't bow or greet us right away despite our obvious status, but your eyes instinctively went to our arm movements. You're a Trekker, aren't you?
Such sharp insight...!==W== Like daughter, like mother...!
Y-yes, mother, ==SEX== ...==W== is a Trekker who's helping me with my paper. I'm writing a thesis about the Monolith.
As the people in Cangwu would say, "among any three people, one can be my teacher." That's why ==SEX== said ==SEX== was my student.
That explanation's way too forced... Would anyone actually believe that?
I see. One learns something new every day. My apologies. I imagine our daughter has caused you quite a bit of trouble.
They actually bought it!? Well... whatever works.==W== At least I'm off the hook...
I've got to turn this weird atmosphere around, and now's my chance!
Not at all! I should be the one thanking you! Professor Canace has helped me so much!
Oh, right! It's afternoon tea time, isn't it? I'll get everything ready. Please have a seat on the sofa.
Hey, hey—you're a Trekker, not the helper! Don't act like one!
Wait a second, afternoon tea? There's nothing like that in my office... The only thing to drink right now is—
Uh... Looks like there aren't any snacks, I'll just make some tea ...==W== from this Artifact? The smell's pretty unique...==W== I'll just try a small sip first...
(gulp)... Ugh, what a weird taste...==W== Is this really the kind of flavor preference of the upper class?
My apologies for the wait.==W== Please, have some tea.
Why does it feel even more tense than before?! Was it my manners? Was it the serving order? What did I do wrong?!
I've got it! Nobles usually have a servant taste for poison first, right? In that case...
My apologies—I wasn't thinking...==W== Uh... Please allow me to taste for poison first.
Wait, you're not supposed to drink—
Such a weird taste...==W== How can people like this...
Ah... Ah, eeh~ Eeh~? My eyelids ...==W== are getting so heavy...
Hmph. Let's go. I cannot entertain this ridiculous farce any longer.
Leaving already? We've only been here. Next time won't be for another three months, you know.
Staying too long would just give those old foxes something to use against me. I've gotten the answers I came for, there's no reason to linger.
Canaris de Metonia. I'll give you a passing grade, this time.
That's great, Canace...==W== E-even though I don't really get it...==W== She said you ... p-passed... Ugh?!
<size=50>Boss! Come on, snap out of it!</size>
I hear Canace scream, then everything goes black.
Yeah,==W== you passed out right after you drank that tea yesterday.==W== Luckily you didn't get hurt...==W== Gosh,==W== I caused you so much trouble.==W== I'm sorry.
Yeah,==W== you passed out right after you drank that tea.==W== Luckily you didn't get hurt...==W== Gosh,==W== I caused you so much trouble yesterday.==W== I'm sorry.
No, it wasn't a bother at all.
By the way, how long was I out?
Not for very long,==W== it's almost noon now.
A night has passed.==W== It's almost noon now… I think.
Noon?! I didn't hold you up from work, did I...?
Don't worry,==W== it's weekend.==W== There's no one else here but us.
Don't worry,==W== it's the weekend.==W== There's no one else here==W== but us.
And ...==W== actually...==W== Watching you sleep==W== was kind of healing.==W== I didn't feel like it was a hold-up at all...
And...==W== Maybe it's a weird thing to say ...==W== but watching you sleep==W== was kind of fun.
Huh? So you didn't go home last night?
Of course not.==W== This is my responsibility, after all.==W== I couldn't just leave you alone here at the school.==W== So,==W== I just stayed with you overnight.
Of course not.==W== It is my responsibility that things ended up like this.==W== I couldn't just leave you alone here and go home myself.==W== So,==W== I just stayed with you overnight.

Yeah,==W== maybe because I was working on my thesis,==W== time just flew by.==W== Also,==W== thanks to you,==W== the paper was supposed to take three days,==W== but it was pretty much done last night.

Yeah,==W== maybe because I was working on my thesis,==W== time just flew by.==W== Also,==W== the data you collected==W== was very helpful.==W== Thanks to you, the paper was supposed to take three days,==W== but it was pretty much done last night.
You didn't get any sleep all night, did you?
I guess not.==W== By the time I was ready to rest,==W== it was almost eight...==W== So I probably got about...==W== three hours of sleep?
I guess not.==W== By the time I was ready to rest,==W== it was almost eight...==W== So I probably got about ...==W== three hours of sleep?
You were sleeping so soundly next to me,==W== and you had such a nice scent,==W== that I ended up falling asleep without even realizing it...
You were sleeping so soundly next to me,==W== and you had such a nice scent,==W== that I ended up fast asleep.
Oh!==W== Don’t get the wrong idea!==W== You suddenly rolled over==W== and bumped into me,==W== which means==W== that was completely an accident.
Don’t get the wrong idea,==W== it's just that you suddenly rolled over==W== and bumped into me,==W== which means that was completely an accident.
But...==W== you were completely at rest,==W== and holding you felt so reassuring==W== that I just ended up using you as a body pillow...
But… ==W== because holding you felt so reassuring,==W== I just ended up using you as a body pillow.
(She used me as a body pillow?!)
Anyway,==W== I owe you a big thank you.==W== It was definitely the right decision to ask for your help.
Um…==W== Maybe we can go out again sometime.==W== I’m sure it’ll be fun.
If you don't mind,==W== please feel free to drop by.==W== I'd be happy to see you.
Come to think of it...==W== The way you addressed me yesterday sounded a little different from usual...
It's just your imagination. You were exhausted at the time.
No, you definitely called me Boss. You usually just call me by name.
You aren't very convincing, you know...
Wait a second... I remember now—==W==what was that tea of yours? One sip and I was out cold!
That was my special magic sleep tonic. It's meant to improve sleep quality. You drank way too much at once...
That explains it... No wonder I suddenly felt so sleepy...
Then...==W== What was with your outfit and the way you were talking yesterday?
You were just like a noble lady. And your parents, that surname of yours—it's a noble family name, isn't it?
No way! I saw it with my own eyes and heard it with my own ears!
Wait a minute, your mother mentioned a name, Canaris de Metonia...==W== Don't tell me that's your full name?
Anyway... I'm not some noble lady, and I don't have some posh last name. Please, just think of it as a dream you had.
Hmm...==W== I don't quite get it, but it seems like you've got stuff that you can't talk about.
Y-you're really understanding, aren't you... Anyway, please do me a favor and forget all about how awkward I looked in that dress.
Since you put it that way, I'll do my best to forget...==W== But I gotta say, you looked really good in that dress.
Forget that dress!==W== Remember me as I am now.
O-Okay, okay...==W== Alright, I'll try to forget that.
But for one reason or another, Canace ended up wearing that dress in front of me more than once. So instead of forgetting, it's now burned even more clearly onto my memory.

I guess not.==W== By the time I was ready to rest,==W== it was almost eight...==W== So I probably got about ...==W== three hours of sleep?
You were sleeping so soundly next to me,==W== and you had such a nice scent,==W== that I ended up falling asleep without even realizing it...
You were sleeping so soundly next to me,==W== and you had such a nice scent,==W== that I ended up fast asleep.
Oh!==W== Don’t get the wrong idea!==W== You suddenly rolled over==W== and bumped into me,==W== which means==W== that was completely an accident.
Don’t get the wrong idea,==W== it's just that you suddenly rolled over==W== and bumped into me,==W== which means that was completely an accident.
But...==W== you were completely at rest,==W== and holding you felt so reassuring==W== that I just ended up using you as a body pillow...
But… ==W== because holding you felt so reassuring,==W== I just ended up using you as a body pillow.
(She used me as a body pillow?!)
(She used me as a body pillow?!)
Anyway,==W== I owe you a big thank you.==W== It was definitely the right decision to ask for your help.
Anyway,==W== I owe you a big thank you.==W== It was definitely the right decision to ask for your help.
Um…==W== Maybe we can go out again sometime.==W== I’m sure it’ll be fun.
If you don't mind,==W== please feel free to drop by.==W== I'd be happy to see you.
Come to think of it...==W== The way you addressed me yesterday sounded a little different from usual...
It's just your imagination. You were exhausted at the time.
No, you definitely called me Boss. You usually just call me by name.
It's just your imagination. You were exhausted at the time.
You aren't very convincing, you know...
Wait a second... I remember now—==W==what was that tea of yours? One sip and I was out cold!
That was my special magic sleep tonic. It's meant to improve sleep quality. You drank way too much at once...
That explains it... No wonder I suddenly felt so sleepy...
Then...==W== What was with your outfit and the way you were talking yesterday?
You were just like a noble lady. And your parents, that surname of yours—it's a noble family name, isn't it?
It's just your imagination. You were exhausted at the time.
No way! I saw it with my own eyes and heard it with my own ears!
It's just your imagination. You were exhausted at the time.
Wait a minute, your mother mentioned a name, Canaris de Metonia...==W== Don't tell me that's your full name?
Anyway... I'm not some noble lady, and I don't have some posh last name. Please, just think of it as a dream you had.
Hmm...==W== I don't quite get it, but it seems like you've got stuff that you can't talk about.
Y-you're really understanding, aren't you... Anyway, please do me a favor and forget all about how awkward I looked in that dress.
Since you put it that way, I'll do my best to forget...==W== But I gotta say, you looked really good in that dress.
Forget that dress!==W== Remember me as I am now.
O-Okay, okay...==W== Alright, I'll try to forget that.
But for one reason or another, Canace ended up wearing that dress in front of me more than once. So instead of forgetting, it's now burned even more clearly onto my memory.

strings.text: There's no age requirement for being a forest guardian.
This is Eaze Village, a small settlement tucked away from both the city and the Wilds.
For Trekkers looking to relax without diving straight into a city,==RT==this place is the perfect vacation spot.
A cool breeze, gentle sunlight… ==RT====W==The air is filled with the scent of wheat and the earthy smell of fresh soil.
This feels so nice...==RT==It'd be amazing to just fall asleep here, like I'm lying on a soft, fluffy cloud...
Just then, my fingertips brush against something soft and fluffy.==RT==It's too warm to be a cloud, though—
Oh, it's you, Little Coco.==W== Aren't you supposed to be with Ann?
What’s going on? Where are you taking me?==W== Looks like you're trying to lead me to her.
Alright, alright.==RT==I'll go with you, just stop pulling on me like that.
Huff... Huff...==RT====W==Is Ann really out here in the middle of this forest...?
I follow Coco, pushing aside layers of thicket. Suddenly a small patch of flat grass opens up before me.==RT====B==And...
She's really sleeping out here, huh.
Ann is sleeping on the grass alongside a group of small animals. It's a scene that feels straight out of a fairy tale picture book.
But she might catch a cold from sleeping out here.
Hey~ Little Ann, time to wake up.
Mmm...==W== Bubble, you need to behave when I'm napping...
You awake now? Good morning, Little Ann.
Am I dreaming?==RT====W==Wait, I'm not dreaming! Bossy? <size=40>Bossy? <size=45>Bossy, <size=50>Bossy! <size=55>Bossy~!
Whoa ...==RT====W==Don't just jump at me like that. I almost didn't catch you!
But somehow, you always catch me just right and make me feel safe!
That's why I just wanna cuddle with you, Bossy!
Waaah! It's you, Bossy! You came to play with me!
Ann, have you been good these days...==W==<size=50> Wahh!
That's why I said it's dangerous. I can't promise to catch you every single time.
Don't tell me you are mad at me... Aren't you?
No, I'm not mad. It's just I don't want to get you hurt.==RT====W==Remember to give me a heads-up before you jump at me next time, okay?
Ah... Okay!==RT====W==Next time I'll shout really loud so you can hear me from super far away!
I didn't forget, Coco. You don't need to remind me.
That it's almost time for the forest patrol.==RT==Don't worry, I remember. Coco, you worry too much.
You mean your daily routine? If so, count me in, too.
Bossy wants to come along?==W== Oh yeah, let’s go!
Hold my hand, okay? The forest is big and we don't want you to get lost.
Bossy, be careful! There are lots of bad guys around here!
I follow carefully behind Ann.==RT==The deeper we go into the forest, the more beautiful the scenery becomes, but my attention is occupied elsewhere.
Because I can sense it: there's something dangerous hanging in the air between the trees, sending a chill down my spine.
What's wrong, Bossy? ==RT====W==Wait... Did you sense that too?
Huh? No. What are you talking about?
No need to hide it from me.==RT==Don't worry, I've set up plenty of traps all through this forest!
Ann picks up a stone by her feet and tosses it onto an area seemingly clear ahead. A large net instantly springs up from beneath the grass.
Wow... I had no idea there was a net hidden underneath all that...==RT==Would have totally fell for that.
I made this trap myself. It's caught plenty of bad guys. Coco and I chased every last one of them out of the forest.
I patrol every day to make sure there aren't any bad guys around. But some of the old traps are broken, so I need to find and fix them while I'm out here.==W== Got it, Bossy?
Old traps...==W== Wait, Ann, are you telling me you made all the traps inside this forest?
I'm good but I'm not that good!
Those traps were set up by the Eaze Village Adventurers.==RT==Back then, there were lots and lots of people on the squad. It wasn't always just me!
Granny Enya taught everyone how to hide traps with branches and leaves. Nalan could run fast and jump high, so he was in charge of setting up all the moving mechanisms.
Little Pea was great at drawing and could turn realistic pictures into cleverly disguised traps.==RT==And Uncle Mike could fix anything—whenever a mechanism broke, he'd always get it working again.
We used to build traps together to keep out dangerous monsters and stop those masked bad guys from sneaking into the forest.
But eventually...==W== The squad got smaller and smaller. Some said "see you tomorrow" but never came back.==RT==Before I knew it, I was the only one left...
I heard that they went off to live in the city. But I just don't understand. Why does everyone end up leaving their homes? Are they never coming back...?
Instead of giving my answer, I crouch down and steady Ann's little straw hat before it slips off.
The answer to that question is something that you'll have to find out for yourself, once you grow up.
So no point in hurrying to find out. And even without your teammates, Ann, you’re strong enough to keep going, right?
I pat Ann's head again. She tries to act all grown-up and serious, but her tail gives away everything she's feeling.
Stay here and don't move, Ann.
I walk toward the spot where Coco is keeping watch. It's a patch of leaves stained with some kind of red liquid.
Looks like what Coco's wary of is whatever's hiding behind that thicket.
I move in front of Ann and carefully push aside the branches.==RT====W==Hiding there is something unbelievably massive—

strings.text: Trap handling, medicine grinding, wound treatment, animal communication... Don't be surprised—these are all required courses.
That's ... a Bark Boar.==RT==And judging by its size and scars, it's likely an Overlord-class beast.
It's the powerful monster that rules over this part of the forest.
Uh... I don't really get it...==W== You mean it's like the "big boss," right?
You're a smart one, Ann. You can think of it that way, yes.==RT==Bottom line, it's a very dangerous creature. We should get away.
For now, let's make a careful retreat to the village, tell everyone to get ready, and then contact the Association for help.
It's okay, Bossy. No need to go to all that trouble! Coco and I can handle it ourselves!
Besides, it's my duty to protect the forest and everyone in it!
But even several elite Trekkers won't be able to handle that beast.
We've already marked where it showed up. The right thing to do now is retreat carefully,==W== then organize a proper hunting party...
To make sure no one wanders in by mistake, we'll also need to put up warning signs around here...==W== Hey, are you even listening, Ann?
It's fine, Coco. Let me talk with him.
Um, Mr. Big Boar...?==W== I'm Ann, and I'm not a bad person. I'm the captain of the forest scout squad.
"Is a captain tasty?"==W== Of course not! A captain is just like you—the boss of everyone!
I think you might need help. Can I come a little bit closer?
Don't worry. I'm not going to hurt you.==RT==Let me see where are you hurting, okay?
Mm, mm... Yeah, that's right... Just a second.
Mm... I see... Just like I thought. Thanks, I get it now.
Don't be scared. Bossy is a good friend of mine. Bossy won't hurt you.
I understand everything now.==RT==It's all right. I'll help you.
So it's true. I've heard that Flufla can communicate with monsters...==RT==But it's my first time seeing it in person.
As long as you're not hurt... Can you tell me what the boar said to you, Ann?
Hmm... He said a lot. Bossy, which part do you want to hear?
Nothing. I was just worried it might have said something mean.
I quote: "You potato-on-legs! I'm gonna hoe you straight into the dirt!"
But it was so agitated just a moment ago. Why is it so calm all of a sudden?
Because he listened to me and now he knows that you and I aren't baddies.
I told him that we don't mean him harm.==RT==Besides, Mr. Big Boar didn't come to the forest to cause trouble.
I see...==RT==Then why did it come to this forest in the first place?
Are you still hurting...? I'm sorry. I'll get you treated right away!
Bossy, let's head to my secret base first. Mr. Big Boar is hurt, and I need some stuff to treat him.
Following Ann's lead, we come up to an old, abandoned cabin along the path we came from.
So this is your secret base? I thought it was just an abandoned old house.
Uncle Mike used to live here.
After he let us have the house, we all gathered some tools and built a secret hideout together.
Ah, I see. So it's a place full of memories.
Yeah, you can really tell a lot of this was handmade.
Isn't this a bit too intense for kids?
Help—==W== Me— ==W== Ugh! I can't reach it!
Don't move, don't move. This glass jar, right? I'll get it.==RT==It's dangerous, you know. Don't try to do it alone.
I usually do all things by myself. Just couldn't find the ladder today, that's all.
Mmm… I want to grow up fast!
...==W== Once you really grow up, you won't think that anymore.
So what's inside this jar? Herbs?
Yep! I go up the mountain every week to gather some and keep it stored, just in case something like this happens.
As Ann speaks, she grabs a mortar, pestle, and a stool. She climbs up the stool and starts grinding the herbs. She looks so practiced, one can't help but wonder how many times she's done this before.
Little jar spins and twirls, three to the left, three to the right~==RT==Marigold hops with joy, angelica laughs in powdery light~
Little mortar rings ding-dong; in spring we grind cloud, in fall it's frost~==RT==Mint leaves has the cool breath, honeysuckle a soothing gust~
Heave-ho...==W== Here we go! Just rub this on the wound and it'll heal up in no time.
Bossy, let's hurry and take the medicine to him~
Thanks for waiting, Mr. Big Boar! This might sting a little. Stay still, okay?
I told you to stay still! I've only got this much medicine left—if it's not enough, it's going to keep hurting!
That's better. Hang in there, it'll feel better in no time~
What a sight... A massive beast that even elite Trekkers couldn't handle, tamed by a little girl...
All right! You can get up and walk around now, but don't force yourself, okay?
No need to thank me. Just doing what I'm supposed to.
Mm! Your wound's all taken care of, so it's about time to say goodbye!
Since we're friends now, make sure to come by often from now on.
Why are you suddenly hiding behind me, Ann? That's not how you say goodbye.
N-no reason! No peeking, Bossy! And ...==W== Mr. Big Boar, take care of yourself too, okay...?
Wait a second, is it going the wrong way? That direction leads deeper into the forest.
When I was saying goodbye to Mr. Big Boar, I could feel he wanted to say something. ==W== He must've known his time is almost up... That's why he came here.
There used to be some small animals in the forest who'd play with me, but sometimes, without saying a word, they'd just suddenly stop coming around... Back then, I never really understood why.
Eventually people in Eaze told me, "They've left forever."
I ... I remember hearing the grown-ups in the village say it before, but I never really understood what the words meant.
I have thought about it and thought about it, but I still don't get it.
So Bossy, could you tell me?
What does it mean to "leave forever"?

strings.text: When something doesn't make sense, get some sleep first. One day, you'll understand.
What does it mean to "leave forever"?
A breeze drifts through. It's as if it has blown away all the earlier noise, leaving only the rustling of leaves behind.
I must answer her properly, but how should I phrase it...?
What do you think it means, Ann?
Hmm... I'm not really sure. Maybe they just went somewhere far away?
Answering with a question feels like shirking my responsibilities. After all, this is something one has to face as part of growing up.
I can't try to get out of it... I have to answer her question honestly!
I'm sorry, Ann, but the answer to that question runs a bit long...
Let's sit under that tree and talk about it.
Under the tree's thick branches, I stare in the direction the Bark Boar had wandered off to. After a moment of thought, I pick up a fallen leaf.
Ann, do you know where do these leaves come from?
Well...==W== First there's a seed, then a sapling, and when the sapling grows into a big tree, it falls from the tree...?
And where do the leaves go, in the end?
There will be lots and lots of leaves, piled up...==W== And then ... I don't know...
Every leaf has its own journey. Most will break down into the soil, helping new seeds sprout and grow into the next generation of great trees.
They turn into soil ... and help other trees grow?
Yes. Those who have left forever are like the fallen leaves. Does that make sense?
Once they lose their shape, fallen leaves might look like they're "gone," but they're still close by, sometimes even becoming part of a brand-new tree.
They are still close by ... as a part of a brand-new tree.
Yeah, it's not just true for trees and leaves. Animals ... and people are the same way.
Your forest friends "left" for all kinds of reasons and never came back... But in their own way, they're still with you.
That's right. Because you still remember all those friends who "left," don't you?
As long as you don't forget them, they'll always be with you, just like fallen leaves that turn into soil and stay with the trees.
"Leaving" just means they've changed form. You may not see your friends the way you used to, and that can feel lonely...
However, as long as you remember what they were like, you'll always feel their presence somehow... At least, that's what I believe.
"Leaving" just means they've changed form... But...==W== Um...
Uh oh, I might've used a hard metaphor.==RT==Was that a little too complicated for Ann...?
It's okay. Even if you don't completely understand it right now, you will, bit by bit, as you grow up.
Right now you're like a little sapling, still hasn't grown to your fullest. But one day, you'll for sure feel the presence of your friends around you.
Yeah! I'll eat lots of food and grow up so fast!
That's right, Ann. You have to eat properly or you won't grow.
Wow...! Oh my, bad Coco! You eat too much!
If you eat too much, you'll just grow into a ball instead of growing up!
Looks like it's been a long, tiring day. Let's head back to the village and get some sleep.
Well...==W== I think you might be tired too, Bossy! We should rest here first before going back to the village!
True that. Very thoughtful of you, Ann. Let's lie down and rest here for a bit.
What is it, Ann? Didn't you want to nap?
Haha.==RT==Sleeping while talking nonsense with eyes wide open—Ann really is something else.
Y-yeah! I can sleep with my eyes open, so sleeping like this is no problem at all!
No way! That kind of stuff only happens in fiction.

Zzzz ... Coco! No eating my snacks...

param: When something doesn't make sense, get some sleep first. One day, you'll understand.
What does it mean to "leave forever"?
A breeze drifts through. It's as if it has blown away all the earlier noise, leaving only the rustling of leaves behind.
I must answer her properly, but how should I phrase it...?
What do you think it means, Ann?
Hmm... I'm not really sure. Maybe they just went somewhere far away?
Answering with a question feels like shirking my responsibilities. After all, this is something one has to face as part of growing up.
I can't try to get out of it... I have to answer her question honestly!
I'm sorry, Ann, but the answer to that question runs a bit long...
Let's sit under that tree and talk about it.
Under the tree's thick branches, I stare in the direction the Bark Boar had wandered off to. After a moment of thought, I pick up a fallen leaf.
Ann, do you know where do these leaves come from?
Well...==W== First there's a seed, then a sapling, and when the sapling grows into a big tree, it falls from the tree...?
And where do the leaves go, in the end?
There will be lots and lots of leaves, piled up...==W== And then ... I don't know...
Every leaf has its own journey. Most will break down into the soil, helping new seeds sprout and grow into the next generation of great trees.
They turn into soil ... and help other trees grow?
Yes. Those who have left forever are like the fallen leaves. Does that make sense?
Once they lose their shape, fallen leaves might look like they're "gone," but they're still close by, sometimes even becoming part of a brand-new tree.
They are still close by ... as a part of a brand-new tree.
Yeah, it's not just true for trees and leaves. Animals ... and people are the same way.
Your forest friends "left" for all kinds of reasons and never came back... But in their own way, they're still with you.
That's right. Because you still remember all those friends who "left," don't you?
As long as you don't forget them, they'll always be with you, just like fallen leaves that turn into soil and stay with the trees.
"Leaving" just means they've changed form. You may not see your friends the way you used to, and that can feel lonely...
However, as long as you remember what they were like, you'll always feel their presence somehow... At least, that's what I believe.
"Leaving" just means they've changed form... But...==W== Um...
Uh oh, I might've used a hard metaphor.==RT==Was that a little too complicated for Ann...?
It's okay. Even if you don't completely understand it right now, you will, bit by bit, as you grow up.
Right now you're like a little sapling, still hasn't grown to your fullest. But one day, you'll for sure feel the presence of your friends around you.
Yeah! I'll eat lots of food and grow up so fast!
That's right, Ann. You have to eat properly or you won't grow.
Wow...! Oh my, bad Coco! You eat too much!
If you eat too much, you'll just grow into a ball instead of growing up!
