strings.text: You accept a commission to be Post Haste's special delivery person. What duties await?
Come, Boss. This is our final showdown.
Yup. I won't go easy on you.
Then I will do the countdown.
Ugh, the rain's coming down so hard. I can barely keep my eyes open.
How did it come to this...
Because of a commission, I show up at Post Haste bright and early.
Good morning to you, Boss. ==W==It has been quite some time—I do hope you have been faring well.
What's with the formality? And a full-on hat tip?
Thank you for taking on my commission. With Donna and Teresa away today, you've really helped us out here at Post Haste.
Don't mention it, I'm happy to be your special delivery person. So, what do you need me to do?
Your role will simply be to navigate the delivery routes, and I shall do the rest.
Yes. The highlighted points on the map show where we'll be heading.
I usually deliver letters by bike as it's more efficient. Normally I'd stop to check the map, but today I'm on a tight schedule with much to do, so I'll have to trouble you for directions.
Got it. Let me take a look at the map...==W== We sure are hitting a lot of places.
I did the math last night. I'll be biking a total of 57 kilometers.==W== Not counting the rest stops, it should take about four and a half hours.
It's actually a light day. Normally we're out for five or six hours.
That sounds like a lot of work...==W== But how will I guide you?
Don't tell me you're planning to ride the bike while I run alongside you?
Aha...That would be highly disrespectful … and impractical.
I asked Teresa to make a few modifications to the bike.
...==W== That's just...adding a seat on the back.
With this addition, I can carry a passenger while making deliveries. The back seat gives you a good view for navigation.
I see.==W== Then I'll be counting on you to give me a ride.
You're most welcome. Shall we depart?==B== Just remember to hold on tight when you're on...
Boss, we've arrived.==W== You look rather pale... Are you feeling alright?
It's nothing...==W== Just … feeling a bit ...==W== queasy.
My sincere apologies. I should have thought it out better.
In the future, I could add a sunshade over the back seat to block direct sunlight.
Is it possible that ...==W== you rode the bike too fast?==B== We practically flew down that slope.
Ah. What you say makes sense.==W== And here I thought that downhill was the perfect time to … accelerate.
It's not like you are racing somebody!
Thank you for pointing that out. I shall be extra careful in the future.
I'll go park the bike in the open area over there. Please wait just a moment.
Why is it not moving? Is something stuck? Let me try again...
Judging by the sound, something's broken again.
Again? You mean this has happened before?
Ever since I started using this bicycle, something breaks almost every three days.
Loose chains, bent handlebars, flat tires, broken bells...==W== I'm always troubling Teresa with something that needs to be fixed.
Maybe riding a bicycle is not for me, Boss.
I don't like to ...==W== cause trouble for people.
"Artifacts Jinx Syndrome"... Could that urban legend be real?
They say some people have a peculiar constitution: Artifacts tend to break really easily when they handle them.
It's okay. If it breaks, just fix it.
I'm guessing Teresa's the type who actually enjoys working on bikes?
That is true... She really enjoys taking things apart.
Besides, you are such an excellent bike rider. Don't let your skills go to waste.
I just took a quick look. It's just the chain that came off. Should be fine once it's back on.
Next time...==W== I'll be more careful.

strings.text: Most would agree that dueling with someone wielding an earth-shaking giant axe is a bad idea.
After fixing Freesia's bike, we arrive at a small cottage.
Letter from your mom and dad again.==W== Let me know when you have the reply letter written.
Yup! They'll be back next month to see my sister and me.
By the way, when's our next duel? I can't wait.
Did I hear it wrong...? Freesia is going to have a duel with this little girl?
Ahem...==W== Let's talk about that another time.
I've got a lot of letters to deliver today. See you later.
Bye, Miss Freesia! I'll be waiting!
Auntie Helen. It's Freesia, I have a letter for you.
Thanks for putting up with me. My legs aren't great, so you always have to come inside.
It's nothing. Just doing my job.
I haven't thanked you properly for last time.
Everyone says you're amazing. Even the kids next door are pretending to "duel" just like you.
It was just a regular duel... Thank you for your kind words.
Thanks to you, it's been peaceful.
What are they talking about...? I'll just ask Freesia about it later.
Boss, do you want to rest for a bit?
With your help, deliveries have been way more efficient. We should be able to wrap up early today.
==W==<size=50>You! Get out of here! You hear me?
==W==<size=50>I ain't leaving until you give me what's mine!
What's all the fuss down there? Is someone arguing?
Looks like it. There's a crowd gathered at the shop over there.
You guys be the judge! I used to work here and the owner still owes me three months' pay.
Every time I ask him for it, he says he's short on cash and can't keep the business afloat.
But yesterday, I ran into him at a fancy restaurant downtown.
I'm a waiter there. He ordered a whole table's worth of stuff! That bill alone could've covered everything he owed me!
I told you! You've got the wrong person! Who's to say you actually saw me there? Got any proof?
If you keep making a scene and the shop loses business, you can kiss your money goodbye for good.
I...==W== I'll sue you! I'll take you to court!
Hah! Do you have any idea how much it costs to take someone to court? You couldn't afford it even with a year's worth of your wages.
Boss, I want to help her.
But I'm worried that if I step in, I might just make things worse.
You won't. At the very least, it'll show her that someone's willing to stand by her.
We can think of something together.
That pocket square in the boss's jacket looks awfully familiar...==W== Ah, I remember now.
Such fine observation! Just as expected from the Boss.
With that key piece of evidence, there's no way he's getting out of this.
Sir, deliberately withholding wages from your employees is a serious violation of the law.
I urge you to settle this as soon as possible. Otherwise, you could be facing even more serious legal consequences.
Who are you? Mind your own business!
Who I am doesn't matter. What matters is that I have enough evidence to prove you've been deliberately withholding her back pay.
The embroidery on your pocket square is the logo of Tosca's.
I happen to know that pocket square is only given to customers who've spent a certain amount at the restaurant.
That's true... I've seen the ads. That place is really expensive.
What a disgusting man. I'm never setting foot in his shop again.
Utter nonsense! You've not only dragged my name through the mud but ruined my shop's reputation, too!
Duel...==W== I demand a duel with you!
Is this "duel" that they keep mentioning always this dangerous?
Very well.==W== I accept your challenge.
They are gonna duel! A duel is happening!
Please don't... I don't want to drag you all into this.
Freesia, are you going to be okay? Be careful!
I will be fine. Please trust me.
Everyone, please maintain a safe distance. I wish to prevent any unnecessary injuries.
What a joke—you're not gonna injure anyone.
Hey, w-wait a minute, I changed my mind...
After that, the shop owner admits defeat and pays every Dorra he owes without complaints.
The employee treats Freesia and me to lunch to show her thanks.

strings.text: New memories are made, and the girl, troubled by her past, finds her rock.
In the afternoon, we finish delivering the rest of the letters one by one, then take a break on a bench by the roadside near Post Haste.
I wasn't sure what kind of snacks you like, so I picked up a bit of everything.
Sorry about today. So many unexpected things came up.
Not at all. You were amazing, Freesia.
When you two said you were going to duel, I was seriously worried.
Dueling was the easiest solution given the situation.
He was the one who challenged me, I just accepted.
By the way, Aoi and Auntie Helen also mentioned "duels"—what exactly are they?
Aoi skipped class to hang out with her sister, and I happened to catch them.
They refused to go back to class, so I challenged them to a "Marble Champion Showdown" duel.
Yes. I won fair and square and they promised me they'd never skip class again.
And I promised them that as long as they behaved, we could hang out and play it again.
So that's why she was so keen on having another duel with you... ==W==What about the duel Auntie Helen mentioned?
That was with a giant boar.
It probably ran out from the nearby forest and wandered into Auntie Helen's yard.
I was hoping to talk things out with it, but it refused to listen to reason.
So I challenged it to a duel. It lost and I dragged it back into the forest.
I can't believe you took down a wild boar so easily...
No wonder everyone's so grateful. You're such a great help to them.
When Aoi mentioned the duel earlier, you looked so nervous. I thought it was some kind of big secret.
… S-sorry, I didn't mean to hide it from you.
I was worried that hearing about the duel might make you think poorly of me ...==W== or Post Haste.
Most people, when they first hear about it, think it's some kind of barbaric practice.
I've heard a bit about the old "Trial by Dueling" tradition myself. Settling things like that is actually pretty effective.
Besides, you don't duel for selfish purposes. You do it to help people.
Still, it was terribly improper of me to duel in front of you.
When I'm in a duel... I've been told… I can get pretty scary.
Even if I said I wouldn't think that, Freesia would probably just assume I was trying to make her feel better.
...==W== Ah, there's only one piece of snack left.
I'll leave this one for you, Freesia.
No... Please, Boss, you should be the one to enjoy it.
A divergence of opinions... ==W==We need a way to settle this.
The winner gets to decide who can have the final piece of snack.
The duel is in the form of a marble game, with both sides in full agreement.
Let me see how good you are, Freesia.
Very well, Boss. I'm going to give it my best shot.
Just a drizzle. It should stop soon.
Do you want to go back first and duel after the rain?
No, thank you.==W== A duel in the rain is more exciting.
Come, Boss. This is our final showdown.
Yup. I won't go easy on you.
Then I will do the countdown.
My last shot! Here it comes!
The marble streaks low and fast, carving a perfect arc as it races straight toward its target.
Thank you for the challenge. Say, you don't look that different when you are dueling, Freesia.
Just a little more serious than usual.
Boss, I know what you're trying to do. You didn't have to.
It was never about winning the duel for you, was it?
You saw right through it, huh?
But I swear, I never underestimated you. I gave it everything I had.
Same here. It was an honor to duel with you.
Since the decision is mine to make, I want you to have the last piece of snack.
And as agreed, I shall accept it.
As Freesia heads upstairs to change, I sit down on the living room sofa by myself.
Brr, I'm freezing soaked through. Guess I'll just have to wait for my clothes to dry.
Kinda sleepy from running around all day...
Boss,==W== please wake up.==W== I brought you some dry clothes.==W== You should change out of those wet ones.
With this weather,==W== you could easily catch a cold if you stay in soaked clothes.==W==
With this weather,==W== you could easily catch a cold if you stay in soaked clothes.
Oh, it's fine... Don't worry about me
I really appreciate all your help today.==W== I'd feel terrible==W== if you were to fall ill because of me.==W==
I didn't really do much … honestly
You were always there for me today,==W== delivering letters, supporting my duel,==W== and playing marbles with you.
Still...==W== I honestly didn't expect you ==W==to dive in to those "childish games" quite so enthusiastically. ==W==You were really good at them, too!==W==
If anything, I should be the one thanking you
Aw, thanks.==W== But ... it looks like the rain is picking up, doesn't it?
The truth is...==W== I don't have very fond memories of rainy days. ==W==Just the sound of it seems to weigh on my heart.==W==
Does the rain still bother you?

Not anymore,==W== because I've made a new memory.==W== Starting tomorrow,==W== when it rains again,==W== the first thing I'll think of ...==W== is this night with you—==W==steady and unshakable==W== in my heart.
If I can do that, who knows? ==W==I might learn to even like rainy days. ==W==So, again... ==W==Thank you.==W==
If I can do that, who knows? ==W==I might learn to even like rainy days. ==W==So, again... ==W==Thank you.
Oh my. ==W==Your hair's all damp. ==W====W==Stay still, please, and let me dry it for you.
The rain didn't stop that night.==B== It lashed and the wind howled outside, but Post Haste stood firm, offering warmth and shelter for Freesia and me.

strings.text: The grand stage of the Magician Maximus—today, you're the guest of honor.
Ozora Production is the top talent company in Flavio, a city where the entertainment industry is thriving.
The city's most iconic show, "Flame Illusion," is performed by Flora, a magician who also leads the guild.
Alright, everyone—let's party till we drop! Ready~♪
As the magician calls out and streamers burst into the air, flames flicker at her fingertips, blurring the line between illusion and reality.
Like tamed spirits, they traced blazing arcs across the sky before blooming into brilliant flowers, turning the whole stage into a garden of flames.
Wow...! Flora really is the top magician in Nova...! She's like the second coming of the legendary <r=Celine Robert></r>magician!
Hehe. Honestly, Grandpa. You're getting so excited!==RT==You saw Flora's performance just last year, didn't you?
That's right. Could you tone it down a bit? You're going to bother everybody else...
With flawless stage control and a performance like a dream, it’s a one-of-a-kind rendition that no one could ever reproduce.
She really lives up to her hype.
Just as my mind spins between the dazzling spectacle and the quiet thrill of getting so lucky to attend the show, ==W==a woman quietly takes the seat beside me.
The show's almost over. Why is she only showing up now?
Please remain quiet during the performance. For now, let's just lose ourselves in this world of flame and light.
She's saying the most cringy lines with such a deadpan voice ...
Today's complimentary ticket was tucked inside the letter she sent to me.

==A-1==Dear Boss:==P====RT====RT====A-1==Next weekend at 7 PM, West End Theater, Flavio—I shall be waiting for you.==RT==Ozora Production extends you the warmest welcome.==P====RT====RT====A-1==                                                            　　　                    Vanny
It's thanks to her that I got to enjoy such a magical night.==RT==So I guess there's nothing to complain about...
<size=50>==W==Hey—! What's going on here? Why's it so packed here?!
You can't come in! The show's not over yet! Please keep your voices down ... Or leave the venue!
Did I say you could talk? Where's this month's front maintenance fee? With business this good, don't tell me you're short on cash.
I'm really sorry—==W==Wait, no! The fee for this month...?! Didn't we just pay it in full a few days ago?!
Huh? You saying I'm trying to scam you now? If you paid it off, where's the proof?
Are they arguing over money? I probably can't do much to help… But let me go see what's going on.
One moment. Please stay here and watch.
Looks like a fight's about to break out...
Should I stay in my seat or make a run for it?
They are actually special assistants for tonight's grand finale illusion! Sorry if they scared you!
Hey, you up there on the stage! Didn't you hear me?! You've got some nerve—
Then ... ==W==Here we go! The Flame Illusion Show! Hope you all enjoy!

The moment Flora waves her wand, a dazzling burst of light erupts. Dreamlike smoke and rainbow flames instantly sweep across the entire theater. Her clear, ringing voice and upbeat music rise together—
And that's a wrap for today's grand finale—"The Art of Binding!" Thank you all for coming, and see you next time!
Amid thunderous applause and a shower of flying bouquets, Flora keeps smiling and waving, right up until the curtain slowly falls.
Heh. Commission completed, perfectly done ... That's Flora for you.
We took on a commission from the theater owner. It was to teach a lesson to those thugs who keep causing trouble.
I see. That's the kind of job only Ozora Production—well-traveled and experienced across Nova continent—would be trusted to handle.
Amid cheers and applause loud enough to shake the roof, just as the stage curtain is about to close completely—
Oh my~ You over there, little cutie~ Something on your mind?
U-Um ... ==W==Thank you so much for showing us such amazing magic today...!
I'm so glad you enjoyed it. I should be the one thanking you for all your support!
Hehe. Even the flame butterflies are saying "thank you" to you too♪
One of the flame butterflies from the stage lands gently in the girl's hand. The next moment, it turns into a flower.
A little gift for you—hope you'll come see the show again next time!
Even after all that, she handled the enthusiastic crowd with such ease. She really is a top performer.
Pretty impressive, right? She has a natural connection with the audience. No wonder everyone loves her.
That's why she's the ace of Ozora Production.
Now that I think about it ... You worked that whole gate-crash with the thugs right into the show. Don't tell me it was all planned from the very start?
Thanks for the kind words ... But it wasn't quite like that. I was startled, too, when they suddenly barged in.
I had no idea how Flora planned to handle it ... But turning even something that unexpected into part of the show ... That's genius, right there.
Graceful as always. What do you think, Boss?
An incredible performance. I was completely drawn in.
Thanks, Boss! Vanny, thank you, too, for helping with the invitation.
It's been a while, Boss! How are you?
Y-Yeah ... It's been so long since we last saw each other...
It's still a little nerve-wracking, being face-to-face with such a big star.
I first met Flora when I happened to catch one of her shows during her world tour.
I was chosen as the "Audience Member of the Day" and went on the stage to help with the performance.
Since our on-stage interaction was so well-received, ==RT==she started inviting me to be her assistant whenever there was a major performance.
Are you asking me to be your partner again? If so, can we maybe have a bit more rehearsal time this time around...?
You guessed it~! ==W==Though I'd love to say that, that's not the case this time.
<size=35>To be honest, I'm still debating if I should ask you to help with something so personal...
Hmm...? If you find it hard to say in person, you can also message me.
It's not really anything embarrassing or secret, just ... ==W==Uh...
Anyway, could you wait a moment? I need to head backstage and change. Meanwhile...==W== Vanny, could you please keep Boss company?
Why is she beating around the bush like this?
I know. After all, in a way, I'm involved too.

strings.text: A chance to be a big star's personal assistant—better make the most of it.
After passing through the grand lobby, I follow the directions Fannie gave me and arrive at the door.
I wonder what kind of impossible commission this is going to be ...
For these next few days ... ==W==I'm counting on you to look after Flora!
Yes, literally. I hope you will take care of Flora. I've got something important to take care of, so I'll be away for a few days.
So, I need you to be Flora's magician's assistant while I'm gone.
A magician's assistant, huh? I get it. But does an assistant really need to "look after" the magician? And would a magician actually need looking after?
Normally, no; but Flora's situation is a bit unique ...==RT====W==I usually live with her.
You mentioned before that you two are sisters.==RT====W==Wait, I'll need live with her?
Yeah, normally I'm the only one who can really handle this job. But Flora said to me, "Boss should be able to do it."
Hold on, wait! I don't actually know how to do magic. I've just been on stage as a helper before. Can I really be her assistant?
Of course. You and no one else.
Flora's unique magic show ideas flow from her "unconventional personality" ...==RT==To spark her creativity, her assistant has to be someone she trusts completely.
That unconventionality might be a plus for her performances and creativity, but in everyday life ... not so much.
If her fans ever saw her like in daily life ... They would get disenchanted with her.==RT==So, now you get why it has to be someone she absolutely trusts, right?
Alright, hearing all this actually makes me a little curious.
You will be well-compensated. Just please take care of my sister!
Since I've already agreed, there's no way I can back out now.
Now that I think about it, Fannie gave me a note earlier that said ... ==W=="Please help put out fires"?
Well, she is a magician who works with fire, so a reminder to watch out for fires actually makes sense ...
I knock the door but get no response.
It's getting close to noon. Even a late rise ought to be up by now ...
That sounds like Flora?! What's happening?!
And there's a burnt smell in the air ... I really hope nothing's wrong ...
I dig out the spare key Fannie gave me. Letting myself in without warning feels wrong—but this is an emergency. The door clicks open, and I step inside without wasting a second.
<size=50>Help, aaaaaah—!==RT==The fire won't stop! Please, tell me how to put it out ... !
Alright, leave it to me!==RT====W==...==W==Uh, isn't it as easy as turning the switch off?
Wow, amazing—it really went out! Thank you, you saved me ... !
There's a frying pan on the now-off stove. All that's left inside is a pile of burnt, blackened stuff.
No, no, no—my eggs! That was the last carton I had!
What a shame. ==W==Excuse me, is Flora around? Are you an assistant, too?
Fannie wouldn't hire another assistant, would she? Who is this girl, anyway?
What are you talking about? I, I'm Flora!
W-Wait! So this person, who's frantically making eggs and yelling at the same time ... This is Flora?
Oh, come off it! I just changed into something more comfortable and you don't recognize me?
Flora—are you there? Someone who looks like your little sister says they want some fried eggs!
Oh, I'm sorry... Looking closely, she really does look just like Flora...
How is anyone supposed to recognize her?! Where did that cool star magician go?!
So, what were you doing just now? Are you hurt? I'm your assistant now, if you need help with anything, just let me know.
I was just trying to make breakfast...
Got it, so you were researching breakfast magic. What do you need me to do?
Heyyyyy!! It's not magic! I was actually just making breakfast!
Hmm, this side of Flora is actually pretty cute.
Usually, as soon as I get up, Fannie brings me pancakes and scrambled eggs...
Right, and you tried to make them yourself today.
So that's what Fannie meant when she wrote "please help put out fires"...
So, since the opportunity came up, even though you already were coming to help, I wanted to try cooking for myself!
Seeing as I'm great with fire, I figured using a regular stove should be a piece of cake...
It's the thought that counts. But seriously, a magician must take care of her hands!
Yeah... You're right. I didn't think that one through.
In that case... ==W==How about we go grocery shopping first? We're out of ingredients anyway.
No need. I already bought some ready-to-eat snacks and stuff that just need a quick reheat.
That's just like you and Fannie! ==W==Wait ... How come it feels like you both know exactly what I'm thinking?
Oh, right! You come eat, too.
Thanks, but I had breakfast at home.
What a shame. I wanted to have breakfast with you.
I'll tidy up the place in the meantime. It's so messy, you can't eat in a place like this.
Besides ... If you let the hotel room get this messy, it's gonna be a problem when you change rooms, isn't it?
Oh, no worries on that front. This room is a long-term rental.
See, I have to travel all the time for work, right? Renting a place long-term makes more economic sense than buying property everywhere.
When you put it that way, it does make sense.
But if I keep letting it get messier and messier, Fannie's going to scold me again.
So "please help put out fires" wasn't just literal ...
Leave the cleaning to me. I'm actually pretty good at it.
You are so dependable! ==W==But, um ... Actually, it's not just this room ...
Flora gives me a sheepish grin. Like a hotel staffer, she opens the door to the next room with a little welcome flourish—
Surprisingly, it's not nearly as messy as I imagined—though there is a lot of stuff piled up.
At first glance, it's just a bunch of strange stuff ... There's just so much of it!
Could I ask what these are?
Hehe ... As you can see ... I've lost track of what's in here myself.
Nothing's going to get done if I just stand around ... I'd better get started.
Bought a whole bunch because the packaging looked tasty ...==RT====W==But when I tried them, they had no flavor at all ... Turns out they were pet biscuits.
Why did you buy five back cushions with the exact same pattern? What's wrong with the ones on your bed?
Oh! That's because I heard these are made with cutting-edge tech. So soft and comfy that, even if you drop an egg from mid-air onto them, the egg won't break ...
So have you actually tested it?
Yeah! I tried the egg thing. The egg didn't break!
You use back cushions for that?! And if it's just for that, why did you need five?!
Every time I walk past a stall, I end up buying one because I don't remember that I already have a bunch at home.
Want me to pack up the extras for you? If there's anything you don't need, I can donate them to the community or the kids in the Ash District.
Sure! If someone else can actually use this stuff, I bet it'll feel a lot less wasted.
So, with Flora munching on snacks to keep her energy up, we begin sorting the piles of items and decluttering together.

param: A chance to be a big star's personal assistant—better make the most of it.
After passing through the grand lobby, I follow the directions Fannie gave me and arrive at the door.
I wonder what kind of impossible commission this is going to be ...
For these next few days ... ==W==I'm counting on you to look after Flora!
Yes, literally. I hope you will take care of Flora. I've got something important to take care of, so I'll be away for a few days.
So, I need you to be Flora's magician's assistant while I'm gone.
A magician's assistant, huh? I get it. But does an assistant really need to "look after" the magician? And would a magician actually need looking after?
Normally, no; but Flora's situation is a bit unique ...==RT====W==I usually live with her.
You mentioned before that you two are sisters.==RT====W==Wait, I'll need live with her?
Yeah, normally I'm the only one who can really handle this job. But Flora said to me, "Boss should be able to do it."
Hold on, wait! I don't actually know how to do magic. I've just been on stage as a helper before. Can I really be her assistant?
Of course. You and no one else.
Flora's unique magic show ideas flow from her "unconventional personality" ...==RT==To spark her creativity, her assistant has to be someone she trusts completely.
That unconventionality might be a plus for her performances and creativity, but in everyday life ... not so much.
If her fans ever saw her like in daily life ... They would get disenchanted with her.==RT==So, now you get why it has to be someone she absolutely trusts, right?
Alright, hearing all this actually makes me a little curious.
You will be well-compensated. Just please take care of my sister!
Since I've already agreed, there's no way I can back out now.
Now that I think about it, Fannie gave me a note earlier that said ... ==W=="Please help put out fires"?
Well, she is a magician who works with fire, so a reminder to watch out for fires actually makes sense ...
I knock the door but get no response.
It's getting close to noon. Even a late rise ought to be up by now ...
That sounds like Flora?! What's happening?!
And there's a burnt smell in the air ... I really hope nothing's wrong ...
I dig out the spare key Fannie gave me. Letting myself in without warning feels wrong—but this is an emergency. The door clicks open, and I step inside without wasting a second.
<size=50>Help, aaaaaah—!==RT==The fire won't stop! Please, tell me how to put it out ... !
Alright, leave it to me!==RT====W==...==W==Uh, isn't it as easy as turning the switch off?
Wow, amazing—it really went out! Thank you, you saved me ... !
There's a frying pan on the now-off stove. All that's left inside is a pile of burnt, blackened stuff.
No, no, no—my eggs! That was the last carton I had!
What a shame. ==W==Excuse me, is Flora around? Are you an assistant, too?
Fannie wouldn't hire another assistant, would she? Who is this girl, anyway?
What are you talking about? I, I'm Flora!
W-Wait! So this person, who's frantically making eggs and yelling at the same time ... This is Flora?
Oh, come off it! I just changed into something more comfortable and you don't recognize me?
Flora—are you there? Someone who looks like your little sister says they want some fried eggs!
Oh, I'm sorry... Looking closely, she really does look just like Flora...
How is anyone supposed to recognize her?! Where did that cool star magician go?!
So, what were you doing just now? Are you hurt? I'm your assistant now, if you need help with anything, just let me know.
I was just trying to make breakfast...
Got it, so you were researching breakfast magic. What do you need me to do?
Heyyyyy!! It's not magic! I was actually just making breakfast!
Hmm, this side of Flora is actually pretty cute.
Usually, as soon as I get up, Fannie brings me pancakes and scrambled eggs...
Right, and you tried to make them yourself today.
So that's what Fannie meant when she wrote "please help put out fires"...
So, since the opportunity came up, even though you already were coming to help, I wanted to try cooking for myself!
Seeing as I'm great with fire, I figured using a regular stove should be a piece of cake...
It's the thought that counts. But seriously, a magician must take care of her hands!
Yeah... You're right. I didn't think that one through.
In that case... ==W==How about we go grocery shopping first? We're out of ingredients anyway.
No need. I already bought some ready-to-eat snacks and stuff that just need a quick reheat.
That's just like you and Fannie! ==W==Wait ... How come it feels like you both know exactly what I'm thinking?
Oh, right! You come eat, too.
Thanks, but I had breakfast at home.
What a shame. I wanted to have breakfast with you.
I'll tidy up the place in the meantime. It's so messy, you can't eat in a place like this.
Besides ... If you let the hotel room get this messy, it's gonna be a problem when you change rooms, isn't it?
Oh, no worries on that front. This room is a long-term rental.
See, I have to travel all the time for work, right? Renting a place long-term makes more economic sense than buying property everywhere.
When you put it that way, it does make sense.
But if I keep letting it get messier and messier, Fannie's going to scold me again.
So "please help put out fires" wasn't just literal ...
Leave the cleaning to me. I'm actually pretty good at it.
You are so dependable! ==W==But, um ... Actually, it's not just this room ...
Flora gives me a sheepish grin. Like a hotel staffer, she opens the door to the next room with a little welcome flourish—
Surprisingly, it's not nearly as messy as I imagined—though there is a lot of stuff piled up.
At first glance, it's just a bunch of strange stuff ... There's just so much of it!
Could I ask what these are?
Hehe ... As you can see ... I've lost track of what's in here myself.
Nothing's going to get done if I just stand around ... I'd better get started.

strings.text: When the spotlight fades, she reveals the true secrets behind her "magic."
Whew ... Finally done cleaning up!==W== You have been such a huge help, ==PLAYER_NAME==. Thank you♪
This is a little thank-you from me. Order anything you like.
Then I won't hold back.==RT====W==By the way, aren't you worried about being recognized just sitting out here in the lobby?
Not a problem. I came prepared—disguise mode, on!
Does Fannie help you with tidying up, too? How did so much stuff get piled up on short notice?
Ah, haha ... well...==RT====W==I'm scared that she'd get mad at me, so I never let her see that room. Glad I managed to clean it up while she's gone.
I think I get it. Is it that you are so tired from the doing the shows that on your days off, you just don't have the energy to deal with all this?
But you should really try to tidy up more often so it doesn't get this messy.==RT==That way, Fannie won't get upset.
You're right ... I'll try to be better about it. But honestly, that's not the only reason things get so messy...
More like, I'm just too scatterbrained...
Scatterbrained? But during your performances, you handle so many things at once, perfectly.
You really think so? You're not just joking?!
Of course not. It's self-evident to me.
You dealt with the interlopers without even skipping a beat.
And you're really kind. For example, you gave a little surprise to that girl. That kind of improvisation takes both talent and experience.
You ... You noticed even little details like that?
I ... I feel a little embarrassed.
Isn't that exactly why you're such a beloved star magician?
On the stage, maybe ... But off it, I'm useless when it comes to domestic stuff.
Yeah, I've already gotten a taste of that.
You don't have to agree with me so readily!
Even so, I think you're plenty able.
Not much can be done about that. After all, you don't even know how to work a stove Artifact.
And I buy multiples of the same thing and can't keep my room organized?
Well ... Trying to hide your messy room means you do care about keeping things clean. Even if that's not backed up by concrete action...
Thank you so much for helping me clean up. The least I can do is buy you a drink.
Being able to express appreciation is a virtue, too. This is really good. Thanks.
You really know how to make someone feel good. I mean, I'm the one who should be thanking you ... ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Sigh ... Whenever I'm with you, I just feel so at ease.==RT==Could this be some kind of special magic you own?
Truth to be told, I'm officially recognized by the Grace Imperium ... as one of those rare people totally immune to magic.
Even if that's true, I still think ... You're really good at using the "magic of trust."
Whenever I talk to you, I end up opening up without even meaning to.
I don't have to put on my stage persona ... I can just be my real self with you.
Yeah, that must be why——You're the only one who accepts the real me...
It's an honor to be thought of that way by Nova's top magician.
Hehe, you can brag about it to people! "The famous Flora said all these nice things about me~"
Oops, I did it again without even realizing it.
I don't know when it started, but the moment I put on my stage costume, I'm not just myself anymore.
Being on stage, performing in front of an audience, makes me feel the weight of everything I'm carrying—
The responsibility of being guild leader, the drive to make my fans happy... All of it kind of forces me feel that way...
"Why am I performing magic in the first place?"
But that's not necessarily a bad thing. Understanding what I carry actually helps me grow. It's just that...
It's always the "on-stage" me who gets all the praise. Sometimes I wonder if I'm of value to anyone off the stage.
I hope Fannie and everyone else always see the cool side of me...
You don't have to back yourself into a corner.
I really hate feeling this way! That's why I want to give you a commission, ==PLAYER_NAME==!
I want you to help me get better at taking care of myself! Teach me how to handle all that everyday stuff!
You accepted me as I am, flaws and all, so you're the only one who can help me with this. Please, I'm counting on you, Boss!
No problem. I'll do my best to help you.
Really...?!==W== Thank you, ==PLAYER_NAME==, you're the best!
Before Fannie comes back, I'll do my best to help you with all this. Even the smallest bit of progress counts as a win.
Tough road ahead... But as long as she's motivated, there's always a way.
Ever since then ... Flora's been a lot more trouble than I imagined, but she really is making progress, little by little.
Today's the last day of the commission. Flora can finally get up on her own when the alarm goes off, but since there's a show today, I decide to check in on her just in case.
How strange. No one answers the door. Did she already head to the venue?==W== No, something tells me that's not it...!
As I get ready to open the door, I suddenly remember my first time here and can't help but smile.
The room is quiet and neatly organized, though a little dim. Compared to my first visit, it's a huge improvement.
Nice work, Flora...! Of course, I deserve some credit, too!==W== But still ... where did she go? Her shoes are still by the door, so she probably hasn't left.
I step inside, take off my shoes, and spot Flora fast asleep at her desk. There are magic props and experiment notes scattered around her.
She must've stayed up all night working on a new trick ... No wonder tidying up wasn't on her mind.
Flora's gotten a lot better at handling domestic tasks, too. I suppose this commission is a success.
But ... If she keeps sleeping like this, will she make it to tonight's show on time?
Huh...?! I fell asleep without realizing it ... ?!==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==?! When did you get here...?
Did I woke you up? Sorry!
Oh, no. It's time for me to—
<size=50>Oh no! Nooo! Only two hours left before curtain!
True ... But there's still time. The venue isn't far from here.
No, no, no! There's still SOMETHING I ABSOLUTELY HAVE to do...! We need to hurry...
To the venue. Like, right now!
She grabs my hand, throws on her sunglasses, and rushes out the door. Looks like this is the last part of my commission.
As soon as we get to the venue, Flora dashes straight into the backstage dressing room.==W== A few minutes later, she calls me in—
Hee hee hee!==W== What's the matter,  ==PLAYER_NAME==?
Hee hee hee!==W== What's the matter, ==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==?
Unlike usual,==W== I feel like I'm getting some very heated stares...==W== Are you captivated by this rarely-worn costume?
Unlike usual,==W== I feel like I'm getting some very heated stares...==W== Are you captivated by this rarely-worn costume? ==W==
So, that thing you wanted to do was changing your clothes?
That's right!==W== I usually ask Fannie to dress me,==W== but I wanted to give it a try today!
Hee hee! ==W==Pretty nice, huh?==W== Feel free to give me lots and lots of compliments!==W==
Well, you certainly gave it a try.
My skirt?==W== Um...==W== It's so strange.==W== No matter how many times I do it,==W== I always get the buttons wrong.==W====W==
My skirt?==W== Um...==W== It's so strange.==W== No matter how many times I do it,==W== I always get the buttons wrong.
I wonder if...==W== maybe someone gunning for the top magician spot==W== put a curse on me.
It'll be a while before you can do things on your own.
Hey!==W== B-But I've gotten better about lots of other things, right?==W== And I was only kidding about being cursed. I need a little time,==W== but I can...==W====W====W==
Hey!==W== B-But I've gotten better about lots of other things, right?==W== And I was only kidding about being cursed. I need a little time,==W== but I can...
I trust you and all, but...
You don't have much time until the show starts.
True...==W== Th-Then,==W== could you help me with the skirt?==W====W==
True...==W== Th-Then,==W== could you help me with the skirt?==W==
Brush up on putting on your skirt later, okay?
(Sigh)...==W== I really wanted to show you how far==W== I've come by changing on my own...==W==
Maybe next time, I guess. Well, then—
Hwaaaah...?!==W== H-Hey!==W== Why are you breathing on my back? ==W==
I mean, there's not much I can do about it!
Kyah!==W== Hey, stop!==W== That tickles!==W== H-Hey! Is that on purpose?==W== You better stop or else!
Okay, should I just not help you?
N-No!==W== We don't have that kind of time!==W==
N-No!==W== We don't have that kind of time!==W====W==
Okay, fine!==W== I'll just deal with it!==W== Let's get this over with!==W==
Flora, Nova's one and only Magician Maximus—her show is about to begin!
Hi, everyone! Thanks so much for coming to my magic show today!
Ladies and gentlemen! Children of all ages! Enjoy the show!
<size=30>Especially you, who has worked so hard for my sake.
Flora seems to be whispering something, but with her mic already off, I can't quite make out the words.
But her lip movements give it away. Even without hearing the words, I can still feel them in my heart—

strings.text: The Clever Courier Never Gets Hurt (Part I)
They say, ''If you're always by the river, your shoes are bound to get wet''... but this is a bit much, isn't it?
Early in the morning, I arrive at the forest on the outskirts of Port Bellin to collect the herbs that the client needs.
Sigh ... Hope I can find it soon.
The pay for gathering herbs isn't great, but for a Trekker like me who can't use magic, this kind of job is all I can really take on.
Not far ahead, you see strange patterns carved into the trunk of a large tree. Step closer for a better look—
Could it be claw marks left by an animal...? No, that's not it. They look more like human-made signs.
Bones… Could it be a warning about some kind of danger...?
Guess I'll try following the direction the fish head is pointing to. That patch of grass up ahead looks suspicious.
Whoa! A snare trap that yanks someone off the ground! Close call.
If it weren't for that sign, I would've walked right into it.
Whoever made that mark really did me a favor.
Oh no, someone else got trapped.
Cough, cough ... My throat's killing me ... ==B==And still no one's shown up.
Am I gonna be stuck here forever?
Could this be ... my life flashing before my eyes...? ==B==No! You are real! What are you doing here...?!
Just passing by. I'll get you out of here pronto. Worry about the rest later.==RT==
...Sooo, how did you end up falling into a trap like this?
I ... I accidentally stepped into a Shrubshrew hole...
Trapped in this hole with no one coming to help ... I really thought I was going to starve out here… I'm so glad, meow～～～!!!
I noticed the trees around here all have fishbone marks showing where the traps are. You didn't see them?
Ah, so you noticed those marks. Yep, I drew them all, hehe.
There are groups of mischievous Shrubshrews roaming around in this forest. They are fighting over territory, so they've put a bunch of traps.

Ugh...! It stinks...! If you fall into that trap, the smell probably won't come off for days...

Anyone walking by would be bound to notice a hole this size.

This isn't a trap. This is a hole.
Uh ... ==B==I mean, you've made a good point.

Sure, the markings are really detailed, but they don't seem to have much to do with why you fell into the hole...

Sounds like a back-handed compliment. But I'll take it, meow♪

strings.text: The Clever Courier Never Gets Hurt (Part II)
Some people just have a knack for the most unusual abilities.
Bo-Boss! You look awful—are you okay?!
Nobody's walked this mountain trail in ages, huh ... ==W==I can't even feel my legs at this point ...
I'm not quite sure what you mean… But let's take a break here first.
I've got some water in my backpack. I'll grab it for you.
That backpack's huge. You moving or something.==W== Hold on—are those all Artifacts?
Yup! Most of them are broken, though.
I haven't figured out exactly what to do with them yet...==B== But Trekkers put so much into wishing these into existence, Just leaving them out here feels really wasteful.
And even if broken Artifacts can't be used the way they were before, they might still come in handy for something else.
Like this one, you can press it. Not bad for stress relief, huh?
Hmm ... The clicking feel when I press it is kind of fun...==W== But for some reason, it feels like I'm working.
Well, stress relief's different for everyone.
Such a nice and cool breeze.
Boss! I think that smell's coming from Purple Nettles!
I think so! I'm sure it is! Yeah, like 100 percent!
My nose is actually super sharp!
Yeah! Don't get separated. Stick close to me, Boss!
There's a cliff up ahead. I can smell the faint fragrance, too. But where are the Purple Nettles?
I follow Teresa's pointing finger and see a few tiny flowers swaying in the wind high up on the cliffside.
So we found them. But they're up so high...!
I knew they grew on steep slopes, but I didn't think it'd be this steep.
Trekker commissions really are never easy.
Boss, watch my stuff for me.
Climbing that cliff and picking the Purple Nettles for you. What else?
It's too dangerous. Plus, this is my commission to begin with.
For me, a climb like this is a piece of cake!
I've climbed cliffs way taller than this while out delivering letters.
Is she always doing such dangerous deliveries...?
Besides, you saved me today, Boss. Consider this my "thank-you." Okay, be back in a jiff.
Heave-ho ... ha...==B== Whew ... Climbed pretty high, meow...
The rocks over here are a bit loose. Can't use them as footholds.
But there's really no better spot...==B== Guess I'll give this route a try...!
Despite my worries, Teresa skillfully grips the cracks in the cliff surface as she climbs upward.
Such quick, agile moves ... But...==B== Just how does someone as nimble as Teresa fall into a simple hole like that...
Oh no, she's climbed into a dead end. There's nothing around she can grab onto.
It's time for a double wall-kick here ... Heeya!
Oh wow ... ==B==She jumps and catches hold of a ledge higher up.
That's amazing...!==RT==One can tell you do this all the time!
Just a little more ... to the top.
Heh heh! Boss, did you see that?==RT==This is nothing compared to the cliffs I climbed as a kid.
Quite a lot growing here ... Taking half of these should be okay.
Two ... Four ... Six ... Boss, six is enough, yeah?
Got it! Hehe, if we leave this much behind, the whole area should be blooming next year.
It's fine. Even if I fall, you will catch me, right?
W-wait, let me gather some leaves to cushion the fall.
Just kidding. A little cliff like this is nothing to worry about. It's as easy as going up and down stairs.
A few tiny heads pop up at the top of the cliff.
Squeak squeak, quack quack, squeak squeak squeak squeak!
Why are there Shrubshrews above my head?
They look really mad… Wait—was that spot earlier your den...?
I'm sorry! I didn't do that on purpose.
Hey, don't throw rotten tree fruits at me! They stink so bad.
Oh no ... ! The timing couldn't be worse...! I've got to find a way to help Teresa...!
I hurl a stick at the Shrubshrews, trying to scare them off.
The cliff is high. Can't reach them.
Oh no ... This is not good...
Teresa narrowly dodged the barrage of flying fruit—

strings.text: The Clever Courier Never Gets Hurt (Part III)
A bandage hides the wound, but not the pain behind it.
The moment Teresa falls from the cliff, I throw out my arms and rush toward where she's falling.
But there's no jolt like I expected.
Teresa lands in my arms, light as a feather.
Uh ... that was way easier than I expected… Teresa, did you use some kind of technique...?
Actually, I climb dangerous cliffs all the time,==RT==so I'm totally used to falling by now, meow!
I've got at least three ways to land safely.
Using the ledges on the cliff to absorb the force of the fall.
Driving my greatsword into the cliff to stop my fall.
Or spreading out my body to soften the impact when I land.
So you didn't need me to catch you at all?
I just felt safer with you down below. Knowing someone is there to catch me makes my movements a little sharper.
I see ... Well, as long as you are okay.
Mm...! Ah, time to head down!==RT==If we don't run now, we might be in real trouble!
True. We'd better shake the Shrubshrews off before they catch up ...
What's the safest way to make our escape...?
Leave it to me! When I was falling down, I happened to spot a small path.
It's hidden by plants so it's only visible from the air. No way the Shrubshrews will catch up with us if we go that way!
Going that way will make the delivery much faster than usual. Let's go, Boss.
Hah... hah... I slipped up... didn’t expect so much walking.==W== The shortcut still took two hours. Teresa, how long does it usually take you to deliver a letter like this?
But since there are people who live in remote places like this, and there are others who want to convey their feelings to them...
Then no matter how long it takes, proper deliveries must be made!
Hang on a sec, I'll be right back.
Heheheh～♪==RT==Do you think the old lady will be happy when she gets the letter?
No matter the distance, a letter still contains a heartfelt message...
Here, try this. The old lady gave us some fruits as a "thank you."
Huh ... Never seen this before. Is it a fruit? Smells really nice ... Munch munch.
Right? She says it's one of the perks of living deep in the forest!
It's so delicious, it honestly makes me feel like all the effort to get here was totally worth it...
Yeah, when you think of it that way, the fruit tastes even sweeter.
Oh right, Boss. Don't throw away the pits.
I'll take them to those Shrubshrews.
Well, I did step on their burrow entrance first.
Also, this delivery route goes right through their territory. If I stay on good terms with them, there won't be any trouble next time.
But right now, they're probably still holding a grudge against you.
It's fine. Worst case, we just duke it out. Last time was on a cliff, but on flat ground, I'm not scared of them at all.
I can dodge all their attacks.
On the way back, Teresa does dodge every attack from the Shrubshrews.
She also successfully calms the Shrubshrews with the fruit pits.
We make it back to Post Haste in the early evening.
Please have a seat, Boss. I'll get you some tea.
No need for that. You've had a long day already.
That mountain trail is no big deal. You're my guest, Boss. Sit back and let me be the host.
The tea ... I think the tea leaves are on the second floor.
Teresa nimbly hops up the stairs and vanishes in an instant, so I just sit down and relax.
Teresa moves so quickly and thinks through every detail, so how does she end up bruised all over?
I ... I fell from the stairs.
I just forgot I wasn't wearing shoes and was running so fast. I stubbed my pinky toe going upstairs. Then I tripped and fell, hehe.
I'm totally used to it, no problem at all. Seriously, don't worry about it, meow.
And look, I've even got medical tape on right here.==RT==It's totally fine!
Sigh. I need to borrow your first aid kit.
Eh, what are you doing, Boss?
W-Wait, hold on?! Why are you inching towards me without saying anything～!
You can barely stand, so stop trying to act tough.
When it hurts, you have to say it out loud. Got it?
Nyaaaaa?!==W== Boss, stop!==W== Don't be rough!
Settle down... I'll put some medicine on.
M-Medicine?!==W== I don't need any!==W== It's too much to ask from you anyway...
B-Besides, it's the kind of injury that should heal on its own.==W== See? Look here!==W== This is where I got hurt before, and it's all healed up!
There's a scar... It wasn't disinfected, was it?
H-Hey! Seriously, wait!==W== No!==W== No antiseptic! ==W== L-Look, I'm pretty tough! I don't need any antiseptic!
H-Hey! Seriously, wait!==W== No!==W== No antiseptic!==W== L-Look, I'm pretty tough!==W== I don't need any antiseptic!
I'm totally fine with it!==W== Gyaaaaahhh!!!
O-Ow! It stings!==W== B-Boss...!==W== I'm begging you!==W== No more, please!
O-Ow! It stings!==W== Yowch! Yowch!==W== Ugh...!==W== B-Boss...!==W== I'm begging you! No more, please!
So, you really can't deal with it.
Ugh... Yeah.==W== No, I can't... I can't deal with it.
Ugh... Yeah.==W== No,==W== I can't... I can't deal with it.
It's like==W== the pain echoes through my whole body==W== and I just can't!==W== What...?==W== Wait.==W== It suddenly doesn't hurt as much==W== after you disinfect it...
It's like the pain echoes through my whole body and I just can't!==W== What...?==W== Wait.==W== It suddenly doesn't hurt as much==W== after you disinfect it...
There's a right way to do it. And I got a bandage on there for you.
Th-Thank you!==W== Hm?==W== This bandage...==W== it's so cute!
Is this yours,==W== Boss? I wouldn't have expected it, but... I like it!
Is this yours,==W== Boss?==W== I wouldn't have expected it,==W== but... I like it!
We should probably put some more antiseptic on.
Yikes!==W== No, I think I'm good!==W== Please, Boss!==W== No more, please?
Alright, alright. Since you know it hurts, try to be more careful next time, okay?
You can safely land from falling off cliffs...==B== But you still fall into those in-your-face holes, and even trip inside your own home.
Cliffs are dangerous, so I stay on high alert.
Maybe it's because once I'm somewhere safe, I let my guard down...?
If that's the case, then you're way too careless.
No, uh, it's only because I'm so relaxed when I'm with you, Boss.
When I'm with you, I tend to pay more attention on you than on the dangers around me...
Got it. I'll try to come here less often from now on.
No no no! That's not what I meant! You should come more often!
Next time I see you, I'll wrap myself up in bandages ahead of time so I won't get hurt.
That's taking it a bit too far. Alright, I was just kidding. Sorry.
In Sailstead there's a shop that sells old broken Artifacts. Lots of them, and affordable, too.
Eh, really?! If you want to go, I'd love to come along, meow!
Sure. But… This time, don't get hurt again, okay?
If you can promise me that, I'll take you.
Got it. I'll do my best to go a week without injury!
In the end, Teresa was extra careful not to get hurt. She did manage to achieve her "one week without injury" goal.
However, the very next day, she got so excited heading out that she smacked her forehead on the door frame.
<size=50>Going a week without injury is so hard, meow~

O-Ow! It stings!==W== B-Boss...!==W== I'm begging you!==W== No more, please!
O-Ow! It stings!==W== Yowch! Yowch!==W== Ugh...!==W== B-Boss...!==W== I'm begging you! No more, please!
So, you really can't deal with it.
Ugh... Yeah.==W== No, I can't... I can't deal with it.
Ugh... Yeah.==W== No,==W== I can't... I can't deal with it.
It's like==W== the pain echoes through my whole body==W== and I just can't!==W== What...?==W== Wait.==W== It suddenly doesn't hurt as much==W== after you disinfect it...
It's like the pain echoes through my whole body and I just can't!==W== What...?==W== Wait.==W== It suddenly doesn't hurt as much==W== after you disinfect it...
There's a right way to do it. And I got a bandage on there for you.
Th-Thank you!==W== Hm?==W== This bandage...==W== it's so cute!
Th-Thank you!==W== Hm?==W== This bandage...==W== it's so cute!
Is this yours,==W== Boss? I wouldn't have expected it, but... I like it!
Is this yours,==W== Boss?==W== I wouldn't have expected it,==W== but... I like it!
We should probably put some more antiseptic on.
Yikes!==W== No, I think I'm good!==W== Please, Boss!==W== No more, please?
Yikes!==W== No, I think I'm good!==W== Please, Boss!==W== No more, please?
Alright, alright. Since you know it hurts, try to be more careful next time, okay?
You can safely land from falling off cliffs...==B== But you still fall into those in-your-face holes, and even trip inside your own home.
Cliffs are dangerous, so I stay on high alert.
Maybe it's because once I'm somewhere safe, I let my guard down...?
If that's the case, then you're way too careless.
No, uh, it's only because I'm so relaxed when I'm with you, Boss.
When I'm with you, I tend to pay more attention on you than on the dangers around me...
Got it. I'll try to come here less often from now on.
No no no! That's not what I meant! You should come more often!
Next time I see you, I'll wrap myself up in bandages ahead of time so I won't get hurt.
That's taking it a bit too far. Alright, I was just kidding. Sorry.
In Sailstead there's a shop that sells old broken Artifacts. Lots of them, and affordable, too.
Eh, really?! If you want to go, I'd love to come along, meow!
Sure. But… This time, don't get hurt again, okay?
If you can promise me that, I'll take you.
Got it. I'll do my best to go a week without injury!
In the end, Teresa was extra careful not to get hurt. She did manage to achieve her "one week without injury" goal.
However, the very next day, she got so excited heading out that she smacked her forehead on the door frame.
<size=50>Going a week without injury is so hard, meow~

strings.text: Donna the courier knows every corner of this town—this is the Donna you know.
Weird... This should be the spot.
Noya and the others are swamped, so I'm stuck on supply duty.==W== But seriously... Where is this shop?
Hm? Someone just tugged on my sleeve...
A little girl... Was she the one tugging at me?
I-I can't find my house!! Mommy... Where are you—
Alright, shh... Don't cry. I'll help you. Do you know where you live?
She's not talking...==RT==But I can't just leave her like this...
Huh? I swear I heard a kid crying...==W== Oh? It's Boss!
This kid...==W== She lost or something?
Oh!==W== Or did you do something to make her cry, Boss?!
Huge misunderstanding!==W== I didn't do a thing!
Hehe, I'm kidding!==RT==I know you wouldn't pull anything weird, Boss.
Ah, so she really is lost.
<size=52>Waaaaah!!==W== I want Mommy!! I wanna go home!!</size>
I tried asking where she lives, but she's crying so hard I couldn't understand a thing. It's impossible to get through to her.
Hmm... Mind if I give it a shot?
There, there. Scary being all alone, huh? Don't worry, I'm here to take you back to your mommy. So dry those tears, okay?
(sniff) Can you really ... find my mommy?
That got her to stop crying?!
You bet! I'm a Courier Trekker! No matter the location, I always make the delivery!
A Courier Trekker... That's so cool!
Hehe! Isn't it just? ==RT==Now, can you tell me where you live?==W== Or maybe there's something nearby that stands out?
Um... There's a toy store next to my house,==W== and a really, really big tree!
A toy store and a big tree... Pretty sure I've been by there on my rounds.==W== Alrighty, let's get you home!
You're a lifesaver...==W== But do you still have work to do? I hope this hasn't taken up too much of your time...
No sweat! I actually just dropped off my last letter for the day. Come on, let's get her home!
—And then, keep straight down this road. Once we see the flower shop, we'll take a left into the alley.
The poor kid looks so pale... Being lost must have really terrified her.
Still, pinning down the location with just that... You're definitely living up to your name as a Courier Trekker.
I deliver on this street all the time. Do it enough and you just memorize the layout!
Well, isn't it Donna! Thanks again for getting that letter from my son the other day.
Post Haste is always so reliable. We'll be counting on you next time, too.
You got it! Just give me a holler whenever you need something sent!
Are Courier Trekkers really that cool?
Heh, you know it! High mountains, deep oceans, even the top of the Monolith!==W== If it's on the Nova Continent, we'll get it there on time!
Whoa... That's awesome!==RT==If I write a letter someday, could you deliver it for me too?
You bet!==W====RT==We'll make sure it reaches the right person safe and sound!
Okay! When I need to send a letter, I'll ask you for help!
You've really got a way with people, Donna.
Being cheerful and friendly to everyone is just how it should be, right?
Staying on everyone's good side is how we keep business booming at Post Haste!
So it's about the PR...==RT==You really are a born leader. Always looking out for Post Haste.
Oh, the flower store! Turn left at the next corner.
I know this place! We're reaching my house!
Awesome! Why don't you show us the way, then?
... Then again,==W== I doubt she's doing this just for Post Haste's sake.
Hey Boss! Keep up or I'm leaving you in the dust!
Oh, good grace... Where on earth did you go?! I was worried sick!
But I met this super cool courier lady! She brought me all the way back!
You really are a handful...==RT==I am so sorry for the trouble she caused you.
No trouble at all!==RT==We're just relieved she's home safe and sound.
We'll head inside now.==RT==Come on, say thank you.
Thank you!==RT==I'm gonna write a letter, so come visit me again, okay?
You got it—pinky promise! See ya later!
Phew... Good thing you were there. I wouldn't have had a clue what to do on my own.
No sweat! We gotta look out for each other, right?==W== But... Well, if you really want to thank me...==W==
You could send a few big-ticket commissions my way ... or maybe some new clients?==W== Hehe, just kidding!==W== Catch you later, Boss!
See ya.==RT==Guess I should get back to my shopping list...
Well... Noya and the others sent me on a supply run, but I couldn't find that shop...
The way here was pretty confusing, and I didn't memorize it... Pretty sure I'm totally lost now.
Hahaha... So it's your turn to get lost now, Boss?==W== Didn't they give you a map or something?
They did... But it starts from the Lucky Oasis! We've walked so far that it's basically useless now!
You sound pretty confident for someone who's lost... Here, lemme see.
Oh, this place? I made a delivery there just last week. Come on, I'll take you.
No biggie! Let's go. Stick close so you don't get lost again!

strings.text: Donna from Post Haste loves dressing everyone up. Look, these are the new clothes she made!
Hah... Another quiet one.==W== Perfect weather to just wander ar—==W==hm?
Is that ... Donna? She's loaded down with bags. Looks like she's struggling...
Hey, Donna. What's with the massive haul?
Oh! Hi, Boss! These are supplies.==W== I kept spotting good stuff and tossed 'em in the basket, and ... well, here we are.
Need a hand? That's way too much for one person to carry.
Nah, I'm good! Hauling cargo is part of the job, remember? This little stack is a total piece of cake!
Whoa there!==RT==See? Told you it was too much.
Hehe... Thanks. Nearly dropped the whole load right there.
I do remember someone saying this was a "piece of cake." Hearing things, were I?
Ugh...==W== Usually I handle this stuff no problem...==W== Weird.
Don't force it, okay? Just ask. Here, give me half.
Phew, thanks a ton. You can set those on that table over there.
Sure thing. By the way... Where're Teresa and Freesia?
Teresa's out in the forest, and Freesia biked over to the next town for a delivery... Neither of 'em will be back till this evening.
Heheh. But it's perfect timing! With them out of the way, I can finally execute my master plan in broad daylight!
Lace, plaid, solids... Look at all these different fabrics. Ribbons and buttons, too.
So everything we bought today was material for making clothes?
Bingo! I used to only patch holes or stitch up loose seams to get by. But lately, I figured making whole new outfits from scratch is actually faster.
Right, Donna mentioned she likes sewing for the crew. She handles all the daily mending at Post Haste, too...
Since we're already here, mind if I watch?
Be my guest! Sit back and witness my skills firsthand!
Alrighty then. First things first: the design!
In-Incredible... She filled that sketchbook with cute designs in no time...!
Next, I'll match the patterns and cut the fabric...
Such clean, sharp movements! Zero hesitation...!
Finally, I use this sewing Artifact to stitch it all together!
Ta-da! All done! Another masterpiece I'm totally confident in~
That was amazing... You've got the skills to go pro, or even open your own boutique.
Heheh. I am the multi-talented Donna, after all! This is just easy work. Not planning on making money off it yet, though—it's purely a hobby.
I see... Wait.==W== You didn't make all those clothes hanging over there too, did you?
You bet! The back rack is Freesia's dresses, and those over there are shirts and jackets for Teresa...==W== Every single piece is adorable, right?
They're cute, sure... But isn't this a bit excessive?! The closet is practically bursting.
Well, they're almost always in their Post Haste uniforms.==W== Their casual clothes never get worn out, so naturally, the pile just keeps growing.
Ever considered... I don't know, making less?
No way! Everyone at Post Haste needs to stay cute 24/7, which is why I churned out these outfits!
I sort of get it... Actually, no...==W== Anyway, haven't you ever made anything for yourself, Donna?
Sure I do. Right over there.
Over there... You mean that little pile? Compared to what Freesia and Teresa have, isn't that a little sparse?
Well what can I do? Those two are just too cute!==W== I'd much rather dress them up and see how they look than wear the stuff myself.
Can't wait to have them try on the ones I just made!
Donna really does love this whole fashion thing.
I wonder if she'd be willing to make something for me?
Hey, Donna? I've got a favor to ask...==W==
Hmm... An outfit for Boss?==W== Well...==W== Like I said, it's just a hobby. I haven't really made anything for anyone besides Freesia and Teresa...
But! Since it's you, Boss, I suppose I could make a special exception.
Really? Awesome! I'll cover the material costs upfront!
Put your money away. But in exchange... I'll be expecting you to send some big orders my way!
You never miss an angle, do you? Deal.
Alright then, let's get right to it—
No, no, I should be the one asking that! Why are you suddenly hugging me...?!
I'm not!==W== I'm just taking your measurements. Mea-sure-ments! Can't make the clothes if I don't know your size, right?
Oh, is that it... Should've just said so then. You nearly gave me a heart attack.
My bad. Totally forgot to mention it. Okay, starting for real now. Just stand exactly like that and don't move, got it?
First things first, tape around the waist... There we go.
I barely ever buy new clothes, and I've certainly never been to a bespoke tailor. This is actually pretty intimidating...
Come on now, arms up a bit higher! Time to measure your chest!
O-okay—==W==Eek!? Wait, hang on! That's a little...!
Boss, I told you to stop wiggling!
Haha! Ahahahaha!==W== I—I can't... It tickles...!
I know you're ticklish. Just bear with it for a second.
I'm trying to hold still...==W== Pfft! Seriously Donna—are you tickling me on purpose!?
As if! You're moving so much you're basically tickling yourself.==W== Okay—just pretend you're a Monolith. Stand tall and freeze!
I am a Monolith,==W== I am a Monolith...==W== Uh...==W== Huh?
Pfft—hahahaha!!==W== Nope, I can't do it! Have mercy—
I'm ... exhausted too... Never had to work this hard just to take a few measurements...
How do you survive fitting rooms if you're this ticklish?
Hey, being ticklish is totally normal!
Try reacting like that with a normal clerk... You'd scare them off. Anyway, at least I got the numbers. Time to get to work—
I just realized... After making those outfits for Teresa and Freesia...
I've pretty much burned through all the fabric.
I am so sorry! Not a scrap left...==W== Next time! I promise, definitely next time!
Look on the bright side—I've got your measurements on file now, Boss!==W== Once I restock, I'll whip one up and deliver it right to your door! Stay tuned!

strings.text: So... Which side of Donna are you seeing right now?
Meeting time's come and gone... Is Donna running late...?==W== Ah—there she is!
Sorry! Took me a minute to spot you...
Hello? Donna?==RT==... She can't hear me over the noise?==W== Donna! Hey! I'm here!
Hehe... My bad. Got a little distracted by that window display.
The window display? Was she eyeing the dress inside?
Anyway, we're here to shop, right? What's on the list for today?

Yep! I'm planning a total gear upgrade, so it's gonna be a big haul.==W== So, I was wondering if you'd mind lending me a hand? New delivery bags, hats ... and maybe some accessories! Are you okay with them?
You got it. I might be useless in a fight. But hauling luggage? That I can do!
Is... Is that really something to brag about?==W== Anyway, it's great to have you here, Boss! Let's get moving—first stop, straight ahead!
Come to think of it... Was she staring at that red dress in the window back there?
Welcome! This section is our new seasonal collection. Feel free to pick up anything you like!
This bag is gorgeous! It'd be perfect for Freesia!
And look, this hat has little cat ears! They're so soft... Teresa would absolutely love this!
I knew it. She lights up when she's picking things out for the others. Just standing by her side lifts my spirit.
Bags, hats, and... Oh, this headband is cute. You still holding up back there, Boss?
Easy.==W== It's only two bags—keep 'em coming!
Great!==W== Excuse me! I'll take ALL of this!
Heehee, look at this kitty clip! It's practically made for Teresa!
Boss, grab this bag too, would ya? Thanks a bunch!
Hmph.==W== Three measly bags? I can handle this in my sleep!
I love the shoe designs here. They'd go perfectly with Freesia's dress.
Hmm... If I have to pick one of these five, which works best?==W== Ugh, forget it. It's impossible. I'll take 'em all!
That is quite the shopping strategy!?==W== N-no, I'm good!==W== Pile 'em on!
Thanks for your business!==W== Please come again soon!
Score! Found the exact same messenger bag I'm using now! You can stuff a mountain of letters in there. Super practical!
Boss...? You holding up okay back there?
Huff... I'm beat...==W== Huh? I-I'm fine!==W== Just ten bags? Walk in the park!
Really? Could've sworn I heard you say you were beat...
You must have misheard. Ahem. This is just ... a little cardio! Let's go, we're not done yet!
If you say so... But let me grab a few.==W== Just say the word if you need a break, okay?
Ugh... Arms are going numb.==W== Thankfully we're almost done. Gotta push through!
Looking at this haul, though... Not a single one is for Donna herself. She doesn't seem like someone who's indifferent to fashion?
Ahhh! Nothing beats a cold juice after a spree! If you're still thirsty, Boss, go ahead—order one more.
Yeah, let me finish this one first. We really bought a ton of stuff today...
Hehe! Just means I know how to pick the best shops! Hopefully with all this new gear, everyone will be even more pumped for deliveries!
Oh, right! Speaking of deliveries, Freesia was...
Is Donna looking at ...==W== those two girls?==W== Or is it the red dresses? Almost identical to the one she was eyeing earlier.
Donna,==W== you sure you didn't miss anything on the shopping list?
I hit every shop I wanted and grabbed everything I needed. Nope, pretty sure that's it!
Can't tell if she means it or if she's just acting indifferent...
Well then... There's actually something I wanted to check out. Mind keeping me company?
Sure! Gimme a sec to finish this drink.
You want something from here, Boss? Isn't this where we met up earlier...?
Yeah. I was actually debating going inside when I first arrived.
Oh... Did something in there catch your eye, too?
"Too"? Sounds like great minds think alike.
Haha... Come on. I'm excited to see Freesia and Teresa all dressed up too, but since we're here... I want to see a cute, dolled-up Donna too.

strings.text: Throwing down over honor and turf? Just another day in the life of a delinquent girl.
You're the one called Minova, yeah?
Why'd you roll up alone? Makes it look like we Ground Vipers got the drop on you.
I can handle you guys myself.
Tsk, you're facing all the Viper elites.
Getting cocky like that's gonna cost you.
Leader, she's got one scrawny sidekick with her.
Watch your mouth. This is the Boss. Haven't you ever heard of the Boss Accord?
What're you yelling for? That "Boss"or whatever—what the hell is that supposed to be?
Leader, that's the one who stood on the Waterway Bridge and just wiped out hundreds of Stellaroids in one go!
Wow, people sure do love to exaggerate...
Th-that's pretty impressive. But I-I can do that, too.
Gotta hand it to you, Minova. Finding someone so impressive to back you up … you got some serious pull.
But this is between the Ashwinds and the Ground Vipers—are you really gonna let an outsider interfere?
I'm not just anyone—Minova's with me.
I can't believe you sold out like that.
No need to get so worked up. I'm not here to help Minova.
I'm just here as a witness. You're fighting over the rights to this section of the Waterway Bridge and the 30 meters of turf on either side, right?
I'm not interested in claiming new turf; but I'm not about to let the Vipers move in, either.
The right to this turf will be decided through a free-for-all.==W== No limit on numbers.==W== The fight ends when one side surrenders or can't keep fighting.
The Ground Viper Gang has brought fifteen solid fighters, enough to both cover the whole width of the Waterway Bridge while still having some backliners.
I guess the Vipers' leader isn't just all brawn after all.
That woman smashed the Waterway Bridge!
Cut the crap. She's no giant Stellaroid. Nobody tears down a bridge that quick.
I heard Minova was there when the giant Stellaroid went down. She smashed one of its arms clean off with a single swing of her bat.
Whoops, sorry. Guess my swing went a little off course.
I'll be sure to aim right next time.
Wh-what's the point of fighting when the bridge is all smashed?
Just you wait! We'll settle this another day.
Yeah, that outta keep them away for a few months.
Not really. A gang needs to have it out with rival crews every once in the while.
Otherwise, the young and immature members get restless and start turning on each other.
Must be tough for a fake gang like the Ashwind Clan, then.
Yeah. Luckily you thought of this easy way out for me.
Using magic to disguise the already broken Waterway Bridge and make it look like it was smashed apart with a single bat swing.
Of course, Boss Accord takes care of its employees.
Honestly, even if it came down to a real fight, I think you'd still win.
The Ashwind Clan has way too few members, so we avoid making enemies when we can.
We can play pufferfish—just puff up and look tough enough to scare off the enemy.
Oh, speaking of which, Boss. Let's use this as a practice opportunity.
I don't think I'm the right sparring partner.
Not fighting. I want to practice how gang members talk.
I can't do that tongue-click thing, either...
No need to be so formal. ==W==I picked it up from those movies in the Monolith. You're a Trekker, so you must have seen those, too.
Yeah, I watched a few while I was climbing the Monolith.
Just talk like the characters from those movies, then.
Okay, I'll give it a shot...==W== It just needs to sound like something a gang member would say, right?
Yup. Let's get started. First up is calling somebody out!
We belong to rival gangs and bump into each other on the streets.
Oi, the hell you lookin' at?
A punk's what I'm looking at.
It ain't just you. I'm saying you're all trash.
Boss, you didn't even sound that aggressive, but you totally shut me down.
I was just repeating some lines I remember.
Let's run another scenario. A begging scene.
==PLAYER_NAME==, I'll give you anything you want, but please help me, I beg of you.
What have I ever done to make you treat me with such disrespect?
You do not offer me friendship. You simply ask me to do this, for money.
I... I just want to show that I'm sincere.
You don't even think to call me... Boss.
And you aren't even in a gang! You truly are amazing, Boss.
I need to watch more gangster movies in my future Monolith climbs.
Life's gotta be tough for you.
It's not so bad. The kids' smiles mean everything to me.
Besides, today's battle is only halfway through.
I need to head to the next battlefield.
No, no. More complicated than that.
Want to come and see for yourself?
