strings.text: For this delinquent girl, some battles are fought not with a bat, but a pen.
Artifacts are gifts bestowed upon the Novians by the God of Grace.
Only those brave enough to challenge the Monolith earn the right to receive this gift through the Wishing Rite.
This'll definitely be in the final exam. Make sure you've got it down.
I sit in the second-to-last row by the window, surrounded by the soft rustling of pens on paper.
I need to head to the next battlefield.
So this is what Minova meant by "next battlefield?"
Fighting with other gangs while still having to attend class. Must be tough.
Now that I think about it, everyone else's taking notes, and here I am, just looking around. Doesn't look too good on my part, huh?
Uh-oh, I zoned out there for a second. I have no idea what the question was!
Uh, the answer to the question, that is...
此处有密涅瓦的笔记本（Q版图片）
Minova quietly pushes her notes toward me.
What is god-given cannot be defied.
So we cannot, and should not, dismantle Artifacts.
That is correct. You may sit.
Not wanting to repeat my mistake, I focus intently for the rest of the Artifact lecture.
Finally, class is over.==W== I had no idea just listening could be so exhausting!
This professor is pretty strict,==W== but she's also the most dedicated Monolith Studies instructor.
Next... Let me check the schedule.
Ah, I only have this one Monolith Studies class today.
I go two or three times a week, and sometimes I'll attend classes all day.==W== They're all about the Monolith and the Trekkers.
I know that hands-on experience is an essential part of becoming a Trekker.
But I want to learn the know-hows as fast as I can, wish for Artifact parts, and have everyone in Ashwind put together their own Artifacts.
What you want goes against what you were taught.
What is god-given cannot be defied. We cannot, and should not, dismantle Artifacts.
Well, textbook is one thing, reality is another.
Rote memorization gets you through exams, but real understanding comes from adapting theories to your own purposes.
Ahem, I guess I got a bit too nerdy there.
As the leader of a gang, I should probably say something like...
I don't have time for all those words! Just tell me how to beat people up and make money!
Feels weird to hear you say that while you're wearing the student uniform.
Speaking of which, don't Platinum Academy teach these things?
People in Gold District are all about getting jobs in big companies.
The Monolith knowledge at Platinum Academy is all focused on the company side, totally different from the Trekker path I want to take.
That's why I got an audit pass for Grace Light Academy.
And brought me along for the ride.
It's all thanks to this uniform.
"Anyone studying at Platinum Academy must be the daughter of company execs or Senate big shots."
"And those who around her must be the right sort of people."
So you got a free pass.
I don't like this uniform. It feels like a glorified bird cage.
It's just that... A lot of the time, it actually does help me—and Ashwind—with avoiding trouble.
She's only got one companion with her. Looks like the scrawny sort. Should we go for a sneak attack?
Are you blind or what? Can't you see that she's in a Platinum Academy uniform?
If you are stupid enough to attack a Platinum student, they'll find you hanging from the rafters tomorrow morning.
Some of those students' parents might actually be the patrons financing the gangs.
The gang members watch as Minova and I casually make our way through their turf.
Come to think of it, Minova seems more ladylike now that she's wearing the uniform.
Boss. You're quietly judging me, aren't you?
Something like... The way I walk is weird.
This skirt makes it hard to move. I can only walk in small steps, and it feels so awkward.
The first time I got into a fight, I was wearing a Platinum Academy uniform.
I ripped the skirt so I could run better. Hehe.
Good thing Platinum gives out two sets of uniforms.
So that's how your regular outfit's half-a-skirt came to be.
Yes, that skirt holds a lot of memories.
I cut it to length and dyed it dark blue, so now you can't tell it was originally a school uniform.
Hey you, hand over the dough!
Listen to her unless you want to be used for punching practice.
Except for the street Ashwind Clan is on, Ash District is a really dodgy place.
If it were the usual Minova, she would've charged right in by now.
But right now she's wearing her Platinum Academy uniform, and this isn't Ashwind's turf.
Only cowards spar with regular people. Next time you're itching for a fight, come find me.
And you, stay away from this area next time. The gangs here are real lowlifes.
Is it really okay for you to do this? This isn't Ashwind territory, after all.
Didn't you say to avoid making enemies when you can?
I can back down when it's just about me, but if I don't step in when others are being bullied, then I'm not being true to myself.
Besides, I've got you as my shield.
All the Ash District gangs think that you're backing Ashwind Clan.
Those were just small potatoes. They dare not say a word.
I didn't know I was that impressive.
Sure enough, most gang members squatting by the roadside who aren't complete rookies avoid making eye contact with me.
I'm totally riding on your coattails now. Or as the Loongs like to say, a fox relying on the might of a tiger.
Amused by this revelation, I try making eye contact with every gang member I pass by as we make our way home.
Minova, there's a suspicious box making a ticking noise in front of the clan.
It says... "To Minova at Ashwind Clan. Contains bomb."
Let me deal with it, Boss.
Did she just crush the detonation mechanism with sheer grip strength?
Emergency calls, Boss. I need to completely dismantle this bomb.
I'm fine. Ashwind gets threats like this all the time.
Bombs. Assassins. I'm used to them by now.
I'll properly thank you another day.
Minova's expression is a little uneasy. She scratches her cheek, bids me goodbye, and walks inside.

Come to think of it, Minova seems more ladylike now that she's wearing the uniform.
Boss. You're quietly judging me, aren't you?
Something like... The way I walk is weird.
This skirt makes it hard to move. I can only walk in small steps, and it feels so awkward.
The first time I got into a fight, I was wearing a Platinum Academy uniform.
I ripped the skirt so I could run better. Hehe.
Good thing Platinum gives out two sets of uniforms.
So that's how your regular outfit's half-a-skirt came to be.
Yes, that skirt holds a lot of memories.
I cut it to length and dyed it dark blue, so now you can't tell it was originally a school uniform.
Hey you, hand over the dough!
Listen to her unless you want to be used for punching practice.
Except for the street Ashwind Clan is on, Ash District is a really dodgy place.
If it were the usual Minova, she would've charged right in by now.
But right now she's wearing her Platinum Academy uniform, and this isn't Ashwind's turf.
Only cowards spar with regular people. Next time you're itching for a fight, come find me.
And you, stay away from this area next time. The gangs here are real lowlifes.
Is it really okay for you to do this? This isn't Ashwind territory, after all.
Didn't you say to avoid making enemies when you can?
I can back down when it's just about me, but if I don't step in when others are being bullied, then I'm not being true to myself.
Besides, I've got you as my shield.
All the Ash District gangs think that you're backing Ashwind Clan.
Those were just small potatoes. They dare not say a word.
I didn't know I was that impressive.
Sure enough, most gang members squatting by the roadside who aren't complete rookies avoid making eye contact with me.
I'm totally riding on your coattails now. Or as the Loongs like to say, a fox relying on the might of a tiger.
Amused by this revelation, I try making eye contact with every gang member I pass by as we make our way home.
Minova, there's a suspicious box making a ticking noise in front of the clan.
It says... "To Minova at Ashwind Clan. Contains bomb."
Let me deal with it, Boss.
Did she just crush the detonation mechanism with sheer grip strength?
Emergency calls, Boss. I need to completely dismantle this bomb.
I'm fine. Ashwind gets threats like this all the time.
Bombs. Assassins. I'm used to them by now.
I'll properly thank you another day.
Minova's expression is a little uneasy. She scratches her cheek, bids me goodbye, and walks inside.

strings.text: The "bomb" turns out to be the delinquent girl's biggest secret.
Did you hear? Ashwind's Minova crushed a bomb with her bare hands, easy peasy.
Nah. What really happened was, right before it went off,==RT==Minova gripped the bomb and used brute force to stop the explosion.
People in Emor really love exaggerated tales.
By comparison, that story about my taking down hundreds of Stellaroids alone doesn't sound so far-fetched after all.
Still worried about Minova, I make my way back to Ashwind's headquarter.
I found a copy of "Magical Explosives and How to Stop Them" on the bookshelf of the Lucky Oasis. Might come in handy.
I'm fine. Ashwind gets threats like this all the time.
Bombs. Assassins. I'm used to them by now.
There's something about her expression that's hard for me to ignore.
It's coming from over there. Sounds like Minova.
It's all your fault... My heart's racing faster than ever.
Is this... A staircase leading to the basement?
Oh no, could the bomb be a decoy, and there's an assassin hiding in the clan?
Bwuh?==W== Assassin? ==W==There's no one like that here.
Yeah... ==W==I might've been role playing and said it out loud without realizing...==W==
B-==W==But that just proves how amazing Phantom Bomb Knight is, okay?!
So "bomb" is the title of the manga, and "assassin" is a character in the manga…
S-Sorry. ==W==I didn't mean to trick you or anything.==W== Anyway, ==W==I'll explain. ==W==But first, can you shut the door?
I don't want any else to hear this...
There are no others. I was faking.
Do you have to be this secretive?
Sigh... ==W==Okay, I'll explain everything. ==W==But before that ...==W== p-promise me you'll keep the fact I read comics a secret.
I'll do anything you say, just promise!
Vollara, I think I hear Boss's voice.
It's Vollara and Neuvira. Boss, come over and hide in this.
No time to explain. Please just do as I say.
Huh? Why's the basement library door open? Did one of the kids wander in there?
Minova, there's no way a single-person wardrobe like this can hide two people.
Let's shift a bit. Come into my arms.
That way, you can move your arms.
If we get caught like this, it would look way worse than you reading shojo manga.
No. Me reading shojo manga is definitely worse.
Maybe someone just forgot to close the door after grabbing a book.
Come on, is "Minova reads shojo manga" really some kind of top classified info?
Uh, well... Yeah...==W== This isn't a safe place. Let's talk somewhere else.
Here we are. This is where it all began.
Minova pulls me up onto a broken section of the Waterway Bridge, where a few odds and ends are scattered across the surface.
Back when I first met Vollara and Neuvira, this is where we used to hang out.
The way Ashwind survives in this District is to act like a fearsome gang.
If word got out that Ashwind's leader likes reading shojo manga, nobody would take us seriously anymore.
No, but they'd realize... I'm also just a regular person with regular hobbies.
And regular people do not inspire fear.
I'd love to have more stories about me that feature me smashing a bridge with a single bat swing.
That's why you lied to me and said the package contained a bomb.
See? It really did contain a bomb—Phantom Bomb Rider.
That's how I usually explain it too. The beeping light? Just part of the disguise.
But now I know the truth.
It's okay that you know. Afterall, my soul's already in your hands.
You said it yourself. So long as I don't tell anyone, you'll do whatever I ask, right?
I know how frustrating it is to get interrupted half way through a manga. I totally get it.
It's kinda boring just sitting here while you read, though. Got anything I can do?
There's some paint and a skateboard stored here.
Do you want to paint the skateboard, Boss?
Minova and I sit back to back on the bridge.
I pick up the paintbrush, and she flips open her manga.
When I finish my final stroke, night has already descended.
Having finished reading her manga, Minova sits in silence, gazing out at the majestic city of Emor.
You can see Ashwind Clan from here.
Minova lifts her bat and casually points it into the night.
I can't tell which house she's pointing to, but I know she's got it right.
I'm so happy. I got to do so many things with you today.
Got into a fight. Went to class. And secretly read my manga.
Sigh. Now you know all my secrets.
So... Which version of me do you like more?
Or rather, which one do you think is the real Minova?
What a silly question. All of them, of course.
The top student at Platinum Academy who reads shojo manga and knows how to fight—that's the real Minova.
Boss, I'm starting to feel like giving my soul to you was a really good idea, because you understand people.
Stop it, I'm just a regular Trekker.
The wind may blow far, but it never forgets where it started.
Boss, when the journey wears you out, don't forget to come back and visit Emor once in a while.
Don't forget that there's a soul here that belongs to you.
My shoulder brushes against Minova's as the cool night breeze sweeps through the bridge, lifting her hair.
Then the skateboard I just painted, let's call it a gift from your Boss.
Not bad at all. I didn't realize a painting technique like this existed...
Thanks...?==W== Ahem, the theme of the painting is—
These twisted lines … the exaggerated expression of tension...
It's perfect for scaring the hell out of enemies!
No, actually, it's you. Standing on the Waterway Bridge, gazing into the distance.
Yeah... Now that I look closely, that really is me.
Ahem—this really nails the confusion and frustration I felt back when Creta Trading had us cornered.
No need to butter me up. It's just a small token of how much you mean to me.
If you want to show how much I mean to you, perhaps we should hold hands on our way back.
Under the moonlight, hand in hand, we glide across the Waterway Bridge, slowly slipping into the misty night.
The skateboard is later displayed on the wall of Ashwind's lobby.
Only to be ceremonially taken down for major battles with rival factions.
When that happens, Minova herself rides it, leading the Ashwind Clan in their fiercest charge.

strings.text: The meaning of the pinwheel gift is a secret that would never be told.
I'd arranged to patrol the market near the Trekker Camp with Nazuka. But when the time came, she still hadn't shown up...
I didn't get the time and location wrong, did I?
It's strange for Nazuka to be late. It's not like her at all...==W== Ah, there she is.
Sorry I'm late. Work got really hectic.
No worries, I haven't been waiting long. Catch your breath first.
Thanks... Whew...==W== I really am sorry.
Don't sweat it. I appreciate the thought.
Let me make it up to you, yeah? Like...==W== Is there anything you'd like, Boss?
It just so happens that I'm a little hungry. How about we grab a meal together?
M-Maybe later! Let's do our patrol first!
Today's objective is to check if there's anyone suspicious around here.
Lady Nazuka! Thanks for your hard work!
Good. Let me know right away if anything comes up.
Hey, isn't that Nazuka! Come try this! It's a thank-you for all you do for the camp. Your friend can have some too.
Thanks, that's kind of you. We're on patrol right now, though. Maybe later...
Got it. But if you take too long, there might not be any left.
Well, since it's so nice of you to offer, I'll just try a little bit.
You know we're still on duty, right? Eating while patrolling is a bit...
It's like they say, you can't work on an empty stomach. And certainly not if someone's stomach keeps growling next to you, either.
And hey, this counts as your compensation, Okay? Thanks to you, I got to eat this for free.
Sorry, could I have one more skewer?
Sure! Eat as much as you like. My treat. The meat today's top quality.
Well then, don't mind if I do...
Actually... I am kind of hungry. I can focus better on a full stomach. Thank you so much.
Of course. After all, we all count on you for emergencies, Nazuka.
Lady Nazuka!==W== Could it be that you are here with your sweetheart?==W== Wow, are you two on a date?
Eh? No, no...==W== ==SEX1== is just here to help me with the patrol.
Haha, no need to hide it! Oh, by the way, what do you think of this?
That's right. It's the symbol of Philae! It's a popular keepsake for couples these days, said to have a lovely meaning...
Like I said, we are not in that kind of relationship.
But you two look perfect together...==W== Then, how about getting this as a gift to bring you two even closer?
I'm this close to getting mad at you.
Haha, sorry, sorry. I just thought it'd be nice if Lady Nazuka could do some free publicity for us. Oh well~
That's what I thought.==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, let's go.
Was it just my imagination, or did she purposely cut that vendor off?
For Nazuka, today's been a hard day to stay calm.
Being late was bad enough, and now her stomach had to rumble on top of it...==W== How careless.
A date!? W-Well, I did meet up with ==SEX4== here, and we did eat skewers together...==W== Do people really think we look like a couple?
It's that old local folklore, right?==W== The pinwheel turns with the wind. To exchange them with someone means you're both promising to stay with each other... Which means...
No... I absolutely cannot let ==PLAYER_NAME== know of this.
Look perfect together? Me and ==PLAYER_NAME==? Really...?==W== No, stop it, Nazuka! Get a grip!
So, was that all just sales talk ... or...
Why has Nazuka gone quiet all of a sudden...
I knew it... That pinwheel really caught her eye...
Did you interrupt that shopkeeper on purpose?
Do those pinwheels have some special meaning behind them?
What was that sound? Was that an explosion somewhere?
Look! Smoke's rising from the camp entrance!
I'll check it out. ==PLAYER_NAME==, please stay here and wait for me.
Wait! I'm coming, too!==W== Ah, she's already gone. Must be nice to have magic.
I said I'd patrol with you today. I'm not letting you do this alone.
Fair enough. You're never the type to stand by and watch.
Did you find out what caused the explosion?
Someone tried to attack the market. They were going to break through from that direction. Luckily, no one was hurt.==W== But by the time I got here, the culprits had already fled.
Sounds like this attack was planned in advance.
They tried to disrupt the peace of this camp... And I won't let them get away.
Nazuka looked into the distance. Her eyes burned with resolve.

strings.text: The real reason for being late is a secret; I just wanted to share your burden.
Someone tried to attack the market. They were going to break through from that direction.==W== Luckily, no one was hurt. But by the time I got here, the culprits had already fled.
Sounds like this attack was planned in advance.
They tried to disrupt the peace of this camp...==W== And I won't let them get away.
I understand how you feel, but they've already escaped. What's your next move?
I have a rough idea as to where they might be.
Actually, the reason I was late today was that I was investigating a suspicious group's hideout.
I caught some of them, but the rest managed to escape. That was my mistake.
That's why you asked me to join the patrol?
Yeah. I was hoping maybe you'd notice something I missed, given your insight...==W== Didn't expect them to assault the camp in the open.
So, do you know what they're after?
Most likely supplies. Since the hunting squad disbanded, security around the camp's gotten weaker. They've already carried out several thefts.
If they managed to slip past you, they must be pretty crafty.
They know I'm after them and are being careful. They've changed hideouts multiple times in just a few days.
But today, they went too far. To attack openly like this... I'm taking them all down, no matter what.
Thanks, but I don't want you taking unnecessary risks.
I know it's dangerous. And not to brag, I definitely look like the fragile type.
That's definitely not something one brags about...
Still, that might work in our favor. The weaker I look, the more they'll let their guard down.
I can serve as bait to draw them out.
I have someone I can rely on. If anything happens, you'll protect me, right, Nazuka?
All right. We did make a promise, after all.
So, what exactly is your plan?
We go straight for the source. Do you have any leads on where they might be? We can check one by one.
Judging from the direction they fled, it's likely the forest...==W== There's a suspicious spot there. It was already on my list.
Then it's settled. Lead the way.
==PLAYER_NAME== can't use magic, I really shouldn't have let ==SEX4== go alone.
"I have someone I can rely on. If anything happens, you'll protect me, right, Nazuka?"
How am I supposed to respond to that?
But that kind of trust really means a lot to me.
The old me would've never imagined feeling this way.
Eek! You're way too friendly...==W== Nazuka, help meee!
Pfft...==W== And here I thought something must have happened. It's just a deer!
Don't laugh! It's too strong—ow!==W== Okay, okay, you want me to pet you, right?
A wild deer being this friendly, huh...==W== Guess animals really like you.
Now's not the time to analyze that!==W== Hey! Don't chew my clothes! You'll get sick!
The deer knows you won't hurt it.
Are you saying I'm too gentle, or too weak? Ugh, fine, I'll take that as a compliment...
Wait—did you hear that?==W== Shh, stay quiet.
Nazuka and the deer both turned toward the forest... Something's there.
You're not getting away!<size=50> My dinner!
Hey, look! It's the deer that got away earlier!
Didn't think dinner would come find us! Talk about lucky!
So this deer came to us for help.
You actually came chasing after us even after the explosion?
Hmph, of course you wouldn't just let us go...
Let's all give them a proper beating so they won't dare chase us again!
You said "lucky" just now, eh?==W== I think so, too. It's time to make up for my mistake.

I have someone I can rely on. If anything happens, you'll protect me, right, Nazuka?
All right. We did make a promise, after all.
So, what exactly is your plan?
We go straight for the source. Do you have any leads on where they might be? We can check one by one.
Judging from the direction they fled, it's likely the forest...==W== There's a suspicious spot there. It was already on my list.
Then it's settled. Lead the way.
==PLAYER_NAME== can't use magic, I really shouldn't have let ==SEX4== go alone.
"I have someone I can rely on. If anything happens, you'll protect me, right, Nazuka?"
How am I supposed to respond to that?
But that kind of trust really means a lot to me.
The old me would've never imagined feeling this way.
Eek! You're way too friendly...==W== Nazuka, help meee!
Pfft...==W== And here I thought something must have happened. It's just a deer!
Don't laugh! It's too strong—ow!==W== Okay, okay, you want me to pet you, right?
A wild deer being this friendly, huh...==W== Guess animals really like you.
Now's not the time to analyze that!==W== Hey! Don't chew my clothes! You'll get sick!
The deer knows you won't hurt it.
Are you saying I'm too gentle, or too weak? Ugh, fine, I'll take that as a compliment...
Wait—did you hear that?==W== Shh, stay quiet.
Nazuka and the deer both turned toward the forest... Something's there.
You're not getting away!<size=50> My dinner!
Hey, look! It's the deer that got away earlier!
Didn't think dinner would come find us! Talk about lucky!
So this deer came to us for help.
You actually came chasing after us even after the explosion?
Hmph, of course you wouldn't just let us go...
Let's all give them a proper beating so they won't dare chase us again!
You said "lucky" just now, eh?==W== I think so, too. It's time to make up for my mistake.

strings.text: What I said that day is a secret; someday, I'll tell you what's truly in my heart.
You said "lucky" just now, eh?==W== I think so, too. It's time to make up for my mistake.
Hah, did you hear that? She thinks she can take us three on by herself.
You're just a barely famous Trekker. You'll regret crossing us!
That's right! Listen up, guys—once I give the signal, charge!
As for me...==W== I'll be off!
O' leaves that with the wild wind play, weave now a wall to bar the way!
We talked about this before. The attackers already knew about Nazuka and kept avoiding her. The ones left wouldn't dare face her head-on.
I thought I'd get caught up in the fight, but at this rate...
It's already over in an instant... Amazing.
A wall of wind and leaves blocking their escape...==W== You used this magic before, when fighting the Spirit of Brutality, right?
Heh, you remembered. The wind barrier doesn't just defend me; it traps the enemy inside.
Scouting, attack, capture... Nazuka really can do it all.
I've called for reinforcements. They're on their way.
Once we get these guys to tell us where the others are hiding, the rest won't be a problem.==W== That'll wrap up our patrol for today.
Thanks for keeping me company. And...==W== I'm so so sorry. Even with me here, you still got a scare.
I just got a deer bite, that's all.
Don't worry about it. I just wanted to help you catch those criminals.
Now we can relax and stroll around the market, right? Haha.
Still, if I'd captured them all earlier, I wouldn't have had to drag you into all this.
There seems to be some sort of misunderstanding.
Did you think I was blaming you?
You just made one mistake. You're way too hard on yourself.
I only wanted to repay your trust, that's all.
You are the perfect fighter, but I just wanted to help, even if that meant being the decoy.
In the end, I didn't do much, but I'm still glad I got to work with you.
I just realized... We both try so hard to live up to each other's expectations.
But ==PLAYER_NAME==, to me, you're already one of a kind—a partner I can't replace.
As long as you stay with me, then...
That's a secret.==W== I want to keep this feeling to myself, for now.
Now you've got me even more curious. Guess I'll just have to work harder until you tell me yourself.
Now, what's next? We already had those skewers, so I'm not hungry.
Oh, by the way, Nazuka, let's go back to that souvenir shop from earlier.
I'm curious about the pinwheel thing.
You reacted oddly back then. Does it mean something I don't know about?
Then let me put it this way... If I gave you a pinwheel, would it make you happy?
Excuse me, could I have one of those pinwheels from before?
Eh?==W== You,==W== you actually bought the pinwheel?...==W== Can I really accept this?
B-==W==Boss…?!==W== This...==W== pinwheel...==W== Can I really accept this?
I do!==W== Ah...==W== I mean...==W== the pinwheel...==W== I like it.
N-No, not at all!==W== I just, uh...==W== No,==W== it's no==W== bother…
It's...==W== It's just==W== too sudden...==W== Th-==W==Thank you,==W== I like it very much.
I was...==W== just a little surprised, that's all.==W== But I'm really happy.==W== Th-Thank you.
So what does giving a pinwheel mean, anyway?
No way.==W== It's a secret.==W== You can't know about it.
That...==W== I can't tell you.==W== Not even you.==W== It's a secret.
Then … can I give one to someone else?
No.==W== I won't tell you.==W== And,==W== you can't give one to anyone else either.==W== Don't ask others what it means…
Because I can't.==W== But,==W== promise me you won't give anyone else a pinwheel.==RT====W==Oh, and,==W== don't ask anyone else what it means to give someone a pinwheel.
… and don't tell others==W== that you gave me one.
Also...==W== Don't tell anyone else==W== that you gave me one.==W== Promise?
You've got a lot of rules. But I'll agree.
O-==W==Okay...==W== And...==W== I'm getting you one, too…
O-Okay…==W== That's good.==W== In that case,==W== I may just give you a pinwheel too…
But!==W== You absolutely mustn't tell others==W== about me giving you a pinwheel.==W== Promise?
But after I do,==W== you absolutely,==W== absolutely==W== must never tell anyone else.==W== Got it?==W== Absolutely!
Alright, then this is our little secret.
Eh…==W== Hm.==W== Hehe.==W== This pinwheel...==W== I'll take good care of it.==W== For the one from me,==W== remember to do the same…
Ah...==W== Hehe,==W== thank you.==W==This pinwheel...==W== I will always treasure it...==W== And I hope==W== you'll always treasure yours.
Speaking of which, these two pinwheels seem to look a little different.
Of course, that's the characteristic of handmade pinwheels from Philae—the difference lies in the details of the craftsmanship.
So every windmill is "one of a kind"...
So, if you don't have anything else coming,==W== shall we walk around the market together?
With pinwheels in hand, the two of us strolled through the bustling market, our steps light and easy,==W== until night finally fell...

strings.text: The adventures have come to a temporary end. Growth has brought on new troubles. You and the timid white-haired girl reunite once again as Philae is slowly covered in snow.
Hey, something's going on up ahead. Is it a festival or something?
Hurry, hurry—if we don't move now, we'll never get to see them.
The Petal Bloom Guild and Lady Fuyuka must be really busy right now. Do you think they have the time to come?
Don't underestimate my intel network. I've checked Lady Fuyuka's complete schedule!
Oh, you have actual intel? Nice.
Ah, it's Fuyuka. No wonder there's a crowd... But judging from that look on her face...
Wow, you're amazing! This...==W== This is my first time seeing you in person, Miss Fuyuka! Could I have your autograph?
Miss Fuyuka, I have a one of the kind hunt commission here. Would you be interested to join?
Miss Fuyuka, I've been following your impressive work for a while! I'm preparing an academic report on the Big Three. Would you be willing to accept an interview?
She looks totally overwhelmed. Facing this many people at once must be terrifying for an Introvert. Guess I should go help her a little.
Enough, you lot. Can't you see you're imposing on Lady Fuyuka?
Hey, at least someone can read the room.
She's Philae's biggest star! The top Trekker around here, no question!
People like that don't owe us ordinary folk their attention.
That's true...==W== Lady Fuyuka's silent, regal presence is utterly captivating. We didn't even notice that. We should be ashamed!
Guess I can't just stand by and watch...
What are you doing here? Weren't you on a commission today?
You and your terrible memory. This was a special commission the client asked us to keep secret.
<size=30>Don't ask questions, just follow my lead.</size>
Oh... That's right.==W== Sorry, I forgot. Let's go right now.
Could everyone clear a path, please? We're on the job. She's really busy.
Who was that just now? And how did ==SEX== manage to get Fuyuka to come along?
Shh, keep your voice down. That looked like ...==W== the CEO of The Boss Accord. They say that with a single magic, ==SEX== wiped out a Stellaroid as big as a United Harvest factory.
Wow, Lady Fuyuka being invited by a CEO in person. So cool.
Okay, we have gotten away from the crowd now.
Th-thank you...==W== Master, you saved me again. Um... My hand.
I've been running so long that my hands are sweaty, but I kept clinging to you with these damp hands. So sorry...
Phew...==W== That's a relief.Um—Master, in that case,==W== could you keep holding my hand? It makes me feel safe.
You really saved me back there. I might've fainted otherwise.
Don't mention it. I just happened to be passing by.
You're famous now. Having an enthusiastic fanbase is normal. Next time, wear a cloak or something, disguise yourself a little.
Actually...==W== I did it on purpose. I wanted to challenge myself by getting out from my comfort zone.
At first, I practiced with a friend. A few days ago I thought I was ready to give it a try, but it still didn't work out...
But I think it's necessary.==W== Oh! I haven't finished today's training yet, so please excuse me!
She ran off so fast...==W== I can't tell if that means she's too timid or just way too proactive.
She practiced with a friend? I should go check it out. I'm curious about this training thing.
Fuyuka should be nearby.==W== How did I end up in the woods?
Today I tried talking to strangers. It turned out real conversations didn't go like practice...
But when I was so scared that I couldn't even move, my Master showed up and came to my rescue...!
Fuyuka is ...==W== talking to a tree?
No, she's talking to a bird in the tree. Is that the friend she mentioned?
Master already helped me mastered my punch. If I have rely on ==SEX4== to fix my talking problem, too, I'll be a total failure as an apprentice...
First, I'd like to talk, uh, talk about...
Is that ...==W== a speech? Fuyuka's been working at it quietly, but just practicing like that won't be enough.
In that case, I should do my part as the Master.==W== Hmm, maybe I could—
Caw-caw, not the tree. A little bird.
A little bird...==W== No, wait—you sound like Mas—
That's right. I'm the little bird hermit who lives in the forest and provide guidance to Trekkers.
In short, caw-caw, I specialize in teach Trekkers all sorts of things.
You came all the way into the heart of the forest because you were feeling lost, right?
<size=30>Oh...==W== You noticed. Such sharp observation—==W==just as I'd expect.</size>
I—I do have something troubling me that I would like to tell you, Mas—==W==erm—Hermit!
Our camp has a tradition: Trekkers give talks to share adventure tips and encourage others...==W== And I was picked to give the next talk.
It shows that everyone thinks highly of you. They believe that represent the best of Philae's Trekkers.
I, I know. And I really do appreciate the chance.
But...==W== I'm terrible with talking to strangers, never mind public speaking...
I read that picturing the audience as small animals or plants helps with nerves, but...==W== It didn't really work.
Ugh...==W== Am I doing this the right way?
Don't be upset. Leave it to me.

strings.text: Her efforts may be clumsy, but they're sincere. And the change is happening before anyone realizes it.
Think of conversations as a battlefield?
Yes. Since you can throw punches freely now, there's no reason you can't speak freely.
Use a perspective-shift: turn things you're unfamiliar with into things you are familiar with.
Turn them into familiar things...==W== I—I think I understand, thank you for the advice. Um...==W== May I ask, is there anything I can do to repay you?
Hmmm...==W== As her teacher, I couldn't very well ask for payment... Then...
The bitter wind and snow will soon arrive. If you wish to repay my guidance, then when the time comes, prepare a warm nest for the little birds in the forest.
Ah...==W== I guess the Master—I mean, the little bird hermit—is gone.
Whew...==W== Now it's up to me. Picture it as a battlefield...==W== battlefield, a Trekker's battlefield...==W== Then I should go take some commission first!
She ran off so fast again. Probably went back out there. Still, I'm a bit worried, I'll just follow and see...
So, so many people...==W== It looks like the same crowd from before.
If I just walk over casually, I'll get surrounded like last time—I did get the commission, but how do I get to the client...?
Think of it like a battlefield ... a battlefield... ==W==So all I have to do is dodge the attacking monsters while making my way forward as fast as I can...
Wait, did someone who looked like Fuyuka just run over that way...?
She got on the roof in an instant?!
Damn, if I don't chase now I'll lose her. Excuse me, coming through!
These are building materials needed for the marketplace. Please be careful carrying them.
Wow! Lady Fuyuka! Out of nowhere!
Um...==W== I'm here to accept a commission.
This commission is hauling goods; it doesn't seem too hard. The client looks easy to talk to. I'm sure this will be fine!
So it was really you!? I thought it had to be someone with the same name.
Y-yes, it's me. Please tell me about the situation...
Ah, got it. We're getting ready to expand the camp's marketplace, and the commission is to haul building materials.
That's the situation. Do you have any thoughts?
Phew...==W== Didn't see that coming, but luckily I caught it in time.
Th-that was so scary. I thought we were about to be crushed...
Everyone, look, Lady Fuyuka stepped in! She swooped in and saved several people in a flash. So cool!
Thank you so much! Did you foresee this and that's why you took the commission!?

Heheh...==W== That makes me feel better.

strings.text: You're going about your usual business when you discover the secretive gaze of Mistique the witch...
A pretty ordinary day, with bustling streets full of people.
My task for today is the honorable and important task of material procurement.==RT==At least, that's what I thought at first.
After I'm done, I can take advantage of the good weather, enjoy some sunshine, and laze around for a bit...
But first, I need to deal with the issue before...==W== Or, more precisely, the one behind me.
About fifteen minutes ago, I started feeling a chill creeping up my back every now and then.
It was a hungry stare—sharp, wicked, and dripping with anticipation.
Stop it, Mistique. I saw you already.
If you keep sneaking photos of me, I'm gonna start charging you a fee.
A sudden breeze, sweet-scented and wild, blows past. And just like that, a clever, charming little witch swoops down on her broom right next to me.
What, walking's not good enough for you? Or do you get your broom' maintenance done for free?
I'm a witch, I gotta look the part!
Witch Rule #1: Never run when you can fly!
Making stuff up again, huh...==W== You don't even remember what number you got to last time, do you?
Never mind all that, Boss. How'd you even notice me?
If you're gonna tail someone, even if you don't bother with disguises, at least hide that hat of yours!
Also, at least mute the shutter sound on your camera...
Oh, my! I didn't even notice that! For shame!
Curses! This has gotta be the biggest mistake of my whole career as a witch... ==W==My one regret...!
I would believe you, except you're snapping more pics as we speak...
In Nova, witches are people who fly around on brooms, snap photos, and turn stories into reports.
Most of them work for Scarlet Sights Media and follow their instructions. But of course, Mistique feels differently.
Witch Rule #2: Nothing can stand in the way of truth!
Alright, alright, I get it.==W== So, what kind of "truth" are you trying to get out of my face today?
Sheesh, there are too many eyes and ears on the street. This kind of important collaboration needs a proper, quiet place to talk it over!
I know that Mistique is full of secrets.
She rarely releases any reports through Scarlet Sight Media.
Or rather, even if she does, it won't be under her name. It's like she's gotten kicked out of the industry or something.
Anyway... Better not draw attention to ourselves out here on the street. Let's find somewhere to sit down and talk.
No sooner do we settle into the dessert shop than Mistique bursts out, buzzing with excitement. She's just picked up a "mysterious commission"!
Anyway, this one pays really well...!
Besides, it just so happens to line up perfectly with what I've been into lately!
Now I've got the perfect excuse, hehehe. ==W==I can finally take a proper photo of you, Boss!
Can you at least put the camera down while you are talking to me...?
So the commission was to take photos of me?
Exactly!==W== And it's gotta be close-up, juicy and sweet, perfectly fresh...
What am I to you? A fruit?
So, ==W==Boss!==W== Pretty please,==W== just show me mercy and obediently surrender under my camera's lens, okay?
You want my mercy or my surrender? Never mind all that...
What's in it for me, Miss Witch?
Her cheerful smile from just a moment ago freezes in place. The corner of her mouth starts to twitch.
Don't tell me—you're planning to snap your photos, vanish without a trace, and keep all that money to yourself?
She presses her fingers together, eyes darting to the side—like that's somehow gonna help her talk her way out of this.
If you want the Boss to grant your wish, you'd better be ready to pay up!
Wah!! Boss, how could you even say such a thing to me?!!!
Why are you crying? I'm the victim here.
The witch pulls her usual trick by throwing a dramatic tantrum.
Mhm, and next comes the "poor me" act, right?
Ugh... As you know, my work is super unsteady most of the time!
I work my butt off writing all those reports, and the money I make barely covers a cupcake a day!==W== Ah, no, thank you, I wasn't ordering...!
Ahem... Finally, thanks to a generous benefactor, I get a chance to make some easy money with a side gig, only to be cruelly turned down by—
This time, ==W==I shall be your generous benefactor!
Clear your schedule for the day.
You're mine for the rest of the day.
Bo-boss! Wh-what do you want me to do?!!!
The weather sure is nice today.
Perfect for snapping pictures, don't you think?

You're mine for the rest of the day.
Bo-boss! Wh-what do you want me to do?!!!
The weather sure is nice today.
Perfect for snapping pictures, don't you think?

strings.text: Your special interview with Mistique is cut short by mysterious stalkers.
These and those too, please help me pack them up.
Please have them delivered to the address on this slip tomorrow—if no one's outside, just knock on the RV's door.
Oh, right! Add a few more of these too...==W== Yup, thanks! And no delivery fee this time either, right?
<size=50>So touching! Truly the thrifty Boss we all never expected!
It's just food and adventure supplies, but the quantities are spot-on, everything's well-balanced, and you even managed to hit the free shipping minimum!
With leadership qualities like yours, you will be running the greatest company in Nova in no time!
Excuse me, miss. Would you mind not standing in front of the counter if you're not paying?
Ah! Sorry, I was just running my mouth. It was a compliment, haha!
Can you dial back the over-the-top lines a little? Coming up with a snarky reply for everything can be tiring, you know.
Gotta have a few lines prepared. It makes writing the report so much easier later!
That's one of the witches' favorite pro tips, you know!
Anyway... Asking a witch for image rights fee is beneath someone like me.
So in exchange, I'm having Mistique write a piece about Boss Accord Staffing—and in the process, take a few pictures for me.
As to what else she's going to do with the pics, ==W==I'm not going to ask.
Is it the right thing to do?==W== Oh well, I guess it counts as free advertising. Might bring in some extra business.
Plus, it's solid proof to the girls that I'm not slacking off even on my day off!
Little by little, I will build my everlasting authority. Mwa Ha Ha!
So you aren't carrying any of the stuff you just bought?
Last time I insisted on carrying everything back myself and ended up with strap marks all over my hands.
Ever since I found out they offer delivery, I've been hitting that free shipping minimum...
Speaking of which, I grabbed a packet of dried fish just to round out the order. I figured I'd share it with the others.
Come on, learn to enjoy life a little...==W== This is supposed to be your day off!
Trekking through the wilds, dealing with Monolith crises all the time... It's only fair for a Trekker to enjoy a bit of peace and quiet during a rare city break.
A chance like this only comes once in a long while. Are you seriously not gonna sneak in a snack to treat yourself?
The snack is for everyone in the New Star Guild. I can't take them all for myself.
Oh my gosh, Boss! Who would've thought you were such a noble, team-minded leader!
Even when there's only one packet of snacks, you won't hesitate to share it with your loyal crew!
That's right. So none for you.
I hold up a piece of dried fish, dangling it right in front of Mistique's eyes.
Her eyes follow the dried fish as I wave it around. Then she lunges … and misses.
It's clear as day...==W== Be it New Star Guild … or Boss Accord Staffing...==W== Business is booming for you!==W==
Even while out of breath from trying to grab the dried fish, she keeps going with her rambling.
I, I may just be a humble witch … but there's still plenty … I can do for you!==W== Don't you think...?
I gently pop the dried fish into her mouth.
Money's been tight lately. I haven't bought this brand of dried fish in ages!
Can't believe Mistique's still like a kid—a few pieces of dried fish and she's beaming.
Now that I look at her... With the hat on, she might actually be taller than me.
Mistique's always full of curiosity about me, but I've never gotten to know anything about her past.
Sigh... I guess I should figure myself out first before moving on to others.
She looks so happy munching on it... Maybe I'll try one, too.
A picture of you smiling on your day off. This photo's gotta fetch a good price!
Oh, so this is to catch a shot of my smile, huh?
Mistique... She's actually a pretty amazing witch, isn't she?
Weird. I'm getting that same eerie chill again.
Looks like this stroll can use a little upgrade.
Her gesture seems to say, "don't worry, everything's under control."
Wait, no... Come to think of it, I'm usually the one saying stuff like that.
There's a shortcut from the shopping street to here...? That's useful.
So, you noticed it too, right, Boss?
Yeah, someone was secretly taking photos of us.
Though, I can't believe they did a worse job of staying covert than you.
Was that a compliment? Fufu, Mistique one, shady stalkers zero!
Jokes aside, are you sure you were the only one who took that commission of taking my photo?
Pretty sure. After all,==W== they specifically asked for me.
Yeah. I mean, the commission was a simple notice on the bulletin board, but it specifically stated, "for Mistique, the witch who seeks the truth!"
Come to think of it, even if it were open to everyone else, only you' actually stalk me and snap photos.
Hey, I was not stalking you. I was practically doing it out in the open.
Tsk. And here I thought I had shaken off those pesky rats.
No sooner had Mistique finished speaking than a group of armed Trekkers stepped out from the shadows of the alley.
She's not alone? Guess we have no other choice.
We go on three, let's bag this.
You dare interrupt a witch's interview … during her day off? Such audacity...
Sweeping away those who interfere with an interview,==W== that's also the duty of a witch!

strings.text: The Boss and the Witch form an alliance and share an unforgettable moment.
I feel dizzy... I really wanna throw up.
Wow, I had no idea you could fly that fast...
It's just part of the job when you're a witch!
Even though she threw out some cool lines at those creeping stalkers, Mistique surprisingly—and pretty decisively—made a run for it!
Well, at least she had the decency to grab me before taking off.
Her broom really is fast... But if there's ever a next time...
I hope it'll at least be a nice, smooth ride, not a frantic escape like this.
But seriously, Boss, I had no idea you were this valuable.
Looks like this client wants more than just photos of you.
Ugh, this is a total mid-commission hijack attempt! Ever heard of professional ethics?!
So even a mischievous witch like her has moments when she can't keep her cool.
We might be safe for now, but who knows when the bad guys will show up again?
… They specifically asked for her, huh?==W== … I see.
The answer's right there in the question. If I don't clear it up now and Mistique gets the wrong idea, that'll create problems.
<size=30>Tch... And here I was hoping to check out a few more spots with you.
Mistique, calm down, listen to me—
Don't you think what happened was really strange?
Oh? Has my brilliant Boss figured something out?
… Ah, hearing the Boss call me by name—what a treat!
I'm used to this kind of teasing from her, so I just keep explaining my theory.
Were those people really after me?
Mistique, have you been getting tailed more than usual lately?
So you're saying... You aren't the one being followed, it's me they are after?
When you think you're the hunter, you might actually be the prey.
Oh my gosh, are you actually worried about me?!
N-no, of course not. Just a logical deduction, that's all.
Mistique, you're always on the move, hard to track down. Whoever's after you probably noticed how interested you've been in me lately.
So they figured if they used me as bait... You'd show up on the streets without a second thought.
I see... They got me there.
When you're on your own, no one can catch you, because you're always zipping around on your broom.
But if you need to sneak photos of me, you start to move slower and become way easier to spot.
You must have some idea, Mistique. Who would want to catch you?
She answers me with a teasing grin, skipping in circles with her hands tucked behind her back.
Trying to dodge my question again, huh?
As you know, I'm a witch, and a great one at that.
Yes, we all know that. Please go on.
I've pissed a lot of people off with my reports.
Scarlet Sight Media's already stopped giving me assignments a while ago, but I'm still out there every day, chasing stories on my own.
There are just way too many people who want me to stop digging.
I didn't figure anyone in Nova could attract even more attention than Boss Accord.
One of the perks of being a witch, I guess.
If what you're saying is true, and all this trouble started because someone's trying to take me down...
Then maybe I should stop flying by to hang out with you.
… Because I still want to be that witch who chases the truth.
But if being around you puts you in danger... Then I really would be just a witch who brings bad luck...
This isn't something to joke about, so I cut her off mid-sentence.
I don't want her to get the wrong idea.
Didn't I just say? You are the special kind of witch...
A fearsome witch whose very existence alone draws the attention of enemies, just like Boss Accord!
The Boss who wants to turn the world upside down, and the Witch who's managed to tick the whole world off. Sounds like a power duo to me!
Besides, I'm the Boss! Protecting a witch is easy peasy!
Heh,==W== I'm gonna remember what you just said!
No, no, very much befitting your station, Boss!
The Witch and the Boss, making a pact! Ah, what a memorable moment...
Can I take a photo to capture the moment?
I'm gonna hold you to that.
Hey, Boss? ==W==How are you feeling right now?==W==
I-I can't move! What did you do!?
Relax. ==W==It's just little spell that gives me control of your body. ==W====W==It's your fault, you know. ==W====W==Sneaking into my heart like that.
Ehehe...==W== After all, ==W====W==if we're taking a photo, ==W==it has to be a good one. ★==W==
You know, ==W==the Boss mustn't break promises. ==W====W==You agreed to the photo shoot, remember? ==W====W==Now come on, smile! ♪
Hm? ==W==The framing isn't bad ...==W== but that face. Hmm...==W==
Hm? ==W==The framing isn't bad ...==W== but that face. Hmm...
Hah-ha. ★ ==W==Fair point. ==W==But if a photo like this were to get out, ==W====W==I wonder what people would say?==W==
Unless ...==W== you don't actually mind getting caught up in scandal with me? ==W====W==Ehehe. Come on, let's have the truth!==W==
Aww, playing it cool?==W== You're so adorable. ♪ ==W==Then how about this?
If this photo of your pathetic self made its way into the world, ==W====W==what would happen to your company's reputation?
That's not teasing anymore, that's blackmail!
Yes, ==W==that's it! ==W==That's EXACTLY the face I wanted to see, Boss! ==W==Ehehe! Now hold still... ♪
Yes, ==W==that's it! ==W==That's EXACTLY the face I wanted to see, Boss! ==W==Ehehe! ==W==Now hold still... ♪
I'm not sure if Mistique let go or if I just pulled too hard—either way, I managed to break free.
What kind of pictures did you take!
Perfect! I'll title this one: The Boss's Soft and Squishy Moment!
Oh well... What am I gonna do with you...
Hehe, thanks a ton! A witch never forgets a favor!
This exclusive report will be my gift to you, Boss!
… Yeah, I can't say I am looking forward to it.
A pretty ordinary day, with bustling streets full of people.
The Witch and the Boss, our story has just begun.
Hehe, this photo of us together...

strings.text: You accidentally stumble into a gathering of noble ladies ... and see a different side of hers.
Ah, the fruit tarts look gorgeous today. The fruits are sparkling like jewels.==W== Right, Eleanor?
And isn't this black tea your favorite? I remember you raving about it to us.
Eleanor! Are you even listening to us?
Whoa?! S-Sorry, what were we talking about?
Unbelievable...==W== You've been miles away this whole afternoon. What's on your mind?
You know you can tell us anything. If something's bothering you, we're here to listen.
No, it's nothing like that...==W== Oh.
Sorry, do you mind if I answer this?
I'm heading to Emor next week. Got something I'd like to discuss in person.
Just name the date, Mentor! I'll be there to welcome you!
I can't believe it... Mentor wants to see me...!
My, my. Sounds like we're expecting an important guest, Vivian.
It certainly does, Caterine. A really special guest for our dear Eleanor, it seems.
W-Wait! It's not like that! Mentor and I aren't—!
Oh? How strange. Is the great Boss not considered a special guest?
Hehe. You don't need to explain. We already know.
Speaking of which, we haven't officially met the famous Boss yet.
Good point. Eleanor, why not take this chance to introduce us to the Boss?
We can even invite the Boss to join our tea party while ==SEX== is here.
Great idea. Eleanor, do you know what kind of black tea the Boss likes?
W-Well! I need to ask ==SEX4== first...
Got it, I'll ask right now!
Hehe, no rush. Take your time.
<size=85%>... Vivian, you know what I mean, right?</size>
<size=85%>Of course, Caterine. We'll talk details later...</size>
Nice to meet you. I'm Vivian. We've known Eleanor since we were kids.
Pleasure to meet you, Boss. I'm Caterine. It's an honor.
Great to meet you both. Eleanor talks about you all the time.
I heard you two helped her become a Trekker.
She speaks highly of you too. She told us if you hadn't reached out back then, she might have given up on her dream already.
Whoa! Wait, Vivian! That was supposed to be a secret!
Oh my, Eleanor, you're blushing!==W== Feeling shy?
Aw, there's nothing to be shy about!
Ahem, sorry about that. Anyway, Mentor, what's on your mind?
I'm going to a ball at the end of this month as the company rep, but I can't dance to save my life.
So I was hoping you could teach me.==W== You take dance lessons, right?
I'm not that good! I can introduce you to my instructor if you want...
Spoken like a true CEO. You definitely found the right person.
Yeah! If you want to learn, Eleanor is the perfect choice!
Even her instructor thinks she's great. Plus, with your rapport, you'll feel way less nervous. Right?
Fair point.==W== But if it makes Eleanor uncomfortable, I won't push it...
<size=85%>Say yes, Eleanor! You've been dying to repay your Mentor, right?</size>
<size=85%>Well, yes, but...</size>==W== <size=85%>Caterine! That was supposed to be a secret too!</size>
Boss, could I borrow you for a second?
I know we just met, forgive me for being forward...==W== But for Eleanor's sake, please help us.
Could you find a good time to ask what's on her mind?==W== She's been sighing nonstop lately, and we're really worried.
There are things she won't share with us. But if you ask, she might open up...
Don't get me wrong. Her dancing talent is the real deal. She is the best person to teach you.
Got it. I'll find some time to ask her about it.
Thank you! Eleanor is right about you. She said you were her most trusted Mentor.
She talks about me that much? I'm kind of flattered...
Vivian, were you whispering something to Mentor?
I was pitching you to the Boss as ==SEX3== dance teacher, of course!
That's right. I'm counting on you to teach me, Eleanor.
A personal request from the Boss ==SEX8==, Eleanor! The perfect chance to return the favor.
O-Okay.==W== If it helps you, Mentor,==W== I'll do it.
Then it's settled! You two have logistics to sort out, so we'll get out of your hair.
No time like the present! Catch you later, Eleanor. Boss.
... Well, they didn't waste any time.
I'm sorry, Mentor. Looks like our tea party will have to wait...
Don't worry about it. But honestly, Eleanor, is something on your mind?
That so? I heard you've been sighing nonstop lately.
Ah...==W== Vivian told you, didn't she? Which means Caterine was keeping me busy to...
To give her a chance to talk to me alone, yeah.
You've got two great friends. Try not to make them worry.
I'd like to help, too. If you trust me, I'm always here to listen.
... It's nothing, honestly. I've been wondering how to be more like you.
Yeah. I want to be a great leader like you. But I'm still inexperienced...==W== Realizing how far more I have to go has been weighing on me.
But Eleanor, you've already proven yourself. Everyone here knows you're a capable Trekker.
Not at all. I'm nowhere near that level!
An issue like that shouldn't worry her friends this much...
Tell you what. Have you taken on any commissions lately? I'd love to see how much you've grown.
Let me shadow your Trekker work for a few days. Once I get a feel for your routine, we can figure out exactly what you're missing.
Wait, you don't need to go to all that trouble...==W== What about your dance lessons?
No rush on those. Let's get your worries sorted first. That way you can focus entirely on teaching me, right?
Ah...==W== That makes sense...==W== I'll be in your care then, Mentor.

param: You accidentally stumble into a gathering of noble ladies ... and see a different side of hers.
Ah, the fruit tarts look gorgeous today. The fruits are sparkling like jewels.==W== Right, Eleanor?
And isn't this black tea your favorite? I remember you raving about it to us.
Eleanor! Are you even listening to us?
Whoa?! S-Sorry, what were we talking about?
Unbelievable...==W== You've been miles away this whole afternoon. What's on your mind?
You know you can tell us anything. If something's bothering you, we're here to listen.
No, it's nothing like that...==W== Oh.
Sorry, do you mind if I answer this?
I'm heading to Emor next week. Got something I'd like to discuss in person.
Just name the date, Mentor! I'll be there to welcome you!
I can't believe it... Mentor wants to see me...!
My, my. Sounds like we're expecting an important guest, Vivian.
It certainly does, Caterine. A really special guest for our dear Eleanor, it seems.
W-Wait! It's not like that! Mentor and I aren't—!
Oh? How strange. Is the great Boss not considered a special guest?
Hehe. You don't need to explain. We already know.
Speaking of which, we haven't officially met the famous Boss yet.
Good point. Eleanor, why not take this chance to introduce us to the Boss?
We can even invite the Boss to join our tea party while ==SEX== is here.
Great idea. Eleanor, do you know what kind of black tea the Boss likes?
W-Well! I need to ask ==SEX4== first...
Got it, I'll ask right now!
Hehe, no rush. Take your time.
<size=85%>... Vivian, you know what I mean, right?</size>
<size=85%>Of course, Caterine. We'll talk details later...</size>
Nice to meet you. I'm Vivian. We've known Eleanor since we were kids.
Pleasure to meet you, Boss. I'm Caterine. It's an honor.
Great to meet you both. Eleanor talks about you all the time.
I heard you two helped her become a Trekker.
She speaks highly of you too. She told us if you hadn't reached out back then, she might have given up on her dream already.
Whoa! Wait, Vivian! That was supposed to be a secret!
Oh my, Eleanor, you're blushing!==W== Feeling shy?
Aw, there's nothing to be shy about!
Ahem, sorry about that. Anyway, Mentor, what's on your mind?
I'm going to a ball at the end of this month as the company rep, but I can't dance to save my life.
So I was hoping you could teach me.==W== You take dance lessons, right?
I'm not that good! I can introduce you to my instructor if you want...
Spoken like a true CEO. You definitely found the right person.
Yeah! If you want to learn, Eleanor is the perfect choice!
Even her instructor thinks she's great. Plus, with your rapport, you'll feel way less nervous. Right?
Fair point.==W== But if it makes Eleanor uncomfortable, I won't push it...
<size=85%>Say yes, Eleanor! You've been dying to repay your Mentor, right?</size>
<size=85%>Well, yes, but...</size>==W== <size=85%>Caterine! That was supposed to be a secret too!</size>
Boss, could I borrow you for a second?
I know we just met, forgive me for being forward...==W== But for Eleanor's sake, please help us.
Could you find a good time to ask what's on her mind?==W== She's been sighing nonstop lately, and we're really worried.
There are things she won't share with us. But if you ask, she might open up...
Don't get me wrong. Her dancing talent is the real deal. She is the best person to teach you.
Got it. I'll find some time to ask her about it.
Thank you! Eleanor is right about you. She said you were her most trusted Mentor.
She talks about me that much? I'm kind of flattered...
Vivian, were you whispering something to Mentor?
I was pitching you to the Boss as ==SEX3== dance teacher, of course!
That's right. I'm counting on you to teach me, Eleanor.
A personal request from the Boss ==SEX8==, Eleanor! The perfect chance to return the favor.
O-Okay.==W== If it helps you, Mentor,==W== I'll do it.
Then it's settled! You two have logistics to sort out, so we'll get out of your hair.
No time like the present! Catch you later, Eleanor. Boss.
... Well, they didn't waste any time.
I'm sorry, Mentor. Looks like our tea party will have to wait...
Don't worry about it. But honestly, Eleanor, is something on your mind?
That so? I heard you've been sighing nonstop lately.
Ah...==W== Vivian told you, didn't she? Which means Caterine was keeping me busy to...
To give her a chance to talk to me alone, yeah.
You've got two great friends. Try not to make them worry.
I'd like to help, too. If you trust me, I'm always here to listen.
... It's nothing, honestly. I've been wondering how to be more like you.
Yeah. I want to be a great leader like you. But I'm still inexperienced...==W== Realizing how far more I have to go has been weighing on me.
But Eleanor, you've already proven yourself. Everyone here knows you're a capable Trekker.
Not at all. I'm nowhere near that level!
An issue like that shouldn't worry her friends this much...
Tell you what. Have you taken on any commissions lately? I'd love to see how much you've grown.
Let me shadow your Trekker work for a few days. Once I get a feel for your routine, we can figure out exactly what you're missing.
Wait, you don't need to go to all that trouble...==W== What about your dance lessons?
No rush on those. Let's get your worries sorted first. That way you can focus entirely on teaching me, right?
Ah...==W== That makes sense...==W== I'll be in your care then, Mentor.

strings.text: Those who take things too seriously are often the ones who push themselves too far.
Eleanor and ==PLAYER_NAME==?==W== Now there's a pair you don't see every day.
I'm just tagging along as Eleanor's mentor today. Want to see for myself how much she's grown.
Hehe, get ready to be impressed.
Now I'm looking forward to it.
Miss Willow, I'll be counting on you for today's commissions!
Willow...==W== What's with all these commissions?==W== It'll take us all day to pick one.
To be clear, these are all direct requests for Eleanor. That's why I brought them all out.
I knew she'd been active and even won some awards, but I didn't expect her to be this popular...
Thinking back to when she started... It's incredible how far she's come.
Well, you've got options. Which one are you taking, Eleanor?
Right, all of them...==W== Wait,==W== all of them?!
Yes! If a commission has my name on it, I'm taking it.
People are putting their trust in me. I refuse to let them down.
I understand where you're coming from, but isn't that way too much for one person?
Eleanor always follows through. She's a huge help to the Association, honestly...
But don't overdo it, Eleanor. I've said it before: every Trekker has the right to say no.
Thank you for worrying about me. But I chose to be a Trekker, and I want to do absolutely everything I can.
Mentor, there's no time to lose. Let's head out!
Is she going to be okay...?
Mentor, this is your room for tonight.
Thank you, Eleanor, you've thought of everything.==W== Are you sure it's alright if I stay, though? I don't want to impose on your parents.
Please don't worry. Mother and Father fully support my Trekker duties now, and I let them know you were coming.
That's a relief. I'll take you up on that, then.
You were incredible today, by the way. You handled all those commissions like a pro. You can hold your own now.
Heh heh, thanks. But I owe it all to your guidance, Mentor.
After seeing you today, I think you should give yourself more credit.
... I still have a long way to go. If I want to catch up to you, I need more experience under my belt.
... Hard work is great, but don't push yourself too hard.
Once Eleanor leaves, I sink into the soft bed and close my eyes.
I don't know how long I've slept, but I get up, all groggy, and stumble into the corridor...
...==W== Where's the bathroom again? This place is huge, and with the lights off, I can't see a thing.
I can't wake someone up just to ask for directions...==W== Wait. Is that light coming from under that door?
Perfect! Someone's still awake. I'll ask them for directions.
Sorry to bother you this late. I was wondering...
... Mentor? What are you doing up at this hour?
Forget that, I have a bigger emergency...!==W== Eleanor, where's the bathroom?
Phew...==W== It's a good thing you were awake. You saved me.
I'm sorry, Mentor, that was my fault. I should have given you a tour of the house before bed.
It's fine...==W== But what are you doing up so late?
I'm studying business management theory. Since I was out running Trekker commissions all day, I haven't finished the coursework Father assigned me yet.
Wait, didn't you say your parents gave you permission to be a Trekker?
They did. But when I got their blessing, I promised them that my studies as the family heir wouldn't suffer.
They respect my dream, but they also expect me to become a capable heir who can lead the family. I refuse to give up on either.
That's admirable, Eleanor, but don't overdo the late nights.==W== We still have commissions tomorrow.
Got it. Just one last bit,==W== and I'm going to bed.
... Alright, I'll let you get back to it. Good night.
Has she been pushing herself this hard every day since they gave her permission?
Miss Willow, I've brought the Artifacts for the commission. Could you do a quick check?
Thanks for the hard work. You can set them down right here.
Okay! Here's this one,==W== and this one—==W==ah!
I catch the Artifact the moment it slips from her hands.
Glad it didn't break. Willow, that should be all of them.
Is it me, or is Eleanor completely zoning out?
... Alright, everything checks out. Commission complete. You're as efficient as ever, Eleanor.
Heh heh,==W== thank you. Okay, Mentor, let's head to the next one...==W== Eh?
As she turns to leave, she stumbles. I step forward and catch her on instinct.
I'm sorry, Mentor.==W== Why do I keep messing up today...?
That's weird...==W== The room is spinning...
You're finally awake. You're in your room.
Wait, what time is it?! I have commissions to finish...
Hey, relax. I already handled your commissions.
All you need to do now is rest. The doctor said you collapsed from overwork.
I see...==W== Sorry...==W== I've been nothing but trouble, Mentor.
Eleanor, I may have told you to believe what you can achieve as a Trekker...
But you have to know your limits too. If you collapse again, you won't be able to finish both your commissions and studies.
True...==W== But...==W== I have reasons to keep going...
Balancing a Trekker's life with being an heir... That was my choice.
Resting when you're tired...==W== It sounds like an excuse for weakness.
... Is that the real issue here?
At the tea party, you paused when I asked what was bothering you.
And when I offered to join you on your commissions...
Wait, you don't need to go to all that trouble...==W== What about your dance lessons?
When you first wanted to become a Trekker, you specifically asked me to train you.
If your worry was about becoming more like me, you wouldn't have been so reluctant.
I figured there was more to it.==W== Looks like I was right.
... Ahaha, nothing gets past you, Mentor.
Lately, I've been losing my confidence...==W== I keep thinking maybe I can't juggle being both a Trekker and an heir.
To become a guild captain, I need experience. To become an heir, I have a mountain of things to learn. But there's never enough time...
I made up my mind to work hard, but ultimately, I lost the confidence to see it through.==W== How pathetic. I'm ashamed...
So you've been carrying all this weight by yourself?
You went out of your way to help me, yet I'm completely useless. I'm sorry...
I don't see it that way.
Anyway, I understand the root of the problem now. Don't worry, we'll figure it out.
Nonetheless, your health comes first. Rest up, and we'll tackle this together later.
Mentor...! ==W== O-Okay, got it. I'll get back on my feet in no time!

strings.text: Take her hand and sweep her into a dazzling dance!
I'm sorry for worrying you before, Mentor.==W== I'm fully recovered now, I promise!
As long as you learned your lesson, that's what counts.==W== Since it's your first day back, how about we start with this commission?
Let's see...==W== Auditing a ledger?==W== And the client is a guild captain?!
This commission could be the breakthrough you need.
Understood! I'll give it my best!
Sorry for the wait. The ledger is fully organized. Please take a look.
Thank you! Without your help, Miss Eleanor, I'd be stuck crunching numbers forever.
I... I want to be as capable as you.==W== If you have any secret tips for getting things done this efficiently, please share!
... How do I put this? It's something I've studied for years. I wouldn't call them secret tips...
I see! It all comes down to consistent effort! Someone as amazing as you must lead a famous guild, right?
You misunderstand! I hope to lead a team someday, but there's still a long way to go.
Haha! You're reliable and capable, Miss Eleanor. No need to be modest!==W== When you do become a captain, your guild will be a rising star, just like you!
Heh, sounds like the client was impressed with you.
I'm glad to hear that, but ... wasn't that a bit generous?
Not at all. She meant every word. That's how much she trusts you.
Alright, let's go grab our next commission.
Eleanor, there you are! Feeling better?
Much better, thank you. Miss Willow, I'm sorry for all the trouble I caused the other day.
Don't worry about it, it was nothing. Don't push yourself too hard from now on, okay?
Are you two here to pick up a new commission?
That's right. Do you have anything that would put Eleanor's skills to use?
I see...==W== How about this one from the Trekker Association headquarters? Eleanor has handled it before and done a great job every time.
Look, Mentor! The scenery out here is gorgeous!
You can even see the Monolith from over there. Perfect spot for sketching.
Speaking of which, I didn't know you illustrated for the Nova Geography Journal. That's impressive.
Well, I've been drawing since I was little. At first it was tough to learn, but over time I started using it to capture how I felt.
Back then, I must have drawn the view from my window a hundred times...
See? All those skills you built up back then are still paying off now that you're a Trekker.
That's true. This morning's ledger commission went smoothly because of all that heir training...==W== Ah.
... So my life as a noble and as a Trekker are actually connected?
Continue to progress in this direction. Handle your Trekker commissions while building the skills you need as an heir.
You gain field experience to lead a guild, while growing through your studies right now.==W== They both matter to you, don't they?
Your time and energy are limited, obviously. The trick is improving your efficiency and picking commissions that actually suit you.
You're amazing, Mentor!==W== I never thought to look at it that way!
I always assumed being a Trekker and being a noble were polar opposites...==W== I ran away back then because I felt a sheltered girl who never left her house could never become a real Trekker...
But now I know they don't actually clash. They feed off each other. Even a noble lady can become a Trekker one day!
There you go with "one day" again...==W== You're already well on your way to achieving that dream, aren't you?
From now on, manage your time well. Align your Trekker goals and your noble duties.
Yeah!==W== I feel a lot more confident all of a sudden. Though...==W== Heh heh, wanting to be both an excellent Trekker and a graceful lady... Is that a little too greedy?
What's wrong with being a little greedy?
Being a Trekker is all about freedom. You never have to limit your own potential.
Don't be quick to doubt yourself.
Trekkers are freer and hold more potential than anyone else.
I see... You told me that a long time ago.==W== Heh, I guess I flew right back into my cage without realizing it.
I'm glad you finally let go of that. Anyway, let's finish this commission before dark. We still have a forest to explore.
Wow...==W== Mentor, look! These flowers are lovely!
Yeah, it's a great view. Want to sketch this place too?
... These remind me of the flowers in a childhood picture book. Pure and spotless.==W== Come to think of it, I used to dream about being one of those princesses in a flower crown.
Heh, my younger self never could have imagined this. Back then, all I pictured was being locked in that manor, mindlessly taking over Father's business, and drifting through the rest of my life.
... Eleanor, do you ever regret becoming a Trekker?
Of course not! I've faced danger and hardship, but the growth and rewards make it worthwhile. That's why I always go all out... Even if I end up collapsing...
That's not something I'd encourage. Please be more careful from now on.
I know! I've learned my lesson.
... If I hadn't become a Trekker, I never would have realized how vast the world is. Or that the nameless flowers in my books actually bloom in real life.
Watching my world expand... I'll never get tired of exploring the unknown.
Even with the challenges ahead, I've never once regretted chasing my dream!
Ah, I got carried away talking and forgot to draw. I need to focus now, Mentor.
Alright. I'll take a walk nearby.
Okay, that should do it. Mentor, I'm done!
Perfect timing. Just done with my walk too.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Mentor.
Don't worry about it. Say...==W== Eleanor, could you close your eyes?
Mentor? Did you put something on my head...==W== Oh...!
Ah...==W== Is this a flower crown?
I made it while you were painting.
Wow...==W== It's beautiful!==W== And incredibly cute!
But Mentor,==W== why a flower crown...?
I realized I haven't celebrated with you.
Since you're officially recognized as a Trekker.
A-A celebration...!?==W== Thank you so much!
Um,==W== Mentor!==W== Does it look good on me?
Um,==W== Mentor!==W== Does it==W== look good on me?
I feel like a princess from a picture book...==W== It's so nice.
Ehehe...==W== I'm so, so happy.==W== I feel like a princess from a picture book...

Ehehe...==W== Being a Trekker is amazing.==W== It lets me fulfill so many dreams and aspirations...==W== This is definitely something I never could have experienced==W== if I had stayed in the mansion.
Being a Trekker is amazing, isn't it?==W== It lets me fulfill so many dreams and aspirations...==W== This is definitely something==W== I never could have experienced if I had stayed in the mansion.
Let's keep making them come true.
My new dreams...==W== Right now,==W== my dream is to become a proper "lady Trekker,"==W== establish a guild of my own,==W== and to go on lots of adventures with my precious friends.

My new dreams...==W== I think...==W== Right now, my dream is==W== to become a proper "lady Trekker,"==W== establish a guild of my own,==W== and to go on lots of adventures==W== with my precious friends.
Mentor...==W== Thank you.==W== I'm so glad I met you...==W== I'm truly happy to be under your guidance.
Mentor...==W== Thank you.==W== I'm so glad==W== I met you...==W== I'm truly happy to be under your guidance.
Please==W== continue to watch me grow,==W== will you?
Please continue==W== to watch me grow, will you?
Oh, right, Mentor!==W== Please==W== let me do something to thank you!
Oh, right, Mentor!==W== Please let me do something to thank you!
You wanted==W== to learn dancing,==W== right?==W== If you'd like,==W== how about right here?
You wanted to learn dancing, right?==W== If you'd like,==W== how about right here?
Yes,==W== it's just the two of us here,==W== no one will be looking,==W== so we can dance freely...==W== It makes a lovely dance floor,==W== don't you think?
Yes,==W== it's just the two of us here, so we can dance freely...==W== It makes a lovely dance floor, don't you think?
Yeah. And it's a beautiful place.
Then,==W== Mentor,==W== please take my hand.==W== Let's dance together!
I gently take her hand. Sunlight filters through the canopy, and the shadow of worry has vanished from her face.
On this private dance floor, her steps are light and graceful, like a free-spirited woodland fairy.
