You gain field experience to lead a guild, while growing through your studies right now.==W== They both matter to you, don't they?
Your time and energy are limited, obviously. The trick is improving your efficiency and picking commissions that actually suit you.
You're amazing, Mentor!==W== I never thought to look at it that way!
I always assumed being a Trekker and being a noble were polar opposites...==W== I ran away back then because I felt a sheltered girl who never left her house could never become a real Trekker...
But now I know they don't actually clash. They feed off each other. Even a noble lady can become a Trekker one day!
There you go with "one day" again...==W== You're already well on your way to achieving that dream, aren't you?
From now on, manage your time well. Align your Trekker goals and your noble duties.
Yeah!==W== I feel a lot more confident all of a sudden. Though...==W== Heh heh, wanting to be both an excellent Trekker and a graceful lady... Is that a little too greedy?
What's wrong with being a little greedy?
Being a Trekker is all about freedom. You never have to limit your own potential.
Don't be quick to doubt yourself.
Trekkers are freer and hold more potential than anyone else.
I see... You told me that a long time ago.==W== Heh, I guess I flew right back into my cage without realizing it.
I'm glad you finally let go of that. Anyway, let's finish this commission before dark. We still have a forest to explore.
Wow...==W== Mentor, look! These flowers are lovely!
Yeah, it's a great view. Want to sketch this place too?
... These remind me of the flowers in a childhood picture book. Pure and spotless.==W== Come to think of it, I used to dream about being one of those princesses in a flower crown.
Heh, my younger self never could have imagined this. Back then, all I pictured was being locked in that manor, mindlessly taking over Father's business, and drifting through the rest of my life.
... Eleanor, do you ever regret becoming a Trekker?
Of course not! I've faced danger and hardship, but the growth and rewards make it worthwhile. That's why I always go all out... Even if I end up collapsing...
That's not something I'd encourage. Please be more careful from now on.
I know! I've learned my lesson.
... If I hadn't become a Trekker, I never would have realized how vast the world is. Or that the nameless flowers in my books actually bloom in real life.
Watching my world expand... I'll never get tired of exploring the unknown.
Even with the challenges ahead, I've never once regretted chasing my dream!
Ah, I got carried away talking and forgot to draw. I need to focus now, Mentor.
Alright. I'll take a walk nearby.
Okay, that should do it. Mentor, I'm done!
Perfect timing. Just done with my walk too.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Mentor.
Don't worry about it. Say...==W== Eleanor, could you close your eyes?
Mentor? Did you put something on my head...==W== Oh...!
Ah...==W== Is this a flower crown?
I made it while you were painting.
I made it while you were painting.
Wow...==W== It's beautiful!==W== And incredibly cute!
Wow...==W== It's beautiful!==W== And incredibly cute!
But Mentor,==W== why a flower crown...?
But Mentor,==W== why a flower crown...?
I realized I haven't celebrated with you.
I realized I haven't celebrated with you.
Since you're officially recognized as a Trekker.
Since you're officially recognized as a Trekker.
A-A celebration...!?==W== Thank you so much!
A-A celebration...!?==W== Thank you so much!
Um,==W== Mentor!==W== Does it look good on me?
Um,==W== Mentor!==W== Does it==W== look good on me?
I feel like a princess from a picture book...==W== It's so nice.
Ehehe...==W== I'm so, so happy.==W== I feel like a princess from a picture book...

Ehehe...==W== Being a Trekker is amazing.==W== It lets me fulfill so many dreams and aspirations...==W== This is definitely something I never could have experienced==W== if I had stayed in the mansion.
Being a Trekker is amazing, isn't it?==W== It lets me fulfill so many dreams and aspirations...==W== This is definitely something==W== I never could have experienced if I had stayed in the mansion.
Let's keep making them come true.
Let's keep making them come true.
My new dreams...==W== Right now,==W== my dream is to become a proper "lady Trekker,"==W== establish a guild of my own,==W== and to go on lots of adventures with my precious friends.

My new dreams...==W== I think...==W== Right now, my dream is==W== to become a proper "lady Trekker,"==W== establish a guild of my own,==W== and to go on lots of adventures==W== with my precious friends.
Mentor...==W== Thank you.==W== I'm so glad I met you...==W== I'm truly happy to be under your guidance.
Mentor...==W== Thank you.==W== I'm so glad==W== I met you...==W== I'm truly happy to be under your guidance.
Please==W== continue to watch me grow,==W== will you?
Please continue==W== to watch me grow, will you?
Oh, right, Mentor!==W== Please==W== let me do something to thank you!
Oh, right, Mentor!==W== Please let me do something to thank you!
You wanted==W== to learn dancing,==W== right?==W== If you'd like,==W== how about right here?
You wanted to learn dancing, right?==W== If you'd like,==W== how about right here?
Yes,==W== it's just the two of us here,==W== no one will be looking,==W== so we can dance freely...==W== It makes a lovely dance floor,==W== don't you think?
Yes,==W== it's just the two of us here, so we can dance freely...==W== It makes a lovely dance floor, don't you think?
Yeah. And it's a beautiful place.
Yeah. And it's a beautiful place.
Then,==W== Mentor,==W== please take my hand.==W== Let's dance together!
I gently take her hand. Sunlight filters through the canopy, and the shadow of worry has vanished from her face.
On this private dance floor, her steps are light and graceful, like a free-spirited woodland fairy.

strings.text: Allie may be a mom now, but she's never been in love, let alone married... Does that still make her a mother?
Morning, everyone! Go wash up, then come grab breakfast!
Haha, wakey-wakey, sleepyhead. The sun's already up. Take off those pajamas and splash some water on your face.
Mom... I have an extra button on my shirt...
Oh dear! No worries, I'll be right there to fix it!
Boss, could you grab some eggs from the pantry? We're having pancakes this morning.
On it!==W== You're always so quick and efficient, Allie.==W== It's impressive.
Just the perfect Mom for Daisy Orphanage!
Ah... Boss... Um... I was trying to flip a pancake, but I didn't expect it to fly that high...
And now it's stuck to the ceiling. That's talent...
Sigh... Why am I always like this? I was being careful...
Hey, it's fine. I'll make a fresh batch! The kids need to eat. We can review your flipping technique after breakfast.
The pancakes are so good! I want more!
Haha, alright, calm down! There's plenty to go around. Form a line, no pushing.
Boss... I know it's a lot to ask, but could you teach me how to cook?
You want me to teach you?
But... Am I the right person for this? If we're talking about cooking, it'd probably be better to ask Noya...
But the New Star Guild is out on a commission. They won't be back for a while.
Plus, it can't hurt to learn from more than one teacher. I have to get better at this, for the kids' sake!
Fair enough! No time like the present. Let's try those pancakes again.
Thank you, Boss!==W== Okay, step one. Sift the flour...==W==
Cough, cough! A... Allie... Take it easy on the sifter! You're shaking it way too hard...
I-I'm sorry! That's weird, I felt like I was holding back already...
First a pancake on the ceiling, now a flour blizzard. Before we cook anything, I need to teach Allie how to control her strength.
Allie, could you give me your hand?
Sure, but... What are you doing with my hand?
I want you to feel how much force I use.==W== Yeah...==W== Right, like that. Relax your grip. You don't need to squeeze.
Keep the sifter steady with your left, and tap it with your right. Like this... Tap, tap, tap...
Oh,==W== it only takes a light touch like that?
See? Completely different from what you were doing. While you've got the feel, let's try cracking an egg!
Got it, Boss! Remember... Just a gentle tap...==W== Ah.==W==
You barely tapped the bowl, and the whole egg shattered. Looks like I underestimated your raw strength...
I'm sorry! I'll clean this up right now...==W== Yikes!==W==
Oh no, sorry! Why am I always causing trouble...
Hey, take a deep breath. I'll handle the broken plates...==W== Ouch!==W==
Allie grabs my hand and pops my bleeding finger straight into her mouth.
Ah?!==W== I'm sorry! That's how I treat the kids' scrapes. I wasn't thinking...
Ah... I see. Haha. That makes me feel like a kid again. A bit embarrassing, honestly.
R-Right. You aren't exactly a child, Boss...
Good grief, what on earth did I do...
Huh? Mom, Boss, why are your faces so red?==W== Do you both have fevers?==W== Are you sick?
N-No, we're fine! Mom feels great! Right, Boss?
Huh? Oh, yep! Right as rain! Nothing to worry about!
Even without memories of my own childhood, being coddled like a kid is still embarrassing...
Still... Why did Allie's face turn red too?
"And so, the princess and the prince got married, and they lived happily ever after. The end."
Alright, that's it for tonight. Time to crawl into bed, everyone.
Huh? Well... It's when two people's lives become one and they make a promise to stay by each other's side.
"Becomes one"? Mom, did the prince and princess become one person?
But the picture book shows them as two people!
Ah... You're right, that was a bit hard to understand.==W== How about "getting along with someone you like and helping each other out in life"? Easier to understand?
So, are you and Boss married?
Because you and Boss get along really well, right?
Yeah! You were laughing and cooking together this afternoon!
W-Well, Boss and I do get along, but we aren't getting married...
Boss! Boss!==W== Are you and Mom married?
Me?! Uh...==W== No, Allie and I aren't married.
Is it because==W== you don't like Mom...?
No, of course not!==W== I like Allie a lot!
How do I put this... You love Mom Allie too, right?
But you aren't "married" to her, are you?==W== Because you're her precious kids. Does that make sense?
Exactly. You don't have to be married to care about someone and help them out.
I'm helping Mom Allie out, the same way you do!
Phew... That explanation should satisfy them.
But if that's true, why did the prince and princess have to get married?
Couldn't the princess be the prince's mom,==W== and the prince be the princess's dad?
Then can we marry Mom and the Boss when we grow up? We love you both the most!
Okay, that's enough questions for one night! Good kids should be asleep by now.
No "hmph." We'll save the rest for tomorrow.
Fine. Good night, Mom. Good night, Boss.
Haha... Kids really know how to catch you off guard. I didn't expect them to think of it like that. Right, Allie?
I couldn't explain to the kids in a way they'd understand. It proves I lack real-world experience...
Boss... The truth is, I've never been on a date, let alone had a relationship.==W== I'm just playing "mom" by copying what other parents do.
Falling in love,==W== walking down the aisle,==W== having a child...==W== A real mother knows what that feels like.==W== But I don't know a single thing about it.
So I was thinking, to answer their questions, maybe I should find out what "marriage" is for myself...==W==
<size=52>Whoa, whoa, whoa!</size>==W== I get where you're thinking,==W== but jumping straight to marriage is way too fast!
A-Actually! Do you have free time later? There's a place I want to show you.

strings.text: Even if she's not good at housework, even if she's never had children, Allie can still be a "true mother."
I had a great time today, Boss. Visiting Philae and watching that Stella Drama together was a lot of fun.
The story had me nervous at first. I'm glad the couple finally got together,==W== and even the mother of the heroine got her happy ending, too!
What made you suddenly decide to bring me here anyway,==W== Boss?
Weren't you saying you didn't know what a "real mother" is supposed to be like?
Personal experience matters, but fiction helps too. Seeing things through other people's eyes can fill in the blanks.
I figured connecting with the characters might help you understand what being a mother is all about.
That makes sense. A lot of those scenes hit close to home, and the writing was beautiful.
Which part stood out to you?
Probably when the mother helps the heroine into her wedding dress. Watching your child find happiness has to be a parent's greatest joy.
And her smile in the final scene was gorgeous.==W== Seeing their romance beat the odds made me feel incredibly happy too...
Never mind. Anyway, since we're in Philae, I want to pick up some gifts for the kids before we head back...
Oh, I'm so sorry. Are you hurt?
Please, help me...! Someone's chasing me!
Ganging up on a single girl?==W== I'm going to teach you all a lesson!
What happened? Why were so many people after you... Wait.
Is that a wedding dress in your bag?
Yes. I was supposed to get married today.==W== Everything was ready, but my mother suddenly objected and locked me in the house...
I managed to sneak out in disguise, but it looks like they still spotted me.
So she sent mercenaries after you? Locking up your own daughter on her wedding day is horrible.
Please,==W== could you escort me to the wedding venue?
Of course! You don't mind, right, Boss?
Not at all. Let's get moving! She might have sent more people after you.
Julia! What happened? You're so late, I was worried sick!
I'm sorry, Robin. I'll go change and do my makeup right now...==W== Ah!
Oh no, there is a tear in the dress.==W== And I am absolutely hopeless with a needle...==W==
Don't worry, I can mend it for you!
Mister, please buy us some time before the ceremony. I'll be as quick as I can.
Come on, let's get you to the dressing room.
Allie, are you sure about this? I mean... You're...
You are worried I am going to ruin it, aren't you?
Actually... I'm surprisingly good at this. Just leave it to me.
I feel terrible. You escorted me all the way here safely,==W== and now I'm making you fix my dress too...==W==
It's no big deal.==W== A wedding is a once-in-a-lifetime event. You deserve to look your absolute best.
Thank you so much. I must have snagged it when I tripped earlier.
Does Robin know your mother is trying to stop the wedding?
If I told him, he probably would have canceled it. I didn't want him to worry about me anymore.
Besides, my mother is being completely unreasonable. She had no issues when we were dating, but flipped the second we got engaged.
That's strange. Dating is fine, but marriage crosses the line?
Whatever her reason is, a parent shouldn't stand in the way of their child's happiness. And ... done! Good as new.
Wow. Thank you! Now I can finally—
Julia. Call off this wedding right now.
I'm doing this for your own good.==W== Come on, we're going home!
I am Miss Julia's bodyguard. What you just said was incredibly hypocritical, and I can't let that slide.
You say it's for her own good, but aren't you simply trying to keep her under your control?
If you wanted what is best for her, the two of you would sit down and talk.==W== Locking her in a house against her will is the definition of controlling her.
That... Well, you have a point. Locking her up was a step too far. But you have to understand, I don't want Julia to suffer down the line.
I heard you had no problem when they were dating. Why the sudden change of heart now that they're getting married?
I don't want my precious daughter to be abandoned one day. If she stays unmarried, she never has to face being cast aside.
With all due respect, worrying about divorce before they even say their vows is a bit pessimistic, don't you think?
How could I not worry?! Because my clumsy daughter...==W==
<size=52>She's completely hopeless when it comes to chores!</size>==W==
She burns food constantly, mixes up salt and sugar, and makes bigger holes when she tries to sew!==W== A bride who fails at every chore is going to end up discarded sooner or later.
Oh, she did mention she was hopeless with a needle earlier...
My husband walked out on me years ago. I endured so much to raise Julia alone. What kind of mother wants to watch her daughter walk down that same painful path?
I understand where she is coming from. Still, calling off the wedding over chores is a bit much...
Please don't worry, ma'am. I am great around the house. We will support each other and build a happy life together!
Talk is cheap. Being in a relationship and living under the same roof are two completely different things.
... Why not try trusting them just this once?
To be honest, I am a walking disaster with chores too.==W== Just the other day, I flung a pancake onto the ceiling and shattered a bunch of plates.
It's embarrassing for an orphanage director to make such rookie mistakes.==W== But even so, the kids still call me Mom, and they step up to help me with the things I'm bad at.
You cover for each other's flaws. You build a life together step by step.==W== Isn't that what becoming a family is all about?
I might not have biological kids, but I understand wanting to shield your child from the world.==W== I would walk through fire to protect the kids. But...
There comes a day when a child has to spread their wings.==W== When that day comes,==W== trusting them to chase their own future is another way of loving them.
Miss Julia's life is just beginning.==W== Given time, she might surprise you and overcome those shortcomings.
Mom, I'll work harder! I love Robin, and I am willing to learn every chore in the book for him! Please, give us your blessing!
I humbly ask for your blessing too. I love Julia with all my heart, and I swear I will never abandon her. You have to believe me.
It seems my protective streak got the better of me.==W== All right. You have my blessing.
Mother...!==W== Thank you! We'll live our life well, I promise!
What a beautiful wedding. I'm glad it all went smoothly.
Right as we were leaving, Julia's mother pulled me aside...

You really taught me a lesson today. You said you don't have children of your own, but from where I'm standing, you're already an amazing mother.==W== With a mother like you, those kids at the orphanage must be incredibly lucky.
Having her call me an "amazing mother" surprised me. After all... I'm not a "real mother" like she is...
Every word you said back there was filled with a mother's love. That's exactly why you were able to get through to her, isn't it?
Allie, biology has nothing to do with it. As far as I'm concerned, you're already an incredible mother.
Boss... You're right. I was completely overthinking things, wasn't I?
I won't let myself be conflicted anymore. I'll hold my head high and be the best "Mom" for those kids.
That's the spirit! Because to the kids at the orphanage, there's only one "real" mother, and that's you.

<size=52>She's completely hopeless when it comes to chores!</size>==W==
She burns food constantly, mixes up salt and sugar, and makes bigger holes when she tries to sew!==W== A bride who fails at every chore is going to end up discarded sooner or later.
Oh, she did mention she was hopeless with a needle earlier...
My husband walked out on me years ago. I endured so much to raise Julia alone. What kind of mother wants to watch her daughter walk down that same painful path?
I understand where she is coming from. Still, calling off the wedding over chores is a bit much...
Please don't worry, ma'am. I am great around the house. We will support each other and build a happy life together!
Talk is cheap. Being in a relationship and living under the same roof are two completely different things.
... Why not try trusting them just this once?
To be honest, I am a walking disaster with chores too.==W== Just the other day, I flung a pancake onto the ceiling and shattered a bunch of plates.
It's embarrassing for an orphanage director to make such rookie mistakes.==W== But even so, the kids still call me Mom, and they step up to help me with the things I'm bad at.
You cover for each other's flaws. You build a life together step by step.==W== Isn't that what becoming a family is all about?
I might not have biological kids, but I understand wanting to shield your child from the world.==W== I would walk through fire to protect the kids. But...
There comes a day when a child has to spread their wings.==W== When that day comes,==W== trusting them to chase their own future is another way of loving them.
Miss Julia's life is just beginning.==W== Given time, she might surprise you and overcome those shortcomings.
Mom, I'll work harder! I love Robin, and I am willing to learn every chore in the book for him! Please, give us your blessing!
I humbly ask for your blessing too. I love Julia with all my heart, and I swear I will never abandon her. You have to believe me.
It seems my protective streak got the better of me.==W== All right. You have my blessing.
Mother...!==W== Thank you! We'll live our life well, I promise!
What a beautiful wedding. I'm glad it all went smoothly.
Right as we were leaving, Julia's mother pulled me aside...

You really taught me a lesson today. You said you don't have children of your own, but from where I'm standing, you're already an amazing mother.==W== With a mother like you, those kids at the orphanage must be incredibly lucky.
Having her call me an "amazing mother" surprised me. After all... I'm not a "real mother" like she is...
Every word you said back there was filled with a mother's love. That's exactly why you were able to get through to her, isn't it?
Allie, biology has nothing to do with it. As far as I'm concerned, you're already an incredible mother.
Boss... You're right. I was completely overthinking things, wasn't I?
I won't let myself be conflicted anymore. I'll hold my head high and be the best "Mom" for those kids.
That's the spirit! Because to the kids at the orphanage, there's only one "real" mother, and that's you.

Morning, everyone!==W== Go wash up, then come grab breakfast!
Haha, wakey-wakey, sleepyhead. The sun's already up. Take off those pajamas and splash some water on your face.
Oh no!==W== Boss, could you help the kids get dressed?
She might be terrible at chores and never had kids of her own, but her love for them is completely genuine.

Allie, are you alright?==W== Whoa?!==W== Where did all these bubbles come from?

But I accidentally crushed the soap, and then this mountain of bubbles exploded everywhere.
I guess soap is no match for Allie's strength, either.
Anyway, let me grab some water and rinse this away.
Phew...==W== That's the last of the sheets hung up.
I am glad you were here, Boss.==W== If I were by myself, I probably would have fainted in that pile of bubbles...
And here I was determined to be a good mother. Looks like I still have a long way to go.

And that is more than enough.

Hehe. I give great advice to others, but I overthink things when it comes to myself. It's a terrible habit.
You are right.==W== I should look up to families like Julia's.
Say, Boss.==W== Have you ever thought about getting married and starting a family?
Marriage?==W== I haven't given it much thought.==W== Honestly, dealing with my own issues is already keeping my hands full.
I used to be like you. All I cared about was the orphanage, and marriage never crossed my mind.
But when the kids asked me about it the other day, I drew a total blank.==W== Romance feels like a completely different world to me...==W== Almost like a fairy tale.
Do you want to get married, Allie?
I'm the mother here. How could I abandon the kids just for my own happiness?
Still...==W== Seeing people together with the love of their life makes me a bit envious.
I've been looking after these kids by myself for years. Maybe that's why I find myself daydreaming about how nice it would be to have someone to do this together.
Marrying the person you love, protecting your home together, sharing the highs and lows...==W== It must be wonderful.
When these kids grow up and find love,==W== I'll support them with everything I have.==W== Heh, I'm looking forward to it already just thinking about it.
I mean, if you set aside your role as a mother for a moment. What do you want?
Not as a mother, but as myself?
Because I can tell there's a part of you that wants to get married.
Didn't you say something like that after we watched that Stella Drama?
And her smile in the final scene was gorgeous.==W== Seeing their romance beat the odds made me feel incredibly happy too...
T-That was because I was caught up in the moment...
Besides, getting married now? Doing it for the kids is one thing, but doing it for myself feels selfish...==W== Eek!==W==
Hah...==W== That startled me.==W== Such a strong wind.==W== I can't believe the laundry got blown all the way over here.
That startled me...==W== Such a strong wind.==W== I can't believe the laundry==W== got blown all the way over here.
Thank you, Boss.==W== Let's hurry up and hang these again...==W== Ah.
Thank you,==W== Boss.==W== Well,==W== let's hurry up and hang these again...==W== Ah.
Allie, you kind of look like a bride right now.
A bride?==W== Me?==W== Hehe...==W== Boss,==W== you're such a smooth talker.
Me?==W== A bride?==W== Oh...==W== Boss, you're such a smooth talker.
But...==W== I'm everyone's "Mom Allie."==W== It's too late for me==W== to be a bride now.
I told you, didn't I?==W== I'm everyone's "Mom Allie."==W== It's too late for me==W== to be a bride now.
Is a "Mom" not allowed to be a bride?
Eh...==W== That's... ==W== not always true, but...
Uh...==W== That's...==W== How should I explain this...==W== I don't think there was ever a rule like that…
I think it's fine if you want to get married.
Really...?==W== Is it fine?==W== I do dream of getting married but...
Really...?==W== Is it fine?==W== I do dream of getting married, but...
You are Allie, before you are a "Mom."
If you want, then you too can become a bride.
To me,==W== the kids' happiness is what matters most.==W== As long as they can grow up safe and sound==W== and find happiness,==W== I'll be perfectly content.
Even if==W== I have children to take care of?==W== A mother==W== should always put their children's happiness==W== before her own.
But I think children want their mother to be happy, too.
You want to build a family that helps each other, right?
... You're right, Boss.==W== If so,==W== could I ask you a favor?
Boss...==W== If so,==W== could I ask you a favor?
Would you==W== be my partner in a make-believe wedding?==W== Like==W== the kind of game the children usually play.==W== We can recite==W== the bride and groom's wedding vows together...
I'd like to ask you to be my partner in a make-believe wedding.==W== Would you like==W== to say==W== the wedding vows with me?
If it's all right with you...
Thank you.==W== Alright then,==W== let's start.
Whether in good times or bad,==W== in wealth or in poverty.
Whether in sickness==W== or in health…
Whether in health or in sickness, I will stay by your side.
Whether in poverty or in wealth…
I swear==W== to love,==W== respect,==W== and cherish you for all days to come.
I swear to love,==W== respect,==W== and cherish you for all days to come.
Hehe,==W== that's good enough==W== for me.==W== Thank you, Boss.==W== You made my dream come true.
Hehe,==W== that's good enough for me.==W== Thank you,==W== Boss.==W== You made my dream come true.
By the way...==W== Was I that obvious about wanting to get married?
Well,==W== based on what you said the other day and earlier... Yeah. It was obvious.
You saw right through me that early on?==W== Aw... I feel embarrassed now.
Not a word of this to the kids, okay! They'll think I'm being so childish!
My lips are sealed!==W== But I think wanting to get married has nothing to do with age.
Remember to value your own feelings instead of burying them under a title.
I could say the same thing to you.
You carry a lot of weight on your shoulders. Being the "Boss" can't be easy.
So don't forget.==W== Before you're the Boss, you're a person, too.
Point taken.==W== I'll keep that in mind.
If there is ever anything I can help you with, let me know. No holding back, okay?
You helped make a little wish of mine come true. I want to help make one of your wishes come true, too.
Having Mom Allie in my corner makes me feel a lot better. Thanks!
Right?==W== Okay, let me hang these sheets back up!
And then it's snack time for the kids!==W== Today's menu... Pancakes!==W== I'll make them perfectly this time.
Haha, love the enthusiasm. Maybe go easy on the batter this time, though.
You bet!==W== Mom Allie is going into overdrive today!
Yeah,==W== I should probably stay in the kitchen with her...

strings.text: A genius inventor has unexpectedly hit a creative wall. Where should I go to find new inspiration?
Ow... What the heck was that?
An alarm clock?! So you're the culprit...!
It even has springs built into the base. This thing is obviously designed to physically beat people awake if they won't get up... Who on earth designed this thing?!
...==W== Still, after all that, I'm definitely awake now.
Today is my first day on the job, after all... I absolutely cannot oversleep.
I'm at this address right now.
Rabbit Pie is going offline for routine maintenance for a while.
So I wanted to ask you to do something for me.
What's the job, and what's the pay?
I want you to take Rabbit Pie's place and be my ==SEX19==.
The pay is 300,000 Dorra a day, with room and board included.
Leave it to me. See you tomorrow!
THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND Dorra... Hehe, I'd better take this job seriously.==W== First, I'll let Sparkla get a taste of my signature dish: toast! There's no breakfast without toast.
The oven... This should be the oven, I guess.==W== All right, start!
What?! W-why is the oven shooting out confetti?! It's just toast! Isn't this a little over the top?!
Haaah...==W== Finishing a dish is a cause for celebration. And a feature like this is great for boosting the chef's morale...
Cooking is a kind of creative work, too. Do not underestimate the effort behind every single dish...==W== Haaah...
Um... Sparkla?==W== You don't look too good. Do you want to go back to sleep for a bit?
Haaah... I'm fine.==W== It's already time to get up... And I can smell the toast...
...==W== I see. Work's been rough, huh?
Yeah... I've hit a wall with the <color=#3faeae>Tyrant Pie</color> design lately. I've been stressing over it so much that I haven't really slept.
Tyrant Pie... Right,==W== Sparkla did mention before that she was developing a Monolith-climbing support automaton modeled after me.
But even you get stuck sometimes, huh? I thought that would never happen to someone like you.
Well, maybe it's because Tyrant Pie has been all I can think about lately. I guess that's why I haven't made any new progress...
Okay... I can't really help with your inventions. So... Why don't we eat breakfast first?
Chomp chomp chomp...==W== Hmm, this tastes incredible, as usual!==W== Well, Sparkla? How's the toast I poured my heart and soul into?!
Chomp... Chomp...==W== Yeah... It's really good...
S-She still looks dead tired even after eating my toast...==W== If it goes on like this, I'm gonna feel like I don't really deserve my 300,000 Dorra a day...
Sigh... I still can't get motivated. At this point, there's only one thing left to do...
Boss. Can you come over here for a second?==W== Yeah, sit next to me.
Hm? You want me to sit here?
Mmm... Yes!==W== This is the perfect distance<size=60>♪
Hold on, hold on, this is way too close! And what exactly is "perfect" about it?!
Haaah... Just as I thought, Boss, you are so cute.
Those blue eyes are just like a mermaid's from a fairy tale. Ah, and even the shape of your pupils is gorgeous, too~
And these cheeks are so soft and smooth.
You're so pretty, so why do you insist on covering one eye?
Even if you say that, I'm not changing my hairstyle. Lots of Stella Drama heroes have this kind of signature look, and I like it.
And your ears too... Can I just ... touch them a little? Heeheehee~<size=60>♪
Hmm, what a shame. In that case, can I just ... touch your ears a little?
I-it tickles!==W== It really tickles, stop already!
You're touching them already!==W== I-it tickles! It really tickles, stop!
Aw, you won't let me touch them a little longer?
Come think of it, it's amazing that someone who matches my exact type actually exists, and it's someone I know too...==W== I'm so lucky<size=60>♪
Now that I've got my energy back, I'm suddenly starving.==W== Boss, could you toast me another slice?
You got your appetite back just from looking at my face?
Are all inventors this weird or what...
Whoa, I just dusted a little, and there's this much already. I didn't realize the place was so dirty.
Right! Next, I'll dust off the furniture and the walls, too. I can open the windows while I'm at it and air the place out.
Right! Looks like we're low on ingredients too. I should head out and buy some groceries for lunch!
...==W== She's staring way too hard! There's no way I can focus on chores like this!
R-Right, so after you encountered the bottleneck, have you tried talking it over with Bloc or Leona?
Sometimes hearing an outside opinion can spark an idea.
Oh, those two? I blocked them the day before yesterday.
What?! Didn't you just unblock them a week ago?!
Because Bloc kept bombarding me with messages.
And Leona kept nitpicking the name "Tyrant Pie." She said something like "Tick-Tock Boing-Boing Capsule Unit" would sound better. Absolu~~tely no taste.
If you let other people drag you around all the time, you'll never come up with any good ideas.==W== So I decided to block them again.
...==W== Which means Bloc's probably gonna come crying to me later because she can't contact you, again.
Ugh, just thinking about it is annoying. Let's drop it.
Then how about doing something else for a change? It might help clear your head.
We at New Star Guild do that all the time. Whenever we need a rest, Iris starts grinding practice questions, Noya always goes to tune up Loxy. And Amber runs outside to play with Inky.
Sparkla, do you have any hobbies that help you unwind? Or just anything that you like doing.
Things that I like doing...==W== I guess spending all day in the workshop inventing things.
Well, that sounds good. In that case, why not invent something as a way to relax...
Wait. Trying to get over a creative block in inventing by inventing is just a logic loop, isn't it...
Ahem... Okay, let's put inventing aside. Literally anything else is fine.
What about fairy tales? There seem to be a lot of those on your bookshelf.
I used to read them all the time. I read lots of stories about Trekkers, too...==W== I used to collect works published in Flavio.
But lately I haven't been able to find any new books at all...
Called it. She does love fairy tales...==W== I remember Flora mentioning that a troupe from Flavio city is touring with a fairy-tale stage play right now.
That might be just the thing to help Sparkla take her mind off things. I should ask around.
Perfect. That troupe is actually in Philae right now.
Sparkla, want to go see a fairy-tale play?
A fairy-tale play...==W== You mean The Wizard in the Emerald Castle?
That's right. You've heard of it?
It's a famous work. And besides...
On second thought, forget it. I shouldn't go out. I'm still on the Imperial Guard's wanted list, so I'd better not show myself in public.
It's fine. I've seen your wanted poster. It looked nothing like you.
And Rabbit Pie is under maintenance today, so if we don't bring it with us, you won't stand out. It'll be totally safe.
That does make sense.==W== The portrait on that wanted poster was so ugly that I almost wanted to ask them to redraw it. But as you are saying, that turns out to be a good thing.
Let's get ready to go out, then.

Haaah... Just as I thought, Boss, you are so cute.
Those blue eyes are just like a mermaid's from a fairy tale. Ah, and even the shape of your pupils is gorgeous, too~
And these cheeks are so soft and smooth.
You're so pretty, so why do you insist on covering one eye?
Even if you say that, I'm not changing my hairstyle. Lots of Stella Drama heroes have this kind of signature look, and I like it.
And your ears too... Can I just ... touch them a little? Heeheehee~<size=60>♪
Hmm, what a shame. In that case, can I just ... touch your ears a little?
I-it tickles!==W== It really tickles, stop already!
You're touching them already!==W== I-it tickles! It really tickles, stop!
Aw, you won't let me touch them a little longer?
Come think of it, it's amazing that someone who matches my exact type actually exists, and it's someone I know too...==W== I'm so lucky<size=60>♪
Now that I've got my energy back, I'm suddenly starving.==W== Boss, could you toast me another slice?
You got your appetite back just from looking at my face?
Are all inventors this weird or what...
Whoa, I just dusted a little, and there's this much already. I didn't realize the place was so dirty.
Right! Next, I'll dust off the furniture and the walls, too. I can open the windows while I'm at it and air the place out.
Right! Looks like we're low on ingredients too. I should head out and buy some groceries for lunch!
...==W== She's staring way too hard! There's no way I can focus on chores like this!
R-Right, so after you encountered the bottleneck, have you tried talking it over with Bloc or Leona?
Sometimes hearing an outside opinion can spark an idea.
Oh, those two? I blocked them the day before yesterday.
What?! Didn't you just unblock them a week ago?!
Because Bloc kept bombarding me with messages.
And Leona kept nitpicking the name "Tyrant Pie." She said something like "Tick-Tock Boing-Boing Capsule Unit" would sound better. Absolu~~tely no taste.
If you let other people drag you around all the time, you'll never come up with any good ideas.==W== So I decided to block them again.
...==W== Which means Bloc's probably gonna come crying to me later because she can't contact you, again.
Ugh, just thinking about it is annoying. Let's drop it.
Then how about doing something else for a change? It might help clear your head.
We at New Star Guild do that all the time. Whenever we need a rest, Iris starts grinding practice questions, Noya always goes to tune up Loxy. And Amber runs outside to play with Inky.
Sparkla, do you have any hobbies that help you unwind? Or just anything that you like doing.
Things that I like doing...==W== I guess spending all day in the workshop inventing things.
Well, that sounds good. In that case, why not invent something as a way to relax...
Wait. Trying to get over a creative block in inventing by inventing is just a logic loop, isn't it...
Ahem... Okay, let's put inventing aside. Literally anything else is fine.
What about fairy tales? There seem to be a lot of those on your bookshelf.
I used to read them all the time. I read lots of stories about Trekkers, too...==W== I used to collect works published in Flavio.
But lately I haven't been able to find any new books at all...
Called it. She does love fairy tales...==W== I remember Flora mentioning that a troupe from Flavio city is touring with a fairy-tale stage play right now.
That might be just the thing to help Sparkla take her mind off things. I should ask around.
Perfect. That troupe is actually in Philae right now.
Sparkla, want to go see a fairy-tale play?
A fairy-tale play...==W== You mean The Wizard in the Emerald Castle?
That's right. You've heard of it?
It's a famous work. And besides...
On second thought, forget it. I shouldn't go out. I'm still on the Imperial Guard's wanted list, so I'd better not show myself in public.
It's fine. I've seen your wanted poster. It looked nothing like you.
And Rabbit Pie is under maintenance today, so if we don't bring it with us, you won't stand out. It'll be totally safe.
That does make sense.==W== The portrait on that wanted poster was so ugly that I almost wanted to ask them to redraw it. But as you are saying, that turns out to be a good thing.
Let's get ready to go out, then.

strings.text: I only acknowledge people who truly understand my inventions~
The hit adaptation of a Monolith fairy-tale, an absolute must-see—==W==The Wizard in the Emerald Castle—is about to begin its final run! Theater lovers, don't miss it!
Excuse me. Can I get two of your cheapest—
Right, right...==W== Two front-row tickets, thank you.
Sorry, front-row seats are already sold out. We only have rear seats and obstructed view seats left.
Wow, it's really that popular? Well, even Flora's been following them.
Then I guess that makes the choice easier. Obstructed view seats sound miserable...==W== Is the back row okay?
It's fine. Front row is obviously the best, but the back rows have their own advantages too. Just wait and see.
Don't worry, Totty! As long as we're together,==RT==there's nothing to be afraid of.

Whoa... We're this far away, but I can see everything so clearly, down to the stage machinery's details.==W== This thing Sparkla invented, <color=#3faeae>the Long-Eared Lookout Pie</color>, is amazing!
And it's not just binoculars. It can also shine lights in all kinds of colors. Would definitely come in handy at concerts.
Wow, is that puppy onstage real? Looks like it can actually understand Dorothea!
Shush. Those are obviously just props.
Totty, hold on tight to me!
The house is ... about to fly away?!
The house prop actually lifted off?! And it circled all the way around the theater… Like it really got swept up by a tornado.
That was incredible... A performance like this really does make the ticket worth it.
But those mechanisms... Are they Artifacts? They used so many over the course of just one show...
They're not Artifacts. All the things you see onstage are inventions.
Sparkla seems to know a lot about stage machinery. Could it be...

Hey, that tornado scene just now was amazing, wasn't it?==W== It felt like an illustration straight out of a fairy-tale book had come to life right in front of me. My heart was pounding the whole time<size=60>♪</size>
Hmmm, better save that question for later.
The kid in front of us has been fidgeting nonstop ever since Act Two started...
I see. Here, you can borrow this.
It's called the Long-Eared Lookout Pie<size=60>♪</size> Just move the little carrot lever on the side, and the viewing tube will pop out. Look through it, and you'll be able to see the stage clearly.
Of course. Actually, I've been thinking about adding interchangeable lenses. That way, you could swap magnification depending on what kind of show you're watching...
All right, all right, go on and use it. The next scene is where the first companion shows up.
Thank you, Miss.==W== And... Um... Sorry for disturbing you earlier...
Hehe~ It's fine. The most important thing when you watch a show is having fun!
That should let him focus on the stage now. And now I can relax and enjoy the rest too.
That was amazing! I finally get it now—even adults can enjoy a fairy-tale play!
Hehehe~ Looks like you have finally discovered the joy of fairy-tale theater!
Y-you lent me your Long-Eared Lookout Pie, and I still haven't given it back yet.
Aw, what a nice kid you are. You even remembered the name?
Yeah. Because it sounds really cute...
Right? Right?! You've got taste, kid.
I especially liked the carrot lever on top. It was super fun!
Hmm. If you like it that much...==W== All right! This Long-Eared Lookout Pie is yours now.
R-really?! I can really have it?!
Of course. Anyone who appreciates how cute the Long-Eared Lookout Pie is clearly has good taste. I'd be happy for you to have it~
Yay! Thank you so, so much, Miss!
Oh, right, right. And if you ever want to try fitting it with different lenses,==W== you can get in touch with the person next to me~
Honestly, why is she suddenly volunteering me for extra work?==W== Still... Since it's for a kid, I can't really say no.
Hehe<size=60>♪</size> I knew you wouldn't let me down, Boss<size=60>♪</size>
And thanks for bringing me to see the play. My mind feels a lot clearer now, and my mood's way better, too.
That's great. Seeing so many people enjoy your inventions must make you want to work even harder.
Hehe~ Boss, you deserve a little gold star!==W== Actually, all the stage machineries we saw today were invented by me<size=60>♪</size>
That was the only commission I took recently. Compared to the clients who drone on forever and pile on request after request, this one was a lot more fun.
My dream, ever since I was little, has been getting to be the heroine of a fairy tale with magical powers, like in The Wizard in the Emerald Castle or Alicia's Underground Adventure.
Rabbit Pie was actually designed after that always-late rabbit from Underground Adventure~
So that's why you made all those stage machineries, too?
Exactly. When the troupe director came to me, she said she wanted to recreate Dorothea's adventure perfectly onstage, and I knew right away it would be fun to work on.
And they even complimented Rabbit Pie's tea-making skills~ Once I realized the director actually had good taste, I figured I should put some real effort into the commission.
The more we talked, the more we hit it off. In the end, I did the whole thing for free. And I even threw in that little mechanical dog as a bonus gift.
Totty is like family to Dorothea, after all. It can't just be some random prop. I had to create something really worthy of that role.
You did it for free... And even threw in a bonus freebie? If Bloc ever finds out, she's going to lecture you for hours again...
Oh that, she already knows. That's why she bombarded me with messages. And then I blocked her.
O-Oh, I see... It all makes sense now...
So, what do you think? My stage inventions worked pretty well, didn't they?
They were incredible. It really felt like I was going on an adventure with Dorothea.
Of course, the actors were fantastic, too, but without your inventions, there's no way the show could have felt that magical.

That's what inventing is for—to make people happy. Sure, every now and then somebody complains and tells me not to add all those extra bells and whistles... But then, why did they come to me in the first place?
On the other hand, if someone really appreciates what makes my inventions special, I'm more than happy to give them one as a gift<size=60>♪</size>
No wonder you gave the Long-Eared Lookout Pie to that kid today.
Because I could tell he genuinely liked it~
And... Boss, thank you so much...
I'm still a wanted fugitive, so I was hesitating to attend the performance in person. At most, I could look at the photos the director sent me.
But today...==W== Because of you, I got to see this play with my own eyes. So thank you.
You're welcome. I just happened to stumble into the right idea. I'm glad to see you feeling better.
Hehehe, exactly! Taking a break really helped. I feel so much lighter now, and all kinds of fun new ideas are already starting to come to me!
All right, all right, let's hurry home! I don't want to waste a single second!
W-wait!==W== I'm not even seated properly—waaahhh—

strings.text: Boss, what kind of features do you want to add to Tyrant Pie? I can make anything happen, you know~
The moment Sparkla got back from the theater, she locked herself in the workshop again...
Still, as long as she's got her inspiration back, that's what matters.
Sparkla, I made dinner. Here you are.
Hang on, I'm almost done...==W== Ah, never mind. I should eat now.==W== By the way, ==PLAYER_NAME==, do you want to eat with me?
Of course. I don't have a "no eating or drinking rule" here in the workshop.
Then I'll go bring my food too. Just give me a second.
Sorry to keep you waiting. I'm coming.==W== Though... Does it feel like there's even more stuff in here now?
That's because after you came by last time, I've been inventing all sorts of things~<size=60>♪</size>
That's why you are the master inventor. Can I see what's inside these boxes?
Go right ahead. No need to be shy <size=60>♪</size>
The box closest to you has a voice alteration device in it. I got the idea from that fairy tale where the big bad wolf disguised itself as Grandma!
Hmm... So with this, I can change my voice?
That's right. Just turn the dial, and you can make your voice as deep or as high as you want.
And if you turn it all the way to the right, it turns into a cat's meow. All the way to the left, and it becomes a dog's bark.
That actually sounds pretty fun. Let me try it.==W== First I'll turn it to the right...
Hahaha! Oh my, this is so much fun!
Right?==W== But the client said, "Who needs a feature that turns your voice into animal noises?" And then they returned it.
So the moment I delivered the order, I blocked them. And I'm keeping this for myself.
So the others are like that, too?
All of these are inventions that got returned because of the design or the unrecognized extra features.
But you know, since they've been returned, maybe they'll meet someone who can appreciate what makes them special.
Also! The invention in that box was inspired by Alicia's Underground Adventure—
Haha, maybe we should eat first. We can look at the rest of the inventions later.
...==W== The meal's over. But it looks like I'm not leaving the workshop anytime soon.
She did say she can't make progress unless she's looking at my face while she works...==W== Well, whatever. At this point, I'm used to being stared at.
Just sitting here doing nothing feels a little silly. Maybe I'll take a look at Tyrant Pie's design.
Not bad, not bad. It does look pretty cute...==W== Hmm...
But ...==W== isn't it kind of small? It's only half the size of Rabbit Pie's hat.
It may be small, but I'm planning to make it the strongest automaton I've ever built. What I'm trying to do now is to see how tiny I can make it without cutting any of the core functions.
Eventually I want to make it even smaller...==W== Ideally, small enough to carry around in a coat pocket.
Tiny and portable, so you can keep it on you all the time and snuggle with it whenever you want. Heehee~
Then it'd be nice if it also had cooling and warming functions.
You could adjust its temperature depending on what you need—warm your hands when it's cold, cool you off when it's hot!
Wow! That's a super cool idea!
But if I do that, I'd need to add a temperature-control switch too. Which means new parts...
Looks like she's focused again. I'd better not interrupt. I'll just sit here and read until she's done.
==PLAYER_NAME==, if you're sleepy, you can just go to bed.
Mm... I can't do that. A ==SEX19== can't go to bed before her employer.
My, my. My ==SEX19== is so dedicated~
That book you've got in your hands is The Bubble Princess, right? You picked that one? You really do have good taste♪ Oh, should I read it to you?
No, it's fine. You should be working on your inventions, Sparkla.
Then you go ahead and sleep. Just make sure you wake me up early tomorrow.
All right then. Good night, Sparkla.
That sound just now... It came from the workshop, didn't it?!
I-==W==it's nothing~==W== I just wanted==W== to shift into a different thinking position for a bit...==W== Yeah, I'm fine!
I-==W==it's nothing~==W== I just wanted to shift into a different thinking position for a bit...==W== Yeah,==W== I'm fine!
Oh, I see. Should I help you up first?
Okay, okay...==W== Ah, wait!==W== Pick up my notebook first!==W== All my Tyrant Pie ideas are in there.==W== I can't let it get wet!
Phew...==W== That's good.==W== Right!==W== Since you're here,==W== why don't you pick the feature you want most?==W== I'll make that the top priority==W== and implement it as soon as possible!
Phew...==W== That's good.==W== Ah, right!==W== Since you're here,==W== why don't you pick the feature you want most?
This way it can play lullabies for you before bedtime.
Play lullabies for me?==W== Hmmm...==W== Yeah.==W== With Tyrant Pie's music,==W== I'm sure I'd have sweet dreams every night...
Play lullabies for me?==W== With Tyrant Pie's music,==W== I'm sure I'd have sweet dreams every night...
Maybe I'd get a lot of inspiration from that, too!
If I could just improve Tyrant Pie's response speed and control precision a little more…==W== Hmm, I've got a new idea!==W== Hehe~==W== When I'm with you,==W== inspiration just keeps flowing…
If I could just improve Tyrant Pie's response speed and control precision a little more…==W== Hmm, feels good!==W== Hehe~==W== When I'm with you,==W== inspiration just keeps flowing…
Uh... Eh?==W== What's going on...==W== My head feels all fuzzy...
Uh... Eh?==W== My head feels all fuzzy...
Because you just took a fall and stayed in that position for too long.
Hehehe...==W== Stars are spinning~==W== They're so cute...==W== Now I kind of want to give Tyrant Pie a star-catching function too~
Hehehe...==W== Stars are spinning~==W== They're so cute...==W== Now I kind of want to give Tyrant Pie==W== a star-catching function too~
Ah—==W==that was close!==W== Huh?==W== Why are the stars getting bigger...==W== Ah...==W== Quick,==W== quick, help me up...
Ah—==W==that was close!==W== Come to think of it,==W== I'm starting to feel a little sick...==W== Please, help me up?
Phew... Thanks, ==PLAYER_NAME==. I feel much better now.
You were probably having a good sleep, and I woke you up, didn't I? Sorry.
It's fine. Taking care of you is a part of the job.
And from now on, maybe you should pick a safer position when you're trying to think.
<size=50>I'm awake, I'm awake, I'm awake! I'm getting up, just don't hit me!
Phew. Not gonna get me a second time.==W== All right, it's time for this ==SEX19== to start working.
Oh hey, Rabbit Pie! Good morning!
Wow! You made this toast? The browning is absolutely perfect...==W== So much better than mine.
Hi, Sparkla. You're up, too? Looks like Rabbit Pie's maintenance is all finished.
Actually, I still want to make its speech module a little smoother~
All right, all right. I'll think about it. Give me some time.
Now that Rabbit Pie's back on the job, I guess it's about time for me to step down. Hope I've done a satisfactory job.
You're being too modest. Just getting to admire your face up close has already made this whole thing worth it for me~<size=60>♪</size>
Umm...==W== So...==W== As a wrap-up==W== for this commission, could I ask you for one more favor?
And so, Sparkla happily finishes her breakfast while staring at my face.

strings.text: You seek help from a famous Xuan Shi to investigate a haunted village—only to find her terrified of ghosts.
Hm? You're asking about those "haunting" rumors going around Cangwu lately?==W== Heh, you've come to the right person.
Just the other day, during a routine patrol, the Baize Bureau noticed groups of folks gathered around, looking worried.
Curious, they asked around and found out that everyone was talking about this place northwest to the city—rumor has it, it's haunted.

The Baize people aren't the superstitious type, but they went on to explain that someone had accidentally wandered into an abandoned village in the mountains northwest of the city. They say it was filled with wooden dolls...
So a brave soul went to visit the village at night.
Word is, they came back completely unhinged, rambling about how those dolls were all cult followers.
At night, the dolls supposedly started moving around, surrounded by will-o'-the-wisps. And you could also hear whispers...
Well! That about sums up all I know.
Not bad, huh? Guess you could call me a bit of an expert on everything!
I … I guess...==W== But just knowing the rumors won't solve anything. If it really is haunted, we'll need someone who actually knows how to catch ghosts...
Ghost-catching's my master's specialty! You can wait for her to come out of the retreat, then ask her for help!
But she won't be available for another two months, right? Baize Bureau wants me to get to the bottom of this thing ASAP.
Come to think of it, you are a Xuan Shi, too. Can you lend me a hand?
Huh? Me??==W== Uh, well, my master left me a ton of homework, so I really can't.
Maybe you can ask my seniors? I don't know where they are, but they say if your heart is true, then your prayer will be answered.==W== Anyways, I wish you the best of luck!
But I've heard you’re the most skilled Xuan Shi in Cangwu after your master. Born with a gift, flawless with your talismans, and a true feng shui expert.
If you can't help me, then I really don't know what to do... Sigh...
Well, uh, if you put it that way...
Alright, alright, fine! It's just an abandoned village, right? I'll handle it tonight. Leave it to me!
I'll head back to get ready. You better not chicken out and bail, tsk tsk!
So the rumors are true. If you want Chixia's help, all it takes is a couple of compliments...
It's pitch black in here. I can't see a thing...
Oh, right, I got an Artifact from the Trekker Association that works as a light at night. Perfect time to put it to use.
==W==<size=50>WAAAH!!! Yao Mo Gui Guai Kuai Li Kai!!! Evil spirits, begone!!!
Ahem... You scared the life out of me! Seriously, if you're here, at least say something!
You're the one who scared me!!
...==W== Why are you still standing there?
You … you go first! If something comes from behind, I … I can cover your back... ==W== <size=50>Aaaahhh! There's something in the grass!!
Let go already, you're gonna break my arm...==W== It was just a mouse, seriously! It ran off that way!
Wh-what's going on? Why are you getting so close all of a sudden?
The, the, the doll over there. Is it … crying...?
In the waist-high grass, a couple dozen wooden dolls are lined up in perfect rows. Eerily green, glowing "tears" are slowly dripping out from their eyes.
Let, let, let's get out of here.
But aren't we here to investigate? Let's go over and take a look...
Aaaaaaaaah!!! I think they're looking this way!!
Hey! Wait! Don't just grab me and run!!!
Let's stop running...==W== If those are real, running won't do us any good, right?
May … maybe we should just head back for now... I mean, my master never actually taught me how to fight ghosts...==W== It's definitely not because I'm scared!
Isn't it a bit too early to jump to conclusions? Could just be some mice or owls.
You mean, mice and owl monsters? I'm not exactly good at fighting monsters either...
Do you have any talismans you can use to scan the village? Maybe they'll help us figure out what the problem is.
Ah! My master did teach me one of those before going into retreat. Maybe I can use it to see if there really are any ghosts around.
Busybody much? As long as it gets the job done, right?
As she speaks, Chixia holds the finished talisman between her palms and whispers something silently.
Hey, Chixia?! Where are you?? Chixia!
Cough... Quit playing and come out!
Doesn't everybody say that while Chixia might be unreliable in some things, she's top-notch when it comes to drawing talismans???
No way I'm that unlucky to catch her the one time she screws up, right?!
Boss! ==PLAYER_NAME==!! Stop messing with me! Come out right now!!
Don't think a cheap trick like that's gonna scare me...!
I'm gonna be real mad if you don't come out right now!
Aahh! When did you sneak up behind me?! You scared me half to dea ...==W== death...
Bo-boss... Your...your neck...==W== It's gonna...gonna snap...
My neck? What about my neck?
I reach up and touch my neck but it feels completely normal.
Eh...? What was that just now?
Chixia's scream is so loud it probably scared off every owl within five miles.
But thanks to her, that weird dizziness from earlier seems to have eased up for the most part.
Okay, stop screaming. What's going on?
Your... Your head...==W== Huh? It's still on...
No, I mean... Just now...==W== It was an illusion???
It really was an illusion... Really scared me to death...
I'm the one who almost got scared to death! What's going on with this talisman of yours?!
Just a teeny tiny accident...==W== But hey, it worked, so whatever!
<size=30>You caused an explosion. You call that "whatever"??
N-nothing...==W== So, you said it worked?
After the talisman lit up, it flew toward that house over there.==W== Maybe there's something over there... Or maybe... Hmm...
Anyway, just trust me. Let's go!

strings.text: What really happened during the wedding in the diary? And is there really a ghost?
The talisman flew into a house that had clearly been through a fire. The smoke-blackened walls and charred furniture say it all.
The air in the house has this lingering burnt smell. I'm not sure if it's from the talisman or just our imagination.
This village really is full of dolls everywhere...
I've heard that even though dolls look human, they don't have souls—so they're easy targets for wandering spirits and ghosts to possess...
But there are so many dolls here...
Ahem, let's just...==W== Hey, what are you even digging around for? This place is clearly empty, nothing to investigate. Let's just get out of here.
Weren't you the one who said to trust you? Since your talisman flew this way, we should at least check it out.
A notebook...? Something's written in it.
"Floris Month, Honeysuckle Day. Rain... I made plans to go into the city with him. It's the first time he's ever invited me."

==A1==Chixia and I flip through the charred diary.==P====RT====RT====A2==Some of the writing has faded from age and water damage. However, from the legible parts, we are able to piece together a bit of the writer's past.==P====RT====RT====A2==The diary belongs to a young girl. It tells the story of how she met a Loong man, how they got to know each other and eventually fell in love. You could feel her happiness and hope for the future in every word.==P====RT====RT====A-2==On the final page of the diary, it says that tomorrow was the big day; her mother made her a red ceremonial dress for the traditional Loong wedding.
It's such a happy story, but it ends right before the wedding day.==W== Could it be... Something went wrong during the ceremony?
Hey, ==PLAYER_NAME==... ==W==When we got here, the whole village was dark, right?
Then... What's going on over here?
<size=45>I look to where Chixia's finger is pointing and see a soft orange light ==RT==glowing from a window in the dark.
<size=45>A shadowy figure stands at the window. It looks like it's staring straight at us.
<size=45>In the blink of an eye, the shadow in the window vanishes. That unsettling feeling of being watched is gone, too.
Aren't you a Xuan Shi?! Don't you want to go check out what's going on right now?!
No way! That's exactly how it goes in all the Monolith movies. Curiosity kills the cat; people who go looking for trouble end up dead!
Rock, paper, scissors. If you win, we head home right now.
Before I came out here, I gave my word to the Baize Bureau. I told them I'd brought in Chixia the Xuan Shi and that you'd definitely get the job done.
It's probably nothing. Maybe that shadow was just the curtain blowing in the wind.
You sure? That's exactly what people say right before they get themselves killed in those movies!
Keep it in your inner pocket. If things get dangerous, it might come in handy.
Wait—is this the legendary, super-useful protection talisman that every Trekker's gotta have?!
Absolutely! They say no matter how dangerous things get, if you've got a protection talisman from Chixia the Xuan Shi, it's basically like having an extra life.
Since your talisman is so powerful, what are you even worried about? Come on, let's go!
Hehe. Chixia the Xuan Shi will definitely get the job done...
Huh?! Hey! Boss!!==W== Slow down! Wait for me!
The room's empty, except for an old carved wooden table with a few red candles set on top.
I've got a bad feeling about this...==W== Hey, ==PLAYER_NAME==, you're just gonna walk in like that?!
<size=35>Ugh, seriously, where do you even get that kind of courage? Mind sharing a little of it with me...?
Red silk ribbons hang from the beams and pillars of the rundown house, and a tattered "Double Happiness" symbol is still stuck to one of the broken windows.
Time's worn the vibrant red down to a dull gray, adding an eerie vibe to the place.
What's all this for? Some kind of ceremony?
It ...==W== looks like the traditional Loong wedding?
Oh right, the diary did mention a wedding... Could this be where the ceremony was supposed to take place?
It's possible.==W== But... Why are these candles still burning? Not to mention...
Why are these fruits on the table still so fresh?!
They look like they've just been picked.
But the wedding must have taken place a long time ago.
<size=50>A horrible accident must have befallen the bride on the day of her wedding—that's why the diary ended there. She never made it to the ceremony, hence the lingering bitterness...
Ooh, nice deduction!==W== So her spirit's been lingering, and that's why the village is haunted?
Maybe those dolls are connected too—what if her fiancé made them to remember her?
A cold gust of wind blows through. The flickering candlelight stretches our shadows across the wall, making them look like they've come to life.
Chixia, are you okay? You look as pale as a...
I, I, I'm fine. I'm Chixia the Xuan, Xuan … Xuan Shi! I, I, I can do it!
Honestly, if you're this scared, we're better off leaving.
No, I'm fine! I, I can't embarrass Yunji and the profession of Xuan Shi.
Ahem... I've heard that if someone passes away with regrets, they can't move on to the afterlife. That means all we have to do is...
Fulfill her last wish? Recreate what happened that day?
Yes, yes!==W== Hmm, how did you know that?
Yeah … how did I know that? Sounds like the plot of a movie...
Anyway, I'm sure that'll work! Go me! Hehe.
If we're going to recreate what happened that day, how do we figure out exactly what she's holding onto?
Since she led us here, it must be...
There's no wind, so why did the candle just flicker...?
Uh... So that means if we finish the wedding she never got to have, ==W==she'll finally be at peace and able to move on...?
<size=50>Ahhhhh! I knew it! There's a ghost here!!!!

strings.text: As a third shadow flickers in the candle light, the secret will soon be revealed...
Hey, hey, take it easy! You're going to crush my arm...
Hey, are you feeling colder? 'Cause I'm getting this weird chill from the knees down.
I think so. That's so cool.
Why are you so excited?! Aren't you scared at all?!
Well...==W== I've never really run into something like this before, so I guess it's like they say, "newbies don't know fear."
Besides, we've been here all this time and nothing's happened to us. Pretty sure that means the "ghost" isn't actually trying to hurt anyone, right?
I, I guess that makes sense...
A-alright, let's get started! The sooner we're done, the sooner we can get outta here!
So we're gonna recreate their wedding ceremony from back then?
I guess. In Loong traditions, aside from wearing red, there's one really important part of the ceremony—the couple has to bow to the heavens and earth, to the parents, and finally, to each other.
Wait a minute. If we are going to recreate the scene, don't we need two more people...?
It's not exactly safe to drag others into this, considering...
Makes sense...==W== But maybe we can use something else to stand in for people?
Perfect, then. There are dolls all over the place outside. We can just bring a couple in to stand in.
Boss, you go get two of them. I, I'll stay here and start the preparation.
Right...==W== Just don't go too far, okay? If you're not back in five minutes, I … I swear I'll summon a talking fire dragon and have it shout your name across the whole mountain!
I kinda wanna see the talking fire dragon, though...

I notice Chixia standing by the pillar with her hands pressed together. "Sorry," she says, "I'm just gonna borrow this." She carefully tears off a small piece of red silk from the ribbon draped over the pillars.
This will be the red veil. In Loong wedding traditions, the bride wears a red cloth over her head during the ceremony.

strings.text: An unexpected meeting with Chitose on the street leads to a conversation about the training of "Jinken Hitotsu"...
The reunion with Chitose was an unexpected one.
<size=30>... As I suspected. Simply by waiting here, I would see you again.
Ah, Chitose! Long time no see!
You waited here just for me? Is something the matter?
My ==SEX11==... If I may speak plainly, this time I came to you because ...==W== I have a request to make.
Yes. Until now, I have remained steadfast in my training, ever honing myself as the blade that protects you.
What I seek is none other than the state of "Jinken Hitotsu."
"Jinken Hitotsu"? I don't want to sound dumb, but could you explain?
It means that the blade can sense its wielder's thoughts and feelings from afar and act of its own accord without needing commands. Such is the ideal I pursue.
I see, so that's what you meant.
You want me to train with you so you can achieve this "oneness between blade and wielder"?
As one might have expected, my ==SEX11==, you have seen through my intention. You already understand the true meaning of "Jinken Hitotsu."
Huh? No, I just ... kind of guessed—
I wish to experience your state of Oneness—here and now, if possible! I hope to grasp its true essence as soon humanly possible.
That's some intense admiration... But setting that aside for now, this whole "Jinken Hitotsu" thing... This is the first I've heard of it...
Is it that ... in your eyes, I'm still not ready to grasp that Oneness?
Ugh... It's all my fault... I'm simply not worthy... I've let you down, and I'm truly ashamed...!
Wait, wait! Don't just jump to conclusions and immediately start blaming yourself—!
Anyway—I think it's going to be fine! Chitose, I know you'll definitely be able to master "Jinken Hitotsu."
Of course. After all, I—ahem ...==W== I'm speaking as someone who has already mastered Oneness!
She always seems a little lost whenever she's in a crowd.
Is there anything you're interested in seeing?
Very well. Even if I tried to hide it, you'd see right through me, my ==SEX11==, since you've already mastered "Jinken Hitotsu."
Sorry to let you down, but there's no "see right through" going on here!
As you know, I am an "unsheathed blade." Thus I'm always worried I might accidentally harm someone merely passing by.
Now that she mentions it, that's actually true. For some reason, I seem to be the only one who can touch Chitose without getting hurt...
So you're still having trouble controlling your body's magic blade?
I-I'm terribly sorry... It's all because my training is still lacking...
I have no choice but to break my own blade as an apology!
Wait! That was just a throwaway question!
My ==SEX11==...! You are always so kind and forgiving. I am ... truly unworthy!
Whew... Hearing Chitose talk about "breaking her own blade" is way too scary. That's not something to joke about...
Anyway, if you're worried about there being too many people around...
You can come a little closer to me. This way, you definitely won't hurt anyone else.
You wish for me ... to come closer to you, my ==SEX11==...?
What's with that reaction?! Did you misunderstand me?!
No, my ==SEX11==, this too is part of the training to attain Oneness between wielder and blade. I understand completely...!
Is it what you believe? Oh well, never mind. Let's just hold each other's—
Then... If you will pardon my boldness—
She hugged me so tight all the sudden!!!
What do you mean, "how does it feel"?! What are you even doing right now?! Hey, hey—are you listening?!
I am your blade, my ==SEX11==; and a blade rightfully belongs at its ==SEX11=='s side.
That's why I am attempting to have you "sheathe your blade"...!
Ah... That look on your face... Could it be that I've misunderstood your command?
No... It's not your fault. I'm the one who said we could get close. Anyway, it's not so much that you misunderstood…
Have I failed to understand your intention, my ==SEX11==...? So much for attaining Oneness between wielder and blade. Have I already failed...?
There is no hope for me...! Now I have no choice but to break my own blade—
No, I can't let myself get swept up in her way of thinking... I need to figure out how to steer the conversation…
Chitose, if you want to master Oneness, how about trying a different approach?
Do you mean a test cut? I am prepared.==W== Please instruct me. What would you have me cut?
So, we're going to a shop. I want you to try guessing what I'm planning to buy. Simple enough, right?
So I am to guess what you wish to buy... I see.
As you wish, my ==SEX11==. I will not fail you.
And so, with Chitose clinging tightly to my waist, we walk into the blacksmith's shop.
Welcome! Looking for a particular blade? Our shop's wares are unmatched for miles around!
Is this ... a blacksmith's shop...? Ahhh...
My ==SEX11==... Is it because I lost composure earlier...? Are you really going to discard this blade—discard me—right here and now...?!
No, that's not it—! Don't always assume the worst!
But seriously, if I really did say I wanted to buy a new blade—what would you do, Chitose?
In that case... I would settle it with a test of blades! I must see for myself which blade is truly worthy of serving you, my ==SEX11==...
Ugh, it's my fault for not communicating clearly. No wonder she got the wrong idea...
Sorry. Saying I wanted to try a different approach to achieve Oneness was just an excuse.
To be honest, I just wanted to buy you a gift.
Remember when you gave me that sageo before? I still haven't given you anything in return.
It's only proper to give you something in return, right? So it's not about guessing what I want to buy. I want you to pick out something you'd like for yourself.
Without hesitation, she points to a medium-sized whetstone.
A whetstone? Are you sure that's all you want? They have plenty of other blade accessories to choose from, you know.
I'm not just being polite—if I had this whetstone...
It means I could ask my ==SEX11== to take care of me in person, whenever I need. For a blade, it is the ultimate bliss...
She really picked a whetstone... Surprising for sure.
But if that's what she wants, then so be it. I did say she could choose for herself, after all.
Alright, alright! I don't really get it, but … if that's what you want, I'll use this to take care of you next time!
With the whetstone bought, Chitose and I leave the blacksmith's shop together, both of us satisfied.

strings.text: It’s said that by holding your breath and locking eyes, hearts can become one… Yet for two who are constantly misaligned, can they truly make it work?
Leaving the blacksmith's shop, Chitose and I walk side by side down the street once more.
After some convincing, she finally stops clinging to my waist.==W== But now she's staring at me with a serious, unwavering gaze.
You've been staring at me for a while now... Is this part of your "Jinken Hitotsu" training, too?
It is as you say, my ==SEX11==.
I-I see... So there's some special meaning behind this intense staring...?
Having received such a precious gift from you, my ==SEX11==, I was so overjoyed... I may have gotten a little carried away...
She looked so calm on the outside, but she was actually really happy...
But once again, I failed to grasp your true intention, my ==SEX11==. It's clear my training is still far from complete...
Don't worry about that, Chitose. It was only because I deliberately misled you...==B== That one is on me.
No, my ==SEX11==. If I had truly mastered Oneness, I would have been able to sense your true intention...
I once read that by holding one's breath, focusing intently, and gazing at one another, two people can deepen their understanding to the point of sharing the same thoughts.
That's why I was staring at you. I hoped that I could understand your great mind, even just a little.
I see. I guess that's why they say "eyes are windows to the soul"...
If you want to understand someone without words... Eye contact really is the best way to do it!
You're right. So, should we try practicing? Staring into each other's eyes?
I gather my courage and meet Chitose's gaze. Her eyes are a clear, mysterious shade of violet.
When you look at me like that, my ==SEX11==... I don't know why, but ... my face is getting all warm...
Mom—! Look! I think they're gonna kiss!
Shh—don't bother other people! Come on, let's keep moving.
Eh? But, but I wanna watch them kiss!
I don't know this "Oneness" stuff, but I do realize Chitose's little "huh—" is pure shock at the girl's misunderstanding.
My ==SEX11==...! That girl said we were about to "kicks"... At this moment, what is that you wish to kick...?
Even passing children can sense your true intentions, my ==SEX11== ... what is it that I'm still lacking...?
Here we go again, dangerous misunderstanding galore...
Calm down, Chitose. I don't want us to kick anything. What she meant was...
Ah—no ... never mind. Just pretend you didn't hear that...
My ==SEX11==, could it be that you are deliberately obscuring your intention in order to test my perceptiveness...?
No, not at all... I just thought it might be a bit too much for you and didn't want to scare you. Don't push yourself.
As you command... Though the more you try to keep something from me, the more it lingers on my mind—
Hmm... Got it. This dictionary will tell me what "kicks" mean...
How is it that you have a dictionary hidden under the blanket?!
Okay, I see... That's what she meant...! It's "kiss"!
Since kiss is "a way to share one's feelings without words"... Then, to attain our Oneness, we must...!
As curious gazes around us threaten to swallow us whole, I grab Chitose's hand and hurry away from the scene.
My ==SEX11==...? Why are you unwilling to kiss me?
That kind of thing ...==B== is for people who are really close, whose relationship has moved onto the next level.
And you are implying ... our relationship is not close enough?
... Ah, n-no. It's not that kind of relationship at all!
Anyway, we can't rush this...! It's for your own sake—and your training—so just forget about it for now!
Yes. I just hope you can get it through your head...
So that means... As long as I continue training by your side, my ==SEX11==, one day, I too will be able to kiss you... Is that what you're saying?
Why is she so focused on this kiss thing?!
R-right... Training! Chitose, let's get back to our "Jinken Hitotsu" training please! Like ... how about we go hunt some monsters together?
As you command. In order to kiss my ==SEX11== one day, I shall never neglect my training!
After leaving the town and spending several hours focused on hunting monsters—
We got a lot of them.
Yes. The monsters in this area should be—
They've probably all scattered like that Shrubshrew.
It goes to show just how strong you are, Chitose. As your "wielder," I'm truly ... honored beyond words.
Thank you for the praise. But ...==B== as a "blade," this hardly counts as showing my true edge. I can't help feeling a little disappointed...
Ah, I've got it! My ==SEX11==, do you see that boulder over there?
Huh? Oh—uh, yeah... That's a pretty big rock. Why?
Then please allow me to show you what I can do.
Where the blade strikes, all falls silent—
Water gathers along the edge of Chitose's blade.==W== In just an instant, the massive boulder splits cleanly and soundlessly into two.
Whoa... Seriously? That rock's almost double my height!
That incredible technique and her control over Aqua element... No matter how many times I see it, it still takes my breath away.
—Wait a second, isn't this a bit too much water?
As the surge of water from Chitose's slash rises, it forms clouds that, before we know it, begin to veil the sky—
Before I can react, the dark clouds turn into a torrential downpour.
I may have ... gotten a little too carried away...

Chitose's long hair sways in the wind. She sits upright beside me, her gaze distant and unfocused.
Good thing we managed to find some shelter from the rain...
