Please forgive me,==W== my ==SEX11==.==W== I have failed to grasp the way of the Oneness,==W== and even worse, failed to help you...==W== I am a disgrace...

Trying?==W== Yes, I suppose so.==W== But what good is that, if it does not bear fruit?
Trying?==W== But what good is that,==W== if it does not bear fruit?
Effort is effort, whether the results come or not.

I guess==W== to someone like me…==W== The dream to master the Oneness==W== is just a foolish, hopeless dream…
It's not just about the Oneness.

...! ==W==The honor is  more than I deserve!==W== Now that you've said something like that…
...! The honor is more than I deserve!==W== Still,==W== now that you've said something like that…

Then I, Chitose—your blade,==W== shall redouble my efforts ...==W== to master the Oneness,==W== and become a truly magnificent blade fit to be in your service!

I vow upon all that is good in this world==W== that I will serve you==W== as long as you need me...
Then as long as my ==SEX11== needs me…==W== No,==W== even if I am no longer needed…

As long as==W== this life lasts,==W== I will remain your blade.==W== I hereby make this vow to you.
Now that I've renewed my vow... My ==SEX11==, that area is dangerous—please, remain where you are for now.
Dangerous...? Wait, what are you doing?!
With my power, ==W==I shall sweep away these raindrops—Haah—!
With utter composure, Chitose strikes in a flash—her blade draws a graceful arc through the air. Before I realize what's happened, she has already sheathed her blade.
What kind of magic was that...?! I was soaked just a moment ago, and now I'm completely dry?!
She can cleave boulders with a single strike ... and use sword wind to sweep away moisture ... Chitose's swordsmanship is truly incredible...
Thank you. Such a great help. Hmm ... I may not have amazing blade technique like yours, but at least I can help dry your hair!
No, I couldn't possibly trouble you over something so trivial...

...Hmm, I guess this is the only thing I can use.

Of course. It's an important keepsake from you, after all.
Uh, I see what you mean—using it to dry your hair just doesn't feel right...

Yes. After all, that sageo was always wrapped around my body before.
Wait—hold on! You were wearing that right against your skin the whole time?!
Yes. So please, there's no need to hesitate. Go ahead and use it...
That just makes it even harder! I can't believe I've been entrusted with something so intimate. What am I even supposed to do with it...
Alright! Anyway, I'll make sure to keep this gift safe and treat it with the care it deserves!
Good. I hope both the sageo and I can stay by your side forever.

You don't have to be by my side every second. It's okay to do what you want, to go where you want.
I'm not forcing myself ... A blade only finds meaning in staying by its wielder's side.
A blade's duty is to protect her wielder—so even during sleep, she should always be close at hand.

strings.text: Driven by a secret purpose, she carefully staged a "chance" encounter.
Most folks are still sleeping on a holiday morning like this, yet here I am...
I promised Noya I'd help...==W== But I didn't expect an errand at the crack of dawn. Let's get this over with.
Ah, sorry...==W== We sold out of those Extra-Large Open-End Wrenches yesterday.
Wait, hold on! We still have this—==W== The shop's crown jewel, our Super Deluxe Repair Kit!
You bet! This kit's got every wrench, screwdriver, and plier!==W== With this, you can fix anything!
And naturally, it includes the wrench you're looking for.==W== It's the last one in stock, so I'll give you a deal. 200,000 Dorra.
Whoa, no way. That's way too steep. I only need one wrench, not a whole kit.
Forget it. I'll try another shop.
If I'm not mistaken, you require that wrench to service a car Artifact, correct?
Otoha?! What is she doing here?
Whatever. Better play along. She's probably got some "secret plan" again.
That's right. Our guild's car has been acting up.
I see.==W== In that case, this kit is actually quite fitting.
It holds not only tools, but also gauges and a head-mounted lighting Artifact. Essential for working beneath the chassis.
However...==W== The toolbox color is rather garish, and the finish is quite scuffed.
I happen to be researching cars at the moment.==W== I admit, that I'm quite intrigued by your guild's vehicle.==W== If you wouldn't mind, may I tag along for a look?
Allow me to purchase this toolset for you. Consider it ...==W== a gift from me.
Oh, you shouldn't have.==W== Just come visit. There's no need for a 200,000 Dorra gift...
Researching...==W== Cars...==W== Wait, could it be?!
You're that legendary genius mechanic everyone talks about, aren't you?!
You haven't heard?==W== She's a wizard at repairs, sure, but she also spends a fortune collecting every new gadget on the market. She never haggles for what she's looking for.
In the repair world, she's an absolute legend!
I heard you only shop at high-end boutiques. What brings you to a common market today?
Occasionally, the market carries the most delightful surprises. Wouldn't you agree,==W== ==SEX17==?
Please wrap this up.==W== Here is the payment.
No need! Please, take the toolset on the house!==W== I've always admired your work. Just think of it as a token of my respect.
I appreciate the gesture, but I insist on paying. I couldn't possibly let you operate at a loss.
Please, don't mention it. That kit has been gathering dust in inventory for ages. It was priced so high, I had no idea when I'd ever sell it.
Besides, business has been booming lately. I've made plenty, so consider this good karma.
So she was just trying to unload dead stock on me...==W== Calling it her "crown jewel." Slick sales talk.
Yes. Wave after wave of Trekkers coming through, all desperate for repair kits. Claiming their weapons busted or something.
Another major raid? Guild conflicts?==W== If things were that bad, we'd have heard rumors by now.
Rust remover, screws, bolts...==W== Standard supplies.
You know, someone pitched me this "insurance" idea the other day. Claimed they cover the full cost if any expensive gear breaks.
They tried to sell you on that, too?
They did, but I chased 'em off.==W== Like I've got cash to burn on insurance!
Total waste of time, if you ask me.==W== Heard they pestered a bunch of Trekkers too, but nobody buys that junk.
Come to think of it, an agent approached Iris too, but she shut her down flat.
But why bring up the insurance now, Otoha?
Well, thanks again for the gift. I won't forget the favor.
I lead Otoha out of the market chaos and into the quiet park, finally catching my breath.
Alright, Boss, you can relax now.==W== That was quite the improvised show back there.
I'll take that as a compliment...
Next time you want to roleplay, mind giving me a heads-up?
Where's the fun in that? It's only entertaining when you never see it coming.
Still, "genius mechanic"? I had no idea you had such a reputation.
Well, my needs for material and tools are a bit more specific than those of average Trekkers.
Fresh Monolith weaponry, scrap metal from street vendors... They all deserve a closer look.
I simply bought a few extra parts and swapped tips with the shopkeepers. Honestly, they flatter me with such a grand title.
She doesn't sound very humble about it...
Anyway, thanks for the toolset. Noya's going to be over the moon.
So, did you need me for something specific?
What if I told you==W== this was all a happy accident?
Those honest eyes of yours... You make it impossible to lie, Boss.
I'm looking into something. And as it happens, it might concern you, too.
That is why I was hoping you'd lend me a hand.
I'm not exactly built for heavy lifting...==W== But I'll do what I can. Consider it payment for the tools.
Thank you for the vote of confidence, Boss.
Just follow my lead for now.==W== I promise it will be an enlightening experience.
Sigh...==W== So much for a relaxing day off.

strings.text: Following her lead, you step onto the stage that has already been set up.
Otoha leads me to a residential house. A young witch answers the door.
L-Lady Otoha...==W== It's been ages! I've been waiting for you!
Sorry we're late. We got held up on the way over.
This Trekker is the interview subject I mentioned. I think ==SEX== will be perfect for your report.
Hi, I'm ==PLAYER_NAME==. Nice to meet you.
==PLAYER_NAME== is quite busy, so I only managed to pin ==SEX4== down this morning.
I didn't have time to notify you in advance. Hope you don't mind the surprise.
I only asked for some writing advice...==W== I never expected you to bring an actual interviewee!==W== Thank you so much!!
Please, take a seat! I'll grab some tea and snacks.
Hehe, she certainly has energy to spare.
Good thing Mistique "interviewed" me before. I should be able to bluff my way through. Still, didn't expect the day to turn out like this...
Boss, we're going to meet a rookie witch soon.
She's going to ask you some simple questions. Just answer them honestly.
In return, she should be able to give us some clues.
I never pegged you as a veteran "witch," Otoha...==W== Did you actually work as one?
No disguise works without convincing evidence to back it up.
I got my Witch Certification before some executives at Scarlet Sights Media were even born.
Of course. It's the genuine article.
Sorry for the wait. Here, please have some tea.
I reviewed your outline yesterday. Tackling the unemployment crisis was a smart move—everyone's talking about it.
As it happens, ==PLAYER_NAME== runs a staffing agency. You should ask ==SEX4== for the details.
Well, technically true, but my staffing agency isn't exactly a common one.
In fact, I was so captivated by ==PLAYER_NAME=='s brilliance that I quit being a witch just to work for ==SEX4== as a special advisor.
Oh dear. Is the tea too hot?
No, no... I'm good. Just went down the wrong pipe...
I see! That explains why no article has been carrying your byline in quite a while.
Well, I won't take up any more of your time. Let's get this interview started!
The interview carries on for about an hour.
Thank you both for coming. You've really given me a fresh perspective on a lot of things.
Happy to help.==W== By the way, there seems to be a flood of reporting on unemployment lately.
Actually, management mandated the topic. Everyone has to write about unemployment. The whole office is thick with tension...
But some of those pieces are clearly blowing things out of proportion. I worry they'll trigger public panic.
They aren't just biased. Every article ends with on-the-nose Omnisky Aegis unemployment insurance.
It reads like paid advertising, not journalism...==W== I'd love to meet the authors face-to-face.
Omnisky Aegis?==W== Are they pulling the strings? Did they pay off Scarlet Sights Media?
Now that you mention it, the paper really has been plastered with their ads...
Regardless, I'm sticking to my principles. I'm going to be a witch who reports the truth and nothing else!
Keep that spirit, and I'm sure you'll go far.
Oh, one request. Please keep ==PLAYER_NAME== anonymous in your final draft.
==SEX1== has plenty of competitors, and we can't risk leaking any trade secrets.
You got it! I'll send the draft over for you to review as soon as it's done.
So that's it...==W== Otoha's actual target is Omnisky Aegis. No wonder she was grilling that shop owner earlier.
But what does an insurance company have to do with me?==W== What is she really after?
Shall we, ==SEX7== CEO? We have other business to attend to.
Otoha pops open her parasol, shielding me from the harsh midday glare.
As if sensing my suspicion, she deliberately leans in close.
We've been working hard all morning. Let's go recharge our batteries.
Okay, but why are we recharging with desserts?
Sweets fuel the body and the soul. Don't you have a sweet tooth, Boss?
It's not that I dislike them, but having dessert for lunch is a bit...
And why did you slide all the plates over to me? I can't eat these by myself!
I simply want to know your preferences, Boss. Think of it as market research.
Ma'am! What brings you into the shop today?
I was in the neighborhood. Decided to bring a friend.
Understood.==W== Oh—here's the monthly order report you asked for. All organized.
Excellent work. I'll look this over. You can get back to it.
Of course. Just holler if you need anything else.
Hehe, that look of shock on your face is quite amusing, Boss.
You're kidding!==W== You actually own this place?
Technically, I'm the investor. Daily operations are handled by a specialist—==W==the manager you just met.
I drop by occasionally to check the books and indulge a little. It's a nice way to unwind.
So, did you open this shop just to satisfy your sweet tooth?
That's a factor, yes, but one shouldn't make decisions based solely on that.
A dessert shop isn't just a space for eating. Its openness facilitates networking.
Networking...==W== You mean it's a perfect drop point for intel, don't you?
Sharp as ever, Boss. You catch on quick.
The problem is...==W== Sometimes I can't just enjoy dessert for what it is.
Exploiting what you love to do what you hate, even if you get results... There's no joy in that.
I can never quite figure her out, but she clearly shoulders a heavy burden...==W== It must be exhausting.
Is the afternoon tea set ready for pickup?
All set. Fifteen orders, right here. Be careful with them.
Sigh... I swear, I've basically turned into a pack mule lately.
We order all these fancy snacks every day, but I never see any big clients signing contracts. Instead of wasting money on tea and cakes, they should just give me a raise.
Heh...==W== Just as I suspected. Boss, take a look at this order history.
Starting last week, an employee would come to pick up a reservation every single day at 3 p.m. sharp. And the client listed is...==W==<color=#0ABEC5> Omnisky Aegis</color>.
That company again...==W== What are they actually up to?
If you're curious, why don't we just go ask them?
And ...==W== you think they'll just tell us?
Aren't they desperate for big clients?

They aren't just biased. Every article ends with on-the-nose Omnisky Aegis unemployment insurance.
It reads like paid advertising, not journalism...==W== I'd love to meet the authors face-to-face.
Omnisky Aegis?==W== Are they pulling the strings? Did they pay off Scarlet Sights Media?
Now that you mention it, the paper really has been plastered with their ads...
Regardless, I'm sticking to my principles. I'm going to be a witch who reports the truth and nothing else!
Keep that spirit, and I'm sure you'll go far.
Oh, one request. Please keep ==PLAYER_NAME== anonymous in your final draft.
==SEX1== has plenty of competitors, and we can't risk leaking any trade secrets.
You got it! I'll send the draft over for you to review as soon as it's done.
So that's it...==W== Otoha's actual target is Omnisky Aegis. No wonder she was grilling that shop owner earlier.
But what does an insurance company have to do with me?==W== What is she really after?
Shall we, ==SEX7== CEO? We have other business to attend to.
Otoha pops open her parasol, shielding me from the harsh midday glare.
As if sensing my suspicion, she deliberately leans in close.
We've been working hard all morning. Let's go recharge our batteries.
Okay, but why are we recharging with desserts?
Sweets fuel the body and the soul. Don't you have a sweet tooth, Boss?
It's not that I dislike them, but having dessert for lunch is a bit...
And why did you slide all the plates over to me? I can't eat these by myself!
I simply want to know your preferences, Boss. Think of it as market research.
Ma'am! What brings you into the shop today?
I was in the neighborhood. Decided to bring a friend.
Understood.==W== Oh—here's the monthly order report you asked for. All organized.
Excellent work. I'll look this over. You can get back to it.
Of course. Just holler if you need anything else.
Hehe, that look of shock on your face is quite amusing, Boss.
You're kidding!==W== You actually own this place?
Technically, I'm the investor. Daily operations are handled by a specialist—==W==the manager you just met.
I drop by occasionally to check the books and indulge a little. It's a nice way to unwind.
So, did you open this shop just to satisfy your sweet tooth?
That's a factor, yes, but one shouldn't make decisions based solely on that.
A dessert shop isn't just a space for eating. Its openness facilitates networking.
Networking...==W== You mean it's a perfect drop point for intel, don't you?
Sharp as ever, Boss. You catch on quick.
The problem is...==W== Sometimes I can't just enjoy dessert for what it is.
Exploiting what you love to do what you hate, even if you get results... There's no joy in that.
I can never quite figure her out, but she clearly shoulders a heavy burden...==W== It must be exhausting.
Is the afternoon tea set ready for pickup?
All set. Fifteen orders, right here. Be careful with them.
Sigh... I swear, I've basically turned into a pack mule lately.
We order all these fancy snacks every day, but I never see any big clients signing contracts. Instead of wasting money on tea and cakes, they should just give me a raise.
Heh...==W== Just as I suspected. Boss, take a look at this order history.
Starting last week, an employee would come to pick up a reservation every single day at 3 p.m. sharp. And the client listed is...==W==<color=#0ABEC5> Omnisky Aegis</color>.
That company again...==W== What are they actually up to?
If you're curious, why don't we just go ask them?
And ...==W== you think they'll just tell us?
Aren't they desperate for big clients?

strings.text: When the curtain falls, how can we tell the difference between reality and pretense?
Otoha and I trail the employee all the way to the Omnisky Aegis building.
Have you memorized the script I gave you, Boss?
The real performance starts now. Let's see what you've got.
Good afternoon. How may I assist you today?
I have an appointment regarding a high-value policy.
Certainly. Do you recall which consultant contacted you?
No idea. My phone rings off the hook all day. I can't keep track of every name.
I believe he was a "Senior Consultant" or something...==W== If no one's available, I'll be on my way.
Please, wait just a moment! I'll check right away!
Allow me. I'll handle this client personally.
But Ma'am, I haven't confirmed whose appointment it is...
No need.==W== We can't keep a valued guest waiting, now can we?
Smooth talker. She's obviously just trying to poach the commission for herself.
But hey, at least it gets us through the door hassle-free.
You aren't the one who called, but I suppose it hardly matters. Business is business.
As the manager led the way, Otoha links her arm through mine as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
I know it's acting...==W== But I'm still not used to this.
Allow me to introduce myself. I manage the Emor branch of Omnisky Aegis. Now allow me to introduce our premium portfolio.
You mentioned high-value policies. What specific coverage do you have in mind?
We offer liability, comprehensive medical, wealth management...
I want the most expensive policy you have. Highest returns possible for ==SEX4==.
Certainly. And may I ask ... the nature of your relationship?
==SEX1== is the lead in the next Stella Drama I'm funding. We have ...==W== quite the connection. Don't we?
Of course...==W== But we have to be discreet. Not a word of this gets out.
Rest assured. Discretion is our currency. Your privacy is safe with me.
Good. I worry myself sick about my little star. Acting takes such a toll on the body.
Just look at that pretty face. If anything happened to it...==W== Well, I'd be devastated.
Okay, too close!==W== And do you have to pinch me that hard?!
Wipe that smirk off your face!!
A friend recommended your firm at a party recently. Her consultant was supposed to meet me here.
But this place is tiny. Hardly any offices. You aren't running some fly-by-night scam, are you?
Absolutely not!==W== You may not know, but our headquarters in Port Goldfinch has led the industry for a decade.
The Emor branch might look modest, but our recent growth is explosive.
We cover everyone—Trekkers, citizens, and VIP clients like yourself.
Was it them? The broken weapons, the sensational news... Were they pulling the strings all along?
In that case, draft me a proposal. My budget is five million Dorra.
Five million...==W== That's the signal. It's showtime.
Are you kidding me?! A measly five million?!
Don't think I'm unaware that you insured your last lead actor for ten million!
Is that all I'm worth to you?
Please, wait! We can work something out!
Phew...==W== Acting really takes it out of you. At least we pulled it off.
Now...==W== I just have to wait for Otoha to snag whatever she's after.
The moment I say "five million," you snap. Get angry and storm out.
We'll split up, and I'll search for the target.
I'm not exactly confident in my acting chops...==W== But alright. I'll give it a shot.
It's been an hour since I walked out. I hope Otoha is okay...
She's a pro.==W== I'm sure she's fine...
Hey, you heard? Something's going down at that building up the street!
Word is, someone started a huge riot inside—
Yeah, I heard! Sounds like they already caught the one.==W== No wonder there was a crowd when I walked by. Even the Imperial Guard showed up.
They're talking about==W== the Omnisky Aegis building...!
Otoha...==W== Please tell me you didn't get caught!
Kept you waiting, didn't I, Boss?
Meet me on the hotel rooftop next to the Omnisky building.
Huh? That was Otoha?==W== Then who did the guards catch...?
By the time I arrive, night has fallen.
I sprint up the stairs and burst through the access door.
Oh, my.==W== Why are you out of breath?
You took so long to get in touch. I was worried.
I'm sorry.==W== There was some trouble,==W== and it took longer than expected.
Is that so... Are you injured?
Hehe...==W== As you can see,==W== I'm safe and sound.
Hehe...==W== Tyrant,==W== you're worrying for the wrong person.
Set that aside,==W== aren't you curious==W== about what I've got?
When you put it that way, it does make me wonder…
Will you tell me the truth?
Hehe.==W== The usual me==W== might have taken the chance==W== and put up a condition...
Hehe.==W== The usual me might have put up a condition, but...
But today,==W== Even if you're not used to lying,==W== you put up with me nevertheless.==W== Hm...==W== To show my gratitude,==W== I'll be honest to your question.
This is my way of thanking you for forcing yourself to lie==W== and putting up with me today.
I doubt I'll ever get used to lying.
But at least today was fun.
The moment a person reveals their true self==W== is when they shine brightest.
But what a shame...==W== My "truth" went away somewhere far.
But my "truth"==W== has already gone away somewhere far.
It is like a full moon floating in the night sky...==W== You can see it,==W== but never reach it.
It is like a full moon floating in the night sky...==W== You can see it, but never reach it.
Even if we can't reach it...
It's true that you can't reach the moon. But—
Even if we can't see it, the truth is there, right?
Then, it is not something to regret.
Hehe.==W== So that’s how you see it.==W== Just like I expected.
Hehe.==W== Tyrant,==W== you are definitely straightforward.
You're right.==W== Truth and falsehood==W== are two sides of the same coin.
As they say,==W== truth and falsehood are two sides of the same coin.
In that case...==W== As you say,==W== I will try to feel==W== the "truth" that is here right now.
In that case,==W== I will try to feel the "truth"==W== that is here right now.
A soft breeze washes over us as we take in the moonlight. For a moment, the world stands still.
So, about that "little incident" earlier... What happened?
Once you were gone, I located the General Manager's office and secured the target.
But as I was extracting, a group of Trekkers barged in, claiming sales reps scammed them out of their payouts.
Imperial Guard showed up to arrest them, so I helped them slip away. Picked up some useful intel while I was at it.
I see…==W== And what exactly did you pull from the office?
Their business strategy for Emor. Or, more accurately—==W==proof of their crimes.
It outlines the whole scheme: flooding the market with corrosive bolts and cheap nuts...==W== Trekkers get hurt on the job, more accident insurance gets pushed.
They also manipulate public opinion to peddle unemployment insurance to regular citizens.
They'll stop at nothing for a profit, huh?
Regardless, I have in my possession what I came for.
I heard their leader has quite an interest in Boss Accord Staffing Co.==W== However, there's nothing about you in these files. I'll keep digging.
Thanks for the warning. I'll keep my guard up.
But...==W== I do have one question.
You could have collected this intel on your own. Why dragged me along?
Your sharp instincts and honesty are truly terrifying, Boss.
What if I said I was simply bored and wanted the company? Would you be upset?
No. I know you. There's gotta be a reason for it.
Then allow me to ask you something in return, Boss.
You had plenty of chances to refuse, yet you played along with my charade all day. Why?
Well...==W== It was a bit of a hassle, but honestly, the acting was kind of fun.
Then we should do it again next time.
It's getting late. You should head back and rest.
Days later, the papers run an exposé on Omnisky Aegis's corrupt==RT==sales tactics, publishing the stolen strategy plan for all to see.
The byline belongs to that rookie witch.==RT==Otoha must have leaked the documents to her.
Until we meet again, Boss, I shall cherish the memory of that moonlight we shared.
To me, it was the only thing that felt ... "real."

strings.text: Echo of Hearts and Stars (Part I)
Tasked with healing the mental scars of troubled Trekkers, the clueless and frustrated Boss hears a familiar melody in Flavio.
A soothing fragrance fills the air. Through the mist, colorful lights sparkle.
A typical scene in Flavio's daily life.
I'm not sure if it's the thick air or the pollen, but I can't help coughing.
Even though it smells wonderful every time I come here...
But is it really okay to keep smelling this scent...?
A few days ago, I received a commission at Flavio's Trekker Camp.
You want me to find a treatment ...==B== for your mental scars?
Yes, as you can see, because of the accident last time, more than half of the Trekkers at this camp...
Ever since that day, whenever I step into the Monolith, my body trembles uncontrollably...==B== I can't fight at all.
The truth is, everyone wants to get back to the front lines as soon as possible...==B== But that's impossible because of the mental scars we are still carrying!
If people have to stay on the sidelines, this camp will have to disband sooner or later...
If it gets disbanded...==W== I can't sing or dance, how am I supposed to survive in Flavio?
So, all I have to do is help the Trekkers recover and get them back in action, right?
This type of commission isn't exactly Boss Accord's strong suit.
… That being said, it's no laughing matter if words get out that the Boss is heartless and can't sympathize with traumatized Trekkers.
The familiar, nostalgic melody helps calm my scattered thoughts and brings me back to clarity.
I turn towards the sound and see a "music space"—a type of performance venue found all over Flavio.
Along with the music, her name and the name of her instrument pop up in my mind—
All this thinking is getting me nowhere.
Might as well go listen to her music for a change of pace.
Through the crowd, I catch sight of the fascinating musician casually jamming.
I guess I'll have to properly say hi to her...
As the audience enjoys the music, a few untimely shouts break the mood.
This is my business card. Please do consider our firm—
Hey you! Save your pitch for later!
Don't interrupt Miss Caramel's performance! This is a rare improvised encore!!!
Ugh—ugh... Alright, I'm sorry, I got it! Don't drag me away...!
That's all for today's improvised performance. Thanks, everyone.
Well, even though I still haven't come up with any good ideas, listening to Caramel's performance has calmed my mind.
I shouldn't bother her. Better get going.
Just as I'm about to leave, I hear her urgent footsteps approaching.
Producer, today's show is over. Let's leave together.
During this brief exchange, the crowd has already caught up with us.
Miss Caramel! Wait! Please sign this for me!
Miss Caramel! Miss Caramel! You didn't take my card—
… Better leave this place quick before things get messy.
I try to clear a way for her.
Sorry, today's performance was an improv, so there won't be a signing session!
Please, make way—!==W== Thank you all for your cooperation!
Caramel and I finally manage to break free from the crowded music space.
Or should I call you Producer?
I'm not, Boss. I really want you to be my producer.
But I just happened to pass by...
Even better... The Monolith must have decided to grant my wish and arranged for me to run into you today.
I don't think the two things are related...
Since you've already been announced as my producer in front of so many people, why not make it official?
Never mind that. What exactly do you mean by "producer" anyway?
I've heard other musicians say that when they're low on inspiration, a little guidance from a producer can work wonders and turn things around...
It's true that I have many talents...==W== But music is not one of them.
If I mess up in that capacity, it's not just my reputation on the line—==B==it'll drag the Boss Accord down, too.
As the Boss, I can't afford to show any weakness!
I don't quite get it, but the way you said that just now had a nice rhythm to it!
I knew it! Getting you to be my producer was the right call!
You came all the way here to listen to my performance for that reason. Right, Boss?
I was simply drawn in by your music, but your performance really was impressive.
It might bruise your ego a bit, but I must admit, it really was pure chance.
So, you're looking for a producer because you're lacking inspiration, right?
… The past few days, I tried playing my bass ...==B== to the ocean, the mountains, and the Monoliths, but nothing came to me.
Before, just a few deep breaths would've been enough for me to hear their call...==B== The sounds they make.
What should I do if ...==B== the Monoliths stop responding to me...?
Caramel is an excellent musician and a unique Trekker who uses music as her weapon.
I've noticed before that she seems to be very in tune with the subtle, distant strange sounds coming from inside the Monoliths.
Those sounds might be a part of the truth about the Monoliths—it's just that people, myself included, don't really understand them.
Anyway, Caramel's talent and curiosity are truly rare and valuable qualities.
… Besides, supporting a talented young artist's work could count as one of the Boss's achievements, too!
I see, it's indeed a serious problem.
Although I don't know much about music, when it comes to finding inspiration, I can definitely help you come up with some ideas.
An awkward note interrupts her voice, which has been growing weaker from hunger.
… Maybe we should sit down to eat first?

Never mind that. What exactly do you mean by "producer" anyway?
I've heard other musicians say that when they're low on inspiration, a little guidance from a producer can work wonders and turn things around...
It's true that I have many talents...==W== But music is not one of them.
If I mess up in that capacity, it's not just my reputation on the line—==B==it'll drag the Boss Accord down, too.
As the Boss, I can't afford to show any weakness!
I don't quite get it, but the way you said that just now had a nice rhythm to it!
I knew it! Getting you to be my producer was the right call!
You came all the way here to listen to my performance for that reason. Right, Boss?
I was simply drawn in by your music, but your performance really was impressive.
It might bruise your ego a bit, but I must admit, it really was pure chance.
So, you're looking for a producer because you're lacking inspiration, right?
… The past few days, I tried playing my bass ...==B== to the ocean, the mountains, and the Monoliths, but nothing came to me.
Before, just a few deep breaths would've been enough for me to hear their call...==B== The sounds they make.
What should I do if ...==B== the Monoliths stop responding to me...?
Caramel is an excellent musician and a unique Trekker who uses music as her weapon.
I've noticed before that she seems to be very in tune with the subtle, distant strange sounds coming from inside the Monoliths.
Those sounds might be a part of the truth about the Monoliths—it's just that people, myself included, don't really understand them.
Anyway, Caramel's talent and curiosity are truly rare and valuable qualities.
… Besides, supporting a talented young artist's work could count as one of the Boss's achievements, too!
I see, it's indeed a serious problem.
Although I don't know much about music, when it comes to finding inspiration, I can definitely help you come up with some ideas.
An awkward note interrupts her voice, which has been growing weaker from hunger.
… Maybe we should sit down to eat first?

strings.text: Echo of Hearts and Stars (Part II)
Caramel asks you to be her producer. What will you do to reignite her spark?
Even the sweet scent in the dessert shop here is stronger than anywhere else. Guess that's Flavio for you.
She looks famished...==W== That's a mighty appetite, Caramel!
There were so many fans at your show just now. You should be making some decent money.
So why are you still starving?
… Sometimes it just slips my mind...
Oh... You get so caught up in the performance that you forget to eat, huh…
I mean, I forget to put the money jar out...
I guess that's a part of being a genius.
Ah! It's not like that happens all the time! I do get paid for performances!==W== The music space owners usually remind me!
But maintaining the bass, buying sheet music, and tickets for performances... It all adds up.
Then there's travel costs... Plus supplies for exploring the Monoliths...
Is it any wonder that I can't afford to eat?
No matter how much music can nourish your soul, it won't fill your stomach.
It's one thing in the city,==W== but you do realize that if you collapse from hunger in the wilds or the Monolith, there's no one around to save you?
Hehe... That's why having a producer is so important!
Watching her happily stuff her face with crepe,==W== my mind eases for a bit.
With the hunger taken care of, Caramel and I stroll down the street—==W==it's time to take on the responsibilities of being her producer.
Ah... That was so tasty. I haven't had so much delicious food in a long time...
You need to take care of your health...
But let's get back to business.==W== How did you usually find your creative inspiration before?
Let me see...==W== Ohhh, I know, watching "performances."
Oops, sorry, should have made myself clear.==W== I mean "performances" by Mother Nature!
Oh... So basically "listening to the sounds of the mountains, the sea, the Monoliths, and the sky"? Something like that?
Once you get used to it, you start to realize that Caramel sees the world a little differently. As her producer, you really have got to pay attention.
Yes, all those are performances put on by Mother Nature...
Just listening to those distant, echoing sounds==W== is enough to bring me to tears.==W== And then, the inspiration just flows on its own...
This type of art might be a bit too avant-garde for Novians.
… You aren't laughing at me, are you?
After all... In the face of nature, even the mighty Boss can feel small and powerless...
In terms of that feeling of being in awe, we're really not that different. It's just that you choose to embrace it while I choose to push back.
I love that! It's got such a great rhythm! Can I turn it into lyrics?
Actually, I've been watching performances in Flavio, too...==W== Even though the tickets add up.
You can't draw inspiration from them any more?
How do I put it...==W== Back then, there were a lot of great performances. They always opened my mind up... I could see the musicians' inner landscape.
But lately those performances are getting few and far in between.
After a long silence, she lets out a deep breath, and explains—
I'm not great with words, but... There are some pieces... No matter how popular they are—I just can't connect with them.
Sometimes I wonder if I've just been out of touch with what people like for too long...==W== But I really can't bring myself to play just for the sake of getting attention.
Music's supposed to express things—your feelings, your stories, right?==W== If it's just about drawing a crowd with loud noise, without painting any inner landscape…
Well, that kind of music has its place too.==W== But when I play alongside them, it feels like I'm not expressing anything at all.
Maybe I'm not good enough...==W== But no matter what, I... I just can't listen to it, and I don't really understand it.
Your words are gentle. The underlying message, not so much.
Huh? W-wait, no! That's not what I meant!
I really believe everyone in Flavio is chasing something meaningful in their own way... We're just going about it differently, that's all.
I see... So, for Caramel, this is a bit of a blind spot.
I ignore her polite attempt to smooth things over and try to steer her thoughts back on track—
—Like you said, music is meant for expression.
Playing for the ocean or the stars—that's beautiful, and it really feels like you.
But honestly, they're not the only ones who truly hear you. ==W==I mean the people in the city—the ones gathered in front of your stage, your fans.
I know, but every time there are that many people, I just...
She puffs out her cheeks and gives me a few light punches—==W==wow, those are a musician's hands alright, strong and solid.
I can't get used to it... I feel so useless...
You feel like you can't see into their hearts?
I really don't know how to communicate with people except through music...
They're different from the ocean and the mountains...==W== They cheer, they call out to me. But I...
What should I say in response...?
If today's performance didn't quite click with the crowd... Do I need to explain myself somehow?
I don't know... It's so hard to think about all this.
All I know is music... Everything outside of that just feels so complicated!
Only a very very small number of people are like you—==W==someone who gets the bass, my music, and what I'm trying to express.
I used to feel really lost... Unsure of everything. But with you as my producer...==W== I feel like I finally have the courage to face it all.
Yeah! Actually, Producer, what you said really makes a lot of sense.
She clenches her fists like she's made up her mind about something. Her long ears perk up as well.
I... I can give it a try. What should I do? Set up a performance right away?
Once she's made up her mind, she starts acting fast. Classic Caramel.
A producer's job is to help the musician find their spark, right?
Then... My theme this time will be "healing mental scars."
Yeah, the reason I've been visiting Flavio is that I need to complete a really important commission.
There's a group of Trekkers who had an accident during a Monolith expedition...==W== As a result, a lot of them are on the verge of mental breakdown.
And this might be your chance to understand their wishes and hear their true feelings.==W== I can’t promise anything, but maybe… it’ll spark something new.
Even as the Boss, I can't possibly grasp what so many people are feeling...==W== But Caramel, you're different.
Me...? I'm just a bass player...
Your music reaches the mountains, the ocean, even the Monoliths.==W== So I believe those who are hurting will hear you, too.
I see... Let me think about this... Really think about this...
Since we're aiming for the same goal, let's start the preparation.
Leave the rest of the details to me, your producer. Caramel, all you need to focus on is the music.
… Thank you for the idea, Producer. I never thought this journey for inspiration would get started so smoothly.
So this is what it feels like … to write music for someone else...

strings.text: Echo of Hearts and Stars (Part III)
In the gentle night, Caramel plucks the strings of her bass and the hearts of the troubled Trekkers. The legend of Flavio is thus born.
Through the mist, the city's bright lights still shimmer in the distance.
But out here, there's no harsh smoke, only the soft scent of grass and wildflowers.
The Trekkers and Caramel's devoted fans sit together under the starry sky.
Right now, the earth itself is the stage.
And the Monolith's faint glow is the spotlight cheering on the performer.
Yeah. I figured you'd feel more at home in a place like this.
Miss Caramel, once the opening act wraps up,==W== it'll be your turn to take the stage.
Yes... I'll give it everything I've got!
So many people came today... Not to mention there's also the Monolith, the earth, the sky, the moon...==W== And you, Producer.
Yup. I'll listen with all my heart.
Using Caramel's music to heal the Trekkers' mental scars...
And using this experience to let Caramel better understand their inner worlds and feelings...
I guess I'm a cunning producer.
The mellow sound of the bass cuts through the night sky.
Time, once the cage that traps those Trekkers, begins to flow again.
Ugh... My body... Every time I see a Monolith, I just go limp... What's wrong with me?
… If a Stellaroid or some monster shows up... We wouldn't be able to fight back like this... Performing here is very dangerous, isn't it?
I lower my voice as much as I can, trying to ease the tension in those anxious whispers.
Close your eyes and focus! Miss Caramel is doing everything she can to help us...
I'm sorry, but... Does this really work? I mean, it's just music... Right?
It's as if it's beating in sync with my heartbeat.
… Now that you mention it, that low boomy sound...
It sounds just like the footsteps you hear when walking on the Monolith...
I don't really know that much about music.
But I do get the emotion contained in this melody.
There's a hint of sorrow in it—gentle, yet cathartic.==W== It feels like... Remembrance.
Just listening to it takes you back...
I see. So the theme Caramel came up with is "the past."
The past... The Flavio that used to be. Those early adventures.
Will the Trekkers remember why they set out on their journey in the first place?
At times like this, it's more about just feeling the music rather than trying to make sense of it.
With that in mind, I stop overanalyzing whether it's working. After all, feelings aren't something you can break down and dissect.
The night's only just begun, but the music's already filling the camp with a gentle warmth.
… How did I let fear get such a hold over me...
… I remember now... The reason I first wanted to become a Trekker—it was because...
Looks like they're starting to pull themselves together.
Time keeps ticking, but no one wants to leave the moment.
The show is an unprecedented success.
Without even inviting any Witch to report it, the show we pulled off together somehow made it into Flavio's newspapers and even turned into an urban legend.
Caramel's probably going to be even more famous after this... ==W==Not that she cares about that kind of thing.
Time flies.==W== A few days later, Caramel's dragging me off on another "inspiration journey."
Just thinking about that performance gets me all excited again!
It's been so long since I've had that much fun playing! The inspiration just keeps flowing!
I'm so relieved to hear that.
It's all thanks to you, Producer!
Every time Caramel praises me like that, I can't help but feel a little embarrassed...
Producer... Was it really just a coincidence that you picked me for this commission?
No way! It's because your music always draws me in, Caramel!
A little flustered, she punches me gently.==W== Ah, the strong fists of a true musician again.
You've always said that music is meant to express things, right?
Yes... With music, I can express my inner landscape...
And then... I can talk...with the Monoliths.
Actually, the inner landscapes of different people can also be shared, exchanged, and even blended. That's how it's supposed to be.
Yeah... I understand that now. It's been a truly rare and valuable lesson.
Haha, if anything, it's people like you—who can express themselves to the earth, the ocean, the Monoliths, the sky... You're the rare kind.
You're making it sound like I'm amazing or something.
That's because you are amazing... And not just that, either. You understood their pain so quickly.
With just your music, you got them to let their guard down, to face their fears and reconnect with the dreams they started out with.
I heard... No, I saw those landscapes.
Even though they didn't say a word, I could still feel their sadness. It's like they left something behind in the Monolith.
That part of them they left behind in the Monolith... I heard it, saw it. I tried to listen to it.==W== And that was the song that came to me.
Your music has the power to echo deep in people's hearts. It's strong enough to move the soul.
She lets go and spins around, hugging her bass close.
Say... I haven't thank you properly yet, Producer!
Don't say that. You played a huge part in this inspiration journey!
Thanks for also spending all this time with me today! I've got so much inspiration flowing right now!
Producer, can I play something just for you?==W== Think of it as … a little summary of all the inspiration I've gathered lately.
The moment she starts talking about performing, she sounds excited again.
Looks like today's inspiration journey isn't over yet...==W== As the producer, I've got to see it through.
Not far from here is the "music space" she often goes to.
Her strong hand takes mine as she leads me up the steps by the back door...
Upstairs is Caramel's own space. Her little corner of freedom.
It's incredibly strange, but... ==W==You know how you're always there for me at EXACTLY the right time?
It's incredibly strange, but... ==W==You know how you're always there for me at EXACTLY the right time?==W==
I was wondering... ==W==Could it be that you've heard the Monolith Notes, too?
I was wondering... ==W==Could it be that you've heard the Monolith Notes, too?==W==
Yeah! ==W==You've been through the Monolith lots of times. ==W==You must have heard them, right?
Those strange sounds ==W==that seem to echo endlessly...
Now that you mention it, I do remember a kind of music...
They say the Monolith is where dreams come true and wishes are granted! ==W====W==So I started wondering if the Monolith Notes were made of people's wishes!==W==
And I've been chasing them ever ==W==since that idea came into my head!==W==
I hope one day to join the Monolith ==W==and make beautiful music with it!==W====W==
I hope one day to join the Monolith ==W==and make beautiful music with it!==W==
Dream big or go home, right! ♪
Um, so, as I was saying... ==W==You know everything about the Monolith, ==W==you're super positive, ==W==and you always understand me...==W==
And that's exactly why you're the only one who can be my producer!
And that's exactly why you're the only one who can be my producer!==W====W==
Well, since you put it that way...
Let's see what we can do together
Wow... ♪ ==W==Thank you so much! ==W==You'll see! One day I'll solve the mystery of the Monolith Notes with you by my side!
Wow... ♪ ==W==Thank you so much! ==W==You'll see! ==W==One day I'll solve the mystery of the Monolith Notes with you by my side!==W==
The fragrant scent still lingers in the air, and the neon lights still shimmer brightly.
Above this swaying city, her bass rings out bright and clear, cutting through the night.

strings.text: What hidden secrets lie behind those wild, defiant eyes?
Is that...==B== the one who teamed up with ... the one from the Dusk Arbiter?
To take a job with that Gerie and be able come back in one piece... Seriously something else.
Keep it down! That's the "Boss" who runs her own company. I heard ==SEX1== and Gerie got ...==W== real close in the Monolith.
Keep it down! That's the "Boss" who runs his own company. I heard ==SEX1== and Gerie got ...==W== real close in the Monolith.
I've got a bad feeling some nasty rumors are spreading like wildfire...
I can handle it, but Gerie's with the Dusk Arbiter. This could cause problems for her. I should give her a heads-up.
Gerie, hey! Why'd you just take off like that?
Nngh...==W== Oh. Did you need something?
Whoa, you're burning up! What's with this fever...==B== Are you sick?
No ... even a bad fever shouldn't feel this hot...
Heh... Don't tell me ... you're actually worried about me?
Of course, how could I not be? Your fever is really serious. C'mon, I'm taking you to a doctor.
Inhibitor? This thing? You're hot as lava right now ...==W== just try to hold still.
After taking the inhibitor, Gerie's temperature drops, and the tension in her brow finally eases. But she has no intention of resting. She just grabs her weapon and heads back toward the Monolith.
Hey, don't push yourself. Where are you going?
Gotta ... get to the Monolith...==B== This inhibitor won't hold for long...
The Monolith? You're in no shape to go anywhere!
It's nothing. I just need to go and unleash my magic.
Just like this? Aren't you afraid you'll just collapse?
Hehe... Quite the opposite, actually. Like you, I have a special constitution with magic. My body generates it a hundred ... no, maybe thousand times faster than a normal person's.
A thousand times faster? So you don't even need the magic in Soul Stone?
Sounds convenient, doesn't it? The problem is, if I don't use it, the magic just builds up inside me ... and my body starts acting up.
That's just one symptom. My senses are already numb from the constant overflow. If I just let it be, the magic will clog them until I can't see or hear ...==W== and I'll go mad.
And if I don't release it soon, I'll just—==W==BOOM—be blown apart by it. Taking everything around me with me.
So, the only cure is a total release. Letting all the excess magic out.
I see, that's why you have to go to the Monolith...==W== But is there really no way to cure it?
In a way, it isn't a disease, it's my gift. So there's no "cure." All I can do is release my magic regularly and use inhibitors to manage it.
I get the situation, but even so ...==W== you're an easy target in this state. It's dangerous.
Hehe, you're worried about me. That makes me kinda happy... But for me, danger is a good thing. Getting hurt would be even better...
Better? What's so good about getting hurt?
Fighting while injured burns through more magic. The blood and bruises just sharpen my senses. It makes me feel more alive.
When you think of it that way, even pain becomes ...==B== endearing. It turns into this sweet sensation that builds to ... absolute ecstasy==W==!
The more wounded I am, the more it hurts, the stronger the pleasure gets! That's why I crave injury! It's my purpose! I crave pain! Pain is sweet, pain is bliss, pain is—
Err ...==W== she's getting worked up. I really shouldn't have brought this up.
Hah ... hah... Nngh... I'm burning up again ... so hot... But==W== this scalding agony ... it's just as sweet... <size=60>♪
We're still a ways from the Monolith. I don't know if Gerie can hold out...
Heh heh... I really let loose back there ... but I've still got plenty of magic to burn... I should've used that magic more.
So ... was she holding back==W== 'cause I was there? If so, I feel kinda bad.
Gerie, just hang on a little longer. Once we reach the Monolith, you can cut loose all you want.
Heh ... that's a tempting offer ...==W====RT== but I'm afraid I'm at my limit...
Gerie's hand trembles, reaching for the cord on her choker. She's about to unleash the spell that instantly vaporized the Stellaroids.
Hey! You can't use that here!
In the nick of time, I lunge forward and snatch the cord from her neck.
Ooh~ What ... is this feeling? <size=60>♪ <size=40>==W==My dear... Boss... What did ... you do to me...?
Was that a scream? Is somebody hurt?
Do you need help? I'll call for aid right—==W==huh?
Ahh ... it's incredible, Boss... I'm a servant of the God of Grace ... and yet... I can only think of you...
I feel so light... What is this? I've never felt anything like it!
GE—RIE—!! Stop it! Just stop! Don't you think this is weird?! I mean, you're always weird, but this is a whole new brand of weird!
Okay, this is bad. This is really bad.
What in the world?! I thought someone needed help! Doing ... that?! Have you no decency?! We're in a public street!
Whoa ... that's ... intense.==W== Hey, whatever you're into is your business, but maybe find someplace a little more private?
It's not what you think! This is a misunderstanding! Gerie, back me up here!
Hmm? I don't really get it ... but being held by you like this ...==W== it feels so wonderful. Keep this up ... and I might get hooked, my dear Boss... <size=60>♪
Nope! She's no help at all!
She's completely out of it. Is this from the magic overload? No, this feels different from what she said before.
Wait! Everyone, I know this looks strange, but we're just rehearsing! We're actors from Flavio!
Uh-huh. "Actors." Riiiight.==W== Just ... take it down a notch.
Dammit! You shameless freaks! To think I was actually worried!==W== Just get a room, you two! Or better yet, a jail cell!
Hah ... hah... The excess magic ... it's fading.==W== Huh? What just happened?
You! What did you do to me!?
So you're finally lucid. Congrats, but it's a little too late.
Tell me now...==B== What==W== did==W== you==W== do==W== to==W== me!?
I just grabbed the cord on your neck==W== before you could cast that magic I don't know the name of.
I told you when we took the commission:==W== if your methods went too far, I'd stop you.
The job's over, but I still can't let you go on a killing spree in the middle of the street.
You don't sound like you're lying.
This choker and cord are sacred relics that store the legendary spell "Soul Judgment." No one but me is ever allowed to touch them.
But that feeling I just had...==W== I have to confirm it wasn't a coincidence.
A "legendary spell," huh? Well, if it'll calm her down, I guess I should do it.
Take hold of the cord on Gerie's choker
Ahhh~ Boss... Yes, that's the feeling~
Mmm, I could just melt away~~~ <size=60>♪
There she goes again! It's less a cord, more an on-switch. If anyone sees her like this...
Whoa, no way...==B== Are those the two everyone's talkin' about?
That's the Boss from Boss Accord, right? Taming a Dusk Arbiter... Damn. What a legend.
Oh, Boss...==W== I feel so... whole. Are you truly a messenger, sent by the God of Grace to save me~~~ <size=60>♪
The God of Grace sends me as a messenger? Yeah, right. If there really is a God of Grace, this has to be my punishment.

strings.text: The reins of fate are now in your hands—you are destined to tame the ravenous girl before you.
Night has fallen. With her head clear, Gerie guides me into a small alley.
A narrow, dark stairway leads down to a rusted iron door.
It's an old secret prison of the Dusk Arbiter. Been abandoned for ages.
A prison? Oh no...==W== Did I touch something forbidden? You're not going to lock me up, are you?
Please, don't worry, Boss. When you held the cord—not just pulled it—==W==the numbness, the excess magic ... it all just vanished.
But I barely did anything ...==W== other than grabbing the cord.
I brought you here so we'd have some privacy. There are things we need to discuss, like the sacred relic around my neck.
Is this something I should be hearing?
You are. In fact, you have to know. Because you're special.
Both relics and artifacts are treasures gifted to us by the God of Grace through the Monoliths.
But unlike artifacts, which anyone can use, if an unworthy person touches a relic, it's considered blasphemy.
The relic will consume their soul, turning them into a walking corpse.
Only those chosen by the God of Grace can touch a relic and command the "legendary spell" sealed within.
And every single one of them gets just two choices:==W== join the Dusk Arbiter, or be imprisoned by them forever.
Wait, so does that mean I'll have to...==W== No, hold on. You didn't pick either of those.
Do you recall what happened the first time you touched this cord?
I think I saw ... someone else's memories...
I knew it. You've seen right through me.
My relic holds a legendary spell, "Soul Judgment." When cast, it pits my soul against a target's. The weaker of the two is beheaded.
The day I used it on you, your soul wouldn't budge. Instead, mine was the one laid completely bare before you.
So what I saw ... that was Gerie's soul. Her memories.
That's why I hid your existence from the Dusk Arbiter.
After today, it's finally clear. You weren't just chosen by the God of Grace—you're a messenger, sent here to save me.
I have no idea what you're talking about.
It's not just that "Soul Judgment" failed to work on you. When you hold my relic, all my excess magic just drains away—no, it's more like it's being drawn right out of me.
The sensation is just ... marvelous. My vision's never been clearer, my hearing never sharper. I can even feel a warmth from you, reaching me from across the distance.
There's no pain, yet I feel more alive than ever. It's a joy beyond compare.
A miracle like this can only be the work of the God of Grace.
You are so special. To hide anything from you now would be an act of blasphemy.
I'm Boss, a Trekker, a CEO ... and now I can add "Messenger for the God of Grace" to the pile.
I'm racking up titles like they're going out of style.
Ohohoho... It's quite extraordinary, isn't it? A Dusk Arbiter, sworn to the god, now completely at your command... The very thought...
<size=37>Ahhh~ <size=60>♪<size=37> Just imagining it sends a thrill right through me~~!!
And there she goes again, into that mode...
Please, I'm begging you... Let me feel it again. That sweet sensation you taught me, the one without any pain—==B==That ultimate bliss only you can give me—
Whoa, hang on, are we sure this is a good idea? If we keep this up, isn't this ... y'know, also blasphemy?
Ohohoho... A sin? Oh no, my dear Boss. This is just to deepen our bond—==W==our bond with the God's divine messenger. Yes, think of it as a sacred ritual~ <size=60>♪
Gerie reverently offers me the cord from her choker, her expression one of complete surrender.
Now that I think about it, it was the same back then too…
That's just one symptom. My senses are already numb from the constant overflow. If I just let it be, the magic will clog them until I can't see or hear ...==W== and I'll go mad.

strings.text: Laru has a rule: no work talk while fishing. But if you catch a fish, she's all ears.
The Soul Stone Shop? Must have wandered here while zoning out.
With weather this nice, Laru's probably skipped work to go fishing...
I don't know who put together this month's afternoon tea order, but it's been nothing but different flavors of fries all month long.
Our afternoon tea? Come on, fries every day for a whole month? That's just too much.
You wish. Like we'd get that kind of treatment. I mean the Senate's afternoon tea.
I was over at headquarters for something and just happened to see Lady Albedo  going off about it.
Whoever made the order's gonna be in deep trouble.
Maybe I should warn her about it?
That's odd. She should be fishing somewhere around here.
Hmm … that spear the statue's holding... It looks kind of familiar...
Damn it, it got away! My fish...!
Who the heck just walks over and scares my fish off like that?
Don't tell me Willow paid you to stop me from fishing?
I have something important to tell you.
Something important? Don't tell me it's work-related.
Nope, not listening! This is my fishing time!
You didn't mess anything up at work, did you?
You know me. I never slip up when it comes to work.
That's true... Maybe I'm just overthinking it.
Still, in the whole Grace Imperium, she's probably the only one who actually likes fries. Better double-check just to be sure.
Alright, enough work talk. Since you're here already, how about joining me?
I tossed about three pounds of ground bait here today. So even a newbie would be able to catch something.
Are you really fishing or just feeding the fish?
It's a big one! Gotta be huge!
Dammit, it's not tiring out at all! If this keeps up, it's gonna get away!
Hah—??? What am I supposed to do with it????
Just hang on tight, don't let it slip away!
Laru jumps into the water without hesitation.
Seriously? You'd do that to get a fish?
Yah-hoo—==W==this is awesome! An absolute whopper! Gotta be over seven pounds... No, ten!
Now that's what I call fishing! Heh, my quick strike sealed its fate!
Do normal people actually jump in to catch the fish themselves?
Hurry, hurry—take a picture! And make sure the fish looks big!
Tomorrow, I'm putting this photo right where everyone can see it in the office.
Hey, you over there! How'd you know I just reeled in such a huge fish?!
Don't get all jealous now. This one...==W== Heh, it's not even my biggest catch.
Ah, yeah, it is pretty big.
Now please excuse me. Have a good one.
This fish is a sign my luck's turning. I'm gonna make out like bandits today, heh!
What are you standing around for? Sit down and fish with me!
Alright then. Let's fish and chat. There's something that I heard...
Still thinking about work? Come on, now's the time to ride the momentum. Fish now, work later!
Will you just let me finish?
Pfft, it's just work. No need to stress out about it till the deadline day.
Alright, fine. Enough with the long face.
I'm in a good mood today, so I'll make an exception and listen to work stuff while I'm slacking off.
On one condition...==W== You've gotta catch something too.
Alright, here. I'll lend you my spare rod.

strings.text: A catch is a catch, even if it is just water weed. As for fries … wait, what fries?!
Haah—haven't had a catch this good in ages!==W== This must be what they call a lucky break. Totally worth slipping out today!
Hang on a sec. Where's your fish?
Wait. Your fish is a plant?
You spent all that time and only caught a piece of water weed?==W== Hahaha... I can't—this is too funny!
Water weed is food too. I've decided to go vegetarian for a while.
Well said. That's the spirit of a true angler! At least you got some plant. That's better than nothing...
Pfft— Sorry, just let me laugh a little longer, hahaha...
Okay, enough teasing. What did you want to tell me?
As long as it's work-related, there's nothing I can't handle.
How should I put this to her? After all, I'm not sure if she's actually the one in trouble...
It's like this. I've got this friend who...
Are you going to let me finish or not?
My friend is in charge of ordering afternoon tea, and she ordered some snacks that she liked most.
Only later did she realize that the order was for her higher-ups, and her tastes were very different from theirs.
Wow. Sounds like a big problem.
If nobody finds out, it's not really a mistake.
People already know, and her coworkers have started talking about it.
That makes things difficult. Maybe she can hire a team of Trekkers to hijack the order.
Then she'll have a reason to redo the order.
Robbery is an even more serious problem, isn't it?
True...==W== Then there's only one way!
The "Guaranteed-to-Succeed Apology Method" that's basically the unofficial office legend at Grace Imperium.
"As long as you're honest and come clean, you'll be forgiven— even if it's as severe as blowing up Grace Imperium's HQ, you won't get punished or lose your job."
Hah! Another one! I gotta concentrate for now!
Ahhh! Boss! Help me with the pull!
Ugh... How can it be so heavy...
Damn,==W== the fishing line snapped. Definitely not a good sign.
Okay, keep going. What snacks did your friend order?
I think she ordered fries for afternoon tea … for a whole month.
She's got good taste. Fries are basically the greatest food ever. You could eat them every day and never get sick of them.
Come to think of it, when I was bored last week, I put together a month-long "different fries flavors" tasting plan.
Unfortunately, I don't know where that list went.
Boss, where does this friend of yours work?
Grace Imperium, probably. I heard the news while passing by the Soul Stone Shop.
I also heard Lady Albedo's absolutely furious.
I thought maybe it was you at first, but seeing how confident you are, it must've been some other poor soul.
I wonder if she's heard of the "Guaranteed-to-Succeed Apology Method" that you mentioned.
This friend of yours,==W== it's me...

Oh no, oh no, oh no.
The buyer told me she'd taken the order sheet, but it's still sitting here...
How could she mistake the random stuff you scribbled for an official work document?
Because I scribbled it on a blank purchase-order form...

Too perfect though.==W== Even the buyer is fooled.
What should I do now?==W== The purchase is probably already made at this point.
I got, it, Boss!==W== You can go rob all of them for me!
Even if it means committing robbery, we can't let this batch of fries be delivered.
Calm down. You just ordered the wrong stuff for the afternoon tea. Maybe it's no big deal.

But it's for the Senate! They'll definitely come after me for this.
In a place like the Grace Imperium...==W== The moment you show any weakness, people will pounce on you and tear you apart.

That jittery thrill of almost getting caught, the pride of secretly rebelling, and the guilty pleasure of getting paid to do nothing—==W==that's the true art of slacking off!
If you don't even have a job, it's not called slacking off, just … being a jobless bum! You get it?
Sure sure, I absolutely get it.
Sob... This is horrible!==W== How could you carefree Trekkers possibly understand how we office people feel!
Don't people say "working is for suckers" these days?
But if I manage to slack off during work, then I'm not a sucker, but a winner!
And if I can eat fries while fishing during work, that makes me a winner twice over!
You should just get yourself fired. I'm starting to pity Grace Imperium for hiring someone like you.
Do you think it's possible that...
By this time tomorrow, the Goddess of Fries will make the Senate all fall in love with fries?
No matter how much you love fries, there's no way you can eat it every day for a month straight.
Darn it... How did it come to this...
That's just an office legend. I don't wanna be the first one to try it.
If that fails, I won't be able to get hired anywhere in Emor, then I'll have to head out into the wilds and become a Trekker.
What are you looking at me like that for? New Star Guild doesn't take on new members.
No, no, Boss. I don't mean New Star Guild. Don't you have your own company?
If I get fired, you can just hire me! Problem solved!

Oh, money-schmoney! ==W==I'll give you the Friends and Family discount!==W== And I KNOW ==W==you won't let a helpless young lady like me get laid off with nowhere to go, would you?==W==

With an elderly cat ==W==and a two-year old puppy at home ... ==W==and 30 years left on her mortgage ... ==W==(sniff)==W==
I seem to recall once you telling me how good you are at pulling heartstrings...
Oh... ==W==THAT silly old talk! ==W==Never mind that—==W==I've seriously never been in a bind like this before.==W==You're the only hope I have in the whole wide world!
Why didn't you just ask for help up front?
You think ==W==I can come right out and beg?==W==
I mean, like... ==W==You're the only person I've ever ... ==W==spoken to so honestly, ==W==you know?
Oh yeah? The only one, huh?
Why are you laughing!? ==W====W==I'm seriously in trouble here! Grr!
Think about it, Boss! ==W==What if you couldn't see me whenever you wanted anymore! ==W==I know ==W==you'd be sad! ==W==Please, Boss! ==W==I really need you right now! Hire me!
If I happen to get fired, you'll definitely get me a new job!
You'll let me join your company so I can slack off—==W==uh, no, I mean, work hard there.
If it comes to that, let me know.
I'll find a way to give you an impossible workload so you won't have any time to slack off.
Judging by the look on your face, I take it you didn't get into trouble for the afternoon tea fiasco?
I was just about to talk to you about this. Come here, I'll whisper.
I think the Goddess of Fries really was at work.
After you left yesterday, I packed up my things and was just waiting for Angel to fire me.
And guess what? The Senate, for some reason, wants to study a fast-food industry that mimics Monolith food.
My fries were a great hit! They even asked me to get more Monolith food.
Even Angel was surprised and asked me how did I figure it out in advance.

strings.text: A nostalgia scent, drifting on the sea breeze.
As promised to Shia, I arrived in Carlo Town early in the morning. The air here carries the scent of the sea breeze.
Shia said she's taking me on a one-day "seaside adventure" today...
I wonder where we would go... Can't wait!
Wrong answer. My name is not "What's happening."
This soft, warm sensation... Someone's covering my eyes with their hands...?
Only Shia==W== would do something like this to me...
Good morning, Shia. You really startled me just now.
Next time, could you maybe—==W====RT==Hey, what are you up to now?!... Do I smell weird or something?
Just like always...==W== Yep. The one, the only, the Boss<size=60>♪</size>
You do this right off the bat? My poor heart can't take it...
But ... today there's something different, a scent like ripe fruit.==RT====W==Boss, are you nervous or something?
Anyone would be nervous if their eyes were suddenly covered and someone started sniffing them, right?
Really? Then...==W== Boss, why don't you try smelling me too<size=60>♪</size>
… ==W==<size=50>Huh? You want me to smell you right here, on this busy street?
Yeah~ How do you think I would smell, Boss?
Oh wow...?! I thought she would smell like the ocean, but I never expected...
Flora? Hehe, that's just my shampoo.==W== I went swimming at the beach early this morning and came to see you right after my shower.
Forget it. I'm not like you; I can't read people just by their scent.
Besides, if two people go around smelling each other in public like this… everyone else's gonna think it's super weird...
Boss, you're getting shy... How cute. You know, scent really can help you understand someone<size=60>♪</size>
Hmm. Looks like Shia's in an especially good mood today.
Okay, here is our first stop.
Yup. Cruising along the coastline in a sightseeing boat to take in the scenery is the number one attraction for visitors here in Carlo Town.
We arrive at the bustling pier—our "seaside adventure" had officially begun.
Attention, all passengers waiting for the sightseeing boat: We're very sorry, but our helmsman is currently receiving treatment for an injury...
We appreciate your patience while we...
The helmsman slipped while docking and got a wrist injury. It looks like we might not be able to set out today...
How could this happen...? We came all the way from out of town for this...
Well, that's that, then. Let's go check out somewhere else.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. We will issue a full refund, and we would also like to offer you a voucher for the seaside restaurant...
I can pilot the boat if that works for you guys.
We appreciate the thought, but this is a professional job, not for the tourists...
Wait. You look familiar. Are you ... Shia?!
Sorry, I haven't been back in a while and my memory's a bit hazy. May I ask who you are...?
Oh, I should be the one apologizing. We haven't met before, but your grandmother—Mrs. Marlene—used to look after me when I was young.
When Mrs. Marlene was around, she'd always step in to help us pilot the boat on days like this. She'd even help with repairs... Once in a while, she'd leave some of her catch at my doorstep.
...Yeah, that definitely sounds like something granny would do.
Since you're Mrs. Marlene's granddaughter, that's a different story. If you can help us with piloting the boat, we won't let you go back empty-handed.
As you can see, right in front of us is our town's most famous bay. Surrounded on three sides by rocky reefs, it's like a private beach...
The water's so clear...==W== Wow! You can see fish over here!
It's peak season for sea bass right now. They usually dwell in brackish waters, but during this time of year you can often spot them in the shallows.
Fresh sea bass is delicious whether steamed or braised. Perhaps you can give it a try after the tour.
Ah, the lady over there with the hat—if you're holding snacks, the seagulls might target you. Dangerous, you know!
Aside from steering the boat, Shia's basically doing the tour guide's job too.
Everyone, watch out! Boss, are you okay?
I'm fine. Just got splashed on.
Oh good. Dear passengers, just now we passed a wave crest. The boat has now stabilized.
Alright, that's enough. If you keep clinging to me, it's gonna get even hotter.
Just a few more minutes ... please.
This is really nice... It brings back memories of the old days...
As the boat pulls into the dock and the tour is wrapped up, Shia and I wave goodbye to the other passengers.
I wanted to say this back on our last trip—you're incredible at steering.==RT==You make that big boat move like a nimble fish.
I learned it from my granny. When I was little, she used to take me out fishing with her. I've been around the helm since I was a kid.
Every night, while granny sat at the bow fishing, I'd lie behind her, just watching her without saying a word.
Maybe it's because I was remembering all that, but even though that wasn't granny's boat just now, I could've sworn I caught the scent of something nostalgic<size=60>♪</size>
Shia and everyone in town really admired her grandma...
Can you tell me a bit more about your grandma?
Sure! I want you to know more about her, too.
To be honest... She was pretty eccentric. All she ever taught me were things about the sea. Sometimes she'd go a whole day without saying a single word.
But there's one thing that really stuck with me.
The sailors in Carlo Town have a tradition—they always hug their families before setting out to sea. One time, I tried copying them and gave Granny a hug...
I didn't see it coming, but she suddenly started crying... She almost never showed her emotions.
It really startled me... But then she hugged me back, tight. That made me so happy<size=60>♪</size>
No wonder... When she saw those two passengers hugging on the boat just now, she looks...
A hug really is a great way to share how you feel.
Alright. To the next stop, Boss.

strings.text: The scent, once lingering in the streets, has now vanished.
Around noon, Shia brings me to a small snack shop, saying it serves the most authentic flavors in town.
Huh? Why did they change the sign out front?
Wait, the scent is totally different, too...
Maybe we're in the wrong place? Or they moved?
The owner lives right next door. She's been running this place for decades. I don't think she'd just up and move.
Let's just go inside and take a look.
Welcome to "Sunset Coral: Secret Island Café"~ Will it be a table for two?
Excuse me, is this a new place? I don't think I've seen it here before.
Yes, we had our grand opening last month.
Do you know where did the owner of the previous shop go?
She came by a little while ago to say goodbye to our owner...==RT====W==Oh right, I think she and her family moved to Sailstead.
Must be nice... I'd love to work in Sailstead, too. Big cities' hourly wage is way better than here.
I see. Thank you for telling us.
Alright, let's order. I'll have a strawberry milk. What about you, Boss?
Let me think... ==W==I'll have the same.
We find a spot by the window and sit down. Shia glances around, taking in the surroundings.
Upon a closer look, the pillars are in the same spots, and the windows haven't changed shape either.==W== Somehow, this makes me feel a bit more at ease...
This is where the snack place used to be?
Yeah. An energetic auntie used to run this place all on her own.
It wasn't nearly this fancy. Just plain wooden tables and chairs, and her little girl doodled on the walls... Definitely not what you'd call tidy.
But everybody liked this place. We would always come here to eat and chat.
By the way, their signature dish was "fresh-fried sardines."
Every morning, auntie would fry up freshly caught sardine right in front. The smell was irresistible. There'd be a long line forming outside first thing in the morning.
It was so crispy and light... Such a shame that you can't try it now.
If it was that popular... Now I really want to know what it tasted like.
Right? Just thinking about that smell is making me crave those fried small fish all over again.
They said she'd moved to Sailstead. Maybe now she's selling those there?
Hmm, hard to say. Since her family asked her to move over... Maybe she's retired?
Still, even if she's really retired, it doesn't mean we'll never see her again. It's fine.
Shia looks a little down somehow... I need to find a way to cheer her up.
Don't worry! Even though we can't have those fried small fish today—
Someday, I'll recreate that flavor. And when I do, Boss, you've gotta try it too<size=60>♪</size>
I'll look forward to your version of it.
I was worried she'd feel down for a while, but it looks like she's bounced back for now.
After a short break at the café, we pick up where we left off with Shia's "seaside adventure" plan.
This shop's been around forever. They specialize in custom swimsuits. I've been getting mine here since I was a kid!
Since it's not every day you come to visit, I wanted to bring you here to get a swimsuit that fits you perfectly.
Well, actually, I don't get to swim that often...
Really? But even just floating on the water is super relaxing. You won't regret getting one!
When I'm feeling down, I often go surfing.
Ah, I knew it! I recognized that voice right away. Shia! Long time no see~!
Hehe, just kidding. Today I want to ask you to help my friend get a custom swimsuit.
How fast can we get it?
Oh, we don't do custom orders anymore. Now we just sell ready-made swimsuits, like all the other shops.
Custom orders were too much hassle, and they took too long. Tourists didn't want to wait.
Besides, we carry a wide range of sizes. There's always something that fits.
No wonder that scent of sun-dried thread is gone...
The scent of thread? What does she mean?
It's fine. I'll pick something ready-made.
Shia, can you help me pick one? To be honest, I have no idea which to choose.
Really?! You want me to pick one for you?
Hehe, then I'll pick something I like~
After we picked out the swimsuit, Shia took me to a few of her old haunts.
But each of those places has changed, though some more than others. None of them have stayed exactly the way she remembered.
There used to be a little ice cream stand right here...
That sweet, gentle scent of ice cream... And the scent of happy, smiling customers.
You haven't been back for a long time, Shia?
If I count it up, it’s not really that long.
Carlo Town's a small place, after all. Karin and I live nearby in Sailstead for work, but every now and then, I come back to the old house here to clean it up.
But I always just focused on cleaning the house, it didn't occur to me to visit those places...
And got really surprised today... Heh.
So it wasn't just my imagination. Shia really does seem a little down.
I said I'd be your guide, and yet we haven't made it to a single place I wanted to show you...
To make it up to you, let me treat you to a seafood feast tonight, okay?
It's alright, Shia. No need to feel bad. I've been having a great time.
I need to think of a way to cheer her up...
