strings.text: Always there, just behind me—the same scent, unchanged.
As Shia promised, the seafood dinner is a feast.
I'm so full ... I can barely walk...
As long as you enjoyed it, that's the important thing. Next time, I'll take you to another place<size=60>♪</size>
We step out of the restaurant to find the sky completely dark.
That wraps up today's "seaside adventure." I hope you had a good time, Boss.
Yeah! Definitely! We bought swimsuits today and didn't even get to use them.
If our seaside adventure ends here... I'll be regretting it for the rest of my life!
Ah—sorry, sorry...! My mind's been all over the place—I completely forgot...!

strings.text: Even with their eyes blinded by desire and their soul tormented by time, that person never ceased their journey.
This round little guy is called Count Chompchomp the Shark.
Count Chompchomp the Shark loves to roll around, so he needs to stay on a soft sofa.
Nazuna slowly tidies up the room==W== while introducing her stuffed dolls to me.
Why is he called Chompchomp? Is it because he has sharp teeth?
Because he chomps on everyone he meets!
Is that really the way to greet people...?
And this one with wings is King High Flyer. He loves high places.
Nazuna stands on a chair, stretching up on tiptoe,==W== trying her best to place the doll on the high shelf.
Nazuna misses her step and falls off the chair, landing headfirst in the pile of stuffed dolls nearby.
Hang on a sec. I'm coming.
Nazuna is light==W== and it doesn't take much to pull her out of the pile.
Thank you, ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W== Whew, for a second there I thought I was a goner.
Well, maybe that would be for the best. That way, I won't have to keep on fighting.
What fighting? You're just cleaning up your room.
If I could just lie quietly beside my frie<r=dolls></r>nds like that, and wait for my last breath...
You're just spewing nonsense... So basically, you just don't want to bother with cleaning up, do you?
Don't you have something more important to do than waiting to draw your last breath?
Some new frie<r=dolls></r>nds are calling me.
They're asking for my help.==W== I must save these frie<r=dolls></r>nds from their pri<r=claw machine></r>son!
As Nazuna talks,==W== she shuffles step by step toward the door.==W== No doubt about it, she's about to run away.
Are you sure it's okay==W== to leave your friends==W== like this?
If you keep up like this, I'm gonna go home.
What? W-wait!==W== There's no way I'll finish cleaning today without your help, ==PLAYER_NAME==!
I don't want to get Kaede mad. Kaede is super scary when she's mad.
==PLAYER_NAME==, you can't just leave me to her wrath! Please...
Weren't you waiting to draw your last breath?
What about saving new friends from their prison?
I'm sorry. I know that was wrong of me. Please forgive me~
Honestly, you really are a handful.
Let's keep cleaning up together, then. But you'd better take it seriously this time.
You're welcome==W==...==W== What's with this all of a sudden?
I never knew cleaning a room could actually be this much fun.
Once the place is tidied up, it's like all the tangled-up feelings inside me get sorted out too.==W== I feel really really great right now.
There's no way I could have done it alone...==W== It's so nice having you here, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
I don't want to burst your bubble,==W== but...
The thing is,==W== we've only just finished tidying up the area==W== by the door.
Wha—no way!==W== I'm already this tired and we've only done that much!?
Sorry, but you need to face the truth,==W== which is that there are still three whole mountains of dolls left inside.
But with this many... There's no way they'll all fit in the room.==W== We'll have to put some of them in storage.
What, you're going to lock ever<r=the dolls></r>yone up in storage!?==W== Even coming from you, ==PLAYER_NAME==, that's just too cold!
Besides, wouldn't that just mean I'll have to let ever<r=the dolls></r>yone go?==W== I don't want to be separated from ever<r=the dolls></r>yone—no way!
But if you keep piling them up here, the room will never get clean.
Even if that's true, why does it have to be the storage room!?==W== Are you really that cruel, ==PLAYER_NAME==!?
How about looking at it another way?==W== We're preparing a new home for your friends.
Exactly.==W== The friends who can't fit in this room can move into a new home.==W== If we pick somewhere close by, it'll be easy for you to visit them, Nazuna.
True friends stay connected,==W== no matter how far apart they are.
Or are you saying your bond with your friends is so fragile==W== that it'll break==W== just because you don't see each other every day?
Of course not! Our hearts will always be together!
Then it's all settled.==W== Let's get their new home ready,==W== so your friends won't get hurt anymore.
You're right.==W== The most important thing is keeping everybody healthy.
And just like that, the great doll migration began.

strings.text: Come on, Karin, let's give Shia a surprise! Wait, no—not that way!
Let me see... Shall I go take a commission from the Trekkers' House, or go to the Monolith entrance...==W== Hmm?
It's not here, either...==W== Sob... I'm not gonna make it...
Karin? What are you doing here?
Eh, it's you, Boss...==W== You scared me...
You're the one who scared me...
How could you not see me? I'm right next to you. That's not like you.
I was just ... too focused on my search.
Oh, Boss! Did you happen to see any Monolith entrance nearby?!
Mmm... No...==W== Are you looking for it?
Alright... I've been searching for two weeks in vain...
There are just way too many seafaring Trekkers nowadays!!!
Makes sense... Everyone's competing for the entrance now.
Alas... What else can I do...==W== Oh, Boss! You free now?! If you are, can you help me look for it?!
Karin asking for my help? This is unusual.
Urgh, I'm at my wits' end! Can't waste any more time, or I won't make it to Shia's birthday...
Are you gonna wish for a birthday present for Shia?
H-How do you know my secret plan?!
If it's a secret, don't say it so loud...
Since you already know, I won't beat around the bush.==W== Are you going to help or not?
Well...==W== I'm a CEO after all, and I'm incredibly busy every day...
Ahaha, I'm just kidding! I'll help you!
Karin has put a lot of effort into doing this, and time is against her. I really should help her as much as I can!
Aren't we supposed to look for the Monolith entrance? Why are we here at the Trekkers' House?
You just said you couldn't find it on your own, right?
That's why we're here to collect some info from other fellow Trekkers.
Excuse me, may I ask when was the last time you found a Monolith entrance, and where was it?
I didn't find one myself, but I hear someone did a couple of days ago.
About a week ago, here. But it's certainly gone by now.
We haven't found anything lately...==W== Our last climb was a month ago, around this area, probably?
We didn't get anywhere by asking around. Are we really going to find a lead on the entrance like this?
Trust me, this is usually when you dig up hidden info.==W== Oh, there's a Trekker we haven't asked yet!
Where on earth does that confidence come from...
Hey, you two...==W== If you're looking for the Monolith entrance, I suggest that you not ask around too much...
Because if you keep digging, you might just find out about "that entrance"...
Huh?! So there really is a hidden entrance!
There is one...==W== But no one's ever gonna use it...
Because...==W== It's said to be haunted.
I see. Ghosts at the entrance huh?==W== No wonder people stay away from it.
Now I remember. They say your equipment would vanish, sometimes even your companions...
Hmph! That's all it takes to scare them off? That's spineless!
I'm nothing like those cowards! If they don't want it, let's go for it!
If you're so brave, why are your legs shaking?
I-I'm just excited for our upcoming victory!==W== A stupid rumor like that wouldn't scare me—==W==
Here! Over here, Boss! Pull me out!
This trap is pretty deep.==W== Are you okay?
B-But! Mystery solved! Those missing Trekkers must have just fallen into a trap like I did!
That's right! It's just an ordinary cave...==W== Very ordinary...==W== Nothing weird about it...
Are you trying to persuade yourself...?
Hmm? What did you say, Boss?
No, I did hear right! There is a strange sound...==W== Ah!
Boss! Look! Isn't that the Monolith entrance?
Wait, Karin! You just got out of a trap. We must be more careful.
Don't worry. We'll be fine! Now we just need to enter the—
Don't panic! It's probably just a bird.
A bird?==W== What's with the loud squeak?!
Your hands are cold, Boss. Are you scared? You're literally petrified... Hah...
Umm...==W== Karin? Why are you talking to a rock?
You're not wearing your contact lenses? But you could see well earlier...
I... Umm...==W== I thought I would be less afraid if I couldn't, so I took them off...
And when I tried to put them back on...
The bird's cry scared you and you dropped them?!
Yeah... So, I'm basically blind right now... If...==W== Ah!
My contact lenses... I just stepped on them...
Ugh... Should have asked you to stay still...==W== Did you bring an extra pair? Or maybe glasses?
No... That was my last pair, and I left my glasses on the boat...
It-It's alright! It's just a Monolith. I can climb it without my eyesight...
I'll show you, Boss! You just stay here and I promise it'll be fine! I'm feeling great right now!
Back off! You seriously can't see me if you're not this close huh?!
I think we should go back, Karin. It's too dangerous for you.
But we came all this way to find the entrance! It may not be here anymore the next time!
No time to waste...==W== I'm definitely doing this, even if I have to do it alone!
Okay... Fine...==W== Let me be your eyes then.
Oh, Boss...==W== Thank you so much!
Let's go get our Wishing Box then, chop-chop!

strings.text: Even if your signature skill is sealed, there's no need to worry. You're not alone, remember?
I offered to be Karin's eyes, but...
Phew...!==W== I think we've taken down all the Stellaroids on this floor!
That's awesome... You don't need my help here at all, Karin...
Well, I've got pretty sharp ears!
Like I said, everything in nature makes its unique sounds, and so do Stellaroids.
A peep from a Stellaroid, and I can locate it even without sight!
Hahaha... But my acute hearing is also the reason I got startled back in the cave.
You mean you got scared by the bird's cry? I see, it must have sounded so loud for you.
Just so you know, I was startled, but that doesn't make me a coward!
Eeeeeehhh?! What's that about?! You saw a ghost?!
Ah, no, it's just my hair getting into my ear. It tickled.
Ugh!==W== If you ever dare scare me again, I'm going to make fish food out of you! You hear me?!
Sorry, no more shouting, I promise.
Just curious, since you can operate fine without lenses or glasses, why do you wear them?
Contact lenses can only be found in Wishing Boxes, and as for glasses...==W== I don't think you love them, right?
You're right. I can certainly do without them if it's just for my daily errands.
But...==W== Since I'm a seafaring Trekker, it's essential to stay sharp-eyed.
Alright! Let me explain what it takes to be a seafaring Trekker then!
That was when I first started my seafaring Trekker training with Shia—
Good. You did great with the wheel and sails. I can tell you've got some talent here.
Really?! Hehe...==W== Guess I can soon become a real seafaring Trekker...!
Alright, why don't you try driving the boat on your own? Drive as far as you want.
You got it!==W== Alright, the wind is coming from this way, so I'll turn the wheel all the way right...
Watch out! Karin, steer left, NOW!
I spotted a huge shadow in the water, so I asked you to turn quickly. Might be a whale or some kind of monster. It was pretty close. Did you not see it?
Umm... I'm sorry... Actually, I can't see well...
Oh, I see. You forgot to bring your glasses today?
Well... I did, actually. It's just...
Hmm? So you don't want to wear them. May I ask why?
I'm actually quite blind, so my glasses are super thick. I even got bullied for wearing them...
I see... This is tricky then. If something similar happens again and you fail to notice it in time, you may get yourself killed.
So, better wear your glasses while sailing...
G-Got it! Won't let glasses stop me from becoming a seafaring Trekker...!==W== Fetching them now!
I see... A clear vision is indeed essential for safe sailing.
That's it. A simple and obvious logic...==W== Funny how ignorant I was just back then.
Since then you've always worn glasses?
Of course. Can't put Shia in danger just because I can't see clearly, right?==W== And then, one day—
Hey, Karin, why don't you make a wish to the Wishing Box and ask for something that allows you to sail without wearing glasses?
Eh?! But you found this box. Are you sure you want to give your wish to me?
Of course~<size=60>♪</size> Since you're determined to become a seafaring Trekker, you should be able to enjoy the fun of sailing wholeheartedly!
Oh, Shia...==W== Thank you!!==W== O mighty God of Grace, please hear our prayer—
Thanks to Shia, I no longer have to wear my thick glasses!
I certainly couldn't have enjoyed sailing so much if Shia hadn't given me that precious gift...
She must have noticed that Karin had been hiding her true self.
You are very lucky to have such a gentle mentor like Shia.
I am! Shia is the kindest soul in the world! Hey, so you are capable of saying nice things <size=60>♪</size>
Shia and I are not related, but she takes care of me like I'm her sister... And to me, she's always my dearest sister.
So, my gift to Shia has to be the most precious and most unique!==W== Enough said, let's move on to the next floor!
I understand Karin's feelings, but considering the future...
Boss, have you found the Wishing Box?
Watch out, Karin! It's from this Stellaroid!
Is the Stellaroid too loud for her to hear me?!
The sound comes from ...==W== its head?!
You can't hear me if I'm not close enough!
No time for talk now!==W== Karin, jump to the left!
Do as I say. We'll dial in the aim and take it down in one shot!
G-Got it! I'm relying on you on this one.
A little higher...==W== Stop. Hold it... Wait for it to come closer...
The sound's gone...==W== Did we get it?!
That was a really tough Stellaroid, so there must be a Wishing Box nearby...==W== Ahh!
Ouch... Something just tripped me...==W== Ah! What—is that—
Finally! Great! Now I can get Shia a gift!
But Karin...==W== How about wishing for a pair of contact lenses for yourself instead?
You know how important it is to see clearly for a seafaring Trekker. It also helps with Monolith climbing... Don't you agree?
Think about your future adventures with Shia. I suggest that you wish for a new pair of contact lenses as soon as possible...
No need to waste the Wishing Box on me, really. I can still do with my old glasses if it's necessary.
But you don't really want to wear them, do you?
That's true, but...==W== A gift for Shia is way more important.
I really want to see her smile!
Alright, I'm making my wish now!==W== O mighty God of Grace, please hear our prayer—
Wow! What a lovely compass! It matches Shia perfectly! She's gonna be so happy to receive it!
As long as you like it.==W== By the way... Could you do me a favor?
Another Wishing Box. That was quick! Thank you so much!
No big deal!==W== So, what did you wish for, Boss? I can't really see its content...
I'm really moved by what you've done for Shia, so I want to give you this gift.
... So you asked me to help you find another Wishing Box... For myself?!
I know you can make do with your glasses, but I also know that you'd prefer enjoying sailing without them. Am I right?
Choose the version of yourself that you prefer. That's what matters most.
Hmph, I didn't ask you to butt into my business, did I?==W== But, anyway...
I'll take them ... with gratitude...==W== I mean, thank you...

Why else? Because somebody decided to betray me!
Oh, that's terrible—who's the scoundrel? I'll avenge you—==W==oh wait, that's me! Sorry!
Ugh, even now you're being mean to me...
I... I just hate this kind of physical work.
That sleigh is the one used for delivering gifts during the Snowish Festival, right?==W== So your "physical work" is pulling that thing?
The idea you came up with—the one about using a cannon to deliver gifts—I turned it into a proposal and submitted it. And the higher-ups immediately built a prototype.
Then they started talking nonsense like, "If this works, we can use it for other purposes," and "the one who proposed it should test it herself."
So you were the lucky chosen participant... But why this outfit for the cannon's test run?
After Albedo caught me, I tried to escape again but tripped hard enough to tear my uniform. Then she pinned me down, and this was the only spare outfit left at HQ.
How hard did you have to fall to rip your uniform that badly?
A repeat performance of your own doing, huh?
You—this is partially your fault, too!==W== If you hadn't sold me out...
Didn't you leave work early for no reason?
To be fair, I do share some responsibility. I agreed to cover for her without asking what was going on, and later broke that promise.
Alright then... as my penance for "betraying" you, I'll help you with the test.
That cannon's too heavy to pull alone, isn't it?
Tyrant... thank you! You're my true friend!==W== It's so nice to have friends!
First I'm a traitor, now I'm a friend. You sure are something else.
This spot looks good. The cannon noise shouldn't bother anyone here.
Yeah... But we're way out in the Wilds. How are we supposed to deliver the items from here?
Once you channel magic into the cannon, it can shoot things a long way. In fact, I'd say that this thing was made for long-distance delivery!
You sure about that?==W== Guess we'll find out.
Heh heh... I'll send this huge tree fruit to Bastelina.
Let's see...==W== At this distance, it should land right in front of the Soul Shop~
First, put the tree fruit in the shock-absorbing capsule,==W== load the capsule into the barrel,==W== and finally infuse the cannon with magic.
That sounds way too casual. You sure this is safe?
Relax~ Let me just get the assignment over with.==W== Ready... ==W== Fire!
That was powerful! Think the tree fruit actually made it to its destination?
Thank you for coming~==W== Whew... Rush hour's almost over.
Huh, something just flew across the sky—what's that?
Oh, it's a message from Albedo.==W== Bastelina must be busy with the gigantic tree fruit. That's why she asked Albedo to contact me.
I just got a report that the Soul Shop got bombed...==W== Tell me that wasn't you. The front door's blown wide open, customers thought it was a rival company's raid, and several fainted on the spot.
<size=50>You have five seconds to answer with either "it was me" or "I'm sorry."
Uh, um—please, give me a second chance!
Whatever Albedo said, it clearly doesn't look good for Laru.

strings.text: First test of the cannon delivery system, the capsule we fired... Why is it coming back?
Is it really okay to just hang up like that...? Albedo's your superior, isn't she?
It's fine, it's fine! I was just conducting the cannon delivery test on Albedo's orders, right?==W== Tyrant, you can vouch for me, can't you?
So... Even if the test results aren't ideal, that's just the outcome of following orders, right? Whatever happens, it's on the superior who gave the order—==W==right?
Looks like she's grasping at straws...
If you end up getting a taste of your own medicine again, don't say I didn't warn you.
Tyrant, you worry too much~==W== You've got to have a bit of that free spirit.
Life's short. Seize the day, seize the day...==W== Huh?
Someone's sitting under that tree...==W== Come on, let's go take a look.
Ah, sorry for worrying you two.
Yeah... I twisted my ankle earlier. Just need to rest for a moment.
But if I delay any longer, I'll miss the commission's deadline...==W== Sigh...
How much time do you have left?
It's an urgent Artifact commission. There's ...==W== less than five minutes left. I'm doomed.
That's right! This is exactly the moment for the cannon to shine! Witness the power of my Cannon Delivery System!
Sudden injuries? No problem! Handle any emergency with ease! This is the delivery king of the future! The days of running packages on foot are over~
Sounds impressive... Must be expensive though?
New product—free trial~!==W== Just this once!
Our meeting must be guided by the God of Grace... Heh heh, let me show you how it works!
Wait!==W== Didn't the last attempt fail!?
No worries, no worries. As the saying goes, failure is the mother of success! That last test gave me a perfect grasp of the balance between distance and magical infusion.
You'll see!==W== These are the Artifacts for your urgent delivery, right? Where are they supposed to go?
To the Ashwind Clan...==W== Is it really going to be okay? They won't get damaged, will they...
Relax, I'll pack them in shock-absorbing capsules.==W== Let's see...==W== Ashwind Clan is that direction...
Two o'clock,==W== distance twenty-five hundred,==W== elevation forty-five degrees...==W==<size=45> Wind steady</size>,==W==<size=50> capsule loaded</size>,<size=60>==W== magic energy charged!
Such confidence... Maybe it really will work!
Did you hear? The Soul Shop got bombarded by a mysterious cannon just now!
Yeah, I heard. No idea whether the attackers were targeting the Grace Imperium or just hitting random spots...==W== Either way, keep your eyes open.
Ma'am, there's a projectile coming our way!
Tch... Speak of the devil.==W== As long as I'm here, nobody's gonna touch the Ashwind Clan!
Nice work! We knew you could!
And thus, peace returned once more to the Ashwind Clan.
Now, time to check the delivery status. My calculations were flawless. It should've gone perfectly...==W== Huh?
It—it's the capsule!?==W== Tyrant, get down!
What just happened? Why did the capsule come back!?==W== Nooo... My cannon...
It's completely blown apart... That counterattack was brutal.
At least the capsule's intact!==W== But with the cannon destroyed, there's no way to continue the deliveries...
Let's pause the test for now. Since we promised, we'll just have to deliver the goods on foot~

strings.text: If the gift of gratitude were me, myself... Of course, I'm just kidding!
Weird... No one's here? She did invite me, didn't she?
Whew~ Finally done.==W== I'm exhausted. That was awful... Down with overtime...
Think about it. If you'd just gotten serious about work from the start, you wouldn't have had to stay late.
I'm just not good at getting serious about work!
Anyway, thanks for lending a hand today. If it were just me, I never would've finished those deliveries.
Don't mention it. We're in this together. After all, two people get things done faster than one.
Ugh...==W== You're too nice, Tyrant.==W== I love you!
Oh, right, are you free tonight?==W== Come over to my place! I'll thank you properly.
She did say that, back then...
Laru, are you here?==W== Huh? The door's unlocked...
Did she forget to lock it? Or worse...==W== Did someone break in?
What's that strange groaning sound?! Someone did break in!
Now is not the time to hesitate... Laru, I'm coming in!
No sound of footsteps. No movement either. Hiding somewhere, waiting to ambush me?
That groaning again...==W== Sounds like it's coming from over there.
What's this? A huge gift box on the floor...
The sound's coming from inside the box.==W== There's a tag on it that says—
Is this what Laru meant when she said she'd thank me "properly"?
What now? Maybe I should just pretend I didn't see it...
An empty room, a giant gift box big enough to fit a person, and weird noises coming from inside...
I've got a bad feeling about this...
Hmm...==W== Forget it, I'll just go home.
Sounds desperate. Should I open it? But what's in there...
Listening closely, I think that really is Laru's voice...
No idea what kind of stunt she's pulling this time... But fine, I'll open it.
Tyrant, you're too slow!!!==W== I've been waiting for you for ages; I thought you were going to ditch me...==W== I almost fell asleep!
You took so long,==W== why are you even hesitating to open a gift?
Don't tease me at weird times—==W==if you're gonna open it, just open it already, okay?
Seriously, just looking at this box gives me a bad feeling...
Uh, why are you in the box?
Of course==W== it was to give you a big surprise!==W== The moment you open the box,==W== I was gonna pop out with a "Ta-da,"==W== and give you a super awesome gift!
To surprise you, of course!==W== When you opened it,==W== and "Bam," I just pop out. Wouldn't it be funny?
Plus, I also wanted to try out one of those ...==W== top-5 Women's must-have lines in life—==W=="The gift for you==W== is ... me~"
Plus,==W== according to my research,==W== the "Top 5 lines for girls to say"==W== includes "The present==W== is... ME==W==~"
But it looks like I've lost the chance this time...==W== Anyway, I'll just—==W==Uh,==W== Ow, my...
So that's why...==W== Huh?==W== Wait, Oh no…
Uhh,==W== I think I stayed in the box in this position for too long...==W== My feet are completely numb now...==W== Can't put any weight on it...
Uhh,==W== I think I stayed in the box in this position for too long...==W== My feet are numb now...==W== I can't get out.
Umm,==W== my feet feel like they're being zapped by bouncy fairy lights...==W== numb, painful, and itchy all at once...==W== I think just need to rest,==W== and then I'll be fine.
Well, I can't put any strength in them—==W==and they feel tingly.==W== But I'm sure it'll be fine if I just rest for a bit.
Uh...==W== You-==W==What's with that smile...==W== What do you want?==W== Why do I have a bad feeling...
Uh...==W== Eh?==W== What's wrong, Tyrant...==W== Why are you grinning like that?
Eeeeek! Hahahaha!==W== What are you doing! Tyrant!==W== Stop it!==W== Don't poke me, hahaha!
Gyaaaahhh! ==W==W-Wait, Tyrant!==W== What on earth are you doing?!
Sorry, Laru. I can't pass up an opportunity like this.
Waaahahaha!==W== Stop, quit it!==W== Don't play with other's body like that!
Waaahahaha!==W== Hey!==W== No poking!==W== My body's not some kind of toy!?
Aaaahh—==W==s-stop, stop!==W== I said don't play—hahahahaha!
No no no, what do you mean you can't help?!==W== I said I'm not your toy—
Stop it,==W== it tickles!==W== Have mercy on me!!
Hah, hah...==W== Alright, have you had enough fun?==W== Isn't it about time you got me out of this box...?
Hah, hah...==W== Alright,==W== have you had enough fun?==W== If you have,==W== isn't it about time you got me out of this box?
You can't get out by yourself?
If they weren't,==W== I'd have crawled out already...==W== So,==W== could you...
If I could, I would have by now!==W== So...==W== Help me out?
Just...==W== Carry me out.==W== You've messed with my body for so long,==W== you owe me at least this much compensation alright?
Phew... Safe at last. That was way too close.
Honestly... Next time, think about what might happen if your plan goes wrong.
I'll reflect on it...==W== Ugh, why did Bastelina have to tie it so tight?
Why did you ask her to do it?
She happened to stop by my place.
Yeah, with a pile of documents too.==W== See? They're right there.
Hmm...==W== The contents are a bit...
A bit what? I haven't looked at them yet.
It's the repair invoice for the Soul Shop's front door...
Ahahaha, right! That reminds me—==W==here! This is for you!
Fishing gear? And a sleeping bag?
It's a Winter Wild Fishing Kit~ Well? Don't you feel that urge to cast a line already?
Hehe, I'm glad. But you won't know how good it is unless you try it, right?
I see. You were planning on this from the start, weren't you!
But hey, you're not wrong. You only know how good the tools are once you use them,==W== so you're gonna teach me how to fish.
Hehe... Come on, let's go!==W== I know a secret spot where the fish bite fast!

Later that night, we camped at Laru's "secret spot," waiting all night without catching a single fish. But sharing a sleeping bag with her turned out to be unexpectedly warm and comforting... Before long, we both drifted off to sleep.
The next day... Well, it's not hard to guess. After paying the "invoice" issued by both Albedo and Bastelina, Laru's wallet ended up empty,==W== just like our fish basket.

strings.text: During her vacation in Cangwu, she casually issues a few more prescriptions.
Coming right up!==W== Careful now, it's hot!
Oh, hot, hot...==W== Alright, first bite!==W== Mm, so good!
You really can't go wrong with any of the food stalls in Cangwu.
Buns, fried dough, skewers... Tried 'em all.==W== What should I hit next?
My stomach hurts...==W== Did I eat too much?
Oh, ==PLAYER_NAME==? Why are you curled up over here?
Hold still. Let me examine you.
Pale complexion, cold sweats,==W== and freezing hands. It appears you have overindulged.
Wait a moment. I recall seeing one nearby...
Excuse me. May I have a cup of Digestive Tea?
Oh, Doctor Coronis! Please, take it! It's on the house!
My apologies. I lack my usual tools and reagents at the moment, so this is a great help.
Sorry for the wait.==W== Here, drink slowly...==W== It should alleviate the discomfort.
Phew...==W== I feel much better. Sorry for the trouble.
I'm surprised... Who knew tea could work like medicine?
This is a specialty of Cangwu—==W==the Medicinal Tea. Each cup is a blend of herbs tailored to boost natural recovery.==W== An excellent supplementary treatment.
Turning a regular drink into medicine...==W== That is actually impressive.
Not necessarily. Anything we ingest can be either medicine or poison.==W== This applies to meat, vegetables, fruit, pastries, and even tea.
Food and medicine share the same roots, after all. Dietary management is crucial for your health. Consider this a lesson learned.
Understood, Doctor...==W== I will reflect on my poor choices...
Doctor Coronis. How is the tea? Need another bowl?
The issue has been resolved. Thank you.
And thanks for the tea. It tasted pretty good.
Oh, you are too kind! But really, Doctor Coronis's diagnosis is never wrong!==W== If only I could convince her to do a rotation at my clinic...
Actually, I am a doctor by trade.==W== I just set up this stall during the holidays as a small side business.
Indeed. Since arriving in Cangwu, I have been consulting her on prescriptions for medicinal tea and other herbal remedies.
Doctor Coronis is sharp and learns fast. I was more than happy to share my recipes!==W== Her custom blends are already quite popular among the patients.
You flatter me. You are a capable instructor yourself.
Hahaha, you are far too humble! Anyway, I should get back to work. I hope you two enjoy your time in Cangwu!
Wait, aren't you supposed to be here on vacation? I can't believe you're still studying...
Cangwu has many fascinating aspects,==W== particularly its medical practices. There is a wealth of knowledge and techniques here that I have never been exposed to.
Though, now that you mention it...==W== I have been so immersed in analyzing Loong medicine that I haven't properly explored the city.
Since the festival is underway, it would be logical to observe the cultural side of things as well.
Perfect! How about I show you around? Consider it a thank-you for patching me up earlier.
Plus, I got some tips on the best spots from a local friend. You won't be disappointed!
You got it. Leave it to me!
Look, it's the Loong Dance! Spectacular, right?==W== It blew me away the first time I saw it.
Oh?==W== Is that Loong handmade?==W== The craftsmanship is precise and delicate.==W== Quite impressive.
Wow, they jumped that far? Is that magic?
That's the skill of lightness. I hear they don't use magic at all—it is pure technique!
To think the human body is capable of such feats without magical aid... Fascinating!
No, no, no! I shouldn't eat anything else!
Huh... It seems like your appetite has returned?
Heh. We have been walking for a while. If you are worried about overindulging, why don't we split one?
Excuse me. I would like one skewer of Tanghulu.
Coming right up!==W== Wait... Doctor Coronis? You saved my little brother just the other day!==W== Please, take this one for free!
Thanks to your prescription and that special herbal tea, he has fully recovered!
Excellent.==W== However, please make sure he finishes the full course of medication, even if he is feeling better already.==W== And thank you. This does look appetizing.
You got it! Take care now!
Coronis...==W== Let me get this straight. You are technically on vacation, right?
I am. Is there an issue?
That vendor was a patient's relative, right?==W== Have you been taking on new cases?
Yes. I happened to overhear that his brother was unwell. The symptoms sounded intriguing, so I decided to perform a quick examination.
Don't tell me there are others...
If they seek aid, I will not refuse.==W== Besides, treating locals provides valuable clinical data. It is an efficient arrangement.
I get her logic... But does this even count as a vacation?
It's sweet, it's tart, and the textural contrast between the brittle glaze and the fruit...==W== Not bad at all.
Right? It's the perfect combo...==W== I could eat this all day!
Have you forgotten your lesson so soon?
You have sugar crumbs right there.==W== Who would've guessed a capable person like you could be so careless?
Did she just...==W== Augh, this is so embarrassing...
Very well. Where are we off to next?
I found today quite enjoyable. Thank you for your company.
No problem. I'm just glad you had a good time.
By the way...==W== Do you have any plans for tomorrow?
Nothing specific. I plan to ...==W== perhaps explore the city a bit on my own. Why do you ask?
In that case, how about I show you around again tomorrow?==W== I know a perfect spot to unwind. We should check it out.

I understand, though.==W== I've experienced it too.==W== After all...==W== Feeling a sense of excitement==W== when touching another's body is perfectly natural<size=60>♪</size>
Sometimes,==W== I even get the illusion ...==W== that every inch of the other person==W== is under my complete control...
What I want to do ...==W== all rests on my whim.
... that if I wished,==W== I could dominate that body entirely...
… Every inch of the other person is under my complete control...==W== When casting spells, I even experience this illusion.
That's what you meant by "something else"?!
That's what you meant by "something else"?!
What else?==W== Mmm~==W== So, what exactly ...==W== were you thinking just now?==W== Hehe,==W== don't be shy,==W== be a good ==SEX9== and tell me...
Mmm~ So, what exactly were you thinking just now?==W== Don't be shy, be a good ==SEX9== and tell me…
Give me a break... Stop teasing me.
Give me a break... Stop teasing me.
Hehe,==W== you caught me.==W== I can't help it;==W== your reactions are always so ...==W== entertaining.
Hehe,==W== you caught me.==W== Your reactions are always so entertaining,==W== I can't help it.
But in all seriousness,==W== medical treatment==W== is built entirely on trust.==W== After all,==W== you have to hand over your everything—even your life—to the other person.
But in all seriousness,==W== medical treatment is built entirely on trust.==W== You have to hand over your everything to the other person.==W== That's how it works.
Now you understand==W== why I requested you specifically.==W== If it's you...==W== I wouldn't mind handing over==W== my "everything" at all.
Now you understand why I requested you specifically.==W== If it's you...==W== I wouldn't mind handing over my "everything" at all.==W== That's what I mean.
I... think I get it, mostly...
I... think I get it, mostly...
In that case,==W== let's continue—==W==don't forget,==W== you promised you would "heal" me properly...
In that case,==W== let's continue—==W==don't forget, you promised you would "heal" me properly...
I'm looking forward ...==W== to how you'll make every part of my body tremble with pleasure~
I'm looking forward ...==W== to how you'll give me the pleasure~
Ah...==W== That feels wonderful! I did not expect you to be such a talented masseuse.
Phew...==W== I am glad you like it.
Man... Giving a massage is actually quite the workout...
Well?==W== How does it feel to have complete control over my body?
Please stop phrasing it like that!
I-I mean, it allows me to understand you on a deeper level. I can physically feel the fatigue you have accumulated...
Like knowing exactly which muscles are tense.
Besides, I really do want you to properly relax...
If there is a next time, I will always choose you.
After all, getting to touch my body all over like this ...==W== is a privilege reserved only for my most excellent assistants.

strings.text: Finally, a holiday! Why is my schedule already exploding with random drama?!
==RT====Off====RT==<margin-left=6em><align=left>Willow, do we really have to do this?</align></margin>
<margin-right=6em><align=right>Yes. For the safety of this beach and everyone here,==RT==I need your cooperation.</align></margin>==Off====RT====RT==
<margin-right=6em><align=right>==PLAYER_NAME==, you're the only one I can count on.</align></margin>==Off====RT==
==RT====Off====RT==<margin-left=6em><align=left>She's dead serious...==RT==What did I get myself into...?!</align></margin>
The resort's finally back to normal. It's great seeing everyone return.
Yeah.==W== Having the whole beach to ourselves was nice, but this bustling vibe works too.
Willow, you hardly ever get a break.==B====W== Let's get back into vacation mode.
You have a point. Since the trouble is handled, taking a breather shouldn't hurt—
Thank you!==W== I would've been a goner without you two!
Jumping in without stretching is a surefire way to cramp up. Next time, make sure you warm up before swimming.
Classic Willow. You're practically a professional lifeguard.
Trekkers face danger every day. I've taken plenty of first-aid courses to stay prepared.
Incredible. You're the model employee for the Trekker Association.
I'm glad I could help. At least the training paid off. Anyway, what were we talking about? Something about having fun—
Phew... That takes care of it.
Why won't you listen?! I told you it's dangerous outside the swim zone!
It never ends! We can't handle all this ourselves.
==PLAYER_NAME==, call Noya and the others! We need all hands on deck!
Phew... I think that's everything.==W== Thanks for the backup. I'm sorry for dragging you all away from your lovely vacation.
You needed help, no way we'd leave you hanging!
Good thing no one got hurt...
Wait a second. All these accidents, and no sign of a single staff member. Why?
I noticed that too, so I asked around.
Business was dead lately. They couldn't make payroll, so the whole staff quit...
<size=50>What?!==W== But the beach is packed! How are they operating without any staff?!</size>
They couldn't train new hires fast enough for the tourist rush.
That's dangerous!==W== Good thing we were around...
This resort finally bounced back. If this keeps up, a fatal accident is inevitable.==W== We need preventative measures. So—
Right this way for the safety lecture! Hosted by Willow, head of the Emor Trekker Association!
The lecture is open to everyone! Come on in—!
More people showed up than I thought.
Looks like Willow thought this through. She set up the venue in no time, and got the local shops to spread the word... No wonder she's the Association's go-to.
Heh, you know how to flatter me.
I'm just being honest.==W== How are things on your end? Lecture all set?
Yes.==W== Amber, could you hand these materials out to the audience?
Need a hand with anything else?
I was about to ask.==W== Would you be my demonstration partner for the lecture?
Me? If you need a demonstration, Noya's a strong swimmer. She might be a better fit...
Most of the audience aren't strong swimmers, or they rarely go out to sea.==W== Since you're a beginner, your reactions will naturally mirror theirs.==W== That makes you the perfect choice.
Makes sense. Leave it to me.
Great.==W== Here's the demo script. Review it before we start.==W==
Hmm... I see. You want me to play the drowning victim...==W== Wait, what?!
Willow... We're doing this part too...?!
Of course. It's the most important part.==W== If you're ready, let's begin!
Next, I'll explain how to rescue a drowning victim! First, when you notice someone drowning—
That's my cue... I'm getting nervous now.==W== But I trust Willow...
Willow, do we have to do this?
Yes. For the safety of this beach and everyone here, I need your cooperation.
Uh... Can I really do this?
==PLAYER_NAME==, you're the only one I can count on.
Willow already set this up... I can't back out now!
Now, let's continue with a live demonstration.==W== Please welcome my partner:==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==!
This is for the safety of the beach! I'll bite the bullet and do it...!
Thanks for the support.==W== Now, please lie on your back.
We'll now cover basic first aid for drowning victims. First, shout loudly and tap their shoulder to check for a response.
If they aren't breathing, move them to a safe spot and start CPR immediately. Inhaling seawater cuts off oxygen, which can cause cardiac arrest.
That makes rescue breathing critical. Watch closely. First, tilt the chin back to open the airway...
Then pinch the nose shut, open your mouth, and form a tight seal over theirs.
It's a demo, it's a demo, it's a demo... She isn't actually going to do it, right?!
But... Why can I feel her breath on my face? Maybe I should ... sneak a peek?
<size=50>W-Whoa?! Willow?!==W== W-Wait, aren't we a little t-too close?!</size>
Well, yes. I'm demonstrating rescue breathing.
B-But it doesn't have to be that realistic...!
Perhaps, but I can't properly demonstrate the mouth seal if I do it from a distance.
<size=50>I think they get the picture!==W== Any questions from the crowd?!</size>
Uh-huh... I think we've got the gist of it ... probably?
To keep a cool head in an emergency, memorize these exact steps.
Honestly, if it gets the gorgeous Miss Willow to rescue me, drowning might actually be worth it.==W== Haha, just kidding!
"Someone will just save me"... That kind of naive arrogance will get you killed, you know?
<size=50>Anyone who treats their own life as a joke doesn't deserve to set foot on this beach!==W== Reckless idiots only endanger the people around them. You're worse than trash!</size>
<size=50>Eeek!</size>==W==<size=50> I'm sorry! I take it all baaack!</size>
I've never seen Willow look so terrifying...==W== I should absolutely not piss her off...

strings.text: Work??? Vacation??? Forget it—another event has popped up!
Yesterday's safety lecture ate up the whole day. I barely got to enjoy the trip.==B====W== Today I'm going to kick back and get some proper rest—
Miss Willow, about the boat schedule...
Miss Willow! The suspect's sketch is done!
<size=50>Everyone! I'll handle your requests one by one. Please form a line.</size>
Oh, it's you.==W== Until the supervisor arrives, I'm running the inquiry desk for tourists and sailing Trekkers.
Basically, this is a temporary branch of the Trekker Association.
Ah, sorry...==W== I'm swamped right now. Can it wait?
Phew... Finally a breather. Better grab a quick bite while I can—
Willow, you're pushing yourself too hard...==W== I bought a bunch of food. Want to join me?
Seafood pizza, Windhowl Island chow mein ... plus tropical drinks and shaved ice!==W== Everything looks amazing.
I didn't know what you'd prefer, so I grabbed one of everything that looked good. Glad you like it.
...==PLAYER_NAME==, have you been waiting to eat with me this whole time?
Honestly, you didn't have to wait. You should've eaten first.
How could I eat first when you're skipping meals to work?
Sorry for making you worry.==W== But I couldn't turn a blind eye...
You saw all the chaos yesterday. Plus, this time of year brings a lot of Trekkers through here.
Trekkers unfamiliar with sailing run into problems all the time.==W== I figured they needed somewhere to go for advice, so I set up this temporary office.
I'm not saying it's a bad idea—it's great.==W== But doesn't that mean you get zero rest?
It's fine. Compared to working at the Emor Trekkers' House, this is practically a vacation.
Oh wait, we're already on vacation.
Honestly... Hardworking is a virtue, but making a habit of burning out isn't.
I get where you are coming from, but at this rate—
Oh, right. I got the notice. They finalized the new supervisor.
Yep. I checked with Trekker Association HQ, too. They're sending official staff soon.
That's a relief. I thought you were planning to run this whole place yourself...
Handing things off is part of the job. Two more days, and it shouldn't be this crazy—
Hey, deep breaths. What's going on?==W==
<size=50>A monster! It's dragging a boat around and wrecking everything!</size>
==PLAYER_NAME==, get everyone on the beach to safety!
Wait, why is a monster dragging a boat around?
It probably bit a hook.==W== Here,==W== look through the telescope.
Are you serious?! Hey! You on the boat! Can you hear me?!
No way! Do you know how hard it was to hook a catch this big?!
Do you want the fish or do you want to live?! Let go!
Thanks, big help. We should be good here too...==W== Wait, what?
<size=50>M-Miss Willow! The monster's still circling the boat—Aaaagh?!</size>
It broke free. Why's it attacking the boat?!
That monster... No way. Is that a Mutated Shark?!
It's a shark monster. Once it goes berserk, it's lethal. Its destructive power rivals a Monolith Meltdown.
They're relentless. Even if the boat makes shore, it'll follow.==W== We have to strike first.
What?! But it's out in the water. How do we even fight that?
Eek! Wh-What am I supposed to do?!
Am I gonna end up as fish food?! Nooo!
Mister! Calm down and do exactly what I say!
Full throttle, straight for the shallows! We'll intercept it there!
What?!==W== If I hit the shallows, I'll run aground! That's suicide!
The rescue team's on standby! Trust me and come in full speed!
If you wait, you're dead! Might as well take the gamble!
Dammit, I've got no other choice...!==W==<size=50> Chaaarge—!!!</size>
Willow! I've got the ranged Trekkers lined up!
==PLAYER_NAME==, everyone, thanks!==W== Take your positions and move on my signal!
<size=30>Just a little closer...==W== Three,==W== two,==W== one...</size>
Cough, cough...!==W== What an impact... Is the Mutated Shark down?!
Your tactics won this, Miss Willow. Incredible.
Hehe, only because you all jumped in without hesitation.
Shame, though... I almost had that big catch.
Such a shame? Use yourself as bait next time.
Your life or the fish—which matters more? You were at my lecture yesterday.
What's the number one rule of sailing? Answer me!
You'll end up as fish food and monster bait.
Eeeeeek! I'm sorry! I've learned my lesson!
Noted. I should never tick Willow off...

strings.text: It's a hard-to-come-by holiday, so why not clock out for once and just enjoy the vacation?
Hours after the Mutated Shark attack...
Willow said she'd finish the incident report today.==W== It's getting late, she should be done—
Miss Willow, I need to ask you something too...
No problem! Form a line and I'll help you one by one.
She'll probably work straight through vacation... Guess I need a Plan B.
Oh, ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W== What brings you here? Did you need something?
Willow, did you finish that report?
Not yet, I haven't even touched my pen. There were way too many questions...==W== Things finally quieted down, so I was about to start.
What, are you here to drag me to dinner?==W== I'll probably be writing late, so go ahead with the New Star Guild.
No, it's not that... I actually need to talk to you about something urgent.
It's easier if I show you. Come with me.
We're all the way at the edge of the beach. So what's going on?
Crap, I didn't even think of an excuse for bringing her out here...!
How am I going to talk my way out of this...?
Wait...==W== Was your whole plan to drag me away from work?
Your eyes are darting all over the place.
O-Oh, right! Two Trekkers got into an argument...
But there isn't a soul around.
Haha...==W== Maybe they already worked it out?
Well, if it's resolved, there's no reason for me to stay.==W== I need to get back to my report, so if you'll excuse me—
She's going right back to work! Think! I need an excuse to keep her here...
Um...==W==<size=50> I wanted you to see the results of my swimming practice!!</size>
Oh no, was that excuse too flimsy...?
Ugh... Willow's gonna chew me out for sure—
I said I'm in. Helping Trekkers is my job, after all.
Besides, I taught you. It's only fair I see how it paid off.
<size=30>I didn't practice at all, but I'm in too deep now. Gotta commit!</size>
Okay, I got this.==W== Keep steady, hold the rhythm, remember to breathe...==W== Wait—?!
Calm down. Stand up. You can touch the bottom.
With all due respect... You claimed you wanted to show your results. But what I just saw wasn't an improvement.
I blurted that out in a panic, but now I feel terrible for dragging Willow into this...
... Alright. I'll teach you from scratch, step by step, until you've mastered it.
==PLAYER_NAME==, your legs are sinking! Relax and keep your body flat!
Stop flailing your arms the second you panic! Keep a steady stroke rhythm!
And time your breaths! Otherwise you'll be drinking seawater until you're full!
Huff...==W== Puff...==W== Willow, can we take a break...?
Good call. Let's get you some water.
See that buoy over there? Next, I want you to kick with only your legs. Ten laps.
That's right. We're drilling the basic form into your muscle memory.==W== Ten laps is letting you off easy.
Uh... Willow? Is it just me, or are you being way stricter than last time?
Still playing dumb?==W== I never pegged you==W== for such a troublemaker.
Using this "swim practice" as an excuse,==W== while your real goal...
Using this "swim practice"==W== as an excuse,==W== while your real goal==W== remains all the same…
... was just to drag me away from work==W== so I'd actually enjoy the vacation.==W== Right?
You just wanted to drag me away from work...==W== Right?
You were a dead giveaway.==W====RT== Besides,==W== acting that sketchy==W== just doesn't like you.
Judging from your expression,==W== it's pretty obvious.==W== Acting like that just isn't like you.
So,==W== why bother with such a clumsy lie?
You'd never take a break if I didn't lie.
Oh?==W== So this is my fault now?
... Heh.==W== Just kidding.==RT====W== You're right.==W== I gave you no choice but to tell a lie.
Just kidding.==W== You're right.==W== I gave you no choice==W== but to tell a lie.
You've been trying so hard==W== to get me to enjoy this trip,==W== and I just kept brushing you off.==W== I'm sorry.
You've been==W== trying so hard to get me to enjoy this trip,==W== and the one who keeps turning down your kindness==W== is none other than me.==W== I'm sorry.
You don't have to apologize. It's just...
You need to start treating yourself better, Willow.
Treat myself better?==RT====W== Hmm...==W== I honestly haven't given that much thought.
Treat myself better...==W== You say?==W== Hmm…==W== I guess I haven't given that much thought.
Plus, if you don't take a proper breather, you're going to burn yourself out.
Yeah,==W== I see your point...==W== But==W== I love what I do,==W== so it doesn't really feel like work.
I see your point...==W== But==W== I love what I do,==W== so it doesn't really feel like work…

We're all the way at the edge of the beach. So what's going on?

Your eyes are darting all over the place.

strings.text: A strange sense of déjà vu, a chance to change—it all begins with her name.
Ugh... This sword has a mind of its own. No matter what I do, it just feels off...
Let's try again. Let the blade do the work...==W== Hah!==W== Swish...==W== Whoa?!==W==
Ow... Well, that was graceful. So embarrassing.==W== Haha, at least nobody saw...
... That's quite the scream. You've certainly got the lungs for it.
Seriously, sneaking up on people without a sound... You scared me half to death.
I just followed the noise... You're up unusually early. That's not like you.
Training? That hardly seems like something an Acolyte needs to do.
Uh... I figured I should learn some self-defense. If I'm completely helpless out on patrol, you'll just end up having to watch my back.
This is ...==W== a stance a friend taught me. She said it was perfect for beginners.
Admirable, but pointless like this. Your body is stiff, and you're wasting energy...==W== Wait, did you even warm up properly?
Then you didn't do it right. Your muscles are locked up. That's why you lost your balance and fell flat on your back.
Come on, we're starting over with stretches. Stand back-to-back with me, like this...==W== Now link arms.
Like this. Back to back with me...==B== Now hook your arms with mine.
This feels so familiar... It's exactly like when Noya helped me stretch...
Next stretch... Sit down with your legs straight. Lean forward slowly and try to touch your toes.
As she presses against my back, her weight slowly bearing down on me... It feels exactly like that day.
Ow, ow, ow, ow! I yield, I yieeeeld!==W== I yield, Noya!
Ah... Sorry. I just thought of an old friend, and it slipped out...
... Calling me by others' name? It seems you still have energy to spare. To help you focus on your stretches...
I'll just apply a little more pressure!
Wait, wait, wait! I'm focused! I'll focus,==W== waaah!
Is your body feeling more relaxed?
Huff... Huff... This isn't about being relaxed anymore. I thought my spine was going to snap...
Don't worry. The human body is much sturdier than you think...==W== Hm?
A carriage. It sounds like it's heading this way. ==PLAYER_NAME==, let's hide.
Alright, let the horses rest here for a bit. Then we make a straight push for Lord Caligula's estate.
Heh, we bagged a prime one this time. She should fetch a handsome price, right?
Lord Caligula is more than happy to pay a premium for women! He even arranged a hidden route into the city for us. Makes our job a whole lot easier. What a lifesaver.
Is that ... a slave trader's carriage?
It appears so. Caligula... I never thought he'd be involved in the slave trade.
His father hails from Emor. A member of the Senate. Their family owns vast estates across Filanis.
He puts on a show of opposing slavery, yet secretly profits from this filth.==W== Unforgivable!==W==
... Do you want to save those slaves?
It's written all over your face.
But I am a Night Watcher of Filanis. I have no authority to free slaves outside the city limits.
Wait to intercept them after they enter the gates...? No. From the sound of it, this isn't their first transaction. Caligula will have a way to cover it up.
Without evidence, the Night Watchers cannot touch the family of a Senator.
In that case, if you just stop being a Night Watcher of Filanis for a moment... Problem solved, right?
It's simple. The slavers aren't attacked by a Night Watcher, they're ambushed by passing bandits. Out here in the Wilds, getting targeted by bandits is perfectly normal.
True, but what are the odds of bandits conveniently showing up right now...==W== Wait, don't tell me...
We? A Night Watcher masquerading as a bandit... That's completely crossing a line. It stains the honor of the Night Watchers.
So you're just going to stand by and watch?
I think ignoring your own conscience here would be a much bigger stain on your honor.
And if you really think it's crossing a line, well, you've got me here to cross it with you.
My conscience... ==PLAYER_NAME==, do you realize you are tempting a Night Watcher to stray from her path?
But ... you're right. Let's do it!
These woods are ours, and we claim this road!
If you want to pass, you pay the toll!
Heh, looks like we caught a big fish today! If you value your lives, leave the cargo and walk away!
Bandits?! You've got some nerve. Do you have any idea whose cargo this is? The name alone would make you tremble.
I don't care whose it is. Today, this ill-gotten loot belongs to Boss.
Boss? Is that what you call yourself? Heh, I'll remember that.==W== You might want to start picking out your gravestone.
You're the one who'll be needing a grave.
Huh? M-My sword... How did it snap in half?!
Heh heh heh... Unless you want my Dark Knight here to slice you in two,==W== running away would be the smart move.
Please! I'll do whatever you want, just let my sister go!
Take these coins and run. Head north to Filanis. Keep moving, and you'll be there in an hour.
No slave trader can touch you once you're inside its walls.
Oh... Thank you! Thank you so much!
Phew. They all got away. Once they make it to Filanis, they'll be safe.
Yeah. By the way, you play a pretty convincing bandit.
... Should I take that as an insult?
Not at all. It's a compliment.
A compliment...? I hardly think that is something to be proud of.
And what was that Dark Knight nonsense about?
Having aliases makes things easier. See? I called myself Boss too, didn't I?
If someone can commit crimes under the guise of the Fallen Saintess, I don't see the harm in us using fake names to do some good.
Playing bandits... What a despicable tactic. How can you be so resolute? Why was there zero hesitation?
Hmm... Because it was a choice I won't regret.
Yeah... If we'd let those slavers go back there, I know I would have regretted it.
So I just trusted my heart and took action. That's all there is to it.
Even if you say it's despicable, I will always make a choice I won't regret. Every single time.
... So you really thought it all through.
Huh? What kind of person did you think I was?!
When someone suddenly says we'll become bandits, any normal person would assume they've lost their mind.
But...==W== You helped me. Without you, I would have just stood there, unable to do a thing. And I know I would have regretted it, too...
That being said, crossing the line ends today! For the sake of both our reputations, we can never speak of what happened here.
Which means this stays between you and me.==W== Do we have an agreement?
A secret between the two of us...==W== Ah, I understand.
By the way...==W== What happened today...==W== Let it stay our little secret, please?
You're scared that Iris will nag you, aren't you?
If she finds out,==W== I won't be allowed to sit behind Loxy's steering wheel for the next two months!
Now that I think about it, I made a similar promise to Noya once...
Noya, Iris, Amber... How can I find my way back to you...?
<size=85%>There's that name again... Noya. Maybe I really do look like her.</size>
<size=85%>I wonder... What kind of person is she?</size>

strings.text: I want to be closer to you, stand by your side, and become a companion you can rely on.
A pinch of salt...==W== Let it sear until it's golden...
I'm back. Smells amazing...==W== What are you making?
Grilled fish. Just give it a second, it's almost done.
So that's how you do it...
Wh-what is it? You're staring so hard I'm getting distracted...==W== Don't tell me you hate fish?
Not at all. I'll eat anything as long as it's made well. That's not what I meant. It's just... I have a favor to ask.
Could you ...==W== teach me how to cook?
Sure, I can do that. But what brought this on?
I can't keep letting my guest do all the cooking. As the host, it's my job to take care of you.
I really don't mind...==W== But alright, if you want to learn, I'll teach you.
Just a warning though, I won't go easy on you. You'd better be ready.
Of course. I wouldn't have it any other way.
Let's start with the vegetables. Cut the potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Wait, you're not going to peel them? And these chunks are huge. How is anyone supposed to eat them?
You can eat the skin. And if they're too big, just bite them in half.
I suppose the skin isn't completely inedible, but the texture is awful. Plus, they won't cook evenly if they're this big. And most of all, it's just a pain to eat!
I had no idea there were so many details to consider...
You can't cut corners if you want good food. I'll handle the chopping. You just watch for now.
Alright, the vegetables are soft. Time to season. Add some salt to taste for me.
You're just dumping the whole jar in? Aren't you going to use a spoon...?
This is faster. Besides, if it's "to taste," doesn't that mean I can just add as much as I want?
That's not what that means...==W== Let me ask you this, Alina. Do you like your food salty or mild?
Got it...==W== Alright, then just about this much. Here, try a sip.
Oh, that's good...==W== If you knew exactly how much to add, why didn't you just say so?
Because everyone's palate is different. That's why I said "to taste."
Figuring out what flavors your guest prefers, learning how each ingredient works...
Knowing all that before you even start cooking is the real secret to a good meal.
So cooking requires just as much precision as swordplay. I never knew.
Haha, honestly, my half-baked skills came from a friend. I'm just copying what she taught me.
Yeah. Every dish Noya whipped up was a masterpiece. She used to teach me all the time.
What kind of person is she... This Noya?
You've called me by her name more than once. It's hard not to be curious.
... Fair enough. Let's see, how should I put it...
I guess her smile is the first thing that comes to mind. Her energy and warmth saved me more times than I can count.
And she always looked out for me. She'd even share half her favorite drink with me...
Always shielding me. Making sure I never got hurt.
... So you meant a great deal to her?
Now that you mention it, she did say something like that once.
Is that so...==W== And your habit of bending the rules? Did you pick that up from her too?
Ah...==W== Probably. Noya was always coming up with the wildest ideas.
Like when she decided to drive Loxy straight into that massive Stellaroid. Really scared the life out of me.
Uh...==W== Just imagine ramming a carriage full-speed into a giant monster. Makes more sense?
What kind of strategy is that...?==W== It's completely reckless.
Haha, anyone would think so. But somehow, she pulled it off.
But ever since then, I just knew...==W== As long as Noya was by my side, no matter how crazy things got, we'd always find a way out.
No matter how crazy...==W== I see. I think I understand why you're always so bold.
<size=85%>Compared to her, I still have a long way to go.</size>
<size=85%>Alright. I'll use her as my goal. Let's start by mastering the kitchen!</size>
Anyway...==W== Thank you for telling me all this. I've got the soup recipe down.
It's about time for the main course. I'll put everything I just learned to use. You can leave the rest to me.
Alina's so fired up. I'd better do my best to help her out.
For some reason, I'm not surprised.
I was so careful to follow everything you said...
It smells great, though! Terrible presentation doesn't always mean it tastes bad.
You don't have to force it. I'll just throw this out...
W-Wait, what are you doing?! Spit it out! You're going to get sick!
Mmm...==W== The burnt parts are a little bitter, but it gets better the more I chew. It's actually not bad...?
I told you, you don't have to force it!
I'm not. The seasoning really is much better this time.
Yeah. The only real issue this time was the heat. Learn from this, and I know your next dish will be amazing!
I'm sorry...==W== You said to make sure everything was cooked through. I did, but I think I went a little overboard...
Pfft...==W== Hahahaha! You're so blunt and earnest, Alina.
Nothing's wrong with it. I just didn't expect to see such a cute side of you.
Alright, just scrape off the burnt edges. The rest is fine to eat.
Are you even listening to me...?==W== It's practically charcoal, and you're still going to eat it?
It should be fine, right? Like I said, the flavor itself isn't bad. Plus...
You put so much heart into this. It'd be a shame to just throw it away.
... Did you learn how to cheer people up like this from Noya, too?
Though I guess her optimism might have rubbed off on me a little.
They say food turns out tastier when the cook is happy.
Happy...==W== Maybe I should try smiling a little more.
Open wide. Try a bite, it really is delicious.
Hey, don't treat me like a child. I can feed mysel—
Lady Alina! Lady Alina, please help! My family...==W== My family's been taken!
Try to calm down. Who took them? Do you know where they went?
It was Caligula! His men dragged my family and our neighbors right into his estate! I barely made it out alive...
Caligula again...==W== Rest easy. I swear I'll get everyone back.
But how are you going to do that, Alina? I know protecting Filanis is your duty, and we're in the right, but kicking the front door down with just the two of us isn't exactly the smartest move...
We don't need a frontal assault. A few months ago, I busted a gang of thieves. They were digging a tunnel through the caves beneath Filanis to rob Caligula's mansion.
We can use that tunnel to slip inside.
Sneaking in through a thieves' tunnel...==W== Sounds like crossing a line for someone like you.
I'm simply making a choice I won't regret.
Besides, I have you here to cross it with me, don't I?
Haha, exactly. I'm right by your side.

Grilled fish. Just give it a second, it's almost done.
So that's how you do it...
Wh-what is it? You're staring so hard I'm getting distracted...==W== Don't tell me you hate fish?
Not at all. I'll eat anything as long as it's made well. That's not what I meant. It's just... I have a favor to ask.
Could you ...==W== teach me how to cook?
Sure, I can do that. But what brought this on?
I can't keep letting my guest do all the cooking. As the host, it's my job to take care of you.
I really don't mind...==W== But alright, if you want to learn, I'll teach you.
Just a warning though, I won't go easy on you. You'd better be ready.
Of course. I wouldn't have it any other way.
Let's start with the vegetables. Cut the potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Wait, you're not going to peel them? And these chunks are huge. How is anyone supposed to eat them?
You can eat the skin. And if they're too big, just bite them in half.
I suppose the skin isn't completely inedible, but the texture is awful. Plus, they won't cook evenly if they're this big. And most of all, it's just a pain to eat!
I had no idea there were so many details to consider...
You can't cut corners if you want good food. I'll handle the chopping. You just watch for now.
Alright, the vegetables are soft. Time to season. Add some salt to taste for me.
You're just dumping the whole jar in? Aren't you going to use a spoon...?
This is faster. Besides, if it's "to taste," doesn't that mean I can just add as much as I want?
That's not what that means...==W== Let me ask you this, Alina. Do you like your food salty or mild?
Got it...==W== Alright, then just about this much. Here, try a sip.
Oh, that's good...==W== If you knew exactly how much to add, why didn't you just say so?
Because everyone's palate is different. That's why I said "to taste."
Figuring out what flavors your guest prefers, learning how each ingredient works...
Knowing all that before you even start cooking is the real secret to a good meal.
So cooking requires just as much precision as swordplay. I never knew.
Haha, honestly, my half-baked skills came from a friend. I'm just copying what she taught me.
Yeah. Every dish Noya whipped up was a masterpiece. She used to teach me all the time.
What kind of person is she... This Noya?
You've called me by her name more than once. It's hard not to be curious.
... Fair enough. Let's see, how should I put it...
I guess her smile is the first thing that comes to mind. Her energy and warmth saved me more times than I can count.
And she always looked out for me. She'd even share half her favorite drink with me...
Always shielding me. Making sure I never got hurt.
... So you meant a great deal to her?
Now that you mention it, she did say something like that once.
Is that so...==W== And your habit of bending the rules? Did you pick that up from her too?
Ah...==W== Probably. Noya was always coming up with the wildest ideas.
Like when she decided to drive Loxy straight into that massive Stellaroid. Really scared the life out of me.
Uh...==W== Just imagine ramming a carriage full-speed into a giant monster. Makes more sense?
What kind of strategy is that...?==W== It's completely reckless.
Haha, anyone would think so. But somehow, she pulled it off.
But ever since then, I just knew...==W== As long as Noya was by my side, no matter how crazy things got, we'd always find a way out.
No matter how crazy...==W== I see. I think I understand why you're always so bold.
<size=85%>Compared to her, I still have a long way to go.</size>
<size=85%>Alright. I'll use her as my goal. Let's start by mastering the kitchen!</size>
Anyway...==W== Thank you for telling me all this. I've got the soup recipe down.
It's about time for the main course. I'll put everything I just learned to use. You can leave the rest to me.
Alina's so fired up. I'd better do my best to help her out.
For some reason, I'm not surprised.
I was so careful to follow everything you said...
It smells great, though! Terrible presentation doesn't always mean it tastes bad.
You don't have to force it. I'll just throw this out...
W-Wait, what are you doing?! Spit it out! You're going to get sick!
Mmm...==W== The burnt parts are a little bitter, but it gets better the more I chew. It's actually not bad...?
I told you, you don't have to force it!
I'm not. The seasoning really is much better this time.
Yeah. The only real issue this time was the heat. Learn from this, and I know your next dish will be amazing!
I'm sorry...==W== You said to make sure everything was cooked through. I did, but I think I went a little overboard...
Pfft...==W== Hahahaha! You're so blunt and earnest, Alina.
Nothing's wrong with it. I just didn't expect to see such a cute side of you.
Alright, just scrape off the burnt edges. The rest is fine to eat.
Are you even listening to me...?==W== It's practically charcoal, and you're still going to eat it?
It should be fine, right? Like I said, the flavor itself isn't bad. Plus...
You put so much heart into this. It'd be a shame to just throw it away.
... Did you learn how to cheer people up like this from Noya, too?
Though I guess her optimism might have rubbed off on me a little.
They say food turns out tastier when the cook is happy.
Happy...==W== Maybe I should try smiling a little more.
Open wide. Try a bite, it really is delicious.
Hey, don't treat me like a child. I can feed mysel—
Lady Alina! Lady Alina, please help! My family...==W== My family's been taken!
Try to calm down. Who took them? Do you know where they went?
It was Caligula! His men dragged my family and our neighbors right into his estate! I barely made it out alive...
Caligula again...==W== Rest easy. I swear I'll get everyone back.
But how are you going to do that, Alina? I know protecting Filanis is your duty, and we're in the right, but kicking the front door down with just the two of us isn't exactly the smartest move...
We don't need a frontal assault. A few months ago, I busted a gang of thieves. They were digging a tunnel through the caves beneath Filanis to rob Caligula's mansion.
We can use that tunnel to slip inside.
Sneaking in through a thieves' tunnel...==W== Sounds like crossing a line for someone like you.
I'm simply making a choice I won't regret.
Besides, I have you here to cross it with me, don't I?
Haha, exactly. I'm right by your side.

strings.text: Becoming each other's comfort, fingers intertwined, protecting a secret that belongs to just the two of us.
I had no idea the caves under Filanis were this huge...
The rock here erodes easily. Over time, the water just carved out these tunnels.
Looks like nature wants to see this scumbag pay.
Why make our move at dawn, though? Wouldn't midnight be safer?
Just the opposite. These nobles party all night and don't sleep until dawn. Right now is when they're out cold.
If staying up all night makes you a noble, I've been living like royalty for a while now.
Wait, no. It's not like they have to climb the Monolith and hunt monsters every day.
==PLAYER_NAME==, over here. I got the tunnel open.
Hold on. Caligula's dungeon is right ahead...==W== Shh! Someone's there.
What?! The contract is void?! You can't do this! Let me see Lord Caligula!
You let them escape, and you still have the nerve to ask for an audience? Do you know how much time and money your mistake cost us?
Who's been catching your slaves all these years?! Even if I messed up, I still put in the work!
You're just a slaver, so watch your mouth! Lord Caligula is done with you. Now get lost!
Alina, it looks like the captured citizens are locked in there.
I saved those slaves, and now the citizens of Filanis are paying the price...
... No. If I had just walked away, I never would have forgiven myself.
Then that's enough. That is your justice.
You didn't do anything wrong. The real crime is the slave trade, and the nobles who gladly profit from it.
We saved those sisters, and now we're going to save the people in there, too.
... You're right. Now isn't the time to blame myself. Let's go!
Is everyone alright? The guards are out cold. Let's move, and keep quiet!
That uniform...==W== You're a Night Watcher? Thank goodness...!==W== You're here to save us, right?
Stay close, everyone. I'll lead you out through the tunnel.
The rescue goes surprisingly well. Alina and I sweep the dungeon, and we don't leave a single person behind.
Slow down, there's no rush. It's dark, so watch your step.
This girl is the last one. Now it's just Alina and me...
Hey, did you hear something from the dungeon?
Oh no...!==W== The patrol heard us!
I'm sorry! I'm so sorry! I-==W==I...
It's not your fault. Hurry up and join the others. We'll hold them off here.
Alina, let's run the other way!
Over there! Stop right there, slaves! You are the property of Lord Caligula!
Who are you calling property?! Catch us if you can!
Good, the plan worked. They're all coming after us!
Once we hit the streets, they won't be able to stop us...==W== Whoa!
Ow...!==W== Watch where you're going! I'm already in a terrible mood!
Hmm? This voice... Have I heard it somewhere?
Ah! That voice! You're the bandits who stole our slaves!
Dammit, why now of all times...!
Hmph. You should be honored to supply Lord Caligula with slaves, yet you dare ask for money?
If you have a problem, take it up with my guards.
You're not the only ones with backup in this city! We'll make you regret this!
Perfect timing. Let's go this way!
There they are! Stop right there, you thieving scum!
I see how it is...==W== Lord Caligula voids your contract, so you set the slaves loose for revenge? You really don't know your place!
Bastards! Caligula is the one who broke the contract and refused to pay!
Talk about a lucky break. Now they're at each other's throats...
They were right on our heels. It's a good thing they turned on each other... Saved us a lot of trouble.
Nothing. I'm just impressed by how quickly you came up with that lie. A few words and you had them fighting each other.
And whose fault is that? Being around you, I feel like I'm picking up bad habits.
Though ...==W== it doesn't feel too bad right now.
I know. A secret just between us, right?
This is ...==W== the Olympia Bathhouse? Alina, why are we here?
We're hiding. I asked Lulu to arrange a private bath for us, one normally meant just for nobles.
If Caligula's men realize they caught the wrong people, they'd never suspect the real culprits to be taking a relaxing bath.
Besides, we just ran all over those caves, and we're covered in dust. It's the perfect time to wash up, and destroy the evidence while we're at it...
Makes sense...==W== W-Wait, Alina?! Why are you taking off your armor...?
How else am I supposed to take a bath? Come on, hurry up.
A bath so fancy...==W== I only get to use it thanks to you.
The warmth of the steam,==W== the gentle scent of flowers...==W== It's so soothing.
The warmth of the steam,==W== the gentle scent of flowers…==W== So this is what it feels like to be healed.
Alina, your back... Are you hurt?
Hurt?==W== I don't think I...==W== Ah, do you mean my old wounds?
If so,==W== they don't hurt anymore,==W== so please don't worry.
If so, they don't hurt anymore,==W== so please don't worry.
Old wounds? From when you were a gladiator?
Yes.==W== But==W== I've always healed quickly,==W== so most injuries wouldn't even leave a mark==W== if left alone…
Yes.==W== But==W== I've always healed quickly,==W== so most injuries wouldn't even leave a mark if left alone…
Those must have been especially deep==W== That said,==W== they'll fade little by little,==W== so there's no need==W== for concern.
Those must have been especially deep,==W== which is why they remain.==W== That said, they'll fade little by little,==W== so there's no need for concern.
So you're the type who doesn't scar easily too.
"Too"?==W== Could it be that Noya, the one you say resembles me,==W== is the same?
"Too"?==W== Could it be that Noya,==W== the one you say resembles me, is the same?
… Honestly,==W== it's always Noya this, Noya that.==W== The one who faced hardship by your side was not Noya, but me…
… Honestly,==W== it's always Noya this, Noya that.==W== The one who faced hardship by your side==W== was not Noya, but me…
To you,==W== I'm just someone to fill the loneliness of not being able to see her. A substitute, aren't I?
I've never thought of you as someone else's replacement.
If you see traces of her in me,==W== that only proves==W== the memories you shared with her still remain in your heart.
If you see traces of her in me,==W== that only proves the memories you shared with her still remain in your heart.
Unlike me ...==W== who can't even remember the faces of the companions==W== I once fought back-to-back with…
But I can't even remember the faces of the companions I once fought back-to-back with…==W== It's good you're not like me…
I ... treasured these old scars==W== on my body as offerings to the comrades==W== who fell in the arena.
I ...==W== treasured these old scars on my body==W== as offerings to the comrades who fell in the arena.
And yet...==W== As the scars began to fade,==W== so too did the scenes of those days.
To be honest,==W== I envy you.==W== You still have someone you long to see.
To be honest,==W== I envy you.==W== You still have==W== someone you long to see.
I no longer==W== have anyone like that anymore…
Hehe... ==W==You really do==W== have a way with words.
Hehe...==W== You really do==W== have a way with words.
When I'm with you,==W== I just want to keep crossing the lines forever.==W== You really are ... quite the handful.
When I'm with you,==W== I just want to keep crossing the lines forever.==W== You really are ...==W== quite the handful.
Alina quietly avoids the topic. She takes off the rest of her clothes and pulls me into the private bath meant just for the two of us.
I don't know what she's thinking, but as we sit in the water, she keeps her fingers laced with mine.
Her fingers are slender, but her grip is steady and firm.
Later on, Caligula's crimes are made public. But the story of that day remains a secret, one that's forever shared only between the two of us.
If only ... I could become your "Noya."
