strings.text: The reward for hard work is a sound sleep and sweet dreams.
Forgive the short notice, Boss. Thanks for coming.
Don't mention it. You said over comms that Ruby and Sapphire were acting strange...==W== What's actually going on?
I believe it's best you see for yourself. They're right next door.
Let's gooo! Sales figures: verified! Project plan: drafted! Next up: the meeting minutes!
Collate the quarterlies. Adjust Lady Firenze's schedule… So much to do, but if I skip lunch, I can definitely make the deadline...
O-Okay, that's intense...==W== They didn't even notice us walking in. You're right, something feels off.
I've asked them what's wrong, but they just tell me not to worry. They simply refuse to be honest with me.
So you brought me in to dig up whatever they're hiding?
Precisely.==W== You always were sharp. So, care to lend a hand?
Well, I'm already here, so I'll help.==W== Just don't expect a miracle, okay?
Relax, I know. You talk like that, but you always deliver results in the end, don't you?
She knows exactly how to play me... Guess I have to give it a shot.
Hey, Ruby? Sapphire? Sorry to interrupt.
Full speed aheaaad! My mind is clearer than ever! Throw more work at me, I'm ready!
Mmhmm, file this report...==W== Check those numbers...
They're totally tuning me out.==W== Gotta be louder.
Finally got through. Do you two have a sec?
Heheh. Since you're here, don't even think about leaving!
Typos here, syntax errors there...==W== Wait, are there missing numbers too?
How's it looking, Boss? Five hundred measly spreadsheets should be an easy case for you!
These materials are for the upcoming agenda. Please review them thoroughly. No typos or omissions allowed. We are counting on you.
Let's see...==W== "Locals prefer hand-grown suburban veggies over greenhouse crops, despite the price hike"?
Hey Boss, tag the types and prices for those, yeah?
Boss, many shops still await inspection. We must leave now, or we will fall behind.
Wait! I haven't finished the paperwork—!
Report received. The new project is proceeding smoothly. Please continue.
Wait...==W== I only came to ask a question. How'd I get dragged into this?
This workload is insane. Have they always been this swamped?
Nice! Most of the scheduled tasks have been completed. Keep this pace up, and we'll be kicking back in no time!
Indeed. We just need to return later to wrap things up.
Kicking back? Are they clearing their future workload just to secure a vacation?
Boss, please deliver this report to Lady Firenze. We have matters to attend to at Production, so we'll be heading back.
Sorry to interrupt. Here's that new research report.
Well, Boss? Isn't Sapphire supposed to be running this project?
They looked completely swamped, so I decided to pitch in.
Also, I think I know what they're up to. Sounds like they're planning some time off.
I only had a hunch. Thanks for confirming it.==W== It's a bit embarrassing. They've been with me for ages, yet I haven't done a single thing to reward them. I feel terrible.
Something still feels off...==W== If they wanted a break, why not simply ask? There must be more to it.
I'll check on them again. Might find out more.
Well, once that leave request hits my desk, I'll have some floral tea ready. It works wonders for stress.
I'm back. Anything else needs doing? Just say the word.
Thanks, but we've just about wrapped everything up.
As expected of Firenze's team. They are incredibly efficient.
Since they're done, I should just ask them straight out—
Phew...==W== After all that, Lady Firenze's schedule has to be clear now!
Naturally. I ran the simulations a hundred times. We've guaranteed a minimum two-hour window.
Huh? Thought you were working this hard to get a vacation?
Umm...==W== Sort of? What we really wanted ...==W== was time to relax with Lady Firenze!
We wanted to repay Lady Firenze for her kindness, but she's never free, so we thought that we should shoulder some of the load.
Hehe, quit stalling in front of Boss! Sapphire just wanted some girl time!
You should've heard her whining: "Lady Firenze's always talking to Boss so much, I'm so jealous! I wanna hang out with her too!"
... H-Hey, quiet! Anyway, we're wasting time! Let's go look for Lady Firenze.
You got it! Oh, grab the snacks we made! Come along too, Boss!
Odd. Why hasn't anyone checked in? Usually, I'd have a mountain of contracts to sign by now...
Lady Firenze? Do you have a moment?
Here already? The tea's just been brewed.
Pardon the intrusion, Lady Firenze! We have news!
Boss already filled me in. Rest assured, I will approve it.
Really? How wonderful...==W== We finally get the chance to share tea time with you, my Lady.
Tea time? I thought you were here to ask for leave.
Well, it is leave... But we worked our tails off just so we could spend that free time relaxing with you!
Anyway, that's the gist of it. What do you think?
So you wanted my company...==W== Haha. You two never fail to exceed my expectations.
In that case...==W== The weather is lovely. Shall we go for a picnic?
Look! The wisteria is in full bloom right now!
I'm on cake duty!==W== Heheh, witness the ultimate slicing skills I honed through years of training!
I've set the plates here. Just serve the slices once you're done.
Then allow me to pour. Where is the tea set?
No, no! You shouldn't have to lift a finger!
Please, allow me to handle it.
Consider this a reward for all your hard work.
Mmm...==W== Don't mind if I do! Heheh, tea brewed by Lady Firenze herself... What a treat!
Aah...==W== Simply divine! Hands down the most aromatic tea I've ever tasted!
I'm pleased you enjoy it.==W== The cake is exquisite. Is the filling made from that fresh fruit shipment?
Correct. It's a new arrival from our suppliers, and the locals are loving it.
Why are we talking shop again? I thought this was supposed to be a break.
It's fine! Work is part of the fun! Honestly, chatting like this is plenty relaxing for us.
The enemy we faced on that commission was truly formidable, but in the critical moment, it suddenly occurred to me that I could leverage historical combat experience...
Sapphire? Ruby? You still with me?
Mmm... Zzz... I can manage ... another bite...==W== Tea party ... with Lady Firenze...==W== Heheh...
Look at you, fighting to stay awake...==W== Just rest. Since today is special, you may use my lap as a pillow.
Are you ...==W== sure? Then ... if you don't mind...
Shh. Let them sleep a little longer.
To think they worked so hard...==W== And all they wanted was to sit with me for tea and a chat.
They really look up to you and adore you.
I'm hard on them. Sometimes I worry that deep down, they see me as nothing more than a cold, unapproachable senior.
No matter how close we get, there's always a wall between superior and subordinate.
Heheh... Lady Firenze...==W== M-More... Keep talking...
No fair... Only the Boss...==W== We wanna hang out with Lady Firenze too...
It seems I was worrying for nothing.
Still, both passing out is intense. Given how they were acting earlier,==W== they must have been running on pure willpower this whole time.
Relax, it's the tea. It's a relaxant. Since they've been wound so tight, it hit them much harder than usual. A good nap is exactly what they need.
Ah, makes sense. Though I bet they're going to kick themselves when they wake up for dozing off so fast.
There will be plenty of chances. Next time, I'll clear my schedule properly and invite them out myself.
They're going to be over the moon when they hear that.
Hehe, I hope so. For now, let's just enjoy the quiet. Seeing them sleep so soundly isn't a luxury I get often, after all.

param: The reward for hard work is a sound sleep and sweet dreams.
Forgive the short notice, Boss. Thanks for coming.
Don't mention it. You said over comms that Ruby and Sapphire were acting strange...==W== What's actually going on?
I believe it's best you see for yourself. They're right next door.
Let's gooo! Sales figures: verified! Project plan: drafted! Next up: the meeting minutes!
Collate the quarterlies. Adjust Lady Firenze's schedule… So much to do, but if I skip lunch, I can definitely make the deadline...
O-Okay, that's intense...==W== They didn't even notice us walking in. You're right, something feels off.
I've asked them what's wrong, but they just tell me not to worry. They simply refuse to be honest with me.
So you brought me in to dig up whatever they're hiding?
Precisely.==W== You always were sharp. So, care to lend a hand?
Well, I'm already here, so I'll help.==W== Just don't expect a miracle, okay?
Relax, I know. You talk like that, but you always deliver results in the end, don't you?
She knows exactly how to play me... Guess I have to give it a shot.
Hey, Ruby? Sapphire? Sorry to interrupt.
Full speed aheaaad! My mind is clearer than ever! Throw more work at me, I'm ready!
Mmhmm, file this report...==W== Check those numbers...
They're totally tuning me out.==W== Gotta be louder.
Finally got through. Do you two have a sec?
Heheh. Since you're here, don't even think about leaving!
Typos here, syntax errors there...==W== Wait, are there missing numbers too?
How's it looking, Boss? Five hundred measly spreadsheets should be an easy case for you!
These materials are for the upcoming agenda. Please review them thoroughly. No typos or omissions allowed. We are counting on you.
Let's see...==W== "Locals prefer hand-grown suburban veggies over greenhouse crops, despite the price hike"?
Hey Boss, tag the types and prices for those, yeah?
Boss, many shops still await inspection. We must leave now, or we will fall behind.
Wait! I haven't finished the paperwork—!
Report received. The new project is proceeding smoothly. Please continue.
Wait...==W== I only came to ask a question. How'd I get dragged into this?
This workload is insane. Have they always been this swamped?
Nice! Most of the scheduled tasks have been completed. Keep this pace up, and we'll be kicking back in no time!
Indeed. We just need to return later to wrap things up.
Kicking back? Are they clearing their future workload just to secure a vacation?
Boss, please deliver this report to Lady Firenze. We have matters to attend to at Production, so we'll be heading back.
Sorry to interrupt. Here's that new research report.
Well, Boss? Isn't Sapphire supposed to be running this project?
They looked completely swamped, so I decided to pitch in.
Also, I think I know what they're up to. Sounds like they're planning some time off.
I only had a hunch. Thanks for confirming it.==W== It's a bit embarrassing. They've been with me for ages, yet I haven't done a single thing to reward them. I feel terrible.
Something still feels off...==W== If they wanted a break, why not simply ask? There must be more to it.
I'll check on them again. Might find out more.
Well, once that leave request hits my desk, I'll have some floral tea ready. It works wonders for stress.
I'm back. Anything else needs doing? Just say the word.
Thanks, but we've just about wrapped everything up.
As expected of Firenze's team. They are incredibly efficient.
Since they're done, I should just ask them straight out—
Phew...==W== After all that, Lady Firenze's schedule has to be clear now!
Naturally. I ran the simulations a hundred times. We've guaranteed a minimum two-hour window.
Huh? Thought you were working this hard to get a vacation?
Umm...==W== Sort of? What we really wanted ...==W== was time to relax with Lady Firenze!
We wanted to repay Lady Firenze for her kindness, but she's never free, so we thought that we should shoulder some of the load.
Hehe, quit stalling in front of Boss! Sapphire just wanted some girl time!
You should've heard her whining: "Lady Firenze's always talking to Boss so much, I'm so jealous! I wanna hang out with her too!"
... H-Hey, quiet! Anyway, we're wasting time! Let's go look for Lady Firenze.
You got it! Oh, grab the snacks we made! Come along too, Boss!
Odd. Why hasn't anyone checked in? Usually, I'd have a mountain of contracts to sign by now...
Lady Firenze? Do you have a moment?
Here already? The tea's just been brewed.
Pardon the intrusion, Lady Firenze! We have news!
Boss already filled me in. Rest assured, I will approve it.
Really? How wonderful...==W== We finally get the chance to share tea time with you, my Lady.
Tea time? I thought you were here to ask for leave.
Well, it is leave... But we worked our tails off just so we could spend that free time relaxing with you!
Anyway, that's the gist of it. What do you think?
So you wanted my company...==W== Haha. You two never fail to exceed my expectations.
In that case...==W== The weather is lovely. Shall we go for a picnic?
Look! The wisteria is in full bloom right now!
I'm on cake duty!==W== Heheh, witness the ultimate slicing skills I honed through years of training!
I've set the plates here. Just serve the slices once you're done.
Then allow me to pour. Where is the tea set?
No, no! You shouldn't have to lift a finger!
Please, allow me to handle it.
Consider this a reward for all your hard work.
Mmm...==W== Don't mind if I do! Heheh, tea brewed by Lady Firenze herself... What a treat!
Aah...==W== Simply divine! Hands down the most aromatic tea I've ever tasted!

strings.text: A hesitant attempt, a bright beginning.
This is the story of Freesia when she first joined Post Haste.
The address on this letter ...==W== yes, this must be it. Recipient and house number confirmed. Delivery done.
Now, where's my next stop? Gotta check the map again...
Ugh, running late again...==W== I need to memorize these routes asap if I want to be as fast as Teresa. Well, better pick up the pace and try to stick to the timeline.
Recipient? Check. Address? Check. Delivered. Next stop...!
Hey there, rider girl! Got a minute?
Yes. Freesia from Post Haste, at your service. Your letters will be delivered with speed and precision.
Excellent! Lucky me. Though I should mention I have quite a few letters here. Would that work for you?
These are all greeting letters for our VIP clients. I'll make it worth your while...==W== Oh, are you alright?
I saw that look on your face. Feeling overwhelmed?
Not at all. You have my word that each letter will be delivered with proper care.
I'll leave them in your capable hands, then.
Well, this complicates things. Though a big order should be good news...
Donna would've handled this way better—she could probably even turned them into a loyal customer.
I'm part of Post Haste, yet I can't seem to do anything to help.
No use moping. I took the job, so I'd better get every letter delivered in time.
If I give it my all, I should make it...==W== No, I HAVE to make it—!
Ouch, that hurts... What's wrong now?
Not the chain again?! I can't finish today's route without the bicycle...==W== No, I've got to hurry back and fix it.
You gotta be kidding me. I'd better find cover before these letters get drenched.
Phew...==W== Should be safe here. Quick check... Yep, all the letters are dry.
Deliveries unfinished, bicycle broken. If these letters were ruined too, how am I gonna face Donna and Teresa...
Hmm... Do I really deserve to stay in Post Haste when I can't even handle the basics?
Maybe Post Haste would run smoother with just Donna and Teresa.
I cannot allow myself to hold them back.
... Just something I need to sort out myself.
Oh, is that so?==W== Well, if you share it with me, I might be able to help you figure it out more easily.
I hate to say it, but ... maybe I'm just not cut out for this courier job...
What? What could possibly make you think that?!
I'm not like Teresa—she's got all the routes down pat. I just keep taking forever with deliveries.
I blew a perfect chance to promote Post Haste when a customer wanted more services...==W== Donna, you would've totally won them over as regulars.
And ...==W== in my "brilliant" attempt to speed things up, I ended up wrecking the bicycle instead.
Then the rain started pouring...==W== Sure, I saved the letters, but that was literally the only thing I did right today. Talk about a total fail.
Maybe this is a sign that I'm just not cut out for Post Haste...
Hold it right there—I simply cannot let you continue like this!
Let me be clear—your performance has been nothing short of admirable. Your self-doubt has no basis at all.
Let me finish! You're trying to compare yourself to Teresa and me, aren't you?
It's not really fair to make those kinds of comparisons. You're still learning the ropes, while we've been at this for quite some time.
Just speak up—ask Teresa if you need directions, and let me handle the tough customers.
But that just means more work for you...==W== I don't want to be a burden because of my shortcomings.
Why would you even consider yourself a burden?
You're an absolute gem, Freesia. Post Haste is fortunate to have someone as conscientious as you.
Everyone's got different strengths. There's no shame in asking for help where others shine. But make sure to nurture your own talents too, Freesia.
To be honest, I'd prefer if you leaned on us more often. True family bonds are forged through mutual support and trust.
Hmm, understood. But ... do you think Teresa feels the same way you do?
Hehe, you won't know unless you ask her yourself.
... Ah, there you are! Donna! Freesia! I brought umbrellas!
With all this rain, I called her to come pick us up. By the way, about that question earlier—why don't you ask her now?
What's with all the hush-hush, you two?
Um ...==W== Teresa, can I ask you something...
Huh? Did the rain mess with your head, Freesia? Why are you acting weird?
Well... Not only am I slow with deliveries, I also wrecked the bicycle, and now I need your help fixing it—again.
No biggie—we'll just fix it up. Let me take a look...==W== Whoa!
This chain is completely trashed! You must've used some crazy strength to snap it like this... Freesia, you're really pushing it with these deliveries!
I'll reinforce it this time so it won't break no matter how hard you pedal! Then Freesia will be zooming around—==W==maybe even faster than those scooters!
Faster than scooters? Then we can surely deliver to more distant places...==W== Ah, that's right! Cycling is your talent, Freesia!
Exactly! Plus, when I'm doing repairs, Freesia's my super-strong assistant who can lift the bike up high like it's nothing!
All of these ...==W== are actually my talents?
Alright, time to hit the road and finish these last deliveries. Teresa, you can give Freesia a little tour of the area.
Got it! Trust me, Freesia, I've got this whole area memorized, even the hidden paths!
Thank goodness they're here. Now maybe these deliveries will actually get done.
We can put away the umbrellas now—==W==Whoa, check that out!
They say rainbows bring good luck!
Beautiful! Look at all those colors across the sky!
(Donna and Teresa are both so caring... I guess I was overthinking it. I never should've doubted them.)
(They believe in me... No way I'm going to let them down.)
I'm still new to this whole delivery thing, and I'm pretty rough around the edges. Thanks for putting up with me—I'll do my best to improve.
Also, I'll try to ... rely on you both a bit more.
Awesome! Teamwork makes the dream work! Let's turn Post Haste into an empire!
Is becoming a courier really the right choice? Freesia isn't sure—her past failures still make her doubt herself.
But meeting Donna and Teresa changes everything—this has to be a fresh start, like a beautiful new day breaking through.

strings.text: In a tranquil garden that nurtures secrets, the witch silently descended.
Basically, all of these idol merch are defective goods.
Forget "premium," you couldn't even resell them second-hand.
You hear that? Passing this off on fans is one thing—but trying to scam us!?
No way! All these came from the proper channels, with official certificates! If you don't believe me, look—
Look at what? You think you can fool us at the Merch Oversight Guild?
Merch Oversight Guild...==W== Aren't you just some civic group? What right do you—
Watch your tone. We've got Witches reporting for us.==RT==You don't want this splashed everywhere, do you?
But... this doesn't have to be a problem. You know what to do, right?
Half of the profits, paid every week...
Hahaha! Here's someone who talks my language!
W-witch lady! They're saying you'll just make things up! You won't, will you?
Heh...==W== Don't you know us Witches well?
Listen well: Witches will do anything for a big scoop~
Honestly, Flavio is not for someone as naive as you.
Just settle last week's take for now. We'll be back in a few days.==RT==Don't get any funny ideas. So long as you're in Flavio, there's no way you can get out of this.
From now on, every shop in the city will be paying us regularly!
We are the authority. Go against us, you go against all of Flavio!
Heh, poor-quality merch hurts idols and fans alike. Any shopkeeper would just cave.
And it's all thanks to your brilliant idea!
Eh~ I can't take all the credit. The real star today is our Witch.==RT==A toast to the great Witch!
Hic...==W== Don't just sit there drinking. Haven't you thought about what you're gonna do once you are loaded?
Me me me! Eh~ I wanna buy a car and ride it around the Gold District every day!
To be honest, I've been looking at property to let over there.==W== When I have the money, I can go to Aobelle's concerts every day, ehhehe...
Tch, that's all you can think of?
Me? I'll keep expanding our business model. One day, I'll be collecting in Emor!
Wow, that is visionary! Right there! What about you, Witch lady?
Me? Nothing in particular~ If I had the money, I'd want to build another Witch's Beacon.
That way, exposing rats like you would be much easier.
W-What? Who are you going to expose?
The Merch Oversight Guild, which means all of you here.
Hmph, I knew you had an angle. But what proof have you got?
Ahaha~ Sorry, but I've got plenty.
Good thing we locked the doors. You're the underground rat now. No escape.
Heehee~ Be my guest~ Won't stop me anyway.
Extortion, vandalism, forgery. Pick your favorite charge, or do you wanna just take the whole shebang~?
Damn...==W== Don't be afraid, guys! She's just a Witch. Show her what happens when you cross us!
The consequences of angering a witch... Of all people, you really should know~
Lights out...==W== and let the judgment begin~
It's the Imperial Guard! They are coming for us!
The Guard!?...==W== Damned Witch! They'll arrest you, too!
Guard! Nobody move! Both hands down!
Where—where is she!? Witch! Come out here—!
Wh-who's there!? Another shakedown—?==W== Please, wait!
Shhh, don't scream, it's just me. Look at you, all jumpy.
The Witch lady? Why are you here? If it's for protection money, isn't that only due later!?
Protection money?==W== I'm just here to have a chat~ I went by your store, but no one was there. Took me a while to track you down.
I-I'm not running it anymore...==W== I'll be leaving Flavio in a few days.
What you mean, 'how come'?==W== After I paid the protection fee, I couldn't even make rent.
And last week they took half my profits... I can't keep doing this anymore...
Heh, here you go. Got you your money back, didn't I?
Sorry about that. I had to pretend to side with them so I could infiltrate their little gang. Here, I'm giving the money back to you now~
Thank you so much! Now I won't have to close!
Don't mention it. If you really wanted to thank me...==W== You know what Witches are really after, right?
A story like this is best told when the victim speaks up~ So, I'll be counting on you!
No problem! I'll tell exactly how it happened!
Hey, check the papers! A huge scandal about that Merch Oversight Guild~
Aren't they a civic group? What kind of scandal could there be?
If you read on, it says that "An collaborative investigation by a Witch and the Guard revealed serious corruption."
Lemme see...==W== Her name is Mistique.
Witch coming through! Pardon! Excuse me!
Cough...==W== Hey! Watch where you're flying!
Wait... Wasn't that Mistique? From Scarlet Sights Media? She's the Witch who wrote this piece!
No way! I didn't even notice...
Heh~ Looks like this report is getting quite the reaction~
If I don't stir things up and make some real noise, wouldn't all my effort just go to waste~?
But this is just the beginning~
It's strange that a bunch of street punks could pull off something this organized.
Heheh~ In the city's shadows, secrets grow. And secrets draw hungry Witches.
Witches answer the people's thirst for truth and deliver what they crave.
Secrets, desire, truth, passion—such is the brew of a witch's elixir~
Now then... Time to find something even juicier.==W== Hm?
No, wait, more like came back from suspension!
I think it's called ...==W== "Boss Accord Staffing Company."
Looks like I'll have to make a trip to Emor.

Hmph, I knew you had an angle. But what proof have you got?
Ahaha~ Sorry, but I've got plenty.
Good thing we locked the doors. You're the underground rat now. No escape.
Heehee~ Be my guest~ Won't stop me anyway.
Extortion, vandalism, forgery. Pick your favorite charge, or do you wanna just take the whole shebang~?
Damn...==W== Don't be afraid, guys! She's just a Witch. Show her what happens when you cross us!
The consequences of angering a witch... Of all people, you really should know~
Lights out...==W== and let the judgment begin~
It's the Imperial Guard! They are coming for us!
The Guard!?...==W== Damned Witch! They'll arrest you, too!
Guard! Nobody move! Both hands down!
Where—where is she!? Witch! Come out here—!
Wh-who's there!? Another shakedown—?==W== Please, wait!
Shhh, don't scream, it's just me. Look at you, all jumpy.
The Witch lady? Why are you here? If it's for protection money, isn't that only due later!?
Protection money?==W== I'm just here to have a chat~ I went by your store, but no one was there. Took me a while to track you down.
I-I'm not running it anymore...==W== I'll be leaving Flavio in a few days.
What you mean, 'how come'?==W== After I paid the protection fee, I couldn't even make rent.
And last week they took half my profits... I can't keep doing this anymore...
Heh, here you go. Got you your money back, didn't I?
Sorry about that. I had to pretend to side with them so I could infiltrate their little gang. Here, I'm giving the money back to you now~
Thank you so much! Now I won't have to close!
Don't mention it. If you really wanted to thank me...==W== You know what Witches are really after, right?
A story like this is best told when the victim speaks up~ So, I'll be counting on you!
No problem! I'll tell exactly how it happened!
Hey, check the papers! A huge scandal about that Merch Oversight Guild~
Aren't they a civic group? What kind of scandal could there be?
If you read on, it says that "An collaborative investigation by a Witch and the Guard revealed serious corruption."
Lemme see...==W== Her name is Mistique.
Witch coming through! Pardon! Excuse me!
Cough...==W== Hey! Watch where you're flying!
Wait... Wasn't that Mistique? From Scarlet Sights Media? She's the Witch who wrote this piece!
No way! I didn't even notice...
Heh~ Looks like this report is getting quite the reaction~
If I don't stir things up and make some real noise, wouldn't all my effort just go to waste~?
But this is just the beginning~
It's strange that a bunch of street punks could pull off something this organized.
Heheh~ In the city's shadows, secrets grow. And secrets draw hungry Witches.
Witches answer the people's thirst for truth and deliver what they crave.
Secrets, desire, truth, passion—such is the brew of a witch's elixir~
Now then... Time to find something even juicier.==W== Hm?
No, wait, more like came back from suspension!
I think it's called ...==W== "Boss Accord Staffing Company."
Looks like I'll have to make a trip to Emor.

strings.text: With everything settled down, how would Ashwind Clan face the new challenges ahead?
Phew...==W== thanks to you, Boss, we finally shook free of Creta Trading!
If not for you, we'd probably still be stuck in that nightmare right now~
Eh? You two dragged me out in the middle of the night just to thank me again?
Of course! You are the great benefactor of the Ashwind Clan! No matter how many times we thank you, it'll never be enough.
Something feels off... Don't tell me you've got a favor to ask?
Nothing escapes you, Boss. You saw right through us.
Just say it. I'll do what I can to help.
As you know, the Ashwind Clan was formed to protect the orphanage, to keep Creta Trading and other gangs away.
Now that all our enemies have been defeated, and Ashwind Clan has a new goal of assembling Artifacts. Yet, we're still quite lost on what kind of mindset to face the challenges ahead.
So really, I asked you out tonight just to talk it over, to hear your thoughts.
If you put that way... I don't have an answer for you off the top of my head.
That's fine! No rush. We can think while we walk. It's just us taking a stroll!
Fair enough. I haven't taken in the Ash District's night view in a while.
Then let's head toward the Waterway!
Look! Over here—there's a Stella Drama poster!
Looks like the one you told us about last time...
Oh, that one! I remember there was a line from it that I especially liked!
"Inside every heart there is both black and white. Most people choose to remain in the gray. But I—"
Uh... What was the rest again...?
Don't tell me you forgot during your last trip to the Monolith to make a wish?
I must have. I can't remember at all.==RT==Dang it, it was such an important line...
Guess the only way is to watch it again inside the Monolith.
Not necessarily. If you still remember the story, we could probably deduce the rest.
We've walked all the way to the Waterway but still can't figure out the rest of the line.
I only remember one of the protagonists was an anti-hero whose moral code was kinda gray, but I can't remember how it turned out after that.
I'm sure he went full hero. That's how these stories always go.
That would have been way too boring. No way I'd enjoy a story like that.
I think the rest of the line had to be about the hero reflecting on his own inner world.
Reflecting on his inner world, huh...
Hey! You there! What are you doing sneaking around in the middle of the night?!
We're just out taking a walk, that's all. Problem?
There's a shipment of Artifacts being transported tonight. This whole area is under lockdown!
What's the point talking to these Ash District trash? Just run them out of here! Who knows if they're gonna try to steal the Artifacts.
If your men are this inefficient, I'll have to hire another company next time!
My apologies! I'll discipline him right away!
You! This is what you get from spending too much time in the Ash District. Don't waste time talking to these trash lowborn. Our mission is to satisfy the employer’s requests.
Yes, Captain! It won't happen again...
Hey! What are you two chitchating over there? Who're you calling trash!
Calm down, Vollara. We're not here to pick a fight tonight.
Hmph. At least one of you get it.
Huh? Hey! You there! Why have you been hiding in the back all this time!
How come I've never seen you in the Ash District before?!
This the one who saved all of us from the Monolith Meltdown! What do you mean, "never seen you before"?
As if someone like that would ever stoop to mingle with trash like you!
Men! Detain this suspicious person! Lock them up until the transport's finished!
Wait a second! How can you say Boss is suspicious just from that?
That depends on how much bail you can put up.
Not extortion, just company policy. Surely someone like you say wouldn't be short on money. Let's say... 5,000,000 Dorra as proof?
Minova, we don't have that much...
I say we just fight it out. Teach them a lesson!
No. The Imperial Guard knights aren't easy pickings. If we start a fight here, it'll only end badly for us.
Then what do we do? We can't just stand by while they drag Boss away~
If only I had on that uniform today...
Alright. I'll draw their attention. The rest of you slip into the alleys!
Look out! Someone's going after the Artifact shipment!
Damn it! How dare you trick me!
After them! If you let these little trash get away, kiss the contract goodbye!
Damn, once they duck into those alleys, it's impossible to find them...
Keep looking! How else are we going to get out of this one?
Who're you calling trash, huh?! If you can't say anything nice, you should just keep your trap shut!
A bomb goes off at the knights' feet. Minova, who's been waiting on the rooftops, leaps down to rumble with the rest of the pursuers.
I crouch behind a crate, watching Minova wiping the floor with the knights.
The wealthy man who had been watching from nearby just moments ago has already vanished without a trace.
As for the missing line from that drama... It doesn't seem to matter anymore.==W== From that look in Minova's eyes, I can tell that she has already made her own choice.

strings.text: People always dream in springtime. In your lidded eyes, a dream of a vast, azure sky...
Iris said dropping these snacks off at Post Haste was the whole job, but...==W== It's dead quiet. Are they closed today?
Coming! Sorry!==W== I was in the back...
Huh? Boss? You here on business? Or...==W== Did you come all this way just to see me?
Well...==W== You're half right. Iris sent some snacks over. A thank-you for handling that rush order the other day.
Aww, she's too kind! We were just doing our job.==W== Be sure to thank her for us, okay, Boss?
Stick around for some tea?==W== I was about to take a break anyway.
... I see.==W== So Freesia and Teresa took those gift tickets and went on a trip.==W== But with only two tickets, how did you decide who went?
They had time, and I'm swamped, so I let them go have fun.==W== Besides, looking out for my staff's well-being is part of the job!
But...==W== Yawn...==W== I worked late last night...==W== I'm fading fast. The tea's making me all warm and fuzzy and sleepy...
Ugh... I was also up way too late,==W== reading manga...==W== Now I'm crashing too...
H-hello? I'd like to send a letter...
Mailing a letter, right? Who's the recipient?
A Trekker! He saved me from a monster, so I wrote a thank-you note.==W== But I don't know his name or address...==W== Can you still deliver it?
That's a tall order...==W== You don't even know who he is...
Of course! Leave it to Post Haste!
You sure you should be promising that?!
Easy peasy! Now, sweetie, what did he look like? How old was he? Was he holding anything?
Um...==W== He was about as old as the boy at the bakery. He had a sword ...==W== and he was wearing a green stone on his wrist.
Green gem on the wrist...==W== Sounds like a bracelet.==W== Okay! With that, I bet we can find him.
You got it!==W== I'll keep your letter safe. Time to go find this guy!
That's barely any info, Donna. How are you gonna find him?
Heh. Doubting me? Just tag along and watch a pro at work!
A guy with a green gem bracelet...==W== Yeah, rings a bell. He mentioned he rarely left this street when he wasn't diving in the Monolith. Stick around, and you might run into him.
See? A solid lead right off the bat! Thanks for the tip!
Snagging a major clue right out of the gate. We're on a roll.
I know, right? At this rate, we'll have this delivered in no time!
Bracelet with a green gem? No clue. Never seen him.
I feel like I've seen him around ...==W== but not lately.
Huh? What Trekker? I don't know!
You realize whose turf this is? Get lost before I make you regret it!
Bracelets are a dime a dozen around here. How am I supposed to know which Trekker you mean?
Forget that—can you help me out?==W== We took a monster hunting gig, but we're short-handed.==W== You look like you can hold your own, right? Skipping that burden behind there.
Sigh...==W== We've combed every street and alley with nothing to show for it.
I really thought we'd find him right away after getting that first clue...
I guess delivering a letter to a stranger with no name or address was a long shot after all.
But I'm not giving up!==W== This letter carries that child's gratitude. No matter how long it takes, I am going to deliver it!
I'll stick with you to the very end!
Excuse me, are you two looking for someone?
He's not a Trekker,==W== but there's a waiter at the restaurant up ahead wearing a green gem bracelet. Might be worth checking out?
But he doesn't fit the "Trekker" part of the description...==W== What do you think?
We have to check, even on the slightest chance!==W== Oh—and thanks for the tip!
<size=90%>Boss, look at his wrist. That chain peeking out from his cuff…==W== Is that the green gem bracelet the girl mentioned?==W== This might be our guy...</size>
Sorry to bother you...==W== Do you have a sec to talk?
I used to be a Trekker, yes. But now...==W== As you can see, I'm just a server here.
Actually, a little girl you once helped asked us to bring you this letter.
A little girl? That does ring a bell...==W== But why would she write to me?
Let me see...==W== "Thank you, Mister. Because of you, I made it home safe."
I-I was a total failure as a Trekker...==W== Every commission ended in disaster. I was nothing but a burden, so I lost my nerve and quit...
But this letter... It feels like a lifeline. To know that I actually helped someone...==W== Thank you for bringing this to me. Thank you.
Don't mention it! That's just part of the service at Post Haste!
That's great news. He said thanks to that letter, he might even consider becoming a Trekker again.
Yeah!==W== You know, this actually brings back some memories for me, too.
You've been through something similar, Donna?
Mhm. A letter saved me once.==W== That envelope, and the courier who delivered it, taught me something. It might feel light in your hands, but it carries enough weight to save a soul.
That's why I became a courier. I wanted to deliver messages just like they did. Figured maybe I could save someone else along the way.
I traveled everywhere delivering mail. Eventually I met Freesia and Teresa, and we started Post Haste. You could say letters gave me a second chance at life.
I get it now...==W== No wonder you were so dead set on finding that guy.
Mm-hm! By the way, what about those tickets the server gave us just now?==W== Looks like they're tickets to the theme park inside the nearby Monolith.
A theme park inside a Monolith?==W== That's odd. Can you even bring tickets like that outside?
Good point...==W== But who cares! We've got two tickets and zero plans. Let's go check it out!
Whoa—==W==look at that giant wheel! And those Artifact cars zooming down the tracks!==W== When did this Monolith get all this cool stuff?!
Welcome to the park!==W== Here's a balloon for you.==W== Stay close to your grown-up now, don't get lost!
Whoa, that is a lot of balloons!
And hey, I'm not a kid—==W==whatever. Still, I feel like I'm gonna float away holding all these! Here, Boss, take half—
Huh? That happy scream sounds familiar...
Boss, look up there! It's Freesia and Teresa! So this is where they went for their trip!
Pfft-hahaha! Look at Teresa's face! Wait, how is Freesia still keeping a straight face...? They're nothing like me. It's hilarious.
You're all so different, yet you make such an incredible team.
When Post Haste first opened, we had the passion, but absolutely zero clue about how to actually run things.
We didn't have the funds to handle deliveries out in the remote regions.
So we took every commission we could get, micromanaged our routes, and scraped together travel fare before setting out.
But through it all, no matter how hard it got, I only had to look up to find Freesia and Teresa by my side.
That's how I know we'll find a way through anything, as long as we're together.
It's what they taught me.==W== No... It's a precious gift they gave me.
I haven't been on my own for a long time.
You really treasure them, don't you, Donna?
You bet! They're the most important partners I have!
Once they get down here, let's have fun together...
Huh?! W-wait?! The balloons...!==W== Seriously?! They're actually carrying me away?!!
Uhh...==W== Boss, g-get me down...==W== I'm drifting away...
Shh. Donna is resting...==W== And...==W== Why is Boss here as well?
Nggh...?==W== Must have dozed off...==W== Oh, you're back!
Indeed. It seems Donna has been overloading herself with work in our absence again...
Let us keep our voices down and let her rest. We can wake her once dinner is ready.

strings.text: A chance encounter, a pleasant surprise; this cabin in the woods belongs to the two of you, encircled by the echoing call of deer.
I'm out in the forests of Philae, alone, after taking a herb-gathering commission.
It's unnervingly quiet ... and what's with these marks on the trees?
Couldn't be from a monster, right? I only came alone 'cause I heard it was safe. If one actually shows up, my only option would be to run for it.
But the commission brief didn't warn about anything like this...
Maybe it's just the bark peeling off. No point getting spooked over nothing.
Right. Better to just get this over with and head back.
He sounds agitated. I haven't done anything to get an earful, have I?==W== Wait, am I even in the right spot?
That's right. On a commission from the Trekker Association.
Thank the stars! You couldn't have come at a better time!

strings.text: When the scenery of spring has become part of everyday life, she starts hoping to meet someone who walks into her spring.
How did she spot us?! We were completely hidden!
Impossible... She took us all out by herself...
Whoever's left,==W== come at me together.
Just local troublemakers near the Monolith.==W== Doubt there's any link to Nocturn Eterna.
I'll let the Guard handle the cleanup.==W== Need to head back and resupply.
And get this... that "Silver Gale" from Sentinel of Dawn took down every last one of those thugs single-handedly!
The Silver Gale, eh? Heard plenty of rumors, but never seen her in the flesh.
Ammo? Sure thing...==W== Wait. That outfit... That long silver hair... You're the Silver Gale, aren't you?!
Oh, I suppose people call me that.==W== Excuse me, where's the ammo?
I-It really is you?!==W== Ammo's right on the counter there—please, take your pick!
Can't believe it's actually her...==W== Look at that weapon. My junk sword ain't even in the same league.
The famous Silver Gale, shopping at my place! What an absolute honor!
Excuse me. You with the sword. A moment?
We're both holding swords here. Who're you talking to?
The one on the right, then.==W== Where did the shopkeeper go?==W== You know, the person I was speaking with just now.
Are you? I recall the shopkeeper being unarmed.
I wasn't holding it a minute ago, but I haven't left. You okay? Working too hard?
No need to worry. Standard operational load.==W== Two boxes of these rounds, please.
Here you are. Thanks for the business! Come back anytime!
I will.==W== Thank you,==W== Sword Shopkeeper.==W==
So the rumors were true... The Silver Gale recognizes weapons, not people.==W== Now I've seen everything.
You ... must be "Miss Book."==W== Good timing.==W== Here are the mission logs.
Roger that! I'll get these to the right department. Thanks for the hard work!
But...==W== Miss Wraith, there's a huge mistake here.
I'm not "Miss Book"!==W== I am the cute and charming Bastelina!==B====W== Hmph!==W== You're not leaving until you get my name right.
Come on, say it with me:<size=50>==W== Bas-==W==te-==W==li-==W==na.</size>
Spot on! ==W==Let's do a quick test. Close your eyes.
Sigh… Same old bad habit. You remember what people are holding, but never their faces...
Ah,==W== you two can get back to work.==W== Thanks for playing along!
What was the point of that...? I'm swamped...
Let it slide. We did it for the Silver Gale, after all.==W==
Say...==W== Doesn't forgetting everyone's face make your life hard?
No. On the battlefield, I only need to know friend from foe.
True enough...==W== Hey, you've been running missions non-stop.==W== Must be exhausting.==W== I know a great spot to unwind. Would you like to go?
I appreciate the thought,==W== but I can't rest while Nocturn Eterna is still out there.
Oh? Well...==W== I did hear rumors about Nocturn Eterna activity over there.
<size=30>Heheh, works every time.==W== Mention Nocturn Eterna and her whole look changes.</size>
Here, the route's all in this guide.==W== It's a fair distance away, so do take care out there.
Peaceful. Serene, even...==W== Then again, that makes it the perfect cover for Nocturn Eterna.
Don't they have anything better to do? Why pick a backwater like this to stir up trouble?
Those Monolith wreckers? Pah, the bugs eating my crops are far scarier!
Are those Nocturn Eterna bad news?==W== Then I'm gonna beat 'em up!
Zero leads.==W== Yet the handbook Miss Book provided points explicitly to this location...
Oh, I am fine.==W== Tell me,==W== have you heard of "Nocturn Eterna"?
But I know a special place!==W== When I'm sad, I go there and the wind blows all the bad feelings away.==W== You should try it too!
The place she mentioned should be right around here.
Phew.==W== Been walking a while. ==W==Starting to get warm.
A breeze...==W== Is that a clearing ahead?==B====W== Perfect timing. I'll rest there.
So cool. Feels nice...==W== She was right, this really is a good spot.
Nothing like the North. Back there, it's just endless wind and snow...
Blue skies, green trees, drifting petals...==W== Everything here is beautiful.
I only saw this view thanks to that girl and Miss Book. Need to thank them properly later.
Next time, I have to call Miss Book by her name, or she'll get mad again.==B== Mm... What was it?
Strange. We talked for so long... Yet ... why can't I remember it at all?
And the girl's face... It's getting blurry too...
Chest feels tight... What is this feeling?
Since leaving home, have I changed that much?
I hope one day,==W== you will meet the one who can rewrite the world in your eyes.
Yeah. Think that's what she said.
I only recognize people by their weapons. Could I ever remember a voice? A face? Maybe even a name?
If that person actually shows up...
I wonder what they'd be like.

strings.text: Before she knew it, she had stepped onto a bigger stage. More people began to see her shine, but her trust in you has never changed.
At Fuyuka's invitation, I came to Philae, where the people are preparing for a grand festival.
Oh hey, Boss. What brings you here?
Fuyuka invited me, saying there would be a festival.
Of course I know that.==W== But the festival's tomorrow, isn't it? You didn't get the date wrong, did you?
Nah, I just wanted to see if I could help out.
Really? That's so kind of you. Everyone's been busy as a bee, they'll be so glad to see you.
I see. ==W==If I may ask, Miss Nazuna... For your part, what are you doing?
Hey...==W== What's the look on your face... You are just convinced that I'm slacking off, aren't you?
For the Harvest Festival, Fuyuka will be giving a speech on behalf of Philae, so I'm working on a special outfit for her to wear on stage.
Philae is a land built on agriculture, and the Harvest Festival is the most important of all its celebrations. It's known as the king of festivals.
Fuyuka's role is different this time. She used to be the Trekker representation for this, but this time around she will speak on behalf of the city. It's a big deal.
It's an important festival for an important friend,==W== so I have to make the perfect outfit for her to show my support. Don't worry, Kaede will be helping me, too.
Wow, Fuyuka's gonna represent the whole city?==W== That's amazing...
Probably helping with setting up the fireworks.
Okay, I'll go look for her.
S-sorry to bother you...==W== Where should I put this firework launcher?
Right here's fine! Whoa, Miss Fuyuka, only you could lug a four-meter firework launcher like it's no big deal!
Not at all. Helping carry heavy stuff is about the only thing I'm good for anyway...==W== Ugh—
I... I'm fine.==W== Just got tripped a little...
You don't look too well. Please don't force yourself. That was the last firework launcher anyway, so please leave the rest to us.
Sorry for the trouble. Then...==W== I'll head over to the next place to help out...
Is ... is there anything else you need?
This is a token of our appreciation. It's not much, but please accept this.
Fuyuka is talking with people, all normal-like...
It looks like her shyness has improved a lot, that's great news.
You too...==W==Master?! Why are you here?
Ye ... yes...==W== But the festival is tomorrow?
I know. That's why I showed up in advance to lend you guys a hand.
Mm...==W== But all I wanted was for you to enjoy the festival...==W== I mean, really enjoy it...
That's how things stand...==W== I guess I'm still a little worried...
Coming a day early was definitely the right call.
Even though the speech at the camp went really well,==W== this time the audience will be a hundred times larger—==W==no, a thousand times larger. If something goes wrong...
You're not the same person you used to be. Don't worry, you'll do fine. Even before I got here, you've been doing great in front of everyone, haven't you?
That's true. But the moment I see you,==W== I can't help but want you to spoil me a little, hehe.
Lady Fuyuka~! Do you have a moment? We'd like to run a rehearsal for the opening ceremony!
Sure! I'll come over right away!
Don't worry. I'll stay right next to you.
That's great! With you here,==W== I suddenly feel so much more at ease.
Fuyuka stepped onto the podium, her expression unusually solemn.
People bustled around, their eyes turning toward the podium in anticipation.
Then, let's get started... Three,==W== two,==W== one...==W== Go!
Before I could even react, she suddenly went rigid—like a puppet with its strings cut—and collapsed straight to the ground.
Uu...==W== Ugh...==W== Why am I in bed...?
You fainted on stage during the rehearsal.
The rehearsal...==W== Ah! Right, I was rehearsing my speech!
I have to get over there right away...==W== Or everyone's going to start worrying!
There's no hurry. Take a breather first.
I heard you've been helping out with the festival preparations these past few days. The staff are worried they might have asked you to do too much and you pushed yourself to exhaustion.
No way...==W== I really wanted to help. It's not anyone else's fault!
I get it. That's why, to make sure your speech goes smoothly tomorrow, your job right now is to rest and recover.
Fuyuka, you're under too much pressure. Hmm...==W== How about we set off some sparklers to help you relax?
Didn't the craftsman give you some before?
Oh, right, he gave it to me as a token of appreciation...
It's settled then. Let's celebrate a little ahead of time, just the two of us.
Sparks crackle and shimmer in the air, and before she knows it, Fuyuka is lost in thought, gazing at the light.
As the sparklers burn, the tension and unease in her heart seem to melt away little by little...
I believe that, to the people of Philae, you're just like fireworks.
To them, you're their brightest light of hope.
Just like fireworks that light up the night sky.
I, I'm nowhere near that great...
Maybe not yet, but one day.
I see what you mean, Master.
You've always worked hard for the people of this city.==W== I'm sure everyone wants to see the future lit by your light.
Anyway, don't overthink it. Just do what feels right to you, and don't push yourself too hard.
If you ever feel lost, or if something's too much for you, come to me for help. I'll always be here to support you. After all ...==W== I'm your teacher.
Suddenly, a few shooting stars streak across the night sky.
R-right! I have to make a wish!==W== Shooting stars, please grant my wish...
That...==W== Uh, never mind.==W== It's a secret!
If I say it out loud, it won't come true!==W== So no, I can't say it, even to you. Hehe~
Now you're just making me even more curious...

Maybe the shooting stars really did grant her wish. After a night's rest, Fuyuka's opening speech went off without a hitch, and the Philae Harvest Festival came to a perfect close amid laughter and applause.

Coming a day early was definitely the right call.
Even though the speech at the camp went really well,==W== this time the audience will be a hundred times larger—==W==no, a thousand times larger. If something goes wrong...
You're not the same person you used to be. Don't worry, you'll do fine. Even before I got here, you've been doing great in front of everyone, haven't you?
That's true. But the moment I see you,==W== I can't help but want you to spoil me a little, hehe.
Lady Fuyuka~! Do you have a moment? We'd like to run a rehearsal for the opening ceremony!
Sure! I'll come over right away!
Don't worry. I'll stay right next to you.
That's great! With you here,==W== I suddenly feel so much more at ease.
Fuyuka stepped onto the podium, her expression unusually solemn.
People bustled around, their eyes turning toward the podium in anticipation.
Then, let's get started... Three,==W== two,==W== one...==W== Go!
Before I could even react, she suddenly went rigid—like a puppet with its strings cut—and collapsed straight to the ground.
Uu...==W== Ugh...==W== Why am I in bed...?
You fainted on stage during the rehearsal.
The rehearsal...==W== Ah! Right, I was rehearsing my speech!
I have to get over there right away...==W== Or everyone's going to start worrying!
There's no hurry. Take a breather first.
I heard you've been helping out with the festival preparations these past few days. The staff are worried they might have asked you to do too much and you pushed yourself to exhaustion.
No way...==W== I really wanted to help. It's not anyone else's fault!
I get it. That's why, to make sure your speech goes smoothly tomorrow, your job right now is to rest and recover.
Fuyuka, you're under too much pressure. Hmm...==W== How about we set off some sparklers to help you relax?
Didn't the craftsman give you some before?
Oh, right, he gave it to me as a token of appreciation...
It's settled then. Let's celebrate a little ahead of time, just the two of us.
Sparks crackle and shimmer in the air, and before she knows it, Fuyuka is lost in thought, gazing at the light.
As the sparklers burn, the tension and unease in her heart seem to melt away little by little...
I believe that, to the people of Philae, you're just like fireworks.
To them, you're their brightest light of hope.
Just like fireworks that light up the night sky.
I, I'm nowhere near that great...
Maybe not yet, but one day.
I see what you mean, Master.
You've always worked hard for the people of this city.==W== I'm sure everyone wants to see the future lit by your light.
Anyway, don't overthink it. Just do what feels right to you, and don't push yourself too hard.
If you ever feel lost, or if something's too much for you, come to me for help. I'll always be here to support you. After all ...==W== I'm your teacher.
Suddenly, a few shooting stars streak across the night sky.
R-right! I have to make a wish!==W== Shooting stars, please grant my wish...
That...==W== Uh, never mind.==W== It's a secret!
If I say it out loud, it won't come true!==W== So no, I can't say it, even to you. Hehe~
Now you're just making me even more curious...

Maybe the shooting stars really did grant her wish. After a night's rest, Fuyuka's opening speech went off without a hitch, and the Philae Harvest Festival came to a perfect close amid laughter and applause.

strings.text: Chitose and you come to a limited-time Tanikaze hot spring, which remids Chitose of her hometown…
Sigh... I've been climbing the Monolith way too often lately. I just want to relax for once...
What's with the crowd around that notice board? Some kind of event?
Goodwind Homecare Limited-Time Hot Spring Experience—We look forward to your visit...==W== Goodwind Homecare? You ever heard of them?
Nope. From the name it sounds like a housekeeping company. Why are they running a hot spring?
I remember Goodwind Homecare is run by a group of ninjas. This must be some kind of special assignment...
My ==SEX11==, what are you looking at?
Uwah! Chitose?! When did you get behind me?
From the moment you stepped into the Market, I've been at your back.==RT==As your blade, it's only natural that I accompany and protect you.
So Chitose's been shadowing me this whole time... Is my perception that bad, or is it that she's just too good at steathing...?
Goodwind Hot Spring Experience... My ==SEX11==, are you interested in going to a hot spring?
Yeah, kind of. I've been really worn out lately.
Come to think of it, you're from Goodwind, right? You must know all about hot springs.
In the past, while in my homeland, I often trained in hot springs to strengthen myself.
Training ... in the hot spring? You trained while soaking in a hot spring?
Yes. My "Parents" and my "Master" were all tempered in blazing furnaces before becoming blades.==RT==I, too, must gradually raise my training temperature if I am ever to truly become your blade.
So to her, bathing in hot springs is a form of forging...
Yes. I'm already accustomed to training in a hot pool. It's how I hone my resistance.
A hot pool, huh... That sounds painful...
My ==SEX11==! I have a proposal!==RT==If we train together in the hot spring, surely we will reach the state of Oneness even faster!
Well, since I was going to have a soak anyway, let's give it a try.
Then let us depart at once!
This should be the entrance of Goodwind Homecare Hot Spring. Looks like we're the first guests here.
But there's no one at the door to greet us... Don't tell me this is a trap?
No need to worry. If there's any danger here. I can sense it.
Besides, the sign says "unmanned, self-service hot spring." Once we drop the fee into the box, we can enter.
Oh, I see. Then let's head inside.
It's nice having someone who knows her way around hot springs with me...
Wow, the interior is gorgeous. Quiet and peaceful, not what I expected.
You seem really familiar with this place. Have you been here before?
No. But it's very much like where I once lived. Even if I've never stepped foot here, I know where to go.
So you used to live in a fancy courtyard like this?
Yes, though it was much larger.
So you come from a great house!
My ==SEX11==, there is something I want to know about you.
Please, go ahead. If I can answer it, I will.
Do you ever miss your homeland?
I guess she's homesick, seeing this place.
Sorry... I don't really have any memories of a homeland. So it's hard to answer.
But... Being away for so long, alone... I think I can understand that loneliness.
... Forgive me. I left because I was resolved to find my wielder, yet here I am, still distracted by nostalgia.
As you are my wielder, wherever you are, that is where I belong.
No, no. That's not some petty distraction. Missing home is only human.
Come think about it, I've never really learned about your homeland.
Maybe someday, Chitose, we can visit your homeland together?
Of course! I would be honored and do my utmost to fulfill your wish!
I'm looking forward to that day. But right now, how about that soak?
Of course! This way please, my ==SEX11==.
I'm changing... Is something the matter?
I cannot go into the hot spring dressed like this...
Eh?==W== You're really going to change here? Then I'll use the other room...
To remove one's clothes is to be utterly defenseless. What if an assassin takes this opportunity to attack you?
As your blade, I must always remain at your side, guarding you!
Who would attack me here? Besides, didn't you just say it was safe?
You must never lower your guard, not even in a safe environment! And as your sword, I must keep watch in your place!
Uh... She isn't backing down for a single bit.
After who knows how many rounds of back-and-forth,==W== she finally agreed to set up a folding screen so we could change with our backs to each other.
But in the end, I still couldn't go into the hot pool with her...==W== Because the water Chitose wanted to train in was far, far too scalding for me.

strings.text: No matter the script, each is a stroke in her writing of the world.
With that, this week's routine inspection is over.
Hm? That figure over there ... looks like...==W==Chixia?==RT====W==What's she doing, crouched in a corner like that...?
Guess I'll go and take a look.
Mhm~<size=60>♪</size> Perfect! I really am the greatest Xuan Shi~<size=60>♪</size>
Phew... ==W==Oh, it's you, Shimiao. You scared me for a second...
Sorry. You were here alone, so I thought I'd say hello...==W====RT==What are you doing?
That wooden plaque...==W== Don't tell me it's a new type of talisman?
What are you talking about?==RT==Can't you tell this is just my name?!
To be honest, I didn't recognize it at first...
Since you're here, come help me write!
I mean, I could... But what exactly is this?
Shimiao, you know about Yunji's "Most Respected Disciple Ranking," right?
Of course, I thought I'd be number one for sure...
But guess what?! I wasn't nominated at all! Not even once!
How could that be? Me, Chixia, the genius Xuan Shi, not number one?! Impossible!
No way...==W====RT==So you're ... voting for yourself?
Hahaha, that's right!==RT==I'm going to hang up twenty plaques with my own name on them!
Sounds a little shady to me, yeah.
But they never said you can't vote for yourself, so it should be fine, right?
At worst, Master will just scold me a little. No big deal!
Getting scolded...==W====RT==Look, if people are going to call it cheating, I can't really help you.
Fine then.I'll just write them myself.
Feels like I haven't seen Chixia in a while...==RT==Could it be that ==W==she's gone off traveling again?
But every time she leaves Cangwu she causes some stir. If there's no news, she's probably still in town. Maybe I'll check the dojo...
How strange... She's not in any of her usual hangout spots...
Shimiao? Wow, I don't see you here often. What brings you by?
Ah, hello. I came looking for Chixia...
Oh, Chixia? She got grounded. She's been copying texts over at the training grounds lately.
Grounded?! Don't tell me it's because she voted for herself with those wooden plaques...
Chixia was writing her own name on plaques, saying she was gonna vote for herself as the most respected disciple...
Ohhh! So that's what those plaques were? They had her name on it? We all thought they were ghost prevention talismans.==RT==We thought maybe she was messing around because she didn't get nominated.
Makes sense now. No wonder her master punished her with calligraphy drills!
I see...==W====RT==So I probably won't catch her today. Guess I'll head back for now.
Well, we call it "grounded," but it's not that strict. If you want to see her, just head through the training grounds.
I see. Thank you for letting me know. I'll go to the training grounds.
But after being grounded this long... Knowing Chixia, she must be going stir-crazy by now...
Chixia is sprawled on the floor, sheets of paper all around her, ink smudged across her face.
Calligraphy's just like drawing talismans~ One stroke at a time. Honestly, I think I'm doing pretty well.
Hm... The shape of "Lightning" looks awfully familiar...
Wait! That tracking talisman Master taught us last time—it looks almost the same!
Right, Master did say that words themselves are part of talismans... Then what if I add a few extra characters to an existing one, like this...==W====RT==Then one more here...
But seriously... why did Master punish me with calligraphy? Writing characters is so boring...
Hmm... But if adding words works, then what if I erase words from a talisman instead...==W====RT==Hehe, guess I'll give it a try!
Oh, Shimiao, you're heading out? Didn't find Chixia?
I did. She looked pretty perky, so I'm no longer worried.
And she seems busy experimenting with talisman papers. I'll come back another day.

strings.text: If all have forgotten it, was it ever truly real?
Phew! I'm stuffed! That was amazing! No wonder you picked this cake shop, Nanoha!
Looks like you are really happy with today's new item, Boss. Frees Patisserie's new items are always delicious. Maybe we could come more often.
Speaking of new items, the sunflower cake I tried today…
Huh? Right, I expected it to taste like sunflower seeds, but instead, it gave off a true sunflower aroma.
That's what makes Frees incredible—recreating something you can't even eat in the first place, capturing the essence of sunlight.
Although, using the fragrance of edible flowers to mimic inedible ones is a clever trick used a lot in patisserie.
Nanoha, you sure know a lot about pastries...==W== You must really love them. Speaking of sunflowers...
Excuse me. Here's your tea refill. Is there anything else you'd like?
Nah, we are good...==W== It's so delicious, and I've had way too much already.
It's not just being polite...==W== I'm totally stuffed... I even feel a bit bloated.
Then let's walk a bit on the way back. Should help with digestion.
By the way, Nanoha, do you mind taking a detour? There's a place I want to take you to.
Of course. I am your maid. Anywhere you want to go, I'll be right by your side.
It's just ahead. When I was having the cake, I suddenly thought of this place.
The endless wheat fields,==W== the sound of the stalks in the wind, the smell of fresh grass. Hard to believe something this beautiful is so close by.
But most importantly, over there! Look beyond that hill!
Isn’t it beautiful? It goes perfectly with the sunflower cake we just ate, both carrying that similar sunny scent.
Yeah, it’s really pretty… so pretty it almost makes you want to disappear into it.
Tell me, Boss—Do you like sunflowers?
Well… I don’t have memories, so I’m not sure if I liked it before…==W== but I definitely do now. Why did you ask?
It's just that I suddenly remembered some things from long ago...
When I was little, I planted a sunflower field with a senior colleague from Goodwind Homecare.
A sunflower field you planted as a child... I kind of want to see it. Is it still there?
It's gone ...==W== or rather, it's become a place that never existed.
A place that never existed...==W== What do you mean?
Because of a mission, I was separated from that senior and left the sunflower field. When I returned and asked people about it, they were certain that there had never been one...
But I remember it so clearly...==W== Was I wrong? The sunflower field and my senior seem to have vanished from this world.
So that's what happened...==W== Could it be that those people you asked... They sacrificed those memories when they made a wish at the Monolith?
If a sunflower field disappears from the world, forgotten, and one day even I, the last person who have memories of it, no longer remember—then did it ever truly exist?
Maybe there are countless sunflower fields like that in this world. They are forgotten and erased. In the end, they leave no trace at all.
… It’s something we can’t do anything about, I suppose.
Wow! Boss! You are here, too?
Of course! Master talks about you all the time! We've been dying to meet you!
Ahem. Isaki, now that you have finally met Boss, mind your manners.
Ehehe, sorry...==W== I'm Isaki, a trainee ninja with Goodwind Homecare!
Ah, oops! I'm supposed to say trainee maid while I'm in public...
So you're Nanoha's junior. Nice to meet you. By the way...==W== Is that a Camera Artifact you're holding?
Hah, you're amazing, Boss! Sharp eyes!
A Camera Artifact...==W== The kind that can imprint scenery onto special paper, right? How come you have this?
I bought it at the Market just now, with all the pocket money I saved up!
There you are! Geez, of all the places to run off to!
Okra's coming! Master, Boss, I'm outta here!
Got you! No more running away, Isaki!
Okra, calm down. As maids, we should always stay composed.
Understood! Uh…?==W== Senior Nanoha! What are you doing here? And that person beside you is...
My apologies for the commotion...==W== It's an honor to meet you, Boss.
My name is Okra, trainee maid under Nanoha. I have heard so much about you and your many famous exploits.
H-Hello…==W== Am I really that famous?
... That's because... Nanoha's been talking so much about you...
... Ahem,==W== Okra, let's—why were you chasing Isaki again?
Because==W== she spent all the allowance money on that useless Artifact.
It's not useless at all! The Camera Artifact is super powerful! It must be useful in missions too…==W== Uh… Well, it can definitely be used in missions! Possibly!
Possibly...==W== Again. You bought it because it looks cool, right?
No, of course not! You see, it can record the enemies we’ve defeated, and it has a lot of other functions too!
Hmm...==W== Aside from assassination, we also have to do recon sometimes. This might come in handy.
Isn't it called a Polaroid? And ...==W== where's the film? Without film, it won't work, right?
It's a paper with special fluid, about the size of this slot on the side of this Artifact.
A Camera Artifact prints the scenery right away on a film. Did you not get any when you bought it?
Oh, you mean these? I have a few!
Still usable, but ...==W== these are all damaged, either with corners missing or already turned yellow.
It's probably just that nobody wanted these things, so they sat in the warehouse for too long.
Still, they'll do for now. Once you use them up, you'll need to make a wish at the Monolith for more.
So, with this film, the Camera Artifact could be useful for missions, yeah? See, I was right to buy it! Expensive though, but practical.
I didn’t say buying it was a mistake...==W== It's just our money wasn't easy to save, and we should still be careful with it.
Isaki and Okra are having fun with Boss...
...==W== I miss the time when we used to take care of the sunflower field together, Master...
Boss! Look! This film's still fresh!
Oooh that's a nice one! It's well-preserved.
Alright! Let’s test it to make sure it works! If it breaks, we’ll have to fix it or return it!
Huh? Why are you suddenly interested? You were just upset about the money a minute ago!
I’m not…==W== I just don’t want it to go to waste. That’s why I want to check it, okay?
Anyway! Boss, you're the one who knows how to handle this best.==W== Please, we're counting on you!
Sure, no problem. But ...==W== what should we take a photo of?
My memories of that sunflower field also start to fade...==W== Maybe someday, when I'm climbing the Monolith, I might forget everything, even this peace scene in front of my eyes...
Shh! Nanoha's spacing out. Let's take a photo of her!
Don't tell me, Boss,==W== you want to...
No, I shouldn’t have shown such worry. As a maid, that’s unforgivable. Master once taught me …==W== to always remain composed, to keep a smile, and to perform tasks with ease.
I shall cherish those warm, gentle days within my heart. Even if they gradually blur, the feeling, the fragrance—==W==I will never forget them…
Perfect! That's the look I want!
Haha, you had such a rare distracted look. I had to capture it.
Let me see! I wanna see!
Stunning...==W== Like a painting in a museum!
It's certainly a nice photo...==W== But you two sure are over the top...
You're far too modest! This is practically the ideal posture and expression for a maid! Boss! Please, you must sell me this photo!
Hey! Just a moment ago you were telling me I was wasting my allowance money! This is a photo of the Master, so of course it's for her. You can't buy it!
Your expression was so perfect, I couldn’t resist taking a photo. Be confident, Nanoha.
Of course. As long as you have this photo, Nanoha, you'll never forget this sunflower field.
Thank you, Boss. I'll treasure this photo, and I'll never forget today.
The fragrance of the sunflowers, the warmth of the sunlight, and the moments I shared with Boss—I will always …==W== always remember them.
