Of course. I am your maid. Anywhere you want to go, I'll be right by your side.
It's just ahead. When I was having the cake, I suddenly thought of this place.
The endless wheat fields,==W== the sound of the stalks in the wind, the smell of fresh grass. Hard to believe something this beautiful is so close by.
But most importantly, over there! Look beyond that hill!
Isn’t it beautiful? It goes perfectly with the sunflower cake we just ate, both carrying that similar sunny scent.
Yeah, it’s really pretty… so pretty it almost makes you want to disappear into it.
Tell me, Boss—Do you like sunflowers?
Well… I don’t have memories, so I’m not sure if I liked it before…==W== but I definitely do now. Why did you ask?
It's just that I suddenly remembered some things from long ago...
When I was little, I planted a sunflower field with a senior colleague from Goodwind Homecare.
A sunflower field you planted as a child... I kind of want to see it. Is it still there?
It's gone ...==W== or rather, it's become a place that never existed.
A place that never existed...==W== What do you mean?
Because of a mission, I was separated from that senior and left the sunflower field. When I returned and asked people about it, they were certain that there had never been one...
But I remember it so clearly...==W== Was I wrong? The sunflower field and my senior seem to have vanished from this world.
So that's what happened...==W== Could it be that those people you asked... They sacrificed those memories when they made a wish at the Monolith?
If a sunflower field disappears from the world, forgotten, and one day even I, the last person who have memories of it, no longer remember—then did it ever truly exist?
Maybe there are countless sunflower fields like that in this world. They are forgotten and erased. In the end, they leave no trace at all.
… It’s something we can’t do anything about, I suppose.
Wow! Boss! You are here, too?
Of course! Master talks about you all the time! We've been dying to meet you!
Ahem. Isaki, now that you have finally met Boss, mind your manners.
Ehehe, sorry...==W== I'm Isaki, a trainee ninja with Goodwind Homecare!
Ah, oops! I'm supposed to say trainee maid while I'm in public...
So you're Nanoha's junior. Nice to meet you. By the way...==W== Is that a Camera Artifact you're holding?
Hah, you're amazing, Boss! Sharp eyes!
A Camera Artifact...==W== The kind that can imprint scenery onto special paper, right? How come you have this?
I bought it at the Market just now, with all the pocket money I saved up!
There you are! Geez, of all the places to run off to!
Okra's coming! Master, Boss, I'm outta here!
Got you! No more running away, Isaki!
Okra, calm down. As maids, we should always stay composed.
Understood! Uh…?==W== Senior Nanoha! What are you doing here? And that person beside you is...
My apologies for the commotion...==W== It's an honor to meet you, Boss.
My name is Okra, trainee maid under Nanoha. I have heard so much about you and your many famous exploits.
H-Hello…==W== Am I really that famous?
... That's because... Nanoha's been talking so much about you...
... Ahem,==W== Okra, let's—why were you chasing Isaki again?
Because==W== she spent all the allowance money on that useless Artifact.
It's not useless at all! The Camera Artifact is super powerful! It must be useful in missions too…==W== Uh… Well, it can definitely be used in missions! Possibly!
Possibly...==W== Again. You bought it because it looks cool, right?
No, of course not! You see, it can record the enemies we’ve defeated, and it has a lot of other functions too!
Hmm...==W== Aside from assassination, we also have to do recon sometimes. This might come in handy.
Isn't it called a Polaroid? And ...==W== where's the film? Without film, it won't work, right?
It's a paper with special fluid, about the size of this slot on the side of this Artifact.
A Camera Artifact prints the scenery right away on a film. Did you not get any when you bought it?
Oh, you mean these? I have a few!
Still usable, but ...==W== these are all damaged, either with corners missing or already turned yellow.
It's probably just that nobody wanted these things, so they sat in the warehouse for too long.
Still, they'll do for now. Once you use them up, you'll need to make a wish at the Monolith for more.
So, with this film, the Camera Artifact could be useful for missions, yeah? See, I was right to buy it! Expensive though, but practical.
I didn’t say buying it was a mistake...==W== It's just our money wasn't easy to save, and we should still be careful with it.
Isaki and Okra are having fun with Boss...
...==W== I miss the time when we used to take care of the sunflower field together, Master...
Boss! Look! This film's still fresh!
Oooh that's a nice one! It's well-preserved.
Alright! Let’s test it to make sure it works! If it breaks, we’ll have to fix it or return it!
Huh? Why are you suddenly interested? You were just upset about the money a minute ago!
I’m not…==W== I just don’t want it to go to waste. That’s why I want to check it, okay?
Anyway! Boss, you're the one who knows how to handle this best.==W== Please, we're counting on you!
Sure, no problem. But ...==W== what should we take a photo of?
My memories of that sunflower field also start to fade...==W== Maybe someday, when I'm climbing the Monolith, I might forget everything, even this peace scene in front of my eyes...
Shh! Nanoha's spacing out. Let's take a photo of her!
Don't tell me, Boss,==W== you want to...
No, I shouldn’t have shown such worry. As a maid, that’s unforgivable. Master once taught me …==W== to always remain composed, to keep a smile, and to perform tasks with ease.
I shall cherish those warm, gentle days within my heart. Even if they gradually blur, the feeling, the fragrance—==W==I will never forget them…
Perfect! That's the look I want!
Haha, you had such a rare distracted look. I had to capture it.
Let me see! I wanna see!
Stunning...==W== Like a painting in a museum!
It's certainly a nice photo...==W== But you two sure are over the top...
You're far too modest! This is practically the ideal posture and expression for a maid! Boss! Please, you must sell me this photo!
Hey! Just a moment ago you were telling me I was wasting my allowance money! This is a photo of the Master, so of course it's for her. You can't buy it!
Your expression was so perfect, I couldn’t resist taking a photo. Be confident, Nanoha.
Of course. As long as you have this photo, Nanoha, you'll never forget this sunflower field.
Thank you, Boss. I'll treasure this photo, and I'll never forget today.
The fragrance of the sunflowers, the warmth of the sunlight, and the moments I shared with Boss—I will always …==W== always remember them.

strings.text: O lucky prize bewitched by the great Chaton's Demon Eye! Submit to my dark power!
Hear me, you pathetic Stellaroids! I am the great Chaton, the God-Slayer! My left eye holds the power of darkness!
Any trash blocking the great Chaton's path==W== becomes a sacrifice for the Uncompleted Codex Entry!
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten...! A twenty-kill streak! Total annihilation!
Heh heh! How'd I do? Amazing, right? I'd score that a solid ninety.
Honestly, after seeing our flawless teamwork, I kinda want to spar with you, too!
Haha... I'll pass.==W== Besides, you don't strike me as the type to play on easy mode.
Obviously! But if you suddenly awaken mid-match... Things might go straight to hell mode!
I wouldn't count on it.==W== Is this "awakening moment" you keep going on about ever going to happen?
Hmph! It will! It definitely will! It absolutely will!==W== And even if it doesn't, the great Chaton will force it out of you!
Whoa, intense... You're as obsessed with this as ever.
Of course! Because if the Tyrant's true power never awakens—
—then I can't defeat you at your peak to make my own dark power stronger!
If your power is already that strong, you wouldn't need to defeat me.
Since you hold the title of Tyrant, you must be the master of all dark power!
If I defeat the Tyrant... I'll become the new Tyrant!
Come to think of it, that is how it works in her lore...
I still can't get used to her bizarre way of talking, though...
Behold! The Promised Land! Tell me, Tyrant, what's the great Chaton's kill count?
Hmm... Fell short of the high score. Not enough monsters spawned—can't be helped. Pity.
But still! Seventy percent of those were one-hit criticals! We're another step closer to awakening!
Let's put the awakening stuff aside. If this is your "Promised Land," then we've reached today's destination, right?
Heh heh... Precisely! This is the sacred battlefield, an arena dyed in the blood of countless warriors!
Let's clash again and make our souls resonate! That way, the Tyrant and the great Chaton can ascend to a higher realm together!
Sorry, what do you mean by that?
Since we couldn't duel properly while hunting Stellaroids,==W== games will have to do! This is how we power up our dark force and forge a mightier Tyrant!
Vita alone is enough to train me...
Come on, Tyrant! Let's start with that machine!
Is this a rhythm game? Looks like you stepped on the arrows on the floor...
Yep, piece of cake! Now watch!
O music from the heavens,==W==<size=50> resound across this mortal realm!</size>
Nyahaha! An overwhelming victory for the great Chaton!
Pant... Pant...! This game's way more hardcore than I thought...
You're completely wiped, but your score's not bad!==W== Let's ride this momentum and hit the next game!
What?! Hold on, Chaton, let me catch my breath!
Tyrant, you're insane at Monolith Air Hockey!==W==<size=50> One more game! I will have my revenge!</size>
That's nine in a row.==W== Ready to call it quits?
I-I was charging my dark power! I'll win this round!
What should we play==W== next...==W== Hm?
Th-This dark aura ... seeping from the abyss...!
Chaton? Where are you going? Hey, Chaton!!
Finally caught up... Chaton, why'd you bolt like that?==W== Wait...
Tyrant, check this out! Doesn't this plushie look like you?!
... Does it look that much like me?
It totally does!==W== Heh heh... Our bond guided us to this fated encounter!
O lucky prize, bewitched by the great Chaton's Demon Eye! Submit to my dark power!
Did you miss? It didn't even budge.
... Hmph. First try.==W== Consider it a warm-up. Next time for sure...!!
I can't catch a thing! What's up with this claw?! The settings are rigged!
Hey! Heyyy! You were doubting me, weren't you?! Fine then, you try it, Tyrant! I'll spot you!
More right... Yeah, stop! Now ease it in...==W==<size=50> Now!</size>
I thought we had it! Aaaah!
This is harder than I thought... You're the sniper, Chaton. You handle it.
Swapping roles again! This time you're the spotter, Tyrant!
Yeah, left a bit...==W== Stop. Aim for the side. A little deeper...
Sigh... How many tries is that? I guess it's time to qui—
Wait! We're not done! I have one more tactic!
Huh?! Chaton, what are you doing—
From in here, I get a perfect view!
Isn't that cheating if you just get inside the machine?!
Course not! It's a legitimate strategy!
The key to sniping is the spotter's position!
You're right there—why don't you just take it?
No way! As the Tyrant and wielder of dark power, our image is everything!
You're already inside... What difference does it make?
The difference is the satisfaction! You'll see, Tyrant!
Right twenty! No, overshot. Left five. Bring it my way...
Those who dare defy the dark power—submit! And embrace the void!
Chaton commands! Silver Wings, heed the Tyrant that commands the eternal night!
Yesss! We got it! The great Chaton always gets the last laugh!
Well done! The Tyrant's awakening draws near!
Awakening aside,==W== that was indeed incredibly satisfying.
Shame we can't keep it. All that effort...
Right? Only Wishing Box loot leaves. God of Grace is so cheap!
But hey, we got more than a plushie!
Hmph! The memory of us winning this together!
The XP from this true Tyrant trial is now etched in our souls!
Even though every dream would fade, she couldn't resist reaching out. Perhaps that is the fate of a girl bound by dark power.
And so, she left the Monolith proudly, hugging the prize she and her Tyrant had won.

strings.text: A question that has haunted a Seeker for years awaits your answer.
Phew... The evening market's still buzzing like always. Nice place for a stroll.
Huh? Wait a sec... Was that...
Excuse me, a basket of Sacred Grapes, please. And could you point me to the florist?
Well now, if it isn't Lord Arbiter! Welcome!
Here are your grapes. The flower shop? Go straight, turn right, the second store.
Thank you. May the God of Grace watch over us.
Thanks for waiting! Here are your white lilies. It's a huge bouquet, be careful with it!
I will. Thanks for the flowers and the reminder. May the God of Grace watch over us.
Bread... Sacred Grapes... Flowers... Next up...==W== Right, the book store.
Excuse me, is the final volume of The Adventures of the White Knight out yet?
The Adventures of the White Knight... That's a comic, isn't it? Gerie loves comics?
Hehe~ I was wondering who this familiar presence was~
So, it was you following me, Great ==SEX12==~ Honestly, if you missed me, you could have just said so~
G-Gerie!? I thought you were inside the store!
I'm done~ The book I'm after isn't out yet~
Besides... I could feel you staring so intensely. I just had to come and say hello.
That's not it. I just happened to see you and was surprised you were into comics, that's all.
A pity. I was hoping for a little excitement~
To answer your curiosity, I don't actually care for comics myself.
But you were just asking about one, weren't you? Or are you planning to gift someone?
You're here just in time. Think you could give me a hand?
It's so quiet. Gerie hasn't said a word since we stepped into the forest.
She asked for my help, but never said what for...==W== And now she's led me this deep into the woods.
Ah...==W== Apologies, Great ==SEX12==. My mind was elsewhere.
Are you feeling unwell? Is your symptom...
Don't worry. You helped me vent plenty last time. I'm feeling perfectly fine now.
That sound... It's a large monster.
Huh? Normally, you'd be charging right in...
... Sorry. I don't feel like fighting today.
Huff... Huff...==W== I can't believe we've walked until nightfall.
Thank you for your patience. We're almost there.
This is really strange. Gerie is acting so ... normal today.
Moss-covered headstones dot the woods. Gerie kneels gently before one, brushing the dead leaves from its surface.
I came to pay my respects to an old friend.
This forest ...==W== graveyard... Right, isn't there a Sanctuary of Grace nearby?
I spotted it on one of Iris's maps.
Yes, the Sanctuary is just beyond those trees.
But it was abandoned years ago, after the last Arbiter left.
The living can move on, but the departed remain bound to this land. So someone needs to take care of them.
Yeah. You have to vent the magic that builds up inside you, or it goes critical or something?
There was another child once, with the same condition.
Back when I was an apprentice, I met a girl here, all skin and bones.
She was born with a severe illness, and her parents abandoned her here.
But her case was far worse than mine. She couldn't wield magic at all.
Not quite. Just being near magic made her sick. They had no choice but to send her to the Sanctuary of Grace, outside the city.
We became friends. We didn't have a single thing in common—food, hobbies, you name it—but our shared condition connected us.
But... I suppose I was just more suited for combat. I made full Arbiter fast enough. She, on the other hand...
She asked me once==W== if the Gods had forsaken her. I could only tell her the God of Grace abandons no one.
It must've been hard on you both.
I didn't know what else to do. And duty called.
I was on a mission across the continent when the news of her passing reached me.
There was a meltdown at a nearby Monolith. To protect everyone, she unleashed this incredible, blinding spell and neutralized the threat.
Wait. Didn't you say she couldn't use magic?
That's when I learned the truth. It wasn't that she couldn't wield magic... She was fatally allergic to it.
That spell she cast to save everyone... It was the first and last time she ever touched magic.
Great ==SEX12==, do you think the God of Grace is actually real?
Whoa, hey now. You're a Dusk Arbiter. That's a dangerous question to ask.
Heh... You're right.==W====RT==Fate can be so cruel. If this isn't some sick joke by the God of Grace, what else could it be?
Rather than getting caught up in that, I prefer to believe in "paradise."
A final home for every soul that fought to the very end, no matter their faith or their path in life.
Maybe someday, we can ask your friend in person what was truly on her mind at her last moment.
W-What's so funny? Was it something I said?
Ahem... Forgive me~ I wasn't laughing at you. Actually, I'm touched you took my question so seriously. I just ... wasn't expecting it.
Paradise, huh... What a romantic thought.
Thanks to you, my heart is finally still.
Huh...!? This feeling... I know that murderous aura!
Just as I thought. Of all the souls I've met, yours is the strongest, the most unique ... and the one that intrigues me most.
Yes... I simply must make you mine, no matter what it takes~
So ... how about becoming my Great ==SEX12==, and mine alone? I'll make it well worth your while~
I'm happy you're feeling better, but I'm gonna take a hard pass on that...!
There you go again... But that's another thing I adore about you.
A soul, once gone, can't return. But the one before me now can still be saved. And for that I'm willing to use forceful methods.
W-Wait...! Are you serious this time!?
Hehe... I shall spare you this time. Seeing that flustered look on your face was worth it, Great ==SEX12==~
Hah... Don't joke like that again! I can never tell when you're actually being serious.
Oh? But I'm always completely sincere with you, my Great ==SEX12==.
That's why I'm always on edge!==W====RT==Anyway, why'd you bring me all the way out here?
I couldn't get her her favorite comic book, so I was hoping you could share about your adventures with her.
Oh, I get it. Leave it to me.
Hehe... Thank you~ I know she'll be thrilled.
We sit together, and I share stories of our journey so far.
Wow, it's gotten late. Looks like I won't finish tonight.
There are still so many stories left. I'll come back if I get the chance.
I'm really looking forward to it...==W== Well, then, let's call it a day. It's so late, I will escort you home~
Hehe...==W== Don't worry about it. Carrying you back in my arms will be much faster than you walking by yourself, don't you think?
No need! I can walk on my own.
That night, Gerie sees me safely back to the Lucky Oasis, as serene and gentle as a true devotee of the God of Grace.

Heh... You're right.==W====RT==Fate can be so cruel. If this isn't some sick joke by the God of Grace, what else could it be?
Rather than getting caught up in that, I prefer to believe in "paradise."
A final home for every soul that fought to the very end, no matter their faith or their path in life.
Maybe someday, we can ask your friend in person what was truly on her mind at her last moment.
W-What's so funny? Was it something I said?
Ahem... Forgive me~ I wasn't laughing at you. Actually, I'm touched you took my question so seriously. I just ... wasn't expecting it.
Paradise, huh... What a romantic thought.
Thanks to you, my heart is finally still.
Huh...!? This feeling... I know that murderous aura!
Just as I thought. Of all the souls I've met, yours is the strongest, the most unique ... and the one that intrigues me most.
Yes... I simply must make you mine, no matter what it takes~
So ... how about becoming my Great ==SEX12==, and mine alone? I'll make it well worth your while~
I'm happy you're feeling better, but I'm gonna take a hard pass on that...!
There you go again... But that's another thing I adore about you.
A soul, once gone, can't return. But the one before me now can still be saved. And for that I'm willing to use forceful methods.
W-Wait...! Are you serious this time!?
Hehe... I shall spare you this time. Seeing that flustered look on your face was worth it, Great ==SEX12==~
Hah... Don't joke like that again! I can never tell when you're actually being serious.
Oh? But I'm always completely sincere with you, my Great ==SEX12==.
That's why I'm always on edge!==W====RT==Anyway, why'd you bring me all the way out here?
I couldn't get her her favorite comic book, so I was hoping you could share about your adventures with her.
Oh, I get it. Leave it to me.
Hehe... Thank you~ I know she'll be thrilled.
We sit together, and I share stories of our journey so far.
Wow, it's gotten late. Looks like I won't finish tonight.
There are still so many stories left. I'll come back if I get the chance.
I'm really looking forward to it...==W== Well, then, let's call it a day. It's so late, I will escort you home~
Hehe...==W== Don't worry about it. Carrying you back in my arms will be much faster than you walking by yourself, don't you think?
No need! I can walk on my own.
That night, Gerie sees me safely back to the Lucky Oasis, as serene and gentle as a true devotee of the God of Grace.

strings.text: A great adventure in a single room, a tiny legend of the toys.
Without a doubt, evil is creeping into our world.
That dreadful aura is staining the once-pure land of light.==W== We must join forces and drive it out!
Thus concludes my speech. Does anyone have objections?
Hmm, silence.==W== Looks like everyone agrees.
<size=48>Count Chompchomp, let's go!</size>==RT====W==Charge into the Dark World and win this fight!
...==W== Now there's just one problem.==W== For an army, the numbers look ... a little thin.
Well, nothing for it.==W== Mr. Puffy Dango will have to keep you company.
Not a soul around. Gloomy, dim...
Everyone, high alert!==W====RT==If—if something's lurking in the shadows—
Like, you know...==W== Eight legs, hiding in corners...==W== Or long tails, squeaking...
N-no,==W== I can't keep thinking about them!==RT====W==Anyway—if anyone finds anything, report to Lady Nazuna immediately!
...==W== But honestly, there's nothing here.==W== Sealed off, no light, bad air circulation...
Take a rest, Mr. Puffy Dango.
No interesting Artifacts,==W== no forgotten toys,==W== not even a dirty corner or a stray bug.
Makes sense.==W== Usually it's Kaede doing the cleaning, with Fuyuka helping her.
... Which makes me wonder,==W== am I making zero contribution?
No, no, that's not true!==W== There are things I can do, right?==W== Like winning plushies prizes, making friends...
Hmmm...==W== Though those don't really help anybody...
Forget it. I'm bored. Let's just head back.
... Ah, right. No one's home today.==W== Otherwise I wouldn't have had the chance to sneak around.
Windows?==W== Maybe there's a window I can climb out of...==W== Nope, just a tiny crack.
Nazuna lays out a mat on the ground, rolling back and forth on it until she ends up flat on her back, staring at the ceiling, not moving.
That's it, I give up. There's nothing I can do.
... But if someone finds out I died on an adventure at home...==W== That's just way too embarrassing.
Should've gone Monolith climbing==W== with little Fuyuka,==W== since I'm her senior and all.
Wanted to slack off, kill time—==W==so here I am, stuck.
...==W== What are you saying, Count Chompchomp.
Even if I don't know any useful magic right now, breaking a door like this would be easy peasy.
But I just don't want to ruin Kaede's hard work...==W== That wouldn't be fair to her.
Well...==W== Since the place is so clean, I might as well nap until they get back.
Right,==W== better make some nap time preparations==W== in advance.
Nazuna stacks up crates from the storage room and makes a small bed out of them.
At the end, she carefully clips a white flag at the window frame.
This should work,==W== since Kaede always patrols the whole Trekkers' House.
Somehow, she's clutching the claw of a giant claw machine==RT==as it rises, with triumphant music blaring in her ears.
Above lies an unknown world of darkness, and below==RT==are her companions, their eyes full of hope.
Well, I'm not exactly sure what's going on but...==W== I feel all fired up!
Hmph...==W== Hmhm, of course, leave it to me!
Nazuna grips the plushie tight and charges forward==RT==into her great adventure—
I-I've searched everywhere, up and down...==W== But I still haven't found her.
Really? Then maybe she finally went out to take a commission...
I don't think that's the case.==W== Lately she's been in a slump, too lazy even for doing her share of chores.
Probably napping somewhere. Let's keep looking.
Ah, I'll go look, too!==W== Kaede, let's split up.
A white flag...==W== I see. Nazuna must be inside.
Wow, Kaede, you found her so fast!
Not really.==W== Honestly, only Nazuna would pull something like this.
As they near the storage room, they all notice the white flag fluttering.
This isn't her first time hiding in here.==W== She even used to play hide-and-seek with me.
Does she like this place that much?
Oh right, that door's lock is finicky.
Huh? So she got stuck inside?
It should be easy for her to break this door down...
But this time she just waited patiently for us to return. Heh...==W== How cute.
Huff... Hehe...==W== Now this feels like a real adventure...==W== Huff...
Fast asleep, huh. And built herself a big comfy bed, too.
Yeah,==W== and she even tidied up the place so she could make the bed.
It feels a bit cruel to wake her up now. Let's just move her into her room, bed included.
Honestly,==W== what she really needs is someone willing to keep her on track.
Nazuna's laziness is a flaw, sure...
But as soon as she starts acting cutesy, I always cave in.
So I hope someday,==W== she'll find someone she can truly lean on, someone who will protect and guide her.
Kaede gazes down at Nazuna's innocent, sleeping face and can't help but smile fondly.

strings.text: In her heart, every gift from you is one of a kind.
Hey, Karin. It's way past your bedtime—
It's gone ...==W== gone...==W== Can't find it anywhere!
The cracks, the bushes... I've looked everywhere...
Karin? What are you looking for?
The earring you gave me... it's gone.==RT==The red one...==W== See?
Oh, you're right...==W====RT==But it's so late. How 'bout we look for it together tomorrow?
It's fine, Shia, you should go home! I'll keep looking...==W== Ah! I remember now!
She's off like a shot... Where could she be going?
Not here ... not here... Still nothing!
Heh, I had a feeling I'd find you here.
You just bolted. I was worried sick.
I-I'm sorry... Don't mind me. It's my fault that the earring's missing. I'll find it.
Right! If it's not on the path or here on the beach, I must've dropped it while I was swimming!
Shia, what are you stopping me for...?
The sea's dangerous at night. You can't just dash in there. You need to listen to me, okay?
... Waaah! Shia, that's not fair!==W====RT==Going for my ears is cheating!
Don't worry. If we don't find it, I'll just make you another one. It's okay.
No. I have to find this one.
Because ...==W== it's really, really special to me!
I see. I'm happy you care about it so much. But it's too late to go back in now. Let's come back first thing tomorrow, okay?
That's my girl. C'mon, let's head home~
Karin—?==W====RT==Huh... She already left? I was gonna go with her.
"Went to the Lost and Found. Hope someone turned in the earring! Don't worry about me!"
Hmm... Then I'll check the sea.
Karin said it fell into the sea... She usually swims around here, but the tide... Ugh, it could be anywhere by now.
For Karin... I have to find it!
Gasp... Searched everywhere. No sign of it.
There has to be another way...
(If the waves carried the earring away, maybe I should let them carry me, too. The current might take me to it.)
I'll grab a swim ring. Then I can just float.
It's been a while since I've used one of these...
Karin used to need one, too. At first, she could barely even breathe while swimming, let alone dive.
I wanna swim just like you, Shia!
I'm never using a swim ring again!
Hey, there's no need to rush...
I wanna swim with you ... but I'm still a little scared...
Well, here, take this. It's a good luck charm.
It's enchanted, so you can swim freely like a fish. It helped me a ton when I first started learning.
'Course! But you still gotta practice a lot to master the magic. Don't worry, I'll be right here with you.
I only made up that story about the "magic earring" to encourage her. I had no idea she took it to heart.
I have to find it. No matter what.
Oh, hey there, little one. I'm looking for a pretty red earring. Have you seen anything like that?
Huh?! Why are you nudging my swim ring? Are you ... trying to show me something?
It's beautiful... Wait, did you bring me here because you understood when I said "pretty"?
Yeah, this place is really pretty...
I had no idea a place like this was in Carlo Town. Thank you for showing me.
This blue coral... Is it Azure Coral?
Oh, right. You wouldn't know the name humans gave it. But if it really is Azure Coral...
Little one, would it be okay if I took some of these pieces that have broken off?
Is that a "go for it"? Thank you! I'll just grab these, then.
Karin should be back soon. I'll just wait here for her. Hope she likes this new earring...
Shia! I'm back! You gotta see this!
Some sweet person from the Trekker Association found it! I gave her a ton of dried fish in return.
Hehe, it's a treasure from you! I'm never losing it again!
Oh, right. Shia, you were about to say something, weren't you?
I was. I came across some Azure Coral today. It's perfect for making jewelry, so I crafted a new earring.
This is a gorgeous blue. It'd look perfect on you!
Actually, I made it for you. But... I suppose you don't need it now that you found your old one.
This doesn't carry any magic, you know.
I don't care! You made it just for me, and that makes it special!
It doesn't matter if it's blue or red... They're both gifts from you.
They're all precious memories we share. That's why I looked so hard for it...
You look beautiful. And Karin, you know ... they say Azure Coral carries the ocean's blessing.
I was thinking, "With the ocean's blessing, maybe we could find the lost earring?" So I made this one.
Oh! You finding the Azure Coral has to be why I found my earring then!
I know so! That means I have awesome swimming magic and the ocean's blessing now?!
Those make you the greatest seafaring Trekker ever.
Whoa... I feel the power surging through me!
But, Shia, you're the grea—test treasure I have!==W== As long as I'm with you, I'm fearless.
Hehe... Having you here with me makes me happy too, Karin.
Under a dim streetlamp, the two of them stand close, each one the other's anchor in the world.

strings.text: Pick out a souvenir, and let's create more memories together.
Not much time left in Cangwu...==W== Gotta finish my shopping while I can!
Oh? You here to shop, too?
Ah, Coronis. Just picking up souvenirs before we head back.==W== You here for supplies?
Perfect timing. I wanted to check out the local specialties myself.==W== Actually, could you help me pick some suitable gifts?
Thanks. I'm relying on you, then,==W== my dear assistant.
It's nice that she trusts me, but what if we have different tastes?...==W== Well, I'll give it a shot!
Weren't we buying gifts...?==W== How did we end up in the woods?
Coronis? Aren't we supposed to go get some local specialties?
Mm-hm. I remember it being right around here...
Finding city specialties in a forest? Does that make any sense?
Found it!==W== I couldn't move it alone. That's why I asked for your help.
Well? Isn't it beautiful? I spotted it when I first arrived. Can't believe it was left out here, exposed like this...
My, it's preserved perfectly.==W== Never seen this species in Philae or Emor. I absolutely have to take it back for study.
Almost forgot...==W== This is Coronis's style...
Ahaha...==W== It certainly suits your taste. Alright, let me grab this end—
Heh...==W== Lucky us. Looks like we're adding another souvenir to the collection today.
Step back, Boss. It'd be a waste to shatter its fine skeleton by mistake.
Never thought I'd see the day I pity a monster...
The hotel owner eyed us really suspiciously, but at least we got it back in one piece. Thanks, my assistant.
By the way...==W== Mind if I ask for one more favor?
She has her sights on another set of bones?
Since these are for Igna, I need snacks with a long shelf life. Might be a while before I see her again...
Which of these two looks better?
Huh? Let's see...==W== I'd go with the baked ones. They look pretty appealing and appetizing.
Mm, good point.==W== Excuse me, could I get this gift-wrapped?
Huh. So she also buys normal souvenirs.
Who's Igna? A friend?==W== Well, at least she's not gifting a bag of bones. No, that's rude...==W== I shouldn't judge...
Huh? Sorry, zoned out...==W== What's up?
Nothing major...==W== Heh. Thinking something rude about me, were we?
Eh? No I wasn't! Why would you say—
Dilated pupils, irregular breathing...==W== Heh, never mind. Let's hit the next shop.
I can't hide anything from her...==W== This doctor is terrifyingly sharp!
Is this stall selling ...==W== traditional handicraft?
What's wrong? Surprised? Even I have the right to appreciate beauty, don't I?
Knew it. This color suits your complexion perfectly.
Excuse me, I'll take this. Mind if we pay with it on?
Wait! This is way too nice! I can't accept this!
It's fine. Consider it a gift. I saw it the other day and knew it'd look good on you.
Besides, I've dragged you around all day. Just think of it as a thank-you.
Fine...==W== If you insist. I'll accept it.
But I can't just take a gift without giving one back...==W== Is there anything you'd like?
A gift in return...==W== Does that mean I can ask for anything?
Er...==W== I want to say yes, but...==W== since Iris keeps a leash on our budget, I'm a little short on pocket money.
Don't worry. What I want won't cost you a cent.
You're not asking for ... bones again, are you?
What do you mean? You're just lying on a hotel bed. Don't be so tense.
Didn't you say you wanted to give me something in return?
Besides, you're sharp. As soon as I mentioned a gift "in return," you must've realized exactly what I wanted...==W== Right?
Who says a gift has to be tangible? The memories we make on the road are just as precious. Don't you agree?
I guess I see your point...
Then it's simple.==W== The gift I want is memories of us spending time together.
We've made plenty of memories since arriving here, sure. But sadly, I've always been a rather greedy person.
After all, you can never have too many memories, can you? Especially for a Trekker.
It's a pity we can't control which memories pay for our wishes... The thought of the Monolith devouring my time with you is ... rather unpleasant.
Isn't this specific memory a little ... scary?
Hm? What are you staring at...?==W== Oh! This? You mean the syringe?
I'm not going to use it on you; it's just for atmosphere.
Ah...==W== Just imagining the face you'll make, the sounds you'll let slip...==W== It's getting me all worked up...!
Don't be scared. A doctor's gotta be gentle with her patients, right?
... Ah, wait. What we are again... Doctor and assistant? No... Surely something far more intimate...
Hehe...==W== You know you're special to me, don't you? I wouldn't do anything ... naughty.
Hehe, always so guarded...==W====RT==Come now, relax. Focus on my voice ... and surrender your body and mind to me.
Making new memories together, far from home...==W== Mmm,==W== now that is the perfect souvenir!
Ahh...==W== My body feels ... weightless. Incredible.==W== You've got magic hands, Coronis.
Makes my clumsy attempt earlier look downright embarrassing...
Just your first time, that's all! Besides, your technique wasn't half bad.
Glad to hear it...==W== But I'm the one getting the massage.==W== How is this a gift in return for you?
How is it not?==W== Like I said ... what I wanted was the memory.
Every twitch, every face you made, every little noise...==W== I've memorized them all. Mmm... I'm quite satisfied.
Don't say it like that! It's embarrassing enough already...
Honestly, it felt so good my mind just went blank...
By the way, might I keep you a little longer?
Memories hold their shape better when spoken aloud. Why don't we have tea and ...==W== savor everything that's happened here?
Well, if you put it that way...==W== I look forward to your tea, Coronis.
Then I'll brew my finest leaves. Do look forward to it,==W== my one and only little assistant.

Oh? You here to shop, too?
Ah, Coronis. Just picking up souvenirs before we head back.==W== You here for supplies?
Perfect timing. I wanted to check out the local specialties myself.==W== Actually, could you help me pick some suitable gifts?
Thanks. I'm relying on you, then,==W== my dear assistant.
It's nice that she trusts me, but what if we have different tastes?...==W== Well, I'll give it a shot!
Weren't we buying gifts...?==W== How did we end up in the woods?
Coronis? Aren't we supposed to go get some local specialties?
Mm-hm. I remember it being right around here...
Finding city specialties in a forest? Does that make any sense?
Found it!==W== I couldn't move it alone. That's why I asked for your help.
Well? Isn't it beautiful? I spotted it when I first arrived. Can't believe it was left out here, exposed like this...
My, it's preserved perfectly.==W== Never seen this species in Philae or Emor. I absolutely have to take it back for study.
Almost forgot...==W== This is Coronis's style...
Ahaha...==W== It certainly suits your taste. Alright, let me grab this end—
Heh...==W== Lucky us. Looks like we're adding another souvenir to the collection today.
Step back, Boss. It'd be a waste to shatter its fine skeleton by mistake.
Never thought I'd see the day I pity a monster...
The hotel owner eyed us really suspiciously, but at least we got it back in one piece. Thanks, my assistant.
By the way...==W== Mind if I ask for one more favor?
She has her sights on another set of bones?
Since these are for Igna, I need snacks with a long shelf life. Might be a while before I see her again...
Which of these two looks better?
Huh? Let's see...==W== I'd go with the baked ones. They look pretty appealing and appetizing.
Mm, good point.==W== Excuse me, could I get this gift-wrapped?
Huh. So she also buys normal souvenirs.
Who's Igna? A friend?==W== Well, at least she's not gifting a bag of bones. No, that's rude...==W== I shouldn't judge...
Huh? Sorry, zoned out...==W== What's up?
Nothing major...==W== Heh. Thinking something rude about me, were we?
Eh? No I wasn't! Why would you say—
Dilated pupils, irregular breathing...==W== Heh, never mind. Let's hit the next shop.
I can't hide anything from her...==W== This doctor is terrifyingly sharp!
Is this stall selling ...==W== traditional handicraft?
What's wrong? Surprised? Even I have the right to appreciate beauty, don't I?
Knew it. This color suits your complexion perfectly.
Excuse me, I'll take this. Mind if we pay with it on?
Wait! This is way too nice! I can't accept this!
It's fine. Consider it a gift. I saw it the other day and knew it'd look good on you.
Besides, I've dragged you around all day. Just think of it as a thank-you.
Fine...==W== If you insist. I'll accept it.
But I can't just take a gift without giving one back...==W== Is there anything you'd like?
A gift in return...==W== Does that mean I can ask for anything?
Er...==W== I want to say yes, but...==W== since Iris keeps a leash on our budget, I'm a little short on pocket money.
Don't worry. What I want won't cost you a cent.
You're not asking for ... bones again, are you?
What do you mean? You're just lying on a hotel bed. Don't be so tense.
Didn't you say you wanted to give me something in return?
Besides, you're sharp. As soon as I mentioned a gift "in return," you must've realized exactly what I wanted...==W== Right?
Who says a gift has to be tangible? The memories we make on the road are just as precious. Don't you agree?
I guess I see your point...
Then it's simple.==W== The gift I want is memories of us spending time together.
We've made plenty of memories since arriving here, sure. But sadly, I've always been a rather greedy person.
After all, you can never have too many memories, can you? Especially for a Trekker.
It's a pity we can't control which memories pay for our wishes... The thought of the Monolith devouring my time with you is ... rather unpleasant.
Isn't this specific memory a little ... scary?
Hm? What are you staring at...?==W== Oh! This? You mean the syringe?
I'm not going to use it on you; it's just for atmosphere.
Ah...==W== Just imagining the face you'll make, the sounds you'll let slip...==W== It's getting me all worked up...!
Don't be scared. A doctor's gotta be gentle with her patients, right?
... Ah, wait. What we are again... Doctor and assistant? No... Surely something far more intimate...
Hehe...==W== You know you're special to me, don't you? I wouldn't do anything ... naughty.
Hehe, always so guarded...==W====RT==Come now, relax. Focus on my voice ... and surrender your body and mind to me.
Making new memories together, far from home...==W== Mmm,==W== now that is the perfect souvenir!
Ahh...==W== My body feels ... weightless. Incredible.==W== You've got magic hands, Coronis.
Makes my clumsy attempt earlier look downright embarrassing...
Just your first time, that's all! Besides, your technique wasn't half bad.
Glad to hear it...==W== But I'm the one getting the massage.==W== How is this a gift in return for you?
How is it not?==W== Like I said ... what I wanted was the memory.
Every twitch, every face you made, every little noise...==W== I've memorized them all. Mmm... I'm quite satisfied.
Don't say it like that! It's embarrassing enough already...
Honestly, it felt so good my mind just went blank...
By the way, might I keep you a little longer?
Memories hold their shape better when spoken aloud. Why don't we have tea and ...==W== savor everything that's happened here?
Well, if you put it that way...==W== I look forward to your tea, Coronis.
Then I'll brew my finest leaves. Do look forward to it,==W== my one and only little assistant.

strings.text: As the breeze dies and the blooms fade, the world awakes to find the floral expanse is but a woven dream.
Tonight at midnight, I will arrive to claim the Pure White Piece.==RT==<margin-right=6em><align=right>—The Nameless Phantom</align></margin>
Is this ...==W== a calling card?==W== "The Pure White Piece"...==W== Is it the Seal of Grace?
I've never heard of this thief, though.==W== Maybe it's just a prank?==W== But then again, if it isn't...
What am I supposed to do?==W== The New Star Guild won't be back from their commission for two days. If the thief visits now, I'm defenseless...
Ah, right!==W== I still have that business card. Maybe I'll give Goodwind Homecare a try...
Where is she?==W== We're supposed to meet right around here.
Sorry to keep you waiting! Goodwind Homecare, at your service!==W== You're ==PLAYER_NAME==, right? The one who requested a bodyguard?
Huh?==W== Oh...==W== Yeah, that's me. And you are...?
Senpais are swamped right now, so I'm filling in for them!==W== Don't you worry. I'll keep you safe!
Leave it to me!==W== By the way, mind if I take a look at the seal before we get to work?
I need to be familiar with the real one, otherwise I might not notice if it's swapped for a fake.
Hehe...==W== You're still such an easy mark, aren't you?
Wait... That tone.==W== You can't be...?!
You need to keep your guard up.==W== If I were the phantom thief, I'd have swiped that seal ages ago.
Otoha?!==W== Wh-What are you doing here?
Your voice doesn't match the face at all! I never would have guessed...==W== Gwah!?
S-sorry! I'm in a rush!==W== My apologies—!
Hey!==W== Watch where you're going, lady.==W== My bad, Otoha...
She was standing right here...==W== How'd she vanish like that?
Don't bother looking. That was just a magical clone of me.
A clone?==W== You mean I've been talking to...?
Spot on. That Goodwind maid was nothing more than a magic illusion.==W== What do you think? Isn't it flawless?
It's impressive,==W== but why waste such high-level magic on me?
Isn't it obvious?==W== I wanted to see you all flustered.
What a total waste of talent!
Hmm...==W== A calling card from a phantom thief.
That's right. I'd like to hire you as a bodyguard, to be safe.
Sure.==W== But Boss,==W== doesn't this letter seem off to you?==W== Did it never cross your mind==W== that I might've staged the whole thing?
I'd be lying if I said the thought never crossed my mind. But you don't have a motive.
Who knows?==W== Maybe I only put on this little show because I was just dying to see you, Boss?
You're too skilled for a clumsy ruse like that. If you wanted to see me, you'd just drop in.
Even if you were hiding something, you'd probably slip in disguised as someone I trust.==W== If you were playing for keeps, you wouldn't leave a single trace for me to find.
And you certainly wouldn't have broken character so early.
Hehe...==W== So, you even noticed I left those gaps on purpose. That's very insightful.
My apologies for the little test.==W== You're right, of course. This thief has nothing to do with me.
Now, back to business. Let's get ready for our uninvited guest.
... And tie another rope to secure it...==W== Alright, I think this should do it.
Whew. Setting up even one trap is a total workout. Hope she's alright.
Otoha, I'm all done over here. Anything else you need a hand with?
Be careful...==W== I've already rigged this whole area. Please, try to stay put.
I'm fine.==W== Sorry for breaking your trap, though...
Don't worry about it.==W== It was just a trap—==W==okay, restored.
W-Wow.==W== You fixed that in a heartbeat. Took me forever just to set one up...
Occupational hazard. I've had plenty of practice with my hands.
Aside from that shin-buster, I've prepped arrows, boulders, explosives...==W== All sorts of fun—==W==I mean, delightful traps.
... Your explanation's terrifying.==W== Glad I triggered a "safer" one.
But this is a public area. Are you sure turning it into a minefield is a good idea?
No worries.==W== I've leaked a rumor about hazardous waste on-site. That'll keep the crowds away until tomorrow.
Hehe. There will be no collateral damage when it comes to a true professional.
Well then.==W== That's all for preparations. Let's relax with some tea and treats while we wait for our guest to drop in.
Yeah, good to go on my end.
That's the spirit. And it's midnight in...==W== Three,==W== two,==W== one—
Behold the rising star among phantom thieves—the Nameless Phantom! True to my calling card, I've come for the Pure White Piece—
O-Ouch...==W== Exactly how many traps are there...?
I heard that the Boss is weak. Wasn't expecting such a massive "welcome gift"...
But I'm a phantom thief! I never walk away from a prize! Like the card says, the Seal of Grace is mine!
Oh my. Still standing? You're tougher than you look.==W== Please stay back, Boss.
Dammit... Nobody said the Boss had a bodyguard like this...
I'm on the payroll. It's only right that I give my client their money's worth. Hehe...==W== Prepare yourself.
Huh? That umbrella...==W== W-Wait, is that a weapon!?
Sure is. Chic, don't you think?
You're barely on your feet...==W== Ready to throw in the towel?
Forgive me, but I've got people counting on me!!
Hahaha!! How's that for a gift in return!==W== What'd you say? Taste my magic!
Alright, I'll just take the Seal—
Leaving so soon? We're not finished here.
No way! I knocked you out!
C-Clone magic…!?==W== I see. What I just defeated was just a fake!
Heh. Took you long enough. Maybe try to aim better this time.
Dammit, just stand still and get hit!!
Your aim is perfect...==W== But you don't have the sharpest eyes.
A magical clone only works if there's a real body to mimic.
But sometimes ...==W== even I can't tell which one's real.
Well... Enough chit-chat.==W== Time to bring the curtain down.
Ugh... I-I'm sorry...==W== I've learned my lesson...
You look like a regular guy to me.==W== Why play phantom thief and go after the Seal of Grace of all things?
I... I just happened to overhear those bigwigs talking about it...==W== That the Boss possesses a priceless Seal of Grace.
N-No idea.==W== A few days ago, a company in the Gold District held a grand opening ceremony, and I was hired as a cleaner there. That's when I overheard their conversation.
Boss, looks like you'll have to be more careful from now on.==W== Mine are not the only eyes watching you in the shadows. Hehe.
Yeah, I'll remember that.==W== By the way, what's with this phantom thief identity?
Call yourself what you want. You're still just a petty thief at the end of the day.
If you're serious about making money, get an honest job.==W== Here. Take this card.
An acquaintance of mine runs this workshop.==W== With your knack for magic, the pay should be decent.
Th-Thank you so much!==W== I'll never forget your kindness!
Phew.==W== Glad that's finally over.==W== Thanks, Otoha. I couldn't have kept the Seal of Grace safe without your help.
Hehe, I could hardly refuse you, Boss.==W== Besides, having you owe me a favor is a nice bonus.
Why does it sound like bad news to me?
By the way... Is this the real you? Or am I still talking to a clone?
Hehe, isn't it obvious?==W== I'm the real deal—the one and only~

strings.text: As the midnight bells ring and the celebrations quiet down, she, too, deserves a gift of her own after a long day.
Tyrant! I bet your favorite fries are the Fried Chicken-flavored ones, right?
No way! The Tyrant is definitely Team Gingerbread!
Unless ... what the Tyrant really craves isn't a snack, but ... me? Oh, you! But I guess that's okay...==W== I've even got Laru-flavored fries, you know.
Come on, Tyrant! Which one is your favorite?!
This has to be a dream. It's gotta be!
A few hours earlier, the night of the Snowish Festival—
Phew, I'm beat. Who knew handing out gifts would be such a workout?
Yawn...==W== So sleepy. I'll deal with the rest ...==W== tomorrow...
Where am I...? Shouldn't I be asleep on the Lucky Oasis!?
This place...==W== It looks like the inside of a Monolith.
Laru and the Shrubshrews are ... fighting?
Oh, Tyrant! Please, I'm begging you—help me!
If those things catch us...==W== They're gonna make us into chew toys!
I'm helpless! You wouldn't just stand there and watch, would you?
That's true, but without a weapon...==W== Wait. I can use my shoe!
Used the Slippers from Key Items.
Oh, Tyrant! Thanks to you, we're safe from becoming Shrubshrew snacks!
<size=80%>That bite mark on her back...==W== Well, I should stay quiet.</size>
Laru, I'm just glad you're not hurt.
I'm not the ordinary Laru anymore...
What are you up to now...?
Never mind that! Let me introduce myself properly.
Behold! Laru, the princess==W== of the Kingdom of Fries, has arrived! And I’m personally here to challenge the shrubshrews!
Those scoundrels were after our fry fields! They ambushed us, and—oops—I got surrounded.
...Where are you getting all this gibberish from...
We've chased off all the shrubshrews, so I'm taking you back to Kingdom of Fries now~
...Are you planning to launch me over there?
Let's roll! Destination: Kingdom of Fries!
Every table in the room is heaped with fries ... and a Laru stands in front of every single one.
Why are there so many of her?!
Since we can't agree, let's settle this with fries!
We'll feed the Tyrant our top picks, and let ==SEX4== be the judge!
Uh, no thanks. I can feed myself...
Heheh...==W== No escape! Get the Tyrant, girls! Surround ==SEX4==!
Got it! Everyone gets a turn, so get in line!
Surrounded by fries... Lucky you, Tyrant. Which flavor are you going to start with?
Try mine! They're sweet and tasty...==W== One bite and you're hooked!
My fries are good for your health! Come on, eat up, eat up!
There's no escape! What do I do...
How'd you fall asleep? Was it... a food coma?
Ugh, time's up already? Fun flies by, but work drags on forever!
I had a blast at this year's Snowish Festival. Here, this is for you!
Ta-da!==W== A souvenir from the Kingdom of Fries! Cute, isn't it?
I carved this one fresh. So? Spitting image of me, right?
Keep it close! That way, whenever you look at it, you'll remember our big adventure tonight.
Heheh...==W== If you lose it, I'll make you regret it.
Oh! And if you ever get swamped, just ask the doll for help. I'll pop right out to assist you with the Grand Slacker Strategy!
Slacking off, of course! I'll whisk you away to the fry fields. We'll bask in the sun, smell the fries, and have the best nap ever.
If I'm that swamped, how am I supposed to sleep?!
Just go with the flow! Who knows? Maybe some magical elves will sneak in and finish your work for you.
Wait... you didn't get ambushed by the Shrubshrews
because you were napping in the fry fields, did you?
No way! As if! A brilliant mastermind like me would never make such a rookie mistake!
Sorry... Can't keep my eyes open... Night, Laru.
What a weird dream...==W== I must be totally drained.
Huh?! Why am I here? This is Laru's room... I could've sworn I fell asleep on the Lucky Oasis.
Morning, Tyrant. Don't you remember? You were totally out of it last night, so I had to bring you back to my place.
Then I got sleepy too, so I just crashed right next to you.
I-Is that what happened? Sorry for the trouble.
Stay for breakfast! I have different fly flavors. They're delicious!
Uh, actually, I just remembered I have something urgent to do. Gotta run, bye!
Aww...==W== Tyrant... But you loved the fries last night...
Phew, made it out. Sleeping at Laru's place and having that weird dream... Talk about awkward.
All that stuff last night...==W== It was a dream, right? It had to be!

Keep it close! That way, whenever you look at it, you'll remember our big adventure tonight.
Heheh...==W== If you lose it, I'll make you regret it.
Oh! And if you ever get swamped, just ask the doll for help. I'll pop right out to assist you with the Grand Slacker Strategy!
Slacking off, of course! I'll whisk you away to the fry fields. We'll bask in the sun, smell the fries, and have the best nap ever.
If I'm that swamped, how am I supposed to sleep?!
Just go with the flow! Who knows? Maybe some magical elves will sneak in and finish your work for you.
Wait... you didn't get ambushed by the Shrubshrews
because you were napping in the fry fields, did you?
No way! As if! A brilliant mastermind like me would never make such a rookie mistake!
Sorry... Can't keep my eyes open... Night, Laru.
What a weird dream...==W== I must be totally drained.
Huh?! Why am I here? This is Laru's room... I could've sworn I fell asleep on the Lucky Oasis.
Morning, Tyrant. Don't you remember? You were totally out of it last night, so I had to bring you back to my place.
Then I got sleepy too, so I just crashed right next to you.
I-Is that what happened? Sorry for the trouble.
Stay for breakfast! I have different fly flavors. They're delicious!
Uh, actually, I just remembered I have something urgent to do. Gotta run, bye!
Aww...==W== Tyrant... But you loved the fries last night...
Phew, made it out. Sleeping at Laru's place and having that weird dream... Talk about awkward.
All that stuff last night...==W== It was a dream, right? It had to be!

strings.text: Where the stars twinkle, children's wishes find their home.
Firefly, pin them down! Don't let them strike back!
Got it. Avalanche, auto-target mode: active.
Nope. That was fun. Firefly is completely satisfied.
She's terrifying as ever in a fight... Actually dominated a Stellaroid Boss.
I did what you say, and the rest was easy... Bang, bang, bang, job done. Tyrant's words are like magic.
With Tyrant around, Firefly is invincible.
That's a relief...==W== Since I can't fight on the front lines with the rest of you.
With Canace's permission, Firefly and I head to the Monolith today. Our target is...
"Photo Capturer film"... Will the wish work today?
That depends on how well you picture it. A clearer, more precise image means a better chance of success...
Hmm... Mostly practice. Try it a few times and you'll get the hang of it.

Actually, the New Star Guild sometimes touches the Wishing Box together...==W== But they have to picture the exact same thing and pool their knowledge. If they don't, the success rate actually tanks...
Is that Amber's trick? Does it work every time?
Ummmmm...==W== It works about three out of ten times.
People have plenty of tricks. Like saying the wish out loud.

I've even heard rumors about walking clockwise around the box twice, then counterclockwise seventeen times, tapping the lid seven times to a beat, and finishing with a roundhouse kick... Supposedly, a fairy pops out.
How do you usually do it, Tyrant?
I... Well, since we have the actual item right here, let's try this...
Did you bring the Photo Capturer film?
Alright, stare closely at the film with me... Now, put your hands on the box.
Now close your eyes and keep quiet... Picture the film in your head, and repeat after me—
O mighty God of Grace, please hear our prayer—
Please grant us ... an Artifact==RT==to get this Photo Capturer working again!
It's the film! Great job, Firefly. It worked!
The film...! Firefly is happy! Tyrant is amazing! Thank you!
You can try this yourself next time...==W== But even if you know how to wish, no climbing the Monolith alone, okay?
Good girl! Well... We got what we came for. Time to head back.

—Wait, Firefly?
What's wrong? Why are you grabbing my hand...

Hey, Firefly...!?
Where are you taking me!
Firefly? I know we cleared out most of the Stellaroids,==W== but we still need to be careful. Don't wander off!
No problem. Firefly will be fine.
This is the exact spot where Firefly fought the Stellaroids and took her "victory photo."
This is where Tyrant took my picture for the first time... Firefly likes it here.
A Stellaroid...!? We didn't clear them all out?!
It's fine. The toys here are well-behaved. Shake.
Did she actually tame these things...!?
The magic circle's light is bouncing off the ornaments...==W== It looks like stars twinkling inside the Monolith.
It's beautiful.==W== I don't think I'd ever get tired of this view.
Keep it a secret from everyone. Nobody else knows about it... It's my special place.
But you're Firefly's best friend, Tyrant. You taught me how to make wishes today. As a thank you, I'm sharing it with you. Only you.
Thank you. I'll gladly accept your gift, Firefly.
Don't tell anyone. I mean it. Not even Ms. Canace. If you blab, we aren't friends anymore.
I definitely don't want that... Got it. I won't tell a soul. Promise.
And you can't come here by yourself... If you sneak over to play without Firefly, we aren't friends anymore either.
(How would I even find this place without her...?)
A tiny hand gently wraps around my fingers. Firefly looks up at the stars with a faint smile.
Let's climb the Monolith together again. Then, when we're done playing, we can rest right here.
From today on, this is Firefly and Tyrant's secret base.
Thank you, Firefly. You'll have to bring me here again next time.
Inside this Monolith, where no stars should ever shine, countless specks of starlight drift softly down...
The silent stars seem to gently rock a cradle, quietly watching over us as we rest...

strings.text: It is a keepsake for the two of us alone, filled with the deepest feelings I have for you.
Morning, Sparkla~==W== Today's delivery day. Got everything ready?
It's all piled up by the door. Just take it and go.
That's our Sparkla! Alright then, I'm off~==W== Gotta strike while the iron's hot and turn these goods into Dorra ASAP.
Um...==W== Bloc. What kind of birthday gift do you think is best for a friend?
A birthday gift?==W== Obviously a huge red envelope!! Stuff it full of Dorra so they can buy whatever they want~
Oh hoho...==W== Does this mean Sparkla and I have finally reached the stage of exchanging birthday gifts?!==W== Just so you know, my birthday is only—
We'll talk about that when the time comes.
Sigh...==W== I asked the wrong person after all. Rabbit Pie doesn't even need Dorra, so your advice is totally useless.
Oh, so it's for Rabbit Pie...==W== Wait a sec... Rabbit Pie has a birthday?
Of course. The day I created Rabbit Pie is that little one's birthday.
Alright, I have no more questions for you, so you can leave now.
Wait! A gift for Rabbit Pie, huh?==W== Oh, I know!
How about giving something that can be a special keepsake just for the two of you?==W== Something filled with your feelings for Rabbit Pie—something truly one of a kind.
A keepsake just for the two of us...==W== Didn't expect someone as money-obsessed as you to be so sentimental.
Huh? Really? I mean...==W== It might not seem like it, but I don't spend every second thinking about Dorra, you know!
<size=90%>Honestly, I was just copying an old ad slogan that used to be super popular...==W== Didn't think even Sparkla would buy it...</size>
Ahh, no time to chat now! I still need to finish these deliveries!==W== Catch you later, Sparkla! Thanks again for the hard work~
Ah, wait!==W== I wanted to ask more about it...==W== Running off that fast? Don't blame me if I refuse your next order.
Hmm...==W== I thought maybe browsing a gift shop would give me inspiration...==W== But nothing feels quite right...==W== Hm?
Lily, maybe we should exchange something else instead?==W== Photo capturers are too expensive, and there's no way our allowance could cover it...
They're struggling to pick a gift too? Let's go talk to them—
You're moving really far away soon...==W== And my body's too weak for me to go visit you anymore...==W== Cough, cough cough...
If I had a picture of you...==W== Then maybe I wouldn't feel so alone anymore...
I know! Then let's think of another idea together!
Hello there. I actually have a suggestion for you two, if you'd like to hear it.
Sorry, didn't mean to scare you.==W== I'm a prop designer from the "Spicy Carrot" Fairy Tale Troupe in Flavio.
Um... Did you need something from us?
I happened to overhear you talking about photos earlier. I might be able to help.

Mhm <size=60>♪</size>==W== Our troupe recently created a new kind of prop called an "Automaton Doll". Once connected to a power source, these tiny dolls can move according to pre-programmed instructions.
I'd like to make a custom Automaton Doll set just for you two. The dolls can recreate one of your favorite memories together.
Hehe. Sounds a lot more interesting than just taking a photo together, doesn't it?
That sounds amazing!==W== Ah...==W== But we don't have any money...
Don't worry about that.==W== It's my first time making this kind of prop anyway, so I'll treat it as a prototype. No charge.
Thank you so much, Miss Prop Designer!
Then let's get started right away. Why don't you tell me about a memory you want to preserve?==W== We can chat over some tasty snacks <size=60>♪</size>
Hmm...==W== There are so many memories. How do we even choose just one?
Hehe, you two really are close.
Mhm! Mimi's my best friend!==W== Even when I get sick all the time, she always stays with me and plays with me.
Oh! Mimi, what if we recreate the very first day we went out together?==W== That was the happiest day of my entire life!
We did have fun...==W== But halfway through, Lily got a fever.==W== It was my fault for dragging her outside...
Getting sick wasn't your fault! Besides...==W== There were happy things too.
And what happy thing was that? Can you tell me?

Mm. Back then, I was actually really scared...==W== I thought maybe Mimi would stop hanging out with me like the other kids did.==W== We were having fun, and then I suddenly collapsed. I figured I must've scared her...

But ...==W== Mimi came to visit me in the hospital wearing a fluffy hat. She even promised my mom, "I won't let Lily get sick anymore, so please let us keep playing together!"...==W== I was really happy.
Of course I do. That's why that day means the most to me.
Hehe, sounds like we've made our decision.
Yep! If Lily thinks that day was special, then I'll pick that one too!
Alright then. Next, tell me what you two were wearing that day.
Mmhm, perfect.==W== I've got all the details I need now. I'll make you the most special keepsake ever!
Thank you! Um...==W== About when will it be finished? Mimi's moving away really soon...
Hmm...==W== Maybe I can bring it here around noon tomorrow. How about we meet again in this same spot?
Tomorrow?!==W== Fast is great and all, but can dolls really be finished that quickly?
Of course. You can always count on your big sis ♪
Thank you! See you tomorrow, Miss Prop Designer!
Oops... I accidentally compressed the schedule down to half a day.
But seeing how excited they are... I really want to see their reactions as soon as possible.==W== Guess I'll just pull an all-nighter and finish it tonight~
Morning, you two. Mimi and Lily's Automaton Dolls are officially complete~<size=60>♪</size>
Watch closely, okay? You wind up the spring in the base like this...==W== And the two dolls start walking hand-in-hand toward the flower field.
Amazing, amazing! It's exactly like the real us from that day!
Looks like I recreated it pretty well. That's a relief. So, do you like it?
We LOVE it! Thank you so much, Miss Prop Designer!
Hehe, after Mimi moves away, I'll have this to keep me company! I'll treasure this forever!
We should get going now! Thank you again for everything!
A symbol of friendship ... carrying precious memories within it...
Mom, can't I go have a snowball fight with the other kids yet? I'm not sick anymore, you know?
Just because you're feeling a little better doesn't mean you can overdo it. The weather's been freezing lately. If you get sick again, you'll have to keep taking medicine.
I know you get lonely staying home by yourself...==W== H-How about this? I'll ask your dad to build a giant snow rabbit in the yard. You'll be able to see it right from the window.
Pfft, then it'd have to be a HUGE rabbit! Alright...==W== I'll stay inside like a good girl...
That's my good girl. Look, Mommy bought you a new fairy tale book. I know you'll love it.==W== Oh dear, your hands are still freezing cold. I'll go make the fire warmer.
... It's okay.==W== Nobody would want to play with a kid who's always stuck in bed sick anyway...
Sparkla, look outside! Dad finished building your snow rabbit!
Waaah—it's amazing!==W== Hello, snow rabbit. Would you like to be my friend?
I wish someday I could hold your hand, and we could go outside together...
This commission really brought back a lot of memories.
Thank you, you two. Because of you, I finally figured out what gift to make too.
Rabbit Pie, you can open your eyes now.
I installed a music box inside the base. Wind it up, and it'll start playing music. Doesn't it sound lovely?==W== And the dolls in the center are you and me.
Cute, right? This is the scene I always imagined of us going on adventures together~
Ever since I was little, I dreamed of having an adorable best friend who would leap right out of a fairy tale book and invite me on exciting adventures.
Someone who would always stay by my side ...==W== so I'd never have to feel the loneliness of being left all alone again.
I kept wishing for that ... until exactly one year ago today.==W== The moment you were born, every dream I ever had about friendship finally came true.
Happy birthday, my most important friend.
This is a birthday gift filled with all my gratitude and affection for you... And a proof of our friendship!
Hehe. It's okay if you don't understand yet. I believe ...==W== someday, you definitely will.
From now on, I'm counting on you too, Rabbit Pie. We're going to experience all kinds of adventures together.

strings.text: Listen to your heart in this stillness beneath.
What a beautiful morning.==W== Days like this make you want to get a head start on—
Wait, no, stop. I am on vacation...==W== I am on vacation.
One second of downtime and my brain goes straight to the office.==W== Muscle memory is terrifying.
I promised ==PLAYER_NAME== I would actually take a break today. No more working.
Time to kick back and enjoy this trip.
Morning, Willow. I was half expecting to find you buried under paperwork again.
Not to worry. Today I am officially running on vacation mode.
Honestly,==W== it's been ages since I went out for fun. I'm entirely in your hands, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Haha, you don't need to be formal. We're here to chill, not optimize a workflow. Take a breath.
There's a beach market today. Lots of games, local food. Want to go take a look?
Wow...!==W== It's livelier than I expected. Everyone looks like they're having a great time.
This brings back memories.==W== I used to come to the beach all the time back in Sailstead.
Then you must know these beach games better than I do.
Not exactly. Usually when I came out here it was to...==W== Hmm?
That is way too many tourists for this tiny security detail...==W== Should I call the Trekkers' House for backup?
Willow? Did your brain switch back to work mode?
Ah, sorry. I can't believe you noticed. Vacation mode, Willow. Need to stay in character.
Look, they're playing Beach Flags over there. Wanna give it a shot?
Beach Flags? Isn't that a competitive drill for lifeguard training? It does look fun...==W== Ah!
They're going at it so hard. An amateur could tear a muscle doing that. What if they collide?==W== I don't see a single medic stationed nearby.
Willow? Why the serious face? What's wrong?
N-Nothing. ==PLAYER_NAME==, no Beach Flags. If you got hurt out there, I'll never be able to face the New Star Guild.
We are finding a safer game to play.
Willow?! Okay, we don't have to play. Just don't pull my arm so hard!
Yep. Just like the name says. You put on a blindfold and try to smash a watermelon using nothing but voice cues from the crowd.
Th-That is way too dangerous! What if you miss the watermelon and smash someone's head open? It would be an absolute disaster...!
The stick they give you can't actually crack a skull! Plus, the people watching aren't blindfolded. They can easily dodge if things get risky.
... But if that's your concern, we can always play something else.
So you just take home whatever you manage to ring? What if a pro shows up and cleans out their entire stock? Would the owner actually hand it all over?
Hahaha! Don't you worry about that, miss! Pulling off a grand slam at my stall is harder than it looks. What do you say? Wanna give it a shot?
Wait, are you some kind of ring toss pro, Willow?
Ah, no, that's not what I meant...!==W== I was just curious about the stall's business model, that's all.==W== Sorry.
No need to apologize!==W== We're on vacation, you don't need to sweat the details. Having fun is all that matters.

Oh, honestly...==W== I can't believe you noticed me staring.

strings.text: I won't let Shia's kindness go to waste! I have to ride this wave!
"Karin, do you want to be friends?"
Happy birthday, birthday girl!==W== Here's the plushie and surfboard you asked for! <size=60>♪</size>
Wow...!==W== Thanks, Shia! Are all these gifts for me?!
Of course! Seeing you happy makes me happy! <size=60>♪</size>
Shia! I want to learn to surf right now!
I've slowly gotten the hang of sailing and reading waves. Surfing can't be that different. I'll pick it up in no time!
Hmm...==W== Karin, don't you think it's a bit early to head straight into the water?
I'm fine! I'm getting the hang of it...==W== One more time!
Let's practice on the beach a bit more first. What part is giving you trouble?
It feels like I'm fighting the whole ocean.==W== I can't even stand up. The waves knock me off, the current steals the board, and I can't keep my balance at all.
I see...==W== How about==W== we go about this a different way?
That's right! Don't try to fight against the ocean, try to make friends with it!
<size=85%>Argh...</size>==W==<size=85%> I don't get what Shia is saying. She's trying so hard to teach me, yet all I am is useless.</size>
<size=85%>But if I give up now, I'd be letting Shia down. I'm going to learn to surf, no matter what!</size>
Nobody around?==W== Great. Secret training begins!
You're Shia's stand-in today. Watch closely!
Ugh...==W== Failed again.==W== What does making friends with the ocean even mean?==W== The ocean isn't friendly at all...
"It's okay! You made friends with me, Karin, didn't you? You can make friends with the ocean too! <size=60>♪</size>"
Really? Hehe, well if Shia says so, I've got this!
Huh? Come to think of it...==W== Shia said something like that before.==W== Wait...
What's that look for? Stop staring at me like I'm pathetic!
"Look at this dumb bunny talking to a plushie."
I know what you're thinking! Shut up! Mind your own business!
Who's a dumb bunny?! Hmph, you wait. I'll become a surfing pro!
Yes...==W== Yes! I'm up!==W== I'm finally on the board!
Now to ride the wave...==W== Pwah!
Wah...==W== I finally stood up, and the wave knocked me down again. What's the point?==W== The ocean just won't be my friend...==W== Ow!
Stupid bird! Why are you tugging at my hair? Let go!
Uh...? Do you want me to follow you?
She looks at where the bird's pulling her towards. Colorful fish and turtles sway with the waves.
Is that what you meant?! Mind your business!
Don't be mad, Karin. They're showing you how it's done.
Wait, Shia's plushie? How'd you get here? I left you on the beach...==W== And hold on, I didn't even open my mouth! How are you talking?!
I'm talking inside your head, Karin <size=60>♪</size>
Don't worry about that <size=60>♪</size> Copy that jellyfish. It said you were fighting the water too hard.
<size=85%>Copy a jellyfish?! Well...</size>==W==<size=85%> If you say so...</size>
That's my Karin! <size=60>♪</size> Keep going! Now let's try other sea creatures!
Did you see that?! I broke my record again!
Okay, at least I'm good enough now to not make Shia cringe...==W== Wait, where am I?
Oh, crap! I was so in the zone I drifted way out to sea! What do I do? I can't even see the shore...
Am I gonna die out here like an idiot?==W==<size=120%> No, no, no! No way!</size>
Calm down, Karin. You've got this, I know you do!
But what can I do? Sure, I know how to surf now, but that's not gonna get me all the way back to land!
That's not true. You're an awesome surfer. If you just make friends with the ocean, I know you can ride out any wave.
Make friends with the ocean...==W== Here we go again.
<size=85%>Again...?==W== Oh! I knew that sounded familiar. Shia told me the exact same thing before...</size>==W==
Want to know the secret to sailing?
Yeah! I wanna be like you, Shia! I want to sail through anything that comes my way!
The trick is to stop fighting the sea.==W== Feel the tides, the wind, the creatures around you. Make them your friends.
Then sailing will feel as natural as moving your own arms and legs.
Make friends? Aren't you supposed to conquer the waves with pure skill?
Nope. To a seafaring Trekker, Karin, the ocean is never the enemy. The ocean is—
A friend...==W== That's right. That's what Shia told me back then.
But all I cared about was beating the ocean...==W== No wonder I couldn't do it.
Karin, look out! Monster wave incoming! You're gonna get swallowed whole!
Whatever, it's now or never! Like Shia said: feel the current, remember how the sea creatures moved...
Whoa...==W== I'm riding it!==W== This wave is massive and I'm actually riding it!
Oh? You're guiding me to shore?
Alright,==W== watch me ride this straight back to Carlo Town!
I tamed a monster wave on my first try...==W== Am I a surfing prodigy?!
Ow! What is your problem, you stupid bird! Quit pecking my head or I'll swat you!
I think it's telling you not to let this go to your head. By the way, Karin, don't you have something to say?
Thank you, everyone in the ocean! If you hadn't shown me the ropes, I never would've gotten the hang of surfing.
And if this annoying bird hadn't led the way, I'd probably be lost at sea. I only made it back safe because of you guys!
I owe this all to you!==W== Thank you!
Hehe...==W== I guess this means ...==W== the ocean and I are finally friends, huh?
Look, Karin. The fish are swimming right up to you.
They're saying it's nice to meet their new friend! <size=60>♪</size>
... Thank you! We're officially best friends now!
Be safe on your way back! Let's play again next time we meet!
You scared me riding in on that massive wave! Are you alright? Did you swallow any water?
I'm fine! The plushie you gave me and my sea friends helped me out.
The plushie? And your sea friends?
The plushie you gave me talked! It spoke right into my head...==W== Even translated what the animals were saying.
I made that plushie myself,==W== and I definitely didn't give it any magic powers...
What?! No way...==W== Wait, YOU made this?! Oh no, did I get it dirty?!
Hehe, looks perfectly fine to me. I don't entirely understand what happened out there, but it sounds like you and the ocean have become friends, Karin.
We have! Come on, Shia, let's go surfing!
Let me show you everything my friends taught me!
Maybe that voice from the plushie ...==W== was the ocean itself.
