strings.text: The me in the painting and the me in the mirror—which one is the real me?
No. Show us the next one.
My lady, please reconsider. A Trekker lived here before you. It'd be perfect for a guild base.
Plus, there's a bonus if you sign today! We'll even throw in the Monolith exploration gear the previous tenant so kindly left behind...
Keep it. I won't risk taking on someone else's baggage for a few freebies. Let's move on.
<size=85%>Isn't Eleanor being a bit too picky?</size>
<size=85%>Once bitten, twice shy. She got scammed before, so naturally she's extra careful this time.</size>
You have excellent taste! It was recently renovated, one of our premium listings.
Why not, Eleanor? I thought this one was nice...
Look closely at the layout. There is zero airflow. The air will stagnate, and it'll be suffocating in the long term.
... I think we have moved past simple caution now.
She sounds like a fussy old lady.
This is the last property we have available. But it might not be fit for a lady of your standing.
The building's not too old, and the layout makes sense. This is what a Trekker base should look like.
She has a point...==W== It's a quick walk to both the Trekkers' House and the Monolith.
But as you can see, isn't the environment a bit spartan for you? It only has the bare essentials...
That's a plus. An empty room means no blind spots to hide suspicious traps.
We can buy our own furniture.==W== Heh, I'm already looking forward to decorating.
Yes. Look at that corner over there. It's the perfect spot for my favorite table.
Hang some paintings on the walls, and our headquarters will look much grander!
Great idea. Don't we happen to have a master painter right here with us?
Wait, you want to use my paintings?
You are the best artist among the three of us, aren't you?
Then there's no time to lose. Let's head to Eleanor's house and pick a few out.
Whoa, hold on, you two. Stop pulling me so hard...
My ladies! Are you still signing the lease or not?!
I brought over my old paintings, but ...==W== they are all practice pieces.
Wow, I didn't expect there to be so many. Look, I've always loved this one.
We'll take that one, then. As for the rest...
What about hanging a portrait? We have family portraits on the walls at my house.
Exactly. Eleanor is our Guild Captain, so it only makes sense to hang her portrait up as our centerpiece.
Hanging up my own picture for a reason like that ...==W== feels a little embarrassing.
Well, it's not. You are our proud captain and the face of our guild.
She's right. Pick out one of your portraits, Eleanor. You must have had someone paint you before.
My family hired a famous painter to do one recently...==W== Give me a second, I'll go grab it.
It's beautifully done. Captured your features well. It's ideal for our centerpiece.
Yeah, it's a good painting. But...
I can't quite explain it.==W== It is supposed to be me, but it looks like a stranger to me.
Hmm. Now that you mention it...==W== The expression on your face does look a little off...
Yes. The way you smile now is much prettier than the one in the painting.
I was thinking the same thing...==W== Well, why don't we commission a new one?
Umm...==W== Let's not. That money would be better spent on the guild.
Plus, being a model is exhausting.==W== You have to sit still for a whole afternoon. I never want to go through that again.
Ugh, I know what you mean. I've had to do the same thing.
Then how about you paint it yourself, Eleanor? A self-portrait.
A self-portrait...?==W== I've never tried painting one before...==W== Alright, I'll give it a shot!
Sigh...==W== I talked such a big game,==W== yet I can't paint anything that satisfies myself...
I've painted it over and over, but all of them just felt awkward. I followed the proper techniques, so why does the girl in the painting look like someone else?
"The way you smile now is much prettier."==W== What exactly is different?
... I can't figure it out. I should go for a walk to clear my head.
This has become my favorite spot. The "dance floor" where I danced with Mentor...==W== The scenery is beautiful. It always calms me down.
I wonder if Mentor would know where this weird feeling is coming from.
... No! I can't keep relying on Mentor. I need to solve my own problems.
... I didn't realize a place like this was hiding deep in the woods. The water is crystal clear. So beautiful.
Come to think of it, I read in a book that people used to paint self-portraits using their reflections in the river.==W== I should try that.
Uh...==W== I guess it should look something like this...==W== Huh?
Why does it look different from the mirror?==W== Is it the water? Or my clothes?
... The me in this reflection looks happy. It seems this forest has helped me relax. The old me would never have dreamed of coming out to the wild to clear my head.
In the past, taking a break meant reading, drinking tea, or painting...==W== Those things made me happy, yes, but back then, I didn't know there were other ways to enjoy life.
If I hadn't become a Trekker, I would have spent my whole life not knowing...==W== Ah.
A breeze brushes past Eleanor's cheeks, and sunlight filters through the leaves. She lifts her head and gazes up at the endless sky.
... Right. It all makes sense. I haven't been that version of myself for a long time already.
Trekkers are freer and hold more potential than anyone else.
Trekkers are free.==W== In that case...
Struck by a sudden realization, Eleanor stands up.
I think I finally understand...==W== It's time to head back.

I am Eleanor, the "Lady Trekker." How can those high-society techniques capture the Trekker I am today? I need to forget the formulas, the theories, the rules... I'll paint from the heart.==W== That is the only way to do justice to who I am now.
I'll capture the joy I've felt since becoming a Trekker, along with my hopes for the future. I'll paint the real "me"...!
Vivian, Caterine, welcome. As of today, this is our guild headquarters!
Finally.==W== Heh, choosing this place was the right call.
We all chose it at first sight. I guess great minds think alike.

I wanna go on an adventure!

I wanna be friends with a kitty.

You get used to it. If you'd like, I can read from it tonight. It's been a while.
Speaking of which, why don't you tell me the story of your dreams, Boss?

strings.text: To be by the person's side again, the knight makes a vow under the stars and the tower.
Good. Bring it down hard. Loosen your wrists. Leave yourself room to pivot.
Better. Center your weight. You're leaning too far forward. You need balance to shift your stance.
Alright, let's try a real fight, ==PLAYER_NAME==. Come at me with everything we covered. Don't hold back.
Blades ring out in the quiet night. Gripping my training sword, I throw everything I have into the offensive.
A basic slash is just gonna get blocked. She said use everything, so...
Feint a slash to set up a thrust
The tip of my sword slips right past her guard. My first clean hit of the night.
What...==W== What just happened? I-I'm on the ground?
Alina, ease up...==W== I can't breathe! I yield!
S-Sorry, ==PLAYER_NAME==! That was pure reflex. Are you hurt?==W== Here, let me help you up.
I'm fine, don't worry about it. Besides, you protected me, right? When you took me down,==W== you grabbed my shoulders to break the fall.
But hey, wasn't that move pretty slick? I actually forced you to pin me! My swordplay must be getting somewhere, huh?
Your swordplay...==W== It is smoother. And feinting the slash to set up a thrust was clever.
But your body lacks conditioning. It just can't keep up with your head. When you shifted your stance, you left a massive opening.
The kind of opening that ...==W== makes an opponent instinctively want to close the gap, sweep your legs, and drop a headbutt.
It was just too tempting. My body reacted on its own. Thank the stars I stopped before the headbutt.
Wait. So you didn't grab me gently to break my fall... You were pulling me in to break my nose?!
Hey now, isn't that a little brutal?! We're supposed to be practicing!
Ahem. That was my mistake. But if you don't go all out in practice, you won't last a second in a real fight.
You felt it too, didn't you, ==PLAYER_NAME==? Your body is holding your brain's response back. The best tactics in the world mean nothing==W== if you can't execute them.
But conditioning doesn't happen overnight. Even if you train every day, you need months to see real results.
Starting tomorrow, come jogging with me at night. We'll mix stamina work with your sword forms. Just stick with it, and eventually, everything will get better.
Got it, got it. I'll take it seriously.
Still, get you talking about swords and you'll never want to stop.
Wha—? D-Do I? Am I really that chatty?
Come to think of it, out of all the time we spend alone, I'd say fifty percent of it is just training...
Th-That's not true!==W== We patrol together too... Speaking of, let's go on patrol right now! A change of pace will do you good.
And the other fifty percent is patrolling.
Yeah. I have absolutely no comeback for that.
I hate to admit it, but my life is just ...==W== monotonous. It must be a total bore hanging out with me, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Objectively? Yeah, it's a little dull.==W== But doing it all with you makes up for it.
It does?==W== But... I'm hardly interesting. I'm nowhere near as sharp or well-read as Elis, and I don't know Filanis half as well as Lulu.
Just being around you makes me feel safe.
My swordplay is good, and I will always protect you. But I can't fix every single problem.
Even when patrolling the "perfect" city of Filanis, we could run into a starving thief, or some violent thug from another city.
Y-You absolutely can't drop your guard just because I'm here! You can't just feel safe. What if we get ambushed?
Strictly speaking, I can't guarantee your safety in every conceivable scenario. So...==W== Please don't let your guard down.
I didn't mean that kind of safe. I mean...==W== Even when we're walking through the dark, and even though barely anyone here knows what you do for them...
... You never get discouraged. And you never stop pushing for a better tomorrow.
You're like a warm little sun. Just being around you, I catch some of your drive.
Phew. I need to step it up, too. When you finally earn your way back into the Monolith, I'm going to find a way home.
Your home...==W== Would you tell me about it more?
You said before that there are no slaves there...==W== What kind of city is it?
Oh, my home isn't exactly a city. It's a vehicle.
My friends and I drive it all over the world. But it's true, out of all the places we've visited, none of them have slaves.
That sounds ...==W== so free. Growing up, the only places I've ever known are the Grand Arena in Emor and Filanis.
I don't even know ...==W== what Emor looks like outside the Arena walls.
You'll get your chance. You're free now too, Alina. You're only staying behind to repay a debt, and to help make Filanis a better place.
Someday, Filanis will be the city you've always dreamed of. When that day comes...==W== If I'm still around, we'll go traveling together.
Ah, look at the time. I need to start patrol and blow the timekeeping horn.
You stayed up late last night doing the Night Watchers' ledgers...==W== Can you even keep your eyes open?
Don't underestimate me. I'm the ultimate night owl.
Fast asleep after all. You drifted off right in the middle of walking, holding onto my sword hilt.
You've been pushing yourself too hard lately, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Alina scoops up the ==SEX9== who's leaning against her, pushes open the insula door, and gently lays ==SEX4== down on the bed.
<size=85%>Does being by my side ...</size>==W==<size=85%> really make you feel safe?</size>
<size=85%>To be honest...</size>==W==<size=85%> Being by your side makes me feel safe, too.</size>
<size=85%>Especially ...</size>==W==<size=85%> when I look at your sleeping face.</size>
The night patrol ends. Alina sits down, leaning against the edge of the bed.
Beneath the cold starlight, their soft breathing syncs as they drift into a deep slumber.
Sometime later, the knight jolts awake.
The bed is empty. The pillows and blankets are neatly arranged, as if inviting a weary traveler to rest.
The knight never sleeps in the bed. She is used to dozing off against its edge. That bed...==W== It's reserved for someone. Someone important to her.
The knight picks up her longsword and steps out of the cramped insula, bathed in cold starlight.
The Filanis of today no longer needs her night patrols.
Young citizens have joined the Night Watchers, taking daily shifts to guard the city that belongs to them.
Yet she still leaves the house at this hour out of habit, stepping into the empty lot beside the insula.
Her gaze wanders. She searches for a silhouette, waiting for a familiar voice to call her name.
But her own soft chuckle breaks the illusion.
She is no longer Alina. She is Noya, an insignificant existence.
A Noya who wants to become the Noya ==PLAYER_NAME== spoke of...==W== A Noya even ==PLAYER_NAME== doesn't know yet.
What am I looking for out here? ==SEX1== is right there, inside the Monolith.
The knight murmurs to herself, slowly raising her longsword into a guard, as if the companion with more ideas than sword skills still stands right in front of her.
I will protect this future you brought us. Always.
I'll make sure the marks you left on Filanis endure.==W== Until the day you fulfill our promise.
Yes. As long as I stick with it, everything will be fine. Every wish will come true.
I have no regrets, ==PLAYER_NAME==. And I don't think you do, either.
Just watch me. I'm going to get even stronger.
Next time, I will protect you to the very end. So please... Let me make one wish.
The knight raises her sword in a vow to the night sky. Out here,==RT==the only ones listening to her wish are the stars above and the silent tower.
As for whether that wish comes true... That is a story for another age.

I'm fine, don't worry about it. Besides, you protected me, right? When you took me down,==W== you grabbed my shoulders to break the fall.
But hey, wasn't that move pretty slick? I actually forced you to pin me! My swordplay must be getting somewhere, huh?
Your swordplay...==W== It is smoother. And feinting the slash to set up a thrust was clever.
But your body lacks conditioning. It just can't keep up with your head. When you shifted your stance, you left a massive opening.
The kind of opening that ...==W== makes an opponent instinctively want to close the gap, sweep your legs, and drop a headbutt.
It was just too tempting. My body reacted on its own. Thank the stars I stopped before the headbutt.
Wait. So you didn't grab me gently to break my fall... You were pulling me in to break my nose?!
Hey now, isn't that a little brutal?! We're supposed to be practicing!
Ahem. That was my mistake. But if you don't go all out in practice, you won't last a second in a real fight.
You felt it too, didn't you, ==PLAYER_NAME==? Your body is holding your brain's response back. The best tactics in the world mean nothing==W== if you can't execute them.
But conditioning doesn't happen overnight. Even if you train every day, you need months to see real results.
Starting tomorrow, come jogging with me at night. We'll mix stamina work with your sword forms. Just stick with it, and eventually, everything will get better.
Got it, got it. I'll take it seriously.
Still, get you talking about swords and you'll never want to stop.
Wha—? D-Do I? Am I really that chatty?
Come to think of it, out of all the time we spend alone, I'd say fifty percent of it is just training...
Th-That's not true!==W== We patrol together too... Speaking of, let's go on patrol right now! A change of pace will do you good.
And the other fifty percent is patrolling.
Yeah. I have absolutely no comeback for that.
I hate to admit it, but my life is just ...==W== monotonous. It must be a total bore hanging out with me, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Objectively? Yeah, it's a little dull.==W== But doing it all with you makes up for it.
It does?==W== But... I'm hardly interesting. I'm nowhere near as sharp or well-read as Elis, and I don't know Filanis half as well as Lulu.
Just being around you makes me feel safe.
My swordplay is good, and I will always protect you. But I can't fix every single problem.
Even when patrolling the "perfect" city of Filanis, we could run into a starving thief, or some violent thug from another city.
Y-You absolutely can't drop your guard just because I'm here! You can't just feel safe. What if we get ambushed?
Strictly speaking, I can't guarantee your safety in every conceivable scenario. So...==W== Please don't let your guard down.
I didn't mean that kind of safe. I mean...==W== Even when we're walking through the dark, and even though barely anyone here knows what you do for them...
... You never get discouraged. And you never stop pushing for a better tomorrow.
You're like a warm little sun. Just being around you, I catch some of your drive.
Phew. I need to step it up, too. When you finally earn your way back into the Monolith, I'm going to find a way home.
Your home...==W== Would you tell me about it more?
You said before that there are no slaves there...==W== What kind of city is it?
Oh, my home isn't exactly a city. It's a vehicle.
My friends and I drive it all over the world. But it's true, out of all the places we've visited, none of them have slaves.
That sounds ...==W== so free. Growing up, the only places I've ever known are the Grand Arena in Emor and Filanis.
I don't even know ...==W== what Emor looks like outside the Arena walls.
You'll get your chance. You're free now too, Alina. You're only staying behind to repay a debt, and to help make Filanis a better place.
Someday, Filanis will be the city you've always dreamed of. When that day comes...==W== If I'm still around, we'll go traveling together.
Ah, look at the time. I need to start patrol and blow the timekeeping horn.
You stayed up late last night doing the Night Watchers' ledgers...==W== Can you even keep your eyes open?
Don't underestimate me. I'm the ultimate night owl.
Fast asleep after all. You drifted off right in the middle of walking, holding onto my sword hilt.
You've been pushing yourself too hard lately, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Alina scoops up the ==SEX9== who's leaning against her, pushes open the insula door, and gently lays ==SEX4== down on the bed.
<size=85%>Does being by my side ...</size>==W==<size=85%> really make you feel safe?</size>
<size=85%>To be honest...</size>==W==<size=85%> Being by your side makes me feel safe, too.</size>
<size=85%>Especially ...</size>==W==<size=85%> when I look at your sleeping face.</size>
The night patrol ends. Alina sits down, leaning against the edge of the bed.
Beneath the cold starlight, their soft breathing syncs as they drift into a deep slumber.
Sometime later, the knight jolts awake.
The bed is empty. The pillows and blankets are neatly arranged, as if inviting a weary traveler to rest.
The knight never sleeps in the bed. She is used to dozing off against its edge. That bed...==W== It's reserved for someone. Someone important to her.
The knight picks up her longsword and steps out of the cramped insula, bathed in cold starlight.
The Filanis of today no longer needs her night patrols.
Young citizens have joined the Night Watchers, taking daily shifts to guard the city that belongs to them.
Yet she still leaves the house at this hour out of habit, stepping into the empty lot beside the insula.
Her gaze wanders. She searches for a silhouette, waiting for a familiar voice to call her name.
But her own soft chuckle breaks the illusion.
She is no longer Alina. She is Noya, an insignificant existence.
A Noya who wants to become the Noya ==PLAYER_NAME== spoke of...==W== A Noya even ==PLAYER_NAME== doesn't know yet.
What am I looking for out here? ==SEX1== is right there, inside the Monolith.
But conditioning doesn't happen overnight. Even if you train every day, you need months to see real results.
Starting tomorrow, come jogging with me at night. We'll mix stamina work with your sword forms. Just stick with it, and eventually, everything will get better.
The knight murmurs to herself, slowly raising her longsword into a guard, as if the companion with more ideas than sword skills still stands right in front of her.
I will protect this future you brought us. Always.
I'll make sure the marks you left on Filanis endure.==W== Until the day you fulfill our promise.
Yes. As long as I stick with it, everything will be fine. Every wish will come true.
I have no regrets, ==PLAYER_NAME==. And I don't think you do, either.
Just watch me. I'm going to get even stronger.
Next time, I will protect you to the very end. So please... Let me make one wish.
The knight raises her sword in a vow to the night sky. Out here,==RT==the only ones listening to her wish are the stars above and the silent tower.
As for whether that wish comes true... That is a story for another age.

strings.text: Nothing is more boring than working alone at a convenience store. If only someone would come help Portia with the sales.
Tch, feels like I'm always a hair away from clearing this stage...
Welcome... Please feel free to look around...
Ugh, I'm wiped out, Iris!==W== Let's grab a drink, the peach one looks good.
I want the Star Bell.==W== Music one, I like it.
Hey, Stella Coins are hard to come by, you know! We should be careful about what to spend them on.
(Not much hope of making a sale, then.)
Come on, don't they always say, "when it's time to buy, you should just buy"?
The Potential Drinks and the Star Bells all help us with using magic inside the Monolith.
But the type of magic they correspond to isn't the kind that we need right now.
So let's save our money and check again next time we stop by.
(Looks like they aren't exactly flush with Stella Coins... So frugal.)
(I was going to test my new pitch, but...==W== Forget it, too much work.)
If we fail to get an Artifact this time, we won't be able to complete the commission! Then the guild's done for.
If the guild gets disbanded, we'd be out there on the streets. And out there on the streets, our gear will get stolen. Once our gear gets stolen...
Here we go again. She's gone back to full crisis mode.
This is like the fifth time since we got into the Monolith.
In the end, we'd miserably strike our last match in the freezing snow.
(Ugh, that's depressing. Next time, I'll just give them a discount.)
Come on, relax. This time we'll definitely get an Artifact!
Right...==W== Now's not the time to mope!
If only someone would just buy everything in one go.
At this rate, when will I ever clear out the store stock?
Alright, alright, stop staring at me. I'll hustle.
But if those Trekkers just don't buy stuff, what am I supposed to do?
Okay, fine, I'll be more proactive next time with my pitch.
You know what, if you'd actually walk a few steps and talk to people instead of zoning out, our sales would be higher. Or at the very least, you could help me ring them up.
With all the Monoliths and Trekkers out there, we can't keep up even if we work nonstop.
<size=50>I'm still running this store by myself!
Sigh, when will I finally get someone to help me...
When that day comes, I'll put them in the manager's—==W==no, no, the penguin mascot suit to draw customers.
That way, we'll clear the stock in no time!

strings.text: Rehiring former employees comes with plenty of perks: they already know the company culture, they're familiar with the rules, and most importantly—they require zero training.
Welcome. Please feel free to look around...==W== Hm?
Well now... If it isn't my cute former employee. Been a while.
Uh, h-hey... Yeah! Long time no see!
What's the matter? Can't forget the taste of my pork cutlet? Back to pick up a shift?
When I first met the New Star Guild,==W== I got lost in the Monolith and accidentally ate a pork cutlet bento ...==W== which ended with me working in the store.
Luckily, the Guild bailed me out before I lost myself completely... Although looking back, it feels more like Portia just let me off the hook.
The Tyrant is one of us! ==SEX1== isn't coming back to work here!
We're not handing the Boss over to you.
I can almost never tell with you...
Hahaha, chill. I do need the help, but I'm not yet shady enough to scam Trekkers into doing my grunt work.
Besides, I still haven't cleared this level... Interviews and training? Who has time for that?
So, buy something or don't. My ex-employee over there included.
Hmm... Guess she doesn't mean any harm.==W== C'mon, Iris! Let's check the Potential Drink aisle!
Ah, wait! Noya!==W== We can't let our guard down yet!
Wait! That aisle is right next to…
The pork cutlet shelf! The stuff that nearly trapped me here!
No way! I can't go over there! Just seeing that packaging gives me the creeps...
I'll just wait for you here by the counter.
That exploration really took it out of me. I'm gonna rest here a bit. Sorry!
Hmph... If you say so... Just promise you won't wander off!
Phew... The pork cutlet trauma runs deeper than I expected...==W== Hm? What's that noise?
I knew it—Portia. She plays those games louder every day... Can she really watch the store like this?
Tch... Why are there no mid-level save points...
Thinking back to my clerk days, I was always the one stocking shelves while she played video games.
I'll give her a little nudge, out of the kindness of my heart.
The shelves are basically bare, Portia. Aren't you gonna restock? If Manager Sherlock catches you slacking, don't expect me to cover for you!
Hm? But empty shelves just mean business is booming, right?
And since I don't have my amazing assistant anymore, I guess they'll stay empty...
That attitude won't fly! You're an employee—it's your responsibility to keep them stocked!
Responsibility... True, someone should be responsible for restocking. But I don't see why that has to be me.
If you're that worried, why not come back to work here? You look like you're dying to put the uniform back on anyway!
Not good... This conversation is heading into dangerous territory!
Ahem. I've officially resigned. Right now, I am strictly a customer.
And I'm speaking as a customer. If someone came in to buy something and found nothing, they'd definitely file a complaint!
That's hardly "as a customer"... Complaints are a headache for the store. A real customer would just leave quietly.
Anyway, cut the chatter. Since you're here, come help me restock!
Portia is freakishly strong. Before anyone else notices, she drags me right into the wall.
I'm doomed... Am I gonna get lost in the Monolith again?
Don't be such a downer. Chill out. I just need a hand. Once we're done, you're free to go.
You were just standing around waiting for those three anyway. Might as well make yourself useful.
"Make myself useful"...? I never agreed to help you...
After that big speech, helping out is only fair! Besides, those shelves aren't gonna stock themselves.
There's more to being a clerk than just stocking shelves and greeting customers.
Fair point... But how exactly do we restock?
Phew! Finally got 'em. But seriously, this floor barely dropped any Star Bells...
All that fighting for this? Maybe we should double-check those flowerbeds?
Ugh... Let's just bail. Not worth the time searching for scraps. We gotta hit the Wishing Box on the next floor!
Alright. Let's hurry to the elevator then!
Work? What are we actually doing?
Restocking, obviously. Lots of squads are too lazy to pick up every single Star Bell or Stella Coin that drops.
All we do is follow and pick up after them. Restocking with minimal effort.==W== Efficient, right?
My guild always sweeps the battlefield clean... I thought everyone did that.
Hey, quit spacing out. Get over here and help.
No way! I never said I'd help!
Is that so? Don't help, then. Think you can find the store alone? If you get lost, I'm not saving you.
Don't be stubborn. Be a good assistant, finish up, and you'll see your friends sooner. Help out or get lost—your call.
Are you threatening me?!==W== I object! Vehemently!
Portia ignores me and starts rummaging through the flowerbeds.
Despite my protests, my body moves on its own as I watch her work.
Say, I keep hearing your friends call you "Tyrant" and "Boss." Are those your actual name?
Not really a name, strictly speaking. More of titles... But they're catchy, so they stuck.
Uh-huh... "Boss" is one thing, but "Tyrant"? Sounds kinda...==W== Eh, forget it.
I'll have the manager set up an "Employee of the Month" award. You can be the first winner.
No biggie. Ex-employees are eligible too.
As for the prize... Haven't figured that out yet.
What's even the point of winning that?
All I see is a future where Portia bosses me around forever...
Hang on! We forgot the Star Bells!
But the shelf was empty, wasn't it?
Oh? You need Star Bells?==W== Just got a fresh batch in. Wanna see?
Ten Melodies of Skill, ten Melodies of Ventus... Exactly the amount we need?
Tell you what. Save me the trouble of shelving them, and they're yours for half price.
What a steal! Let's spend our leftover Stella Coins on something else then!
Doesn't a sudden half-off deal seem shady to anyone?!
Half-price...==W== Ah, music to my ears!==W== And for the exact Star Bells we need?==W== We can't let this chance slip by!
Alright! That's everything. On to the next floor!
Wait a minute... Something just doesn't feel right!
The surprise discount has everyone over the moon. My gut screams "trap," but the others shove me into the elevator before I can protest.
As the doors slide shut, I see Portia through the gap. She gives me a knowing smile and waves.

strings.text: Wandering among the star towers, a pure-white girl without wings—yet known to all as an "angel."
Today, we climbed an empty Monolith.
There's nothing here inside this Monolith. Just like the one where ==PLAYER_NAME== was found.
It's strange that we've hit two broken Monoliths recently... The books say broken Monoliths are rare, most Trekkers never see one in a lifetime.
Who needs this kind of luck!
Hey, everyone, be careful. In a broken Monolith like this, the ceiling and floors can be unstable. Very dangerous.
I must've stepped on a rotten floorboard...==W== It's so high that I can't even see the level above. I probably fell more than one floor.
It's gonna be okay... I've got Iris's magic thread on me. She'll find me, just like before. More importantly, I need to check my surroundings.
Stellaroids!? There are Stellaroids in a broken Monolith?
Crap, I can't fight them alone...==W== Gotta run for it!
Hah, Hah, I should've shaken them off by now.
Huh, where is this? I ran like mad to get here, but now I'm totally lost.
Excuse me but... Who are you?
I got separated from my companions. Did you, too?
That's odd. She should be able to hear me.
I'm not interested in your story. Do you need medical treatment?==RT==If not, please don't bother me.
Medical treatment?==W== Ah... When I fell, I did hurt my arm. It's swollen now.
I'm injured here. Can you heal this?
No problem. One injection and any wound heals instantly.
Instantly?! That sounds a bit sus...
I'm very busy. Do you want the shot or not?
I know not to eat or drink anything from the Monolith, but if it's medicine...
You're hopeless...==W== Ah, your companions are here.
Ahh, she tricked me! Ugh, that needle's thick, but ...==W== it doesn't hurt at all.
Not only does it not hurt... The swelling is visibly going down!?
But magic doesn't work on me, right...? Which means that this isn't magic? Anyway, I should thank her.
Thank you, I feel much better. I'm ==PLAYER_NAME== of the New Star Guild. You can also call me Boss.
I'm Beatrixa. I'm a part of the Monolith staff. My job is treating Trekkers injured inside the Monolith.
Monolith staff... You mean like Portia? I buy stuff from her all the time.
Anyway, if you get hurt in the Monolith you can come to me for treatment. It's free of charge. But please do be careful. Don't get reckless and increase my workload.
She vanished just like that?==W== Well, Monolith staff are strange, aren't they? Always so mysterious.
Ouch! Damn... Is this the Stellaroid from before?
Hah... hah... I ran this far, so I should... I should be safe now.
I told you, do not increase my WORK LOAD. Do you need me to spell it out for you?
Ah... sorry, I got ambushed by a Stellaroid just now. I'll be more careful next time!
Treatment's done. Hope I never see you again—
Even though she kept grumbling, she did heal me.
Ok, now I should cheer up and go find everybody else!==W== —Wahhh?
Ouch ouch ouch... My foot's slipped into a crack.
... Are you doing this on purpose?
No way. I'm just super unlucky. Could you please treat me again?
By the way, why do you randomly appear and disappear?
I told you, I'm busy. Across all the Monoliths in the entire world, there's only one nurse—me. Too many Trekkers need my help.
So you teleport to other Monoliths? Amazing!
Tch... Don't pry into Monolith stuff. A little scrape like that is fine with some spit.
Beatrixa gave me a fed-up look and shoved the syringe hard into my skin. One injection... And the medicine did its job.
Thanks to her, by the time I reunited with my companions, I was in perfect health.
Hah, note to self: Try not to get injured inside the Monolith again.

I'm not interested in your story. Do you need medical treatment?==RT==If not, please don't bother me.
Medical treatment?==W== Ah... When I fell, I did hurt my arm. It's swollen now.
I'm injured here. Can you heal this?
No problem. One injection and any wound heals instantly.
Instantly?! That sounds a bit sus...
I'm very busy. Do you want the shot or not?
I know not to eat or drink anything from the Monolith, but if it's medicine...
You're hopeless...==W== Ah, your companions are here.
Ahh, she tricked me! Ugh, that needle's thick, but ...==W== it doesn't hurt at all.
Not only does it not hurt... The swelling is visibly going down!?
But magic doesn't work on me, right...? Which means that this isn't magic? Anyway, I should thank her.
Thank you, I feel much better. I'm ==PLAYER_NAME== of the New Star Guild. You can also call me Boss.
I'm Beatrixa. I'm a part of the Monolith staff. My job is treating Trekkers injured inside the Monolith.
Monolith staff... You mean like Portia? I buy stuff from her all the time.
Anyway, if you get hurt in the Monolith you can come to me for treatment. It's free of charge. But please do be careful. Don't get reckless and increase my workload.
She vanished just like that?==W== Well, Monolith staff are strange, aren't they? Always so mysterious.
Ouch! Damn... Is this the Stellaroid from before?
Hah... hah... I ran this far, so I should... I should be safe now.
I told you, do not increase my WORK LOAD. Do you need me to spell it out for you?
Ah... sorry, I got ambushed by a Stellaroid just now. I'll be more careful next time!
Treatment's done. Hope I never see you again—
Even though she kept grumbling, she did heal me.
Ok, now I should cheer up and go find everybody else!==W== —Wahhh?
Ouch ouch ouch... My foot's slipped into a crack.
... Are you doing this on purpose?
No way. I'm just super unlucky. Could you please treat me again?
By the way, why do you randomly appear and disappear?
I told you, I'm busy. Across all the Monoliths in the entire world, there's only one nurse—me. Too many Trekkers need my help.
So you teleport to other Monoliths? Amazing!
Tch... Don't pry into Monolith stuff. A little scrape like that is fine with some spit.
Beatrixa gave me a fed-up look and shoved the syringe hard into my skin. One injection... And the medicine did its job.
Thanks to her, by the time I reunited with my companions, I was in perfect health.
Hah, note to self: Try not to get injured inside the Monolith again.

strings.text: Overindulgence is the root of all misfortune. Stick to a healthy diet, and you can avoid a lot of trouble.
Iris! Let's take five! My legs are turning to jelly over here!
Bet our Tyrant is totally beat too, right?
I'm holding up, but it has been a long haul.==W== Since everyone's winded, let's catch our breath before pushing on.
Remember, this is a priority commission. The sooner we finish, the bigger the payout.
But burning out won't help efficiency...==W== Fine. Ten minutes. Then we move.
Huh? Who was that? She looked so familiar...
I was a huge hassle for her last time. Never got the chance to say a proper thanks.
That shop over there caught my eye. I'm gonna check it out real quick—be right back.
Nah, you rest up. It's close by. I'll shout if anything comes up.
Don't eat anything from the shop.
You bet! I learned my lesson the hard way!
One of these, please.==W== Yes, that one.
Is this ... a fried chicken stand?
Hey, Beatrixa. It's been a minute.
Gah?!==W== How long have you been standing there?!==W==
Spotted you walking this way in the lounge, so I followed you over.
I want to properly thank you for patching me up last time.
No need... I was doing my job.
Job or not, I still owe you a thanks.
Right...==W== Gratitude acknowledged. Now, can you leave?
I'm on break. Do not disturb me.
A break, huh? Reminds me of my shift back at Portia's place.
Whenever I visit, she's either gaming or sleeping.
No, see... I ate a pork cutlet bento there once, got stuck working as a clerk for a bit...==W== Thankfully, the New Star Guild bailed me out.
I wouldn't recommend that store to any lost soul in the Monolith. Learn your lesson. Don't let it happen again.
If you ask me, you should cut out junk food entirely. Not just the pork cutlets.
You need to maintain a balanced diet.
But uh, Beatrixa...==W== What are you doing in a fried chicken stand?
I do not require sustenance. I am merely taking a break.
Anyway, you've said your piece. When are you heading back to your friends?
Why do I get the feeling she's dying to get rid of me...
Face it, you're just a weak, small-fry Trekker. What happens if a Stellaroid shows up?
Then I guess I'll have to count on you to patch me up...
Tsk... Do you have any respect for my downtime?
Oh... I see. How about I give you a shot right now?==W== Once I stick you, you'd better vanish!
No, that's not what I meant...==W== Huh? Beatrixa, is there something on your face?
Yeah... Looks like a fried chicken crumb?
You're seeing things. Monolith staff have no need for food.
If you aren't gone in ten seconds,==W== I'm sticking a needle in your head!
Man... That fried chicken smells amazing. Just one whiff tells me it's crispy and juicy...
Too bad I can't actually touch anything inside the Monolith...
... It's overrated. The chicken here is dry and way too salty.
She's the one who slipped up! Why is she blaming me?
Next time you need treatment, I'm using my biggest needle. Remember that!
Huh? Was dear Tyrant talking to someone just now?
Better not mention I was talking to a Monolith staff. Don't want them worrying.
It's nothing. Just talking to myself.
Talking to yourself?==W== You... You haven't been possessed, have you?!
The Tyrant's way too tough for that! No evil spirits can touch ==SEX4==!
I was just critiquing this fried chicken menu.
Oh. Guess I panicked for nothing.
Let's hit the next floor. Our client is waiting!
Seriously... Going out of ==SEX3== way just to talk to me? This "Tyrant" really is an oddball.
But rest assured... No matter what happens, you won't die on my watch.

strings.text: That demon stepped out of the White Room, offering you a lure that pulls you toward the abyss.
After an all-out fight, we finally cleared every Stellaroid on this floor.
Whew...==W== This turned out to be a really tough climb. So many Stellaroids.
They are quite vicious today.==W== Boss==W==, please rest here for a bit; we'll go scout ahead.
I have a feeling we're close to the Wishing Box.
If anything comes up,==W== send a message.
Got it. I woke up way too early today...==W== So sleepy.
Hehehe,==W== Boss. Even asleep, you're adorable~==W== Just because you cleared the Stellaroids on this floor==W== doesn't mean you can let your guard down.
Zzz...==W== Let me doze a little longer…
<size=48>Wow!? Bernina! What are you doing here?!</size>
Because this is the Monolith, of course.==W== Did you come all this way just to see me~?
I only came with my guildies to find the Wishing Box.==W== Wait—why can I see you?
Did I get attacked by a Stellaroid while I was asleep?==W== Are we back at Home Screen again?
Not a Stellaroid.==W== It's ...==W== acute balloon sickness.
Acute balloon sickness? Never heard of it...==W== Is that something from inside the Monolith?
Yes.==W== Those infected swell up like balloons,==W== then go POP==W== and explode.
R-really...?==W== So if I popped while sleeping==W== and don't have terrifying memories of it,==W== I guess that's the silver lining.
But...==W== shouldn't I have ended up in the White Room? Why am I still here?
The White Room is under renovation.
Hey now.==W== Going from white to white, can you really call that a renovation?
Anyway, while the White Room's unavailable,==W== if you want to return to Home Screen, I'll have to guide you there.
Please sit still. Boss. What would you like to drink?==W== Coffee==W== or black tea?==W== I even brought cake~
Wait a second.==W== I only want to go back and start over again. I'm not hungry.
The lesson from the pork cutlet is still fresh in my mind...==W== So...==W==
Your prudence is remarkable, Boss.==W== But really, it's fine to eat now.
Before you make your choice, your state is similar to ours, so it's okay to eat Monolith food.==W== We Monolith staff need to eat, too, after all.
I see. But I'm really not hungry.
Hmm...==W== how about keeping little ol' me company for a while?
Think of the key needed to open that entrance door,==W== then think of this afternoon tea as the key that lets me guide you.
Since Bernina's going to guide me, I should agree to it.
Alright...==W== I'll have a cup of black tea, then.
Bernina slipped into the little Monolith shop I'd never enter.
Before long, she returned under the umbrella, carrying two cups of tea and a slice of cake.
No, no need for that. I can manage myself.
No, no—==W==this is part of the "key" too. Try it.
This shop's cake is quite amazing;==W== if you don't open your mouth, the cake will drop to the ground.
How is the cake I fed you?
It's good, but I wouldn't call it amazing…
Hehe...==W== Hehehe.==W== Boss, you fell for it~
I was just pranking you with that acute balloon sickness.==W== People swelling up and popping—what a ridiculous idea.==W== Boss, you're perfectly healthy.
And the White Room isn't being renovated—how could anyone alter your room?==W== No one has the right to change it without your permission.
You went through all that just to feed me this cake!?
Hm...==W== What do you want out of this?
I just ...==W== want to keep you here inside the Monolith ... forever.
Just kidding. I simply wanted to go on a date with you.
The cake and tea came from outside the Monolith. I asked Portia to get them from some Trekkers.
After watching a Stella Drama with Virigia,==W== I thought it'd be nice to have a date like that with you.
Being able to feed you cake is quite enough.==W== Thank you for spending time with me today~
Huh? She's gone. So she really only wanted a date...?
The whole thing felt like a dream; Bernina vanished before I knew it.==RT==I sat under the umbrella while a breeze brushed my hair.
She may be gone, but the smile she gave me before disappearing is burned into my memory.

strings.text: To find your beloved in a sea of strangers... Does it take destiny's design, or simply the patience to wait?
Business as usual today. I headed into the Monolith for a run with the New Star Guild.
We cleared the first floor, then split up to sweep for loot to save some time.
Huh? I swear Noya smashed a few massive Stellaroids right here. Where are the drops? Did they get blasted halfway across the map?
Ugh... At this rate, I'll be here all day.==W== If only I had a spell or Artifact to just vacuum everything up in one go.
If that is what dear Tyrant desires, then naturally, consider it granted.
It is I, Bernina, your most devoted servant.==W== Did Tyrant really not recognize my voice? I clearly need to spend more time by your side to make a lasting impression.
Oh, Bernina... You scared me—I thought it was an ambush.
You're not fooling me this time! This definitely isn't the White Room. Virigia isn't here!
As if I would ever deceive you, my dear Tyrant! I am your most faithful and loyal servant!
You literally just tricked me into thinking I might drop dead from "acute balloon sickness"!
That was merely a harmless little fib to set the mood for a date with my Tyrant.
So she admits she was lying...
So ... do you need anything, Bernina?
Nothing in particular. Running into Tyrant like this is purely a happy accident.
Dear Tyrant, are you familiar with a certain Stella Drama?
The lonely heroine waits in an alley amidst the swirling snow, until finally, she meets her beloved...
Two souls deeply intertwined will always find each other through fate.
Our encounter today is just like that scene, wouldn't you agree, my Tyrant?
Right. Honestly though...==W== It sounds more like you were just camping out here waiting for me.
Oh, hush. The how doesn't matter. It's the fated result that counts.
So we're calling lying in ambush "fate" now?
Ahem. Let's not get bogged down in semantics. Did you know a new boutique just opened nearby?
No idea...==W== New shops actually open inside the Monolith?
Of course. And since fate brought us together, would you be a dear and help me pick something out?
Clothes shopping...?==W== Pass. I need to sweep this floor for supplies and regroup with the team.
You know, if you agree to my little request, I can handle the manual labor for you.
After all, isn't doing all that exhausting? Not to mention what a waste of time it is.
Lucky for you, as a Monolith employee... I can collect everything in the blink of an eye.
That would save me a lot of trouble...==W== But a deal from Bernina always smells like a trap.
Well, my Tyrant? It's a high-reward deal with zero risk. Literally no consequences for indulging your desires.
Hmm... I don't want the team to worry. If it's quick... Then I accept.
Hee hee... Naturally. Right this way, Tyrant.
So, which style do you prefer?==W== This intellectual look?==W== Or the cute one?
They're ... both fine, I guess. Just pick whichever you like, Bernina.
Zero points for that answer, my Tyrant.
Zero?! I thought hard about that!
But I want you to pick for me. Personally.
Why does my opinion matter? You might not even like what I pick.
Since you don't know my taste, you should think even harder about what suits me.
That way, your mind will be filled with nothing but me. Sounds blissful, doesn't it?
Is... Is that how it works?
Besides, if you don't choose, I'll have to try on everything here. That would take quite a while.
Then please, give it some serious thought.
Easy to say, but I'm clueless when it comes to fashion...
Ah...==W== Allow me to demonstrate, then!
Great! I could use the inspiration.
Hmm... Let's see what suits the Tyrant...
Portia told me. You wore this exact one when you worked for her.
Such a pity I never saw it myself... Would you be a dear and put it on, Tyrant? Just once?
No way! If I get stuck in that thing again, I'm in big trouble! I nearly got trapped in the Monolith forever last time!
And would that be so bad? I'd keep you company forever. You'd never be lonely again.
That's not the point...==W== The Guild would panic if I just vanished!
... Now that reminds me... Did something happen to you all? Is that why you're stuck here as Monolith employees?
Hmm... That is a question even I can't answer, Tyrant.
Come to think of it, I've lost track of how long I've been in the Monolith. Must be ages by now.
Virigia and I go way back, though. That much I can remember clearly.
So Bernina and the others used to live on the Nova Continent, too...
But enough about me. Are you sure you won't try on the suit, dear Tyrant?
What a shame...==W== Well, to make up for it, you'll have to help me pick out lots and lots of outfits.
I hope you'll think it over while I try these on.
Hey! Wait up! Bernina! We're already wasting too much time!
She's already in the fitting room... I need to find her the outfits she's pleased with, fast!
Despite the rush, Bernina can't find anything she likes, and the clock keeps ticking...
The selection here is dreadful. Nothing caught my eye...==W== But having my Tyrant's company is enough for me.
After all that fuss, she didn't buy a single thing...
Wait a minute... I spent the whole time thinking which outfit would fit her best...==W== Was that her plan all along?
Bernina, isn't it about time you held up your end of the bargain?
Of course. Leave it to me.==W== Ready ... and, activate!
That's the Auto-Vac Artifact from your White Room. I tweaked it to help you scoop up Stellaroid drops.
That room actually needs cleaning? And since when can a vacuum Artifact do this?
Like I said, results are what count. And it certainly got the job done, didn't it?
Whoa, heavy! Isn't this a little excessive?
Well, one of its best features is its exceptionally wide range, after all.
Oh my, today was wonderful! I look forward to our next meeting, dear Tyrant~
Oh, and let's keep today our little secret. Especially from Virigia.
And ... she's gone.==W== Whatever. I need to regroup with the team. I've wasted enough time already.
You made it back without getting lost, good...==W== Wait, where did you get that massive sack?
Uh, this? I guess I was just ... thorough.
You're amazing, Tyrant!==W== We came up empty-handed...
We found loot. It got snatched.
I was reaching for a drop when something zoomed in and swiped it!==W== Must be a new Stellaroid breed that mugs Trekkers!
Wait. Don't tell me this bag is the loot from the entire floor?
Ah-haha... Maybe... Maybe I just got lucky? Like, really lucky?
Anyhow! We've got the loot, so let's hit the next floor!

Virigia and I go way back, though. That much I can remember clearly.
So Bernina and the others used to live on the Nova Continent, too...
But enough about me. Are you sure you won't try on the suit, dear Tyrant?
What a shame...==W== Well, to make up for it, you'll have to help me pick out lots and lots of outfits.
I hope you'll think it over while I try these on.
Hey! Wait up! Bernina! We're already wasting too much time!
She's already in the fitting room... I need to find her the outfits she's pleased with, fast!
Despite the rush, Bernina can't find anything she likes, and the clock keeps ticking...
The selection here is dreadful. Nothing caught my eye...==W== But having my Tyrant's company is enough for me.
After all that fuss, she didn't buy a single thing...
Wait a minute... I spent the whole time thinking which outfit would fit her best...==W== Was that her plan all along?
Bernina, isn't it about time you held up your end of the bargain?
Of course. Leave it to me.==W== Ready ... and, activate!
That's the Auto-Vac Artifact from your White Room. I tweaked it to help you scoop up Stellaroid drops.
That room actually needs cleaning? And since when can a vacuum Artifact do this?
Like I said, results are what count. And it certainly got the job done, didn't it?
Whoa, heavy! Isn't this a little excessive?
Well, one of its best features is its exceptionally wide range, after all.
Oh my, today was wonderful! I look forward to our next meeting, dear Tyrant~
Oh, and let's keep today our little secret. Especially from Virigia.
And ... she's gone.==W== Whatever. I need to regroup with the team. I've wasted enough time already.
You made it back without getting lost, good...==W== Wait, where did you get that massive sack?
Uh, this? I guess I was just ... thorough.
You're amazing, Tyrant!==W== We came up empty-handed...
We found loot. It got snatched.
I was reaching for a drop when something zoomed in and swiped it!==W== Must be a new Stellaroid breed that mugs Trekkers!
Well, one of its best features is its exceptionally wide range, after all.
Wait. Don't tell me this bag is the loot from the entire floor?
Ah-haha... Maybe... Maybe I just got lucky? Like, really lucky?
Anyhow! We've got the loot, so let's hit the next floor!

strings.text: That demon stepped out of the white room, ready to put you to a special test.
I found a strange mirror on the floor while climbing the Monolith with the New Star Guild.
Huh? Why is there a mirror here? It looks familiar... like I've seen it somewhere before.
Noya, Iris, Amber—where are you? Everything around me looks different.==W== Have I been teleported again?
Virigia!? How are you here? Don't tell me, did I...
Croak again. Every time I see you, it's the same—==W==I die from something, then I have to go to the White Room and select my feature all over again.
But today the White Room feels a bit different. Decor change?
You misunderstand. You're very much alive, and this isn't the White Room.
Eh? Then how are you here...
Oh come now, you don't really think I only hang out in the White Room, do you? I'm quite busy; I have other duties.
We only met by luck because you picked up MY mirror. It teleported you straight to me.
Virigia didn't throw the mirror there on purpose, did she?==W== Never mind. Now isn't the time to worry about that.
I see...==W== So, how do I get back?
Let me think...==W== I could tell you, but you'll have to do something for me.
Play a little game with me~
The rules are simple. For the next ten minutes, you can only answer "yes." If you make it to the end, you win.
She definitely put the mirror there on purpose, no question. But if it gets me back faster, I'll play along.
Heh, then I will proceed with the questions. Ready—start!
Boss, Boss— If you could never go back to New Star Guild, can you accept that?
... That's a loaded question right off the bat.==B== But the rule being what it is, I'll have to answer "yes."
I can't accept this. The answer might be fake because it's just a game, but the guilt I feel is all too real...
Great answer~ Do you really not want to go back to them? They must be worried sick.
Heehee, if your trusting companions heard that, they'd be heartbroken.
Don't let her mess with your head. It's just a game... a game to bring you back to everyone.
Did you take leave from your companions because you wants to be with me forever?
Wow~ You really do care! I'm so happy!
So... Would you like to have afternoon tea with me?
I can't just mechanically say "yes" to that. Eating food from the Monolith that wasn't obtained through a Wish... It could leave me stuck inside again, just like last time.
Silence counts as breaking the rule. If you break the rule, you lose.
Heh, you really know what a girl wants. Follow me, please~
I follow Virigia to a quiet corner of the floor and sit under an umbrella. There's nobody else around, no Stellaroids causing trouble; Virigia brings out cake and tea for me.
I saw a Stella Drama with Bernina and I wanted to have a café date with you, just like in that play.
I've heard that you grant wishes. If so, could you grant my tiny wish today?
So she teleported me over just to tease me like this? Virigia really has too much time on her hands. Somebody, increase her workload!
Wonderful. But it's not just a date that I want. I also want you to ...==B== feed me cake.
They say cake fed by someone you like always tastes so much better. I'd love to experience that myself~
When Bernina fed me, the taste stayed exactly the same.
Boss, please give it a try.
You want me feed you...?==W== Fine, as long as I don't have to eat it.
Hmm~ Maybe I'm too nervous to taste the difference. Could you try again?
Nom...==W== Hmm! That did taste a bit better.
Ah, so I must do like you.
Why not leave those three Trekkers and come live in the Monolith with me?
The game is still on. I can only answer that with...
Ah, what a shame. The time's up, you didn't have to answer that one.
Hearing that answer, even if it was for a game, made me happy. Thank you. I shall send you back.
Huh? Somehow==B== it doesn't feel like she was just pranking me...
Oh, one more small favor. Keep what happened just now between the two of us, okay?
Why did you disappear all of a sudden? Were you hurt?
See, Iris, I told you. Boss could get out of trouble just fine. No need to worry.
Come! Come! We've found the Wishing Box. What Artifact do you want to wish for, Boss?
I want to wish for an Artifact that you'd like.
When I placed my hand on the Wishing Box, I thought of Virigia's tiny "wish" again.
Those things that she said at the end... What's that supposed to mean?
For a while after that, I kept my promise. But the smile Virigia gave me before we parted never faded from my mind.

strings.text: The words and illustrations in her books are more than a pastime. Preserved between the pages is her longing to share a distant journey with the Tyrant.
Weird... Empty counter? Where'd the clerk go?
Portia's usually glued to a game right here...==W== Hm? There's a note.
So we handle the payment ourselves. Got it.
Self-checkout... That's bold. What stops a Trekker from just grabbing something and bolting?
They wouldn't dare. Aside from the Wishing Box, everything in this Monolith is property of the God of Grace.
True... Fear keeps people honest, I guess.==W== Let's split up and grab what we need.
That should cover the basics... Now I just need five Melodies of Ventus.
Strange. They're usually stocked right here... Did they move them?
If it's the Melody of Ventus you seek, try over here.
Hush—keep your voice down. We wouldn't want your friends uncovering our little connection, would we, my dear Tyrant?
What a pleasant surprise, Tyrant. It makes my rare trip to the store entirely worthwhile.
I'm surprised, too... I didn't take you for the grocery shopping type, Virigia.
I usually have them delivered, so I rarely grace the aisles with my presence.
It has been ages since my last visit... Disappointing to see the selection hasn't changed in the slightest.
Now that you mention it, true. I don't think I've ever seen new stock on these shelves.
Doesn't Portia make trades with Trekkers, though? You know, for goods from the outside?
Like that cake Bernina fed me the other day. She said Portia got it off a Trekker.
Bernina ... fed you?==W== Strange. I haven't heard a single whisper about that...
Uh. Did I say something wrong?
That's a terrifying expression Virigia just made.
Ahem... Pardon the lapse in composure. It is rare we get to meet, my dear Tyrant. Let us not let trifles spoil the mood.
I knew it. Shouldn't have brought that up.
Now, where were we? My dear Tyrant?
Ah... Right. The store inventory never changes...
Especially the manga and magazines. They haven't been updated in eons. I could recite every volume blindfolded.
Oh... Didn't know you were such a reader.
Books are nourishment for the soul. And, truthfully, one of the Monolith's few entertainments.
That reminds me! Tyrant, could you bring me some books from outside? Just hand them to Portia; she'll pass them on.
Of course, if it's just a few books. What books, specifically?
Hmm... I would like a few copies of Chronicles of Nova!
Chronicles of Nova... Trekkers get them when hitting new regions. It lists local Wilds, Monolith statuses, sometimes commission ads... That's the one?
Correct. That is the one. I have always been curious what the current editions actually say.
"Current" editions? That's an odd way to phrase it...
Compared to manga or other magazines, though, those journals are pretty dry reading...==W== Are you sure that's what you want?
Yes. Since I cannot leave the Monolith, that publication serves as one of the few windows I have into the world outside.
Actually, I believe there is a copy right here...==W== Ah, found it.==W== Please, take a look at this, Tyrant.
This is ... a really old issue.
It is the special feature of the Matsukawa Goodwind Hot Springs. I have read it cover to cover countless times.
Did you know, Tyrant? Rumor has it they observe a mysterious custom there: after a soak in the springs, one must drink milk with a hand firmly placed on one's hip.
I had no idea... Does the journal actually say that?
Indeed. Would you care to read it yourself, Tyrant?
Everyone else is still shopping... I guess a quick look won't hurt.
Huh... I see.==W== So aside from the post-bath milk, they also have a tradition of hitting a ball around a table?
Apparently, it is a sport called "Bouncy Ball." Does that intrigue you?
Hehe. Discussing foreign lands with you like this... It truly feels as though I am traveling right alongside you.
Just imagine: journeying to Matsukawa with my dear Tyrant,==W== taking in the scenery,==W== and sharing the hot springs...
It says here: after a full day out, return to the inn for a hot spring soak... The thought alone is relaxing.
But ... if you're already worn out, is a round of Bouncy Ball really necessary?
Of course! It is an essential part of the experience!
Just as one must watch the Waterway sunset in the City of a Thousand Monoliths, or feast on local delicacies in Cangwu!
Whoa... "Essential"? You're surprisingly strict about these things, Virigia.
And you seem to know the highlights of those cities inside out.
After all, I cannot wander in and out of the Monolith as freely as you, Tyrant.
A chance to travel would be a rare privilege indeed. I must prepare thoroughly so I can cherish every moment.
Haha, oh my. I've dampened the mood. Let us speak of something else.
I remain puzzled. If one plays Bouncy Ball after a soak, sweating is inevitable. And having sweated, one must return to the spring...
Sounds like an infinite loop waiting to happen...
To solve this riddle, we definitely need to track down some newer travel journals.
Leave it to me! Standard issues, special editions... Whatever I can find, I'll bring it to you next time!
Truly? I shall look forward to it!
My thanks, dear Tyrant... It seems only proper that I prepare a gift in return to show my appreciation.
A gift? No need, really. It's on the house.
As your humble servant, Tyrant, accepting such kindness without giving anything back feels inappropriate.
Rest assured, I will craft something to your satisfaction. Please, await it with expectation.
Alright. Since you insist... I'll accept your gift gratefully.
Boss! You done shopping yet? We're heading out!
Then, Tyrant, until our paths cross again.==W== Safe travels.
You bet! You take care of yourself too, Virigia!
Yet ... amidst a sea of magazines and manga...
Why does my heart fixate solely on Chronicles of Nova?

strings.text: All done... Time to head back?
Yeah, just let me calculate our costs and profits real quick.
Amazing! We actually came out a bit ahead!
We nailed it! Let's go home!
Oh, look, a kitty over there.
I'm gonna go give it a pet.
Ehh!? You need to stop petting every cat you come across!
Okay, time to wrap up and go... What's the deal?
Please tell me we made some money, Iris!
They're selling Pep Pep Juice! Can I get one?!
Again... Fine, but only one, that's it.
Great job, New Star Guild! How about we celebrate?
That's unnecessary... Let's just pack up and go.
Come on— You guys are such buzzkills!!
Nah, never mind. Just ignore me.
Mission's done, meow... Ready to head back?
This morning, Donna asked us to grab some food for dinner on our way back.
She probably won't make it back in time to cook tonight.
We should totally get buns! The shop in town makes the best ones!
What a pleasant surprise to see you here, Madam Shimiao!
Hey, who are you calling a madam?
Come to think of it, we're practically in the same line of work, right?
Well... I suppose you could say that...
I heard Baize Bureau offers way better benefits than the Imperial Guard, is that true?
My apologies... I'm not really sure...
Job's finished. Why the long face?
I don't have a... S-stop right there!
No fire tricks here! Everything's flammable!
What's the problem? I didn't see any "No skateboarding" sign here.
Uh...sorry. Force of habit from work...
I said don't bother... Wait a sec, what is that?!
It's pretty unique...! Thought you might enjoy it...
Where do you even find this stuff...
I-is everything okay? You've been staring at me for a while...
Your style is very Goodwind... It's difficult to put into words...
That's a wrap! Hmm? Something I can do for you?
Those tricks were incredible...! I'm totally blown away!
Oh yeah? My my... Have I gained another devoted fan?
Then this next trick is just for you, my special fan☆!
Fancy meeting you here! The great magician Lady Flora...
Well well... If it isn't the witch of gossip herself...
Missed my chance for a headline about you this time...
Is that so? Maybe you'll get lucky next time...
Did the New Star Guild have a falling out?==RT==Give me the deets! Will ya?
Not really... Work's done, I'm leaving.
Why the rush? That's so lame.
Something's up with the New Star Guild, right?==RT==You're all on separate missions these days.
Huh? For what? What's with that expression?
Hey there! Journalists doing Trekker commissions now?
Bills don't pay themselves... Times are tough... (Weeping)...
If you feel bad for me, how about a little scoop? Maybe spill some tea about the Boss? You're buddies with ==SEX4==, aren't ya?
Whoops, time's up. Catch you later!

strings.text: The Snowish vacation can't come fast enough...
When I get to be the director of the institute...
We're gonna celebrate Snowish Festival every month...
Oh, perfect—here's a package for you.
Another commission completed by Post Haste!

strings.text: Shia, Shia! We've had a great haul today!
Hehe, looks like this is our lucky day~
Don't be so nervous. I was just passing by and thought I'd take a look.
You mean putting this piece of paper on the sore spot can actually ease muscle aches?
Of course! It's a secret remedy passed down through my family!
I never would have guessed this dog-shaped rune had such healing powers...
No! I meant the ointment on its back!
Don't worry, this is the good stuff—I got it from a Monolith~

See you on the roof tonight, then!
I thought this emoji was super cute all the sudden
So I wanted to show it to you
When Inky came back the last time, he also had a flower on him
Maybe when Inky was busy squeezing through the bushes
The flower happened to land right on his head
You got a pic? I wanna see
Maybe when Inky was busy squeezing through the bushes
it landed right on his head by pure chance
I was about to take a photo
Boss, do you want to get a pet?
But I wanna be your pet, Boss
Someone will play with me every day
and I wouldn't have to work
I wanna be Amber's pet too

strings.text: Newbie squire Tilia, Defender of Justice!
Red is the color of passion and bravery!
No, I'm talking about the color of the heart!
Yes, red like the color of one's heart!
Gotta go patrol now. Catch you later!
Sorry... I can't come over today...
Not just today... In fact, from now on...
No need to exaggerate this much... You are too cooperative.
My leg's injured... And I smell.
No, just a leg ligament sprain...
It's just that...the doctor said I'll need a week off to rest.
Which means no perfect attendance bonus this month for me.
While patrolling Little Lantern Street today, I saw a poster for the Round Table Squad.
I got a little too caught up staring at it and accidentally drove the Lapis Eagle into the bushes.
Then... I fell into a trash can.
Next time, be careful when you drive. Don't look around so much
The Lapis Eagle is too slow.
Sometimes it can't even keep up with a casual skater.
Maybe its top speed is capped?
But as they say, Routes are countless, Safety is foremost
No! The Lapis Eagle has a soul of its own!
I won't be able to catch crime offenders.
I guess I'll have to modify the Lapis Eagle after all.
But it's against the Imperial Guards' rules.
If I follow the rules, I won't be able to uphold justice.
But if I break the rules, then I'm turning back on justice itself...
As long as it looks cool, right?
I went to a Masked Knight fan meetup the other day...
You met up with other fans?
But you don't look too happy about it.
Well...they all thought I was a security guard, not one of the fans.
Imperial Guard standard-issue armor, of course.
And I had the helmet on too.
I knew it. No wonder they were confused.
(Crying face) With the helmet on, I was totally masked!
I looked exactly like a masked knight!
Boss, I have something I want to ask you!
I want to hang out with somebody...
No... I mean patrol with somebody...
But Noya went off to train.
Iris needed to study for her exam.
And I haven't seen Amber since this morning.
Kaydoke doesn't have the time, either...
So ==PLAYER_NAME==, you are my last hope!
Yeah. I haven't finished playing the game I just bought
Don't just stay cooped up at home all the time. It's not good for your health.
It's so nice out. Let's take a walk.
I've got nothing to say to people with actual lives
I knew it! You're the best!
Wanna see the dragon with me?
Where? In a cave? Or a castle?
Inside the Imperial Guard Museum of History.
Oh, the one you mentioned before.
It's normally closed off to the public.
But a Gold District school's students are coming here on a field trip.
Thus a rare opportunity presents itself.
I thought of you right away.
Aren't I a good friend? Come, come.
Be honest with me. You just want me to help you with watching the kids, isn't it?
Morning. What have you been up to lately?
Arranging flowers, attending concerts, and having afternoon tea with friends.
Ehh? Oh, it is ==PLAYER_NAME==! But why?
I'm sorry. I thought you were one of my parents checking up on me
They like you doing those thing?
No. I just didn't want them to worry about me.
Didn't want them to think I was still running around, getting into trouble.
You were always like this eh?
Not much has changed actually. I still like the same things.
Maybe I just haven't grown up at all?
You used to have a dream. Now you are on your way to realize that dream.
All the sudden I'm very confidence.
That's right. It's your birthday, isn't it?
Oh... Right, I guess it's my birthday today...
I was so excited that I forgot.
Haha, I guess birthdays aren't really a big deal to me...
I've got the present and the cake. Came over when you're free
Noya, Iris, and Amber are here, too
You went to all that trouble for me? I'm so touched...!
We also got you a limited-edition Masked Knights merch
I... I love you all so much!
As I expected, my initial decision turned out to be the correct one.
At the very, very beginning. Did I say back then?
When we met. Back then, I thought...
One can't really uphold justice by being a lone wolf.
After fighting alongside you, I've become even more certain of this.
And I'm one step closer to realizing my dream.
That's thanks to having comrades like you.
I got the Runic Disc you sent me last time.
Did you listen to it? What do you think?
Did you like it or not?
I liked it, I guess... The thing is...
It made me think of some things from the past.
It's rare to see your nostalgic side
What do you mean? I am capable of having delicate emotions, too.
I remembered the dream that I had. That hasn't changed.
I want to become the true knight, a hero who can protect everyone.
Yes, I'm sure you can do it

strings.text: The Imperial Guard's vibes are all wrong
A lot of people don't know anything about the old knight legends
We have so many famous knights in history!
Guess people just aren't that excited about old stories anymore
But you could try recommending your favorite classic stories to colleagues around you
Or newer stories in the same vein
I know what to do now!
What kind of hobbies do you have?
So when I talk about the things I like...
Does it feel sudden or awkward?
Honestly, by listening to people talk about their hobbies
I may pick up a new one along the way
That's actually a hobby of mine
But now I feel relieved, haha
Will you come cheer for me?
Haven't you already taken first place before?
I always thought you had amazing stamina
Do you have some kind of training routine?
Mostly just patrolling and working, I guess
In order to become a knight
I used to do a lot of special training!
It's not too late to start!
If I remember right, long-distance runs in full armor...
Yeah, I think we know why you took first place
Boss, the helmet I gave you
Hehe, then are you free tomorrow?
Is there a connection between those two questions?
I'm gonna attend a Masked Knight tribute event
And I want to do a transformation performance on stage with you
But I might not be very good at it
I really want to go to that place again
Yes! I knew you'd get me
You're not even going to ask why?
You just "happen to have the time," right? Same here
I'll bike over to pick you up!
A way to stand guard in the blazing heat with a helmet on
Maybe it's better to just quit doing that...
But as a knight, I want to overcome my weaknesses
I went to a hot spring place!
Exactly. At first I wanted to go in with my helmet on
But the staff wouldn't let me
So I just enjoyed the hot spring without my helmet

strings.text: This is my work phone. If you have a commission for me, please contact me by phone
Captain, I want to report something!
Chaton said one day she'll replace you as the captain
Chaton said "Pfft, one of those days, I'll become the captain"
Chaton seems to be eying your captaincy
It's the drama queen in her
The relationships within your troupe seem pretty complicated
Even though she says things like that all the time
Chaton's a real softie at heart
Of course, that's one of the captain's duties
I saw a Troupe member entering the game room
Somebody snuck into the game room
Some Troupe members are hooked on games
Give me the names and I'll double their morning training load tomorrow
But do tell me, how did you find out?
You were there, too, weren't you
"Those who dwell in The Wilds cannot afford to neglect their training even for a single day, regret always comes too late."
Of course, this is just one of White Cat Troupe's rules. You do not need to follow it
But I think it does contain a kernel of universal truth
Hey, keep your thoughts to yourself
Boss, do you think I've grown old
Like, "young people these days are not what they used to be..."
They said I sounded like an old geezer
But that's what our instructors said to us back when I was in training
Could it be that I've fallen behind the times
Sounds about right for somebody who can't figure out how to use a cellphone
As it turns out, the young people from the previous generation were already no good
I just don't want to develop a reliance on phones
But that's why Kasimira is so dependable
Could you not lump me in with the previous generation, please
You aren't that much younger than me, ==PLAYER_NAME==, are you
Sorry, I said it without thinking
You're always so reliable, that's why people think of you as older than you actually are
Hum, I knew you are all in cahoots
The White Cat Troupe members all seem to be very interested in the game room
A little bit of relaxation never hurt
So I use access to the game room as a reward aiming to bring the most out of everyone
I thought the captain wouldn't go in for that sort of thing
I'm surprised that you think this way
You've got the wrong idea about me
Even someone as boring as me can appreciate the fun of gaming
Even mother cats initially teach their kittens to hunt through games
Games are very special to us White Cats
They're a bit like threads that have been passed down through generations...
Yes. Threads that bind us together through friendship and fate
Work hard, play hard, that has always been White Cat's way
You talked about a lot of personal stuff on your work phone. Doesn't that go against the rules?
Wait, do you guys use a different phone for personal stuff?
Sorry, this is the only phone I have
But you said that this was your work phone when we first started
Yes, I initially bought the phone for work purposes
And it's the only phone I have. Is there a problem?
Do you know that you're easily misunderstood by others?
When I was shopping today, the supermarket owner told me they were hosting a gacha event
I tried five times but all I got was a measly Fourth Prize
I get it. Coming in fourth sucks
It's not the top, but it's not the bottom, either...
So in short, now our troupe has extra tissues
Gotcha. I'll take them for the New Star Guild
Thanks. You are such a big help
Do you have some free time to spare
Come to think of it, I didn't get to see you playing the arcade last time
The more I thought about it, the more I thought, what a shame!
How about it? Want to play against me
If I lose, I'll pay for your tokens
Lower your expectations, please. I'm no good at it
Nah, there's no way I can beat you!
Really? And here I thought you could give me a run for my money
I'll go if it's some kind of cooperative game
Then we can see who contributes more points at the end
Have you been listening to me at all?
Captain Kasimira, can I ask you a question?
No need to be so formal. Out with it
I always have this feeling that you are different from the rest of the White Cat Troupe members
The other cats prefer ranged attacks or sniping
But Kasimira, you seem to be great at melee
Your area of expertise...seems to differ?
That's a sign of the changing times
The new members have it really easy these days
In the old days, melee training was taken very seriously
Nowadays, it's hard to find people who can teach CQC skills
Thank you, captain. I'm glad we had this talk
You're welcome. I usually don't get a chance to talk about these things
Talking about White Cat's history makes me happy
Thank you for coming to help with our training
Everyone, myself included, have learned a lot
It's natural for Trekkers to help each other
Not only are you a good strategist, your character is also truly admirable
My expectation for you keeps growing

No. It's just that even over text, your tone feels serious
It's about a commission request, after all
Then why don't we meet in person?
I thought someone as important as you would always be busy
I can always make time for you
Hearing that makes me happy. See you soon
Lately, I've been deliberately using my phone more often
Sorry if I kept bothering you earlier
I wanted to overcome a weakness of mine
There's a reason I'm not used to using a phone
Through a screen, you can't observe someone's expressions or body language
It's not an excuse. For people in our line of work, it's about survival
You have to know if the client is trustworthy
So once you meet face-to-face, you can figure it out
Makes sense, most people would have a hard time lying to you
Wanna go play games in the Monolith?
Anyway, enough chatting—I do have something serious to discuss with you
I'm planning to hold a joint drill
This time, not just with our own members
You want to spar with people outside the White Cat Troupe?
Yes, and I trust that you know plenty of powerful fighters
Maybe you could introduce a few of them to me, for a friendly match?
Sounds fun. I'll think of some candidates
I'll wait for your good news
Boss, would you like a gift?
Recently, I played games a bit too much...
Not just inside the Monolith, I guess?
I jump in and take part whenever I see something fun at a market
And I can't stop before I get the top prize
And you haven't been banned from all those stalls yet?
I do have a few haters
Especially those sneaky vendors who cheat and set traps for players
What I hate even more than losing is people who can't accept a loss
I expose their tricks after I win
Boss, can you go out with me today?
You need my help with some work?
No, I have just finished my last commission
She said I need someone to accompany me these few days
Or some great misfortune will befall me
What a pain—I wanted some alone time, relaxing
But now I have to ask you to accompany me
You can't ask your troupe members?
