I don't want them to get the wrong idea of their leader
You just want me to keep you company, don't you?
Alright, that's not the right way to put it.
I don't want to show any weakness in front of others
You saw right through me, Boss. Just as expected.
Alright, whatever you want, I'm in

In a sense, that's part of my job. I'm the Boss, after all
So you mean... You're just "doing your duty"?
Sorry for my wording, feels like tooting your own horn

Anyway, I'm honored that you think we have something in common

On my precious day off, I'm going to go through as many questions as I can
Sounds like something you would do
==PLAYER_NAME==, if you're out already, could you bring me back some coffee?
Not the kind from the Monoliths
I want faux coffee made from koopei beans, the cheaper the better
I'll bring you a cup, mildly bitter at room temperature
I'll bring you a cup, no ice, medium bitterness
I'll bring you a cup, extra ice and extra bitter
I'll bring you a cup, mildly bitter at room temperature
The more bitter, the better. Thanks
Just tell the cafe staff that
I'll bring you a cup, no ice, medium bitterness
I want it extra bitter, with a lot of ice
I'll bring you a cup, extra ice and extra bitter
I took on too much freelance paperwork by accident
The client is rushing me, saying it needs to be delivered by tomorrow
Only faux coffee will get me through tonight...
I want to get more certificates
Don't you have a lot already?
Don't you have a lot already?
I do, but I feel like they aren't enough
But I'd feel more secure with more certificates
If I come cross some nice commission or freelance work
But can't take them on because I don't have the right certificate...
There will always be another commission
There will always be another commission
We don't get to pick when we are in dire need of money
I want to be able to provide financial backup for the guild
That will take some pressure off you guys, too...
That way I can take more jobs
And it will take some pressure off you guys, too...
So, I made a schedule for the certificate tests ahead
First, get certified as a professional smile expert
Then, get certified as a poetry therapist
And a vending machine operator's license
A Level 2 Monolith Food Analyst Certificate
I'm going to start with these!
Not sure what all those are, but I'm behind you 100%!
Please don't tell anybody what I'm about to say to you.
Oooo, a little secret just for me?
Oooo, a little secret just for me?
Promise me you won't tell first
Even if Mistique ties me to a tree upside down and torture me
I'll still keep my mouth shut!
Okay, that makes me feel better...
Are you in some kind of trouble?
Where are you? I'll get Noya and Amber and we'll come to you in no time.
Wait until nighttime, then come to Garden Cross Street in Silver District.
There is a bakery called "Don't Eat Cake, Eat Bread."
Stand in front of the shop and look to the left front; you'll see a small alleyway.
Walk to the alley entrance and stop in front of the vending machine there.
And then, get me out from the vending machine.
How did you get in there in the first place?
Well, I was doing temp work today...
And the assignment was to work as a salesperson inside the vending machine
I had no trouble getting in.
But after my shift ended, I got stuck at the backdoor. So now I can't get out...
==PLAYER_NAME==, you cannot let anyone else know of this.
Sneak in by yourself and get me out tonight.
I really want to just stay in bed
Want to just stay at home without working
Want to get paid a lot without working for it
I reallllllly want to slack off!
Who's this? Give the phone back to Iris!
It was a moment of weakness
No worries. I have this kind of thoughts all the time.
I was just a little bit shocked
that you would want to slack off, too...
The reason I'm working so hard now is so that I won't have to in the future
Once I have saved up a lot of money
When I don't have to worry about us becoming homeless or going broke...
I'll buy a huge house for everyone in the guild
So that we can all just stay at home without working!
Sounds nice! I'll hold you to it!
How has it been since you joined the guild?
Is there anything you're having trouble with?
How does it feel to climb the Monoliths with us?
What's with all these questions all the sudden?
A place to sleep and three meals a day
What's with all these questions all the sudden?
It's been quite a while since I have joined New Star Guild
A bit too late for doing an orientation, don't you think?
Could it be that my probationary period is up?
It's not an orientation. And New Star Guild doesn't have a probationary period
Our situation has improved so much ever since you joined us, ==PLAYER_NAME==
We no longer have to worry about where's the next meal going to come from
We no longer struggle to get good commissions because of poor performances
Nor do we end up paying huge penalties because of some crooked magic contracts
Boss, you really saved the New Star Guild from falling apart
Life's getting better for us every day
We have all worked hard for it
You're going to make me blush
We have all worked hard for it
You're going to make me blush
I'm sure you could join any big guild and do great there.
But I like the New Star Guild as it is now
I like being a Trekker alongside you and everybody else in the guild
If there's anything bothering you at all, you have to tell me!
I'll think of a way to make it right!
Even if it's a problem that can't be solved immediately, I'll work to make the situation better for you!
Please don't go about pretending everything is fine
Maybe you've got all these negative feelings bottled up
You don't want to upset us, so you say nothing
You just put up with it...
Until one day you can't anymore and just walk out on us without telling anyone!
You sure have got a whole detailed scenario going there...
But I really haven't got any complaints
And I'm not planning on switching guilds
I'm so relieved to hear that.
Noya and Amber. They're acting all weird
I haven't even said anything yet...
Just now, Noya told me that...
She was hungry last night and really, really, really wanted to eat instant noodles
But then she thought about how we were down to our last cup
So she made do with Tawny Nightingale instead
Then she wanted to fry some bacon to go with it
But we were low on bacon, too, so she only spread half a spoonful of jam on it
But once she got back in bed, she felt like she hadn't satisfied her cravings at all
She was tossing and turning into the wee hours
Finally she gave in. She got up, ate the instant noodles, fried the bacon
She cleaned up our entire food supply
But how did she even manage to eat all that?
Then Amber showed up and told me...
At first, she wanted to climb through the sunroof onto the roof to feel the breeze
But apparently the breeze there wasn't strong enough for her
So she went up a tree
Right through the sunroof and into the cabin
She smashed our newly bought pillow to pieces
But how on earth do you smash a pillow into pieces?
Now, the two of them are heading out to replace the items and restock
Sounds like something those two would do
I don't even know what to say
Sounds like something those two would do
I don't even know what to say
Noya wouldn't be sitting around waiting for me to wake up over something like this
She even cried as she apologized, asking me to wait for her inside the RV
Said that I shouldn't go anywhere until they came back
There's no way she would fall from a tree
Haha, I think you're overthinking this...
I'm feeding the pigeons in the city square!
Really? You mean you aren't concocting some scheme with those two?
Fine, maybe I really am being paranoid.
I saved some money from my side jobs. Let's go out to eat something nice
We'll go when you come back!
Okay, we'll go when we come back!
==PLAYER_NAME==, I have a big favor to ask...
If you want me to tell Noya to go easy on the snacks
I wouldn't ask you to do that...
You're not gonna ask us to cut expenses starting next month, are you?
No, no, it's not like that.
I wanted to ask if you can go into the Monolith with me so I can do special training.
From our last few trips to the Monolith, I realized that we have a weakness
Noya and Amber are great with their weapons
But sometimes we still drop the ball
And that's because I'm the weak link in the team
Oh, you don't need to try to make me feel better
I'm not strong, and my reflexes aren't sharp—facts are facts...
But I want to work with the team
So that's why you want to do special training
At the very least, I need to stop tripping when we're dodging.
As soon as I get ready, we'll head out!
Since becoming a Trekker, just how many memories have I lost...?
Sure, most of them are unimportant
But I'm sure I've also forgotten important things along the way
It's a problem every Trekker must face.
But sometimes, I find myself obsessing over it
I want to know what exactly have I forgotten
We are so lucky that we've met you, ==PLAYER_NAME==
Now we can glimpse into our past thanks to the Runic Disc
No, no, I'm just an average person
That memory is indeed quite mysterious
As one might expect of you.
That I memorized Ancient Novian so many times...
Memorize and forget, memorize and forget, over and over again
Well, I guess that's what learning is
No no, this is all because of Monoliths
But there's no way around it.
There is some consolation in the thought that at least I don't have to sit for exams recently

strings.text: Feels like I really should learn another language
Knowing Novian should be enough, right?
Are you planning to move to another city and out-compete the locals for jobs?
If I know more languages, I'll have more job opportunities
Our journey will take us through all kinds of places across Nova
If I can speak other languages
Things will be much easier on the road
So I'm thinking of starting with the Loong language
==PLAYER_NAME==, I need to talk to you about something
Whatever you do, don't share your pudding with Noya
Noya bought two servings of pudding for herself last month
And then she ate my portion, too
So I axed her pudding budget for this month
She'll definitely come to you to whine about it
And then you'll feel sorry for her
And give half of your pudding to her
How do you know all this?
Because this isn't the first time
Don't tell me she's already done it
She needs to learn her lesson this time
==PLAYER_NAME==, do you know of any way to make Noya drive more safely
It's not like she's ever gotten into an accident, right?
Let air out of the tires?
There's a first time for everything...
First of all, we haven't got any money to repair Loxy
Plus, the medical bills alone would crush our fragile finance
Then we'll be in for some dark, dark times...
Like putting something under the gas pedal so Noya can't press it all the way
But what if something urgent happens and she needs to accelerate quickly?
That would make her drive slower
But also make driving even more dangerous
Guess it's back to the drawing board

I wouldn't go so far as to say that
our finances were in a death spiral

Even though now we have one more mouth to feed
And adding up all the daily expenses
Our quality of life actually keeps improving?
Maybe you imagined some of the bad stuff
We've been doing pretty well on commissions lately
But after you joined, we definitely started making more money
I guess what I'm trying to say is
The client from a few days ago was really generous
We even got paid extra, did not expect that
But... I was planning on saving this money
Yeah, that's how I feel as well
But we worked really hard for such a big payout
Feels wrong to not celebrate it properly
How about we use some of the money
And have a nice meal together
We can either have Noya make it or go to a restaurant
I'm doing the guild's budget for next month
Is there anything special that you need, ==PLAYER_NAME==?
Things that should be bought with guild fund
Like Loxy's maintenance fluid, or exploration gear
Then I'll go ask Noya and Amber
Why are you asking this all the sudden?
Because it's been a while since our last supply run
We should restock and do proper maintenance
And it's gonna cost quite a bit
So we need to make a plan

Eh? Is it a bug on my end?
No, I just sent it twice because I was so excited

Huh? No? Is there something wrong with this phone?
How much does a new cellphone cost?

Oh, I almost forgot the important stuff
If you feel unwell for any reason at all, let us know, okay?
We'll take good care of you since we brought you out of the Monolith!
Awww, the Tawny Nightingale today... It was like eating sawdust.
Maybe it's been left out too long?
Maybe it's been left out too long and expired.
I don't think so... Every time we go shopping, Iris makes it a point to test the bread's texture
She picks the relative soft ones because they are fresher
If Tawny Nightingale sits out there for too long, its texture will go from woody to stony
This bread is shockingly packed with sawdust, it feels like I'm chewing on wood
I really miss the time when we got unbelievably lucky and managed to buy a bag of Tawny Nightingale that was actually soft...
Even though we paid for it with several days worth of bad luck afterwards
If I could reverse time and go back, I would still...pick up that bag of bread...
Our first priority must be improving our food supply!
Hey, ==PLAYER_NAME==, are you going to make it rain Dorra for us?
Is there any way to improve our luck?
Of course, making money is important,
But when it comes to Tawny Nightingale, luck might be even more crucial
We need to tackle the problem from both sides!
Let's ask Amber and Iris and see if they have any ideas!
I can't find it... I can't find my film reel!!
Don't rush, take your time and think about where you put it last
What film reel? When did you last see it? Could it have just been misplaced?
Could it be underneath that pile of cushions inside Loxy?
Somebody left a Runic Disc there last time
I almost sat on it and broke it
Wow, that's a lot of questions all at once
It is called The Bear Squad. I watched it so many times!
After watching it last time, I put it...
The gap between sofa cushions... The black case blended right into the shadows. The perfect hiding spot for it!
Luckily, Iris was reaching in underneath to grab a Dorra. She stretched her hand all the way in and found it
I would have been so sad if I lost The Bear Squad...
There's an empty space under the armchair. Just use that as its designated spot from now~
That way, you'll never lose it again
I had terrible nightmare last night...
Must have been really bad to have scared you like this, Noya
I dreamed that Loxy transformed into an Autobot
And got into a big fight with Braude!
It's the name of the teddy bear that I carry with me
In my dream, it grew really big, even bigger than a Monolith. It broke the Monolith in the city center of Emor in half with a single paw swipe
But Loxy wasn't ready to admit defeat. It dragged Braude and they broke the Waterway
Loxy's antifreeze and Braude's cotton stuffing were scattered all over the place...
Seeing that made me so sad!!
I don't know. By the time they got to round 23, Emor's Monolith exploded
Braude held Loxy in the arms, crying, as they both died in the flames together...
I'm getting the feeling that a lot happened during those 23 rounds...
I can tell you all that I remember!
Typing is too slow. I'll switch to talking~
We found something amazing on our shopping trip today! Guess what it is!
The antifreeze that you've wanted for so long?
Cookies with cute kitten designs on them?
Yay! Finally, a break from Tawny Nightingale!!!
After so many years, Noya is cooking for us once more...
You're overreacting. It's only been a month.
When you're chewing on wood, a day sure feels like a year...
No, let's stick to the usual and decide the winner with rock-paper-scissors!
Then get ready for me to ten-peat!
This story I was following on "Trekker's Story Collection," it just ended!
Oh, you mean that side story from the Twin Stars series?
I thought the author wrote the side story because they wanted to make up for the original ending...
In the end, Galavera still didn't get her star
But as long as she holds onto her dream, it's not the end
Galavera and Daria's adventures haven't ended
I'm going to get her to send a letter to the magazine for me. Maybe the author will write a side story to the side story!
Iris went to take another certificate exam today
And I think Amber is taking care of a cat that's just given birth to a litter
In other words, we are in charge of watching over Loxy
Cast your mind back to the last time we were in charge of the RV
We got scammed by someone faking an accident on the road
We spent the better part of the day doing repairs
Oh... You mean you want to...
Take Loxy to go on a joyride again?
I promise I'll drive slow this time
See, I've got Iris' recording with me
You came prepared... You want to drive that bad?
To tell you the truth, I do miss the rush of driving like maniacs
Cola? What kind of flavor is that?
Wait wait wait, where did all these Pep Pep Juice come from?
It's your birthday, Noya, you can have any Pep Pep that you want
In that case... Can I take the whole shebang?
Of course. Whatever you ask, you shall receive!
Did it take you long to collect all these?
It wasn't too bad. I just found a Monolith which produced a lot of these
Amber and Iris did the collecting.
I was in charge of transport!
Then I'll wait for them to come back before opening any of these~
You don't want to try the new flavors right away?
These came from you all. I want to share them with all of you!
Next time, maybe we can take higher level commissions!
Now you get to read a few more volumes of The Trekker's Handwritten Encyclopedia!
Here's a trophy for you, the ultimate hardworking Trekker!
I have a hard time processing the text. Maybe take a break?
Just like the level 999 Cryo in Tamago Pet!
Level 999 Cryo... Doesn't sound all that powerful.
Wow, without realizing it, we've already collected so many Runic Discs
Especially these. They have us three on the cover
Be they good or bad, as long as I can recall something that we did together
I also think it's very lucky that
I get to be a Trekker with you all
Hehe, do you feel the same way?
Wow, I didn't expect such emotional words...
I'm going to forward this to Amber and Iris!
That's how I feel as well

Iris says that it's been a while since we had good food
So tonight I will cook with my heart's content
She even gave me a lot of money to buy food
Hehe, I'll prepare a feast for sure!

I'll share half of mine with you

This is just not a good idea
YES! I know you are the best ever, Boss!

You don't drive, you speed, there's a difference
Same scam act as last time all over again
No, I really did drive safely this time
They were the ones driving recklessly!
So I've been preparing a plan
I'm going to mod Loxy specifically for this
Add a ram bar and spiked wheel rims
Turn Loxy into a reaper chariot!
Driving a chariot like that inside the city will definitely get you stopped by the Imperial Guard
It's not healthy to bottle up anger
If I do all those mods
Loxy's performance will take a dive

strings.text: I am Shimiao from Baize Bureau. Would you happen to be ==PLAYER_NAME==?
Okay, now I can confirm that this is your number
Why? Didn't we add each other face to face?
Lately, monsters have been spotted in the wilderness around Cang Wu City
I see, thanks for the heads-up
I look forward to working with you
Reminder from [Baize Bureau]: If you encounter someone claiming to be a Xuan Shi master of feng shui or fortune-telling, please verify their identity with care.
Scams such as "paying to change your fate" or "advance payments required" are common. Please stay vigilant and stay on your guard!
An official Xuan Shi should have a graduation certificate from their Xuanist Association. You may ask them for their registered ID
Once you have the number, send it to Baize Bureau's official number. The on-duty staff for the day will verify its authenticity
Can I just send it to you directly?
Raising fraud awareness is a public duty
With someone as responsible as Shimiao... No wonder everyone has such a great impression of Cang Wu!
No, it's not because of me. It's thanks to everyone who lives here.
Hehe, last time we didn't get a chance to fully experience it
Next time, we must go on an in-depth tour of Cang Wu!
But first, we have to save enough money
==PLAYER_NAME==, the Bureau recently received a banner of commendation.
Oi? I don't remember such a thing
Of course, there was a reason for that
Oi? Oi oi oi? I don't remember such a thing
Somebody asked me to send that. Somebody who wished to remain anonymous
You really helped her out and she wanted to thank you
But she couldn't come visit Cang Wu, so I gave her an idea
You mean, the banner of commendation?
I suggested that she make a banner of commendation and then get a Post Haste courier to deliver it to Cang Wu
This way, even though she can't come to thank you in person, she is still able to properly express her gratitude, right?
...Alright, I truly appreciate the thought, but there's no need to send a banner next time
But banners are like kudos! Those who do good things should be properly recognized!
Fine. But please, use less dramatic terms next time
Now my colleagues keep calling me "Shimiaovelous"
Got a video? I want to verify that.
I heard that Mirage is a city famous for its love of spicy food?
Mirage's love of spice is known far and wide
That much is true. You are interested, Shimiao?
It seems Mirage's fame for spiciness has traveled far and wide, even reaching the people of Cang Wu!
It just so happens that Fenghuang Diner is holding this competition called "No Spice No Life."
Especially the customers who frequent the ultra-spicy hotpot restaurants in the city—they all received a questionnaire.
So eating spicy food is one of your hobbies, Shimiao?
Well, it's a bit complicated, but I do frequent hotpot restaurants a lot.
The questionnaire asked whether they would be willing to try specialty foods from other cities, such as Mirage's ultra-spicy wrap.
So I'm thinking, if Fenghuang Diner really ends up inviting Mirage's restaurants to Cang Wu for the event...
The Bureau and the Loong Guards must make plans for the occasion.
You are planning so far ahead...
We've got a saying in Cang Wu: Failing to plan is planning to fail
Anything you do, preparation leads to success, while a lack of preparation leads to failure.
==PLAYER_NAME==, if you are interested in Loong sayings, you can refer to this book, "Loong Proverbs and Idioms: A Compendium."
Who are you! Why are you using such cute emoji stickers!
You are not the Shimiao I know!
It's my day off. I'm tutoring the neighbor's kid. She took my phone when I wasn't paying attention.
And...sent you a bunch of things.
Your emoji stickers were really cute
Your emoji stickers were really cute~
I'm shocked! I cannot imagine you had saved emoji stickers like those
Send them to me! Even I don't have those!
These are from my colleagues at the bureau. They use them a lot when they're chatting with each other
And you seem to like them, too.
Sending an emoji every now and then makes the conversation feel way more relaxed
You should use them, too, Shimiao! You have so many saved already!
I was thinking about that... So...
Could I practice using them on you?
Until I can master the timing of emoji sticker usage.
Sure thing! I'm calling it right now—you'll love them so much that you won't be able to have a phone convo without them!
Aobelle's tour seems to be adding another show in Cang Wu.
Since you said it, Shimiao, it must be happening!
Since you said, Shimiao, I’m sure it’s true!
Thank you for trusting in me.
Yes. We've received a permit application from Aobelle's team and are already drafting a crowd control plan for the event
It is good to see you are using the emoji stickers so fluently now...
There's nothing left for me to teach you, Shimiao!
Recently, my colleagues at the bureau have been initiating conversations with me much more frequently than before
They prefer to communicate with me via phone
After all... You do look very intimidating in person!
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step... I'm using that saying correctly, right?
Your mastery of Loong sayings puts the preschoolers in Cang Wu to shame
I'm going to buy some tools to put into my Multifunction Ruler Box tomorrow.
What is a sword-shaped Multifunction Ruler Box?
It's known as Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword!
Fine, it's Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword then.
I know it only by Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword!
So if there's anything you want put into it, let me know and I'll buy it
That way we can munch on them whenever we want!
In theory, the storage box can hold anything
Please make a list of snacks you want to eat. I'll try to buy everything I can find here in Cang Wu for you
Shimiao... Shimiao... Right now, you're as amazing as that amazing Blue Round-Headed Cat!
A Blue Round-Headed Cat? What's that?
It's the protagonist of a Monolith movie
It can pull out all sorts of things from its pocket to solve problems for its friends!
Next time, take me to see that movie too, please?
It's a deal then—no backing out, okay?
==PLAYER_NAME==, Iris has told me of your plan
Huh? What are you talking about?
No... Iris... How did she spoil the surprise?
We were having dessert together. She said you want her to pick out a cake
Yeah, I did ask for her help
Fine. I was trying to pick a birthday cake for you
The photo doesn't do it justice
This flower on the cake can spin while playing the birthday song!
This is the most unique birthday cake in the entire continent, bar none
You should be getting it soon!
Ah... I am hearing the doorbell
The entire office has gathered around me to watch the cake
The cake is great but I have just one question
How can I turn this flower off? It doesn't seem to stop
Haha, I forgot to tell you...
It will only stop the music and the spinning when it runs out of magic power
This one is the super long-lasting model; I heard it can spin for three days and nights straight!
Okay. This is truly the most unique birthday cake in the entire continent, bar none
New Star Guild's training method is right on par with the large guilds
For example, just now, Noya suddenly stepped into the trap you had set up
It helped honing everyone's trap-disarming skills
And then there's Amber, leading everyone in tracking the migration of Shrubshews family through these woods
It's as you say. All these were planned training exercises...
I wrote a letter to my sister yesterday
Huh, that came out of nowhere
It's because of the Disc that you gave me...
I was attending my sister's graduation ceremony along with my parents
She was Yanquan Academy's top graduate of her grade. She even gave a speech as the student representative
Wow, your whole family is so accomplished!
I could never compare to my sister
She's pretty famous in Cang Wu. She gets a lot of attention
My parents are very proud of my sister.
And I'm sure now they're very proud of you, too, Shimiao!
I wasn't looking for someone to comfort me, but thank you
It's just that the Disc brought back these memories for me

strings.text: There was an incident in Cangwu today.
A kid accidentally threw a firecracker into someone's yard and set some stuff on fire.
Luckily they noticed it fast, and the yard didn't have much in it, so the damage wasn't too bad.
It's been so dry lately, we all need to be careful.
I thought the same, so I drafted a proposal today to run some fire-safety campaigns in Cangwu to raise awareness.
If they end up putting me in charge of it, then I...
Don't worry. I know you, Shimiao, and I know you'll be fine!
If even you say so, ==PLAYER_NAME==, then I'll believe I can do it!
This month's bulletin board has been completed.
Should you need to, please review it at the community notice board.
Sorry, ==PLAYER_NAME==, that was supposed to go to my supervisor.
I thought you were inviting me to review your work
Even you send messages to the wrong person, huh
You are welcome to, if you'd like.
I was too busy just now, I didn't look at the avatar.
Still, I didn't know you could draw stuff for those bulletin boards.
It's nothing special, but if you'd like to see it, come over.
I'd like to ask you something, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
You do look a bit serious.
A senior told me today my expression is too serious.
When I stand next to the supply post, I don't look like I'm giving out goods, I look like I'm hunting criminals.
It's just that once you said it, I suddenly pictured it...
Being serious isn't a bad thing!
A huge cockroach showed up in my office!
Wait for me, I'll come over and deal with it!
It's fine, you don't have to come anymore...
It suddenly flew up, I freaked out, grabbed something and threw at it.
Didn't expect you to be scared of bugs, though. I thought you were absolutely fearless.
But if you're scared of them, too, then even if it's gross, I'll still try my best to protect you.
From this day on, I shall be known as Shimiao, Conqueror of All Chili Peppers!
Are you eating that ultra-spicy hotpot again?
I didn't even tell you yet.
You're drunk on peppers again, aren't you...
Stay where you are, I'm coming to pick you up.
Just sit still and don't run off!
I ordered some chili peppers a few days ago, and the shipment just arrived at my door.
Yes... Lots and lots of chili peppers...
Oh I get it, you want me to help you portion and store them
Like the ones I saw at your place last time.
No, when I placed the order, I accidentally entered two extra 0s...
I now have 100 pounds of chili peppers at my door...
Can you think of something... anything to help me...
Then... Why not sell them to the hotpot restaurant?
They need tons of chili peppers for spicy dishes, right?

strings.text: Hmph. Just what I'd expect from a fellow wielder of the dark power.
I'll hit you up if I need anything.
Hey! Guess what the great Chaton is up to right now?
I just smashed my own record in the Monolith!
Just as I thought—the only one who can beat me is myself!
Well? Are you bowing down in awe yet?
... You pretty much said it all yourself.
What? You got a problem with that?
That's because you take forever to reply!
A Tyrant can't be this bad at texting, you know?
If you go up against someone as fast as me...
You won't even be able to get a word in
But anyway, congrats on breaking your record again.
Wh-Why are you saying that all of a sudden?!
I'm gonna go celebrate! Done talking to you!
The games coming out of the Monolith lately are a total letdown.
Couldn't even hold the great Chaton's attention!
That's just because you're too good.
Obviously the great Chaton is the best!
Don't think flattery will get you anywhere!
Then here's hoping the next one actually gives the great Chaton a real challenge!
Actually, there's one more game I haven't touched yet.
When I boot it up, you're playing it with me!
If you dare stand me up...
I'll have the White Cat Troupe hunt you across the entire continent!
The great Chaton read the stars tonight, and beheld a profound darkness looming in the cosmos!
Which is why I've decided to pull off something huge.
Isn't the night sky always dark?
It's different! The darkness of dark power is like...
I knew the Tyrant shared my dark resonance!
Then what are we waiting for?
Hurry up and get out of Loxy!
When did you even get here?
Heh heh! The great Chaton pulled off something EPIC today!
What kind of trouble did you stir this time?
Is Kasimira blowing you off again?
I taught those crooked shooting gallery scammers a lesson they won't forget!
The great Chaton is straight-up a hero today!
Hey! What's THAT supposed to mean?!
I saw something shady going down and had to step in!
I helped a little girl get her prize back from those dirty scammers!
This has NOTHING to do with Kasimira!
I was just walking past a street shooting gallery this afternoon
And decided to teach those cheating cheapskates a lesson!
Oh? What exactly did you do?
Just called them out on their little scam.
I wiped the floor with them!
That's not exactly something to brag about!
You gotta hit 'em hard so they don't even think about trying it again.
A Tyrant like you gets that logic, right?
Alright... You make a fair point...
Yo Tyrant, you got any cash on you?
Meet me at that street we always hit up.
Huh??? Is this some kind of ... scam?
What's going on? Is everything alright??
Nothing! I just don't have enough cash on me!
I'll kick your butt if you're late!
But you could at least tell me what happened?
My gun accidentally went off and shattered a dessert shop's window.
Do NOT tell anyone! Or I'll murder you!
You gotta believe me! It really was an accident!
Anyway, just get over here NOW!!
We were supposed to have a showdown at the training grounds today.
Is she seriously standing me up again?!
Why are you always trying to duel Kasimira?
Hmph. Beating her is the only way I'll become the strongest in the White Cat Troupe!
And prove I'm worthy of my sacred title—the sole inheritor of the dark power within the White Cat Troupe
You're always going on about being an "inheritor"

strings.text: a visit from management would be a once-in-a-blue-moon thing...
Boss, some of the crops i was trying to grow finally sprouted!
there are some berries. i'll bring some over for you!
they're much sweeter than normal berries
their growing conditions are super strict
so for now, we can only grow them on a small scale
hey boss, i dug up something hard in the fields today
... it was actually something i buried a long time ago...
it was my emergency food stash
but i buried it and then completely forgot about it
only remembered when i dug it up today...
Is the food inside still good?
it is! it's the kind of food that keeps for a long time
and i stored it really well
so i checked it and buried it again! :)
hey boss, are you free today?
my 20th cellar is almost finished today
hehe... i guess i just kept digging and... here we are...
there's just one cellar door left, and i was hoping we could install it together
finishing the last step with you...
boss, whenever i'm munching on tawny nightingale
i always think about this one argument...
that united harvest's new tech is destroying our traditions
Philae is just full of artificial food these days
but at the end of the day, it did boost food production
without all the related artifacts and their replicas...
we couldn't possibly feed this many people
being able to eat is what's most important!
but tawny nightingale really does taste awful lol
the bland taste really gets you thinking...
a relative asked me again the other day
as someone with a college education
why i ended up farming after graduation
i don't see anything wrong with it
sure, there are plenty of people cooped up in their labs
working hard to cultivate all sorts of plants
convinced those strange new things will change the world
hmm, it's not really a matter of if they did or not
the point is, when everyone is busy with high-level design
someone has to stay on the ground and worry about the yield
True. Ideas without roots are just dreams.
i've stood at the top of the company's high-rise and looked out
but in the end, i chose a quiet life on a small hill...
boss... i get worried about you and your company sometimes
your company doesn't have any physical assets
and you don't even have a permanent office!
Now that you mention it... I guess that's true.
you'll be out on the streets...
i can't even bear to imagine it... :'(
Why am I suddenly going bankrupt?!
i've decided to share my cellars with you
W-wait... Are you sure about this?
any of my cellars on the continent can be your safe house
Holy... just how many have you dug...
we could go to my special cellar together
Special cellar? There are different cellars?
it's where i keep all the good stuff i'm saving for special occasions
not only is everything in there top-grade
this cellar is also really spacious
it has a table, chairs, a pot, and even a bed!
is just for the two of us
Those little plants look so cute.
even if they did, i bet they wouldn’t taste good
delicious fruit takes time to grow and ripen
but if you ever get a craving
you can always come to me for some fresh fruit!
boss, boss! i had a nightmare last night!
woke me right up in a panic
i was gonna reinforce it this morning
i realized it was just a nightmare after all ^^

This is bad, this is really bad!

strings.text: If you have any suggestions regarding the service or dishes at Huaijing Restaurant, please feel free to contact me directly!
Of course! And it's a good one!
New customers will receive a complimentary signature stir-fry dish~
Spend over 6,000 Dorra and you'll also receive a discount coupon: 3,000 off for every 5,000 spent.
Wow, that is such a good deal!
Yeah, but we have our own coupon policy~
You can use up to two coupons per visit, and you'll get an extra one after you use them
We hope to get repeat customers this way, you included~
Heyhey, do you prefer salty or sweet?
As long as it tastes good!
Salty, when it comes down to it
Most of the time, our guild members subsist on Tawny Nightingale with a pinch of salt
When Noya does the grilling, she also likes to put a lot of spices and salt on the meat
She says doing that is from firsthand knowledge amongst Trekkers.
Not sure why it is the case, but I'll take this down!
When Noya does the grilling, she also likes to put a lot of spices and salt on the meat.
But sweet stuff is what picks me up!
It doesn't matter, as long as it tastes good!
Hehe, seems like you aren't picky. In that case...
The long and short of it is, Huaijing Restaurant is looking for Trekkers to serve as dish testers as part of our new business expansion plan!
If you like salty food, we will have you try our new salty dishes~
And if you have a sweet tooth...
You will have me try the new sweet dishes?
What does a dish tester do exactly?
Our restaurant introduces new dishes every quarter, and the dishes testers get to try them for free
After tasting, testers are required to fill out a questionnaire and provide their feedback on the new dishes~
If you happen to be in Philae when we're launching new dishes, be sure to stop by!
Hehe, look what I got: "Scientific Mahjong Playing Guide 3.0!"
Hehe, the other day my mom and I went back to Cang Wu, and I asked Shimiao to compile this for me!
Thanks, but I'll pass. No amount of science can fix bad luck and a lousy hand...
No, no, this version will definitely help!
Wow, this version has a lot of illustrations
Even though they don't help at all with understanding the formulas Shimiao wrote
Oh, the illustrations were drawn by Chixia...
She's my hometown neighbor's great-uncle's sister-in-law's daughter's cousin.
In short, a friend, got it
She suggested adding something to make the whole thing more readable and personally created these "masterpieces"!
I saw them! Masterpieces, in a way.
As long as you think so
Make sure you read it through carefully~
Next time when you come, if you can beat me in mahjong
Your whole guild can eat for free!
I'll immediate get everybody else on this as well!
You haven't gotten the questionnaire back to me yet!
We suddenly got a lot of commissions these past few days. I meant to turn it in soon...
That means you and everybody else in New Star Guild won't have to eat Tawny Nightingale everyday!
The questionnaire can wait. Making money comes first!
The hardworking members deserve a good meal!
How about having it at Huaijing?
Hehe, I think it is a great idea!
It just so happens we are close to Philae right now...
Could Miss Manager please reserve a large table for us? We'll see you tonight!
Maybe learning grammar takes talent. What do you think, Boss?
Got a bad score on your test?
Couldn't memorize them for your test?
So bad... I got nine out of ten grammar questions wrong, and the one I got right was just a lucky guess
That takes a certain kind of talent, too
No, it was a quiz my mom gave me
I got nine out of ten grammar questions wrong, and the one I got right was just a lucky guess
Let me teach you a trick I learned from a teacher—a handy mnemonic!
You mean the one that goes like "three short, one long—pick the longest; three long, one short—pick the shortest"?
Wow. You know that one, too?
Some things are just universal no matter which city you live in
But it didn't do me any good
Which shows there are no shortcuts to learning. You just have to do it the hard way in the future!
Well, it's not like I have a choice.
Mom confiscated my mahjong tiles. If I fail the quiz again next week, I won't ever see them again
Make sure you hide the set of mahjong tiles that I gave you!
If things go south next week... That set of tiles will be my last hope!
How is it that you can always tell what I'm feeling?
You did it when we were playing Mahjong last time
And when I couldn't figure out my homework
And when we didn't get the "Outstanding Business" award this quarter.
It's because I have the power of observation
It's because I can read your mind
It's because I have the power of observation, of course
You don't know? You have this tell.
It's because I can read your mind, of course
You didn't really believe it, did you!?
Actually, it's because you have this tell
When you're happy, you shake your tail upward three times—once to the left and twice to the right.
When you are sad, it just droops.
When you're angry, it puffs up like woah
You're making me feeling like I'm a kid!
I'm going to get my tail under control from now on!
Ta-da! I have good news to share!
We are replacing our wine cabinet with a new one!
We are keeping so many bottles for our customers that the current cabinet is getting too small
So we're going to replace it with something bigger, taller~
My mom says it's the manager's pejorative, hehehe
Yes, a whole row of bottles from you!
Hmm... Now that I have said it, it's more like the Boss' prerogative
The Boss' prerogative... Sounds very impressive!
It's only impressive if the whole row is filled up
Guess I'll have to work even harder from now on!
Today is my birthday, so my mom made this bowl of noodles for me~~
Don't tell anybody else this, Boss
Before this year, when my mom was sick, it was always Grandpa Qin who made me birthday noodles.
It's not that they weren't tasty, and I definitely didn't want to make my mom to go through all that trouble, but...
I really wanted to eat birthday noodles made by her
So last year on my birthday, I made a secret wish, hoping that Mom would get healthy again
And that... She would make me birthday noodles
When Grandpa Qin said my mom made these noodles, I was so happy!
And my mom promised me that she'd make me these every year on my birthday from now on
Ok I gotta go eat my noodles before they become mushy!
The Trekker training course works better than I thought!
I'm ready to accept all your praises
I'm ready to accept all your praises!
In my dreams, I can handle the chefs who come into the restaurant looking for trouble and confront the thugs that harass Cai!
Not what I expected to hear...
I had no idea running a restaurant is such a tough business.
Well, in my dreams it is

Hmph, figure that out for yourself

param: If you have any suggestions regarding the service or dishes at Huaijing Restaurant, please feel free to contact me directly!

New customers will receive a complimentary signature stir-fry dish~

Wow, that is such a good deal!
Yeah, but we have our own coupon policy~
You can use up to two coupons per visit, and you'll get an extra one after you use them
We hope to get repeat customers this way, you included~
Heyhey, do you prefer salty or sweet?
As long as it tastes good!
Salty, when it comes down to it
Most of the time, our guild members subsist on Tawny Nightingale with a pinch of salt
When Noya does the grilling, she also likes to put a lot of spices and salt on the meat
She says doing that is from firsthand knowledge amongst Trekkers.
Not sure why it is the case, but I'll take this down!
Most of the time, our guild members subsist on Tawny Nightingale with a pinch of salt
When Noya does the grilling, she also likes to put a lot of spices and salt on the meat.
But sweet stuff is what picks me up!
It doesn't matter, as long as it tastes good!
Hehe, seems like you aren't picky. In that case...
The long and short of it is, Huaijing Restaurant is looking for Trekkers to serve as dish testers as part of our new business expansion plan!
If you like salty food, we will have you try our new salty dishes~
And if you have a sweet tooth...
You will have me try the new sweet dishes?
What does a dish tester do exactly?
Our restaurant introduces new dishes every quarter, and the dishes testers get to try them for free
After tasting, testers are required to fill out a questionnaire and provide their feedback on the new dishes~
If you happen to be in Philae when we're launching new dishes, be sure to stop by!
Hehe, look what I got: "Scientific Mahjong Playing Guide 3.0!"
Hehe, the other day my mom and I went back to Cang Wu, and I asked Shimiao to compile this for me!
Thanks, but I'll pass. No amount of science can fix bad luck and a lousy hand...
No, no, this version will definitely help!
Hehe, the other day my mom and I went back to Cang Wu, and I asked Shimiao to compile this for me!
Wow, this version has a lot of illustrations
Even though they don't help at all with understanding the formulas Shimiao wrote
Oh, the illustrations were drawn by Chixia...
She's my hometown neighbor's great-uncle's sister-in-law's daughter's cousin.
In short, a friend, got it
She suggested adding something to make the whole thing more readable and personally created these "masterpieces"!
I saw them! Masterpieces, in a way.
As long as you think so
Make sure you read it through carefully~
Next time when you come, if you can beat me in mahjong
Your whole guild can eat for free!
I'll immediate get everybody else on this as well!
You haven't gotten the questionnaire back to me yet!
We suddenly got a lot of commissions these past few days. I meant to turn it in soon...
That means you and everybody else in New Star Guild won't have to eat Tawny Nightingale everyday!
The questionnaire can wait. Making money comes first!
The hardworking members deserve a good meal!
How about having it at Huaijing?
Hehe, I think it is a great idea!
It just so happens we are close to Philae right now...
Could Miss Manager please reserve a large table for us? We'll see you tonight!
Maybe learning grammar takes talent. What do you think, Boss?
Got a bad score on your test?
Couldn't memorize them for your test?
Got a bad score on your test?
So bad... I got nine out of ten grammar questions wrong, and the one I got right was just a lucky guess
That takes a certain kind of talent, too
Couldn't memorize them for your test?
No, it was a quiz my mom gave me
I got nine out of ten grammar questions wrong, and the one I got right was just a lucky guess
That takes a certain kind of talent, too
Let me teach you a trick I learned from a teacher—a handy mnemonic!
You mean the one that goes like "three short, one long—pick the longest; three long, one short—pick the shortest"?
Wow. You know that one, too?
Some things are just universal no matter which city you live in
But it didn't do me any good
Which shows there are no shortcuts to learning. You just have to do it the hard way in the future!
Well, it's not like I have a choice.
Mom confiscated my mahjong tiles. If I fail the quiz again next week, I won't ever see them again
Make sure you hide the set of mahjong tiles that I gave you!
If things go south next week... That set of tiles will be my last hope!
How is it that you can always tell what I'm feeling?
You did it when we were playing Mahjong last time
And when I couldn't figure out my homework
And when we didn't get the "Outstanding Business" award this quarter.
It's because I have the power of observation
It's because I can read your mind
It's because I have the power of observation, of course
You don't know? You have this tell.
It's because I can read your mind, of course
You didn't really believe it, did you!?
Actually, it's because you have this tell
When you're happy, you shake your tail upward three times—once to the left and twice to the right.
When you are sad, it just droops.
When you're angry, it puffs up like woah
You're making me feeling like I'm a kid!
I'm going to get my tail under control from now on!
Ta-da! I have good news to share!
We are replacing our wine cabinet with a new one!
We are keeping so many bottles for our customers that the current cabinet is getting too small
So we're going to replace it with something bigger, taller~
My mom says it's the manager's pejorative, hehehe
Yes, a whole row of bottles from you!
Hmm... Now that I have said it, it's more like the Boss' prerogative
The Boss' prerogative... Sounds very impressive!
It's only impressive if the whole row is filled up
Guess I'll have to work even harder from now on!
Today is my birthday, so my mom made this bowl of noodles for me~~
Don't tell anybody else this, Boss
Before this year, when my mom was sick, it was always Grandpa Qin who made me birthday noodles.
It's not that they weren't tasty, and I definitely didn't want to make my mom to go through all that trouble, but...
I really wanted to eat birthday noodles made by her
So last year on my birthday, I made a secret wish, hoping that Mom would get healthy again
And that... She would make me birthday noodles
When Grandpa Qin said my mom made these noodles, I was so happy!
And my mom promised me that she'd make me these every year on my birthday from now on
Ok I gotta go eat my noodles before they become mushy!
The Trekker training course works better than I thought!
I'm ready to accept all your praises
I'm ready to accept all your praises!
In my dreams, I can handle the chefs who come into the restaurant looking for trouble and confront the thugs that harass Cai!
Not what I expected to hear...
I had no idea running a restaurant is such a tough business.
Well, in my dreams it is

But now I have the courage to face them and protect everyone else!
And it's thanks to you, Boss!
I got the Runic Disc you sent me, Boss.
The cover, the melody, and the memories sealed within it are all irreplaceable
Hmph, figure that out for yourself

strings.text: Hey Boss, wanna come eat at Jing's Bistro today?
I came up with a new dish~
And I wanna invite you to come try it~
Customers kept saying my egg fried noodles and egg fried rice are great
But one portion isn't enough to fill you up
And if you order both, you can't finish
So I made an improved version!
Anyway, drop by later and try it~
Do you think I should make some savory dishes, too?
Because whenever I finish dessert I want savory snacks
And after savory snacks I want dessert again
If Jing's Bistro serves both sweet and savory dishes
Sweet then savory, savory then sweet
But people can't just eat forever
But expanding the menu is a nice idea
If you make something new, I wanna try it too~
Once I come out with new dishes, you'll be my very first taste tester!
The wild mushrooms up in the mountains should be ready now, right?
Boss, wanna go mushroom picking with me this week?
Yeah! Wild mushrooms taste amazing in both soups and stir-fries
Lots of Loong go into the mountains to do mushroom picking
There's a guide who knows the mountains leading a group this Saturday
Oh no, oh no, oh no.
My mom checked my schoolwork today
I failed my quiz and she said that's because I spent too much time playing mahjong
Did you stay up all night playing again?
Mom said she's confiscating my mahjong tiles
hang onto them for me for a while?
Tell you what, you leave them with me
And when you pass your quiz next time
Uh... Something about this feels off
Boss, I have good news to share with you!
I looked through some old books recently
They said you can cook herbs with food to make medicinal meals
Gramps knows herbs really well, so I asked him to make a recipe for my mom
She's been eating it for a month and she seems to be getting a bit better!
But Mom can't really go out right now...
Then do what you're best at
A delicious feast, plus a handmade get-well-soon card?
We're gonna go dig for wild greens. Wanna come?
Didn't you say you were going to thoroughly clean the restaurant tomorrow?
Early morning we'll gather greens, then hit the market, do the cleaning job in the afternoon, then play mahjong with some regulars in the evening
Where do you get all that energy?
You're up before five to prep, open at eight, close at ten in the evening, then clean the kitchen afterward
And maybe do a supply run in between
So are you coming with us tomorrow morning?
I'll try my best to get up...

strings.text: If you change your mind at any point, just come find me at the clinic~
If you joke with me like that, I might take it seriously.
You are such a rare and precious specimen—if I don't do some research on you...
I will regret it for the rest of my life~
Alright then, I'll be looking forward to the day you visit my clinic of your own volition~
I have just acquired a new specimen
Isn't this just a common butterfly specimen?
The kind of specimens that you wish to see~
Next time you visit the clinic, I'll show them to you~
No!! That's not what I meant!!
I've prepared a new medicine for improving one's sleep
Are you interested in giving it a try?
Do you really wish to refuse?
I can give you a free checkup in exchange
How is that a fair exchange...?
You just want to research my body!!
This was specially made for you—I heard that you haven't been sleeping well.
I am very concerned about you
What a pity, I was hoping to gather some clinical data on you
I shall think of a better reason next time
Hopefully you will not turn me down then~
Even if all that remains of a person is a set of skeletons, the bones can still tell a story.
...Just what are you talking about? It sounds terrifying.
I can tell a person's gender by their pelvis, and their age by their teeth
Broken bones leave marks. Toxins and medication also leave traces on one's bones
It's the kind of romance that only you can understand, Coronis.
Even though I don't really see it...
Maybe it's because you haven't seen enough dead bodies.
Perhaps if you look at more of them, you'll come to understand their beauty.
Next time I prepare a specimen, I will invite you to watch.
Boss, I have a question for you
Do you have a way to manage your monthly expenses?
Control my expenses? My motto is that "Not buying it means 100% off."
Nope. Money is meant to be spent.
What you say seems to make sense
But it's impossible to put into practice, isn't it?
I quite admire your way of thinking
I shall try it if I get the chance
Why asking me this all the sudden?
The clinic's expenses have been mysteriously increasing every month
If I don't take action, the clinic might end up in the red
Never mind. I just thought I'd ask
Why do humans need to work in order to make money?
Why isn't passion and dedication rewarded with money?
Wasting scientific research time on such trivial matters is a waste of talent
The human brain uses rambling nonsense as a way to balance emotions
This is a normal physiological phenomenon
That was also rambling, wasn't it?
No, today's patient was very boring, that's all
Standard injury from a trip to the Monolith
I gave the guy a quick stitch, it'll heal up in just a few days
Yeah, sort of. But I was hoping for some challenging cases
Didn't you say that you wanted to see my right eye?
Oh yeah! The enchanted right eye!
If I look at it, will I turn into stone?
What? Where did you get that from?
You are good at joking, Boss
I will be calibrating my prosthetic eye this afternoon
Please come find me at the clinic if you are interested
A patient at the clinic gave me a bag of snacks today
I will leave it there for you
...Did I even say I was going?
Don't keep me waiting for too long
I made two extra bottles of hemostatic powder, good for stopping bleeding
If you want them, feel free to pick them up
I just remembered, there's something I want to tell you
Oh, is today already the Woodcarver Day?
I don't celebrate my birthdays so it's natural for me to forget.
After all, it comes around every year.
How did you know when my birthday is?
Oh? Seems like there's a story here
But thank you for remembering it for me~
The power of the scythe allows me to levitate
But honestly, I still have no idea how it actually works
Would be nice if I could thoroughly look into it
There should be any number of artifacts that allow one to fly.
This scythe is not an Monolith artifact
Too bad there is only one
Otherwise, I'd love to take it apart and see what's inside
Even though you don't fully understand this weapon, you still wield it with such skill
Fighting with weapons is also a natural survival instinct
But my passion lies in studying its mechanism
Maybe if I uncover its secret, I would be able to figure out that other matter as well
Well, it's just me babbling to myself
Human memory is a strange maze
Even if you get to see it again in real time, if you can't organically recall it on your own, you will only feel like an observer
It's just that some images flashed through my mind while I was listening to the Runic Disc
They are supposed to be my memory
But apart from a sense of familiarity, I cannot confirm that this is truly mine
It's as if I'm watching a movie with myself as the protagonist
Without any sense of real personal experience
No need to apologize over something like this!!
I'm really happy that you're sharing all this with me
As long as you don't find it annoying

I'm reporting this to the Imperial Guard
It's just a new fizzy tablet I invented
A new fizzy tablet I invented
and it turns the water into a drink or a potion
You're totally gonna grab me once I get there
I needed to check on a patient
So I'm not in the clinic right now
And I forgot to turn off the reaction kettle for the potions
So for the sake of the rare specimens in my room
And so I have a place to sleep tonight
Can you please get there and turn off the reaction kettle
But I don't know how to
There's a red handle on it, just turn it left
If the clinic blows up, I'll have to crash with your guild for a while
Have you been shedding a lot of hair lately?
I'm not gonna buy shampoo from you
I'm not trying to sell shampoo
I have run out of your hair samples
Next time you shed some hair
Fine... As long as you're not experimenting on me
How do you even have my hair in the first place!
When you came in for a checkup last time
Did you collect what fell off
Or did you yank it out
It will take a lot for you to go bald
Come have a meal with me
What are you up to this time?
What kind of person do you think I am?
Some mad scientist who wants to turn me into a specimen
Then meet me tonight at the entrance of Jing's Bistro
Why are you suddenly treating me to a meal?
Back when you worked as my assistant
Remember how we had that patient who claimed he had a brain lesion?
I gave him placebo meds for a while
Now he thinks he is CURED and paid me a huge thank-you fee
So I figured I'd treat my excellent assistant to a nice meal
But he wasn't really sick, was he?
Of course he wasn't, but I'm a great doctor
Anyway, don't forget, come to Jing's Bistro tonight
Don't forget to come back for your follow-up
You're telling me to not go to your clinic
The seasonal flu is making the rounds in Ash District
You might catch it if you come
I can't even get a single corpse sample
Which I've been distributing these past few days
Make sure you take care of yourself, too
My potion research has hit a bottleneck
No, I mean I just don't know what to research next
Sleep potion, hemostatic potion, energizing potion...
Is there anything you would like?
A potion that's the equivalent of three full meals
A potion that heals wounds instantly
A potion that makes you invisible
That would save my guild during food shortages
I did make one that makes you not want to eat for three whole days
So that would basically save you nine meals
Not ... want to eat for three whole days?
You could honestly substitute them for several meals, in theory
But I do want to try researching that
Its principle is similar to United Harvest's plant gene mods
So there's a risk of it turning me into a monster?
Fairly high risk, I would say
But if you're willing to be my test subject...
So you DO want to experiment on me!
Think of the contribution to science
If I succeed in making this
People will honor your memory for generations to come
I'll just transform into a monster and get taken out by the Imperial Guard at sight!
I'd use Charon to take you out before that happens
A good idea, to be sure
Even though I'm not sure if it's possible
But I can already predict this
If this is a potion that you drink
Then only your body would become invisible; your clothes, not so much
Yep, once you drink it, you'd have to take all your clothes off
Can't you make the clothes invisible, too?
Then it has to be something you rub on your body and clothes
But then the timing gets tricky
If it wears off on your body before it does on your clothes...

What did you make this time?

Steam sticky rice and make it into a dough, then wrap cream and fruit inside
Then it turns into a little white dumpling
It's similar to a dessert from my homeland
So I tried making a few
But this is my first time making it
Then I shall see you soon, ==SEX7== ==PLAYER_NAME==
I heard that if you eat too many sweets, you get cavities
Like worms digging holes in your teeth
You'll lose all your teeth to the worms, it's horrible
Then I'll get rid of all the worms
You really can't give up sweets, can you?
Eating too much dessert does cause cavities
But I think the "worms" part is just to scare kids
I feel a lot better now, thank you
Then... Do you know why ice cream is always shy?
Because if its emotions get too heated, it melts
Do you know why math books are always gloomy?
They have too many unsolved problems
Sorry... I can't catch my breath
...?? You really think they're that funny?!
Sorry for showing you that side of me
No, just tell them to me in person next time
I want to see your face when you say it
Then next time we meet, I'll prepare as many jokes as possible
Now that you mention it, I probably do...
We have been super busy these past two weeks, so the Lucky Oasis is a complete mess
All right, I'll head over now, please wait for me
Come to think of it, your commission fees are pretty high
I need to discuss with Iris before we can hire you
I can't do that to you
I heard from Miss Iris about your guild's current situation the other day
How you took on a big commission so no one has had time for chores
Then I gratefully accept. I'll help out, too
I will bring the cupcakes that everyone likes so much
==SEX7== ==PLAYER_NAME==, have you ever seen a field of sunflowers?
On the way to the Monolith last time, we passed a village
I heard that their fields were full of sunflowers
But when we went, it happened to be harvest season
So all the flowers had been cut down
Don't be sad, though, they'll flower again next year
When they do, ==SEX7== ==PLAYER_NAME==, would you be interested in going to see them with me?
Just remind me when it's time
Sorry for disturbing you so late again
When I was shopping for supplies today, I think I saw her
or someone looking really like her
The shop was crowded, so I couldn't see clearly
It was just a moment, and then she was gone
It was my fault... A ninja should always be alert
I shouldn't have spaced out while waiting in line
Don't be so hard on yourself, Nanoha
If it wasn't her, then it doesn't matter
And if it was, you will definitely meet again
It's just ... when I close my eyes, that moment keeps replaying itself in my mind
If you can't fall sleep, maybe take a walk?
I'll wait for you in our usual spot

strings.text: Please contact me on this number from now on
So, you don't have a work phone?
I don't like having too many rules
Whether it's work or personal, just contact me directly
By the way, I'm not great with cellphones
If possible, I prefer face-to-face communication
What's the point of cellphones, then?
I'll look into this after I'm done with all 12 meetings I've got lined up
Being a teacher is tough, huh?
It's just the boring paper I'm reading
Is it one of the papers you have to grade?
No. My students are way better than this
Wait, a teacher gotta keep learning too?
Of course. we have to submit research programs
and prepare for annually lecturer evaluations
Busier than a beaver, I mean a student
You're right. I even go to bed later than they do because I'm always up working
How long did you sleep last time?
Please, go catch up on your sleep.
The students there are forced to read aloud at the top of their lungs during morning reading
Maybe it's to wake them up
Is it because they knew you were coming?
They're still kids. Their bodies are still growing
It will do them far more harm than good if they end up injuring their vocal cords because of it
If they had known I was coming, they probably would have ran away screaming
I'm known as the Devil Teacher
I thought it was a cool moniker and mentioned it in class
Before I knew it, a boy burst into tears. He was kneeling on the ground, apologizing
It wasn't until afterwards that I found out he was the one who came up with the name
Well, to come back to my original point...
I have always loathed doing unproductive things just for appearance's sake
That's why I suggested to the headmaster to let the students do the morning reading in their own way
There's no need to force anything. No need to pretend for anyone
After the students learned of this, they were extremely grateful to me
I have a question for you, if you don't mind.
Do you know what gyaru-talk is?
I heard the girls in my class talking about it.
Seems to be some trend that originated in Flavio
They probably got it off a Monolith book...
So, what does it sound like?
No... I'm having a hard time imagining your expression right now.
I want to know what my students are thinking
Why do they have a different way of communication every day
That's just how young people live
Guess it's time to blend in and embrace the youthful vibe
Any suggestions on where to start?
My suggestion would be to not start at all
It's hard to understand the young.
You aren't that much older than your students
Have you heard of the saying of "five-year generation gap"?
I'm one generation ahead of my oldest students, two when it comes the youngest ones
Even if I'm the youngest professor here
I feel like this conversation is entering into a dangerous territory...
But thank you. Talking with you has made me feel a lot better
I have to go attend another meeting now. Goodbye
And it's pretty out of hand
Are you okay? Are you at the school or at home?
Do you need me to contact...
i had classes 21 day in a roll
You're overworked, Canace. Please get some rest ASAP
i want to goo somewhere with you toooo
We will when we get the opportunity
I'll show you in a sec
Nobody can stem the tide of time
I can just barely fit in
Then the button at the collar just popped off
I put on weight after I started working...
Do you make it a habit to learn new things?
It's always a good idea to learn new skills.
It's always a good idea to learn new skills. It can't hurt
I guess that's only to be expected. I'm the same way
No matter how busy I am day-to-day, I always make time to sit down and learn something new
I'm very pragmatic. I only learn new things when I need to
Ah, that's the first I've heard of it
By the way, what are you learning right now?
How to move someone who's out cold
I was so tired the other day. I fell asleep in your RV
Which new field are you looking into, Canace?
Didn't expect that one, did you?
Hah! People are going to be so surprised!
To tell you the truth, I was born into an aristocratic family, so dancing was a required subject
But after I got kicked out, my dancing skills grew rusty
The Academy holds a social dance every year
But I've never had the right partner. Or more like, nobody dared to be my partner
Then I'll have to find the proper attire for you
Wow, it actually is my birthday today
Besides, it's not right of me to receive presents
Is there anything you want to do today?
This is too sudden. I can't think of anything right now
How about you decide for me?
I trust you will make the right decision
Enjoy the day as much as you can
Do something that you've always wanted to do but never got around to it
Try to enjoy this day as much as you can
Whether it's shopping or relaxing, take the opportunity of your birthday to treat yourself
I see. Birthdays can have this kind of meaning, huh?
Now that I think about it, my shoulders have been feeling pretty sore lately from sitting too much
Do you want to go somewhere and relax a bit?
Hmmm... I heard there's a hot spring great for treating soreness
I'd like to go there if possible
Oh, that's great~ A car drive is nice, too
How about doing something that you've always wanted to do but never got around to?
It's your special day—use it as an excuse to go for it!
I see. So that's how people spend their birthdays
Come to think of it, I've never joined any society activities
Maybe I can go get a taste of it. I just need to change into casual clothes
It's already a luxury to me
I've got a department meeting to attend
Oh no! It's your special day...
Hah. Don't feel so bad for me
Since you have designed a full special day schedule for me
Let's just pick a day to celebrate and I promise I will follow the schedule you made. Any day can be a birthday!
Thank you, Canace, for doing a mock battle with us
Still, I was so surprised. Even though I knew you're a Trekker
I didn't expect you to be such a great fighter
You were able to simultaneously suppress frontal attacks from Noya and Iris while also defending against Amber's attack from behind
It's just because I have more experience. Keep it up and you'll surpass me one day
Oh by the way, is Amber okay? I'm afraid I overdid it
She's fine, just frustrated by the defeat. Threw herself into training again
Ahaha... I'll have to bring a cake with me the next time I come over to visit
Speaking of which, I found a thick piece of chalk on the scene--did you drop it?
Ah, I was wondering where did my Self-Defense Knife go
I guess my body moved instinctively when Amber ambushed me
Really fortunate that she was able to dodge it
I want to see what damage it can do
Just enough to punch through a few load-bearing pillars
Please don't mention this to her the next time you come to visit
Canace, I heard you asked for a day off yesterday
Yes. I needed the time to confirm something for myself
Anything you want me to do?
Does it have anything to do with the Runic Disc?
I'm sorry, but I don't want to give you a wishy-washy answer
It would affect your judgment and goes against my way of doing things
So until everything becomes clear, let's just pretend it never happened
But rest assured, I've always had this feeling that...
If you keep following this path
One of those days, the two parallel lines will eventually intersect
When that day comes, the bonds you've forged between individuals around you will propel you to take a crucial step toward the truth
And I'm just one of those many individuals
I won't ask you any more about that
See you at the dawn of truth

It's just because I have more experience. Keep it up and you'll surpass me one day
Oh by the way, is Amber okay? I'm afraid I overdid it
She's fine, just frustrated by the defeat. Threw herself into training again
Ahaha... I'll have to bring a cake with me the next time I come over to visit
Speaking of which, I found a thick piece of chalk on the scene--did you drop it?
Ah, I was wondering where did my Self-Defense Knife go
I guess my body moved instinctively when Amber ambushed me
Really fortunate that she was able to dodge it
I want to see what damage it can do
Just enough to punch through a few load-bearing pillars
Please don't mention this to her the next time you come to visit
Canace, I heard you asked for a day off yesterday
Yes. I needed the time to confirm something for myself
Anything you want me to do?
Does it have anything to do with the Runic Disc?
I'm sorry, but I don't want to give you a wishy-washy answer
It would affect your judgment and goes against my way of doing things
So until everything becomes clear, let's just pretend it never happened
But rest assured, I've always had this feeling that...
If you keep following this path
One of those days, the two parallel lines will eventually intersect
When that day comes, the bonds you've forged between individuals around you will propel you to take a crucial step toward the truth
And I'm just one of those many individuals
I won't ask you any more about that
See you at the dawn of truth

strings.text: Boss. Interested in a side gig?
I'm sending you a photo capturer. A present.
Need you to record the Trekkers climbing the Monolith.
Might use the footage for my classes.
Couldn't you just lend it to me?
Well, since I'm asking for a favor
I'll set it up as a commission so you get paid.
Honestly... If I could, I'd rather be climbing with you guys.
Just send the request. I'm in.
Wait. That didn't look like a pocket dial.
Sorry, Boss. Did you need something?
Was someone else just using your...
Heard some teachers talking about a special kind of bread today.
Apparently, if you write notes on it and eat it, you memorize whatever's written instantly.
Pretty sure that's just a manga trope.
True. Would be nice if it were real, though.
You're a teacher. Thought you'd hate shortcuts like that.
Well, skipping the tedious, painful part of memorization sounds appealing.
I wouldn't mind that at all.
But exploring the knowledge yourself is the fun part.
Whether it's rote memorization or eating magic bread...
I prefer learning through hands-on practice and application.
Just sent my formal dress for professional cleaning.
Mother is coming for an inspection, and I can't get the dress back in time.
If you don't mind the cost, you could just buy a new one?
Why didn't I think of that!
I don't really spend money, so I've saved up.
More than enough for a dress.
Come with me then. I need an objective evaluation.
It's where they trap a bunch of exhausted teachers with piles of grading to do
and force us to "bond" when we'd rather just go home.
I'm not doing prison a second time.
Anyway, sneaking out to play on my phone like this
makes me feel like I'm back in school.
You used to do that as a student?
So you got more rebellious after becoming a teacher.
Holidays aren't really a "thing" for us Trekkers.
But you rarely get time off. Shouldn't you relax?
That's exactly why I have to make it count.
I actually did some homework on this.
Wanna go to a hot spring resort with me?
Supposed to be the perfect place to de-stress.
I'm down, but funds are tight...
Don't rush. Break hasn't even started yet.
But I'll text you the second it's official.

strings.text: You borrowed this phone from the village chief?
You type slow so you want me to wait for you, yeah?
Can you keep up with me~?
You're such a nice kid. TTYL~
If you eat well and get plenty of sleep every day, you'll grow taller for sure
Ann, you'll only grow taller if you eat well and get plenty of sleep every day
Wait, why does it feel like she's the one doing the comforting here
Actually, Ann, you've been secretly growing taller at night all this time
You can't fit into clothes from a few years ago anymore, right?
Remember to give the phone back to Chief before you fall asleep
I read books at Grandpa Chai house
We'll swing by in a bit and take you for a ride
It's a reward for all your hard work helping out in the village
Stay calm, wait for me to come over
What? Let Coco deal with them!
I thought you would believe in the fairytales.
Stay calm, Ann, and wait for me to come over
It's not like you can do anything, stay put
We cant let them get away!
Wait, I was just trash talking
You aren't really going after them, are you?
Because it gets so muggy when it rains
Bubble is doing it for us
Then I will have Bubble do it
I've had enough airflow! It's cool here!
Oh, I think the rain has stopped
I will head out to play!
Don't forget to wear your rain boots!
I have a surprise for you
The Coco Experience for a day
It's a drawing board, isn't it?
Wait, you meant to give me something else, right?
Would it be a commendation medal?
I havent made that one yet
Its not time for the award yet!
Bossy didnt hear me saying that!
Want to be Coco for a day? Running wild in the woods feels pretty great
When they are ripe I will give them to Bossy
Grandpa Chai says I can grow more
I can give them to Noya and everyone else!
Have to say, I did not expect this
Are you looking forward to it?
Looking forward to it so much!
You are eagerly waiting for the tasty strawberries to ripen.
I'm the Boss, is there anything that I don't know?
I got a small cake for our birthday girl
So I can only eat half of the cake
Then I can eat the other half!
That was a hard training session, thank you taking Coco and Bubble along with you
Nice to see you here, Chief
I'm shocked at myself for thinking of that in an instant...
One of them was very gentle
Maybe you can see them again in your dreams

strings.text: Guess Ignis really is weak against Aqua.
I mean, since Coco uses fire magic
it makes sense she'd hate water.
Just wipe the dirty spots with a damp towel. Dry her off after.
Don't get too carried away, alright?
Hm? You want to learn how to take photos?
Look for the icon on your phone that looks like a Photo Capturer.
Tap that and you're ready to snap some shots.
After that, you'll have to figure things out yourself.
Try taking pics of the people and stuff around you first.
Can't wait to see your photos!
Haha, I can just picture it.
Saw some bad guys in masks.
Oh, so you rescued Bubble from them?
Of course, our Scout Squad Captain to the rescue.
You know you can just text me if you miss me.
If you apologize nicely to the Chief,
I'll swing by for a visit next time I'm in the area.
Don't worry, plenty for the both of you.
people who looked just like me
They tried to take me away
But you wouldn't go with them, right?
If you don't want to go, it won't happen.
Because nightmares just try to scare you.
They're weak if you aren't afraid.
Then I won't be scared of
I knew I could count on you.
You gave me a heart attack... Glad you're okay.
What do I do with it?
A fairy comes at night and swaps it for a Dorra.
I wanna wait up and play with her!
Staying up all night again? Like last time?
But friends from Loong and Goodwind tell me that's just what you do.
Losing a tooth is proof you're getting big.
That's more of a one-at-a-time thing…
