strings.text: Is this some kind of weird welcome ceremony?
No... I'm not very familiar with this.
There were a few times when I meant to touch with someone but ended up blocking them instead.
Donna told me that after touching with someone, you can test it by sending a bunch of numbers.
It was easy this time, though
Freesia wants to add you as a friend.
You and Freesia are now friends.
...I knew it, I spoke too soon
This kind of testing is useless!
Why can't I unsend this message?
You sent it too long ago
I had my phone in my pocket while riding; I might have accidentally bumped it
I have a lot of mail today so I saw it just now. Sorry
The other day, I heard Donna saying that aside from delivering letters, Post Haste also handles package deliveries. Is that right?
Yes, we at Post Haste can do delivery of all sorts
If you insist on sending prohibited items, please let me know
I can serve as your legal advocate at your trial
Wait a minute, it's not like I'm going to be sending prohibited items to begin with!
Boss, there is something I'd like to get your opinion on
If Post Haste were to develop a side business, which one of the following do you think would be best?
3. Do house calls to capture wild boars
A tailor shop sounds nice; it must be Donna's idea
The other day she mended a tear in my clothes for me. She's great with a needle
Thank you for your kind words. I will tell her
I don't think treasure hunting sounds legit
That was something Teresa insisted on adding
She said treasures are everywhere in this world; we just lack the insight to see them
And what's with this wild boar capture thing?
To be honest, that was my suggestion
A while ago, I helped some residents drive away a wild boar that had wandered out of the forest
I believe this is a huge business opportunity waiting to be explored
Boss, you're well-informed—do you know if any big companies are having masked wild boar troubles?
We can give them a discount if they know you
Maybe you should just stick to delivering letters
Boss, I have an urgent situation
Today, when I was passing by the shopping mall, I noticed there was a sale on potato chips
Before I knew it, I had bought a whole bunch
If Donna finds out, she's going to lecture me again
Maybe you can stash them in some corner of the house?
But Donna is at home right now
Didn't you think about that before you bought them?
I meant to share them with everybody
One for Donna, one fore me, one for Teresa, one for me...
Anyway, I hope you can help me eat all the extra potato chips I bought. Then I'll take the rest home
You just have to eat ten packs
Notify me once you’re present then
Lay it on me. What's up?
Look, with just these few stickers, we can do rock-paper-scissors without seeing each other
No time like the present—let's start now! I'll go first
Let's do another one. Best two out of three
Such incredible predictive abilities... Truly admirable
Did you really not notice that something was off?
I get it. This duel was too easy for you
Perhaps we could arrange a duel of Reversi, face to face
Do you have the time for it now?
Have you gotten back home yet, Boss?
I'm very sorry about today. I didn't mean to startle you
No, no, don't worry about it
You saw injustice and jumped in to make it right
Those guys were the worst, picking on an old lady like that!
I think they were some Trekkers who got kicked out from a big guild
They've been hanging around here lately, stirring up trouble wherever they go
When Donna got back a couple of days ago, she told me that they'd stolen all the citrus fruits from Aunt Betty's garden
The whole town is afraid of them. Even the kids don't dare to play outside at night anymore
Good thing you taught them a lesson today—they had it coming
When you took down that big, burly guy, everyone around started clapping
Really? I didn't really notice at the time...
After all, he almost fell onto you. I had such a scare
Not your fault. I got so caught up in watching that I wanted to jump in to help you
Ended up just getting in the way, though
Not at all—if you hadn't held me back, I might have ended up beating all of them to a pulp
Then I'd probably have to shell out a fortune for their medical bills, and Post Haste's budget would take yet another hit
Handing them over to the Association like we did was definitely the best way to handle it
Freesia is on the side of Justice
That's a word I haven't heard in a while. Makes me a bit nostalgic
There's a question I'd like to ask you, Boss
What kind of person do you think I am?
It's hard to answer a sudden question like that
Let me put it another way, then
How do you feel about me?
How about this? Freesia, why don't you start by sharing your impression of me?
When I'm with you, I feel very relaxed and at ease
Even when I encounter something frustrating, as long as you're there, I can quickly calm down
All things considered, in my mind, you're the color white
Yes, white represents tranquility and peace
...Where are you getting all this gibberish from...
From a book that I'm reading. It's called "How to Build Good Relationships"
It says, "understand other people's impressions of you through personality color analysis."
To be honest, I'm not really sure how do you feel about me
But I hope to grow closer to you and maintain a lasting relationship
If you want to know something, just ask me directly
But it can't be unilateral. I'm all about doing a fair trade.
Dear Boss,==RT====RT==You are cordially invited to grace our humble abode today to attend my birthday celebration.==RT====RT==The entire Post Haste team eagerly awaits your arrival.
I didn't expect such a formal invitation
Even though I'm more familiar with you now, it's still important to follow proper etiquette
What time will you be free? I will come to pick you up in advance
No, it's your birthday, I don't want to make you do extra work
It would be a birthday surprise
I bought a special birthday gift for you
Thank you for going to all that trouble
I'm sure I will love it no matter what it is
I wish you happiness, good health, and great business for Post Haste!
Thank you so much for your kind words
But I have a favor to ask...
I will ask you when I see you in person next time
Whoa... That whirlwind you pulled off at the end today was absolutely awesome!
It took down all the minions in one fell swoop
You give me too much credit
If you hadn't spotted their ambush plans in time, I would have been in serious trouble
This has been bothering me a lot lately
Even though enhancement magic significantly boosts my physical resistance during battles
It also makes me more impulsive
When facing cunning enemies, I worry that this might blind me and lead me straight into a trap
To make strength submit to reason... Such has always been the lifelong quest for everyone in my family
But I don't think you need to worry too much
After all, you have me and everyone else, too
Even if you fall into some trap, we'll be there to pull you back
Every time we do battle, as long as you're there, I always get this strange feeling
To use a popular saying I've just learned, it "just feels like drinking 100% Energy Pep Pep Juice!"
Where did you get that one from?
Does it sound weird in this situation?
It's that kind of tangy and sweet flavor that leaves you feeling energized all over after drinking it
Looks like I've still got a lot to learn
Boss, have you already gotten the strange disc with sounds coming out of it?
Oh, you mean the Runic Disc
Yes, I've got your Runic Disc, Freesia!
Oh? Is this me on the cover?
It feels both familiar and strange at the same time
I seem to recall how once, on a rainy day, when I squatted by the roadside, staring blankly at puddles and little flowers
Maybe I saw this scene in a dream.
The music from this disc sounds lovely
It's like that refreshing feeling after a rainy day, with the air filled with the scent of grass and trees
Your description is starting to make me curious
I've heard that everyone's Runic Disc holds a unique memory within it
To tell you the truth, when I found out you had accidentally obtained my Disc, I was a little nervous
The past isn't always pretty; it can be full of regrets
But what's past is past, right?
It's like the cover of this Disc. The rain has stopped
Regrets, sadness, whatever--they all turn into the rainbow in the end

strings.text: How much instant noodles is just right
Honestly, if it's about your health
You really shouldn't be eating any.
As expected of the Boss. Your standards for self-discipline are impeccable.
Why? How many do you want to eat?
I recently acquired a full carton.
However, Donna explicitly forbade me from consuming them just days ago.
Thus, I am formulating a plan
To expedite the consumption of said noodles.
Are you trying to eat them all yourself just to hide the evidence?
Then I have no choice but to bring them home.
Boss, there is something I need to confirm with you.
Do you consider my Reason to be heavy?
Reason...?! Why are we getting so philosophical all of a sudden?
I mean, I think you do things for a reason 99% of the time. Except for maybe...
Wait. You mean the axe, Reason's Edge, don't you?
I've never actually tried to lift it.
But seeing how you swing it around, it can't be that heavy, right?
That is what I thought as well.
However, I visited the Trekker Association today, and the staff asked me to leave it by the entrance.
I suppose I didn't prop it up securely enough, because it toppled over.
When I came back out, I saw two Trekkers competing to lift it.
I guess Reason really is a heavy burden.
Indeed. But I have one more question.
You cut yourself off earlier. "Except for maybe”... What?
Nothing. Pretend I never said that!
Limited Time Offer!==RT==From now until the end of the month, enjoy 20% off all delivery fees at Post Haste!
Donna instructed me to advertise with bulk messaging. Tapped your profile by mistake.
No worries. Actually, I do have something to send.
Do you mean your physical heart?
How exactly do you propose to extract it from your body?
If you are referring to the abstract concept...
However, if you can materialize it into an object, Post Haste can process the order.
I told you, I was kidding!
Apologies. I took it too literally.
Boss, if I were to give a friend a gift,
what do you think would be the best choice?
Why not just stick to something they already like?
I have given similar gifts in the past. I am concerned it might seem unoriginal.
Nah. If they really love it, they'll be happy every time they get one.
I will take that into consideration.
If you're stuck on what to buy,
have you considered making something yourself?
I have absolutely no artistic talent though.
It doesn't matter how it turns out to be. It's the thought that counts.
Boss, I heard you're heading to Emor tomorrow.
As it happens, Donna just assigned me a Post Haste delivery for Emor.
If you don't mind, we could go together.
Sure, how are you getting there?
I could give you a ride.
I'm a very fast rider. I give Donna and Teresa rides all the time.
Noya even challenged me to a race against Loxy.
Yes, but we still need to find a suitable location.
It would be a shame to get caught for speeding.
You know what, I think I'll go by myself!
Boss, should you ever find yourself in need of an Advocate...
Please know that I am prepared to offer you my full assistance.
Huh? Where is this coming from all of a sudden?
It's alright. I already know what happened. You do not need to hide it from me.
After all, it was not your fault.
I haven't done anything illegal lately... Have I?!
To be honest, I witnessed the Imperial Guard detain you yesterday.
I also saw the Knight issuing you a penalty notice.
Surely it was a wrongful accusation. I shall defend your rights.
That Knight was just asking me to fill out a survey on traffic conditions...
It was super long, so I was stuck on the roadside for quite some time finishing it.
My apologies. I misunderstood the situation.
However... I meant what I said earlier.
If such a dire situation ever truly comes to pass...
Wow, that was actually pretty cool!
But I'm gonna try my best to stay out of court regardless.

I think the playwright has the right idea

Pretend to be someone else and live their life

Let's play hunters tracking down witches in the city!

You see, a guild leader is responsible for leading and mentoring the Trekkers under their wing

A producer also needs to mentor and train their artists
They also have to negotiate those long-winded contracts
If Trekkers and Paperworks are the same to Artists and Contracts, then set Guild Leaders equal to Producers. So, QED

And now she needs a business partner

If you have to deal with so many complicated documents and contracts every day

Flora, is that you? Why are you so moody all the sudden?

Just calm down! This isn't like you!
Okay okay, As the Tyrant of the Ancient, I will listen to anyone and everyone's confessions
O lost Magician, tell me what is getting you so down
I lost my temper during practicing with this kid who made the same mistake twenty times
What should I do... I really didn't mean to...
I'm really worried that I ruined her day...
In a way, that kid sounds pretty impressive...
It takes a special trait to repeat the same mistake twenty times
In a way, that kid sounded pretty impressive...
I forgive you for committing the sin of wrath
Calm yourself down and talk to her again
Thank you! The Supreme Lord Tyrant!
Oops, my fingers moved faster than my brain did...
Yeah, I feel a little bit better now...

After all, I'm Flora, Magician Maximus
How could I ever need help from an ordinary—
Okay so I'm sorry for my frivolous talk!
Don't tell anyone about this, or my image will be completely ruined!
Just finished my performance, now I'm backstage, removing makeup.
Afterwards... Just go back and lie down
I see. Now I'll show you a magic trick
I will use a single sentence to make you remember something important

I can take off my makeup later—I need to head out first

Hah, you'll find out soon enough~

I heard they have parfaits now
Okay, I do need to get my temp down...

I had no idea they actually existed

You're the one who made this Runic Disc what it is

Everyone had a hand in the making of this magic happening
So I'm like a magician's assistant?
Of course, if it weren't for you, the butterfly would have never returned to me
But don't tell anyone about this side of me, okay?

strings.text: I'm not exactly a celebrity, you know
Sometimes you have to sign things over and over.
So, do you have any practice tips?
Hehe~ I was waiting for you to ask.
Hang on a minute, I'll grab some tools and teach you in person~
You're just trying to sneak out, aren't you?
I made a small mistake during today's performance.
For a moment, I lost control of my wand. Luckily, nobody noticed.
I checked it after I got offstage, but I couldn't find anything wrong.
I don't really get how wands work...
But maybe the problem lies with its user?
Have you been performing non-stop lately?
Go get some rest, Flora. For your health
I can't believe I instantly started blaming my wand.
Thanks for the reminder. I'll rearrange my upcoming show schedule.
This might sound like it's coming out of nowhere, but I want to ask...
Do I seem like someone who dwells on the past?
You do bring up the past sometimes
But I don't think it matters
We're all made up of countless past moments
Even this conversation right now will be the past in a few seconds
The present is already the past; and the past was, at one point, the future.
It's all connected, like a magic trick.
I just sometimes wonder if I talk about the past too much with people.
Does it come off as self-centered?
Having a lot of past experiences is a good thing. A luxury that I don't have
Then... Can the me of today become a part of your past in the future?
Woah, when did you become such a smooth-talker?
Ha! Turned the tables on you~
Where are you? I'll come meet you
Why didn't you ask me what I wanted to do?
I didn't want to pry, in case it was a personal matter
Why are you being so distant?
Aren't we way past that? Like, didn't we bare all to each other?
Putting me aside for a moment...
If someone else saw this conversation, what would you do?
Don't worry. Nobody can touch my phone except for Fannie
And she doesn't have a problem with that?
Well... she does tell me all the time not to cause trouble for you.
Yet what you're doing isn't anything near...
I've decided. I want to buy some new outfits for going out.
For business? I don't know much about that
No, not for business. The kind I'd wear when I go out with you.
You always just wear those same loose hoodies
Sometimes changing clothes also changes one's mood.
Alright, what kind of clothes do you want to try?
What style do you think suits me?
I've been wanting to try some dresses on.
I had no idea you liked this kind of style though, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
I just think it matches your stage presence the best
Got it, got it~ I hear you~
How about a cool, androgynous style?
First of all, it helps you with concealing your identity
Second, I think you could pull off a new look
I heard there's a style that's "cute but super toxic"
Oh yeah, I've heard about that recently.
But... You'd actually want me to wear something like that...?
I think it could be worth a try?
I feel like I'd need some mental prep for that.
But if you really want to see it, ==PLAYER_NAME==, I'll give it my best shot.
Anyway, just talking about it isn't going to get us anywhere.
No day like today. Let's go pick something out right now.
No, this time, I'll come to you.
I saw you from the VIP section at today's show.
My guild just got into town, and we're still very busy with all the commissions
Sorry I couldn't help with the rehearsals
Perish the thought! Just you being here has made me very happy.
Gave me extra energy on stage.
Yeah, I could tell. Some of those tricks were extra flashy. Really enjoyed it
Ah, Fannie's calling me to pack now.
You're leaving already? I thought you'd stay a few days more
Schedule calls. We're traveling separately. It's already super lucky that we ran into each other.
So, you wanna go for a walk right now?
Yeah, I'll be done packing soon. I can hang out with you for a bit before I leave.
But you're still wearing your stage outfit. Aren't you worried...?
This chance to see each other is rare. I don't want to miss it.
If someone sees us and starts spreading rumors, so be it~
Well, since you put it that way, how could I say no?
But while you're packing, I'm going to change into something else, too
Since when did you get so conscious about your image?
Hey, if I'm gonna be with Flora the Magician Maximus, I need to wear something that matches the occasion~
I've got a nice outfit put together. You may look forward to it
Try to keep your cool when you see me, okay?

Even this conversation right now will be the past in a few seconds
The present is already the past; and the past was, at one point, the future.
It's all connected, like a magic trick.
I just sometimes wonder if I talk about the past too much with people.
Does it come off as self-centered?
Having a lot of past experiences is a good thing. A luxury that I don't have
Then... Can the me of today become a part of your past in the future?
Woah, when did you become such a smooth-talker?
Ha! Turned the tables on you~
Where are you? I'll come meet you
Why didn't you ask me what I wanted to do?
I didn't want to pry, in case it was a personal matter
Why are you being so distant?
Aren't we way past that? Like, didn't we bare all to each other?
Putting me aside for a moment...
If someone else saw this conversation, what would you do?
Don't worry. Nobody can touch my phone except for Fannie
And she doesn't have a problem with that?
Well... she does tell me all the time not to cause trouble for you.
Yet what you're doing isn't anything near...
I've decided. I want to buy some new outfits for going out.
For business? I don't know much about that
No, not for business. The kind I'd wear when I go out with you.
You always just wear those same loose hoodies
Sometimes changing clothes also changes one's mood.
Alright, what kind of clothes do you want to try?
What style do you think suits me?
I've been wanting to try some dresses on.
I had no idea you liked this kind of style though, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
I just think it matches your stage presence the best
Got it, got it~ I hear you~
How about a cool, androgynous style?
First of all, it helps you with concealing your identity
Second, I think you could pull off a new look
I heard there's a style that's "cute but super toxic"
Oh yeah, I've heard about that recently.
But... You'd actually want me to wear something like that...?
I think it could be worth a try?
I feel like I'd need some mental prep for that.
But if you really want to see it, ==PLAYER_NAME==, I'll give it my best shot.
Anyway, just talking about it isn't going to get us anywhere.
No day like today. Let's go pick something out right now.
No, this time, I'll come to you.
I saw you from the VIP section at today's show.
My guild just got into town, and we're still very busy with all the commissions
Sorry I couldn't help with the rehearsals
Perish the thought! Just you being here has made me very happy.
Gave me extra energy on stage.
Yeah, I could tell. Some of those tricks were extra flashy. Really enjoyed it
Ah, Fannie's calling me to pack now.
You're leaving already? I thought you'd stay a few days more
Schedule calls. We're traveling separately. It's already super lucky that we ran into each other.
So, you wanna go for a walk right now?
Yeah, I'll be done packing soon. I can hang out with you for a bit before I leave.
But you're still wearing your stage outfit. Aren't you worried...?
This chance to see each other is rare. I don't want to miss it.
If someone sees us and starts spreading rumors, so be it~
Well, since you put it that way, how could I say no?
But while you're packing, I'm going to change into something else, too
Since when did you get so conscious about your image?
Hey, if I'm gonna be with Flora the Magician Maximus, I need to wear something that matches the occasion~
I've got a nice outfit put together. You may look forward to it
Try to keep your cool when you see me, okay?

strings.text: I finally managed to add you as a friend!
Hi, I look forward to working with you
Hi, I look forward to working with you~
And I look forward to your guidance!
Don't say that, you sound like l am not approachable...
You are the third contact I added on this phone!
Are the first two Donna and Freesia...?
Oh, I got another post delivery task!
I'm making mushroom soup, are you interested?
I didn't know you could cook
I'm a bona fide Trekker, after all!
I may not have my mom's cooking skills
But I do make a nice mushroom soup!
I'm seeing you in a whole new light now
I know how to tell the edible mushrooms from the poisonous ones!
If... If you don't believe me...
Why are you so nervous? Didn't you say you could tell them apart?
Don't you need to keep an eye on it?
I just saw an Artifact identical to mine at a street vendor's stall!
Are you thinking about buying a pair of new goggles?
Keyboard... You mean the Artifact that you always carry with you?
Yes! It feels really nice to the touch!
Touch... What do you normally do with it?
Do with it...? I use it to relax, of course
When I'm tired, I lie on it... It helps me unwind!
You use it for back massages?
I guess that's one way to use it
Huh? Boss, did I use it wrong?
I've already finished my letter deliveries for the day
Donna and Freesia have gone out, leaving me to watch the house by myself
I know what's going to happen next
Good. You've got some alone time
You can do whatever you want
Two thieves will try to break into your home
And you'll need to make creative use of common household items to fend them off
Well, I know this plot from that Monolith movie
Are you about to nod off?
Try not to drop your phone on your face
I dropped it on my nose...
Well that will keep me busy for a while at least...
Waaah... I was so bad that I got thrown out
So you are aware of the problem
That was so embarrassing, good thing I didn't bring Donna and the others along.
So you still haven't told me what actually happened
I brought a bunch of new stuff to sell at the second-hand market
But people said they belong to the garbage bin
The truth is, they were just abandoned
None of them were actually broken...
I... I couldn't make them see my point, so I just came back for now...
Second-hand goods have to look good
Get them cleaned up first, then maybe you'll be able to get better prices
If it weren't for you, they might just rot somewhere
Thank you for talking with me, Boss!
When I've got the time, I play a bit
I once bought a second-hand handheld game console with only grayscale graphics
But I was worried that I might get addicted to it and let it affect my job
So I asked Donna to seal it away for me
I'm not good at it; I'm a total newbie when it comes to games
I can't believe there's something you aren't good at
Hehe, somehow it's a comforting thought
Well, to come back to my original point...
A while ago, I delivered a letter for a Trekker
They gave me a game cartridge they'd found inside a Monolith
It's a game where players scavenge in a post-apocalyptic world
It looks like a lot of fun. Do you want to play it with me?
Sure, we can take turns and switch when one dies
Watch me clear the game in one shot
Sure, watch me clear the game in one shot!
Nobody else is at Post Haste today. I'll wait for you here!
I appreciate the thought, but I'm not hurt
It's always nice to be prepared
Or do you have your own special way of healing?
My body heals itself—the human body is amazing, isn't it?
Huh? My body always heals itself no matter what
The human body is amazing, isn't it?
The process is hard, that's all...
I recommend a personal health insurance policy from Deepsea Finance Financial
All minor illnesses and prescriptions are covered
I didn't expect there'd be a service like this
But just thinking about anything related to magic contracts gives me a headache
So I really don't want to look into it...
Invincible against all poisons, immune to all damages!
That sounds like a line from some game!
When have you ever seen me get injured?
So jealous... I wish I had that kind of body, too
Then I wouldn't have to worry about getting injured when I'm protecting others
That's why you should be careful while fighting
Even if you have band-aids, you should still try to avoid getting hurt as much as possible
Delivery task has nothing to do with what day it is today~
But I found a place great for setting off fireworks!
Boss, could you recommend to me some small-scale fireworks?
They may be small, but they're very bright
But can I hold two of them at the same time?
Sure, it's your birthday, after all
I've always wanted to try that!
Time to make your dream into reality
What are those? They sound cool!
It gives off sparks and then shoots up into the sky, spinning
I definitely want to try those!
I'll bring them over right now
Because I'm spending my birthday with you, Boss!
Which makes it a very special day!
I'll wait for you right here!
There's something I want to ask you
Just how do you swing that giant sword?
Oh... I haven't told you about it, have I?
I found this sword inside a forest ruin
I don't know why but it linked itself to me
Before I knew it, I was able to lift this sword
What kind of price did you pay, then?
I wish I could have taken a photo!
But I actually got my phone from my dad
It's so old that it doesn't have a camera
You see this kind of trope in Monolith recovered novels and mangas all the time
Amazing powers always come with a price tag attached
Noooo! I'm very young! And I still have tons of deliveries to make!
At least wait till I've finished delivering them!
That's why those things only happen in made-up stories
You're still alive and kicking, so I'm sure you're fine
Yes, did it remind you of something?
If I close my eyes, I feel like I can see my parents' face
How about going back for a visit when you've got the time?
But I want to hone my skills a bit more first
So I can show my dad just how much I've grown when I do go back!
I want to, but I can't just leave Donna and Freesia to deal with everything at Post Haste.
But maybe I can find a time when we're all free.
Then we can take a vacation there!
Every now and then, send a letter back to let them know you're doing okay
Who would deliver such a letter...
I better go see if I can switch my shift!

strings.text: Well, Donna and Freesia are both coming back late today
So I've just been sitting here hungry
And I started thinking, maybe I should learn to cook or something...
Yeah, at least you'd be able to handle emergencies
Before you met those two, Teresa, how did you manage three meals a day?
When I was still living at home, Mom packed meals for me
After I struck out on my own, I just picked wild fruit in the forest and stuff
You were living like a total wild person!
Didn't you ever eat something you shouldn't have?
Nope! I learned how to identify wild plants really early on~
Sometimes I could even sell them for a few Dorra~
I guess life really does find a way...
Why is it that even when I try so hard to be careful, I still end up causing all kinds of trouble?
"The more you worry about something happening, the more likely it is to happen."
Being too careful just makes you unable to focus
No wonder I mess up the things I care about the most
But how am I supposed to prevent bad things from happening?
We're just mortals. We can't predict every bad thing
But we have experience. That's how we protect ourselves against the risks
You're pretty sharp with traps when you're treasure hunting, aren't you, Teresa?
I feel like I mess up all the time...
That's because you always venture into dangerous situations. Most people aren't as capable as you
And aren't you more agile now compared to before?
Hehe, I think I'm starting to get it, Boss
I went treasure hunting today and all I found was a button
It was red, about half the size of my palm
And it's covered by a clear lid
Can you sell something like that?
I feel like it's a knick-knack at best
Yeah, that's what I figured, too
If I could take it apart, maybe I could turn it into a doorbell
Maybe the Neo Grace Organization would be interested in it
I think those tech maniacs would love it
Sounds suspicious. Best just leave it alone
What do you think it is, Boss?
Could be the trigger for some mechanism
But I didn't see any mechanism nearby...
I opened the lid to get a closer look and accidentally pressed it...
All it does is say, "I'm hungry."
It just keeps going, "I'm hungry, I'm hungry."
Could it be a toy for pets?
I have a question for you, Boss, if you don't mind
A friend of mine wants to give a gift to another friend of hers
But that other friend is surrounded by a lot of cool people
So they get all kinds of cool gifts
She's worried that her gift is too ordinary, maybe even handmade
She's afraid it won't be good enough for her friend, right?
I know what you're about to type the moment you start typing
Really? Then I won't type anything
This "friend" of yours wouldn't happen to be...
She really is a friend, I swear!
But didn't you say the only contacts in your phone are Donna, Freesia, and me?
I, I make friends in real life, too!
Anyway, this might sound weird, but...
I don't think that person your friend likes would look down on a gift given from the heart
Yeah, in things like this, it's better to be direct
Uh, I mean, I'll tell my friend to do that!
I got a package from home today
My dad sent it. A book he wrote when he was young
The thing is, I found an illustration tucked inside
It's a drawing I did as a kid. It must have gotten stuck in his book back then
Ehehe. It's a drawing of "what I want to be when I grow up."
Hehe~ Wanna guess what I drew, Boss?
You wanted to be a legendary Trekker, just like your dad?
I did think my dad was the coolest when I was little!
But my ambitions didn't stop there~
You wanted to become a great messenger?
It would be touching if one looked back and realized that they'd already fulfilled their childhood dream
Wrong guess. I didn't even know what a messenger was back then~
That's just an ad from the Monolith!
I actually wanted to be a "hero"!
Hmph. I knew you were coming to get me, after all
The hero from fairy tale picture books
My mom even made me a hero outfit based on the one in the book
One of those days, I'll bring you back home with me!
I've always wanted to introduce you to my mom and dad~
I bought a recording of an adventure-type Stella Drama
It's an old recording, so it needs a specific model of projector Artifact to play it
Let me check the warehouse and see if I have that model!
I found one! I found one!
You never cease to amaze me
I don't know if I can fix it
We've gotta at least try! Gimme a minute, Boss!
There are some alleys in Port Bellin I haven't explored yet
Would you mind taking me around?
Hold on! I'll be right there~
I promise I'll be fast this time!

strings.text: Hello, I'm Donna from Post Haste! Nice to meet you!
If you ever need a letter delivered, feel free to contact me anytime~
Since it's you, I can even offer a discount~
A special discount for a friend?
This is starting to sound like a sales pitch...
Hahah yeah, I've been told that a lot.
But I only give discounts to friends, okay? Five percent off, just for you!
Okay okay, I was just kidding~
Just don't actually block me! I'm not to do sales!
==PLAYER_NAME==, Quick Quiz, off the top of your head!
If you had to pick one: whale, dolphin, or shark?
Ahh, whale... That's the same one Teresa picked!
A deep-sea spirit and singer. A solid choice, too.
Dolphin? Then you picked the same one as Freesia~
I knew you'd pick shark, haha! Same as me!
Is this some kind of personality test?
... You're not trying to trick me, are you?
We want to get a new rug for Post Haste~
But the three of us all picked different patterns, so we wanted to ask you to be the tiebreaker~
If you had the chance right now to put your best friend in a suuuuuper cute maid outfit...
Would you make them wear it?
Not if they don't want to...
Great, we're on the same side!
So you are the lawful-good type after all?
Are you sure you wouldn't wanna see it?
Since you want to see it as well, I'll go get things ready!
Just look forward to our next meeting!
Spot check! Have you seen A Big Shark yet?
I think I've heard of it.
It's a new Stella Drama that just came out!
It's about a giant shark that suddenly grows legs and can walk from the sea onto land.
So you've heard of it, too?!
I found out that it's a Stella Drama made by some rich guy just for fun, and it's being shown in lots of places lately.
The open-air theater near us is screening it, too!
Actually, don't tell me. I don't want spoilers!!
You want to go see it?
But Freesia and Teresa both said it's not their kind of thing.
So I was wondering if you might wanna go watch it with me.
Then how about the day after tomorrow, 2 p.m.? Does that work?
I have a secret that I want to tell you. Wanna hear it?
A little blue flower has bloomed!
Look, this grew behind Post Haste!
Maybe it's a sign that Post Haste is about to make a lot of money!
Someone just came in, I've got to go greet them!
Come, money, come! Talk to you later!
We went over budget again this month...
At this rate... We're never going to save any money!!
Hey, money always finds a way. Pat pat.
Why can't Dorra just fall in love with each other if you put them together, get married, and make baby Dorra?
Wait. Maybe there's some kind of Artifact in a Monolith that lets Dorra multiply on their own?
Maybe... We can try a Monolith?
Money has to be earned the honest way... I mean, I keep telling myself that.
But it's okay to complain once in a while, right?
Sorry, that was silly of me.
Feeling discouraged sometimes... That's just part of being human.
I'm taking it as you comforting me, ==PLAYER_NAME==~
I'd like to ask you something.
It's hard for me to say this...
It's just hard for me to say, okay!
Didn't I say before that I'd make you an outfit?
So whenever you have time, could you come by Post Haste?
If it doesn't fit right, I can adjust it for you on the spot~
This weekend. I'll be waiting for you at Post Haste!
Hello there, Your Excellency, the mighty Boss~
Do you know what day is today?
Do you ever not sleep in?
The birthday of the unbelievably adorable yours truly!
You know, Teresa told me a few days ago!
Hey! What kind of reaction is that?! Aren't you supposed to say "happy birthday" in a situation like this?!
I was going to say it to you this evening.
We wanted it to be a surprise.
We got a cake and presents and everything.
Oh come on!!! Making such a big fuss is embarrassing!!!
Too late~ See you tonight at Post Haste!
It's amazing. It was just a simple little game, but it got everyone saying things you normally never hear.
Did you come up with that game yourself?

strings.text: I just can't think of anything
I made new outfits for Teresa and Freesia recently
And both of them keep telling me that I should make one for myself, too
I suppose they have a point
You've been wearing this outfit for quite a while now
But I just can't come up with any ideas
Why not ask Teresa and Freesia what they think?
Before I ask them, I'd rather hear what you think!
But I don't know anything about fashion or design
What matters is what kind of style you like
You mean the sort of thing you'd wear to a banquet, right?
I've never tried that kind of style before
Something like what I usually wear for climbing Monoliths?
I think I've got an idea now
The owner of the dessert shop where I worked last time
gave me a whole bunch of cookies
I thought I'd share some with you
If you want some, I'll bring some over
No, no, you don't have to
I can come pick them up myself
There's no need to go to all that trouble
We can't have the customer come pick things up themselves!
I'll bring them over to you right now
I watched a Stella Drama just now
A courier gave it everything she have and overcame one obstacle after another
to deliver a letter containing vital intel to the right people
That sounds a lot like you, Donna
But I think I've still got a long way to go before I can compare myself to her
At this point, I don't think I could cross a battlefield, evade enemies, and infiltrate their stronghold at the end
Maybe you just haven't had the opportunity to prove yourself yet
I wouldn't want to prove myself in that way!
Things are much better the way they are now
I'm sure that one day, Donna, you will become a great courier just like that lady in the drama
Then I'd better keep improving myself
That outfit I made for you last time
If you ever need anything else
Like having old clothes patched, or if you want something new
You can always come to me!
I'm starting to feel like I'm taking advantage of you
My pajamas got a hole in them
Should I come pick them up, or do you want to bring them over next time you're here?
I'll just bring them with me next time
I've finally managed to save up a little money
I should figure out what to spend it on
But the whole point of saving money is so you can spend it when you need it later, right?
Everyone in Post Haste just got back from delivery
So I was thinking of treating everyone to a big meal!
But you've worked so hard to save that money
If you just spend it like this, isn't that basically the same as not having saved it at all?
I'll take out a little of it and buy some groceries
And cook a nice meal right here at Post Haste!
We picked up a new job recently
Basically, we deliver fresh milk to everyone's doorstep at the same time every morning.
But you have to get up super early for milk delivery
Like going to the pasture and pick up the milk before dawn
We're taking turns with it for now
Me first, then Freesia, then Teresa
Sounds like you've been working really hard
You drink milk in the morning?
Then tomorrow I'll deliver yours first, and everyone else's afterward
That way, it'll definitely be on my way!
Anyway, I'll sign off for now

strings.text: This is the way to reach me
Since we added each other, we are pals now
From now on, I got your back
We're not in the same clan
Come to our place any time
Don't make such a fuss over it
Two of the new kids don't know what's what
I stepped in to stop them and got a push
Then my girls jumped in, ready to teach the newbies a lesson
I got hurt while stopping them
I sent them back to their rooms, one by one
And gave them enough training tasks to wear them out for the day
Sigh… They are still way too hot-headed, very impulsive
The opponents might easily exploit that
As long as you are okay
I have medical supplies, do you want to come get them?
Even the Boss needs some basic self-defense skills too, right?
Even if you're the brains of the operation, what if someone takes you down in melee?
Worst case scenario, I'll off myself and take them down with me
So come find me at Ashwind's secret base
But if it comes to that, you'll protect me, right?
It's fine, worst case scenario, I'll off myself and take them down with me
How do you propose to train me?
It's very simple, you just keep practicing defense and counterattacks on the wooden post
Oh, you got a wooden post for this?
In this scenario, I am the wooden post
Isn't that against training safety protocols?!
I know, but don't give up so soon
Nah, I just happened to pick up the phone
Truth be told, I'm planning to buy a cheap camera Artifact
What made you suddenly want one?
I'm taking a stroll on the Waterway right now, and the view here is beautiful
And it's different from the view I get when I'm skateboarding
I want to use the Artifact to capture the view I see while I'm skating and share it with you
I can't wait to see it!
So, do you have time to come and help me pick one out?
Subgum, Dark Chocolate, or BBQ—which one would you like?
Lollipop flavors. Which one would you like?
Okay I got it for you, I'll bring it over later
Ah, adventurous and with good taste.
It's the last one. I got it and will bring it over later.
Wow, so it's a real flavor?!
Wait, why did you suddenly think of buying me candy
Boss, you're always dealing with so much every day—you need to replenish your sugar level, right?
Besides, that line of reasoning leads right to sugar addiction...
Uh...I am not? I exercise every day...
You want to ask me for a favor, don't you?
You saw right through me. Just as expected...
The clan is going to do a thorough cleaning and I'm worried the manga I bought might get discovered...
Okay, I get it, you can leave them with me
Are you there? Any interest in watching a movie?
It just so happens that I'm looking into it right now—do you have any recommendations?
I borrowed a few film reels from a Loong videoshop owner
You can pick one to watch
I'll go with The Many Faces of Stellaroid
You've got good taste in movies
This is a very popular comedy
It's about a Trekker who gains a mysterious power from a Monolith that allows them to transform into any Artifact. The Trekker then return to Emor to pursue a lost love
This is my favorite one out of the lot!
It's about the Imperial Guard and a certain gang, each planting an undercover agent within the other's ranks, leading to a web of deception, confrontation, and entanglement
The Stella Drama portrayals of each side are way more impressive than their counterparts in reality, but it makes for a very exciting Drama
This is a story set in Cang Wu?

Yes. It's a story about a group of Loong tasked with protecting someone in significance. They arrive at an inn in the middle of nowhere and find themselves in a struggle with the local forces and the enemies on their trail
Although I don't really understand the concept of "Xia" that's popular over in Cang Wu
I think it's really similar to the ideal of Ashwind Clan
All that is true, but...I meant to ask
You've already watched all of them, haven't you?
I'm allowed to do a rewatch, aren't I
Anyway! I spent a lot of effort to borrow these film reels
I'm already on my way. No backing out!
Do you remember how I mentioned to you about getting a camera Artifact?
I took a lot of photos with it
But they're all out of focus, not usable at all...
Something's wrong with the Artifact, then
Maybe your hands were not stable enough
I'm sure something's wrong with the Artifact
After all, you get what you pay for
Maybe you move too fast and the focus function couldn't handle your speed
Or you forgot to turn some function on. Where's the manual?
Well, I did say it's pre-owned
Could it be that you came across something paranormal...
Something like that wouldn't scare me
Even if they really existed, I'd just bat them on the head
It's a shame that I can't get good photos to share with you
Maybe it's better for you to directly see them from my POV
I asked a friend at the cat cafe to modify a new skateboard—now two people can ride it together
So even if you don't know how to ride it, I can take you along...
So, how about it? Any interest?
Since you've gone through all that trouble
How could I ever say no
Then let's go right now, I'm at your 2 o'clock position
Oh, you were texting me while skateboarding?
Let's go on the newest skateboard!
I've followed you all this way...in my school uniform!
I guess even you slip up sometimes
I was so focused on thinking about getting you a gift
So I was planning to intercept you up ahead
It's not the kind of things you do in front of my underlings
Let's go to our usual spot
This is the second time I've sparred against New Star Guild
But I think Ashwind Clan did great, too
You really gave us a hard time the first time we met up
After all, that's how we established ourselves in Ash District
Can Neuvira and Vollara tag along next time?
I think it would be a great opportunity for them to grow
Sure thing, after all, you have also helped us a ton
That's so generous of you! It's a deal, then!
Huh...? Is that really what happened?
It's not your fault that you've forgotten them
Regaining what was once lost is the best feeling in the world
And it's thanks to you, Boss
I just did what I could
Could I have a little more time?
I guess I still want to stay in that place for a while
Of course, it's just to process some information and emotions
I'll wait for you to come back
I'll be the best version of myself right now

Some random new gang just crawled out of the woodwork
Small-time crew, but they're stirring up trouble left and right. Picking on the weak
They've even got the nerve to mess with us Ashwinds now
Anyway, I already sent Vollara and Neuvira to dig up some dirt on 'em
Give it a few days and they're history
I modded my board with boosters!
Ok technically I just strapped a bunch of fireworks to it
I got the technique down now
Had to wipe out a few times to get it right though
That doesn't sound chill at all.
They are a Cangwu specialty, after all
Bet they're hard to find in Emor.
That Artifact ride of yours is sick
Man, having a ride like that must be sweet
You can just cruise wherever you want
Plus, you don't get wet when it rains

Got me wanting to hit the Monolith, make wishes, and build my own
Having a car is pretty great
It's not as glamorous as you think
on how to wish for the right parts
Noya got the parts for Loxy from wishing,
then put Loxy together from scratch.
It was actually a pretty complex process.
You gotta maintain it, worry about dents...
Plus, you need to make sure it can be easy to drive
If I can't swing a car
Maybe I'll settle for two wheels
Pretty sure Tilia from the Imperial Guard rides one
But a bike won't protect you from the weather.
Not as agile as my board anyway

Need you to snag the new vol of Phantom Bomb Rider
Vollara and Neuvira are dragging me to Trekker training tomorrow.
You're the only one I can count on for this!
Word is this new release is gonna be insane
Bet there's gonna be a massive mob camping out for the drop
If you're late, it's definitely gonna be gone
Should I go camp out there tonight then?

I'll stick it out for the restock
I'll secure that manga for you.

I need some fresh content for once

It's hard to explain. They just don't look the way I see them in my head

It's not worth you catching a cold
If you miss it, then forget it
I'll stick it out for the restock
I'll secure that manga for you.
Let's go! Time to hang out!
Feels like forever since we hung out, Boss
Heard there's a new theater in the Ash District
Heard there's a new theater in the Ash District
Hope they're showing some new Stella Dramas
The ones at our usual spot
I need some fresh content for once
Cool, let's go check it out.
So, I've actually been drawing some short shoujo manga lately!
I'd love to properly appreciate it.
Just ... promise you won't laugh if the art sucks
Why would I do that? You gotta have some faith in yourself, Minova!
But something about the characters still feels a bit off
It's hard to explain. They just don't look the way I see them in my head
Sounds like it might be an issue with the fundamentals.
Guess I really gotta go back to basics, then
Take your time. Every artist starts somewhere.

strings.text: You can entrust me with any commission.
If you have any questions, feel free to ask me.
I'll use everything I know and do everything I can to help you.
I've organized everything into a report and sent it to you.
Please check it when you can.
Got it. I'll look it over and send you feedback.
Your messages are always so serious, Nazuka.
Work is to be taken seriously.
Still, you could send messages that aren't about work, once in a while.
Everyone ends up chatting with me about all sorts of things.
Like the little troubles or worries in their daily lives,
People share that kind of stuff with me all the time.
I will do my best next time.
No no, don't feel pressured, please.
Just whatever feels natural to you.
Yeah. Seeing you use stickers was kinda unexpected.
Uh... You don't have to send that many all at once...
I didn't mean that I wanted ... to be like that with you.
Sorry, I guess I got a little carried away.
No worries. I send that sticker to people sometimes too.
"All of these, to me, are death and the sorrow of the world."
"All of these, because they will fade, live in my heart."
"And my heart is slightly larger than the entire universe."
It's a poem I came across recently. I want to share it with you.
Wow... It feels kind of sad.
Does it? I find it rather romantic.
Making a connection between these two... It's exactly the sort of thing a poet would do.
Did you find this poem in the Monolith as well?
Lately I've been thinking of compiling the poems I like into a collection.
Of course, they don't belong to me. It would just be to share.
Come to think of it, it's not just poetry. There are also movies, games...
The Monoliths' had just an immense influence on this world.
And that's not even counting all kinds of Artifacts.
Yes, Monolith holds so many amazing things.
How many more secrets and treasures are still undiscovered?
It really ... stirs your imagination, doesn't it?
I think you once said that...
I can message you even if it's not work-related, right?
What would you like to talk about?
Sorry, I haven't thought of anything yet.
That's fine. I'll come up with a topic.
So ... why don't we just meet in person?
Like always, I go there when I don't have work.
About the Trekker's Handbook draft that I sent you a while back...
I read it over with Noya, Iris, and Amber.
Everyone had a positive take on it.
We all think you're doing something really worthwhile.
Your feedback is very thoughtful, I really appreciate it.
I've been asking for your help all this time.
Nah, it's something that will help everyone.
What if, one day, I want to trouble you with my personal matters...
I've said it before, haven't I? We are pals.
Then please allow me to thank you in advance.
I would like to give you a present.
Is there anything you would like?
No reason. I just thought ... we've known each other for quite some time now.
Maybe gift-giving would be a nice way to mark that.
It means I haven't decided yet. I'd like to save the wish for later.
But even though you don't have Wish Coupons...
I would still be happy to fulfill your wish.
Huh? But didn't I give you one already....
Oh, You are kidding, aren't you?
It's just that I really can't think of anything.
If there's something I need, I'll just ask you directly.
Since you don't have anything in mind, let's leave it at that.
Mm. But thank you, all the same, for thinking of me.
Excuse me but... do you have a moment?
Well, I have something I need to prepare for today.
I mean, I've got the time for you!
Sorry, I'm not sure I'm understanding you correctly.
You didn't really think I'd forget your birthday, did you?
When I said "something to prepare for," I meant your birthday present.
Don't worry, I'll definitely be there for your birthday party.
Why do you say that all of a sudden?
I'd already reached the limits of my own abilities.
After all, I've trained for years,
and I've been a Trekker for a long time.
I found new possibilities within myself.
You're not the first one to say that.
Guess that means I'm pretty talented in inspiring others, huh?
Do you remember the one time we went up a mountain...
and found a little house there?
The time when we ran into a herd of wild deer?
Yes. I didn't think you'd still remember.
Of course I do! It was just the two of us.
The next time when we're both free, maybe we could go back there again.
It feels like a nice place to unwind.
Maybe we'd run into the same herd.

strings.text: Boss, I just got back to Philae. Would you like to meet sometime in the next couple of days?
Sure. Haven't seen you around lately
I got commissions that sent me to other cities
Although, I gotta say... You really are famous!
Your reputation extends beyond the city walls of Philae!
That's all thanks to the Trekker Association helping to spread the word
Having more work is always good
As it means more and more people are recognizing my abilities
But it also means less time to spend with friends
Sometimes I do feel a tinge of regret about it
You'll find a way to make it up, little by little
I'm sure everyone understands how it is
I'd like to eat something sweet
Kaede said I've been too tense lately
And that I need to relax a bit
I thought about it, and food was the only thing that came to mind
You could go out and have some fun that way, too
But every time I go out, I end up worrying
What if something happens in the guild while I'm not around?
Hmmm, Kaede wasn't kidding when she said you were tense
I know I need to learn to trust my guildies
But still, I can't help but worry...
Alright then, I'll give you a commission, right now
Today. Come out and hang out with me
I know you can't use magic
What kind of magic would you want to do?
Ventus magic like yours sounds pretty nice
Because it could take me into the sky
Who wouldn't like the feeling of flying?
I once saw a line in the Monolith...
"Flying is an age-old dream of mankind."
I think that makes perfect sense. That's exactly how I feel
I'd like to ask you something, Boss
How do you achieve work-life balance?
Isn't it exhausting to handle so many things?
Well... I feel like it's not too bad?
Whether as a Trekker or as a CEO
I've made a career out of living through adventures
All traveling does get a bit tiring sometimes
But thanks to this great adventure
I've been able to meet so many wonderful people and do so many interesting things
Sorry, I got carried away, didn't I?
No, not at all. Thank you for answering me
So I suppose rather than thinking about balancing, it's more about enjoying it...
I think I'm starting to get used to it
It's a bit different from before
But I feel full of hope
I've got many friends by my side
And I've met people whom I can count on
You're the one who made all this possible
Really? I'd love to see that expression on your face
Hmm, if I get the chance
I'll say this to you in person ... a couple of times
There's something I want to share with you
I have a hobby that I've enjoyed since childhood
True. As a Trekker, it's easy to forget the past
People tend to live in the present and care more about those around them
And the things you do remember about the past
Shine more brightly because of it
Don't tell me that hobby is...
Today, I want to go see the waterwheel outside Philae
I haven't been there in a long time

strings.text: Hello, Master. We ... we finally meet again.
Glad to have you as my student.
I've been doing great—thanks to you!
N-no, it's the other way around!
I hope I can have more chances to learn from you!
Master, I ... I've been a little troubled lately.
At the camp, people I've never met keep greeting me.
They're all so friendly. Some even look like they admire me.
But I don't know their names, and I never know how to respond.
Looks like you've become quite the celebrity, Fuyuka.
E-eek, M-Master, please don't make fun of me.
I'm not really used to it yet, but ... I want to deal with it on my own.
I-I know... It just takes some getting used to, still...
Fuyuka, there's something I've always wondered.
Your weapon looks unusual... It's big and heavy.
I oil it regularly, wipe it clean after battles
and store it in a special cabinet at home.
When I'm out in the Wilds, though,
sometimes it's too big to fit anywhere properly,
so I just keep it by my side.
You don't worry about losing it?
I see. It is way too heavy.
No, most people can't even lift it.
A few have tried, but I'm the only one who can.
Hehe, I guess I do have some confidence in my strength.
If you ever need help with any heavy lifting, Master, please let me know!
Fuyuka, there's something that's always puzzled me.
Don't you feel hot wearing like that?
Your outfit always gives off such a winter vibe.
It looks all warm and fuzzy. I can imagine it's perfect for winter.
Doesn't it make you prone to sweating?
A-and even if I did, I wouldn't smell. So please don't worry!
Uh, that's not what I meant...
Today's the meetup day for the Petal Bloom and the New Star Guild!
Could you please bring everyone in New Star Guild over, Master?
Usually it's Kaede or Nazuna who does the inviting.
Umm... I... I volunteered for the job.
I'd like to handle these invitations from now on.
I figured... If I can't even talk about things like this with you, Master...
It'll be even harder with anyone else.
Then I'm honored to be your practice partner.
Master! It is an urgent situation!!!
Did the dog eat your homework?
I have something important I'd like to discuss with you.
Ahem. Nothing, just my feeble attempt at humor.
R-right. So, there's going to be a joint operation soon—
We'll be partnering up with another guild.
And ... I'm not sure how to carry myself around them.
Don't worry. I've been paying close attention to your battles.
Just do what you always do.
I can't do speeches or pep talks...
Every leader has their own strengths.
Yours is leading from the front.
When people see you charging ahead
I think I'm beginning to understand...
Do you have a bit of free time today, Master?
Th-there's a place that I'd like to go to.
Going on a date with someone like me would be a total waste of time!
I just... I feel like I've grown a bit
and I've been seeing things differently lately.
And I'd like to share some thoughts with you.
Also, being with you is never a waste of time.
I just want to get that on the record.
Thank you for everything you've done for me.
I meant ... it's your birthday today.
S-sorry, I got it mixed up!
Then, Master, will you come to my birthday party?
T-that's great! I'll start getting ready!
I've been watching you fight lately.
You seem much more at ease out there.
Y-yes! It's all thanks to your training, Master.
I finally understand what strength really means.
When I think only of protecting my friends
I can fight at my full power.
I listened to the Runic Disc you sent me last time, Master.
Did you think of things from the past?
I've had a perfectly ordinary past.
I grew up in a small town, around ordinary people.
But ... I don't know how to put it...
That kind of ordinary life is precisely what's worth protecting.
You can read me like a book...
Heh, after hearing that track, I feel so full of energy.

strings.text: What is it? You sound unusually happy
Hehe, the senpais have been saying that I've improved a lot lately
They say I'm starting to look like a proper guild leader
I'm sure more and more people will recognize your leadership abilities!
I'm so grateful for having you as my Master
It's not just because of me
All this comes from your willingness to work hard and change yourself
I feel like working for a company
is completely different from being a Trekker
One values rules, structure, and stability
The other stands for freedom and adventure
It's natural to feel out of place
But whenever I think that you'll help me
I feel like I can face either kind of life
Whenever you want, you can come to me for help
There's something I still don't quite understand
Whenever I go to accept commissions with the senpais
I get so nervous every time that I can't say a word
But they always tell me it's fine, I should just keep looking like that
And the clients don't seem to mind, either
Still, I'm afraid that I'm being impolite...
Fuyuka, that's because other people see you like that
They saw you as the stern, unsmiling type to begin with
Even though that's far from the truth
It makes people with bad intentions think twice before trying to trick you
Still... Can I really keep this up forever?
If you want to show your true self to others
You'll need to put in more effort than you do now
It's rare to see you so eager
I've gotten to the point where I can ask to do out-of-town commissions on my own
It's as you taught me last time
Explain the situation as clearly as possible during the initial contact phase
Then plan for contingencies and figure out what to say in case they happened
That helps with completing the commission itself, too
Just remember to watch out for unplannable risks
Hehe, that's why before every trip
I would always set a time with others
If anything went wrong, they would come and back me up
That's amazing. You really thought it through
Master, would you come to the forest with me?
It's rare for you to invite me like this
I usually worry about bothering you too much
But this time, it's not just about me
I want to visit some old friends with you
Friends who live in the forest?
Oh, you mean that bird pack?
They might have flown away by now
Winter has come to an end
They should be heading to their next destination
Yes, I just want to make sure
Come to think of it, you're always encouraging and praising me
Or is criticism what you actually want?
Just imagining you scolding me makes me want to cry!
I... I was just worried that maybe you're being too nice...
And not always telling me the truth
Fuyuka, you've always been good at a lot of things
That really is my only strong point
Even while fully equipped, you can move without making a sound
... Uh, that's because... I was always scared of running into people...
So that's how I got my stealth skills
even if you never changed at all, nobody can look down on you
And now, you're been even more awesome
Your words always warm my heart

strings.text: Heyyyyy! Mistique here on the EXCLUSIVE line!
Got any hot scoops? Lemme know FIRST!
r u free?? u free? u free? u free? HELLOOO???
busy busy busy busy busy busy
Nah no emergency, just BIG NEWS!
BIG NEWS BIG NEWS BIG NEWS!!!!!
Trekker saw phantoms of "people they know" inside the Monolith!
Which means I might run into ANOTHER ME!
Take me with you!! You must know the Monolith inside out by now, right?
Uh, I'm still pretty new to this...
Sweet! Just don't forget to invite me on your next adventure, k?
Counting on you for today's interview!
Just text me back right here, okay? hehe
Uh, when did I agree to this??
Sorry, we failed to deliver your message.
Whoa, no need to be so formal!
U can just say yes now!
Heh! Nice try, but u can't hide from my sources!
Okay, here it comes! So tell me, Boss:
What exactly motivated you to become the Boss of Tyrant Accord?
Kinda makes things awkward. People these days want spice, not straightforward heroics...
Ooooh, I get it. So the Boss needs funding just as much as followers...
Sounds like a juicy conspiracy! This is gonna make a huge headline!
GASP! SCANDAL ALERT! So that's the REAL reason tons of ladies gather under the Tyrant Accord!
Hey!! C'mon, I'm trying to do a serious interview here! News needs FACTS!
It's kinda complicated. Hard to explain in a text.
Fair point. Guess I need more than just a quick chat to write a really good story...
Anyway, thx! Catch ya for the next interview!
I'll pay you for the interview next time!
Great! Wait no, actually it's terrible.
Ugh, I don't think I can finish this story anymore
The victim doesn't wanna be named, and the suspect is still out there
Even the Guards' getting nowhere. What good is my writing gonna do? I'm just a witch with a pen.
Makes me wonder if any of this is even worth it...
A witch brings truth to light
A witch always helps the people
Whoa, you think that highly of me?!
I dunno if I deserve such a noble title yet!
Well yeah, hehe, it's a bonus!
Everyone deserves to know what's really going on!
We don't stir the drama, we just deliver it piping hot!
Seriously, chatting with you made me feel way better
A witch can't let a little trouble scare her off!
Such a hard worker! Love it!
Hey, wanna swing by later? Got some new pics to show ya!
Can't wait to see your masterpiece!
They aren't just selfies, are they...
Finally, someone with taste! Gonna run all my pics by you first now!
Well...okay, maybe! But lemme print some more copies first!
I'll broom over later to grab ya!
Know you're swamped, but take care of yourself, okay?
Soooo... I heard they literally dug you out of the Monolith?
Yeah...still trying to figure that part out myself
False! I actually fell from the sky like a star.
Ah, memory loss... It's practically a Trekker starter pack item.
Totally wild! That's pure headline gold!
Haha, so you ride broomsticks like me?
Love the headline...but where should I even start...
C'mon, I've been your loyal groupie for so long! At least give me this scoop!
Isn't that headline a little dramatic?
Make sure that interview fee hits my account!
I'm actually hurt! I thought our friendship goes beyond!
Gonna keep you right where I want you...
And sloooowly uncover ALL your secrets!!! Mwahaha!
I'm gonna embed myself in your life, dig up your past, and be THERE for every single future plot twist!
Don't think this'll be easy on you!
Seriously, if anything big happens, don't let the scoop happen without me there!
I'm so done with this job!
Whyyyy do I always miss the big news?!
Meanwhile, you're headline material wherever you go!
News doesn't just fall outta the sky!
True... If I just keep following you...
Promise you won't get totally sick of me tho?
A witch, right in the middle of the action...
Hmph! I'm always spilling the tea for you. Where's your juicy gossip?!
Mystery is part of my charm
BREAKING NEWS: Brilliant Witch Defeated by Silver-Tongued Boss!
Gave It Her All, But Still No Scoop!
I'm playing the long game tho.
I can wait for the day you spill everything...
Ohohoho! This witch is totally leveling up her game lately!
Ever since we teamed up, everything's been going so much better!
Must treat this top-tier witch with respect!
You're my trusty partner in crime!
The legendary Witch and the fabled Boss … hehehe
Never thought the reporter chasing news would end up being news!
Let's find some more chaos to get into!
Make a splash in this world!
Lanterna, Pumpka... Wish this witch packed more magic sometimes...
What crazy scheme are you cooking up?
Are you kidding?! It's all flash! I need wayyy more...
Heheheh, just imagine if I had the power to make actual miracles happen...
Seriously?! Magic is really that easy to get?!
Hypothetically, if I ever turned into some kinda big bad villain, would you hunt me down?
Being a witch means anything is possible!

strings.text: Boss!!! I'm literally dying over here!
If you drop dead on the job, the workers' comp payout will be huge.
I am a witch dedicated to THE TRUTH!
If I die, it's a massive loss for the whole Nova!
But seriously, what are you working on?
That investigative report on the underground Magical Girls
Company wants to "optimize our promo strategy" for that sector
So naturally, they dumped all the research on me
Not only do I have to do the field visits
I also have to pull all-nighters writing it up
When you're done, let's go grab some drinks!
Thinking of upgrading my photo capturer
Is your current one giving you trouble?
Just saw the latest model at the store
It looks way smaller and has a ton more features
That's like six months of my writing fees. I'd have to starve just to afford it
You could just go to the Monolith and wish for a new one
But what if the one I wish for ends up worse than the one I have?
Actually, now that I look at my old one
Don't fall into the consumerism trap.
Notice anything weird on South Street in the Ash District? Like way too many people?
I do see a crowd heading that way.
Report back to me the second you know
Shouldn't a star witch be handling this herself?
Ugh, I'm undercover at a factory
And snap a few pics while you're at it
You won't be laughing for long
Boss Accord CEO Caught Littering Outside United Harvest HQ!
News is supposed to be based on facts!
You can't just make stuff up!
Okay fine, I tossed a can.
But it went in the bin!
But I picked it up and got it in the bin!
That's taking things completely out of context!
Who cares about context once the story is out?
Got a tip from a concerned citizen
There was nobody else at United Harvest that day.
Okay, I was following you. But I didn't take any pictures
Still, for a CEO, you're not great at handling bad press
You should hire me as your personal PR consultant
Aren't you the source of all my bad press?
Got any juicy scoops happening lately, Boss?
It's just boring daily trivia. Who'd want to read about that?
If I don't write something soon
I can kiss next month's paycheck goodbye
But seriously, it's all just boring trivia.
For a big-shot entrepreneur like you,
even the weeds in your garden are headline material!
Then I definitely shouldn't tell you anything.
I'm charging you an Information Access Fee!
You know what's the best part
about being a witch like me?
It's getting the exclusive scoop before anyone else
A super cheap drink spot just popped up in the Silver District
Their chocolate coffee slushies are to die for
before it blows up and the lines get crazy!

strings.text: Mentor! I can finally message you!
all the maps my family confiscated!
I feel this is a bit sudden
I guess that was a bit abrupt
Let's talk it over properly the next time we meet!
I have so many fun things to tell you about today!
My parents always said it was too crowded and messy, so they never let me go
And it was like a treasure trove right in the middle of the city!
I bought some freshly baked pastries
Though I got a little too excited
And ran straight into a fruit stand...
Please do not be alarmed, Mentor. I did compensate the owner adequately
No, no! That's not what I meant...
I was asking if you were hurt
I'm fine, I'm fine. Fit as ever!
Hehe, Mentor, you care so much about me
Next time, let's go to the market together, shall we?
I know I've been scammed plenty of times before...
But this one really is different!
The treasure's supposed to be close to home
Right at the top of a small hill
So even if it was a hoax and we made the trip for nothing
We wouldn't have wasted too much time or energy
Um... So, I've already packed my belongings
I want to get there as soon as we can
Then, in the morning light, drink hot cocoa at the top of that hill
I bet it'll taste completely different up there
Mentor, will you make that trip with me?
I knew it! You're the best!
There's a secret that I want to share with you, Mentor
On my way back, I passed through the forest...
And found a tree that looked really strange!
Its branches looked just like outstretched hands
The whole tree looked like a person dancing
I stood there staring at it for the longest time
By the time I snapped out of it, it was almost dark
And then ... I missed the carriage back
But because of that tree, the whole trip ended up feeling really special!
Did you dance with that tree, then?
Of course not. I'm not that silly...
Mentor... You're not making fun of me, are you?
Changing one's plans just to follow up on their curiosity...
That is not a very common quality in people
Next time, can you take me to see that "dancing tree"?
Next time, I'll remember to bring my art supplies
And make a sketch of the tree to keep as a memento
I'm at the market right now, and I've gotten myself into a really tricky situation!
I ran into an old woman selling flowers
so I thought I'd help her carry it
But... That thing was just ridiculously heavy!
The old lady kept telling me what a good girl I was...
And was kind enough to invite me for tea back at her place.
The problem is ... I couldn't bring myself to walk another step!
Where are you in the market exactly?
I'm close by. I'll come lend you a hand
Wah, you're such a kind soul!!!
Oh, the old lady said she'd give us some flowers to thank us
What color do you like? I'll pick some for you!
Mentor, I've been working on building up my strength lately
Do you have any good training tips?
Or maybe someone I could learn from?
For example, Miss Fuyuka, leader of the Petal Bloom Guild
I seem to recall that she is super strong
But why the sudden interest in strength training?
It doesn't really suit your fighting style
Ah, I knew I couldn't hide it from you...
The truth is, my suitcase is just too heavy
I keep stuffing more and more things into it
Before I knew it, it had gotten way too heavy for me
Why not take some things out?
Agree. Building up your strength makes sense then
Huh? But every single thing in there is important...
A Trekker has to be prepared for anything, right?
Eleanor, I just had an idea
Could be used as a weapon in its own right, couldn't it?
I only ever saw the weight as a burden...
Thank you for the advice, Mentor!
Mentor! I'm in urgent need of your help!
Or is there something else you can't carry?
Remember when we went on that adventure a while back?
You changed out of your coat, and I said I'd wash it before returning it
So I thought I should try doing the laundry myself for once
And put your dark coat and my dress in the same basin
Then I added half a bag of stain remover
Now the basin is overflowing with suds!
And your coat looks like some kind of badly dyed patchwork...
Mentor, should I buy you an identical replacement?
Or crawl into a hole and never come out again?
I know I messed up, but please don't ignore me!
Let's go shopping for new clothes together sometime
Just don't be so reckless next time
Next time we go out, everything's on me!
I've been staring at the calendar for three whole days, waiting for today to finally arrive!
And I've planned a special outing for us as well
I've always thought that if you don't go somewhere special on a day like this
You'd be wasting a once-a-year opportunity!
So I found two special places on the map that are supposed to have amazing views:
A valley where you can see fireflies and a cliff where you can do stargazing
Which one would you like to go to?
It doesn't matter where we go
No problem! I've got everything ready!
What matters is that I get to spend the day with you
Anyway, today we're leaving all our worries behind
And we're going to spend the day like true adventurers
Please look forward to it, Mentor!
Mentor, I've realized that you're really amazing
After following your lead all this time
I've really come to understand how different it is to fight as a team instead of going it alone.
Whenever I fought by myself, I was always worried about someone attacking me from behind
But when I'm with you, I don't have to think about that at all
I was worried my fighting style might be too unpredictable...
And other people might not like me as a partner
But as long as you're calling the shots, none of that matters
I suppose this is what they call being in sync?
Mentor, let's keep fighting side by side!
Music really is amazing, isn't it?
My parents had me learn all of them
I may not look it, but I'm actually a very good singer
You already have such a lovely voice
Mentor... You really know how to flatter a girl
I'll sing for you next time I get the chance
But only after I've had plenty of time to prepare!

strings.text: So, this means we're friends, right?
I've never talked to anyone with a phone before.
Didn't the New Star Guild add you?
I mean... I have used them...
But it's not like I have contacts, or anyone to text.
They couldn't afford phones when they first set out as Trekkers.
If you hadn't brought them all the way here...
We probably never would have connected.
I gotta go, the kids need me.
Just wrapped up my chores, so I'm a little tired.
Uh... That's not exactly what it means.
You sweat when you work hard, right?
Now that I think about it, Iris sends me this one from time to time.
Is she working too hard lately?
When she sends it, there's a very good chance...
Got busy, haven't had a chance yet.
What's more important than taking care of yourself?
Can't believe it's actually raining in Mirage today.
Tell me you brought an umbrella, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
But I found a rock to hide under
And the New Star Guild is already on their way with Loxy
I never leave home without one!
Who expects a downpour in the middle of a desert?
I've never seen it rain this hard here either.
The weather's been totally crazy lately
Could someone be messing with it using magic?
I don't think magic like that exists.
Let's chat when you get home.
==PLAYER_NAME==, wanna hear a story about Noya when she was little?
I was cleaning out some boxes today.
I really don't think she'd mind.
She used to kick her blankets off in her sleep all the time.
Turn my back for two seconds, and she'd kick it right off again.
So I came up with a fix.
I tied the blanket to the bed frame with rope so she couldn't kick it away.

were actually sent by Boss Pie!

I sent you a text about it

You know, the one you met before!
Wonder what kinda goodies she's bringing me this time
Ugh... Except Jiyue always loves messing with me when she visits
Wait, hold on! That's not the point!
You said your senior is coming back.
Whatever! I'll tell you when I remember!
Your friend poked you to show off her stunning artwork.
Well? Am I giving off "Grandmaster" vibes, or what?
Did you actually send something? Or is the chat glitching?
That's just a system notification. It doesn't magically send the picture for you!
Then how am I supposed to show you?
Maybe take a photo with your phone?
I need to investigate this further. Talk later!
Jinglin just sent me a whole bunch of stickers!
Ooh, that's cute. Don't have that one yet
Yikes, Master is here checking my homework

There's a creepy shadow hovering outside my room!
Thought it was just someone passing by at first

Get over here!!! I'm freaking out!!
It was just a junior calling me for dinner
Let me guess. Nearsighted and forgot her glasses?
She mistook my window for the door
Scared the living daylights out of me...
I'll take that as a yes. Nice!
I snagged a Monolith commission for the weekend
Don't worry, we can totally work something out for the pay
Which middle-of-nowhere Monolith are you too chicken to hit solo this time?
Hey, I can totally handle it by myself!
Just figured having you around would make it more fun
