It's not like there are weird ghost rumors about the place or anything
Plus I heard it's sunny with a great view
Fine, I get it. I'll be there.
Knew I could count on you!
I just mastered this super cool spell
Gotta show you next time we meet
So, I conjure up a ball of energy, and then—whoosh—launch it into the sky
The move is called Golden Trees and Silver Flowers. Bet it looks amazing at night
Haha, no problem! Leave it to me!
If it's gonna explode anyway, maybe I can change the shape?
Like, have it fly up and turn into a giant fire dragon
Wait, that might actually work... I'm gonna go try it!

She's the one who made me want to become stronger
To have the strength to repay her kindness
I am so thankful to her

strings.text: Why is something moving inside my bottle?
So can I still drink it?
Did you leave it open for a long time?
Opened it last week. Forgot the cap when I went out
Then I went on a mission
Anyway, it's gone bad. Don't drink it.
Where are you right now, Boss?
Hanging out at the Trekker Association HQ.
You know you aren't supposed to tell me that, right?
Irrelevant. You will not detect me
Uh, aren't you standing right next to that vending Artifact?
Whatever you do, DO NOT get out of the car
Your horoscope says you're going to have "terrible luck in travel" today
So, purely for your own safety
This friendly warning smells suspiciously like a trap.
Just because Aeloria says "people love doing the opposite of what they're told"
doesn't mean I'm counting on that!
So let me get this straight. You're crouching right outside the door
waiting for me to get rebellious and walk out
Man, nothing gets past the Boss
How did you figure it out?!
Your face is literally smooshed against the window!
Why are you replying here, Boss??
Wait, is this not my memo app?
So, are you heading out to the store?
Wanna come, Boss? Heard they have a new soda flavor
Sure. I need to pick up some daily supplies anyway.
Okay. I'll wait for you by the entrance
Boss, do you know where I can get a nail file?
Pretty sure most general stores carry them.
Do you need it right now?
If you're in a hurry, maybe just borrow one from a nearby Soul Shop?
A Soul Shop? Aren't those run by the Grace Imperium?
I can't let the Grace Imperium know. I need it to file down my horns
Right. I saw someone do it once. Yeah, soy milk.
I'm going to the store now
Boss. I have a favor to ask
I am NOT letting you "kidnap" me!
So. I need you to let me pretend I captured you
I really need material for my monthly report!
I didn't even say it yet! How'd you know?!
Because you try this every time!
That's what you said last time.
Then you tried to haul me off the second the ropes were tight!
I promise I won't do it this time
Forget that. Want to try a new drink?
I just scored some Wasabi Coffee Drink.
You shared your location with Cosette.

strings.text: I'll be using this for our comms from now on.
Ping me immediately if you run into trouble.
Okay, that might be too reliable of you...
Just published my latest weapon write-up.
Did you catch it in the new issue?
Though they really buried it in the bottom corner...
Seriously, does that not bug you?
You're always relegated to the margins.
It's just a side gig. If it helps people, I'm satisfied.
Besides, I did make the front page once.
The Absolute Worst, Most Gimmicky Weapons
Were you trying to start a war?!
Yeah... I learned to keep my head down after that.
Why am I sending so many messages?
Did you lean on the screen? Where was your phone?
Working. I had to reach way across the table to grab a spare part.
I think I've solved the mystery...
Just about chugged a bottle of panel liner instead of my water.
How do you even mix those up...
We used to wish for it from the Monolith just to varnish furniture.
But turned out it adds amazing depth to plastic models.
... Good thing you stopped yourself in time.
Doesn't it look totally different from water?
I was in the zone. Wasn't looking.
Be glad you realized before swallowing...
Guess it's time to organize my workbench. And my living area...
I'll come over and help you tidy up.
You know the spot. I'll be waiting.
Thanks for humoring me. Always wanted to try that.
Is it always this sweltering out here?
You just grew up in a freezer, remember?
I'd become a laughingstock if anyone found out.
I just happened to pass a dessert shop.
And their ice cream just happened to offer a buy-one-get-one deal.
This is just an excuse to...
It's a limited time offer. Please get here, stat!
Stumbled on a real find at the market the other day.
Never thought I'd find a piece of home all the way out here.
Spot on. And it's in pristine condition.
Can't blame you. I suppose I usually only talk about weapons and models.
But I've been playing since I was a kid.
Heard it was the hardest instrument to learn, so naturally, I had to master it.
Been a while, but I started practicing the moment I got it.
Finally got my touch back today.
I'm right near my place. Come on over.
Don't miss this. I want you to hear a true melody of Norstheim.
Just wrapped up a new weapon review. Got a sec to check it?
You've never heard of a birthday?
Just looked it up. I think I grasp the concept now.
We didn't do that kind of thing back home.
We only celebrated dates that mattered to the whole tribe.
Don't worry. I know the rule: When in Philae, do as Philae people do.
So, did you prepare a cake?
Yep, was just about to tell you.
Thanks. I won't let your efforts go to waste.
Sprinting to your coordinates now. I'll be there in a flash.
Fast as the wind, as always!
Since it's my first birthday here...
I want to spend it with you.
I've actually been meaning to ask...
With your massive collection, why do you only ever use that one?
Every weapon has a unique specialty.
You need to deploy them in the right combat scenario to maximize their potential.
That is why I review them.
I'm officially calling you the Weapon Master.
So do you stick to that bayonet for the same reason?
Actually, there is a bit of personal bias involved.
This one has been with me the longest. It's an heirloom from my father.
It was damaged in an accident, but I managed to reforge it by fusing it with another weapon.
A symbol of your new life here, maybe?
Do memories have a durability stat, just like weapons?
The deeper the impression, the harder it is to wear down.
My homeland only knew winter. I never understood what "spring" really meant until I came here.
It was beautiful. It brought ... peace.
I can't think of any other way to describe it.
It is nice. But I let it slip away...
Then let's just go find it again.
You're right. How could I overlook something so simple?
But you're the one who helped me recover it.
Thank you. That is one thing I promise I'll never forget.

strings.text: I recently checked out the secondhand market for models.
It got me a bit worked up.
Somebody was selling a model they'd assembled but never painted.
They probably finished putting it together and then decided painting it was too much work
If you've already decided to build it
How can you just give up halfway through?
If they were too busy lately and didn't have time to paint it, I could understand that.
But just putting it up for sale to someone else... No.
Do you know what happened to me today?
Someone said they read one of my weapon reviews
And found the weapon that suited them best because of it.
that my effort really has helped other people
I'm thinking of starting a new series soon.
Trying Out the Most Unusual Weapons in the World.
What made you think of that?
Because I ran into a gang the other day. They had no idea what they were doing.
I mean, I drove them off without breaking a sweat.
But the weapons they dropped while running away were pretty interesting.
Yeah. If you swing one with only light force, it stays rigid like a sword or hammer.
But if you put enough force into it, the end of the weapon lashes out like a whip.
Sounds like something you can only get by wishing inside a Monolith
But it also got me curious.
Once I finish reviewing this fluid weapon
I'm going to look for the most unusual weapons in the world
And turn it into a long-running review series.
I can't even make myself go out
Wraith, don't tell me you're getting a heatstroke
I think you really do have one
I'll buy some ice cream and come over right now
Drink plenty of water until I get there!
Are you sure you don't need a weapon?
Even if I did, I wouldn't know how to use one
Though I have been practicing a little
You should still keep a small knife or something on you.
I can't always be there to protect you.
What if you run into danger when you're all alone?
If it really came to that...
You've got some kind of secret weapon?
Who do you think I am?
If I really ended up in danger all by myself
My intelligence would naturally be my greatest weapon!
After all, I've never seen that particular "weapon" on anyone else before.
If you ever find yourself in danger, find a way to contact me first.
Use that intelligence of yours to figure out how. Leave the rest to me.
By the way, do you know what an all-you-can-eat buffet is?
I went to the Trekker Association the other day to submit my review
And saw a new restaurant that had opened by the roadside.
It was some kind of buffet, asking for fifty thousand Dorra per person.
Oh, that means you pay the entry fee and then eat as much as you want
I'd definitely never eat enough to get my money's worth
And the restaurant definitely wouldn't let you, anyway
Otherwise, how would they make any money?
You want to give it a try, Wraith?
If it's you, I bet you could absolutely eat your money's worth
One time I went a whole week without eating and then ate nearly a hundred thousand Dorra's worth of food in one go.
I'll eat enough to make up your share, too, while I'm at it.
Are you sure the owner won't throw us out halfway through...?

strings.text: You and Chitose are now friends. Let the chatting begin!
Whoa, how many friend requests did you send?!
Excellent, my ==SEX11==. I have at last succeeded.
My ==SEX11==, it will rain this afternoon. Please do not forget an umbrella should you leave the house.
But how do you know it's going to rain?
Because the air is heavy with moisture.
Therefore, there will be rain this afternoon.
The scent of wind and rain already lingers in the air.
My ==SEX11==, the streets are quite safe at present.
Was that you who just zipped past me on my right?
It was not. I am not there.
Are you hiding behind that barrel?
But I can see the hilt of your blade.
It must surely be another swordswoman.
I must ask you not to, my ==SEX11==...
Fine, fine. I'll head out then.
Please be careful on your way, my ==SEX11==.
I saw my homeland within the Monolith.
I know that it is all an illusion.
But the cherry blossoms of my homeland, the snow...
They all seemed so very real.
I must admit, I became quite flustered.
The Monolith amplifies your senses and emotions.
If I train to become a truly strong warrior...
Perhaps then I will not feel such trepidation when faced with home.
My ==SEX11==, are you available at the moment?
A bit busy, but I'm good!
May I invite you to be my guest at Amekiku, my ==SEX11==?
It is a way station I restored for the convenience of Trekkers.
It is quite all right, my ==SEX11==.
Then I'll be your first guest to get the full experience!
My ==SEX11==, do you require an escort at this time?
In that case, will you require an escort later, my ==SEX11==?
Chitose, you can take a break.
You don't have to be on guard 24/7.
Then, will you require an escort tomorrow, my ==SEX11==?
You can just come over now, Chitose.
My ==SEX11==, have you had a sudden need for an escort?
But we could go for a walk and clear our heads.
My ==SEX11==, I believe the time has come.
The time for you to become my Wielder.
I have brought a whetstone and blade oil.
Yes, my ==SEX11==. That is one way to interpret it.
This is a pretty big deal...
If anything, my training isn't up to par.
I can be your Interim Wielder.
We train together until we can truly trust each other with our convictions.
Only then will I become your true Wielder.
Then I shall endeavor to do so alongside you, my ==SEX11==.
Perfect timing, I was just looking for you.
Do you remember that today is your birthday?
I do, but I have not celebrated it for quite some time.
Well, that's about to change. Come on over.
We have a birthday surprise for you.
Truly, there is no need for such a fuss.
A fine blade deserves a fine sheath!
We got you a cake shaped like an onigiri.
Please wait a moment, my ==SEX11==. I am on my way.
My ==SEX11==, I believe I have reached an impasse in my swordsmanship.
What seems to be the problem?
I'm guessing it isn't an issue with your form.
You are correct, my ==SEX11==. The problem lies within my heart.
When I raise my sword, I find myself unable to achieve a tranquil mind.
The moment my blade falls, memories of the past flood my thoughts.
Maybe you shouldn't worry about it so much.
It's normal for your mind to race when you swing a blade.
You're not an unfeeling fighting machine, after all.
Yes. Only by thinking carefully and grasping the reason you raise your sword
can you strike a blow free from all distraction.
Reaching that state takes time. It's a journey.
I will take my time to comprehend this.
I wonder when it'll finally clear up.
In Goodwind, there is a sword technique that involves multiple slashes.
The blade is swung so swiftly it can shatter each falling raindrop.
Ohhh, I've seen you use that move!
But it is not yet perfected.
I possess three blades, yet my strength is not threefold.
The journey of tempering one's blade is a long one.
My ==SEX11==, would you be willing to witness as I walk this path?
No matter how long or winding the road is, I'll be with you the whole way!

strings.text: I had an exceptionally salty stew today.
My hand slipped, added too much salt.
One should add water when it's too salty, and add salt when the taste becomes too bland...
Sadly, the pot was nearly filled to the brim.
The heart of the problem was that I was thrown off balance.
Halfway through making the stew, someone came knocking at the door.
That courier who rides a bicycle.
She said there was an urgent express delivery, therefore I signed for it.
Then I went back inside and resumed cooking.
Just as I was about to add the salt, another urgent delivery arrived. I was startled and accidentally poured in a whole spoonful.
In the end, I moved the stove and the pot right to the doorway. Just in case...
My ==SEX11==, there was a mud rain here yesterday.
Dust gets swept into the sky by the wind; and if it happens to rain at the same time, it turns into mud rain.
When it falls on clothes, it leaves muddy spots.
For those who have laundry drying outside, it's a grave disaster.
Fortunately, I sensed the coming of mud rain and brought the laundry in beforehand.
I even warned a passerby to hurry home and take in her clothes; alas, she did not believe me.
She said, "If it's going to rain mud, why are you standing out here without an umbrella?"
She even thought I was trying to sell her some kind of laundry Artifact.
I debated with her point by point, and in the end she got annoyed and walked away.
What I don't understand is this... Disagreeing with her doesn't mean I dislike her.
... I think most people have trouble distinguishing between the two...
My ==SEX11==, I recently attended a fireworks festival.
When I was young, I saw fireworks from my family's courtyard, but only from afar.
This time I was there in person and had to look up to watch.
The fireworks shot upward, drawing bright lines across the night sky, then suddenly exploded with thunderous sounds.
They burst into shapes I had never seen before. For a brief moment, the flashes even lit up the Monolith in the background.
I felt like I could never have enough of such splendor.
My ==SEX11==, do you think people could see those fireworks from Matsukawa?
When people in different places watch those same fireworks, what kind of things would be on their minds?
And those old acquaintances I haven't seen in a long time... Might they also be looking at the same sight?
Matsukawa is probably too far away... You probably need to be in the same city to see it...
My ==SEX11==, it's been a long time. How have you been lately?
I'm doing well. How about you, Chitose?
I'm still learning how to cope with people.
I've never been good at understanding how things work, so I often end up in awkward situations and even get taken in by sly people.
It's a dangerous world out there. You must be careful, Chitose!
Indeed. My ==SEX11== is learned and well-traveled, so you surely don't have such troubles.
As for me, my clumsiness in handling social relationships leaves me exhausted, sometimes even on the verge of tears.
Social skills really do take a lot of practice...
If only human relationships were as simple as the crossing of blades...
My ==SEX11==, I'm still thinking about the social skills you mentioned last time.
Some insights, yes, but also new worries.
When others show me kindness, I can never accept it without unease, and I certainly don't dare ask for it myself.
I know such kindness does not come with a price tag, yet I find myself constantly trying to calculate how to repay them.
Is this truly in line with what people call favor? Or is the sincerity of intention the only thing that matters?
You definitely need reciprocity, but it's not a math calculation...
Especially with friends, when you count every little thing, it starts to feel, well, not very friendly at all...
Sigh. The human relationship really is very complicated.
But one thing I'm sure of is this: Relationships are like knots, growing tighter with each exchange.
Sometimes all it takes is tying a knot to hold a bond firmly in place.
My ==SEX11==, I recently learned to make a new dish
First, cut the potatoes into chunks, slice the onions along the grain, and slice the meat as well.
Heat the pan and sauté the onions until golden. Then add oil, put in the meat, and stir-fry until it changes color.
Next, add sugar and soy sauce, then the potatoes, and finally enough water to cover everything. Let it simmer for half an hour.
Add seasoning right before serving, and it's done.
If your schedule allows, my ==SEX11==, would you come by Amekiku for a visit?
Let me prepare dinner for you.
Noted, I've already prepared tea and snacks. I am waiting in anxious anticipation.

param: I had an exceptionally salty stew today.
My hand slipped, added too much salt.
One should add water when it's too salty, and add salt when the taste becomes too bland...
Sadly, the pot was nearly filled to the brim.
The heart of the problem was that I was thrown off balance.
Halfway through making the stew, someone came knocking at the door.
That courier who rides a bicycle.
She said there was an urgent express delivery, therefore I signed for it.
Then I went back inside and resumed cooking.
Just as I was about to add the salt, another urgent delivery arrived. I was startled and accidentally poured in a whole spoonful.
In the end, I moved the stove and the pot right to the doorway. Just in case...
My ==SEX11==, there was a mud rain here yesterday.
Dust gets swept into the sky by the wind; and if it happens to rain at the same time, it turns into mud rain.
When it falls on clothes, it leaves muddy spots.
For those who have laundry drying outside, it's a grave disaster.
Fortunately, I sensed the coming of mud rain and brought the laundry in beforehand.
I even warned a passerby to hurry home and take in her clothes; alas, she did not believe me.
She said, "If it's going to rain mud, why are you standing out here without an umbrella?"
She even thought I was trying to sell her some kind of laundry Artifact.
I debated with her point by point, and in the end she got annoyed and walked away.
What I don't understand is this... Disagreeing with her doesn't mean I dislike her.
... I think most people have trouble distinguishing between the two...
My ==SEX11==, I recently attended a fireworks festival.
When I was young, I saw fireworks from my family's courtyard, but only from afar.
This time I was there in person and had to look up to watch.
The fireworks shot upward, drawing bright lines across the night sky, then suddenly exploded with thunderous sounds.
They burst into shapes I had never seen before. For a brief moment, the flashes even lit up the Monolith in the background.
I felt like I could never have enough of such splendor.
My ==SEX11==, do you think people could see those fireworks from Matsukawa?
When people in different places watch those same fireworks, what kind of things would be on their minds?
And those old acquaintances I haven't seen in a long time... Might they also be looking at the same sight?
Matsukawa is probably too far away... You probably need to be in the same city to see it...

strings.text: Just let me know if you ever need a hand with anything.
Do you provide housekeeping services too?
I just didn't expect that to be your very first question.
But of course. If you need it, I'd handle those services personally for you.
"Personally"? Now that just sounds like a scam.
Tell me, Boss, how well do you know the moon?
I read up on some of those concepts back in the Monolith.
The Monolith also houses a few books on astrology and astronomy.
They say the moon only ever reveals one side to us.
While the other half remains forever hidden in the dark.
Makes it feel rather elusive, doesn't it?
Still, it's crazy how such different concepts apply to the same thing...
Well, that's the moon for you.
Nanoha always seems so happy around you.
Knowing that puts my mind at ease.
Wait, how do you know we went out?
But when I want to know something, I have my ways of finding out.
Pay it no mind, I'm just thinking out loud.
But seriously, how did you know?
I was running the shop today. I even passed you the bottle of water you bought.
I'll let you be the judge of that.
[Goodwind Homecare Reminder: It's clear and sunny outside, perfect for drying clothes.]
[Reply "0" to unsubscribe, "1" to continue your subscription.]
You aren't actually with Goodwind Homecare, right?
It's fun to slip into character every now and then.
Back to your old job again?
Of course not. It's just a little role-play.
Come to think of it, this message looks familiar.
So that's what you meant by "role-playing."
Nanoha sent me this exact same text once.
Hehe. I'm glad you're paying attention, Boss.
If you'd forgotten a message she worked so hard on...
Well, I might never forgive you.
Notice any fabric merchants while you were in Philae?
You looking to buy some fabric?
Just keeping an eye out for a specific batch, that's all.
You mean the fabric shop next to the Soul Shop?
What kind of fabric are you looking for anyway?
They might have something like it in the Monolith.
I highly doubt it's something you'd find in the Monolith.
I'm sure it'll turn up when the time is right.
I used to play pretend as an employee in a company.
You sure know how to entertain yourself.
You know, putting yourself in the story, laughing and crying along with the main character.
Deep down, I think everyone enjoys role-playing.
You can become whoever you want, start completely fresh as many times as you like.
Every new persona is a brand new start.
Yeah, I am. You here too?
What a coincidence. Want to grab a drink?
We actually just headed out of town. Why?
I was just passing through and wondering if you'd like to grab a drink.
I know a cafe around here that makes amazing desserts.
You really do love your sweets, huh.
I might take a rain check, though. Let me see...
Sure. Let's catch up when you're free next.
Got any free time today, Boss?
Ah! I know what this is about!
It's a secret. Don't spoil it.
If you're free, come meet me at that dessert shop.
I have a matcha cake waiting for you.
Ah, nothing beats the classic Goodwind taste.
I made sure the chef doubled the usual amount of matcha powder.
I'd heard you weren't much of a fighter...
... But I didn't realize you were this helpless.
Or is this all just a clever act?
If so, your performance is flawless. Truly a masterclass in deception.
You're giving me way too much credit.
Still, I could show you a few tricks to keep yourself safe, if you're interested.
I'm actually quite a capable mentor.
Just say the word whenever you're ready to learn.
Boss, do you remember that Disc?
Of course. You looked stunning in it.
Now, here's a little riddle for you.
Was that really me, or actually one of my clones?
Is this some kind of test?
I can barely tell you two apart when you're standing right in front of me, let alone in a still picture...
What brought on such a strange question?
Listening to that Disc just stirred up some old memories.
I find myself wondering... Was it really me standing among those flowers that night?
When memories start to blur, you lose track of even yourself.
Ah, sorry. I didn't mean to ramble.
It's fine... I just wish I had some way to actually help.
It's getting late. Go get some rest.

strings.text: Tell me what you wanna hear, and I'll play it for ya!
Oh! Silly me, I forgot to introduce myself.
Actually... I've got no cash for food.
Could you maybe spot me a little? I promise I'll play for you next time!
Sooo...could I maybe get paid upfront?
Sobs, I have no money for food
Sounds like you're in a real pinch
How about I just give you some cash?
Nope, I have standards as a musician!
So! I'll come play for my dinner right now! Sound good?!
Hey ==PLAYER_NAME==! What kinda tunes are you into?
So that's how you stay connected with the masses!
Gotta have that unique taste to be the Boss, right?
It's not that complicated. I just like what I like
Hey, I just seasoned 'em in some sick bass grooves while they cook!
Maybe I should just spot you some cash for actual groceries?
Whaaat?! My musical cuisine is awesome!
Pretty sure "music pro" wasn't in the Boss' job description...
Look! The point is, I heard that once you get a producer
the awesome music ideas just start flowing!
I think you might've misunderstood how that works
How do I convince you to be my producer?
Let me hear some more of your playing first
Since when am I your producer...
Hehe, you get my music the best. Let's just roll with it!
Soooo next time ur hitting up the Monolith, can I tag along?
BUT! The second I start play my bass, those Stellaroids always book it
Yeah, it's super handy, but kinda bums me out.
Maybe someday you'll win them over
That'd be a dream come true
Give me more chances to perform!
I feel way more confident playing for people now!
You always seemed pretty confident to me
Pfft, no way! I just get lost in the groove and forget anyone's watching
Can we go on another inspiration journey sometime soon?
Whoa there. Do you even know where we're going?
Let's maybe make a plan before running out the door next time
We've got all the time in the world. That's what producers are for, right?
My bass skills just hit a whole new level!
Now even those Stellaroids will stick around for my riffs!
Not to burst your bubble, but they might just run away faster
What? Why would they do that?
Is my amp too loud or something?
Maybe your music is just too mind-blowing...
We should totally test it out
You can take point this time
Why do I feel like there's a catch?
It's like a whole movie playing in my head right now!
Down in the audience, completely mesmerized
Gotta study the masters to become one yourself
We all level up by learning from each other
It's all fuzzy...but weirdly familiar at the same time
I'm actually tearing up. Been forever since music hit me this hard
Don't worry though! It'll come back to me eventually
With you helping me out, I'll crack this mystery for sure!

strings.text: What's going on? Why the panic?
Do i find a repair guy?
But i'm broke ... like cant-afford-lunch broke...
We'll fix her, buy a new one. We can even make a wish at the Monolith...
I'll do whatever it takes to help.
Ehe... Turns out i was just passing out from hunger
Vision got blurry for a sec. Midas is actually totally fine
Stay put. I'm coming over right now!
Do you think I should've debuted in a group instead?
A little late to be asking that, isn't it?
Well, a "band" isn't really supposed to be just one person
I admit, it is a little unusual.
Couldn't find anyone to stick with long-term?
The musicians I've played with were all nice enough
But it always felt like something was missing
I'm sure you'll find the right fit eventually.
Or honestly? It might not even matter if you don't.
Because whoever you play with, whatever the instrument
you always find a way to harmonize perfectly.
You know, whenever I talk to you, Producer
It feels like all my doubts just clear away
I was gonna wait to tell you in person later
But never mind, i can't wait
I got paid for the gig!
So i can finally pay you back
for all those meals you covered for me
Gonna pay it all off in one go!
That's great news. But no rush—feel free to just pay back a portion for now.
Did you make sure to keep enough for your own living expenses?
Thanks for reminding me. Totally forgot about that part
I'll tell u the rest when we meet up!
Producer, you know a lot about music, right?
You never show off. So humble
Eh? You aren't just being modest?
Because I noticed something a while ago
Producer, you really understand people's hearts
Most people just hear the melody
But you "see" the story behind it
Aaaah, I wish I had a gift like that...
Nothing i write feels fun anymore...
Every creator hits a wall eventually.
Come out with me right now! Let's go find some inspiration!
I'm gonna be performing on stage for the competition!
Hehe couldn't have done it without your support
You'll stick with me through the whole thing, right?
Hope i can make it to the biggest stage someday
and have you right there in the front row, listening to me play

strings.text: I'm Arbiter Gerie, from the Grand Sanctum.
May the God of Grace watch over you.
Do Arbiters need to punish heretics?
Arbiters don't punish heretics; it's the Grace that wish to purify them...
To cleanse the filth with divine agony~
Great ==SEX12==, a question for you. What are your thoughts on pain?
Do I need to have thoughts on it?
Hmm... The less of it, the better, I think.
But I believe only pain and suffering can lead to salvation.
Is that true? The price of this salvation is a bit too heavy.
It's a heavy burden I must bear.
So, have you been enjoying your life today? ;)
Only an honest heart can glimpse the truth of Grace.
We aren't meant to fully comprehend the ultimate Grace.
I can feel ... the wound pulsing...
My faith shines brilliantly in this overflowing blood!!!
This is the kiss of Grace! I shall offer this pain and blood as a sacrifice!!!
This is the sweetest spot on the path to salvation!
Grace is watching me NOW!!! I shall be ELEVATED!!!
?? Even if it's a small wound, please bandage it quickly!
I will follow this road, for pain is the torch in the darkest night...!!!
??? I'm getting one of the others to come help you.
How can this pain be shared with anyone else...
Please, don't worry about me... I will attend to it myself...
Please avoid getting injured in the future! And absolutely do not toy with your wounds!
"Embrace all pain while you're still young."
What do you think of that, Great ==SEX12==?
If you start looking for suffering now
you'll probably still have endless suffering later on.
Oh, is that how it works?
Understood. I'll go savor some suffering at once ;)
It's supposed to be about spiritual hardship
So it's encouraging you to build resilience and temper your will...
care to come and temper my soul?
The God of Grace hasn't looked upon me for a long time.
You mean you haven't felt pain recently? That's great news!
But I haven't felt alive in ages!
I can't stand it any longer!!
But you told me I mustn't hurt myself!!!
Please pull the rope!! I need it now!!!
Um... I'll head to the sanctuary right now...
...It’s still not enough... I’m developing a kink for this...
Hey! I'm still on the way!
Something deeper than faith is surging through my veins...
Is it you, Great ==SEX12==? Don't leave me...
Just hold on! I'll be right there!
Great ==SEX12==, I've been pondering something lately.
This might sound a bit abrupt, so my apologies.
If you were to pass away suddenly one day, could you have me handle the funeral arrangements?
Leaving aside the "suddenly pass away" part...
how exactly would I contact you after I'm dead?
Right. I suppose I didn't think that through.
I get where you're coming from, Gerie.
But for now, I plan on staying in the world of the living.
For a very, very long time.
So if you want to be there for my final moments
you'll have to live that long too!
But to make it up to you...
This world is so ugly, yet you remain untouched by it.
May the blessings of Grace protect you.
I never used to care much about this day.
But since that accident, I've really come to understand what it means to be alive. So now, I cherish it.
Let's not get all serious on your birthday.
In that case... Will you spend the day with me? ;)
I'll be praying while I wait.
Am I asking for too much grace, perhaps?
Next time we go to the Monolith, if we need to go deeper, let me take point.
And if we have to retreat, I'll cover our backs.
It's my duty to mend the wounds of this world.
And it's my responsibility to keep everyone safe.
I can't let you do that.
Please, don't worry about me. I can handle it.
Strategy is key in battle. Everyone has a role to play, and we have to stick to it.
Similarly, getting hurt isn't just about one person.
Even if you aren't afraid of the pain, that kind of worry spreads through the whole team.
Just because you say you're okay doesn't mean we'll just stand by and watch you get hurt.
Your compassion shines just as brightly as it did that day.
Is that me on the Disc?
That must be who I was back then.
Back then, I must have been shattered into pieces...
But the God of Grace looked right past me.
The gates to Underworld were closed to me. I was rejected.
So I picked myself back up. My pilgrimage isn't over yet.
Isn't that a good thing, though?
I've forgotten all the suffering I went through.
Now, I wander in search of salvation.

It's a heavy burden I must bear.
So, have you been enjoying your life today? ;)
Only an honest heart can glimpse the truth of Grace.
We aren't meant to fully comprehend the ultimate Grace.
I can feel ... the wound pulsing...
My faith shines brilliantly in this overflowing blood!!!
This is the kiss of Grace! I shall offer this pain and blood as a sacrifice!!!
This is the sweetest spot on the path to salvation!
Grace is watching me NOW!!! I shall be ELEVATED!!!
?? Even if it's a small wound, please bandage it quickly!
I will follow this road, for pain is the torch in the darkest night...!!!
??? I'm getting one of the others to come help you.
How can this pain be shared with anyone else...
Please, don't worry about me... I will attend to it myself...
Please avoid getting injured in the future! And absolutely do not toy with your wounds!
"Embrace all pain while you're still young."
What do you think of that, Great ==SEX12==?
If you start looking for suffering now
you'll probably still have endless suffering later on.
Oh, is that how it works?
Understood. I'll go savor some suffering at once ;)
It's supposed to be about spiritual hardship
So it's encouraging you to build resilience and temper your will...
care to come and temper my soul?
The God of Grace hasn't looked upon me for a long time.
You mean you haven't felt pain recently? That's great news!
But I haven't felt alive in ages!
I can't stand it any longer!!
But you told me I mustn't hurt myself!!!
Please pull the rope!! I need it now!!!
Um... I'll head to the sanctuary right now...
...It’s still not enough... I’m developing a kink for this...
Hey! I'm still on the way!
Something deeper than faith is surging through my veins...
Is it you, Great ==SEX12==? Don't leave me...
Just hold on! I'll be right there!
Great ==SEX12==, I've been pondering something lately.
This might sound a bit abrupt, so my apologies.
If you were to pass away suddenly one day, could you have me handle the funeral arrangements?
Leaving aside the "suddenly pass away" part...
how exactly would I contact you after I'm dead?
Right. I suppose I didn't think that through.
I get where you're coming from, Gerie.
But for now, I plan on staying in the world of the living.
For a very, very long time.
So if you want to be there for my final moments
you'll have to live that long too!
But to make it up to you...
This world is so ugly, yet you remain untouched by it.
May the blessings of Grace protect you.
I never used to care much about this day.
But since that accident, I've really come to understand what it means to be alive. So now, I cherish it.
Let's not get all serious on your birthday.
In that case... Will you spend the day with me? ;)
I'll be praying while I wait.
Am I asking for too much grace, perhaps?
Next time we go to the Monolith, if we need to go deeper, let me take point.
And if we have to retreat, I'll cover our backs.
It's my duty to mend the wounds of this world.
And it's my responsibility to keep everyone safe.
I can't let you do that.
Please, don't worry about me. I can handle it.
Strategy is key in battle. Everyone has a role to play, and we have to stick to it.
Similarly, getting hurt isn't just about one person.
Even if you aren't afraid of the pain, that kind of worry spreads through the whole team.
Just because you say you're okay doesn't mean we'll just stand by and watch you get hurt.
Your compassion shines just as brightly as it did that day.
May the blessings of Grace protect you.
Is that me on the Disc?
That must be who I was back then.
Back then, I must have been shattered into pieces...
But the God of Grace looked right past me.
The gates to Underworld were closed to me. I was rejected.
So I picked myself back up. My pilgrimage isn't over yet.
Isn't that a good thing, though?
I've forgotten all the suffering I went through.
Now, I wander in search of salvation.

strings.text: Occasionally, deep within the Monolith, I will encounter dying Trekkers
Some of them are gravely wounded from fighting Stellaroids
Others have undergone severe mutations after lingering there too long
Either way, they will never be able to leave the Monolith
Yet I would not call it a tragic sight. Their pilgrimage of suffering has reached its end
Yes, the proper thing to do is to grant them the coup de grâce
At the moment they draw their last breath
The pain or madness vanishes completely from their face
All that remains is a kind of loneliness that I don't recognize
You really are a good observer...
Heretics always flee in panic when they see me
Why are they unwilling to raise their weapons to defend their wicked beliefs?
Is it because they feel powerless facing the verdict of Grace?
I don't think that's the case...
I think they're simply afraid of you
Their feeble convictions can't sustain them in a fight to the death
From the moment they turned their backs on Grace, weakness and hypocrisy were branded into them forever
When judgment descends, all they can do is scatter in fear
Gerie, you and your power are incomparable
Do you remember our earlier conversation? The one about pain and suffering?
Heh, thank you for your concern.
I only meant to discuss it as an idea
Even though Grace made me suffer, it also knew I wasn't beyond redemption
If I could simply endure it, sooner or later, I shall be once again redeemed
Any pain that cannot lead one to transcendence is endured in vain
Boss, today an elderly woman came to the sanctum to confide in me
Her husband passed away not long ago, and she is still in mourning
That kind of loss is truly hard for one to accept
Indeed, there is very little we can do
We can never truly feel another's grief of lost family
We can do little except for offering some comforting words
If someday, you were to go before me...
What a heavy burden that would be for me
Why are you talking about me dying again?
O God of Grace, if I am found sinful, then let the miraculous one guide my path
Yet on this pilgrimage, I cannot see a future where the two of us reach the end side-by-side
If I am destined to be alone at the last, is this encounter a miracle—or simply another divine punishment?
My apologies, Boss. I guess I lost it again
Boss, when my magic energy is at its peak
I would keep recalling fragments from the past
The creaking ropes of a swing
The heavy wooden doors of the sanctum
Though most of them have grown blurry
Even though you've forgotten most of it
Still, the most important fragments remain buried in your consciousness
And they can be awakened by magic
Yet those fragments seem slightly different each time
Because memory is a living thing. It keeps changing
Forgotten details are replaced by things that never really happened
I remember, the first time I went to see the Chief Justice...
The novices gripped my hands tight; I thought my judgment had finally come
She pushed the door open a crack, and a scent like the fireworks from the Snowish Festival drifted out
The Chief Justice spoke of miracles and absolution
I was terrified, but in the end, I was taken in
It was clearly a good thing, yet whenever I recall it, I still feel uneasy
The past always feels unbearable to me
What you can't bear is only your memories and imagination
Perhaps you were too lonely as a child and didn't have friends by your side
Boss, my magic almost went out of control again just now
Don't worry. I've calmed down already
In that moment, I could feel the energy surging through my veins
Then, a searing heat and a wave of pain began to consume my entire being
Fortunately, I injected the sedative in time
My mind is at its clearest after the magic fades
The searing pain cleanses my soul once more
Is this, too, a part of Grace?
I don't want injections anymore. What I want is love.

Pssh, you don't understand how satisfying it is to procrastinate at work
The Great Laru is gonna hook a huge one today!
WHERE IS MY ASSISTANT?! WHERE'S MY CREW?!
WHERE U AT RN?? ANSWER ME NOW!!
DOESN'T MATTER WHERE!! YOU HAVE TO SEE THIS!!!
CHECK OUT THE ABSOLUTE UNIT I JUST LANDED!
Thing's gotta be like TEN POUNDS!!
Even random seagull passing by were like "Daaang, nice fish!!"
Look, not to burst your bubble
But you need to get back here ASAP if you want to survive this
AAAAH buy me some time!! I'm omw back!!!!
Heyyy, haven't seen you around lately?
They're fresh outta the fryer! Better hurry before the seagulls get 'em!
Are you sure you actually work here?
How are you out getting fries again?
Eh, boring details. Stop asking questions! C'mon, meet me at the pier.
Uhhh, never mind, don't bother coming.
Uh oh. A seagull just jacked your fries...
Yeah, and not only did it steal your fries, it left a little...surprise...on my hand.
This meeting's been for two hours straight.
I've literally fallen asleep three times already! And it's still not over!
You sitting through a whole meeting? That's rare.
Sounds like a good time for another nap then
I was just about to make a break for it, but Albedo caught me right at the door!
Dragged me right back in and stuck me in the front row
Can't! My back is totally killing me from sitting here forever
I need to get outta here and get some fresh air like, rn.
Can't you just use the "gotta use the restroom" excuse?
The number one classic escape move! How did it slip my mind?!
Thx for the reminder! Operation Escape starts!
I AM SO MAD RIGHT NOW!!!
So I brought this new bait today, right? And I accidentally spilled like, HALF THE BAG.
At first I was like, whatever, extra bait, guess I'm celebrating my massive haul early!
First some people started arguing nearby, then others started fighting!
And then someone just started chucking trash into the river!
ALL THE FISH GOT SCARED AWAY!!!
Half a bag of bait down the drain and I got totally SKUNKED!
I'm seriously about to explode here!
Oof, that's some seriously bad luck...
How about some fries? My treat.
No need, already stuffing my face with some comfort fries.
These fries are actually pretty amazing today, so I guess I'll forgive those idiots. For now.
But if I see them again, I swear I'm gonna jab 'em right in the butt with my lance.
Today is just perfect? Beautiful breeze, not a cloud in the sky
Did someone steal your phone? Who is this??
I forgot my fishing rod when I left this morning
So now I'm ditching work with nothing to do
Where are you?? C'mon, let's grab some fries
Not everyone can just slack off whenever they feel like it!
Yeah yeah, so are you coming or not?
I'll be at the pier waiting!
Okay, hypothetical situation: Let's say I don't wanna be in the office today
Could you maybe, possibly, send a commission request to our Grace Imperium
say you're heading to a Monolith and urgently need assistance from someone like ME?
Aww, don't say no so fast!
How about a bribe? Fresh, hot fries, courtesy of your Great Laru!
Just help me out this one time
But if you want to go to the Monolith, why do I need to send the commission?
Duh! Because tagging along with you Trekkers to the Monolith is way easier!
I can fudge the hours on the form
And zero boring work reports when I get back
Next big fish I catch is all yours, promise!
Just this once. Don't make it a habit.
YES! I knew you were the best Boss ever
Guess where I am right now!
Shouldn't you be at the office right about now?
Shouldn't you be at the office right now?
Pfft, office? At this hour? As if!
Hey! Is fishing seriously the only thing you think I do?
And getting fries at the pier.
Hey, there are lots of awesome fry spots, you know.
True, but if you're at the pier, besides fries
maybe you'll get other unexpected surprises?
Can't you say something nice for once?
Alright, spill it. Where are you really?
Isn't it your birthday today? I got you a cake
Oh wow, you're right! Hahaha, it totally slipped my mind!
Well, get yourself up here then! Cake's waiting!
So, I've been thinking about something lately
You know how my lance conducts electricity, right?
What if, like, during a thunderstorm, I just hurl it and stick it right into some enemy?
Wouldn't it turn into a lightning rod?
One massive bolt from the sky and ZAP! Instant toasted bad guy!
Gives off a divine punishment vibe, don't you think?
Okay, but before you chuck your lance
So how exactly do you plan to make sure the lightning fries the enemy and not you?
What sent your head down this particular rabbit hole?
Just some dumb assignment. We have to demonstrate our combat techniques.
Guess it's back to the drawing board.
It's a disc record I found in the Monolith.
For some reason, I feel like you should have it.
Okay. But what's the point of the music?
Although, anything from a Monolith probably has some kinda special function, right?
Like maybe if I play it, it'll hypnotize all the fish in the water
and they'll just line up one by one to jump on my hook?
Is fishing literally the only thing in your mind?
Well, now that you mention it...
This music does sound kinda familiar
Like I've heard it somewhere before...
Sounds familiar to me too. You always hum a little tune when you reel in a big fish
That little song you hum sounds a lot like this
Seriously?? I don't even realize I'm doing it!
Whatever, I'll take this disc off your hands.
Definitely gonna try it out on my next fishing trip

strings.text: Queen Laru just did the coolest thing ever!
Don't you do that all the time?
I was parading my catch around town to show it off when I ran into a poor mother and daughter from the Ash District
They looked so hungry, so I just gave them the fish
Well?! Isn't Queen Laru just the sweetest saint alive?!
That was actually really sweet of you.
Why does that sound so sarcastic? Are you mocking me?
No way!! I mean it! Seriously! From the bottom of my heart!
Heh. Alright then, I'll believe you this time
What are you in the mood for supper?
I dug up a HUGE bucket of clams today
I guess you could say that?
You agreed way too fast. Definitely a trap...
I caught a bunch of massive crabs today
Great! So when you come over
make sure to grab some roast chicken, bread, dessert, drinks... Oh, and a fruit basket would be perfect!
So THAT was your plan all along!
Just had a huge epiphany while I was fishing
You know how a standard workday is eight hours?
If I speedrun all that work and finish in just ONE hour
I get to slack off for the other seven
Which basically means my hourly rate for that one hour of actual work is 8x the normal wage!
Does Albedo know this is how your brain works when you're skipping your shift?
Come on, you have to admit this is a groundbreaking discovery!
I've got a major business proposal for you
I think we should revisit that idea from last time
you poach me from Grace Imperium, put me on your payroll, and let me work for you instead
Then boom, you instantly have a cute girl on your staff
And what value would you actually bring to the company?
Go splash some cold water on your face. You're dreaming.
No fish pics. No dinner. No hiring your friends. And no, I don't want to discuss "the truth of the universe."
You stole all my lines! What am I supposed to say now?
Bastelina just messaged me. She said Albedo is hunting you down.
Should I send her a screenshot of this chat?
I just baited the water here! I can't let the bait go to waste!
Well, that depends on the bribe.
Plus one fish from today's catch
You say that every time, but you always come back empty-handed...
You didn't have to call me out like that!
Alright, I'm just messing with you.
But seriously, get back to the office. Albedo is really looking for you.
Thanks for the heads-up. I'll pack up and head back
Guess what's on my mind right now
Get it right and you get a prize
You're obsessing over the size of that fish that got away earlier.
Okay, but that fish WAS huge!
Wait, no! That's not it! Guess again
Then is it some new trick for slacking off without getting caught?
Hahahaha! Well? Was that cheesy enough for ya?
Okay okay, my bad. Just joking
Your boss is standing right next to me. She read everything.
You nearly gave me a heart attack!

strings.text: hey boss, sry to keep u waiting!
sooo let me introduce myself properly
you've got such a unique scent, boss...
i have a feeling you're gonna be an interesting person!
I need to get a phone that can smell things next time!
hehe, that was just a quick sniff from when we met earlier~
boss, i've got some fresh shaved ice here!
come to the little hut on the shore if u want some!
I'm gonna get baked to a crisp...
it's got condensed milk and fruit jam on it...
taking a big bite on a scorching summer day...
and that chilly rush washing over your tongue!!
a sweet, rich taste like a memory of last summer
Okay okay, you're making me drool.
boss, got any good ideas for makin' money by the sea?
pfft, all the treasure's been found already
it's super hard to make money that way without, like, a whole supply chain, y'know?
u gotta find a way to make us rich, boss!!!
there's some sashimi for u on the rack
just caught it from the deep sea!
the quality drops super fast once it's out of the water
so i sent it right over with my snow rabbit
hey bosss, if I remember right, u can't swim, can u?
don't worry! even if you dissolve
i'll just scoop you back up with a spoon, bit by bit
so what happens if u fall in the water by accident then?
I'll call you before I sink...
aww u really trust me that much!
boss, I tried frying some dried fish today!
the second batch wasn't crispy enough
but it didn't taste as good as I remember from when I was a kid
why do u think that is?
Nothing beats itself in the memory.
maybe the taste itself isn't all that different
but I'm no longer who I was back then
and I'm just now realizing this town isn't so big after all
even the taste of fried fish on my fingertips isn't the same anymore
did u know? Hugging before setting sail is an ancient tradition for seafarers
probably before our written language even existed!
it was already a super important way to show how you feel
back in the age of discovery
generation after generation of explorers set out to sea
they gave their lives to the tides
so that the shape of our continent could slowly be drawn
people hugged before leaving so they wouldn't have any regrets
That hug must have been worth a thousand words.
sometimes we get so caught up in the meaning of words
that we know exactly when they don't mean a thing
so instead of talking and talking, a tight hug is way better
Things just got a little heavy...
after all that typing, wanna go for a walk, boss?
let's go to the coast, the weather's amazing today
a perfect day for watching the sunset
we'll head over together in the evening
oh! and wear sandals or flip-flops
the spot i picked is super special
at night, the tide comes all the way up to your calves
feeling the waves come n go is like proof that I'm really here, y'know?
being with someone on your birthday like that... it's the best feeling ever
trust me, you'll love the feeling of the waves on your ankles
how was the little water exercise just now?
Just please don't flip my floatie over next time...
You grabbed me before I even started to sink.
I felt so safe when you held my hand.
awww, now you're making me blush
it was totally my fault, after all
Don't worry about it. We can go again sometime!
u know that record from the coast
the one that was half-drowned in the water?
Oh, right! Did you find anything out?
or more like, i REMEMBERED a lot
when i touched the grooves on the vinyl
i could smell the afternoons from when i was a kid again
and i saw that perfect shade of blue from back then
i'd spend every lazy afternoon just soaking in the sea
the tingle from the sea breeze nearly took my breath away
those days just... stopped one day, poof! gone
the shouts of the street vendors, the smell of pickled snacks from the shops...
it all faded away, like sea spray...
It's okay! Even if you can't get back what you lost,
we can make new memories together!

strings.text: A new restaurant just opened near me
I went to check it out today
I ordered a dish called Bobo Fish
It's a bit like spicy boiled fish slices
The amount of fish fillet in it was truly pitiful
Yeah, it was mostly just bubbling soup
Which contained mostly bean sprouts and whatnot
I felt like even the soup base was one of those pre-made seasoning packs. They probably got it wholesale from United Harvest
A few days ago I submitted a paper to the Association journal
It was about Monoliths in coastal waters
Oh, oh? How did it go?
By the time I got to the review comments, I broke out in a cold sweat
The abstract can't just be a simple summary of the main text
And I only reached vague, empty conclusions that didn't really explain the matters I discussed
In short, it needs major revisions, but the reviewer gave a lot of concrete suggestions
And they did say to revise carefully and aim for publication
A veteran with tons of experience, probably
I feel like there's a lot I could learn
But at the same time, it also feels like they're dangling a fishing bait in front of me...
The sky looked especially beautiful this evening. I was so happy
Nothing happened at all. I was just happy, for no reason
The living room was empty and quiet. The laundry Artifact was rumbling on the balcony. I could lift my eyes and see the sea
The cries of seabirds, the scent of detergent, the evening breeze passing through the room
It was such a bliss. I almost wished time could stop right then and there
The rose-colored sky reflected inside the room. Fingers brushing the Runic Disc, listening to the melody
That's what life is supposed to be like
Agree, that's what life is supposed to be like!
Boss, I'm planning to go out to sea alone for a while
I was working at a fish-drying yard a while back
Before curing and drying, the fish have to be scaled, gutted, deboned, then sliced
So I was processing catches nonstop. Ah... Endless fish...
That stifling environment left me really down
The only way I can wash that smell off me is by going out to sea
Is that what people call "work stink"?
Maybe. That smell of "not being free," mixed with an overly heavy fishy odor.
It's like holding seawater in your hands. If you don't let it flow freely in the ocean, it just turns into cloudy brine, lifeless
It's fine. She can take care of herself
This is not the first time I've done something like that
Nice! Then I wish you a smooth voyage!
Remember to contact me when you can!
Boss, I'm out at sea right now
It's fine. Trust my sailing skills
Even in the storm, I can steer with one hand and message you with the other
Right now it's just me, the wind, the rain, and the sea
They surround me, rocking me back and forth
To be honest... The loneliness of sailing by myself is always hard to bear
And that feeling becomes magnified when you're facing the vast ocean
The storm forces me to focus, letting me forget that heaviness for a while
In times like this, I can shout at the top of my lungs and let everything out
The sound of heavy rain hammering the waves also helps cover up such undignified behavior
Boss, my sea journey will soon come to an end
Hahaha, it feels like it took quite a while
I miss you because that's just how I feel, not because you miss me
Karin said she had prepared a feast
Yes! I'll be on my way at full speed
I'm gonna be the first face you see when you return to port!

We should go hit the claw machines sometime!
but i still have work to do...
but i don't wanna eat instant noodles any more
Philae is an important grain production area for United Harvest
There should be plenty of good food here.
well, there's a lot of it, i guess
but the food in philae is all about quantity
doesn't mean it's actually any good
so, ==PLAYER_NAME==! what do you know about united harvest?
Why the sudden interest in the United Harvest?
Thinking of getting an office job?
but there's one thing i probably have in common with their office workers
we both want the company to go bankrupt already
can't go on like this anymore!
i'm gonna defend my daily life with everything i've got!
i'm gonna work extra hard at slacking off, and waste time with all my might
that's the life i gotta defend
wanna come over and help me defend it?
On my way to join the cause!
had a weird dream last night
what else can it be besides claw machines
oooh! you know me so well, ==PLAYER_NAME==
in my dream i was trying to grab a Count Chompchomp the Shark in the claw machine
but i lost my grip and it fell
then the claw machine god appeared
"did you drop... this golden Count Chompchomp the Shark, or this silver one?"
shouldn't I be getting the praise...?
You're really good at sewing, Nazuna.
But your sewing skills are definitely more amazing.
it took me a whole week
i even picked out a fabric specially for it
i'm gonna put it somewhere everyone can see it
But no sticking pins in it, okay?
heheh... depends on what kind of mood i'm in...
We've got cake, so get over here.
save some extra seats for my friends

and King High Flyer needs an extra stool
and Princess Windrise HAS to sit right next to me
...whatever... i'm no longer who i used to be...
guess i gotta try a little...
it had me on it, and everyone else
we were so close back then
felt like nothing could ever tear us apart
anyway, i'm sure we'll be like that again someday!
You're just going to wait for time to fix everything?
I think you should be more proactive about it.
Don't let this chance slip away.
i won't let go this time!

strings.text: I saw a report that said
40% of grown-ups still have plush toys
and 30% sleep with a plushie toy every night
Do you keep plushies on your bed, too?
I'm afraid I'd crush them in my sleep, so I put them somewhere else
I'll get you one next time
That makes sense. It'd be bad if they got damaged
Didn't expect you to have such refined taste
I feel like you are a full-blown plushie addict
I knew that full well. No hope for the likes of me, hehe
But that fluffy texture... Once you start touching it, you can't stop
I've been put in charge of training some newcomers
When Kaede first asked me about it, I actually wanted to turn it down...
Eh... What did you tell her?
That my legs felt sore and I had an acne breakout
And something about success knocking on my door
And how did that turn out?
All of them were rejected, every single one. Looks like I'll have to learn to be strong this time...
Aren't you being a bit overdramatic...?
You know how some people desperately collect responsibilities, and then desperately try to dump them
But I, the Lord Nazuna, play no such games
Don't worry. Since I've taken the job on, I'll see it through to the end
Some new Trekker recruits recently... Ahem...
They're saying I act all immature...
Instructor Nazuna, you're acting all high and mighty...
You know, there was a time when I thought being a grown-up was very cool indeed
Wearing crisply pressed clothes, holding résumé with my teeth
But you know me. I realized that kind of life is not me
And I won't be able to carry my friends with me all the time
Forget it, forget it. I'm gonna keep being a kid for the next twenty years, at least
==PLAYER_NAME==, I've started a bulk order purchase
That's right, it's for plushie toys
Custom-made plushies are very very expensive!
If I can get other people to buy together
The cost then gets spread out
So what kind of plush are you after this time?
Don't you already have something similar...?
No no no, this one's completely different from before
I'll show it to you once it's made!
And now as the Manager, I'm gonna go whip that bulk order into shape, since I'm the sponsor, organizer and all
They said I set the bulk order price really high and made a huge profit from it
So how much was one plush?
Only sixteen thousand Dorra each, and it even comes with handmade clothes
Exactly! Other places charge over twenty thousand for a 12-inch!
It was purely a labor of love!
It has to be other shady business owners who's badmouthing me out of jealousy!
My new friend, all 16 inches of it!
That's right! After powering through all kinds of slander and rumors...
The bulk order has finally come through!
I even reserved one for you~
But right now it's just the base doll... No winter outfit yet...
The outfit won't arrive for another month...

strings.text: Seriously, we've known each other for a while now. Why are we only adding each other now?
Because all kinds of stuff kept getting in the way!
I don't care. Next time, you're not allowed to forget
How would there even be a next time after we've already added each other?
When you get a new phone?
The point is, don't forget that I'm on your friends list now!
You are literally standing right across from me right now
Why did you suddenly walk away?
You were sneaking glances at me just now, weren't you?
I was only looking at Shia. She's right next to you
Then I won't be able to walk, will I?
Then I'll hold your hand and lead you
That's right, you're basically a pet, so I have to keep an eye on you or you'll get into trouble!
Usually, the seeing-eye dog is the one doing the leading...
Now you're the one stealing glances at me
Give me the realest, rawest, most unfiltered, straight-to-the-point answer I've ever heard!
What kind of dessert do you like?
That's got nothing to do with it!
What's wrong with that? I'm a savory-snack person
Those are sometimes used as fish bait, you know...
Ugh! Why didn't you tell me earlier?!
Pfft... Hahahaha~ Look at your face~
If it really was fish bait, would they actually sell it to people?
What I meant was, I'll go with whatever you like
So why are you asking me this all of a sudden?
I'm in town, and I figured I'd pick up some snacks to bring back
Then you don't need to ask me. You should ask Shia, right?
I already know what Shia likes. I'm asking you
I haven't even been staying at your place that long, though...
Finish the snacks before you leave!
Why did you take up swimming all of a sudden?
Seeing how amazing you and Shia are makes me feel a bit wistful
Just think about how long we've been training
Besides, when we practiced, we had each other watching our backs
Though, honestly, it was mostly Shia watching mine...
Think of it as a reward for how well you've been behaving lately...
But the tide's coming in now, so the beach isn't a good place for it
Oh, I know. You can practice your form in the inflatable pool
Are you getting in the pool, too?
Of course. I have to hold your hand, don't I?
What's wrong? Are you getting cold feet?
No, I mean... It just occurred to me, but...
Does this count as bathing together?
I was so tired yesterday that when I got back, I lay down on the bed and fell asleep right away
I forgot to take my contacts out...
Why do you have to take them out before bed? Is it bad to keep wearing them?
I don't know how it works, but it is written on the instructions that come with the contact lenses I wished...
"It's best not to sleep while wearing them."
Then take them out for now. You probably shouldn't go out today either
You don't like wearing those thick glasses, right?
Hmph. You sure are good at guessing
I also know you'll be bored at home by yourself today
Why do you understand me so well?
So, do you want me to come over or not~
Thought maybe you lost your phone
I just got back after a commission...
Anything you want me to do?
Am I not allowed to call on you if nothing happened?
There should at least be a reason, right...?
Don't tell me you've been doing surveillance on me
I mean, I do have to keep an eye on you...
I was looking through an animal encyclopedia earlier, and I saw something about rabbits
It said rabbits can get sick if they get too lonely...
I'm kind of curious about that book now, too
Can I come over and read it with you?
Don't be so impatient. All in good time, yeah?
I'm picking things out with Shia right now
Oh, that was taken care of way back then
Right now, we're actually picking out a cake
I wanna pick it out with you guys!
You just wait at home, okay? Can't have the birthday girl do all the work
Oh, I forgot to say it this morning, so I'll say it now
You looked really pale just now
Anyone would be scared if they saw a shark half the size of a boat
Sometimes when we're hunting out at sea, it just suddenly shows up
When it meets you for the first time, sure
So I fought it, but in the end, neither of us would back down
Then I found out it likes fish cakes, so sometimes I toss it some as an escort fee
When it's around, it keeps other big sea creatures from coming over and causing trouble
But most of the time, it's the real troublemaker!
What a strange bond you two have
And this time it gave you a scare, too
I'll remember this. Next time I see it, I'm bonking that giant head
You're surprisingly impressive when it comes to things like this, Karin
Of course they can. You can safely say sound is a part of memory itself
I heard a strange melody in the Monolith just now...
For a moment, it felt like I remembered something
I see. No wonder you suddenly froze
Usually, this is where you'd say you didn't hear anything
True. But we're inside a Monolith right now. Anything can happen here
So my guess is, you must have heard a melody from your memories
Okay. Even though I don't really get it...
But... That memory was like a kind of fruit
The first bite tasted bitter, but then, very quickly, there was a sweet aftertaste
The way you described that, Karin. That was so you
What's that supposed to mean? You're making fun of me again...
Fine. Since I got to experience something amazing this time, I'll let it slide

Then you don't need to ask me. You should ask Shia, right?
I already know what Shia likes. I'm asking you
I haven't even been staying at your place that long, though...
Finish the snacks before you leave!
Why did you take up swimming all of a sudden?
Seeing how amazing you and Shia are makes me feel a bit wistful
Just think about how long we've been training
Besides, when we practiced, we had each other watching our backs
Though, honestly, it was mostly Shia watching mine...
Think of it as a reward for how well you've been behaving lately...
But the tide's coming in now, so the beach isn't a good place for it
Oh, I know. You can practice your form in the inflatable pool
Are you getting in the pool, too?
Of course. I have to hold your hand, don't I?
What's wrong? Are you getting cold feet?
No, I mean... It just occurred to me, but...
Does this count as bathing together?
I was so tired yesterday that when I got back, I lay down on the bed and fell asleep right away
I forgot to take my contacts out...
Why do you have to take them out before bed? Is it bad to keep wearing them?
I don't know how it works, but it is written on the instructions that come with the contact lenses I wished...
"It's best not to sleep while wearing them."
Then take them out for now. You probably shouldn't go out today either
You don't like wearing those thick glasses, right?
Hmph. You sure are good at guessing
I also know you'll be bored at home by yourself today
Why do you understand me so well?
So, do you want me to come over or not~
Thought maybe you lost your phone
I just got back after a commission...
Anything you want me to do?
Am I not allowed to call on you if nothing happened?
There should at least be a reason, right...?
Don't tell me you've been doing surveillance on me
I mean, I do have to keep an eye on you...
I was looking through an animal encyclopedia earlier, and I saw something about rabbits
It said rabbits can get sick if they get too lonely...
I'm kind of curious about that book now, too
Can I come over and read it with you?
Don't be so impatient. All in good time, yeah?
I'm picking things out with Shia right now
Oh, that was taken care of way back then
Right now, we're actually picking out a cake
I wanna pick it out with you guys!
You just wait at home, okay? Can't have the birthday girl do all the work
Oh, I forgot to say it this morning, so I'll say it now
You looked really pale just now
Anyone would be scared if they saw a shark half the size of a boat
Sometimes when we're hunting out at sea, it just suddenly shows up
When it meets you for the first time, sure
So I fought it, but in the end, neither of us would back down
Then I found out it likes fish cakes, so sometimes I toss it some as an escort fee
When it's around, it keeps other big sea creatures from coming over and causing trouble
But most of the time, it's the real troublemaker!
What a strange bond you two have
And this time it gave you a scare, too
I'll remember this. Next time I see it, I'm bonking that giant head
You're surprisingly impressive when it comes to things like this, Karin
Of course they can. You can safely say sound is a part of memory itself
I heard a strange melody in the Monolith just now...
For a moment, it felt like I remembered something
I see. No wonder you suddenly froze
Usually, this is where you'd say you didn't hear anything
True. But we're inside a Monolith right now. Anything can happen here
So my guess is, you must have heard a melody from your memories
Okay. Even though I don't really get it...
But... That memory was like a kind of fruit
The first bite tasted bitter, but then, very quickly, there was a sweet aftertaste
The way you described that, Karin. That was so you
What's that supposed to mean? You're making fun of me again...
Fine. Since I got to experience something amazing this time, I'll let it slide

Come on, make a guess! That's what makes it fun!
There are so many things in a tool cabinet

With this thing, we can drill through even thicker ice

To an ice-covered lake in the nearby mountains, of course!
Are we going to make it back alive?
The Snowish Festival is almost over...
Now I have to go back to work again!

You were basically working when sending those gifts

All the suppliers will go back to work and start sending over piles of new documents
All lovely things come to an end

strings.text: You were staring at me there
Is there something you'd like to say to me?
I was just looking at your syringe
I've never seen you dressed like this
Ah, this one's a little different from the usual kind
Don't worry, I'm not going to use it on you
I changed into it especially for today. Fits Cangwu's festival vibe, doesn't it?
You know, people who tell lies get dragged off by demons and get experimented on
Only you want to run experiments on me!
Anyway, I'll sign off for now
But I am glad to see you in Cangwu
Let's find a time to talk properly later
Do you know how to make window paper-cuts?
I thought if you were interested, I'd invite you to come join us
Jinglin is teaching me how to make them
Are you interested in learning it?
I thought if you were interested, you can join us
There may not be a Monolith in Cangwu, but there are many in the surrounding area
I thought I should find time to make a visit
Well then. How about tomorrow? Want to come with me?
This is too sudden, I'll pass...
Sure, I've got nothing lined up tomorrow
Then I'll wait for you in front of Yunji Retreat tomorrow morning
A bit too on the fly for me. Can we do a different day?
I'll scout the route myself then
When you feel like going together, ==PLAYER_NAME==, just let me know
==PLAYER_NAME==, I met a kid today who wasn't afraid of syringes
Not only did she not cry, she came over to ask if she could touch it
So bold... Could be doctor or researcher material
Are you thinking of taking this kid on as a student?
Not at the moment. I haven't got the energy
Just thought it was a rare quality
If I see her again, maybe I'll entertain her for a bit
I could have her accompany me on a monster dissection
Or let her observe me doing a surgery
Wait a minute, you sure that's appropriate for kids?!
Or did you indulge in market snacks again?
Just two days ago, you gorged on them to the point of stomach pain, so much that you couldn't walk, and Shimiao had to carry you to me.
I only had one skewer of candied haw today... No way I overate!
And I had lunch on time, too!
Still, if you've consumed a lot of sugar, I suggest washing it down with liver-cleansing tea
Come by my inn later; I'll mix a digestive herbal tea for you
You're not making one of your weird brews again, are you?
If it's another "Calming Bone Brew," I'm not touching it...
My tea can only be beneficial for you
I saw a patient at Jinglin's place today with a kind of fleshy growth I've never encountered
It looked so unpleasant the other customers complained nonstop and wanted him thrown out
So with his permission, I examined him on the spot
But the cause is unclear. I gave him my card and told him to come find me in Philae
You're still as obsessed with strange diseases as ever
Well, only humans get all these bizarre ailments
But you're different. Your very existence already fascinates me
Whether I say it or not, it's simply a fact
Are you free tonight, my dear assistant?
And here I was, all bored
What do you need me for?
I've mixed a new essential oil that relaxes the nerves. I need a volunteer to test it
If it's dinner, I just made a reservation at a Loong-cuisine restaurant
No. Is there anything else you want to do?
I've mixed a new essential oil that relaxes the nerves
If you're free after the dinner...
We can take a walk and then test it at my inn
The last time you "tested" something on me, my legs were weak for three days...
That just means you were too tense. I'll be gentler this time
You mean you'll gently massage me while analyzing the nerve state of my muscle fibers!
But it sounds fun, doesn't it?
Today is truly a special day
Is today a special day or something?
So you really didn't remember my birthday. How disappointing
Of course I remember your birthday!
Honestly... And here I even decorated everything before tricking you into coming!
But since you already let the cat out of the bag, you might as well come over right now
Lately, I feel like I have come to understand you better
I know your body data like the back of my hand
Based on your muscle strength and how you apply force
I think we can come up with a combat style that suits you best
What did you think I meant?
But speaking of your body data...
There's one particular data point I've been thinking about lately...
Perhaps I can measure it when I see you tonight
Have you heard it somewhere before?
But strangely enough, when I listen to it, I remember the days when I first arrived in Philae
It's not associated with a particular memory...
But my heart skipped a beat, and my eyes stung a little
Is this what they call body memory?
Even if the mind forgets, the body remembers
Experiencing it firsthand feels so different from reading about it in a patient's notes
I thought you were being sentimental for once and was about to comfort you
Perfect timing. I just brewed a new potion
I shall be supremely comforted if you're willing to try it
