strings.text: ==PLAYER_NAME==, come find me in the guest room on the third floor of that inn tonight
What do you mean, what am I planning?
You're not trying to lure me over there, tie me up, and conduct some shady experiment on me, are you?
Of course not. How long have we known each other?
Do I really seem like the kind of person who would do something like that?
Sigh... You're always misunderstanding my intentions. It really hurts...
The inn has just added a new dish to their menu, and I wanted to try it with you, that's all
I'm sorry that I got the wrong idea
Why do I still feel like something's off?
If we're just having dinner, couldn't we meet in the lobby? Why did you specifically get a room?
Because there are too many people downstairs
They'd get in the way of me observing you while you eat
I knew it! I knew you had some ulterior motive!
The room's balcony is the best spot for fireworks. I wanted to watch them with you
Honestly, you could've just said that from the start
It wouldn't be too much to ask for a blood sample while we're at it, would it?
I knew it! I'm not going!
Don't say that! I already ordered the food!
Someone from the Baize Bureau came to see me this morning
Did they find out you were researching some illegal medicinal tea?
Even if I were researching something like that, there's no way they'd ever find out
The Snack Fair is just around the corner again
They're looking for an on-site physician
Makes sense. The food at the Snack Fair is always so good
Every time, there are people who are already stuffed but keep on eating anyway, then they throw up or get a stomachache
Are you sure you're not talking about yourself?
Just meet up with me first that day
But as my assistant, make sure you don't eat yourself sick before we even get started
Cangwu really is the kind of city that makes it hard for you to leave
Sometimes I can't help wondering whether I should just stay here for good
For one thing, there's all sorts of delicious food here
And since it's all the way on the other side of the Nova Continent, some illnesses here are different from the ones in Philae and Emor
Besides, the Loong's medical practices are well worth studying as well
Coronis, are you going to stay here?
I still have patients back in Philae who need looking after
If I stayed away for too long...
I knew it, you really are a good doctor who worries about the patients
No. I'm simply curious to see how their conditions develop
You know, ==PLAYER_NAME==? In Loong medicine, there's a concept known as "pulse pattern"
By reading someone's pulse, you can diagnose their general condition, and even what they're thinking
I have heard that you can get a general idea of a patient's condition from their pulse
But being able to tell what they're thinking sounds pretty much like a scam
Based on my own experiments, it probably isn't~
When we met in Cangwu, I found an opportunity to record the changes in your pulse
After studying pulse patterns over the past few days, I've managed to work out roughly what you were thinking at the time
Just as I thought, you get nervous when you see me. Don't you, ==PLAYER_NAME==?
I wonder why. Are you simply afraid of seeing a doctor? Or... Is it because it's me?
Back in Philae, you were always trying to experiment on me
I thought you tailed me all the way to Cangwu!
Hehe. Very good. Looks like I guessed right~
I don't think that really required much guessing
You were wearing something completely different from your usual style
And then you suddenly ran into me in Cangwu. Anyone would be a little cautious
That's unexpected. Completely different from what I guessed
Well. This feels a lot like ... those fortune-tellers with crystal balls in Emor's Ash District
They lead you along with a few simple prompts, then give you vague descriptions that could apply to almost anyone
It makes you feel as though they've read you perfectly or predicted things with incredible accuracy
When really, there's no basis for any of it. They're just making things up
Hmm... Now that you mention it, that's true
Still, it is certain that a patient's general condition can be diagnosed from their pulse alone
Mm-hmm! I've heard that many older Loong physicians diagnose patients that way
I should make time to visit some of those elders
How was the tea I gave you last time?
You mean that tea for digestion?
I was feeling a little woozy after eating all those sweets
But after I drank the tea, I was quickly myself again
Sounds like it worked very well
See? I wasn't lying to you
The teas I make are nothing but good for you
So this time, I've blended a new one
I call it "Dreaming Butterfly Sleep Tea"
It's meant to help you sleep
I could tell that from the name
Well? Would you like to help me test it, too?
I've already tested it on animals and monsters
After the Alpha Boar drank some water mixed with my tea, it was lights out
Now I want to try it even less
That's just animal tranquilizer, isn't it!
What if I never wake up?
Then I suppose I'll have no choice but to turn you into a specimen for my personal collection
Come to think of it, running into you here was a good thing
Have you ever heard the Loong saying about meeting an old friend far from home?
It's one of what they call the "four great joys of life"~
Since it's such a joyous occasion, we ought to celebrate properly
And leave behind a few mementos that belong only to the two of us
Didn't we already celebrate by eating at that hot pot restaurant?
I think every place we've visited together in Cangwu, every person we've met, and everything that's happened over these past few days...
Are the best mementos I could ask for
So... While neither of us has to head back just yet
Let's make a few more memories that belong only to us
Now that, I like the sound of that
To be honest, I'm already getting a little impatient
Let me get a little closer to you ... to study you properly

param: ==PLAYER_NAME==, come find me in the guest room on the third floor of that inn tonight
What do you mean, what am I planning?
You're not trying to lure me over there, tie me up, and conduct some shady experiment on me, are you?
Of course not. How long have we known each other?
Do I really seem like the kind of person who would do something like that?
Sigh... You're always misunderstanding my intentions. It really hurts...
The inn has just added a new dish to their menu, and I wanted to try it with you, that's all
I'm sorry that I got the wrong idea
Why do I still feel like something's off?
If we're just having dinner, couldn't we meet in the lobby? Why did you specifically get a room?
Because there are too many people downstairs
They'd get in the way of me observing you while you eat
I knew it! I knew you had some ulterior motive!
The room's balcony is the best spot for fireworks. I wanted to watch them with you
Honestly, you could've just said that from the start
It wouldn't be too much to ask for a blood sample while we're at it, would it?
I knew it! I'm not going!
Don't say that! I already ordered the food!
Someone from the Baize Bureau came to see me this morning
Did they find out you were researching some illegal medicinal tea?
Even if I were researching something like that, there's no way they'd ever find out
The Snack Fair is just around the corner again
They're looking for an on-site physician
Makes sense. The food at the Snack Fair is always so good
Every time, there are people who are already stuffed but keep on eating anyway, then they throw up or get a stomachache
Are you sure you're not talking about yourself?
Just meet up with me first that day
But as my assistant, make sure you don't eat yourself sick before we even get started
Cangwu really is the kind of city that makes it hard for you to leave
Sometimes I can't help wondering whether I should just stay here for good
For one thing, there's all sorts of delicious food here
And since it's all the way on the other side of the Nova Continent, some illnesses here are different from the ones in Philae and Emor
Besides, the Loong's medical practices are well worth studying as well
Coronis, are you going to stay here?
I still have patients back in Philae who need looking after
If I stayed away for too long...
I knew it, you really are a good doctor who worries about the patients
No. I'm simply curious to see how their conditions develop
You know, ==PLAYER_NAME==? In Loong medicine, there's a concept known as "pulse pattern"
By reading someone's pulse, you can diagnose their general condition, and even what they're thinking
I have heard that you can get a general idea of a patient's condition from their pulse
But being able to tell what they're thinking sounds pretty much like a scam
Based on my own experiments, it probably isn't~
When we met in Cangwu, I found an opportunity to record the changes in your pulse
After studying pulse patterns over the past few days, I've managed to work out roughly what you were thinking at the time
Just as I thought, you get nervous when you see me. Don't you, ==PLAYER_NAME==?
I wonder why. Are you simply afraid of seeing a doctor? Or... Is it because it's me?
Back in Philae, you were always trying to experiment on me
I thought you tailed me all the way to Cangwu!
Hehe. Very good. Looks like I guessed right~
I don't think that really required much guessing
You were wearing something completely different from your usual style
And then you suddenly ran into me in Cangwu. Anyone would be a little cautious
That's unexpected. Completely different from what I guessed
Well. This feels a lot like ... those fortune-tellers with crystal balls in Emor's Ash District
They lead you along with a few simple prompts, then give you vague descriptions that could apply to almost anyone
It makes you feel as though they've read you perfectly or predicted things with incredible accuracy
When really, there's no basis for any of it. They're just making things up
Hmm... Now that you mention it, that's true
Still, it is certain that a patient's general condition can be diagnosed from their pulse alone
Mm-hmm! I've heard that many older Loong physicians diagnose patients that way
I should make time to visit some of those elders
How was the tea I gave you last time?
You mean that tea for digestion?
I was feeling a little woozy after eating all those sweets
But after I drank the tea, I was quickly myself again
Sounds like it worked very well
See? I wasn't lying to you
The teas I make are nothing but good for you
So this time, I've blended a new one
I call it "Dreaming Butterfly Sleep Tea"
It's meant to help you sleep
I could tell that from the name
Well? Would you like to help me test it, too?
I've already tested it on animals and monsters
After the Alpha Boar drank some water mixed with my tea, it was lights out
Now I want to try it even less
That's just animal tranquilizer, isn't it!
What if I never wake up?
Then I suppose I'll have no choice but to turn you into a specimen for my personal collection
Come to think of it, running into you here was a good thing
Have you ever heard the Loong saying about meeting an old friend far from home?
It's one of what they call the "four great joys of life"~
Since it's such a joyous occasion, we ought to celebrate properly
And leave behind a few mementos that belong only to the two of us
Didn't we already celebrate by eating at that hot pot restaurant?
I think every place we've visited together in Cangwu, every person we've met, and everything that's happened over these past few days...
Are the best mementos I could ask for
So... While neither of us has to head back just yet
Let's make a few more memories that belong only to us
Now that, I like the sound of that
To be honest, I'm already getting a little impatient
Let me get a little closer to you ... to study you properly

strings.text: Just let me know if you ever need a hand with anything
Okay, that might not be a very precise way to put it
Within the Trekker Association's purview, I'll do everything I can to help you
As for things that I cannot...
If there's someone I can contact to aid you, I won't leave you to deal with it alone
Judging from the clouds this evening, it might rain tomorrow
If I remember correctly, you said you wanted to take a boat out to sea tomorrow?
Will the weather really be that bad?
If my experience's anything to go by, it's gonna rain cats and dogs
You can check again tomorrow morning
But if the clouds haven't cleared, don't force it
The ocean can be very dangerous on a rainy day
Rain inevitably brings wind and waves
And you are a terrible swimmer
If something happens, you won't be able to look after yourself.
Of course I am! This isn't something to joke about!
Yeah, I see what you mean.
Earlier at the beach, people caught a huge sandworm
One of the kids was so scared that they started crying
Sandworms are actually delicious, you know?
Back in Sailstead, whenever the tide went out, we all loved heading to the shore with buckets and shovels to forage
One time, Leafia dug up an entire bucket full of nothing but sandworms
Please stop ... I can already picture it...
It really makes you wonder—what was going through the mind of the very first person who ate a sandworm?
Maybe they thought, "What if it tastes good?"
You've never tried one, have you?
I'll take you to try some next time
Don't look like you're marching off to your death!
Treat yourself to a nice meal!
Go take a hot bath and relax!
Hmm... I can't think of anything I'm especially craving lately
Hot pot's not really something you eat by yourself
Maybe we could go get hot pot together tonight?
Sure! I know a really good place.
A good idea, to be sure
But it's still pretty early. What should I do tonight after that?
I think there's a bonfire dance on the beach tonight. Do you want to go check it out with me?
Sure! Where should we meet up?
Are you free right now? Could I ask you for a favor?
I think my arm is running low on power
But I can't step away from my work right now. Could you help me go find Bloc?
By the way, if you run into those Grace Imperium people...
Well... Buying and selling Neo Solution is the kind of thing we should probably keep low-profile
Also, Bloc should be at the dessert shop this evening
Maybe you'd want to try it
Then I'll bring one back for you, too!
Oh right, there's something I want to tell you...
On a second thought... Never mind
You can't just leave me hanging like that!!!
What were you going to tell me?!

If you don't tell me I'm going to be thinking about it all night then I won't sleep a wink and lie there staring at the ceiling until morning then show up at your office with dark circles under my eyes and stare at you
I just wanted to ask whether our plan to go surfing still stands?
It's just that you've been so busy these past few days
I was going to ask you about it this weekend
Right. You always keep your promises
Never mind, then. Let's go next weekend. See you then!
Yay! I'm already looking forward to it!
Uh, you're not here for a spot check to see if I'm staying up late, are you?
Is that what you think of me?
Nothing, really. I just suddenly started thinking about some things in the middle of the night
Horizon told me today that a Trekker filed a complaint against me, saying I hadn't done enough to help him
He didn't have a leg to stand on, and Horizon already dismissed the complaint, but...
Oh, man... But it's not your fault at all, Willow!
The person making unreasonable demands is the one who should be ashamed!
I know, but when I suddenly remembered it just now...
I feel kinda down about it...
Still, saying it out has made me feel a lot better
I mean, I'm not a superhero. It's normal to have feelings when something like this happens, right?
Of course. That's just normal human emotion.
I think I've come to accept it. There are so many people in the world, and some of them are just never going to like me
As long as I know I did nothing wrong, that's enough
I just remembered—didn't we have plans today?
Sorry, there's been so much going on that I think I got things mixed up
But I do remember promising to keep today free for you... It was today, right?
But you don't remember what day it is today?
It's a day with flowers and presents
Oh, I get it. And besides those, you need cake too, right?
But thank you for remembering it for me
Then let's put work aside today and go relax properly~
Got it. Then please wait for me for a little bit
Don't tell me you forgot about our swimming lesson today
I'm awake. I was just brushing my teeth!
I thought you might be ignoring me on purpose to get out of training
How did you know? The thought did cross my mind when I first woke up
Do you really think I don't know you by now?
Make sure you don't forget anything, and remember to eat breakfast
You are like a worrywart mom, Willow...
I only worry this much because it's you!
Honestly, somebody had to show up for swimming lessons last time without even bringing a swimsuit
Now hurry up and get ready. I'll be waiting for you at the beach!
No running away at the last minute!
I feel like I've heard this melody somewhere before
Was it from inside the Monolith? Or...
How strange. I feel like there's a blurred memory somewhere in my mind...
I'm fine. It's just that, when I listen to this melody, I feel like I'm remembering something
But all I can vaguely recall is how I felt back then
If it hurts, don't force yourself!
Maybe I shouldn't have given this to you...
No. Actually, I should be thanking you
It's reminding me that I have seemingly forgotten a very important memory
Forgetting is a form of betrayal against one's self. Even if that memory is painful, I think I should try to find it again
Then let me stay with you!
When you remember it, whether it turns out to be painful or happy...

strings.text: Looks like the invite went through. Try saying something!
Take your time. You can type the whole thing out before hitting send.
Okay, getting a little scary there!
What just happened? You sure you don't need help?!
I pressed send and the device spat out all those words on its own.
How hard did you press it for that to happen...
Don't do that. You'll break the screen!
Just give it a light tap. Nice and gentle.
There is much I don't understand Ellipsis
I hope you can teach me Exclamation Point
I think I see the problem...
Looks like you still don't really know how to use the keyboard.
See the symbols? Just pick the one you want.
If you want to send an emote, it's the same method too.
I don't mean that. I mean these
An assassin has infiltrated the device!
That's not an assassin. It's just a... picture, a picture in the phone! It expresses my feelings!
I already had my hand on my hilt.
Very well. So what exactly is this emote we were discussing?
Let's just drop it for now...
If every Night Watcher carried one, it would drastically improve our communication.
Though upon further reflection, I do see a potential risk.
Staring at the screen constantly divides one's attention.
Your situational awareness drops, leaving you vulnerable to accidents.
A lot of people back home don't even realize that
Pretty impressive you caught on to that so fast
I was so focused on our conversation that I walked straight into a tree.
I'm trying to fix it. Give me a moment.
Take all the time you need...
Lulu is throwing a tantrum. She threw out my prized bread.
You should talk to her. You can't just throw food away
Yes. I bought it at the market ages ago. It smelled wonderful.
I was saving it for a special occasion, so I kept it for her birthday today.
Bread goes bad! Lulu definitely chucked it because it was covered in mold
What a waste. Just because it had mold on it...
Spoiled food goes in the trash
And before you even touch a stove, we need to have a serious talk about expiration dates
Understood... I will not make this mistake again.
In that case, I will take her to the market right now to buy a fresh loaf.
Never took you for a bookworm
It is actually more like listening.
I cannot read well, so Lulu and Elis explain things to me.
Did you suddenly decide you want to go to college?
A place where a bunch of wise people get together
I see. You are wise, did you go to one of these colleges?
Actually, I never went to college either... I think?
So what kind of books are you reading?
It's just a sudden whim. Do not act so shocked.
I'm helping rebuild some houses soon, so I wanted to learn the basics.
You're not just hauling stones but actually helping with the redesign?
Correct. I want the new houses to last.
Elis has a grander vision. She wants to completely redesign the streets of Filanis.
It's like she's planning a thousand years ahead
Others have said as much. But they are already doing everything they can just to feed their families.
Elis believes her power obligates her to shoulder more responsibility.
Honestly, being willing to learn all this and help rebuild... I think you're pretty amazing yourself
Thank you. Hearing that gives me a second wind.
I noticed a tiny mark at the bottom of our messages.
Does that carry the same meaning as a document being reviewed?
It just lets you know the other person saw it
I see. In that sense, it is much like exchanging letters.
There is an added layer of confirmation. Once you send a message, you must wait for that mark to appear.
It places an invisible burden on both the sender and the receiver.
Wow, you figured that out already?
Are you sure you've never used a phone before?
I'm simply putting myself in the other person's shoes.
I know people who write letters. I understand the emotions they go through.
The longer the wait, the heavier the anxiety.
But receiving a reply turns that anxiety into joy.
I would not say I hate waiting. If waiting is inevitable, I will endure it, and look forward to the moment it ends.
We've never really talked about things like this
Feels like I'm getting to know a whole new side of you
Perhaps that is the true value of writing letters on a phone.
Is there a way to erase text?
Unsend? You mean ... you can ask the text to come back?
Think of it as deleting a message you sent
Hate to break it to you, but your phone doesn't have that function
Then this is different from writing letters. It is more like speaking.
Spoken words cannot be taken back. I must choose every word with the utmost caution...
Just type whatever comes to mind
If you make a typo or forget something, just send another message
Your first message didn't look like a typo, though
Did you accidentally hit send before you finished?
That is all I wanted to tell you!
I miss you too, by the way
I would like to unsend my words now...
Got any favorite drinks or recommendations?
Because I didn't have anything sweet on hand when you visited.
And you didn't complain at all.
I prefer things on the sour side
I just figure anyone who drinks sour stuff must be pretty tough.
I have met nobles with all sorts of tastes, but very few of them can handle sour.
Have you ever tried it yourself?
I have. I bought a cup at the market upon Lulu's recommendation.
She said the look on my face alone could keep her laughing all day.
Now I kinda want to see it
Please don't make fun of me...
They're sweet and sour drinks with a lot of fizz. They make your mouth tingle when you drink them
Is that a beverage from your homeland? I'm quite curious.
But I apologize, I cannot find anything similar around here.
I was just throwing it out there
So why the sudden question about drinks?
It appears today is my birthday. People have been sending me fruit since dawn.
I was planning to make some fresh juice.
Oh, it's your birthday today too?
A friend of mine has the exact same birthday.
She'd be thrilled to know she shares it with a Knight Captain.
Please wish her a happy birthday for me.
Done with today's sparring. I feel like I have improved since last time.
How do you normally train anyway?
Wooden dummies? Or sparring partners at your level?
Both. But more accurately, I fight imaginary enemies in my mind.
Who makes the cut for an imaginary enemy?
Sorry, I didn't mean to open old wounds...
Do not apologize. That is not what I meant...
I ruined the mood. I'm sorry.
I was actually referring to the puppets I faced in the Grand Arena.
They were powerful, and could mimic my movements flawlessly. That is why I answered "both."
But since they will never appear again, I can only fight them in my mind.
Are there no other Night Watchers who can spar with you?
Some are naturally gifted and learn fast.
But crossing swords with them simply turns it into a one-sided lesson.
While I love watching them grow, if I'm to protect everyone, I must train against opponents far stronger than myself.
Spoken like a true Knight Captain!
You flatter me. After hearing your stories, I know your path has been far from easy as well.
Often, the enemies you face cannot be defeated by a sword alone.
A companion of mine said the exact same thing. But having them by my side is the only reason I get to stand before my enemies in the first place.
Allow me to ask, what exactly is a Runic Disc?
You can think of it as a disc that holds memories
If you tinker with it, it even plays a special tune
Then why is my portrait on this one?
Because it's a memory of you
Do you remember what you were doing there?
I have ... faint memories of it.
I was lost during that time, so I went to the lake alone.
Then I simply swung my sword, until I couldn't swing it anymore.
But for some reason, talking to you made that feeling of being lost fade away.
Memories are always a bit hazy
I'm just glad you found your way again!
Yes. And I will continue to protect you with this sword, just as I always have.

Is that a beverage from your homeland? I'm quite curious.
But I apologize, I cannot find anything similar around here.
I was just throwing it out there
So why the sudden question about drinks?
It appears today is my birthday. People have been sending me fruit since dawn.
I was planning to make some fresh juice.
Oh, it's your birthday today too?
A friend of mine has the exact same birthday.
She'd be thrilled to know she shares it with a Knight Captain.
Please wish her a happy birthday for me.
Done with today's sparring. I feel like I have improved since last time.
How do you normally train anyway?
Wooden dummies? Or sparring partners at your level?
Both. But more accurately, I fight imaginary enemies in my mind.
Who makes the cut for an imaginary enemy?
Sorry, I didn't mean to open old wounds...
Do not apologize. That is not what I meant...
I ruined the mood. I'm sorry.
I was actually referring to the puppets I faced in the Grand Arena.
They were powerful, and could mimic my movements flawlessly. That is why I answered "both."
But since they will never appear again, I can only fight them in my mind.
Are there no other Night Watchers who can spar with you?
Some are naturally gifted and learn fast.
But crossing swords with them simply turns it into a one-sided lesson.
While I love watching them grow, if I'm to protect everyone, I must train against opponents far stronger than myself.
Spoken like a true Knight Captain!
You flatter me. After hearing your stories, I know your path has been far from easy as well.
Often, the enemies you face cannot be defeated by a sword alone.
A companion of mine said the exact same thing. But having them by my side is the only reason I get to stand before my enemies in the first place.
Allow me to ask, what exactly is a Runic Disc?
You can think of it as a disc that holds memories
If you tinker with it, it even plays a special tune
Then why is my portrait on this one?
Because it's a memory of you
Do you remember what you were doing there?
I have ... faint memories of it.
I was lost during that time, so I went to the lake alone.
Then I simply swung my sword, until I couldn't swing it anymore.
But for some reason, talking to you made that feeling of being lost fade away.
Memories are always a bit hazy
I'm just glad you found your way again!
Yes. And I will continue to protect you with this sword, just as I always have.

strings.text: A terrifying legend is told in a summer seaside town: A green light from a "Ghost Ship" flickers out on the distant sea. You witness that eerie light, and are engulfed by the ocean...
"In the downpour of a stormy night, an eerie green glow blooms at the edge of the ink-black sea."
"It's a long-corroded ship, without sail or oar, its deck piled high with bleached bones."
"A dozen figures stand frozen on deck, drenched and rigid, locked in the very moment of their deaths."
"Their faces have rotted into empty sockets that stare into the endless night."
"Their souls are forever trapped on the ship, unable to find peace or escape."
"The lanterns in their hands swayed with a ghastly light, like demons' eyes,"
"luring naive sailors, step by step, toward an abyss from which there is no return."
"That light is the unfinished whisper of the dead, and the eternal curse that has sunk to the seafloor."
"Once you get close, there is no turning back..."
Stop it! How's anyone supposed to get any sleep after that?!
Sun, sand, and the ocean.==W== Now this is what I call summer!
Oh! They've got snack stands and drink shops over there! Heck yeah!
Ugh, this sun... I'm burning up.==W== Maybe I should just change back.
No way!==RT====W==You gotta wear a swimsuit at the beach!==W== 'Sides, you look super cute, Iris. Right, Boss?
Totally. It looks great on you.
Okay, if Boss thinks so, I'll try...==W== Yikes! Amber, your arm's like a block of ice!
Indeed... Amber doesn't look hot at all.
Everyone's in a swimsuit, but their states are completely different.
Ooh, let me!==W== Ahhh, that feels amazing...
Boss, if you're feeling hot too,==W== you can...
N-No, I'm good! Let's just find some shade over there.
Noya insisted on telling that Ghost Ship story last night.==W== I couldn't get the image out of my head and was up till sunrise.
... I'm kinda hung up on it, too.
Rotted face... What's that even look like?
Is it just the skin rotting off, or does the skull melt?
...==W== Okay, okay, let's drop it. Any more of this and no one's getting any sleep tonight.
Hey, I was just reading the commission Mistique sent!
She's the one who asked us to investigate this Ghost Ship. Gotta know what we're walking into, right?
Speaking of, where's Mistique? She's late for our meet-up.
Bet she's hiding somewhere, spying on us. Again.
Heh heh! Busted for talking behind my back!
Mistique?! Where'd you pop out from?
...==W== Under the coconut tree by the drink stand?
I saw you too. Didn't interrupt 'cause I thought you were catching crabs.
O-Oh...==W== You guys are sharp, New Star Guild...
Nothin'~ I say you've passed my little sneak-attack test! Now, for the main event!
Alright, team. For this commission, I need you to help me hit the streets and crack the case of the Ghost Ship legend.
Crack the case? So, you think the legend is fake?
Legends always start with a grain of truth. They just get ... exaggerated in the retelling.
A mysterious light does appear out at sea. That much is a fact.
But whether that light is a "Ghost Ship"? That's just speculation.
But you know how rumors get spun...==W== Give it enough time, and even a simple glimmer of light★ can become a terrifying tale.
In fact, some rumors claim the "Ghost Ship" is just a hoax to hide something that certain people want to keep secret.
Something to "keep secret"... Well, well. How cliché.
The light emerged again after that big storm a few days back, and now the whole town's in an uproar.
This is my chance to uncover the truth and land a front-page story!
When I get my annual bonus from Scarlet Sights Media, I'll make sure you're all generously rewarded.
I've already scouted some key locations. Your job is to go ask around.
I've got a bad feeling about this.
Ah, what the hell. Might as well enjoy the summer beach vibe while I'm here.
Good. My cover's holding. This "swimsuit" is the perfect camouflage to blend in with the crowd.
Now, back to tailing Boss.==W== This time, I won't fail.
I've been asking around all day and have come up with nothing.
Since the light appears so far out at sea, no one's actually seen it up close, making this investigation a real challenge.
Strange... Some locals just scoffed when I mentioned the "Ghost Ship." I guess they didn't buy into that kind of tall tale.
Boss, thanks for your help today! Give the beach one last look for me, please?
Sun's down. If anyone's lurking, they'll be making their move now.
Yell if you see anything, and I'll zip right over on my broom! ★
Alright, alright. I'll go check again.
Seriously, "lurking"? Are there really shady people out here?
Huh? Am I seeing things?==RT==That light... It's flickering.
No, I'm sure of it. That's—
I move closer. A single point of light bobs on the sea, fading in and out with the swell of the waves.
"A dozen figures stand frozen on deck, drenched and rigid..."
Who are you?!==W== No, wait—where am I?!
Hey, don't be scared. It's okay~<size=60>♪</size> Just breathe.
Ah, sorry. Didn't mean to yell.
Hmph. Can't believe they let someone this sketchy on board. Makes no sense...
Okay, she's definitely not a fan of me.
So, all I remember is the wave taking me, and then nothing.==W== What is this place?

strings.text: Two strange rabbit girls rescued you. They're heading out to find the source of the ghost ship's glow.
==SEX1== just woke up. Let's not get ==SEX4== too worked up.
How are you feeling? Any discomfort?
I'm okay ... just a little fuzzy-headed.
That's probably from the lack of air when you were drowning. A good rest should clear that right up.
Lucky for you. We'd just set sail when we spotted you flailing in the waves.
If Shia hadn't fished you out, you'd be shark food by now.
Th-Thank you both so much! You saved my life!
Oh, it was nothing! Helping someone in trouble is just the right thing to do.
When I pulled you up, you were clutching this lantern.==W== Where'd you find it?
In the sea...==RT====W==A wave swept me away when I tried to grab it.
... Ahem. I take back what I said about you being lucky.
That lantern was on our deck. Must've gotten knocked overboard when the waves picked up.==W== I was looking everywhere for it ... and found you instead.
We're so sorry! It's our fault you ended up in the water.
It's okay. You saved me, so we're even.
...==W== So this really is a lantern from the "Ghost Ship."
Let's introduce ourselves. I'm Shia,==W== and this is Karin.==B== We sailed from the port in Carlo Town.
Carlo Town... Isn't that the town we're investigating?
Shia, Karin. It's a pleasure to meet you both.==RT==I'm ==PLAYER_NAME==, but you can just call me Boss.
B-Boss?!==W== What a weird name to go by...
Alright, 'fess up. Why were you skulking around here by yourself?
Which guild are you from? Who sent you?
Easy there. I'm just a regular Trekker.
That's mine. Sorry, I should get this.
Hmph. Your backup checking in, I suppose.
We couldn't get a hold of you! We were all worried sick.
Sorry, there was a little accident... I fell into the ocean.
You fell into the ocean?!!==RT====W==Boss, are you hurt? Where are you now?
It's all Mistique's fault! Sending you to investigate the beach when she knows you can't swim... I should've gone instead!
Hey, sorry to make you worry. I'm fine. Some kind people pulled me out. I'm on their boat now. I'll be back soon.
Oh, thank goodness...==RT====W==We'll be at the food stall by the beach. See you in a bit!
Yep, see you in a bit!
I'm definitely in for an interrogation when I get back.
... Why are you looking at me like that? Did I say something wrong?
You just said you'd be "back soon," correct?
Wait... It's just open sea in every direction.
As you can see, we're already a long way from the shore.
And we're on an important mission which puts us on a tight schedule. We can't take you back.
Still, you look pretty pathetic. I'll spare you some canned food so you don't starve or somethin'.
Oh, Karin, don't be so harsh.
Why're they looking at me like that?
We're stopping by an island tomorrow for supplies. Probably can find someone to give you a lift back to town.
For tonight, though, I'm afraid you'll have to stay on the ship with us.
Got it. So, you're headed somewhere far?
Yep. Very, very far. Way too far for even the seagulls to follow.
Iris said the local conditions were perfect for sailing. That's why so many seafaring Trekkers operate out of here.
But not many can actually handle open-sea voyages.
Wait... Are they going after that mysterious light? That's incredibly dangerous...
Wow, I'm impressed you managed to sail out this far.==RT==I honestly thought this was just a regular fishing boat...
Ha! You bet! We're the best-known Trekkers in all of Carlo!
In terms of sheer skill, Shia's the undisputed champ!
As for me...==W== I'd probably crack the top ten.
That makes sense. Handling a multi-masted ship is one thing, but sailing into the open sea during storm season? You'd have to be amazing sailors to pull that off.
You sure know a lot about sailing for someone who can't swim.
Most people would be terrified of the sea after almost drowning. The thought of being stuck on a ship? They'd lose it.
But you're so calm. Almost ... excited, even.
So, Boss ... are you really just a "regular Trekker"?
Ahaha, I've just picked up a few things, that's all.
I heard your call just now. Something about "investigating the beach." What are you really up to?
And hey, I wasn't trying to eavesdrop! Their voice just ... carried.
You and your friends, you're here for the light at sea too, aren't you?
It's been two years since it last appeared, so a lot of people are flocking here hoping to see it. I take it you're one of them.
Well, can't really lie now. They did save my life.
Alright, you got me. The truth is...
I give them the short version of why I'm here.
Hmph... So you are after the "Ghost Ship."
You're talking to the family of Mrs. Marlene—the greatest seafaring Trekker this town's ever seen.
And...==W== Mrs. Marlene's the only one who's ever seen that light with her own two eyes.
It's true. Thirteen years ago, my grandma saw it herself...
She swore it was the glow of the Ghost Ship.

strings.text: You learn about Shia and Karin's purpose for this journey: They seek to clear their grandmother's name. For some reason, Shia is unusually affectionate toward you…
Thirteen years ago, a mysterious light appeared over the sea, plunging the whole town into panic—people thought it was a sign, an omen of some coming disaster.
Granny was the best seafaring Trekker around, so with a brand-new ship and the town's hopes behind her, she sailed out to learn the truth.
Three days and nights she sailed ... and she finally reached it.
—But it wasn't just light. It was a massive Ghost Ship, glowing in the dead of night.
Granny was gone for almost two weeks. Everyone thought we'd lost her.
Then one morning, someone found her passed out on the beach. She'd made it back in a tiny, rickety rowboat.
She was covered in bandages, clothes in shreds, worn down to nothing... I was scared stiff when I saw her.
When she woke up, she told us what happened.
Never ...==W== ever ... go near those waters.
Once you're in the Ghost Ship's territory, there's no escape.
The ghosts ... they crawl onto your ship when you're not looking, choke you, and claw at your skin ... anything to drag you under.
I tried to fight them off with a weapon, but my effort was to no avail. I had to abandon my ship...==W== If it wasn't for that spare boat... I'd just be another ghost aboard it now.
Ghost Ship... So it's actually real? I thought it was just a myth.
The sea's full of things you wouldn't believe.
That's what makes it so enticing!
But if you know it's the Ghost Ship, why risk heading back out there?
Because some people in town don't believe what Granny said.
They think the light is some huge sunken treasure.
And that the Ghost Ship was just a story she made up to keep the treasure for herself...
No wonder some folks just laughed at us when we asked about the Ghost Ship.
I'm afraid they think it's just a hoax.

Since then, the light has appeared every few years. Whether it's a coincidence or not, it always shows up after continuous summer downpours. And since that's when storms are most frequent, no one dares to go out to sea.
But it stopped appearing a few years ago ... right around when Granny passed away.
So people started this awful rumor that the light vanished 'cause Granny took all the treasure before she died.
She was trying to protect everyone, and they call her a liar... It's so messed up.
But after that big storm a few days back, the light finally returned. This is our chance. We have to find that Ghost Ship.
Oh, I get it now.==RT==You're doing this to clear your grandmother's name, right?
Exactly. And the jerks spreading those lies? They hired their own Trekkers and are bragging they'll "find the treasure within a week."
...==W== A big storm should just get rid of 'em. Right?
Did she just say what I think she said...? No, I must've misheard...
Right? Right? Right? Right? Right? Right? Right?! RIGHT?!
Granny never cared about the rumors, but I can't stand people trashing her name.
... And yeah, I need to solve the mystery she left behind.
A mystery?==RT==So her grandma was hiding another secret?
You bet! A stupid ghost ship doesn't scare us!
Besides, we even got a special camera from the Trekker Association to catch those ghosts on film!
Hmm, if you actually got a shot of the Ghost Ship...
—We can take cursed photos!==RT====W==That'll curse all the jerks who bad-mouthed Grandma! For generations! Right?!
Anyway, we're after the same thing.
Wonder if they'd let me join...
Ahem. Got a proposal for you two.
What is it? Out with it.
Since we're all here investigating the light, mind if I tag along?
I can't swim or sail, but I'm quick on my feet, and I can pull my weight. Another pair of hands, right?
Hmm...==W== What do you think, Shia?
Sounds good, but what if ==SEX=='s actually a bad person?
Like, ==SEX== could finish our food when we're asleep ... or worse, mess with the rudder!
Hehe, don't you worry, Karin~<size=60>♪</size> Boss isn't a bad person.
Does she have some kind of special ability...?
Fine. Your gut's never wrong. I'm in~
Glad to be here. This is my first time at sea, so I'll be counting on you to show me the ropes.
Mhmm! We'll take good care of you. Don't worry!<size=60>♪</size>
No sweat! The sea's got our back! Smooth sailing ahead!
... Thought I'd have trouble sleeping on a ship, but I was out like a light.
It's dead quiet in here. Are they still asleep?
Sleep okay? How was your first night at sea?
Great. Wasn't as rocky as I expected, and the bedding smelled ... nice.
Oh, you noticed...==RT====W==Sorry 'bout that. It's the blanket Karin and I use.
... Oh! You really didn't have to. The floor would've been fine.
Don't be silly. You're part of the crew now, Boss. We look after our own.
Alright, if you say so. Thanks, I appreciate it.
By the way, I thought I heard a weird noise last night. Was everything okay?
Just the waves. They got pretty rough for a bit. I was surprised you slept through it.==W== You were totally knocked out...<size=60>♪</size>
W-Wait, were you watching me sleep?
The cabin lurches, and a triumphant shout rings out from the deck.
<size=50>WHOA! What a HUGE cod! I finally caught one!
Come on! Let's see who's stronger, you or me!
She's been up fishing since dawn. Said she wanted to impress you.
How big is that fish for her to be making all that racket...
A much more violent jolt rocks the cabin. The floorboards heave, and I lose my footing, toppling backward.
Right before I hit the floor, Shia yanks the blanket off the bed and shoves it under me. I land in a soft heap.
Phew, close one.==W== You okay, Boss?
Thanks for saving me ... again. You're okay?
I'm good.==RT====W==Good thing, too. If you'd hit that floor, you could've really cracked your head open.
This blanket of yours was a lifesaver.
Hehe<size=60>♪</size> Don't be shy, you can praise me some more, you know~?
But maybe we should, y'know, get up first?
Shia's hair tickles my neck. She leans in close, taking a soft sniff right by my ear.
A moment this perfect? Couldn't pass it up.
Yep. That freshly awake scent is the purest. If I'm gonna check, it's gotta be now~
Knew it. You've got a trustworthy scent, Boss. You just might be the key to solving my little mystery.
You can tell all that just from my scent...?
Heh, didn't you know? Us bunnies have a keen sense of smell.
Still... There's something else I can't quite place.==W== Guess I'll need another sniff.
I got it! I finally got it!!
Whoa~! It's huge!<size=60>♪</size>==RT====W==How should we cook it? Stewed? Fried? Or maybe...

param: You learn about Shia and Karin's purpose for this journey: They seek to clear their grandmother's name. For some reason, Shia is unusually affectionate toward you…
Thirteen years ago, a mysterious light appeared over the sea, plunging the whole town into panic—people thought it was a sign, an omen of some coming disaster.
Granny was the best seafaring Trekker around, so with a brand-new ship and the town's hopes behind her, she sailed out to learn the truth.
Three days and nights she sailed ... and she finally reached it.
—But it wasn't just light. It was a massive Ghost Ship, glowing in the dead of night.
Granny was gone for almost two weeks. Everyone thought we'd lost her.
Then one morning, someone found her passed out on the beach. She'd made it back in a tiny, rickety rowboat.
She was covered in bandages, clothes in shreds, worn down to nothing... I was scared stiff when I saw her.
When she woke up, she told us what happened.
Never ...==W== ever ... go near those waters.
Once you're in the Ghost Ship's territory, there's no escape.
The ghosts ... they crawl onto your ship when you're not looking, choke you, and claw at your skin ... anything to drag you under.
I tried to fight them off with a weapon, but my effort was to no avail. I had to abandon my ship...==W== If it wasn't for that spare boat... I'd just be another ghost aboard it now.
Ghost Ship... So it's actually real? I thought it was just a myth.
The sea's full of things you wouldn't believe.
That's what makes it so enticing!
But if you know it's the Ghost Ship, why risk heading back out there?
Because some people in town don't believe what Granny said.
They think the light is some huge sunken treasure.
And that the Ghost Ship was just a story she made up to keep the treasure for herself...
No wonder some folks just laughed at us when we asked about the Ghost Ship.
I'm afraid they think it's just a hoax.

Since then, the light has appeared every few years. Whether it's a coincidence or not, it always shows up after continuous summer downpours. And since that's when storms are most frequent, no one dares to go out to sea.
But it stopped appearing a few years ago ... right around when Granny passed away.
So people started this awful rumor that the light vanished 'cause Granny took all the treasure before she died.
She was trying to protect everyone, and they call her a liar... It's so messed up.
But after that big storm a few days back, the light finally returned. This is our chance. We have to find that Ghost Ship.
Oh, I get it now.==RT==You're doing this to clear your grandmother's name, right?
Exactly. And the jerks spreading those lies? They hired their own Trekkers and are bragging they'll "find the treasure within a week."
...==W== A big storm should just get rid of 'em. Right?
Did she just say what I think she said...? No, I must've misheard...
Right? Right? Right? Right? Right? Right? Right?! RIGHT?!
Granny never cared about the rumors, but I can't stand people trashing her name.
... And yeah, I need to solve the mystery she left behind.
A mystery?==RT==So her grandma was hiding another secret?
You bet! A stupid ghost ship doesn't scare us!
Besides, we even got a special camera from the Trekker Association to catch those ghosts on film!
Hmm, if you actually got a shot of the Ghost Ship...
—We can take cursed photos!==RT====W==That'll curse all the jerks who bad-mouthed Grandma! For generations! Right?!
Anyway, we're after the same thing.
Wonder if they'd let me join...
Ahem. Got a proposal for you two.
What is it? Out with it.
Since we're all here investigating the light, mind if I tag along?
I can't swim or sail, but I'm quick on my feet, and I can pull my weight. Another pair of hands, right?
Hmm...==W== What do you think, Shia?
Sounds good, but what if ==SEX=='s actually a bad person?
Like, ==SEX== could finish our food when we're asleep ... or worse, mess with the rudder!
Hehe, don't you worry, Karin~<size=60>♪</size> Boss isn't a bad person.
Does she have some kind of special ability...?
Fine. Your gut's never wrong. I'm in~
Glad to be here. This is my first time at sea, so I'll be counting on you to show me the ropes.
Mhmm! We'll take good care of you. Don't worry!<size=60>♪</size>
No sweat! The sea's got our back! Smooth sailing ahead!
... Thought I'd have trouble sleeping on a ship, but I was out like a light.
It's dead quiet in here. Are they still asleep?
Sleep okay? How was your first night at sea?
Great. Wasn't as rocky as I expected, and the bedding smelled ... nice.
Oh, you noticed...==RT====W==Sorry 'bout that. It's the blanket Karin and I use.
... Oh! You really didn't have to. The floor would've been fine.
Don't be silly. You're part of the crew now, Boss. We look after our own.
Alright, if you say so. Thanks, I appreciate it.
By the way, I thought I heard a weird noise last night. Was everything okay?
Just the waves. They got pretty rough for a bit. I was surprised you slept through it.==W== You were totally knocked out...<size=60>♪</size>
W-Wait, were you watching me sleep?
The cabin lurches, and a triumphant shout rings out from the deck.
<size=50>WHOA! What a HUGE cod! I finally caught one!
Come on! Let's see who's stronger, you or me!
She's been up fishing since dawn. Said she wanted to impress you.
How big is that fish for her to be making all that racket...
A much more violent jolt rocks the cabin. The floorboards heave, and I lose my footing, toppling backward.
Right before I hit the floor, Shia yanks the blanket off the bed and shoves it under me. I land in a soft heap.
Phew, close one.==W== You okay, Boss?
Thanks for saving me ... again. You're okay?
I'm good.==RT====W==Good thing, too. If you'd hit that floor, you could've really cracked your head open.
This blanket of yours was a lifesaver.
Hehe<size=60>♪</size> Don't be shy, you can praise me some more, you know~?
But maybe we should, y'know, get up first?
Shia's hair tickles my neck. She leans in close, taking a soft sniff right by my ear.
A moment this perfect? Couldn't pass it up.
Yep. That freshly awake scent is the purest. If I'm gonna check, it's gotta be now~
Knew it. You've got a trustworthy scent, Boss. You just might be the key to solving my little mystery.
You can tell all that just from my scent...?
Heh, didn't you know? Us bunnies have a keen sense of smell.
Still... There's something else I can't quite place.==W== Guess I'll need another sniff.
I got it! I finally got it!!
Whoa~! It's huge!<size=60>♪</size>==RT====W==How should we cook it? Stewed? Fried? Or maybe...

strings.text: Midway through the journey, you stop on a small island to get some rest. There, Karin hears a strange voice. A group of ill-intentioned Trekkers reveals themselves.
Hehe, Karin. It's not what you think.
Boss tripped, and when I went to help ==SEX4== up, I lost my balance, too.
Uh, yeah, right... That's pretty much it.
To be fair, the ship was rocking like crazy because you were fighting that monster of a fish, lil' Karin.
Wait, so this was my fault?
You landed a huge catch, Boss is okay—it's a win-win, see?
She's forcing a smile, but that look is still murderous.
Alright, let's not just stand around. Time to pack up and get some breakfast.
Hey, could you and Boss do a quick supply check? We should be arriving at the next island in about an hour.
Fine. I'll be sure to ... play nice ... with ==SEX4==.
I've got a really bad feeling about this...
Bags are packed, list is checked. We should be good.
I shuffled a few things around to balance the weight distribution. My notes are on the list if you wanna look.
Wow, Boss. You're a lot more on top of things than I thought.
Heh, you're giving me too much credit.
That doesn't mean I've forgiven you for this morning!
To do that to Shia...==W== Unforgivable! Utterly unforgivable!
I didn't do a thing! I just tripped, and she's the one who came over and sniffed me...
What?!==W== She went out of her way to sniff you?!
Dang it. I shouldn't have said that. Now she's really mad...
Ha! Okay, I see what's going on. Your true identity...
What's she getting at? Don't tell me she thinks...
You're a siren right?! You've obviously bewitched Shia!
I knew somethin' was up! Why else would Shia allow you on the ship and be so nice to you? She's usually so wary of people.
She... She used to only be like that with me...
So that's what this is about. She thinks I'm stealing Shia from her.
Please—I'm begging you, leave Shia alone! If you're gonna cast a spell or anything, do it to me!
What are you even talking about?!
I'll do anything if you just turn her back to normal! You can have every fish I catch for the next few decades!
Wait... I don't need that many fish.
—And my five king crab coupons! And the three pounds of croaker my neighbor's kid owes me from a bet! Even the two giant carp in my backyard!
If that's still not enough ...==W== you can use me as bait!
I've never seen her this serious... Shia must really mean the world to her.
Look, that was a total misunderstanding. Shia probably came over to me because she detected my "scent."
She said "You've got a trustworthy scent, Boss"... To be honest, I don't really get it either.
Hmph. Shia's sense of smell is incredible. She trusts it more than she trusts her own eyes.
Grrr... What do you smell like, anyway?!
I'll just have to sneak in while you're asleep and snip off your hair! Bit by bit, I'll get enough to make a sachet ... and if I wear it, Shia will...
Fine! You pass my inspection ... for now. But I'm still watchin'!
Well, that's a relief, I guess.
Mmm, something smells amazing... Could that be...?
That must be Shia with breakfast! I'm outta here!
To my surprise, Shia's an incredible cook.
With full stomachs, we pack our gear and get ready to head ashore.
We're here! The weather's perfect today, a great sign.
This beach feels completely different from the ones back in town.
Duh! It's a deserted island. This is the ocean at its most primal!
You can catch rare fish and giant scallops around here. They sell for a pretty penny, so some Trekkers come to test their luck.
But most people just turn back here. We've still got a long way to go.
Alright team, we need to gather as many supplies as possible before sunset. Let's stick together for safety—no one gets left behind!
G-Got it!==W== You hear that, Boss? You'd better not wander off!
Says the one who's actually scared...
Huff ... puff...==W== Is this enough yet? My bag's about to burst...
The herbs are sorted, and the waterskins are full.
These vines and loose bark will be perfect for patching the ship. We even found some pine resin. What a great haul!
Think Boss is our lucky charm?
Hmph. We would've been just fine on our own, you know.
Karin, that's not very nice.==RT==Didn't the Boss offer to carry your pack for you when you were dragging your feet just now?
W-Well, I didn't let ==SEX4==! ==SEX1== was already carrying a ton of stuff...
Ugh ... ow! What did I slip on? It was so slick.
Is this... a Tawny Nightingale wrapper?!
Ugh, gross! Who just leaves their trash lying around?
This looks fresh. Could someone else be on the island as well?
But there weren't any other ships at the shore when we got here.
They might have landed from the other side of the island. The fishing season is over, so coming to the island at this time… They probably have some other intentions.
Could it be that gang who were bragging about searching for treasure?
We won't know for sure until we find them. They might have already left.
The scents here are muddled. Haven't picked up on anyone new yet.
Ah, I guess that's my cue!
As long as they're on this island...==W== I can find them!
Oh? You have a way to do that, Karin?
Every tree, every fish, every bird ... anything with a heartbeat makes a sound.
All those sounds converge and dissolve into the earth... The earth, in turn, whispers the secrets to me.
Shia and I hold our breath. Karin crouches, pressing her ear to the ground and closing her eyes. She listens for a moment, then edges a few steps forward to try a new spot.
So her hearing is just as keen as Shia's sense of smell ... transcending natural bounds.
Must be one of Flufla's gifts.
Following Karin's instructions, we cross the forest to the far side of the island.
In the distance, a wisp of smoke rises from a beach where a group is huddled around a fire, grilling fish.
Nice work, Karin. Your ears are sharp as ever.
Okay, let's circle around behind those rocks and get a better look.
If they're just passing Trekkers, we can leave. We should get back to the ship anyway, stay on schedule.
Shouldn't we get a move on? What if we get beat to the punch?
Relax. The boss has that old geezer's diary. Just follow the route, and no one's outrunning us.
If his luck hadn't crapped out on him, he'd have been there with Marlene at the very end...
Granny...?! Someone was tailing her ship?!
Marlene was just using her rep to spin some spooky tales and scare off the competition. All so she could keep the treasure for herself.
Heh, can you blame her? It's a whole Monolith! I'd want it all for myself, too!
Who knows how much loot she had squirreled away... Anyway, she's pushing up daisies now. It's our time to cash in!
A Monolith? So that's where the light's coming from...
No doubt about it. It's gotta be them!
Karin, let's go. We're gonna round 'em up. I want a word about that diary.
Boss, you stay back. We won't be long.
W-Who the hell are you?! Where'd you come from?!
Karin, their lunch looks a little ... plain.==W== Let's liven things up for them, shall we?

strings.text: All the clues suggest that their grandma lied.==RT==The "Ghost Ship" is merely a decoy to mislead others.==RT=="Facing the truth requires courage."
Quick, get the boss on the line!
We'll be doomed if things go on like this!
The boss replied! She's waiting on the ship! Let's move!
Think you can run?! Think again! Time to see what this harpoon gun can do!
Karin, you pin 'em down. I'll swing around to the ship and cut off their escape.
Those people hardly had any chance to fight back... This kind of seamless coordination is built on the trust between Shia and Karin.
My vision very soon clears, but our targets have already vanished.
Over there! Their ship's pulling away!
Dammit, what a dirty trick... I'm going after them!
Leave them. We could be walking right into an ambush.==W== We're after the same thing—our paths will cross again.
Fine. But next time, they'll get what's comin' to them!
Boss, you okay? You didn't get hurt, did you?
I'm fine ... and the supplies we gathered are all intact.
Good. It's getting late. We should head back.
Shia's been quiet... Must be upset those people got away.
And what's this about a "diary"? Could what they said about the "Monolith" ... actually be true?
You barely ate, Karin. Something wrong with the food?
N-No, that's not it...==W== Dinner was great!
The mood here is a little thick...==W== I should probably try to lighten things up.
Ahem. That's on me. I prepped the fish. Guess I missed a few scales, huh?
Heh, ever the peacemaker, aren't you, Boss?
Hey, Karin. Even the Boss can tell something's weighing on you. Talk to us about it, will you?
You're the one who's been off since we got back. You've just been moping around, and you barely even touched your soup... Don't think I didn't notice.
"Talk to us about it"? Shia, you're the one holding everything in!
Huh? I'm not... Where's all this coming from anyway?
It's what those people were saying, isn't it?!==W== Ugh, I'm gonna stuff them in a salted fish barrel one by one! That'll teach 'em to spread rumors!
She's right! Someone oughta sew their mouths shut!
Hehe...==W== I don't know what to do with you two.
Karin, Boss, you're both right. When you can't figure something out on your own, it's better to share the burden.
There is something ...==W== that has been haunting me for a long, long time.
When Granny returned all those years ago, everyone saw how badly hurt she was, wrapped in bandages from head to toe.
But ... I'm the only one who knew the truth. She wasn't injured at all. The bandages were just for show.
The first night she was back, I was too worried to sleep, so I snuck into her room to check on her.
And that's when I saw it. She'd taken all the bandages off. There wasn't a single scratch on her.
By the next morning, she was all wrapped up again... I never understood why she did it.
A few days later, I worked up the courage to ask. She denied everything. Said I was confusing nightmares with reality in my distress...
But I know what I saw. It was real.
I mean, if she really ran into it, there's no way she'd get away without a scratch. The ghosts in the legends aren't exactly friendly.
She didn't get hurt, yet pretended to be seriously injured...==W== Was it to deepen people's fear of the Ghost Ship?
W-Why are you making it sound even creepier—Aaaah!
That "diary" those people mentioned... It's been bothering me. Granny kept a meticulous ship's log for every voyage. If she couldn't write at sea, she'd fill it in the moment she got back.
But I leafed through her logbooks once. That specific trip was the only one without a single entry.
That's why on this voyage, we have to constantly get our bearings, keep a sharp lookout to log our position, and adjust our course as needed.
She must have left it blank on purpose, right? It'd be a huge problem if someone else got the log and tried to follow her route.
My thoughts exactly. With other Trekkers searching for the Ghost Ship, your grandma probably left it out on purpose.
We still need more intel... My companions are investigating back in town. I'll check in with them and see if they've dug up any new leads.
Okay. We're counting on you, Boss.
Your grandma was an impressive fighter! She must have beaten all the ghosts, which was why she came back unscathed!
If that were the case, why wouldn't she write "all ghosts defeated" in her log? The fact that she didn't ... could mean...
It means...==W== Karin might still get her chance to join the Ghost Ship's crew.
Aaaaah—==W==Stop it!! Now you're just messing with me, Boss!!
I'm just exploring the possibilities. If you're scared now, what will you do if we find a real ghost? Think you could even hold the camera steady?
Hehe. Alright, Boss, that's enough teasing. Any more and poor Karin will be too scared to sleep tonight.
Th-That's not true! I'm totally fine sleeping by myself!
Heh... Looks like everyone's finally loosened up a bit.
It's my turn for the night watch. I sort through the intel we have and give Mistique a call.
...==W== So, that's what we've got. Any updates on your end?
Of course! After a few days of clandestine investigation, this witch has unearthed something spectacular!★
Back then, several Trekker crews were tailing Marlene, but they were hit by a storm. Most of the ships turned back, all but one.
One Trekker weathered the storm and kept sailing after her. He was a zealous treasure hunter, convinced there were deep-sea treasures at the source of the light.
Hold on... You don't think the diary that group had today belonged to him, do you?
But why are they so certain the light comes from a Monolith?
—Because the man chronicled what he saw with his own eyes:==W== the source of the light was a colossal object on an island.
A massive, glowing object rising from an island...==W== It could only be a Monolith right?
If that's the case, why do most people still cling to Marlene's version of the "Ghost Ship" story?
Well, who are you more likely to trust? The living, or the dead?
So you're saying ... he never made it back? No wonder that crew said his luck crapped out on him.
Precisely. When his ship was recovered, all that was left aboard were his skeletal remains and a diary.
He was gravely injured in the storm and suffered a psychotic break. The latter half of the diary is incoherent—even his own family dismissed it as feverish delirium.
I see...==W== So how did his diary end up in their possession?
Who knows? They likely offered a handsome sum for it. One can hardly blame the family for selling...★
Right...==W== By the way, was there any mention of Marlene in the diary?
His family didn't mention her, no. I'll have to investigate that further~
Very few people are privy to this. It took considerable effort to persuade them to talk, you know.
In exchange, you need to keep close tabs on that crew for me, Boss~
Understood. I'll let you know the moment I learn anything.
Okay, at least I know where the rumor came from now. But how am I going to tell Shia and Karin?
They trust their grandmother so much...

Over there! Their ship's pulling away!
Dammit, what a dirty trick... I'm going after them!
Leave them. We could be walking right into an ambush.==W== We're after the same thing—our paths will cross again.
Fine. But next time, they'll get what's comin' to them!
Boss, you okay? You didn't get hurt, did you?
I'm fine ... and the supplies we gathered are all intact.
Good. It's getting late. We should head back.
Shia's been quiet... Must be upset those people got away.
And what's this about a "diary"? Could what they said about the "Monolith" ... actually be true?
You barely ate, Karin. Something wrong with the food?
N-No, that's not it...==W== Dinner was great!
The mood here is a little thick...==W== I should probably try to lighten things up.
Ahem. That's on me. I prepped the fish. Guess I missed a few scales, huh?
Heh, ever the peacemaker, aren't you, Boss?
Hey, Karin. Even the Boss can tell something's weighing on you. Talk to us about it, will you?
You're the one who's been off since we got back. You've just been moping around, and you barely even touched your soup... Don't think I didn't notice.
"Talk to us about it"? Shia, you're the one holding everything in!
Huh? I'm not... Where's all this coming from anyway?
It's what those people were saying, isn't it?!==W== Ugh, I'm gonna stuff them in a salted fish barrel one by one! That'll teach 'em to spread rumors!
She's right! Someone oughta sew their mouths shut!
Hehe...==W== I don't know what to do with you two.
Karin, Boss, you're both right. When you can't figure something out on your own, it's better to share the burden.
There is something ...==W== that has been haunting me for a long, long time.
When Granny returned all those years ago, everyone saw how badly hurt she was, wrapped in bandages from head to toe.
But ... I'm the only one who knew the truth. She wasn't injured at all. The bandages were just for show.
The first night she was back, I was too worried to sleep, so I snuck into her room to check on her.
And that's when I saw it. She'd taken all the bandages off. There wasn't a single scratch on her.
By the next morning, she was all wrapped up again... I never understood why she did it.
A few days later, I worked up the courage to ask. She denied everything. Said I was confusing nightmares with reality in my distress...
But I know what I saw. It was real.
I mean, if she really ran into it, there's no way she'd get away without a scratch. The ghosts in the legends aren't exactly friendly.
She didn't get hurt, yet pretended to be seriously injured...==W== Was it to deepen people's fear of the Ghost Ship?
W-Why are you making it sound even creepier—Aaaah!
That "diary" those people mentioned... It's been bothering me. Granny kept a meticulous ship's log for every voyage. If she couldn't write at sea, she'd fill it in the moment she got back.
But I leafed through her logbooks once. That specific trip was the only one without a single entry.
That's why on this voyage, we have to constantly get our bearings, keep a sharp lookout to log our position, and adjust our course as needed.
She must have left it blank on purpose, right? It'd be a huge problem if someone else got the log and tried to follow her route.
My thoughts exactly. With other Trekkers searching for the Ghost Ship, your grandma probably left it out on purpose.
We still need more intel... My companions are investigating back in town. I'll check in with them and see if they've dug up any new leads.
Okay. We're counting on you, Boss.
Your grandma was an impressive fighter! She must have beaten all the ghosts, which was why she came back unscathed!
If that were the case, why wouldn't she write "all ghosts defeated" in her log? The fact that she didn't ... could mean...
It means...==W== Karin might still get her chance to join the Ghost Ship's crew.
Aaaaah—==W==Stop it!! Now you're just messing with me, Boss!!
I'm just exploring the possibilities. If you're scared now, what will you do if we find a real ghost? Think you could even hold the camera steady?
Hehe. Alright, Boss, that's enough teasing. Any more and poor Karin will be too scared to sleep tonight.
Th-That's not true! I'm totally fine sleeping by myself!
Heh... Looks like everyone's finally loosened up a bit.
It's my turn for the night watch. I sort through the intel we have and give Mistique a call.
...==W== So, that's what we've got. Any updates on your end?
Of course! After a few days of clandestine investigation, this witch has unearthed something spectacular!★
Back then, several Trekker crews were tailing Marlene, but they were hit by a storm. Most of the ships turned back, all but one.
One Trekker weathered the storm and kept sailing after her. He was a zealous treasure hunter, convinced there were deep-sea treasures at the source of the light.
Hold on... You don't think the diary that group had today belonged to him, do you?
But why are they so certain the light comes from a Monolith?
—Because the man chronicled what he saw with his own eyes:==W== the source of the light was a colossal object on an island.
A massive, glowing object rising from an island...==W== It could only be a Monolith right?
If that's the case, why do most people still cling to Marlene's version of the "Ghost Ship" story?
Well, who are you more likely to trust? The living, or the dead?
So you're saying ... he never made it back? No wonder that crew said his luck crapped out on him.
Precisely. When his ship was recovered, all that was left aboard were his skeletal remains and a diary.
He was gravely injured in the storm and suffered a psychotic break. The latter half of the diary is incoherent—even his own family dismissed it as feverish delirium.
I see...==W== So how did his diary end up in their possession?
Who knows? They likely offered a handsome sum for it. One can hardly blame the family for selling...★
Right...==W== By the way, was there any mention of Marlene in the diary?
His family didn't mention her, no. I'll have to investigate that further~
Very few people are privy to this. It took considerable effort to persuade them to talk, you know.
In exchange, you need to keep close tabs on that crew for me, Boss~
Understood. I'll let you know the moment I learn anything.
Okay, at least I know where the rumor came from now. But how am I going to tell Shia and Karin?
They trust their grandmother so much...

strings.text: Shia has known that her grandma was hiding something for quite some time. She decides to go ahead and check things out before the others. However, a figure in the darkness has been watching her the entire time.
How am I supposed to break this to Shia and Karin? Those entries in the diary...
Hehe, you were deep in conversation. I've been standing here for so long my legs are numb.
Oh... so you heard all that?
Hehe, I wasn't eavesdropping.==RT==I just came to bring you a jacket. The wind's picking up, and I didn't want you to catch a chill.
But then I saw how serious you looked, Boss,==W== and I couldn't bring myself to interrupt.
That's really thoughtful of you. Thanks.
Shia's taking this surprisingly well. This isn't how I thought she'd react at all.
You know, that treasure hunter who was following Granny... It rings a faint bell.
They found his ship a few weeks after Granny returned. She went to his family's home to offer her condolences, but they threw her out. I guess they had to blame someone.
Our families haven't spoken since. And this is the first I'm hearing he even left a diary.
But he's gone now. There's no way to verify if any of it is true.
That part about the light's source was probably just a delusion. He was completely obsessed with finding that "deep-sea treasure."
"Obsessed," huh?==W== Hehe. Anything you're obsessed with, Boss?
Honestly ... nothing comes to mind right now.==W== How about you, Shia?
But it was working just yesterday, wasn't it?
The day you found it, its light was blinding. It's been getting dimmer ever since.
This lantern sailed with Granny for years. I was sure it was dead a few times, but she wouldn't let me get rid of it. She'd just say, "It'll sort itself out."
... It still sputters on and off, even now. And she never told me why.
She always kept things back from me, even trivial things like this. Her last voyage was the same... I had to learn the details from others.
Just a thought, but ... maybe she was trying to keep you away from this life? So you wouldn't have to risk everything on the open sea like she did?
You're right, Boss. That's exactly like her. Always trying to shoulder every burden alone.
But I'm her granddaughter. Giving up isn't in my blood.
Now, uncovering the truth of the "Ghost Ship" and what really happened to Granny... It's my obsession now.
The apple doesn't fall far from the tree... You two really are alike.
I'm ready to give anything to see this through. Whatever the truth is, I can take it.
But there's one thing I can't shake...==W== Boss, can I ask you for a favor?
It's Karin... She worships Granny. She sought us out because she was so inspired by her reputation.
It's a pity she came too late—Granny had already passed away. Karin's greatest regret was never getting to see her.
So that's how it is… I thought you two were family.
In these years, we've lived together, and we've become like one... Karin helped me through the darkest days after Granny left.
She always admired Granny, hoping to grow into a seafaring Trekker as strong and capable as she was.==W== I'm worried… What if the truth wasn't what Granny told us...
That's why I need to scout ahead. Get the lay of the land so I can prepare for what's next.==W== Boss, can you help me keep Karin out of it for now?
I've run the numbers. At top speed, my surfboard can get me to the light source in under two hours.
The second I spot the Ghost Ship, I'll signal you. If it's a false alarm... we'll regroup. At least Karin's hero can remain on a pedestal.
I'll be back before dawn no matter what. If Karin wakes up, just tell her I'm on patrol. That should keep her from worrying.
Risky, but it's the fastest way to get eyes on the situation and plan our next move.
Scouting ahead is a good call, Shia. But I'm not okay with lying to Karin.
If you're gone too long, she'll know something's wrong. You can't fool her with a simple excuse.
Besides, if you run into trouble, I need to strategize with Karin. She knows ten times more about fighting at sea than I do.
Look, I get you don't want her to worry. But you resent your grandma for keeping secrets from you. Do you really want to do the same thing to Karin?
Heh... Fair enough, Boss. You've convinced me.
I'll leave you to break it to her, then. I just hope she won't be too angry with me.
Alright, stay safe. If something happens...
W-Why are you sniffing me agai—
... Your scent is so calming, Boss.
Let's call it my lucky charm~
The words are barely out before Shia vaults over the railing. Her surf-jet slices a silver streak across the water, then vanishes into the night.
...==W== Just make it back by dawn.
That voice is... Karin?!==W== I need to go check on her.
Ugh... Since when did Shia leave...
I rolled over in my sleep and ... my hand touched nothing... I thought the nightmare had come true...
Don't worry, dreams and reality are always the opposite.
You were right next to her. How'd you not hear her get up? I thought you had sharp hearing.
I do, but only when I'm awake! Once I'm out, I can't even hear thunder!
Is that really something to brag about...
I explained briefly about why Shia left on her own.
Anyway, Shia's scouting ahead. We need a backup plan ready for her signal.
Don't worry about it! I might not have as much combat experience as Shia, but I'm no rookie.
Forget those goons. Even a giant sea monster wouldn't stand a chance against me!
Heh, and to think Shia was worried you'd be mad.
Hmph, she always treats me like a child, thinking she should be the one to protect me in front.
After all, Shia has always seen you as her little sister.
She actually told me about the things that happened when you first met. She said now you're really part of the family, so of course, she wants to look out for you.
Wait, she even told you that?
Alright, I'll let it go this time. I know she's just trying to do what's best for me. We are family, after all.
Back then, everyone thought I was a weak, cowardly kid and didn't want to play with me… Shia was the first person who really believed in me.
Because of her support, I found my strength again. From that moment on, Shia became the closest person in my life… and she always will be!
Well, when we get the chance, I'd like to hear that story.
Story time's gonna cost ya! One dried fish per sentence!
You love your fish huh? Are you part cat or something?
That jolt... Did it come from below us?!
Boss, stay put! I'm gonna check the deck!
Thank goodness! It went through!==RT==Boss, you gotta get out of there,==W== there's—
Crap, I have to find Karin, now!
