strings.text: A giant Hexhorn Whale attacks, but you and Karin manage to shake it off. Just as you think the danger is over, Shia gets caught in a whirlpool. In that moment of despair, that eerie green glow silently emerges.
Th-that sound... It's a Hexhorn Whale!==RT==Ugh, those giant fellas are the absolute worst to deal with!
It's all my fault. I totally jinxed us. Now a real sea monster's here...
This is bad. We gotta reach Shia, now!
Shia just called. The signal cut out almost immediately—the waves must be too rough.
She must've run into the monster, too. She told us to go without her...
Go without her?! No way!==W== She's out there all by herself! We have to go save her, right now!
Karin, calm down. We don't know her exact position. Rushing in blind could make things worse.
Let's get our facts straight and come up with a plan. You don't want to put her in more danger, do you?
A Hexhorn Whale this huge... We can't win a head-on fight. Gotta avoid its attacks...==W== C'mon, think. What would Shia do?
Ah, I've got it! Boss,==W== I need you to back me up.
I'll be the bait. You take the helm and follow my lead, Boss. We'll lure the Hexhorn Whale away, then lose it.
Bait? You think it'll take it that easily?
Shia said whales are sensitive to bright lights. I can get its attention with a flare.
As long as it's chasing us, it's not chasing her. We'll keep it occupied and buy her time to meet up with us.
If Shia saw the monster too, she can't be far... This is risky, but it's our only shot.
Understood. We'll do it your way.
But Shia entrusted you to me. If things get dangerous, I'm prioritizing your safety.
Pfft, don't worry about me!==W== After this is over, I'm treating you to a deluxe seafood platter! On me!
<size=50>Hey, big fella! Got some suuuper tasty fish over here for ya! Come and get it!
Karin launched a flare into the sky. A blinding light erupted, and the Hexhorn Whale's attention snapped toward it.
Karin, it's charging straight for us!
Steer the ship! Don't let it ram us!
More flares burst across the sky, but the Hexhorn Whale was still on our tail, relentless. It looked pissed.
We've travelled so far, dammit... How is it still on our tail?!==W== Alright, time for Plan B—
Boss! Get the high-pressure gas tank from the cabin! If we use it for a boost...
Exactly! But it packs a serious punch, so keep a death grip on that helm!
The tank erupted in a thick white cloud, the force of it nearly lifting the ship clean out of the water.
Wait, we're going way too fast!!
I'm fine...==W== What about the Hexhorn Whale?!
It's gone...==W== I think we lost it.
I saw the flares and came as fast as I could! Nice work, you two!
The sea around Shia suddenly started to churn. A massive whirlpool opened up right beneath her, sucking our ship straight towards the center.
A whirlpool! Boss, take the helm! I'll get Shia!
Hold on—that huge shadow under the water... Is that...
A dark shadow erupted from the sea. The Hexhorn Whale's roar unleashes a monstrous wave, instantly engulfing Shia.
The wave tossed our ship skyward, flinging Karin and me into the air.
Dammit, the ship's going to capsize—!!
Just as I was about to plunge into the ocean, a grappling hook shot out from where Shia was, securing me and Karin to the ship's railing.
Well now... Looks like a complete wipeout.
Boss! Target Mackerel's status is unknown. No movement from Puffer or Shark. Awaiting your orders!
No rush. Keep watching. You know what they say: when two dogs fight for a bone, the third one runs away with it.
Let them and that monster beat each other black and blue. Then we can just swoop in and clean up.
You're a genius, boss! Everything is proceeding exactly as you've foreseen!
Heh heh. After this score, I'll go down as the greatest seafaring Trekker Carlo Town has ever known!
That old man's diary wasn't complete nonsense—"Marlene was swallowed by a great whirlpool. She must be dead."
Ah, is this the cycle of fate? That both Marlene and her granddaughter would fail to escape the whirlpool's grasp...
Wait a minute! If Marlene had died back then ...==W== who was it that later returned to Carlo Town?!
D-Don't tell me ... she was a ...==W== g-g-ghost?!
It's all your fault! You sneaked up on her and scared her half to death! Don't you know she's terrified of ghosts?!
S-Sorry, boss! I was just bringing you a late-night snack ... and forgot to knock...
<size=50>A ghost! GHOST! Stay away from me—!!
What... What do we do now, Boss...?
The Hexhorn Whale and Shia were gone. Did that whirlpool just swallow them both?
The Hexhorn Whale's charge actually freed us from the whirlpool's pull. Now we were just adrift in calmer waters.
We'll wait for the whirlpool to die down, then we'll go find Shia. Chances are they were both pulled to the same place.
Hey, she'll be okay. The boat was about to capsize, and she still nailed that shot with her grappling hook.
You're right...==W== Shia has to be okay! She's probably riding that whale's giant fin like a surfboard right now!
That's one monster of a surfboard. Only Shia could handle that.
Yeah! Shia's the best seafaring Trekker there is. She's gotta be fine!
Okay, let's get ready to set off anytime! First, we need to get this deck cleaned up. It's a complete disaster.
We also need to fish our supplies out of the water and dry them off. I'll take this side, you check over there.
As Karin and I fished the scattered crates out of the sea, a familiar glimmer in the distance caught my eye.
Huh? Why is it ... glowing again?
While I was staring at the lantern floating on the water, Karin stumbled over and shoved the binoculars into my hands, her face pale with terror.
No, wait. That silhouette... It can't be a ship...
It... It looks like an island...
The light ... is not coming from the Ghost Ship...?

D-Don't tell me ... she was a ...==W== g-g-ghost?!
It's all your fault! You sneaked up on her and scared her half to death! Don't you know she's terrified of ghosts?!
S-Sorry, boss! I was just bringing you a late-night snack ... and forgot to knock...
<size=50>A ghost! GHOST! Stay away from me—!!
What... What do we do now, Boss...?
The Hexhorn Whale and Shia were gone. Did that whirlpool just swallow them both?
The Hexhorn Whale's charge actually freed us from the whirlpool's pull. Now we were just adrift in calmer waters.
We'll wait for the whirlpool to die down, then we'll go find Shia. Chances are they were both pulled to the same place.
Hey, she'll be okay. The boat was about to capsize, and she still nailed that shot with her grappling hook.
You're right...==W== Shia has to be okay! She's probably riding that whale's giant fin like a surfboard right now!
That's one monster of a surfboard. Only Shia could handle that.
Yeah! Shia's the best seafaring Trekker there is. She's gotta be fine!
Okay, let's get ready to set off anytime! First, we need to get this deck cleaned up. It's a complete disaster.
We also need to fish our supplies out of the water and dry them off. I'll take this side, you check over there.
As Karin and I fished the scattered crates out of the sea, a familiar glimmer in the distance caught my eye.
Huh? Why is it ... glowing again?
While I was staring at the lantern floating on the water, Karin stumbled over and shoved the binoculars into my hands, her face pale with terror.
No, wait. That silhouette... It can't be a ship...
It... It looks like an island...
The light ... is not coming from the Ghost Ship...?

strings.text: You finally reach the source of the light. There is no ghost ship, only a desolate island. Toward the final goal, set forth!
... No! Granny would never lie! It had to be a giant Ghost Ship!
... It's a Ghost Ship, isn't it? Boss ... c'mon, say something!
This scene is just like what Mistique described in the diary.
A massive, glowing object rising from an island... It could only be a Monolith right?
Karin... I'm sure she wouldn't lie. If she wasn't telling the truth, it must've been a white lie.
"A white lie"...? What do you mean? That look on your face... It's like you know something.
Just tell me. I'm tougher than I look. No matter what, Granny's always gonna be the greatest seafaring Trekker in the world to me!
Besides, I've got a mind of my own. I'm not just gonna believe everything you say.
I tell Karin everything from the diary.
Huh?! So the diary is real? And here I was thinking those guys made it all up.
If there really is a Monolith on that island, Grandma would've led everyone to climb it. She always wanted Carlo Town to prosper.
So ... she kept other Trekkers away because there's something terrifying on the island. The Ghost Ship story was just to protect everyone.
Or maybe the Ghost Ship is real.==W== And the entire island is the ship, swarming with ghosts!
That's a huge overreaction to a joke, even for Karin.==W== Wait ... this sound wasn't hers...!
If I'm right, Shia should be over there. The whirlpool probably swept her and the whale to the same spot.
Then let's go get her! Boss, you take the helm. I'll navigate!
Oh! I'll fire off some more flares, too. If Shia's really there, she'll see 'em. Then she'll know we're coming and won't have to keep running around by herself.
Good idea. I'll go grab them from the cabin.
Shia...==W== Hang on! We're coming for you!
Ugh... My whole body aches... But I don't see any open wounds.
Huh? That sound... It's the same cry I heard from the ship... the Hexhorn Whale?
I remember the ship was caught in a giant whirlpool. I had to jump overboard to save myself... Then that Hexhorn Whale just appeared out of nowhere. I thought it was going to eat me...
So you saved me. Thank you.
I'm Marlene. What should I call you? How about "Whally"? Is that alright?
You like that, huh?==RT====W==Wait, where are you going?
Are these ...==W== the bones of Hexhorn Whales?!
Is this island a graveyard for your kind?
I see, Whally, you're watching over your family.
I know that feeling all too well. I have family I need to protect, too.
Don't worry. I'll help you keep this place a secret. I won't let anyone disturb them.
But I have to ask a favor of you, too.==RT====W==If you ever meet my family someday...==W== Please, help her if she's in danger.
Ah, so I didn't get away... The ocean really put me in my place.
I wonder how Karin and Boss are doing... That rope should've kept them on the ship.
Strange... Where am I? And why do I smell something so ... familiar?
She glances around. A green light flickers in the darkness, like a familiar summons.
Looks like Boss was right... The source of the light is on this island.
But how did I get here? I remember being dragged into the whirlpool ... and then...
When I fell into the water, I felt something lifting me up... Was it the Hexhorn Whale?
It seems calm. I think I'll try saying hello.
Hey there, Hexhorn Whale. Did you just save me?
I don't sense any hostility from your scent... So it really was you. Thank you.
Karin and Boss must be so worried... I need to find a way to let them know I'm safe.
Oh, I've got it! Hey, Hexhorn Whale, can you do me a favor? Can you let out a biiiiig bellow for me?
Karin and Boss will know where to find us.
The Hexhorn Whale seems to understand. Its massive body shudders as it opens its mouth—
Whoa, that was incredible!==RT====W==Thank you! There's no way they won't hear a sound like that.
Can I tell you a secret? When I fell into the sea, I had a wonderful dream.
In my dream, I caught my Granny's scent. It felt like she was the one who pulled me out of the water...
Do you think... Granny was here, too?
Granny... I hope you aren't mad at me for ignoring your warning and coming all this way...
I just wanted to follow in your footsteps ... to see you again.
... Even if it was just a trace you left behind.
Familiar flares burst and paint the distant sky. Shia gets to her feet, knowing the truth is finally within her grasp.
Let's go. Time to go get Karin and Boss.
Karin! Boss! Oh, thank the stars you're both safe.
We had a feeling you'd be with the Hexhorn Whale. We came sailing as soon as we heard it.
Whoa—a Hexhorn Whale!!==W== Everybody, be careful!!
Don't be scared, Karin. It's the one that saved me...
Shia fills us in on what happened.
No way... So the Hexhorn Whale wasn't a bad guy—==W==er, bad fish—after all.
Then why did it slam into our ship? That's what knocked you into the whirlpool...
Not exactly. That collision actually saved us.==W== If we'd kept heading straight for the light, we would've sailed right into that whirlpool before we knew it.
And I was right in the center of the whirlpool. If the Hexhorn Whale hadn't come to my rescue, I would've been a goner.
I was so wrong about you, Hexhorn Whale!==W== Now that I'm getting a closer look, you're actually kinda cute!
Heh, let's save our thank-yous for later. We have more important things to deal with.
As you can see, the light is coming from deep within this island. We're in uncharted territory, so we better be careful.
No problem, we're fully geared up. I even brought this lantern with me, see?
Huh? Why is it ... lit up again?
Not sure. It fell into the ocean, then Boss found it again.
Yeah, it was just floating there, glowing... I thought my eyes were playing tricks on me.
This lantern and I... It feels like fate keeps bringing us together. I can't shake this feeling...
Anyway, I think it's a good omen! And since it was Granny's, having it with me is like a good luck charm.
Woohoo, is it finally time for the grand finale? I'm so excited—
The true finale, I fear, will be a far cry from what you expect.
<size=50>Eternal slumber beneath the waves, with this whale as your tomb—that shall be your glorious end!

strings.text: Amidst the heavy rain, the Hexhorn Whale skeletons emit a brilliant glow. This place is their habitat, their grave. It is also the place countless Travelers mistake for a heaven filled with treasure.
We got a full count? Supplies and tools ready?
Boss, we're all in position. Awaiting your command.
Alright, lads! The plan's simple—==RT====W==Take out "Mackerel," "Puffer," and "Shark," and that treasure is as good as ours!
... W-Wait, why's it getting darker the deeper we go?
The trees are thicker here, blocking out the light.
It's okay, Karin. We're headed the right way. We just gotta get through this forest to reach that light.
R-Really? This isn't one of those "forests you can never escape," is it...?
We've been leaving trail markers. We'd know if we were going in circles.
Okay... I guess I'm just on edge. My chest feels so tight...
If a forest was truly "inescapable," it would have to be a ghost's trap or something.
Boss, stop trying to scare me! I'm not falling for it this time!
Hold on. It's not just your imagination, Karin.
The wind is carrying a strange scent...
Footsteps ... so many ... getting closer...==W== That is...
Ghosts, really?==RT====W==... Wait, it's starting to pour!
Huff ... puff... Can't ... keep running... The rain's so heavy...
There's a light! The exit's just ahead!
Boss, watch your footing, it's slippery!
Enormous skeletons lie strewn across the beach, glowing with an eerie green light in the pouring rain.
So that light we've been following has been coming from these skeletons all along?
B-But ... why are there so many...?
This must be their home. The Hexhorn Whale that saved me showed up around here, too.
I wonder if Granny ever saw this...
Maybe Granny thought they were ghosts? J-Just like me at the start... That's why she told everyone about a Ghost Ship...
Glowing green skeletons... Pretty terrifying, no matter how you slice it.
Glowing green skeletons... Pretty valuable, no matter how you slice it.
Heh heh... Much obliged for paving the way. You'll have to forgive our uninvited entrance.
Though this deviates from my hypothesis. For the light source to not be a Monolith... How disappointing!
Still, Hexhorn Whales are a true rarity. Their bones alone must be worth a fortune.
It's that crew of treasure hunters from the island...
Dammit! So those footsteps weren't from ghosts, but those creeps!
No wonder there was a foul stench on the wind. Turns out some filth has washed up.
Cut the crap. These bones are ours. Get in our way, and you'll regret it.
What villain cliches. That's the kinda thing you say right before your whole group gets wiped.
Exactly. Those who talk big are always the first to fall.
Shia, we've gotta teach these punks a lesson for the Hexhorn Whale, right?
Absolutely. The Hexhorn Whale saved us. The least we can do is protect its home.
Perfect! We still have a score to settle from last time. Let's finish this, once and for all!
I'll guard the skeletons, then. Make sure they don't pull anything.
Hold the line! Anyone who runs can forget about gettin' a bonus!
Karin, their formation is shifting to surround us. Let's split up. You take the left flank, I'll take the center.
Got it! The rain's stopped. Time to take 'em all down!
Shia and Karin have the clear advantage. This should be over soon.
Shia, Karin, watch your six! Their boss is making a break for it!
Cough, cough... Dammit... Still playing dirty, huh?
I've had my eyes on her. She slipped behind the reef to the right.
Good work, Boss. Karin, you two go on. I'll handle the rest of these guys and catch up.
Okay, you be careful! Let's move, Boss!
Heh... Haha... To think it was hidden here all this time...
We give chase, scrambling over towering reefs until a shipwreck comes into view.
W-What's a ship doing all the way out here?!
She's vanished. Must've gone inside the ship. Karin, stand guard. I'll find her in there.
This place gives me the creeps... Don't take too long!
Whoa, Shia! You're here already? What happened back there?
I tied them up on the beach. The Hexhorn Whale just arrived, so I asked it to keep an eye on things.
Perfect! Just their head left. Let's blow up the ship. See if she still feels like hiding!
Let's try another way... I can't bring myself to do that.
Huh? Is there something special about this ship?
Oh, S-Shia, I'm sorry... I thought it was some random old ship.
Don't sweat it, Karin. I mean, you're not wrong. The ship's a total wreck.
It's just... I spent so many nights on this ship with my grandma. I recognized it the second I saw it.
Guess that creep led us somewhere good for once.
So this is where Granny Marlene was staying when she went missing.
Judging by the damage, she must've been caught in a terrible storm. But Shia said her grandma wasn't hurt...
Did a Hexhorn Whale save her, too? Just like us?
Ahem! Listen up in there! We have you surrounded, and your goons are all taken care of!
Your only option is to surrender, so get out of there now!
... Is that your idea of a threat? How very uninspired.
Just you wait! I'm coming in to get you myself!
Hmph... I wouldn't be so hasty. Only fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
Besides, I'm holding the thing you came here for.
The voice comes from above. A figure stands on the ruined deck, brandishing something in her hand.
Wait ... you found that on the ship?!
This is Marlene's diary. It holds every last one of her secrets.
And I bet you're just dying to know what's inside.

strings.text: You fight off the treasure-seeking Trekkers who have been tailing you. In the chaos, you accidentally recover Granny's diary. Now, you understand the secret behind that glow.
Yes. Granny would keep a diary while at sea and then compile it into a nautical log once she got home.
I remember Shia saying that the log is missing entries from this specific period.
If that's really Granny's diary, then once we get it, we can finally find out what happened back then.
That jerk showed us just a glimpse before hiding it away—How stingy.
She wants to use it as leverage. We need to think of something.
What we need to do is "devalue" the diary—to make her think it's worthless, and trick her into handing it over willingly.
Still hesitating, everyone? This diary is solid proof that Marlene was lying.
If you want to protect her name, you'll obediently let me go, and I'll keep it a secret for you.
Hmph, do you think we're that easy to fool? Why should we believe that's her diary?
Don't think we don't know—There's another diary by a different Trekker from that time. You're planning to trick us with that!
Nonsense! I just found this on this rotten ship!
Karin, no need to argue with her. Even if the diary is real, Granny eventually made it back to town safely, and that's all that matters.
<size=35>Exactly. Let her think we don't care about the diary.
You're lying. If you truly don't care, why are you here?
You don't believe her whole "Ghost Ship" story either, do you? Now you must admit that it was a complete and utter lie.
Marlene must have secretly come back here many times over the years, and sold a lot of whale bones. What a disgrace for such a famous traveler to be so greedy for profit.
How dare she slander Granny like that... I'm gonna beat her into a fishcake!!
She's trying to provoke us. Don't fall for it.
Don't worry, Boss. She underestimates my trust in Granny.
Besides, her scent has changed—she's getting desperate now.
Decided yet? You wouldn't want Marlene to become infamous in town, or even throughout the world, do you?
Listening to you... I just feel so pathetic for you.
Huh?! What are you talking about!?
Everything you've said is just your own delusion. You have no way to prove she did anything.
That's right! Only a person as selfish as you would think everyone's the same! Grandma would never sell whale bones!
Fine. As you all wish, I'll reveal her wicked secrets right here in this diary!
Good, she's taking out the diary. Now all we have to do is...
Karin! Aim for her right hand!
A bullet whizzes through the air, accurately striking the treasure hunter's hand. She cries out and drops the diary, which falls to the ground.
Just as she was about to hit the ground, Shia leaped forward and caught her steadily.
Phew... You're not getting away anymore.
No more talking! Get out of Shia's arms right now! I'll tie you up!
Hmph. We'll consider this a loss. But everyone has their day, I'll make a comeback sooner or later!
You dare to come here again? You should count how many lives you have first!
The moment your ship sails in this sea, the Hexhorn Whale won't let you off the hook!
If that's the case, why don't we make a deal? You handle the transportation, and I'll find a buyer.
So many bones are like gold scattered all over the place. It's such a waste to just leave them here.
Hey, are you done already? You're way too greedy!
It seems she hasn't given up yet…==RT====W==Can we keep these Trekkers away with just the Hexhorn Whale in the future?
Huh? Why do I feel this whale skeleton is dimmer than before?
So it's not just me...==W== I think the light on the entire island has grown dim.
Yeah, we've been watching their light slowly fade when we guarded here…
What's going on? Are these bones broken?
Heh, whale bones aren't like ordinary things, how could they be broken?
Besides, we only see this light in town every few years, right? Otherwise, we wouldn't have to wait so long to come.
This lantern sailed with Granny for years. I was sure it was dead a few times, but she wouldn't let me get rid of it. She'd just say, "It'll sort itself out."
... It still sputters on and off, even now. And she never told me why.
The light emerged again after that big storm a few days back, and now the whole town's in an uproar.
"In the downpour of a stormy night, an eerie green glow blooms at the edge of the ink-black sea."
Lantern, heavy rain, light... If that's the case...
Knew it. It's not working again.
What is it, Boss? Why the sudden urgency?
The first time I saw the lantern, it was glowing in the sea. Later, when it was on the ship, it went out.
But last time, when it fell back into the sea, it lit up again.
Could it mean that whenever the lantern meets water, it lights up?
Shia walks to the sea and soaks the lantern in the water. A moment later, the lantern lights up, just as expected.
That's amazing! You're incredible, Boss. How did you know?
I'm guessing there's some kind of glowing material inside the lantern that's activated by water.
Shia, if you don't mind, can I open the lantern and check what's inside?
It's okay.==W== But we don't have any proper tools…
We have tools that can pry open this kind of lamp case. Do you wanna borrow them?
Thank you.==W== Wait. Why are you suddenly so cooperative?
Curiosity is human nature. If I wasn't curious, I wouldn't be a treasure hunter.
The treasure hunters bring over their tools. After a few tries, a crack appears on the outer case. I pour out the glowing substance inside.
Pieces of glowing bones lie in my palm. Their eerie-green color is exactly the same as the whale bone.
If I'm not mistaken, the bones inside this lantern should be from the Hexhorn Whale.
The first time we saw that whale skeleton, it was glowing brightly in the rain. After the rain stopped, the light had gradually faded.
I remember Shia mentioned that the light always appears after several days of heavy summer rain.
The whale bones only emit a light bright enough to be seen from town after absorbing enough water.
That's why the light hadn't been visible for the past few years.
Damn it, and those scammers were spreading rumors that Granny stole the treasure. It was actually the weather!
So, we spent all this time searching for treasure, and not only is there no Monolith...
... But even these bones are just glowing materials?!
Hexhorn Whale bones were very valuable years ago.
What did I say? Such a magical thing must be worth a lot.
But with the popularization of Lantern Artifacts, people probably don't use such a troublesome and unstable method of lighting anymore.
That's true. This kind of lantern is almost impossible to find on the market now. I thought about taking it to get repaired, but even the craftsmen couldn't recognize it.
How can this be...==W== I-It's not true!
Alright then, I'll just have to find a way to prove it to you.
Hey, Mistique, you there? I've got big news for you.
What's up, Boss? If it's not really explosive, I won't forgive you for disturbing my sleep★
It's absolutely explosive. But you have to do me a favor...
Whale bone lanterns? Never heard of them... You mean lanterns with whale bones as the casing?==W== If there's nothing else, I'm leaving. The morning market is about to open...
It was a popular type of lantern in the past. It needed to be regularly filled with water, yet too much water would block the light. It's outdated now.
Such a troublesome one. The Lantern Artifacts are so much better. They only need a little bit of magic to light up.
Did you hear that? These bones won't sell for a good price.
M-Maybe there are still places where Lantern Artifacts haven't been put to use...
Perhaps, but by the time you haul these heavy bones back, considering the cost of magic, storage, and making the casings for the lanterns...
How can this be a completely losing business...==W== I-I'm out!!
Nice one, Boss. You almost made her cry.
And the travel allowance, transportation allowance, accommodation, and overtime pay we agreed on…
Cut the whining! I'm not going back on my word! How can one be a boss without integrity?
Crap... I didn't earn a single Dorra, and now I'm in a huge debt...
Hehe, that's what you get for being so greedy.
Sh-Shut it!==W== Guys, hear me out! I still got an old treasure map! Let's go now. This time we'll definitely come back rich!
You really think you can just walk away like that?
You've been slandering Granny everywhere. I haven't settled the score with you yet.
That's right! My salted fish bucket is ready! You all better be prepared to be beaten into fishcakes!
And so, the treasure hunters apologize to us, promise to clear up all the rumors about Granny, and swear they would never return to this island to disturb the Hexhorn Whale.
At sunrise, we set off on our return journey. The Hexhorn Whale swims alongside the boat, saying goodbye.
Bathed in warm morning light, Shia and Karin open the long-sealed diary:

==RT====RT====RT====A-1=="... Calor Month 18th, Cloudy.==RT==This is my third day on the island.==RT==Whally helped me recover the boat, but it was too damaged to repair."==P====RT====RT=="==A-1==Calor Month 21st, Cloudy.==RT==I found a dying Hexhorn Whale on the beach. Whally was very sad. I could only watch as it stopped breathing.==RT==I collected some shells and placed them beside it,==RT==hoping it would have a long, peaceful dream."==P====RT====RT====A-1=="Calor Month 30th, Sunny.==RT==I built a new ship and was ready to go back. Whally didn't want me to leave.==RT==I don't know if I can protect their home from other people in the future."
This is the last entry. I remember Granny returned to town a few days later.
There's nothing else? Let me see...==W== Huh? There's something written on the back cover!
"To the person reading this: if you are not Shia, please stop here.==RT==The following words are what I have always wanted to say but never had the chance to."

==RT====RT====A-1=="Shia, congratulations. You've figured out the truth through your own efforts.==RT==You must be an amazing seafaring Trekker now."==P====RT====RT====A-1=="The source of the light is these bones. It is neither a ghost ship, nor treasures.==RT==You must be surprised, right?==RT==Only a third-rate Trekker would be discouraged by it not being treasures."==P====RT====RT====A-1=="I believe you understand, that this island is the sacred resting place of Hexhorn Whales.==RT==To prevent greedy people from disturbing them,==RT==I will make up a ghost ship story. Please continue to protect this island in my place."
That's Granny. She knew those "third-rate Trekkers" would follow us.
And she knew you'd find your way here even before she left the island.

==RT====RT====A-1=="I'm sorry, Shia. Please forgive me for keeping this from you all this time.==RT==You were still young, and I was worried you might accidentally let it slip.==RT==It would bring too much danger, and I fear I couldn't protect you."==P====RT====RT====A-1=="You must be all grown up now, right? I really wish I could see what you've become... But unfortunately, I won't have the chance.==P====RT====RT====A-1==Alright, don't be sad. Even if I've left this world, I will always be by your side, just like the sea.==P====RT====RT====A-1==<size=60>You are my most precious treasure."
To Granny, the most precious treasure was Shia...
Thank you, Boss. Thanks to you, we got to read Granny's diary.
And... I finally understand what was in her heart.
Oh, little Karin, why are you crying?
Good thing the sun is already up, or you might attract ghosts.
There you go again! You won't scare me anymore! Boss, just you wait...
Granny… Don't worry. I'm not alone anymore.
By my side, I already have companions, who are like family to me.

I remember Shia saying that the log is missing entries from this specific period.

That jerk showed us just a glimpse before hiding it away—How stingy.

Karin, no need to argue with her. Even if the diary is real, Granny eventually made it back to town safely, and that's all that matters.

Marlene must have secretly come back here many times over the years, and sold a lot of whale bones. What a disgrace for such a famous traveler to be so greedy for profit.

She's trying to provoke us. Don't fall for it.
Don't worry, Boss. She underestimates my trust in Granny.
Besides, her scent has changed—she's getting desperate now.
Decided yet? You wouldn't want Marlene to become infamous in town, or even throughout the world, do you?
Listening to you... I just feel so pathetic for you.
Huh?! What are you talking about!?
Everything you've said is just your own delusion. You have no way to prove she did anything.
That's right! Only a person as selfish as you would think everyone's the same! Grandma would never sell whale bones!
Fine. As you all wish, I'll reveal her wicked secrets right here in this diary!
Good, she's taking out the diary. Now all we have to do is...
Karin! Aim for her right hand!
A bullet whizzes through the air, accurately striking the treasure hunter's hand. She cries out and drops the diary, which falls to the ground.

Phew... You're not getting away anymore.
No more talking! Get out of Shia's arms right now! I'll tie you up!
Hmph. We'll consider this a loss. But everyone has their day, I'll make a comeback sooner or later!
You dare to come here again? You should count how many lives you have first!
The moment your ship sails in this sea, the Hexhorn Whale won't let you off the hook!
If that's the case, why don't we make a deal? You handle the transportation, and I'll find a buyer.
So many bones are like gold scattered all over the place. It's such a waste to just leave them here.
Hey, are you done already? You're way too greedy!
It seems she hasn't given up yet…==RT====W==Can we keep these Trekkers away with just the Hexhorn Whale in the future?

strings.text: All is well, and now you can finally relax. This is a summer that belongs to you, to everyone—a summer that never ends.
... Hey, Amber, wake up!==W== You just crashed right here at the table?
Last night I was texting Boss and fell asleep without even realizing it...
Boss said ==SEX=='ll be here an hour ago, but it's been so long! Ugh, if ==SEX== doesn't get back soon, I swear I'm going after ==SEX4== myself!
Iris keeps trying to stop me, going on about how "sailing a ship's not like driving a car." C'mon, what's the difference?
To the beach, now!==W== Boss is back!!
H-Hey! Don't touch my ears! Only Shia gets to do that!
I'm so sorry! I apologize for Noya...==W== She has absolutely no sense of personal space!
She's not just clueless, she's deaf!==W== Hey! Are you even listening to me?!
Whoa! So this is the legendary Karin who helped Boss out so much!<size=60>♪</size> So unbelievably soft! So fluffy!
What's got you so mesmerized by that drink?
It's the color of the seafloor. It's beautiful.
She's fascinating. Her scent is quite unique, as well.
When she's calm, like right now, she smells of mint soda candies.
But yesterday, when I caught her...
That cool mint fizzed and popped like a packet of popping candy.
I asked her why she was watching me. She just ducked her head and wouldn't say a word.
So that's why her face was bright red when she came back yesterday.
You caught her in the act.
Don't you worry, Boss. I was perfectly gentle. I even taught her how to use a water gun, and she adored it.
I see... Looks like you two hit it off right away.
Hey Mistique, how's that article of yours doing? Getting good feedback?
Are you kidding? When this witch is on the job, it's front-page news. Get ready to collect your share!
Oh, that's a huge relief.  I was so worried that buying all this food would leave the guild's funds in the red again…
Well, we have Shia to thank for letting me run the inside story.
Ah, it's done! First skewer's mine—
Speaking of, why did you decide to just tell everyone the truth, Shia?
I gave it a lot of thought. It's better to just be upfront about what's on the island instead of being all secretive.
Once those treasure hunters realize the Hexhorn Whale bones are worthless, they'll just give up and leave.
Besides, that witch really went out of her way to clear my grandma's name. Now no one can accuse her of lying to hoard treasure. She can finally rest easy.
That's great. It means all your grandma's hard work paid off.
And thank you and Karin for being such amazing hosts.
Don't mention it. After all, we're...
... Damn, that was too close. The rabbit girl almost spotted me.
I swear she was watching my every move. I never got a single chance.
What was she about to say to Boss, right at the end?==RT=="We're..."?
Ugh, whatever.==W== Gotta grab one of those limited-edition beach sodas.
And so we spent a long, lazy afternoon by the sea.
The beautiful summer we'd all been waiting for is finally here—

strings.text: The lively Snowish Festival has arrived! Dressed in a beautiful uniform, Laru tricks you into joining her for a busy day as a Snowish Festival Messenger.
The winter air is sharp and cold, and crystal snowflakes drift slowly from the sky. The streets, blanketed in white, glimmer under the colorful decorations of the festival.
So this is the Snowish Festival, huh? The streets are so lively. It's actually kind of refreshing.
Since it's a holiday, I'll let myself relax for once and wander around for a bit.
Seriously, where am I supposed to find someone to help me right now? Shouldn't they give me a heads-up about this in advance?!
Hmm? That person over there ... looks kind of familiar.
It's the Snowish Festival today! Everyone must already have plans...==W== Huh?
Eh? Ehhhh!? Bo-boss?! Why are you here?!
I just saw you and thought I'd come over and say hi...
Why are you hiding from me?
Ugh...==W== Of all times to run into you, it had to be now.
Cute?! If you like it so much, I'll just take it off and have you wear it.
I'll pass.==W== But are you heading to some kind of event in that outfit?
This is the uniform of a Snowish Messenger. Basically...==W== Grace Imperium assigned me this job.
Every year, during the festival, Grace Imperium sends out messengers to deliver gifts to the children.
A long time ago, there was a mysterious Snowish Tree Spirit dressed in red who rode a sleigh through a snowstorm, delivering Artifacts to keep people warm.
There are lots of details about the legend, like how the Tree Spirit would drop the Artifacts down the chimney and so on.
It's said that the Tree Spirit was a messenger sent by the God of Grace, making everyone's wish for a warm winter come true.
To commemorate the messenger's gift, Grace Imperium declared that day, 25th of Gelu Month, the Snowish Festival.
Ever since then, every year on this day, Grace Imperium would have staff dress up as the Tree Spirit to give gifts to children and make their wishes come true.
I don't know why, but I always ended up getting assigned this job...==W== And the same thing happened this year.
It was supposed to be done in pairs, but just now my boss suddenly told me we're short-staffed and asked me to find another partner by myself...==W== What am I gonna do?
By the way, Boss, got any plans today? Don't tell me you're meeting someone?
Not really...==W== I just came out for a stroll since everyone is celebrating.
Perfect! Let me show you around! I'm with Grace Imperium, after all. Nobody knows more about the Snowish Festival than us~
Don't you have work to do?
That's nothing! Just stick with me and you'll get the full experience—the history, the traditions, the festival vibe, all of it, in-depth~
Uh...==W== How does visiting Grace Imperium figure into the festival experience?
Relax, will you? This is just to whet your appetite before the main event.
Hah, you'll find out soon enough.
I've got a bad feeling about this...
You're not going to try and put that ugly red hat on me, are you?
That's right~ It's the traditional Snowish Festival hat!
A traditional hat...==W== Fine, I'll wear it.
Eh? Boss, you're a lot more chill about this than I expected. I thought I'd get the chance to see you all flustered.
It's just a hat...==W== Some of us have it far worse.
Wait a minute. What did you mean by that?
Hmph, I'll let that slide this time. It's just a bit embarrassing to be seen like this by someone I know...==W== It's not that I dislike the outfit.
Oh really? I thought you hated it.
Why would I? Kids love seeing me like this!
Anyway, I get the gist now. You want me to help you deliver gifts, right?
Oh wow, you figured it out!
But if you think about it, not just anyone can do this job. Besides Grace Imperium employees,==W== only people with a heart as pure as a child's can pull it off!
You just made that second half up, didn't you?
What's with that look? Too late to back out now.
Fine...==W== I guess I'll have to beg, on my knees...
Please, Boss! Help poor Laru out—!
All right, all right. Even if you didn't beg, I'd still help you.
Yay! Thanks, Boss~! I knew you wouldn't say no to me!
Of course I want to help for the kids' sake. Whatever you need today, I'll help.
Really? Then how about you wear this instead~

param: The lively Snowish Festival has arrived! Dressed in a beautiful uniform, Laru tricks you into joining her for a busy day as a Snowish Festival Messenger.
The winter air is sharp and cold, and crystal snowflakes drift slowly from the sky. The streets, blanketed in white, glimmer under the colorful decorations of the festival.
So this is the Snowish Festival, huh? The streets are so lively. It's actually kind of refreshing.
Since it's a holiday, I'll let myself relax for once and wander around for a bit.
Seriously, where am I supposed to find someone to help me right now? Shouldn't they give me a heads-up about this in advance?!
Hmm? That person over there ... looks kind of familiar.
It's the Snowish Festival today! Everyone must already have plans...==W== Huh?
Eh? Ehhhh!? Bo-boss?! Why are you here?!
I just saw you and thought I'd come over and say hi...
Why are you hiding from me?
Ugh...==W== Of all times to run into you, it had to be now.
Cute?! If you like it so much, I'll just take it off and have you wear it.
I'll pass.==W== But are you heading to some kind of event in that outfit?
This is the uniform of a Snowish Messenger. Basically...==W== Grace Imperium assigned me this job.
Every year, during the festival, Grace Imperium sends out messengers to deliver gifts to the children.
A long time ago, there was a mysterious Snowish Tree Spirit dressed in red who rode a sleigh through a snowstorm, delivering Artifacts to keep people warm.
There are lots of details about the legend, like how the Tree Spirit would drop the Artifacts down the chimney and so on.
It's said that the Tree Spirit was a messenger sent by the God of Grace, making everyone's wish for a warm winter come true.
To commemorate the messenger's gift, Grace Imperium declared that day, 25th of Gelu Month, the Snowish Festival.
Ever since then, every year on this day, Grace Imperium would have staff dress up as the Tree Spirit to give gifts to children and make their wishes come true.
I don't know why, but I always ended up getting assigned this job...==W== And the same thing happened this year.
It was supposed to be done in pairs, but just now my boss suddenly told me we're short-staffed and asked me to find another partner by myself...==W== What am I gonna do?
By the way, Boss, got any plans today? Don't tell me you're meeting someone?
Not really...==W== I just came out for a stroll since everyone is celebrating.
Perfect! Let me show you around! I'm with Grace Imperium, after all. Nobody knows more about the Snowish Festival than us~
Don't you have work to do?
That's nothing! Just stick with me and you'll get the full experience—the history, the traditions, the festival vibe, all of it, in-depth~
Uh...==W== How does visiting Grace Imperium figure into the festival experience?
Relax, will you? This is just to whet your appetite before the main event.
Hah, you'll find out soon enough.
I've got a bad feeling about this...
You're not going to try and put that ugly red hat on me, are you?
That's right~ It's the traditional Snowish Festival hat!
A traditional hat...==W== Fine, I'll wear it.
Eh? Boss, you're a lot more chill about this than I expected. I thought I'd get the chance to see you all flustered.
It's just a hat...==W== Some of us have it far worse.
Wait a minute. What did you mean by that?
Hmph, I'll let that slide this time. It's just a bit embarrassing to be seen like this by someone I know...==W== It's not that I dislike the outfit.
Oh really? I thought you hated it.
Why would I? Kids love seeing me like this!
Anyway, I get the gist now. You want me to help you deliver gifts, right?
Oh wow, you figured it out!
But if you think about it, not just anyone can do this job. Besides Grace Imperium employees,==W== only people with a heart as pure as a child's can pull it off!
You just made that second half up, didn't you?
What's with that look? Too late to back out now.
Fine...==W== I guess I'll have to beg, on my knees...
Please, Boss! Help poor Laru out—!
All right, all right. Even if you didn't beg, I'd still help you.
Yay! Thanks, Boss~! I knew you wouldn't say no to me!
Of course I want to help for the kids' sake. Whatever you need today, I'll help.
Really? Then how about you wear this instead~
See? You do hate it after all.

Whoa, that's amazing! Maybe we can summon some helpers then~

strings.text: You and Laru start handing out Snowish Festival gifts to the kids in the Ash District. Along the way, you chat about her wild idea of "launching gifts with a cannon." Suddenly, a mysterious figure catches your eye.
Laru led me into a warehouse that's filled with wrapped presents.
We've only got one sleigh. How are we supposed to fit all these?
We'll make it fit! Otherwise, there's no way we'll finish the deliveries today!
If only we could launch the gifts like cannonballs straight into the kids' laps.
If we could use magic to turn the cannon sleigh into a gift launcher, deliveries would be so much easier.
Next year, I could just set the address on the list as drop coordinates and deliver everything right from the office without breaking a sweat!
Oh? Shall we test it out right now?
With my magic, the gifts would explode into fireworks the moment they're fired.
I call it leaving the engineering to the professionals. I'll draft a proposal and send it to Grace Light Academy. I'm basically handing them their new research project for next year.
And when it actually gets made, I'll have them mention your name in the thank-you's~
"We have to thank the great Tyrant==W== for this invention's initial concept!"
It really would be nice if such a spell existed. That way,==W== even during the festival, I could go fishing in peace.
You probably don't know this, Tyrant. Night fishing at the harbor in winter is a unique pleasure.
Especially in winter, around the Snowish Festival. You can see glowing fish rising to the surface in schools.==W== It's truly beautiful, like something straight out of a fairy tale.
Of course! I'll take you to see them sometime~
You really like those fish, huh?
They're beautiful. Who wouldn't like them?
I mean ...==W== the look on your face just now... You looked softer when you talked about them.
I-I did? You must've imagined it...==W== Anyway, the gifts are loaded up! Let's go!
The kids are waiting for us!
As if to hide something, Laru grabbed my arm and hurried me out of the warehouse.
By the way, does every kid get a gift during the Snowish Festival?
That's right! Starting this year, everyone gets one.
Yeah. In previous years, only kids in the Gold and Silver Districts would get presents.
But this year someone suggested that every child in the city should receive one.
So this year we are delivering gifts to the Ash District, too.
I see. That's why even you, the Queen of Slackers, are required putting the effort in.
Hey, I know where to draw the line!
Work efficiently, then fully enjoy deserved free time—that's my motto. Which means I take my work seriously.
And this particular job is very rewarding. Why would anyone want to slack off?
As you know, Grace Imperium acts on behalf of the God of Grace.
To the children, we're like divine messengers bringing them gifts and blessings.
When you see their eyes sparkling with joy and innocence...==W== That's the best part.
So Laru has this side to her, too...==W== Guess this really is the kind of job that makes everyone's dreams come true.
We cut through a few narrow streets and reached the area Laru got assigned to—the eastern part of the Ash District.
First address—East 1st Street, No.123...==W== It's this way.
Hold on. If we go from door to door, we'll be here all night.
<size=120%>Hey! Kids living on East 1st Street and East 2nd Street! The Snowish messengers are here with gifts—!!!<size=120%>
Oh, wow... I didn't think of that...
As long as the presents get delivered, any method works!
Hahaha, "Fishing Queen"? What kind of dumb nickname is that?
Wait, don't tell me they mean me?!
Fishing Queen, what are you doing here?
I am not the Fishing Queen...==W== I'm the Snowish messenger, here to deliver presents to you all~
The rumors were true?! We're really getting presents this year?!
Of course! Why else would my sleigh be full of them?
Right, so where do you live?
Let's see... Yep, it's on the list.
Here, this one's yours~ See? This is real.
Ahem, since you're the first one to get a gift today, I'll give you an important job.
You can help me by telling everyone to come get their presents~
Got it!==W== Just wait there, I'll go get them!
Before long, one after another, the kids in the neighborhood came running.
Don't rush, everyone gets one! Line up, one at a time.
Your address is...==W== East 1st Street, No.234? Okay, here you go~
Mommy...==W== Can I get one, too?
Of course you can. Go on, be brave and ask the nice lady yourself.
Hi! I'd like a gift, too! I live at ...==W== East 1st Street, No.165!
Good job! Here you go, don't drop it~
You're welcome~ Have a wonderful Snowish Festival!
She looks like a totally different person.
Hey, Fishing Queen, is this cannon real?
Stop calling me that!==W== And the cannon's just for display, it doesn't actually fire. So don't touch it, okay?
It doesn't work? But didn't the Grace Imperium people say...
<size=80%>Shh,==W== don't tell them the truth! What if they start asking to play with it?</size>
What are you whispering about? A grown-up secret?
Well, we were planning to use the cannon to deliver the presents, but it's not possible yet.
That's why we didn't tell anyone.==W== If in the future, you can come up with a magic spell that can do it, that would be amazing.
Why don't you make a wish to the Snowish Tree Spirit?
A rustling sound comes from nearby.
That child ...==W== wears clothes different from the children in the Ash District...
Hi! Are you here for a present, too? Come and pick one.
Wait,==W== that was strange. Why did she run away...

strings.text: A rumor is spreading among the kids about a photo that shows a glowing sprit. Laru, who usually loves slacking off, is surprisingly motivated today and eagerly takes on the task of "finding the sprit photo."
Nope, we play here every day. Never seen her before!
I feel like I've seen her somewhere...==W== Ugh, I can't remember.
I see...==W== Boss, if she's on the list, then we have to make sure she gets her gift, too.
Don't worry, maybe we'll run into her again later?
Speaking of which, she seemed interested in the Snowish Tree Spirit...==W== Is that a famous story or something?
Yeah! I read it in a book. A great person wearing the Grace Imperium uniform gave it to us.
Yeah, she brought us lots of books!
Probably charity work. Grace Imperium does this sort of thing regularly.
The book said that if you make a wish to the Snowish Tree, the nice Spirit will grant it!
Oh, I heard that story when I was little, too~
Come on, it's just a story. Stuff like sprits is...==W== Anyway, that's so childish.
There's a photo in it, too—==W== A sparkly figure under the Snowish Tree in the park!
The great person said she took that picture herself before, so it must be the Snowish Tree Spirit!
We got so many presents this year... The Tree Spirit must've helped grant everyone's wishes!
Uh...==W== A sparkly figure... Wait...==W== is that...
N-nothing...==W== It's just that I'd love to meet a Spirit who grants wishes, too. Would make my deliveries way easier!
Right! Boom! Fire them from a cannon and you're all done! That'd be so fun!
No way, I don't want a cannon, I want the nice lady to give it to me!
Haha...==W== Thank you. I'd love for it to be easier, but if I don't get to see everyone's happy faces, I'd feel lonely.
Then you can use the cannon right in front of me! I can catch it! Two birds with one stone, right?
Hahahaha! You really are a silly one!
Hmm...==W== If we adjust the cannon power... Maybe it's possible?
It'll work, it'll work! The Snowish Tree Spirit will help us!
Hmm...==W== But I still want a lovely way of getting my present.
Wow... The Snowish Tree Spirit really does grant every wish...
Of course! She glows, you know!
Just because she sparkles, they believe it? Ah, kids...
Glowing fish, glowing spirits, and even the streets are glowing with lights...==W== Is the Snowish Festival a holiday about light?
Uh, I wouldn't put it that way...
Wah...==W== I really wanna meet the Snowish Tree Spirit.
Has anyone ever seen her with their own eyes?
Everyone's been looking, but nobody can find her...
When we saw the photo, we also asked the great person about her.
She said==W== she only saw the Spirit that one time when she took the picture, and never again.
The girl just run away was peeking at us the whole time when we were discussing the Tree Spirit with the great person.
Maybe she knows something about the Tree Spirit.
Wait, no, I think she must be a scout sent out by the Spirit, listening to our wishes and then reporting back!
Looks like everyone is very interested in this Spirit.
But it's no use...==W== We can't even find a trace of her.

Let me think...==W== Didn't you say you have a photo of the Spirit? Can you show it to me? I can take a picture with my phone and send it to my friends. Get everyone to help, and then maybe we'll find her.
Great idea! Hey!==W== Does anyone know who has the photo right now?
No idea. It was tucked inside the book, and everyone kept fighting to read it.
Ugh...==W== Then it'll be hard. Donated books will be passed around among the kids.
But there must be at least one kid who has it, right?
Th-That's hard to say. They're kids, after all. They'd probably just finish the book, toss it aside, and forget all about it.
It's common for books that get passed around to just disappear. I'd say let's not bother looking for it.
What a pity. I really wanted to get a look at the Snowish Tree Spirit.
The Spirit lady is super cute!
Really? Th-then, I want to meet her too...
But the Spirit lady seemed a bit lonely. That's why we wanted to find her—so that we can be friends!
Uh... Well, if we can't find the photo, then we can't do anything...==W== Yeah, there's nothing we can do~
There is a way! Today's the Snowish Festival. Everyone will come to pick up presents. If we ask them one by one, somebody's gotta know something!
Yeah! Let's split up. We'll find her quicker that way!
You kids just enjoy the festival. Leave the spirit-searching to us!
You sure you're up for it? Aren't you just the Fishing Queen?
Of course! We just need to ask while delivering the gifts... Easy peasy...==W== Right, Boss?
We're the Snowish Festival Messenger, after all. It's our duty to see to it that these kids' wishes come true.
Something's off...==W== Why did Laru suddenly get so into it? This photo search is clearly extra work for her.
We just need to find anyone who's read the book, and then track each person down in order. That way, we'll eventually find the last one, right?
You've all read the book. Do you remember who you handed it to last?
I finished it first and gave it to a friend from the Ashwind Clan.
Vollara from Ashwind gave it to me...==W== I gave it back after reading it.
I... Let me think. I gave it to a white-haired kid. She didn't look like a local.
Did she come to collect a gift just now?
I didn't see her, but if she's still in Emor, she's definitely coming, right? Who would refuse a festival gift?
Oh right, on my way here, I saw a Messenger on the next street over. She wore the same clothes as you and was delivering books. Maybe she'll know something.
We can check in with those people while delivering gifts ...==W== if we actually manage to run into any of them.
Okay, which way should we go first?
Maybe we'll run into the white-haired girl.
Let's start with the Ashwind Clan. There're many kids there; maybe we can find a new clue.
Their skateboards are pretty fast, right? We can ask them to help us deliver gifts.
Let's keep handing out gifts here for now, maybe we'll run into that white-haired kid.
And we can keep asking the kids who come for gifts about that her; as long as she hasn't left the city, someone is bound to know something.
Let's go to the next street to find the Messenger first. Maybe she knows more.
A Messenger wearing the same clothes as me...==W== That's strange. Are there still Messengers in Nova now?

You kids just enjoy the festival. Leave the spirit-searching to us!
You sure you're up for it? Aren't you just the Fishing Queen?
Of course! We just need to ask while delivering the gifts... Easy peasy...==W== Right, Boss?
We're the Snowish Festival Messenger, after all. It's our duty to see to it that these kids' wishes come true.
Something's off...==W== Why did Laru suddenly get so into it? This photo search is clearly extra work for her.
We just need to find anyone who's read the book, and then track each person down in order. That way, we'll eventually find the last one, right?
You've all read the book. Do you remember who you handed it to last?
I finished it first and gave it to a friend from the Ashwind Clan.
Vollara from Ashwind gave it to me...==W== I gave it back after reading it.
I... Let me think. I gave it to a white-haired kid. She didn't look like a local.
Did she come to collect a gift just now?
I didn't see her, but if she's still in Emor, she's definitely coming, right? Who would refuse a festival gift?
Oh right, on my way here, I saw a Messenger on the next street over. She wore the same clothes as you and was delivering books. Maybe she'll know something.
We can check in with those people while delivering gifts ...==W== if we actually manage to run into any of them.
Okay, which way should we go first?
Maybe we'll run into the white-haired girl.
Let's start with the Ashwind Clan. There're many kids there; maybe we can find a new clue.
Their skateboards are pretty fast, right? We can ask them to help us deliver gifts.
Let's keep handing out gifts here for now, maybe we'll run into that white-haired kid.
And we can keep asking the kids who come for gifts about that her; as long as she hasn't left the city, someone is bound to know something.
Let's go to the next street to find the Messenger first. Maybe she knows more.
A Messenger wearing the same clothes as me...==W== That's strange. Are there still Messengers in Nova now?

strings.text: At the Ashwind Clan, you encounter Flora, who's currently on her winter tour. She happened to have seen the photo of the Spirit, and offers you a lead to a carpenter's house on East 1st Street.
To find the photo of the Tree Spirit, we come to the place of the Ashwind Clan.
No one's here...==W== That's odd. Normally they would be around.
It's the Snowish Festival. They must have gone out together.
Hmm, sounds like things are happening out there...
Why don't we go and take a look?
Who's the next spirit going to be?
Then...==W== How about the girl in the red dress, in the back row!
That looks like ...==W== the super-famous Magician Maximus, Flora...?
A glowing sphere rose from the tip of her wand and slowly circled around a girl.
All right! A new spirit has appeared!
Wow! I'm a spirit too! Thank you, nice lady!
Oh, she's performing magic for the children.
You're welcome~ Hehe. Now, who's next...
Tyrant, perhaps we shouldn't disturb them. Let's maybe check somewhere else first?
Hm? I thought you'd be interested in this kind of magic show.
It's work time! We have to finish the task as Messengers first!
The queen of slacking is taking the initiative? This is strange... Something's definitely up...
M-Me? I'm Laru from the Grace Imperium.==W== You must be the great magician Flora, right?
Hehe, you are too kind. Let me show you a bit of Snowish Festival magic~
You're so pretty! Just like the Snowish Tree Spirit!
The ... the Tree Spirit?==W== Haha, not quite.
All right everyone, that's the end of the morning show. Go have lunch, and we'll meet here again at two, okay? Don't be late!
Hehe, I didn't expect to see you two here.==RT==I'm on my winter tour and decided to play with the kids here for a bit.
The first time I met Flora was also during one of her tours. I was chosen as the guest participant on stage. Good times...
By the way, why are you two dressed like this? Is it for the festival?
This is a special Snowish outfit! Grace Imperium is having me deliver gifts to the kids, and I asked Tyrant to come with me.
We're also looking for a photo. Apparently, it shows the Snowish Tree Spirit. All the kids want to see her.
The Snowish Tree Spirit...?==W== Oh! That must be the photo I saw this morning.
Yes. The children were gathered around reading a book, looking very serious, so I got curious and went to take a look.
By the way, the magic trick I just performed was inspired by that photo. A spirit, radiating rays of light...
Flora, do you remember who was holding the book at the time?
Hmm...==W== There were too many of them. I didn't notice who was holding it.
But I heard them say they were going to show it to another kid afterward.
I think it was the carpenter's daughter on East 1st Street.
The carpenter's daughter on East 1st Street...
As far as I know, there aren't many carpenters on East 1st Street. I'm not sure which one has a daughter, but if we ask around, we'll find out soon enough...
Glad I could help~==RT==Speaking of which...
What's wrong? Why are you looking at me like that?
Sorry, I just didn't expect members of Grace Imperium to wear outfits like this. It's so different from your usual uniforms.
Like I said, it's for work!
Still, Flora, is it all right for you to be here doing magic for the kids? Aren't you busy?
Oh right, I should go prepare now.
If only you two weren't at work... I'd invite you to tonight's special performance for the Snowish Festival.
Heh, since it's a special show, will you be wearing a Snowish outfit, just like us?
That's a good idea. A festive costume would be eye-catching. I'll think about it.
Umm...<size=30>==W== I guess sarcasm doesn't work on celebrities.
After saying goodbye to Flora, we set off toward East 1st Street.
I didn't expect you to be so committed to finding the photo.
I thought you just wanted to finish delivering the gifts quickly and relax afterwards.
Well...==W== The kids are really worked up about it. So I'm curious, too.
I see. I thought maybe there was something in that photo that really caught your attention.
Well... It's not like there wasn't any...==W== But just a little bit...!
You kept glancing away, you know? Well, then tell it to me once we find the photo.
Even if you didn't ask, I'd have to explain it to you anyway then.
Okay, okay. I'm looking forward to it.
Don't get your interest up for this sort of...==W== Wait, Tyrant, look—
That's the child who was peeking at us just now.

strings.text: You run into Cosette by chance, but Laru's greeting and her cannon sleigh frighten her away. After being offered a drink, Cosette reveals that the book with the photo is now in the carpenter's house on East 1st Street.
In order to find the Snowish Tree Spirit's photo, we hand out gifts to kids while asking them about the white-haired girl.
Oh! I remember her! Long white hair—
She looked kind of scary...==W== We were too scared to really talk to her.
Don't worry, I'll go! Do you remember which way she went?
We saw her just now...==W== Ah! Over there!
Eh? Cosette, why is she here?
Not really. She's been following me for a while and tried to kidnap me though...
Following you?! And kidnapping?! Tyrant, did you get yourself into trouble?
Let me say this right now—I can be your bodyguard, but the commission fee is separate.
Since we know each other so well, I'll give you a discount. I just happened to have my eyes on this newest fishing rod...
Uh, it's not what you think...
Cosette isn't a bad person. She said she wanted to kidnap me, but even after following me for so long, she never laid a finger on me.
Ohhh~~ I get it. That kind of following around.==W== You sure are popular, Tyrant.
She's getting the wrong idea again...==W== Never mind.
Since you two know each other, this will be easy. Just go ask her.
Cosette is always alert... To get something out of her, we might need another approach.
Hello! I'm Laru from Grace Imperium. Do you have a moment?
Isn't this ... a bit too direct...
Huh? Wait! Why is she running?!
Why are you still standing there? Go after her!
Huff...==W== She—she runs way too fast!!
I see her!==W== Over there—==W==come on!
You stay right where you are. I won't go any closer. Let's just talk like this, okay?
Cosette, don't be nervous. We just want to ask you this one thing.
Yeah, you know ==SEX4==, right? We're not bad people. Why did you run?
Why would the good guys drag around a sleigh with a huge cannon on it?==W== You're definitely bad!
Plus, you said you're from Grace Imperium...
Is our reputation really that terrible?
Alright, listen. This cannon sleigh isn't for blowing anyone up. It's for delivering gifts, to kids.
See? It's full of presents. We're asking you because it has to do with the kids' Snowish Festival wishes.
Of course, why else would I dress up like this?!==RT==Even if you don't believe me, don't you trust the person standing right next to me?
I'll vouch for her. She's telling the truth.
The kids said they lent you a book with a photo tucked inside. Is that true?
"A book with a photo tucked inside"? What kind of new criminal code word is that?
I don't know anything! I've never heard of it!
Cosette really is on guard... Looks like we don't have a choice.
Let's make a deal. You tell us what you know, and I'll buy you something to drink. How about it?
Something to drink? What kind of bribe is that...
Really? You'll buy me a drink?! Can I get the new winter special?!
Sure. Can we get one around here?
It's in the vending Artifact in the park! I saw it just now! Let's go, let's go! Right now!
Then why did I chase her for so long?!
Ahh—so good~~ A warm drink for this season...
As promised, can you tell us about the book and the photo now? Do you remember the book of the Snowish Tree tales?
... I think I did borrow it to read.
Yeah. That's the one, with a photo of the Spirit inside.
Ah, I remember now—so that's what the photo's about.
Exactly. Do you still have the book?
No. I finished it with some kids at the Ashwind Clan this morning,==W== and then passed it on to others.
Do you remember who you gave it to?
Lemme see...==W== A kid on East 1st Street.==W== I think their family works with wood.
Works with wood?==W== You mean a carpenter's kid? I think I know who that is.
Alright, let's go take a look.
Y-you're welcome. And thanks for the drink, Boss...==W== It was really good...
After saying goodbye to Cosette, we set off toward East 1st Street.
Hmm, I hope something turns up this time...
All we can do is hope.==W== By the way, you seem really invested in finding that photo.
Th-that's because I've never seen the Snowish Tree Spirit before, so I want to see for myself!
Besides, it would make the kids' wish come true...
Don't give me that suspicious look! Anyway...==W== Let's just find the photo first!
Is it just me, or does it feel like ...==W== someone's following us?

strings.text: The Messenger turns out to be Freesia, who's also distributing gifts in a uniform. She recalls that the book went to the carpenter's house on East 1st Street. Laru hurriedly rushes away before you even finish the talk.
In order to find the Snowish Tree Spirit's photo, we head to the next block to look for the Messenger lady the kids mentioned.
Yeah, with a mailbag that big, she's definitely a Messenger.
And that outfit looks familiar...==W== Is she a coworker...?==W== Wait, who is that?==W== I don't recognize her at all...
Boss? Good day.==W== That hat of yours is...?
Oh, it really is Freesia! She's in Emor, too... And that outfit...
I ...==W== took a commission from Grace Imperium to deliver Snowish Festival gifts.==W== And that left me with this hat.
What a coincidence. Post Haste also got the same commission,==W== delivering to Emor's residents. So we're technically on a work trip.
It's a good thing of course...==W== But Post Haste is short-staffed, so even with "everyone on deck," we aren't making much progress...
Huh? So they even outsourced help? That's wild...
Heh-heh, either way, anyone who lends a hand is a benefactor of mine.
So you two already know each other? You're one of the pros from Post Haste...==W== Uh so, dear benefactor, what is your name?
Nice to meet you. I'm Freesia from Post Haste.
Mm-hmm~ I'm Laru. A pleasure to work with you, Freesia! There is a big chance that Grace Imperium will ask you to pitch in again for next year's delivery~
Of course...==W== Actually, I also have something I'd like to ask you, if you don't mind.
Hm? If it's work-related, ask away! Like the most efficient way to play hooky—==W==err, I mean, to carry out your work ... or anything!
About the commission...==W== As Boss can attest, it is not my usual working dress code.
Oh good. She brought up the subject I wanted to raise...
You mean this "Snowish Festival Messenger" outfit? Heh-heh, cute, right?==W== And yours is pretty cute, too!
You flatter me, Lady Laru—wait, no. What I want to ask is...
For this delivery job, we're supposed to wear a uniform ...==W== which I understand, though this "uniform" is ...==W== quite unexpected.
What I actually want to ask is... This commission was given to Post Haste as a whole,==W== but we only received one uniform.
Sounds like a tough call for her.
So in the end, I'm the one who got stuck with it...==W== Was there a mistake somewhere?
You didn't get enough outfits? Hmmm... Somebody probably just counted wrong...==W== Happens all the time...
Don't tell me it was you. Laru...
Hey, don't start rumors!==W== Anyway, just enjoy the festival atmosphere! Once you put it on, you're a Snowish Festival Messenger. Feel proud!
... And are we just gonna ignore the miscounted uniform?

Um... It's too late anyway...==W== Ahem! Right now we're all carrying important duties...==W== On behalf of Grace Imperium, I thank you for your contribution! As for the problem you mentioned, I'll pass it along to our staff later.
Thank you so much...==W== We at Post Haste would be happy to work with Grace Imperium again in the future.
No problem! Oh right—==W==I almost forgot, I have something to ask you, too.
Among the gifts you delivered, there must be quite a few books, right?
Yes, the people in Emor really love reading.
Then have you seen a book about the Snowish Tree tales, with a photo tucked inside?
A photo? You mean the "Snowish Tree Spirit" photo? But it's client privacy, I can't...
This is all for making the kids' wish come true...==W== We really need this information. Please tell us. We will pay them a proper visit.
Alright, since you put it that way...==W== The recipient is ... a kid on East 1st Street.
Any other details you recall? Like ... the house number?
The house didn't have a number, but the inside smelled pleasantly of pine shavings. Maybe a carpenter?
But,==W== how come a photo can grant the kids' wish?
Oh, they're making a fuss about seeing the Spirit~ And Tyrant is quite interested, too. Right?
Hmm... I can kind of understand ==SEX3== curiosity. After all, the spirit in the photo ...==W== looked like a very cute kid.
Ahem! I—I just remembered, we need to hurry with gift deliveries! We'll never make it at this rate!
Sorry for taking up your time! Good luck! Tyrant, let's go!
Huh? Ah... Well, until next time, Boss.
What's wrong? Why are you so flustered?
Nothing! And anyway, we still have tons of gifts left to deliver...
That's true...==W== But do we need to rush like this? Didn't we just get a lead?
W-well, we already got the key piece of info, that's enough. I'd feel bad if we kept her occupied!
Wow...==W== I didn't expect you to be this thoughtful, thinking about your "coworker"'s workload.
A-anyway! Never mind that, let's keep delivering gifts!==W== And of course, we'll look for the photo while we're at it.
We're moving somewhat slowly, but at least now I know we're moving in the right direction.
Following Freesia's lead, we arrived at East 1st Street.
Let's deliver gifts while asking around. There shouldn't be many carpenters on this street.

Huh? Ah... Well, until next time, Boss.

Nothing! And anyway, we still have tons of gifts left to deliver...

strings.text: Laru confesses that the person in the photo is herself. She talks about how she was shunned by her peers when she was little because she couldn't control her light magic, as well as the existence of the true Spirit.
Ah...==W== Tyrant, you're so mean...==W== You already knew, didn't you? You just wanted to mess with me.
That so-called "Snowish Tree Spirit" in the photo ...==W== is me.
Of course I knew.==W== One look at the photo and it's obvious.

And when you think about it, it all makes sense. You usually dodge work whenever you can, yet you were so eager to find that photo.==W== And you tried to avoid talking about the Spirit whenever the topic came up...
Alright, alright, stop with the analysis! Yes, I'm the Spirit in the photo! I admit it!
I was planning to grab the photo before you saw it. Then I'd either hide it or toss it out...
But when I saw how happy the kids were talking about it, I guess...==W== Better to just let it be.
Besides, I was thinking...==W== What if...
N-never mind! I just didn't want you to see it, okay?!
Because it's from when I was a kid!==W== Ugh, it's so, so embarrassing!
Embarrassing? I actually think you looked really cute.
The soft glow around you gave it an air of mystery.==W== No wonder the kids thought you were the spirit.
W-Well...==W== To tell the truth, I really was glowing...
Huh? Wait, you mean that wasn't lighting?
Ah! Fine. Since you've already seen it,==W== I might as well explain before you get the wrong idea.
When I was little, all the kids on my street were into fishing.
What's with this fishing talk again?
Boss! Would you just let me finish?
Ahem—so, every kid made their own fishing rod and bait. They'd all gather by the water to see who could catch the biggest fish.
I wasn't that into it back then, but I didn't want to get left out.
So I grabbed some sticks, threads, and bait, threw them together,==W== and made my own rod.==W== I didn't know what I was thinking when I tried to join them.
... Judging from your tone,==W== I guess...
Uh...==W== C-can I fish with you, too?
Go away! Every time something happens, you cry, and when you cry, you start glowing! You'll scare the fish away!
Ha! You're glowing already! What are you, a lightbulb?
Ugh...==W== Not again... Why am I like this...?==W== Why am I different from everyone else...
I wanted ...==W== to fish with everyone, too...
And that's pretty much what happened.==W== When I was a kid, my body would light up whenever I got emotional.==W== Weird, right? It was hard to make friends.
By the time I stopped crying, everyone was gone...
Don't worry about it.==W== I've gotten used to it.==W== It didn't really bother—
Ugh! No, of course it bothers me! I must've been miserable back then...!
But if I started to cry, I would glow again...
The more I tried to hold it in, the worse it got.==W== Honestly, I had no idea what to do.==W== Poor little me...
Not long after that, I heard a saying: "If you make a wish beneath the Snowish Tree, it'll come true."
Yes. That's where it came from.
Long, long ago, when Artifacts were rare, and life was hard...
One winter, the snowfall was especially terrible. People quickly ran out of firewood and huddled in their homes, shivering.
Then suddenly—thunk! Something fell through a chimney and landed in the ashes of a dead fireplace—it was an Artifact no one had ever seen before.
And==W== it wasn't just that one family.==W== Every household received one.
They looked strange and all different from one another, but if you just poured a little magic into them, they'd warm the entire house up!
Those with chimneys found their Artifacts dropped down through them; those without found theirs hanging on nearby tree branches.
People went around asking who could have sent such precious gifts, and all they saw was a figure in a red scarf, riding a sleigh through the snow...
He called out, "Have a happy winter season! Accept these gifts!"
When people followed his trail into the forest, they found a great tree piled high with more gifts...
But the sleigh rider was gone, vanished like a spirit.
Thanks to those Artifacts, everyone survived the blizzard next day in warmth and safety.
Believing they were blessings from the God of Grace, people named the tree the "Snowish Tree."
And the gift-giver became known as the "Snowish Tree Spirit" sent by the God of Grace.
To commemorate this event, people began leaving gift boxes beneath the tree; they also copied the spirit by exchanging presents with friends and family...
And that's how the Snowish Festival began.
Every kid probably thinks that after making a wish, the gift they want might just appear beneath the tree...==W== Something like that.
But even back then, I wasn't that naive. I didn't believe in something like that would just happen to me.
After all...==W== If you're going to make a wish, you should be looking for a Wishing Box in the Monolith, not some tree.
But a kid can't go exploring the Monolith alone, right?==W== So I went to the tree instead, to make a wish I knew wouldn't come true.
That photo ...==W== must've been taken then.
So that's the truth==W== behind the Spirit photo.
Pretty much, yeah! I just never imagined I'd end up being passed around as some kind of "Snowish Tree Spirit"...==W== Hahaha!
Not your everyday experience, for sure.
So there's no spirit, after all.
