A tiny figure walked through the deep snow and stopped beneath the Snowish Tree.
If I just make a wish to this tree...
She murmured as she gazed at the rough bark.
Spirit of the Snowish Tree, I'm making a wish! Please... Please give me a friend I can play with!
Under the tree that was covered all in white, her small voice trembled with hope.
Please...==W== Please give me a friend I can play with!
Once, twice...==W== She repeated the same wish, over and over.
Her eyes stayed tightly shut. She didn't know how many times she'd said it.
From somewhere nearby, a voice came.
Laru opened her eyes and turned toward the sound.
Standing before her was a woman she had never seen before.
Oh my! You're flickering like a little crystal globe!==W== So cute!
Stung by the comment, Laru immediately tried to bolt.
Wait—==W==don't run away the second you see me. I am not scary.
A warm but steady hand came down on her shoulder.
I am ...==W== the Spirit of the Snowish Tree. And I have heard your wish~
Of course. But before I grant it,==W== I need to know a bit more about you.
Can you answer a few questions?
Laru? Oh, such a cute name!
Tell me, little Laru, would you like to play with a gentle sister, like me?
And where did you come from, little Laru?
That's great. And why do you want a friend?
Because it's so lonely, all by myself...
But you're such a good kid. How is it that you don't have any friends?
I ...==W== can't control my power...==W== I always end up glowing before I realized it...
And the fish get scared away by the light...==W== So no one wants to have me fishing with them...
I see. You aren't very good at controlling magic yet?
No...==W== If I am, I wouldn't be glowing like this now.
Is that so? I don't think that's the case at all~
You're going to say something like I have a talent for magic, aren't you?
Oh? I suppose someone's already told you that?
Grown-ups always say stuff like that. "Oh Laru, you're such a special kid." Whatever... They're all just lying...
If I were really special,==W== I'd be a cool kid. I'd have lots of friends!
I also believe that you do have something special inside you!
Why...==W== Why are you just like them? You're not a Spirit! And yet you said you'd grant my wish...==W== Liar! Liar!
I'm not lying, Laru. I will grant your wish.
As Laru got emotional, her body lit up again.
See?==W== I'm glowing again! No one will ever be friends with me like this!
Hmm...==W== Do you not want to be friends with me, little Laru?
Do you think the reason you can't make friends==W== ... is because you can't control the glow?
Because your light scares the fish away?
But, you see? I don't mind that at all.==W== Besides, I think you're super cute when you light up~
That's ...==W== just another lie! Grown-ups always lie. I don't wanna be friends with people like you!
Hmm~ I can see why you would think that way.
If we can't play together, what kind of friend is that?
How about we go play together? What do you say?
I'm not lying, and I'll prove it to you!
If I can get you to believe me,==W== you will call me your friend, Okay?
Uh...==W== Where are you taking me...?
The young witch winked and, with a swift motion, pulled a broom from who-knows-where.
Yep, it's a broom! And it's super comfy, don't worry.
Alright! Hold tight!==W== We're taking off!
Woah! W-we're flying!==W== This is amazing!
The broom shot upward, carrying them through the winter sky.
Laru had no idea where they were headed, but something warm bloomed quietly in her chest.

Wait—==W==don't run away the second you see me. I am not scary.
A warm but steady hand came down on her shoulder.
I am ...==W== the Spirit of the Snowish Tree. And I have heard your wish~
Of course. But before I grant it,==W== I need to know a bit more about you.
Can you answer a few questions?
Laru? Oh, such a cute name!
Tell me, little Laru, would you like to play with a gentle sister, like me?
And where did you come from, little Laru?
That's great. And why do you want a friend?
Because it's so lonely, all by myself...
But you're such a good kid. How is it that you don't have any friends?
I ...==W== can't control my power...==W== I always end up glowing before I realized it...
And the fish get scared away by the light...==W== So no one wants to have me fishing with them...
I see. You aren't very good at controlling magic yet?
No...==W== If I am, I wouldn't be glowing like this now.
Is that so? I don't think that's the case at all~
You're going to say something like I have a talent for magic, aren't you?
Oh? I suppose someone's already told you that?
Grown-ups always say stuff like that. "Oh Laru, you're such a special kid." Whatever... They're all just lying...
If I were really special,==W== I'd be a cool kid. I'd have lots of friends!
I also believe that you do have something special inside you!
Why...==W== Why are you just like them? You're not a Spirit! And yet you said you'd grant my wish...==W== Liar! Liar!
I'm not lying, Laru. I will grant your wish.
As Laru got emotional, her body lit up again.
See?==W== I'm glowing again! No one will ever be friends with me like this!
Hmm...==W== Do you not want to be friends with me, little Laru?
Do you think the reason you can't make friends==W== ... is because you can't control the glow?
Because your light scares the fish away?
But, you see? I don't mind that at all.==W== Besides, I think you're super cute when you light up~
That's ...==W== just another lie! Grown-ups always lie. I don't wanna be friends with people like you!
Hmm~ I can see why you would think that way.
If we can't play together, what kind of friend is that?
How about we go play together? What do you say?
I'm not lying, and I'll prove it to you!
If I can get you to believe me,==W== you will call me your friend, Okay?
Uh...==W== Where are you taking me...?
The young witch winked and, with a swift motion, pulled a broom from who-knows-where.
Yep, it's a broom! And it's super comfy, don't worry.
Alright! Hold tight!==W== We're taking off!
Woah! W-we're flying!==W== This is amazing!
The broom shot upward, carrying them through the winter sky.
Laru had no idea where they were headed, but something warm bloomed quietly in her chest.

strings.text: The witch carried Laru into the sky, where Laru witnessed glowing schools of fish on the vast lake surface for the first time. She gradually came to terms with her own uniqueness.
The magic broom, carrying both of them, reached the edge of the harbor shrouded by the night.
Woah...==W== This is ...==W== the sea! It's my first time seeing the sea!
Haha, looks like you are excited, too. This is not the sea, actually. Just a very large lake.
A lake? Hmm...==W== That's like the same thing, right? What are we gonna do here?
You're so smart, little Laru...==W== And here I was trying to hide it for a bit longer...
Wait! Don't run off by yourself! It's dangerous!
Waaah...==W== You brought me all the way out here, in the middle of nowhere. You're gonna kidnap me, aren't you!!
Liar! I have seen scenes like this in movies! I knew it...==W== As if someone like me could ever make real friends...!
You're trying to kidnap me for sure...!
Laru, you've got it all wrong! I honestly want to be your friend! So please ... stop saying "someone like me," alright?
But I... I don't have anything that'll make people like me in the first place...
But you are adorable, Laru! I just love kids like you!
Nonono...==W== Not like that! I mean, because you look so innocent and pure!
That's why you figured you could kidnap me with ease!
Wow, this is totally not what I said... Fine then! Since you still don't believe me, Laru, I have no choice but to show this to you—
This is ...==W== the Snowish Tree Spirit Appointment Certificate! Look, I've got the proof right here. You gotta believe me now...
Yes, yes! Just believe me, please. I'm not trying to kidnap you!
Then... Where exactly are you taking me?==W== Are we still not there yet?
It's a very mysterious place! So let me keep it secret just a little longer, alright?
Haha, Laru, you're finally not frowning anymore!
Friends don't keep a distance from each other. And you look super cute right now!
Exactly, just like that! You're just the cutest like this!
Ah—no, I didn't mean anything weird by that!
Well...==W== That's only because I didn't want you to get the wrong idea~
Fine, I believe you.==W== Then let's go. Take me to that ...==W== secret spot of yours!
Laru finally smiled again, and the distance between the two quietly faded away.
The broom rose into the air once more, skimming over the water as it carried them toward the distant horizon.
On the pitch-black sea, her small figure stood out as it blinked in and out of view.
Laru, are you scared of flying up here? Hehe, don't worry. I'll get you to our destination safe and sound!
I...==W== I just thought my glow would scare away the fish again...
The fish you saw before swam away from you because they lived in a little stream.==W== But here, it's different.
Woah—!!! The water...==W== The water is glowing?!
Those are glowing fish. And look...==W== They're following us...==W== No... They're following you, Laru!
They aren't scared...==W== Why? Usually,==W== the moment they see my glow, they all swim off...
Some fish do swim away from light. But there're also some that swim toward it.

Laru, everything you saw before was just a little stream.==W== But even coming out here to a lake, you've already met different kinds of fish.==W== And farther beyond this place, there is an entire ocean waiting for you.
You are still little right now, so the world around you is small, too.==W== But as you grow, your world will grow wider and wider!
Once you've seen more of the world, Laru...==W== You'll discover that there are so, so many different people out there.
Different ... people...==W== Will they be friends with me?
Of course. You will have many, many friends.
And I'm already your friend, right?
Anyway,==W== that's what happened. That's how I met the real "Snowish Tree Spirit" back then.
Stop—==W==I know what you're about to say!
You're going to say that she was just someone working for Grace Imperium,==W== or maybe some witch passing by...==W== Or someone doing a side gig?
It doesn't matter if you think it was babying a kid or just something silly.==W== What matters is that I got myself out of a dark place!
A small figure has been at our side without us noticing.
Isn't this the little girl we'd run into several times today...?
You... You know ...==W== the Snowish Tree Spirit?
Ah...==W== Hm? I guess ...==W== you could say that?
How...==W== How can I meet her?
How about this: tonight, come with us to the Snowish Tree.
... If I come, can I meet the Spirit?
The girl smiled, satisfied, and skipped away.
Ah! I forgot to ask if she got her gift.
Well, it's fine. We can ask her tonight instead.==W== Right, Miss Spirit?
Hehe, you read my mind! So then...==W== Tyrant, you'll come help, right?
Naturally. Tonight, I'm the "Snowish Festival Tyrant," Limited Edition!

strings.text: Laru plays the part of the Snowish Tree Spirit, fulfilling the kids' wish. It is then that the mysterious girl who has been secretly following you finally makes her appearance.
Happy Snowish Festival to you, too! Bye-bye!
That kid was the last one in line...
So the girl who just left ...==W== probably doesn't live nearby, right?
Yeah, I guess she came to us just because she wanted to see the Snowish Tree Spirit.
Right...==W== And that makes what we'll do later all the more meaningful...
In other words, it'll be challenging, but fun.
Wow, I really admire your positive attitude, Tyrant!
All right! I—==W==Lady Laru—will make an exception for you today and work overtime!
After that ambitious declaration, Laru and I go to her favorite fishing gear store to prepare for the plan.
Hmm... I think I need a new fishing line...
Wow! The latest fishing rods! They look so good... But I just bought one the other day...==W== Ah, never mind!
Okay, just a fishing line and some bait for today...==W== But what if I'll never find these rods again...
She is buying what she needs for our plan... Right?
Though it doesn't look like it...
Hey, Tyrant! Which one do you prefer? The one for shallow water fishing, or the one for deep sea fishing?
Come on, you are the expert here. Just pick whichever you think suits best.
Oh, please! Do it for me! Just follow your gut!
Well, deep sea fishing sounds cool. I'll pick that one!
Great! That's pretty much everything we'll need!
Oh, so you really are preparing?
Of course! I've got everything ready!
I thought you just wanted a new set of fishing gear...
Eh? Well... I deserve it! After all,==W== I work soooo hard every day!
Alright, we should go back to the Snowish Tree now. I'll tell you the details of the plan along the way.
A lot of kids have gathered around the Snowish Tree when we arrive.
Will I ... actually see the Snowish Tree Spirit?
Please... Let me see the Spirit before I have to go home...
It's getting dark now. We'll see her soon!
Yeah! The Snowish Tree Spirit shines! We can definitely spot her easily!
Wow, the kids are all here, as expected.
Except that little girl... That's weird... She seemed so excited to see the Spirit...
Never mind. I'll carry out Laru's plan first...
Hey, it's you! Are you here for the Spirit, too?
Yeah! I saw that photo, and I really want to see the Spirit with my own eyes.
Then let's wait for her together!
We've all got presents this year, so we'll definitely see her!
Suddenly, a dazzling light lit up the whole square.
Could it be ...==W== the Snowish Tree Spirit?!
The Spirit ... is bigger than I imagined...
Does the Snowish Tree Spirit grow just like us?
Oh no, the kids are getting suspicious. We must do something!
Ah! The light's so bright! Ah, my eyes!
It really is the Snowish Tree Spirit!
Haha! Dear kids, I could sense how much you wished to see me, so I rushed over just for you!
Thank you, everyone! Thank you for waiting for me in spite of the cold! Now, warm yourselves up with these yummy fries!
You are welcome, kids. I'm so happy that you like them!
Uh-oh, I have to head home now, or my mom is going to be mad at me!
We saw the Snowish Tree Spirit! I need to tell everyone about it!
Bye-bye, Miss Spirit! Happy Snowish Festival!
And that little girl never came...
I follow Laru's gaze, and I see a familiar figure standing there.
Now that all the other kids are gone, the girl scampers over.
... Miss Spirit... I have a wish...

strings.text: To fulfill the wish, you and Laru bring the mysterious girl, Firefly, to the Monolith, only to discover that her strength is extraordinary... A somewhat nonsensical "game" begins.
Erm...==W== Miss Spirit ... I have a wish...
A wish? Hmm...==W== Okay... I see.
I can make it come true, but before that,==W== I need to know you a bit better.
Can you ...==W== answer a few questions first?
Little Firefly... What a lovely name!
Tell me, little Firefly, do you like the gentle Miss Spirit?
Uh... I'm just trying to act like Miss Witch...
Gentle... Miss Spirit...? I don't understand...
Haha... Right, my bad!==W== Next question! Where did you come from?
Oh, your professor! Alright...==W== Have you received the gift from Grace Imperium?
I see...==W== So your wish isn't about gifts, was it?
Okay... Then, what is your wish?
I wish for ...==W== a friend to play with.
... Am I asking for too much, Miss Spirit?
Absolutely not! I'm just wondering—why would you have no friends to play with?
Alright! Then I—the Snowish Tree Spirit—will keep you company!
What do you want to do, little Firefly?
I want to ... go to the Monolith.
You want to go to the Monolith ...==W== to make a wish for something?
No, I want to ...==W== play there.
My professor... She doesn't allow me to go alone...==W== But if you can go with me...
Play in the Monolith...==W== Well, I guess the more forbidden a place is, the more enticing it is... How about we...?
... But the Monolith is too dangerous for a kid!
Well...==W== Ah!==W== Tyrant, a word, please!
The Monolith in town is managed by Grace Imperium, so it should be safe, right?
You work for Grace Imperium.==W== You should know that better than me.
She didn't say she wanted to climb it, so we can just bring her there for a peek... That won't be a problem, right?==W== Especially since we'll be there.
So we just show her around the entrance?
Yes, yes! That should be fine!
Okay. Let's do it then. It should be ...==W== fine, right?
Little Firefly, let's go to the Monolith!
We thought we could make it a safe little adventure without going deep inside the Monolith. But...
Seriously?! There shouldn't be so many Stellaroids here!
Complain about it later.==W== Protect Firefly first!
Firefly walks from behind Laru straight toward the Stellaroids, with no sense of fear at all.
The Stellaroids run away when I go near them, but when everyone joins, we can play with them.
Are you playing hide-and-seek?==W== Okay, I'm the seeker now. You wanna join?
Are you talking to Firefly, or the Stellaroids...?
I don't know what's going on... Just follow her first!
Come on, guys! Make it harder for me!
You run, I chase, so much fun...
Hmm... Do you think Firefly has no friends because...
I've caught them all. That's so easy. Almost boring, actually.
Impressive... She took down so many Stellaroids ... on her own...
Who knows...! Anyway, I think we should go back. There'll be more danger ahead...==W== Let's leave!
... Wow! Look at it! This one looks fun!

strings.text: The work is done. Laru brings you to the place where she first witnessed the "magic of friendship." She had specially prepared a gift for you—one that was very much in her style...
Hah... Hah...==W== Finally... We survived it!
Whew...==W== That was too much... We were supposed to have fun...
Uh, you are welcome... Time for us to go back!
Firefly...==W== Are you sure you don't need us to send you home?
Mm-hmm. Thank you ... for the good time.
I promised your wish would come true! Oh, by the way, don't ever go into the Monolith on your own!==W== We know you're really good... But still, it's dangerous!
Good girl! Here are some hot and crispy fries for you! You earned them!
They smell so good! Thank you.==W== Bye!
Laru waves goodbye emotionally until Firefly is no longer in sight.
Emor City is so full of wonder... I bet all kinds of amazing kids live here...
That's true, including one born with the magic of light!
Hey! Stop teasing me!==W== Take this!
Phew... Actually, Miss Witch and I said goodbye the same way back then.
And I never saw her again after that.
Well, since you said she was a witch...==W== She probably went to some other places to hunt for news.
You'll see her again someday.==W== I just have this feeling.
If I ever see her again, I'll tell her that I can also fulfill many kids' wishes now acting as a Spirit, just like she did!
Whoa! Is that why you worked so hard today?
Kind of... If I see her again on the day of the Snowish Festival, I want to at least be able to talk to her without guilt...==W== Uh, to show her that I've become a better person...?
But of course, the children's joy and happiness are my main drive!
Good for you. You really have become a better person.
Oh, by the way, did you manage to make friends after meeting Miss Witch?
Whoa! That's sharp!==W== Actually... Not really...
I still glowed from time to time when I couldn't keep it in check...==W== And the kids just kept their distance from me...==W== But thanks to her, I've gradually stopped letting it get to me.
And I realized, I don't need another person to fish, so I started to go fishing on my own... And it just became my obsession...
With a lot of practice,==W== I started to make big progress, and other anglers started to approach me for fishing tips!
And ... that's how I made many fishing buddies! Hahaha!
I've also been glowing a lot less ever since...==W== Maybe fishing actually brought peace to my mind and body?
... So you do need fishing for your mental and physical health...
In a word, what Miss Witch said to me allowed me to finally accept my true ...==W== special self.
Like she said,==W== never be limited by what you see...==W== There is a much bigger world out there awaiting my exploration.
Heh-heh... I do wish to become someone like her... So, for Snowish Festival, I'm happy to work hard!
You can also work hard on other days!
Listen! The bell's ringing... The Snowish Festival celebrations have come to an end.
Thank you for your hard work.==W== I mean ... we did well!
... Umm... Tyrant! Can you stay with me a little longer?
Sure, no problem. Something else you need to do?
Just let me ... repay what you've done for me today!
Laru grabs my hand and runs all the way to the port.
What's going on? Dragging me all the way out here without a word—==W==don't tell me you're trying to kidnap me too?
I want to show you ...==W== this!
Her body glows softly. Unlike the bright way she shone for the kids,==RT==this time, the light is ... gentle.
She indicated toward the water under the pier.
Laru's glow attracts many fish, and they keep swimming in circles in the harbor.
This is amazing... I never expected to see something like this here.
You don't see this every day! This is me working my magic!
Simply put, they are drawn to my light.
Mm-hmm... But magic like this is too conspicuous, which is why I'm only showing it to you now, when it's quiet!
I always come here after the Snowish Festival celebrations to draw fish with my magic...==W== And they answer me with their glow, too... Then I can call it a day with peace of mind.
Is this ... what Laru saw when she was a little girl...?
I wanted to show this to Miss Witch first,==W== but ...==W== I decided that it's okay for you to be the first one!
Thank you. It's my honor to have this privilege.
Your Snowish Festival gift! Haha! Isn't it adorable? This rod is yours, too!
Isn't this rod what you just bought? And where on earth did you get that glowing fish?
With this rod...==W== Is that fish meant to be bait? But isn't it a little too big for bait?!
See? Just hook one up, and you can attract more fish!
Haha, I see. Did you develop this magic to help with your fishing?!
Anyway...==W== Haha, thank you for this gift.
I'm looking forward to catching many fish with it...
Wow, look who's crazy for fishing now! Let's fish through the night!
Don't worry.==W== You won't be able to get enough of it!
The Snowish Festival has come to an end, and a new day is dawning...==W== And here we are, still savoring our own little moment.

Firefly...==W== Are you sure you don't need us to send you home?

They smell so good! Thank you.==W== Bye!
Laru waves goodbye emotionally until Firefly is no longer in sight.

Whoa! Is that why you worked so hard today?

Good for you. You really have become a better person.
Oh, by the way, did you manage to make friends after meeting Miss Witch?
Whoa! That's sharp!==W== Actually... Not really...

... So you do need fishing for your mental and physical health...

Like she said,==W== never be limited by what you see...==W== There is a much bigger world out there awaiting my exploration.

strings.text: The New Star Guild has gone missing in Cangwu! While out searching for them, you cross paths with Coronis, who's on her own search for Jinglin.
Perfect timing. We hit a Loong festival. That's why the streets are way busier than usual.
A recent festival? Oh, you mean Lovers' Day?
Had no idea the Loong went this hard for Lovers' Day! They must be romance pros!
Huh? Wait, are they bad at it?
Actually,==W== it's the "<color=#3faeae>Springseek Festival</color>"—the biggest festival of the year for the Loong.
They say every Loong who can make the trip comes back to Cangwu to celebrate with family and friends.
Exactly! Wait, how do you know all that,==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==?
Read it in this pamphlet. It even lists the local food spots and souvenirs.
Sweet! I've been dying to try authentic Loong hotpot!
Souvenir stalls over there.==W== Wanna take a look.
Rest assured, hotpot and souvenirs are happening.==W== I even snagged a discount at the inn. We're finally in Cangwu, so let's make it count!
But first, we've got business to take care of...
... Taking commissions and raking in Dorra!
<size=50>You bet!</size>==W== Holiday rates are through the roof. We'd be crazy to walk away from a payday like this!
Stack the cash now, then splurge later without guilt!
Fair point. Should we head to the Trekkers' House?
We'll handle the commission. Boss, you go ahead and get us checked in.
If we miss the check-in window, we lose that discount.
And just like that, the three girls of the New Star Guild vanished into the bustling streets of Cangwu.
A whole night has passed, and still no sign of them.
We'll knock this out in a flash!
It's getting late. Are you coming back tonight?
Is something wrong? I can't reach any of you.
Please reply when you see this.
Calls aren't connecting, and total silence on texts.
Even the staff at the Trekkers' House haven't seen them.
Didn't they say they picked up the commission there?
I suppose I should report this...
To get to the Baize Bureau...==W== Do I go this way, or was it that way?
Oh my. If it isn't my adorable assistant.
I follow the voice. The streets of Cangwu are bustling as ever.==W== But among the festive sights, a familiar—yet striking—figure stands out.
I didn't expect to see you here. Consider this a pleasant holiday surprise.
I received an invitation, so I decided to take a vacation here in Cangwu.
What is it? Is my attire distracting you?
I don't even know where I'm supposed to look!!
When in Cangwu, do as the Loong do. It's all part of the fun, isn't it?
It allows me to blend into the environment. I prefer not to draw unnecessary attention to myself.
No, you stick out even more now!==W== Everyone is staring at you...
You seem so intrigued. Shall I take you to the tailor? We could get an outfit made for you, too.
That's kind of you... But I'll pass.
Really? A pity. I was curious to see how you would look in Loong's fashion.
Since we're both here, why don't we walk together? You could guide me through the sights of Cangwu...
Or so I'd like to say. But I have urgent matters to attend to.==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, do you know the way to the Baize Bureau?
You're heading to the Bureau too? Perfect. I'm actually on my way there right now.
Yeah. My friends, the New Star Guild members, have gone missing.
What a coincidence.==W== I can't reach Jinglin, either.
==PLAYER_NAME== arrived near Cangwu with Noya, Amber, and Iris on a commission, stopping here to rest and resupply.
After arriving yesterday, the three of them split off with you to take a side commission. After that, ==PLAYER_NAME== lost contact with them.
As for Ms. Coronis, she has known Jinglin since treating her mother in Philae. She came here on vacation at Jinglin's invitation.
However, when she visited Jinglin's home yesterday, she learned that Jinglin had gone out and never returned.
I still can't reach any of them. We'd look for clues ourselves, but we don't know our way around as Coronis and I are new to Cangwu.
I understand. Ordinarily, I'd lead the search myself, but I have urgent official business I cannot step away from...
I will, however, alert my colleagues to keep a lookout. If any leads surface, I'll notify you immediately.
In that case, leave it to me!
Chixia? What are you doing here?
Got sent on an errand run, what else?
Ta-da! Behold, Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword, polished and good as new! The seniors even added some mods—you're gonna love 'em!
New mods... Right. Thank you. Please pass on my regards to your seniors as well.
Anyway, I heard what you were saying.==W== Missing friends? That sounds pretty serious.
Since Shimiao's stuck at her desk, I, the great Xuan Shi Chixia, will help you track them down!

strings.text: Hearing about the missing group, Chixia takes the lead and guides you and Coronis through the bustling marketplaces in search of clues. From the locals' accounts, you've gathered useful information.
Aaaand ... done! Heh. Pretty slick, huh?
Look at those strokes! So ... majestic. It's like a soaring swan, or ...==W== Uh... Or a...
Ahem! Anyway! A Xuan Shi clearly has a masterful hand. The writing captures your spirit perfectly. Bold and extraordinary!
Since you were such a big help, these are for you! A little thank-you gift.
Oh, you're too kind! I just answered a few questions, hardly any trouble at all.
But this ... masterpiece... You really should take it with you. Surely someone out there needs it more than I do!
Think so? Well, thanks for the compliment. We're off, see ya!
Chixia weaves out of the crowd and trots back to us, waving the freshly dried papers.
These? "Springseek Couplets."==W== Folks paste new ones around their doors to welcome the season.
That looks like Loong scripts. What do they mean?
Just some phrases for good fortune... Ward off bad vibes.
Ward off bad vibes? I see. The glyphs do look quite mysterious and chaotic. Might look nice on my clinic door...
You want 'em? All yours! If you like them, I can churn out a whole stack for you!
Please do. Perhaps they will attract some rare diseases for me to study.
Ahem... I'm pretty sure that's the opposite of "good fortune"...
Never mind... Anyway, at least we finally got a solid lead.
Yep. Noya and the others stopped to watch him write the scrolls. He remembered Iris clearly—not many Novians can read Loong script, so she definitely stood out.
They talked about buying a set, but passed because they had to rush off to meet a client.
So, they skipped the Trekkers' House and picked up a commission straight from someone in town.
That's still not enough to go on... Let's keep asking around.
Sorry, the group doesn't ring a bell.==W== But that short girl in the photo? She grabbed breakfast here yesterday. We even chatted a bit about groceries.
Yeah, with the Springseek Festival coming up, folks are stocking up like crazy. Stuff that's usually everywhere is running low.
She was prepping for a Springseek feast I think, but was short on ingredients. Said she'd look elsewhere.
No trouble.==W== Say, you folks eaten? Wanna try my specialty broth buns?
Been making 'em for decades. One bite and you're hooked, guaranteed!
Why did you take such a huge bite? Careful! There's an art to this: nip a hole in the skin, sip the broth...
Hah, tried to warn you, but you chomped it right down! Love the gusto—makes me hungry! Hahaha!
Hmm... Thin yet resilient membrane. Rich fluids. Compact, succulent core tissue.
Loong cuisine offers such infinite inspiration.
Indeed. It would be an excellent delivery vector for oral medication.
Let's move. We have sampled the local fare; we must resume our investigation.
What? Jinglin's missing?! But I just asked her about vacation homework a couple of days ago... How could she...
Correct. We are currently gathering leads. Do you possess relevant information?
You don't think ...==W== maybe a kidnapper lured her away?
Why do you suspect a kidnapper?
B-because ...==W== it's happened before! A while back, kidnappers just ... swarmed the city out of nowhere!
Yeah! Wicked people in black robes and bird-beak masks. Many followed them and never came back!
Black robes, bird beaks... Wait, you don't mean...
Oh! Shimiao mentioned that! She said a company called "United Harvest" was practically dragging people off the streets to work in Philae.
Once they got there, they were so buried in work they never had time to come home.
And on the rare chance a letter arrived, it was total gibberish. Everyone was terrified they'd suffered a mental breakdown.
Uh... From what I hear, United Harvest in Philae has cleaned up its act. Seriously.
Chixia guides Coronis and me down the street as we ask around.
Hey, there's a stall ahead with amazing sugar-roasted chestnuts! And its Tanghulus are to die for!
The owner does sugar art and dough figures too...==W== Last time, he made me a tiger!
Ahem! T-That's obviously not why we're here! We need to, uh, survey the area for clues... Ah! Look at that line forming! If they sell out, I'm done for...==W== Huh?
Well, well. Look who it is.
Senior Jiyue, you're here too? What brings you here?
You...==W== You made up that errand for me to go to Shimiao just to sneak out for snacks on your own?!
No, no. These are for Master.
Swear! She was pacing holes in the floor, desperate for sweets. She didn't want anyone knowing she broke her no-sugar diet, so she sent us on a secret snack run...
Here, take the Tanghulu. Just keep this between us, okay?
Way too smooth. Definitely not their first time pulling a stunt like this...
Oh! Senior, actually, could I ask a favor?
Between bites of Tanghulu, Chixia fills her seniors in on the search mission.
Could you do a reading for us? We're trying to track down Jinglin and the New Star Guild.
I can try...==W== But the best I'll get is a vague direction relative to them.
I'd heard Xuan Shi's divination was quite potent. Is calculating precise coordinates not possible?
Hah! If our arts worked like that, the world would be in total chaos by now.
People move, minds change, energy shifts. Pinpointing a living, breathing target... Well, let's just say the currents of fate aren't stable enough for a lock right now.
I see. I made a false assumption.
No harm done. So,==W== shall I proceed with the reading?
Their fates are tangled... Everyone you're seeking is gathered at the same spot, right this moment.
All of them together? What in the world is going on?
My vision is hazy on the details. Head east and examine the walls—you may find a clue there.
The walls? What does that mean?
Go. All will be revealed once you arrive.
Are Jinglin and the others safe?
Rest assured, they are unharmed. They have simply been detained.
Thanks! We're off! Come on everyone, let's hit the east side!
Don't forget to come back for the feast later!
You saw something else, didn't you? Something involving that thing we investigated?
Why keep them in the dark?
That anomaly is harmless. Since it poses no threat, we should let nature take its course.
Telling them changes nothing. We need not interfere. Let fate guide it to those meant to find it.
Fine. They're gone. You can drop the mystical sage act now.
I know, I know—divination isn't exactly your forte, so you're just afraid that the more you say, the more you'll get wrong. It’s totally fine, really!
Those roasted chestnuts were delicious. I'll get you another bag.

strings.text: At a hotpot restaurant, you run into Shimiao, who is investigating the firecracker thefts. As the pieces fall into place, you realize your friends' disappearance is tied to a smuggling ring...
Hey, you sure we followed Senior's directions right?==W== 'Cause I'm seeing nothing on this wall!
The eastern wall...==W== Miss Chixia, did your Senior mean for us to check the actual wall?
I assumed it was a metaphor. Something only a Xuan Shi could interpret.
Senior knew our limits, so she translated the hexagrams into plain speech.
If she said the wall on the east, she meant the wall on the east.
Hm? Wait, looks like there's something posted over there...
High-paying porter job. No contact info, just a meeting spot...==W== "Red Pot Restaurant," No.9 Fangcao Road?
Oh! I know that place! Great hotpot. Shimiao actually cried her eyes out from the spice last time.
The paper's still crisp. Must be a fresh posting.
We'll knock this out in a flash!
They mentioned a delivery job, too...
They probably saw this flyer and took the gig.
The hotpot spot doesn't seem linked to Jinglin, but let's go ask around anyway.
Thought things had finally settled down. Can't believe this is happening again.
I understand the frustration.==W== The Baize Bureau is investigating, and we'll have answers for you soon.
Excuse me, I'd like to ask if—==W==huh? Shimiao?
Oh, it's you. Any luck with the search? Or are you just here for hotpot?
We're following a lead. Came to ask a few questions.
What are you doing here? Back for round two with the Heaven-and-Hell Ultimate Spicy Hotpot?
Wh-what nonsense...==W== I'm here on duty. Investigating the stolen firecrackers.
Sigh... Thief broke in last night. Cleaned out our entire stock of firecrackers.
It just isn't a festival without them. I tried to restock, but they're sold out everywhere.
My kid's been counting down the days. You can imagine how crushed they are now.
Relatable! If I couldn't play with firecrackers as a kid, I'd have cried my eyes out.
Good thing I hoarded a ton of 'em. I'll have some sent your way later.
Right, you mentioned ... you had questions?
We're looking for someone. Seen any of these girls around?
You show the owner the photos of the New Star Guild and Jinglin.
Why, that's Jinglin! Distant relative of mine. Stopped by just yesterday to catch up.
Said she was heading out of town to harvest winter bamboo shoots. They make a great stew.
I remember those three. Came in just as the lunch rush was winding down. Sat for a bit, but ...==W== they weren't alone. Someone else was with them.
A local girl in red—seemed pretty high-energy. They didn't order anything, just chatted for a while then took off in a hurry.
Oh, right. When I served them tea, I heard them planning a trip out of the city. Something about moving valuables.
It was? Glad I could help then.
We'll let you get back to business. I will notify you once we reach a conclusion regarding the stolen firecrackers.
You're welcome. Safe travels!==W== And do come back to try our signature hotpot...
Shimiao, when you said you had work earlier, were you referring to this firecracker theft?
Yes. The city has been plagued by a string of firecracker thefts recently.
From what we've uncovered so far, one thing is certain—the fireworks have been moved out of the city...
Unfortunately, the trail ends there. We haven't been able to locate the thieves' hideout in the vast Wilds.
Wait, that rings a bell...==W== I think someone at the retreat was warning everyone to stay alert, too.
I thought the case was going cold when the thieves vanished without a trace for days ...==W== until we started receiving a flood of reports today about last night's thefts.
They went dark for days, only to come back and steal more?
Correct... And their mode of operating has shifted.
The earlier thefts affected many households, but only small quantities of fireworks were stolen from each.
But last night, they targeted homes with large stockpiles and cleaned them out completely. Not a single sparkler was left behind.
But why steal so many? Is this guy trying to throw the biggest Springseek party in history?
Working as an underground doctor in the Ash District teaches you a lot about how the gray market operates.
My guess? We're dealing with smugglers.
Smugglers? Seriously? What's the point of smuggling firecrackers?
The firecrackers are just a front.==W== They use them to traffic gunpowder across city borders undetected.
I've heard rumors of a buyer paying top coin for gunpowder. They want weapons that don't need magic. No success stories yet, though.
Fireworks production and trade in Cangwu are strictly regulated. Unauthorized export is absolutely prohibited.
That makes this a grave offense. We cannot stand by while Cangwu's goods are exploited for malicious ends.
What is it? Did you realize something?
Based on what the restaurant owner said, the New Star Guild definitely took that commission from the ad.
And the job has to be moving that stolen cargo out of the city.
Huh? I thought they were hauling firecrackers from inside the city to the outside?
Shimiao just confirmed the group has already moved the firecrackers outside city limits.
They likely smuggled them out in small batches to avoid detection, stockpiling everything at a hideout in the Wilds. Now that they have a full load, they're ready to move it all at once.
A shipment that size requires extra hands. Hiring the New Star Guild for labor... Yes, that logic holds up.
Their fates are tangled... Everyone you're seeking is gathered at the same spot, right this moment.
Rest assured, they are unharmed. They have simply been detained.
If the New Star and Jinglin are together, maybe they ran into the smugglers and got stuck!
Plausible... But how did Jinglin get entangled in this?
It's just a theory based on the divination, but here is what I suspect...
The New Star likely realized the nature of the job mid-transport and confronted the client.
And Jinglin, who was out hunting for ingredients, probably stumbled onto the scene and got dragged into the mess.
If that is the case, locating the smugglers is our top priority.
But how? Tracking a group that has vanished into the Wilds is almost impossible.
About that... I actually have a plan...
We can bait them into walking right into our hands.

strings.text: Using a large stockpile of fireworks, you successfully lure the smugglers straight into your trap at nightfall.
Chixia and Coronis shove a cart overloaded with firecrackers through the busy crowd.
I hand-picked every single one of these firecrackers myself.
Tweaked a few of 'em, too. They pack three times the punch...==W== No, scratch that—five times, minimum!
Oh? Fascinating. I wasn't aware you dabbled in pyrotechnics.
You bet! My custom crackers are actually kinda famous among enthusiasts!
Like this one—sealed a talisman inside. Plays a recording when it blows.==W== This one shouts "Prosperity to You,"==W== that one screams "Money Go My Home!"
And check this: my new Sky-Quaking Thunder Pillar. It's man-sized!==W== Seniors tackled me before I could test-fire it at the retreat, though...
Hehe... I must say, I admire your innovation. Your commitment to field testing is quite refreshing.
For real? Finally, someone who gets me!
If you dig this stuff, Coronis, swing by Yunji Retreat sometime. I've got way cooler gadgets stashed away.
I'd be delighted. Xuan Shi arts fascinate me. I'm sure they'll provide ample inspiration.
Arts? You mean our spells?==W== Hehe... Just you wait. I'll show you my talisman skills later!==W== Try not to be too blown away, okay?
I look forward to it.==W== Now then, where exactly are we heading?
If we want eyes on us, let's hit the street opposite. It's packed.
Huh? That's a huge cart of firecrackers. You two setting up a stall?
Look at the size of those things! Bet they make a serious bang. Gonna be quite a show!
Heh heh, you've got a sharp eye!
Just look at this beauty. Pretty on the outside, sure, but the inside is a masterpiece of...==W== Ah—
As Chixia sneezes, a flame shoots right from the tip of her tail.
Huh? Where'd those sparks come from?!==W== Q-Quick, put it out!
You two. That is a lot of explosives you are transporting. I presume you filed the necessary declarations?
Pyrotechnics of this magnitude require mandatory reporting and inspection for both transport and storage.
Furthermore, the fuses are of inconsistent lengths, and the casings violate safety standards. These are unauthorized modifications, correct?
I am unaware of your specific alterations, but unstable explosives pose a severe risk. One mistake could be catastrophic.
Do you know the danger this poses? If that fuse had not been extinguished, the resulting fire would require far more than a simple apology to resolve.
I mean... Yeah, you've got a point...
For safety reasons, the Baize Bureau will take custody of this batch. We shall determine their disposal after a thorough assessment.
Fine. Guess I'll have to part with my babies...==W== You take good care of 'em for me!
Before the watching crowd, Shimiao confiscates the entire haul of firecrackers and takes them away.
She has departed. You may stop cowering now, Miss Chixia.
Phew...==W== Scared me half to death. Shimiao is absolutely terrifying when she's in work mode...
So... How was the acting? Pretty solid, right? Like the real deal!
A splendid performance. Especially those sparks you conjured. It gave the bystanders a genuine fright.
Anyway, that should do the trick, right?
Yes, the intensity and frequency were sufficient. Now, we simply wait and watch.
Night falls outside a deserted warehouse.
Pick up the pace! Any slower and the patrol's gonna catch us red-handed!
Keep it down! All that racket... You're trying to get us caught?
Hey! You there! What do you think you're doing?!
Taking a breather. What's it look like?
Suck it up and keep moving! Every second counts right now. We don't have time for breaks!
It's not that we won't... We literally can't. I haven't slept in two days...
Pull it together! Don't let the struggle beat you down. Let the money knock you out!
We're not moving firecrackers here. We're carrying next year's savings, a new house, and good karma for the next life!
We pull this off, and no one looks down on the Prosperity Gang again! Impressive haul for a few nights of toiling!
D-Did ...==W== that noise just come from the firecracker pile?!
Did the firecrackers just talk?! Are we hallucinating from exhaustion...?
Rest assured, your ears work just fine!
Oh gods, now there are firecracker spirits... I've officially lost my mind.
Use your head! That's obviously an enemy! D-Don't panic! There's only one of her. She can't take us all.
Ah-haha... The firecracker spirits are multiplying!
Wait... You're with the Baize Bureau?!
Theft, smuggling, and now, assault with intent.==W== We have caught you red-handed with undeniable evidence. I strongly advise you to surrender immediately.
Tch! Can't get busted here! Forget the loot! Scatter!
On it!==W== Wait... M-My legs... Why won't they move?!
It appears ...==W== the special anesthetic is finally taking hold.
Anesthetic?!==W== Did we... Did we walk straight into a setup?
Took you long enough to catch on.==W== Then again, seeing how dead on your feet you were, I suppose this is expected.
Impossible...==W== We were careful. Covered every track. How did you sniff us out?
Hehe. Simple. Our brilliant commander foresaw your every move.
About that... I actually have a plan...
We can bait them into walking right into our hands.
It can't be that easy.==W== What does the plan entail?
Like I said, they've been smuggling firecrackers out in small batches to a hideout. Now they're just waiting to stockpile a fuller load before moving it.
And yesterday, they hired New Star for transport.
Needing extra hands meant they had already gathered enough stock. They were ready to leave Cangwu.
But last night, the thefts suddenly resumed.
This time, they broke their pattern and cleaned out every last firecracker from the victims' homes.
My guess is that they hit a snag yesterday. Lost the cargo, panicked, and rushed back to restock.
They're still hiding in the city. And nothing draws desperate thieves like a massive, unguarded pile of firecrackers.
And exactly as predicted, the criminals led us straight to their nest.
Those firecrackers? Consider them a gift. The perfect bait, prepared just for you.
We were this close to a fortune! I'm not going down like this!

strings.text: From the smugglers, you learn the truth behind your disappeared friends. You decide to launch a rescue at the Monolith, but the leader delivers a trembling warning—the legendary "Nian" resides inside.
Stop the beating! I surrender, okay?!
<size=60>Start talking and we'll go easy on you. Keep quiet, and you'll regret it!
I'll talk! Whatever you wanna know!
Just give us the truth. We'll decide your fate==W== once we've heard the full story.
You hired three Trekkers for a cargo run yesterday. So, where are they? Why are you the only ones who made it back?
Huh? Oh... Right, them... Well, see, it went down like this...
Look at all these cargos... You guys moving in or something? Trying to cash in a mountain of wishes all at once?
She's right...==W== Besides, making that many wishes costs too many memories.
Oh, it's fine! Don't worry about that!
Your payment is generous...==W== Incredibly so. But we can't in good conscience stand by and watch you walk into a death trap.
I get why you're worried, but trust me, it's fine. Honestly...==W== These supplies aren't for the climb.
Then why are we hauling all this stuff inside?
I guess you aren't gonna let this go, are you? Fine. I'll level with you.
I had a best friend once. We grew up together. Back when times were the hardest, we only survived because we had each other to lean on...
The client tearfully recounts how her best friend sacrificed herself to save her, using her final breath to smile and ask her to live on.
I'm not the only one. Everyone in our group has lost someone to the Monolith—friends, family...
That's why we return to the Monolith every Springseek Festival with their favorite things.
They say the Monolith is a place of miracles. What if ...==W== they really could come back home to us?
I see... No wonder these supplies mean so much to you.
Waaah! That is the most touching thing I've ever heard!!!
Wh—Where did this kid pop out from?!
Oops, sorry! I was digging for wild herbs nearby and couldn't help overhearing. Didn't mean to pry!
It was just such a moving story... I couldn't stop the tears...
Hold on, aren't you the manager of Jing's Bistro? What are you doing all the way out here? Shouldn't you be in Philae?
I'm back for the festival! And you guys? What brings you all the way to Cangwu?
We wrapped up a commission nearby and decided to stop here for a breather.
Seeing Jinglin reminds me of her cooking... Great, now my stomach's growling.
Hehe. Wanna drop by my place tomorrow for a family feast to kick off the new year?
Too bad the Springseek rush cleaned out the markets. I can't find half the ingredients I need.
Half a day of scavenging, and this handful of greens is all I've got to show for it.
Tag along with us to the Monolith then... Get whatever ingredients you want straight from a Wishing Box!
Brilliant idea! I'm coming with you!
Ahem... Taking a kid into the Monolith seems ... risky.
Don't worry, I'm keeping my eyes on her. Besides, Jinglin packs a mean punch—she can handle herself.
Er... Give us a second to talk it over.
What's the play? That girl's a Loong. If she sniffs out our cover...
They just want to travel together. Making a scene excluding her will only make us look suspicious.
Fine. Just watch your mouths. She's not local, so she probably won't notice anything off.
Alright, we'll travel as a group. But keeping the young lady safe is on you.
That's the gist of it... We posed as Loongs, spun a sob story, and tricked those Trekkers into hauling our firecrackers into the Monolith.
But why stash them inside the Monolith?
Moving that much powder is a nightmare. You get inspected at every city gate, and rival gangs are always looking to hijack you.
So we figured we'd dump the stash in the Monolith first. That allows us enter the city clean to resupply, then smuggle the goods out in small batches later.
It didn't matter if anyone else found it. We did our research. We know that Trekkers can only bring out Artifacts they get from the Wishing Box.
In a way, the Monolith is the world's safest vault.
These guys really covered their bases...
We'll take the other path so you can pay your respects in peace. But first, we need to settle that final payment.
Oh! Right! Your fee! Let me just... Huh? Where is it?==W== Ahem... This is embarrassing. I must've rushed out without my wallet...
Tell you what—meet us at the Red Pot Restaurant at ten tomorrow morning! I swear, I'll pay you in full!
H-Hey, don't give me that look... It's not like I'm trying to scam you.
That thing dropped out of nowhere and swallowed our entire haul!
I can't believe that... Did everyone else make it out?
I have no idea! We panicked and ran for our lives... We didn't realize until we got out that those three Trekkers and the girl were still inside.
And to make up for your losses, you decided to break into town and steal more firecrackers tonight.
We had no choice! Without that money, we'd be living on the streets!
Save your excuses for the Bureau. Right now, your priority is guiding us back into the Monolith to save them.
Y-You want to go back in there?!
Of course. They are still trapped inside.==W== We are getting them out.
No, no way! That thing will eat us alive! I-I got a good look at it. That monster... It has to be the legendary...

param: From the smugglers, you learn the truth behind your disappeared friends. You decide to launch a rescue at the Monolith, but the leader delivers a trembling warning—the legendary "Nian" resides inside.
Stop the beating! I surrender, okay?!
<size=60>Start talking and we'll go easy on you. Keep quiet, and you'll regret it!
I'll talk! Whatever you wanna know!
Just give us the truth. We'll decide your fate==W== once we've heard the full story.
You hired three Trekkers for a cargo run yesterday. So, where are they? Why are you the only ones who made it back?
Huh? Oh... Right, them... Well, see, it went down like this...
Look at all these cargos... You guys moving in or something? Trying to cash in a mountain of wishes all at once?
She's right...==W== Besides, making that many wishes costs too many memories.
Oh, it's fine! Don't worry about that!
Your payment is generous...==W== Incredibly so. But we can't in good conscience stand by and watch you walk into a death trap.
I get why you're worried, but trust me, it's fine. Honestly...==W== These supplies aren't for the climb.
Then why are we hauling all this stuff inside?
I guess you aren't gonna let this go, are you? Fine. I'll level with you.
I had a best friend once. We grew up together. Back when times were the hardest, we only survived because we had each other to lean on...
The client tearfully recounts how her best friend sacrificed herself to save her, using her final breath to smile and ask her to live on.
I'm not the only one. Everyone in our group has lost someone to the Monolith—friends, family...
That's why we return to the Monolith every Springseek Festival with their favorite things.
They say the Monolith is a place of miracles. What if ...==W== they really could come back home to us?
I see... No wonder these supplies mean so much to you.
Waaah! That is the most touching thing I've ever heard!!!
Wh—Where did this kid pop out from?!
Oops, sorry! I was digging for wild herbs nearby and couldn't help overhearing. Didn't mean to pry!
It was just such a moving story... I couldn't stop the tears...
Hold on, aren't you the manager of Jing's Bistro? What are you doing all the way out here? Shouldn't you be in Philae?
I'm back for the festival! And you guys? What brings you all the way to Cangwu?
We wrapped up a commission nearby and decided to stop here for a breather.
Seeing Jinglin reminds me of her cooking... Great, now my stomach's growling.
Hehe. Wanna drop by my place tomorrow for a family feast to kick off the new year?
Too bad the Springseek rush cleaned out the markets. I can't find half the ingredients I need.
Half a day of scavenging, and this handful of greens is all I've got to show for it.
Tag along with us to the Monolith then... Get whatever ingredients you want straight from a Wishing Box!
Brilliant idea! I'm coming with you!
Ahem... Taking a kid into the Monolith seems ... risky.
Don't worry, I'm keeping my eyes on her. Besides, Jinglin packs a mean punch—she can handle herself.
Er... Give us a second to talk it over.
What's the play? That girl's a Loong. If she sniffs out our cover...
They just want to travel together. Making a scene excluding her will only make us look suspicious.
Fine. Just watch your mouths. She's not local, so she probably won't notice anything off.
Alright, we'll travel as a group. But keeping the young lady safe is on you.
That's the gist of it... We posed as Loongs, spun a sob story, and tricked those Trekkers into hauling our firecrackers into the Monolith.
But why stash them inside the Monolith?
Moving that much powder is a nightmare. You get inspected at every city gate, and rival gangs are always looking to hijack you.
So we figured we'd dump the stash in the Monolith first. That allows us enter the city clean to resupply, then smuggle the goods out in small batches later.
It didn't matter if anyone else found it. We did our research. We know that Trekkers can only bring out Artifacts they get from the Wishing Box.
In a way, the Monolith is the world's safest vault.
These guys really covered their bases...
We'll take the other path so you can pay your respects in peace. But first, we need to settle that final payment.
Oh! Right! Your fee! Let me just... Huh? Where is it?==W== Ahem... This is embarrassing. I must've rushed out without my wallet...
Tell you what—meet us at the Red Pot Restaurant at ten tomorrow morning! I swear, I'll pay you in full!
H-Hey, don't give me that look... It's not like I'm trying to scam you.
That thing dropped out of nowhere and swallowed our entire haul!
I can't believe that... Did everyone else make it out?
I have no idea! We panicked and ran for our lives... We didn't realize until we got out that those three Trekkers and the girl were still inside.
And to make up for your losses, you decided to break into town and steal more firecrackers tonight.
We had no choice! Without that money, we'd be living on the streets!
Save your excuses for the Bureau. Right now, your priority is guiding us back into the Monolith to save them.
Y-You want to go back in there?!
Of course. They are still trapped inside.==W== We are getting them out.
No, no way! That thing will eat us alive! I-I got a good look at it. That monster... It has to be the legendary...

strings.text: Springseek decorations have inexplicably appeared in the Monolith. Suspecting Nian is at play, you follow the festive music, and finally come face-to-face with the monster...
We'll knock this out in a flash!
It's getting late. Are you coming back tonight?
Is something wrong? I can't reach any of you.
Please reply when you see this.
We hit a snag. Stuck in the Boss's Domain, but we're safe.
Hang tight. We're coming for you now.
No need to rush. It's actually not that bad.
Forget it. Just wait for me.
They replied. Everyone's safe, and Jinglin's with them.
Wonderful news. The interference from the Monolith explains the radio silence.

Yeah. Communication between inside and outside the Monolith is impossible. Even though I have the power of Unlimited Heartlink to connect with friends in other cities, I couldn't break through this restriction.
Now that we're inside the Monolith, our comms are working again.
They're trapped in the <color=#3faeae>Boss's Domain</color>, though not in any immediate danger.
Trapped in the <color=#3faeae>Boss's Domain</color>, but not in danger? Are you kidding me?
I'm fuzzy on the details... But that's what Iris said.
A pity. It seems my emergency surgical protocols won't be required after all.
Haha... Yeah, let's count our blessings...
Hey, why the shivers? Is Doctor Coronis really that terrifying?
Don't tell me she forces you to drink that black, bitter sludge like the other doctors in town...
Bitter meds would actually be a mercy.==W== Coronis scares me on a whole different level...
Oh my... That is rather dramatic of you. You'll scare the poor girl.
Sigh... This is exactly why you give me a headache.
Jokes aside, I genuinely hope we won't need to resort to such measures.
Agreed. We must locate them immediately.
We've been hiking forever, and there's still no sight of this "Nian" that the smuggler was ranting about.
Hey, Shimiao, you think Nian actually exists in a place like this?
You are the Xuan Shi. Shouldn't this be your area of expertise?
But I've never seen a real one! That's way out of my league!
I recall Loongs describing the Nian as a formidable creature. Care to tell me more about it?
Nian is nothing but a massive pest! Used to emerge every festival to wreak havoc.
It'd scare the kids and trash our houses, ruining the big Springseek feast everyone worked so hard on!
Actually, the ancient texts explicitly state that the creature "devours humans."
Huh? For real? Maybe there are different versions. My version is my Senior's.
Well... Anyway! Since disaster followed it everywhere, people had no choice but to lock themselves indoors every time it started to roam.
Eventually, they figured out it was terrified of three things: loud noises, the color red, and firelight.
So folks started putting up red couplets and lanterns. They'd keep the lights on all night and set off firecrackers to drive the beast away.
That is why we gotta make a huge racket with firecrackers during the festival! It's tradition!
I see... That explains your earlier insistence that "it isn't a festival without firecrackers."
Incorrect. That is merely because Chixia enjoys the noise and chaos.
Today, Springseek couplets and firecrackers are no longer about warding off Nian.==W== They live on as enduring symbols of the festival.
I doubt anyone sets off firecrackers solely to drive away Nian these days.
However, the legendary Nian appearing inside the Monolith... That is certainly a cause for concern.
But that smuggler claimed it swallowed the firecrackers the moment it appeared. That contradicts the legend, doesn't it?
Maybe it's a smart one! Knows the bangs are its weakness, so it gobbled them up before they could go off!
Regardless of the specifics, there is undeniably a powerful entity residing within the Monolith.

When that smuggler mentioned Nian,==W== she presented with rapid breathing, pallor, and acute muscle tension. Physiological reactions do not lie. There is no doubt she encountered a terrifying creature.
As for whether it is truly the legendary monster...==W== Heh. Shall we investigate and see for ourselves?
Space inside the Monolith is chaotic; the routes never stay the same. Yet all we can do is press on.
No matter how the layout shifts, the path always leads down. We're bound to reach the Boss's Domain eventually.
Have you noticed that ... something feels different around here?==W== Look at that shop. Above the door.
Those red papers...==W== Aren't those Springseek Couplets?
The Monolith still looked as usual when we first walked in.
But we're seeing more and more Springseek decorations along the way.
Indeed. And not just couplets. Look at the paper cutouts on the windows, the lanterns on the eaves.
I see Tanghulu skewers over there as well.
You're right! That corner is packed with festival snacks! Melon seeds, peanuts, fruit drops—it's got everything!
It appears this entire sector has begun its own "festival celebration."
We've encountered phenomena like this before.
Powerful Stellaroids can warp reality. Remember how King Glopo turned his domain into ... a laundry room?
Usually, though, that power is limited to their immediate vicinity.
But this "festival" zone extends far beyond a single chamber.
If Nian is capable of reshaping such a vast area...
Then its power is not to be underestimated. Everyone, please proceed with caution.
I'm getting some seriously bad vibes from up ahead...==W== We must be getting close.
Uh... Well, you definitely can't say the atmosphere isn't...
And where's this music coming from? It's digging up some weird, repressed memory ... like a bad earworm I can't shake.
You've never heard this? It's a total classic among Loongs!
I wish you wealth today—<size=60>♪</size>==W== I wish you joy to stay—<size=60>♪</size>
Please, stop... You're gonna brainwash me into singing along...
Ugh... What was that winning formula again...?
N times bracket A-B-C, plus M times bracket A-A-A, plus A-A.
Forget the math! I'm just gonna trust my gut!
I win! That's a Full Flush!
Uh... What exactly are you guys doing...
<size=70>Why are you playing Mahjong here of all places?!

strings.text: It turns out the "Nian" only keeps everyone in the Monolith because it was lonely. Now, it's suffering from a stomachache after snacking on too many firecrackers. Sounds like a job for the Doctor!
Sorry, ==PLAYER_NAME==. We didn't mean to worry you.
We tried texting to explain, but every time a phone came out, Lucky here tried to snatch it. Nearly chewed through Amber's screen.
Huh? This little guy's called Nian?
It matches the smuggler's description. Looks a fair bit like the Nian from the legends, too.
Right, you wouldn't know. The guys who hired you were running a gunpowder smuggling ring.
But they said they needed to find their friend in the Monolith...==W== Was that a lie?
Just a cover story. They aren't even Loong.
No wonder they acted so shady and wouldn't pay the balance upfront.
I did think it was weird that they only packed firecrackers. Guess that's how they smuggle the powder...
My fault. I should've vetted the job better before we took it.
Exactly! Those smugglers were great actors! I can't believe I cried over their fake sob story... Ugh, so embarrassing...
So ... did they make it out of the Monolith alive?
Perfectly healthy too. In fact, they had enough energy to fight back when we arrested them.
A bit, sure. But honestly, I was more worried they'd get hurt in the Monolith.
Besides, now that they're caught, they'll get what they deserve, right?
Precisely. The culprits have already been handed over to the Loong Guard.
Hehe! Guess that counts as getting even for us, then.
I'm just glad you're all safe.
The smuggler boss claimed a ferocious Nian attacked them. Said they barely escaped with their lives...
So is this ... that "ferocious Nian" in question?
Doesn't look all that dangerous... Actually, looks like the lot of you are having a blast.
We didn't expect things to turn out like this, either...
Lucky was pretty fierce when it first popped out. Scared us half to death!
But then we realized ... it had no intention of attacking us.
It seemed ...==W== all it wanted was to snack on the firecrackers.
Then why didn't you just drop the stash and make a run for it?
That was exactly the plan. The problem is...
See? Just like that. Every time we try to head for the door, Lucky cuts us off and won't let anyone out.
We knew you'd find us eventually, ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W== Figured we might as well have Jinglin teach us Mahjong. Beats staring at the walls!
I know Mahjong is popular among the Loong, but this is ... dedication. Didn't expect Jinglin to carry a full set everywhere she goes.
Carry a set everywhere? Are you kidding? We got it from a Wishing Box. We asked for a fully automatic Mahjong table and—poof!—there it was.
Using a wish on a game table proves you're obsessed... Anyway, I get the picture.
One thing bothers me, though...==W== What's with the name "Lucky"?
Grandma had a dog named "Lucky." We were inseparable growing up!
This little guy reminds me of him, so the name stuck.
For us Loong, "Lucky" is basically a classic pet name.
Awesome. If I ever get a pet, I want one exactly like this guy!
Hey Lucky, wanna show us a trick?
A diet of firecrackers... Fascinating behavior.
But why it keeps you here? A territorial beast should be driving intruders out, not trapping them in.
Uh, did it tag us as emergency rations the moment we walked in?
No way! Lucky isn't like that!
Oh? Then what's your theory, Jinglin?
I think...==W== It wants to celebrate the Springseek Festival with us, too.
Back then, the whole family would return to Cangwu and gather at Grandma's for the festival.==W== Lucky would get so excited, running around begging everyone to play.
But when the festival ended and people left, he'd get depressed.==W== Sometimes he'd even block the door to stop us from leaving.
Blocking the exit like this ... reminds me exactly of how Lucky used to guard the door.
Makes sense...==W== At least it hasn't tried to attack us yet.
It just wants company for the festival... Hmm...
Seeing it like this, who'd have the heart to beat it up just to leave?
Lucky isn't the only one feeling lonely.
We wanted to spend the festival with you, too, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
No matter where you are, I'll find you.
Hey! Get over here! Something's wrong with Lucky!
It seems agitated. Just look at it pacing, getting up and lying back down over and over.
You see that?! It's breathing fire now!
Did it display any of these symptoms earlier?
No... It was full of energy just a moment ago, running circles around us.
Then it suddenly went quiet. I assumed it'd just tired itself out.
Hmm... Allow me to take a look.
I see...==W== It has ingested an excessive quantity of firecrackers. A severe case of indigestion.
Is there anything we can do? The poor thing looks miserable.
Hehe... To think I would encounter such a fascinating case in a place like this.
It is fortuitous that I decided to pack this for the journey.
L-look at the size of that thing...! Is that the "emergency surgical protocol" you mentioned earlier?!
That is ... very on-brand for Doctor Coronis...==RT==Hang in there, Lucky.
Shhh, just be good. This will all be over soon...
Lucky! Stop running! The shot is for your own good!
(sigh) I cannot administer treatment under these conditions... Everyone, please help restrain the patient.

strings.text: Coronis successfully heals Lucky. After close examination, she finds that "Nian" is a unique Stellaroid, brought into existence by the Loong's shared wishes and expectations for the new year.
Lucky! Hey, Lucky! Wake up, sleepyhead!
Dad's coming home soon! Come on, let's go to the crossing and meet him!
Wonder what fireworks he's got this time... Hope it's those huge ones again, just like last year!
Why are you hiding? Haha! Still a scaredy-cat about the noise, huh?
Okay, tell you what: we'll stick to sparklers this year. They're pretty and quieter, so less terrifying.
Lucky, you gotta hold down our home while I'm gone, alright?
Mom's been under the weather. Look after her, make sure she rests.==W== And keep an eye on Yu—don't let her run wild all day.
Good boy. Knew I could count on you. Now I can head to the Monolith.
Alright, time to hit the road. I'll wish for a huge haul so we can all have a killer festival.
Mmm... Lucky? Doze off, did I?==W== Getting old really takes it out of you... Back when I first left home, I could work days on end without blinking.
Come to think of it... Been thirty years since I left Cangwu. Heh. Lucky, how 'bout I take you back to the old hometown this year?
Festival's eve, we'll hit the hilltop for fireworks. My secret spot as a kid... Hope it's still there.
Can't wait to show you the view back home...
Miss Coronis, Lucky's spaced out. Is it okay?
Oh...==W== Lucky's fine. Don't worry. Sedative hasn't fully cleared its system yet.
I've finished the check-up. It swallowed a massive amount of debris, which threw its magic flow into chaos. Basically, it has acute indigestion.
I've given it an injection to flush out the blockage. Once it kicks in, it'll be right as rain.
Don't panic. That means the meds are working.
A torrent of firecrackers spews from Lucky's mouth, scattering across the floor.
Look at 'em all! Just ... how much did it eat?!
There. Purging all those should bring it significant relief.
They've been through a stomach, but they look intact... We can still light these.
Lucky glances around the room, looking a bit dazed from the sudden expulsion.
Moments later, it's prancing around the pile of fireworks, tail wagging furiously. The nausea is clearly gone.
Thank goodness! You're feeling better now, aren't you?
Okay, okay, I get it! You're feeling better... Hey, cut it out with the licking! It tickles! Haha!
Honestly ... calling this thing "Nian" feels wrong. It acts more like an overgrown puppy.
Miss Shimiao, do you truly believe "Lucky" here is a Nian?
Hmm...==W== Strictly my personal theory, but Lucky looks far more like a Stellaroid.
Then again, descriptions of the Nian are notoriously vague. The archives aren't always reliable, so ...==W== I cannot definitively rule it out.
However, if a legendary beast of that magnitude actually appeared...
Lucky! Come on, show me that fire breath again!
Nice one! You've totally got it down now!
...==W== The Xuan Shi would have taken action long ago.
Very rigorous, Miss Shimiao.==W== Indeed, we cannot judge by looks alone. We require ... hard proof.
Coronis... You found something, didn't you?
I noticed something during my exam. Lucky's physiology differs from a standard monster's...==W== It is formed almost entirely of pure magic.
I trust a veteran Trekker recognizes those traits.
Inside the Monolith, made of pure magic... Wouldn't that just be a Stellaroid?
Precisely. And a special case...==W== A Stellaroid manifested specifically because of the Springseek Festival.
Because of the festival? Does the Monolith celebrate festivals too?==W== If so, Lucky and all the decor... They're all a setup? But who arranged it?
Us?==W== Hardly. Renovating a room inside the Monolith is pure fantasy ... and beyond any ordinary person.
Nah, that's not it. Hmm... How to put this...==W== I've been inside long enough to just ... pick up on the vibe.
I see her point. She suspects the collective wish of Cangwu ... is influencing this Monolith.
Trekkers realized ages ago that a Monolith's Artifact drops aren't set in stone.
If a crowd wishes for the same item in the same Monolith,==RT==the odds of the Wishing Box yielding it skyrocket.
Some claim the God of Grace hears us, others think our harvested memories react with the Monolith...==W== There are endless theories.
However, that theory fails to account for the specific anomaly occurring here.
From those observations, Trekkers deduced a fact: Human desire affects more than just the rewards. It reshapes the Monolith itself.
Take that drought-stricken town a while back.==RT==Locals flocked to the nearby Monolith to pray for rain…
Guess what? A massive storm started raging inside.
Oh, rings a bell! Rumor says that water-controlling Stellaroids==RT==now spawn in there too!
I believe I understand.==RT==The nature of the wish dictates not only the Artifact yield, but also the Monolith's internal environment as well...
This Monolith sits near Cangwu, frequented by Loongs. With the Springseek Festival approaching, their festival spirit must have seeped into the structure...
That likely explains Lucky's genesis.==RT==Physiologically, it mimics the "Nian" legend, but Jinglin naming it "Lucky" likely imprinted it with new emotional significance.
Indeed...==RT=="Lucky" is a very common name Loongs give their puppies.
Despite its Stellaroid nature, its behavior profile matches that of a canine. No wonder you mistook it for a large dog, Miss Shimiao.
In short, it embodies the affection and memories attached to every dog named "Lucky."
Perhaps ... it truly just wanted to celebrate the festival with us.
No wonder it fought so hard to keep us from leaving...
Why don't we just play with it then?
Lucky, it's fireworks time!==W== Everyone ready?
I have positioned the firecrackers in the corner.
Don't be scared, Lucky, I'm right here. The fireworks are beautiful. Let's watch them together.
Under Lucky's eager gaze, everyone lights their sparklers.
Lucky stares, mesmerized, as if trying to etch this moment==RT==into its memory forever.
Dancing sparks reflect in its glistening eyes, blooming like==RT==tiny fireworks against the night sky.
Lucky, we have to go now...==W== My mom will worry if I'm not home soon.
Hey, wipe that frown off your face! I'm leaving these firecrackers in your charge. Just promise not to eat them all again, okay?
I'll be back for you whenever I can!
Lucky plants a paw on the pile, as if accepting the task with solemn determination.
Its proud, loyal posture is amusing yet heartwarming. But then...==W== A bittersweet feeling wells up in our hearts.
Do you think ...==W== we'll ever see Lucky again?
Hard to say. It might vanish with the festival...==W== Or perhaps, like the other Stellaroids, it's destined to wander this Monolith forever.
Regardless. Everyone still wants to play with Lucky, to watch the fireworks together.
And the environment inside a Monolith responds to the will, correct?
Then logic suggests, if we simply wish to see Lucky again, the Monolith should answer that prayer.
Okay! Then I'm wishing to see Lucky again!
Heh. I'm certain Lucky is hoping for the exact same thing.
Let's have a great new year together.

==RT====RT====A-1==When "it" first opens its eyes, it feels a faint presence deep within.==P====RT====RT====A-1==Fragments of memory. "It" doesn't know the faces in those fragments, nor does it understand what the scenes mean.==P====RT====RT====A-1=="It" only has a feeling—a vague sense that these pieces make up its whole. "It" is these memories.

==RT====A-1=="It" tilts its head, staring blankly at the world.==P====RT====RT====A-1=="It" likes this place. It feels warm, familiar.==P====RT====RT====A-1==Across the blank slate of its mind, blurry thoughts rush in.==P====RT====RT====A-1=="It" wants a festival painted in bright red. Wants the crackle of firecrackers, the bloom of fireworks.
"It" ... or perhaps "They" ... want to be with family.==RT==To celebrate a happy festival together.
If only ... that wish could come true.

Wonder what fireworks he's got this time... Hope it's those huge ones again, just like last year!
Why are you hiding? Haha! Still a scaredy-cat about the noise, huh?
Okay, tell you what: we'll stick to sparklers this year. They're pretty and quieter, so less terrifying.
Lucky, you gotta hold down our home while I'm gone, alright?

Good boy. Knew I could count on you. Now I can head to the Monolith.
