strings.text: Back from the Monolith, the group gathers in a hotpot restaurant for a rowdy Springseek Eve feast. As the midnight bell tolls, a new year arrives amidst the roar of fireworks...
Tying up loose ends took a while... I hope I didn't keep you waiting?
Don't sweat it! You're right on time. Go wash up and let's eat!
Booking the entire restaurant... I imagine that costs a fortune?
No worries, a distant cousin of mine runs this place!==W== She insisted on comping the night—her way of thanking us for cracking the case.
My mom even stopped by to whip up her specialties. Come on, dig in!
By the way, are there any traditions regarding the Springseek Eve menu?
Hmm...==W== Families mostly cook what they like, but there are definitely staples. It's about family reunions and ringing in the new year after all, it's only fitting to have a sense of ritual!
I actually researched this out of curiosity.==W== I understand that many common dishes symbolize good fortune.
I thought I'd be spending the eve buried in casework...==W== Thanks to everyone, we actually wrapped it up in time for dinner.
We're the ones who should be thanking you and ==PLAYER_NAME==. If not for your help, we'd probably still be stuck in the Monolith gnawing on stale bread.
Absolutely. Springseek Festival is all about gathering together for a joyful feast.
Keep talking and the food's gonna get cold. Come on, grab a seat!
Fair point. But I haven't seen Chixia yet. Where did she go?
She is in the kitchen, insisting on demonstrating her culinary prowess.
Ta-da! And now for the grand finale!
Heh heh. Behold my masterpiece: Wok-Seared Medley!
Is this another one of Cangwu's traditional delicacies? Fascinating...
No, no, no... There's no way that's traditional cuisine... Look at that freakish color!
It's fine! We should just be happy we have food on the table!
I mean, sure, but what if we get food poisoning...?
Do Trekkers really need a cast-iron stomach just to survive in this line of work?
Um... It's awfully red. It's not too spicy, is it?
Oh, it's definitely spicy, but that's what makes it good! Come on, Shimiao, be brave!
Everyone gathers around, sharing a feast filled with laughter this Springseek Eve.==W== Time quietly slips away, drawing them closer to the turn of the year.
Witnessing this firsthand... It is far more vivid and intriguing than I imagined.
At the year's end, everyone shares the same hope==W== as they welcome spring with family and friends they hold dear.
Is this the moment the Loong hold most dear?
Yes. This is the most important night of the year for us.
That explains the memories of Lucky...
Back in the Monolith, when I examined Lucky... Perhaps due to the magic, or the sheer intensity of the wishes involved, I caught chaotic glimpses of memory.
They likely belong to different people, carrying the weight of collective hope, which ultimately catalyzed Lucky's birth.
But I found it curious that... Despite the varying ages, statuses, and locations, the owners of those memories shared the exact same wish. Or rather...
—to go home. To spend the festival with the people who matter.
For the Loong, Springseek Festival isn't just about ringing in the new year.
It's a reminder for us to honor the past, look to the future, and never forget where our home is.
No matter how busy we are or how far we drift, we always fight to make it back for this one night. Just to be together again.
Because we believe that as long as there's a "home" waiting for us, there's hope.
Now that I've seen it firsthand, I think I get what drove those people.
Their intense longing warped the Monolith's environment and manifested Lucky into existence.
In a way, that creature is the living answer to their prayer for reunion.
Why the solemn faces? It's the Springseek Festival!==W== Come on, let's go set off some fireworks!
Step right up to the clearing! Prepare yourselves, mortals! The Great Master Chixia is about to show you the true,==W== <size=46>earth-shattering power of the Springseek spirit!</size>
Chixia smugly rolls out a massive launch tube that towers over her, its surface covered in wild, swirling runes.
Feast your eyes on my latest masterpiece: The Heavenly Chromatic Blaster!
Is something that big ... actually safe?
Judging by the mass and rune density, it should theoretically produce a spectacular visual phenomenon.
Of course, the probability of a spectacular catastrophe is also statistically significant.
Ahem! Don't be a buzzkill.==W== I double-checked the math. This time, it's absolutely—
Chixia, your tail... I think you just lit the fuse...
Wh-what?! You should've said that sooner!
The firework shell shrieks skyward with unnatural speed, pulls a sharp, bizarre U-turn, and barrels straight toward the hotpot restaurant's entrance.
Wait... It's heading for the restaurant! If that thing gets inside, the repair bill's gonna be astronomical!
Th-that wasn't supposed to happen—Turn! Fly somewhere else! Please!
The shell zigzags wildly, scraping the eaves and barely missing a lantern before snapping into another sharp turn, dive-bombing straight at Chixia.
Waaah!==W== Not this way! Go up! Up!
How did we end up here...?
Chixia blindly tosses a talisman in panic.
As if commanded, the rogue shell corrects its course, shoots skyward, and bursts into a dazzling display of light.
I was already mentally calculating the settlement check...
I forgot to install the guidance talisman... I really thought it was perfect this time... Sorry...
Chixia's Blaster was gorgeous, though! And since nothing broke, all's well that ends well!
Since it's Springseek Eve... I'll let this slide. But for safety's sake, only regulated fireworks from now on. No more unauthorized mods.
Look at the time! Midnight's almost here!
Before anyone realizes it, a tide of firecrackers has swept through the streets, sending wave after wave of fireworks into the night sky. In the distance, faint bells begin to toll.
Here's to a smooth year, and no more giant messes from me!
I wish that Mom stays healthy, and that business at Jing's Bistro goes through the roof!
Hm? What's going on over here?
It's a Loong tradition to pray for good fortune at the start of the year. Why don't you join in? A wish, a resolution... Anything works.
Then I wish for nothing but happiness, every single day!
I want to be someone the New Star Guild can rely on even more.
What about you, Shimiao? What's your wish?
We may leave our past troubles behind, and the coming year will bear fruit for us all.
You're always so serious. But hey, that is very "you," Shimiao!
Heh. I suppose I should follow suit and make a wish.
I wish to find the cure for even more of this world's unsolved pathologies.
... is for us==W== to stand under this same night sky every year, full of hope for the coming year.
Anyway, let's give this year everything we've got.

strings.text: You wake up in a carriage heading to the snow-swept North. At Wraith's reminder, you recall your journey to the North for a special commission.
I can't feel my limbs anymore. My mind is drifting into the fog.
The enemy is closing in, and I have no one to cover my back.
A sharp blade stands before me. A voice inside promises that if I take it, the pain will end.
Absolute, overwhelming power to bring the world to its knees.
Tyrant, no! Do not touch that cursed weapon!
Wake up from this nightmare! Your true enemy is...
Oh. Finally back with us. You know, sleeping in this cold is a great way to die.
Without a heating Artifact, you'd freeze solid even inside this carriage.
Or did you seriously rush to the North without doing any homework?
Carriage... The North...?==W== Ugh, my head is spinning... Where am I?
I try to sit up, but a weight on my shoulder pins me down.
Mmm... Wait... I still don't get that part... My deadline is... Zzz...
What is going on? Why am I in a carriage with these two?
She's the client for this commission. Have you forgotten already?
Client...? Right, I took a commission heading the North.==W== Ugh... My head feels heavy. I can't think straight.
You look pale. Want some water?
Thanks,==W== but my friends must have packed a bottle for me before I left. Should be right here...
Guided by memory, I feel around until my fingers finally brush against a bottle behind me.
Here it is. My Pep Pep Ju—==W==huh? W-what even is this?!
Hmm... Here, and there. Pretty nasty damage.==W== But hey, swap the broken bits for new ones and it's problem solved.
Easy fix. The local Monolith is accessible again. We can wish for the parts we need.
But we need a ton of them, which means we're stuck here for the long haul.
Fighting and fixing cars aren't exactly my strengths. Perhaps I can make myself useful in other ways.
While you handle repairs, I'll run some simple commissions solo.
Don't worry. I'll stick to jobs that take brains, not brawn. You know how those go.
As long as it's not a combat gig, it's fine! You know how capable Boss is, right Iris?
Alright... Counting on you then, Boss.
Leave the repairs to us. We'll have the Lucky Oasis back in tip-top shape before you know it.
Right, better get moving. I'll head to the Trekker Association to see if anything suits me.
It's Pep Pep Juice! Good for the nerves. If you run into trouble, take a sip and you'll be fine!
I'd prefer to stay out of trouble, but ...==W== thanks, Noya! See ya!
And off ==SEX== go...==W== I really hope this works out...
Don't sweat it, Iris. Boss can handle it.
I know, but I just can't shake this bad feeling...
Weird... Has anyone seen my rust remover? It was right here a second ago.
Didn't you leave it by the toolbox earlier?
I did. But I turned my back for one second and it magically became a Pep Pep Juice...?
Oh, that's mine! Perfect timing, I'm parched!
Wait. Didn't I just give that to Boss? Why is it sitting over here?
... Noya, please tell me you didn't just blindly throw the first thing you grabbed...
I headed to the Trekker Association solo to find work. But...
A total bust! Forget about regular commissions—I can't even find a stray cat to rescue.
This is bad. I talked a pretty big game back there. If I'm striking out here, maybe I should try my luck in the Gold District...
I'm fine. That was my fault... Too busy scanning the crowd for someone I didn't watch my step.
Oh my. Now that I get a good look... You're the Tyrant, aren't you? Just the person I need.
Ahem. Pardon my manners. I'm Edda, a researcher with the Eye of Grace.
The Eye of Grace... Canace mentioned them. They're the intellectual elite, the absolute peak of academia and research on this continent.
What does the Eye of Grace want with me?
I have a commission for you, actually. But it's crowded here. Let's speak somewhere private.
This should work.==W== My apologies, but this involves classified intel. We need to keep this strictly between us.
Ever hear of the<r=Norstheim> Northern </r>City? Nocturn Eterna destroyed its Monolith, snuffing out its light. The city's been abandoned ever since.
I've only read about it in books.
You've likely encountered the culprit responsible. The Nocturn Eterna on this wanted poster.
I knew it. You recognize her. We've recently received reports that Norstheim's Monolith has suddenly reactivated.
We're assembling an expedition to investigate. But we need a consultant—someone with firsthand experience dealing with a Nocturn Eterna.
So that's why you're here. But isn't Norstheim a massive trek from here...?
Rest assured, the Eye of Grace covers all expenses. Besides, it's a routine investigation. No danger involved.
The Lucky Oasis repairs are going to take a while, and suitable jobs are hard to come by right now...
Got it. Count me in. I'll help with the investigation.
Really? Thank you so much! I feel a lot safer knowing the Tyrant is coming with us.
One condition, though. I need half the commission paid upfront to my guild.==W== It's a long trip, and I want to make sure they're covered while I'm gone.
No problem. The funds from the Eye of Grace will reach them by tomorrow.
Oh, actually, there is one more thing...
I couldn't help but overhear you mention the Nocturn Eterna. If you're heading to the<r=Norstheim> Northern </r>City...
Okay, I think I've got a handle on everything that's happened...
That sleeping girl is Edda from the Eye of Grace. And this woman... She claims to be a Sentinel of Dawn who tracks Nocturn Eterna.
You're ... Wraith? I don't remember her dressing like this...
By the look of it, you're starting to remember. You've been in rough shape since we got here—passed out a few times, actually.
Ugh... My ears are still ringing...==W== But I'll be okay.
Follow my lead. Breathe in ... and out...Open up your chest, steady your breathing.
Huh... That actually worked. The dizziness is gone. No more ringing too.
Typical reaction for a first-timer in Norstheim. It just hit you harder than most.
Sorry to press you the moment you wake up, but I need to know... You said you knew the Nocturn Eterna on those wanted posters. Is that true?
You mean Aeloria?==W== Well, the thing is...
S-Stellaroids...?! What are they doing out here!?
Tyrant, are you hurt?! Where did a swarm like this come from...?
Wait! Wraith, what is with that outfit?!
Save the questions. We've got a problem to deal with first.

param: You wake up in a carriage heading to the snow-swept North. At Wraith's reminder, you recall your journey to the North for a special commission.
I can't feel my limbs anymore. My mind is drifting into the fog.
The enemy is closing in, and I have no one to cover my back.
A sharp blade stands before me. A voice inside promises that if I take it, the pain will end.
Absolute, overwhelming power to bring the world to its knees.
Tyrant, no! Do not touch that cursed weapon!
Wake up from this nightmare! Your true enemy is...
Oh. Finally back with us. You know, sleeping in this cold is a great way to die.
Without a heating Artifact, you'd freeze solid even inside this carriage.
Or did you seriously rush to the North without doing any homework?
Carriage... The North...?==W== Ugh, my head is spinning... Where am I?
I try to sit up, but a weight on my shoulder pins me down.
Mmm... Wait... I still don't get that part... My deadline is... Zzz...
What is going on? Why am I in a carriage with these two?
She's the client for this commission. Have you forgotten already?
Client...? Right, I took a commission heading the North.==W== Ugh... My head feels heavy. I can't think straight.
You look pale. Want some water?
Thanks,==W== but my friends must have packed a bottle for me before I left. Should be right here...
Guided by memory, I feel around until my fingers finally brush against a bottle behind me.
Here it is. My Pep Pep Ju—==W==huh? W-what even is this?!
Hmm... Here, and there. Pretty nasty damage.==W== But hey, swap the broken bits for new ones and it's problem solved.
Easy fix. The local Monolith is accessible again. We can wish for the parts we need.
But we need a ton of them, which means we're stuck here for the long haul.
Fighting and fixing cars aren't exactly my strengths. Perhaps I can make myself useful in other ways.
While you handle repairs, I'll run some simple commissions solo.
Don't worry. I'll stick to jobs that take brains, not brawn. You know how those go.
As long as it's not a combat gig, it's fine! You know how capable Boss is, right Iris?
Alright... Counting on you then, Boss.
Leave the repairs to us. We'll have the Lucky Oasis back in tip-top shape before you know it.
Right, better get moving. I'll head to the Trekker Association to see if anything suits me.
It's Pep Pep Juice! Good for the nerves. If you run into trouble, take a sip and you'll be fine!
I'd prefer to stay out of trouble, but ...==W== thanks, Noya! See ya!
And off ==SEX== go...==W== I really hope this works out...
Don't sweat it, Iris. Boss can handle it.
I know, but I just can't shake this bad feeling...
Weird... Has anyone seen my rust remover? It was right here a second ago.
Didn't you leave it by the toolbox earlier?
I did. But I turned my back for one second and it magically became a Pep Pep Juice...?
Oh, that's mine! Perfect timing, I'm parched!
Wait. Didn't I just give that to Boss? Why is it sitting over here?
... Noya, please tell me you didn't just blindly throw the first thing you grabbed...

strings.text: In the Northern City, the commission initiator, Edda, introduces you to the members and briefs you on possible Nocturn Eterna activities within the city. You then split into teams to investigate.
Good work. Everyone in one piece?
I appreciate the concern, Tyrant. I'm fine. And I'm sure Wraith can hold her own.
Glad to hear it... But bad news.==W== The carriage and driver are gone.
Can't blame him. Trekkers might be used to this, but for an ordinary person, running away is the only natural reaction when they see Stellaroids.
No matter. The<r=Norstheim> Northern </r>City is close. If we leave now, we'll reach its Ash District by nightfall.
A civilian? He was sent by the Eye of Grace. Trekker or not, he should've been a professional... Am I reading too much into this?
Hey! You there! Is everyone alright?
Ha... Hah... Ms. Edda, we were out on patrol when we heard the sounds of battle over here, so we rushed over.
We ran into some Stellaroids on the way. Don't worry, we took care of them.
Why are there Stellaroids outside the Monolith? Is there ... a Meltdown?
Yes. Since the reboot, there've been multiple minor Meltdowns.
Thank you for your hard work. I'm just glad everyone's safe.
A rebooted Monolith... Sudden Meltdowns ... and Nocturn Eterna...
Tyrant, is something on your mind?
I remember Aeloria,==W== that Nocturn Eterna agent.==W== Back in Emor, she used a specific spell to force a Meltdown.
Are you suggesting Nocturn Eterna has already infiltrated the<r=Norstheim> Northern </r>City?!
Just a theory. A Monolith left unmanaged long enough can trigger a Meltdown on its own.
I see... That hadn't occurred to me. And I promised you a safe investigation... My sincerest apologies.
It was unexpected. Not your fault, so no need to apologize. Let's just focus on getting to the<r=Norstheim> Northern </r>City.
Right, follow us. We got here a few days ago and set up camps in the Ash District.
Nocturn Eterna... Would they really come back?
We trail the investigator for a while, reaching our destination just as night falls.
We're here. Welcome to the city humanity left behind.
Total ruins.==W== It looks like the aftermath of an apocalypse...
I've never seen anything like it...
The city was abandoned once the Monolith went down. Years of neglect left it unrecognizable. Only the most durable Artifacts still work.
Tens of thousands lived here once. It was the biggest city in the North. Rumor has it that their forging skills were top-tier—snagged them quite a lot of orders from the Grace Imperium.
Those skills were eventually scattered across Nova following the departing citizens. By now, they may very well be lost to time.
Not really. Many citizens were taken in by the Grace Imperium, and their skills have been preserved as well.
I've also heard that ... the talents here were targeted by the Grace Imperium long ago. Back when the Monolith was still bright.
As expected of Ms. Edda.==W== You certainly know the Grace Imperium better than most.
You flatter me.==W== We should keep moving. The warming spell on Tyrant's clothes is fading.
Warming spell?==RT==Now that you mention it, I haven't felt the cold at all. Is that why?
Precisely.==W== You are vital to this operation, Tyrant. I will do whatever it takes to keep you safe and healthy. It wouldn't be good if you caught a cold.

Phew, no wonder I feel all warm and toasty—this magic's pretty handy. But...==W== There seems to be someone here wearing even less than I am.==W== I remember her wearing her coat on the train, and now she's taken it off after the fight...
Hey!==W== We're back, and we brought the rest of the team!
Good work, everyone. Let me get dinner warmed up.
I didn't expect to find a building this intact out in the middle of nowhere.
They went ahead to scout and set up the base. We need this foothold to keep the investigation running smoothly.
We tidied up and arranged the essentials.==W== Make yourselves at home. We'll be stationed here for a few days.
Huh?==W== I'm short one meal. Ms. Edda, did we pick up an extra guest?
My apologies. Something came up on the road, and I didn't have time to radio ahead.
Actually, perfect timing.==W== Let me introduce our special consultant—Tyrant.
==SEX1== has made contact with a Nocturn Eterna. Not many people have that kind of experience.
Wait, the Boss?!==W== The one who saved Emor and Philae, runs a company,==W== and has a staff of only beautiful girls?!
Hold on!==W== Leaving aside the first part... Where did you hear that last bit?!
From the witch's report on Scarlet Sights Media, obviously.
And this is our other new addition—==W==Wraith.
We were ambushed by Stellaroids on the way here. She took out most of them all on her own.
Right. I'm Wraith...==W== My specialty is hunting down members of Nocturn Eterna.
Sorry, were you ... asleep?==W== You looked a little out of it.
I wasn't sleeping. I was thinking.==W== Meeting so many new people takes time to process.
By the way, who are you again?
Eh? What're you talking about? I'm Edda!==W== We were just in the same carriage!
So it was you==W== who rode in the carriage with me earlier...
Hm. If she's Edda ... and you're also unarmed...==W== Process of elimination makes you ...==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==.
That is a very strange way to recognize people...
Don't tell me we're the only two people you can actually identify.
Not at all. I know Axe, Longsword, and Mage perfectly well. Impressive, right?
"Axe," "Longsword," and "Mage"... You identify people by their gear?
Correct. A weapon—and how it's wielded—reflects the owner's soul. Easier to track than a face.
Like that old Loong saying, "Handwriting reveals the character"?
Take Axe and Longsword. Your blades bear identical claw marks. The two of you must be teammates.
And Mage. You were born left-handed, but an injury forced you to switch hands.
Hey~ How about me?==W== No weapon, sure, but you saw me fight!
Take that!==W== Now you have nowhere left to run!
It's a blur. I was too busy protecting ==PLAYER_NAME== and neutralizing threats.
I do recall that ... You're a skilled fighter, but you shouted every time you attacked. It was kinda loud.
That's my signature style!==W== Quit being so critical!
Ahem. Moving on. Since we're all acquainted,==W== let me reiterate our objective.
We're here to investigate the Monolith's reboot and figure out why Nocturn Eterna has surfaced in this area.

Nocturn Eterna left this city in shambles years ago, but recent Monolith anomalies suggest they might still be lurking nearby.==W== That's why we're pairing up—stay sharp as we scout the city for any signs of their return.
As for the teams... I'll partner up with Tyrant, and—
I am taking ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W== ==SEX1== possesses zero combat ability. I am the logical choice for an escort.
Ha... Fine.==W== Then I'm with the "Axe Guy," and "Miss Longsword" takes "Mage Girl."
She just rolled with those nicknames? Is she trying to simplify things for Wraith?
But in exchange, I get to pick our patrol routes.
Everyone, get some sleep. We're all exhausted.==W== The real work starts tomorrow.
Oh, and Tyrant? This room is yours. We've already prepared the bed.
Thanks a lot. I really appreciate the help. See you in the morning.
Hm? Aren't you going to your room?
But this is my room...==W== Oh, do you want to swap?==W== I don't mind—
No. We are sharing this room.
Was I unclear? I meant:==W== for the next few days,==W== we are sleeping together.

strings.text: At night, you and Wraith have a long talk outside. You learn that this was her hometown and get to know the stories of both the city and her past.
I meant: for the next few days, we are sleeping together.==W== That's all there is to it. Why are you shocked?
It's only normal to be shocked!! Could you at least tell me why?
The Monolith has "rebooted." Nocturn Eterna could be nearby, plotting another sabotage. I need to secure your safety 24/7.
Ah... Are you worried about the sleeping arrangement?==W== Don't worry, I sleep better sitting up. I won't take your bed.
That's not really what I was worried about...==W== Well, whatever. If you don't mind, then I guess I don't either.
Hm? Then what were you worried about? Is there something else?
No, nothing! Just drop it! It's getting late—let's just get some sleep!
Mm. Rest easy. I'll keep watch.
Wraith's coat?==W== Did she tuck me in?
Strange. She left without her coat. Where would she go at this hour?
Looks like she headed out of camp.
Under the faint moonlight, I follow her tracks to a clearing near our camp.
As if reading the room, a crooked streetlamp flickers on, lighting the figure at the path's end.
How did this place ... end up like this...
Bathed in that light, she seems more solitary now than she did by day.
What are you doing out here? I thought you were keeping watch for me.
I am on watch. But that doesn't require me to stay at your bedside the entire night.
Relax. I rigged the room with defensive wards for Nocturn Eterna. If they get close, they'll be riddled with holes.
Sounds ... dangerous. Did you factor my safety into that setup?
Hmm...==W== Guess that detail slipped my mind.
Aren't those wards even more dangerous than Nocturn Eterna!?
Just kidding. I just rigged up basic alarms that make noise if anyone breaks in. I'm just patrolling nearby. Be back in a flash if needed.
I didn't take you for the joking type.
I have a sense of humor, you know. Though it's gotten a bit rusty. Since getting to the City of a Thousand Monoliths, I've mostly kept to myself.
Being here reminds me of the old days with my team. Put me in a nostalgic mood, I guess.
Under the lamp's glow, I notice the unique badge she's clutching.
You said "getting to" Emor, yet you know this place inside out. Does that mean...?
Hm? Did I never mention it?==W== The<r=Norstheim> Northern </r>City is my home.
The<r=Norstheim> Northern </r>City was once as prosperous as any other city.
Raised in this harsh climate, Northerners revere strength.==RT==And more importantly, unity.
We hunted together. Climbed the Monolith together. And to survive==RT==the cold, we used our wishes for Artifacts that gave us warmth.
But a few years ago... The Monolith went dark. The people here==RT==had no choice but to abandon the city.
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to drag up bad memories.
Don't be. Northerners are tougher than you think. We may have left, but we'll rebuild somewhere else.
Is this your first time back?
Yes. When the Monolith went dark, we fled in haste and never returned.
I swore an oath. I have to stop that tragedy from happening again ... and find out what happened with the Monolith.
My grandfather backed my decision. So, with that resolve, I traveled to the City of a Thousand Monoliths alone.
Later, I joined the Sentinel of Dawn and learned about Nocturn Eterna—fanatics destroying Monoliths everywhere.
... I see. No wonder you're so fixated on them.
Speaking of which, I shouldn't have suspected you back in the carriage. I'm sorry.
In the City of a Thousand Monoliths, I spotted a Nocturn Eterna tailing you.==W== I assumed you were their insider.
But after watching you for a while, I realized I was wrong. Let's just call it a misunderstanding.
Huh? A Nocturn Eterna was tailing me...? Did you get a good look at them?
Ah, sorry, I was just thinking...==W== I don't think I actually saw her face.

She wasn't carrying any weapons, so I can't recall the specifics... But her pale skin, characteristic of the Bayan, and the white, pointed horns atop her head were proof enough that she was a member of Nocturn Eterna.
Nocturn Eterna traits... Aeloria's skin is pale, sure, but she doesn't have white horns...
It doesn't matter. Even if they do show up, I can handle them.
Instead of fearing unseen enemies, better get a good night's sleep now and prepare for tomorrow. Come on, let's head back to our room.
You're right. It's freezing out here. Let's go—quietly, so we don't wake the others.
No problem. I'm a pro at this.
Hm? Could it be... You always sneak into people's rooms while they're asleep?
Heh, that's a nice one. But no. I used to sneak into the hunting grounds at night for archery practice.
Usually wouldn't make it back till around now.
Ran into a real monster once. Scared me stiff. I couldn't even pull the trigger.
Then what? How'd you get out of there alive?
A passing girl saved my skin. Her magic was insane. Dropped the beast in a single shot.
I never saw her again, though. I asked around everywhere, but nobody knew a thing.
Most folks back home rely on steel. You'd think a mage would stand out.
If I ever run into her again, I just want to thank her properly.
Wraith... Did you sneak out tonight hoping you'd bump into her, at this hour like you did back then?
Was actually looking for something to polish this,==W== but all I dug up were some grimy rags.
Wraith pulls out the badge I noticed earlier.
I've had this on me since I left home. But the humidity down south is no joke. It's in pretty rough shape now.
Oh... I've got an idea. Have the perfect thing for that.
Isn't that the "drink" you pulled out on the carriage?
... Just trust me. It'll strip the rust right off.
And... Done! Look, rust is completely gone.
Woah...! It looks exactly like it used to!==W== What kind of Artifact is this?!
Rust remover. Rare, but handy! A member of my guild wishes this stuff up all the time.
But if it's that precious, are you sure you want to waste it on this...?
Of course.==W== It means a lot to you, doesn't it?
If my friends were standing here instead of me, I know they'd make the exact same choice.
Sounds like you have an amazing team...Thank you. I won't forget this favor.
Ugh, I'm roasting... Edda's warming spell is still going strong on these clothes...
Wraith put her coat over me again? She's the one who needs to worry about the cold.
I appreciate the thought, but you need this more than I do.
Sigh... I just put that back on you...
Ughh... Grandpa, I want ice cream...
Looks like she's having a sweet dream... Best leave her be.
And so, on my first night in Norstheim, I barely got a wink of sleep...

param: At night, you and Wraith have a long talk outside. You learn that this was her hometown and get to know the stories of both the city and her past.
I meant: for the next few days, we are sleeping together.==W== That's all there is to it. Why are you shocked?
It's only normal to be shocked!! Could you at least tell me why?
The Monolith has "rebooted." Nocturn Eterna could be nearby, plotting another sabotage. I need to secure your safety 24/7.
Ah... Are you worried about the sleeping arrangement?==W== Don't worry, I sleep better sitting up. I won't take your bed.
That's not really what I was worried about...==W== Well, whatever. If you don't mind, then I guess I don't either.
Hm? Then what were you worried about? Is there something else?
No, nothing! Just drop it! It's getting late—let's just get some sleep!
Mm. Rest easy. I'll keep watch.
Wraith's coat?==W== Did she tuck me in?
Strange. She left without her coat. Where would she go at this hour?
Looks like she headed out of camp.
Under the faint moonlight, I follow her tracks to a clearing near our camp.
As if reading the room, a crooked streetlamp flickers on, lighting the figure at the path's end.
How did this place ... end up like this...
Bathed in that light, she seems more solitary now than she did by day.
What are you doing out here? I thought you were keeping watch for me.
I am on watch. But that doesn't require me to stay at your bedside the entire night.
Relax. I rigged the room with defensive wards for Nocturn Eterna. If they get close, they'll be riddled with holes.
Sounds ... dangerous. Did you factor my safety into that setup?
Hmm...==W== Guess that detail slipped my mind.
Aren't those wards even more dangerous than Nocturn Eterna!?
Just kidding. I just rigged up basic alarms that make noise if anyone breaks in. I'm just patrolling nearby. Be back in a flash if needed.
I didn't take you for the joking type.
I have a sense of humor, you know. Though it's gotten a bit rusty. Since getting to the City of a Thousand Monoliths, I've mostly kept to myself.
Being here reminds me of the old days with my team. Put me in a nostalgic mood, I guess.
Under the lamp's glow, I notice the unique badge she's clutching.
You said "getting to" Emor, yet you know this place inside out. Does that mean...?
Hm? Did I never mention it?==W== The<r=Norstheim> Northern </r>City is my home.
The<r=Norstheim> Northern </r>City was once as prosperous as any other city.
Raised in this harsh climate, Northerners revere strength.==RT==And more importantly, unity.
We hunted together. Climbed the Monolith together. And to survive==RT==the cold, we used our wishes for Artifacts that gave us warmth.
But a few years ago... The Monolith went dark. The people here==RT==had no choice but to abandon the city.
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to drag up bad memories.
Don't be. Northerners are tougher than you think. We may have left, but we'll rebuild somewhere else.
Is this your first time back?
Yes. When the Monolith went dark, we fled in haste and never returned.
I swore an oath. I have to stop that tragedy from happening again ... and find out what happened with the Monolith.
My grandfather backed my decision. So, with that resolve, I traveled to the City of a Thousand Monoliths alone.
Later, I joined the Sentinel of Dawn and learned about Nocturn Eterna—fanatics destroying Monoliths everywhere.
... I see. No wonder you're so fixated on them.
Speaking of which, I shouldn't have suspected you back in the carriage. I'm sorry.
In the City of a Thousand Monoliths, I spotted a Nocturn Eterna tailing you.==W== I assumed you were their insider.
But after watching you for a while, I realized I was wrong. Let's just call it a misunderstanding.
Huh? A Nocturn Eterna was tailing me...? Did you get a good look at them?
Ah, sorry, I was just thinking...==W== I don't think I actually saw her face.

She wasn't carrying any weapons, so I can't recall the specifics... But her pale skin, characteristic of the Bayan, and the white, pointed horns atop her head were proof enough that she was a member of Nocturn Eterna.
Nocturn Eterna traits... Aeloria's skin is pale, sure, but she doesn't have white horns...
It doesn't matter. Even if they do show up, I can handle them.
Instead of fearing unseen enemies, better get a good night's sleep now and prepare for tomorrow. Come on, let's head back to our room.
You're right. It's freezing out here. Let's go—quietly, so we don't wake the others.
No problem. I'm a pro at this.
Hm? Could it be... You always sneak into people's rooms while they're asleep?
Heh, that's a nice one. But no. I used to sneak into the hunting grounds at night for archery practice.

... Just trust me. It'll strip the rust right off.

If my friends were standing here instead of me, I know they'd make the exact same choice.

strings.text: You and Wraith discover ancient murals of legends and rites in an underground cave. After a sudden onslaught from a teammate, you decide to return at once to organize your findings.
Grace ... refilled.==RT==There. That'll keep the warming spell running another day.
Thanks, Edda. Appreciate the extra effort.
Don't mention it. It's the least I can do.
Stay safe. If you spot Nocturn Eterna, retreat immediately. We're only here to scout the Monolith. Don't be a hero.
Our patrol covers the east Silver District. After that, we hit...
Hm? You look pale. Rough night?
Silence is golden and all, but...
We've got days of work ahead. I need the rest. Better just tell her.
Yeah, that's pretty much it. Hence the lack of sleep.
I see... My apologies. I didn't mean to trouble you.
As long as you're not sick, it's fine. But ... aren't you freezing?
My body's ... different. Northerners handle cold well, but my tolerance is high even for them.
The trade-off is, I overheat easily. I took off my coat during combat because it got too hot in the carriage. Last night was probably the same situation...
I didn't realize I was keeping you up. I'm truly sorry.
Don't sweat it. Having you close actually makes me feel safer. Knowing I won't get ambushed by the Nocturn Eterna takes a load off. I'll sleep like a rock tonight.
That wraps up our scouting here.==W== Let's move to the next... Hm?
Hear that ... strange whistling? Doesn't sound like the blizzard. More like...
Tracing the sound, we find our way into the depths beneath the city.
I had no idea there was a cavern this massive underground.
You've lived here for quite a while, haven't you? You never heard about it?
No. I knew the outskirts were riddled with mines, but this doesn't look like one. Feels more like a natural formation.
That "whistling" you heard seems to be coming from just ahead.
Yeah. It's blowing right out of this fissure.
Passage is too tight... I can't get a clear look inside.
Uh... I think I can squeeze through. Scout ahead.
Be careful. Holler if anything happens. I'll be right behind you.
That's reliable. But ... with her figure, is she actually going to fit?
Shoving myself through, I glimpsed an even vaster underground space.
This cave ...==W== shows many signs of human activity.
Huh? Looks like there's something painted on that wall over there.
Nocturn Eterna ambush?!==W== Hold on! I'm coming!
Ow, ow...==W== I'm good. Just tripped.
What is this, a sword?==W== Rust-stained...==W== Looks like a very ancient one.
Nothing. I stepped on a sword and lost my footing.
Glad you're safe. Hang on, I'm coming through—==W==ngh... Huh?
Don't worry, it's just a tiny gap—I'll squeeze through in no time... Ngh!
My apologies, ==PLAYER_NAME==... Could you give me a hand?
Alright.==W== On my count,==W== we pull.
Phew. Thanks. Thought I'd be trapped there forever. Talk about a humiliating end...
Yeah. Take a look at these murals.
This script is ancient. Must be a relic site from the first settlers of the North.
The ancient script of the North... Can you read it?
I get the basic idea. But our people pass history down through stories and deeds, not records.==W== I can't be 100% sure about what this truly means—
"In the distant past, the fires of war burned all the way==RT==to the frozen plains of Norstheim..."
"The people's prayers summoned the God of War.==RT==Wherever their spear pointed, victory followed."
"When war ended, they entrusted peace to humanity and returned==RT==to the Monolith, leaving the people to safeguard peace with their own hands."
Is this "God of War" another name for the God of Grace?
No, I've never heard of the God of Grace having any other name.==W== I suppose it's just a unique belief of the North. People here revere more primal, natural entities.
For example, sailors would tattoo ocean waves onto their bodies, believing this would grant them the sea's power and ensure safe voyages.
So this cave was ... a site for nature worship, or something?
I suppose so, but...==W== This mural's content is pretty bizarre.
Looks like they're performing some kind of ... ritual?
"God descends from the Monolith...==W== Participants...==W== Duel...==W== Answer..."
No, these engravings are too badly weathered to discern any more specific details.
It seems to record some kind of ritual to summon a deity—one that requires the participants to duel with weapons.==W== These relics must have been left behind from those ancient rites...
Wait, something's not right. There's blood on these weapons. Fresh blood, from just days or weeks ago...
... Which means these aren't just ancient relics. Someone was here recently, using these old weapons to perform the ritual. And...
It looks like it worked. Or at least, it was partially successful.
Was this the Nocturn Eterna's doing? We must get word to the others.
Huh?==W== Miss Longsword? What are you doing here?
Get back, ==PLAYER_NAME==!==W== Something's wrong with her!
Her moves are so distorted...==W== This isn't how normal humans fight; someone is pulling the strings.
Where is the spellcaster? Show yourself!
No worries. She's just passed out.
The weapon... That isn't her usual sword. It looks like an ancient one.
The murderous aura vanished the second I disarmed her. That weapon doesn't look good. We'd better not touch it.
Anyway, let's get her back to base. It isn't safe here. I'll secure an exit route. You stay put and keep an eye on her.
She blacked out the moment she was disarmed...==W== Is there a connection?
She's not injured. That mage she partners with is missing, too.
Could it be that they were attacked by Nocturn Eterna ... and she was turned into this by their magic?
The murals, the ritual, the weapons, and now the Nocturn Eterna... Maybe there's a connection between all of this...
Urgh... No...==W== I think I'm stuck again...
Little help here? It's kind of... Urgh...

strings.text: Back at the camp, you rescue Edda, who is also under attack. She claims she saw Nocturn Eterna entering the Monolith. You decide to take a short rest before heading inside to uncover the truth.
She seems ... stable... Breathing's steady...==W== Hah... Looks like ... she's just fast asleep...
I didn't mean her. I meant you. You're panting.==W== If you're tired, let me take her.
Huff... I'm okay. Not tired... it's just...
So hot... I think I'm getting heatstroke...
Sorry, I might need a cooldown...
I knew you were bad with heat, but this is ridiculous. You're wearing so little in this freezing cold and still feeling hot...
Hah... Hah... I can't... The heat is making me dizzy... My vision is blurring... I have to do something... And fast.
These clothes are stifling... Hard to peel them off with her on my back, though...
Whoa, whoa, hold on! What do you think you're doing?!
Hm? Venting heat. Isn't that the most efficient method?
Did the heat fry your brain? You don't need to strip just to cool down!
Fine, but remember—you're the one who said it was hot. Don't blame me if you freeze later!
Good thing there's plenty of stuff to cool off with here... A handful of snow should work—
Mm, using snow is a sound strategy. ==PLAYER_NAME==, could you apply some to my face? That should help.
I think you're already dressed cool enough as it is... How's that feel?
Phew... Much better. My head's clearing up.
Great. Let's catch our breath, then we keep moving—
I'll need you to handle the rest of my body, too. Apparently, cooling the armpits and inner thighs is most effective when one's suffering from heatstroke...
No way! You can do those parts yourself!
Huh. Guess we're the first ones back.
I'll carry Miss Longsword to her room.
Good work. Now we just wait for the others to come back.
Still... Look at the time. Why hasn't anyone else returned?
And Miss Longsword's partner, that Mage Girl, is missing too. This is getting a bit worrying.
I'm back. The other rooms are empty too.==W== Does this mean... Something happened to the others, too? Just like what happened to Longsword...
Likely. Whatever made her like this...If I were Nocturn Eterna, I wouldn't stop with just one victim.
We rush in. Edda stands guard over an unconscious Mage girl, shielding her from a berserk guy with an axe.
Snap out of it! It's me! Edda! Ugh!
The Legion... Urgh...You are... THE ENEMY!!!
Stay back! I'll take care of him!
He looks like he's controlled too! Watch out!
The Iron Hooves ... will crush you all—!!!
What strange movements... But if it's the same situation as before, I just need to disarm him like I did with Longsword—
Thought so... No idea how it works, but as soon as I knocked away his weapon, he lost consciousness.
Edda, it's over. Are you hur—
Don't worry, it's all right now.
I'm sorry... I never thought something this terrible would happen...
Your safety comes first, but... I was so scared I completely froze...
It's okay. Danger's gone...==W== Come on, deep breath.
Huff... Puff... Your heartbeat, Tyrant... It makes me feel so safe.
Sorry to interrupt. Hug all you want, but mind filling me in on what just happened?
Uh—my apologies... I'll tell you everything.
Phew. I've taken Axe and Mage back to their room. Hope they'll wake up soon.
Thank you... At least no one is badly injured. It's a miracle.
I saw you shielding the Mage. Did Axe Guy hurt her?
No... We found her collapsed on the ground with a strange weapon nearby. The second he picked it up, he just...
Attacked you like he was being controlled, right?
Yes... What in the world is happening?
We ran into the same situation.
I give her the rundown on the weapons and murals in the cave and how Miss Longsword attacked us.
I can't believe something that horrible happened twice...
From the looks of it, they were likely attacked by Nocturn Eterna.
Just a guess, though. Wraith and I did not spot any Nocturn Eterna.
I don't know if this counts as a clue, but...==W== I saw them.
They have white horns on their head. There's no mistaking it.
Sounds like the stalker of me Wraith mentioned, the one that's been stalking me.
Is that so?! Then... Maybe Nocturn Eterna's true target is Tyrant...==W== Right, that Nocturn Eterna headed for the Monolith.
In Emor, Nocturn Eterna—Aeloria's goal was to destroy Monoliths.
But why would they enter a Monolith they already destroyed? Was it because the Monolith was rebooted?
Are they trying to destroy the Monolith before it returns to normal? Or are they just here to stall our investigation?
But regardless of the goal, there's no reason for them to be performing that kind of ritual.
Something feels off... Am I missing a piece of the puzzle?
Wraith. The mural said: "God descends from the Monolith... Participants... Duel... Answer..." Right?
Word for word. I remember it clearly.
This is just my own speculation, but... It explains why they haven't touched us. They want us to do their work and finish the ritual.
I see... So that's what the text means. Gather participants for a ritual and have them duel one another until a sole victor remains—only then will God grant a response.
They aren't trying to take us out; they're thinning the herd. They need a "sole victor" to receive that answer.
And once a victor is chosen, then what?
That's the missing piece. We'll have to track down Nocturn Eterna and beat the truth out of them.
Brilliant deduction! I'd expect nothing less from you, Tyrant.
The plan is set, then. We head to the Monolith and flush Nocturn Eterna out of their hole.
Any objections? If not, let's get straight to planning—
S-Sorry... I haven't had a bite since this morning...
Haha... I'm actually starving, too. Let's grab some grub first.
Wait, our resident chef is Mage Girl, isn't she? And she's still out cold...
I have canned rations stashed away. Give me a second.
Wraith stepped away. A good while later, she returned with an armful of assorted cans.
What kept you? Should've given me a shout if you needed a hand.
I took some time to sort through them. These are standard rations for the Sentinel of Dawn. Taste mediocre, but they'll keep you full for hours. Quite useful during missions.
True. At times like this, taste certainly isn't the top priority.
What's wrong, Edda, something on your mind? You've been standing there frozen.
Huh!? Oh, sorry... I was tense for so long, and now that I've relaxed, I'm suddenly feeling a bit sleepy...
I guess I really am feeling a bit tired today... I'll head back to rest now, but I'll make sure to handle the follow-up action plan properly.
Ah, okay... Are you all right? Not feeling sick or anything?
Not at all! I'll be fine after resting for a bit~
You should take some of these cans back to eat. I took them here anyway. Pick a flavor you like?
Thank you, thank you. Well... I'll head inside then. Enjoy your meal, everyone, and goodnight.
Wraith keeps her eyes fixed on Edda's back as she returns to her room. It isn't exactly a look of concern ... but more like she's trying to confirm something.

And Miss Longsword's partner, that Mage Girl, is missing too. This is getting a bit worrying.
I'm back. The other rooms are empty too.==W== Does this mean... Something happened to the others, too? Just like what happened to Longsword...
Likely. Whatever made her like this...If I were Nocturn Eterna, I wouldn't stop with just one victim.
We rush in. Edda stands guard over an unconscious Mage girl, shielding her from a berserk guy with an axe.
Snap out of it! It's me! Edda! Ugh!
The Legion... Urgh...You are... THE ENEMY!!!
Stay back! I'll take care of him!
He looks like he's controlled too! Watch out!
The Iron Hooves ... will crush you all—!!!
What strange movements... But if it's the same situation as before, I just need to disarm him like I did with Longsword—
Thought so... No idea how it works, but as soon as I knocked away his weapon, he lost consciousness.
Edda, it's over. Are you hur—
Don't worry, it's all right now.
I'm sorry... I never thought something this terrible would happen...
Your safety comes first, but... I was so scared I completely froze...
It's okay. Danger's gone...==W== Come on, deep breath.
Huff... Puff... Your heartbeat, Tyrant... It makes me feel so safe.
Sorry to interrupt. Hug all you want, but mind filling me in on what just happened?
Uh—my apologies... I'll tell you everything.
Phew. I've taken Axe and Mage back to their room. Hope they'll wake up soon.
Thank you... At least no one is badly injured. It's a miracle.
I saw you shielding the Mage. Did Axe Guy hurt her?
No... We found her collapsed on the ground with a strange weapon nearby. The second he picked it up, he just...
Attacked you like he was being controlled, right?
Yes... What in the world is happening?
We ran into the same situation.
I give her the rundown on the weapons and murals in the cave and how Miss Longsword attacked us.
I can't believe something that horrible happened twice...
From the looks of it, they were likely attacked by Nocturn Eterna.
Just a guess, though. Wraith and I did not spot any Nocturn Eterna.
I don't know if this counts as a clue, but...==W== I saw them.
They have white horns on their head. There's no mistaking it.
Sounds like the stalker of me Wraith mentioned, the one that's been stalking me.
Is that so?! Then... Maybe Nocturn Eterna's true target is Tyrant...==W== Right, that Nocturn Eterna headed for the Monolith.
In Emor, Nocturn Eterna—Aeloria's goal was to destroy Monoliths.
But why would they enter a Monolith they already destroyed? Was it because the Monolith was rebooted?
Are they trying to destroy the Monolith before it returns to normal? Or are they just here to stall our investigation?
But regardless of the goal, there's no reason for them to be performing that kind of ritual.
Something feels off... Am I missing a piece of the puzzle?
Wraith. The mural said: "God descends from the Monolith... Participants... Duel... Answer..." Right?
Word for word. I remember it clearly.
This is just my own speculation, but... It explains why they haven't touched us. They want us to do their work and finish the ritual.
I see... So that's what the text means. Gather participants for a ritual and have them duel one another until a sole victor remains—only then will God grant a response.
They aren't trying to take us out; they're thinning the herd. They need a "sole victor" to receive that answer.
And once a victor is chosen, then what?
That's the missing piece. We'll have to track down Nocturn Eterna and beat the truth out of them.
Brilliant deduction! I'd expect nothing less from you, Tyrant.
The plan is set, then. We head to the Monolith and flush Nocturn Eterna out of their hole.
Any objections? If not, let's get straight to planning—
S-Sorry... I haven't had a bite since this morning...
Haha... I'm actually starving, too. Let's grab some grub first.
Wait, our resident chef is Mage Girl, isn't she? And she's still out cold...
I have canned rations stashed away. Give me a second.
Wraith stepped away. A good while later, she returned with an armful of assorted cans.
What kept you? Should've given me a shout if you needed a hand.
I took some time to sort through them. These are standard rations for the Sentinel of Dawn. Taste mediocre, but they'll keep you full for hours. Quite useful during missions.
True. At times like this, taste certainly isn't the top priority.
What's wrong, Edda, something on your mind? You've been standing there frozen.
Huh!? Oh, sorry... I was tense for so long, and now that I've relaxed, I'm suddenly feeling a bit sleepy...
I guess I really am feeling a bit tired today... I'll head back to rest now, but I'll make sure to handle the follow-up action plan properly.
Ah, okay... Are you all right? Not feeling sick or anything?
Not at all! I'll be fine after resting for a bit~
You should take some of these cans back to eat. I took them here anyway. Pick a flavor you like?
Thank you, thank you. Well... I'll head inside then. Enjoy your meal, everyone, and goodnight.
Wraith keeps her eyes fixed on Edda's back as she returns to her room. It isn't exactly a look of concern ... but more like she's trying to confirm something.

strings.text: You push deeper into the Monolith, but the sense of unease only grows. Under Wraith's pointed questioning, Edda's facade crumbles, revealing that the entire "incident" is a trap of her own making.
Wraith! Hostiles at twelve and three! Watch the flanks!
Ugh, seriously! Why are there so many Stellaroids?!
Phew...==W== Sector clear.==W== Good work, everyone—
Nice shot.==W== Thanks. I got careless. Missed that one completely.
These Stellaroids are acting strange. They're way too smart, meaning they're either being controlled ... or drawn to something.
Usually, Stellaroids swarm out during a Monolith Meltdown.
But these ones are digging in... Is something hiding inside the Monolith?
The harder they fight, the closer we get! Nocturn Eterna has to be hiding deep inside!
Sigh... Finally. We can catch our breath in here.
Hm... The air between them's been heavy since last night. Maybe I should break the ice?
S-So... How are we getting back after this?
It's a long haul back to Emor. Do we have a carriage arranged? Wait, no... The driver's already...
... Well, that just made things worse.
Relax. I booked a backup carriage before we even left the city.
If things go to plan, it will arrive tomorrow to pick us up.
"To plan"? We might not finish the mission by tomorrow... Why is the return date set in stone already?
I get it. But ... hypothetically, what if we take a prisoner?==W== A carriage has limited seats. Did you factor that in?
Extremists who destroy Monoliths don't deserve due process... We simply neutralize them. Problem solved.
Edda, that's enough. Even for Nocturn Eterna, vigilante justice isn't the answer. We will hand them over to the Dusk Arbiters.
Surprising. I expected a Sentinel of Dawn to back me up on this.
Destroying a Monolith is unforgivable blasphemy, but rules are rules. As a Sentinel of Dawn, I can't break protocol for a personal vendetta. If I do, I'm no better than they are.
Wow...==W== A textbook answer. You really place your faith in the Grace Imperium, don't you?==W== —Ah, doors are opening. Let's move.
This ... is the Boss's Domain.==RT==Once we clear this zone, the summit is ours.
You certainly know your way around here.
Naturally. The mission involves the Monolith... Isn't it only logical to do my homework beforehand?
Sharp memory. I guess that figure you spotted on the street really was a Nocturn Eterna.
Of course. Normal Novians don't have white horns on their heads. That was definitely a Nocturn Eterna. I saw it clearly.
White horns, huh...==W== In all my years fighting Nocturn Eterna, I've never seen a single one with white horns.
What are you talking about...?! You're the one who said they have white horns—
That's right. I did mention that detail to ==PLAYER_NAME==. However—
Huh? A Nocturn Eterna was tailing me...? Did you get a good look at them?
Ah, sorry, I was just thinking...==W== I don't think I actually saw her face.
Not sure who it is yet...==W== But if I plant some fake intel, I'll smoke the rat out eventually.
If ==PLAYER_NAME== is a mole, ==SEX=='ll bite on the lie and do something.==W== If not... Then ==SEX=='s in the clear.

She wasn't carrying any weapons, so I can't recall the specifics...==W== But her pale skin, characteristic of the Bayan, and the white, pointed horns atop her head were proof enough that she was a member of Nocturn Eterna.
I realized someone was eavesdropping, so I fed you that lie on purpose.
I hoped I was just being paranoid... But sadly, I was right. We have a traitor in our midst.
Are you joking?! I saw those horns clear as day! You're the liar here, Wraith! You're the traitor!
We lacked hard evidence before. But last night, while grabbing food, I took a closer look at the injuries the others sustained.
No wonder you were gone for so long... It all makes sense now.
And guess what? Their wounds were identical—inflicted by magic.==W== The only ones here capable of that ... are you and Mage.
Since Mage is already down for the count...==W== The only suspect left is you,==W== Edda.
That is pure speculation! Boss, don't let her twist the truth! She's the liar here!
No. I think Wraith is right.
First—==W==this whole situation feels off.==W== It's nothing like my previous run-ins with Nocturn Eterna.
Second—==W==you sent us to a specific spot ... and coincidentally,==W== that's exactly where we found those murals and ancient weapons.
Finally—==W==you're the only one left standing.==W== Unharmed, and in total control.
Huh—so what?! That proves nothing! You and Wraith are fine too. Can't you both use magic as well?
My case is ... unique. But forget that. The one thing that truly bothers me is this:
Why are you so hell-bent on getting us inside the Monolith?
We came to investigate... You specifically promised that safety came first, that we wouldn't face any real danger.
Yet halfway through, you used the Nocturn Eterna as bait to lure us into the Monolith... Almost like you were the one eager to hunt them down.

The mission was a simple investigation. There was no need for such risk. As our employer, you should've been cautious. Yet you pushed us deeper into the Monolith because it held traces of Nocturn Eterna... Why?
Heheheh...==W== You really live up to the rumors, Boss. Nothing gets past you.
Guess I'll have to speed things up...==W== No matter. Just a minor complication!
You were inches from the summit... Such a waste.
What are you after?! Why are you hurting everyone?!
Ooh! Rare to see the Tyrant lose ==SEX3== cool! You're really fitting that legendary image now.
With that anger, the ritual's success rate ... just skyrocketed!
Hehehe. The ritual to bring "Them" back to this world, of course.
I've devoted myself==W== to ancient prophecies of their descent,==W== scouring Nova and collecting ancient weapons...
Do you have any idea how much work went into this?
Sorry. I've got zero interest in your ritual nonsense.
How rude! Have your teachers never taught you not to interrupt someone while they're speaking?!
My bad. The only subject I cared about in school was physical education.
I hate that type, too.==W== Makes killing you guilt-free. Saves me the trouble.
I'll crush you, become the sole "Victor" ... and the perfect sacrifice!
Sacrifice...? What kind of twisted plan is she talking about?
With the "Victor" and "Witness" both here...==W== The God will walk this earth once more...!
Save the speech for after you win!
Heh. You last longer than most==W==. But ... can you take this?
(Her power keeps climbing... It feels wrong, yet she's in control.==W== Is this "God" actually fueling her?)
Stubborn. My Stellaroid array should've drained you dry, yet here you are, still kicking.
Drain me? Huh.==W== That wasn't even a warm-up.
Let's see how long you can keep up that tough act.
(Another trap... They're not just here. The whole Monolith is rigged...==W== She really came prepared.)
Struggling only prolongs the pain...==W== Just submit already!
So... I'm actually underestimated. Still, her form is flawless. Time to rethink my approach...==W== Let's try this.
Finally at your limit?==W== Then it's my turn!
(Impossible... I had a lock on her. Is she fighting on pure instinct?)
(No, she's reading my every move... It's like she can see the future!)
(Is this the true power of Wraith ... the Sentinels' Silver Gale?)
They're going to bring the whole Monolith down! I need to find a way to help Wraith...
Tsk... You freak!==W== I should've taken you out back in Emor when I had the chance.
You were boasting about being the "perfect sacrifice" a minute ago. Where's that nerve now?==W== You've exhausted every spell and every trick. The game's over. Surrender.
Surrender? Me?==W== Hah! Don't celebrate just yet...==W== Take this—
Give it up. I've anticipated your every move.==W== You're out of options. It's finished.
H-how... You really are a monster...==W== I actually didn't stand a single chance—
—Or am I?==W== You took the bait.
A strange magic circle unfurls across my body, pulsing with terrifying energy.
Magic has no effect on me, but I realize too late that she's standing right beside me.

strings.text: Conflict erupts between you, Wraith, and Edda. In a momentary lapse, Wraith's consciousness gets imprisoned. Edda then reveals her true purpose: To awake the mighty "Archons."
It's no use. Now that the circle's active, her mind is already gone from that shell.
I fell for it. Edda's attack was a trap—she wanted Wraith to shield me and come closer...==W== But ... why did the circle activate on me?
It's okay. Danger's gone...==W== Come on, deep breath.
Huff... Huff...Your heartbeat, Tyrant... It makes me feel so safe.
When you pretended to panic and hugged me, you planted the circle on my clothes?
Exactly~ Quite convincing, wasn't it? The warming spell I cast on your clothes earlier was just to hide the sigil.==W== Tyrant, you are too gullible.
You should be grateful you ran into kind old me. If it had been Nocturn Eterna who found you... Well...
What did you do to Wraith?!
Hmph. This Monolith might be drained, but phase one is complete...==W== This domain belongs to Them now.
They seized her mind and cast it into a rift in spacetime. She's gone for good.
Who is this "They" you keep talking about?
I don't usually share my secrets, but for Tyrant, I suppose I can make an exception.
After all, I still need you two to see my plan through.
This world may worship supreme beings like the God of Grace... But in Norstheim, we revere something else entirely. They are—
They once commanded the Monoliths and demanded fear ... until the Grace Imperium tried to erase them from history.
I'm not like those fools. I found the remnants in ruins and banned scriptures, and I learned the truth of their power.
The Archons are fickle, however. Few are ever deemed worthy to become their "Kin."
But in my search... I was lucky enough to earn Their gaze.
In that instant, it all became clear. The cryptic runes, the whispers in the dark... Suddenly, I understood everything!
The one who blessed me, without a doubt, is the Archon who holds the authority of "War."
And to bring the Archon of War into this world... I will gladly sacrifice everything!
That's a lot to process... But is that why you tricked Wraith into coming all this way?
That's right. The moment I mentioned Nocturn Eterna, she agreed to follow. Easy, too.
Only if warriors powerful enough join the ritual will They be satisfied.
Then why me? I'm as good a fighter as an ordinary person with no magic.

The Archons exist beyond the laws of reality. The summoning ritual merely anchors their passage into this world. To draw Their attention, besides performing the rites They favor... A <color=#bd3059>"special individual"</color> is also required.
As the Tyrant, you are the final piece of the puzzle. The most critical component—<color=#bd3059>the Witness</color>.
As long as you stand here, within the ritual, They will surely take notice. That's what makes you ... special!
I'd planned to just lock you up, but ...==W== that nuisance was sharper than I gave her credit for. I never found an opening.
Wraith was protecting me from the start...==W== Did she have Edda figured out all along?
Hmph. Doesn't matter now! You've disrespected the Archon, and you'll pay the price!
Wait! Don't hurt Wraith! Look, this is all just in your head! Those ancient texts, the legends—none of them are proven!
Silence. Even coming from you, Tyrant, that tests my patience.
Hmph. Seeing is believing. Before the ritual ends, allow me to show you...
... what I've sacrificed to reach this exact moment!
A tide of raw magic rushes toward Edda, shaking the entire floor.
Thick darkness spreads through the air, something vile and unhinged stirring within it.
No... I can't stare at it. It's stealing my senses.
Come, Tyrant. Etch this moment into your memory.
Let me think... I blocked that spell for ==PLAYER_NAME==, then I was swallowed by that strange light ... and lost consciousness...
Did I fail? Wait... Don't tell me this is...
"Lavish decorations. Grand halls. A sanctuary overflowing with food and wine, echoing with beautiful verses..."
"The final resting place for all Northern souls—<color=#bd3059><r=Ainheir>the Hall of Everfeast</r></color>..."
Still... This place looks more like Emor's luxury hotel.
Oh? A fresh face. Are you new here?
Mm~ If you're reporting in, go see the Vice Commander. He's at the far end of the long table.
("Assistant Commander"? Shouldn't a place like this have a "Chieftain" or "Warlord"...?)
"A fool is best silent in company. For if he speaks not, none shall know of his ignorance."
It seems a ghost still clinging to "life" has wandered into our land of exile.
"Ghost"? You mean me? Sorry, but I don't plan on dying today.
Watch your tone! You stand before the Legion's Vice Commander!
Let her be. We perished on that battlefield long ago. Now, we are nothing but lingering wills trapped within the weapons.
(Wills within a weapon... Does he mean those ancient weapons?)
(That explains it. The ones who lost control were influenced by these spirits.)
Young soul, you still seem lost. Perhaps you should reflect on—
My partner's in danger. Sorry, but I don't have time for this.
Haha, in a rush? Then I'll be blunt.==W== This is a war camp. You must prove you deserve to leave.
Hmph... "Might makes right," huh? You should've just led with that.
Fighting would be meaningless. Just look, child.
The old man points out the window. A scene reflects in Wraith's eyes—
That Kin's next move is to destroy your weapon. You're out of time.
She's not bluffing... The ritual is nearly complete.==RT==I have to stop this now, or Wraith won't make it!
Tyrant, please watch closely. For peace. For Nova. For a world free from the clutch of Nocturn Eterna... Everything I've done.
And what does summoning this Archon have to do with that?
Oh my! Apologies. I got so caught up praising Them, I forgot to mention the connection.
Once the Archon of War fully descends, He will transform this entire Monolith into a fortress of war.
With the Monolith fully fortified, Nocturn Eterna won't be able to infiltrate or sabotage it.
The Monolith will never go dark again, nor will the Cities' tragedy repeat itself again...
So this is ... your final answer?
Ah, I see that you understand. You will be safe. I didn't deceive you.
As the Witness, you're different from us. Just take a seat in the "spectator stands" and watch the duel unfold.
I don't believe in the Archons, nor will I sit safely in some "spectator seat."

In that instant, it all became clear. The cryptic runes, the whispers in the dark... Suddenly, I understood everything!
The one who blessed me, without a doubt, is the Archon who holds the authority of "War."
And to bring the Archon of War into this world... I will gladly sacrifice everything!
That's a lot to process... But is that why you tricked Wraith into coming all this way?
That's right. The moment I mentioned Nocturn Eterna, she agreed to follow. Easy, too.
Only if warriors powerful enough join the ritual will They be satisfied.
Then why me? I'm as good a fighter as an ordinary person with no magic.

The Archons exist beyond the laws of reality. The summoning ritual merely anchors their passage into this world. To draw Their attention, besides performing the rites They favor... A <color=#bd3059>"special individual"</color> is also required.
As the Tyrant, you are the final piece of the puzzle. The most critical component—<color=#bd3059>the Witness</color>.
As long as you stand here, within the ritual, They will surely take notice. That's what makes you ... special!
I'd planned to just lock you up, but ...==W== that nuisance was sharper than I gave her credit for. I never found an opening.
Wraith was protecting me from the start...==W== Did she have Edda figured out all along?
Hmph. Doesn't matter now! You've disrespected the Archon, and you'll pay the price!
Wait! Don't hurt Wraith! Look, this is all just in your head! Those ancient texts, the legends—none of them are proven!
Silence. Even coming from you, Tyrant, that tests my patience.
Hmph. Seeing is believing. Before the ritual ends, allow me to show you...
... what I've sacrificed to reach this exact moment!
A tide of raw magic rushes toward Edda, shaking the entire floor.
Thick darkness spreads through the air, something vile and unhinged stirring within it.
No... I can't stare at it. It's stealing my senses.
Come, Tyrant. Etch this moment into your memory.
Let me think... I blocked that spell for ==PLAYER_NAME==, then I was swallowed by that strange light ... and lost consciousness...
Did I fail? Wait... Don't tell me this is...
"Lavish decorations. Grand halls. A sanctuary overflowing with food and wine, echoing with beautiful verses..."
"The final resting place for all Northern souls—<color=#bd3059><r=Ainheir>the Hall of Everfeast</r></color>..."
Still... This place looks more like Emor's luxury hotel.
Oh? A fresh face. Are you new here?
Mm~ If you're reporting in, go see the Vice Commander. He's at the far end of the long table.
("Assistant Commander"? Shouldn't a place like this have a "Chieftain" or "Warlord"...?)
"A fool is best silent in company. For if he speaks not, none shall know of his ignorance."
It seems a ghost still clinging to "life" has wandered into our land of exile.
"Ghost"? You mean me? Sorry, but I don't plan on dying today.
Watch your tone! You stand before the Legion's Vice Commander!
Let her be. We perished on that battlefield long ago. Now, we are nothing but lingering wills trapped within the weapons.
(Wills within a weapon... Does he mean those ancient weapons?)
(That explains it. The ones who lost control were influenced by these spirits.)
Young soul, you still seem lost. Perhaps you should reflect on—
My partner's in danger. Sorry, but I don't have time for this.
Haha, in a rush? Then I'll be blunt.==W== This is a war camp. You must prove you deserve to leave.
Hmph... "Might makes right," huh? You should've just led with that.
Fighting would be meaningless. Just look, child.
The old man points out the window. A scene reflects in Wraith's eyes—
That Kin's next move is to destroy your weapon. You're out of time.
She's not bluffing... The ritual is nearly complete.==RT==I have to stop this now, or Wraith won't make it!
Tyrant, please watch closely. For peace. For Nova. For a world free from the clutch of Nocturn Eterna... Everything I've done.
And what does summoning this Archon have to do with that?
Oh my! Apologies. I got so caught up praising Them, I forgot to mention the connection.
Once the Archon of War fully descends, He will transform this entire Monolith into a fortress of war.
With the Monolith fully fortified, Nocturn Eterna won't be able to infiltrate or sabotage it.
The Monolith will never go dark again, nor will the Cities' tragedy repeat itself again...
So this is ... your final answer?
Ah, I see that you understand. You will be safe. I didn't deceive you.
As the Witness, you're different from us. Just take a seat in the "spectator stands" and watch the duel unfold.
I don't believe in the Archons, nor will I sit safely in some "spectator seat."

strings.text: After battling the ancient souls within the illusion, Wraith successfully breaks free and returns to reality, joining you to confront an utterly deranged Edda.
I don't believe in the Archons, nor will I sit safely in some "spectator seat."
So that is your answer. How ...==W== disappointing. Truly a shame.
Very well, Witness.==RT==Once the ritual is done, you will have outlived your usefulness.
Tyrant, have you lost your mind? A weapon is used to protect yourself, not vice versa.
Edda, you're still putting on an act, aren't you?
Your true target is her weapon. Correct?
I don't know about your God or War or the Archons' ritual and all that.
But on second thought, no commander would possibly order their warriors to kill each other before battle.
Plus, every person Wraith and I encountered who had been controlled would collapse after their weapons were knocked out of their hands.
The real rule of this ritual ... is to disarm your opponent, isn't it?
Wraith clung tightly to her blade even when she fell to the ground—==W==she never gave up the fight.
Hmph, Tyrant, as a "Witness," you can kiss your safety guarantee goodbye the moment you intervene.
Do you really think you can beat me?
I wouldn't dare say this about anyone else, but if it's you—who can only use magic—
You're from the Grace Imperium, you should be aware of my unique condition.
Mind you. I'm no stranger to swordplay!
Edda draws the dagger she carries and approaches me slowly.
Come on, Wraith, wake up! I know you haven't given up fighting!
For ==PLAYER_NAME=='s sake... I won't fall here!
Is this all you've got?==W== Come at me all at once. I'm in a hurry.
She took down our whole regiment with her bare hands.
That fighting style... Where did you learn it?
Where? In Norstheim, kids drill these moves from the moment they can stand.
Rely too much on your weapon, and you'll get yourself killed. That's basic training.
Damn you! How dare you mock our traditions!
Vice Commander! Why stop us?! We can still fight!
The outcome is clear. This fight was never fair. Press on, and we lose our last shred of dignity.
Before I declare the victor, young soul. I have a question.
These skills of yours... In your world, are they truly common knowledge?
... Or so I've heard. Legend has it that this style was once a closely guarded secret among the nobility.
But in the frozen lands, if you can't fight, you won't survive.
Eventually, it became a survival skill for everyone—man, woman, and child.
Ah... Has so much time truly passed in the world outside? No wonder the appearance of this hall keeps shifting.
I can still tell this was a place for dining, though it looks nothing like the tables in our memories. This must be ... the architectural style of your era.
Hmph, you're far too sentimental. A table is a table—as long as you can eat at it, what's the problem?
Haha, I like your spirit. You remind me of the days when I was still among the living.
We have witnessed too much slaughter, watched war reduce everything to ruins, cycle after cycle.
Yet ... from this scarred earth, new life and order always seem to rise.
God must have guided you to us. Perhaps to deliver a message.
I've been wondering... Are you the legion from the murals? The ones who marched with the "God of War"?
We did campaign with her, yes ... and in the end, we lost ourselves within the Monolith, right alongside her.
She was once a legendary fighter, but somewhere along the line, she became isolated ... obsessive. We tried to bring her back to her senses, unfortunately...
You failed. And your souls were trapped right here.
But you're different, young soul. Your fate isn't sealed in this place.
Thanks to your companion's nature, the ritual binding us here has weakened significantly.
If we ... channel our remaining power, we should be able to break you out of this domain.
Don't look at us like that. We are merely echoes of the past. Aiding the living is the release we desire.
Thanks, kid! Haven't had a brawl that good in ages!
Make sure you tell the world about us! Hahahaha!
Hmph... Since you're returning, see that you finish what you started.
<size=70><color=black>What we left unfinished in life... We entrust to you!</size></color>
I hear you.==W== And I will carry your will and spirit with me—
That body of yours is a real nuisance, Tyrant. Isn't it time to quit?
Huff... Honestly, I'd rather not take this too far.==W== Just lay down the weapon, and I'll see you safely back home. I have indeed booked a carriage for tomorrow.
Huff... Huff... You're the one who needs to stop! Your obsession is going to get everyone killed!
Oh no... I can't run anymore...
Hmph... Heh. I'm near my limit too... But it looks like the victory still belongs to me!
In a split second, a massive shockwave sends me flying.
You're at death's door, yet you're still clutching that?
That magic immunity of yours won't save you. Not from a physical blade.
If you don't let go, I'll cut off your fingers one by one until you can't hold anything again. How's that?
Edda, you look absolutely pathetic, scraping for power resorting to such desperate measures.
Shut up... I told you! I need to save Nova from Nocturn Eterna!
And if anyone gets in my way—I don't care who—I will eliminate them. By any means necessary.
That is the mission entrusted to me ... by the Archons!
You're wrong, Edda. True peace can never be won through the weight of sheer force.
What...? Impossible! How are you awake?!
Sorry to keep you waiting, ==PLAYER_NAME==. I'm back.
Impossible. What have you done?! No one escapes the Archon's Domain...
Maybe not. Yet here I stand.
It seems that "power" you worship isn't as absolute as you thought.
Fine! You got lucky this once. But we've already passed the point of no return!
Today—<size=48>none of you are leaving here alive!</size>
Got it. Wraith, we will make it out!
