strings.text: It takes a brutal clash for Edda to realize she cannot defeat Wraith. In desperation, she tries to force Wraith's hand to finish the ritual, but Wraith refuses.
Edda, you're out of options. Stop this before it's too late.
I lost my way back a long time ago!
How?! Why has it turned into Norstheim when we're inside a Monolith?
You're running low on Grace. Quit stalling. If you've got a trump card, use it.
Throw whatever you've got at me. I'll put you down every single time.
If you wanted this over, you would've pulled the trigger already.==W== But... Look around. Familiar? The day the Monolith went dark.
How do you know about that day?!
Of course I know. Like I said—I did my homework before coming here.
Not just the Monolith... I dug into everything regarding Norstheim.
After all... I wasn't able to stand here with the person who mattered most that day.
I may not care for this city...==W== but who wouldn't want to know the truth about their own homeland?
That's right. Born and raised. Though most people just called me the Disgrace of Norstheim.
Heh. I feel nothing for this place, yet it haunts the back of my mind...==W== Like a curse.
But you... You're from the Warlord's bloodline. You lived a comfortable life before that day, and even after… You'll never understand how I feel.
You're right... Seeing what you've done, I can't pretend to understand you. But I've never forgotten my clan's honor.
Ahem... Excuse me. I just didn't expect such high-and-mighty words coming from you.
Hm? Did I say something strange?
You think I don't know? Wraith, you haven't killed a single Nocturn Eterna.==W== The monsters that destroyed your home... You haven't laid a finger on them.
And you have the nerve to say you never forgot... Don't make me laugh.
Wraith, don't let her get in your head!
Thanks for the warning, but I'm fine. Nothing she says changes the truth. I never forgot that honor.==W== No... Actually, you helped me reclaim it.
Ah... So that's what you meant. I suppose that did happen.
At it again... I hate people like you...
Acting like you deserve everything. Flaunting everything... Everything I can never have...
Why do you get to have it all? Is it because I wasn't born a warrior? Or because I used that as an excuse to run away?
Forget it... Doesn't matter now. Just pull the trigger. End it...
Edda, don't force it! It's too dangerous! Put the sword down, now!
Sorry... I just ... wanted to try one more time...
You're too frail. It took years of treatment just to get you on your feet.
Why can everyone else do it, but not me...?==W== Yesterday, they... They called me a stray. Said I'm not a real child of Norstheim...
Listen, Edda. Ignore them. This is your home. The gates of Norstheim are always open to you.
Don't fret about your origins or what people think... Even if you can't swing a sword, you'll find your own strength. You don't have to be a warrior to serve this city.
Um, Master... Actually, I snuck out to the hunting grounds last night. Saw a girl getting attacked by a monster. And then I...
Defeating a massive Bark Boar with a single spell?! What incredible talent...
This child... Perhaps we should send her to Grace Light Academy? No... Why not have the Eye of Grace researchers evaluate her directly?
Edda, I want to hear your decision.
I... I want to go.==W== But isn't the City of a Thousand Monoliths really far...? Plus I'm basically broke...
Forget the cost. A gift like yours is rare... We'll fund everything. I'll even write the recommendation myself.
Oh dear, crying before school even starts?
Because...! That means I have to leave you, Master...
Hahaha! It's not like we'll never meet again. Just come visit during the holidays—this will always be your home!

==A-1==Dear Master,==RT==How have you been? It feels like ages since I left Norstheim.==P====RT====A-1==I pretty much live in the library and the lab these days...==RT==But everyone here is so unique. I'm doing well and making plenty of friends.==P====RT====RT====A-1==I still miss home, though. The holidays are coming up, so I should be back to visit soon.==P====RT====A-1==I'll stop here for now. I want to save the rest for when I see you.==RT==—Edda
Now, just need to find a courier to send this out—
Hm? Aren't you Edda? From the Elite Class?
Y-Yes! I'm Edda! I never expected to run into a graduate like you here...
Well... It's complicated. I'm stuck here under observation for a while.
Oh, right, my letter! With the holidays coming up, I wanted to send a note home before I head back...
Aren't you from ... the Northern City?==W== If that's the case...
Yes...? Why... Did something happen back in Norstheim?
Ah... Well, I've only heard rumors. But word is there was a massive catastrophe at the Norstheim Monolith...==W== They say it's gone dark.
Hello. Are you the new researcher assigned to this unit?
Yes. I've been assigned to the Ancient Studies Department.
Understood, let me get you registered...==W== And place of birth?
Place of birth... Can I put N/A?==W== My home is already—
Master promised me that I would always have a home to return to... But since the Monolith had gone dark, I had nowhere left to go.
I buried myself in work, day and night, trying to forget. Then I found the truth: Nocturn Eterna destroyed the Monolith. They destroyed my home.
My people prided themselves on their strength. So why couldn't they stop Nocturn Eterna? For the longest time, I couldn't understand it...
But now...==W== I see it clearly. It's simple, really.
Norstheim fell for one reason: they were weaker than Nocturn Eterna. That is the only truth.
Then I need power, power so absolute no enemy dares challenge it... With that, I can protect everything.
So I used my rank in the Eye of Grace and accessed archives meant to remain forbidden.
I pieced the clues together... Until I found Them, buried deep in the ruins.
With this power, history will never repeat itself—that one thought drove me to prepare for today.
The final step of the plan... Even if every ritual before this failed, as long as Wraith killed me in the end—
After all, the magic circle on me is my weapon. Destroying it still counts as "disarming" me... Which means the ritual could still...
My wish was supposed to come true...
Why...==W== Why didn't you shoot?! Why!
The battle is done. There is no need for this.
I get it... You're soft. Just like the other warriors. They hesitated before Nocturn Eterna, too. That indecision is why...
You are wrong. You still don't understand.
The strength of Norstheim never came from their weapons.
They survived a harsh land by supporting one another. Their unity was their true power.
<size=50>Sentiments like that ... didn't save Norstheim! Did they?!
I understand your pain. But as I said... Northerners were strong because they stood together.
So what?! What good did it do?!
As long as one of us draws breath, the city lives on. Even if we have to rebuild from a single brick elsewhere...==W== That refusal to yield is Norstheim's soul.
Then what was it all for...?
You've been blaming yourself this whole time, haven't you? Hating yourself for being too far away to stop the disaster.
That's why you pushed yourself to the edge. Anything to numb the pain.
But people back home cared about you. If they saw you destroying yourself over a tragedy you couldn't control... How do you think they'd feel?
You think some sentimental speech is enough to stop me?
Don't be naive. If you don't kill me here, I might just try to restart the ritual someday.
I told you: pull whatever tricks you want. If you try anything, I'll just take you down again.
She's out of Grace. Can't hold this space together anymore!
Edda! It's not safe there! Get over here!
Stop! You'll get dragged in with her!
Don't just stand there! Edda, come with us!
My, you really are ... hopelessly naive.
Heh... I was going to offer you up as sacrifices, you know.==W== Let me go, and you'll regret it sooner or later...
Your acting's terrible... Who's the naive one now?
Apologies, but I can't let myself get caught yet. Until next time...
Oh... Almost forgot. Still owe you half that reward, Tyrant.
Can't conjure up the Dorra like this, though. So take this advice as payment instead—
You should take care of yourself, for there are plenty who desire you—your body, your soul... All of it.
Rubble falls as the platform gives way.
Her silhouette vanishes into the dark,==RT==leaving only a cryptic warning behind.

I buried myself in work, day and night, trying to forget. Then I found the truth: Nocturn Eterna destroyed the Monolith. They destroyed my home.
My people prided themselves on their strength. So why couldn't they stop Nocturn Eterna? For the longest time, I couldn't understand it...
But now...==W== I see it clearly. It's simple, really.
Norstheim fell for one reason: they were weaker than Nocturn Eterna. That is the only truth.
Then I need power, power so absolute no enemy dares challenge it... With that, I can protect everything.
So I used my rank in the Eye of Grace and accessed archives meant to remain forbidden.
I pieced the clues together... Until I found Them, buried deep in the ruins.
With this power, history will never repeat itself—that one thought drove me to prepare for today.
The final step of the plan... Even if every ritual before this failed, as long as Wraith killed me in the end—
After all, the magic circle on me is my weapon. Destroying it still counts as "disarming" me... Which means the ritual could still...
My wish was supposed to come true...
Why...==W== Why didn't you shoot?! Why!
The battle is done. There is no need for this.
I get it... You're soft. Just like the other warriors. They hesitated before Nocturn Eterna, too. That indecision is why...
You are wrong. You still don't understand.
The strength of Norstheim never came from their weapons.
They survived a harsh land by supporting one another. Their unity was their true power.
<size=50>Sentiments like that ... didn't save Norstheim! Did they?!
I understand your pain. But as I said... Northerners were strong because they stood together.
So what?! What good did it do?!
As long as one of us draws breath, the city lives on. Even if we have to rebuild from a single brick elsewhere...==W== That refusal to yield is Norstheim's soul.
Hahaha! It's not like we'll never meet again. Just come visit during the holidays—this will always be your home!
Then what was it all for...?
You've been blaming yourself this whole time, haven't you? Hating yourself for being too far away to stop the disaster.
That's why you pushed yourself to the edge. Anything to numb the pain.
But people back home cared about you. If they saw you destroying yourself over a tragedy you couldn't control... How do you think they'd feel?
You think some sentimental speech is enough to stop me?
Don't be naive. If you don't kill me here, I might just try to restart the ritual someday.
I told you: pull whatever tricks you want. If you try anything, I'll just take you down again.
She's out of Grace. Can't hold this space together anymore!
Edda! It's not safe there! Get over here!
Stop! You'll get dragged in with her!
Don't just stand there! Edda, come with us!
My, you really are ... hopelessly naive.
Heh... I was going to offer you up as sacrifices, you know.==W== Let me go, and you'll regret it sooner or later...
Your acting's terrible... Who's the naive one now?
Apologies, but I can't let myself get caught yet. Until next time...
Oh... Almost forgot. Still owe you half that reward, Tyrant.
Can't conjure up the Dorra like this, though. So take this advice as payment instead—
You should take care of yourself, for there are plenty who desire you—your body, your soul... All of it.
Rubble falls as the platform gives way.
Her silhouette vanishes into the dark,==RT==leaving only a cryptic warning behind.

strings.text: With the investigation finally wrapped up, you and Wraith wake everyone and return to Emor with the New Star Guild... It seems the "Archon" incident didn't go unnoticed after all.
How's everyone holding up? Any discomfort?
Thanks to you, ==PLAYER_NAME==, I've pretty much recovered.
Felt a bit drained when I first woke up, but otherwise, I'm good.
Thank goodness... No lasting side effects.
Haven't seen her around since we got back.
She headed out a while ago. Said she was hunting for some decent "trophies."
Gulp...==W== Haa... Good. It didn't freeze.
Wraith? What are you doing out here?
Whoa... Oof! Where'd you get this? And it's blackberry flavor...
Don't sweat the details. Come on, cheers!
Hold on! Edda's still missing. We shouldn't be standing around drinking!
That's exactly why we drink. Dwelling on it will just drag you down.
I'm back home, I've made new friends, and we solved a crisis to boot. Isn't that enough reason for a toast?
One good news after another. I'd throw a whole banquet if I could.
Is this the Norstheim way, too?
Yes.==RT==Eat well, hunt well, study well, sleep well.
Disaster strikes when you least expect it, catching you off guard... So you have to live in the moment. Enjoy it while you can. Live with no regrets.
Enjoy it while you can, and live with no regrets... I get it. Guess I can't say no to a toast, then.
To new friends and the<r=Norstheim> Northern </r>City. Cheers.
Wraith raises her glass toward the Monolith, offering a silent salute.
You know, something's been bugging me.==RT==I know I used that fake intel on Nocturn Eterna to expose her...
But why'd you play along? You know Nocturn Eterna well, ==PLAYER_NAME==. Didn't strike you that I might be bluffing?
Relax. I booked a backup carriage before we even left the city.
If things go to plan, it arrives tomorrow to pick us up.
Her story had holes from the start.
Think about it. She's meticulous. Someone that prepared doesn't just ... slip up like that.
Maybe deep down, she actually wanted someone to stop her? ... Maybe I'm overthinking it.
Look at it the other way: if Edda was truly committed to playing the victim, she wouldn't have bought your intel so fast.
I see. Makes sense...==W== Anyway, ==PLAYER_NAME==, take this.
For me? Isn't this your treasure? You literally pointed at it earlier and called it your "clan's honor."
It is. Proof of my clan's honor, no doubt.
But when Edda's magic hit... I wouldn't be standing here right now if you hadn't had my back.
Had your back...? I was running for my life!
Besides, without you, we wouldn't have stood a chance. I'd have been dead meat either way.
You looked pretty sharp running away, you know.
Why do you make it sound like you were watching a show?!
I didn't just "sound" like it. I saw it. That hall was ... magical.
Heh. You've got guts. I like that. Here, take this badge.
It's a mark of the Norstheim warriors. Represents a bond that goes beyond life and death.
My grandfather gave it to me. Said I'd eventually find a partner worthy of holding it.
Anyway, that's the story. Do you want it or not?
Sigh... Well, since you put it like that...==W== I'll take it. Thanks.
Oh, almost forgot a tiny detail...==W== Accepting this==W== makes you the giver's family.
Heh. You are a part of Norstheim now.==RT==Let's look out for each other from now on.
Scared you?==W== Heh, were you perhaps hoping for a different kind of meaning?==W== But if that's actually what you want,==W== I'm certainly open to it.
Sigh... Quit teasing me.==W== Regardless,==W== I promise to keep this safe.
Good. That sets my mind at ease.==RT==Alright, now that business is handled, let's head back.
Welcome home! Please, have some canned food.
Ooh,==W== another canned food party? Perfect timing. I need to catch up on the new flavors...==W== Which one should I pick?
I personally recommend the luncheon meat paired with a salad. A balanced diet is essential.
I'll follow your lead, then.==W== Oh, pass the dressing, please.
<size=120%>Wait.</size>==W== Noya?! Iris and Amber, too?! What are you all doing here?
We're here to pick you up, obviously! We fixed up Loxy and drove a==W== loooong==W== way==W== here, just to reach you, Boss.
I'm not talking about the distance!==W== How did you even know where to look?
Heheh. You have the cute and charming Bastelina to thank for the intel!
Miss Wraith, I burned through my brand-new annual leave for this! You owe me big time!
Even Bastelina is here...==W== What actually is going on?
Before we departed, I gave Bastelina our itinerary. I instructed her to find us if anything went wrong.
By the way, the other three investigators already took a carriage back.
I have so many questions for you, Boss, but first...
This is Wraith. The commission got dangerous, and she saved my life more than once...==W== I wouldn't be here without her.
Greetings, I am Wraith. Rest assured, I stayed with Boss for the entire mission.==W== I even kept ==SEX4== company while ==SEX== slept.
Okay, technically true...==W== But do you have to phrase it like that?! You're making it sound weird!
Listen...==W== We just slept in the same room, not in the same bed—!
Oh!==W== So you slept together? That's also what we did back home!
Huh? Well, I guess when you put it that way...==W== Wait…
Uh...==W== Bastelina, hold on. I think you're getting the wrong idea.
Wow. You really can't judge a book by its cover. The Boss works fast.
Get your mind out of the gutter!
Regardless! Thank you for taking such good care of Boss all this time!
Aren't you two going to back me up?! No, wait, technically she's right...==W== Ugh, I can't win!
Seems like it'll be a fun night.
Wraith—! This is your fault! Even though I know you didn't mean it...
Alright.==W== Grace is refilled. Let's head back.
Bags packed and ready, we finally depart==RT==from the<r=Norstheim> Northern </r>City.
And that covers the entire incident report.
Good work. I'll sort through the files shortly.
<color=#bd3059>Archons descending and influencing other Monoliths</color>...==W== Is that truly possible?
We lack sufficient proof. But either way, the Archons are a threat we cannot ignore.
Your intel is valuable. We'll classify this as an official business trip.
You mean ... my annual leave is safe?==W== Thanks for understanding! I'll get right back to monitoring the Boss's team.
Chariot and Ghost... Two Archons are showing signs of awakening. We can't ignore this any longer.
We need to establish a dedicated crisis response unit. As for the candidates...
Simply put: Nocturn Eterna is what destroyed your hometown.
Join the Sentinel of Dawn. You need our intel, and we need your strength. I'd say that's a fair trade.
An elderly gentleman insisted I pass this letter to you, no matter what.
He told me: Norstheim is rebuilding. Don't worry about home. Just do what your heart desires.
You should take care of yourself, for there are plenty who desire you—your body, your soul... All of it.
Looks like...==W== There's one more thing to investigate.
Oh no... I think I'm lost...
Hello?==W== Is anyone out there?! Anyone?!
The buildings here are so run-down ... and dark ... and—==W==achoo! Freezing!
Ugh... Is the Tyrant really somewhere like this?
I still have some allowance from Lady Aeloria...==W== One hot drink to warm myself up shouldn't hurt, right?
Huh? I put money in, but where's my drink?!
Oh, right! The book said a kick at a forty-five-degree angle fixes these things!==W== But if I break it, Lady Aeloria's gonna be angry again...
Sigh... Forget it. I'm going ho—==W==<size=50>whoa!
Oww...==W== Who left this junk right here?! I'm not in the best mood right now! Watch it, or I'll...
Huh? I thought it was just trash... It's actually a person?==W== Hello? Are you alive?
Eh? Tyrant? You know the Tyrant?==W== Hey! Don't pass out again!
Wake up! It's super dangerous to sleep out here!

strings.text: The mail-stealing monsters are running rampant near Port Bellin. You and the New Star Guild have accepted a commission from Post Haste to tackle the backlog of deliveries.
We've always entrusted our feelings to the written word.==RT==And today, another letter starts its journey to someone special.
Slip this inside... There. Now... How do I actually get it delivered?
That envelope holds far more than paper—==RT==it carries the sender's heart and soul.
Whose letter is this? Lying here all crumpled up...
Spanning distance and time...==W== No matter the era, letters have always had the power to connect us.
The paper may fade, but the feelings inked upon it remain as vivid as ever.
And so, today, a girl sets out to—
Right. We'll be sorting mail and packages, too. We're heading over to help Post Haste.
Hehe! Talk about luck! A job falling right into our laps! We've got ==PLAYER_NAME== to thank for this.
Freesia's the client, actually. I just passed the message along. Didn't really do much.
No, no! It's all thanks to the Boss's connections! Without this gig, we'd be... Ugh, I don't even want to think about it!
Do we really have less than a hundred Dorra to our name?
Stop rubbing salt in the wound! Aaaah... If we don't get paid soon, we'll be starving on the streets...==W== No! I won't let it happen!
That's the spirit! Starving isn't really my style either. Let's give this job everything we've got!
If only Dorra grew on trees...
Welcome to Post Haste, New Star Guild!
I'm Donna. I lead the crew... Well, more or less! No need for formalities. Just call me Donna!
Heheh, so you're the famous ==PLAYER_NAME==? Freesia and Teresa told me all about you. They say you're brilliant and totally dependable!
Of course. Boss is wise and trustworthy.
Boss knows everything! Leave it to ==SEX4==, and this mess will be fixed in a flash, too!
Okay, not a mess… But we hit a snag...==W== A pretty big one.
It started last week. I was out on a delivery run...
Good pace! Keep this up, and I should be able to finish my rounds and get back to Port Bellin by sundown.
Go me! Another full power day!==W== Hm? What's that?
Sun's bleached the envelope white. Faded. The address is a blur, too... Huh? Something hard's inside...
You sure you dropped it here?
Of course! I inherited my Ma's memory. Trust me!
If that were true, we wouldn't have lost it! We're here for the treasure, not to clean up your mess...
Seen an old letter around here? It has something hard inside.
We're pro treasu—uh, letter ... hunters! Yeah. Just kind-hearted Trekkers delivering mail.
Sketchy...==W== I'd know them if they were in the biz.
For real?! Ugh... Fine. Forget it!
You moron. "Ma's memory," my ass! What if that envelope had the loot?
They were definitely thieves...! Guess Post Haste will hold onto this for safekeeping.
It's ancient! Looks like it's gonna disintegrate if I so much as breathe on it.
The only other legible part is the surname Howard.
As you can see, the sender's details are too damaged to read. We cannot even return it to its source.
Someone might still be waiting for this. We really want to get it to them if we can just figure out who they are.
I see... The mission isn't delivery. It's about tracking down the recipient.
Hold on. That doesn't add up.
Post Haste processes tons of mail daily. Illegible addresses can't be rare... Why hire us specifically for this one?
I have to ask. Is there something else going on? Something besides the letter?
And here I thought this was just a happy "Let's find the recipient!" adventure. Guess not?
To be honest, we get letters with unknown recipients all the time. Usually, the three of us can handle it no problem...
However, a letter-snatching monster has recently surfaced in Port Bellin.
Yeah. None of the passing Trekkers dares to take delivery jobs anymore.
The outcome is unfortunate. Trekkers used to help with deliveries on their way, but they are too terrified of the monster to do that now. All the rejected letters are piling up at our doorstep...
I get it. A delivery run means risking a monster fight, but monster hunting costs way more than a standard delivery fee.
Normally I'd never say no to more business! But there's no way just the three of us can manage this backlog...
Living expenses, guild funds, equipment upgrades... We have to seize this chance to earn as much as possible before the well runs dry!
Alright, two things on the agenda. First, check out that mystery letter. Second, help clear the backlog from the monster panic.
Got the picture. Now...==W== How about we split up to cover more ground?
Good call. We'll get way more done if we split up.
Here's the plan: three teams. Sorting, delivery, and tracking down that recipient.
Iris, Teresa—think you can handle the deliveries?
Finally, Amber and I will hunt down our mystery recipient!
As for you, ==PLAYER_NAME== ... feel free to jump in wherever you want!
Where should I lend a hand?
Go ask around about the recipient.
Help Freesia and Noya sort letters
Assist Teresa and Iris with deliveries
I'll join the search team. More people asking around means better intel.
I'll help sort. If we clear the pile now, we'll have more hands for deliveries later.
That is a huge help. We will retrieve the stored letters immediately.
I'm on delivery duty. Best to get these overdue commissions cleared out ASAP.
Yay! Road trip with Boss! Follow me!

Alright, two things on the agenda. First, check out that mystery letter. Second, help clear the backlog from the monster panic.
Got the picture. Now...==W== How about we split up to cover more ground?
Good call. We'll get way more done if we split up.
Here's the plan: three teams. Sorting, delivery, and tracking down that recipient.
Iris, Teresa—think you can handle the deliveries?
Finally, Amber and I will hunt down our mystery recipient!
As for you, ==PLAYER_NAME== ... feel free to jump in wherever you want!
Where should I lend a hand?
Go ask around about the recipient.
Help Freesia and Noya sort letters
Assist Teresa and Iris with deliveries
Where should I lend a hand?
I'll join the search team. More people asking around means better intel.
I'll help sort. If we clear the pile now, we'll have more hands for deliveries later.
That is a huge help. We will retrieve the stored letters immediately.
I'm on delivery duty. Best to get these overdue commissions cleared out ASAP.
Yay! Road trip with Boss! Follow me!

strings.text: You and Donna set out to track down the recipient and hear the story of how Post Haste was first formed. Thanks to Donna's strong social skills, you're able to learn more about the recipient.
We scour the city for the "Howard" mentioned on the envelope, but...
We've been at this for ages with nothing to show for it. Maybe we need a different angle.
Oh right, it's lunch time! Let's grab a bite nearby!
Don't be shy—it's on me today!
This is one packed sandwich.==W== Delicious.
Wait, Donna, are you sure you're paying?!
That's fine.==W== Don't worry, my wallet's got a little extra padding this month.
Besides, I've been dying to see what kind of Boss has Freesia and Teresa so head over heels!
Hahaha! Sorry, sorry! Slight exaggeration on my part.==W== Here, have some water.
Thanks.==W== Whew. You really caught me off guard.
But seriously, they trust you so much. That's why I wanted to know what you were really like.
Now that we've actually met and work together, I get it. You're definitely someone they can count on, Boss.
We haven't known each other long. What makes you so certain?
It's how you handle your work. And you're sincere, you give helpful advice... I can tell you put your heart into everything you do.
Also, you have this calming presence. You're just so ... dependable? It makes people want to be around you—to rely on you.
Mhm. Precise, Donna. I do feel safe when Boss is around.
Hehe! I am the leader of Post Haste, after all!
I don't think I'm doing anything special...==W== It just feels normal to me.
Honestly? I'm kind of jealous... Guess I really need to step up my game—
I don't think you have anything to worry about. Freesia and Teresa are proud of you. They're always singing your praises to me.
Praises? Me?==W== Wait, what exactly did they say...?
Aside from deliveries, they mentioned how you'd manage finances, map out new routes...==W== Basically, that you're a reliable and capable partner.
They also said that no matter how crazy things get, seeing your smile always lifts their spirits.
Ah... Yeah. I've upset them by doing that before. Can't deny it. ==W==So ... that's what they think of me, huh?
Has it always been just the three of you running Post Haste?
Yeah. But I was working as a Courier Trekker long before the business existed.
You were doing this alone? What made you decide to become a courier in the first place?
Reality. Courier commissions pay next to nothing...
That's how most Trekkers see it.
Climb the Monolith, wish for Artifacts, cash out.==RT==It's simple math—that's where the real money is.
Which is exactly why the Trekker Association used to have mountains of letters==RT==piling up that nobody wanted to touch.
But ... once you've witnessed the power a letter brings, you realize what a tragedy it is when messages are not delivered.
Mhm. That's why I chose this life. I wanted to deliver as many of those life-saving letters as I possibly could!
Though, getting to this point was quite the journey...
Hi there! Are you Mr. Pete? Got a letter for you! And a package, too!
Right to my doorstep? Thanks a bunch!
No problem! If you got a letter to send, you know who to find!
I realized folks were thrilled when I delivered other items along with their mail. So I started taking all kinds of requests, and business just took off!
It wasn't a fortune, but I finally started turning a profit.
Morning milk delivery! Leaving it right here for ya!
Thanks, Donna! Could you handle these client letters for us, too?
Slowly but surely, word got around that I was reliable, and the commissions started pouring in.==W==To speed things up, I started hunting for shortcuts and nearly got myself in big trouble!
Weird... I should be out of the woods if I just walked straight. Why does it feel like I'm going in circles...?
It's gonna be dark soon... Starving...==W== Thought this would be a quick trip, so I didn't pack a thing to eat...
I've been watching you walk in circles... Are you lost?
But just in the nick of time, I met Teresa.
We never would've met if I hadn't gotten lost. Guess losing your way isn't always bad luck, huh?
Freesia? I just bumped into her during a delivery...
Saw that giant axe of yours. Betting you're pretty handy in a fight?
Hehe, I'm Donna! We met once at the market—remember?
Mm... I have a vague recollection.==W== Nice to meet you. I am Freesia.
Got any plans for later? If not, I'm heading to Philae. Could I hire you as my bodyguard?
Even after the commission, she looked so weighed down. I couldn't just leave her, so I asked her to tag along. Told her to treat it like a vacation.

And ... that's the story. The three of us found each other, and Post Haste was born. If I were still on my own, I'd probably just be wandering aimlessly somewhere, haha. No way I'd have the life I do now.
Waking up together, grabbing a bite, tackling the day's work side-by-side, then having dinner together at night... What else can I ask for?
Together every day. Share worries, as well as joy.
I love everyone in New Star, too.
That sounds wonderful. I've got to admit, I'm a little jealous.
Boss is also a part of New Star.
I haven't been with the guild for very long, remember?==W== You've built that trust and friendship way before I showed up.
I don't have memories, which means I don't really have a past. So I envy you for that kind of bond, one that's forged over time.
Hang in there. Your bond with everyone is only going to get stronger from here on out, Boss.
As long as you care about each other, those connections aren't going anywhere.
No matter the distance or how much time passes, that feeling keeps people connected... It's like how a letter ties two hearts together, even when they're apart.
See? Didn't this letter bring us closer together, Boss?
I hope we can stay friends for a long time!
Fair point ...==W== Thanks. I needed to hear that.
Don't mention it! Alright then, let's hit the road again!
Hang on, I was thinking... What if the address isn't a home, but a shop the recipient visits often?
Trying to find a private residence in a new city is tough.==W== But a shop? That's much easier to track down.
That's what it's for. If you're handing a letter to a Trekker who doesn't know the area, using a landmark or a store as the drop-off point gives them a way better shot at finding it.
Great idea! Let's ask around the local shops.
Table for three?! Sorry, we're absolutely packed right now! Could you please wait in line?
Wow, look at this place! It's jumping today! Their seafood platter is seriously to die for.
No, no! It's usually not this crazy. It just happens to be busy today!
Sorry to bother you while you're in the weeds like this. But do you happen to know a "Howard"? We've got a letter for him.
Yeah. Dealing with strangers is just second nature to her.
Howard? I know most of our regulars by name...
But that one draws a blank. Sorry.
Howard? Hmm... Rings a bell, but I can't place it.
Been setting up shop here for ages. Never heard of a "Howard."
Blowout sale! Buy two, get one free! Don't miss out!
Looking for Trekker gear? You've come to the right place! Best prices and value in town!
Oh—Howard? Now there's a blast from the past.
The Howards were legendary smiths. I used to stock their gear all the time.
Do you know where to find them now?
Rumor says the heir ran off to be a Trekker. Think his son took over the business?
They might still be at it, just not under the "Howard" name.
That's a helpful clue. Knowing the background narrows the search.
Let's get back to Post Haste and meet everyone!
Going by the intel we've gathered, this has to be Howard's place.
Incredible! You actually tracked down the address?!
Good thing Freesia managed to borrow those files from the archives!
Spotting the info on "Howard" in a mountain of records was all thanks to Noya's sharp eye.
Looks like the equipment shop called "Howard" shut down, and a few years later another one called "Justin" opened… That matches Teresa's map perfectly.
Good thing Iris spotted it, or we would've missed it completely! That map is pretty ancient, after all.
Great work, everyone! It's getting late, though. Let's handle the delivery tomorrow.
You've all worked so hard. Tonight calls for a reward! I whipped up a feast! Dig in and eat as much as you want!
Oof... I'm stuffed... Can't eat another bite...
Now that we're all well fed, we're all fueled up for tomorrow!==W==
Donna? Where's she wandering off to this late...?
Oh! Boss? Did I wake you?
I was still up. Strange... I'm not sleepy at all.
I had so much fun tonight! Maybe I'm too excited to sleep.
Your cooking was incredible.==W== Making all that at once... It must have been exhausting.
Not at all! It felt like my family suddenly got a whole lot bigger. I loved every second of it!==W== I love having everyone together, loud and lively.
Like I said earlier, back at the start, it was just me alone.
On my own, there was no way to finish all the deliveries in one run.
I had to split the routes and take them day by day.
Looking back... I have no idea how I managed.
Just thinking about it gives me a headache...
But then Freesia and Teresa came along, and we started Post Haste. Now there's so much more we can achieve.
Through worries and joys alike, we stand together. I'm so happy these days... It actually scares me a little.
I just...==W== I don't ever want to be alone again.
Ah! Whoops, that sounded kinda weird, huh?==W== I didn't mean anything deep by it! It's just...
Look, the workload keeps piling up! One person definitely can't deliver it all, right?==W== So what I meant was—flying solo isn't an option anymore!==W== Nope, absolutely not!
Anyway! Gotta get up early tomorrow, so I'm off to bed!==W== Nighty-night, Boss!
What was that strange feeling just now...? For a split second, Donna looked like a child on the verge of tears...
Don't ever want to be alone again, huh...

strings.text: You sort through the pile of letters alongside Freesia, hearing the story of how she met Donna. Drawing on her legal knowledge, Freesia searches public records and uncovers the recipient's information.
Hello! Post Haste here for the collection.
I can't thank you enough! Here. These are the outgoing letters and parcels.
Most of these are headed for the sticks. It takes days to deliver for peanuts... Naturally, nobody wants the gig.
But having Post Haste take this load off our backs is a huge relief.
If this is their daily grind...==W== Must be rough for Post Haste.
We just gotta haul them outside, yeah? Heave-ho!
I'll grab this crate...==W== Oof, it's heavy?! Oh no—!
Sorry, Freesia. It's way heavier than it looks. Almost lost my grip...
Please, allow me to handle those.
You lifted those one-handed like it was nothing?!
Leave the heavy lifting to me. Would you be so kind as to attend to the letters?
That mountain of mail is almost gone already...
Is this daily grind the secret to her strength? No, this workload is just insane... Freesia, you have my respect.
Next, we sort. We verify addresses, categorize by region, then bundle neighboring locations together.
Talk about attention to detail. And then you have to hand-deliver every single one? That's incredible!
Deliveries are Post Haste's foundation. Our principle is simple: The letter must reach its destination, no matter what.
It sounds simple, but just imagine the sheer effort required...
Yes. I'm told she's been upholding that standard since her first days as a Courier Trekker. To Donna, the connection between sender and recipient is everything.
In a way, I owe my meeting with Donna to that very conviction.
Eh? So you weren't always with Post Haste?
Correct. I used to be an Advocate.
Advocate!? No way! That is so cool!
It's not as glamorous as you imagine... I was an Advocate in name only. Barely competent.
Family expectations, professional doubts, my own mistakes...==W== The weight of it all just felt like a torrential downpour drowning me.
In the end, I couldn't bear it any longer. So I ran away.
I never expected Freesia to have a past like that...
As I wandered aimlessly... I met Donna.
Phew—and just like that, another letter reaches its recipient safe and sound! Mission accomplished!
Gotta say though, Freesia, you were incredible back there!
If you hadn't stepped in, that boar would've knocked me off the mountain!
It's my duty to help. You did commission me as your bodyguard, after all.
Yeah, but the delivery's done! Technically, your job is finished.
Not until I see you safely back to Port Bellin.==W== The contract stands.
So, after you drop me off at Port Bellin, what's next for you?
Um...==W== I'm not sure. I suppose I'll just see where the road takes me.
... I suppose even I don't really know what my next step should be.
If that's the case...==W== Do you wanna join me as a courier?
After this commission, I'm more convinced. Having a reliable partner is truly amazing! What do you say? Come team up with me!
Actually... I've been curious. Why go to such lengths just to deliver letters? This one was over a decade old. You're not even getting paid for it.
It's not about the money. Some things just have to be done.
People write letters to convey what they can't express in person, yet still wish to convey. If the letters get lost... Then those heartfelt messages never reach the heart they belong to, do they?
That is precisely why I became a courier. The thought that if I try just a little harder, perhaps one more person might be saved by a letter delivered in time...
Saving others... It truly is an important job.
Right? Then starting today, Freesia, we're partners!
Well... The pay isn't exactly great... But if you don't want to go back just yet... You can stay with me! I can cook too! How about it? How about it?
But...==W== Perhaps I have no right to be a courier. After all, I'm the one ignoring the very feelings ... that are trying to reach me.
When I ran away from home, my mother tucked a letter into my bag. I still haven't been able to open it...==W== How can I be a courier, when I can't even face a letter from my own family?
I see...==W== But I think that's all the more reason you should give it a try!
Why? I can't even treat the feelings within these letters with such sincerity like you do...
Actually, I was just as lost as you are when I first started... I even hesitated, too, over whether or not I should open that letter addressed to me.
But I still became who I am today—a courier. Who knows? Maybe you too will change your mind someday, if the right opportunity comes along.
Just think of it as a trial run for a little while... Couriers always travel to many places, encountering all sorts of people and things... Who knows? You might just find your answers along the way.
That encounter was like a sudden gust... A wind named "Donna"==RT==that scattered the dark clouds looming in my heart.
And so, I began traveling with Donna to deliver letters. Later, I met Teresa, our navigator, and slowly came to understand Donna's conviction.
That's so nice! A chance encounter changing the entire course of your life... Sounds so romantic!
So ... what did that letter from your mother actually say?
That letter... To be honest, I still haven't opened it.
But I believe if I keep working here, I'll eventually find an answer of my own. Not one dictated by others or my circumstances, but one chosen by my own heart. An answer belonging to me alone...
So ...==W== until I find it, that letter stays sealed.
That's exactly what makes life so interesting! Just when you think "I'm totally done for," a new path can open up out of nowhere!
True. It was precisely because I endured those difficult times that I was able to meet Donna and Teresa.
Before that, I thought being an Advocate was the only path I could take... So I really am grateful to Donna. She showed me there were other ways to live.
Hold on... Did you say Advocate?
If Freesia has an Advocate license, couldn't we use her access to check the archives for "Howard"?
Oh! So we just look the name up and boom—mystery solved?! As long as we have Freesia with us?
Well... But my license... It is currently...==W== And accessing personal information without a valid reason is prohibited.
But... Let me think... The archives...
Have you finished sorting the mail?
Even without a legal license, there might be other ways.==W== Please, lend me a hand.
Whoa! Freesia, what are all these thick books...?
According to the Nova Continent's public information disclosure act regarding city-state history, I've borrowed the archived registration records—these are documents anyone is permitted to review.
Records of neighborhood transitions and ownership changes... If the Howard family truly lived in Port Bellin, we might find some trace of them here.
I see. Still, this is an incredible amount of paper...
That letter was quite old...==W== So I borrowed the records spanning the last twenty years.
The sheer amount of information... It's enough to make my head spin...
It's actually the same as sorting mail. Just focus on the necessary information and flip through the pages one by one.
All we need to look for right now is the name "Howard." It's simpler than sorting all those letters.
Howard... Howard... Ah!==W== Found it! I found it, but...
The owner of this equipment shop... His name was indeed Howard, but the shop is already closed...
... At the same address, a new equipment shop opened under the name "Justin" a few years later.
Not sure, but I think a field investigation is necessary... If they're in the same trade, the shop that opened later might know something.
Boss is right. Once Donna and the others get back, let's discuss it together.
Going by the intel we've gathered, this has to be Howard's place.
Thanks to everyone, I can now confirm the connection between "Howard" and "Justin."
The Howards were a famous line of artisans. Matches Freesia's research result perfectly.
The reason for his disappearance fits.
And the address matches my map, too! This is definitely the place!
Great work, everyone! It's getting late, though. Let's handle the delivery tomorrow.
You've all worked so hard. Tonight calls for a reward! I whipped up a feast! Dig in and eat as much as you want!
Oof... I'm stuffed... Can't eat another bite...
Now that we're all well fed, we're all fueled up for tomorrow!==W==
Donna? Where's she wandering off to this late...?
Oh! Boss? Did I wake you?
I was still up. Strange... I'm not sleepy at all.
I had so much fun tonight! Maybe I'm too excited to sleep.
Your cooking was incredible.==W== Making all that at once... It must have been exhausting.
Not at all! It felt like my family suddenly got a whole lot bigger. I loved every second of it!==W== I love having everyone together, loud and lively.
Back at the start, it was just me delivering the letters.
On my own, there was no way to finish all the deliveries in one run.
I had to split the routes and take them day by day.
Looking back... I have no idea how I managed.
Just thinking about it gives me a headache...
But then Freesia and Teresa came along, and we started Post Haste. Now there's so much more we can achieve.
Through worries and joys alike, we stand together. I'm so happy these days... It actually scares me a little.
I just...==W== I don't ever want to be alone again.
Ah! Whoops, that sounded kinda weird, huh?==W== I didn't mean anything deep by it! It's just...
Look, the workload keeps piling up! One person definitely can't deliver it all, right?==W== So what I meant was—flying solo isn't an option anymore!==W== Nope, absolutely not!
Anyway! Gotta get up early tomorrow, so I'm off to bed!==W== Nighty-night, Boss!
What was that strange feeling just now...? For a split second, Donna looked like a child on the verge of tears...
Don't ever want to be alone again, huh...

param: You sort through the pile of letters alongside Freesia, hearing the story of how she met Donna. Drawing on her legal knowledge, Freesia searches public records and uncovers the recipient's information.
Hello! Post Haste here for the collection.
I can't thank you enough! Here. These are the outgoing letters and parcels.
Most of these are headed for the sticks. It takes days to deliver for peanuts... Naturally, nobody wants the gig.
But having Post Haste take this load off our backs is a huge relief.
If this is their daily grind...==W== Must be rough for Post Haste.
We just gotta haul them outside, yeah? Heave-ho!
I'll grab this crate...==W== Oof, it's heavy?! Oh no—!
Sorry, Freesia. It's way heavier than it looks. Almost lost my grip...
Please, allow me to handle those.
You lifted those one-handed like it was nothing?!
Leave the heavy lifting to me. Would you be so kind as to attend to the letters?
That mountain of mail is almost gone already...
Is this daily grind the secret to her strength? No, this workload is just insane... Freesia, you have my respect.
Next, we sort. We verify addresses, categorize by region, then bundle neighboring locations together.
Talk about attention to detail. And then you have to hand-deliver every single one? That's incredible!
Deliveries are Post Haste's foundation. Our principle is simple: The letter must reach its destination, no matter what.
It sounds simple, but just imagine the sheer effort required...
Yes. I'm told she's been upholding that standard since her first days as a Courier Trekker. To Donna, the connection between sender and recipient is everything.
In a way, I owe my meeting with Donna to that very conviction.
Eh? So you weren't always with Post Haste?
Correct. I used to be an Advocate.
Advocate!? No way! That is so cool!
It's not as glamorous as you imagine... I was an Advocate in name only. Barely competent.
Family expectations, professional doubts, my own mistakes...==W== The weight of it all just felt like a torrential downpour drowning me.
In the end, I couldn't bear it any longer. So I ran away.
I never expected Freesia to have a past like that...
As I wandered aimlessly... I met Donna.
Phew—and just like that, another letter reaches its recipient safe and sound! Mission accomplished!
Gotta say though, Freesia, you were incredible back there!
If you hadn't stepped in, that boar would've knocked me off the mountain!
It's my duty to help. You did commission me as your bodyguard, after all.
Yeah, but the delivery's done! Technically, your job is finished.
Not until I see you safely back to Port Bellin.==W== The contract stands.
So, after you drop me off at Port Bellin, what's next for you?
Um...==W== I'm not sure. I suppose I'll just see where the road takes me.
... I suppose even I don't really know what my next step should be.
If that's the case...==W== Do you wanna join me as a courier?
After this commission, I'm more convinced. Having a reliable partner is truly amazing! What do you say? Come team up with me!
Actually... I've been curious. Why go to such lengths just to deliver letters? This one was over a decade old. You're not even getting paid for it.
It's not about the money. Some things just have to be done.
People write letters to convey what they can't express in person, yet still wish to convey. If the letters get lost... Then those heartfelt messages never reach the heart they belong to, do they?
That is precisely why I became a courier. The thought that if I try just a little harder, perhaps one more person might be saved by a letter delivered in time...
Saving others... It truly is an important job.
Right? Then starting today, Freesia, we're partners!
Well... The pay isn't exactly great... But if you don't want to go back just yet... You can stay with me! I can cook too! How about it? How about it?
But...==W== Perhaps I have no right to be a courier. After all, I'm the one ignoring the very feelings ... that are trying to reach me.
When I ran away from home, my mother tucked a letter into my bag. I still haven't been able to open it...==W== How can I be a courier, when I can't even face a letter from my own family?
I see...==W== But I think that's all the more reason you should give it a try!
Why? I can't even treat the feelings within these letters with such sincerity like you do...
Actually, I was just as lost as you are when I first started... I even hesitated, too, over whether or not I should open that letter addressed to me.
But I still became who I am today—a courier. Who knows? Maybe you too will change your mind someday, if the right opportunity comes along.
Just think of it as a trial run for a little while... Couriers always travel to many places, encountering all sorts of people and things... Who knows? You might just find your answers along the way.
That encounter was like a sudden gust... A wind named "Donna"==RT==that scattered the dark clouds looming in my heart.
And so, I began traveling with Donna to deliver letters. Later, I met Teresa, our navigator, and slowly came to understand Donna's conviction.
That's so nice! A chance encounter changing the entire course of your life... Sounds so romantic!
So ... what did that letter from your mother actually say?
That letter... To be honest, I still haven't opened it.
But I believe if I keep working here, I'll eventually find an answer of my own. Not one dictated by others or my circumstances, but one chosen by my own heart. An answer belonging to me alone...
So ...==W== until I find it, that letter stays sealed.
That's exactly what makes life so interesting! Just when you think "I'm totally done for," a new path can open up out of nowhere!
True. It was precisely because I endured those difficult times that I was able to meet Donna and Teresa.
Before that, I thought being an Advocate was the only path I could take... So I really am grateful to Donna. She showed me there were other ways to live.
Hold on... Did you say Advocate?
If Freesia has an Advocate license, couldn't we use her access to check the archives for "Howard"?
Oh! So we just look the name up and boom—mystery solved?! As long as we have Freesia with us?
Well... But my license... It is currently...==W== And accessing personal information without a valid reason is prohibited.
But... Let me think... The archives...
Have you finished sorting the mail?
Even without a legal license, there might be other ways.==W== Please, lend me a hand.
Whoa! Freesia, what are all these thick books...?
According to the Nova Continent's public information disclosure act regarding city-state history, I've borrowed the archived registration records—these are documents anyone is permitted to review.
Records of neighborhood transitions and ownership changes... If the Howard family truly lived in Port Bellin, we might find some trace of them here.
I see. Still, this is an incredible amount of paper...
That letter was quite old...==W== So I borrowed the records spanning the last twenty years.
The sheer amount of information... It's enough to make my head spin...
It's actually the same as sorting mail. Just focus on the necessary information and flip through the pages one by one.
All we need to look for right now is the name "Howard." It's simpler than sorting all those letters.
Howard... Howard... Ah!==W== Found it! I found it, but...
The owner of this equipment shop... His name was indeed Howard, but the shop is already closed...
... At the same address, a new equipment shop opened under the name "Justin" a few years later.
Not sure, but I think a field investigation is necessary... If they're in the same trade, the shop that opened later might know something.
Boss is right. Once Donna and the others get back, let's discuss it together.
Going by the intel we've gathered, this has to be Howard's place.
Thanks to everyone, I can now confirm the connection between "Howard" and "Justin."
The Howards were a famous line of artisans. Matches Freesia's research result perfectly.
The reason for his disappearance fits.
And the address matches my map, too! This is definitely the place!
Great work, everyone! It's getting late, though. Let's handle the delivery tomorrow.
You've all worked so hard. Tonight calls for a reward! I whipped up a feast! Dig in and eat as much as you want!
Oof... I'm stuffed... Can't eat another bite...
Now that we're all well fed, we're all fueled up for tomorrow!==W==
Donna? Where's she wandering off to this late...?
Oh! Boss? Did I wake you?
I was still up. Strange... I'm not sleepy at all.
I had so much fun tonight! Maybe I'm too excited to sleep.
Your cooking was incredible.==W== Making all that at once... It must have been exhausting.
Not at all! It felt like my family suddenly got a whole lot bigger. I loved every second of it!==W== I love having everyone together, loud and lively.
Back at the start, it was just me delivering the letters.
On my own, there was no way to finish all the deliveries in one run.
I had to split the routes and take them day by day.
Looking back... I have no idea how I managed.
Just thinking about it gives me a headache...
But then Freesia and Teresa came along, and we started Post Haste. Now there's so much more we can achieve.
Through worries and joys alike, we stand together. I'm so happy these days... It actually scares me a little.
I just...==W== I don't ever want to be alone again.
Ah! Whoops, that sounded kinda weird, huh?==W== I didn't mean anything deep by it! It's just...
Look, the workload keeps piling up! One person definitely can't deliver it all, right?==W== So what I meant was—flying solo isn't an option anymore!==W== Nope, absolutely not!
Anyway! Gotta get up early tomorrow, so I'm off to bed!==W== Nighty-night, Boss!
What was that strange feeling just now...? For a split second, Donna looked like a child on the verge of tears...
I just...==W== I don't ever want to be alone again.
Don't ever want to be alone again, huh...

strings.text: You deliver mail with Teresa and hear the story of her encounter with Donna. Teresa drew numerous maps, and within the old ones, you uncover the recipient's information.
Listen up, everyone! Today's mission is all about deliveries!==B====W== Check your cargo before we roll out. Leaving a package behind would be a disaster!
Understood. Show me the ropes, Teresa!==W== Let's see...==W== Quite a few long-distance drops today. Prep work is definitely key.
You bet! Like that one time I rushed out the door and totally forgot my wallet...==B====W== I couldn't even buy lunch. I almost starved to death, meow!
Letters...==W== Map...==W== Lunchbox...==W== Got 'em all!==B====W== Huh? What was supposed to go in this box again...?==W==
<size=30>Um... Boss... Teresa is a professional <color=#3faeae>courier</color>, right?==W== I have to be honest, I'm starting to panic a little...</size>
She might be a bit scatterbrained, but she really is a top-notch courier.==W== Just follow her lead.
Meow-aaah! Montana's house is on today's list! We gotta get this to her, fast!
Boss, Iris! We're gonna have to take a shortcut!==W==<size=55> Follow me!</size>
Wait, Teresa?! Don't just leave us in the dust!
Call this a "shortcut"? It's not even a game trail!==B====W== Where's the fire? Why the rush?
T-Teresa! I know we're in a hurry...==W== Huff... But couldn't you pick ...==W== a path with actual footing?!
It's way faster this way! Trust me! Keep up!
Iris, stay close to her!==W== If we get separated, we're in real danger of getting stranded out here!
Ms. Montana! Post Haste delivery! Letters and medicine, safe and sound, meow!
Oh... That was quick!==W== I can't thank you enough!
We'd just run out... Her symptoms came back last night. I was worried sick...==W== Thank you... You're a lifesaver.
Mission accomplished! That's the Post Haste guarantee!==W== Anytime you're in a pinch, just leave it to us!
I see... It was a package for a sick child.
It was definitely an emergency. Still, a little heads-up would've been nice...
Sorry! Medical deliveries are huge emergencies! I remembered that and my brain just ... went into overdrive.
I actually met the girl on a delivery run a while back.==W== She's such a sweet kid, always looking out for her family!
Thinking about her being in pain... I panicked.
I understand.==W== Well, at least we made it in time.
Hehe. Thanks for keeping up with me, you two.
We're fine. But we've still got deliveries to make. Let's not fall behind.
Boss...!==W== You're right!==W== Let's knock out the rest of these orders!
So you took that shortcut==W== because you knew how urgent the package was.
Bingo!==W== But ... that's not the only reason!==W==
Oh? Do you take "shortcuts" like that often?
Blazing a new trail is an adventure all on its own!
You never know what surprises await on a new route!==B====W== Exotic flowers,==W== unknown birds fluttering by...==W== You might even stumble on a hermit's hideout and make a new friend!==W==
The further you go, the more you find!==W== Isn't that exciting?
Wandering into the unknown... Sounds risky. Aren't you scared?
No sweat! If trouble shows up, I'll just whip out Gram and handle it!
Plus, blazing a trail helps everyone. Enough footsteps turn a rough path into a real road! Then people can travel even further!
And more travelers means more people to carry letters, right? See? Forging new paths solves everything at once!
I suppose I misunderstood your intentions, Teresa.==W== You truly are an exceptional courier!
Hehe, yay! I got praised!==W== Thanks! You're doing a great job today too, Iris! Top-tier courier work!
Come to think of it...==W== I think I first met Donna==W== in a forest just like this...
Mmm—nothing beats a nap up in a tree!==W== All charged up! Time to head out...==W== Huh? Do I hear someone?
This is bad. I think I'm actually lost...==W== What am I gonna do when it gets darker?==W== They say monsters lurk around here...
Why didn't I bring a weapon today of all days...==W== Ugh...==W== So reckless... Am I being dumb?
... Huh?==W== You're not a monster...==W== Who are you?
Name's Teresa!==W== Let me guess... You got lost?
Hi... I'm Donna. I tried to take a shortcut, but got completely turned around the second I stepped into the woods...==W== Embarrassing, but yeah ... definitely lost.
No biggie!==W== Just follow me, I'll get you out!
We made it out...!==W== Thank you! You really saved my hide back there.
I run deliveries through here all the time. It's basically my backyard! Hehe!
Deliveries...?==W==<size=50> Wait, you work as a "courier" too?</size>
Me too!==W== I'm working as a<color=#3faeae> Courier Trekker</color> myself!
Actually, I was out scouting a new postal route. Wanted to chart a path people don't usually take...==W== But, well, got myself lost.
Right! If the main roads get blocked or damaged, the packages stop moving...==B====W== I figured having more options would make the whole system more reliable...
That's amazing! So cool! I can't believe I found someone who thinks just like me!
Whoaaaa?!==W== Are these ... maps?==W== Did you draw this whole stack yourself?!
If I link up all the possible routes on these... Maybe we can reach even more people!
Teresa! You have to team up with me!
With your help... My dream of connecting all of Nova might actually happen!
You got it! Count me in!
<size=50>That's all it takes to convince you?!</size>
And that's the story of how I met Donna! Meow!
What are the odds!==W== You stop to help a lost stranger, and it turns out you share the exact same dream.
Fate really brought you two together.
Caught me off guard too!==W== Freesia was already there when I joined. That's how the three of us started Post Haste!
Our dream at Post Haste is simple: help as many people as we can through our deliveries. So while we're out delivering, we're also charting postal routes across the entire continent!
Mapping all of Nova... That's a massive undertaking.
Teresa, you keep those maps in your bag, don't you? May I take a look?
Incredible... The detail here rivals the Chronicles of Nova...==B====W== And look at these shortcuts and backroads... Your map might actually be better than the official ones!
Whoa... How many pages are in here? Have you walked halfway across the continent already?!

Nowhere near close...==W== Hehe, but I did walk all the way from Port Bellin to the City of a Thousand Monoliths on my own two feet!==W== I made sure to mark down pretty much every house and shop along the way!
Hey, is there any chance you marked a house labeled "Howard" somewhere in here?
I've already combed through the maps I'm using... No luck, unfortunately.
Right, checking the map is the first thing anyone would do—==B==wait.==W== No...
The map you're "using"...? Does that mean there are maps you no longer use?
Yup!==W== Roads get wrecked and shops change all the time. I have to keep my maps updated so I don't get lost on a delivery!
Hold on. In that case, maybe we should be looking at your older maps...==W==
Exactly. A "Howard's House" might have existed back then!
Oh!! You're right, meow!==W== How did I miss that...? Hang on, lemme check—
This one,==W== and this one...==W== And check this one too!
Pardon me, let me help you look...==B====W== Howard... Howard...
Found it!==W== It's on the map—look, right here!
Whoa, it actually says "Mr. Howard's House" right there...!==W== We used to walk right past it... I totally forgot, meow...
Thanks to you two, it's all coming back to me, meow!==W== I've gotta tell Donna the second we get back!
Going by the intel we've gathered, this has to be Howard's place.
If the map's right, it's gotta be somewhere around here...
It matches the area from the archives.
A famous family with multi-generational history...
Then it looks like it's the Howard family we're looking for.
Great work, everyone! It's getting late, though. Let's handle the delivery tomorrow.
You've all worked so hard. Tonight calls for a reward! I whipped up a feast! Dig in and eat as much as you want!
Oof... I'm stuffed... Can't eat another bite...
Now that we're all well fed, we're all fueled up for tomorrow!==W==
Donna? Where's she wandering off to this late...?
Oh! Boss? Did I wake you?
I was still up. Strange... I'm not sleepy at all.
I had so much fun tonight! Maybe I'm too excited to sleep.
Your cooking was incredible.==W== Making all that at once... It must have been exhausting.
Not at all! It felt like my family suddenly got a whole lot bigger. I loved every second of it!==W== I love having everyone together, loud and lively.
Back at the start, it was just me delivering the letters.
On my own, there was no way to finish all the deliveries in one run.
I had to split the routes and take them day by day.
Looking back... I have no idea how I managed.
Just thinking about it gives me a headache...
But then Freesia and Teresa came along, and we started Post Haste. Now there's so much more we can achieve.
Through worries and joys alike, we stand together. I'm so happy these days... It actually scares me a little.
I just...==W== I don't ever want to be alone again.
Ah! Whoops, that sounded kinda weird, huh?==W== I didn't mean anything deep by it! It's just...
Look, the workload keeps piling up! One person definitely can't deliver it all, right?==W== So what I meant was—flying solo isn't an option anymore!==W== Nope, absolutely not!
Anyway! Gotta get up early tomorrow, so I'm off to bed!==W== Nighty-night, Boss!
What was that strange feeling just now...? For a split second, Donna looked like a child on the verge of tears...
Don't ever want to be alone again, huh...

Look, the workload keeps piling up! One person definitely can't deliver it all, right?==W== So what I meant was—flying solo isn't an option anymore!==W== Nope, absolutely not!
Anyway! Gotta get up early tomorrow, so I'm off to bed!==W== Nighty-night, Boss!
What was that strange feeling just now...? For a split second, Donna looked like a child on the verge of tears...
I just...==W== I don't ever want to be alone again.
Don't ever want to be alone again, huh...

strings.text: You arrive at Howard's house. He accepts the letter, but is clearly holding back something. Just as the job seems finished, Teresa—watching from the shadows—reports that the letter has gone missing...
Look at the size of this house! My gut says this is definitely the spot.
This building looks ancient... It's been standing for a long time.==W== Is that right, Freesia?
Correct. The address has remained the same over the years. Donna mentioned that a family of artisans has resided here for generations.
My research matches Teresa's map perfectly. This is the place.
Donna... Is something on her mind?
Oh, Teresa! Remember that little favor I asked you for earlier? It's just a hunch, but better safe than sorry!
Got it, Meow. When you get a hunch, you're usually spot on!
Huh? What exactly did you send Teresa to do?
Heheh, that's a trade secret.==W== Time to switch into business mode.==W== Whew... Deep breath...
Who's there? What's all the racket outside my door...
Eh, what's going on? What's with the crowd?==W== I'm not running a show here. You've got the wrong house.
Apologies for the intrusion! We're from Post Haste!
We're here to deliver a letter...==W== Is Mr. Howard in?
... Howard? Never heard of him.==W== You've got the wrong place. Please leave.
With all due respect... The address is correct.==W== I checked the archives myself. This residence is listed under Mr. Howard.
Look, I'm telling you, you've got it wrong! Leave!
She jammed her foot in the door...? Tension's spiking.
I don't know the story behind this letter...==W== But I know it's crossed years and miles to get to this doorstep.
Out in the Wilds, things get lost, stolen ... or deliveries just get abandoned. It happens. But thanks to the wandering Trekkers...
Even though the journey is deadly, brave souls risk everything to make sure messages like this get through...
At Post Haste, we carry that same pride. We see this duty through, no matter what—==W==and this letter represents that promise.
It's someone's heartfelt message, entrusted to us. That makes it precious. But if Mr. Howard isn't in, we can come back tomorrow.==W== We won't give up that easily. Sorry for the trouble!
Sorry. It's me. Justin Howard. Since I'm the owner and the only living here, I guess I'm who you're looking for.
In that case, Mr. Howard, we have a letter for you. Please sign right here.
It's finally here ... after all this time...==W== Sigh. Whatever. It doesn't matter now.
That was ... kind of different from what I expected...
Huh? How did you think it was gonna go, Iris?
If I waited that long for a response...==W== Surely I'd be happier to finally hold it in my hands.
Everyone has their own story! You never know how a recipient might react.==W== Anyway, job done! Let's head back to Post Haste!
Where's Teresa? She isn't back yet.
She's tying up a few loose ends—so let's get a head start on lunch without her!
Huh? So... We're just closing the commission like this?
Well... The letter made it to its destination.==W== In that sense, yeah, I'd say we technically fulfilled the request.
Seems like nobody's fully convinced. And Mr. Howard's reaction was definitely off.
The sender's name was illegible, yet Howard didn't even blink. He must have recognized it instantly.
He got the letter he was expecting, but he looked so conflicted... Why?
Come to think of it, what exactly did Donna have Teresa do?==W== It's taking her a while.
Whoa!? Don't sneak up on me...
Why the thousand-yard stare? You okay?
I just asked you what you wanted for lunch, and you completely tuned me out!
S-sorry... I was lost in thought. I didn't hear you.
Still hung up on that letter?
Relax. Teresa is already on the case.
Teresa...? Wait, is that the favor you asked of her—
Bingo! I've got her staking out Mr. Howard's place from a distance.
Huh? Is a stakeout really necessary?
Post Haste is about more than just dropping off envelopes at the right address...==W== We have a duty to make sure the sender's feelings actually reach the person.
Something clearly happened to that family in the past...
The Howards were legendary smiths. I used to stock their gear all the time.
Do you know where to find them now?
Rumor says the heir ran off to be a Trekker. I think his son took over the business?
They might still be at it, just not under the "Howard" name.
If the Howards are that famous... Their address shouldn't be a secret. Delivering a single letter shouldn't be this hard.
And yet, that letter was left drifting in the wind for so long...==W== I get the feeling that this is more complicated than it looks.
So, I asked Teresa to keep watch from the shadows... Just to prevent a worst-case scenario.
I'm worried Mr. Howard might just throw it away.==W== We've seen that happen before, haven't we, Freesia?
But why...? Doesn't a courier's duty end the second the package is delivered?
Iris has a point. Once he accepts it, whatever happens next ... isn't on Post Haste's conscience.
But ... what if it's a final message from a long-lost relative?==W==<size=30> If he throws it away... Then realizes his mistake when it's too late... Wouldn't that be ... tragic?
It's only hypothetical! That's exactly why I have Teresa playing spy!
What's wrong? Deep breaths. Take your time.

strings.text: Following Teresa's intel, you track the missing mail. On the street, you bump into those treasure hunters from earlier, now collecting old letters. Freesia draws her weapon instantly…
... After all this time, perhaps some things are better left buried.
He stares at the envelope, weighing it in his hand.
The young Trekkers had given him a relic—==RT==a letter weathered by decades of silence.
This is surely from the one I've tried to cast out of my mind…==RT==I don't even need to open it to know who it is.
Reading it will only tear open old wounds.==RT==But I can't seem to just toss it away. What a burden…
If only someone would just take this thing off my hands...
It is as if the universe hears his wish—
Teresa, walk us through what happened.
Mm... As you requested, Donna, I staked out the place and kept an eye on Mr. Howard for a bit...
Mr. Howard went inside...==W== He was holding the envelope, so Donna's delivery was a success!
But he didn't open it. He just left it on the windowsill... Hope he didn't trash it...
Yawn—==W==no, no, no. Job's not done! Can't snooze now...
Mmm... But I've been up way too late ... with all these commissions lately...==W== No... Gotta ... stay ... awake...
Gah—! What?! What's happening?! What was that noise—
Did I seriously fall asleep?!==W== Ah, right, the letter...
A large hole was left in the tightly shut window,==RT==and the letter on the sill had vanished into thin air.
What just happened?! Is Mr. Howard okay—==W==hm?
Wait up, Cap! You're going way too fast!
Quit stalling! We gotta move before someone else swipes the <color=#bd3059>letters</color>—
I saw that group sprinting toward the harbor. Something about them felt off...
But I was worried about Mr. Howard... By the time I checked on him and looked back, I'd lost them...==W== At least he looked unscathed.
Teresa... Did you notice a girl with them? Wearing a bandana, carrying a huge pack?
Yeah! I did!==W== She had this giant bag—it was practically her size!
I knew it...!==W== It has to be them... That same crew from the other day looking for the letter.
Seen an old letter around here? It has something hard inside.
They claimed they were volunteer couriers, just like us...
But that was clearly a lie... They were scoundrels planning to steal the letter all along!
Sorry! If I'd paid closer attention, none of this would have happened...
Hey, it's okay. Panicking won't fix anything. We need a plan.
First order of business: tracking down those "letter thieves."
Wait. You aren't seriously planning to fight them, are you?
They even broke windows to force their way in... Aren't they a bit dangerous?
Post Haste has one job: getting every single letter safely into the recipient's hands!
Even when people are miles apart, a letter keeps their connection alive... When someone writes a letter, they're pouring their heart out on paper.
I swear on my name as a courier, I will retrieve that important letter. I will get it back and deliver it properly!
Besides! If word gets out that "Post Haste lost a letter in Port Bellin," our brand is toast!
We handle almost all local deliveries now. I can't have people doubting our competence!==W== On behalf of Post Haste, I have to fix this!
As am I.==W== Stealing private letters is simply unforgivable.
That said, this wasn't part of the deal...==W== Tell you what: Post Haste will hunt down the thieves.==W== New Star stays here and sorts the backlog. Sounds fair?
Don't be a stranger! If you're manhunting, you'll need all the help you can get.
Our contract is to assist Post Haste's work. If retrieving a lost letter counts as a duty, then technically, we're obligated to help.
But it could get messy... I shouldn't drag your whole guild into this...
I am better at punishing bad guys.
We're all on board. Let's do this together.
Since you put it that way... I'll take you up on that offer!
Alright, it's decided! Let's go catch some thieves!
Donna and Teresa said one of the thieves was... "A girl with a backpack her size," right?
Wait... That rings a bell. I've seen a girl like that... Where was it again?
Hey! Watch where you're going! You almost knocked my gear everywhere!
Heh heh... Much obliged for paving the way. You'll have to forgive our uninvited entrance.
Sh-Shut it!==W== Guys, hear me out! I still got an old treasure map! Let's go now. This time we'll definitely come back rich!
It's you—! From Hexhorn Whale's island...!
<size=50>AAAHHH! THAT FACE!! I'd know that mug—!</size>
Boss, what's wrong...?==W== Ah, it's her!
So you really are the culprit...
Huh? Boss, do you know this person?
Long story short, we have a history...
Why did you steal the letter?
Hey, you over there! We've met, right? We are ...==W== delivering letters for free! That's right, just helping out!
Besides, I am a Trekker traversing the continent for legendary treasure—a woman of grand ambition! Not like those petty thieves, mind you!
Your bag's nearly full—must've been taking on many jobs, yet we've never heard of you guys, even though we're in the same line of work.
Boss! I just picked up this letter...! Is there any room left in your bag?
So, you weren't actually hired to deliver them.
Tch. Well, guess the jig is up...
Yeah, you're right! The letters in my bag are our tickets to the treasure!
Legend says there's a treasure map hidden inside an old envelope just like that one! We've been busting our humps searching everywhere for a lead like this!
You call it stealing? Don't make me laugh. In the treasure-hunting biz, the only rule is "finders keepers."
We found it, so it's ours! And I'm not handing it over to anyone!
Incorrect. A letter belongs to the person it's addressed to. No stranger has the right to take it. No exceptions.
You stole more than paper. You stole someone's heart and soul.
"Heart and soul"? Look at this tattered thing! It was clearly tossed out because nobody wanted it! If it's trash, it's up for grabs!
Hey, wait a minute... Why are you mimicking how I speak?! You're stealing my whole brand image!
Enough talk. I shall let my Reason's Edge communicate the rest.
This duel will settle our dispute—and cleanse your sins—right here and now.
