strings.text: Thanks to Leafia, everyone realizes that the real thief is a monster called the "Gale Owl," not the treasure hunter. Determined to set things right, Donna gears up, vowing to retrieve every last letter.
Whoa, hey! Wait, wait—stop! You nuts?! One hit from that axe and I'm dead meat!
Oh? Quite the show. Is that Lanto over there?
Hand over the letter in your bag. Now!
Crap...! The treasure map inside is mine! You're not taking it!!
You know that's just a hoax, right?
Hello, everyone. I'm Leafia, from the Trekker Association. I'm a surveyor for the Sea Wakers, but I handle general exploration, too.
Saw the uniform. Figured the Trekker Association sent someone.
Spot on. And speaking of which, I've heard plenty about you and your crew, Tyrant.
Screw the stories! Back up to the "hoax" part! What do you mean?!
The Trekker Association looked into those "treasure map" rumors about two years back. We never found a credible source or any evidence, so we wrote it off as a hoax.
Hah?! Then explain why Port Bellin is covered in these vintage-looking letters! It's gotta be because other Trekkers are also fighting over the maps inside them!
Letters... Port Bellin...?==W== Wait, do you think that letter-stealing monster dropped them?
At a closer look... They look worn out, perhaps because they've been torn and bitten, stained by rain and mud splatters...
What?! So we've been breaking our backs collecting trash some monster spat out? And here I was guarding the pile from other Trekkers with my life?!
"Collecting"? You mean you didn't smash windows to steal one?
Smash windows?! No way! We found these lying on the ground all over the city, I swear! Besides, if we were gonna pull a heist, we'd go for something way more legendary than letters!
Speaking of which... Why are you lot so obsessed with a single letter? I thought you were rival hunters trying to beat us to the treasure…
We're with Post Haste. We're investigating a delivered letter that was stolen during a break-in...
If you are not the culprits... Then please accept my sincerest apologies for my behavior.
So we got beat up for absolutely nothing?!
Afterward, hoping to earn some quick cash, the Treasure Hunters==RT==take a commission from Leafia to properly deliver the letters they've found.
However, even after searching through her bag,==RT==the letter addressed to Howard is nowhere to be found.
We're hoooome!==W== Whoa! Look at the table! We're gonna be buried alive in letters! We haven't delivered any mail today…
I've cleared that batch over there. The drop-offs are local... If we hustle, we can still make it.

With all hands on deck, we'll wipe out this pile before sundown! While you guys are on your runs, I'll stay here, keep sorting—and get dinner started! I know it's been a long day, but I need everyone's help on this!
Leave it to me! I can keep going all day!
But isn't there still a massive amount of sorting left? Can Donna really handle all of that on her own...?
I'll stay and help you sort, Donna.
Thank you, Boss. Alright team, let's get moving!
Mn... Yeah.==W== Sorry. Didn't mean to bring the mood down.
Do you plan to keep looking for it?
Sigh... We're already so behind schedule after that monster attack...==W== As the leader, piling even more work on everyone... Maybe I'm just being stubborn…
The trail's gone cold. We might have lost Mr. Howard's letter for good… And we have so many other deliveries waiting...==W== Boss, what's the right call here?
Hmm... From a purely practical standpoint, we should prioritize the jobs we know we can actually finish.
Right? A leader is supposed to make the rational choice... Deep down, I know that...
But knowing the logic doesn't make it any easier to accept.
Haha... Yeah. No matter what I tell myself, I just can't let it go. That letter's still there, untouched…
Why are you so hung up on this one letter, Donna? It's really eating you up.
... Haha. You've really been looking out for me lately, Boss... I guess...==W== I owe you the truth.
The thing is... My own life was saved by a letter.
My parents died when I was really little...==W== After that, I just got shuffled from one relative to the next.
I don't blame them. Having some random kid show up begging, "Please make me part of the family!"...==W== That's a burden on anyone.
Even back then, I figured it out pretty quickly:==W== No matter where I stayed, I'd always just be the outsider.
I just...==W== I don't ever want to be alone again.
... So that's what she meant. She's been through so much...

To avoid getting tossed aside, I watched everyone constantly, shape-shifting into whatever they wanted me to be… Just when I started losing track of who I really was...==W== It found me. A letter from my parents.
Haha... It gave me quite a shock, too. Turns out, they mailed it while they were still alive.
But it never reached me. Right after sending it... They died in an accident. And since I kept bouncing between relatives, it was never delivered to the right address.
Then ... how did it finally find you?
It was the courier. He refused to give up the search ... for years.
Incredible, isn't it? I owe that courier ... everything. I'm only standing here today because that letter was delivered to me.
The pages were filled with their love, with affections—"Donna, we love you."==W== Realizing I was actually deeply loved by someone... It saved my life.
I see... I'm so glad that letter found its way to you.
That's why ... I decided to become a courier.
I want to help people by delivering their sentiment. Maybe I can save someone, too. Just like how that courier saved me.
That explains why you're so desperate for the recipient to read their letter.
Yeah. It's tragic when feelings vanish without ever being heard. And ... I do not wish for regrets upon the recipient.
But ... in the end, that's just me projecting. Bringing personal emotions into work is wrong!==W== I'm the leader of Post Haste. I need to make decisions that are best for the business...
Sometimes, there's nothing wrong with that. In fact, we can call that your "conviction."
Yeah. Only a leader with conviction is worth following.
It's the compass that sets your direction. If that compass is off, the whole team gets lost.
Deep down, you've always known exactly where you want to go, haven't you?
Then stop hesitating. Hold your head high and lead your team toward that goal. A leader's first duty is to show the way, after all.
Show the way...==W== You're right. If I keep wavering like this, Freesia and Teresa will just worry even more.
Exactly. Now that we have a destination, let's figure out how to get there.
We need to hunt down the letter-stealing monster. I believe that's the key to fixing this whole mess.
The letter-stealing monster? Wait! You think a monster smashed the window and grabbed it right off the table?
It's highly likely. And look, even if the monster doesn't have Mr. Howard's letter, stopping it can relieve delivery backlogs. That frees up your schedule to investigate properly, right?
I see... That actually makes sense. We'd clear the Post Haste backlog, fix the logistics mess in Port Bellin … and potentially find the letter to put my mind at ease... Hehe.
You really live up to your reputation as the Tyrant, killing two birds with one stone. Just how greedy are you?
Now that the decision is made, let us devise a plan to track down this beast together.
Teresa?! And Freesia, too?! How... How much did you two hear...?
Hmm... Maybe around the part about "bringing personal emotions into work is wrong"?
That was ages ago—! Why didn't you say something when you got back?!
My apologies. You seemed to be in a serious conversation with Boss… We thought it would be rude to interrupt.
Ugh... You saw me worrying? I could just die of embarrassment...
There's no need! Don't we eat, live, and work together already? We should share our worries, too!
Indeed. Teresa and I both wish to be of help to you, Donna... Please, allow us to share the burden.
The New Star Guild can handle the sorting and deliveries for now. We've gotten pretty efficient, so rest easy! You couriers just focus on hunting down that monster.
You know Port Bellin... You'll find it faster.
Looks like everyone's on the same page! So, leader of Post Haste, what's the call?
My, oh my. It's been a while since I slipped into this outfit. Good thing I've kept you in top shape... Domina.
... It's not about "what I should do," but "what I want to do." Right? You really know the quickest way to a girl's heart, don't you, Tyrant?
It's time to say goodbye to the old Donna—the one who always looked for the "right answer" and played the "good girl." No more hesitation. I'm going to follow my own heart.
Because now ... I have the best and strongest partners in the world!
Morning, Donna—==W==whoa! What's with that outfit?!
If I just sat in the office all day, I wouldn't be much of a courier, would I?
Now that monsters are blocking the mail routes, it's time for this courier to show what she's really made of!
Whoa, it's been ages since I saw Donna in this outfit! So cool!
Hmph! Pesky monsters... they've caused everyone so much trouble. Now they've really ticked me off!
For the peace of Port Bellin, and for the hearts of every sender—"Operation: Find the Stray Letters," commence!
It's great to see Donna so fired up, but...==W== How exactly are we supposed to find the monster that steals the letters in the first place?

param: Thanks to Leafia, everyone realizes that the real thief is a monster called the "Gale Owl," not the treasure hunter. Determined to set things right, Donna gears up, vowing to retrieve every last letter.
Whoa, hey! Wait, wait—stop! You nuts?! One hit from that axe and I'm dead meat!
Oh? Quite the show. Is that Lanto over there?
Hand over the letter in your bag. Now!
Crap...! The treasure map inside is mine! You're not taking it!!
You know that's just a hoax, right?
Hello, everyone. I'm Leafia, from the Trekker Association. I'm a surveyor for the Sea Wakers, but I handle general exploration, too.
Saw the uniform. Figured the Trekker Association sent someone.
Spot on. And speaking of which, I've heard plenty about you and your crew, Tyrant.
Screw the stories! Back up to the "hoax" part! What do you mean?!
The Trekker Association looked into those "treasure map" rumors about two years back. We never found a credible source or any evidence, so we wrote it off as a hoax.
Hah?! Then explain why Port Bellin is covered in these vintage-looking letters! It's gotta be because other Trekkers are also fighting over the maps inside them!
Letters... Port Bellin...?==W== Wait, do you think that letter-stealing monster dropped them?
At a closer look... They look worn out, perhaps because they've been torn and bitten, stained by rain and mud splatters...
What?! So we've been breaking our backs collecting trash some monster spat out? And here I was guarding the pile from other Trekkers with my life?!
"Collecting"? You mean you didn't smash windows to steal one?
Smash windows?! No way! We found these lying on the ground all over the city, I swear! Besides, if we were gonna pull a heist, we'd go for something way more legendary than letters!
Speaking of which... Why are you lot so obsessed with a single letter? I thought you were rival hunters trying to beat us to the treasure…
We're with Post Haste. We're investigating a delivered letter that was stolen during a break-in...
If you are not the culprits... Then please accept my sincerest apologies for my behavior.
So we got beat up for absolutely nothing?!
Afterward, hoping to earn some quick cash, the Treasure Hunters==RT==take a commission from Leafia to properly deliver the letters they've found.
However, even after searching through her bag,==RT==the letter addressed to Howard is nowhere to be found.
We're hoooome!==W== Whoa! Look at the table! We're gonna be buried alive in letters! We haven't delivered any mail today…
I've cleared that batch over there. The drop-offs are local... If we hustle, we can still make it.

With all hands on deck, we'll wipe out this pile before sundown! While you guys are on your runs, I'll stay here, keep sorting—and get dinner started! I know it's been a long day, but I need everyone's help on this!
Leave it to me! I can keep going all day!
But isn't there still a massive amount of sorting left? Can Donna really handle all of that on her own...?
I'll stay and help you sort, Donna.
Thank you, Boss. Alright team, let's get moving!
Mn... Yeah.==W== Sorry. Didn't mean to bring the mood down.
Do you plan to keep looking for it?
Sigh... We're already so behind schedule after that monster attack...==W== As the leader, piling even more work on everyone... Maybe I'm just being stubborn…
The trail's gone cold. We might have lost Mr. Howard's letter for good… And we have so many other deliveries waiting...==W== Boss, what's the right call here?
Hmm... From a purely practical standpoint, we should prioritize the jobs we know we can actually finish.
Right? A leader is supposed to make the rational choice... Deep down, I know that...
But knowing the logic doesn't make it any easier to accept.
Haha... Yeah. No matter what I tell myself, I just can't let it go. That letter's still there, untouched…
Why are you so hung up on this one letter, Donna? It's really eating you up.
... Haha. You've really been looking out for me lately, Boss... I guess...==W== I owe you the truth.
The thing is... My own life was saved by a letter.
My parents died when I was really little...==W== After that, I just got shuffled from one relative to the next.
I don't blame them. Having some random kid show up begging, "Please make me part of the family!"...==W== That's a burden on anyone.
Even back then, I figured it out pretty quickly:==W== No matter where I stayed, I'd always just be the outsider.
I just...==W== I don't ever want to be alone again.
... So that's what she meant. She's been through so much...

To avoid getting tossed aside, I watched everyone constantly, shape-shifting into whatever they wanted me to be… Just when I started losing track of who I really was...==W== It found me. A letter from my parents.
Haha... It gave me quite a shock, too. Turns out, they mailed it while they were still alive.
But it never reached me. Right after sending it... They died in an accident. And since I kept bouncing between relatives, it was never delivered to the right address.
Then ... how did it finally find you?
It was the courier. He refused to give up the search ... for years.
Incredible, isn't it? I owe that courier ... everything. I'm only standing here today because that letter was delivered to me.
The pages were filled with their love, with affections—"Donna, we love you."==W== Realizing I was actually deeply loved by someone... It saved my life.
I see... I'm so glad that letter found its way to you.
That's why ... I decided to become a courier.
I want to help people by delivering their sentiment. Maybe I can save someone, too. Just like how that courier saved me.
That explains why you're so desperate for the recipient to read their letter.
Yeah. It's tragic when feelings vanish without ever being heard. And ... I do not wish for regrets upon the recipient.
But ... in the end, that's just me projecting. Bringing personal emotions into work is wrong!==W== I'm the leader of Post Haste. I need to make decisions that are best for the business...
Sometimes, there's nothing wrong with that. In fact, we can call that your "conviction."
Yeah. Only a leader with conviction is worth following.
It's the compass that sets your direction. If that compass is off, the whole team gets lost.
Deep down, you've always known exactly where you want to go, haven't you?
Then stop hesitating. Hold your head high and lead your team toward that goal. A leader's first duty is to show the way, after all.

strings.text: Teresa stuffs a letter with corn kernels and baits Gale Owl to snatch it. Following the trail of dropped corn, with Teresa's superhuman path-clearing skills, you track the monster back to its lair.
By the way, I'm wondering why that monster is so obsessed with "letters," of all things...
The evidence points to a simple reason: nest building.
Whoa, Leafia?! How long have you been here?
Since the moment you arrived at the port. After all, our objectives align.
I take it you're also tracking this letter-stealing monster?
Correct. Investigating Gale Owl is the entire reason I came to Port Bellin.
"Gale Owl"? Is that the monster's name?
It's less a name, more a code designation from the Trekker Association.==W== Monsters don't name themselves. But without a label, records and research become impossible.
Gale Owl is a migratory avian monster.==W== It moves nests frequently to evade predators—==W==quite intelligent behavior.
And the recent migration cycle brought it to Port Bellin.==W== It identified "<color=#3faeae>letters</color>" as premium nesting material...==W== Hence the theft.
A nest made of letters? I'm trying to picture that, but it's ... weird.

Apparently, it loves the texture. And to build a proper nest, it needs a massive supply. Since envelopes contain multiple sheets,==W== perhaps stealing letters is the most efficient way to gather resources.
What a nuisance...==W== Does it have any other habits we should know about?
It's cunning.==W== Records show plenty of cases where they flew into private homes to snatch valuables.
Into people's homes?! If that's true, then Mr. Howard's letter—
Highly likely to be resting in that Gale Owl's nest right now.
The question is ... how do we find it?
If it's raiding Port Bellin, the nest must be somewhere nearby, no?
Port Bellin is one of the biggest hubs on the continent... "Nearby" still leaves us a huge area to cover.==W== Any way to narrow it down?
I have a plan...==W== Would you care to test it out?
Mommy, look! What are they doing?
If we keep this up, Post Haste's brand image is going to be ruined…==W== If it doesn't show up soon…
Hmm... Regrettable. No sign of the target.
Auditory mimicry should have drawn it out, in theory...==W== But apparently... It's not working.
You said this Gale Owl looks like... Well, an owl. But you guys are cycling through every random bird noise in the book...
We can't assume it sounds like an owl just because it looks like one... We have to test every variable to be safe.
Spoken like a true scholar. So rigorous... Shame it didn't work. Is there another way... Wait, I've got it!
If we want to lure a letter thief... Why don't we just use a "letter" as bait?
A logical deduction. We actually attempted that before, but we failed.
Gale Owl's too fast. Once it grabs the bait, we lose it before we can track it to the nest.==B====W== That's why I suggested the calls, hoping it would lower its guard.
So the key is just not to lose sight of it, right?==W== In that case, I've got a plan! Leave it to me!
Ta-da! My Special Corn-Kernel Letter is ready for action!
A Special Corn-Kernel Letter? You stuffed the envelope with grain... For...?
Yeah, Teresa always has a unique way of solving things.
Wait, is everyone else following this?!==W== Even you, Donna?
Freesia, take a closer look right here—at the bottom corner.
The corner?==W== Ah, a small puncture.==W== I get it now.
Heh heh, finally.==W== The idea is that corn will fall out of the letter and leave a nice little trail for us to follow straight to its hideout!
Even if we cannot match Gale Owl's speed, we can still locate its nest...==W== Brilliant, Teresa! I never would have conceived of such a plan.
There is one flaw, though. It can fly over obstacles that we can't.==W== If the trail crosses a dead end or a wall...
Correct. The terrain around Port Bellin is complex. We are highly likely to encounter impassable routes.==B====W== Even if we follow the trail, the path could easily be cut off halfway.
No sweat! You can leave the navigation to me!
Boss, Leafia, leave the pathfinding to me!==W== As the Post Haste leader, I guarantee it!
Understood. Let's give it a shot.
<size=30>We've laid out plenty of bait letters...</size>
<size=30>Do you truly believe it will come...?</size>
<size=30>Patience, you two! My dad always said: once the trap is laid, patience is the hunter's strongest weapon!</size>
Oh, so that is its actual vocalization... Let me record that data—
No time for notes!==W== Gale Owl has already taken the bait!
Don't just look for corn—watch for my markers too!
Teresa scrambles up the wall and darts across the rooftops, chasing the monster with cat-like agility.
Well, we certainly can't follow her up there...==W== It's okay, we can take the long way around and find the next kernel.
Is this ... the Special Corn-Kernel Letter...? Did it toss the whole thing...?
Looks like it figured out our little trick.
Sharper than I gave it credit for...
This is not looking good. We're gonna lose the trail...
You guys chasing that bird monster? It flew over there—!
The owner of the equipment shop?!
You're gonna take that thing down, right? We're counting on you, Trekkers!
Looking for Teresa?==W== She already zoomed past here!
The monster went that-a-way! Go get 'em, Post Haste!
Amazing. The whole town... Everyone is pointing the way for us!
Oh, stop it—you're gonna make me cry!==W== Being a courier and helping everyone like this... It's just the best!
Agreed... We can't let them down.==W== Let's pick up the pace and catch that thing!
Crap... It dropped the letter halfway!==W== If I lose the trail now, this whole chase was for nothing!
If that letter is gone forever because I messed up...==W== No! Think, Teresa! I have to find its nest!
But getting too close might spook it away from the nest entirely...==B====W== Is there another way to mark it...?==B====W== Wait. This forest...
Just my luck! In that case, time for a change of plans!
Stop right there—! Wait for me—!
Teresa hurls a stone at a branch...
Instantly, a deluge of overripe, rotting fruit rains down upon Gale Owl.
This forest is full of Shrubshrew traps. Now you're covered in the stink of rotting fruit peels!
Heh heh, my nose knows!==W== You can't escape now—I'm taking you down!
Everyone! Gale Owl's nest's right here!!!==W== Huh? We circled all the way back to the seaside—!
Incredible work, Teresa! Those markers you left were a huge help!
Leave the fighting to us.==W== Boss, we await your command.
Roger that. Let's take down this monster and get Mr. Howard's letter back!
Building a nest on the most scenic cape in Port Bellin... It certainly has good taste.
You know... The people of Port Bellin write and receive countless letters every single day.==W== Can you guess why?

Because they trust Post Haste. They believe we will deliver every single letter to its recipient!==B====W== No letters left behind, no feelings unexpressed...==W== That is why they entrust their letters to us.
That trust... Those bonds connecting people through these letters...==W== I'm taking it all back!==W==<size=50> Prepare yourself!</size>

strings.text: You recover the letter and attempt delivery once more. Moved by Donna's sincerity, Howard finally accepts both the letter and his father's love and apology. At last, years of resentment melt away.
Whoa... This nest is way bigger than I expected. It's actually spacious in here.
It seems to have used its saliva to glue all the letters it collected into a clump.
We have to peel them apart...==W== Ugh, this is gonna take forever.
If we take our time,==W== we will find it.
Freesia's right! Let's split up and start digging!
Since Mr. Howard's letter contains a hard object, I assumed it would be easier to distinguish...
I can't find it at all,==W== meow...
We've practically dismantled the whole nest... I've looked through this entire sea of letters...
We've been at this for so long with no luck. Maybe it's just...
There's something hard inside! This has to be Howard's letter!
A yellowed envelope ...==W== addressed to "Howard"! This is it!==W== You're amazing, Boss! You actually found it!
That's great, Donna!==W== Hurry and get it to Mr. Howard. Make sure he actually reads it this time!
Now then. What shall we do with the rest of these scattered letters?
We can't just leave them here...==W== Let's haul the whole lot back. We're delivering every last one.
Right. We can start sorting them the minute we get back.
Wow! You catch on quick, Boss! Sounding like a pro already!==W== But you sure you're up for more? It's a huge pile, and half these envelopes are shredded...
"Every letter delivered, no matter the situation." That's the Post Haste way, isn't it?==W== We've come this far; might as well see it through.
Hehe, counting on you then! I don't know what we'd do without you guys!
Having cleared the Gale Owl's nest, the Post Haste bids farewell to Leafia.==RT==With the precious letter finally secure, they set off for Howard's house...
<size=52>Hello—!</size>==RT==<size=38>Post Haste delivery! Mr. Howard, we have a letter for you!</size>
Huh... So it's you lot making all that racket... Thanks for the effort, I suppose...==W== Wait—
That letter!==W== Why do you have it...?!
We recovered it from a monster's nest ...==W== and brought it back. Please accept it.
A monster's nest?! That sounds incredibly dangerous... You went to all that trouble just to retrieve this?
It's just a letter. If it was lost, let it stay lost... No need to risk your necks over it. I wouldn't have blamed you.
Rain or shine...==W== Even if it's stolen by monsters, we'll make sure every important letter is delivered! Meow!
That is the motto of Post Haste.
Work is important, sure, but ideals only go so far...==W== Sigh. Look at you, all scraped up. You could have been killed. It's not worth it.
A scrap of paper versus your lives... You're young. You need to get your priorities straight. Take better care of yourselves.
With all due respect, sir...==W== To me, the letter is more important.
If that's your attitude,==W== then I definitely can't accept this.
But we worked so hard==W== to retrieve it...

Exactly. If I take it, you'll feel like heroes, won't you? You'll tell yourselves,==W== "Even if a monster steals the mail, we have to get it back at all costs."==W== And next time, you'll make the same reckless decisions.
Keep running into the Wilds with that mindset, and your luck will run out.==W== If you die out there, have you thought about what that does to your families?
Mom ... Dad ... gone? An accident...?==W== You're lying...!==W==<size=52> No! You're lying!

Mr. Howard, maybe we do seem reckless to you... Maybe it looks like we're gambling with our lives. But—

... I always figured Trekkers were just reckless idiots with a death wish.==W== Exactly like the bastard of a father who wrote this.

... Someone has to look out for those suicidal maniacs, don't they?==W== Someone has to save their necks.

If that's true,==W== why do you badmouth him so much, meow?

Sigh... Sorry you had to see that.==W== I made a fool of myself. I'll take the letter.

Is this ... a rolled-up ruler with markings? Looks handy, I guess. But why would the old man send me this kind of th—
Howard chokes on his words, eyes glued to the letter.

"Not sure if this will ever reach you,==RT==but I found a neat Artifact I wanted you to have.==RT==It's called a 'Tape Measure.'==RT==Figured it'd come in handy for sizing things up when you're crafting gear."

"You always dreamed of being a smith.==RT==But the shop started failing under my watch, and I've always felt like I let you down...==RT==I left the city to find work and raise money...==RT====RT==But I was too ashamed to tell you the truth before I left.==RT==Please, forgive your old man's foolish pride."

"These days, I take Trekker commissions and sell my gear in the field.==RT==Even doing maintenance on the side—business is booming!==RT====RT==So, just focus on honing your craft.==RT==Don't worry about money. I'm sending cash to your mother."
"I'll come home once I've saved up a bit more...==RT====RT==When I do, I'd love for you to work on my gear...==RT==Haha, too much to ask?"
Until then, thank you for keeping the family name alive"...==W== What is this... What in the world?
Dad left ... for the family? For me? That's why he became a Trekker...?
You have to be kidding me... And I... All this time... Ugh...
My father became a Trekker for my dream... Yet I've sat here hating him for it all this time...==W== How could I be so... I'm pathetic...
Don't say that!==W== I think you've done amazing, Mr. Howard!
Look at you! You became an incredible smith, didn't you?==W== Your father's wish has already come true!
He supported the dream of the son he loved...==W== And you made it happen with your own hands!
... Thank you. Thanks for bringing this to me...==W== Because of this letter, I think ... I can finally take a few real steps forward.

strings.text: Back at Post Haste, a mountain of mail awaits... After much effort, all lost letters are returned to their rightful owners. Parting ways with Boss, Donna picks up a pen to write a letter for the first time in ages...
Operation: Find the Stray Letters is a wrap! Another victory!
Hm? The New Star Guild... You do not look well.
Wh-what happened?! You look like the walking dead!
I'm sorrrry! We took the job, but we're nowhere near done! Aaaah!
I underestimated the workload... Bit off more than I could chew, I am so sorry!!!
Hahaha! Is that all? Don't sweat it!
Look at the pile. You have made significant progress since we left.
Yep! For rookies, you're actually doing awesome!
Hahaha! Actually, the pile just got bigger! Mind giving us a hand with these, too?
Uh... Let's just say it's been a long day.
Don't worry, extra work means extra pay! Now then—let's divide and conquer!
Right now?! You've been running around all day... Take a break first!
No, no! Every minute counts—I want these lost letters delivered ASAP!
Addressee confirmed... Got one! Addressee confirmed... Over there!
Teresa! You're up. Take this entire sector!
Amber, Freesia! This batch is ready. Start the delivery run!
And that's the last pile. Sorting complete!
Thanks, Boss! Once we group them by district... We can clear the whole backlog tomorrow!
Through their collective effort, the chaotic mountain of mail shrinks into neat, orderly stacks. Victory is in sight.
... Is the whole Post Haste crew falling asleep?
Can't blame them. They chased the letters down, fought a monster, then came straight back to sort and deliver...
They must truly love what they do.
I've definitely seen that passion firsthand these last few days.
... That courier dedication is intense! I dunno why, but it's actually kinda cool!
It looks exhausting... But the work matters a lot.
Guess this will be goodbye to Port Bellin tomorrow... It was a hectic trip, but I honestly had a blast.
Goooood morning, Boss! Whatcha up to?
Morning, Donna. Just taking in the view one last time. Trying to burn it into my memory.
Gorgeous, right? This is actually my favorite spot for morning-gazing.
It really is. And this breeze... Just enough to wake me up from my morning daze.
Like a log! Now that the job's done, I am recharged, refreshed, and back at 100%!
But ... that also means the New Star Guild's contract is up. You're heading out today, aren't you?
Yeah. Iris says it's time to hit the road.
Aww, what a bummer! You guys are total naturals at this courier stuff. If you stuck around to help, I'd sleep way better at night!
Haha, please. Compared to Post Haste, we're mere amateurs.
Hahaha, I'm just teasing! But seriously... Even if it was just for a few days, I really enjoyed working with you all.
... Yeah. Plus, watching you work made me realize something, Boss. I've got a long way to go before I can call myself a real leader.
There's so much more for me to learn... I have to push myself to be more like you, Boss.
Donna, you don't need to be like me.
You have your own strengths. The Donna standing in front of me is already an incredible leader.
Remember what I told you? A leader without conviction won't have any followers.
It was your conviction that pulled us through. Everyone followed you because they believed in you.
Quit it, Boss! You're way too good at flattery! Keep talking like that and you'll make me blush.
... This is the last time we'll be chatting like this, right, Boss? Makes me feel kinda lonely.
I'm terrible at goodbyes. Did I ever tell you? I used to drift from place to place, never really had a home.
Friendships, trust ... and connections... It always feels like they could vanish at any moment. I can't stop thinking about it...==W== And it makes me feel so alone.
That's why ...==W== I'm terrified Post Haste will end up like that too. I work myself to the bone just to keep us all together...
—Ah! S-Sorry! Why am I getting so emotional...? Somehow, I always end up spilling my guts talking to you, Boss.
Goodbyes happen. It sounds sad, but nothing in this world lasts forever.
But we can write. Even if we're miles apart, a letter can still reach you.
"Even when people are miles apart, a letter keeps their connection alive."==W== Isn't that right, Donna?
As long as we have the power of letters, you'll never be alone.
I'm the courier here, yet you're the one teaching me about the power of letters... You got me.
You're right. Letters are the bridge that connects us all.
Write to me anytime. I promise I'll write back.
You bet! It's a promise, Boss!
No fair! I wanna be pen pals with Boss too!
Exchanging letters with Boss... How lovely.
Wah?! Teresa!? Freesia!? How long have you been listening?!
When? Let me think... I do believe it was right around "write to me anytime."
Whew... So you didn't hear too much...
Whaaaat? Now I'm dying to know what you were talking about before that, meow!
Ah! Look at the time, gotta prep breakfast! Boss, zip it about our little chat, okay?!
The Post Haste really is a close-knit family.
Big thanks again to the New Star Guild! We only made it through safely 'cause of you guys.
The feeling is mutual. We've also learned a great deal from this.
If you ever get in a jam again, give us a holler! I'll hop on Loxy and zip over in a flash!
Teresa, Freesia, Donna! Wish you all smooth sailing in your courier work!
Thanks! And if anyone needs something delivered, send a commission to Post Haste!
To meet, to bond, and eventually to part... That moment is inevitable. Yet, the girl's voice holds no sorrow... Her expression is as warm and open as the clear blue sky.
She knows that as long as she picks up a pen and sends a letter... Her heart will reach them.
(Come to think of it, it's been ages since I actually sat down to write a letter...==W== I'll start it like this!)

strings.text: You've accepted a commission from Igna and travel to Emor, where you are reunited with Firefly—the young girl you first met during the Snowish Festival.
This time, the client told me to meet them beneath Emor's Monolith...
Surely they're not expecting me to climb it, right?
Since this commission supposedly doesn't involve any fighting, I came alone...==W== Still, the fact that they specifically told me to come by myself feels a little strange...
After all, the one who got me this job was—
Sorry to keep you waiting.==W== So... What did you need me for?
What's with that look on your face? You look like a little lab rat resigned to its fate.==W== If you're really not feeling well, I could give you a full body examination first.
No, no, that's really not necessary.==W== No need for all that. Not today...
Then you can relax. I didn't call you here to help with my research today.
Of course. Though I could always change my mind on the spot.==W== There's no test subject more appealing to me than you.
N-no thanks! Just get to the point already!
If it's not an experiment...==W== Then do you have a commission for me?
That's right. More precisely, it's from an old friend of mine.
Your friend...==W== Is she a doctor, too?
A doctor...==W== More or less.==W== She went to the same university as I did. Her name is Igna.
Have you heard of the Eye of Grace, Tyrant?
The Eye of Grace... If I remember right, it's an academic==RT==research institute under the Grace Imperium, right?
So you do know. Igna currently works there, and apparently the project she's been handling lately is short on people.
For certain reasons, I'm still not in a position to stroll openly through the streets of Emor City...==W== So I recommended you to her instead.
A research project? But I don't have any professional medical background.
Big projects always end up outsourcing...
<size=50>So I'm basically the temp who's gonna get blamed if anything goes wrong?!</size>
Heh. When I think of capable, well-read people, you're the first one who comes to mind.
Though... I do get the feeling she never intended to ask me in the first place.
What she actually asked was whether I knew anyone she could bring in to help. I doubt I was ever under consideration.
So I mentioned you to her just to test the waters,==W== and she immediately got very excited. She told me she absolutely had to work with you.==W== Do you two know each other?
I don't think I've met her...
It seems that your fame precedes you then, Tyrant.
I just never expected so many people to recognize your worth.==W== Heh. Yet here I am, wishing I could keep you all to myself.
... Coming from you, that somehow doesn't make me happy...
Wait a second. Don't tell me this friend of yours is also one of those—
Heh. Don't worry. She is not a mad scientist.
At the very least, she's not the kind who'd want to strap you to an examination table and experiment on you.
Still, you should probably watch out.==W== Maybe she's just hiding her obsession behind a respectable facade.
I've known her for a long time, but even now,==W== I still have no idea what's really on her mind...
<size=50>So is she actually normal or not?!</size>
Sigh... Never mind.==W== Back to the point. What exactly is this commission about?
That,==W== I have absolutely no idea.
Apparently it involves confidentiality. She said she would explain the details in person.
But she did explicitly say that there won't be any combat involved, so you don't need to worry about that.
If there's no fighting involved...==W== Then I should be okay going alone, I guess.
Looks like someone's here. Is that the client?
No... Doesn't look like an adult...==W== Is that a lost kid?
Huh? That stray hair looks strangely familiar...
I see...==W== So your wish wasn't about gifts, was it?
Okay... Then, what is your wish?
I wish for ...==W== a friend to play with.
Isn't this the little girl I ran into during the Snowish Festival?
She wants to go inside the Monolith to play again?
Firefly, it's me! Do you remember me?
She doesn't seem to have noticed me.==W== Still, that's a relief. At least she isn't going into the Monolith...
The first time we met, she was running all over the Monolith chasing Stellaroids...==W== Honestly, seeing her with a normal hobby like this is a huge relief.
Is she here by herself? Where's her guardian?
Excuse me, are you the one they call Tyrant?
Nice to meet you. I'm Igna, from the Eye of Grace.
Yes. And it's an honor to meet you.
Looked like you were about to speak to that child...==W== Do you know Firefly?
I see...==W== What an unexpected coincidence.==W== If you don't mind, could you tell me in detail about that meeting?
That's weird. Aren't we going to talk about the commission?
Later, we went into the Monolith together and fought Stellaroids...==W== Anyway, I kinda helped Firefly make her wish come true.
I see. So there was a whole episode like that during the Snowish Festival...
Heh. Then it seems I really did ask the right person for this commission.
... Hm? What do you mean by that?
I mean that, since you already have experience with her, there's clearly no one more suitable for this job than you.
The commission is this:==W== I'd like you to look after Firefly for a while.
Well, it's not as simple as it sounds.
I imagine you've already noticed to some extent that Firefly grew up in a very unusual environment.
Because of that, there are many ways in which she differs from ordinary children...==W== In other words, her sense of what is normal is a little different...
Getting her to behave and listen can be quite a headache—
And that is precisely why I'm asking this of you.==W== Since the two of you already know each other, you really are a very good fit.
I see... If that's all the commission is, then I should be able to handle it on my own.
Come to think of it, Firefly once mentioned she had a mentor.==W== Would that be you?
No, that's someone else. You'll be meeting her soon enough.
I have other matters to attend to, so I'll leave Firefly in your care for now.==W== Once she's had her fill of fun, please take her back to her home in Emor.
<size=50>After explaining the commission, Igna gave me Firefly's address==RT==and told me when we would next meet, then hurried off.</size>

param: You've accepted a commission from Igna and travel to Emor, where you are reunited with Firefly—the young girl you first met during the Snowish Festival.
This time, the client told me to meet them beneath Emor's Monolith...
Surely they're not expecting me to climb it, right?
Since this commission supposedly doesn't involve any fighting, I came alone...==W== Still, the fact that they specifically told me to come by myself feels a little strange...
After all, the one who got me this job was—
Sorry to keep you waiting.==W== So... What did you need me for?
What's with that look on your face? You look like a little lab rat resigned to its fate.==W== If you're really not feeling well, I could give you a full body examination first.
No, no, that's really not necessary.==W== No need for all that. Not today...
Then you can relax. I didn't call you here to help with my research today.
Of course. Though I could always change my mind on the spot.==W== There's no test subject more appealing to me than you.
N-no thanks! Just get to the point already!
If it's not an experiment...==W== Then do you have a commission for me?
That's right. More precisely, it's from an old friend of mine.
Your friend...==W== Is she a doctor, too?
A doctor...==W== More or less.==W== She went to the same university as I did. Her name is Igna.
Have you heard of the Eye of Grace, Tyrant?
The Eye of Grace... If I remember right, it's an academic==RT==research institute under the Grace Imperium, right?
So you do know. Igna currently works there, and apparently the project she's been handling lately is short on people.
For certain reasons, I'm still not in a position to stroll openly through the streets of Emor City...==W== So I recommended you to her instead.
A research project? But I don't have any professional medical background.
Big projects always end up outsourcing...
<size=50>So I'm basically the temp who's gonna get blamed if anything goes wrong?!</size>
Heh. When I think of capable, well-read people, you're the first one who comes to mind.
Though... I do get the feeling she never intended to ask me in the first place.
What she actually asked was whether I knew anyone she could bring in to help. I doubt I was ever under consideration.
So I mentioned you to her just to test the waters,==W== and she immediately got very excited. She told me she absolutely had to work with you.==W== Do you two know each other?
I don't think I've met her...
It seems that your fame precedes you then, Tyrant.
I just never expected so many people to recognize your worth.==W== Heh. Yet here I am, wishing I could keep you all to myself.
... Coming from you, that somehow doesn't make me happy...
Wait a second. Don't tell me this friend of yours is also one of those—
Heh. Don't worry. She is not a mad scientist.
At the very least, she's not the kind who'd want to strap you to an examination table and experiment on you.
Still, you should probably watch out.==W== Maybe she's just hiding her obsession behind a respectable facade.
I've known her for a long time, but even now,==W== I still have no idea what's really on her mind...
<size=50>So is she actually normal or not?!</size>
Sigh... Never mind.==W== Back to the point. What exactly is this commission about?
That,==W== I have absolutely no idea.
Apparently it involves confidentiality. She said she would explain the details in person.
But she did explicitly say that there won't be any combat involved, so you don't need to worry about that.
If there's no fighting involved...==W== Then I should be okay going alone, I guess.
Looks like someone's here. Is that the client?
No... Doesn't look like an adult...==W== Is that a lost kid?
Huh? That stray hair looks strangely familiar...
I see...==W== So your wish wasn't about gifts, was it?
Okay... Then, what is your wish?
I wish for ...==W== a friend to play with.
Isn't this the little girl I ran into during the Snowish Festival?
She wants to go inside the Monolith to play again?
Firefly, it's me! Do you remember me?
She doesn't seem to have noticed me.==W== Still, that's a relief. At least she isn't going into the Monolith...
The first time we met, she was running all over the Monolith chasing Stellaroids...==W== Honestly, seeing her with a normal hobby like this is a huge relief.

Excuse me, are you the one they call Tyrant?

And that is precisely why I'm asking this of you.==W== Since the two of you already know each other, you really are a very good fit.
I see... If that's all the commission is, then I should be able to handle it on my own.
Come to think of it, Firefly once mentioned she had a mentor.==W== Would that be you?
No, that's someone else. You'll be meeting her soon enough.
I have other matters to attend to, so I'll leave Firefly in your care for now.==W== Once she's had her fill of fun, please take her back to her home in Emor.

strings.text: You discover that Firefly has a passion for photography, but she quickly runs out of film and drags you along to the Monolith to make a wish.
... I do. We played together during the Snowish Festival.
I'm honored that you remember me.
I'll be keeping you company for a while.==W== I hope we'll have a great time together.
... Really?==W== Tyrant, you're going to stay with me the whole time?
How long is "the whole time" exactly...?==W== Well, at least until I take you home, I'll stay with you.
Phew... Looks like she's fine with me being around.
By the way, is taking pictures a hobby of yours, Firefly?
Let me think...==W== A hobby is something that makes you so happy you lose track of time.
I know.==W== I press this button.
It goes click-click. Then I'm happy.
Taking pictures makes me happy, too.==W== When I can look at the same thing again.==W== Looking at the pictures makes me happy.
I see. Then this definitely counts as your hobby.
Come on, guys! Make it harder for me!
You run, I chase, so much fun...
Compared to hunting Stellaroids, this is a much healthier hobby...
Firefly, can I see the pictures you took?
The pictures...?==W== They're gone. They won't come out anymore.
Won't come out?==W== Hm...==W== Can I take a look at your photo capturer?
...==W== No,==W== it's not broken.==W== It's just out of film. Do you have any extra film?
I just give the capturer to professor. Professor goes click-clack with it... And the pictures come out.
Sounds like her "professor" has been loading the film for her every time.
But she's been super busy.==W== If I go ask her again...==W== I'll be a trouble.
This film stuff==W== isn't easy to buy outright.==W== Wishing for it at the Monolith might actually be more realistic.

Yeah.==W== There's this Wishing Box that appears inside the Monolith.==W== You recite a prayer,==W== give up some of your memories as the price...==W== And in return, you can obtain an Artifact.==B====W== That's what Trekkers do.
Maybe the film for this capturer originally came from the Wishing Box, too.
If I have film... Then I can take pictures.
Hey, WAIT! What are you doing!?
Go into the Monolith. Find the Wishing Box.
Wait, wait! Hey—the Monolith isn't the kind of place you just walk into!==W== Hey, wait, Firefly—==W==Uhhhhh!!
Director Igna, it's been a while.
Oh, it's you.==W== How unusual to see you outside of the lab. What are you doing in a place like this?
There was something I needed to discuss with you...==W== Though I didn't expect to run into Firefly here.==W== Forgive my bluntness,==W== but are you planning to let that test subject roam free?
Such a valuable sample, and you don't assign any staff to monitor her? You just let her wander around outside alone...==W== If one of my subordinates were this negligent, they'd be fired.
No, a relaxed living environment and moderate contact with other people—==W==both are beneficial to her development. The experimental data have already proven that.
When it comes to a <color=#3faeae>weapon</color>, words alone prove nothing.==W== Only live-testing results can provide trust and stability.
To be frank, you should never have gotten involved in this in the first place.==W== After all, from the very beginning, this has never been your project.
And on top of that, you even let an outsider in on it... What exactly do you think our research is?
If I hadn't stepped in, this project would have been long terminated.==W== Before speaking so bluntly, I suggest you remember your position.
If things had proceeded according to the original plan, all your <color=#bd3059>little secrets</color> would have been exposed already...==W== Hardly an ideal outcome for you, right?
... It seems there's no room for compromise.==W== Then let me get to the point.

After an internal review, we've decided to accelerate the project.==W== If we can't observe clear progress or improved metrics in the near future, we'll have no choice but to take stronger measures.==W== You have now been informed in advance.
No, no.==W== Just a friendly reminder.
Firefly! Wait! Shouldn't we at least let Igna know first?
It's okay. Will be over soon.
That's not the point!==W== Before you do something, you report it first! That's a matter of basic protocol!
I'm just a kid.==W== Can't understand this and that.
Heh. Then let me give you a reminder as well...==W== What happens next will go far beyond your limited imagination.==W== Just now, I acquired my trump card.
Your trump card?==W== ... Don't tell me you mean that Trekker from earlier?==W== Who was that, exactly?
Heh. My goodwill has its limits. I have no obligation to tell you anything more.==W== Be careful... And this isn't a reminder. It's advice.
If you don't want to keep on making fools of yourselves, I suggest you sit back and watch.
So we ended up coming in, after all...
I can float and glide through the air when I hold Firefly's hand... How does this even work?==W== Is it because of this?
<size=30>Well, now that we are here...</size>==W== If we want to get film, the first thing we need to do is find the Wishing Box.
There probably isn't one on the ground floor.==W== We'll need to clear out the Stellaroids and try our luck on the higher levels—
No time to play today.==W== Bye-bye.
The Stellaroids were wiped out in an instant...!
Wait, that was too fast!==W== Don't you need to catch your breath at all...?!
Firefly... I know you're in a hurry, but could you maybe be a little more careful?
... You seem to be in a hurry. Did something happen?
... Have to get back before professor notices.
I entered Monolith, but didn't ask.
Hm? So if they find out you snuck off on your own, you'll get scolded?
... I don't want her to ... not like me.
We made it, Firefly.==W== Look, the Wishing Box. That is what we came for.
Tyrant, Tyrant, how do I get film?
Don't worry, Firefly.==W== I'll make a Wish for you.
Waaah—==W==Tyrant, you really are very, very nice.
... and so kind to me, too.

strings.text: You meet Firefly's guardian, Canace, who leads you to Grace Light Academy. There, she reveals the truth behind Firefly's identity...
Finally heading back... Let's hope we don't run into any more trouble.
Glad you're having fun, but keep an eye on your film, okay?
We went through a lot to get that film. It'd be a shame to use it up all at once.
Ah, sorry. I should've said it sooner.
We can't. We snuck into the Monolith to begin with, so we need to head back today.
Besides, you don't want professor to worry, do you?
I can feel it. Professor is nearby.
Firefly...!==W== Honestly, where did you run off to? I've been looking everywhere.
You know lying is wrong. I searched everywhere before finding you here.
Not lying. I really did take pictures...
You did, did you?==W== Oh...==W== I see. You were doing something else too, weren't you?
Didn't we agree? No going into the Monolith without permission.
==W==Excuse me.==W== I know this is sudden, but may I say a few words?
Firefly had a good reason ... for going inside.
I'm ==PLAYER_NAME==, CEO of Boss Accord. Igna asked me to look after Firefly.
I see. You're the one Igna mentioned...
I should introduce myself, too.==W== I'm Canace.==W== Firefly's guardian, and a professor at Grace Light Academy.
Igna filled me in on you.==B====W== Though she kept it brief. It was more of a one-sided notice.
Igna was just as concise when briefing me on the job... Is that her usual style?
I know it was her call, but handing Firefly over to a complete stranger worried me...
Professor. Don't be mean to Tyrant.
Tyrant is nice to me. We even played together.
... Apologies for my bluntness.==W== Her situation is complicated, but if she's defending you, you must be trustworthy.
Since you brought it up, please explain something for me—why did you two enter the Monolith?
Firefly ran out of film for her photo capturer. We went to wish for more.
Not that it excuses sneaking in, of course.==W== We both owe you an apology!
For what it's worth, she only did it to avoid troubling you.
I'm sorry, Firefly. I've been swamped lately and completely forgot about your film.
It's the film's fault. It ran out too fast.
Heh, alright. Nobody's to blame.==W== Let's drop it.
She must have been a handful.
Don't sweat it. It's part of the job.
Actually, hearing her call you Tyrant rings a bell.==W== She's mentioned you before.
You kept her company during the Snowish Festival, didn't you?==W== Thank you. She had a wonderful time.
Playing with Tyrant is fun.==W== That means Tyrant is a good person.
Heh. You certainly have a way of winning people over. You're a perfect fit.
Igna had her reasons for sending you here...
But that's a conversation for later.==W== Let's get back to campus before dark.
So this is Grace Light Academy…==RT==The largest and most prestigious school in Nova.
It's every scholar's dream to study here.
I think Minova and I sat in on a lecture here once...
Iris always dreamed of seeing this sanctuary of knowledge...
I believe Firenze went to school here too...
I've never spent a day as a student, yet here I am on campus again...
Professor Canace! Do you have a second? I have a few questions...!
Professor, I'm still stuck on that paper you reviewed. Could we go over it again?
Sorry. I'm tied up at the moment.
I have a guest today. We can go over your questions after class tomorrow.
Your students certainly love you, professor.
I do try to be a good professor.==W== But it's costing me my sleep.
Professor never sleeps. Lately she went from busy to super busy.
Haha. I am stretched a bit thin lately. It's starting to affect my actual work...
You're a lifesaver for taking Igna's commission.
Please, have a seat.==W== We need to talk.
Firefly, go play over there for a bit, okay? ==PLAYER_NAME== and I have something important to discuss.
Her room. I blocked off an area where she can run wild.
Right now it's a disaster zone. Photos, snacks, toys everywhere.==W== Sigh... I'm afraid I'll have to ask for your help to clean that up, too.
You're so reliable. Should've brought you on board sooner.
Alright, back to business. You've got questions written all over your face.==W== Ask away. I'll answer whatever I can.
To be honest... Except for the commission details, Igna gave me nothing else.
She didn't mention her connection to you, or to Firefly. I'm completely in the dark here.
You run, I chase, so much fun...
She treats Stellaroids like chew toys...==W== It makes absolutely no sense. Even veteran Trekkers can't do that...
Tell me what's going on with Firefly—whatever you're allowed to share.==B====W== All I know is that her combat skills and personality are ... unconventional.
Before I answer that... How much do you know about Igna's line of work?
The friend who introduced me to this commission mentioned that she's a researcher for the Eye of Grace. Supposedly running some kind of research project.
We're technically colleagues under the Grace Imperium, but she handles the core projects. Meanwhile, I'm but an ordinary teacher.
Colleagues or not, we live in different worlds.==W== Our paths should never have crossed.
But right now, we're working together to protect Firefly, to free her from the Eye of Grace's control.
Protect her? Free her? What do you mean?
Since you're going to be spending more time with Firefly, there's no point keeping you in the dark.
I'll give it to you straight.==W== The truth is... Firefly—
—used to be an experimental weapon for the Eye of Grace.

Haha. I am stretched a bit thin lately. It's starting to affect my actual work...
You're a lifesaver for taking Igna's commission.
Please, have a seat.==W== We need to talk.
Firefly, go play over there for a bit, okay? ==PLAYER_NAME== and I have something important to discuss.
Her room. I blocked off an area where she can run wild.
Right now it's a disaster zone. Photos, snacks, toys everywhere.==W== Sigh... I'm afraid I'll have to ask for your help to clean that up, too.
You're so reliable. Should've brought you on board sooner.
Alright, back to business. You've got questions written all over your face.==W== Ask away. I'll answer whatever I can.
To be honest... Except for the commission details, Igna gave me nothing else.
She didn't mention her connection to you, or to Firefly. I'm completely in the dark here.
You run, I chase, so much fun...
She treats Stellaroids like chew toys...==W== It makes absolutely no sense. Even veteran Trekkers can't do that...
Tell me what's going on with Firefly—whatever you're allowed to share.==B====W== All I know is that her combat skills and personality are ... unconventional.
Before I answer that... How much do you know about Igna's line of work?
The friend who introduced me to this commission mentioned that she's a researcher for the Eye of Grace. Supposedly running some kind of research project.
We're technically colleagues under the Grace Imperium, but she handles the core projects. Meanwhile, I'm but an ordinary teacher.
Colleagues or not, we live in different worlds.==W== Our paths should never have crossed.
But right now, we're working together to protect Firefly, to free her from the Eye of Grace's control.
Protect her? Free her? What do you mean?
Since you're going to be spending more time with Firefly, there's no point keeping you in the dark.
I'll give it to you straight.==W== The truth is... Firefly—
—used to be an experimental weapon for the Eye of Grace.

strings.text: It turns out Firefly is a test subject taken in by the Eye of Grace for the development of a secret weapon. Canace and Igna managed to bring her out, but thawing her frozen heart is the real battle…
Firefly was==W== an "experimental weapon" for the Eye of Grace?
I was investigating the Monolith alone when I stumbled across her.
At first, I thought she was a lost kid who'd wandered inside. I was about to escort her out...==W== But soon I realized something was wrong.
She was chasing Stellaroids around like it was a game of tag.
Hey! How did an outsider get in here?
Probably just a Trekker trying to climb the Monolith. The interior layout shifts. Even with the entrance sealed, a few rats always slip through.
Hey! This is a Grace Imperium testing ground. Unauthorized personnel need to clear out, you hear me?!
That encounter ignited my curiosity as a scholar... I started keeping an eye on her.
I launched a quiet investigation, pulling every string from my university days to source intel on the Eye of Grace...
What I eventually unearthed ... was Project Firefly.
A black-ops program inside the Eye of Grace. They were trying to build a "superweapon." But the resulting power was too massive to control.
To anchor that power, they needed a specific kind of test subject. A child with a pure mind and an unbreakable psyche.
They burned through a fortune scouring the Nova Continent for the perfect candidate. And guess who they found...
Forget it. Pull the plug on today's run.
The telemetry is all over the place. We can run the numbers back at the lab, but don't hold your breath.
Oh, give it a rest. If asking the subject actually worked, they wouldn't need to pay us.
At this rate, we're all getting the axe anyway. When was the last time her output actually spiked?
The day she took an interest in the monitors, I think. We even gave her a photo capturer to play with.
But that peak only lasted a few days before plummeting right back to baseline.
We tried giving her other toys after that… But, well, you saw what happened.
Dang it. What are we supposed to put in the report? If we keep stalling on deliverables, the board is going to—
Wait, someone's coming. Is that... Director Igna?
Internal Investigations? What's she doing down here?
Word around the office is you're burning through funds on a ... fascinating little project.
Handing them a superweapon would certainly make you untouchable here.==W== Shame my recent audits suggest you're nowhere close to pulling it off.
If you don't mind, perhaps I could put in a good word with the higher-ups.
Can't believe they had experiments like that running...
From what I've gathered, the procedures weren't physically harmful, but the psychological toll was devastating.
They can call her the perfect vessel all they want.==W== But at the end of the day, she was still just a kid—
Locked in a lab all day before she could even form a sense of self...==W== It'd completely warp her personality.
Back then, Firefly was more machine than human.==W== Or rather, she tried to kill her own emotions and become one, just to survive.
Children learn how the world works from the adults around them.

If she hadn't shut down entirely, she would've lost her mind. Why was she the only one trapped there and had to suffer alone every single day?==W== How is a child supposed to process that? Especially when no one would give her an answer.
It was. The whole experiment was inhumane... A betrayal of everything a scholar stands for. I couldn't look the other way.
Once I uncovered the truth, I marched straight to her lab to shut it down.
Looking back, it was a reckless move...==W== But luckily it didn't end in disaster.
This is a restricted lab! No unauthorized personnel!
What is security doing?! Throw her out!
Seeing as I'm taking full control of Project Firefly today...==W== What happens to the test subject is entirely up to me.
I've already briefed the higher-ups on your project's progress. Management values this initiative. So much so, they sent me to clean up your mess.
Here's the transfer order. Signed and stamped.
That's impossible! Let me see that!
It... It's real. How is this possible?
B-But this is our research! Our life's work! You can't just steal it!
Complain all you want. Your whining changes nothing. It's just how the rules work.
If you can't create value, you're no better than a hen that won't lay.==W== But don't worry—you did manage one egg. I'll take it from here and hatch it.
You absolute thief... Have you no shame as a scholar?!
Professor Canace, ignore their tantrums. Just do what you came here to do.
I simply see potential in you. Let's hope you can get this stalled project moving again.
You aren't like these stubborn fools. A true researcher embraces the unknown, right?
I'm Canace. I'm a professor at Grace Light Academy.
I'm here to get you out of this place. Do you want to come with me?
And that's how Firefly and I first met.
Igna and I pulled Firefly out of that lab, hoping to give her a normal life.
I handle her living and schooling. Igna acts as our backup, keeping the Eye of Grace off our backs.
Firefly still has to go in for regular "testing," but her life is much more normal now.
Her numbers climbed steadily for a while before they ...==W== flatlined again.
No, nothing.==W== And that's the problem. A safe environment alone isn't enough to fix everything.
Igna thinks Firefly's subconsciously holding back. Her past trauma is capping her progress. Her lack of emotion has become the biggest bottleneck for the experiment.
I've heard magic is tied to the user's emotions...
Exactly. That's the basis for Igna's theory.
Right or wrong, if she stays stuck like this... Sooner or later—
Yes. The only reason we've kept her out this long is by pretending we're still advancing their research.
I want her to grow up healthy, like a normal kid. I've been racking my brain trying to help her open up. And then ... it hit me—
The only place Firefly feels happy is inside the Monolith, surrounded by danger.
Back then, field tests in the Monolith were her only escape from the lab. No painful experiments. To Firefly, fighting Stellaroids was her only free time.
So during the Snowish Festival, when she dragged Laru and me into the Monolith... She was trying to relax in the only way she knew how.
... Wait. Doesn't Firefly love taking pictures? Couldn't that help her open up?
If we can get her to stop burying her emotions, her numbers should go back up, right?
I'm ashamed to admit it, but as her guardian, I only realized this recently. I knew she liked capturer back in the lab, but I figured it was a fluke. Just a kid staring at a shiny new toy.
But recently, I watched her snapping photos of the scenery... And she actually looked happy.
I think... Or at least, I want to believe ... that it's a sign of healing.
I regret missing the signs until now...
It's alright. We still have time.
... You're right. Especially with a capable assistant by my side.
I suspect it already. My company alone isn't enough to help her grow.
I may be a "teacher" to her now, but I'm still far from becoming her "friend." Besides, my work leaves me with barely any time for her.
That's why I need a favor, ==PLAYER_NAME==. Will you be Firefly's friend?
You're the only other grown-up she lets in. She trusts you.
I see...==W== So your wish wasn't about gifts, was it?
Okay... Then, what is your wish?
I wish for ...==W== a friend to play with.
I had no idea back then...
I didn't expect a simple wish for having a friend to mean the world to her.
Things look bleak, which is why I need you. Everything we do is for Firefly.
When you put it like that, there is no reason for me to refuse.
I'm more than happy to be her friend.
What a relief. I think I can finally sleep well tonight.

strings.text: You're officially Firefly's new friend. Canace gets called away, leaving you alone to look after Firefly. To cheer her up, you head back to the Monolith to wish for more film.
When you put it like that, there is no reason for me to refuse. I'm more than happy to be her friend.
Thank you, ==PLAYER_NAME==... What a relief. I think I can finally sleep well tonight.
... Firefly? When did you get here?
Mhm. I want to be with you, too.
She probably heard us. I wonder how she feels about it?
Do you remember your wish from last year's Snowish Festival?
That's right.==W== Well... How would you feel about me being your friend?
Really? Tyrant, you want to be my friend?
I'd love to, if you'll have me.
Wow... Tyrant and I are friends!
You haven't smiled ... in a long time.
Ah… Heh. Some professor I am. Now I have you worrying about me.
I owe you and Igna. With you here, I can finally catch my breath.
Of all the times to call...
... Igna. This is a surprise. You never call me first.
... What's wrong? Give me the details—==W==wait, what?!
Those power-hungry frauds... They don't deserve to call themselves researchers!
We'll talk when I get there.
Sorry, you two. An emergency came up. I have to leave for a while.
A few days, probably...==W== Sigh... I'll have to cancel those lectures I promised my students.
Firefly, give us a minute. We need to discuss work.
Is that Igna? What's going on?
Sigh... Where do I even begin?
The lab is trying to regain control of the project. They want Firefly back.
Are they using her "bottleneck" as an excuse?
Yes. I bet they exaggerated in their reports to the higher-ups and acted on their own.... She is just an object to them. They don't care how she feels.
Igna and I are handling the lab. I need you to watch Firefly for me.
The rules I give her—like never entering the Monolith alone—are meant to keep her out of trouble...
But she's in your hands now. You call the shots. Trust your judgment and do what you think is best.
No problem. I promise to do my best.
Ah... I think she heard us.
... It's fine. She understands more than she lets on.
I need to go. Firefly, make sure you listen to Tyrant, okay?
I talk a big game about doing my best... What am I supposed to do now?
Sherlock pajamas? They look cute on you.
Because Sherlock is cute. I have photos and dolls, too. Want to take a look while we eat professor's snacks?
No rush. Take your time. We can hang out until bedtime.
Looks like your photo capturer's out of film.==W== What else do you do for fun?
Professor shows me how to draw and write.
Professor says to start by "getting to know yourself."
She draws me, and I draw her.
That sounds a lot like taking photos.
Drawings of you and Canace? I'd love to see them.
Is this a bunny? Why is it wearing an eyepatch?
Not a bunny. It's professor's drawing of me.
My eye got injured. Professor says it looks cool this way.
I see. She drew it that way to make her feel better...
I have to agree! It's cool, but cute too. Great drawing.
What does your drawing of professor look like?
Pfft... This Canace looks pretty fierce.
That's professor getting mad after my prank.
But drawing is hard. I'm bad at it.
I think you're a natural. Art is all about capturing a feeling, and you nailed it.
Would I lie to you?==W== Hey, why don't we draw something together?
It's been two days since Canace left. Firefly and I are getting pretty close.
No major disasters, either. Not to brag, but we're basically best buds at this point.
Do we naturally click...==W== Or am I secretly a babysitting prodigy?!
Still, Canace's total radio silence is starting to worry me.
Firefly has to be getting anxious with her gone this long...
Ahem...==W== Alright, Firefly! What should we play today?
Hmm? Wanna draw some more? Or we could play with the toys—
... I'm sorry. I don't know where Canace is either. I can't reach her phone.
She isn't answering my texts either.
Hey, Firefly. Wanna go out for a bit? We can take some photos.
We'll go to the Monolith and wish for more.
... But professor said I can't go in alone.
She said that because if something happened, no one would be there to help you.
I'm not much of a fighter, but I can watch your back and get us out safely if things go wrong. I'll explain everything to her later. What do you say?
Did you miss me? Let's play.
I'll never get used to how strong she is...
She comes alive inside the Monolith.==W== It's like a playground to her.
Are you having fun playing with the Stellaroids?
Did you play with Stellaroids before you lived with Canace?
Yeah. Before, I only got to go outside one day a month.
I got to fly around and play with all sorts of things...
The grown-ups called it ... "comet raining"? I don't know what that means.
I don't like the experiments. My head hurts. I always feel sick.
But fighting Stellaroids doesn't hurt. It's fun.
The more I hear, the sicker it makes me.
Treating an innocent kid like a lab rat...==W== It's unforgivable.
Tyrant is my friend. Nobody hurts ==SEX4==.
I'm fine. Got careless. Thought you already wiped them all out.
That's weird. It feels different today. There are ...==W== way too many toys.
Someone calling for help? A Trekker?
Firefly, let's go check it out!

strings.text: This is the first time Firefly saves someone. She experiences emotions unlike any she has ever known. Just then, a disheveled Canace appears before you both...
Oh, thank goodness...==W== Thank you! Thank you both!
I thought we were goners... I swear I saw my grandpa waving me over.
Ugh, don't say that... But did you see her? She was incredible! She swooped in, went bam-bam-bam, and wiped out every single Stellaroid!
Thank you, sweetie! We wouldn't have made it without you!
She seems to have no idea how to respond to that.
Her situation involves the <color=#3faeae>secret experiment</color> of the Eye of Grace, I need a cover story before they start asking about anything deeper...
Just a few scrapes. You got here right in the nick of time.
We are. I'm ==PLAYER_NAME==, and this is Firefly.
Whoa. Isn't she a little young for this line of work?
She majors in Monolith Studies. We're out here on a field trip...
When we're actually here to fetch film.
She might be young, but you saw her out there. No need to worry!
Fair enough. She completely outclasses us.
Oh, before I forget. We found the Wishing Box for this floor earlier. It's yours.
Please, take it! Consider it a thank-you gift. If Firefly hadn't stepped in, we'd be permanent residents of this Monolith.
Looks like today's our lucky day, Firefly!
Same here. We got what we came for.
Great. No Artifact is worth dying for.
Man, the God of Grace must be furious today. Picked a hell of a day to come down here... Talk about rotten luck.
What do you mean? Did you see something unusual?
The Stellaroids are swarming today. Lots of heavy hitters, too. We dive this Monolith all the time... But I've never seen it this treacherous.
Firefly said the same thing... Something's definitely wrong with the Monolith today.==W==
... Tyrant, I want to take a picture.
But if I take pictures of everything, the film will run out again...
There's no rush. Look around first. It's better to wait for a meaningful moment—something you want to capture—before you hit the shutter.
Yeah. How do I explain this...
Let's put it this way. Look around. Is there anything special here you'd want to see again?
Around...? The twinkling stars are pretty.
But there are stars outside too... So it's not that special.
Guess nothing else stands out...==W== Wait, I've got an idea!
A photo?==W== Sure! It'll make a great souvenir.
What? With my face covered in dust?==W== Well... Why not. We'll laugh about this someday.

But ... I've never taken a picture of anyone.
It's always other people taking pictures of me.
Data recorded. We're done for today.
The numbers are solid. We might actually see that project bonus this year.
Of course. Firefly is our most promising test subject. She's our ...==W== "hope."
Let's hope she keeps it up. If her progress stalls for too long, we'll all be out of a job.

The picture isn't what's making us smile...
Don't waste your breath on a kid.
We already backed up the data. If she's that curious, let her have a copy.

What's wrong? You keep staring at the Photo Capturer. Don't tell me you want it?
... Is she actually showing interest in the Photo Capturer?
Let her have it. I want to run another reading while she reacts.
Photo Capturer snap snap. But... Can't smile...

Did I do something wrong? Am I ... weird?
No, of course not. You have feelings like everyone else... Like any other kid.
You simply haven't found them yet. You locked your feelings away to protect yourself.==W== But one day, that lock will break open...
Let me see...==W== Oh, not bad at all.
Pfft! Your eyes are half-closed!==W== That's hilarious!
I just look like that! Leave me alone!
... I think I'm starting to get it.
What Tyrant said about finding what I want to capture.
Looking at this picture makes me happy. I feel warm inside...
Igna thinks Firefly's subconsciously holding back. Her past trauma is capping her progress. Her lack of emotion has become the biggest bottleneck for the experiment.
I think... Or at least, I want to believe ... that it's a sign of healing.
This is amazing, Canace! Firefly is actually taking a step forward, all on her own!
It's a shame Canace isn't here. The look on Firefly's face... I wish she could see it.
I actually feel different...==W== Tyrant, why is that?
It means you're connecting with them. Their joy reached your heart through the picture.
And they're smiling right now because of you.
Hey, kiddo! Thanks for saving us today! You should come over to our place sometime!
Yeah, and thanks for the great photo!==W== You have to let us treat you to a nice meal.
Aww, is Firefly feeling shy?==W== Adorable! Seriously, you should come join our crew!
Haha, we never say no to a skilled Trekker. We should talk it over at that meal. See you later, Firefly.
Coming out here was a good idea, wasn't it, Firefly?
I'll explain later! Get Firefly out of here!

param: This is the first time Firefly saves someone. She experiences emotions unlike any she has ever known. Just then, a disheveled Canace appears before you both...
Oh, thank goodness...==W== Thank you! Thank you both!
I thought we were goners... I swear I saw my grandpa waving me over.
Ugh, don't say that... But did you see her? She was incredible! She swooped in, went bam-bam-bam, and wiped out every single Stellaroid!
Thank you, sweetie! We wouldn't have made it without you!
She seems to have no idea how to respond to that.
Her situation involves the <color=#3faeae>secret experiment</color> of the Eye of Grace, I need a cover story before they start asking about anything deeper...
Just a few scrapes. You got here right in the nick of time.
We are. I'm ==PLAYER_NAME==, and this is Firefly.
Whoa. Isn't she a little young for this line of work?
She majors in Monolith Studies. We're out here on a field trip...
When we're actually here to fetch film.
She might be young, but you saw her out there. No need to worry!
Fair enough. She completely outclasses us.
Oh, before I forget. We found the Wishing Box for this floor earlier. It's yours.
Please, take it! Consider it a thank-you gift. If Firefly hadn't stepped in, we'd be permanent residents of this Monolith.
Looks like today's our lucky day, Firefly!
Same here. We got what we came for.
Great. No Artifact is worth dying for.
Man, the God of Grace must be furious today. Picked a hell of a day to come down here... Talk about rotten luck.
What do you mean? Did you see something unusual?
The Stellaroids are swarming today. Lots of heavy hitters, too. We dive this Monolith all the time... But I've never seen it this treacherous.
Firefly said the same thing... Something's definitely wrong with the Monolith today.==W==
