strings.text: Stellaroids surge forth in an overwhelming wave that even Firefly cannot withstand. To protect her, people fall one by one... At the final moment, Firefly's weapon begins to glow.
Took days, but I finally caught their trail.==W== Is the Eye of Grace actually about to make a move?
No hard proof, but they've petitioned the board. They're already mobilizing in the shadows, not even waiting for approval.
If they drag Firefly back to the lab, they'll resort to extreme measures. They won't stop until they bleed her dry.
Firefly is a rare success. She's the perfect candidate to wield Avalanche.
Shatter her mind, and Avalanche becomes scrap metal. A fact that those fools still fail to grasp.
But enough complaining.==W== My point is, my hands are tied. If they weaponize Eye of Grace protocols against me, I can't intervene in time.
That's why I need outsiders like you and that Tyrant to step in.
... Understood. What do you need me to do?
Keep Firefly away from the Monolith.==W== I've seen tech that can warp the environment inside.==W== If they deploy it, the tower becomes a death trap.
Other than that, don't panic. Stick to your normal routine until this blows over.
... We have a problem. I already left Firefly in Tyrant's care. I even cleared them to enter the Monolith.
Sorry, I need to head back. I have a terrible feeling about this...
... Of course. My hunches are never wrong.
This Stellaroid surge... Someone is behind it.
Are you dealing with a swarm too?
Yes, it is a nightmare out there.==W== Long story short, we need to leave. Now.
... It's not just the Stellaroids. The Monolith itself is changing.
This is the exact same floor! Why are we back here?
You're still here? I figure you're safely outside by now.
We are trying to leave... But we keep ending up back here. It makes no sense.
This is like a Stella Drama I've seen recently!==W== Do we have to find a specific Exit No. X or something?
But the real showstopper is this Stellaroid parade.
Seeing this many in one place is a total spectacle.==W== Don't tell me we have to fight through all of them.
Just the thought makes me dizzy.
How do we even break through this?
No, Firefly! There're too many! You won't last!
What do you mean she won't last?
... Her weapon, Avalanche. Its power comes at a massive cost. It will take a severe toll on her body.==W== She's too young to keep this up for long.
Then we back her up. We do whatever we can to help.
These Stellaroids on me...==W== They're so heavy...==W==
There're too many for you to fight alone. We need to stick together and break through.
Why...? Don't you believe in me?==W== I can do it. I'll keep everyone safe...
We do believe in you. Everyone here is counting on you—because you matter to us.
You do. Don't forget, you're one of us now. You're fighting to protect everyone—so let us protect you, too.
As the battle wears on, Firefly unleashes force with a ferocity==RT==none has seen before.
The group carves through wave after wave of enemies,==RT==shattering the Stellaroid encirclement and pushing toward the exit.
She's pale as a ghost...==W== Canace was right to worry.
Using it that many times in a row... The mental toll is unimaginable.
The Stellaroids are regrouping! We're gonna get surrounded again!
So I am actually ... that tired...
Forget it. Pull the plug on today's run.
The telemetry is all over the place. We can run the numbers back at the lab, but don't hold your breath.
Oh, give it a rest. If asking the subject actually worked, they wouldn't need to pay us.
Every day... It <color=#bd3059>hurts</color>... And I felt so <color=#bd3059>sad</color>...
Honestly... I <color=#bd3059>hated</color> it... I <color=#bd3059>hated</color> all of it...
Listen to me, Firefly. You don't need to force a smile. Every day in that place was nothing but pain. If anything...==W== You have every right to cry.
Cry...?==W== But ... the tears won't come.
Did I do something wrong? Am I ... weird?
No, of course not. You have feelings like everyone else... Like any other kid.
You simply haven't found them yet. You locked your feelings away to protect yourself.==W== But one day, that lock will break open...
When it hurts... When it's unbearable... I want to cry.
You're not laying a finger on Firefly!
Heh, perfect timing. Didn't think we'd return the favor this fast.
Grandpa always said you can run from a debt, but you pay back a favor while you're still breathing!
Haha, you are right... We must keep little Firefly safe.
Hey, stay with me!==W== No, we're overrun... I have to at least get Firefly out—
... Everyone's going down ... because of me...
I won't forgive anyone who hurts professor.
So ... listen to me. Wake up.
Fight with me... We have to protect the people who "matter"!==B====W== This time, it's no playing games.

strings.text: Firefly saves everyone and collapses weakly into your arms, yet a natural smile graces her face. You decide to capture this precious moment.
Not enough... I can keep going...
But it feels ... different this time.
It hurts ... but I don't hate it...
Avalanche's output is off the charts...!==W== Did Firefly ... push past her own limits?
Firefly! Do you know who I am?
Are you injured? Does it hurt anywhere?
My head ... hurts a little... But...
I wasn't playing around this time...
I fought ... with everything I had...
You did. Your courage saved us all.
You smiled. It looked completely natural.
Yeah. It was a cute smile, too.
You can't look directly at your own face.
That's what the Photo Capturer is for.
Then... Will you take the photo, Tyrant?
Ah, wait... I have something to say...
... I feel the exact same way.
Professor...==W== Am I an "ordinary kid" now?
Well... Hehe, I can't give you a perfect score just yet. You're still growing, after all.
But I promise you this... You are the student I am the proudest of.
You're proud of me... I'm so happy.
And you're ... the best professor in the world... Does that make you happy?
Of course. That is the best thing I've ever heard.
And Tyrant... You're my first friend. My best friend.
Thank you ... for always playing with me...
But ...==W== I can't stay awake... I'm ... sleepy...
She's fading fast...! We have to leave the Monolith now! If we don't—

strings.text: By her own strength, Firefly has broken free from the shackles of the experiments and reclaimed her true self. With you and Canace by her side, she is sure to grow healthily...
Don't worry. Not a scratch on her, and her breathing is steady. She's unconscious from exhaustion.
Just a while ago, we escaped the Monolith and carried an unconscious Firefly back to Canace's office.
I dropped everything the second the report came in.
I have the full picture. Thank you for keeping Firefly safe.
It's the other way around. Firefly saved us.
Even so, without you there, I doubt she'd make it out alone.
That Monolith was Firefly's training ground. Tampering with its internal space alters the Stellaroid count... Someone is clearly weaponizing the technology.
... Is this whole disaster the work of the people trying to capture her?
We need more concrete evidence, but I know who's behind this.
Ironically, this crisis yields the perfect outcome. Her emotional bond with you triggers a massive breakthrough.
Her new combat data shatters every previous record. The numbers speak for themselves.
No one handles Avalanche better than Firefly.
For us, this is excellent news. For certain others... It's a nightmare.
Precisely. Right now, they're likely shaking in their boots back at the lab.
They staked their careers on defying the higher-ups and proved nothing but their incompetence. Their credibility at the Eye of Grace is shot.
They will pay for this. I'm launching an internal investigation to ensure this never happens again.
Also, I want Firefly in a specialized facility. Once she recovers, we'll run a full checkup.
That'd be best.==W== Give me a minute.==W== Let me pack and we'll go together.==W==
Before we do, there's an important matter to discuss...==W== About Firefly's future. Her living situation and education.
Asking you to take her in was a stopgap. After this incident, her safety is fully guaranteed.
Professor Canace, you're busy. Perhaps it's time to entrust Firefly to someone else reliable?
The data proves she needs a healthy, unrestricted environment to reach her potential.
You have my word: she won't suffer any mistreatment in her new home.
... Heh. I'm with the Eye of Grace. It's only natural you don't trust me.
You've got it wrong. That's not what I meant...
If you have concerns, we can sign a magical contract.
I offer an environment where her talents can flourish—along with a much better life than the one she's living.
Care to share your thoughts, Tyrant?
Should we really dictate her future without asking her first?
I think we need to respect Firefly's wishes.
I agree. Let her decide for herself when she wakes up then.
Though I'm afraid the outcome is already set in stone...
Sorry to keep you waiting. I didn't think it'd take this long.
Don't worry. I'm not leaving until Firefly's situation is settled.
I wouldn't be able to sleep if I left without knowing she was okay.
How are you feeling? Everything okay?
I have enough energy to stay up and play with Tyrant all night!
Seeing how close you all are... Heh. Makes me a bit jealous.
Igna, thank you for treating Firefly.
I am merely fulfilling my duties. Ultimately, this incident is a "lapse" on our organization's part.
So, what about Firefly's custody? Has a decision been made?
Firefly is here of her own free will.==W== That is her answer.
I want to stay with professor and Tyrant.
Then I won't intrude any further...==W== Before I leave, I have a word of caution for you both.
We may have guaranteed Firefly the life she wants, but the surveillance won't stop.
As long as she controls Avalanche, the Eye of Grace will regard her as a dangerous weapon. Absolute freedom is out of the question.
No. Firefly isn't a weapon anymore.
From now on, she's an ordinary little girl.
If anything like this ever happens again, I'll put a stop to it.==W== Me ... and ==PLAYER_NAME==.
I'll be there in a heartbeat.==W== No matter what, Firefly's life is her own.
Igna,==W== I want to thank you again.
We couldn't have saved Firefly without you.
You're welcome. I gained a great deal from this as well.
... And the best part was getting to know you.
I like to line up my trump cards in advance. Expect more commissions from me in the future.==W== I hope you won't turn me down.
Igna...==W== You never know what she's thinking.
I've known her longer, but she's still a mystery to me.
I'm sure you've noticed: Igna treats Firefly well, but likely only because she's a valuable test subject—not because she cares about her.
We fundamentally disagree there, making it hard for me to trust her.
As long as we know she won't hurt Firefly, that's enough for me. We can't expect everyone to think like us.
Yeah. Mission accomplished, so I'm heading out tomorrow. Everyone at the New Star Guild is probably worried about me.
Professor, Firefly, Tyrant... We stay together.
Thanks, Firefly... But I have to go back.
Firefly. I know how you feel, but you have to be reasonable.

==PLAYER_NAME== is an amazing Trekker with a duty to help people. That means traveling all over the Nova Continent. If you're ==SEX3== true friend, you won't get in the way of ==SEX3== work. You know that, don't you?
Tyrant is Firefly's only friend. If we say goodbye... I will be lonely.
I'll always be your friend, no matter where I am. And it won't be long before we see each other again.
Didn't Canace just say? A Trekker's job is to travel everywhere. I can come visit you anytime I want.
Yep. Plus, Emor is the center of the continent. I'll pass through all the time—==W==whoa?!
If you're leaving tomorrow, Tyrant, we're playing tonight! I won't let you sleep!
Wait, you were serious about staying up all night?!
Sigh... Alright, you win. The three of us are having a slumber party tonight!
A slum-ber par-ty? What's that? It sounds fun... Let's do that.
Heh. Looks like we'll be seeing a lot of each other. I'll be counting on your help until Firefly grows up.
... You know, you've done a lot for us lately, and I haven't properly thanked you.
It was a coincidence, but I'm grateful it was you who found Firefly.
I should be thanking you. Firefly is my best friend, too.
And so, the girl who once closed herself off begins a new chapter in her life—
—taking her first step toward becoming an ordinary girl...

param: By her own strength, Firefly has broken free from the shackles of the experiments and reclaimed her true self. With you and Canace by her side, she is sure to grow healthily...
Don't worry. Not a scratch on her, and her breathing is steady. She's unconscious from exhaustion.
Just a while ago, we escaped the Monolith and carried an unconscious Firefly back to Canace's office.
I dropped everything the second the report came in.
I have the full picture. Thank you for keeping Firefly safe.
It's the other way around. Firefly saved us.
Even so, without you there, I doubt she'd make it out alone.
That Monolith was Firefly's training ground. Tampering with its internal space alters the Stellaroid count... Someone is clearly weaponizing the technology.
... Is this whole disaster the work of the people trying to capture her?
We need more concrete evidence, but I know who's behind this.
Ironically, this crisis yields the perfect outcome. Her emotional bond with you triggers a massive breakthrough.
Her new combat data shatters every previous record. The numbers speak for themselves.
No one handles Avalanche better than Firefly.
For us, this is excellent news. For certain others... It's a nightmare.
Precisely. Right now, they're likely shaking in their boots back at the lab.
They staked their careers on defying the higher-ups and proved nothing but their incompetence. Their credibility at the Eye of Grace is shot.
They will pay for this. I'm launching an internal investigation to ensure this never happens again.
Also, I want Firefly in a specialized facility. Once she recovers, we'll run a full checkup.
That'd be best.==W== Give me a minute.==W== Let me pack and we'll go together.==W==
Before we do, there's an important matter to discuss...==W== About Firefly's future. Her living situation and education.
Asking you to take her in was a stopgap. After this incident, her safety is fully guaranteed.
Professor Canace, you're busy. Perhaps it's time to entrust Firefly to someone else reliable?
The data proves she needs a healthy, unrestricted environment to reach her potential.
You have my word: she won't suffer any mistreatment in her new home.
... Heh. I'm with the Eye of Grace. It's only natural you don't trust me.
You've got it wrong. That's not what I meant...
If you have concerns, we can sign a magical contract.
I offer an environment where her talents can flourish—along with a much better life than the one she's living.
Care to share your thoughts, Tyrant?
Should we really dictate her future without asking her first?
I think we need to respect Firefly's wishes.
I agree. Let her decide for herself when she wakes up then.
Though I'm afraid the outcome is already set in stone...
Sorry to keep you waiting. I didn't think it'd take this long.
Don't worry. I'm not leaving until Firefly's situation is settled.
I wouldn't be able to sleep if I left without knowing she was okay.
How are you feeling? Everything okay?
I have enough energy to stay up and play with Tyrant all night!
Seeing how close you all are... Heh. Makes me a bit jealous.
Igna, thank you for treating Firefly.
I am merely fulfilling my duties. Ultimately, this incident is a "lapse" on our organization's part.
So, what about Firefly's custody? Has a decision been made?
Firefly is here of her own free will.==W== That is her answer.
I want to stay with professor and Tyrant.
Then I won't intrude any further...==W== Before I leave, I have a word of caution for you both.
We may have guaranteed Firefly the life she wants, but the surveillance won't stop.
As long as she controls Avalanche, the Eye of Grace will regard her as a dangerous weapon. Absolute freedom is out of the question.
No. Firefly isn't a weapon anymore.
From now on, she's an ordinary little girl.
If anything like this ever happens again, I'll put a stop to it.==W== Me ... and ==PLAYER_NAME==.
I'll be there in a heartbeat.==W== No matter what, Firefly's life is her own.
Igna,==W== I want to thank you again.
We couldn't have saved Firefly without you.
You're welcome. I gained a great deal from this as well.
... And the best part was getting to know you.
I like to line up my trump cards in advance. Expect more commissions from me in the future.==W== I hope you won't turn me down.
Igna...==W== You never know what she's thinking.
I've known her longer, but she's still a mystery to me.
I'm sure you've noticed: Igna treats Firefly well, but likely only because she's a valuable test subject—not because she cares about her.
We fundamentally disagree there, making it hard for me to trust her.
As long as we know she won't hurt Firefly, that's enough for me. We can't expect everyone to think like us.
Yeah. Mission accomplished, so I'm heading out tomorrow. Everyone at the New Star Guild is probably worried about me.
Professor, Firefly, Tyrant... We stay together.
Thanks, Firefly... But I have to go back.
Firefly. I know how you feel, but you have to be reasonable.

==PLAYER_NAME== is an amazing Trekker with a duty to help people. That means traveling all over the Nova Continent. If you're ==SEX3== true friend, you won't get in the way of ==SEX3== work. You know that, don't you?
Tyrant is Firefly's only friend. If we say goodbye... I will be lonely.
I'll always be your friend, no matter where I am. And it won't be long before we see each other again.
Didn't Canace just say? A Trekker's job is to travel everywhere. I can come visit you anytime I want.
Yep. Plus, Emor is the center of the continent. I'll pass through all the time—==W==whoa?!
If you're leaving tomorrow, Tyrant, we're playing tonight! I won't let you sleep!
Wait, you were serious about staying up all night?!
Sigh... Alright, you win. The three of us are having a slumber party tonight!
A slum-ber par-ty? What's that? It sounds fun... Let's do that.
Heh. Looks like we'll be seeing a lot of each other. I'll be counting on your help until Firefly grows up.
... You know, you've done a lot for us lately, and I haven't properly thanked you.
It was a coincidence, but I'm grateful it was you who found Firefly.
I should be thanking you. Firefly is my best friend, too.
And so, the girl who once closed herself off begins a new chapter in her life—
—taking her first step toward becoming an ordinary girl...

strings.text: The Lucky Oasis's energy crisis is temporarily resolved with Bloc's help. In return, you accept her commission—to track down the missing artisan, Sparkla.
Welcome! This is Bloc's mobile stall~
I've been expecting you, CEO of Boss Accord~
You're Bloc, the one running the supply shop, right?
This is my first time at the shop. Who are you?
I've been too busy claiming daily rewards... Didn't expect there'd actually be someone here.
How should I respond to her?
Waaah~ You remembered me! After showing my face to you for 225 days straight, Boss, it finally paid off!==W== Good thing I've got such a cute and memorable face~ Please come by more often!
What?! Boss, that's a huge loss for you! I've got little freebies waiting for you here every single day.
You've missed... Let me count...==W== A full 225 of them! What a shame~
But hey, at least now you remember me, right? Looking forward to seeing you again~
W-What?! My 225 days of rain-or-shine smiles... All for nothing?! No way, we totally made eye contact before!
Haha, just kidding. I know you~ So your name is Bloc.
Hehe, Boss, you're too much~ Just because I'm cute doesn't mean you should tease me like that~
I just wanted to stop by and wish you a safe journey ahead.
If anything urgent comes up in the Wilds, feel free to contact me anytime.==W== Bloc the traveling merchant is always on call.
I promise I won't disappoint you. Whatever you need, you'll find it in my trusty little cart.
Stay healthy, Boss! Smooth adventures and lots of luck~
And just like that, I added "Bloc" to my contacts.
She's pretty friendly... But I probably won't need her anytime soon—or so I thought...==W== Until that moment came.
Noya... Are they really ...==W== completely empty?
Yeah. Everyone's Soul Stones are completely drained of Grace. Which means...==W== Loxy won't start!!
We need to replenish Grace... How long until the nearest town?
At least two days by car.
Calm down. Maybe someone can help us.
Bloc, are you available right now?
Oh my, Boss! Perfect timing~ We just got a fresh batch of goods. Want me to show you?
New items, huh... Normally I'd love to take a look, but I need your help right now.
Actually… The Oasis ran out of energy in the Wilds.
Do you have anything that can replenish Grace?
Hmm... Give me 10 minutes. I'll bring it right over~
Out here in the middle of nowhere... Can she really show up on demand?
Bloc... Bloc...==W== I feel like I've heard that name somewhere...
Well, we don't have any other options. Let's just wait.
Hehe~ A great merchant is always punctual. Time is money, after all~
She actually showed up on such short notice...?! How did she even pull that off...
...Ah! I remember now! Willow mentioned a merchant named Bloc; she bought her prosthetic from her!
Ah, that boss from Trekker Association, right? That prosthetic took quite some effort to get—top-tier goods, I might add~
Anyway, Boss, I brought what you asked for! Ta-da<size=60>♪
A perfect substitute for Grace—one crate delivers the power of six! Bloc highly recommends: Neo Solution!
We need Grace, not Neo Grace.
Besides, Neo Solution is a prohibited magic fluid, isn't it?
Yeah, we saw it in Philae before. It's dangerous stuff.
And I've heard it can wreck Artifacts... Even cause explosions, right?
That's with low-quality products~ I only deal in premium Neo Solution. You can trust me.
You all know plenty of Trekkers use Neo products in secret, right? But you've never heard of any major accidents, have you~
Grace can only be replenished at dedicated shops in towns. Out here, there's nothing—Boss, you wouldn't have come to me unless you were out of options, right?
Don't worry~ I'm an expert with Neo products. With me guiding you, nothing will go wrong~
Boss, you decide! As long as we can get moving again, I'll make sure Loxy reaches our destination safely—no matter what!
Got it~ Just draw a magic circuit and let the vehicle absorb energy from the Neo Solution—it'll be up and running in no time.
Yeah! Loxy sounds just like before!
Told you, didn't I? Bloc only sells high-quality goods at great prices~
By the way, I've got more items perfect for you all~ For example...==W== Ta-da! A cooling fan powered by Neo technology! Only 50,000 Dorra~
F-Fifty thousand?! I thought the shop prices usually started at 500,000...
And there's more! I also highly recommend this Neo surround sound system~
This vehicle feels so cozy—must mean a lot to you, huh?
Just imagine... In a peaceful afternoon, sitting inside, listening to your favorite music in crystal-clear sound, leaning back on soft cushions with some Pep Pep Juice...
Hold it right there! This was just an emergency! We're still not convinced about Neo Grace's safety!
Don't worry~ You're all valued customers. I'd never scam you~
If you're still unsure...==W== How about this? From now on, all NGO products you buy from me come with a 10% discount—and full after-sales support.
Between us... I happen to have a great relationship with a top-tier Neo Grace craftsman.
Boss, the prosthetic mentioned earlier—have you seen it?
Willow's prosthetic? Yeah, the craftsmanship looks incredible.
Right? That's the work of a craftsman named Sparkla. With her handling after-sales, you can rest easy~
That does sound tempting...==W== But I want to ask Willow about her experience first.
Bloc mentioned Sparkla—the one who made your prosthetic. What do you honestly think of her work?
She's exceptionally skilled. The prosthetic I use now is flawless—both in precision and control.
Honestly, I don't even want one made by anyone else anymore. I was planning to ask Bloc to contact Sparkla again for my next order.
If Willow speaks that highly of her...==W== Maybe we should give Bloc's products a try.
Oh hoho, Boss, what a wise decision!
Excuse me, this is Bloc. Boss Willow, you mentioned wanting to place another order with Sparkla? Just tell me your requirements—I'll make sure she delivers something perfect for you!
Really? Then I'll leave it to you. I tried contacting her, but I've been blocked,==W== so...
Ahaha, geniuses tend to have their quirks.
Honestly, even I get blocked by her all the time~ In fact, I can't reach her right now either...
...==W== That counts as a good relationship?
That's not good. This order is urgent. If you're blocked too...
N-Now, now, no problem at all~ I'll get in touch with her as soon as possible, and I promise it won't delay your order!
Impressive, Bloc. A true professional merchant.
Haha, thank you~ But finding Sparkla... That part depends on you!
Wait, me? Why not just visit her directly?
Not that simple~ Sparkla lives inside her mobile workshop. If she doesn't share her location, no one knows where she is.
And that's where you come in!! I've heard the New Star Guild is unmatched when it comes to finding people—or even cats.
So… I'd like to commission you...
You want us to track down Sparkla?
Exactly! And once it's done, besides the commission fee, I'll offer even bigger discounts in the future!
Even bigger discounts... Tempting.==W== Alright, we'll take the job.
Can I join you? I never got the chance to thank her in person for this prosthetic.
Oh! With boss Willow joining too, that's even better~<size=60>♪
Also... I've got a lead—might be helpful...
Recently, a lot of Trekkers have been heading to Philae.
I heard that the underground market in Ash District is gathering a lot of craftsmen from Neo Grace Organization. Everyone's probably hoping to snag some rare goods.
You might find a lead on Sparkla there.

strings.text: At Willow's suggestion, you head to Philae's underground market, where the Tech Convention is about to begin. From the Trekkers gathered there, you learn that Sparkla is currently locked up in prison.
The underground market? Neo Grace Organization?

All the Neo Solution and Neo-tech devices circulating on the market are made and sold by us at the Neo Grace Organization, y'know~==W== Take Sparkla and me, for example. She makes the stuff, and I sell it <size=53>♪</size>
Since anything related to Neo-tech can't exactly be sold out in the open, we do our business quietly with Trekkers in the underground market instead~
Aren't you worried that the Imperial Guard will shut you down?

Oh hoho, it's not like we're some heinous villain organization.==W== We're just inventing things and running a small business.==W== Even if we run into the Imperial Guard, as long as we can get away, it's all good~
<size=50>So you ARE being hunted by the Imperial Guard then?!</size>
Oh, relax!==W== These days the Imperial Guard only follows procedure anyway. There are way too many people using Neo-tech for them to arrest everyone one by one.
As long as you don't use it blatantly right in front of them, there's absolutely no problem!
Though... There was one thing boss Willow mentioned that's been bothering me a little...
Yep, yep.==W== As far as I know, unless something HUGE happens, those people would never willingly show themselves~
If the rumors are true, then it's probably because of "that incident"...==W== But I haven't heard anything on my end~==W== Either way, guess we'll have to head to Philae and see for ourselves.
Then let's meet up in Philae.
Trekkers and Neo-tech artisans gathering in one place...==W== Mm~ I smell business opportunities everywhere~ Looks like Dorra herself is calling out to me,==W== fufufu~<size=53>♪</size>
... You didn't forget why we came here in the first place, did you?
Ah, right right!==W== Finding Sparkla!!==W== Don't worry, I didn't forget!
We haven't even entered the city yet, and I've already seen more Trekkers out here than back at camp.
... people carrying giant boxes full of tools and weird equipment...
Bloc, are those the Neo-tech artisans you mentioned?
Welcome, welcome~ Take your time browsing~ I'm sure we've got something perfect for you~
And if you really can't decide, Bloc can always give you a recommendation too, oh hoho~♪

I-I really AM gathering intel too! Setting up a stall is market research at its core!==W== Besides, look at all this Dorra practically walking right up to me...==W== It'd be a waste not to take it, ahahaha~
A-Anyway! I've already gathered some useful information!==W== Follow me, Boss.
She's the favorite to win the convention this time? Then I'm betting on her too!
What about the other contestants? Those odds are crazy high!
It's so lively... What's going on?
This is exactly why all those Neo artisans gathered together in the first place—==W==the "Tech Convention"!!
Normally, the people from Neo Grace Organization are scattered all across Nova. Especially those artisans. They'd rather lock themselves in their workshops inventing stuff all day.
But whenever someone develops a new technology or creates some insanely impressive invention,==W== everyone gathers together to exchange information and show off their skills.
Isn't this supposed to be an internal Neo Grace Organization event? Why are there so many Trekkers here placing bets?
Well~ Usually it's just a small gathering between artisans. It normally wouldn't get this flashy with gambling and everything~ As for why it turned into this...
That part? I already investigated it before you arrived.
And you already uncovered more information too...==W== As expected of the head of Emor's Trekkers' House!

... Ahem.==W== According to my investigation, this Tech Convention is different from the previous ones.==W== Apparently, a major investor offered an enormous prize pool and gathered all the artisans together.
The investor's goal, supposedly, is to develop an automaton capable of surviving in the Wilds. That's why they invited so many outstanding artisans specializing in that field.
In addition, the convention opened a betting pool, so even Trekkers who normally have no interest in Neo Grace Organization products started paying attention.
Boss, I'm sure you've already noticed.==W== Miss Sparkla's name is on the betting list too, which confirms that she was invited as well.
So once the convention starts, we'll be able to meet Sparkla, right?==W== In that case, I guess the commission is basically resolved already.
Looks like it~ Once we find Sparkla, I'll introduce you to her, Boss.
Well then~ Since the commission is practically settled! Time for me to go make a fortune...==W== I mean, time to support my dear friend Sparkla~
Boss, and boss Willow, see you later!==W==
Hey there, mister! I wanna place a bet too!
And of course I'm betting on the most talented artisan there is! All in on Sparkla!
This entire bag of Dorra, plus ...==W== five Neo Coins! I'm putting EVERYTHING on her!
Miss, are you absolutely sure?==W== Once the bet's placed, there's no taking it back.
Of course I am! It's Sparkla we're talking about here.==W== She's practically guaranteed to win. I don't even need to look at the odds.
Whoa, now that's gutsy. Someone actually bet on the contestant with the highest odds.
Hehehe...==W== Huh? Wait, what did you just say? The highest odds?==W== T-That can't be right~
What? Haven't you heard?==W== We just got word—Sparkla<color=#3faeae> got arrested by the Imperial Guard</color>, so she can't participate in the convention anymore.
<size=50>Wha-==W==what the heck is that idiot doingggg?!</size>
Iris, Amber, looks like Boss already tracked down Sparkla's whereabouts.
That's great. Let's hurry and regroup with them.
Huh?==W== That statue ... feels kinda familiar...==W==<size=50> Wait, Bloc?!</size>
It's over... It's ALL OVER...==W==<size=50> Boss, save me!!!</size>
So Miss Sparkla was locked up by the Imperial Guard?
Didn't you say earlier that the Imperial Guard couldn't be bothered with this stuff?
Well... This is my first time dealing with something like this too...==W== I just bet my entire life savings on Sparkla... My ENTIRE life savings...
If Sparkla can't compete in two days, then all the Dorra I worked so hard to save up is gonna go completely==W== down==W== the drain!
Boss, please ...==W== help me out here?
Well... Gambling kinda means accepting the risk, right? Shouldn't this be your personal responsibility, Bloc...?
I can increase the commission fee!==W== As long as Sparkla makes it to the convention, first place is basically guaranteed.
How about this then...==W== We split the winnings fifty-fifty!!==W== Even half would still be an absolutely massive fortune!
I checked already. The prize money really is substantial. Honestly, even I'm a little tempted.==B====W==
... Alright. Then let's give it a shot.==W== No time to waste. To avoid drawing too much attention,==W== Noya,==W== Bloc, and I will infiltrate the place ourselves.
Everyone else, stay on standby in Ash District and wait for my signal.
Boss, Bloc, all the troublesome guards are taken care of!
Dorra really is powerful. Noya's moving way more aggressively than usual...
We really did just charge straight into an infiltration mission on impulse...==W== But now that I think about it, maybe we're being way too reckless... This should be fine... Hopefully...
Not in this room...==W== Not here either...==W== Sparkla, where are you—
What is that?! Should I take it out?
Phew... Good thing Miss Noya asked first.==W== If Rabbit Pie got hurt, we'd be in serious trouble~
Whoa,==W== the craftsmanship is incredible! And it's so soft too!==W== This rabbit is adorable~
Allow me to properly introduce her—==W==this is Rabbit Pie, Sparkla's custom-made adorable mechanical rabbit~
If Rabbit Pie is here, then Sparkla must be nearby too~
And Rabbit Pie can answer simple questions too. Here, let me show you.==W== Rabbit Pie, tell us where your master is.
Oooh~ What a good little bunny <size=53>♪</size>
So she can even create a mechanical rabbit like this... No wonder Bloc said she was guaranteed to win first place.
What is it, Rabbit Pie? Did we get visitors?
:p Correct. Identified as Bloc, plus two unidentified individuals.
Preparing tea.==W== Estimated completion time: three minutes.
Rabbit Pie is such a good bunny~
Bloc, would you like an apple before tea?
Mhm, yes yes~<size=53>♪</size>==W== Nom nom...==W== Whoa, this apple is super sweet!
No no no, wait! Sparkla, is now really the time to casually sit around eating apples?!
Then would you rather see this half-finished puppy? Materials are limited in prison, so I only managed to make the body so far—
THAT'S NOT THE POINT! You can show us the puppy anytime!==W== Right now we need to go to the Tech Convention!==W== Come on, let's go together!
Do you realize I bet my entire fortune on you?! Plus FIVE whole Neo Coins!

param: At Willow's suggestion, you head to Philae's underground market, where the Tech Convention is about to begin. From the Trekkers gathered there, you learn that Sparkla is currently locked up in prison.
The underground market? Neo Grace Organization?

All the Neo Solution and Neo-tech devices circulating on the market are made and sold by us at the Neo Grace Organization, y'know~==W== Take Sparkla and me, for example. She makes the stuff, and I sell it <size=53>♪</size>
Since anything related to Neo-tech can't exactly be sold out in the open, we do our business quietly with Trekkers in the underground market instead~
Aren't you worried that the Imperial Guard will shut you down?

Oh hoho, it's not like we're some heinous villain organization.==W== We're just inventing things and running a small business.==W== Even if we run into the Imperial Guard, as long as we can get away, it's all good~
<size=50>So you ARE being hunted by the Imperial Guard then?!</size>
Oh, relax!==W== These days the Imperial Guard only follows procedure anyway. There are way too many people using Neo-tech for them to arrest everyone one by one.
As long as you don't use it blatantly right in front of them, there's absolutely no problem!
Though... There was one thing boss Willow mentioned that's been bothering me a little...
Yep, yep.==W== As far as I know, unless something HUGE happens, those people would never willingly show themselves~
If the rumors are true, then it's probably because of "that incident"...==W== But I haven't heard anything on my end~==W== Either way, guess we'll have to head to Philae and see for ourselves.
Then let's meet up in Philae.
Trekkers and Neo-tech artisans gathering in one place...==W== Mm~ I smell business opportunities everywhere~ Looks like Dorra herself is calling out to me,==W== fufufu~<size=53>♪</size>
... You didn't forget why we came here in the first place, did you?
Ah, right right!==W== Finding Sparkla!!==W== Don't worry, I didn't forget!
We haven't even entered the city yet, and I've already seen more Trekkers out here than back at camp.
... people carrying giant boxes full of tools and weird equipment...
Bloc, are those the Neo-tech artisans you mentioned?
Welcome, welcome~ Take your time browsing~ I'm sure we've got something perfect for you~
And if you really can't decide, Bloc can always give you a recommendation too, oh hoho~♪

I-I really AM gathering intel too! Setting up a stall is market research at its core!==W== Besides, look at all this Dorra practically walking right up to me...==W== It'd be a waste not to take it, ahahaha~
A-Anyway! I've already gathered some useful information!==W== Follow me, Boss.
She's the favorite to win the convention this time? Then I'm betting on her too!
What about the other contestants? Those odds are crazy high!
It's so lively... What's going on?
This is exactly why all those Neo artisans gathered together in the first place—==W==the "Tech Convention"!!
Normally, the people from Neo Grace Organization are scattered all across Nova. Especially those artisans. They'd rather lock themselves in their workshops inventing stuff all day.
But whenever someone develops a new technology or creates some insanely impressive invention,==W== everyone gathers together to exchange information and show off their skills.
Isn't this supposed to be an internal Neo Grace Organization event? Why are there so many Trekkers here placing bets?
Well~ Usually it's just a small gathering between artisans. It normally wouldn't get this flashy with gambling and everything~ As for why it turned into this...
That part? I already investigated it before you arrived.
And you already uncovered more information too...==W== As expected of the head of Emor's Trekkers' House!

... Ahem.==W== According to my investigation, this Tech Convention is different from the previous ones.==W== Apparently, a major investor offered an enormous prize pool and gathered all the artisans together.
The investor's goal, supposedly, is to develop an automaton capable of surviving in the Wilds. That's why they invited so many outstanding artisans specializing in that field.
In addition, the convention opened a betting pool, so even Trekkers who normally have no interest in Neo Grace Organization products started paying attention.
Boss, I'm sure you've already noticed.==W== Miss Sparkla's name is on the betting list too, which confirms that she was invited as well.
So once the convention starts, we'll be able to meet Sparkla, right?==W== In that case, I guess the commission is basically resolved already.
Looks like it~ Once we find Sparkla, I'll introduce you to her, Boss.
Well then~ Since the commission is practically settled! Time for me to go make a fortune...==W== I mean, time to support my dear friend Sparkla~
Boss, and boss Willow, see you later!==W==
Hey there, mister! I wanna place a bet too!
And of course I'm betting on the most talented artisan there is! All in on Sparkla!
This entire bag of Dorra, plus ...==W== five Neo Coins! I'm putting EVERYTHING on her!
Miss, are you absolutely sure?==W== Once the bet's placed, there's no taking it back.
Of course I am! It's Sparkla we're talking about here.==W== She's practically guaranteed to win. I don't even need to look at the odds.
Whoa, now that's gutsy. Someone actually bet on the contestant with the highest odds.
Hehehe...==W== Huh? Wait, what did you just say? The highest odds?==W== T-That can't be right~
What? Haven't you heard?==W== We just got word—Sparkla<color=#3faeae> got arrested by the Imperial Guard</color>, so she can't participate in the convention anymore.
<size=50>Wha-==W==what the heck is that idiot doingggg?!</size>
Iris, Amber, looks like Boss already tracked down Sparkla's whereabouts.
That's great. Let's hurry and regroup with them.
Huh?==W== That statue ... feels kinda familiar...==W==<size=50> Wait, Bloc?!</size>
It's over... It's ALL OVER...==W==<size=50> Boss, save me!!!</size>
So Miss Sparkla was locked up by the Imperial Guard?
Didn't you say earlier that the Imperial Guard couldn't be bothered with this stuff?
Well... This is my first time dealing with something like this too...==W== I just bet my entire life savings on Sparkla... My ENTIRE life savings...
If Sparkla can't compete in two days, then all the Dorra I worked so hard to save up is gonna go completely==W== down==W== the drain!
Boss, please ...==W== help me out here?
Well... Gambling kinda means accepting the risk, right? Shouldn't this be your personal responsibility, Bloc...?
I can increase the commission fee!==W== As long as Sparkla makes it to the convention, first place is basically guaranteed.
How about this then...==W== We split the winnings fifty-fifty!!==W== Even half would still be an absolutely massive fortune!
I checked already. The prize money really is substantial. Honestly, even I'm a little tempted.==B====W==
... Alright. Then let's give it a shot.==W== No time to waste. To avoid drawing too much attention,==W== Noya,==W== Bloc, and I will infiltrate the place ourselves.
Everyone else, stay on standby in Ash District and wait for my signal.
Boss, Bloc, all the troublesome guards are taken care of!
Dorra really is powerful. Noya's moving way more aggressively than usual...
We really did just charge straight into an infiltration mission on impulse...==W== But now that I think about it, maybe we're being way too reckless... This should be fine... Hopefully...
Not in this room...==W== Not here either...==W== Sparkla, where are you—
What is that?! Should I take it out?
Phew... Good thing Miss Noya asked first.==W== If Rabbit Pie got hurt, we'd be in serious trouble~
Whoa,==W== the craftsmanship is incredible! And it's so soft too!==W== This rabbit is adorable~
Allow me to properly introduce her—==W==this is Rabbit Pie, Sparkla's custom-made adorable mechanical rabbit~
If Rabbit Pie is here, then Sparkla must be nearby too~
And Rabbit Pie can answer simple questions too. Here, let me show you.==W== Rabbit Pie, tell us where your master is.
Oooh~ What a good little bunny <size=53>♪</size>
So she can even create a mechanical rabbit like this... No wonder Bloc said she was guaranteed to win first place.
What is it, Rabbit Pie? Did we get visitors?

Rabbit Pie is such a good bunny~
Bloc, would you like an apple before tea?
Mhm, yes yes~<size=53>♪</size>==W== Nom nom...==W== Whoa, this apple is super sweet!

strings.text: After hearing that you successfully rescued Sparkla, the others finally relax enough to explore the market. Meanwhile, Willow's prosthetic catches attention. Everyone begins eagerly awaiting Sparkla's appearance.
Why's it so noisy over here...? What happened?
Report! We have a prison break in progress! We're on it!
A prisoner detained for illegally using Neo Solution escaped with outside assistance. We tracked the fugitive all the way to Ash District, but lost the trail halfway through!! We sincerely apologize!
A prison break? Illegal Neo Solution use only gets you detained for about ten days. Breaking out, on the other hand, is a far more serious offense.
Something about this case feels off. Let me see the file.
The escaped prisoner had a strange rabbit with them...==W== I see. I think I know what's going on now.
You can stop the surveillance. I'll personally handle this prison break case, along with the search for everyone connected to the use of Neo Solution.
We should be safe here now.
Phew~ Guess we can finally do proper introductions.
Boss, this is the artisan I was telling you all about—Sparkla herself~
<size=35>Sparkla, ==PLAYER_NAME== is one of our biggest clients, so try not to treat ==SEX4== like your last customer and block ==SEX4== the second you get annoyed...
Hello, hello, cute ==SEX13==. I'll be handling all your future after-sales support from now on. Though honestly, even if nothing breaks, I still hope we get to see each other often. Hehe~
Ah... Y-Yeah. Nice to meet you too.
Hehe, it's a promise then? Ahhhh~ Getting to look at such a cute face from now on... This is the best day ever~<size=60>♪
... Whoa. I've never seen you this excited before.
Wait... Don't tell me...==W== Did Boss's adorable face inspire you so much that you finally decided to join the convention?
A face this cute is one of a kind. Just looking at ==SEX4== fills my head with invention ideas nonstop.
And if I want to turn those ideas into real inventions, then the convention prize money—and all the Neo Coins you bet—are absolutely essential.
Hold on, hold on. You got convinced by Boss's face alone... No. I refuse to accept that reasoning!
Because to me...==W== Cuteness is justice! Cuteness matters more than anything else.
Then what about me?! Am I not cute?!
Gwah—instant answer...==W== And so brutally direct too...
Oh, right. Cute ==SEX13==, mind if I just call you ==PLAYER_NAME== from now on?
Yay~ Oh! Since I decided to enter the convention, I need to start working on a new invention too.
My workshop's a little far from here. ==PLAYER_NAME==, would you come with me?
Of course. I want to see what Neo inventions are actually like myself.
Obviously! I've only visited your workshop a couple of times myself. Guess I'm benefiting from Boss's good fortune here. Oh hoho~
I'll contact Amber and update everyone.
Noya, you head back and regroup with the others first.
Mhm! You guys be careful too, Boss!
Don't worry. Neo artisans keep their workshops extremely well hidden. The Imperial Guard won't be tracking us there.
Good! See you all at the Tech Convention~
A compact Neo ice maker for only twenty thousand Dorra?!==W== I'll take it!!
The underground market is amazing! I can actually afford high-end stuff like this without going over budget!
... First time I've seen Iris spend money so freely.
I was worried about Boss and the others earlier,==W== but now that I know they are safe, I instantly relaxed and started shopping like crazy...
Step right up! Seasonal clearance sale! Ninety-percent-new Neo heater! The perfect companion for cold winter nights!
Buy now and you'll also get a full crate of Neo Solution included—only seventy thousand Dorra!!!
Loxy gets freezing cold during winter nights.==W== A heater would make things way cozier.
And I can trick Inky into the car...
With the commission payout, we're still pretty loaded right now, so maybe...
Coming right up! I'll top off the Neo Solution for you two!
This heater's pretty heavy. You sure you young ladies can carry it?
Huh? But it really is heavy though?
It's fine. Ever since I got this prosthetic arm, I can probably lift something five times heavier than this.
Miss, wait a moment! Can I take a look at your prosthetic arm?
What incredible craftsmanship! Hey, take a look at this. It's way better than anything you've ever made.
Hah?! Since when do you get to trash-talk my inventions?! Lemme see...==W== Wait a sec, this is...
Miss, could you fold this paper into a heart shape with your prosthetic... Then unfold it?
... Beautiful. Those movements are unbelievably smooth and precise. Yeah... Way better than mine.
Hey, everyone, come take a look at this too!
Sheesh... This is definitely something special. I'd bet it was made by one of those legendary master artisans with huge bounties on their heads.
I heard Neo artisans are basically judged by the size of their Imperial Guard bounty. A bigger bounty means better craftsmanship.
You people seriously have no eye for quality. A prosthetic this sensitive and advanced is obviously Sparkla's work.
If you don't believe me, check the inside of the control unit. There should be a tiny rabbit logo engraved somewhere.
No need. This is made by Sparkla.
Hmph. Knew it. There's no way I'd mistake one of her inventions. But...==W== Even if this is Sparkla's work, this prosthetic isn't cute at all.
And looks like she only left the most basic functions intact. Lemme guess—you got blocked the second you received it?
Yeah.==W== She wanted to install a transformable rabbit-shaped speaker on my hand, and I turned her down...
Ahh—yeah, that explains why she got upset. If her inventions aren't maximized for cuteness and packed with weird gimmicks, she can't sleep at night.

If you don't meet her aesthetic standards, she immediately labels you as "someone with no taste" and blocks you on the spot. Though to be fair, she'll still deliver the product properly. That's just classic Sparkla.
Sounds like you know her pretty well~
Of course! Sparkla is my destined rival, chosen by fate itself!==W== I was hoping to finally settle things with her at this convention, but turns out she couldn't even make it here...
But you know what? Even if she does show up, the result won't change! My newest automaton, Ticka-Boom—aka Boomy—is absolutely taking first place! Sparkla's only future is crying in the corner!!
Um...==W== Actually, the latest rumor says she escaped prison.
So the news already spread, Cecil? Guess your intel was right after all.
No way! I already bet more than half my savings on Leona winning?!
Haha. Relax. Even if Sparkla escaped, that doesn't necessarily mean she'll enter the convention.
True enough. I still haven't decided who to bet on, but if everyone believes in Leona that much... Alright then...==W== I'll put down three million Dorra too <size=60>♪
Hehe, bigger bets make things more exciting <size=60>♪
U-Um... Maybe I shouldn't butt in,==W== but we do have confirmed information that Sparkla plans to enter the Tech Convention.
Yeah. So if you're placing bets, I figured you deserved to know first... I mean, that's three million Dorra...
What did you say?! Sparkla's competing?! Hehehe... Ahahahaha! Isn't that perfect?! Now things are getting interesting!
Listen up! Bet on whoever you want, but my Boomy isn't losing to anyone!
Oh, and you—thanks for the info too! Heh heh, there's still time left. I need to push Boomy's performance even further!
Yeah, thanks for the warning! You guys are really nice. But I'm still betting on Leona. I loved how confident she sounded just now.
I-I see... M-Miss Leona, good luck then.
Hmph! Don't worry, I fully intend to give it everything I've got!
Phew... There are way too many smells mixed together here. I almost lost control of my expression.
Cecil. Inform the others. We found traces of those three little mice. Next, they'll definitely head for the room with the cheese.

strings.text: You're invited to Sparkla's workshop, where she plans to create a fascinating automaton inspired by you. Under Bloc's relentless urging, Sparkla finally begins preparing for the competition.
Ta-da! Welcome to Sparkla's Mobile Workshop<size=60>♪
Huh? The whole layout changed. It didn't look like this the last time I came here...
After I upgraded Rabbit Pie's housekeeping functions, she optimized the pathing to match my habits.

strings.text: The Tech Convention officially begins, but you, Bloc, and Sparkla are still rushing toward the venue. Meanwhile, the top-seeded favorite, Leona, has already crushed the competition and set her sights on first place.
Could it be Rabbit Pie? I remember she's supposed to be a housekeeping automaton, right?
Hehe. Any experienced artisan leaves room for expansion when designing an invention. Of course Rabbit Pie is no exception~
The automaton competition this time is mainly focused on survival in the Wilds. And if you ask me...==W== The most important part of surviving out there is overcoming your fear of it.
So let me put it plainly—==W==<size=50>all fear comes from insufficient firepower.

But honestly, I couldn't get excited about building a combat automaton from scratch. Since I already had a perfectly good base model lying around, I'll just wire a weapons system into Rabbit Pie instead.
Sigh... The problem is, this is way too easy for me. It barely even feels like a challenge. Even overestimating it, I could finish in a few hours tops.
Yes! This is it! We've totally got this in the bag!==W== My dream of becoming filthy rich overnight is finally coming true~
I'll start modifying Rabbit Pie right away. But taking apart the internals involves this little one's private secrets, so Bloc and ==PLAYER_NAME== should go get some rest first.
Sounds good to me! We're exhausted anyway, so we won't hold back~
Maybe it was because so much had happened today,==RT==I drifted off almost immediately.
Hehe... Dorra... Two hundred million Dorra... Come flying to me...==W== Heheh... Zzz...
Boss, wake up!! Get up already~~~~
We're doomed... How did I choke this hard at the worst possible moment?!==W== Do you even know what time it is?! The convention starts in three hours!!
It's already that late?!==W== Iris left a bunch of missed calls too. We slept like the dead...
Where's Sparkla?! Why didn't she wake us up?!
Mmmh... Bloc, you're way too loud... Keep it up, and I'll block you...
Sparklaaaa!! What happened to Rabbit Pie's alarm function?! Did it break?! I didn't hear a single ring!
No way it broke~ I was exhausted after the modifications yesterday and wanted to sleep in, so I set the alarm later on purpose.
That's WAY TOO LATE!! We're definitely gonna be late now, aaAAAAAHHHHH!!
Bloc, calm down. Aren't you always saying, "As long as Sparkla's around, everything'll work out"?
Hehe, ==PLAYER_NAME==, hearing you trust me that much is making me blush a little~<size=60>♪</size>
Exactly, which is why you need to hurry up and save us!! Sparkla, you're our only hope!
Honestly, what am I gonna do with you? Since you're begging me so sincerely...
I actually prepared one last secret surprise—==W==and now it's finally time for the grand reveal!!
How about Miss Willow? Has she gotten through to Bloc?
Sorry... Maybe I should've gone with Boss back then...
Don't worry. Boss will make it here.
Boss! You finally picked up! What happened over there?!
The wind's way too loud. I can barely make it out...==W== But I think they said for us to head to the venue first.
Um... Excuse me... Would it be okay if I tagged along with you?
Ah! You're the Trekker we met the other day, right? Of course!
She's another Trekker we met at the underground market...
U-Um... How should I address you...?
Miss Gray, I'm Iris.==W== These two are Noya and Amber,==W== and this is Willow.
What?! This person bet three million Dorra?!
Miss Noya, Miss Amber, Miss Willow...==W== It's nice to meet you all.
Nice to meet you too...==W== Huh? Somehow... I feel like I've seen you somewhere before...
Haha, maybe we crossed paths at one of the Trekkers' Houses? I usually work around Port Goldfinch. Wouldn't surprise me if we've bumped into each other near the Monolith over there.
Ohhh, yeah, that actually sounds possible!
Are you by yourself today? What about that butler from before?
Hehe, I sent Cecil off to handle something else.
Didn't you say Sparkla was entering the competition? It's about to start, and she's still nowhere in sight?!
U-Um...==W== She's probably still on the way.
Good. I was starting to think I scared her so badly she ran off with her tail between her legs. If I don't let her experience the full power of "Ticka-Boom," I came here for nothing!
Oh right, I even saved you front-row seats so you could properly witness my greatness. Come with me.
There's actually a perk like that?!
This is incredible... No wonder they say this is the biggest Tech Convention yet.
That investor clearly knows what they're doing. The prize money is insanely generous.
Hehe... If you're already impressed now, you're in for a treat. Things are only gonna get more interesting from here.
... As the host of this year's convention, the Rockefeller family extends our sincerest gratitude to all artisans and Trekkers participating today.

This year's convention is themed around "survival in the Wilds." Contestants will compete in two divisions: "Logistics" and "Firepower." The comprehensive performance of each entry will be judged through multiple rounds of competition!
The Logistics Division will be scored on navigation, carrying capacity, and safety performance,==W== while the Firepower Division is simple and straightforward—an all-out battle!

At the end, the winners of both divisions will face one final safety evaluation. If the Logistics champion withstands the Firepower champion's assault, the Logistics Division wins. Otherwise, the Firepower Division claims victory!
And let me reiterate the grand prize—the champion will not only receive one billion Dorra, but also an exclusive sponsorship from the Rockefeller family:==W==<color=#3faeae> twenty Neo Coins</color>!
Those Neo Coins are supposed to be insanely valuable, right? They're giving out twenty of them?! That's one hell of an investment.
The strongest spear versus the strongest shield... Now that sounds exciting!
Thirty minutes remain before the convention officially begins. Contestants, please make your final adjustments. We wish everyone the best of luck!
... Why is Cecil up on stage?
Sorry for hiding it from you all...==W== My family is actually the main organizer behind this year's convention.
Huh?! If you're one of the organizers, why disguise yourself as a Trekker and join the betting pool?
I just wanted to secretly observe whether the invited artisans would really show up. After all, information shared between Trekkers tends to be the most reliable, right?
As for the betting...==W== Well, the atmosphere was just too good, haha. Besides, that amount of money is basically pocket change to me anyway, so there wasn't any deeper reason behind it.
That's not the issue here!==W== Why isn't Sparkla here yet?!
Hehe, so what do you think of the speed on the heavily customized "Super Action Pie" version?
This is ... your ...==W== surprise...?==W== It's definitely ... surprising!==W== Bleeeurghhh...
I thought ... I was finally starting to get used to traveling like this...==W== But nope... Still can't handle it...==W== Bleeeurghhh...
You guys seriously can't take it anymore? Should I slow down a little?
If you slow down for us... We won't make it to the convention...==W== bweehh?!
Relax~ At worst we'll arrive maybe an hour behind schedule. And honestly, that'll put us right in time for the championship match anyway.
How is ... any of that ...==W== relaxing...
Then we can just storm into the arena and challenge the reigning champion directly. That way we skip wasting time fighting all the weaker contestants. Two birds with one stone~
Isn't that way too reckless...? Wouldn't they disqualify us...?==W== Bweegh...
Those artisans from the NGO love wild stunts like this too, so it's fi—==W==Bleeeurghhhhhh...

Everyone, please observe the driving performance of the Big Brain Automaton under maximum load. No matter how much cargo it carries, it can stop precisely at the designated location. I call this feature the Inertia Crusher!
Who cares if it can park accurately? What if obstacles suddenly appear on the route? Can your so-called Big Brain avoid them perfectly?
W-Well... That feature is planned for a future optimization update...
Hah! Future optimization? Just admit you can't do it. Don't call it a smart transport unit—you should rename it Big Dummy instead!
Get off the stage—! Get off the stage—!
I see now... I finally understand why Sparkla hid out in prison at first.
Why is everything here just a pile of scrap metal...?==W== Guess I should step in early and save everyone some time.
Heeey—all you idiots in the Firepower Division calling yourselves artisans—==W==how about we cut the nonsense and decide the winner right here and now?
... No objections? Great, then it's settled. My Ticka-Boom will take on every single one of your machines at once. Bring it on!
You're all bark for someone that tiny.
Ohhhh, now THIS is what I came to see!
Leona! You'd better win! I bet all my money on you!!
No need to interfere. Miss Leona seems completely confident in herself...==W== Besides, this proposal is obviously far more entertaining, isn't it<size=60>♪</size>
I hereby announce a format change for the Firepower Division—
<size=80>From this point onward, Ticka-Boom will battle==RT==every automaton in the division simultaneously!

If you slow down for us... We won't make it to the convention...==W== bweehh?!
Relax~ At worst we'll arrive maybe an hour behind schedule. And honestly, that'll put us right in time for the championship match anyway.
How is ... any of that ...==W== relaxing...
Then we can just storm into the arena and challenge the reigning champion directly. That way we skip wasting time fighting all the weaker contestants. Two birds with one stone~
Isn't that way too reckless...? Wouldn't they disqualify us...?==W== Bweegh...
Those artisans from the NGO love wild stunts like this too, so it's fi—==W==Bleeeurghhhhhh...

Everyone, please observe the driving performance of the Big Brain Automaton under maximum load. No matter how much cargo it carries, it can stop precisely at the designated location. I call this feature the Inertia Crusher!
Who cares if it can park accurately? What if obstacles suddenly appear on the route? Can your so-called Big Brain avoid them perfectly?
W-Well... That feature is planned for a future optimization update...
Hah! Future optimization? Just admit you can't do it. Don't call it a smart transport unit—you should rename it Big Dummy instead!
Get off the stage—! Get off the stage—!
I see now... I finally understand why Sparkla hid out in prison at first.
Why is everything here just a pile of scrap metal...?==W== Guess I should step in early and save everyone some time.
Heeey—all you idiots in the Firepower Division calling yourselves artisans—==W==how about we cut the nonsense and decide the winner right here and now?
... No objections? Great, then it's settled. My Ticka-Boom will take on every single one of your machines at once. Bring it on!
You're all bark for someone that tiny.
Ohhhh, now THIS is what I came to see!
Leona! You'd better win! I bet all my money on you!!
No need to interfere. Miss Leona seems completely confident in herself...==W== Besides, this proposal is obviously far more entertaining, isn't it<size=60>♪</size>
I hereby announce a format change for the Firepower Division—
<size=80>From this point onward, Ticka-Boom will battle==RT==every automaton in the division simultaneously!

strings.text: During the awards ceremony, the Imperial Guard surrounds the venue. The whole convention was a trap set by their captain, Greyhorn. With everyone cornered, your group arrives to turn the tide.
W-Whoa! Why's Ticka-Boom firing over there?!
Hey, hey, I can hear you from up here, y'know?! Don't underestimate my Boomy. That little guy never makes mistakes!
Yaaahhh!! My Sparrow Scout Unit! How did they spot it?! It's supposed to be a stealth recon drone?!
See? Told you so just now<size=60>♪</size>
Heh, your little sparrow's got some guts, though. Took one of my balloon bombs and still managed to reboot.
Seriously, why are you firepower freaks messing with the logistics division's arena?!
Sorryyy~ Ticka-Boom's detection range is just way too wide. Looks like it locked onto all your little automaton units as enemies too.
Besides, the logistics division gets scored on safety standards too, right? Thought we'd help you show off a little, hahaha!
The direct combat round is the final round, okay?! You trigger-happy idiots can't just wreck the event because you feel like it!
Oho? So now you're blaming other people because your builds suck?
Ohhh~ If you're gonna talk that big, then let's see what your firepower can really do. Forget the brackets—bring it on!
Whoa... It turned into a full-on battle royale...
Gray, aren't you gonna stop them?
There's no need. If anything, the automaton that survives a fight of this scale is exactly what we're looking for.
Feels like we're about to get dragged into this too. Should we move farther back?
Relax. The audience seats aren't getting hit at all, right?==W== Wah!==W== Cough cough... Hahaha... Worst case, a little smoke drifts over here.
That's true... Neo-tech craftsmanship really is incredible...
Right?! Some of the gear those genius artisans make can practically match Artifacts, and way cheaper too.
Grace Imperium keeps banning this and restricting that because they're terrified the Soul Shop and Artifact shops will lose business.
... Looks like this is about to end.
Anyone still got an automaton standing? My Ticka-Boom's right here~ Don't be shy, come at me all together <size=60>♪</size>
Dammit... My babies got blown to pieces... This is why I hate explosive-type automata...
Leona, just you wait! Give me a couple of days to upgrade my tracking bombs, and your Ticka-Boom won't be bouncing anymore!
Hmph, do your best then <size=60>♪</size>==W== Oh, right. Since we're obviously gonna fight again sometime, wanna exchange contacts while we're at it?
Hey, announcer! The winner's obvious already, right?! Hurry up and call it!
Indeed. Since nobody seems to object...==W== I hereby declare the champion of this convention to be—
Miss Leona and her automaton, Ticka-Boom!
Next, we'll begin venue safety inspections and cleanup operations, so please wait a moment. After that, we'll proceed directly to the award ceremony.
Oh dang, there's an award ceremony too?! Congrats, Leona!
Hmph hmph! Told ya this was gonna be easy.
I was hoping that I'd finally get to crush that Sparkla brat who keeps blocking me...==W== But she didn't even show up, so winning doesn't feel nearly as satisfying.
I can increase the commission fee!==W== As long as Sparkla makes it to the convention, first place is basically guaranteed.
How about this then...==W== We split the winnings fifty-fifty!!==W== Even half would still be an absolutely massive fortune!
Bloc just lost her entire life savings! And obviously our reward's gone too!!
The venue cleanup has now concluded.
After the artisans' spectacular competition, we now arrive at the grand finale of today's event—
Members of the Neo Grace Organization, you are under arrest.
Wait... When did this many Imperial Guards get here?!
Weren't those people sitting next to us earlier?!==W== Don't tell me...
I am Greyhorn, Captain of the Imperial Guard.
My duty is to track down and apprehend Neo Grace Organization members hiding across the land.
Don't tell me...! This whole convention was a trap?!
Correct. Rather than chasing rats across the world, it's much more efficient to lure them out and capture them all at once.
NGO artisans are obsessed with invention. Exploit that obsession, and getting you idiots to walk into a trap is easy.
In fact, all we had to do was disguise it as a tech tournament and offer Neo Coins as the grand prize. And just like that, you all came crawling straight into the net.
That's so underhanded! You sneaky bastard!
You criminals aren't exactly in a position to lecture me.

Trekkers present at the venue, do not interfere with Imperial Guard operations. Any obstruction will be treated as aiding the Neo Grace Organization. Additionally, after the arrest operation concludes, all attendees will be required to attend an Artifact safety seminar and examination.
Really? That's all they're doing...? The Imperial Guard actually let us off easy?
So she really is ...==W== the Imperial Guard's infamous "Neo Hound."
Ah! I remember now! She's one of the Imperial Guard members we met before!
Her whole aura feels completely different now.
When she was hanging around with us these past few days, she felt like an entirely different person. No wonder we never noticed who she really was.
For now, let's stay out of it and watch what happens.
If Boss were here, Boss probably wouldn't want everyone dragged into a conflict between the Imperial Guard and the Neo Grace Organization either.
Quit looking down on us! You think we'll just surrender?! Every Dorra on those bounty posters was earned by risking our lives! Everyone standing here is a battle-hardened veteran!
Exactly exactly! A lousy Imperial Guard squad doesn't stand a chance against our automata anyway...==W== Huh?
So you finally noticed? Most of those automata lost functionality during that giant free-for-all earlier.==W== And your Ticka-Boom took serious damage too.
That's what I was saying earlier... I hate explosive automata...
You have nowhere left to run. Surrender peacefully.
Boss! Where are you right now?!
Iris, we're on our...==W== Ah, actually, looks like we're already here.
Sorry to keep everyone waiting~<size=60>♪</size> So who won earlier? Wanna put the championship title and prize on the line and duel my Rabbit Pie?
Sparkla! Read the room already?! How is this the time for that?!
Well then. Looks like the last rat finally arrived.
We've met before, haven't we...?==W== Your name was ... Greyhorn, right?
Greetings, CEO of Boss Accord. I strongly advise against interfering with Imperial Guard operations.
If even one Trekker affiliated with Boss Accord makes a move, every person here will be detained as accomplices of the Neo Grace Organization.
She's trying to ... use everyone else to hold me back.
Oh my, fancy running into the Imperial Guard's famous "hound" here.
Wait, Leona didn't show up?==W== Couldn't even handle a tiny mess like this...?==W== Ah, sorry sorry, there you are. Still, dealing with this alone would be rough even for you, huh?
Hey! Don't look down on me! If my Ticka-Boom hadn't burned through so much power during the competition, wiping out this whole Imperial Guard squad would've been easy!
So basically, you can't do anything alone?
Y-You—==W==stop twisting my words like that!!!
Does Sparkla have a terrible relationship with that person?
Hehe, not really...==W== Though those two absolutely start bickering the second they meet. It's basically their own version of saying hello.
They genuinely respect each other's craftsmanship deep down.
What nonsense are you talking about?! She sucks!
Exactly. Seriously, Bloc, what were you thinking? With Leona's skill level, there's no way she could build anything like my Rabbit Pie.
==PLAYER_NAME==, things were way too hectic this morning for me to show you my newest invention properly, so why not see it in live combat instead—
I'll show you what Rabbit Pie looks like when it gets serious <size=60>♪</size>
:] Target locked. Enemy formations are densely packed ahead. Estimated requirement: five Neo Bunny Bombs.
Mmm... Not cute enough. And definitely not dramatic enough. Let's just go with "Bunny Full-Area Suppression."
:p Understood. Switching to "Bunny Full-Area Suppression" mode.
==PLAYER_NAME==, get behind me. This is the best seat in the house.
Then I'll gladly accept the invitation.
H-Hey hey hey! Don't forget about me over here?!
Sparkla's new bombs?! Lemme see those beauties in action too!
R-Report...==W== Most of our squad has lost combat power, but ... there are no fatalities.
So even defensive magic can barely handle that much...==W== Protecting this many people at once really is too much strain...
As expected of Sparkla! The Imperial Guard got completely wiped out~
Everyone, hurry! Run while you can!
Hmph, trying to flee? I refuse to let any of you escape.
You tanked Rabbit Pie's maximum-output cannon and you're still standing? You're tougher than you look.
In that case...==W== Guess it's finally time to unveil the other little "surprise" I installed into Super Action Pie.
Of course there is <size=60>♪</size> Besides the super high-speed mode, I added a whole bunch of enhancement functions too.
