strings.text: Sparkla's modified Rabbit Pie and the armed Super Action Pie blast through the Guard's defenses. In the chaos, your team escapes to Loxy, where Sparkla makes you a new promise.
Cough cough, Boss, are you okay?!
I'm fine! What about you guys, Iris?
We didn't get caught in it either.
Things got way bigger than expected. We should get outta here fast!
This place is no longer safe. Let's go.
Boss, we should leave too, right?
Yeah. Let's check on everyone first before we retreat.
No worries~ We're used to this kind of chaos. Boss, you guys go on ahead. The three of us will stay behind and cover your escape.
Leona, how much time can Ticka-Boom buy us if it stays behind?
I just threw together a few bombs from spare parts... More than enough to get everyone out safely <size=60>♪</size>
Just don't screw up so badly you blow yourself up.
As if that would ever happen!!
Alright, alright, you two. Temporary truce for now, okay?
Boss, leave this place to us. We'll regroup later where the Oasis is parked!
Understood. Be careful, all of you.
Done talking?==W== Then time to start blasting. Ticka-Boom, FIRE!!!
Woohoo~ Been forever since I had a chase this explosive with the Imperial Guard.
Sparkla, we still good on ammo for Super Action Pie?
Of course it does. Here, enjoy the cuteness of Bunny Tracking Bombs too <size=60>♪</size>
Whoa! Perfect explosion! One hundred points from me!

Bunny Scatter Bombs, Bunny Full-Area Suppression Mode, Bunny Tracking Bombs... This battle is basically free advertising~ Once we get back, we're definitely gonna be flooded with orders. Maybe we should boldly raise prices by twenty percent?
Set the prices however you like, Bloc. But for the next three months I'm focusing entirely on new inventions, so don't dump new orders on me.
If anyone bothers me, straight to blacklist.
Easy easy. We still have plenty of this new ammo stock left, so we won't bug you for a while. I'll have Leona brainstorm some new products too. That should keep sales going for a bit~
So all I gotta do is make something stronger and more popular than Sparkla's bunny bombs, right? Easy peasy <size=60>♪</size>
As expected of Leona. I'm looking forward to it!
You better do a good job... If you screw this up and Bloc comes crying to me again, I'm not cleaning up your mess.
Screw up? Who do you think I am...==W== HEY!! Don't leave me behind?! Wait for me! Let me on the ride too~~~!!!!
We're already this far out and we can still see the explosions...
Do you think they'll really make it out safely...
If they're not back in ten minutes, Amber and I are going back to check on them.
Took a little work, but we finally shook off the pursuers~
Mhm. As long as everyone made it back safely.
You bosses aren't hurt either, right?
We're fine. Thanks to you drawing the Imperial Guard's attention away, nobody came after us.
Actually, I should be the one thanking you. If I hadn't wanted to test the performance of the "Tyrant Pie" setup, I never would've thought to modify Super Action Pie in the first place.
Hehe. Since the inspiration came from ==PLAYER_NAME==, I named it after the Tyrant directly.==W== Fits perfectly, right?
Oh right, and just like I mentioned back in the workshop... It'll analyze Boss's behavioral patterns and focus on support functions inside the Monolith.
That said, with current technology, the most we can really do is improve target detection and scouting functions. Recreating "that idea" completely is still gonna take a lot more time.
She can actually recreate it if given enough time...? Sparkla's talent is seriously terrifying...
So, ==PLAYER_NAME==, we should climb the Monolith together a lot more from now on. I'll collect tons of data and document everything carefully, hehe~
Ahhh~ So THAT's why you installed a weapon system on Super Action Pie besides Rabbit Pie.==W== Don't tell me you're planning to moonlight as a Trekker too?
As if.==W== I just wanted to turn the inspiration ==PLAYER_NAME== gave me into something as cute and perfect as possible.
...==W== By the way, why were Imperial Guard troops hiding at the convention venue anyway? What exactly happened?
The entire Tech Convention was actually a trap set by Greyhorn, the Imperial Guard knight...
That Neo Hound disappeared for a while. I thought she'd been reassigned somewhere else and we could finally relax a little. Turns out she was secretly cooking up something huge instead.
Damn her! In the end, I still never got to settle things with Sparkla!
It's such a shame the Tech Convention got ruined. I really wanted to see everyone's inventions too...
If you wanna see inventions that badly, come visit my workshop! I've got tons of unreleased gear there~ Or we could even organize an artisan exchange meet-up!
You guys should really keep a lower profile for a while. If Greyhorn locks onto you again, it'll be trouble.

Ohoho, Boss clearly doesn't know how things work~ Dodging pursuit while inventing gadgets and running business is normal life for the Neo Grace Organization. This level barely even counts as excitement~
Besides, if you think about it differently, being chased by the Imperial Guard just means we get live test dummies for our newest bombs!
Um, Bloc... There's still the matter of the additional commission fee you promised us earlier...
O-Ohhh...!==W== R-Right... The additional commission fee...
Let's just forget about the extra fee.
Let's review what went wrong during this commission first.
That face says you're plotting some kind of sneaky excuse to dodge payment~
I should discuss the additional fee with Bloc!
The Imperial Guard suddenly got involved, so your finances are pretty tight right now, aren't they? Let's just forget about the extra commission fee.
BOSS!!!! Ahhh, your radiance is too dazzling!!!!
Even if I have to raise prices later, I'll still sell everything to you at the original price!! No matter what happens, I swear!!
But! I do have one tiny request.
Saving Sparkla from prison already fulfilled your extra commission request.
But because I failed to contact Iris in time, I didn't realize the convention format had changed. That's why Sparkla never got to compete in the final match.
So let's just cancel the extra commission fee.
You guaranteed Sparkla would absolutely take first place.
We fulfilled our promise to rescue Sparkla. But unfortunately, you didn't fulfill yours.
That said, agreed payment should still be paid. That's what honoring a contract means, right? As an excellent merchant, I'm sure you know what you should do.
I know, I know...==W== Boss, how about I write you an IOU first?! I'm literally broke right now... Sob sob...
No need for the IOU. But! I do have one tiny request.
Make Willow's new prosthetic really amazing~
Huh? Boss? What do you mean?
Not just because of this. You've always helped me out a lot.
I've wanted to thank you for a long time...==W== But after thinking it over, the only thing I could come up with was asking Bloc to put extra care into your order.
Of course!! I'll make Sparkla create the greatest prosthetic arm ever. Guaranteed to satisfy boss Willow completely!==W== Right, Sparkla?
Loxy's exhaust system still feels kinda lacking. Maybe we should just replace the whole thing?
I've got a Neo speed regulator here that can maintain back pressure even at low speeds. This thing's top quality~
And if you ever get chased again, one hard acceleration burst could shake off pursuers instantly!
Faster than Loxy's current top speed?
Iris, wanna try it for real?
Then promise me you won't drive Loxy like it's flying unless it's absolutely necessary!
Um, Sparkla...==W== Can I help modify Loxy too? I can hand you tools and assist from the side!
Hehe, of course you can. After all, you've been lovingly raising this little one all this time~
I'll show off a little too! And with three people working together, we'll get way more ideas!
Huh? Since when did Leona decide she was joining too?==W== And just so we're clear, Loxy does not need any self-destruct functions.
If we're not doing explosions, then whatever. Anyway,==W== Noya! Wanna join the NGO Tech Exchange Group?!
If you managed to assemble the Oasis all by yourself, that means you already have a basic understanding of Artifacts.==W== But joining the group means passing a trial first...
You need a TRIAL just to join the chat group?!
Yep. But hearing all this out of nowhere is probably confusing, huh? If you ever get interested later, just let me know. I'll help you.
Hey, Sparkla, don't go stealing Noya from me.
Hehe, relax. Noya and Loxy are both adorable, sure... But right now I have a target with even higher priority—
After all, that's the single most uniquely, overwhelmingly adorable existence in this entire world to me~
Things sure are lively over there~ What are they even doing?
Who knows? But it's definitely something fun.

So all I gotta do is make something stronger and more popular than Sparkla's bunny bombs, right? Easy peasy <size=60>♪</size>
As expected of Leona. I'm looking forward to it!
You better do a good job... If you screw this up and Bloc comes crying to me again, I'm not cleaning up your mess.
Screw up? Who do you think I am...==W== HEY!! Don't leave me behind?! Wait for me! Let me on the ride too~~~!!!!
We're already this far out and we can still see the explosions...
Do you think they'll really make it out safely...
If they're not back in ten minutes, Amber and I are going back to check on them.
Took a little work, but we finally shook off the pursuers~
Mhm. As long as everyone made it back safely.
You bosses aren't hurt either, right?
We're fine. Thanks to you drawing the Imperial Guard's attention away, nobody came after us.
Actually, I should be the one thanking you. If I hadn't wanted to test the performance of the "Tyrant Pie" setup, I never would've thought to modify Super Action Pie in the first place.
Hehe. Since the inspiration came from ==PLAYER_NAME==, I named it after the Tyrant directly.==W== Fits perfectly, right?
Oh right, and just like I mentioned back in the workshop... It'll analyze Boss's behavioral patterns and focus on support functions inside the Monolith.
That said, with current technology, the most we can really do is improve target detection and scouting functions. Recreating "that idea" completely is still gonna take a lot more time.
She can actually recreate it if given enough time...? Sparkla's talent is seriously terrifying...
So, ==PLAYER_NAME==, we should climb the Monolith together a lot more from now on. I'll collect tons of data and document everything carefully, hehe~
Ahhh~ So THAT's why you installed a weapon system on Super Action Pie besides Rabbit Pie.==W== Don't tell me you're planning to moonlight as a Trekker too?
As if.==W== I just wanted to turn the inspiration ==PLAYER_NAME== gave me into something as cute and perfect as possible.
...==W== By the way, why were Imperial Guard troops hiding at the convention venue anyway? What exactly happened?
The entire Tech Convention was actually a trap set by Greyhorn, the Imperial Guard knight...
That Neo Hound disappeared for a while. I thought she'd been reassigned somewhere else and we could finally relax a little. Turns out she was secretly cooking up something huge instead.
Damn her! In the end, I still never got to settle things with Sparkla!
It's such a shame the Tech Convention got ruined. I really wanted to see everyone's inventions too...
If you wanna see inventions that badly, come visit my workshop! I've got tons of unreleased gear there~ Or we could even organize an artisan exchange meet-up!
You guys should really keep a lower profile for a while. If Greyhorn locks onto you again, it'll be trouble.

Ohoho, Boss clearly doesn't know how things work~ Dodging pursuit while inventing gadgets and running business is normal life for the Neo Grace Organization. This level barely even counts as excitement~
Besides, if you think about it differently, being chased by the Imperial Guard just means we get live test dummies for our newest bombs!
Um, Bloc... There's still the matter of the additional commission fee you promised us earlier...
O-Ohhh...!==W== R-Right... The additional commission fee...
Let's just forget about the extra fee.
Let's review what went wrong during this commission first.
That face says you're plotting some kind of sneaky excuse to dodge payment~
I should discuss the additional fee with Bloc!
The Imperial Guard suddenly got involved, so your finances are pretty tight right now, aren't they? Let's just forget about the extra commission fee.
BOSS!!!! Ahhh, your radiance is too dazzling!!!!
Even if I have to raise prices later, I'll still sell everything to you at the original price!! No matter what happens, I swear!!
But! I do have one tiny request.
Saving Sparkla from prison already fulfilled your extra commission request.
But because I failed to contact Iris in time, I didn't realize the convention format had changed. That's why Sparkla never got to compete in the final match.
So let's just cancel the extra commission fee.
BOSS!!!! Ahhh, your radiance is too dazzling!!!!
But! I do have one tiny request.
You guaranteed Sparkla would absolutely take first place.
We fulfilled our promise to rescue Sparkla. But unfortunately, you didn't fulfill yours.
That said, agreed payment should still be paid. That's what honoring a contract means, right? As an excellent merchant, I'm sure you know what you should do.
I know, I know...==W== Boss, how about I write you an IOU first?! I'm literally broke right now... Sob sob...
No need for the IOU. But! I do have one tiny request.
Make Willow's new prosthetic really amazing~
Huh? Boss? What do you mean?
Not just because of this. You've always helped me out a lot.
I've wanted to thank you for a long time...==W== But after thinking it over, the only thing I could come up with was asking Bloc to put extra care into your order.
Of course!! I'll make Sparkla create the greatest prosthetic arm ever. Guaranteed to satisfy boss Willow completely!==W== Right, Sparkla?
Loxy's exhaust system still feels kinda lacking. Maybe we should just replace the whole thing?
I've got a Neo speed regulator here that can maintain back pressure even at low speeds. This thing's top quality~
And if you ever get chased again, one hard acceleration burst could shake off pursuers instantly!
Faster than Loxy's current top speed?
Iris, wanna try it for real?
Then promise me you won't drive Loxy like it's flying unless it's absolutely necessary!
Um, Sparkla...==W== Can I help modify Loxy too? I can hand you tools and assist from the side!
Hehe, of course you can. After all, you've been lovingly raising this little one all this time~
I'll show off a little too! And with three people working together, we'll get way more ideas!
Huh? Since when did Leona decide she was joining too?==W== And just so we're clear, Loxy does not need any self-destruct functions.
If we're not doing explosions, then whatever. Anyway,==W== Noya! Wanna join the NGO Tech Exchange Group?!
If you managed to assemble the Oasis all by yourself, that means you already have a basic understanding of Artifacts.==W== But joining the group means passing a trial first...
You need a TRIAL just to join the chat group?!
Yep. But hearing all this out of nowhere is probably confusing, huh? If you ever get interested later, just let me know. I'll help you.
Hey, Sparkla, don't go stealing Noya from me.
Hehe, relax. Noya and Loxy are both adorable, sure... But right now I have a target with even higher priority—
After all, that's the single most uniquely, overwhelmingly adorable existence in this entire world to me~
Things sure are lively over there~ What are they even doing?
Who knows? But it's definitely something fun.

strings.text: Sparkla, you have one, two, three, four ... fifty-eight new orders waiting for you. Please check them at your earliest convenience! W-Wait?! Why am I blocked again?!
Oh hoho! Bunny Scatter Bombs, Bunny Full-Area Suppression Rounds, and Bunny Tracking Bombs sold exactly as I expected! Even after the price hike, they still sold out without a doubt!!

There are dozens more orders specifically requesting Sparkla than before. If I can convince Sparkla to take them all...==W== I should be able to cut down the deficit from this whole incident by a lot!!
Plus the Neo Solution Leona spent an entire week refining without sleep, and… Mm-hmm, that should cover about half of it.
My precious little Dorra, hurry back to me, waaah~~
Send me the requirements for that prosthetic
Sparkla being this proactive? This has to be the first time ever she's come to me asking for a commission, right?!
Miss Willow's requirements are super simple!
First, it needs to look pretty. Second, no unnecessary bulky designs.
Function-wise, the previous one is fine.
But there is one extra request. She wants it to be waterproof. After all, the Trekker Association's work environment isn't limited to land.
In that case, as long as I maximize the waterproofing and make it a prosthetic suitable for underwater use, that should work, right? Something compatible with both freshwater and seawater.
A prosthetic you can use underwater? That's amazing! That's absolutely a selling point~
Once this order is done, if we can add waterproof specs to other models and mass-produce them, it'll definitely make a splash!
Hehe... With this, Bloc's business will be safe and sound!
Are you sure it doesn't need a function that transforms it into a bunny trumpet?
Oh, right. While you're at it, want to take the rest of my orders too~? You're already making one, what's ten more gonna hurt?
I only accepted this order because ==PLAYER_NAME== personally asked me.
Since I already promised, I'll see it through no matter how boring it is.
But aside from that, I won't accept any new orders for the next three months. I told you that already, didn't I?
Bloc, the last barrel of Neo Solution is done! That means we're finally finished, right?!
Well, isn't this rare? Sparkla actually showed up in the group chat! Oh, perfect timing! I just happen to have something important to announce!
Sparkla, Bloc! Behold my brand-new automaton! The upgraded version of Ticka-Boom!
Come on, think of those orders as a little change of pace while you're working on Tyrant Pie. A nice way to relax~
Sparkla, when your Tyrant Pie is finished, you have to tell me right away!
Ticka-Boom Ding-Dong Bang is ready to accept your challenge anytime, hahahaha!
Sparkla, are you really not going to reconsider? If ten is too many, five works too~
I specifically set up Ticka-Boom Ding-Dong Bang's test environment inside the Monolith this time.
All so it can settle things with Tyrant Pie, which is made specifically to support Monolith climbing, on the same battlefield!
If five still takes too long, then three~
Any less and my business won't be able to keep running.
Sparkla has left the group chat.
Why did Sparkla leave the group again?!
Oh no, oh no. I have a bad feeling about this...
AAAAAAAH~ I knew it!==W== She blocked me again! AAAAAAH!!
What am I supposed to do with this mountain of orders...?==B== And how am I supposed to fill the deficit now...
... Ah.==W== I just thought of a great idea~
Sigh. Leona, what do you think I should do with this huge pile of orders specifically asking for Sparkla?
Leona was the one who won first place at the last Tech Convention, but everyone still only wants Sparkla~
What do you mean, "only wants Sparkla"?! I was the champion of that convention, remember?!!
What orders do you have? Send them over and let me see!
Hmph, that's all? These are way too easy. I can make them better than Sparkla, no problem!
Exactly~ That's what I thought too! Then I'll leave these orders to you, Leona. Show everyone what you're made of~
Hmph! Just wait till you see what Leona can do!
Nice. That takes care of the order problem too.
Now I can finally open for business today~!
Welcome, welcome! Feel free to browse~
These are all treasures I personally selected while traveling all across the Nova Continent.
Take your time, have a look. There's bound to be something here just for you~

strings.text: The discovery of a new mineral vein undoubtedly brings new opportunities. Chaton volunteers to survey the mine, only to be refused by Kasimira.
Northwest of the City of a Thousand Monoliths, out in the desert,==RT==lies a mercenary town.
Excellent! Your triumphant expedition marks a crucial step in the grand expansion of our White Cat Troupe...
... To celebrate your glorious return, the great Chaton hereby bestows upon you this plate of nachos!
Well, Benito?==W== Has my boundless generosity left you speechless?
If the crew dragged themselves all the way back here only to be rewarded with nachos...==W== No offense, but I'd betray the troupe right then and there.
But nachos are amazing! Are you saying you don't like them?!
Don't make excuses just because you're craving them yourself...
Sigh... Need I remind you we're out here to gather ingredients for Kasimira and their welcome banquet?
Since you have time to kill, go hunt down some game in the desert. Make my life a little easier.
Then where are you going, Benito?
I'm heading to the Imperial Guard camp to see what supplies they're scalping. If there's anything good, I'll grab it and make tartare for everyone.
And I'll keep an eye out for those nachos you won't shut up about.
Aha!==W== I knew you were the best, Benito!
Alright,==W== alright.==W== Don't wander too deep into the desert! And make absolutely sure you're back in town before sunset, got it?
When the sun sinks beneath the sea of sand... The great Chaton shall return in triumph across the horizon!
Sigh... No wonder Kasimira worries about you.
Ugh... I'm dead. Finally back in Mirage.
Welcome back, Captain! Great job on the expedition.
Thanks. Good work holding down the fort.
The welcome feast is ready. Wash up, everyone—let's eat.
Awesome! A home-cooked feast from Benito!
I hear your summons! Now, as the Dark God-Slayer—I descend upon this realm!
Warriors, returned from the brink of death! Your dark powers may be gone...==W== But for expanding the great Chaton's domain, I grant you this bounty!==W==
Did you change your lines again? That's not what we rehearsed on the way here.
Hmph, those were mere placeholders!==W== The great Chaton demands a far more imposing script for her true descent...==W== Wait, I mean proclamation!
Not quite. We didn't expand any borders. We took a commission in another city.
Still. Glad to see you're still your spirited self, Chaton.
That's it? That's your whole reaction?==W==
Alright, save the theatrics. Everyone's starving. Let's eat and catch up.
Captain! Captain! Tell us about your expedition to Flavio!
I bet a big city like that is worlds apart from here!
It isn't all that different from other places we've been. But compared to Mirage? It's night and day.
I heard that you took a commission from Scarlet Sights Media to help a witch. Is that true?
Yeah. The witch is digging into a corporation's secrets, and our job is to cover her extraction.
So why did you leave me behind?!
It might sound simple, but it was a highly complex operation.
We had to stage a distraction so the client could sneak in, then figure out how to crack the company's underground vault.
There was zero room for error. One slip, and it's over for both the client and us.
Hmph. Still sounds easy to me...
For the great Chaton, it's absolute child's play! ==W==
Ahem. Since it's a witch's commission, I assume the payout includes some juicy intel?
Right... I'm getting to that. You remember the old crystal diamond mine northeast of town?
Yeah, but hasn't that place been bone-dry and abandoned for ages?
Word is, some trekkers clearing monsters from the tunnels stumbled across a new vein.
Yeah. But instead of reporting it to the Trekker Association or going public, they kept it quiet.
They sold the intel to the Desert Scorpions for a fortune.
If that's true, the Desert Scorpions will keep the mine to themselves.
Must've been a hell of a payout.
But it gets worse. When they hit Flavio, they sold the same intel to the local merchants.
Double-dipping? Where's the honor in that? They're blinded by greed!
Still, it's good news for Mirage.
If we bring that dead mine back to life, maybe things can go back to normal.
The Desert Scorpions plan to lock down the vein. No sharing.
The damn Desert Scorpions! Why is it always them?
The Imperial Guard backed them to keep us in line. They stole that mine back then from Mirage and us... Makes me sick!
And in the end, the Desert Scorpions barely made anything off it...
Right after Captain Narida vanished with the Monolith, the mine gave out.
They must've had a hand in it! Maybe Captain Narida disappeared because they—
The priority is to verify the intel and find out what the Desert Scorpions are up to.
Hmph. Every mission we've run has been missing one critical piece...
That's right! The great Chaton—the only one in the White Cat Troupe with the dark power! And with a chance this perfect, there's no reason not to unleash my ultimate power!
Leave the Desert Scorpions and that abyssal mine to the great Chaton!
Tch... I knew you'd say that...
"Too early, too early!" You brush me off with that same excuse every time!
Is my dark power that insignificant to you?!
This isn't something you can solve with "power" alone. And honestly, I still don't get what your dark power is supposed to be.
I haven't even tried, and you're already shutting me down!
You've never let me show my strength! Not once!!
That's not true... I've given you chances, haven't I?
When?! You always jump in and interfere!
Well, let me refresh your memory then! Like... Oh, right, back when we went to Cangwu—

strings.text: Even though it was Chaton who accepted the commission, Kasimira is always "interfering," which makes Chaton feel highly dissatisfied.
Alright, this is far enough. My guys will handle the rest!
Thanks to you, the trip was a breeze.==W== Here's your final pay.==W== We'd love to hire you again if our paths cross!
You flatter us. Until next time.==W==
A successful escort means arriving safely without drawing trouble.
Then why did I even come?!
Well... You all worked hard. Let's take a break. Enjoy the city, and we'll regroup at the Baize Bureau in four hours.
I should've just stayed in Mirage and played games with Benito!
And who was it that begged to tag along?
But if you want some action, come with me to the Baize Bureau.
To grab some quick jobs while we resupply. We need the travel money.
Heh heh, I see... So you had planned all along to unleash the great Chaton's dark power upon this land?
Hehe!==W== The true star always saves her entrance for the finale!
Uh...==W== If that's how you want to see it.
Excellent! Then the great Chaton shall accompany you!
Yeah. We just wrapped up a long escort run. Got anything simple we can finish by today?
I see... These survey jobs might fit. Have a look.
Oh, a commission to clear out monsters in the forest west of Cangwu.
Trekkers report a spike in monsters out there. Likely breeding season.
Heh... This timing.==W== It must be fated.
I knew it... Fate favors the master of dark power!
Miss this, and we will be cursed by the Ancient Meowth God!
A forest trip? Back by today?
It isn't far from Cangwu. You could get it done in hours.
Plus, it's a Baize Bureau job, so you'll get paid the same day.
Hmph. Since fate has made the choice for us—
Alright... Since you want it, we'll take it.
Heck yeah! The great Chaton finally gets to shine!
Then please sign this commission form. Just don't forget to bring back the monsters' horns as proof of your kill.
Heh... I can feel it. The darkness sealed inside me ...==W== is stirring.
Perfect! You'll be my debut sacrifices!
See that?! That's proof my dark power is awakening!
Yes... Good... I feel it!==W== The power keeps pouring in!
Hey, wait!==W== Those were my kills!
Don't push too far up. Watch your surroundings.
If it gets too heavy, fall back behind me.
I'll take close-quarters. You snipe the distant targets.
We've got melee and ranged covered. Let's keep this rhythm and push forward.
Besides, I picked this commission! Let me take care of it!
Wait, that's not what I meant—
Trash like this? I can wipe them out myself!
Hey! Chaton! Don't charge so far ahead alone!
Ugh... I'm beat. Give me a minute...
Hang in there! We can rest in Cangwu!
I said I had it!==W== Back off!
Focus on the heavy hitters. Don't let them block your retreat!
Obviously! You don't need to spell it out, you know?!
You nag me about this every time! It drives me nuts!
She's charging the front line with a sniper rifle... Isn't she a sniper? That's insane...
And watch—==W==when she wounds one,==W== the other lady swoops in for the kill.
The one with the shotgun is a pro.==W== She's covering all her blind spots...==W==
Honestly,==W== it looks more like they're fighting over the kills...==W==
Who cares?==W== They're keeping the monsters busy.==W== Let's make a run for it!
Good point... This place is too dangerous.
I'd have bagged more if she had backed off.
Please, no! You'll ruin the ecosystem...
Thanks! I'll tally your reward. Hang on.
You overextended! What if they cornered you?
Even so, I'd easily fight my way out!
You never let me finish a job on my own.
Not once! You just treat me like a total rookie!
That's not true! What about that time in the City of a Thousand Monoliths?
The City of a Thousand Monoliths? That was—

param: Even though it was Chaton who accepted the commission, Kasimira is always "interfering," which makes Chaton feel highly dissatisfied.
Alright, this is far enough. My guys will handle the rest!
Thanks to you, the trip was a breeze.==W== Here's your final pay.==W== We'd love to hire you again if our paths cross!
You flatter us. Until next time.==W==
A successful escort means arriving safely without drawing trouble.
Then why did I even come?!
Well... You all worked hard. Let's take a break. Enjoy the city, and we'll regroup at the Baize Bureau in four hours.
I should've just stayed in Mirage and played games with Benito!
And who was it that begged to tag along?
But if you want some action, come with me to the Baize Bureau.
To grab some quick jobs while we resupply. We need the travel money.
Heh heh, I see... So you had planned all along to unleash the great Chaton's dark power upon this land?
Hehe!==W== The true star always saves her entrance for the finale!
Uh...==W== If that's how you want to see it.
Excellent! Then the great Chaton shall accompany you!
Yeah. We just wrapped up a long escort run. Got anything simple we can finish by today?
I see... These survey jobs might fit. Have a look.
Oh, a commission to clear out monsters in the forest west of Cangwu.
Trekkers report a spike in monsters out there. Likely breeding season.
Heh... This timing.==W== It must be fated.
I knew it... Fate favors the master of dark power!
Miss this, and we will be cursed by the Ancient Meowth God!
A forest trip? Back by today?
It isn't far from Cangwu. You could get it done in hours.
Plus, it's a Baize Bureau job, so you'll get paid the same day.
Hmph. Since fate has made the choice for us—
Alright... Since you want it, we'll take it.
Heck yeah! The great Chaton finally gets to shine!
Then please sign this commission form. Just don't forget to bring back the monsters' horns as proof of your kill.
Heh... I can feel it. The darkness sealed inside me ...==W== is stirring.
Perfect! You'll be my debut sacrifices!
See that?! That's proof my dark power is awakening!
Yes... Good... I feel it!==W== The power keeps pouring in!
Hey, wait!==W== Those were my kills!
Don't push too far up. Watch your surroundings.
If it gets too heavy, fall back behind me.
I'll take close-quarters. You snipe the distant targets.
We've got melee and ranged covered. Let's keep this rhythm and push forward.
Besides, I picked this commission! Let me take care of it!
Wait, that's not what I meant—
Trash like this? I can wipe them out myself!
Hey! Chaton! Don't charge so far ahead alone!
Ugh... I'm beat. Give me a minute...
Hang in there! We can rest in Cangwu!
I said I had it!==W== Back off!
Focus on the heavy hitters. Don't let them block your retreat!
Obviously! You don't need to spell it out, you know?!
You nag me about this every time! It drives me nuts!
She's charging the front line with a sniper rifle... Isn't she a sniper? That's insane...
And watch—==W==when she wounds one,==W== the other lady swoops in for the kill.
The one with the shotgun is a pro.==W== She's covering all her blind spots...==W==
Honestly,==W== it looks more like they're fighting over the kills...==W==
Who cares?==W== They're keeping the monsters busy.==W== Let's make a run for it!
Good point... This place is too dangerous.
I'd have bagged more if she had backed off.
Please, no! You'll ruin the ecosystem...
Thanks! I'll tally your reward. Hang on.
You overextended! What if they cornered you?
Even so, I'd easily fight my way out!
You never let me finish a job on my own.
Not once! You just treat me like a total rookie!
That's not true! What about that time in the City of a Thousand Monoliths?
The City of a Thousand Monoliths? That was—

strings.text: Back in Emor, the City of a Thousand Monoliths, Kasimira once let Chaton run a mission solo, but it was nothing like the epic adventure she was looking for.
I—==W==in the name of the ancient Meowth God—deliver judgment!
The crimson moon hangs high!==W== The gates of blood swing wide!==W== All who defy the God of Meows shall plunge into the cursed abyss!==W==
Eye of the Demon Lord—==W==Unleash!==W== Burn it all to ash!==W==
You think a weak attack like that can hit the great Chaton?==W== Dream on!
This strike will be your end!
Witness the true dark power!==W== Hyaaaah—!==W==
Heheh! Now you see the power of the great Chaton!
Yay! The great Chaton is so amazing—!==W==
The Monolith has to be packed with dark power after the Meltdown! I need to see it for myself!
Instead, she hands me this boring Ash District patrol! She totally looks down on me!
I don't think the Captain meant it like that. This is a special situation, you know?
You were there when Willow gave the briefing, weren't you?
That covers the situation. We need your help sweeping the area for leftover Stellaroids.
The Imperial Guard rarely has the manpower for Ash District, so be extra careful on patrol.
We also need another team to investigate the interior of the affected Monolith.
However, we have zero intel on what awaits inside, making this commission highly dangerous. Please consider your personnel assignments carefully.
<size=52>That is exactly why I should've been the one to go!</size>
A Monolith Meltdown is a once-in-a-century event! Who knows when the next one will hit!
We could've swept Ash District any day of the week!
Besides, we've been walking in circles forever. There's not a single Stellaroid out here!
But Willow warned us that the commission is extremely dangerous.
Captain must've had her reasons for keeping you off the team.
Besides, checking Ash District is just as important. Any stray Stellaroids could cause real trouble.
But with the great Chaton here, we can wipe them out fast and keep the district safe!
Hmph, obviously! With the great Chaton on the prowl, there's nothing to fear!
That's the spirit! Let's keep moving!
Hey, you! What are you doing snooping around here?!
Strangers! Quick, go tell Sister Vollara!
Easy, we aren't anyone suspicious. We're the White Cat Troupe, just sweeping for leftover Stellaroids.
I think Sister Minova mentioned them... They put on plays.
So, are you gonna put on a play for us?
Are those guns props for a play? Wow... They look exactly like the real thing.
A prop?! This weapon is the ultimate symbol of dark power!
Dark power...? What's that? It ... sounds cool!
Can you show us more? Do you know any spells?
If you insist, the great Chaton will indulge you... Ahem.
Hear me, pathetic Stellaroids! I am the great Chaton, the God-Slayer! My left eye holds the power of darkness! Demon Eye, unleash—!
Ahem. Chaton,==W== we still have a mission to finish...
What?! But I want to see more!
Hey. Sister Minova said we shouldn't bother people.
These kids are young, but mature… Who is this Sister Minova?
Minova's the hero who saved the Ash District Orphanage!
Hmph... I see. So even in the forgotten corners of this city, heroes still rise... Then how could the great Chaton possibly miss her cue?
Since you mortals crave a performance, I'll treat you to the true Theater of Darkness!
Wait, what? We're still on a mission...
Great teamwork. Hard to believe you've just been a Trekker for less than a year.
With a Trekker like you in Ash District, our future is in good hands.
Haha, you flatter me. I've got a long way to go, and plenty to learn from veterans like you.
You think a weak attack like that can hit the great Chaton? Dream on!
That was awesome! The great Chaton is so amazing—!
Wow! I didn't know plays were this fun!!
That was so cool! What a show!
An excellent show.==W== You completed the commission and put on a hit performance.
Is she with you? That was quite a show. Even I got drawn in.
I'm Minova, leader of the Ashwind Clan. And right now...==W== A part-time Trekker.
Minova was working on a Monolith exploration commission too. That's how we met.
Hmph—==W==wait, no! Forget about that! Kasimira! Why did you dump such a boring mission on me? I haven't seen a single one of these leftover Stellaroids!
Ah, about that. Boss's team and I cleared out the Stellaroids around here ages ago. Your commission was likely the Trekker Association ordering a final sweep, just to be safe.
Still, thanks for putting on that show for the Ash District kids. We don't see performances like that around here often.
Oh! Th-There's no need to thank me... As long as they had fun, it was worth the trip!
It's time we regroup with the others. Let's go, Chaton.
Leaving so soon? If you're ever back this way, let me thank you properly.
Show us that awesome move one last time!!
Heheh! Of course!==W== Once your hearts brim with the dark power...==W== We shall return!

strings.text: Benito finally manages to smooth things over, and Kasimira gives the green light to let Chaton carry out a mission on her own. Before they head out, Kasimira quietly has Benito pass Chaton a pendant.
Hmph! A mission like this is completely beneath the great Chaton's talents.
Protecting the children of Ash District is every bit as important as investigating the Monolith. No talent is being wasted here.
I know, I know...==W== But if I'm stuck doing small jobs forever, when do I actually get to use my dark power?
Alright, alright, break it up, you two.
To be fair, she really shone in Cangwu and Emor this time.
Why don't we let Chaton take point on this next investigation?==W== What do you think?
Benito!==W== You're a genius! Yes, exactly!==W== Let's go with Benito's plan!
Wait, what? No, it's not... But...
Sigh... Alright. You make a fair point. I suppose it really is about time.
Alright, since the Captain gave the okay, get some rest tonight, Chaton. We're heading out first thing tomorrow.
Heheh, destiny finally calls!==W== Now the great Chaton must go and recharge.
...==W== No, never mind.==W== Get some rest.
Just don't get so hyped up that you can't sleep tonight!
Heheh, I've got my own secret sleeping technique. Don't worry!
No... I'm just ... a little uneasy.
Yeah. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't worried.
I mean, she messes up about twice as often as she succeeds.
Oh, so you know that. Then why stick up for her?
Because...==W== Ahem.==W== Everyone in Third Squad likes that kid, don't they?
Besides, she won't grow if we don't let her try.
Still...==W== Send a few people with her tomorrow. To be safe.
Yes!==W== Finally, it's the great Chaton's time to shine!
I can feel it.==W== The dark power surging inside me!==W== No problem!==W== I'm gonna crush it today!
A pendant from Kasimira. She said it brings good luck.
She wanted to give it to you herself...
Hmph! I don't need her blessing!==W== The dark power protects me!
Take it. If you don't want Kasimira's blessing, consider it mine.
The Captain assigned us as your subordinates. We're here to back you up.
We made a good team back in the City of a Thousand Monoliths, didn't we?
My subordinates...?==W== Here to back me up?
Yeah. Uh... Let me think. I should be calling you "the great Chaton" now, right?
Chaton, one more thing—you didn't forget the mission, did you?
Huh? Of course not!==W== Um, well...
Ahem.==W== The Captain's orders: confirm if this new mine exists, and—
—figure out why the Desert Scorpions want to monopolize it.
Right! That's it! I knew that!
Alright, let's scout the desert by the mine first!
Dead quiet out here. If they're moving anything from the mine, this is the only way through.
They say this road was packed with ore wagons before the vein dried up. But there's not a single one now.
Don't tell me we got false intel...
Too early to call it. If the Desert Scorpions want to fly under the radar, they'd move the ore at night.
One overnight sandstorm wipes the tracks totally clean, no matter how deep.
<size=30>Shh! Keep it down...==W== Did you hear that?</size>
That damn deputy captain... Dumping me with all the garbage jobs first thing in the morning.
If she hears you say that, we're dead meat!
Hah? What, you think she's got super-hearing?
Excuse me... That job you mentioned... Does it actually pay well?
Trekkers? Why are they mixing with the Desert Scorpions?
Don't worry! The mine's dead short on hands right now.
Put in a few days' work, and you'll walk away with a fat payout. Beats digging in the dirt for Artifacts, right?
Yeah! We even cover room and board!
Ooh! That does sound pretty great!
Talk about lucky. Can't believe we snagged a commission like this.
If our deputy captain wasn't such a softie, you Trekkers would never get a shot like this.
Unless I'm hearing things, they were just talking about the mine.
But there hasn't been a peep in town about the mine looking for workers.
Let's tail them and see what's going on...
Hehehe... Is it finally time?==RT==Time to infiltrate the underground lair consumed by darkness?
Alright! Leave it to the great Chaton to drag the truth into the light!

strings.text: Tracking the missing Trekkers leads them straight into the mine controlled by Desert Scorpions. Turns out the gang is kidnapping people for slave labor—Chaton immediately rushes back to the bar with the intel...
Yep! You're here, so quit stalling and get to work!
Wait, we want to see the dorms and the mess hall first.
No dorms or mess halls here. Wanna sleep? Grab a blanket and crash on the floor. You get three meals of Tawny Nightingale bread a day.
Hey, wait a minute! This wasn't the deal!
Sure it is! We're covering room and board, ain't we?
And the pay?! We agreed on 10 thousand Dorra a day, per person!
Oh, you'll get your money.==W== Don't worry about that.
But...==W== You won't see a single coin until you've put in a full six months. Try to skip out early, and sorry—you walk away with nothing.
Hold on! We agreed to daily payouts, not getting trapped down here for half a year!
We do pay daily! We just settle the tab every six months, that's all. Like I said, you won't be shorted a single Dorra.
You bastards! We're not falling for this scam!==RT==The deal is off. We're out of here!
Quitting? Fine by us, we won't force you.
But that counts as a breach of contract. So, if you'd kindly hand over the 18-million Dorra cancellation fee right now... And don't short us a single coin, alright?
18 million Dorra?! That's exactly what we'd make in half a year!
Bingo! It's right there in the fine print at the bottom. Don't tell me ... you signed it without reading it?
The great Chaton!==W== Over here! We can watch them from here, and they'll never spot us.
Oh, thanks. You seem pretty familiar with these tunnels.
I used to work around here. Good thing the layout hasn't changed much. Glad my experience is still coming in handy.
Ah, no wonder Kasimira specifically sent you along... What a worrywart.
Oh, that. Kasimira had Benito sneak it into my bag.==W== Said it'd bring me luck or whatever.
Ooh, I see how it is.
Nope, only asking.==W== I'm sure it'll bring us luck.
You lying scumbags! Out of our way! We're leaving!
This is our turf. We do what we want.
Huh? Aren't those the Trekkers from earlier? Why are they fighting?
Captain, let's beat these thugs down and bust out of here!
Funny.==W== I was thinking the same thing...==W==
What's going on? All this noise...
Captain! Are you okay?! Wake up!
Quit screaming. He's knocked out. He'll wake up soon.
Deputy Captain? What brings you here? Do you have orders?
And you, stop wasting your breath.==W== These idiots have a death wish. Just throw them in with the monster.
Tell your men to get ready. We're heading to Philae to meet the Captain.
Damn it! Let go! I'm reporting you to the Imperial Guard and the Trekker Association!
Be my guest.==W== Assuming you make it out alive.
Those scumbags...!==W== One bullet and their Deputy Captain drops. We free those Trekkers right now.
Hold on, the great Chaton! Firing now won't save them. You'll just get us all caught!
B-But ... we can't just watch them get dragged away!
We've been in this exact situation before! Take a breath and think!
Hold. The caravan isn't in position yet.
But I have a clean shot at their leader! I can drop him now!
Wait any longer, and we lose the shot!!!
Back then... If I'd just listened to Kasimira, we wouldn't have walked into that trap.
We're falling back! The others need this intel immediately.
Looks like some reckless little kittens slipped in.
Heh. They might be useful after all.
Good work, everyone. You all did great.
See? I can handle real work too, right, Kasimira?
Yeah, you made some sharp calls out there. I'm impressed.
Still, those Desert Scorpion bastards are heartless!
They're not just hogging the mine.==W== They're conning Trekkers into forced labor!
Kasimira! Quit stalling! Let's go rescue them!
Easy, Chaton. You've only seen the tip of the iceberg.
We have no idea how many Desert Scorpions are still in there. If we rush in, we're walking straight into their trap.
What now? We can't just sit around and do nothing.
Since those Trekkers took the job here, someone must have seen them around town.
Send someone to ask around.==W== We'll likely find someone who knows them.
If we figure out how they were tricked, we might be able to sneak in too.
Ah!==W== So we sneak into the heart of their base, unleash the dark power, and wipe them out in one go, right?!
Then leave it all to the great Chaton!
Good. But have a solid plan before you go.
Awesome! I'm heading to town to ask around. I'll bring back solid leads.
Don't pick any fights. If you get in trouble, come right back, got it?
What? The Desert Scorpions are a huge outfit. Why would they hand a job to freelancers like us?
But I saw a few Trekkers with some Desert Scorpions this morning. They all went toward the old mine together.
Did anyone else talk to them?
Alright... Well, thanks for the info anyway!
Walked in circles all day, and I've got zero leads.
Maybe ... I should storm their dark lair and see for myself...
You're ... asking about the Trekkers the Desert Scorpions took this morning, aren't you?
I-I barely got away from them! I have intel!==W==
Help me shake these Desert Scorpions, and I'll tell you everything I know!
Where'd that rat go?! Split up and find him!
There you are, you little punk! Thought you could hide?
Hey! What gives you the right to grab him?!
Mind your business! He broke his contract and owes us. We're taking him back to pay up.
That penalty fee is a scam to kidnap people for slave labor!
Oh? You know an awful lot about our operations, little girl.

Hold on! We agreed to daily payouts, not getting trapped down here for half a year!
We do pay daily! We just settle the tab every six months, that's all. Like I said, you won't be shorted a single Dorra.
You bastards! We're not falling for this scam!==RT==The deal is off. We're out of here!
Quitting? Fine by us, we won't force you.
But that counts as a breach of contract. So, if you'd kindly hand over the 18-million Dorra cancellation fee right now... And don't short us a single coin, alright?
18 million Dorra?! That's exactly what we'd make in half a year!
Bingo! It's right there in the fine print at the bottom. Don't tell me ... you signed it without reading it?
The great Chaton!==W== Over here! We can watch them from here, and they'll never spot us.
Oh, thanks. You seem pretty familiar with these tunnels.
I used to work around here. Good thing the layout hasn't changed much. Glad my experience is still coming in handy.
Ah, no wonder Kasimira specifically sent you along... What a worrywart.
Oh, that. Kasimira had Benito sneak it into my bag.==W== Said it'd bring me luck or whatever.
Ooh, I see how it is.
Nope, only asking.==W== I'm sure it'll bring us luck.
You lying scumbags! Out of our way! We're leaving!
This is our turf. We do what we want.
Huh? Aren't those the Trekkers from earlier? Why are they fighting?
Captain, let's beat these thugs down and bust out of here!
Funny.==W== I was thinking the same thing...==W==
What's going on? All this noise...
Captain! Are you okay?! Wake up!
Quit screaming. He's knocked out. He'll wake up soon.
Deputy Captain? What brings you here? Do you have orders?
And you, stop wasting your breath.==W== These idiots have a death wish. Just throw them in with the monster.
Tell your men to get ready. We're heading to Philae to meet the Captain.
Damn it! Let go! I'm reporting you to the Imperial Guard and the Trekker Association!
Be my guest.==W== Assuming you make it out alive.
Those scumbags...!==W== One bullet and their Deputy Captain drops. We free those Trekkers right now.
Hold on, the great Chaton! Firing now won't save them. You'll just get us all caught!
B-But ... we can't just watch them get dragged away!
We've been in this exact situation before! Take a breath and think!
Hold. The caravan isn't in position yet.
But I have a clean shot at their leader! I can drop him now!
Wait any longer, and we lose the shot!!!
Back then... If I'd just listened to Kasimira, we wouldn't have walked into that trap.
We're falling back! The others need this intel immediately.
Looks like some reckless little kittens slipped in.
Heh. They might be useful after all.
Good work, everyone. You all did great.
See? I can handle real work too, right, Kasimira?
Yeah, you made some sharp calls out there. I'm impressed.
Still, those Desert Scorpion bastards are heartless!
They're not just hogging the mine.==W== They're conning Trekkers into forced labor!
Kasimira! Quit stalling! Let's go rescue them!
Easy, Chaton. You've only seen the tip of the iceberg.
We have no idea how many Desert Scorpions are still in there. If we rush in, we're walking straight into their trap.
What now? We can't just sit around and do nothing.
Since those Trekkers took the job here, someone must have seen them around town.
Send someone to ask around.==W== We'll likely find someone who knows them.
If we figure out how they were tricked, we might be able to sneak in too.
Ah!==W== So we sneak into the heart of their base, unleash the dark power, and wipe them out in one go, right?!
Then leave it all to the great Chaton!
Good. But have a solid plan before you go.
Awesome! I'm heading to town to ask around. I'll bring back solid leads.
Don't pick any fights. If you get in trouble, come right back, got it?
What? The Desert Scorpions are a huge outfit. Why would they hand a job to freelancers like us?
But I saw a few Trekkers with some Desert Scorpions this morning. They all went toward the old mine together.
Did anyone else talk to them?
Alright... Well, thanks for the info anyway!
Walked in circles all day, and I've got zero leads.
Maybe ... I should storm their dark lair and see for myself...
You're ... asking about the Trekkers the Desert Scorpions took this morning, aren't you?
I-I barely got away from them! I have intel!==W==
Help me shake these Desert Scorpions, and I'll tell you everything I know!
Where'd that rat go?! Split up and find him!
There you are, you little punk! Thought you could hide?
Hey! What gives you the right to grab him?!
Mind your business! He broke his contract and owes us. We're taking him back to pay up.
That penalty fee is a scam to kidnap people for slave labor!
Oh? You know an awful lot about our operations, little girl.

strings.text: Raid: Traps of the Dark Nest
Kasimira's gut says it's a setup. But with lives on the line, the White Cat Troupe isn't about to back down. Trap or not, they're going in!
See? I told you I was right.
We should let her try things on her own more often. It's not like she messes up every time.
You're right. She's come a long way.
I know I'm too protective.==W== But sometimes, letting go isn't easy...
Also, you should've given her that pendant yourself instead of having me do it.
When you called her back earlier, you were going to give it to her, weren't you?
Yeah... But knowing how stubborn she is, she'd never take it.
"You won't know how good it is unless you try it." Isn't that what she always says?
You two are more alike than you think. One won't talk, and the other won't listen.
Instead of staying stuck like this, you should sit down and actually talk to her.
Nyahahaha! The great Chaton has returned in triumph!
Heh heh. What did you expect from the wielder of the dark power? Just a quick stroll and—bam!—jackpot!
Everyone, get over here! You've gotta hear this guy's story!
White Cat Troupe, please... You have to save us!
Fished him away from a bunch of Desert Scorpion grunts. Said he was a miner who escaped the camp.
Wait, hold on. An escaped miner? And you saved him all by yourself?
You bet! As if a few measly Desert Scorpions could stop the great Chaton!
Good work, Chaton. But I'm curious... How exactly did he escape right under their noses?
W-Well... There's this massive monster prowling the tunnels. It brought the digging to a dead stop.
But the Scorpions didn't care! They forced us to keep digging until the monster went completely berserk...==W== I slipped away in the chaos.
Yeah! It's huge, and terrifyingly strong. Looks like it's nesting right in the central tunnels...
Oh! We actually overheard their deputy captain talking about a monster earlier.
Right!==W== And that deputy captain just took half her thugs and headed for Philae!
The place is barely guarded right now! If I lead the way, you can save my friends!
Yeah, we caught that part too.
With their guards spread thin... It really is the perfect opening.
It is! So many of my friends are still locked up in there. Please, you have to help us!
They're forcing them to dig right next to that monster today! They could die at any second!
Some are Trekkers they scammed, but the rest are just locals they kidnapped from Mirage...
Understood. If we break the victims out and expose this new ore vein, we can rally the whole town against the Desert Scorpions.
Exactly! Lives are on the line. We can't afford to wait!
But think about it... A monster shows up, and their deputy captain just conveniently leaves with half her people?
That's far too convenient. This has to be a trap.
So what if it's a trap?! We can't just leave them to die!
She's right! We're completely expendable to the Desert Scorpions! Please, you can't turn your backs on them!
Yeah! Captain, those Desert Scorpion bastards are scum!
We've put up with them long enough. Let's make them pay!
Besides...==W== If we want the town to rebel against the Desert Scorpions, we need a win to prove it's possible.
Yes! If you save those people, the whole town and the Trekkers will fight alongside you! I swear it!
Relax! With the great Chaton leading the charge, their little trap is nothing!
Alright...==W== Per Squad Three, Rule One: on any major operational decision, every member gets a vote.
Gear up, everyone. We're hitting the mine.
Damn it! Warn the others! The White Cat Troupe is here!
Just as I thought. Barely any guards!
Hah! Captives of this dark abyss, the great Chaton has arrived to set you free!
Even without their deputy captain, this defense is way too light. Something's wrong.
Chaton, slow down. We don't know what's waiting further in.
Line 'em up, knock 'em down! You're no match for me! Nya-hahaha!
Through that cave. That's where they're holding the Trekkers!
This mine's gonna cave in, isn't it...
Wait! Don't scatter! Get back here!
I'm leaving this to you! I'm out of here!
Captain! The captive Trekkers and townsfolk are right there!
Hmph. The true trial begins now.
Leave this monster to me—the great Chaton!

strings.text: Kasimira's gut is right—it's an ambush. When the Desert Scorpions spring the trap, Kasimira instinctively throws herself in front of Chaton...
Huff...==W== Puff...==W== A weakling like that is no match for the great Chaton!
I'm good too.==W== But seriously... Who are you guys?
Hmph!==B====W== We ...==B====W==<size=40> are the</size>==B====W==<size=50> White Cat Troupe!</size>
Ahaha... Sorry, I'm a bit out of the loop.
B-But we owe you our lives. We'll repay this someday!
Us too!==W== Thanks for saving us!
Hehe, don't mention it!==W== An emissary of dark power just does what comes naturally!
All here, Captain. The Trekkers have a few scrapes, but our team is completely fine.
See, Kasimira?==W== With the great Chaton here, fate is always on our side!
Why aim for Kasimira? Target her team, and she'll take the bullet for them!
Dang it! You played us from the start...
Can't believe this disguise Artifact worked like a charm!
Deputy Captain spotted you the second you snuck into the mine.
That's why she gave me this fake miner gig... To lure you down here to kill that monster for us!
Listen up! Kasimira's down!==W== The White Cat Troupe is finished! Rush 'em and wipe 'em out!
You're dead! No one touches Kasimira...!
Keep pushing! That monster wore them out! They've got nothing left in the tank!
Crap! We can't hold them off much longer!
She's alive! It's not fatal. She's just out cold!
Chaton, focus!==W== If we don't drop these guys right now, we're all dead anyway!
I've got a suggestion... Drop the Trekkers.
Leave them behind, and you might actually stand a chance!
Chaton, any ideas?!==W== We're sitting ducks out here!
Uh... A plan...==W== My plan is...
I've got nothing! My mind's blank!
What am I supposed to do... What if I screw this up again...
Pull it together, Chaton! You've got this!
Why else would the captain trust you with that pendant?
A pendant from Kasimira. She said it brings good luck.
She wanted to give it to you herself...
That pendant is a charm. Captain only hands it out to members when they are about to undertake a major mission.
She might have been too shy to pass it to you herself, but the fact she gave it to you means she thinks you're ready.
Yeah. She plays it off as a good luck charm... But we all know what it means.
This pendant...==W== It's the same color as my dark power...
She had it ready for you a long time ago. A charm meant only for you.
Dammit! If you believed in my dark power all along, why didn't you say anything?!
Something this important... You should've given it to me yourself!
Cap! Those White Cat punks haven't shot back in a while.
Hah, you bet! After fighting a monster that huge, how much could they have left?
They're out of ammo! Come on, boys, let's wipe 'em out!
I'm no Kasimira. I can't command a chaotic battlefield on the fly.
But the one thing I can do—
—is to clear a path for all of you!!!
Look after Kasimira and the Trekkers!==W==
Wait, Chaton! What are you doing?!
You hurt the people who matter the most to me, and you're gonna pay!!
Oho? What's a single sniper gonna do?==W== What? Planning a suicide run?!
Hey! What're you waiting for? Riddle her with holes!
I-I can't! She's moving too fast! I can't get a lock!
Tch, you useless idiots! Move! I'll do it myself!
If you had cared about your crew the way Kasimira does, I wouldn't have had the time to set this up—
Huh? What the hell are you going on about?
Too bad. The time is ripe—
You unforgivable swindlers! Let the abyss of my dark fury swallow you whole!
Hmph. Think you're the only ones who know how to cut off the head of the snake?
Captain, you're awake! Can you walk?!
Chaton opened a gap! Let's fall back while we can!
Don't worry about me! Kasimira, get everyone out! I'll swat these flies and catch up with you!
With the blessing of my dark power, the great Chaton is invincible~
But...==W== No. You're right.==W== I'm leaving this to you, Chaton.
<size=50>Come on, you Scorpion scum! Taste the great Chaton's one-hundred-percent pure dark power!!</size>
S-Stay back!==W== Somebody stop her!==W== Agh!
Damn it! Where'd those come from?!==W==<size=50> Aaaah!!</size>
Eyes on me! The great Chaton's right here!
That giant monster had been hogging the center. It likely drove off the smaller ones.
Now that it's down, they're flooding back. This mine isn't safe. Let's get a move on!
Chaton! We're pulling out! Fall back!
Wait! Please, have mercy! Let me go! I've got a family waiting for me!
I'll quit the Desert Scorpions tomorrow! I swear!
Get lost. Don't let me catch you again.==W== For your family, start over and stay gone!

strings.text: They get the captive Trekkers out, but Chaton can't shake her gloom. The bitter reality of it all is a far cry from the heroic triumph she envisions.
Benito, I'll leave the flour here.
Wait! You shouldn't be working! Go rest!
I'm fine. The bandages came off today.
Didn't the doctor order a month of rest, even after the wound healed?!
I know my limits, don't worry.==W== Besides, I'm used to injuries like this.
Fine, I can't argue with you.==W== Don't push yourself, okay?
Mm. Speaking of... Where's Chaton today?
Oh, she went to check on the abandoned mine. She'll be back before dinner.
Ugh, figured.==W== The cave-in blocked the path completely. No way in.
Whoa! Nachos and soda!==W== What's the occasion?! Look at all this food!
Kasimira! Are you all healed up?
Not entirely, but at least the bandages are off.
I wanted her to rest a few more days, but she insisted she's fine. So I'm holding a recovery party.
Ah, makes sense!==W== Whoa! This is adorable!
It's so cute. I don't even want to eat it!
You keep running off to that abandoned mine. What are you doing there?
What else? Scouting for a way back in.
We finally found a new vein! If we could mine it, the whole town would be set!
I asked the old-timers in town. They all say it's a lost cause.
Even if we dug new tunnels, it'd cost more than we'd ever make back.
I kept going back anyway, just hoping for a miracle. But yeah... It's really a dead end.
So it was all for nothing?==W== The plan was to rescue those Trekkers, then team up with the town and take the mine back!
Instead, the Desert Scorpions played us, and the new mine is gone! How am I supposed to rally anyone with that?!
If we'd left them, they wouldn't have made it out alive.
A worse cave-in would have been catastrophic.
You see all this food and drink? The Trekkers you rescued sent it over to say thanks.
To them, you made a difference.
She's right. If you hadn't cleared a path, we might not have made it out either.
That was the first time we'd seen you fight like that, Chaton!
You charged the front line alone and tore right through their defenses!
When the Captain went down, I thought that was it...
But... You gave me the courage to keep fighting!
When you stood up for those tricked Trekkers, and led the charge to break us out...
That wasn't about proving how strong you are. You wanted to help people in need.
That kind of heart is all you need, Chaton.
You've proven yourself to all of us.
I know I should've said this sooner...
But make sure you keep that pendant safe. It's your lucky charm.
Here's to the strongest of us all—the great Chaton!
That's right! To the strongest—the great Chaton!==W== Cheers!
Whoa! Chaton, what are you doing?! Get down from there!
I am the sole inheritor of the dark power within the White Cat Troupe! Master of the Supreme Assault Sniper! Sacred herald of the Ancient Meowth God! The true agent of the dark power!
And above all else! The strongest being in the world—the great Chaton!
Destiny chose me to wield the dark power! The great Chaton will lead the White Cat Troupe to glorious conquest!
Desert Scorpions or whatever rabble gets in my way! Anyone who dares challenge my supremacy—
<size=50>—will turn to ash in the great Chaton's crosshairs!</size>
<size=50>I will surpass Kasimira! I will become the true apex of the White Cat Troupe!</size>
Haha, nothing wrong with aiming high, right?
I think Chaton's got what it takes.
When that day comes—I want all of you to remember this exact moment!
Want to know why? Because this moment is—
<size=50>—the start of the grand legend of the world's strongest ... the great Chaton!</size>
Yeah! To the strongest—the great Chaton!
Sigh... After all that, she hasn't changed a bit.
Haha, as long as she's happy. No matter how she acts, she's still the Chaton we love.
Heh, you're right. For now, let's just heap praise on the master of the dark power.

If we'd left them, they wouldn't have made it out alive.
A worse cave-in would have been catastrophic.
You see all this food and drink? The Trekkers you rescued sent it over to say thanks.
To them, you made a difference.
She's right. If you hadn't cleared a path, we might not have made it out either.
That was the first time we'd seen you fight like that, Chaton!
You charged the front line alone and tore right through their defenses!
When the Captain went down, I thought that was it...
But... You gave me the courage to keep fighting!
When you stood up for those tricked Trekkers, and led the charge to break us out...
That wasn't about proving how strong you are. You wanted to help people in need.
That kind of heart is all you need, Chaton.
You've proven yourself to all of us.
I know I should've said this sooner...
But make sure you keep that pendant safe. It's your lucky charm.
Here's to the strongest of us all—the great Chaton!
That's right! To the strongest—the great Chaton!==W== Cheers!
Whoa! Chaton, what are you doing?! Get down from there!
I am the sole inheritor of the dark power within the White Cat Troupe! Master of the Supreme Assault Sniper! Sacred herald of the Ancient Meowth God! The true agent of the dark power!
And above all else! The strongest being in the world—the great Chaton!
Destiny chose me to wield the dark power! The great Chaton will lead the White Cat Troupe to glorious conquest!
Desert Scorpions or whatever rabble gets in my way! Anyone who dares challenge my supremacy—
<size=50>—will turn to ash in the great Chaton's crosshairs!</size>
<size=50>I will surpass Kasimira! I will become the true apex of the White Cat Troupe!</size>
Haha, nothing wrong with aiming high, right?
I think Chaton's got what it takes.
When that day comes—I want all of you to remember this exact moment!
Want to know why? Because this moment is—
<size=50>—the start of the grand legend of the world's strongest ... the great Chaton!</size>
Yeah! To the strongest—the great Chaton!
Sigh... After all that, she hasn't changed a bit.
Haha, as long as she's happy. No matter how she acts, she's still the Chaton we love.
Heh, you're right. For now, let's just heap praise on the master of the dark power.

strings.text: Willow, one of the most reliable seniors of the Trekker Association, works so hard that she hasn't taken a vacation in a long time. With Laru's help, you and some friends finally coax her into going on vacation together...
Cough... Cough, cough...==W== That was the last bit of water.
Drifting for two days. No land in sight... If I'd known about that storm, I'd have stayed ashore.
Is that ... a M-Monolith?! There was nothing there a second ago!
Forget it! If I can reach it, I might actually survive!
If I can just reach it...
Congratulaaations, lucky customer!==W== You're a winner! And it's the ultimate grand prize! Unclaimed for five straight years!
You've won a luxury getaway to the Seaside Resort! With luck like this, everyone's bound to be jealous!
Look at the brochure! Luxury ocean-view suites and a private beach! It's the ultimate vacation!
And there's more! This package includes five tickets! Bring your friends and family, and soak up the magic of the Seaside Resort together!
The ultimate grand prize, huh? That's some impressive luck.
Right? I can't believe we actually won either.
Well, congratulations. Make sure you stay safe at the beach.
What are you talking about? You're coming with us, Willow!
The four of us plus you make five. We can all go together.
That sounds tempting, but work has been piling up at the Trekkers' House lately...
But ... this is a jackpot no one's hit in five years!
There are five tickets, but only four of us.
E-Exactly! It'd be a huge waste not to use them!
I appreciate the thought, but my work—
Willow... Do you even remember your last day off?
We heard! Your last vacation was six months ago.==W== And you went back to the office that same night! That's insane!
No, no... When we got here, we just said hello to the others and happened to talk about you.
Iori. You tipped them off, didn't you?
Yeah. Your schedule isn't classified intel. No harm done.
Let me guess, the clerk handing out prizes...==W== Purple eyes, pigtails?
Huh? How'd you know it was La—
Ah, no, no, no! Not her at all! Nope, definitely not Laru...==W== Oops.
Heh... In on it from the start, all to drag me out of the office.
If you wanted to hang out, you could've asked. Why the whole elaborate scheme?
You're too dedicated, Willow. If we asked directly, you'd find an excuse to say no.
Exactly! Last time we invited you out, you shot us down flat.
Fair point... Can't argue with that.
We wanted you to rest, but asking nicely wouldn't work. So we got creative...
A once-in-five-years jackpot, and a perfect party of five!
If we didn't make it a done deal, you never would've agreed to come.
I see... Thanks for going to the trouble.
Go with them, Willow. Everyone agrees you're overdue for a break.
We'll hold down the Trekkers' House while you're gone. Just go have fun.
I hate taking on extra work...==W== But for you, I'll make an exception.
Even Iori is pushing you, Willow. You really have no excuses left.
Alright, since you've planned it all out...==W== It would be terribly ungrateful of me to refuse.
Yes. I would be delighted to join you.
Phew... Getting Willow to take a break is practically a miracle.
But one condition. Since we're going to the beach, everyone's safety—
I know you. Without supervision, you'll go completely wild.
That's mean! Why am I being singled out?
In short, I'll draft a comprehensive safety manual. This includes swimming zones, food hygiene, and recreational rules.
Isn't this supposed to be a vacation?!
Exactly~ Which is why I won't let anything ruin our trip.
This is where we agreed to meet,==W== right?
The code! Quick, what's the code?!
The code is... Wait, what was it again? Fries... What fries...?
Bingo! You got it! Crispy, crunchy fries!
You're way off! Who even likes soft fries anyway?
Laru never misses a chance to goof around...
Anyway, the plan worked. Willow agreed to come to the resort with us.
Awesome! I knew you'd pull it off! That's our Tyrant for you!
No, wait, I didn't mean it like that!==W== Hey, ==PLAYER_NAME==! Why is this kid staring daggers at me?!
Well, as long as Willow's going, giving up this trip was worth it.
Are you sure you're just giving us these tickets for free?
I have to! Look at this pale face—I haven't had a second to slack off in three whole days...
Everyone in the department is grinding non-stop. If I tried sneaking off on vacation, Albedo would string me up by my ankles with fishing line and hang me in the office as a warning...
Waaah... I actually wanted to go to the resort and do some fishing too...
So this is how you "praise" Lady Albedo behind her back, Miss Laru?
Please, please don't tell her I was slacking off! I'm dead if you do! I'll give you half my fries...==W== No, wait, I'll buy you as many as you want!
Sorry, I can't help you there. Lady Albedo noticed you were gone and sent me to "invite" you back.
We'll be heading off, then. See you around!
So this is how big companies operate? Yikes.
A-Anyway! We can't let Laru's gift go to waste. We need to put these tickets to good use!
Exactly! We have to make sure Willow has an amazing vacation.
Laru... Your sacrifice won't be in vain...
We should stock up on some supplies before we go.
And when it comes to a beach trip, the first thing we need is—
Swimsuits? Don't we already have those?
Miss Iori said Willow probably doesn't have one.
Willow still has to wrap up some work before we leave, so she won't have time to shop. Let's pick one out for her.
Awesome! It'll be the perfect travel gift for her!

strings.text: You arrive at the resort, but it's much quieter than you expected. After a quick cleanup, you change into your swimsuits, ready to enjoy the sunny beach by the sea.
Look at that water! The sky!==W== The breeze! And these houses are gorgeous!
The brochure highlighted the beautiful town scenery, crystal-clear water, and premium service.
Strolling down these streets to the sound of the waves...==W== It's the ultimate peaceful getaway.
It is quiet. You wouldn't guess this is a popular resort.
A bit too quiet, isn't it? The beach is practically empty. It looks nothing like the bustling resort in the brochure.
We're on vacation! Don't sweat the details. Let's go check out our rooms!==W== Ocean-view suite, here we come!
Ooh, is this our room? Looks great!
You can see the ocean from the balcony! It's gorgeous...
Approximately thirty meters to the shoreline. Clear evacuation route in case of an emergency.
And this bed looks fancy! I bet it's super comfortable!
Noya, if you're about to dive onto that bed—wait.
The floor? What's on the...==W== Oh!
There's a thick layer of dust. You can see the footprints we just left.
It's on the desk, too. Dust this thick takes time to build up. No one has cleaned this room in days.
Wait, aren't resorts supposed to clean every day?
They should...==W== Should we ask the front desk for a different room?
That's too much hassle! We can just clean it up ourselves!
Come on, let's start cleaning! Time is Dorra!
Noya, I grabbed two buckets of water.
We're at the beach! Of course we wear swimsuits! Come on, hurry up and change!
Swimsuits have nothing to do with cleaning... We can change when we actually hit the water.
Sigh, I can't with you two... ==W====PLAYER_NAME==, say something.
Let's clean up first, then change
Well... The vacation vibes got to me...
Seeing everyone this excited makes me want to get to the beach, too.
Alright. To get this place cleaned thoroughly and quickly, here's the plan.
Noya sweeps,==W== Amber wipes the furniture,==W== and Iris makes the beds.==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, you're with me. We'll handle the luggage and clutter.
She hands out chores like guild commissions. Classic Trekkers' House pro.
Noya, Amber. I know you're eager to hit the beach, but...
... Sorry. I'm with Iris and Willow on this one.
Cleaning a room in swimsuits is just too weird. I can't do it...
The faster we finish cleaning, the faster we get to the beach. We'll change then.
Ahem. Since there are no objections, let's get to work. Here are your assignments.
Noya sweeps,==W== Amber wipes the furniture,==W== and Iris makes the beds. ==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, you're with me. We'll handle the luggage and clutter.
We just need a solution that keeps everyone happy.
One side wants to change right now, and the other wants to wait until we're done cleaning.
So... What if we change while we clean?
==PLAYER_NAME==, do you even hear yourself right now...?
No, wait, hear me out! A reward system could boost our motivation...
Like ... a milestone system. Clean a bit, change one item. Clean more, change another...
Pretend I didn't say anything. Let's just finish cleaning so we can hit the beach.
Under Willow's direction, the room is spotless in no time.
No stopping them. Let's change and catch up.
Should it really be like this? Isn't it a bit ... skimpy?
I hardly ever wear stuff like this. Not ... used to it at all.
You look great! We picked this one because we knew it'd suit you.
Totally! And ==PLAYER_NAME== picked it out. You trust ==SEX3== taste, right?
Why're you so quiet? You're making me self-conscious.
Iris said you picked this out, ==PLAYER_NAME==?
Yeah. The moment I saw it in the store, I knew it'd suit you. Glad I was right.
Thanks for picking it out. You've got a great eye.
And ...==W== this new prosthetic. I owe you for that too.
Bloc told me you talked Sparkla out of adding a bunch of extra features...
Don't mention it. I gave her a little advice, that's all.
Now that we're all changed, let's hit the water and have a blast!
No one gets in the water without warming up first. That means at least three minutes of proper stretching.
Or you'll cramp up halfway out, and we'll end up dragging you back to shore. Got it?
The water's nice and cool, and the sand is so soft... This is so relaxing...
There's a rip current right there. Go any further, and the waves could drag you out.
A r-rip current? I didn't even notice...
The water might look calm, but the currents are unpredictable. Don't wander off too far by yourself.
Good. Once you're warmed up, stay in the safe zones. And absolutely nobody leaves my sight!
I think I'll sunbathe for a bit.
Put on sunscreen first. The sun looks mild, but it'll still burn you.
Of course. We're at the beach.
Yeah... With Willow in charge, we don't need to worry. We follow her lead.
I want to go in, but I can't swim well...==W== Can you teach me?
No. You tossed me in water, said I'd figure it out.
Don't worry, Amber. We're doing it the proper way this time.
Yeah. I might not dissolve in water... But I still can't swim.
Why not learn now? We rarely get beach vacations. It'd be a waste staying dry on the sand.
Good point... I'll think about it.
The distant sound of waves and laughter drifts faintly to my ears.
Willow is practically our leader. With her in charge, we don't have to worry about Noya and Amber.
It's a relief having her around.
If only every day could be this relaxing...
