strings.text: The truth behind the hermit crab's bad temper is revealed: the local Glopo Duke stole the giant conch shell it called home. Karin decides to help it reclaim the shell, but the Glopo Duke's condition is...
Watch out! A Stellaroid in the corner!
M-Maybe it's a Stellaroid disguised as a barrel!
Easy, Karin. The coast is clear.
Never thought we'd find a Monolith underwater.
We came in through a whirlpool... This is creepy.==W== Nothing's gonna pop out at us, right?
Is it still out for revenge...?
Yeah, its body language says...==W== Uh, let me get a closer look.
You made us change course and followed us ... to bring us here?
I think it wants to lead us somewhere...
Hehe, let's follow it then. It keeps checking to make sure we're keeping up.
Phew...==W== That was a rough journey.
No kidding. The Stellaroids here are tougher than I expected.
You've been scowling ever since we got here. You look tense.
No I haven't! I'm...==W== Ahem. It's nothing, don't worry about it.
Oh, the doors are open! Let's go!
Whoa, look at the size of that conch shell!
Hmph, hmph! Hmph hmph hmph! Hmph!
Aww... Look at that face. It looks so miserable it might cry.
I've been meaning to ask... How exactly are you reading its expressions?
Anyway, about that conch shell...==W== You don't think it's...
How can you be so sure?
Karin, stop glaring. You're scaring her.
This hermit crab...==W== Right before it stole my Automatic Vending Artifact, it was wearing that exact shell.
Hold on, let me process this...==W== The thing it was carrying around earlier was Cosette's Automatic Vending Artifact?
You mean the Automatic Vending Artifact from the resort?
I-I've always wanted my own Automatic Vending Artifact... Then one day I fell into this giant whirlpool and ended up here...
And you made a wish for an Automatic Vending Artifact down here?
That's incredible... Those Automatic Vending Artifacts are worth a fortune! Wish one up and you're set for half a year...==W== No, a whole year!
Lady Cosette, please teach me! What prayer do I say to wish up an Automatic Vending Artifact?
I remember I said ...==W== give me lots and lots of drinks that never run out...
Give me lots and lots of drinks that never run out!
Wow, it appeared! Yes! Now I can drink all I want forever!
Give it back! Give it back now!
That hermit crab grabbed my Vending Artifact and dropped its chipped shell. I chased it straight out of here.
But once I got outside, I lost track of it...==W== I was sad for a very long time...
I never expected to run into it again at the resort!
No wonder you got worked up the moment you saw it...==W== That trap was for catching it, right?
But if that's Cosette's Vending Artifact, then where's the one from the resort?
W-Well... I was scared the hermit crab would steal that one too, so I dug a hole and buried it to keep it safe...
That explains it. Those treasure-hunting Trekkers must have mistaken the Artifact on the crab for the missing one.
But I don't think the hermit crab==W== was trying to steal the Artifact.
Back on the island, when we knocked the machine off its back, it looked relieved.
And when it saw that conch shell earlier, it was desperate to get its old home back.
This hermit crab was hunted everywhere for its valuable shell.==W== The hunters even chipped a piece off its prized possession.
Fleeing for its life, it blundered into the Monolith,==W== only to be spooked by the Stellaroids and scurry around in terror.
Oh... We thought it was being aggressive, but it was actually fleeing in terror?
Yeah. Kind of like Cosette. She bolts the moment she sees someone.
While scrambling around the Monolith, the crab crashed into the Vending Artifact Cosette wished for. Then ...==W== it got stuck.
Ever since then, it's been carrying around a new home it never wanted.
It wants its old shell back, but as you can see, that giant Glopo already claimed it.
With its tiny brain, the hermit crab probably has no idea what happened.
All it knows is it saw a human in the Monolith, there was a flash of light, and its conch shell turned into a big square box. It must be completely bewildered.
It probably figured bringing another human back to the Monolith would help it swap its conch shell back.
No wonder it showed up at the crowded resort.==W== It's a shame everyone else saw it as a vicious monster.
H-Hey, don't cry! We know the truth now. Nobody is mad at you!
Karin, you want to help it get its home back, right?
Heh, I don't even need my nose for this. It's written all over your face.
Then our goal is clear.==W== Let's help the hermit crab reclaim its home!

strings.text: Glopo Duke proposes a match. Shia easily wins the first round, but is knocked into the sea by a shameless ambush in the second. Fortunately, Karin rescues her. Now, Karin will handle the showdown herself.
T-The great Duke Glopo, please return the conch shell to its rightful owner...
Come on, don't be stingy. That shell means a lot to the little guy. Hand it over, won't you?
The hermit crab will be sad without its shell.
It's no use. It's completely ignoring us.
It's clinging to that conch shell for dear life. Now it's holding it up to taunt us...
This idiot is trying to pick a fight, isn't it?!
Easy, Karin! You're gonna stomp right through the floor!
Wait. I think the Glopo is trying to signal us.
Duke Glopo points at the shell and waves its "hand."
Next, the Duke summons tiny Glopos. It hops into a boat and rows around the room, leaving the little ones gasping in its wake.
Finally, it puffs out its chest and hoists the shell high above its head.
Oh... Does it want to race us?==W== Winner takes the shell?!
The room just turned into the ocean?!
Hah, you want to race me in the water?==W== Perfect. I'll show you what a real seafaring Trekker can—
I'll take this, Karin. Sea racing is my thing.
Th-Then I'm counting on you, Shia!
On your marks...==W== Three, two, one!
Of course she is! That's Shia for you. In the water, nobody beats her!
Hey, Duke Glopo, we won. Hand over the conch shell. Now.
Hmph, hmph! Hmph, hmph, hmph! Hmmmmph!
The Duke holds up its hand, flashing three fingers, then two.
Best two out of three?==W== This guy hates losing, huh...
Fine, you want another round, bring it!==W== You'll never beat Shia anyway.
Naturally! Doesn't matter how many times we do this, it'll never beat Shia.
Where did these huge waves come from?! Did Duke Glopo do something?!
Ugh, cheating because you can't win? Pathetic!
But Shia won't let a few waves stop her!
Shia weaves through the waves, gaining ground with each swell. She's seconds from the finish line, and then...
Duke Glopo's attack strikes Shia square in the back. She stumbles, gets hurled off the board, and the wave swallows her.
Willow dashes toward the water, but a wave slams her back.==W== Before she can recover, another figure charges past and dives into the roiling sea.
Right... I was hit, fell in the water...==W== Need to get back up...
Huh? My body feels heavy... Can't move...==W== This might be bad...
(You always find me, don't you, Karin...)
Seawater floods her nose and ears. Her chest burns.==RT==Karin dives deeper, driven by a single thought...
I'm fine. Nothing major. Just a little numb. I'll be okay after a while.
You've got to be kidding me... You hurt Shia!
Just wait! I'm gonna wreck you!
Duke Glopo slaps its boat and hoists the hostage again... The conch shell.
Uh...==W== Round two goes to ...==W== Duke Glopo.
Dang it!==W== This guy is infuriating!

strings.text: Forced to dust off her old glasses, Karin steps up for the final round. Her surfboard is swept away, so she teams up with the hermit crab, pulling off a comeback—but the Glopo Duke clearly isn't about to give up that easily.
Haha, look at those bottle-bottoms!==W== Can you even see us through those things?
Bet she can't even see her own feet. Watch her eat dirt!
Come on... Give it back! I found that shell first!
Want it back? Come catch us!
She can't see a thing! Hahaha!
I can see fine! Quit making fun of me!
Ha! Called it! She wiped out!
She hated letting anyone see her in glasses growing up.
Then she scored an Artifact from the Monolith==RT==called contact lenses.
Threw a massive mental party that day.==RT==The era of four-eyes Karin was officially over...
I swore I'd never wear these in public again, but...
The saltwater ruined my contacts! I wouldn't be caught dead in these otherwise!
Kids used to mock me all the time for wearing these. I was finally done looking like a dork...
Ugh, whatever! It's all that cheating jerk's fault anyway!
It hurt Shia on purpose. I'm going to make it pay for that.
Don't give me that look, I'm not mad at you...==W== Just stay out of the way and watch. I'm getting your house back!
Round three is mine! I'll beat it until it's sobbing and handing that conch shell back to me itself.
Karin... She stormed off looking ready to eat someone alive...
I've never seen Karin this angry...
But she looks so dashing and dependable like this!
Are we sure about this? Duke Glopo doesn't play by the rules. What if it pulls another dirty trick...
Hehe. I believe in Karin. She's tougher than you think.
The final round is about to begin. On your marks...==W== Go!
Duke Glopo is whipping up another giant wave.
That's unfair! It's deliberately aiming the waves right at Karin!
Hmph, it's fast...==W== But at the end of the day, it's a coward who has to cheat to win!
Phew... Keep it together... Shia taught me how to surf herself, and I've practiced a ton. These little waves are nothing!
Karin charges into the giant wave on Shia's surfboard. Her movements aren't as graceful as Shia's, but they are sharp and forceful, smashing straight through every obstacle Duke Glopo throws her way.
Seeing Karin closing the gap, Duke Glopo repeats its old trick and launches a barrage of projectiles.
Again? Is that the only trick you've got?
Karin barely dodges the shots, but Duke Glopo doesn't let up. It keeps paddling its little boat forward, relentlessly bombarding her.
You've got this, Karin! Teach that cheating jerk a lesson!
I'm in the lead! Now I just need to hold this pace... Whoa?!
The churning foam clenches in midair, gripping the surfboard like a giant hand. Momentum pitches Karin forward, slamming her hard into the water.
I can't see anything. Did my glasses get knocked off? My board's gone too...
Hey, you guys hear that? Four-eyes Karin says she's gonna be a seafaring Trekker when she grows up!
With glasses that thick? How's she supposed to be a seafaring Trekker?
"Is-Is there a wave ahead? I can't see!"
"Is that a port or a rock on the left? I can't tell either!"
Alright, that's enough. Keep it up and she'll start crying again. Come on, let's go swimming!
Just you wait...==W== I'm gonna sail the seas! I'll be amazing, way better than any of you!
Even if I can't see clearly, I'm still going to become—
You kidding me? I'm not giving up here!
So what if I can't see? So what if my board's gone? I've spent years in this ocean, pushing myself every single day—
Can't see? Then I'll listen. No board? Then I'll paddle. Even if I have to swim the whole way, I'm hitting that finish line!
Ah, I see... You don't want to lose to that jerk either, huh?
Humming, are you? Think you've got this locked up already?
She's riding that hermit crab like a surfboard...
Those old tricks? I can dodge them by sound alone!
The winners of the final showdown: Karin and the hermit crab!
Huff... Huff...==W== Out of excuses? Hand over the conch shell!
Starting a brawl over a lost race? What a sore loser.
Hmph. I've had it with that jerk anyway.

Ha! Called it! She wiped out!

Ugh, whatever! It's all that cheating jerk's fault anyway!

strings.text: The group works together to repair the damaged conch shell, allowing the hermit crab to finally reclaim its home, and everyone sails back safely. Amidst her friends' praise, Karin finally makes peace with her glasses.
Get back here! Acting so tough a minute ago huh?!
Easy, Karin. Let it go. We got the shell back, that's what counts.
This conch shell is gorgeous. Cool and smooth like jade. No wonder everyone wanted it.
Shame about that massive hole, though. You can't call this a home anymore, can you?
Hey, stop crying. We'll figure something out.
We fought hard to get this back. I'm not letting you end up homeless.
If it's a few cracks, maybe.==W== But a hole that big...
We're inside a Monolith! Why not wish for the materials?==W== When Loxy's window broke, I wished for a new pane and popped it right in.
Great idea. What do we need, though?
Karin, you're the marine expert. Any idea what this shell is actually made of?
These giant shells are way thicker than normal ones. Incredibly hard on the outside, but flexible on the inside, allowing them to absorb the shock of crashing waves.
So to patch it up, we'd need something waterproof with a crazy strong adhesive...
Karin carefully details the material properties needed to repair the conch shell.
That sounds complicated. Does a single material even do all that?
We don't have to rely on one.==W== If we combine them, we're looking at three components: a structural filler, an adhesive, and a sealant.
For the base, a composite that balances hardness and flexibility. Resin for the glue, and for the sealant...==W==
O mighty God of Grace, please hear our prayer... Please grant me...
Time to patch this thing up.==W== But... Does anyone here actually know how to fix a conch shell?
It can't be that different from fixing a boat, right?==W== We plug the hole,==W== and then...==W== Uh...
Um...==W== Maybe I could give it a shot?
Have you fixed a shell before, Cosette?
Not exactly...==W== But I dig a lot of traps... And I'm great at making them blend into the environment.
P-Plus...==W== Whenever I finish a drink, I always snap the pull tab back onto the can. As a keepsake.
When it comes to making things fit together seamlessly...==W== I-I have plenty of experience!
That's reassuring. We'll handle the heavy lifting while you guide us, Cosette.
It really is seamless. You can't even feel the patch. Wishing for that sandpaper was definitely the right call.==W== Thanks, Cosette.
Shame we couldn't get rid of this one glaring crack, though.
That actually works in its favor.==W== With a crack like that, the collection value drops. Nobody will try to steal it for a quick payout anymore.
Exactly. Whatever humans think it's worth, this shell is priceless to the crab.==W== It's home.
Yeah. With a smile like that, it definitely loves the new shell.
How can you even read a crab's expression...?==W== You know what, never mind.
Hehe. The crab found its home, which means our adventure is wrapping up.==W== We should probably figure out how to get out of here.
Considering where this Monolith is located...==W== Even if we step outside, we'll still be underwater, right?
Wait...==W== Are we going to have to swim back?!
Is everyone ready? On three, we hold our breath and make a run for it.
Looks like the Monolith dropped us on a random island.
Yes! Talk about lucky. I thought we'd have to swim all the way up from the bottom!
But what now? Our boat is still at the bottom of the ocean.
If the hull is intact, Shia and I can haul it back up.
We don't even need to. Look over there.
A giant bubble lifts Shia's boat to the surface.
You got the Duke Glopo to do your heavy lifting? Not bad, little guy.
Oh, it's scared of us? I didn't think I hit it that hard.
Perfect. The hull damage is way lighter than I expected. It won't affect our sailing at all.
We only survived that whirlpool because of you, Karin.==W== Otherwise, this boat would be in pieces right now.
Hehe. You're an excellent seafaring Trekker now.
I-I just did my job!==W== I'm nowhere near an excellent seafaring Trekker yet.
But you work so hard for your dream. That kind of dedication isn't something everyone has.
My glasses? I dropped these in the Monolith. You went back for them?
Huh? Wait, I can put them on myself!
You'd be lost without them, wouldn't you?
No I wouldn't... I'm perfectly fine without them.
You looked awesome out there with your glasses on.
Yeah! Especially when you threw them on, yelled "I'm going to make it pay" and charged in. That was epic!
You were at your best once you put those on.
Well... They let me see clearly, that's all.
Which means your glasses make you stronger, Karin.
Plus, you look pretty with them on.
You look like a total pro.
What's with all this out of nowhere...?
...==W== Ugh, you are annoying. I'm going to prep the boat! Stop crowding around and staring!
What are you doing out here? Shouldn't you be resting?
I've got to log the underwater Monolith's coordinates, the sea conditions, and the anomalies we confirmed.
Leafia clutches her clipboard, writing line after line with total focus. She pauses at the bottom, then solemnly adds one final note:
I'm not even in the Trekker Association. Why put my name down?
Because you made a huge contribution to this survey. Without you and Shia, I am positive we never would have found the underwater Monolith.
Karin, you and Shia are the best seafaring Trekkers I've ever met.
Hmph~ W-Write whatever you want...==W== But if you ask me...
You're... You're the best surveyor I've ever...==W== Wait, hey! Why is your face turning all sorts of colors?!
The contour lines... They're undulating...==W== Urrgh...
No, no, no, no! Don't throw up! Hold it in a little longer!
Karin! Are there any seasickness remedies left? Cosette is...
Argh, did you plan this?!==W== I'm getting the medicine! Everyone, hang in there!
I told you... Do NOT throw up on my boat!

strings.text: With the incident resolved, Cosette swaps the Vending Artifact for a year of unlimited drinks, and the resort adds new attractions. Reunited on the beach, the friends savor a summer that's not over yet...
The anomaly's handled, the Automatic Vending Artifact's intact, and tourists are trickling back... Looks like I'm keeping my job!
Oh, there's one more thing we need to discuss.
What?! You want to take my Automatic Vending Artifact?!
No, no, no! Absolutely not! I wished my heart out for this thing. If you take it, I lose my endless drinks!
Wait, your Vending Artifact supplies unlimited drinks?==W== Is it actually that magical?
What do you mean? Vending Artifacts always supply endless drinks. Doesn't yours do the same?
Of course not. Someone has to restock the drinks by hand. That's our job.
Wow... The light completely died in Cosette's eyes.
Anyway, why do you want a broken Automatic Vending Artifact?
We had it looked at and it'll work fine with a few repairs. Plus, it makes a great tourist attraction for the resort!
We aren't taking it for free, either. The resort owner offered a one-year unlimited drink pass in exchange.
Right this way to work out the details.
My, my. What a picture-perfect ending for everyone.
The hermit crab gets its shell back, Leafia finds the Monolith in the sea, you all get a peaceful vacation, and I secure a new scoop!
Everything falls right into place. Simply wonderful.
Yeah, all our problems are sorted. Now we can kick back and enjoy the break.
... Where did you pop up from, by the way?
Heh heh. Never underestimate a witch's network. Where there's a scoop, there's me!
Bizarre resort incidents,==W== a thrilling summer adventure, Trekkers conquering the sea, a mysterious Monolith sleeping in a whirlpool...==W== This is pure gold for my readers.
"Sunlit Breeze, Azure Seas Checking In for A Cozy Summer~"==W== and "Surfing Splash: A Sparkling Holiday Adventure!"==W== I already have the feature titles ready to go.
Sounds more like an ad for the resort...
Aww, you saw right through me!==W== Nothing gets past you, Boss.
Turns out the resort owner saw a business opportunity here and wants to strike a deal with the hermit crab and set up some themed attractions.
Stuff like a conch shell wishing spot, hermit crab racing, a thrill night challenge... You get the idea.
Oh, don't give me that look. An underwater Monolith is massive news... Of course I grabbed the exclusive. And since I'm here, there is no harm in making a little side cash.
Have you finished your article yet?
Well, about that... I don't get a resort trip every day! Let me soak up the sun and sand first!!
What about you, Boss? What's your plan? I saw your friends having a blast down at the beach.
Hermit crabs! The ocean! Let's go!
Take a breather first, then grab some chow mein.
I wanna try hermit crab racing!
Watching Karin ride that crab back in the Monolith made me jealous.
Racing around on one of those looks like a great way to blow off steam.
Sounds fun! Count me in! And I'll have my camera ready for the exact moment you fall off!
Can't you root for me for once?
Hehe, I bet half the continent would pay top dollar for a shot of the Boss Accord CEO eating sand!
I'm pretty beat from all the running around lately.
Think I'll rest a bit, then grab some chow mein from a beach stall.
The mighty Boss finally gets a vacation, and your grand plan is chow mein?
Fair point.==W== Plain chow mein does sound a bit sad now that you mention it.
Alright, then I want the deluxe chow mein plus with egg, sausage, and prawns. Plus a huge iced melon soda, some fried squid, two ears of grilled corn, and...
Whoa, hold up! Are you actually going to eat all that? Mmm...==W== Now you're making me hungry.
Let's go! I'm ordering everything I want too!
What else? Dragging you off to write your article.
Didn't you want an exclusive on the underwater Monolith? Start writing before the inspiration fades.
Hold on, you can't force a good story out of nowhere!
I need sunshine, an ocean breeze,==W== and the creative vibe of an iced drink!
Deal. You can write outside in the breeze. I'll even approve the drink.
Not a demon. I'm the Boss.
Let's move. Time is money, and we aren't wasting it.
Nothing. Thought I heard the Boss. ==SEX1== must be having a good time out there.
Anyway, has anyone seen Leafia? She vanished, and she's not answering my texts.
What a map freak.==W== I brought these Squid Rice Crackers for her, too. Oh well.
Come on! We're building a sandcastle on top of Iris!
A sandcastle? Wait. I didn't agree to that!
What are you two doing...? Hey, where are my shoes?!
Hehe! Secret technique: Sandal Sealing Art!
You guys have way too much energy...
Heh heh, Karin, you're young, but you sound like an old lady.
You not going to join them?
I'm not getting involved in that mess.
What an eventful summer this has been.
The waves wash over the sand, then quietly recede. Only laughter, tossed by the sea breeze, lingers on this summer shore.

strings.text: A Tea Party for Young Ladies
Eleanor shares her travel struggles with her childhood friends, who agree to help her train in secret.
Eleanor! Took you long enough. We've been waiting ages!
My apologies, Caterine. I got tied up with a few things.
Sounds like things have been tough lately.
It's alright. I'm getting used to it.
You've been home for a while now, but I hear they're still watching you closely.
You still haven't given up your dream, have you?
Let us know if you need anything. You're my dearest friend.
Me too! You can come to me anytime!
Heh, I know. You both are the best.
Please, sit. I saved my best tea and pastries for today.
Perfectly baked, beautiful shapes. You can tell a master baker made these.
The presentation is flawless! That cookie on top looks especially tempting.
Honestly, Caterine. You're as excitable as ever.
You should learn from Eleanor. Look how perfect her posture is.
Hmph! And you haven't changed either. Still nagging at me like my mother!
Alright, you two, stop bickering. We don't get to get together much, and it's a shame to let good tea go to waste.
... I know. Sorry, Vivian. I was kidding.
It's fine, I understand.==W== Besides, I hardly have the right to sit here and lecture you.
True. Eleanor is the only one of us who's actually seen the outside world.
If only I could ...==W== run away from home for once...
Keep your voice down. We'd be in trouble if anyone overheard that.
I know. You two are the only ones I'd say that to. And honestly, I'd never have the nerve to go through with it...
Let's change the subject. We should relax and enjoy our tea.
Good point. This black tea is amazing, though...==W== It has a wonderful aftertaste.
It does. But speaking of the tea at your estate, Eleanor...
Your former head maid used to brew the most incredible tea.
Come to think of it, it's been a long time since she left.
She was the one who saved your life, right?
Yes. She's the reason I wanted to become a Trekker.
It's a shame. Aside from mentioning she used to be a Trekker, she never told me anything about her past.
I tried tracking her down after I left the estate, but I couldn't find a single clue.
Like a legendary master straight out of a novel!
As intriguing as your head maid sounds...==W== I prefer hearing about your adventures, Eleanor.
What? Again? I've repeated those stories a dozen times since I got back...
We'll never get tired of hearing about the outside world!
You ran into the Three Grand Commissions in Philae==W== and even helped defend a camp from a giant monster! This story gets more epic every time I hear it.
News out of Philae reached us all the way out in Emor. We had no idea you were right in the middle of it.
And then you teamed up with Boss Accord and Goodwind Homecare to take down the syndicate chasing you! That is incredible!
I-It wasn't like that! I barely did anything back in Philae...
When those guys caught me, Mentor and Miss Nanoha were the only reason I managed to escape.
Speaking of your Mentor...==W== It still blows my mind that you know the CEO of Boss Accord.
I heard a lot more went down in Philae after the Big Three, and this Boss person managed to resolve it all.
What an adventure. I could never imagine doing something like that.
So, do you still talk to the Boss? Ready to head back out anytime soon, right?
Eleanor, we turned a blind eye to your stunts before, but you went too far this time.
From now on, you are not leaving this estate without our permission.
Running away for days on end... Have you caused enough trouble yet?
For your little dream, I suppose? Believe me, I know.
But Eleanor, you need to accept reality. You are not cut out for the life of a Trekker.
Mother, how can you say that?
Because you have no idea how dangerous the world is. Listen to me. We are doing this for your own good.
I had the servants dispose of your gear. Take this opportunity to give up on this foolishness once and for all.
Wait, they confiscated everything?! You never said a thing!
Don't worry, I expected this. I already hid everything important.
And the Artifacts you helped me find are perfectly safe too.
I'm trapped in the mansion, but I haven't stopped training. Plus, I get advice from Mentor all the time...
It's incredible we can keep in touch with a phone from completely different cities...
This has to be your secret weapon, right? It's amazing!
Ah...!==W== Don't worry, I promise to keep the phone a secret. We'll stick to the story that we're writing letters.
Anyway, let's get back to your training plan.
"Continuously swap weapons to execute fluid, unpredictable attacks. Keep your enemies guessing with a variety of tactics..."
That's the general strategy Nanoha suggested. Where do you think we should start?
I think I should start by finding a weapon that suits me best. Once I master it, I can slowly branch out to others...==W== What do you think?
You're on the right track. But before you do that, you need to understand the dangers each weapon poses.
Weapons are meant to protect you and defeat enemies. If you end up hurting yourself or an ally, that defeats the whole purpose.
That makes sense...==W== I'll be careful!
One more thing. Honing your skills is important, but knowing how to appraise weapons and gear is just as crucial.
You're a quick study, Eleanor, and eager to learn. That part shouldn't be an issue...
But you still lack street smarts and financial literacy. If you don't cover those blind spots, scammers will take advantage of you in a heartbeat.
At least, that's what Mentor told me.
Wow...==W== That makes a lot of sense, actually.
But honestly... Now I can't even leave the house. How am I supposed to train...?
Ah, sorry! I didn't mean to drag down the mood. I just needed to vent...==W== Ahaha.
You are not doing this alone. Allow us to help.
... I mean, I'm completely on board. But we don't know the first thing about being Trekkers. Seeing how we still come to Eleanor for advice, how are we supposed to help?
Let's look at Eleanor's training.==W== In short, you need to develop an eye for appraising an item's value and function, correct?
Caterine, your family has connections with various merchants and shops, don't they?
Yeah, we do...==W==<size=120%> Oh! I get it!</size>
If I find you a position at one of our shops, your parents might actually let you leave the house!
Exactly. Our families are deeply intertwined since childhood. The adults trust us implicitly, so they shouldn't object.
Then there is your physical conditioning. You need to improve your combat skills...
I lack connections there, but my dance instructor always says dancing builds flexibility and coordination. It sharpens your reflexes. Perhaps learning to dance could work?
If I personally recommend you join my classes, your parents would hardly say no.
Come on, Eleanor. Let us do this for you!
Our roles seem a bit reversed here. I'm the one who needs help. I should be the one begging you two!
We know you would never ask for help unless it was an absolute emergency. We have to be a little pushy.
Exactly! We know you too well.
... Heh heh, fair point. We are childhood friends after all.
Vivian, Caterine... I need your help.
Please lend me a hand. I'm going to finish this training, and my dream of becoming a Trekker must come true!

strings.text: With her friends' help, Eleanor takes up dancing and starts her internship at a general store to prepare for her journey as a Trekker.
Focus. Watch my steps and let the beat guide you.
That's it. Your footwork is coming along.
Excellent. Let's take a quick breather.
Don't mention it. It's my job.
You know, Eleanor, you won't even set that box down in between dances. Something important inside?
I just want to carry it to get used to the weight.
Even in dance class? You're an odd one.
When Vivian came by asking for lessons for a friend, I assumed you wanted to learn noble poise...
But there's more to it than that. Your everyday posture is already flawless. You've clearly had etiquette training.
It's fine. I'm not going to pry.
But...==W== Eleanor, you have a natural gift. Dedicate yourself to dance, and I guarantee you'll make it onto a much bigger stage.
... I'm sorry, teacher. Being a dancer isn't my dream.
I figured as much.==W== I don't know what's in the box, but I imagine it's tied to this dream of yours, isn't it?
Mind if I give it a lift?
Go ahead, but ...==W== please be careful. It's heavier than it looks.
Amazing...!==W== You say that, but you lifted it like it was nothing.
Heh, we dancers train for lifts all the time. Sometimes the costumes already weigh a ton, and we have to hoist our partners or props on top of that.
You bear that weight while keeping your posture perfect and your steps light. No matter how heavy the load, you never let the audience see you struggle...
I can teach you the technique, if you're interested.
Hold your thanks. My standards are high.
It's an unforgiving path for a beginner. I won't go easy on you just because you're Vivian's friend.
Not a problem! I'll work twice as hard!
Good. Let's see what you can do.
Well, since you're still an intern, let's stick to the basics. A new batch of Artifacts hit the warehouse. Sort them by category and shelf them.
A few days ago, you couldn't even tell the basic categories apart. You've been doing your homework.
Heh heh! All thanks to you as my great teacher!
Plus, watching you taught me something. With enough experience, you can figure out how to use any Artifact, even if you've never seen it before.
I want to master a skill like that!
Heh...==W== When Lady Caterine insisted on sending you here, I figured you were some pampered rich girl here to play dress-up. I didn't expect you to actually get your hands dirty.
Since you're so driven, want to take on something new?
Absolutely! Aside from appraising prices, I want to learn how to handle customers. Will you teach me?
I see. You want to learn the sales floor too...==W== Dealing with people is no walk in the park, though.
You have to read the customer, figure out what they want, and pitch the perfect item for them. It takes skill. Are you sure you're ready to put in the work?
I'll do my best! Please teach me everything!
To finish Mentor's training plan, my best bet is to interact with as many different people as possible...!
Besides, I want to see what people think about Artifacts, what they're naturally drawn to...==W== I want to soak it all in!
Haha, look at that fire. Let's see what you can do.
I'm exhausted, but I feel accomplished...==W== I've never experienced anything like this.
Thanks to Vivian and Caterine convincing them, Mother and Father finally let me out of the house.
The teachers they introduced me to are incredible. With everyone's help, my skills have improved in every way.
I never could've made it this far alone. I'm lucky to have friends to help me.
If Mentor were here now, I know ==SEX=='d agree...
But...==W== I need to pull myself together. Now's not the time to rest. I still have an important task to finish.
Please forgive me, Mother and Father, but I have to do this.
I'm not running away from home this time. I'll be back soon.
Everyone's still busy, even at this hour...
So this is the Trekker life. I wonder if I'll be like them someday...
Wait, no time for daydreaming. I came here to gather intel.
Over there...==W== That's the commission board.
I can't bite off more than I can chew anymore. I need to stay grounded and learn how the Trekker world works.
I have a plan. Once I see progress from my training, I'll pick the right commission to test myself...
I'll prove it to myself, to Mentor...==W== And to the friends dearest to me!
Oh...==W== Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you.
I-It's fine. I wasn't expecting anyone to talk to me...
I'm Eleanor. Do you work here?
Yes, I'm Willow, the manager here.
I don't think I've seen you before. Are you a new Trekker?
Truth be told, I'm not a true Trekker yet, just an apprentice preparing to take my first steps down that path.
An apprentice?==W== Heh, that's a charming way to put it.
Well...==W== Being a Trekker is all about freedom. Most people don't think twice before jumping in.
If they hit a wall, they'll just figure it isn't for them. It's rare to see a rookie as deliberative as you.
... I'll be honest. I ran off on an adventure on a whim once. Looking back, it was like playing make-believe...
And inevitably, I got scammed. If a senior Trekker hadn't stepped in, I wouldn't have made it out...
I realized I'd rushed in too soon. So I resolved to prepare myself properly before officially embarking on my journey. It's also what my Mentor advised.
The Loongs say good food is worth the wait. Sounds like you found an excellent guide.
Come find me when you make up your mind. I'll pick out the perfect commission for you.
Looking forward to seeing what you can do, Miss Eleanor.

strings.text: Eleanor's hard work finally pays off. With a little push from her friends, Eleanor sneaks away from home again, ready to tackle her very first commission.
One,==W== and two,==W== and three,==W== and four...
Ha, just as I thought. You're a natural.
I owe it all to your guidance.
After all this training, I can move as I want even with a box this heavy. I still can't believe it.
Your rapid progress comes partly from talent, but mostly from your hard work. That's a rare quality.
Heh, I'm kidding. I know you have your own dream. Keep at it.
I'll keep working hard! Thank you for teaching me.
Hey! Hello...? I-I need an Artifact!
Welcome! What kind of Artifact are you looking for?
Hmm...==W== I-Is the owner not here?
She stepped out for a bit. If you need something, I can also help you with it.
But ... with her gone... I really need it asap.==W== Ugh, forget it. I'll take my chances with you.
So, I-I'm a chef, and I want the same Artifact the head chef next door uses, but I have no clue what it's called.
I can't just waltz into a rival's kitchen and ask!==W== I don't know how to explain it, but it saves a ton of prep time!
Don't panic. Take a breath. Can you describe what it looks like?
Uh, I only got a glimpse from across the room.==W== It looks kind of like a pitcher? With something sharp inside, and it makes this loud whirring noise.
I'm sorry, that's all I remember...
A chef's Artifact, saves time, looks like a pitcher...==W== Got it. I think I know what you need.
Give me one moment. I'll check the back.
Is this what you're looking for?
It's a blender Artifact. Drop your ingredients in, and it juices or chops them up in seconds.
You're a lifesaver, miss. I-I'm awful at explaining things. I always walk out of other shops empty-handed.
B-But the owner here is an Artifact whiz. I mumble half a sentence and she gets it.
When you told me she was out, I panicked...==W== Never expected someone your age to be this sharp!
You flatter me. I've still got a lot to learn from her.
Eek? When did you get back?
A while ago. I saw you with that customer and hung back to see how you'd handle it.
You nailed it. Honestly, I couldn't have done better myself.
Look, Eleanor. I know you're an intern, but say the word and a full-time position is yours.==W== Having you around would be a massive help.
Not to brag, but the pay is solid. I'm opening a second branch soon, and the manager spot is yours if you want it. What do you say?
I appreciate the offer. But ...==W== I have a dream I need to pursue.
I want to be a Trekker.
Ah. You've got the itch to explore. Can't argue with that.
Well, when you make it big, put in a good word for us. Don't forget the little guys, haha!
Oh, please. If that ever happens, I'd be happy to!==W== But right now, that's a world away...
You sure? The way I see it, you're closer than you think.
Good. I've got a commission perfect for a beginner. Want to take it?
This is it...==W== My first commission.
Everyone helped me get this far. Now it's time to face this alone.
Have I grown and matured?==W== I guess I'll find out soon.
Gear is packed, route is set. I leave this afternoon and get back home before dawn. No one will know.
Nothing... I'm amazed at how driven you are, Eleanor.
Caterine and I have been stuck in the same routine all month,==W== yet you've grown so much.
Wait, if you're leaving this afternoon, you're almost out of time.
Oh! I was planning to leave after the tea party...
Don't be silly! Tea parties can wait. This is your first official Trekker commission.==W== You can't slack off now.
It's fine. I finished my prep work ages ago.
...==W== So there's nothing left for us to do.==W== At least let Caterine and me give you a proper send-off.
Don't say that! You've both helped me so much.==W== Without you two, I'd still be holed up in my room moping.
Hehe. Well, if you say so...
Then you should accept our gesture, don't you think?
I've seen you in your Trekker gear before,==W== but you still look amazing.
Wait, hold on. How are you getting out of here?
Don't tell me you're using that...
Relax. I've practiced this a million times.
One more wall and I'm free.
I'm off! You two stay safe!
Strange... Where did she run off to now?
Wait—did I just hear Mother and Father?!
I need to go back inside—
No, you go. Vivian and I have it covered.
I was bummed we couldn't help you anymore, but here's our chance!
Caterine, I'll stall her parents. You clear her room. Leave absolutely no trace.
Are you sure you two will be okay?
We've got this. What, don't trust your best friends?
I...==W== I understand. Thank you both!
Got an excuse ready for her parents? We'd better get our stories straight.
Never thought I'd see the day you rebelled and lied to grown-ups.
You were always the best-behaved out of the three of us.
That's probably because I've been learning from an inspiring==W== "bad influence."
Alright, I'm answering the door. I'll buy you as much time as I can. The rest is up to you, Caterine!
First, hide the dress she changed out of...
Eleanor?! Are you alright in there?
You klutz. What am I going to do with you?
Thanks to you, now we have even more explaining to do.
Vivian... Caterine...==W== I swear I won't let you two down!

param: Eleanor's hard work finally pays off. With a little push from her friends, Eleanor sneaks away from home again, ready to tackle her very first commission.
One,==W== and two,==W== and three,==W== and four...
Ha, just as I thought. You're a natural.
I owe it all to your guidance.
After all this training, I can move as I want even with a box this heavy. I still can't believe it.
Your rapid progress comes partly from talent, but mostly from your hard work. That's a rare quality.
Heh, I'm kidding. I know you have your own dream. Keep at it.
I'll keep working hard! Thank you for teaching me.
Hey! Hello...? I-I need an Artifact!
Welcome! What kind of Artifact are you looking for?
Hmm...==W== I-Is the owner not here?
She stepped out for a bit. If you need something, I can also help you with it.
But ... with her gone... I really need it asap.==W== Ugh, forget it. I'll take my chances with you.
So, I-I'm a chef, and I want the same Artifact the head chef next door uses, but I have no clue what it's called.
I can't just waltz into a rival's kitchen and ask!==W== I don't know how to explain it, but it saves a ton of prep time!
Don't panic. Take a breath. Can you describe what it looks like?
Uh, I only got a glimpse from across the room.==W== It looks kind of like a pitcher? With something sharp inside, and it makes this loud whirring noise.
I'm sorry, that's all I remember...
A chef's Artifact, saves time, looks like a pitcher...==W== Got it. I think I know what you need.
Give me one moment. I'll check the back.
Is this what you're looking for?
It's a blender Artifact. Drop your ingredients in, and it juices or chops them up in seconds.
You're a lifesaver, miss. I-I'm awful at explaining things. I always walk out of other shops empty-handed.
B-But the owner here is an Artifact whiz. I mumble half a sentence and she gets it.
When you told me she was out, I panicked...==W== Never expected someone your age to be this sharp!
You flatter me. I've still got a lot to learn from her.
Eek? When did you get back?
A while ago. I saw you with that customer and hung back to see how you'd handle it.
You nailed it. Honestly, I couldn't have done better myself.
Look, Eleanor. I know you're an intern, but say the word and a full-time position is yours.==W== Having you around would be a massive help.
Not to brag, but the pay is solid. I'm opening a second branch soon, and the manager spot is yours if you want it. What do you say?
I appreciate the offer. But ...==W== I have a dream I need to pursue.
I want to be a Trekker.
Ah. You've got the itch to explore. Can't argue with that.
Well, when you make it big, put in a good word for us. Don't forget the little guys, haha!
Oh, please. If that ever happens, I'd be happy to!==W== But right now, that's a world away...
You sure? The way I see it, you're closer than you think.
Good. I've got a commission perfect for a beginner. Want to take it?
This is it...==W== My first commission.
Everyone helped me get this far. Now it's time to face this alone.
Have I grown and matured?==W== I guess I'll find out soon.
Gear is packed, route is set. I leave this afternoon and get back home before dawn. No one will know.
Nothing... I'm amazed at how driven you are, Eleanor.
Caterine and I have been stuck in the same routine all month,==W== yet you've grown so much.
Wait, if you're leaving this afternoon, you're almost out of time.
Oh! I was planning to leave after the tea party...
Don't be silly! Tea parties can wait. This is your first official Trekker commission.==W== You can't slack off now.
It's fine. I finished my prep work ages ago.
...==W== So there's nothing left for us to do.==W== At least let Caterine and me give you a proper send-off.
Don't say that! You've both helped me so much.==W== Without you two, I'd still be holed up in my room moping.
Hehe. Well, if you say so...
Then you should accept our gesture, don't you think?
I've seen you in your Trekker gear before,==W== but you still look amazing.
Wait, hold on. How are you getting out of here?
Don't tell me you're using that...
Relax. I've practiced this a million times.
One more wall and I'm free.
I'm off! You two stay safe!
Strange... Where did she run off to now?
Wait—did I just hear Mother and Father?!
I need to go back inside—
No, you go. Vivian and I have it covered.
I was bummed we couldn't help you anymore, but here's our chance!
Caterine, I'll stall her parents. You clear her room. Leave absolutely no trace.
Are you sure you two will be okay?
We've got this. What, don't trust your best friends?
I...==W== I understand. Thank you both!
Got an excuse ready for her parents? We'd better get our stories straight.
Never thought I'd see the day you rebelled and lied to grown-ups.
You were always the best-behaved out of the three of us.
That's probably because I've been learning from an inspiring==W== "bad influence."
Alright, I'm answering the door. I'll buy you as much time as I can. The rest is up to you, Caterine!
First, hide the dress she changed out of...
Eleanor?! Are you alright in there?
You klutz. What am I going to do with you?
Thanks to you, now we have even more explaining to do.
Vivian... Caterine...==W== I swear I won't let you two down!

strings.text: Having completed her commission, Eleanor settles into a double life as both a noble lady and a Trekker. One day, she inadvertently foils a scammer trying to sell counterfeit Artifacts.
Perfectly! Both the Trekker Association and the client were pleased.
I always knew you'd pull it off. Never doubted you one bit.
Well...==W== She was texting me at midnight, worried sick about you.
Oh, please! You were just as worried. You didn't sleep a wink either!
Hehe. Thank you both for caring.
By the way, did Mother and Father catch on?
Relax, Vivian handled it. The adults trust her way more than they trust me.
... Anyway, since you're back safe, we need to celebrate.==W== Let's move next week's tea party up to tomorrow.
Sounds perfect. What do you think, Eleanor?
Eleanor? What's wrong? Aren't you happy?
No, of course I am...==W== Something else crossed my mind, that's all.
Vivian, Caterine... Do you ever envy my life right now?
Then... Have you ever thought about ... doing the same?
You've been so supportive this whole time. If there's anything you want to pursue...
Well... Yeah, I've thought about it. Especially on nights I can't sleep, staring at the ceiling.
... Honestly, they're just silly dreams. I don't have a concrete plan.
We're not as brave as you, Eleanor. If I had to put it into words...
I think our biggest wish ... is to find a dream to call our own.
You've got a head start right now, but don't think I'm giving up! The second I figure out my path, I'll catch right up to you.
Promise you won't go too far ahead and leave us behind... Okay?
Never! We're best friends for life!
Oh my, aren't you two impossibly cheesy?
Caterine and I should get going.
I'll get the tea party set up. See you tomorrow!
Before we go... Your life as a Trekker is properly underway now, isn't it?
Yeah. From now on, I'm either taking regular commissions as a proper Trekker or exploring Monoliths.
What about your dance lessons and the shop?
I'm still taking the lessons, just not as often.
I've already talked to the boss about my goals. I'm leaving once my internship ends.
Alright. If you ever get swamped, I'll talk to the boss for you.==W== I recommended you in the first place, after all. I want to see it through.
Things might get tough from here on out...==W== But you're not one to give up, are you, Eleanor?
When I first started, I felt like I was drowning in work. But somehow I've gotten used to the pace.
I've knocked out a lot of commissions lately, so I'm treating myself today. Time to spend my saved-up Dorra on new gear!
I've only snuck into this market a few times...==W== It's as bustling as ever.
Come on! Step right up! We have the finest weapons around, forged for mighty warriors like you. Everything you need is right here!
Welcome sale today! Come on in and take a look!
We sell Artifact bundles made for Trekkers! Top quality, rock-bottom prices, guaranteed authentic!
You scammer!==W== How do you have the nerve to show your face?
You passed off a pile of junk on me! Looked fine on the shelf, but the second I tried using it at home, it fell apart!
Bull! Everything I sell is the real deal. You broke it yourself so you could come back and shake me down. You want to call me a crook? Prove it!
Hey, looks like people are arguing over there.
Excuse me. What's going on here?
These jerks keep calling me a fraud. I bet they're trying to squeeze me for cash.
You look young, miss. Must be a rookie Trekker, right?==W== Tell you what. Want to stock up on handy gear? I'll cut you a sweet deal.
You crooked rat... You are lying through your teeth!
Don't throw your money away, miss! It's a scam!
Hey, if you ain't buying, get lost! You're getting in the way of my business.
Could I take a look at your Artifacts first?
What, won't even let her look? Got something to hide?
Look as you want! Just be careful not to break it, haha!
Hmm...==W== Judging by the design, this is a heating Artifact. Right?
Sharp eye, missy! You'll want this for any trip. Headed somewhere cold? You'll be lost without it...
It is handy, but I'm afraid this Artifact is a fake.
Look right here, everyone. This seam is a clear sign of artificial aging.
If I get it, I'm pretty sure it'll stop responding to Grace in no time.
See? Told you he was a fraud!
Run this crook out of the market!
Yeah! Scumbags like him ruin business for the rest of us!
How did you...==W== Wait! Even if it doesn't run on Grace, it runs on Neo Solution. Cheaper, too!
No. This replica wasn't made by a certified artisan.==W== Powering it with Neo Solution is a massive safety hazard.
And you never mentioned it was a replica either. That's fraud.
After him! Don't let him get away!
I wasn't meddling too much, was I?
I couldn't sit back and do nothing, especially when I remembered how gullible I used to be.
That was amazing, miss! Are you an Artifact appraiser?
Nothing like that. I'm just a regular Trekker...
A Trekker! Then I'm hiring you right now. Come look at an Artifact I bought.
Slipped away faster than a rat. Popped into an alley and vanished.
Bet he had an accomplice waiting.
Oh I almost forgot. Thanks, miss. I'm sure he won't be showing his face around here again after you outed him.
Glad I could help. What's your next move?
He's been prowling here for a while, so there are definitely other victims. I'm rallying everyone, and we're going to make him pay.
Look who's back. How was business today?
Ugh, don't ask. A few of our old "customers" caught up with me.
Time to find a new spot.
Hey, slow down. We haven't even sold off the last batch of goods.
Tsk. We've already milked these broke commoners and Trekkers dry.
If only we could hook some mark with more money than sense. We could make a killing and vanish.
True. Running off with a loss like this would be pathetic.
Oh, and tell the crew to step up their game on the fakes next time.==W== They looked so cheap today some little brat saw right through them. I barely made it out of there.
Haha, seriously? Talk about rotten luck.
In that case, let's lay low for a bit and scrounge up some extra muscle.
And if anyone's dumb enough to come sniffing around...==W== Heh, they won't know what hit them.

strings.text: Caterine has gone missing! Eleanor and Vivian begin investigating, following the trail of clues until it leads them to a heavily guarded hideout.
Got their favorite tea and pastries ready. Now we wait for the guests of honor...
Caterine, you're early! Keep your voice down, or Vivian will chew you out...==W== Wait, Vivian?
Vivian, breathe. Take your time. What happened to Caterine?
She's missing!==W== No one's seen her since last night!
Her family already hired the Imperial Guard and an experienced guild to search...
You don't think she ran away like you did, do you? Did she mention anything?
Besides, if she had planned something, she would've told us first.
That's what I figured... But we've got nothing else to go off on.
Now is not the time to be discouraged, Vivian. If there's no lead, then we'll dig some up ourselves.
Eleanor... From the look on your face, you've heard.
Yes, I have... Caterine's gone missing.
Don't worry. The Imperial Guard and Trekkers are working together to search the entire city. They'll find her soon.
I want to help! She's our best friend...
I figured you'd say that.==W== But no.
Hush. Go to your room. You've caused this family enough trouble.
Father told us to stay out of it...
...==W== Sigh. So we can't do anything to help after all?
No. There has to be something we can do.
Actually... This isn't the first time I've got myself into a mess like this.==W== I got kidnapped once as a kid. They held me for a huge ransom then, too.
Our head maid stepped in and saved me just in time.==W== Turns out, she used to be a Trekker.
A retired Trekker... Is she the reason you wanted to become one?
Yeah. Since that day, I swore I'd grow up to be just like her—==W==a cool, capable adult who protects others.
Caterine is my friend. If I can't protect the people closest to me, what kind of Trekker am I?
I'm not giving up. I will find Caterine.
No one is freer than a Trekker. They always follow their convictions.
But my parents aren't wrong. Running around like headless chickens is just inefficient and gets in the way of everyone.
But we're Caterine's best friends. That means we know things the adults don't.
You're right. There must be something we can do.
I'm not like you, Eleanor... But if there's one thing I can do...
Oh, the chat logs! There may be clues in there.
... It's just her complaining about school and stuff. Nothing else stands out...==W== What about you, Eleanor?
Mhmm. The paperwork's done, but I haven't said goodbye to the owner yet.
Want me to talk to her for you?
Are you sure? Is that too much trouble?
No worries. I got you the job, let me handle it.
... But don't forget to prepare for tomorrow's tea party!
Don't worry, that's the last thing I'll forget.
That's it! I'm heading to the store to check!
We'll just tell them we're going shopping together. That should work, right?
Alright... Let's get ready and head out.
Oh, Eleanor! Welcome back! Here to buy some Artifacts today?
Actually, I need to ask you something.==W== Did Caterine drop by yesterday?
Lady Caterine did stop by. She even thanked me for looking out for you. Such a polite young lady she is.
Did she seem off at all?
Not really... Why?==W== Did something happen to her?
We traced her messages here. Any idea what could have happened?
Hmm, I don't think so...==W== Wait, actually...
Please tell us. Even the smallest detail matters.
Yesterday afternoon, a strange customer came in. He walked through the door right after Lady Caterine left.
Said he was strapped for cash and wanted to pawn an Artifact. Asked if I'd buy it.
I could see it was a fake from across the room. Didn't even need to touch it.
Yep. Soon as I called him out, he bolted.
Hardly. Most folks don't have the nerve.
Can you describe exactly what this man looked like?
This is where you called out that fake Artifact seller, right?
Yeah. Not sure if he's involved... But right now, it's the only thread we have.
Well, if it isn't the young lady! Fancy running into you again.
Want to come take a look? Don't worry, my shop is all about quality goods and fair prices. Inspect them all you want!
Ha! You're clearly using the poor girl to drum up business.
W-Well... Ahem!==W== Anyway, I'm definitely not selling fakes!
Um, I actually wanted to ask you two about someone...
We haven't seen that scammer since that day.
So nobody knows where he is now?
Well, those two folks who confronted him earlier managed to track down a few other victims. They were planning to team up and go demand answers.
Do you happen to know where they went?
We should be heading the right way, but this area is massive... Where do we even start?
Back off, or you'll regret it!
Get out of the way! Let us in!
Open the door! I demand to speak to the shop owner!
You gotta be kidding. Our boss only meets with VIPs. No commoners allowed. Especially not...
Damn that scammer... He hired all these bodyguards...
Who are you calling a scammer, huh? You begging for a beatdown?
Eleanor, what in the world is going on here...?
Hmm... Looks like things just got a whole lot more complicated.

strings.text: With your hint, Eleanor uses her spoiled-heiress persona to bluff her way into the hideout. Inside, she finds something left by Caterine...
Take out the guards and barge in?
Even if I could pull that off, breaking in without proof makes me the bad guy, doesn't it?
Not with that many guards out front. The place is locked down tight...==W== No, too risky.
... But this is our only lead on Caterine. We can't walk away...
Eleanor, that scammer has to be in there. Got a plan yet?
Whoa, you scared me. What happened? Why're you so worked up?
W-Well... I'm in a bit of a jam.
That scammer must've taken Caterine! He's right there, but I can't get near him.
There's a way out of this. And you're the only one who can pull it off.
Your Trekker skills aren't the only cards you're holding, are they?
Think about what other identity you could use to get close. Trekkers have more freedom than anyone else. Don't let a label box you in.
Sometimes==W== you don't even need to cling to the Trekker title.
What do you mean...?==W== Oh! I think I get it.

I had no idea it was this massive down here.

Who is it? The Imperial Guard?
Oh, right. I'm not the only one locked up down here...
Well, if it isn't the girl from the market!
A-Are you here to get us out?!

strings.text: Eleanor frees the hostages from the basement. With the Imperial Guard and fellow Trekkers arriving just in time to provide backup, Eleanor joins the fray to take down the scammers and round up the whole ring.
Thank you for offering Eleanor a job.
You flatter me. Eleanor is a rare talent. I'm the lucky one to have her, my lady.
Eleanor would be delighted to hear that.==W== Well, I should get going. Have a wonderful day.
Oh! I'm sorry. Are you alright?
No worries at all. It was my fault. Sorry about that.
... Eleanor's career as a Trekker is finally on track.
She might not even need my help anymore. Why do I feel a little lonely already?
I know. I should find her a meaningful gift to celebrate...
Hmm.==W== I've looked everywhere, but nothing catches my eye.
Step right up, folks! Don't miss out on these incredible deals!
Practical Artifacts made specifically for Trekkers! Fair prices and completely authentic!
That's it! An Artifact is the perfect gift for Eleanor's debut as a Trekker.
Hey there, young lady. You look interested. Come take a look.
I'd love to...==W== Wait, didn't we cross paths at the shop earlier?
Oh, the lady from earlier! If you came from that shop, you must have a keen eye for Artifacts. Go ahead, take your pick.
If nothing here catches your eye, I've got more items in storage. It's not far. I can take you there myself.
Hmm... Alright. Please lead the way.
Wait here a moment. I'll have my associates bring out our best goods from storage.
Everyone, over here! I found the scammer!
Quick! Don't let him slip away again!
Tch. Of all the times to show up.
You fraud! Give us back our Dorra!
You crook! Coming back here to set up shop again? Have you no shame?!
Don't fall for it, Miss! This guy is a con artist pushing fake Artifacts!
... Whatever. Good thing I came prepared.
Everyone! Round them up! Don't let them ruin our plans!
Huh? Where'd all these people come from?
That's everything. They've kept me locked down here ever since.
Can you believe these thugs? Kidnapping people in broad daylight. I'm sorry you got dragged into this, Miss.
Please, don't worry. Eleanor is here to rescue us. She's an amazing Trekker, so you're all in good hands.
Let me get this cell door open for you.
Wait, the guards still have the keys. How are you going to do that?
Heh, Mentor taught me a trick that's perfect for this.
This one might just do the trick...
You actually picked it...! You're amazing, Mentor!
I can't believe you saved me again. Thank you, Miss.
Don't worry about it. Come on, we need to move.
There's only one exit.==W== That leaves us one option.
Eleanor! That quick change was incredible! You look amazing!
Heh. Good thing I wore my Trekker gear under the dress.
Crap, they're breaking out! That girl was a decoy! Get in here!
I should've known you'd be trouble...!
But you're not getting out. I called everyone back inside. Everyone, get 'em!
Caterine, do not leave my side!
I have to protect Caterine. I have to protect everyone.
"Continuously swap weapons to execute fluid, unpredictable attacks. Keep your enemies guessing with a variety of tactics..."
Eleanor...==W== It's like watching a dance. She's taking them all down with such grace.
I'm back! What happened here?==W== Wait, you? Why is it always you...?!
You're the one who keeps doing awful things!
Crap, she's out of our league!
Fall back! Let's get out of here!
Eleanor, should we go after them?
No, they still have people outside.==W== Let's play it safe and slip away in the chaos.
Vivian? What are you doing here? I thought you went home!
I was worried, but I knew barging in would only slow you down. So I stayed outside and kept watch.
Then I heard things getting rough in there, so I called the Imperial Guard.
They arrived right as those thugs were making a run for it...
As you can see, most of them got caught. But a stubborn few slipped away toward the port.
Great work, Vivian! You're a lifesaver!
Now that we have backup,==W== this might be our chance.

strings.text: Named an "Honorary Citizen" for her bravery, Eleanor attends the award ceremony. There, she finally clears the air with her parents, ready to take the next big step in her life.
Damn it... How did it all fall apart?
Attention! Drop your weapons and surrender.
Wait... The Imperial Guard got here way too fast.
And where did these Trekkers come from?!
Good thing I hired extra muscle...==W== I'll use them as cover and make a break for it.
That was intense! Are you hurt?
Thank you! Thank you for saving us, Miss.
Hehe, I wouldn't say it's quite "over" just yet.
Hey, did you catch that? That little girl's got some serious moves.
She doesn't look like an Imperial Guard. Maybe a hired Trekker?
Excuse me, are you the Trekker who rescued everyone? My, my... Such incredible talent at your age.
You did great work out there! I'll put in a commendation the minute I get back.
That's right. May I ask your name, Miss?
Her name is Eleanor! She's the hero who saved us all.
I still can't get used to this...
That's weird. Shouldn't you be happy? It's your big day!
This all feels unreal to me.
Why? Ah... Is it because this honor came out of nowhere?
Yeah, partly... I never imagined I'd be named Honorary Citizen of the Year, let alone have a whole ceremony thrown for me.
And I'm still a complete rookie...
But you saved me and the others. That's a fact. We all saw it.
We aren't saying this because we're your friends. You stopped those criminals and saved the day. You earned this.
Our Eleanor has been working hard for ages. That's how she became the Trekker she is today.
Now you finally got your chance to shine, Eleanor. Caterine and I are proud of you.
And look, your parents came to your ceremony.
Oh, they are walking this way.
Come on, Caterine, let's head out. Let them have some family time.
Ready to accept your award, Eleanor?
I never thought you could pull all this off without us knowing.
I'm sorry I lied to you.==W== But I never gave up on my dream.
But Eleanor, you need to accept reality. You are not cut out for the life of a Trekker.
Mother, how can you say that?
Because you have no idea how dangerous the world is. Listen to me. We are doing this for your own good.
I had the servants dispose of your gear. Take this opportunity to give up on this foolishness once and for all.
About that day...==W== We were too quick to judge. We decided you weren't Trekker material without understanding you, or respecting the profession.
We're the ones who owe you an apology.
Our daughter faced danger head-on to save her friend and innocent citizens. Not everyone can do that.
... You've grown up, Eleanor. Your mother and I are proud of you.
... Does that mean I can keep being a Trekker?
Eleanor, you're our only heir. We still hope you'll take over the estate.
But... What if I don't want to choose?
I'll learn how to manage the estate, and keep being a Trekker.
... We're starting your formal heir training soon. Balancing that with your Trekker duties won't be easy.
I don't care how hard it gets. I know I can do it!
Maybe...==W== We should step back and let her try.
Heh... Looks like we're on the same page. She's worked this hard. What right do we have to hold her back?
Of course. Your actions have proven you're not a little girl anymore, Eleanor.
So from now on, we'll discuss things with you as an equal.
So much has happened lately... One thing after another. My head's still spinning...
Father and Mother... For the first time, they aren't treating me like a kid. They finally understand me...
... Ah! No time to dwell on that! I'm about to go on stage...!
Next up, the award for Honorary Citizen of the Year...
Faced with a ruthless crime ring, she broke the stalemate with extraordinary courage. Her passion brought peace and order back to our city...
Whoa... They're laying it on thick. My face must be bright red now...
I'm nervous. I have to give a speech soon, don't I? I wrote a draft, but my stomach's still in knots...
Please welcome our award recipient, Miss Eleanor, to say a few words.
H-Hello, everyone. I'm Eleanor, and I'm a Trekker...
It's an honor to be here today... Um, well...
Huh? Is that Vivian and Caterine over there? It looks like they're trying to tell me something...
Don't panic, Eleanor! We're right here!
This is your first major honor! And we saw you earn it!
... Thanks, you two. I'm starting to calm down...
... Becoming a Trekker has always been my dream. But for the longest time, I wondered if I actually had what it takes.
Father and Mother... They're smiling at me.
Today, I finally proved myself. But I didn't get here alone.
To the friends who supported me from day one, the family who never stopped caring, and...
... to my Mentor, who couldn't be here today, but guided me every step of the way.
From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
This honor is only the beginning. I won't stop here. I'm going to keep pushing myself to become a stronger Trekker, and I'll let my actions prove it.
Going forward, I'll continue to protect those in need and always be ready to lend a hand. Because that's the Trekker I want to be.
My dream is far from over!
This entire day felt like a dream...
I got the Honorary Citizen award
Just got back to my room
I'll send you some pictures in a bit, Mentor!
Heh heh... I knew Mentor was looking out for me.
I meant what I said at the ceremony. I'm not stopping yet...
Taking commissions is only part of being a Trekker. Another major task for me is to climb Monoliths.
I've got it all planned out. I'll head out the day after tomorrow. It'll be my first time tackling a Monolith.
But before that...==W== Tomorrow's tea party ... with everyone...

strings.text: Caterine and Vivian open up to Eleanor about what they truly want, and the trio decides to form their own ladies' guild. As her journey continues, she crosses paths with you once again.
You're so slow, Eleanor! We've been waiting out here forever!
Sorry, Caterine. Packing my gear and supplies took longer than I expected, and I lost track of time...
Where's your next commission taking you?
It's not a commission this time. I'm going to challenge a Monolith.
Wow, you're finally making an official climb? Is that going to be tough?
I doubt it'll be easy. But I've prepared for this day for a long time, so don't worry about me.
That sounds amazing. I've always wondered what it looks like inside.
If I get the chance, I'll sketch the scenery or use a Photo Capturer so I can show you both what I see.
But I hear the environments in there shift constantly. It's a shame we can't see it ourselves...
... Ahem. Since we're on the subject...==W== Vivian, don't you think it's time we told Eleanor what we decided?
Yeah... Now is the perfect time.
Eleanor, do you remember the tea party we had after your first commission?
You asked us a question that day. You asked if we envied your new life as a Trekker...
We're not as brave as you, Eleanor. If I had to put it into words...
I think our biggest wish ... is to find a dream to call our own.
And now ... we've finally found it.
We've been by your side through everything.==W== We've seen your bright smiles, and we've seen you struggle when things got hard.
Everything you've experienced is what our lives have been missing.==W== Without us even realizing it, this thought took root in our hearts: we want to live as freely as you do.
And every time we watch you leave, Vivian and I feel lonely ... and useless.==W== We hate just sitting here worrying, unable to help at all.
So Eleanor, we're done just standing here watching you go. We want to walk beside you on this path.
That's right. Becoming Trekkers is how we make that dream a reality.
If the three of us could head out together and go on an adventure... Wouldn't that be amazing?
If that actually happened, I'd be so happy...
... Wait, does that mean you want to come to the Monolith with me today?
Someday, but not today. We aren't Trekkers yet. If we tagged along now, we'd just be a burden.
We know our limits. The skill gap between us is way too big right now.
So we're going to follow your example. We'll study Trekker skills and train hard until we can keep up.
Just give us a little time, Eleanor. We promise to catch up.
Then let me help! I have experience now. I can guide your training.
... Are you sure? You're already overstretched.
Of course! Your dream is my dream. I don't want us to be apart either.
You're so sweet, Eleanor... Maybe I'm drawn to this dream because I saw you chasing it.
Wow, you two are so cheesy...
It's so good to finally see you!
I just arrived in Emor. Didn't expect to run into you near the Monolith. Are you already climbing on your own?
Hmm, you've come a long way.
Speaking of which, you solved a case and rescued your friend, right?
I know the gist, but I want to hear it straight from you.
I have a lot to tell you, Mentor! I'm glad you want to listen.
I had no idea you went through all that...
Eleanor, you've really proven yourself. That was some impressive work.
Heh heh. Thanks, Mentor! That means a lot.
Actually, I'm going to help my best friends, Vivian and Caterine, train to become Trekkers.
They must have seen you chasing your dream and wanted to follow your lead. Just like you were drawn to yours.
That's why I want to help them...==W== I know it sounds bold, but I want to follow your example, Mentor. Even if I can only do a little, I want to do my best for them.
Once they learn how to defend themselves in the Wilds,==W== we'll start our own guild. Then we can all go on adventures together!
A guild, huh... Heh, that's an ambitious goal.
You can only go so far on your own. If you want to climb higher, you need others to help you.
Yeah. Ever since I saw the Trekkers in Philae work together under your lead to take down those monsters, I've felt the same way.
I wouldn't be here without you, Vivian, Caterine, and so many others. I know how much those bonds matter.
You've done well. Looks like I don't have much left to teach you...
That's not true! No matter what happens, you'll always be my Mentor.
Becoming a Trekker, earning my family's approval...==W== Those dreams came true.
But I'm not stopping here. I have new dreams now, new goals.
I want to start my own guild, gain experience, and mature. And when I'm ready...
I want to join Boss Accord with my friends!
Heh, of course it is. It'd be my honor.
I'll continue to improve, Mentor, and I hope you'll be there to see it!

param: Caterine and Vivian open up to Eleanor about what they truly want, and the trio decides to form their own ladies' guild. As her journey continues, she crosses paths with you once again.
You're so slow, Eleanor! We've been waiting out here forever!
Sorry, Caterine. Packing my gear and supplies took longer than I expected, and I lost track of time...
Where's your next commission taking you?
It's not a commission this time. I'm going to challenge a Monolith.
Wow, you're finally making an official climb? Is that going to be tough?
I doubt it'll be easy. But I've prepared for this day for a long time, so don't worry about me.
That sounds amazing. I've always wondered what it looks like inside.
If I get the chance, I'll sketch the scenery or use a Photo Capturer so I can show you both what I see.
But I hear the environments in there shift constantly. It's a shame we can't see it ourselves...
... Ahem. Since we're on the subject...==W== Vivian, don't you think it's time we told Eleanor what we decided?
Yeah... Now is the perfect time.
Eleanor, do you remember the tea party we had after your first commission?
You asked us a question that day. You asked if we envied your new life as a Trekker...
We're not as brave as you, Eleanor. If I had to put it into words...
I think our biggest wish ... is to find a dream to call our own.
And now ... we've finally found it.
We've been by your side through everything.==W== We've seen your bright smiles, and we've seen you struggle when things got hard.
Everything you've experienced is what our lives have been missing.==W== Without us even realizing it, this thought took root in our hearts: we want to live as freely as you do.
And every time we watch you leave, Vivian and I feel lonely ... and useless.==W== We hate just sitting here worrying, unable to help at all.
So Eleanor, we're done just standing here watching you go. We want to walk beside you on this path.
That's right. Becoming Trekkers is how we make that dream a reality.
If the three of us could head out together and go on an adventure... Wouldn't that be amazing?
If that actually happened, I'd be so happy...
... Wait, does that mean you want to come to the Monolith with me today?

We know our limits. The skill gap between us is way too big right now.
So we're going to follow your example. We'll study Trekker skills and train hard until we can keep up.
Just give us a little time, Eleanor. We promise to catch up.

... Are you sure? You're already overstretched.

strings.text: Inside a desert Monolith, three girls discover a Wishing Box. But it doesn't hold the Artifact they seek. It holds you instead, fast asleep.
Phew... That was rough. Is everyone okay?
I'm fine. But we've got another attack on the way.
H-Hey... You two? What should we do with the Wishing Box that came out of the broken ground?
Wishing Box? Oh, that buried one? But ... considering the situation, shouldn’t we just run?
Okay, so, me and Am<r=Kohaku></r>ber will hold it down here while Ir<r=Ayame></r>is esca—Gah?! Seriously? I hate this stupid fist thing!
It's so big and beautiful... I bet whatever artifacts are in that box are worth a lot of money...
I'm sorry, you two! I just have to pull that box out!
Leave support to me. I'll be enough to hold them off.
Um, but... Isn't there something different about the Stellaroid? Like it's... angry or something?
What are you gonna do with the box anyway? Really think you can run away with it?
Of course I can! This thing might have—
A bright, happy future for us inside of it!
Huff… Huff... We made it out alive!
That thing was pretty tough.==W== Kinda wish we could've taken it down while we had the chance.
Where does that confidence even come from...?==W== Seriously. Anyway, let's open the box, shall we?
A box this big has to grant some incredible wish♪
Then like always—go ahead, Ir<r=Ayame></r>is! Am<r=Kohaku></r>ber and I are no good at making wishes.
No... This time Am<r=Kohaku></r>ber found the tower.==W== I think it's worth betting on her luck.
Then... let's all do it together.
Hm. That's actually not a bad idea. And using all three of our memories should boost the Artifact's quality, too.
Just to be clear, the goal is an Artifact we can sell for a fortune, right?
O almighty God of Grace, hear our prayer...
...an Artifact that can defeat any enemy.
...an Artifact that'll make us rich beyond our wildest dreams!
Wait, hold on. What are you two even asking for!?
I mean, if the Artifact grants infinite wishes, we could make all the money we want, right?
We could catch tons of wanted criminals and rake in the bounties.
Ugh... Yeah, having all three of us wish at once was a bad idea.
Hey, look! The box is glowing! Does that mean our wishes actually got through!?
No way. Must be a trick of the light. There's no way those wishes are—
O God of Grace! Please, just give us an Artifact we can sell for an absurd amount of money! I'm begging you!
It feels soft. Almost real, like human skin.
Huh? But this face... I swear I've seen it somewhere before.
Wait, Ir<r=Ayame></r>is? What are you doing? Looking for something?
The Artifact! There's no Artifact in the box!
Actually, no. The fact that a person came out of it should've been the first red flag...
Ugh... All that effort... down the drain...
Ahaha... ahahahaha! We're finished! Everything is over!
No Artifact means nothing to sell. Nothing to sell means no way to make money...
And without money for expenses, we'll have to disband the guild and get real jobs...
But all we've ever done==W== is roam as trekkers!==W== There's no way we'd find work that easily...==W== This is the end!==W== Aaahhh!==W==
Remaining funds for the New Star Guild: 3 Dorra
