strings.text: Stuck, you decide to let time solve your problems,==RT==but it's not on your side. Years later, lost in despair, you are pushed into a river and drown.
Miss Minova, we're gonna go to bed now.
Cap, we're heading to bed too. Our brains are still fried.
Vollara, take off your sunglasses before you sleep.
You must be exhausted too, Neuvira. Need a hand?
Nah, I've got it. Aren't you going to bed, Cap?
I still need to chat with our friends from New Star Guild. I'll turn in right after, don't worry about me.
Sure thing. Don't stay up too late though, Cap.
Neuvira carries the snoring Vollara out of the room.
I miss this. We were just like that when we were kids, weren't we?
It's only been two years and I'm already feeling nostalgic.
Iris would even do bed checks to make sure our blankets were on.
Look who's talking, Noya!==W== You kicked your blankets off more than anyone.
And Amber ... never slept in her own bed. She'd either be hiding in the wardrobe or up on the ceiling beams.
Narrow, high places ... they feel safer to sleep in.
You guys are pretty tight, huh?
Really appreciate you helping with the Monolith climb today. Couldn't have done it without you.
No problem at all! Climbing the Monoliths is just part of our daily routine as Trekkers.
First time climbing a Monolith in the city. It was fun.
We should be the ones thanking you.
I was devastated when I found out the orphanage was gone ... but this place, it feels just the same. It's such a relief.
So, really, thank you ... for protecting a place that means so much to us.
It was nothing. I was just doing it for my own peace of mind.
Anyway, what was it you wanted to talk about?
Right. We were just thinking ...==W== starting tomorrow, we'd like to take over the Monolith runs for the kids.
Whoa, hold on! You've already helped us so much today.
You really don't have to go that far.
Of course we do. We grew up in this orphanage as well.
Aunt Allie was there for us when we needed her. Now it's time we pay it forward.
I'll make sure to wish as hard as I can.
And so, we stay. Each Monolith run for the Creta Trading is physically and mentally draining...
...But we push on, gathering one Artifact after another. Even though I can't use magic, I can still contribute with wishes and paperwork.

We never give up trying to uncover the truth about the loan. But before we can find a crack in Feagin's story, the Creta Trading vanishes one morning, taking our vehicle with them and leaving nothing but a vacant mansion.
Free of debt but without a vehicle, we had to seek new jobs.
What followed was a rollercoaster chapter in our lives.

==RT====RT====RT==<size=43>Noya secured a well-paying position supplying wind to the furnace, becoming the first among us to depart from Emor.==P==</size> ==W====RT====RT==<size=43>She worked there for six months, but right before payday, the foreman fired her for "entering with her left foot first, which is a violation of company policy."</size>

==RT==<size=43>Despite six months of dedicated study, Iris couldn't pass the Grace Imperium interview, forcing her to work at a cold storage facility with a green beak logo.==P==</size>==W====RT====RT==<size=43>She got lucky quickly, and within months, she was promoted to a senior position.</size>==P====W====RT====RT==<size=43>Yet the very day following her promotion celebration, her coworkers vanished with all the stored goods, abandoning her to confront both unpaid rent and furious cargo owners. And she had to face both unpaid rent and furious cargo owners alone.</size>

==RT====RT==<size=43>Working as a waitress at a cat café, Amber was still uncomfortable with human interactions, but found herself beloved by all the animals there.==P==</size>==W====RT====RT==<size=43>However, the cat café suffered a devastating explosion one day and, although everyone survived unscathed, the business was beyond recovery.</size>
==RT====RT====RT==<size=44>Ashwind Clan gradually dissolved after the kids grew up. Minova became a venerated figure in Emor's underworld, but they say she never smiled again.</size>

==RT====RT==<size=43>Me, I ended up joining a guild in some far-off city, found work as a "Wish Trekker."</size>==P====W====RT====RT==<size=43>Years later, the guild started losing customers, and I was dismissed because of my age.</size>

==RT====RT==<size=43>Walking along streets lined with flowing streams, I feel detached from the bustling world around me. I'm holding an old, broken phone that still contains their contact information.</size>==P====W====RT====RT==<size=43>My fingers hover over their names, but I can't bring myself to make the call. It's not that I can't contact them, but what could I possibly say after all this time?</size>
Alas ... What have I been doing with my life?
So please, my Lord Tyrant, don't become a star once more.
The same old road leads to the same old ends.
So that's what the warning in my dream meant.
Merely shouldering everyone else's suffering and duties won't bring me happiness in the end.
It took you this long to figure that out? How dense can you be?
But before I can turn around, I'm jostled off the bridge by the surging crowd.
Am I ... in a hospital? Did I drown?
Drowning? Yes. Hospital? I'm afraid not.
Not a hospital? What do you mean?
You should get into better shape. When you fell into that river, you sank like a stone before any helpful citizen could come to your rescue.
So I ... I see.==W== Is this heaven or hell, then?
Either way, this must be the end.==W== On the bright side, I can finally get some rest.
What are you talking about? You can't slack off now. We've been waiting here for you for years and years.
We can't let you just give up and rest.
Your journey is far from over.
What, can you bring me back to life or something?
No, you need not be revived, for you never truly died.
You've simply stepped away from "the other side" and arrived at "this side."
You'll return to "the other side" when you leave this place.
This is your room, and we are your faithful servants.
In this place, we'll fulfill any request you make of us.
But only within these confines,==W== for the world as it exists now is no longer yours to command.
I don't really follow what you're saying.
Hm, as long as you hold that Artifact, you'll understand sooner or later.
I instinctively glance down at my phone. At some point, it's restored itself to pristine condition. The door to the pure white room slowly creaks open.
This is the very symbol of your ownership of this room.
And your status as the Tyrant.
When I'm feeling down, my phone always cheers me up.
I wish I could get a phone with a big screen like yours, ==PLAYER_NAME==!
I ... I've gone back in time? Or was it all a dream?
No. Even if that was a dream, I can't let things end that way again.

strings.text: A good meal always heals the soul. Over a delicious dinner, you realize the key to helping the children: creating more fun memories.
I never had grilled fishie this tasty before.
Slow down, kiddo. Watch out for those bones.
At the dinner table, Noya's grilled fish is a huge hit, bringing smiles to the children's faces.
I've grilled this same fish before, but it tasted nothing like this.
Spill the beans, Noya. Got some special recipe you're hiding?
Nah, nothing special. I just wing it.
Maybe Amber's the one with the magic touch in catching good fish.
I'm winging it too, but mine doesn't even look edible...
Cap, your "winging it" means just throwing fish on the fire. One side's raw, the other's charred, and you don't even scrape off all the scales.
My bad. How about lending me your knuckle dusters next time? They'd make great scale scrapers.
Who'd want knuckle dusters that reek of fish?!
Sis, not even a mouthful of fish can shut you up, huh?
Noya says she just "wings it," but she's actually adapting her technique based on the condition of each ingredient.
Even with two fish caught at the same time, she'll use different heat levels to cook each one to perfection based on the smallest details.
All that for grilling fish? She can tell just by watching...?
Not at all. I just go with my instinct.
Don't take what a culinary genius says too literally.==W== Even if you tried to copy her, you'd never get it right.
Yeah ... I guess the art of grilling fish is beyond my comprehension.
Delicious food really does help restore energy. Everyone at the table is having a great time.
And this is all ... thanks to Noya's grilled fish?
Original Pep Pep Juice, peach flavor.==W== One sip and you'll be smiling.
It's amazing! The popping bubbles are making my tongue tingle.
Why does drinking this feel so familiar somehow?
Feeling a lot better now, aren't ya?
I wasn't feeling down or anything,==W== but yeah, that Pep Pep Juice definitely cheered me up even more.
Not down? Why were you frowning at dinner then?
I was just worried about the kids, that's all.
Hey Noya, after making your wish in the Monolith today, did you feel any different than usual?
For sure. That wish card took away more memories than usual today. Really knocked me out.
But I'm all good now, thanks to my secret weapon.
Pep Pep Juice, of course! My absolute favorite Monolith drink.
These drinks ... you pick them up inside the Monoliths?
Nope. You can only bring out things that you wish for. You can't just eat things you get inside. Any food you eat inside the Monolith will just disappear the moment you step out.
So yeah ... this Pep Pep Juice is the last one I have. I was saving it for a really special occasion.
Your last one? Are you sure you should be giving me something so important?
Ahh, it's fine, it's fine! Because ... look.
Hm? Noya's can is different from mine. It doesn't smell like peach.
This isn't ... Pep Pep Juice, is it?
I've got the taste of Pep Pep Juice etched in my memory, though. Just thinking about it is enough to wash the fatigue away.
So don't hold back, drink up. I want you to remember this taste, too, Boss.
And hey, just between us ... when it's your turn to make a wish, just imagine you're drinking a Pep Pep Juice—
The God of Grace might just be silly enough to take that happy little daydream instead. I mean, I don't really know what they take, but hey, it's possible, right?
Well, in that case, I'll gratefully accept ...==W== But are you sure, sure? You're just drinking water. That can't be helping with your fatigue.
I guess I just bounce back pretty quick. A little imagination is all I need to feel rested again.
Actually, just talking like this is making me feel more energized!<size=53> ♪</size>
Recovering strength just by imagining something ... Can it really be that simple?
But then again, a happy memory is a happy memory, even if it's imagined. It still fills the void left behind.

After all, memory isn't reality. The line between what's "real" and "fake" is drawn by comparing it to the world around us. But since the memories taken for a wish are never compared to reality ... could imagining—or even creating—new, happy memories actually heal a damaged soul?
The idea sounds absurd, but it's not like we have any other options. It's a long shot, but it's worth a try!
How to help the children recover.
I can't guarantee it'll work, but...
By the way, that thing you said about imagining the taste of Pep Pep Juice...
Is it okay if I tell the others?
Of course. But I don't think they've ever even tasted it ...==W== Will it still be a useful reference for them?
It will be.==W== If my theory is right, it doesn't have to be Pep Pep Juice. Any method that's better suited for the kids should work just as well.

Your last one? Are you sure you should be giving me something so important?
Ahh, it's fine, it's fine! Because ... look.
Hm? Noya's can is different from mine. It doesn't smell like peach.
This isn't ... Pep Pep Juice, is it?
I've got the taste of Pep Pep Juice etched in my memory, though. Just thinking about it is enough to wash the fatigue away.
So don't hold back, drink up. I want you to remember this taste, too, Boss.
And hey, just between us ... when it's your turn to make a wish, just imagine you're drinking a Pep Pep Juice—
The God of Grace might just be silly enough to take that happy little daydream instead. I mean, I don't really know what they take, but hey, it's possible, right?
Well, in that case, I'll gratefully accept ...==W== But are you sure, sure? You're just drinking water. That can't be helping with your fatigue.
I guess I just bounce back pretty quick. A little imagination is all I need to feel rested again.
Actually, just talking like this is making me feel more energized!<size=53> ♪</size>
Recovering strength just by imagining something ... Can it really be that simple?
But then again, a happy memory is a happy memory, even if it's imagined. It still fills the void left behind.

After all, memory isn't reality. The line between what's "real" and "fake" is drawn by comparing it to the world around us. But since the memories taken for a wish are never compared to reality ... could imagining—or even creating—new, happy memories actually heal a damaged soul?
The idea sounds absurd, but it's not like we have any other options. It's a long shot, but it's worth a try!
How to help the children recover.
I can't guarantee it'll work, but...
By the way, that thing you said about imagining the taste of Pep Pep Juice...
Is it okay if I tell the others?
Of course. But I don't think they've ever even tasted it ...==W== Will it still be a useful reference for them?
It will be.==W== If my theory is right, it doesn't have to be Pep Pep Juice. Any method that's better suited for the kids should work just as well.

strings.text: You create fun memories by holding classes, and the children soon recover. But Creta Trading breaks its promise. Feagin withholds your pay using flimsy excuses.
The next morning, a makeshift stage is set up in the Ashwind Clan's hall, complete with a blackboard.
The kids are all sitting properly in their chairs, looking like they're actually in a real classroom.
So, this is what a classroom feels like. It's kinda neat.
The idea is, if we can pack their heads with new memories, especially fun, important ones, these kids should regain their spirits.
I really hope this plan I came up with yesterday works...
Huh? How did you know what I was thinking? Was it that obvious?
I didn't. Honestly, I'm a little nervous myself ...==W== wondering if this will even work.
So yeah, I was kinda talking to myself, too.
Then how can you sound so sure of yourself?
Heh. Well, I may have my doubts...
...But I trust my friends more than I trust myself.
Why are we doing story time this early? Did something happen?
Nope. Cap is going to teach us.
Teach us? Like how the Platinum Academy teach Cap?
Starting today, I'm gonna be schooling you. I'll teach you stuff and teach you how to learn it.
Cap, why do we even need to learn?
It's alright. Vollara's got a point.
Learning starts with asking questions. See? You might have a knack for this.
Heh heh, Cap ... If you put it like that, I'm actually gettin' fired up!
It's a pain, sure ... but to be honest, I've always been kind of curious about school.
We don't even have schools in Ash District, so someone like you, Cap—==W==who's won a scholarship to a fancy place like Platinum Academy ... you're a legend to all of us.
Mhm. And as a reason to start learning, that's more than enough.
If you stick with it, you'll see the benefits. For example ... just knowing how to read can protect you.
When Feagin came to collect, you put your thumbprints on the Creta Trading's debt transfer contract without even reading it, didn't you?
'Cause we heard ... kids have to pay what their parents owed...
They said they'd give me food if I did...

The Creta Trading is definitely in the wrong.==W== But if you could read—==W==if you'd understood that contract—you would've seen it said you were voluntarily taking on a baseless debt. Feagin wouldn't have been able to force you to sign.
No way ... We didn't have to be in debt at all?
Cap, if I study hard, can I learn to read too?
Well ... whether you learn or not is up to you.
But if you want to learn, I'll teach you. Every last one of you. Until it sticks.
Then I'm gonna study super hard!
Me too! Teach me, Sister Minova!
Even if we can read, there's no way we can out-talk a big company like Creta Trading.
Honestly, I think it'd be way cooler if you taught us how to brawl and, like, how to make skateboards.
If you can beat up the bad guys, or at least skate away from 'em, problem solved!
Think this: do you actually understand==W== how those skateboards you're so good with are made?
I ... uh ... How are they made? The wheels? The deck?
And about those skateboards ... Anyone wanna tell me the most important part of a skateboard?
I ... uh ... You're the one who always makes them for me, Cap.
Aaargh! I don't get it at all!
You can only truly improve if you understand the fundamentals. If you just slap things together, that board of yours is just going to fall apart one day.
Cap! I know! The most important part is the truck, especially the axle, right?
That's my Neuvira. You've really thought about it.
Cap! I want to answer a question, too!
It's a little hard to follow, but this is kinda fun.
Cap! Ask us one we can understand!
They have so much more energy than yesterday ... even more than just before class started.
Me? I thought Iris was next.
That was the plan ... but I really want to sit in on your lesson too, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
What's the big deal?It's not like there's a rule about who has to teach.
Me, teach? What am I gonna teach with memory loss!
Maybe I'll just tell them what I saw in the Monoliths.
As a Trekker, I should tell a story about treasures. Kids love those.
The Trekker and the animals worked together, defeated the monster, and returned all the stolen treasure to its rightful owners.
How delicious were those rice dumplings that everyone just followed after eating them?!
Haha, they must've been super-duper, unbelievably tasty!
Animal stories are always a safe bet with kids.
And that's how the monkey, after causing mayhem in the celestial realm, got himself trapped under a ginormous mountain.
So even he couldn't take down the big company from the west?
Well, it wasn't technically a company, but ... yeah, you could say that.
Causing a ruckus big enough to shame those heavenly bigwigs? That's a win in my book.
Okay, it's got a coffin in it, but it's a fairy tale. Should be fine, right?
When they jostled the crystal coffin, the princess coughed up that chunk of poisoned apple and woke right up.
And they all lived happily ever after. The end.
==PLAYER_NAME==, you didn't cough anything up when you woke up.
Wait! Does that mean the poisoned apple is still inside you?
Whoa, hold your horses! Don't mixing up stories with real life! And I'm not a princess!
And so, the New Star Guild holds a special class==RT==for the Ashwind children.
Noya gives the kids a sword-fighting demo.
Iris teaches them how to exchange and handle Dorra.
Amber teaches them how to survey terrain—well, mostly just showing.==RT==I, standing by her side, read the instructions she texts me.
By the end of the class, the kids are clearly more energetic. It seems their weary hearts and fading memories have started to mend.
What am I going to do...?
Yesterday, you signed your souls away to the Creta Trading, all for these kids.
And today, ==PLAYER_NAME== came up with a way to help them heal.
I just got lucky that my random idea happened to work.
Call it luck if you want, but honestly, we'd be totally lost without you.
Oh, right. With everything going on, I almost forgot. Here, take this back.
The key to this place. We're just crashing here. Now that the rightful owners are back, it only feels right to return it.
Returning the key ... Wait, does this mean you're leaving?
Heh. The wind blows where it wants, you know?
But where will you stay?==W== With all these kids, you need a big enough space.
We'll just find another empty building!
Exactly! We've got connections in the Ash District. We'll find a new spot in no time. Probably. Yeah.
Are you staying in the city?
No, I'm a Trekker now. I'll be heading back out to the Wilds.
In that case ... Iris, Amber, are you two cool with this?
Mhm. This place is way too big for just us anyway.
The New Star Guild and the Ashwind Clan are already partners.
So the Ashwind Clan should just keep staying here.
That'd literally be a life saver ... but are you sure? This is the orphanage's property...
We're friends, aren't we? No need to get hung up on this. These formalities are getting old.
We all benefited from this orphanage, and we want to see its spirit live on. What the Ashwind Clan is doing now ... it's just like what...
You guys ...==W== I owe you one. For real.
Hehe, things with the kids and the clan are looking up. Let's keep the momentum going and find Loxy!

strings.text: In Nova, a Seal of Grace allows companies to create rules ordinary people can't defy. Thankfully, Bastelina informs you that you have one, too.
The Lucky Oasis remains in company custody.
What? We shook hands on this...
We held up our end—working for you and making those payments. Where's our ride?
The five of us put in four days last month. At 10 thousand Dorra a head per day, that's 200 thousand right there.
And here's the 650 thousand Dorra we scraped together pulling all-nighters in the Monoliths, plus what Minova pitched in. All told, that's more than enough for this month's payment.
True. On paper, your payment is sufficient.
We held up our end of the deal. Now you hold up yours!
As I said. Sufficient ... on paper.
"On paper"? What's that supposed to mean?
To put it simply, after deducting the fines, your payment is ... inadequate.
Fines?! Wh-what are you talking about?
Fifty flawless wishes over those four days.
You gutter-rats know nothing about proper company with the company.
They run cities, command soldiers—some even have private armies.
They're the closest to the Gods. They only answer to their own rulebooks, not common decency.
Allow me to enumerate the clauses you've violated, one by one.
Iris failed to respond to messages promptly fifteen times. That's 2 thousand Dorra per incident, totaling 30 thousand Dorra.
That wasn't on purpose! I was fighting Stellaroids when your messages came in. I replied right after defeating them.
Company regulations state all comms must be acknowledged within 60 seconds.
And you, Minova. Zero shift logs submitted. That's a 3 thousand Dorra penalty each time, totaling 12 thousand Dorra.
S-shift logs?! Since when? You never mentioned those!
It's in the regulations. Ignorance of the policy is no excuse.
I ... I followed the rules! Answered my messages, and Iris handled my logs...
Eating during Monolith climbs, three times. 60 thousand Dorra.
You expect us to fight all day on empty?! How's that even supposed to work?
This is about protocol. It's about showing proper respect to the God of Grace.
Ah, and you two. Excessive phone chatting during climbs.
50 thousand each, and I'm being lenient.
Amber can only communicate well through her phone, and we were just discussing the mission.
Explaining won't help. She's not docking pay to uphold the rules; she's weaponizing the rulebook.==W== So this is the power of a CEO...
Let's tally it up. 200 thousand Dorra in earned wages. Penalties ... 202 thousand Dorra.
You're 2 thousand Dorra in the red. We'll tack it onto next month's deductions.
Who in their right mind would fall for this crap?!
Ah, ah, ah. Violence is not the answer. You're our employees, so Creta Trading regulations apply.
Heh ... I trust you understand now? This is...
The iron law of the city-state, the company, and the Nova Empire itself!
Noya, don't. She's right. Arguing with her isn't going to change anything.
You're free to quit anytime, but kiss your vehicle goodbye if you do.
And you, quiet one—don't even think about drawing your weapon. Keep in mind the orphanage kids.
And let me be perfectly clear. We hold legally binding magic contracts. For every last one of you—and those children.
Keep climbing those Monoliths. It's all you're good for.
Give 'em an inch, they take a mile...
W-what do you think you're doing?
I'm a senior member of the Imperial Guard! One word from me and the knights will be here instantly.
Where do you think you're going?
Taking leave. The Creta Trading can't deny that request, can they?!
Very well. Emergency leave. That will cost you three days' wages.
==PLAYER_NAME==, stick with her. Make sure Minova doesn't do anything ... drastic. We'll cover this shift.
Right. I need leave too...==W== I...didn't sleep well last night.
Same penalty for you. Don't say I didn't warn you!
Sorry, ==W==I lost my cool. Couldn't control my emotions.
To be honest, all of us wanted to see you punch Feagin in the face.
If you hadn't lost it, I would have.
Heh ... that makes me feel a lot better. Thanks.
But still, it's made one thing crystal clear.
Yeah...==W== I think I can understand...why your Aunt Allie and the children disappeared.
They must have been backed into a corner, just like we were.
Bad guys holding the kids hostage.
Even with enough magic power to defy the Creta Trading ... you can't shield everyone.
So to keep them safe, Aunt Allie had to take the kids and just ... disappear overnight.
Maybe I screwed up from the start.==W== Platinum Academy, Ashwind Clan... I never had the chance to break free.
I shouldn't have been so stubborn, trying to fight them head-on. I should have just become a Trekker like you, taken the kids, and left this place behind.
Thank you ever so kindly for paying a visit to the Grace Imperium! Please, allow me to introduce myself properly.
You remember me! I'm so happy.
Thanks for sticking up for us back there. It's a surprise to see you in a place like this.
It's no surprise at all! I've been looking all over for you.
You left in such a hurry that day, you forgot this file.
Ahem, thank you for waiting. So sorry, but could I ask for just a moment more of your time?
My supervisor just told me there's an important file in the archives==RT==for whoever opened Safe #1. My colleague is bringing it over now.
We completely forgot about this after our vehicle got stolen.
You're right, sorry. We left in a huge rush.
I'm so glad you remember! <size=60>♪</size> Because this file is super, mega, ultra-important!
Thankfully, I got lucky and found you today.
Here you go, this is your file.
Grace Imperium ... They seem different from the Creta Trading. I guess there are some decent people here after all.
So, what's in this "important file," anyway...?
Bastelina, can you explain this? Is what it says real?
As real as the ink on the page. That little piece you took from the vault...
A Seal of Grace?==W== Like the ones companies use?
Why? What's the big deal with this "CEO" title Feagin uses?
Companies are blessed by the God of Grace, stamped with the Seal of Grace and all.
So this seal represents a whole company?!
Exactly! And this document serves as proof that whoever opens the vault is the rightful holder of the seal.
In short, you are now the owner of a company.
I have nothing but questions ... A CEO? Me?
A whole company?! A rotten-to-the-core one like that Creta Trading?
Oh no, dear guest! A company is just a company. Whether it's a decent or rotten one depends on the people who run it.
Actually, most companies and their employees are probably doing everything they can to distance themselves from people like Feagin.
So, you knew about Feagin's dirty dealings? Why didn't you do anything?!
I ... I'm just an intern, you know? Company conflicts are above someone like me.
This Seal of Grace belongs to me, right? Does that mean I can start a company?
You already have one. Holding that piece means you own all of it.
And it's a very impressive one.
The company this piece represents was once at war with the entire world.
At war with the entire world?! What kind of company is this...?
However, your company has been dormant for ages.
Assets, Deepsea Finance accounts ... all locked down.
So the company's basically defunct right now?
That's right. But the freeze is only temporary! If you want to unlock them, come to Grace Imperium. I'll help you submit the paperwork.
Just tell them the "adorable Bastelina" sent you, and we'll get everything ready to process for you right away!
Thanks a lot. Really appreciate your help.
I glance down at the chess piece dangling from my phone strap.
According to Iris, a company's power is nearly limitless. With this ... we won't have to be afraid of the Creta Trading anymore.
All that power ... whether it's used for good or ill all depends on the one who wields it...
Now that I have this kind of strength, maybe I can actually change things. Maybe I can help everyone break free from this cage, together!

Grace Imperium ... They seem different from the Creta Trading. I guess there are some decent people here after all.
So, what's in this "important file," anyway...?
Bastelina, can you explain this? Is what it says real?
As real as the ink on the page. That little piece you took from the vault...
A Seal of Grace?==W== Like the ones companies use?
Why? What's the big deal with this "CEO" title Feagin uses?
Companies are blessed by the God of Grace, stamped with the Seal of Grace and all.
So this seal represents a whole company?!
Exactly! And this document serves as proof that whoever opens the vault is the rightful holder of the seal.
In short, you are now the owner of a company.
I have nothing but questions ... A CEO? Me?
A whole company?! A rotten-to-the-core one like that Creta Trading?
Oh no, dear guest! A company is just a company. Whether it's a decent or rotten one depends on the people who run it.
Actually, most companies and their employees are probably doing everything they can to distance themselves from people like Feagin.
So, you knew about Feagin's dirty dealings? Why didn't you do anything?!
I ... I'm just an intern, you know? Company conflicts are above someone like me.
This Seal of Grace belongs to me, right? Does that mean I can start a company?
You already have one. Holding that piece means you own all of it.
And it's a very impressive one.
The company this piece represents was once at war with the entire world.
At war with the entire world?! What kind of company is this...?
However, your company has been dormant for ages.
Assets, Deepsea Finance accounts ... all locked down.
So the company's basically defunct right now?
That's right. But the freeze is only temporary! If you want to unlock them, come to Grace Imperium. I'll help you submit the paperwork.
Just tell them the "adorable Bastelina" sent you, and we'll get everything ready to process for you right away!
Thanks a lot. Really appreciate your help.
I glance down at the chess piece dangling from my phone strap.
According to Iris, a company's power is nearly limitless. With this ... we won't have to be afraid of the Creta Trading anymore.
All that power ... whether it's used for good or ill all depends on the one who wields it...
Now that I have this kind of strength, maybe I can actually change things. Maybe I can help everyone break free from this cage, together!

strings.text: With your memory gone, you tread carefully. While Iris investigates how companies work, you and the others focus on retrieving the vehicle. Creta Trading continues to be unreasonable, and you have to fight back.
The company this piece represents was once at war with the entire world.
Assets, Deepsea Finance accounts ... all locked down.
If you want to unlock them, come to Grace Imperium. I'll help you submit the paperwork.
Turns out this chess piece is a 'Seal of Grace.' It represents a company that was blessed by the God of Grace.
If I go get it unfrozen at the Grace Imperium, we'll officially own a company.
A c-c-company? We're getting a company?! ==W==I must be dreaming...
She must be overjoyed! Having a steady job at a company has always been Iris' dream!
It's wild... Companies ... those huge, stomping behemoths ... represented by just this tiny chess piece. Or, uh, seal, whatever.
Any company with you is bound to be a good one, I bet.
You seem pretty sure about that.
Heck yeah! You've got more brains than the rest of us put together. And you're a good person.
Hmm... If I'm that sharp, maybe I could've gotten a scholarship to Platinum Academy.
Ugh, no, not like ... book smarts... How do I put it... ==W==Not that you're dumb or anything!
You're diggin' yourself a deeper hole, haha!
Like, things we do without even thinking?==W== ==PLAYER_NAME== just instantly sees the key points and lays it all out.
I mean, I force myself through classes every day just tryin' to keep my memories from fading, but I never really got it like you do.
Maybe it's the memory loss. Without memories, you're not held back by common sense.
You're okay, Iris! This is great news! Your dream's coming true! If ==PLAYER_NAME== starts a company, we'll be the first employees! Right, ==PLAYER_NAME==?
Do any of you have a clue what this actually means?!
Every single morning, the first thing you worry about is whether you can even make payroll this month!
It means backstabbing Senators breathing down our necks with one impossible profit goal after another!
An endless nightmare is what's waiting for us!
Owning a company isn't like having a job—it's the first step on the road to ruin!
Come on, don't be so grim. You've never actually run a company, so this is all just guesswork, right?
I guess... But every reference book says the same thing, so it must be true!
Even with all that, companies still have advantages that individuals or other groups don't, right?
They do. But only if you can hold on to them.
Companies are always trying to destroy each other.
And the winners usually crush the losers completely...
Plenty of failed CEOs end up worse off than street beggars.
... In short, unfreezing the company means throwing ourselves into a brutal, cutthroat war. Please, never forget that.
And the one making that call ... is the holder of this seal. You, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
The moment you use it, other companies will probably come after this seal.
Relax, Iris. ==W==I'll learn more about this whole company situation before deciding whether to activate the seal.
Could you do some research for me? About companies in general, and also what Bastelina meant by "once at war with the entire world"?
We made some discoveries in the Monolith today, too.
Can we just text about it?
After you left, the three of us kept climbing the Monolith.
Feagin was ticked off, so she just handed over a wish card.
I used it to make a wish, and I got—
The Lucky Oasis? What are you talking about?
Amber, are you feeling alright? Did it ... did it take too many memories?
I'm okay. Didn't lose anything vital.
Maybe it's because I didn't wish for the complete Lucky Oasis? Just the outer shell.
And it's not even metal. Feels more like ... you know those Monolith drink bottles?
I have no clue what Feagin's up to.
Wait, is Feagin trying to wish for the Lucky Oasis?
I doubt it. The Lucky Oasis is way too big and complex. No one's ever wished for an Artifact on that scale.
I mean, just picturing it perfectly is one thing, but all those intricate car parts? That's just asking way too much of a person's mind.
A car that big... Forget forming a clear wish—the memory cost would completely drain the wisher's mind!
You're all thinking it ... the kids in the Ash District. Feagin doesn't give a damn what happens to the wisher. She'll just keep tricking more of 'em into trying.
Well, so much for taking it easy.
But something's bugging me... Iris just said you can get whatever you wish for, as long as you picture it clearly enough.
So, if wishing for the whole car is a bust, but you still want the Lucky Oasis ... you'd try wishing for its parts instead. Which means you'd have to—
Oh, wait... They're going to take it apart?
They're gonna mess with Loxy, too?! No way! I can't just sit back and do nothing!
Hmph. If that's the plan, then let's just bust up Creta Trading and be done with it. We'd be doing this city a favor.
I can use my Platinum Academy cover to do some recon on Creta Trading.
Both plans are risky...==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, what's your call?
The best plan is having no plan.
Those who plan more will reign victorious.
We could hide in a crate and sneak in.
Let's just wait for nightfall and sneak right in. Simple is best.
Alright, let's all catch some Zs and power up for tonight.
We're counting on Minova to scout ahead.
The Creta Trading's building is huge, and we're going in blind.
Remember when we were 'working' for Feagin? How did they move the Artifacts from the Monolith?
They were packed in crates. Feagin hired mercs to take them along the Waterway, straight to her HQ.
So, if we hide in those crates, we can get right into the heart of her house.
It's risky, but it might be worth a shot.
Alright, that's the plan. Tomorrow, when we show up for work, I'll distract the mercs. You guys jump in the crates while they're busy.

strings.text: The exploited staff of Creta Trading finally leave late at night, too dazed to spot Minova and the group sneaking in. Inside the main hall, you find Feagin trying to duplicate your vehicle.
Soul Stones are at full capacity.
Okay, this is the spot. Creta Trading's back entrance is right down there.
Let's run through the plan again.
We split up once we get inside.
Target's the Lucky Oasis. Creta Trading's guards are just temps, so the night shift should be pretty light, but we still need to be careful.
How are we getting the Lucky Oasis out of there?
I'll just drive it straight through the gates!
Ugh, that's insane! We don't even know these roads... But I guess we're out of options.
Hold on. There's a big freight lift near here—it should be able to fit your ride.
That way, we can drive it back along the Waterway.
Right, they'll never expect that route. Let's do it that way.
Chief Feagin, you're still here? I can barely keep my eyes open...
Pathetic. If you wanna go home, then go. I'm not stopping you.
I... I really can't go on... Sorry, I'm heading out.
Remember, 9 AM sharp tomorrow. Don't be late.
Seriously, employees these days have no drive at all. How do they expect to get anywhere when they've never even pulled an all-nighter?
That rare Artifact vehicle... If I can just figure out how to mass-produce it with wish cards, Creta Trading will finally be back on top.
And then, everyone who ever slighted me, every company that looked down on us... They'll all pay!
Right, no time to rest. Gotta get these wish cards perfected, ASAP.
"9 AM sharp tomorrow. Don't be late!" Unbelievable. ==W==Who does she think she is?
Easy for her to say. Does she even know what time it is?!
That's six hours 'til nine... By the time I get home and handle everything, I'll be lucky to get two hours of sleep...
Must be nice to be "Her Majesty." Pulls an all-nighter with that scooter, then just crashes in the lounge all day.
Phew... That was way too close.
Ha! We weren't even really hiding, and they walked right past us.
Try running on two hours of sleep. Probably too wiped to notice a thing.
If Feagin's that tough on kids, imagine how she treats her actual employees.
Is it just me, or does it feel like ... someone's watching us?
Oh no, did Feagin see us?
Hmm. If you didn't feel it, maybe I'm just jumpy.
Feagin? Nah, she'd have already sicced the Imperial Guard on us by now.
Listen, those temps said Feagin's checking out your vehicle. Best bet is to head the way they just came from.
Right. Stairs are ahead. Amber and I can check upstairs.
Cool, I'll check the rooms around here.
Hang on, Loxy! I'm coming for ya!
I haven't seen this Lucky Oasis, so I'll stick with ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Let's try the door at the end of the hall.
Dammit, the last wish card only produced the shell ... and it wasn't even metal.
... Wow, found her. That was fast.
Yeah, but what's she up to, muttering to herself like that?
Hard to see ... looks like she's pulling something out.
Okay, let's try this again ... with this Seal of Grace.
Hold on... Is that Seal of Grace shaped like a soldier chess piece? Looks kinda like mine...
Makes sense for a company like Creta Trading to have a Seal ... but are they all shaped like chess pieces?
First, duplicate the vehicle's data with the Seal ... then imprint it onto the wish card.
Done! I'll find someone to test it first thing tomorrow. Right ... that ditzy blonde Trekker will do.
So that's how they make wish cards...
Seals of Grace can do that?
Amber and I found a bunch of documents upstairs. All those rules we supposedly broke were literally just made up!
Feagin's still making up bizarre new rules! This one says "Walking out of formation on the Waterway - 2,000 Dorra fine!"
Sounds like she planned to use it to dock our pay next month!
She never meant to give the vehicle back! She was just using us for free labor!
Just like I thought. Feagin never planned on paying us a dime.
Hiding behind the company name, making up rules that only benefit her.
==PLAYER_NAME==, seems like talking nicely isn't gonna work.
Then we shouldn't bother playing nice anymore right?!

strings.text: Minova changes into a Platinum Academy uniform, impersonating a young lady. Posing as a job applicant, she scouts the company's layout. But will the infiltration really go so smoothly?
Hey, check this out. New job posting from Creta Trading.
They're rushing to fill an Artifact Research spot. Bet it's to poke around your vehicle.
Havin' Platinum Academy on my resume should land me an interview, easy.
Once I'm in, we'll figure out where Feagin stashed your ride.
Uh ... you all see this too, right?
A-Are you actually Minova?! Or like, her long-lost twin sister?!
Whoa, that Platinum uniform really does something! You look totally different!
Whaddaya mean? It's 'cause cap has got style! She makes the uniform look good!
Yeah, if we put that on, we'd just look silly.
You bust your butts just to eat. You're practically kids yourselves, but you still look out for the younger ones.
That's not just respectable, it's amazing.
Clothes are just threads. They don't define who you are inside.
Still, plenty of people only see the surface... Otherwise, she wouldn't be banking on the Academy's name to get her foot in the door.
Feagin knows you, though. Is the uniform really enough? Don't you need, like, makeups or something too?
==PLAYER_NAME==, what are you saying? Look at her! There's no way Feagin would recognize Minova like this!
N-No way ... you can't be serious.
She looks like a completely different person!
Slap on some glasses, boom. Whole new identity.
No, that's not what I'm getting at... I mean ... ==W==ugh, never mind.
Is it just me? Am I the only one not seeing it?
Hi, I'm here for a job interview. Is this the right place?
Right on time, a disguised Minova walks into Creta Trading. ==W==The rest of the crew, waiting by the Waterway, listen in on her phone.
Hello. Do you have a résumé with you?
Oh, from Platinum Academy! We're honored to have you.
Yes, that's right. I graduate this summer, so I'm getting a head start on my job search.
Good afternoon, I'm Feagin. ==W==My apologies—how rude of our staff not to have offered you tea.
Those glasses are a wonderful fit for you. The frames bring out your eyes.
Now then, please come this way.
Oh, um, perhaps you'd like to see my résumé first?
Not at all. A student in a Platinum Academy uniform is already a top candidate.
Reception, please bring us some tea. The good stuff! We have a future star on our hands.
The main duties for this role involve researching Artifact structures, analyzing the functions of various components, and writing up reports.
As a Platinum Academy student, I'm sure you've handled plenty of Artifacts. Makes you an ideal fit for this position, wouldn't you say?
Thank you for the vote of confidence. That's very encouraging to hear.
However, I was under the impression that Artifact structure is already a well-researched subject. The Academy has countless reports on it.
If that's what you require, I can access the Academy archives.
Ah, the Academy's library... Truly enviable.
But I'm not talking about those well-documented Artifacts.
A rare find, isn't it? A recent acquisition. Quite the massive Artifact vehicle. Word is, some Trekkers cobbled it together piece by piece.
It is indeed a rare specimen. Quite valuable for research, I imagine.
Might I have a closer look?
Of course. Take all the time you need. Just be careful not to break anything.
Hmm, the four wheels ... likely separate wishes. And the connections between the wheels and axles... ==W==Ah, so that's how they managed this ingenious structure.
The carriage too, wished for separately then assembled... ==W==No, wait. This section of the body looks handcrafted. It's incredible they matched the color of the wished-for metal so perfectly.
Yeah, that's right! That's our Loxy! All of us worked together to build her!
Minova was spot on. Getting those axle connections right wasn't easy. I don't think I could do it again if my life depended on it.
It's nice she noticed the part that took us forever.
Well, she invented the Ashwind skateboards. Course she gets Loxy. Both have four wheels and the bits connecting them!
A true Platinum Academy eye for detail. I believe we can dispense with the rest of the interview.
If you accept, you can start at Creta Trading as early as tomorrow.
How does five million Dorra a month sound?
Furthermore, if you can successfully analyze each component's function and determine the proper wishing prayers, we can raise that to twenty million monthly. Plus, a seat on Creta Trading's Senate.
Twenty million?! Am I hearing this right?!
Hold on, you're missing the point! She's gonna tear Loxy apart! We have to go in there NOW!
Easy, Noya. We know where she is now. We can get Loxy back before Feagin does anything to it.
This is... very sudden. ==W==But thank you. I accept. I'd be honored to take on the work.
One question, though. What about the Trekkers who built this? Having them here would speed up the research immensely.
Tsk... The last thing I want is to involve those vagabonds.
They left the vehicle as collateral for a debt. Long gone by now, ==W==I'm afraid.
That's a shame. ==W==I have one last question, then.
You mentioned analyzing the wishing method. But even if we understand how it works, we can't guarantee the same results.
So what's the point of this research?
Rest assured, your research will be put to good use for wishing.
You see, Creta Trading possesses ... miraculous "wish cards."
With these cards, comprehension is irrelevant! One simply sacrifices a bit more memory than usual, and poof—they can wish for whatever Artifact recorded on the card.
And you plan to have Trekkers use these cards for the wishing process?
Hire Trekkers for grunt work like that? Far too costly!
Street orphans work just fine. I can get four kids for the price of one Trekker.
But ... won't the children lose huge chunks of their memories?
My, you're quite the bleeding heart, aren't you? Regardless, that's not our problem.
I have them sign contracts when I hire them. So if anything ... happens on the job, it's their own responsibility.
Don't trouble yourself with such trivialities.
With your talent, Creta Trading will reclaim its former glory! We'll be a powerhouse no one dares trifle with!
Join me! Let's be the saviors who resurrect Creta Trading!

Right on time, a disguised Minova walks into Creta Trading. ==W==The rest of the crew, waiting by the Waterway, listen in on her phone.
Hello. Do you have a résumé with you?
Oh, from Platinum Academy! We're honored to have you.
Yes, that's right. I graduate this summer, so I'm getting a head start on my job search.
Good afternoon, I'm Feagin. ==W==My apologies—how rude of our staff not to have offered you tea.
Those glasses are a wonderful fit for you. The frames bring out your eyes.
Now then, please come this way.
Oh, um, perhaps you'd like to see my résumé first?
Not at all. A student in a Platinum Academy uniform is already a top candidate.
Reception, please bring us some tea. The good stuff! We have a future star on our hands.
The main duties for this role involve researching Artifact structures, analyzing the functions of various components, and writing up reports.
As a Platinum Academy student, I'm sure you've handled plenty of Artifacts. Makes you an ideal fit for this position, wouldn't you say?
Thank you for the vote of confidence. That's very encouraging to hear.
However, I was under the impression that Artifact structure is already a well-researched subject. The Academy has countless reports on it.
If that's what you require, I can access the Academy archives.
Ah, the Academy's library... Truly enviable.
But I'm not talking about those well-documented Artifacts.
A rare find, isn't it? A recent acquisition. Quite the massive Artifact vehicle. Word is, some Trekkers cobbled it together piece by piece.
It is indeed a rare specimen. Quite valuable for research, I imagine.
Might I have a closer look?
Of course. Take all the time you need. Just be careful not to break anything.
Hmm, the four wheels ... likely separate wishes. And the connections between the wheels and axles... ==W==Ah, so that's how they managed this ingenious structure.
The carriage too, wished for separately then assembled... ==W==No, wait. This section of the body looks handcrafted. It's incredible they matched the color of the wished-for metal so perfectly.
Yeah, that's right! That's our Loxy! All of us worked together to build her!
Minova was spot on. Getting those axle connections right wasn't easy. I don't think I could do it again if my life depended on it.
It's nice she noticed the part that took us forever.
Well, she invented the Ashwind skateboards. Course she gets Loxy. Both have four wheels and the bits connecting them!
A true Platinum Academy eye for detail. I believe we can dispense with the rest of the interview.
If you accept, you can start at Creta Trading as early as tomorrow.
How does five million Dorra a month sound?
Furthermore, if you can successfully analyze each component's function and determine the proper wishing prayers, we can raise that to twenty million monthly. Plus, a seat on Creta Trading's Senate.
Twenty million?! Am I hearing this right?!
Hold on, you're missing the point! She's gonna tear Loxy apart! We have to go in there NOW!
Easy, Noya. We know where she is now. We can get Loxy back before Feagin does anything to it.
This is... very sudden. ==W==But thank you. I accept. I'd be honored to take on the work.
One question, though. What about the Trekkers who built this? Having them here would speed up the research immensely.
Tsk... The last thing I want is to involve those vagabonds.
They left the vehicle as collateral for a debt. Long gone by now, ==W==I'm afraid.
That's a shame. ==W==I have one last question, then.
You mentioned analyzing the wishing method. But even if we understand how it works, we can't guarantee the same results.
So what's the point of this research?
Rest assured, your research will be put to good use for wishing.
You see, Creta Trading possesses ... miraculous "wish cards."
With these cards, comprehension is irrelevant! One simply sacrifices a bit more memory than usual, and poof—they can wish for whatever Artifact recorded on the card.
And you plan to have Trekkers use these cards for the wishing process?
Hire Trekkers for grunt work like that? Far too costly!
Street orphans work just fine. I can get four kids for the price of one Trekker.
But ... won't the children lose huge chunks of their memories?
My, you're quite the bleeding heart, aren't you? Regardless, that's not our problem.
I have them sign contracts when I hire them. So if anything ... happens on the job, it's their own responsibility.
Don't trouble yourself with such trivialities.
With your talent, Creta Trading will reclaim its former glory! We'll be a powerhouse no one dares trifle with!
Join me! Let's be the saviors who resurrect Creta Trading!

strings.text: You devise a plan to hide in an Artifact crate, but the Monolith suddenly malfunctions, trapping you inside. After eating the food within, you find you can no longer leave.
Okay, today's Artifacts ... five, ten ... fifteen total. ==W==All accounted for.
They're shipping these down the Waterway... So it's gonna get rough when they toss the crates. Stay quiet, or we're busted.
Alright, load 'em up. I already rigged the crates with false bottoms. We'll stick the Artifacts on top and crawl into the space below.
So we just wait 'til the ride's over, then pop out? Feagin's gotta stash these with the other Artifacts, which means we'll find Loxy.
It's a solid plan, but ...==W== with us inside, the weight will be completely different. Are you sure no one's going to notice?
Don't worry. I'll tell the mercs we wished for some unusually heavy Artifacts today. They won't give it a second thought.
Didn't another Trekker, dressed in black, come into the Monolith with us today?
Hmm? Oh yeah ... lost track of her partway up. She probably left the Monolith ages ago.
Worried, ==PLAYER_NAME==? We can always scrub the mission and try again another day, y'know.
Impossible. The Monolith is sealed off from the outside. Even if there was an earthquake out there, we shouldn't feel it in here.
Whoa, lights out all of a sudden.
That's odd... The Monolith lights have never gone out before.
I wanna say "no way," but ... yeah, even I've got a bad feeling about this.
The elevator is stopped... What's happening?
Huff ... puff... How many floors ... have we gone down?
A hundred...==W==no, maybe...closer to two hundred now.
Dammit! How tall is this damn Monolith anyway?!
Aha... Ahahaha... It's useless... The stairs won't get us out. We never climbed this many floors... We're going to get stuck in here forever...
Hey, don't say stuff like that!
The Monolith ... it has to be broken.
We always come in through the elevator room. And even if we actually make it to the very bottom, if we can't open the elevator doors, we're still trapped!
We'll smash through the walls if we have to! We are getting out. The kids are waiting for us.
This mark... I made it an hour ago.
We ... walked in a circle? No ... no, that's impossible! We've only been going down!
I don't get it. Is this some kind of messed-up magic?
How are these Monoliths even built?
No one's ever fully understood the Monoliths' structure.
All anyone knows is: you enter via the elevator, you leave via the elevator, and nothing more comes out except what you wished for.
Let's not spin out about it right now. First things first, let's grab some of this Monolith chow. Hard to brainstorm when you're starving.
Noya, any food eaten here is reclaimed by the Monolith when you leave.==W== And if you keep eating it, you'll forget who you are ... and eventually, you'll just disappear.
I know. But even pretending we're full could help us rally, and maybe we'll think of something ...==W== right? What could one little bite hurt—
And so we were stranded—Noya, Amber, Iris, Minova, and me. We spent what felt like ages exploring. Eventually, on a floor with no stairs leading up, we found a massive hole smashed through the wall.
But looking out, all we saw were endless white clouds. The Monolith's outer walls were perfectly smooth. Might as well jump down if we try to climb that.
The elevator wouldn't budge. We were stuck in the Monolith for good.
By the time that thought truly hit me ... we'd already forgotten what each other looked like.
Sorry, no tabs here. Hope you understand.
Things get pretty rough in the next room. Might wanna check out our gear before you head in?
==PLAYER_NAME==, could you run a delivery for me?

Every now and then, the shop gets delivery jobs. The big, patterned doors are for Trekkers, but we clerks have our own secret routes—like lifting a flashing floor panel or crawling through a laundry Artifact—to get items to the Stellaroids.
Here's that item you wanted. Take care.
Hehehe... So the rumors were true. You're up to something fascinating.
Uh, miss? Could you please sign for the delivery?
They looked kind of familiar. Did they guide me before?
Their faces were kind, but ... unfamiliar. I didn't know them.
... It's tragic, but inevitable. This is what becomes of those who stay in the Monolith too long.
We've been here way longer. We didn't turn out like this.
Just look at me! My skin is absolutely glowing today! <size=60>♪</size>
On the surface, perhaps.==W== But...who really knows what we've become deep down?
But, my Tyrant, your worries are over. Today, we shall use our power to grant you a chance to reclaim it all. <size=60>♪</size>
In other words, the rest is up to you.
Now then... May your journey be a happy one this time.
Hehehe, I wonder when we'll meet again?
Huh? Something's buzzing in my pocket...
If only ... if I could just go back. Back to that moment.
This time, I'll definitely ... trust my friends.

strings.text: Feagin's hired mage casts a strange spell that seals your magic,==RT==forcing you to retreat by pushing the vehicle.==RT==As you cross the Waterway, no pursuers are in sight—someone appears to be helping you.
Hmph. Only five hours' sleep ... barely anything.==W== Suppose I'll have to catch a nap tomorrow afternoon.
Five hours' cuttin' it close.==W== Here, lemme help you out.
One good swing oughta put you down for ... oh, fifteen hours, easy.==W==
What are you doing here? Feeling bad about skipping out? Decided to sneak in some overtime?
Overtime? For this garbage company?==W== Get real. You act like it pains you to pay us.
This is the power granted by the God of Grace.
With the Seal of Grace, I can make any rule I want ...==W== and I have the final say.
For instance...==W== I could just wipe out your entire salary.==W== It's all perfectly legal as long as I use the Seal. <size=60>♪</size>
So that's your master plan, huh? Run the company by shakin' down kids? Real classy.
How dare you talk to me like that?! I'm your BOSS!
"Boss"? Nah. You look more like one of the mangy strays back in the Ash District.
And this place? Just a slightly fancier kennel.
You dare slander Creta Trading!?! I'll sue you! I'll take you to court!
Huh? What was that? Sorry, my hearing's goin' bad.
Minova really ...==W== knows how to get under someone's skin.
But,==W== for a power-tripping bully like her,==W== I guess this is exactly what's needed.
Maybe ... my bat can hear you better?==W==
Eek! What are you planning to do with that bat?!
Don't try anything stupid. It's for your own good.==W== I—==W==I've hired very capable protection.
You mean the temps who are one bad shift away from a total meltdown?
Or the Imperial Guard knights you hired, who are all sound asleep a klick away?
Don't even think about the alarm.==W== And don't move...
... or this babe's going right through your neck.
When did you get behind me?!
While you were busy watching Minova.
Now, be smart. Hands off the button.==W== And stay put!
Okay, okay, Trekkers! I was wrong! Just put the sword down, please!
Let's just talk! We can work this out! Anything you want, just name it! Really, anything!
First, burn the contracts you forced on those kids. Second, come clean about the orphanage. And third, give back the car.==W== Do that, and then we'll talk.
The contracts for the kids and the orphanage are upstairs. Just come with me. The car...==W== It's right over there, take it whenever.
Is what?==W== You got a problem?
<size=48>No, no, no!! Put the bat away!!</size>
I want to copy a few more of those wish cards.
You must've seen it! This wishing method ... it's revolutionary!
Just think!==W== No writing out long requests, no reciting complicated prayers. You just hold a card, offer a memory, and make a wish.==W== Isn't that incredible?
But that Lucky Oasis you're really after? The cards haven't gotten you that,==W== have they?
In theory, it should work. There must be an error in the replication process.==W== I just have to keep trying...
And you're sure it'll work eventually?
Exactly!==W== You get it, right? Like writing out prayer scrolls—you never get it perfect the first time!
Just think! This could change how wishing works...==W== No,==W== it could change the whole world!
We could multiply the Artifacts we produce! Even people who could never afford them could get one, and the quality would be standardized.==W== Don't you see it's all for the greater good?
Sounds great. I just have one question.
Using these cards burns memories.==W== It can even cause serious mental damage.==W== That's a pretty steep price.
Who exactly do you expect to pay that kind of price?
Lost your nerve?==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, waste of time ==W==talking to trash like her.
Amber, take over. I'll get the car.==W== Keep an eye on Feagin. Don't let her pull anything.
You. Come with us. ==W==We're getting those contracts.
Y-Yes! But please, do you have to be so rough?!
Huh?==W== Did Loxy's door just open by itself?
No wonder it's a mess in here. What's all the racket?
Don't tell me you finally pushed your employees so hard they decided to riot.
You're finally awake!==W== Cut the crap and get rid of these people!
Let me go!==W== I paid a fortune for this big-shot mage. One move from her==W== and you're all finished!
Sorry, I'm off the clock.==W== Besides,==W== I'm tech support, not your hired muscle.
Hey, you. This ride yours? How'd you wish it up?
The bed and seats are way comfy. A lot better than the kennel she put me up in.
Heh ... glad you think so.==W== We did all the stitching ourselves.
I see.==W== So it's your handiwork. Interesting.
Hey! Don't ignore me!==W== I'll pay triple—==W==no, ==W==<size=48>ten times your rate!</size>
Not interested==W== in Dorra.==W== How about this... Get a few things for me instead?
Yes, yes, anything! I'll get you whatever you want,==W==<size=48> just get rid of them!</size>
Hey!==W== You really gonna side with this piece of garbage?
She may be garbage,==W== but she's my useful garbage.
Pity though,==W== you hesitated==W== to shoot.
Dammit! What is this magic? I can't draw power from my Soul Stone!
My ice arrows ... they won't form.
Hmph. Pathetic, relying on borrowed power.
So ... there are some decent Trekkers in the bunch after all.
But ...==W== this isn't standard clothing==W== I'm wearing.
Huh? Her body is turning into mist...?!
She snatched Feagin from the middle of our circle and vanished, like dark snow melting under spring sunlight.
The building's not that big! We search room by room, we'll find them!
That shadow is blocking our magic.
I heard Feagin. She contacted the Imperial Guard.
We're gonna be surrounded any minute. No time to hunt them down.
Let's get Loxy out of here first!
Hear about that? Creta's old miser put a bounty on five Trekkers—a million Dorra a head.
Feagin coughing up that much? These five must've really messed with Creta Trading. Almost makes you not wanna go after 'em.
Look at you, getting all sympathetic!==W== Bag this bounty, and we can kick back for months.
Yeah, you're right.==W== Roof's leaking, and gotta pay back that weapon loan...==W== If we run into those Trekkers, guess it's just their bad luck.
They gotta be using the Waterway to get around.==W== We'll set up an ambush right here.
Hey, ==W==get up!==W== This is no time to be resti==W==—
That fork back there leads to a busted bridge.==W== Doubt anyone goes that way.
Weird. Figured Creta's hired muscles would be waiting on the Waterway.
We made it all this way without seeing a single merc, let alone the Guard.
It's unsettling ...==W== but we need to get off this bridge==W== before Creta Trading figures out we stashed our ride up here.
In the darkness, only the cross star atop the Monolith shines.

strings.text: You wait for the lights at Creta Trading to go out before sneaking in. However, an act of kindness by Minova exposes herself to Feagin. Just as knights surround you, a dark figure emerges and strikes them down.
Whew, much better.==W== These are way more practical.
Half an hour later, Minova finishes her interview and slips back onto the Waterway Bridge.
Check this out. Floor plan of Creta Trading.
Your ride's parked right in this room.
Walk five minutes along the Waterway towards the Monolith. There's a big elevator nearby.
Once we grab your vehicle, we haul the elevator up onto the bridge.==W== Feagin's people won't see us then.
Don't even mention it.==W== Companies that bully others just because they have a Seal of Grace deserve to be wiped off the face of Nova.
Hang in there, Loxy!==W== We're busting you out soon!
Settled.==W== We'll infiltrate==W== once Creta Trading closes for the day.
Are they still in there? C'mon, I'm starving!
Relax, it's only seven.==W== Plenty of companies work later than this.
It's 9 PM. They gotta be done by now, right?
Ahaha...==W== Guess we could learn a thing or two from their ... work ethic.
I can barely ... ==W==keep my eyes open...

strings.text: You take down the gangs and mercenaries, but prove no match for the knights. As you flee, the white-haired mage fires a spell, and you dive to shield Minova with your own body.
This way! That gate won't hold 'em long.
How many people did Feagin hire? The area is crawling with mercs and gangsters all lookin' to cash in on us.
Checked my phone. Huge bounty. A million Dorra a head.
That much?==W== Why didn't she just use that money to pay us what she owed?
Paying us more would mean bowing down to us. She'd see it as losing.
Hiring mercs to hunt us down? That's protecting her pride. Something she has to do, in her mind.
What a messed-up way to think.
Too many enemies. If we just flee, the bounty will draw in even more hunters.
They aren't Creta soldiers, just mercs after cash. If the target fights back hard, they lose motivation fast.
You're planning to use the Ashwind Clan's usual playbook?
We're not runnin', and we're not hidin'...
We're gonna wait right here and take 'em head-on!
C'mon, get the door open! They are gonna bolt!
I was here first! Stay outta my way when we get inside.
Ha? Like anyone cares! It's first come, first served. You snooze, you lose.
Outta my way! I was first!
Hey, don't push! Floor's covered in ice!
You think a little trick like this is gonna stop me?!
Come on, Amber, time to roll! <size=60>♪</size>
Amber's black armbands whip out into the crowd, snatching dropped weapons and launching them into the air.
A gust of wind lifts Noya, letting her easily pluck the soaring weapons.
Don't sweat it! We still outnumber 'em! We can take 'em bare-handed!
Everybody charge! We'll split the prize!
Heh. You small fry think you can run your mouths here?
Our mistake! Please, let us go! We won't try anything again!
What, you wanna get acquainted with my bat too? Bunch of spineless cowards.
No, no! We were just ... just walking the dog!
Hey, you're not even a real dog!
Cap! Neuvira and I made it!
It was all Minova's plan.==W== Hitting them hard really did the trick. All of them took off with their tails between their legs.
I-I didn't really do much... This is just how the Ashwind Clan gets by.
What now? Beat them up too?
No. Look at their formation—Feagin must have paid a fortune for them.
Against well-paid Imperial Guards, there's only one thing to do.
Racing through the Ash District's narrow alleys, Minova leads the way, a teenage ==SEX9== with ==SEX14== at her side. Behind them, Vollara brings Noya, and Neuvira brings Iris.
The heavily armored Imperial Guards pursue at a relentless pace. From the rooftops, Amber's shots strike their silver plating, only to dissipate harmlessly.
What quarry you dredge these from?
Durable, certainly. But they can't get those Trekkers with that speed.
Hey, what can you do? The Imperial Guard always puts defense first. And that's what I'm paying for.
Master, could you lend a hand again? What you did earlier was remarkable!
Poof! Just like that, their magic was gone. Oh, the looks on their faces were so satisfying.
I refuse. Participating in such a crude "hunt" is beneath me.
No, no, you don't have to go that far! Just stop their magic like you did before. That's all the Imperial Guard needs to catch them.
If you don't, their fees will drain my savings, and I won't be able to get the materials you need for your research.
Very well. This is the last time.
Let's be clear. I will help you capture them. But leave me alone after this.
The raven perched on the girl's shoulder launches itself like an arrow, straight at Minova.
Minova's skateboard carves a perfect arc across the cobblestones, dodging a knight's lunging spear before she ducks into a narrow alley.
==PLAYER_NAME==, hang on tight! Making a sharp turn!
Whoa, how is this thing so fast? It's just a skateboard!
Feels like ... it's keeping pace with the Lucky Oasis.
It's magic-powered. I'll teach you sometime, if you want. We could even race on the Waterway.
I glance up at the Waterway arching high above the city. A strangely familiar raven plummets towards Minova's back.
Acting purely on instinct, I throw myself behind Minova. The black raven slams silently into my chest.
A sudden, powerful gust of wind tore through the air. In that moment, as I accepted my fate and stood ready to meet my end, it felt as though soft petals brushed against my skin.
In the flash of a clash, before me were gleaming tips of several dead spears, sharp and silent...
My apologies for the delay, my ==SEX11==.

strings.text: Your natural magic resistance nullifies the spell, but a worried Minova rushes you to a clinic anyway. To repay you for feeding her, Chitose pledges to become your blade.
Doc! Please, you have to help ==SEX4==!
Minova, hey, calm down. I feel okay, really.==W== Don't freak out.
<size=48>How can you be ==W==okay?! </size>==W==You got blasted by that dark magic!
<size=54>We can't just wait around until it gets too late!</size>
Quiet, this is ==W==a clinic.==W== Now,==W== which one of you is the patient?
It's ==SEX4==.==W== A crow ... pure magic ... it dove right into ==SEX3== chest! Near the heart!
Doctor, please! ==W==You gotta take a look at ==SEX4==!
A magical crow. ==W==How curious...==W== Anyone accompanying the patient needs to wait outside.
Hey, uh, Doctor?==W== Please, you gotta fix ==SEX4== up. ==W==<size=48>==SEX1=='s really important to the Ashwind Clan.</size>
Apply it on your shoulders and back. It'll heal by tomorrow.
Doc, how'd you even know I...?
It seemed a little awkward when you were opening the door.
Right, Minova took a few hits from those Imperial Knights carrying me here...
This doctor's good. She can see Minova's injuries through her cloak and clothes.
Normally, I wouldn't bother, but I'm just borrowing this space. ==W==Can't have you hurting outside and giving my friend's clinic a bad name.
Th-Thanks... ==W==You're really good. So you can help ==SEX4== then, right...?
That's why you must be quiet in a clinic.==W== Or would you prefer ==W==I stitch that mouth of yours shut?
... ==W==Right. I better not get on her bad side==W==.
Allow me to reintroduce myself. ==W==The name's Coronis.==W== I'm not really interested in curing people, though "doctor" is technically accurate.
Rare cases, however,==W== do interest me.==W== A patient like you,==W== for instance, afflicted by such a fascinating magic.
Is it too late to make a run for it?
Yeah, the black bird kinda vanished into my chest ...==W== but I feel nothing. So I should be ...==W==<size=48>okay?</size>
<size=48>That's CREEPY! </size>==W==Does a checkup really need to be this up close?
Odd.==W== Your eyes show no trace of...
Strange.==W== Even Loong's diagnostics aren't picking up any magic flow.==W== A magic this powerful should show something.
The magic you were hit with is genuinely fascinating.
We are so sorry. We've run a full diagnostic, and your constitution is ... well, it's highly unusual. Your body is immune to magic.
That's right. You might not have known, but your body can't use magic. Without magic, your soul can't resonate with the Water of Grace, so no Soul Stone can be made.
No resonance with the Water of Grace ... total magic immunity...==W== I didn't believe it was possible.
Am I just some lab rat to her?
Remarkable. Utterly remarkable. It's imperative that I become your personal physician.
Oh great, I just made her more interested?!
Didn't you just say you weren't interested in curing people?
Correct. ==W==Your unique physiology, however, piques my interest.
No external trauma, organs intact, vitals stable ...==W== yet completely null to magic. Can't even perceive it.
Such a remarkable subject... You must allow me to study this further.
Hey! You just said the quiet part out loud!
Haha... ==W==So, if nothing's actually wrong with me, guess I can head out?
No.==W== I recommend you be admitted. For observation. It would be convenient.
<size=48>Could you be any more obvious about what you're really after?!</size>
You've been up all night, and the streets are crawling with knights looking for you.==W== Get some rest before you head out.
==PLAYER_NAME==, just take it easy and rest up.==W== We'll head to the club==W== and see what's what.
I'm countin' on you.==W== By the way, where's Minova?
She's outside.==W== It's probably best to give her some space.
She keeps muttering about how she's useless 'cause she couldn't protect you ... stuff like that.
Yeah... Let's just let her be for now.
She probably doesn't want you seeing her all down like this.
Oh... I didn't realize she was taking the hit I took for her that hard.
Don't worry about it, ==PLAYER_NAME==. I'll figure out something to cheer her up, get her back on her feet.
Yeah! I'll remind her how you dodged that huge Stellaroid even with memory loss, and how you held your breath forever inside that wishing box!
A little magic like that? No way it could actually hurt you!
Is that really the normal way to comfort someone?
Although, given everything ...==W== maybe I'm not the best judge of "normal" right now.
I glance to the other side of the room. A girl with dark hair sleeps peacefully under neatly arranged blankets.
In the flash of a clash, before me were gleaming tips of several dead spears, sharp and silent...
My apologies for the delay, my ==SEX11==.
And then she just ... followed Noya and the others into the room.
And now she's just lying here as if it's perfectly normal.
She said she's your blade, so we let her tag along.==W== She's incredible at hacking.
And you’re all just fine with this?
I am Chitose, the blade forged only for you.
As your blade, my ==SEX11==,==W== I must naturally remain close at hand.
A blade does not sleep.==W== Furthermore,==W== I felt the summons of my ==SEX11=='s intense gaze.
My gaze definitely wasn't "intense"...==W== And==W== what's with the weird way you're speaking?
Thanks for helping earlier. ==W==Um, ==W==can I ask you something?
Why do you keep calling yourself a blade?
I do not simply call myself a blade.==W== I am a blade.
You use a blade in combat.==W== If you are a blade, how can a blade wield another?==W== That makes no sense...
That is only because my training remains incomplete.==W== I lack the strength to sever the spears unaided.
Small objects, I can slice through with ease.
Chitose picks up a fallen piece of paper and tosses it lightly into the air.
Using only the edge of her hand, she slices the paper in two.
Are you hiding a knife in your hand or something?
The old scrolls say:==W== "With the blade held within the heart, anything can be an edge."
With absolute focus, severing things with one's body is not difficult.==W== For now, however,==W== I can only sever softer objects.
Logically, that has to be magic, right?
But explaining it would be a pain. Better to keep my mouth shut.
Still, you look like a regular person to me.
My apologies. It is merely proof that my training is still lacking.
So, you mean ...==W== when you've trained enough, you'll turn into an actual sword?==W== Like the ones you carry?
Correct. I am currently on a journey of tempering.==W== One day, I shall become a complete blade.
So I beg of you, allow me to serve you in this form.
Sounds like calling herself a "blade" is her own thing.==W== Guess I'll just accept it for now.
Hmm,==W== whatever she wants to be called is fine.==W== Doesn't really change anything.
You really are quite the blade, then.==W== Very impressive,==W== taking on all those knights alone.
You ...==W== you believe that I am a blade?
Well, yeah. Isn't that what you've been saying?
N-No, I mean... It's just ...==W== you are the first person to accept it so readily.
You truly must be the one fate guided me to.
Right, probably best to just drop this whole blade thing...
Okay, but ...==W== why call me "my ==SEX11=="?==W== And why do you keep saying you're "my blade"?
Because you, my ==SEX11==,==W== are the only one I have met==W== who possesses the character to be my wielder.
Wait, have we met?==W== Could she mean...
I feel bad leaving her here, but let's just leave her some food and get to the orphanage first.
I'm not that hungry. She can have half of my share.
Say, haven't we met before? On the Waterway, maybe?
Oh yeah, I remember everything now.
You finally remember. I couldn't secure any commissions and was stranded on the streets.==W== I couldn't afford blade oil, so I rusted stiff.
It was you, my ==SEX11==, who allowed this blade to be drawn once more.
Yeah, introducing yourself like that probably makes getting work pretty tough.
Anyway,==W== I understand. What's your plan now?
To remain by your side, my ==SEX11==.
I shall not be a bother.==W== In truth... I have been following you ever since I was drawn.
So that feeling of being watched ...==W== that was her.
Well, well.==W== So this is where you've been hiding.
