Normally, I wouldn't bother, but I'm just borrowing this space. ==W==Can't have you hurting outside and giving my friend's clinic a bad name.
Th-Thanks... ==W==You're really good. So you can help ==SEX4== then, right...?
That's why you must be quiet in a clinic.==W== Or would you prefer ==W==I stitch that mouth of yours shut?
... ==W==Right. I better not get on her bad side==W==.
Allow me to reintroduce myself. ==W==The name's Coronis.==W== I'm not really interested in curing people, though "doctor" is technically accurate.
Rare cases, however,==W== do interest me.==W== A patient like you,==W== for instance, afflicted by such a fascinating magic.
Is it too late to make a run for it?
Yeah, the black bird kinda vanished into my chest ...==W== but I feel nothing. So I should be ...==W==<size=48>okay?</size>
<size=48>That's CREEPY! </size>==W==Does a checkup really need to be this up close?
Odd.==W== Your eyes show no trace of...
Strange.==W== Even Loong's diagnostics aren't picking up any magic flow.==W== A magic this powerful should show something.
The magic you were hit with is genuinely fascinating.
We are so sorry. We've run a full diagnostic, and your constitution is ... well, it's highly unusual. Your body is immune to magic.
That's right. You might not have known, but your body can't use magic. Without magic, your soul can't resonate with the Water of Grace, so no Soul Stone can be made.
No resonance with the Water of Grace ... total magic immunity...==W== I didn't believe it was possible.
Am I just some lab rat to her?
Remarkable. Utterly remarkable. It's imperative that I become your personal physician.
Oh great, I just made her more interested?!
Didn't you just say you weren't interested in curing people?
Correct. ==W==Your unique physiology, however, piques my interest.
No external trauma, organs intact, vitals stable ...==W== yet completely null to magic. Can't even perceive it.
Such a remarkable subject... You must allow me to study this further.
Hey! You just said the quiet part out loud!
Haha... ==W==So, if nothing's actually wrong with me, guess I can head out?
No.==W== I recommend you be admitted. For observation. It would be convenient.
<size=48>Could you be any more obvious about what you're really after?!</size>
You've been up all night, and the streets are crawling with knights looking for you.==W== Get some rest before you head out.
==PLAYER_NAME==, just take it easy and rest up.==W== We'll head to the club==W== and see what's what.
I'm countin' on you.==W== By the way, where's Minova?
She's outside.==W== It's probably best to give her some space.
She keeps muttering about how she's useless 'cause she couldn't protect you ... stuff like that.
Yeah... Let's just let her be for now.
She probably doesn't want you seeing her all down like this.
Oh... I didn't realize she was taking the hit I took for her that hard.
Don't worry about it, ==PLAYER_NAME==. I'll figure out something to cheer her up, get her back on her feet.
Yeah! I'll remind her how you dodged that huge Stellaroid even with memory loss, and how you held your breath forever inside that wishing box!
A little magic like that? No way it could actually hurt you!
Is that really the normal way to comfort someone?
Although, given everything ...==W== maybe I'm not the best judge of "normal" right now.
I glance to the other side of the room. A girl with dark hair sleeps peacefully under neatly arranged blankets.
In the flash of a clash, before me were gleaming tips of several dead spears, sharp and silent...
My apologies for the delay, my ==SEX11==.
And then she just ... followed Noya and the others into the room.
And now she's just lying here as if it's perfectly normal.
She said she's your blade, so we let her tag along.==W== She's incredible at hacking.
And you’re all just fine with this?
I am Chitose, the blade forged only for you.
As your blade, my ==SEX11==,==W== I must naturally remain close at hand.
A blade does not sleep.==W== Furthermore,==W== I felt the summons of my ==SEX11=='s intense gaze.
My gaze definitely wasn't "intense"...==W== And==W== what's with the weird way you're speaking?
Thanks for helping earlier. ==W==Um, ==W==can I ask you something?
Why do you keep calling yourself a blade?
I do not simply call myself a blade.==W== I am a blade.
You use a blade in combat.==W== If you are a blade, how can a blade wield another?==W== That makes no sense...
That is only because my training remains incomplete.==W== I lack the strength to sever the spears unaided.
Small objects, I can slice through with ease.
Chitose picks up a fallen piece of paper and tosses it lightly into the air.
Using only the edge of her hand, she slices the paper in two.
Are you hiding a knife in your hand or something?
The old scrolls say:==W== "With the blade held within the heart, anything can be an edge."
With absolute focus, severing things with one's body is not difficult.==W== For now, however,==W== I can only sever softer objects.
Logically, that has to be magic, right?
But explaining it would be a pain. Better to keep my mouth shut.
Still, you look like a regular person to me.
My apologies. It is merely proof that my training is still lacking.
So, you mean ...==W== when you've trained enough, you'll turn into an actual sword?==W== Like the ones you carry?
Correct. I am currently on a journey of tempering.==W== One day, I shall become a complete blade.
So I beg of you, allow me to serve you in this form.
Sounds like calling herself a "blade" is her own thing.==W== Guess I'll just accept it for now.
Hmm,==W== whatever she wants to be called is fine.==W== Doesn't really change anything.
You really are quite the blade, then.==W== Very impressive,==W== taking on all those knights alone.
You ...==W== you believe that I am a blade?
Well, yeah. Isn't that what you've been saying?
N-No, I mean... It's just ...==W== you are the first person to accept it so readily.
You truly must be the one fate guided me to.
Right, probably best to just drop this whole blade thing...
Okay, but ...==W== why call me "my ==SEX11=="?==W== And why do you keep saying you're "my blade"?
Because you, my ==SEX11==,==W== are the only one I have met==W== who possesses the character to be my wielder.
Wait, have we met?==W== Could she mean...
I feel bad leaving her here, but let's just leave her some food and get to the orphanage first.
I'm not that hungry. She can have half of my share.
Say, haven't we met before? On the Waterway, maybe?
Oh yeah, I remember everything now.
You finally remember. I couldn't secure any commissions and was stranded on the streets.==W== I couldn't afford blade oil, so I rusted stiff.
It was you, my ==SEX11==, who allowed this blade to be drawn once more.
Yeah, introducing yourself like that probably makes getting work pretty tough.
Anyway,==W== I understand. What's your plan now?
To remain by your side, my ==SEX11==.
I shall not be a bother.==W== In truth... I have been following you ever since I was drawn.
So that feeling of being watched ...==W== that was her.
Well, well.==W== So this is where you've been hiding.

strings.text: The mage and a squad of knights track you to the clinic. Your companions help you escape, but Creta Trading's immense resources still make them seem unbeatable.
Don't be so hostile. I mean you no harm.
You smashed our door in and you don't mean harm?
Apologies. My curiosity got the better of me.
Not many people can take a hit from my magic and stay on their feet.
Shame we won't get the chance to know each other better.
Excellent work, Master! You caught these strays in a flash. Worth every single credit.
The job is done.==W== Now, about the items you promised and my pass for the Monolith?
So impatient... ==W==Here you go. Your pass for Monolith #7.
Payment received. Farewell, little fledgling Trekkers. Perhaps we'll meet again.
My ==SEX11==, they have us outnumbered. Please, tell me where to direct my blade.
Trying to escape ... or having Chitose grab Feagin... Neither seems possible right now.
I hope the others are okay...
Gotta hand it to you, you're fast runners. I'm impressed.
If I hadn't known you wouldn't just ditch those kids of the Ashwind Clan, you might've actually slipped away.
What did you do to the children?!
Tell that ... bodyguard of yours? To drop her weapons. Then join Creta Trading, and maybe I'll tell you.
Still trying to sell me that nonsense?
You're just gonna have to trust me. Okay, I admit, the pay I offered before was a little low. My mistake, I was being casual with the numbers.
Let's just say I failed to appreciate your true value. Think about it: if I doubled your salary, a few fines here and there wouldn't even matter, right?
Right. And you'd just raise the fines to match.
But we can still work together, you know.
Just talk those kids into signing their ride over as company property, and I can even get you a seat in the Senate.
We can even renegotiate your contract. I'll put you on the same pay scale as that master just now. How about it? That's the best offer you're going to get.
You really expect me to buy that?
The moment things don't go your way, you'll just make up new rules, same as you always do.
This whole offer sounds like another scam to get your hands on our vehicle.
What are you talking about? You've seen the kind of tech Creta Trading has.
We don't need your little vehicle.
Seriously, I'm doing you a favor here!
Hang in there! Help's almost here!
Your best bet is to make her angry.
Make her angry, huh?==W== I think I know how.
Let me guess ... business at Creta Trading isn't exactly booming, right?
Oh yeah? If business was so great, how come I didn't see a single regular employee when I was at your HQ?
Everyone we've run into these past few days has been either a temp or some hired thug.
Th-That's just streamlining! What do you know about efficiency?!
Streamlining? Then why only ever let a handful of us into the Monolith to make wishes at a time?
Wouldn't hiring more Trekkers to wish for more Artifacts be the efficient thing to do?
Hmph... Amateurs should stay out of it. I have my own business strategies!
My guess? It's because there's a limit to how many people you can take into the Monolith each day.
Or maybe ... you can only make so many of those wish cards every day?
Could be both. Which means your only real shot at making money is duplicating rare Artifacts like the Lucky Oasis.
My ==SEX11==, your deductions are remarkably sound. I believe you have grasped the truth.
You... How did you find out about Creta Trading's trade secrets?!
I was just trying to push her buttons. Didn't think she'd actually spill the beans.
That's it, I'm done playing nice! B-Bring them out!
You have five seconds. Tell me where that vehicle is, or you'll never see your friend again.
==PLAYER_NAME==, don't listen to her! They didn't get the kids, only me!
Forget me! The Lucky Oasis is worth way more—ugh!
Is that ... the glint off a metal bat?
Was that a bag of flour falling?
Cough, cough... No, wait ... this is pollen.
Argh, can't scratch it with this helmet on!
Hey! Think I'd bail on the people who saved my hide?
Secret passage, this way. Put this on.
We went to the Ashwind Clan to get the kids... ==W==<size=54>Achoo</size>!
When we arrive, the place is already torn down.
Thank the stars the kids are safe.
We're sifting through the rubble for anything useful...
... When bam! We're surrounded by the Imperial Guard, gangsters, and mercs.
Minova diverted water from the bridge down here, and Iris froze a big patch of ice. That gave us a chance to escape with the kids... ==W==<size=54>Achoo</size>!
And then ... then I got caught. ==W==<size=54>Achoo</size>!
That white-haired girl searched me and found the map ... that's how she found the clinic.==W== I'm s-so sorry... ==W==<size=54>Achoo</size>!
Hey, no need to apologize, Iris. You did great!==W== Staying behind to cover the rest of us? That's some real hero stuff.
It's Ashwind's fault the clinic got trashed. Doctor, I'll figure out how to make it up to you.
It's fine. My friend relocates the clinic every three months anyway.
That hidden passage was built for quick getaways. You just helped speed up the moving process.
Appreciate it, Doctor, but ...==W== this is our mess. We'll build your friend a new clinic.
Ah... Achoo! Minova, how come you're okay?
I... I held my breath when I charged in.
But you were talking when you rescued me.
Uh ... well ... actually ... ==W==<size=45>ACHOO!</size>==W==<size=49> ACHOO!</size>==W==<size=53> ACHOO!</size>==W==<size=57> ACHOO!</size>
You really held that in for a while.
We moved the kids to the Waterway for now, but they can't stay there long.
Same old. Gangs, knights, mercs... Crawling with 'em.
Not my business, but ... take the kids and run. Get out of Emor.
I've heard bits about Creta Trading. Awful company. Their business has been shrinking for years. They only have pull left here in Emor.
So if we leave the city, they can't bother us anymore... Is that it?
Exactly. You're Trekkers, right? Shouldn't be too hard for you.
Here in Emor, no matter how crummy Creta Trading is, they still hold a Seal of Grace.
And as a company, they can keep borrowing Dorra, hiring muscle, even siccing Imperial Guards on you.
That's exactly why my friend has to move the clinic around so often.
Take it as a tip from a wandering doctor. Decide fast.
Everyone, check this out. It's a Creta Trading document Amber snapped.
Project Plan: Elimination of Ash Orphanage
According to this, that chess piece seal Feagin has belongs to the director of the Ash Orphanage. They left it with Creta Trading for safekeeping ages ago.
According to the contract back then, as kids from that orphanage, we have the right to get that seal back. And this contract? Seems it trumps any other rules.
To keep that Seal, Feagin has to silence us. Even if we run ...==W== she'll hunt us down forever.

strings.text: After Iris explains the full scope of company authority, you decide to use your Seal of Grace to establish your own company and fight back. Using her uniform disguise, Minova gets you and Iris into the Grace Imperium.
So that's what this is all about.
Feagin needs that seal to save her company. Even if we run, she won't stop coming after us.
But something's off. ==PLAYER_NAME==, didn't you just say Creta Trading was barely staying afloat?
So how'd Feagin hire all those goons?
I mean, with my memory gone, this is just a guess ...==W== but what if they borrowed the Dorra?
They're shaking us down for money, so it's not a stretch to think they're in debt to someone else, right?
Yes, provided you have acceptable collateral.
The rarer something is, the more it's worth. If Feagin put up that Seal of Grace as collateral, she could probably borrow as much Dorra as she wanted.
Ugh, that witch! Using the orphanage's property to get a loan, then squeezing the kids dry to pay it back...
In my distant homeland, companies are known to be quite benevolent.
The Loong warriors also say their companies are a source of support for everyone.
A company is just an organization. Whether it's good or evil depends on the people of which it is composed.
I heard something similar when I was looking into that thing for you, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Oh, right... The thing I asked you to do. Totally forgot about it.
Thanks for the reminder. Really appreciate it.
N-No, it's fine! So much has happened, after all. Actually, now's a good time to go over it.
I couldn't find anything specific about a company that was "once at war with the entire world," but I did find a list of all the rights this company has.
Well, companies are blessed by the God of Grace, after all.
All companies, big or small, have the exact same rights.
I highlighted the most important ones.
The right to exclusive business operations.
This isn't a company, it's practically a kingdom! They can wage war?
Uh... I think it's when a whole city's worth of people fight to the death against another group of a similar size ... right, Iris?
A little vague, but that's the gist of it.
The fine print under the "wage war" clause says...
I think I know how we can beat Creta Trading.
C'mon, rust buckets! Catch us if you can!
Hold the line! Secure the intersections! Box them in!
This is exactly when you gotta trust the Cap's plan!
Amber's arm wraps snap tight, pulling Vollara and Neuvira straight up to the roof.
Heh. Who knew rooftops were great for skating?
Fall back! Contact the outpost! We need knights skilled in Ventus or Aqua magic!
Whoa, nice moves! Guess I can't let you show me up!
Don't worry, ==PLAYER_NAME=='s got this. We just need to keep these knights busy.
Excuse me, miss. Standard procedure requires us to inspect your bags.
The Creta Trading reported missing property in the Ash District. We're conducting a search.
Just because some company lost something, you're locking down the whole district?
Look, these two cases are full of study materials. They have nothing to do with Creta Trading.
Captain, she won't consent to a search...
A student? Hah... You blind or something?
==W==Can't you see her Platinum Academy uniform?==W== Since when does a young lady from the Academy get mixed up with a crummy company like Creta Trading?
My sincere apologies for the trouble, miss. No inspection needed. Please, go on through.
What if, what? The students at Platinum Academy are all kids of Senate bigwigs.
If you find out anything, we'll get nothing but get caught in the middle of their power fight.
How many Dorra are you even making on this shift? It's not worth sticking your neck out for.
Wow, this Platinum Academy uniform's surprisingly effective.
Platinum Academy... What kind of fancy school is that, anyway?
Welcome! Your super-cute intern is ready to help! <size=60>♪</size>
I'm here for the reactivation service. The materials are in this case.
We made it... When the Imperial Guard stopped us, I seriously thought we were goners.
Iris and I climb out of the suitcases.
See? Told you it'd be fine.
Oh my. It's quite unusual to meet like this.
I've heard a little about your trouble with Creta Trading. You must have been through quite a bit.
We're short on time, so let's get straight to it.
I'm here to reactivate the company connected to this seal.
Hehe...==W== So you've made your decision. I'll get the paperwork started.
But first, I have a question.
We couldn't find anything about this company, not even in the files you gave us. Are you sure the company tied to this seal actually exists?
That's not surprising. The vault holding your device and seal... It probably hasn't been opened in more than ten of my lifetimes all put together!
Things that old ... you'd probably only find records in the Great Library of the Grace Imperium.
But don't you worry. Once you reactivate it, you'll naturally learn all about this company.
I see.==W== How do I reactivate it?
Each company—or rather, each Seal of Grace—contains a unique franchise patent.
As the company's CEO, you simply need to conduct one transaction within its patented domain.
Make a deal, and the company will naturally reactivate.
Hmm... Got it.==W== So what is this seal's patented domain?
Leave that to adorable me! <size=60>♪</size> Just place the Seal on that stone slab, would you?
You do as she says. The Seal slowly lifts into the air, emitting a soft glow.
A line of ancient text appears on the slab.
Thank you for waiting. Your company's patented domain is—

A student? Hah... You blind or something?
==W==Can't you see her Platinum Academy uniform?==W== Since when does a young lady from the Academy get mixed up with a crummy company like Creta Trading?
My sincere apologies for the trouble, miss. No inspection needed. Please, go on through.
What if, what? The students at Platinum Academy are all kids of Senate bigwigs.
If you find out anything, we'll get nothing but get caught in the middle of their power fight.
How many Dorra are you even making on this shift? It's not worth sticking your neck out for.
Wow, this Platinum Academy uniform's surprisingly effective.
Platinum Academy... What kind of fancy school is that, anyway?
Welcome! Your super-cute intern is ready to help! <size=60>♪</size>
I'm here for the reactivation service. The materials are in this case.
We made it... When the Imperial Guard stopped us, I seriously thought we were goners.
Iris and I climb out of the suitcases.
See? Told you it'd be fine.
Oh my. It's quite unusual to meet like this.
I've heard a little about your trouble with Creta Trading. You must have been through quite a bit.
We're short on time, so let's get straight to it.
I'm here to reactivate the company connected to this seal.
Hehe...==W== So you've made your decision. I'll get the paperwork started.
But first, I have a question.
We couldn't find anything about this company, not even in the files you gave us. Are you sure the company tied to this seal actually exists?
That's not surprising. The vault holding your device and seal... It probably hasn't been opened in more than ten of my lifetimes all put together!
Things that old ... you'd probably only find records in the Great Library of the Grace Imperium.
But don't you worry. Once you reactivate it, you'll naturally learn all about this company.
I see.==W== How do I reactivate it?
Each company—or rather, each Seal of Grace—contains a unique franchise patent.
As the company's CEO, you simply need to conduct one transaction within its patented domain.
Make a deal, and the company will naturally reactivate.
Hmm... Got it.==W== So what is this seal's patented domain?
Leave that to adorable me! <size=60>♪</size> Just place the Seal on that stone slab, would you?
You do as she says. The Seal slowly lifts into the air, emitting a soft glow.
A line of ancient text appears on the slab.
Thank you for waiting. Your company's patented domain is—

strings.text: Activating the company requires the trading of a soul. Minova offers her own without hesitation, determined to break free from her cage and fly, no matter the cost.
Thank you for waiting. Your company's patented domain is—
Sorry,==W== I must've misheard.==W== And my memory's gone,==W== so I need to double-check.
Is "soul" some kind of food?==W== Or a type of gem?==W== Is that what this Seal of Grace==W== lets me trade?
My, you have a curious sense of humor!==W== A soul is a soul. Something everyone has.
Though,==W== I suppose to some,==W== they might seem like food or gems.
But how do you even trade something intangible like that?
Since your Seal of Grace holds this particular patent,==W== the God of Grace will provide the answer.
As if reading my mind, fresh script appeared on the stone slab.
Bear this Seal,==W== and let thy life serve as testament.==W== Through it, wishes forge contracts,==W== binding souls to thy own venture.
Okay, so, the Tyrant puts their own life on the line==W== and makes a "Tyrant Accord" with clients to grant their wishes...
When the wish comes true,==W== the Tyrant gets the client's soul.
What a wicked transaction.==W== Using life as collateral and souls as commodities.
Risk your life to grant someone a wish,==W== then take their soul.
Basically gambling with life.==W== Brutal, yeah, but kind of fair.
This world's really something else. You can trade anything.
But wait...==W== This only explains how to get souls. Nothing about selling them.==W== Isn't that just a loss?
So please, my Tyrant, don't become a star once more.
That memory, or maybe it was a dream?==W== That person called me...
Ah,==W== you've misread it.==W== It's Boss.
Your company is called: Boss Accord Staffing Co.
Boss is your title as the seal holder.==W== Think of it like CEO for other companies.
The way you pronounced it, Tyrant...==W== That's an ancient form. It hasn't been used in a very, very long time.
But...==W== Why not use the old name?==W== You can go right ahead and call the company Tyrant Accord! <size=52>♪</size>
So...==W== The Tyrant Accord Staffing Co., it is.
I get the business model...==W== But trading souls? Who'd fall for something that sounds so much like a scam?
So my plan to fight a company with another is out.==W== It seems ...==W== the only other option is...
Bastelina, change of plans.==W== I'm not reactivating the company. I want to sell this Seal of Grace instead.==W== Could you help me find a buyer?
The buyer has to protect the Ashwind Clan,==W== and guarantee the New Star Guild gets out safely—
==PLAYER_NAME==, what happened to the plan you told us about back on the Waterway?
That plan needs the company==W== to be active now.
And ... that's the real problem.==W== We're talking about soul trading. Who's gonna fall for that?
What? This isn't a joke, Minova.
We have no idea what happens after making a deal like that. It's way too risky.
To hell with the risk! I don't give a damn if I lose my soul,==W== so long as I can make those Creta Trading bastards bleed!
Isn't there another option?==W== If we sell the seal, we can still buy some time. We can figure out the rest later.
==PLAYER_NAME==, look, I get it. You're trying to find the safest way out==W== for all of us.
Even if it means taking the hit yourself.
But by now,==W== we both know that the gap between us and the company is just too big.
Try to reason? Feagin'll just pull some new rule out of her backside.==W== Throw punches? Feagin just hires more thugs. We'll be overrun.
We call ourselves Ashwind...==W== We wanna be free, soar high like the wind.
But==W== in reality...==W== I can't even protect my own crew.
So that's still weighing on her...
Hey, uh, Doctor?==W== Please, you gotta fix ==SEX4== up. ==W==<size=48>==SEX1=='s really important to the Ashwind Clan.</size>
She keeps muttering about how she's useless 'cause she couldn't protect you ... stuff like that.
Yeah... Let's just let her be for now.
Some choices... You can only make them after you realize how weak you really are.==W== Don't you think?
No matter what... I just... I need...
You need the strength to protect the people you care about.
Because that's what I want too.
Same thing when we made a break for it...
Minova, your fighting skills were way more important than my brain in that moment.==W== That's why I jumped in front of that spell.
Even if I couldn't move,==W== I could still think, right?
It wasn't just about protecting you
Since we're on the same page, stop beating yourself up over this.
Is this how a real gang leader is supposed to act?
Heh. Guess you really are more cut out to be a cap than me.
Your nerve, your smarts... How you just get people... Yeah, I got nothin' on you.
If I could, I'd make you the leader of Ashwind.
But I know you've got your own path to take. Bigger things are waiting for you down the road.
So instead ...==W== you can have my soul.
I need you to destroy Creta Trading.
And when that wish comes true...
Honored Boss, your name's gonna be known all across Nova!
From Cangwu==W== way out east==W== to Matsukawa==W== in the west,==W== everyone's gonna know who you are!
Bastelina, I need to exercise a company right
That's quick!==W== And what right would that be?
I'm declaring war on Creta Trading.

strings.text: You are the CEO of the Boss Accord Staffing Co. The moment your company is activated, news of it flashes across the world. You immediately declare a "company war" on Creta Trading.
Sorry! Didn't mean to spook you.
I'd love to properly apologize,==W== but something huge just went down in Emor. I gotta fly over there now.
I owe ya one! I'll definitely catch your next show, promise.
Look! There's some huge company news!
News? Just focus on work, Willow. Companies aren't what they used to be. No headline is going to get us a sponsor now.
I should be asking you that. This is my office, not your personal crash pad!==W== Still, your timing's perfect. Urgent company intel. Get this to your master, top priority.
Ugh, I was having such a great nap. Fine, on my way.
An old company just came off ice. Weird name... Boss Accord Staffing Co.?
Heehee, how delightful! It seems we have a new "piggy bank." Hehehe...<size=60>♪</size>
Get me everything on this company. Freshly reactivated... They'll definitely need our financial support.
We're ready to supply housekeeping staff to the newly reactivated company.
A company just reactivated is declaring war on Creta Trading?==W== Interesting...
This marks the first company war in a century. Shall we dispatch observers?
There's no time, nor can we afford such distractions. Our own research is at a critical juncture.
Once our plan succeeds, United Harvest will be untouchable.
Ahahaha, fantastic! Newly reactivated and already starting a war... Guess the legends weren't wrong.
Please, God of Grace, don't let the world descend into chaos. Please, keep the people safe...
What good are prayers? Let's use our heads. Isn't the Tetrad Aspects here precisely to handle situations like this?
The South should have some input... Tch. Absent again. How irresponsible. Utterly irresponsible.
My apologies. Lady Angie had urgent matters to attend to. You were all notified in advance.
I know. Never mind that. Albedo. Was it your new intern who handled the reactivation?
You're not ... pulling something again, are you?
It is all according to the God of Grace's will. That is all I'm permitted to say.
Rest assured, everyone. I will see to the Boss Accord personally.
Wait, what? The Creta Trading's target reactivated a whole company?
Yes, sir. And that company has declared a war against Creta Trading...
What are we standing around for? Pull our units back now!
The Imperial Guard does not get involved in company wars.
Alright, savages! You're surrounded. Give it up!
I had to hock the HQ hall and my Seal of Grace just to corner you rats!
Every one of you is gonna work for me for free for the next fifty years!
Uh oh... This is really not good.
Wonder if ==PLAYER_NAME== managed to pull it off on their end.
Even if ==PLAYER_NAME== couldn't handle it, cap sure can.
So, now what? We've bought enough time. Should we just surrender for now?
No.==W== As my ==SEX11=='s blade, I fight until I break or receive orders.
Hey! Where do you think you're going?! Our deal was to catch them!
This is a serious breach of contract! I'll sue you for it!
Apologies, Chief Feagin. A company has declared war against yours.
The Imperial Guard swore off company wars a century ago. We ask for your understanding.
We sincerely regret breaking our deal. The Imperial Guard Security Solutions Company will compensate you for any penalties incurred.
Dammit! Who is pulling this crap now?
主角带着密涅瓦和鸢尾登场
That would be us. The Boss Accord Staffing Co.
Ha...? What kind of sick joke is this? There's no way you savages could own a Seal of Grace...
Dunno, but the Guard's leaving. Maybe we should bail too?
No way! Those Trekkers are spent! With the knights gone, that bounty's all ours, yeah?
Don't be stupid. A company war is a fight to the death between two companies. It only ends when one side surrenders and meets all the other's demands.
Anyone involved in a company war loses all legal protection.
Wait ... you mean ... we could actually get killed?
That's right. And for the record, nobody gets punished for killing someone in a fight like this. Anything goes.
Yikes! Then what are we waiting for?! Let's bounce!
Don't go! I'll pay you triple! No, five times the rate!
What good's money if you're dead?!
I thought Creta Trading would have at least some loyal employees.
This is what happens when you only hire sellswords.
I may be a blade, but to strike down a defenseless foe is beneath me.
D-Damn you. How dare you all just stand there and gloat...!
Surrender, Feagin. Disband your corrupt Creta Trading, explain what happened at the orphanage, and apologize to everyone you've deceived.
Apologize? Are you kidding me? Who'd agree to that?!==W== The Creta Trading, the orphanage ... fine, whatever. But an apology? That's never gonna happen.
... It's their own fault==W== for being so stupid!==W== When I was the one getting scammed, those jerks just laughed in my face. Nobody ever said sorry to me.
I don't know what you've been through, but that's no excuse to hurt other people.
Then what do you want from me?! It's not fair! Why am I always the one getting screwed over?!
Some, having been wronged before, choose to protect others from suffering the same fate instead.
You're just looking for excuses to make yourself feel better about the terrible things you've done.
Well, well. I didn't expect we'd be running into each other again so soon, my dear new executive.
Or perhaps I should call you Boss now?
I don't know why you're helping her,==W== but are you going to keep enabling this?
What can I say? I owe a debt.
Let's head to the Monolith, Chief Feagin.
I'll show you the value of your investment in me.
Master... This is that new tech you mentioned?
I've connected one hundred wishing boxes with magic. We can call forth an Artifact of any size.
Put simply, any part that exceeds a single box's limit is broken down into a hundred components. We just draw them out and reassemble them.
I had a promise to keep. When I first came to Emor, you were the only one who believed in my magic enough to invest in it.
Hah! I always trust my eye for talent!
Master, conjure an Artifact for me! Something powerful enough to win this war!
You're now the Deputy Executive... No, you're the Co-Executive of Creta Trading!
I'm afraid ... that is not possible.
You see, this particular magic alters the fundamental rules of wishing.
To put it bluntly, these boxes don't require human memories. They run on ... boiling, seething hatred.
The greater the hatred channeled, the larger the Artifact that can be manifested. But I have no one to hate.
Heheh...==W== Ahahaha! Hatred? I have plenty of that.
The hatred I feel for those Trekkers, for all of Emor is practically boiling over!
God of Grace, hear my hatred!
Grant me an ==W==<size=55>Artifact to crush those savages</size>!

strings.text: Refusing defeat, Feagin summons a colossal Stellaroid, playing right into the white-haired mage's scheme. To thwart the plot, Chitose moves to intercept the mage.
Damn it! More Stellaroids just keep pouring out! Are these things leaking from the Monolith?
Experienced Trekkers call this a Monolith Meltdown.
When too many Stellaroids build up inside a Monolith, they spill out.
That usually happens with Monoliths out in the Wilds. No one climbs 'em, so no one clears 'em out. But we're in the middle of a city!
The Stellaroids are going to reach the streets!
The Ash District is right below! We cannot let them get through!
That white-haired mage mentioned heading to the Monolith when she rescued Feagin.
Could it be that they caused this?
These Stellaroids are born of Feagin's hatred.==W== No... Hatred alone isn't enough. They spring from a place far deeper, and far darker...
She's dead-set on getting revenge. On you. On everyone.
But she's the one who's wrong!
Yeah, the people in the Ash District didn't do anything to her!
Oh, how naive. You call this a "war," yet you expect everyone to play by the rules?
You have a point,==W== I'll grant you that. But war has never been played by anyone's rules.
We'll take Feagin down for good and end this war fast.
She's the one we're after. You don't have to defend her, much less follow her.
One such as I, burdened with a sacred mission, would never stoop to join a pathetic group like Creta Trading.
Feagin and I were merely using each other for mutual benefit.
Lux Stealer... You're with Nocturn Eterna?!
My, someone's been hitting the books!
Yup, me and my crew aim to destroy every single Monolith.
Still ... is this really the time for a chat?
The Stellaroid. Up in the sky. It's huge.
Huh? Don't tell me it's that giant Stellaroid we couldn't beat in the desert!
Hahaha! So you're already acquainted. Excellent.
In that case, you should thank Feagin. Consider this a parting gift.
Wait, that monster is charging toward the Ash District!
Hey, what're you playing at?! Your target is supposed to be us! Make it turn back, now!
Hmph. I'm afraid I can't grant that request.
Take the seal, consider yourselves winners. Your little war is over.
As for these Stellaroids... I'll use them as I see fit. It's just... Feagin wished them into existence with so much hatred. They need to run wild a bit before I can get them under control.
The Imperial Guard will protect you.
Minova! We have to stop that Stellaroid!
You think I'd let her get away with this? I swear on the Ashwind Clan, nobody trashes my turf!
You have the seal. You've won. What are you still fighting for?
Why bother? Grace Imperium or the Imperial Guard, someone would deal with it.
Just do what you always do in the Monoliths: wish it away and call it a day.
People give their wishes over to that star.
Because, then, when their wishes don't come true...
"Well, I did the best I could, but my lucky star didn't shine on me."
Simply wishing won't make it happen.
Trekkers face the dangerous Wilds, defeat fierce beasts and Stellaroids, just to reach a Wishing Box.
That's a wish granted through one's own choices and effort.
Big talk. You have no way of defeating a Stellaroid like that.
There's an array on its head channeling Terra magic. If we destroy that array, the Stellaroid won't be able to repair itself with surrounding materials. It might even collapse under its own weight.
Humph. Iris has been pulling all-nighters, digging through records ever since we left that desert Monolith. She finally found something last night.
Are... Are you serious? Researching a Stellaroid you might only encounter once in a lifetime?
Hey, we're professionals! You never know what you'll run into in Monoliths. Gotta study every Stellaroid you find.
Oh! Minova, I've got it! A brilliant idea to take that big guy down!
That thing is important to my plans! You can't destroy it!
If I don't give you a chance to cast a spell, there's no need for me to defend.
I shall hold the enemy at bay—and lend you my aid.
Curse you… How dare you shatter my flawless plan!
But your sword won't always be that fast.
Stripped of magic, you're nothing more than a mere mortal.
To face me and these Stellaroids alone and without magic... Truly, you Trekkers border on insanity.
That's not for me to consider. As the blade of my ==SEX11==, I will strike down all who dare block ==SEX3== path.
Why must you be so needlessly stubborn?
Fine. If you're itching for a fight, I'll give you one.
So that you can learn how powerless you are against me!
I sense ... magic still ongoing somewhere... Is it her right hand? No. The left hand.
It's the shadows she controls. Which means ... I should target her body.
Novian blademaster, this is your final warning. If you do not desist, my next blow shall take your head.
In that case... I shall cut your scheme down and dash it aside. Prepare yourself.
How can she be this fast … without magic?!
Never thought I'd find a Novian warrior worthy of respect.
I am no warrior, merely a blade that battles for my ==SEX11==.
Don't think next time will be so easy.
Try as you might, the end will be the same.
From a young age, I have trained in the art of battojutsu—a technique that relies not on magic. It was proved useful. However, my reliance on my Master suggests that I still require more diligence.
Hm? It seems there are still stragglers.
I have struck the magic circle!
Alright! Now back to the plan—to the Waterway!
Leave the diversion to me. I'll kick up serious mayhem!
Boss, you give the commands from here on!
Iris, hang a right at the next intersection. Chitose will handle any Stellaroids blocking your path.
Noya, back Loxy up another 100 meters! We need a longer runway!
Okay, the lure is working. That giant Stellaroid will reach the Waterway any second now.
Since I'm part of this brilliant plan, I can list my contributions on my internship report, right?
She has zero sense of danger, showing up here at a time like this.
Still, that telescopic Artifact she brought saved our hides.
Looking through the telescopic Artifact, I can see Minova, Iris, and Amber in the distance. They've lured the huge Stellaroid towards a secluded, broken bridge—the perfect launchpad.
That's the stage for today's finale.
This crazy plan of theirs has to work.

param: Refusing defeat, Feagin summons a colossal Stellaroid, playing right into the white-haired mage's scheme. To thwart the plot, Chitose moves to intercept the mage.
Damn it! More Stellaroids just keep pouring out! Are these things leaking from the Monolith?
Experienced Trekkers call this a Monolith Meltdown.
When too many Stellaroids build up inside a Monolith, they spill out.
That usually happens with Monoliths out in the Wilds. No one climbs 'em, so no one clears 'em out. But we're in the middle of a city!
The Stellaroids are going to reach the streets!
The Ash District is right below! We cannot let them get through!
That white-haired mage mentioned heading to the Monolith when she rescued Feagin.
Could it be that they caused this?
These Stellaroids are born of Feagin's hatred.==W== No... Hatred alone isn't enough. They spring from a place far deeper, and far darker...
She's dead-set on getting revenge. On you. On everyone.
But she's the one who's wrong!
Yeah, the people in the Ash District didn't do anything to her!
Oh, how naive. You call this a "war," yet you expect everyone to play by the rules?
You have a point,==W== I'll grant you that. But war has never been played by anyone's rules.
We'll take Feagin down for good and end this war fast.
She's the one we're after. You don't have to defend her, much less follow her.
One such as I, burdened with a sacred mission, would never stoop to join a pathetic group like Creta Trading.
Feagin and I were merely using each other for mutual benefit.
Lux Stealer... You're with Nocturn Eterna?!
My, someone's been hitting the books!
Yup, me and my crew aim to destroy every single Monolith.
Still ... is this really the time for a chat?
The Stellaroid. Up in the sky. It's huge.
Huh? Don't tell me it's that giant Stellaroid we couldn't beat in the desert!
Hahaha! So you're already acquainted. Excellent.
In that case, you should thank Feagin. Consider this a parting gift.
Wait, that monster is charging toward the Ash District!
Hey, what're you playing at?! Your target is supposed to be us! Make it turn back, now!
Hmph. I'm afraid I can't grant that request.
Take the seal, consider yourselves winners. Your little war is over.

strings.text: After defeating the colossal Stellaroid, you are hailed as saviors. Bidding farewell to the Ashwind Clan, you set off on a new journey, taking another step into the vast unknown.
Still no leads on the Ash Orphanage, or where Aunt Allie went?
I've been digging into Creta Trading. Five years ago, when your father was at the helm, Creta Trading was doing just fine, right?
But then, a huge chunk of Creta Trading's savings vanished. Most of its assets were sold off or mortgaged.
By the time you took the reins last year, the outfit was already in deep trouble.
There's gotta be more to that story, right? If you know anything, please tell me.
Um... I get that you need answers, but it's probably best to let it go.
She's been completely unresponsive since we pulled her from the Monolith five days ago. Barely able to eat or drink, let alone speak.
The doctor figures it's from wishing for a Stellaroid far beyond her limits. Said she might recover over decades, or maybe not at all.
About the only thing she's said these past days is...
Yeah. She keeps repeating the name of that city famous for its grain.
No problem at all! Your guild stopped that Monolith Meltdown. The Imperial Guard's got your back.
My name is Tilia, a new squire in the Imperial Guard.
Regarding Creta Trading ... the Imperial Guard gave you all a lot of trouble. I know we were just following orders, but I still think we owe you an apology.
Don't worry about it. The Imperial Guard is a security company. You were just doing your job.
Thank you for understanding!==W== And it wasn't just for Dorra!==W== This was a chance for all of us, myself included, to recommit ourselves to the heart of justice and the Knight's Code!
Sounds to me like those things are already in your heart.
That day when the giant Stellaroid trashed the Ash District, I spotted a young knight shielding some kids.
You were truly brave back there. Like a knight straight out of a legend.
Well, take care. I likely won't be back for a while. If we cross paths again, I might just have to ask you... the Imperial Guard for help.
Can't wait to see you again.
Sorry for the wait! Your one-and-only Bastelina has your Soul Stones all charged up and ready to rock! <size=60>♪</size>
Boss. I'm impressed. Even the Grace Imperium gives you special treatment. Fifty percent off our recharge... Heh... Who on earth are you? You're a truly curious case.
If the concept of a "soul" wasn't dubious, I'd be signing up with your crew right now==W== to dissect—==W==no, observe—a Boss like you.
Did she just say "dissect"?==W== She absolutely said "dissect"!
Blades do not possess souls. Therefore, I cannot join your company through such means.
Don't worry about it. Joining doesn't require a soul transaction. A normal contract works just fine.
In my book, you're already on the team.
My ==SEX11==...==W== Then I shall heed your command.==W== This means I may resume my training journey.
Just come back soon. We're pretty short-handed around here.
As you command. I shall complete my training swiftly, become the sharpest blade in all of Nova, and return to serve under your banner.
This is my sageo.==W== It symbolizes the bond between a blade and its wielder.
A symbol of our bond...==W== Thank you. I'll treasure it.
Well, I'll be on my way.==W== Next time we meet, I'll bring more Soul Stones for you to replenish for me.
Hmm, a brilliant doctor and a skilled swordmaster... Are you letting them go just like that?
Especially the one who calls herself your "blade." Forgive my bluntness, but she was fully prepared to lay down her life for you.
Like I said, I don't need anyone's soul or their life.
I brought this company back to take down Creta Trading and help my friends.==W== To be honest, I haven't even decided if I'll keep it running after that.
A very prudent call. You're sounding more and more like the bigwigs I've met.
Don't give me too much credit. I'm not that impressive.
Coronis does her own thing, she's always moving. And Chitose... Our meeting was just a happy accident on her training journey.
If fate wills it, our paths are bound to cross again.
No, just meeting again is meaningless. Before that happens, I need to start looking the part of a CEO.
Tehe, as your fan, I'll be rooting for you, Boss! Oh, right! Let me give you a little token of my appreciation.
A token? What did you have in mind?
During the investigation, you gave such a heroic account of my performance!
And because of that, I got promoted from intern to a full-time employee! All thanks to you, I've taken my first step toward becoming an adorable member of society!
Congratulations.==W== Still ... you mentioned a gift, and now you've got me curious.
Something like ... free Grace infusions for life?
Oh, my~==W== Even an adorable, full-time employee like me can't quite pull that off! <size=60>♪</size>
It's actually information. There's an info broker in Philae named Serena. She might know something about what you're after.
Think she'd have info on the orphanage? Or the Boss Accord?
Possibly. If Serena doesn't know, it's unlikely anyone does.==W== She might even have intel on that Nocturn Eterna officer you encountered.
Ugh, I really don't want anything more to do with an outfit that wrecks Monoliths.
Boss,==W== sometimes it doesn't matter if you want anything to do with them.==W== It's about who's got you in their sights.
Ugh, my body feels heavy... Completely drained.
Want a sip? It'll perk you right up!
Isn't this just a Monolith drink? All it's got is sugar, right?==W== Ah, whatever. Gimme.
Huh... Wow, I actually feel better. Thanks.
Sweet drinks lift your spirits. A lighter spirit makes for a lighter body.
So that's the trick, huh...?==W== Maybe I should keep these on hand. That woman's strike burned through two years of my magic reserves.
Sorry... The next phase is all on you for now, Cosette.
The Boss, and the Boss Accord Staffing Co.
Exactly. Tail ==SEX4==. I have a feeling ==SEX== is going to complicate our plans.
That's what we're about to find out.
We need a complete picture of ==SEX3== movements.==W== If it comes to it, you have my approval to use any means necessary.==W== Even... abduction.
Wow... You fixed all the damage to the Lucky Oasis!
Hmph. Like Noya said, a car's basically just a big skateboard. Both have four wheels and a platform.
When you said, "If you can build a board, you can fix a car," I was like, are you for real?
Noya takes one look at a part and just knows exactly where it fits.
That's a talent you gotta admire!
Ehehe~ See? My gut is never wrong!
Hmm, wishing for Artifact parts in the Monolith, then assembling them... That could be a solid way to make some cash.
Yep. I talked it over with Vollara, Neuvira, and the rest of the Ashwind kids.
As soon as the clan's back on its feet, we're heading into the Monolith.
One special Artifact a month should cover our expenses!
I've taken notes on all the tips for traveling in the Wilds. I think I can get the hang of it.
So, sorry, Boss. For now, we gotta handle clan business.
If that's the case ... you'll be in charge of holding down the fort for the Ashwind Clan.
This is my first royal stronghold, after all.
Hell yeah! It's a deal, then. We'll run this city 'til you get back, Boss! Leave it to us!
Hey... Isn't this the part where you start making fun of me?
Haha! Nah, it was cool and totally fit your whole vibe.
The Ashwind kids are all spreading the legend—how you played chess up on the Waterway, cool as a cucumber while giving orders, and then BAM—took down that insane Stellaroid!
Seriously? Where do these stories come from? When Noya sent the RV flying, my heart nearly jumped out of my chest!
Huh, you were that worried? I just knew it would work!
"If we charge with Loxy, we'll definitely win!"==W== I'm so glad I had that spark of inspiration!==W== And see? It totally worked!
That's gonna be the New Star Guild's super-secret ultimate move!
Better keep an unpredictable move like that under wraps.
Since we won and all, don't cha think we deserve a little reward?
That's a bit out of nowhere.==W== I'm not against it, but it has to be something I can actually give you.
You want to sign that thing? But why?
We're a Guild! Guilds gotta stick together! Share the good times, share the risks!
Iris told us. We were all with you, but you only signed with Minova.
Shh! Not so loud! You don't have to broadcast it! The atmosphere was so tense, I couldn't get a word in!
Sorry... I got way too anxious.
Honestly, I'm not that into this whole soul-trading thing...==W== Do you even have a wish you're dying to make right now?
In that case, I'd say don't sign. Better to avoid sketchy pacts you don't understand.
I see... Well, can we put a pin in it for now?
Can't let someone else beat us to it again.
Uh...hey, Minova...==W==you feeling anything different lately?
Creta Trading is gone. My wish came true. So, guess my soul belongs to you now.
But I don't feel any different.==W== If anything, I'm more energized than ever.==W== How 'bout you, Boss?
I'm pretty much the same as always.
Guess you can't really hand over your soul, huh?
Which means... Did I just get the short end of the stick on this deal?
But if you mean where I feel different, it's here.
From now on, no matter what hardship I face... I won't feel panic or fear in here anymore.
Because I know my soul's safe with you.
That's why I can walk my own path without hesitation. I can only think this way thanks to you.
No surprise too since it took you seven days to come up with that love confession.
Hey, no fair! We can't let you keep ==SEX4== all to yourself!
If there are no side effects,==W== then there's no reason to say no, is there?
And just like that, with Noya, Iris, and Amber practically begging, we signed that utterly useless "Boss Accord."
The Lucky Oasis roars to life again.
Following clues about the missing orphanage, we set off towards Philae.
Meanwhile, at the apex of Emor's Waterway...
A girl in white peers through a telescopic Artifact, phone in her other hand, reporting in.
Yes, the Boss and ==SEX3== crew just left Emor City.
As you wished, Creta Trading's old baggage is finally cleared up.
The cleanup was perfect, too. That Stellaroid smashed a few warehouses—perfect excuse to write off years of missing Artifacts.
... Mhm, I understand.==W== So now, all that's left is to keep an eye on "that" awakening, right?
Welcome back to the Well of Worlds Tyrant Development System, ==SEX12== Tyrant.
I am Vita, your dedicated, 24/7 personal secretary. Your first mission is—

But I don't feel any different.==W== If anything, I'm more energized than ever.==W== How 'bout you, Boss?
I'm pretty much the same as always.
Guess you can't really hand over your soul, huh?
Which means... Did I just get the short end of the stick on this deal?
But if you mean where I feel different, it's here.
From now on, no matter what hardship I face... I won't feel panic or fear in here anymore.
Because I know my soul's safe with you.
That's why I can walk my own path without hesitation. I can only think this way thanks to you.
No surprise too since it took you seven days to come up with that love confession.
Hey, no fair! We can't let you keep ==SEX4== all to yourself!
If there are no side effects,==W== then there's no reason to say no, is there?
And just like that, with Noya, Iris, and Amber practically begging, we signed that utterly useless "Boss Accord."
The Lucky Oasis roars to life again.
Following clues about the missing orphanage, we set off towards Philae.
Meanwhile, at the apex of Emor's Waterway...
A girl in white peers through a telescopic Artifact, phone in her other hand, reporting in.
Yes, the Boss and ==SEX3== crew just left Emor City.
As you wished, Creta Trading's old baggage is finally cleared up.
The cleanup was perfect, too. That Stellaroid smashed a few warehouses—perfect excuse to write off years of missing Artifacts.
... Mhm, I understand.==W== So now, all that's left is to keep an eye on "that" awakening, right?
Welcome back to the Well of Worlds Tyrant Development System, ==SEX12== Tyrant.
I am Vita, your dedicated, 24/7 personal secretary. Your first mission is—

strings.text: A voice named Vita comes through your phone, claiming to be the Tyrant’s personal secretary. She introduces the Well of Worlds system and asks you to make soul trades to raise your authorization level.
Welcome back to the "Well of Worlds" Tyrant Development System, dear Tyrant.
I am Vita, your dedicated, 24/7 personal secretary. Your first mission is—
Sounded like it came from ... your side, ==W====PLAYER_NAME==. Someone outside the window?
Outside? C'mon, we're in Loxy, and it's moving fast.
My pocket? All I have in there is my phone...
Whoa! What's that weird thing on the screen?!
Tyrant, I must clarify that I, Vita, am not a "weird thing"—I'm your personal secretary.
Allow Vita to correct a minor mistake in your words.
This is your exclusive phone, Tyrant, known as the Throne. The phone itself doesn't speak—I, Vita, am the one speaking.
Ah, sorry. Is it okay ...==W== if I call you Vita?
Vita is happy with any form of address you choose, Tyrant.
Iris, Amber, do your phones also have something like Vita?
Nope. Never seen anything this cool.
==PLAYER_NAME==, your phone's beyond anything we're familiar with—never seen built-in keyboards either...
Let alone a built-in talking secretary...==W== What could this all mean?
I should be the one asking that...==W== Noya, what's up?
A talking phone? Now that's interesting to see!
Tyrant, are these people your subordinates?
Subordinates? Well, we did join Boss's company ...==W== so that's pretty much right.
If we're talking about the pact we signed, then yes, that's accurate.
So Amber counts as one of Boss's subordinates too, right?
Talking with ==PLAYER_NAME== on the phone is something I enjoy.
I could be ==SEX3== subordinate if it means we can keep talking like this.
Hey, hey, hey, don't just go along with what Vita says! Don't you find it strange that a secretary suddenly popped up in my phone?
What's strange about it? You're the CEO now, ==PLAYER_NAME==. In a way, being different from normal people kinda comes with the territory.
From what I know, every big-shot CEO has some kind of unusual ability.
Some say those abilities come from the Seal of Grace.
Take Feagin for example, or the CEO of the Imperial Guard...==W== Wait, their official title might be "Grand Captain." Their shield can bounce off literally any attack, magic or physical!
Wow, that's quite something. Well, in that context ... ==W==a talking phone seems almost normal.
Tyrant, Vita assures you that, Vita, as your secretary, is quite capable as well.
Sorry, but I can't afford to hire a secretary
Are you sure I'm that Tyrant you mentioned?
Capable? So, can you transform into a cute girl?
We might be free of Feagin's debt now, but both the guild and the company are still pretty broke.
The folks from Ashwind Clan and Ash District pooled money to fix our vehicle, but there wasn't much left over. Our savings now stand at ...==W== 10,000 Dorra.
Luckily, the Wilds provide enough to eat, so no food expenses. And Bastelina kindly recharged our magic for the trip to Philae for free. We're getting by for now...
You see? I'm in no position to hire a secretary.
Tyrant, please be assured. Vita requires minimal upkeep—just some sunlight will keep Vita running.
If I may point out, Tyrant, this phone has not drawn upon your magic at all since its reboot.
Hold up, the phone runs on magic?
Well, technically our phones run on magic from Soul Stones, so we don't really pay much attention to it.
You don't have a Soul Stone, but the phone lit up when you received it. We assumed it contained a magical charge.
I see...==W== Well, that takes care of the biggest concern. Shall we move on to other matters?
I'm afraid there's a misunderstanding. My title as the Boss is simply my role as CEO of the Boss Accord. It's not the same as the Tyrant you're thinking of, neither in sound nor meaning.
I must disagree. Vita's database defines "Tyrant" and "Boss" uniformly. The "Throne" cannot be activated by anyone other than the Tyrant.
Furthermore, your physical features are a 99.9% match with the Tyrant's appearance in Vita's database.
Hmm ...==W== thing is, I have amnesia...==W== Can't remember if we've met ... or if I've ever owned this phone.
So if I'm this Tyrant you're talking about, am I supposed to be that Tyrant in the tale?
That is correct, Tyrant. You and your subordinates achieved remarkable things.
Wouldn't that make me ancient? I sure don't look like someone who's lived for millennia.
Age is time's mark on mortals. It does not apply to you.
Looks like this phone won't budge on the whole Tyrant thing. This could go on forever. Better change the subject.
Transform to a cute girl...==W== I apologize, but no search results found.
Not so capable now, huh? My one small wish was for you to turn into a cute girl, yet you can't even deliver on that.
Vita is capable of performing many other functions.
But the only thing I want is for you to turn into a cute girl.
Vita ...==W== as a secretary ...==W== is very capable...
Tyrant ... only wants ....==W== a cute girl...
Failing to meet demands...==W== Vita is not capable... Vita has failed as a secretary...
Is it crashing? Not quite as amazing as it claimed after all, huh?
Probably harmless even if I just ignore it.
Alright, that's enough. Forget about the cute girl thing. I was only checking if you were as "capable" as you said.
Acknowledged, Tyrant. Your intention was to instruct Vita about "modesty." Proceeding to update database.
What concerns me most now is whether participating in soul trading has any effects on human body.
Alright Vita, as my supposed secretary, break down everything about this phone, this Tyrant Development System you mentioned, and how this Soul Trading works.
Certainly, Tyrant. Your wish is my command.

strings.text: Vita wants you to collect souls to raise your authorization level. But being cautious, you're not about to trust her that easily. And somehow, an unfamiliar soul has appeared in your phone.
Long ago, the Tyrant's advisor developed this phone called "Throne" and the Well of Worlds Tyrant Development System to efficiently train the Tyrant.
The system automatically monitors the Tyrant's status and generates missions that promote development. Mission completion allows system level-ups, giving the Tyrant more authorizations.
However, the system proved too unstable for practical use, which is why Priest ■■==W== opted to serve as your personal secretary instead.
Soul trading is a core feature of your phone. According to Vita's records, you've collected five souls—==W==halfway through your first mission. Congratulations!
Five souls...==W== Huh? Hold up...==W== Five, you said?
==PLAYER_NAME== ... ==W==oh, I suppose we should address you as "Tyrant" now...==W== You caught that as well?
There's me, Noya, Amber, and Minova—that's only four, isn't it?
Vita, whose souls exactly have been collected?
Apologies. The system level is insufficient for Vita to answer that question.
What? But you're my personal secretary, aren't you?
True, but Vita has to comply with the rules of the Well of Worlds Tyrant Development System.
Rules are rules... It makes sense, actually. It's like company hierarchy—higher positions access more data.
Precisely, Lady Iris. You understand the principle perfectly.
Alright, different question—are there any risks or costs for people who trade souls with me?
None. These souls are your property, and Vita will safeguard them diligently. Until you actually utilize these souls, both the souls and their original owners remain perfectly safe.
And what does "actually utilizing" them mean exactly?
Apologies. the system level is insufficient for Vita to answer that question.
So I have to level up this system to learn more...==W== Hmm... Doesn't it feel like ...==W== this system is baiting me with information to make me work for it?
Well, at least knowing that the souls are "safe until utilized" is somewhat reassuring. Good to know our gamble against Creta Trading didn't backfire on everyone.
==PLAYER_NAME==, don't stress over our soul trades.
It was our choice. We're a Guild, and Guilds gotta stick together.
Noya and Iris feel the same way. You stood up for us, and we couldn't let you face the risks alone.
Tyrant truly shows great benevolence. But this soul trading comes with remarkable benefits for all employees of Tyrant Accord.
So, we get our weapons charged for free?
Like, lunch magically appears every day?
Well ...==W== can I exchange my benefits for Dorra? I'd like to save some up.
Processing... My apologies, Vita is unable to process that request currently...
Stumped, huh? Well, that's ...==W== some "excellent and capable" secretary I've got.
Ahem, anyway, tell us what benefits you can offer.
Your mercy is appreciated, Tyrant.==W== Currently, Vita can allow you to retain your memories when making wishes! Plus, more benefits will come with higher authorization levels—
Wait, no memory loss for wishes anymore?
Impossible, how can that be? Memory loss is an unavoidable price to pay for wish-making...
You're correct, Lady Iris. Memories are the cost demanded by the Monolith for wishes. However, this rule is waived for those employed by Tyrant Accord.
Tyrant, would you mind showing the original Creta Trading's Seal of Grace you hold?
The chess piece that looks like a pawn? Here...
The piece...==W== It's floating, and glowing.
The Well of Worlds Tyrant Development System has identified the power within this Seal of Grace. It's called "Promotion."
Promotion ...==W== that's the chess rule where a pawn can be promoted to any piece upon reaching the last rank of the board.
Indeed, Tyrant. It may appear to be an ordinary pawn, but it holds limitless potential.
However, since the system isn't at an advanced level yet, we can only access part of its powers—information replication.

Now I get it.==W== To become other pieces means you need their info beforehand. Having replication as part of the Promotion Power makes sense. Just like what Feagin did, we could create wish cards in mass…
Just think!==W== No writing out long requests, no reciting complicated prayers. You just hold a card, offer a memory, and make a wish.==W== Isn't that incredible?
Memories are also a form of information. Vita will replicate memories the Monolith demands during your wish-making, then hand over those copies while you keep your originals.
Can ...==W== it really work like that?
Tricking the Monolith ...==W== no, technically we're not tricking it. The Monolith does get the memories, even if they're copies. Info is info, and a copy works just as well as the real thing.
Huh...? Is that really what happened? So this is ...==W== the power of the Tyrant Development System, or rather, the power of this phone...
With this kind of power, I really could rule the world like the legendary Tyrant.==W== That explains why this phone is called the "Throne," huh?
Indeed. To be precise, these are your powers as the Tyrant. The "Throne," the Development System, and Vita—we all serve you. Please use us as you see fit.
I don't get the mechanics, but it sounds pretty amazing! Are you saying we're immune to amnesia?
That's correct in simple terms. Moreover, anyone who has made a soul trade with you will be considered part of the Tyrant Accord and can access this benefit.
Finally ...==W== no need to log everything on the phone.
Yes, it's great for us, but ...==W== if word leaks about this power, every Trekker and company across Nova will be after our seal!
Guys, this has to stay under wraps. Not a word to anyone, understood?

Lady Iris is quite meticulous, but Vita too would recommend the same. Until you have established an army of true loyalists, Tyrant, everything about the "Throne" and the system must be kept absolutely confidential.
You're right about this. These secrets stay between just us.
Don't worry. Already working on wiping it from my memory.
By the way, Vita, if each chess piece has its own unique power—
That king piece we got with the phone...
Why am I in the White Room all of a sudden...==W== Did we crash the ride? Is everyone okay?!
Please don't be alarmed, Tyrant. This isn't the actual White Room—it's a simulated space Vita created inside your head with the king chess piece's ability.
As the king piece holds abilities of the utmost significance, Vita would strongly advise that our following discussion remain private—for your ears only.
A virtual space created by the king piece? Are you saying ...==W== entering the White Room is the king piece's power?
Allow me to clarify. Its creation ability extends beyond virtual spaces. The original "White Room" itself was constructed by the king piece.
So that place ... was made by the king piece as well?
That's right. It's a power known as "Player"—the king piece on the board represents the "Player," and as such, one can occasionally "undo a move."
Since you've already been to the White Room, you must be aware of its unique nature.==W== That place is ...<size=55> the convergence of time and space in the Monolith.
If you happen to lose your life unexpectedly, you'll return there for a second chance. The two Monolith divine messengers ...==W== or shall I say, employees, will be there to assist you.
So I can't tell anyone else about this ...==W== can I?
I'm afraid not. The ability of this room cannot be manipulated at will. Choosing to forfeit your life will not initiate its function.
Moreover, if any third party besides you and Vita learns of this, the room will cease to function. Though even this safeguard isn't entirely foolproof.

This is precisely why Vita is communicating this to you within the realm of your mind. Plus, Vita has implanted a subtle mental barrier in your consciousness to prevent you from mentioning this to anyone else.
For your protection, please handle everything regarding the White Room with utmost discretion. Vita trusts you will exercise good judgment.
You're very considerate. Thank you.==W== Or maybe you just doesn't trust me enough? ...==W== Just kidding.
Looks like the White Room is just a fallback option. What you're really saying is ...==W== I shouldn't make a habit of depending on it.
All of Vita's actions serve one purpose—to aid you in growing into a mighty Tyrant.
这里往下是过去没有触发过BE的分支
Huh? What is this ... place?==W== Hello—Noya? Iris? Amber?
Tyrant, this is a simulated White Room that Vita has created in your mind. We're having this conversation via your thought right now.
Vita?! ... White Room? What's that supposed to be?
It appears you've successfully evaded all threats. Your wisdom never ceases to amaze Vita.
Please cut to the chase. Weren't we having a regular conversation? Why are you making it so complicated all of a sudden?
Let Vita explain. You inquired about the power of the king's piece. ==W==Due to its significance, this must remain confidential, even from your subordinates.
The seal carries a power known as "Player." The king piece on the board represents the "Player," and as such, you occasionally have the right to "undo a move."
Undo a move? You mean ...==W== I can start over?
Correct. However, it only works for accidental deaths. Choosing to forfeit your life will not initiate this function.
Unlike in my simulated space, should you meet an unfortunate end and enter the White Room, two divine messengers of the Monolith ...==W== or employees will be here to guide you. They look like this—
Although it's possible to start over, hmm ...==W== I'd prefer staying alive. Let's keep this as a backup plan.
I concur, Tyrant. Prudence serves us well.
Moreover, if any third party besides you and Vita learns of this, the room will cease to function. Please be sure to note this.
I see. This mental communication must be to keep everything under wraps.
Back ...==W== from where? You seemed lost in thought—you good?
Was that entire conversation just a few seconds in real time? If I can't tell anyone about the White Room...
My bad, I was just spacing out.
These chess pieces sure are something else.
How should I explain it to them?
After all, it's a precious ability. If sharing it means losing it, I should keep quiet about it.
So we can make wishes without losing our memory now. I'm not fully convinced...==W== But if it really works, that's quite a game-changer.
Coming back to life after dying...==W== It's so unrealistic...
They'd just worry if they knew everything, plus I literally "cannot" tell them. Might as well put it out of my mind.
Making wishes without losing memories ...==W== sounds almost too good to be true...
Assuming it works, we can be more at ease when making wishes from now on.
==PLAYER_NAME==, same for you—no more memory wipes! Oh, oh, why don't we wish for some super-rare Artifacts? Just to test it out, ya know!
I get where you're coming from ...==W== but we should be cautious. Maybe start out with smaller wishes?
"Implanting a subtle mental barrier in the consciousness"...==W== Is such a thing even possible? What if I try to say "White Room" out loud?
I-It won't come out. Then how about I write it down?
Ugh, my mind's gone blank... How to spell the word again...?
Tyrant, prudence serves you well. Testing it yourself is better than blindly trusting Vita.
What are you talking about? What's with the "whi"?
Ahem, "while," I mean, while it's still daylight, we should work on our plans.
Nearly blew it there. Guess there's seriously no way to mention the "White Room" to others...
So, we're heading to Philae next, aren't we?
Right. The trip should take roughly a week, even on the Lucky Oasis.
Fingers crossed we uncover something. I'm really concerned about Aunt Allie and the kids.
No sweat! Little Bastelina even hooked us up with an information broker.
It's actually information.==W== There's an info broker in Philae named Serena. She might know something about what you're after.
Think she'd have info on the orphanage? Or the Boss Accord?
Possibly. If Serena doesn't know, it's unlikely anyone does.==W== She might even have intel on that Nocturn Eterna officer you encountered.
Oh, oh,==W== and get this—the broker Serena has this quirk of playing mind games.
So she might challenge you to play some games ...==W== hehehe. Best of luck when that happens.
What kind of games are we talking about?
Heehee, I'm not sure. Could be anything, but—
That's the only hint I can give you.
Bastelina seems pretty sure about this. Finding Serena should give us the leads we need on the orphanage.
Yeah, let's climb some Monoliths during our trip. We need to raise more funds.
==PLAYER_NAME==, feel free to chat with me anytime on the road.
Hehe, I'll get going and take the wheel, Tyrant. Give me a shout if you need anything!
You don't have to use that title...
Why not? It's pretty awesome, right? Don't you all agree?
Well, using "Boss" seems more appropriate for official matters, considering our positions as employees of "Boss Accord."
I'll just use the name saved in your contacts.
Under the azure sky, the small Lucky Oasis cruises across the endless grasslands.==RT==Vita falls silent, retreating to the depths of the phone until I would summon her again.
The wheels of fate began to turn—slowly, but irreversibly.
Still need five more souls for the first mission.
Should I really continue to collect ...==W== even more souls?
That fifth soul in the phone ...==W== who did it belong to?
