So, trust me, digging for intel out here ...==W== is a huge waste of time.
Finding an orphanage? Pfft, that's nothing. In Flavio, you'd get a lead on that in a second.
Oh? Then you know where it is?
Well...==B== I didn't hear you were looking for it 'til I hit Emor. And this isn't Flavio—flying all the way back now would be pointless.
But ... if you give me an exclusive interview, I'll definitely make it worth your while★
I can handle pretty much anything, like tidying up your vehicle, taking you for a spin in the sky...
An interview, huh... Some public promotions for the guild couldn't hurt.
Besides...==W== There is something she could help me with.
Witches zip around Nova on brooms, right? So you must know the ropes.
Mhmm! Lookin' for a guide? I've hit up most cities in Nova, and I know Philae like the back of my hand.
No, I was actually wondering if you've ever dealt with something like this.
I leave out Fuyuka's name and alter the details so Mistique won't recognize her, then lay out the situation.
Hmm...==W== Sounds like you've already tried the right things.
Well, it's different for everyone. I once interviewed someone who got over it with some "experiential therapy."
Exactly! 'Cause I literally just made it up. It's not, like, official or anything★
Long story short—a certain Stellaroid chased her as a kid, and she's been scared stiff of 'em ever since...
Even after becoming a Trekker, she still couldn't handle that kind of Stellaroid. The moment she saw them, she couldn't stop trembling.
Then one time, she got cornered by one in a Monolith and had to fight. Guess what happened?
Nope! Lost and ran away! But the fear ... poof, gone. During the fight, she realized it wasn't half as scary as she'd imagined...
She even got the feeling that she could totally win next time.
So, confronting one's fear head-on...==W== That makes sense.
What feels like a huge deal right now ... sometimes it just fades.
Hee hee, so I was a pretty big help, right? Does that mean I snag the exclusive interview with the Boss?
You wanna know more about how Fuyuka got scammed?
Yeah. Like, why'd she join that phony guild to begin with?
That part's no secret; we all know why. But ...==W== why are you asking me and Kaede behind her back?
I'd have asked her myself if I could.==W== But I can't just go dredge up painful memories.
Mmm... I get why Nazuna feels weird talking behind her back...==W== But the Boss has a point. It should be fine to tell ==SEX4==, right?
You're right. Okay, I'll tell you. Fuyuka was just desperate to become a Trekker.
Can't anyone just become a Trekker if they want to?
"Anyone who leaves a city is a Trekker"—that's how the saying goes. But by real Trekker standards, you gotta climb a Monolith, make a wish, and beat a tough monster to earn the title.
So it's not that simple. Lots of newbies don't know the ropes, and that's how frauds take advantage.
But you said Fuyuka climbs Monoliths by herself. Wouldn't that make her a "real Trekker" by now?
Yes, that's true. But Fuyuka herself...
I-I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to worry everyone.
Fuyuka, what are you doing hiding under the table?
N-Nothing... It's just that it feels safe being so small and tight in here... Hehe, and ... the living room is so quiet at night.
Great. I was trying to hide from Fuyuka, and we end up in the same spot...
I'm sorry...==W== We discussed your past without permission. We didn't mean any harm...
N-No, it's fine! I know Boss means well for me. It's all because I was too weak...
I finally got on a team and I still couldn't get it right...==W== Someone like me trying to be a Trekker... It was probably a mistake from the very beginning—
On that point, I must say you're mistaken. The very first Trekker legend speaks of climbing the Monoliths and adventuring all alone. That proves you don't need a team to be one.
Just as when they first met, Serena's cloak billows out from the coat rack, revealing her form.
You just ... hang out on a coat rack all day?
My, my. Prying into a lady's secrets is quite rude. Besides, this little chat isn't about me.
Fuyuka, did someone say something to upset you?
I find it hard to believe someone with your dream would give up so easily. More importantly, I'm afraid your grasp of history is a bit flawed.
Lone-wolf Trekkers are rare, certainly, but history has seen its share of famous ones.
To climb the Monoliths alone and become famous...==W== That's incredible.
Okay... I'll tell you all what happened. It was from before I joined the Petal Bloom.
No. I can't let you join the new hunting squad.
But ... you haven't even seen me fight.
I know who you are. The Trekker who decked her own teammate.
I've heard things about that crew. I even suspect it wasn't your fault. But that's not the issue.
If you can't even control your own fists, you could hurt an ally at any time.
In my book, anyone who can't work with others has no right to be a Trekker. They're just dead weight.
And let's just say you can control your fists. If you get framed and don't fight back—or worse, don't even realize you're being framed...
Then you're just naive. That means you're weak, and you're still dead weight.
Besides, word's already gotten around camp. We're facing a massive, dangerous monster. I can't have people doubting the person fighting beside them.
So, the answer's no. If you get it, go home.
Claire, the vice-captain of the new hunting squad...==W== She practically knew Fuyuka was framed...
Oh, so that's the kind of person our vice-captain is. Won't take the slightest risk. How interesting.
Vice-Captain Claire's logic holds up, and her reasons are solid... But still...
For someone so sharp, rejecting Fuyuka without even testing her skills... I feel like there's more to this.
Fuyuka's trauma isn't just from the Monolith climb. It's from everyone judging and blaming her after. To fix the root of the problem, we need to—
ARGH! I can't take any more of this!
S-Sorry, Nazuna senpai... I didn't mean to drag up something so awful, wasting everyone's time...
It's your attitude! "Sorry"? Fuyuka, what'd you do wrong? You really need to ditch this habit of apologizing for everything!
And every last one of those people from the new hunting squad is spouting the same damn nonsense!
And since we're on the topic—I told you Nazuka used to live here, right? The traitor.
She said almost the exact same thing before she left—
Huh... She did? I had no idea.
I didn't wanna get you all worked up. That day, I tried to stop her from leaving...
Nazuka, why are you leaving? We're more than halfway done with our research on those monsters...
Once we figure out all their patterns, we can definitely beat them.
You don't have to do a thing.
I'm starting a new hunting squad.==W== And it has no room for the weak. Goodbye.
I was so mad. I'm still so mad. I have never gotten over it.
Eek—?! Nazuna senpai, please, calm down!
You are NOT weak. And neither is anyone in the Petal Bloom!
We're gonna finish those last two commissions!
And we're gonna show those smug jerks who underestimate the Petal Bloom what we can really do!

strings.text: Nazuna collected intel on the Big Three and requests your help. You apply to join the new hunting squad but are rejected. To complete the commission, you can only rely on your own.
Nazuna yanks a thick stack of papers from under her bed and drops it on the table. The dust sent flying is the clearest proof of time's passage.
My intel on the Big Three. Their habits, attack patterns, weaknesses, territory, tactics... It's all in there.
The first hunt only failed because we were going in blind.
After I got back, I went to the forest every day to watch them. I'd even climb a Monolith on the way and wish for a plushie as a little reward.
So you're not just a claw machine whiz. You're actually pretty amazing!
Hey, hold on! Was that a compliment or are you making fun of me?!
Now, now~ I've seen how hard you've been working, Nazuna.
Kaede!==W== Oh, Kaede...! You're the best!
Oh my, hehe. There, there, sweetie~
What's going on with this vibe...! Feel like my heart's been healed...
Anyway...==W== Now that the new expedition's taking over, all this research is ...==W== useless.
But the intel's solid! I know it can help take those monsters down!
So, ==PLAYER_NAME==... Or I guess, Boss... I know this is a huge ask, especially after I turned you and Serena down before, but ...==W== will you help us with the other two commissions?
How about you pay me with all your plushies?
All of them...?==W== You've got to be kidding me...
Fine! Take 'em! You can even have the one I'm holding! Just ... please, help us!
... Alright. I see how determined you are.
I only said I'd take your dolls to test your determination. My bad. I shouldn't have done it like that.
Huh? So that's all it was? Man... you gave me a heart attack...==W== Boss, you're a bully, you know that?
Can't I play the fairy-tale Tyrant once in a while?
Besides, I promised Serena I'd help Fuyuka, and helping the Petal Bloom clear their remaining two commissions will help, too.
I'll get right on analyzing this intel.
Back in the hall, the cloak on the coat rack swells and takes on human form again.
This was all part of your plan, wasn't it, Serena?
Hm? What're you talking about, Boss? I didn't do a thing. Heh.
Stop being cryptic. I don't know why, but you didn't just want me to help Fuyuka. You used her as a lever to get the whole Petal Bloom Guild moving—to help them get over their past.
You give me too much credit. I'm just an information broker.
I'm just curious... What are you trying to set in motion by using them?
You'll find out in due time. For now, that's my little secret. Good night, my dear Boss.
With a smile and a bow, Serena dissolves back into a simple cloak on the rack, as if she were never there.
Yesterday, Captain Nazuka pinpointed the exact location of the Garden of Parasite. Fifty klicks due east of camp.
Do you get it? This is our chance to divide their forces. We're neutralizing the weaker Spirit of Brutality first.
Alright...==W== The operation starts now. But no matter what, our opponent is the Spirit of Brutality—don't let your guard down.
If you find it, do not engage. Your survival is the top priority. Contact me or Nazuka immediately. Understood?
Impressive drive, and a solid strategy. Their victory against the Blade of Jade was no fluke.
Boss... Are you sure we should talk to them?
Everyone here wants these monsters gone. We share the same goal, so teaming up is the safest play.
Nazuna, your research is solid! One look at this, and they'll be floored. It'll make 'em see the Petal Bloom in a whole new light.
O-Okay... Fine. I'll talk to Claire.
Oh, you're from Petal Bloom. What can I do for you?
Claire, we'd like to join the hunting squad. This is my research on the two monsters. It should be helpful.
Claire takes the notes from Nazuna and starts to skim them.
Hmm. You've noted a few details I missed. The team's setting out now, but having you assist isn't...
Hold on. Some of these faces are new. Did the Petal Bloom recruit new members?
Ah, not exactly. We're with the Boss Accord. We're just collaborating with Petal Bloom for now.
Boss Accord... Never heard of it in Philae.
Uh... please don't sweat the small stuff. They are from Emor.
Why does a company from Emor...
She seems wary of companies. But wasn't it United Harvest that posted the "Three Grand Commissions"?
Claire, let's go. The expedition is heading out.
Nazuka, good timing. Your old friends are here. They want in on the hunt...
Well. You heard the Captain. Time to go.
Just like you, we also spent a great deal of time investigating these two monsters.
Besides, as I've already said, the new hunting squad does not need weaklings. We are leaving now. There's no time to integrate new people.
You've studied these monsters. You know better than anyone that without a specialized, coordinated team, more people are just a liability.
That's... I mean, you're not wrong...
... She's impossible. Has an excuse for everything.
Without looking back, Nazuka leads her team deep into the forest. Claire just gives us a helpless shrug before following them in.
Ugh... Knew it. That idiot is just so damn stubborn...
That's just how she is. She only talks like that 'cause she really treasures her <size=50>friends<size=39>.
Nazuka's reasoning is sound, but that look in her eyes... Something tells me there's more to it.
Is there something about this hunt that we don't know?
So they won't let us join...==W== Fine.
Nazuna, we'll just handle it ourselves.
Right! We'll take down the Spirit of Brutality first and show 'em what the new Petal Bloom is capable of!
Amber, wait! This forest is huge. We can't just scatter to scout. If one of us finds the monster, the rest of us will never be able to regroup.
Mmm... Most of the squad are scouts, anyway. Once they spot the monster, Nazuka's combat team moves in.
Plus, she uses wind magic to watch the whole area from above.==W== Beating them to the target is gonna be tough.
Scouting is our disadvantage. Wait... The air... I've got it!
I have a plan. It'll allow us to find the target before they do.
Hello there, Boss~★ Sorry to keep you waiting!
Whoa, someone just dropped out of the sky...?==W== Who is that?
That broomstick... You're... a witch from Scarlet Sights Media?!
Hi there! Mistique's the name! A monster-hunting contest between a new expedition and the new Petal Bloom? Now that's a story! You absolutely have to give me an interview with you!
It's okay, Fuyuka. No need to hide. She's here for me.
Hehe, you really made me wait for it, Boss! So, that means you're giving me the exclusive, right? You are, aren't you?
Yes. But you're going to help me with something first.
I need you to find the Spirit of Brutality in this forest!
Consider it done! Aerial searches are my specialty. Just don't back out on our deal, Boss!
Boss, you're really connected, huh? You can call on a Scarlet Sights witch just like that.
==PLAYER_NAME==, when did you get to know a witch?
It's a long story... I'll explain when there's time.==W== With her scouting for us, finding the Spirit of Brutality should be easy enough. Let's head into the forest.
<size=35>Boss... Nazuna... Miss witch... Everyone is so capable... Yet I'm...
Deep in the forest, a small figure chips away at the hard earth.
Boss and those Trekkers have been planning their hunt for days.
So, I just need to dig a trap near the monster. When the Boss and ==SEX3== little friends show up to fight it,==W== I can grab them all at once! Just you wait, Boss!
If I'm supposed to be watching the Tyrant, it's safer just to capture ==SEX4==. Lady Aeloria did say kidnapping was an option.
Hmm... This pit is way too small. To catch someone important like the Boss, I need a trap to match—a really, really big one!
There's still time. Gotta keep digging!
The crisp, lonely rhythm of digging echoes through the forest.

strings.text: To put Fuyuka at ease, you feign signing a contract with her. The monsters arrive fiercely, and Nazuka intervenes at a crucial moment to help. In the end, it is Fuyuka who delivers the punch that leads to victory.
Nazuka stands high in the treetops, gazing out at the eastern forest.
The woods over there are too quiet.==W== It's unsettling.==W== I'll scout ahead.
That's the recon team's job. We're the hunting squad.==W== Our orders are to rest and conserve energy for a sudden fight.
Wait...==W== You can hear things from that far off?
Hmph.==W== The wind, huh?==W== Flying high, hearing distant whispers... Must be nice.
I won't stop you, Captain.==W== But don't go too far. The Spirit of Brutality could show up any second.
...==W== You just can't let things go, can you?
They seem to match those of the Spirit of Brutality.
There are a lot of smaller ones as well.
I estimate thirty... No, at least fifty Bark Boars.
Nazuna's intel said the Spirit of Brutality is a giant Bark Boar. It likely leads a massive herd.
The tracks are fresh. They've been active in this area for the past few days.
Ugh... That many of them? How are we supposed to handle them?
That's why the squad is a big one.
If we're clever and use their behavior against them, we can still win.
Bark Boars are monsters that hunt solo. They always zero in on the strongest target they can find.
So, we'll spread out. Whoever gets aggro keeps the Spirit of Brutality tied up while the rest of us deal with the other boars.
Then we focus fire on the Spirit of Brutality.
Alright everyone, stay quiet. Once Mistique gets a visual, she's gonna lure the Spirit of Brutality here. I'll call the shots.
Heh. Standing around waiting to be targeted makes you feel like a prize in a claw machine, huh?
Keep talking like that, Nazuna, and you just might be the prize snagged.
Hey, I was just making a comparison!
The ambush squad is ready. Now we just have to trust Mistique to do her part.
Tucking my phone away, I join Fuyuka on a low cliff, overlooking the soon-to-be battlefield.
B-Boss...==W== At a time like this—==W==no,==W== just because it's a time like this...==W== P-Please, take my soul!
What's this all of a sudden?==W== Yeah, I'm the Boss, but that's just a job title. Not, y'know, the Tyrant kind of Boss.
I heard if I make a "soul pact,"==W== I can become your employee==W== and give my soul to you.
Well, that's technically true.==W== But do you wanna join the Boss Accord?
Ah, no...==W== That's not it...==W== But if signing the pact means joining,==W== I-I-I guess I don't mind...
But I don't want to join a company. I just want ...==W== you to take my soul, so you can control me.==W== That way, I won't have to worry about hurting you when I'm supposed to be on guard duty.
She seems to have gotten it wrong.==W== It's not like I can control a person just by holding their soul.==W== I can't do anything with it, really.
Control you? Who's been telling you this stuff?
I-I'm sorry,==W== I can't just give out their name,==W== but ...==W== as your bodyguard for this fight, I'm terrified.==W== I worry that I might fail to control my own strength...
I doubt Iris or the others would ever mention soul trading...==W== The only one who'd plant an idea like this in Fuyuka's head is Serena. It's gotta be her.
How do I snap her out of it before the fight starts?
Fuyuka, I believe in you.==W== After all that training, you've totally got this.
Exactly.==W== I believe in you, and you, me.==W== So just trust that I know what I'm talking about.
Trust you ...==W== that you trust me...
Heh, this little pep talk has to do the trick!
Ah, uh, um ... so ...==W== I...==W== I should believe in myself...?
Ugh, I-I-I can't think straight!==W== Boss, just take my soul already!==W== Then I can put all my faith in the me whose soul is safe with you!
She's so flustered she just ...==W== short-circuited?
Let's forget the soul stuff for a minute.==W== Fuyuka, run me through the strategy for fighting the Spirit of Brutality.
The Spirit of Brutality is symbiotic with plants. The vines across its face will swat away most attacks.
And ... it's not as reckless as it looks. Might be the smartest of the Big Three. It's already ambushed several hunts...
Sounds tough. Does it even have a weak spot?
It does.==W== The plant mask is great protection, but it kills its field of view. Hitting it from the side or behind is way more effective.
Plus, after it charges, it has to stop to find you again.==W== That's your opening, right when its guard is down.
See? You know this stuff inside and out.
Th-==W==That's all from Nazuna's notes. I just memorized them...
It's more than that. You've been training like crazy, haven't you, Fuyuka?
B-But...==W== I only ever practiced alone, so it's no good... Just take my soul.==W== It's the only way.
Great. All that logic just made her fixate on not having a training partner...
Hmph. A Boss has standards. I don't just claim any soul that comes my way.==W== If you want me to take yours, you'll have to prove its worth.
H-How do I prove it? Should I ...==W== go smash that giant rock over there?
No. That would only prove your physical strength. A soul's true value is measured by the strength of its conviction.
Exactly.==W== To believe in the path you've chosen and walk it to the very end. That's the kind of soul I'm after.
The path I've chosen...==W== I understand now.
Good. Then let's bring our focus back on the Spirit of Brutality, shall we?
Whoa, hey, what's with the kneeling? Get up.
The path I've chosen is to offer my soul to the Boss! I have found my conviction!
It seems that==W== the only way to settle her down is to make a formal deal ... a pact.==W== But...
The more souls you collect, Tyrant, the more I can do for you.
Vita, that thing on my phone...==W== Ugh, I don't really want to listen to it. This feels like I'm just taking advantage of Fuyuka.
Alright, Fuyuka. I'll draw up the terms. Just a moment.
I pull out a pen and paper, then quickly scrawl out a "pact" using some half-remembered Monolith script.
Without a second glance, Fuyuka signs her name on the document.
Seriously? She didn't even read it. She's going to get scammed one day.
So ...==W== my soul is yours now?

Hmph.==W== The wind, huh?==W== Flying high, hearing distant whispers... Must be nice.

...==W== You just can't let things go, can you?

There are a lot of smaller ones as well.
I estimate thirty... No, at least fifty Bark Boars.
Nazuna's intel said the Spirit of Brutality is a giant Bark Boar. It likely leads a massive herd.
The tracks are fresh. They've been active in this area for the past few days.
Ugh... That many of them? How are we supposed to handle them?
That's why the squad is a big one.
If we're clever and use their behavior against them, we can still win.
Bark Boars are monsters that hunt solo. They always zero in on the strongest target they can find.
So, we'll spread out. Whoever gets aggro keeps the Spirit of Brutality tied up while the rest of us deal with the other boars.
Then we focus fire on the Spirit of Brutality.
Alright everyone, stay quiet. Once Mistique gets a visual, she's gonna lure the Spirit of Brutality here. I'll call the shots.
Heh. Standing around waiting to be targeted makes you feel like a prize in a claw machine, huh?
Keep talking like that, Nazuna, and you just might be the prize snagged.
Hey, I was just making a comparison!
The ambush squad is ready. Now we just have to trust Mistique to do her part.
Tucking my phone away, I join Fuyuka on a low cliff, overlooking the soon-to-be battlefield.

What's this all of a sudden?==W== Yeah, I'm the Boss, but that's just a job title. Not, y'know, the Tyrant kind of Boss.
I heard if I make a "soul pact,"==W== I can become your employee==W== and give my soul to you.
Well, that's technically true.==W== But do you wanna join the Boss Accord?
Ah, no...==W== That's not it...==W== But if signing the pact means joining,==W== I-I-I guess I don't mind...
But I don't want to join a company. I just want ...==W== you to take my soul, so you can control me.==W== That way, I won't have to worry about hurting you when I'm supposed to be on guard duty.
She seems to have gotten it wrong.==W== It's not like I can control a person just by holding their soul.==W== I can't do anything with it, really.
Control you? Who's been telling you this stuff?
I-I'm sorry,==W== I can't just give out their name,==W== but ...==W== as your bodyguard for this fight, I'm terrified.==W== I worry that I might fail to control my own strength...
I doubt Iris or the others would ever mention soul trading...==W== The only one who'd plant an idea like this in Fuyuka's head is Serena. It's gotta be her.
How do I snap her out of it before the fight starts?
Fuyuka, I believe in you.==W== After all that training, you've totally got this.
Exactly.==W== I believe in you, and you, me.==W== So just trust that I know what I'm talking about.
Trust you ...==W== that you trust me...
Heh, this little pep talk has to do the trick!
Ah, uh, um ... so ...==W== I...==W== I should believe in myself...?
Ugh, I-I-I can't think straight!==W== Boss, just take my soul already!==W== Then I can put all my faith in the me whose soul is safe with you!
She's so flustered she just ...==W== short-circuited?
Let's forget the soul stuff for a minute.==W== Fuyuka, run me through the strategy for fighting the Spirit of Brutality.
The Spirit of Brutality is symbiotic with plants. The vines across its face will swat away most attacks.
And ... it's not as reckless as it looks. Might be the smartest of the Big Three. It's already ambushed several hunts...
Sounds tough. Does it even have a weak spot?
It does.==W== The plant mask is great protection, but it kills its field of view. Hitting it from the side or behind is way more effective.
Plus, after it charges, it has to stop to find you again.==W== That's your opening, right when its guard is down.
See? You know this stuff inside and out.
Th-==W==That's all from Nazuna's notes. I just memorized them...
It's more than that. You've been training like crazy, haven't you, Fuyuka?
B-But...==W== I only ever practiced alone, so it's no good... Just take my soul.==W== It's the only way.
Great. All that logic just made her fixate on not having a training partner...
Hmph. A Boss has standards. I don't just claim any soul that comes my way.==W== If you want me to take yours, you'll have to prove its worth.
H-How do I prove it? Should I ...==W== go smash that giant rock over there?
No. That would only prove your physical strength. A soul's true value is measured by the strength of its conviction.
Exactly.==W== To believe in the path you've chosen and walk it to the very end. That's the kind of soul I'm after.
The path I've chosen...==W== I understand now.
Good. Then let's bring our focus back on the Spirit of Brutality, shall we?
Whoa, hey, what's with the kneeling? Get up.
The path I've chosen is to offer my soul to the Boss! I have found my conviction!
It seems that==W== the only way to settle her down is to make a formal deal ... a pact.==W== But...
The more souls you collect, Tyrant, the more I can do for you.
Vita, that thing on my phone...==W== Ugh, I don't really want to listen to it. This feels like I'm just taking advantage of Fuyuka.

strings.text: Everyone works together to defeat the Spirit of Brutality. You tell the truth to Fuyuka. Following the advice of Nazuna and Kaede, Fuyuka summons her courage and signs a "master-apprentice contract" with you.
A fist engulfed in flame smashes into the Spirit of Brutality's flank.
The Spirit of Brutality's tusks graze Fuyuka's head as a heavy punch smashes squarely into its jaw, sending splinters flying.
Stop looking around. I'm the one you're fighting.
Careful. It knows it can't beat us, so it's calling the other Bark Boars for backup.
O' leaves that with the wild wind play,==RT==weave now a wall to bar the way!
Heh, it's getting tired. Fuyuka, let's move in!
I'll use my arrows to distract it and mess with its hearing. You hit its weak spot when you get an opening.
The Spirit of Brutality lies unconscious at the foot of a cliff. Its Bark Boar followers have scattered, and the forest is quiet once more.
Yo, Boss, did you see that?! One punch from Fuyuka, and—BAM!—that mask on the Spirit of Brutality just shattered!
That's what I call a training montage payoff! Even with those heavy fists, she was weavin' through my bolts and that idiot's wind blades like they were nothing.
And she must've finally shaken her fear. Her punches were fast and clean, and we were so in sync, we knew what the other was thinking with just a look.
Indeed. Hehe...==W== Much more graceful than a certain crybaby, wouldn't you agree?
Hey, for the last time, I wasn't crying!
Hmph...==W== See? Petal Bloom can take down one of the Big Three all by ourselves. We don't need a whole squad for this.
Settle down, Nazuna. We still have commissions left, so stay sharp. Our friends from New Star Guild have gone to notify the camp and the hunting squad.
We need to keep a close eye on the Spirit of Brutality until they arrive. If it wakes up...
No way. You have no idea how hard Fuyuka's punch was—
Everyone's so happy for Fuyuka, but the star of the show is awfully quiet...
Boss, could I talk to you for a moment?
Don't thank me. This was all you. Your hard work paid off.
N-no, it wasn't! During the fight, I could feel you... You were controlling my body, Boss.
So she really thinks I was controlling her.
That's the only reason I fought so well ... the reason I was in perfect sync with everyone. It was all you, Boss.
Everyone's praising me, and ...==W== it just feels wrong. I'm not the one who did any of those moves.
Should I tell them the truth, Boss? I mean, you can't be with me all the time...
If they think my skills improved and we fight together when you're not here... I... I could get them hurt again.
How should I explain this to her?
Ahem. Fuyuka, about that... We never actually made a soul pact.
W-We didn't...?==W== Then what did I sign?
Uh, what is this? I can't read a single word of it.
Next time, you should read what you're signing. What if you'd just signed your life away?
I...==W== Right. But it was from you,==B== Boss is my only hope... So...==W== I didn't care what it said.
That's ... a staggering amount of trust.
I was just trying to make a point, don't worry. I left the relationship clause blank. There's no actual pact between us.
Fuyuka, listen. You synced up with them so well because you've spent all this time watching how they fight.
E-Even if that's true... You're the one who made it work, Boss. I can't do that by myself.
I can't fight, and I can't use magic. Do you really believe I could've directed a fight that complex against the Spirit of Brutality?
But... But I wasn't scared! I was so decisive! That has to be because you have my soul, Boss!
And if I didn't actually do anything... Would it matter whether I had your soul or not?
What...==W== What's that supposed to mean?
Alright, time to tell her the truth.
The truth is, we didn't make a soul pact. That "pact" was merely a template written in the Monoliths' script. The relationship part was left blank.
Huh? Let me see... It really is ...==W== the Monoliths' script. I can't make out a single word. I didn't even look when I signed.
If you're that worried about messing up when I'm not here, then we'll just stick together.
Y-You're right! I gave my soul to you, Boss. Since I belong to Boss now, it's only right that I follow my Boss.
I-I'm sorry. I should know my place. From now on, I am your slave. I'll follow your every command, Boss.
"Slave"? What in the world does she take me for?
Right, letting her believe this is a bad idea...==W== Better clear things up now.
Ahem. Your naivete is astounding. I'm disappointed you couldn't see through such an obvious trick.
Heh heh. The contract I gave you was written in the Monoliths' script—which you can't read. The relationship clause was left blank.
Meaning, there was no soul pact to begin with.
But ...==W== the way I fought back there...
That was all you. My little trick was just ... a nudge.==W== You train relentlessly and you're a natural. It only makes sense you'd have that kind of power.
It's called the placebo effect. It's a legitimate therapeutic method, you know.
So you're saying ...==W== that was my own strength?
Exactly. I may call myself a Boss, but I'm really just a CEO. I don't have any special powers to hand out.
Hmm...==W== But even if it was a trick, it was only possible because of you, Boss.
You cared so much about helping me, Boss... That kindness was the push I needed!
I feel terrible for making you waste so much time on someone like me...
Hey, don't say that! It wasn't a waste of time at all. Besides—
Every Trekker has a duty to help those with memory loss. 'Cause who knows? Tomorrow, we could be the ones drawing a blank.
That's what Iris told me. It's why she saved me. You may not have amnesia, but I still think...
You don't need a reason to help someone.
Hehe, well said, ==PLAYER_NAME==! People are supposed to look out for each other—
Hey! Hold on a sec. So this is where you two were whispering! I've been looking all over for you.
Fuyuka, your face is all red. Are you just tired from the fight?
Kaede, I...==W== I don't know what to do...
Mmm-hmm, I got it. Okay Fuyuka, listen up. All you gotta do is this, then this, and a little of that!
...Huh?==W== W-W-W-WH-WHAAAT?!==W== W-Wait, Nazuna! If I do that...!
It'll be fine! I'm used to winging it, so just trust me.
Ahem! ==PLAYER_NAME==... or should I say, Boss! Did you really just get our sweet Fuyuka to sign a contract like that?
It's a blank pact. It doesn't mean anything.
I understand, but it's only a blank one for<size=45> now<size=38>, right? Here, Fuyuka. Pen.
Just filling in that little blank you left! Hehe. Shouldn't hand out open contracts like that, Boss. Once the terms are set, they're magically binding.
Huh? What're you writing... H-Hey, Fuyuka, wait!
Fuyuka asks Kaede how to write the Monolith script, then leans over the pact and carefully adds a few words, her face set with determination.
There...! Boss, I-I'll be relying on your guidance...!
Fuyuka... she still seems so tense...==W== What kind of pact is she trying to lock me into?
Uh, let's see...==B== "==PLAYER_NAME== and Fuyuka hereby enter into an apprenticeship"?
Master... ==PLAYER_NAME==, will you be my Master?
I appreciate the thought, Fuyuka, but I have nothing to teach you. You're miles ahead of me as a fighter.
N-Not about fighting! I want to learn about management from you.
You're going to be the guild leader?
Y-Yes. Just now...==W== Nazuna suggested that I should be the one to lead Petal Bloom...
Nazuna said that if someone who was instrumental against the Spirit of Brutality took charge, we'd be on equal footing with that idio—==W==Ah, I mean, Nazuka.
She spends all day at the claw machines, which isn't the best look when new recruits come calling. But she and Kaede promised they'd support me.
Nazuna, you didn't go through all this... just so you can slack off, did you?
Ah, no. Actually, I was the one who decided in the end...
If I'm the leader, then I'll have a reason to ask for your guidance on management.
This way, my connection to ==PLAYER_NAME==, to Boss, doesn't have to end. Right?
Besides...==W== I'm so happy that I'm finally starting to feel a little more confident. I just... I really want to repay you for that.
I don't want our story to be over. I want to give back, even if there isn't much I can do yet.
Whoa, that look in her eyes... She's completely serious. I have to respond with equal sincerity.
Alright. But my training is strict.
That's no problem. No matter what it is, I'll give it my all.
You really mean it. Okay then, our pact is sealed. Let's move forward together, Fuyuka.
Congratulations, Fuyuka. I suppose we'll have to call you Captain from now on.
N-No, please don't! I couldn't ask you to call me that, Kaede...!==W== Just Fuyuka is fine.
Ahaha! All eyes are on you now, Fuyuka. Better start gettin' used to the title!
Sooo...==W== Since that's all settled, how 'bout a party to celebrate taking down the Spirit of Brutality?
Yes! Let's all go out for a big meal and celebrate.
In that case, I'd better pull out all the stops for dinner. ♪
Yay, party time! The Boss and everyone from the New Star Guild are coming too, right?
Oh, you mean Nazuka? It's fine. She likes to do her own thing.
Oh, right. Speaking of Nazuka...==W== Did we technically just steal the hunting squad's kill?
It's fine. As much as that idiot gets on my nerves,==W== she's fair. She wouldn't abuse her authority or try to steal credit.
At the end of the day... Ugh, why are we talking about such a downer? If she wanted to join, she could just ask.
Anyway, c'mon! Let's go get groceries!
Heh. Nazuna says not to talk about Nazuka, but she's the one who won't stop talking about her.
In the end, Fuyuka decides to invite Nazuka, and Nazuna agrees with a reluctant pout.
But ... knowing her, she'll probably just turn us down...==W== So, sorry, but could you go invite her for us, Boss?
She says that, but from what I've seen, Nazuka probably wouldn't refuse if Nazuna herself asked...
As I approach the hunting squad camp, I hear faint voices coming from behind the trees up ahead.
I played only a minor role in defeating the Spirit of Brutality. The real credit belongs to Petal Bloom, the New Star Guild, and that Boss, ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W== Their prowess is impeccable.
However, Claire, even so, do not allow them to join the hunting squad.

I can't fight, and I can't use magic. Do you really believe I could've directed a fight that complex against the Spirit of Brutality?
But... But I wasn't scared! I was so decisive! That has to be because you have my soul, Boss!
And if I didn't actually do anything... Would it matter whether I had your soul or not?
What...==W== What's that supposed to mean?
Alright, time to tell her the truth.
The truth is, we didn't make a soul pact. That "pact" was merely a template written in the Monoliths' script. The relationship part was left blank.
Huh? Let me see... It really is ...==W== the Monoliths' script. I can't make out a single word. I didn't even look when I signed.
If you're that worried about messing up when I'm not here, then we'll just stick together.
Y-You're right! I gave my soul to you, Boss. Since I belong to Boss now, it's only right that I follow my Boss.
I-I'm sorry. I should know my place. From now on, I am your slave. I'll follow your every command, Boss.
"Slave"? What in the world does she take me for?
Right, letting her believe this is a bad idea...==W== Better clear things up now.
Ahem. Your naivete is astounding. I'm disappointed you couldn't see through such an obvious trick.
Heh heh. The contract I gave you was written in the Monoliths' script—which you can't read. The relationship clause was left blank.
Meaning, there was no soul pact to begin with.
But ...==W== the way I fought back there...
That was all you. My little trick was just ... a nudge.==W== You train relentlessly and you're a natural. It only makes sense you'd have that kind of power.
It's called the placebo effect. It's a legitimate therapeutic method, you know.
So you're saying ...==W== that was my own strength?
Exactly. I may call myself a Boss, but I'm really just a CEO. I don't have any special powers to hand out.
Hmm...==W== But even if it was a trick, it was only possible because of you, Boss.
You cared so much about helping me, Boss... That kindness was the push I needed!
I feel terrible for making you waste so much time on someone like me...
Hey, don't say that! It wasn't a waste of time at all. Besides—
Every Trekker has a duty to help those with memory loss. 'Cause who knows? Tomorrow, we could be the ones drawing a blank.
That's what Iris told me. It's why she saved me. You may not have amnesia, but I still think...
You don't need a reason to help someone.
Hehe, well said, ==PLAYER_NAME==! People are supposed to look out for each other—
Hey! Hold on a sec. So this is where you two were whispering! I've been looking all over for you.
Fuyuka, your face is all red. Are you just tired from the fight?
Kaede, I...==W== I don't know what to do...
Mmm-hmm, I got it. Okay Fuyuka, listen up. All you gotta do is this, then this, and a little of that!
...Huh?==W== W-W-W-WH-WHAAAT?!==W== W-Wait, Nazuna! If I do that...!
It'll be fine! I'm used to winging it, so just trust me.
Ahem! ==PLAYER_NAME==... or should I say, Boss! Did you really just get our sweet Fuyuka to sign a contract like that?
It's a blank pact. It doesn't mean anything.
I understand, but it's only a blank one for<size=45> now<size=38>, right? Here, Fuyuka. Pen.
Just filling in that little blank you left! Hehe. Shouldn't hand out open contracts like that, Boss. Once the terms are set, they're magically binding.
Huh? What're you writing... H-Hey, Fuyuka, wait!
Fuyuka asks Kaede how to write the Monolith script, then leans over the pact and carefully adds a few words, her face set with determination.
There...! Boss, I-I'll be relying on your guidance...!
Fuyuka... she still seems so tense...==W== What kind of pact is she trying to lock me into?
Uh, let's see...==B== "==PLAYER_NAME== and Fuyuka hereby enter into an apprenticeship"?
Master... ==PLAYER_NAME==, will you be my Master?
I appreciate the thought, Fuyuka, but I have nothing to teach you. You're miles ahead of me as a fighter.
N-Not about fighting! I want to learn about management from you.
You're going to be the guild leader?
Y-Yes. Just now...==W== Nazuna suggested that I should be the one to lead Petal Bloom...
Nazuna said that if someone who was instrumental against the Spirit of Brutality took charge, we'd be on equal footing with that idio—==W==Ah, I mean, Nazuka.
She spends all day at the claw machines, which isn't the best look when new recruits come calling. But she and Kaede promised they'd support me.
Nazuna, you didn't go through all this... just so you can slack off, did you?
Ah, no. Actually, I was the one who decided in the end...
If I'm the leader, then I'll have a reason to ask for your guidance on management.
This way, my connection to ==PLAYER_NAME==, to Boss, doesn't have to end. Right?
Besides...==W== I'm so happy that I'm finally starting to feel a little more confident. I just... I really want to repay you for that.
I don't want our story to be over. I want to give back, even if there isn't much I can do yet.
Whoa, that look in her eyes... She's completely serious. I have to respond with equal sincerity.
Alright. But my training is strict.
That's no problem. No matter what it is, I'll give it my all.
You really mean it. Okay then, our pact is sealed. Let's move forward together, Fuyuka.
Congratulations, Fuyuka. I suppose we'll have to call you Captain from now on.
N-No, please don't! I couldn't ask you to call me that, Kaede...!==W== Just Fuyuka is fine.
Ahaha! All eyes are on you now, Fuyuka. Better start gettin' used to the title!
Sooo...==W== Since that's all settled, how 'bout a party to celebrate taking down the Spirit of Brutality?
Yes! Let's all go out for a big meal and celebrate.
In that case, I'd better pull out all the stops for dinner. ♪
Yay, party time! The Boss and everyone from the New Star Guild are coming too, right?
Oh, you mean Nazuka? It's fine. She likes to do her own thing.
Oh, right. Speaking of Nazuka...==W== Did we technically just steal the hunting squad's kill?
It's fine. As much as that idiot gets on my nerves,==W== she's fair. She wouldn't abuse her authority or try to steal credit.
At the end of the day... Ugh, why are we talking about such a downer? If she wanted to join, she could just ask.
Anyway, c'mon! Let's go get groceries!
Heh. Nazuna says not to talk about Nazuka, but she's the one who won't stop talking about her.
In the end, Fuyuka decides to invite Nazuka, and Nazuna agrees with a reluctant pout.
But ... knowing her, she'll probably just turn us down...==W== So, sorry, but could you go invite her for us, Boss?
She says that, but from what I've seen, Nazuka probably wouldn't refuse if Nazuna herself asked...
As I approach the hunting squad camp, I hear faint voices coming from behind the trees up ahead.
I played only a minor role in defeating the Spirit of Brutality. The real credit belongs to Petal Bloom, the New Star Guild, and that Boss, ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W== Their prowess is impeccable.
However, Claire, even so, do not allow them to join the hunting squad.

strings.text: You eavesdrop on the conversation between Nazuka and Claire, and almost get caught. Nazuka covers for you, hoping you will keep it a secret. Just at that moment, the Garden of Parasite launches an attack...
Hup ... hup! Phew...==W== How deep should I even make this trap?
Every scoop makes it a little bigger... Kinda addicting, hehe.==W== I totally lost track of how deep I was going...
Man, I'm parched. This looks deep enough. Now, time to grab my favorite Monolith drink and scheme up a way to lure the Boss over.
Huh? M-Monsters everywhere! Crap, has the Boss's raid on the Spirit of Brutality already kicked off? I completely missed it.
Hey! My drink! Give it back, you thieves!
A Bark Boar, with the can skewered on its tusk, tears off through the trees. Refusing to surrender her drink, Cosette darts after the fleeing herd...
... leaving behind a massive, unconcealed pit in the quiet forest.
Don't kid me, Nazuka...==W== Petal Bloom and New Star Guild took down the Spirit of Brutality with that small a crew?
It'd be more believable if you said you did it alone.
The battle in the east forest was already raging when I arrived. See for yourself.
Nazuka offers her phone. The screen shows a group of Trekkers from Petal Bloom and New Star Guild, posing victorious before the fallen Spirit of Brutality.
So ...==W== they actually pulled it off. You must have jumped in, right, Nazuka?
I only offered support, using a spell to split the tide of monsters. They defeated the Bark Boar herd and the Spirit of Brutality on their own.
No, that's not what I meant. You know exactly what I'm asking...
The Spirit of Brutality didn't have "that thing" on it.
I can't decide if we're lucky or not...==W== This means we have no choice but to challenge the Garden of Parasite, and we're seriously shorthanded.
Which brings me back to: why not recruit them? They're obviously capable.
Ugh, fine. Forget I said anything. But it's always the same with you, trying to undertake everything yourself. No one's gonna pin a medal on you for it, you know.
Enough. The expedition party isn't expanding. We've discussed the Garden of Parasite—it has to be just you and me.
I'm not on your level, Nazuka. You really think the two of us are enough to handle that thing?
You know about its hallucinogenic mist. More of us would just mean more people would breathe it in and turn on each other. It'd be a senseless waste, and they'd just get in the way.
I get it, I do, but...
Look, I'm not going to force you. I've already figured out its weakness. If you're too scared, I'll go alone.
Dammit, fine, I'm in! Just stop being so difficult.==W== We have to get "that thing"!
... Good. We can't drag anyone else into this. Of the team that covered the retreat last time, we're the only two left. This is ours to face.
Nngh, definitely overheard something I shouldn't have. Better get out of here—
A dagger grazes your cheek and thunks deep into the tree behind you.==W== A startled squirrel drops its acorn and dives into the tree hollow.
Claire flicks her wrist, and the dagger zooms back into her hand.
Can we just find "that thing" already? All this paranoia is going to give me a nervous breakdown.
Heh, you have a point. Getting spooked by a squirrel... Why don't you head back? I'll stay a bit longer to go over our strategy.
Phew, that scared me to death. Good thing they didn't spot me.
==PLAYER_NAME==? Claire's gone now. You can come out. Your stealth skills could use some work.
...==W== I wasn't expecting a dagger thrown at me.
Wait—how long have you known I was here?
From the very beginning. The wind carries all sounds to me, and your footsteps weren't exactly subtle.
I have to admit, your composure is impressive. Facing down Claire's dagger and my wind blade without making a sound... If you'd panicked, I couldn't have covered for you.
More like I was frozen in place...
Oh, right! I'm here to invite you to the Spirit of Brutality victory party. It's at the old Trekkers' House, tonight at seven.
Thanks, but I can't. I need to work on the battle plan against the Garden of Parasite.
But everyone's really hoping you'll be there...
I'm sorry, but celebrations aren't for me.
And ... a favor. If you overheard anything just now,==W== please keep it to yourself.
I'll explain everything to them after we take down the Garden of Parasite.
Of course. You have my word.
Thank you. Let me see you out. The monsters in the forest get restless around this time.
Is she just perceptive, or actually kind?==W== She's not nearly as cold as she seems...==W== So why push everyone away?
T-The Garden of Parasite ambushed the squad! Warn the others!==W== The intel was wrong. Our scout was tricked by an illusion!
Damn it...==W== It was a trap. And this mist...
It's the Garden of Parasite's magic mist! ==PLAYER_NAME==, get down!
Its magic mist...? Does that mean it's already here?!
Aaaah! Monsters ... here?!==W== Don't! Stay back!
==W==The Trekker's face twists in terror as she draws her weapon and lunges at me.
The hallucinations are setting in. To her, we must look like monsters.
You see? The Garden of Parasite uses these illusions to turn its prey against each other, then moves in when they're vulnerable.
So...==W== Here's the plan. If all you can see are monsters, look for me. I'll be the one with leaves swirling clockwise around me.
As for you...==W== Just lie perfectly still. If I spot a monster that isn't moving, I'll know it's you.
This sounds risky...==W== But alright, got it.
I hear the echoes from the valleys and my heart.
Nazuka chants softly once more. This time, she summons not a gale, but a steady current of wind that sweeps through the forest, scattering the purple mist.
Harvest empty souls with a verdant sickle.
Whoa, this wind...! Is she trying to ...==W== clear out the entire forest?
As the wind intensifies, sweat beads on Nazuka's forehead. The gust rages for one minute ... then three ... then five...==W== Until finally, with not a trace of mist left, her staff stops spinning.
Huff ... huff... There...==W== That should ... do it...
Thanks. You saved us. But your Soul Stone...
Ah, it's gray. I'm completely out of magic.==W== But everyone's ... safe now. The mist is gone.
... Huh? What's that sound? It's making my skin crawl.
That's not good. ==PLAYER_NAME==, we need to go. Now!
The Garden of Parasite itself is right here!
After a few steps, a worn-out Nazuka stumbles and collapses. The hulking treant is nearly upon us.
Dammit, at this rate, we're both finished!==W== There has to be something I can do...
Huh? What's that...==W== A pit? Who dug it? Never mind, no time to think about that—
I grab Nazuka's shoulder and, just as the vines lunge for us,==RT==we leap into the pitch-black pit below.

strings.text: To escape the Garden of Parasite, you leap into a pit with Nazuka. When you wake up, you're resting your head on Nazuka's lap, and she tells you about what happened in the past. If only this peaceful moment would last forever.
This is a story from a distant past—==RT==one never recorded in any history book.
Hey, check this out! My latest creation. From now on, this is our secret hideout.
Why are you always so sleepy? We've still got so much to do!
That's the best part!==W== It means we can decorate it ourselves to our heart's content.
Don't lie on the ground like that. You'll catch a cold.
Here. Next time you feel tired, just rest your head on my lap.
Something soft and warm cradles the back of my head.==RT==I close my eyes, drifting into a peaceful dream.
Before that, tell me: what do you see when you look at me? And describe your surroundings...
As for our surroundings... Is that a light up there? Are we in some kind of hole?
Phew... You haven't been affected by the magic mist from the Garden of Parasite. That's a relief.
The Garden of Parasite... Magic mist?
Right, I remember now! We ran into the Garden of Parasite in the forest, so we took refuge in here.
Yeah. I have no idea who dug it, but this pit was a real lifesaver. It's too deep for those vines to reach us.
I see...==W== Wait, how'd I pass out?
A-Ah, well... After you jumped, I kinda ... landed on you.
Oh.==W== So you knocked me out.
I-It wasn't on purpose! A-And I'm not that heavy...!
Hmph... And here I was trying to be nice 'cause I felt bad...
So she isn't always so cold.==W== Maybe ... this is the real Nazuka?
Hey, it's not your fault. In an emergency like that, you can't really worry about the landing.==W== Besides, you'd already burned through all your magic and stamina.
Hang on, what am I lying on?
A soft warmth cradles the back of my head, just like in my dream. It's only then did I realize I'm resting on Nazuka's lap.
I scramble to get up, but Nazuka holds my shoulders down.
I was worried you had hit your head. Just lie down a little longer.
She's definitely worried. That awkward kindness...==W== It's just like Nazuna.
Also ... it'd be a problem for me if you move around. I inhaled some of that mist while casting magic, so right now ... you don't look like yourself to me.
You were poisoned by the mist?!
It's nothing serious. I've been exposed to it before. The effects wear off in about an hour, without lingering effects.
The hallucinations can shift at any second though, so if I look away, my eyes may play another trick on me. With you on my lap, at least I can be sure you are you.
I see...==W== So the lap pillow's actually practical.
Mhm. So it's best we stay like this 'til I've recovered. You wouldn't want me to ... mistake you for a monster, would you?
Definitely not...==W== But now I'm curious. What do I look like to you now? What kind of monster?
Not a monster. A statue.==W== You know the One-Armed Saint at the Philae Museum of Art? Kinda like that, but with your face.
Don't know that one...==W== But if I look like stone, do I feel cold and hard, too?
Mhm. Rough, cold, and hard. The mist from the Garden of Parasite messes with your sense of touch, too.
This must be uncomfortable... And you've been watching over me the whole time?
It's nothing. When you were unconscious, I wasn't even sure if you'd wake up... That was the real worry.
Sorry, couldn't help it.==W== I just never imagined that the serious, combative, and somewhat aloof Nazuka I know had a side like this.
You're actually pretty gentle. And it's unexpectedly endearing that you'd worry about your weight at a time like this.==W== This version of you is pretty approachable.
I feel like you're teasing me.
If you say so. Still, you're pretty relaxed, trying to lighten the mood even now. Do you really understand the severity of our situation?
The Garden of Parasite is still up there waiting for us, we're trapped in this steep hole that could collapse at any second, and my magic is gone, so I can't fly us out.
Hmm... So we really are at a dead end.
Yeah. All we can do is wait for the magic mist to clear, pray this hole doesn't fall in on us, and try to recover some magic. That and nothing else.
I have a friend who smiles in any situation. I once asked her about, and she said—
Smiling or crying, you're still facing the same problem...
So why not smile and feel a little better?
I think she's right. Even if we really are stuck, there's no point being miserable. A sour face won't fix anything.
We might as well smile since crying makes no difference. Interesting...==W== I shall give it a try since we're stuck here.
That's the spirit. On that note, I have a suggestion—
Why don't we use this time to get to know each other?
If we understand each other's strengths and weaknesses, we'll have more tactical options when a crisis hits.
A way to use our time efficiently... That's not a bad idea.==W== Shall I begin?
Come to think of it... ==PLAYER_NAME==, have you actually been inside Philae since you got here?
Huh? I guess we haven't... We've just been going back and forth between the camp and the Trekkers' House.
But what does that have to do with her...?
Then you probably don't know that the One-Armed Saint statue at the Philae Museum of Art is nude.
But nude statues are pretty common for showcasing the human form, aren't they?
Not a monster. A statue. You know the One-Armed Saint at the Philae Museum of Art? Kinda like that, but with your face.
You see me like that too?!==W== Wait, hold on a sec—
Hey! You're messing with me, aren't you?!
Well, someone was making such a big deal about getting "knocked out" earlier. So now we're even.
Holding a grudge over something so silly...==W== Still, it's good that we can joke around like this.
Wait! What about the statue?! You left out the most important part!
Relax... Some part of the One-Armed Saint is clothed, though it's still about 95% exposed.
How is that any different from being completely naked...?!
Steady. The Garden of Parasite is on the move.
The ground shudders violently, as dirt and rock fall from the wall. Nazuka shields me with her body, using the last of her magic to conjure a wind barrier as thin as a cicada's wing.
Thanks...==W== But you don't have to shield me like that. I'm tougher than most people make me out to be.
I... I just can't bear seeing people around me fall into danger.
You can't bear that, huh?==W== Is that why you left Petal Bloom? Even though I don't actually know the whole story.
But you and Nazuna fought so flawlessly together.==W== I don't think that's possible if you really dislike her.
I don't pay much attention to what people say. I care more about what they do.
Keeping something like that to yourself must be agonizing.
This ... has nothing to do with you.
You're right, it doesn't.==W== After all, I'm just a stone statue with Boss's face now.
"A stone statue with Boss's face"...==W== Pfft. What a weird way to put it.
Exactly. I'm just a statue.==W== Your secret's safe with me. I won't tell anyone.
"The One-Armed Saint statue with Boss's face"... You know, that does make you a fitting confidant.
Fine. If you really want to know... Here it goes.
Two months ago, I was covering the expedition party's retreat. And I saw something I was never meant to see.

Yeah. I have no idea who dug it, but this pit was a real lifesaver. It's too deep for those vines to reach us.
I see...==W== Wait, how'd I pass out?
A-Ah, well... After you jumped, I kinda ... landed on you.
Oh.==W== So you knocked me out.
I-It wasn't on purpose! A-And I'm not that heavy...!
Hmph... And here I was trying to be nice 'cause I felt bad...
So she isn't always so cold.==W== Maybe ... this is the real Nazuka?
Hey, it's not your fault. In an emergency like that, you can't really worry about the landing.==W== Besides, you'd already burned through all your magic and stamina.
Hang on, what am I lying on?
A soft warmth cradles the back of my head, just like in my dream. It's only then did I realize I'm resting on Nazuka's lap.
I scramble to get up, but Nazuka holds my shoulders down.
I was worried you had hit your head. Just lie down a little longer.
She's definitely worried. That awkward kindness...==W== It's just like Nazuna.
Also ... it'd be a problem for me if you move around. I inhaled some of that mist while casting magic, so right now ... you don't look like yourself to me.
You were poisoned by the mist?!
It's nothing serious. I've been exposed to it before. The effects wear off in about an hour, without lingering effects.
The hallucinations can shift at any second though, so if I look away, my eyes may play another trick on me. With you on my lap, at least I can be sure you are you.
I see...==W== So the lap pillow's actually practical.
Mhm. So it's best we stay like this 'til I've recovered. You wouldn't want me to ... mistake you for a monster, would you?
Definitely not...==W== But now I'm curious. What do I look like to you now? What kind of monster?
Not a monster. A statue.==W== You know the One-Armed Saint at the Philae Museum of Art? Kinda like that, but with your face.
Don't know that one...==W== But if I look like stone, do I feel cold and hard, too?
Mhm. Rough, cold, and hard. The mist from the Garden of Parasite messes with your sense of touch, too.
This must be uncomfortable... And you've been watching over me the whole time?
It's nothing. When you were unconscious, I wasn't even sure if you'd wake up... That was the real worry.
Sorry, couldn't help it.==W== I just never imagined that the serious, combative, and somewhat aloof Nazuka I know had a side like this.
You're actually pretty gentle. And it's unexpectedly endearing that you'd worry about your weight at a time like this.==W== This version of you is pretty approachable.
I feel like you're teasing me.
If you say so. Still, you're pretty relaxed, trying to lighten the mood even now. Do you really understand the severity of our situation?
The Garden of Parasite is still up there waiting for us, we're trapped in this steep hole that could collapse at any second, and my magic is gone, so I can't fly us out.
Hmm... So we really are at a dead end.
Yeah. All we can do is wait for the magic mist to clear, pray this hole doesn't fall in on us, and try to recover some magic. That and nothing else.
I have a friend who smiles in any situation. I once asked her about, and she said—
Smiling or crying, you're still facing the same problem...
So why not smile and feel a little better?
I think she's right. Even if we really are stuck, there's no point being miserable. A sour face won't fix anything.
We might as well smile since crying makes no difference. Interesting...==W== I shall give it a try since we're stuck here.
That's the spirit. On that note, I have a suggestion—
Why don't we use this time to get to know each other?
If we understand each other's strengths and weaknesses, we'll have more tactical options when a crisis hits.
A way to use our time efficiently... That's not a bad idea.==W== Shall I begin?
Come to think of it... ==PLAYER_NAME==, have you actually been inside Philae since you got here?
Huh? I guess we haven't... We've just been going back and forth between the camp and the Trekkers' House.
But what does that have to do with her...?
Then you probably don't know that the One-Armed Saint statue at the Philae Museum of Art is nude.
But nude statues are pretty common for showcasing the human form, aren't they?
Definitely not...==W== But now I'm curious. What do I look like to you now? What kind of monster?
Not a monster. A statue. You know the One-Armed Saint at the Philae Museum of Art? Kinda like that, but with your face.
You see me like that too?!==W== Wait, hold on a sec—
Hey! You're messing with me, aren't you?!
Well, someone was making such a big deal about getting "knocked out" earlier. So now we're even.
Holding a grudge over something so silly...==W== Still, it's good that we can joke around like this.
Wait! What about the statue?! You left out the most important part!
Relax... Some part of the One-Armed Saint is clothed, though it's still about 95% exposed.
How is that any different from being completely naked...?!
Steady. The Garden of Parasite is on the move.
The ground shudders violently, as dirt and rock fall from the wall. Nazuka shields me with her body, using the last of her magic to conjure a wind barrier as thin as a cicada's wing.
Thanks...==W== But you don't have to shield me like that. I'm tougher than most people make me out to be.
I... I just can't bear seeing people around me fall into danger.
You can't bear that, huh?==W== Is that why you left Petal Bloom? Even though I don't actually know the whole story.
But you and Nazuna fought so flawlessly together.==W== I don't think that's possible if you really dislike her.
I don't pay much attention to what people say. I care more about what they do.
Keeping something like that to yourself must be agonizing.
This ... has nothing to do with you.
You're right, it doesn't.==W== After all, I'm just a stone statue with Boss's face now.
"A stone statue with Boss's face"...==W== Pfft. What a weird way to put it.
Exactly. I'm just a statue.==W== Your secret's safe with me. I won't tell anyone.
"The One-Armed Saint statue with Boss's face"... You know, that does make you a fitting confidant.
Fine. If you really want to know... Here it goes.
Two months ago, I was covering the expedition party's retreat. And I saw something I was never meant to see.

strings.text: For unknown reasons, United Harvest sets its sights on the Big Three, but ends up with a huge loss. Nazuka and Claire are threatened by Lady Gray. To protect her friends, Nazuka decides to bear the full burden herself.
You ... you stopped it. Are we safe now?
Bought us a second, that's all.==W== They'll come at us again. Get ready to fight.
The Blade of Jade likes to dive from above, so I'll use my Ventus magic to knock it off course.
The Spirit of Brutality is slow to turn when it charges—you're quick with that rapier, so you should be able to dodge it, right?
此处应该是持续战斗中的对话
R-Right. But what about the other one?
The Garden of Parasite's mist...==W== Guess we have no choice but to split up.
At least this way, the hallucinations won't make us turn on each other.
It's a long shot, I know. But we just need to hold them off for ten minutes. That's enough time for the wounded to get clear.
Dammit, what the hell am I even doing here... I became a Trekker to get rich, not to die for a cause!
You can feel sorry for yourself when this is over. Get ready!
克莱儿向猛进之灵挑战
Dang it... Listen up, you monsters!
If you want a fight, COME GET ME—AAAAAH!
克莱儿被猛进之灵逼入绝境
Crap, this thing's way faster than I expected!
It's a boss-level monster! Don't underestimate it!
I know that! But I'm not powerful like you!
Oh crap, can't dodge in time!
Nazuka, look! It's reinforcements! We're saved!
Hey! Are you blind?! I'm a person, not a monster!
Black Stork calling Gray Crow, Black Stork calling Gray Crow. All three targets confirmed. Two Trekkers on-site as well.
Shh—Lady Gray Crow doesn't need to be bothered by this. Right, two Trekkers... But we got here too late ... monsters killed 'em. Got it?
They're trying to silence us! Hide, now!
Clever ones. I like that in a prey.
One squad, flush 'em out and kill 'em. The rest of you, prioritize the targets. Getting "that thing" is our objective.
Nazuka, what do we do? We're pinned down by monsters and these mercs. You might be able to fly out, but I'm really...
The Blade of Jade is still circling, and those guys are carrying guns. I can't get out either.
Right, your companions! They said they'd come back for you!
I'd rather they take their time. If they run into these mercenaries, they'll be in danger.
I get that, but ... aren't you afraid of dying?
Of course I am. But the wounded are safe—that's what matters. Trading our two lives for all of theirs… if I had to choose again, I'd still stay behind.
Haha... I... I really don't get it.
Heh. For a nobody like me to die alongside a great Trekker like you... I guess it's not so bad.
Dammit, where are all these monsters coming from?
What the—? The Blade of Jade just multiplied... Dammit! Don't you underestimate us, you filthy monsters!
Huff, huff... Spirit of Brutality... I'm taking you down with me!
What's happening...? Are they killing each other?==W== Ugh...
This mist... When did it reach here?==W== Oh no... It's the magical mist from the Garden of Parasite.
Claire, the mercenaries, and I ... were all poisoned by the magical mist. We started seeing our allies as monsters.
The battlefield was pure chaos. I knocked out the nearest monster and dragged it outside the forest.
I honestly thought I was going to die.
I cut my arm, using the pain to force myself to stay conscious. I barely made it to the edge of the forest. Thankfully, that was where I ran into Nazuna and Kaede. They had come back for me.
I see...==W== But those mercenaries were from United Harvest, right?
They're the ones who posted the commission to neutralize the Big Three. Why did they try to silence you then? To get out of paying the massive reward they promised?
It was for "that thing" the mercenaries mentioned.
The next day, I went back to where the fight happened, but nobody was seen, not even a drop of blood. It was as if those mercenaries in beak masks had never been there.
They cleaned it up that thoroughly in just a day?==W== "That thing" must be highly confidential.
You catch on quick. Just what I'd expect from the Boss who led the fight against the Spirit of Brutality.
When I got back from the forest, there was a letter on the desk in my room. Then Claire found me, holding an identical one.
You're "Gray Crow," I presume? If you have a commission, you should've gone through the Trekker Association.
You may call me Lady Gray.==W== As for the Association... A fair request, but I couldn't exactly reach you through them.
Because the Trekkers' House outside Philae will be shut down tonight.

It's simple, really. We expected results from the hefty bounty we offered, yet their hunting squad couldn't even take down a single monster. An Association branch that is useless has no reason to exist.
But you two... You walked out of that mess without a scratch. On behalf of United Harvest, I want you to form a new squad and neutralize the Big Three.
Like hell I'm working with someone who almost got me killed.
Hmph. A misunderstanding. My foolish subordinates acted without my authorization, and paid for their insolence with their lives.
So you did hire those thugs! And now you're blaming them? Who's gonna fall for that?!
Heh. I'm merely telling you how things ended for them. I trust that two people resourceful enough to survive such a dire situation can make a wise decision.
Ha! You hear that? Nazuka said we're not gonna—==W==wait, what?! Are you listening to yourself?
Dorra, supplies, weapons, magic scrolls... Name your price. I have only one demand: exterminate the three monsters.
We have a demand of our own.
What is "that thing" you're really after?==RT==What is it you expect to find from those monsters?
I'm guessing Lady Gray never told you what "that thing" actually is.
All she said was, "It's something you'd never find on a monster. You'll know it when you see it."
The next morning, a deposit slip of Deepsea Finance for ten million Dorra was delivered to me, and Claire received a weapons shipment—enough to arm a hundred.
More like a warning than anything.

A battlefield that clean ... means they have the manpower.==W== The letter proves they can get into your room.==W== Shutting down the Trekkers' House cuts off your allies.==W== The money and weapons are a power play.
So that's why you left Petal Bloom...
… and distanced yourself from Nazuna and Kaede.
You were trying to keep them out of harm.
Yes. Claire and I were already in too deep. There's no escape.
If we're heading up a new hunting squad with huge rewards and plenty of supplies, Trekkers will be lining up to join.
But Nazuna and Kaede know me too well... They'd see right through me and jump in without a second thought.
==PLAYER_NAME==, if we make it out of here... Could you keep this between us?
I'm a mere statue. Can't really make promises.
Oh, sorry. The effect actually wore off halfway through our conversation.
Ah, it did? Ahem...==W== Well, I seem to be fine, then.
Relax. No symptoms by now means you weren't poisoned by the Garden of Parasite.
The hole's collapsing! Come on, I'll fly us out of here!
Nazuka grabs my hand. Her Soul Stone, though dim, flickers with the little light it just gathered. A pale green wind gently lifts us, carrying us slowly upward.
You know, you didn't say an incantation this time.
Incantation?==W== Oh, that's just for vibes… A personal quirk of mine. I like to chant a little something when I cast spells.
But more importantly… I'm sorry, but I didn't recover enough magic. I'm afraid I can't get both of us out of here.
Don't worry. I still have enough to get you out. So, don't forget your promise to me—
Amidst the falling rocks and dirt, Nazuka lets go of my hand. She directs the last of her wind to push me toward the opening as she begins to fall.
Let go! If you don't, you won't make it out either!
We won't know unless we try!
I reach desperately for the opening, trying to grab hold of the rocky edge.
My fingertips brush against the damp earth, but all I catch are a few flimsy roots.
The magic is exhausted. The pale green wind dissipates, and the light from the opening shrinks away.
A small hand grabs my wrist, and a familiar figure appears at the opening.
Phew... Made it just in time. That's a relief.
Talk about perfect timing.==W== By the way, how did you even find this hidden hole?
Hehe… Because the bond between Master and me is unbreakable.
Here. You forgot your spare Soul Stone at the Old Trekkers' House.
Thanks.==W== Did you run into the Garden of Parasite?
Based on the tracks, it must have fled deeper into the forest.
I'm so glad everyone's okay,==W== but we've used up way too much magic. How about we fall back to the camp and recover?
Wise call.==W== Knowing when to rest is part of the strategy.==W== Well then, I'll—
I'm the captain of the hunting squad. I have to make sure all my people made it out safely.
I see...==W== Right. You're the captain, after all.
Don't worry. Thanks to ==PLAYER_NAME==, I'm not hurt. The spare Soul Stone you brought is fully charged, so no monster's getting to me.
Before turning to leave, Nazuka gives me a slight nod—silently reminding me of the promise I never actually made.
I'll keep her secret, but I have to protect her.
This isn't something that can be determined using logic alone.
Should I tell everyone or not?
Nazuka opened up to me because she trusts me. I have to honor that...
She should be the one to tell Nazuna and Kaede herself.
The look on her face when she left... It was like she'd made up her mind.
My power might not be much on its own, but it's still something. Besides, that mist doesn't affect me.
I never actually gave my word... So it doesn't really count as a promise.
Sorry, Nazuka.==W== This is my call to make as the Boss.

strings.text: Nazuka vanishes without a trace, along with the Garden of Parasite. You've never given up searching for her. Years later, you venture deep into the forest once more, only to uncover a terrifying truth...
I've asked a bunch of Trekkers. No one's seen her.
Same with the ones at the camp entrance. Not a peep.
I-I checked with the new expedition party. Claire hasn't been able to reach Nazuka since yesterday.
Her tent hasn't been touched.==W== She ... didn't come back last night, did she? Where on earth could she be...?
Hey, let's not jump to the worst-case scenario. Nazuka's strong, she'll be fine...==W== Still, where would she have gone?
Everyone, stay calm.==W== We are already searching the forest. I'm sure we'll hear something soon.
We try to reassure one another, but the worry==RT==is written plainly on all our faces.
Sorry to disappoint.==W== I take it there's still no word on Nazuka?
Yeah. We were out all night. Not a single trace.
Master and the New Star Guild drove to the nearby cities to ask around. Maybe ... they'll find something.
I don't think... Nazuka would just leave Philae.
But you were always with her! How can you possibly not know anything?
That doesn't mean we know everything about each other. Besides... A half-baked Trekker like me could never understand a powerhouse like her.
Anyway, I just wanted to give you a heads-up: there's been no sign of the Garden of Parasite in the forest for days.
Nazuka...==W== The Garden of Parasite...==W== No way.
Nazuka senpai...! You don't think she went after the Garden of Parasite by herself?
Let's widen the search, give the forest another look.
You have some really good friends.
I finally get ... why you wanted to protect them so badly.
It's impossible to find that thing now. I should just get out of here.
No matter how hard I fight it, I can't outsmart that bunch.
The endless rain has washed away any possible trace of Nazuka in the forest.==RT==After a month of searching, we have no choice but to stop—for now.
Before we know it, Trekkers are praising Nazuka as==RT=="the valor who risked her life to take down the Garden of Parasite."
However, as time passes and faces change...
... the "Big Three" become just another camp legend.==RT==Eventually, few people even remember Nazuka's name.
The new expedition disbands. A Trekker saw Claire taken away==RT==by mercenaries in black, but no one knew who they were.
With them, all leads on Serena and the Ash Orphanage also vanished.
The New Star Guild and I work as Trekkers in Philae, occasionally traveling to other cities.
But no matter how far we go, we return here this time every year to search for Nazuka.
There haven't been many monsters in the forest lately, so we can take it a little easier.
Got it. We'll take the east side.
Alright, let's meet back here in three days. Hopefully, we can find a clue about Nazuka's whereabouts this time.
Phew, where are we? All these trees look identical.
Especially after a rain. The paths get overrun, and the trees seem to change overnight... It's easy to get lost.==W== Thank goodness we have Noya—
Mmm-hmm... This is it. This is where ==PLAYER_NAME== and Nazuka fell into a hole back then.
That's amazing. How did you find this place?
Just a gut feeling! Followed my gut, and it led me right here.
That's incredible.==W== Alright, let's spread out and start searching.
By the way, Boss, I'm not picking up on any monsters, but I have seen traces of mimic vines all along the trail. Please be cautious.
That's what the Garden of Parasite's made of.
Normally, mimic vines are just like any other shrub, not aggressive at all. If the soil's not great or they lack sunlight, they'll copy a passing animal to move to a better environment.
