param: Nazuka vanishes without a trace, along with the Garden of Parasite. You've never given up searching for her. Years later, you venture deep into the forest once more, only to uncover a terrifying truth...
I've asked a bunch of Trekkers. No one's seen her.
Same with the ones at the camp entrance. Not a peep.
I-I checked with the new expedition party. Claire hasn't been able to reach Nazuka since yesterday.
Her tent hasn't been touched.==W== She ... didn't come back last night, did she? Where on earth could she be...?
Hey, let's not jump to the worst-case scenario. Nazuka's strong, she'll be fine...==W== Still, where would she have gone?
Everyone, stay calm.==W== We are already searching the forest. I'm sure we'll hear something soon.
We try to reassure one another, but the worry==RT==is written plainly on all our faces.
Sorry to disappoint.==W== I take it there's still no word on Nazuka?
Yeah. We were out all night. Not a single trace.
Master and the New Star Guild drove to the nearby cities to ask around. Maybe ... they'll find something.
I don't think... Nazuka would just leave Philae.
But you were always with her! How can you possibly not know anything?
That doesn't mean we know everything about each other. Besides... A half-baked Trekker like me could never understand a powerhouse like her.
Anyway, I just wanted to give you a heads-up: there's been no sign of the Garden of Parasite in the forest for days.
Nazuka...==W== The Garden of Parasite...==W== No way.
Nazuka senpai...! You don't think she went after the Garden of Parasite by herself?
Let's widen the search, give the forest another look.
You have some really good friends.
I finally get ... why you wanted to protect them so badly.
It's impossible to find that thing now. I should just get out of here.
No matter how hard I fight it, I can't outsmart that bunch.
The endless rain has washed away any possible trace of Nazuka in the forest.==RT==After a month of searching, we have no choice but to stop—for now.
Before we know it, Trekkers are praising Nazuka as==RT=="the valor who risked her life to take down the Garden of Parasite."
However, as time passes and faces change...
... the "Big Three" become just another camp legend.==RT==Eventually, few people even remember Nazuka's name.
The new expedition disbands. A Trekker saw Claire taken away==RT==by mercenaries in black, but no one knew who they were.
With them, all leads on Serena and the Ash Orphanage also vanished.
The New Star Guild and I work as Trekkers in Philae, occasionally traveling to other cities.
But no matter how far we go, we return here this time every year to search for Nazuka.
There haven't been many monsters in the forest lately, so we can take it a little easier.
Got it. We'll take the east side.
Alright, let's meet back here in three days. Hopefully, we can find a clue about Nazuka's whereabouts this time.
Phew, where are we? All these trees look identical.
Especially after a rain. The paths get overrun, and the trees seem to change overnight... It's easy to get lost.==W== Thank goodness we have Noya—
Mmm-hmm... This is it. This is where ==PLAYER_NAME== and Nazuka fell into a hole back then.
That's amazing. How did you find this place?
Just a gut feeling! Followed my gut, and it led me right here.

strings.text: Worried about Nazuka, you chase after her alone. Nazuka is deliberately waiting for you. In the dim forest, you come to know each other more deeply.
Why don't you guys go back first?==W== I need some time alone in the forest.
Are you sure?==W== It's getting dark, and the forest can be dangerous.
Ah ==W==...==W== well ...==W== I need to sort out my thoughts. A moment alone would help.
I-==W==Is there something on my face?
Alright then, Iris, Amber, let's go.
Don't worry. My gut feeling says ==PLAYER_NAME== has something important to do,==W== and ==SEX=='ll be perfectly safe.
With a quick nod to the group, I head off in the direction Nazuka has left.
I never noticed it when I was travelling with Noya and the others...
But now that I'm alone, all these trees look exactly the same. It's getting dark too. I've totally lost my way, haven't I?
What's that sound... Could it be a monster?
Ugh, feels like someone's watching me.==W== I should hide ... maybe behind those bushes.
Phew. It should be safe here.
Yikes! I'm done for!==W== The monster spotted me, and I'm toast!
Wait... It's you, Nazuka?==W== You gave me a fright.
What brings you to wander the forest alone at this hour?==W== I've been observing you from the treetop for quite some time.
Should've got down sooner then, shouldn't you?==W== I came looking for you.
Yep. I'm here to help.==W== Rest assured, I kept the secret to myself.
I appreciate it,==W== but I'm just checking if the squad has withdrawn. I can handle this myself.
Even though I'm a bit lost right now, I know enough to tell==W== that this isn't anywhere==W== near where the squad would be.
You're actually ...==W== after the Garden of Parasite, right? Not the hunting squad.
You're pretty sharp at figuring people out. Starting to live up to that Boss reputation.
It wasn't exactly a tough puzzle. The Garden of Parasite's magic mist warps the minds of those who inhale it.
With too many people joining the hunt,==W== it would be impossible==W== to tell friend from foe.
And knowing you, your only solution for this would be==W== to fight the Garden of Parasite==W== by yourself.
Right now, the Garden of Parasite hasn't gone far,==W== and everyone else has already pulled out of the forest.
For you, this is the perfect opportunity to hunt alone.
If you knew, why did you still rush over?==W== You're a skilled commander, but I've never seen you fight using magic.
Well, I have a unique condition.==W== Ever heard of "magic immunity"?
You're saying you can neither use nor be affected by magic,==W== making you immune to the Garden of Parasite's mist?
I'm still vulnerable==W== to toxins that are physical or biological in nature.
But the magic mist just doesn't seem==W== to work on me.
When we were in the hole, I felt perfectly normal,==W== and I never did experience any illusions.
Then how did you pass out?
That was from a heavy physical impact!
My apologies...==W== Am I really that heavy?
Well, this condition of mine is pretty useful against the Garden of Parasite,==W== since I won't get confused about who's who.
Useful for a commander, indeed.==W== Though==W== your entire army consists of just me right now.
Ah, you've got a point there...
So I'm still going to have to say no.==W== Since it's so late, we should camp here in the woods.
Oh, still a no... Have I messed up your hunting plans?
Not at all.==W== I'd have been setting up camp at this hour anyway.
Pushing through the forest in the dark would be inefficient.==W== Better to get a good night's rest, and I'll escort you out first thing tomorrow.
I follow Nazuka until we come upon a cabin in the woods, where we kindle a cozy fire.
But instead of staying put, Nazuka takes me to a shady area away from the cabin.
Why aren't we staying inside?==W== I thought ... monsters usually avoid fire.
Well, while that's true for most forest monsters, the Garden of Parasite is different.
It's actually drawn to light sources after dark.
You see, the Garden of Parasite wasn't born naturally.
Based on my research, it originated from a common monster called mimic vine.
Mimic vine is normally just a small, magic-infused carnivorous plant, no taller than a bush,==W== that feeds on insects landing on its vines.
When its food becomes scarce,==W== it shapeshifts into suitably-sized creatures it has touched to relocate for food.==W== That's why it's called "mimic."
Regular mimic vines are harmless to Trekkers, but this Garden of Parasite one overgrew.==W== The magic mist that once helped it escape now serves as a weapon for hunting.
Now I understand.==W== It's still following its basic mimic vine nature. Therefore...
Light at night signals food,==W== drawing the monster toward it!
Precisely. We're using the cabin as a lure.
You've mapped this out since the beginning? And here I thought you'd just charge in alone.
Oh? Offering your lap again?==W== Such generosity.
Don't be ridiculous! I need to test some magic—
O' leaves that with the wild wind play, to an armor of sturdiness, I pray!
Perfect. This will do the trick.
This armor of wind will protect you until sunrise. At the minimum, it'll help you take a few hits.
Magic shouldn't work on me, so why is this...
C-==W==Could I borrow your hand for a second?
I remember Iris casting a magic like this before,==W== though I wasn't aware of my special nature at the time...
It's simple. I wasn't using the magic on you.
I may not be able to use it on you, but applying Wind Armor to your clothes works fine.
Unless your outfit is immune to magic, too? Either way, you'll get the same protection.
Huh, that's actually clever.==W== Most people wouldn't have thought of enhancing clothes with magic...
The Spirit of Brutality already discovered this trick and made itself a full suit of armor.
Magic is a very precise art.==W== Even slight adjustments to how you cast can completely transform a spell's effect.
Though Nazuka's voice is barely above a whisper, every word comes through crystal clear.
Is the wind ...==W== delivering your voice to me?
Actually, no. I'm using the Wind Wall spell.
Wind Wall?==W== What does that have to do with sound?
What I did was create a tube-shaped Wind Wall connecting my mouth to your ear.
It's transparent, and in this darkness, it's completely invisible.
You made a speaking tube out of wind... That's incredible.
That's right, magic is versatile like that.
So stop worrying about me—whether I can beat the Garden of Parasite or not, I'll find my way back.
Time to sleep. I've got the wind standing guard.
With skills like yours, why didn't you take a company job? Why be a Trekker instead?
I've ... always admired that sculpture—==W==the one of the hero who sacrificed herself to save others.
Okay, bedtime for me. No more talking.
Does Nazuka mean ... the One-Armed Saint?
Cradled by the evening wind, fatigue soon carries me off to sleep.
Huh? Is it the Garden of Parasite?
Yes.==W== Everyone else is here too.
The Garden of Parasite sneaked into that cabin and has stayed inside since dawn.
I knew I couldn't fight while keeping you safe, so I contacted Petal Bloom backup.
Hmph,==W== was starting to think you'd deleted all your contacts.
So here we all are,==W== ready to help.
Well...==W== The hunting squad noticed us coming into the forest and ... followed us here.
Wait just a minute!==W== "Followed"?==W== Excuse you—Nazuka is a member of the hunting squad, so it's only natural that we get to take on the Garden of Parasite she discovered first.
No,==W== I want to take on the Garden of Parasite myself.==W== The mist is no joke. More of us will only create chaos.
Still, going solo is way too risky.==W== At least let us provide backup from the perimeter.
Nah, let us handle it.==W== Petal Bloom has practiced dealing with the Garden of Parasite's mist==W== like forever.==W== We won't mistake friend from foe.
You people...==W== This prey belongs to the hunting squad,==W== and I've brought my elite members with me.
Back during the Spirit of Brutality hunt,==W== Boss proved to be a top-notch commander.
Let's have ==SEX4== make the call.==W== Everyone okay with that?
Fine by me if Boss decides.==W== You're gonna pick Petal Bloom, right?
Ugh, giving opportunities to others again.==W== Boss,==W== you'll consider all options fairly, won't you?
Let Petal Bloom fight with Nazuka
I should trust Nazuka's judgment on this one.
Given the nature of the mist,==W== having Nazuka handle this alone might be our best option.
Everyone, form a wide circle around the area.==W== Offer ranged support and standby for backup.
Boss, I knew you'd make the right call.
I think==W== having Petal Bloom team up with Nazuka is our best bet against the Garden of Parasite.
You worked great together against the Spirit of Brutality.==W== For monsters like this, shouldn't we maximize our strength?
I'll make an exception and work with them.
Are you serious,==W== Boss? You know how dangerous that mist is.
Under my command,==W== we can minimize the mist's influence.==W== Everyone, tap your phones with mine.
Though I agreed to support Boss's decision...==W== But...==W== Fine, let's proceed as planned.
Taking on such a dangerous monster alone is too risky.==W== I won't accept any casualties or sacrifices.
A competition it is then?==W== Alright...==W== Squad members,==W== prepare==W== for battle!

strings.text: You keep your promise, but follow closely behind Nazuka with the guild. The reluctant Nazuka has no choice but to admit that she planned to defeat the Garden of Parasite alone. You use the cabin in the forest to create a "decoy."
Why do you keep following me around?
Pfft, we're not following you... We're here for Boss.
Boss wanted to take a walk, and you just happened to be going the same way.
Oh really?==W== Even when I purposely doubled back on my path?
I was simply in the mood to take a different path at that exact moment.
==PLAYER_NAME==, I mean, Boss, I need a word with you.
What happened to your promise? Didn't we have an agreement?
Well, technically, I never agreed to anything,==W== and even if I had, I haven't broken any promises.
I haven't told them anything about that.
Then why are you and they following me around?
To help you take down the Garden of Parasite, of course.
I never said I was going to do that...
However, you're heading away from where the hunting squad was stationed.
Ugh, I guess that cover story was too sloppy...
The issue isn't the cover story. I figured someone as thorough as you would reach out to Claire first to verify the squad's entry and exit numbers—
You saw right through me...==W== I really am terrible at lying.
True. Honestly, the Nazuka I met in the pit felt more approachable.==W== Have you considered showing that side more often?
I won't budge on this. The person you see now is the real me.
Sorry for lying. You must know by now that checking on the hunting squad wasn't my real reason for leaving.
Actually, before we parted ways, I had already confirmed with Claire that all squad members had made it out safely.
Talks about not budging, but still apologizes sincerely. Classic Nazuka.
Then why are you heading into the woods after dark?==W== It can't just be "taking a walk," right?
My plan is to take down the Garden of Parasite by myself.
By yourself? Are you kidding me? Taking down the Garden of Parasite at night?
Correct. This presents the perfect chance.
Today's encounter helped me locate its position. That thing has surely exhausted much of its magic.
The primary advantage is that all Trekkers have withdrawn, so we won't have to worry about casualties.
Besides, we're too close to the campsite. Should the Garden of Parasite slip in and spread magical mist, we'd be in big trouble. It must be handled promptly.
Even so, fighting at night is way too dangerous.
I acknowledge the risk. Which is precisely why I've set up a bait for it.
Light flickers to life in the humble forest cabin as we conceal ourselves in the shadows nearby, gripping our weapons tightly.
So the cabin's the bait?==W== But from what I know, most monsters avoid fire. Wouldn't the lights drive them away?
For the majority of monsters, sure, but the Garden of Parasite is different. Nazuka's plan is really clever.
The Garden of Parasite was originally a monster unique to Philae—the mimic vine, a carnivorous plant that preys on insects. Even though its form has changed, its habits remain the same.
As its name suggests, it's highly skilled at mimicking nearby creatures. If its food becomes scarce, it'll crawl to somewhere with more resources.
That actually sounds kind of cute.
While that may have been the case with regular mimic vines, this Garden of Parasite has grown beyond natural constraints. It has no more natural predators.
What's most concerning is that its defensive magic mist has evolved into a hunting tool.
Hunting?==W== Ah, now I get it! A lit cabin means potential prey, and that prey is...
Exactly. The Garden of Parasite should be nearby. This ambush position gives us our best chance at capturing it.
The Garden of Parasite... How tough could it be, I'm curious~
Wh-Why do you sound so excited about this?
Hmm... Not sure I follow,==W== but anyway... Will you all help me with this?
I missed what you said. Mind saying it again?
Someone needs to stand guard tonight. I'll take the first shift.
Alright, I'm gonna hit the hay now, if you don't mind.
With a resigned expression, Nazuka conjures a green wind and springs up to the highest branch.
Boss? Isn't it a bit early for a shift change?
Not here to change shift. I just couldn't sleep and was taking a walk.
Honestly... You should try to rest even if you can't sleep. Combat could break out at any moment.
A little chat counts as a break, too.
By the way... You did properly ask everyone for help earlier.==W== I was expecting you to be way more stubborn about it.
T-That wasn't asking for help!==W== Nazuna and the others would've followed anyway, even if I refused. Better to take charge than let you all run wild... Pure tactical decision.
But what about you—you haven't told them, have you?
No, don't worry. Although I think...
They might appear carefree, but Nazuna and the others are pretty sharp. How far do you think you can keep it from them with how strange you're acting?
I'm keeping it secret for as long as I can.==W== Let's focus on the Garden of Parasite for now.
From the fight against the Spirit of Brutality, you don't seem to be good with magic. When the Garden of Parasite arrives, I'll hide you somewhere safe. Is that okay?
I'm not just bad at it. I literally can't use any magic.
"Magic immunity"... I've never heard of such a thing.
So yeah, I can't use magic, and magic doesn't work on me either.
Of course, if the Garden of Parasite's mist is physical or biological in nature, I'm still vulnerable. But since it's magic, I'm totally immune.
No need to worry too much about me. Actually, I'm probably the most qualified person to command operations in the mist.
And who exactly was unconscious in that hole earlier?
That was from a heavy physical impact—
Hmph... Excuse me for being so heavy then.
Setting that aside... You've got quite the edge when facing the Garden of Parasite.
Wait a second—if you're immune to magic, what happens if I use magic to enchant a wooden arrow and shoot it at you?
Then I'd get hurt.==W== Well, I'm only immune to magic effects themselves, not the actual physical impact of the arrow.
Why? You're not thinking of ... trying out some new moves on me, right?
What kind of person do you think I am? I'm just testing some magic—
O' leaves that with the wild wind play—
—to an armor of sturdiness, I pray!
Perfect. This will do the trick.
I've created a basic wind armor for you. At minimum, it'll help you take a few hits from the Garden of Parasite.
How are you able to use magic on me?
Could I==W== ... borrow your hand for a second?
I remember Iris casting a magic like this before, though I wasn't aware of my special nature at the time...
It's simple. I wasn't using the magic on you.
I may not be able to use it on you, but applying Wind Armor to your clothes works fine. Unless your outfit is immune to magic, too? Either way, you'll get the same protection.
This should keep you safe from flying debris in battle.
So the magic Iris cast on me back then worked the same way.
That's really clever. With magic skills like yours, you could easily land a job at any major company.
Maybe you're right, but all I ever wanted was to be a Trekker.
I've ... always admired that statue—==RT==the one of the hero who sacrificed everything to save others.
Ah, it's you, Boss. Then I'll leave you guys to it and catch some more Z's.
Get back here. No slacking off!
Nazuna ducks under the branch and slips away, with Nazuka chasing after her, leaving me standing there lost in thought.
The hero... Does Nazuka mean the One-Armed Saint?
As dawn breaks after a peaceful night, Nazuka's bait finally attracts the "big fish" she has been waiting for.
A purple mist envelops the cabin. Under its cover, the Garden of Parasite slips inside, and the lights go out.
However, the unexpected appearance of the hunting squad throws a wrench in Nazuka's plan.
Nazuka, why are you acting alone? We've all been worried sick about you.
You know as well as I do about the Garden of Parasite's magic mist, Claire. The fewer people involved in this operation, the better.
Even so, you should have stayed with the hunting squad, not them... And don't forget, you're still the captain.
Alright, thanks to everyone's hard work last night. The hunting squad will take it from here.
Whoa, don't mess this up! The Garden of Parasite's a tough one to deal with. Have you ever prepped for this kind of fight?
Of course we have. Our training was personally overseen by Nazuka.
I... I think I should fight it by myself. It's the most effective way to minimize the magic mist's influence.
Still... Working solo is way too risky, even for you, Nazuka.
This debate is going in circles.==W== Let's have Boss make the call.
No objections to that, I assume? Back during the Spirit of Brutality hunt, ==SEX== proved to be a top-notch commander.
Fine by me if Boss decides, but please let Petal Bloom join.
Fine then.==W== Boss is the CEO after all, the highest-ranking person here. I'll respect your decision.
This is quite a responsibility to suddenly drop in my lap...
Let Petal Bloom fight with Nazuka
What would be the most effective tactic?
I should trust Nazuka's judgment on this one. She's already put in an awkward spot.
Given the nature of the mist, having Nazuka handle this alone might be our best option.
However, everyone, form a wide circle around the area. Offer ranged support and standby for backup.
Boss, I knew you'd make the right call.
I think having Petal Bloom team up with Nazuka is our best bet against the Garden of Parasite.
You worked great together against the Spirit of Brutality.==W== If you can recreate that synergy, more allies would definitely increase our chances against this monster, wouldn't you agree?
I understand. We'll do it your way, Boss.
Master, I'll do my best to support Nazuka senpai.
Petal Bloom, let's do this. We're taking down the Garden of Parasite!
Under my command, we can minimize the mist's influence. Everyone, tap your phones with mine.
Your immunity does make this our best option...==W== But are you absolutely sure about this?
I want to take the safest approach against a threat this severe. Keeping all of you safe is my top priority.
All right,==W== I trust your judgment.

strings.text: Trusting Nazuka's abilities, you decide to let her hunt the Garden of Parasite alone. She suppresses the monster and is preparing to burn it down. However, Claire blocks the path, acting on her company mission.
Boss, I'm at the cabin.==W== No signs of the Garden of Parasite. Moving on with the search.==W== Over.
Copy that.==W== Remote support Trekkers are standing by, ready on your mark.==W== Over.
I saw that massive tree crawl into the cabin with my own eyes...
Hold on,==W== we've got it wrong. The Garden of Parasite isn't actually a tree, just mimicking one.==W== It could transform back into vines and conceal itself anywhere—
A gust of greenish wind tears off the roof, as countless vines==RT==writhe out from the wall cracks, merging into a giant tree.
Clever concealment, but—==W==sneak attacks don't work on the wind.
Hey, the Garden of Parasite has shown itself!==W== Call the shot, Boss.
Hold on.==W== Nazuka hasn't given the signal yet.
Vice-captain Claire,==W== how many in the hunting squad can use fire?
Hmm...==W== A couple.==W== What's on your mind?
Just had a thought—==W==sure, the Garden of Parasite is drawn to fire, but it's still a plant.==W== Haven't you tried using fire against it?
I see your point ...==W== but fire's a no-go.==W== Burning mimic vines creates a ton of mist.
That's the signal! Everyone, focus fire on the Garden of Parasite!==W== Ready,==W==<size=48> fire—</size>
Main branch down.==W== Press the attack.
Nazuka...==W== Is she really gonna be okay out there alone?
No sweat.==W== She's keeping perfect distance,==W== and that clumsy tree is too slow to catch her while she's riding the wind==W==.
With all her preparation,==W== Nazuka must have figured out its attack patterns completely.
Still==W==...==W== This hunt is a little too effortless.
Don't let up!==W== We've almost got it.
BOSS, monsters! They're charging from behind!
There are so many of them...==W== When did they gather? We're surrounded!
Master, please stay behind me.==W== There's something strange about these monsters.
Even the docile shrubshrews are coming at us.
<size=48>Hey! How dare you chew on my sword!</size>==W== What's wrong with these creatures?
I don't think they're attacking us. Looks more like they're ...==W== looking for food.
Did the Garden of Parasite's mist get these monsters too?==W== Ugh,==W== but wasn't it trapped inside the cabin?
Perhaps it sent out vines to release the mist.
Hate to admit it ...==W== but these monsters are pretty sneaky.
Noya, complaining won't help. We need to get away from them now.
Sorry, but you heard what's happening here.==W== We can't send backup right now.
I'll be fine.==W== Take care of yourselves.
I was always prepared—==W==<size=48>to fight it alone!</size>
What's going on? The Garden of Parasite is breaking its branches on purpose?==W== Wait...==W== It's channeling its magic to the buds.
A massive wave of magic mist surges from the Garden of Parasite's branches,==RT==enveloping Nazuka completely.
This old trick again? Won't work this time.==W== There's no one else here to confuse.
I don't want to die... Help me... Please, help me...
I just want to go back to my friends...
What...?! Human voices?==W== That can't be right, there's no one else here.
The Garden of Parasite ...==W== speaking?==W== No, that's even more unlikely...==W== Common monsters don't speak...
<size=48>Ah?!</size>==W== Get it together...==W== This is clearly an illusion.
Why...==W== Why were you the only survivor?
Why didn't you help us ...==W== back then?
You failed to protect us...==W== What makes you think you can protect your new companions...
I can't get distracted now...==W== I have to ...==W== keep fighting...
No, it's not. It's your phone.==W== Check your phone.
My phone...==W== Wait,==W== why is there sound coming from a drink can? Why am I holding a can?
Wait,==W== this is an illusion... I'm holding my phone...==W== The sound is coming through the speaker, and on the other end is ...==W== Boss.
How are you doing, Nazuka?==W== We've taken care of most monsters here. You need a hand?
Having a few illusions, but ...==W== I haven't lost sight of the Garden of Parasite.
Aim fire magic roughly twenty steps in front of where I'm standing.
Wait, Claire warned us this would trigger more magic mist,==W== and you're dangerously close.
Don't worry about that. I can blow away the mist with wind.==W== Boss, focus on incinerating the Garden of Parasite.
This thing isn't some average monster anymore. We have to reduce it to ashes.
Understood!==W== Everyone, cast fire spells twenty steps in front of Nazuka's position.
Trees, split. Let the mountains tremble—
Why is there a shrubshrew near the Garden of Parasite...==W==?
Wait,==W== that's no shrubshrew—==W==that's a Trekker charging in!
No!==W== They'll be hit by the fire magic at that distance.==W== I have to shield them!
The emerald wind barrier instantly shifts direction, enveloping==RT==the Garden of Parasite's treetop and blocking the incoming Ignis magic.
Cough, cough...==W== Are you alright?==W== Why did you rush in—
Claire?==W== What are you doing here?
<size=48>Nazuka,==W== are you out of your mind?!</size>==W== If you'd torched that thing,==W== we would've all gone up in smoke with it!
You're the one who's lost it. Get out of here, now!
H-Hold on? What's happening?==W== Did the Garden of Parasite just ...==W== speak?
Magic mist pours out from the Garden of Parasite's buds==RT==once again, swiftly consuming the woods around us.
We can't keep fighting like this...==W== Time to retreat.
Noya, Amber, Iris,==W== could you clear a path for us?
Nazuna,==W== Fuyuka,==W== let's go get Nazuka.
Been waiting for that order. Let's get moving!

Noya, Amber, Iris,==W== could you clear a path for us?
Nazuna,==W== Fuyuka,==W== let's go get Nazuka.
Been waiting for that order. Let's get moving!

strings.text: You trust the bond between Nazuka and Petal Bloom and let them fight together. Their cooperation remains skillful and successful. However, Claire blocks their path, acting on her company mission.
Fuyuka blasts the cabin door open with a punch.==RT==Nazuna and Kaede file in, expertly covering different angles.
Right side's clear.==W== How's your side, Nazuna?
But that can't be... We saw the Garden of Parasite slip in here.
No matter its size, the Garden of Parasite is just a big mimic vine at heart. And as a vine, it can change its shape.
Lots of cracks in the wall. Pretty normal for a rundown shack, no?
It would be, but a lot of these cracks are fresh.
If the Garden of Parasite dropped its disguise and reverted to vine form, slipping through cracks this size wouldn't be a problem.
No, that's not right. If it were hunting and found nothing, it would've just left. Why bother with such a tricky escape,==W== unless it was trying to—
So, it learned to flank. Smarter than I gave you credit for, huh?
Heh, same old trick? Not gonna work on me twice!
Sounds like the fight's kicked off at the cabin. ==PLAYER_NAME==, we're not just gonna watch, are we?
Have a little faith. Nazuka and Petal Bloom know these monsters better than anyone.
Doesn't mean we're off the hook, though. A fight this big will draw more monsters. Our job is to hold the line so nothing gets through to them.
Got it. Noya and I are on it—==W==Huh? Amber, what's wrong?
Where did all these things come from?!==W== Hey! Knock it off, I'm not on the menu—!
These monsters are behaving strangely. Usually, they'd run from a group of people this big, yet they're now charging right at us...
And the Bark Boars, too. They're docile creatures, but look at them now... They're acting ... feral.
They must have been exposed to the Garden of Parasite's magic mist. We probably just look like food to them.
Oh, that's why they went after Claire—==W==Ack! Get off my hat!
We have to push them back. Whatever happens, we can't let them interfere with Nazuka's fight.
No... at this rate, I'll never get "that thing."==W== Gotta think of something else. Can't keep wasting time fighting these Bark Boars.
Nazuna senpai, watch out! It's heading your way!
Whoa, where'd this Shrubshrew come from? It's chucking berries at the Garden of Parasite?
"Don't panic, it's all an illusion"...==W== Oh, I get it now.
Hmm... So Nazuna's the one throwing berries, and that scary-looking Bark Boar is Nazuka senpai?
What are those Shrubshrews chittering about over there?
It's about to release that magic mist again, huh? What a nuisance.
Heh, nice shot. Plugged that thing's flower bud right up.
Too bad, Garden of Parasite. Looks like your precious magic mist is useless now, doesn't it?
Huh? The bolt went right through it... But how?
Darn it, the Garden of Parasite has made itself part of the illusion, too!
Ugh... This makes things tricky. Was it always this cunning before?
Huh? Why's that Bark Boar so lively?==W== Wait ... could that be ... Nazuka?
Heh, same as always. You're still charging ahead first.
Ahaha... I can tell who you guys are just from your habits and moves!
Well then...==W== I can't let Nazuka show me up!
We've ... taken down all the monsters here. Noya, how about you?
We've cleared out all the monsters caught in the mist. Bet Nazuka and Petal Bloom are almost finished, too.
No one's hurt. But the vice-captain is missing.
Claire? But she was here just a moment ago... Where did she go?
The Garden of Parasite is breaking its own branches... Why is it harming itself like this?
Wait a minute... Is it trying to focus its magic somewhere by trimming itself down?
A new flower bud bursts open, spewing a thick magic mist==RT==that instantly engulfs Nazuka and Petal Bloom.
This trick again? It's useless.==W== I can tell who my real friends are!
I don't want to die... Help me... Please, help me...
I just want to go back to my friends...
Is the Garden of Parasite ...==W== talking?
No, that's not right. This must be an illusion ... its last desperate attempt to survive.
And if these are the last words of the people it killed ... making me listen to them is just plain sadistic.
Why...==W== Why were you the only survivor?
Why didn't you help us ...==W== back then?
You failed to protect us...==W== What makes you think you can protect your new companions...
The little Shrubshrew pats itself, wraps its arms in a hug,==RT==points to the other Shrubshrews, and finally, covers its ears.
Are you trying to say ... that I should ignore what those illusions are saying because you're all here with me? Is that it?
Heh. You know... I have no idea who you are, and I can barely understand a word you're saying—but thank you.
I have to protect everyone.==W== And that means this Garden of Parasite—a thing that learned to talk just to twist my mind and lead us to ruin—has to be destroyed.
We'll drive it into that cabin and burn the whole thing down!
With the Garden of Parasite cornered in the cabin, sparks fly==RT==from the Shrubshrew's fists, setting the thatched roof ablaze.
What the—?! How is this happening?!
There are ... two Gardens of Parasite in there.
I get it—a Trekker must have got in.==W== No, no time to second-guess. We have to put that fire out.
Trees, split. Let the mountains tremble—
A gale of green energy snuffs out the fledgling flames and parts the mist,==RT==granting everyone a moment of clarity.
Cough, cough...==W== Are you alright?==W== Why did you rush in—
Claire?==W== What are you doing here?
<size=48>Nazuka,==W== are you out of your mind?!</size>==W== If you'd torched that thing,==W== we would've all gone up in smoke with it!
Ugh... That sound...?! Everyone, get back! Now!
Huh? What's happening?==W== Did the Garden of Parasite just ...==W== speak?
In an instant, magic mist pours out from the Garden of Parasite's buds once again,==RT==swiftly enveloping the cabin and everyone.
Nazuka, the mist is getting too thick! We have to pull back!
Understood. The Petal Bloom and I will cover our retreat.==W== Boss, you and your team get out of here, now!

strings.text: Under your command, Iris and Nazuka link up the Trekkers with magic. The mist becomes ineffective, and the Garden of Parasite is no match for you. However, Claire blocks their path, acting on her company mission.
Incredible! The water just turned into bracelets that link us all together.
Nazuka can make similar bracelets, too. Please wait in line over there if you want one.
Awesome! Thanks!==W== Hey, could you make this wind bracelet a little prettier? Maybe add some decorations or something?
Don't be a brat. If we waste any more time, the Garden of Parasite is going to get away.
But Kaede and Fuyuka got special ones!==W== I want one too! You have to make mine special!
It's because it took so long to make a maple leaf for Kaede and a rabbit for Fuyuka that I had to rush yours.
Hmph... I mean, that sounds reasonable,==W== but you're doing this on purpose, aren't you? You totally are!
This is ... lively. Hardly feels like we're about to fight a major monster.
Heh, nothing like a bit of downtime before a big battle.==W== And of course, it's you who came up with such a clever way to handle that magic mist.
To protect everyone from the Garden of Parasite's mist,==RT==I modified the locator spell Iris had used on us before.
Employee? This is our companion!==W== See the water ring on ==SEX3== hand? That's a locator magic I cast right before we came in.

By linking everyone with these water and wind bracelets, we'll be safe from the illusions.==W== Even if the mist is strong enough to change how the bracelets look, the connection will help us tell friend from enemy.
That terrifying illusion mist... Boss completely nailed it.
I just had the idea. Iris and Nazuka are the ones who did all the real magic.
And Nazuka is incredible. She learned it in no time and perfectly replicated the bracelets with her wind magic.
Boss, it was a simple task. There's no need for praise.
The hunting squad is linked in groups of three as you instructed. We await your command.
Head to your spots==W== and surround that cabin.
Just focus on commanding, Boss. I'll make sure nothing gets to you.
With a wave of her staff, a green ring of wind forms around my wrist.==RT==A faint, almost transparent thread now connects me to Nazuka, and...
It's just, Nazuka, your whole "charge headfirst into the fight" style is a little much for me.
Iris! Freeze the branches! It's getting weak!
Shattering the frozen branches... A solid tactic.
You three have excellent synergy! Alright, Petal Bloom, you're up!
With Nazuna and Kaede providing cover, Fuyuka charges in from behind.==RT==A heavy iron fist smashes a different attacking branch to pieces.
Now that's brilliant command. With everyone attacking nonstop from different directions, the Garden of Parasite can't even release its mist.
At this rate, we'll take it down in no time. I never thought we could handle such a tricky monster so easily just by changing our tactics.
The Garden of Parasite is far from exhausted. We can't let our guard down.
Still, I have to remind you—Nazuka, don't forget about "that thing." It's more important to us than defeating some monster.
I know. But now isn't the time. On the battlefield, our first priority is always to protect our allies and defeat the enemy.
Keeping an eye on the future is important, too.
The Garden of Parasite is here to hunt, so why would it just wait in an empty cabin for us to surround it? Something's off.
You're overthinking it. A dumb monster like that isn't smart enough to pull any tricks.
See? It's already falling apart. It won't last much longer.
So many branches are snapping... No, wait. It's breaking its own branches... Why is it harming itself like this?==W== Unless ... it's concentrating its power. If that's the case...
It's charging up for an attack! Everyone, get ready!
Boss, a huge swarm of monsters is charging toward us from the forest.
Even the small ones?==W== Impossible. They usually run the moment they see a Trekker.
So that's it. The Garden of Parasite wasn't waiting—it was the bait. It was luring us here.
It used the mist to control the other monsters. We thought we had it cornered, but it was trapping us the whole time.
No way! It's just a monster—
I don't want to die... Help me... Please, help me...
I just want to go back to my friends...
Is the Garden of Parasite ...==W== talking?
No, that's not right. This must be an illusion ... its last desperate attempt to survive.
Why...==W== Why were you the only survivor?
Why didn't you help us ...==W== back then?
Follow the order...==W== We had to get "that thing" ... no matter the cost...
Stay back! We never did anything to you!==W== You're the ones who attacked us! You were trying to kill us!
Claire, calm down. It's just an illusion. No one's here but us.
You—you're the one in black! I don't need you to tell me anything! You're just after "that thing," aren't you?!
Damn you...<size=50> Damn you all! AAAAAAGH!
Wait—stop! Claire...! No, she's running straight for the Garden of Parasite!
Tch! Monsters are pouring out of the forest... Of all the times for this to happen.
Boss, tell everyone to retreat. I'll get Claire.
I'm going with you. If you're going into the mist, I can help.
Hehehe... Almost there ... "that thing" is almost mine.
Lost in a trance, Claire's thrust lacked any force,==RT==failing to even pierce the Garden of Parasite's bark.
Trees, split. Let the mountains tremble—
Why are you getting in my way?! I was so close to getting "that thing"!
Once I have it, all our problems will be solved!
Boss, take her and go! I'll hold them off. Get to safety, now!
You can't do this alone! We're all leaving together.
The Garden of Parasite ... it's talking.
Don't you dare! Stay away from my Master!
Boss! Nazuka! Sorry to keep you waiting!
We'll hold the line! You focus on getting out of here!
Master, I'll give it my all ...==W== to make sure you get away safely!

strings.text: Following the retreat to camp, where Claire confronts Nazuka. Their desires to protect different things ultimately cause Claire to side with Lady Gray. Nazuka, at a loss, tells you the story of the One-Armed Saint.
How are you feeling? Still seeing things?
I'm good. The hallucinations are gone.
All thanks to your magic. We didn't inhale much of that mist, so a little rest was all it took.
You gotta take care of yourself too! You were pushing yourself the hardest out there!
Thanks for the concern. I have fully recovered.
That's great to hear. Captain, let's go for another round! Now that we know the ropes, we can totally take down the Garden of Parasite next time.
Yeah! Though we failed today, everyone made it back in one piece. This time, we'll know what to expect!
I agree. We'll try again soon. For now, get some rest. I'm going to check on the others.
I understand. But don't make a move yet. Let me try talking to her again.
It's starting to rain.==W== Good thing I bought an umbrella.
Noya and the others are finally clear of those illusions. I should get back and figure out what's next.
Is that ... Nazuka?==W== She doesn't have an umbrella. I should go help.==W== Getting sick out here in the rain would be awful.
You insisted we meet right away.==W== What's so urgent?
Just wanted to confirm with you. On the next raid against the Garden of Parasite, we must secure "that thing."
Why the sudden rush? Don't tell me...
You got it. Lady Gray just stopped by to press the issue. She also said ... "that thing" is hidden inside its trunk.
The trunk? And how do you plan to get it? Our raid failed just today.
Well... Why not just capture it alive and take our sweet time? C'mon, we managed to bag the Blade of Jade. How hard can this thing be?
Capture it alive? That's far too risky. You've seen it yourself—the Garden of Parasite gets stronger by the day. We're not powerful enough yet to capture it live.
But we're in deep trouble if we don't get "that thing." Have you forgotten how Lady Gray threatened us?
I remember.==W== So, what's the plan?
The magic mist is the real problem.==W== Once we deplete that, the Garden of Parasite is just a clumsy monster swinging its branches around.
With people. We'll have the squad members charge in first.
Are you insane? Claire, you know as well as I do that you'd be sending them to their deaths.
They'll just be inhaling some mist.==W== That's not fatal ... right?
If they start hallucinating, they'll turn on each other. The result is exactly the same.
Besides, the Garden of Parasite is already too powerful.==W== A monster this dangerous... Claire, we have to destroy it ourselves on the next hunt.
I haven't touched the 10 million Dorra from Lady Gray. After we deal with the Garden of Parasite, I'm returning it. That way, our business with United Harvest is concluded.
You think they'll just let us go once we're "even"?==W== Hah, that's so naive.==W== After everything we've seen, you really think we can just walk away?==W== United Harvest will never drop this.
Think about it. "That thing" can twist a mimic vine into the monstrosity we're facing. United Harvest would do anything to keep their rivals from finding out they have something that powerful.
So, the moment Lady Gray gets her hands on it, she'll have us eliminated.
But, if "that thing" is destroyed in the fight—if no one gets it and we can plausibly deny knowing what it was—United Harvest might just leave us alone.
No way, Nazuka, this is United Harvest! We failed them. There's no way they won't retaliate.
There is! The Big Three have been on a rampage for months, and our hunting squad has been making headlines—not just in Philae, but in other cities too.
We're not just some unknown Trekkers anymore; we're in the public eye now.
That means even a company like United Harvest can't take us out quietly. As long as we stay in the dark about what "that thing" really is, a peaceful way out of this isn't impossible.
So that's your angle... You've always hated the spotlight, but lately you've been actively seeking it out.
But what if they don't care? What if they decide to punish us for botching the job and coming back empty-handed anyway?
If it comes to that... Just say it was all my idea.==W== Act like you knew nothing. I'll take the fall for everything.
Hah. How noble, Nazuka. Turning on Petal Bloom to protect your friends, taking all the blame to shield the team... You've even got an out for me all planned.
Just like the One-Armed Saint from the legends... Sacrificing herself to save Philae.
It's not that dramatic. I just want to keep everyone safe.
Surviving by not seeing "that thing"... Why didn't I think of that sooner? I guess I'm just not cut out for these clever games like you are.
I can't keep up with all the scheming, and I don't wanna die. So I've already signed a magic contract with Lady Gray.
A contract? What kind of contract?
It says as long as I follow Lady Gray's orders to the letter and search for "that thing"...
United Harvest will give me a fortune and a cushy job where I can earn Dorra for life, regardless of the outcome.
How could you trust someone like Lady Gray? This is United Harvest we're talking about. There's bound to be a trap or a loophole in that contract.
Yeah ... maybe. That's why I need your help.
That's right. I told Lady Gray there's no way I can take down the Garden of Parasite alone. But with you, I know we can find a way.
They know how strong you are, of course. Lady Gray said if you join United Harvest and work for her, she'll let you draft the contract.
See? You're the key to this whole deal.
So she just wants to use us as pawns.==W== That plan to have the squad members wear down the mist... That was her idea, wasn't it?
You figure everything out, don't you, Nazuka? But I'm not like you. I'm out of options.
Claire, don't do this. Let me think. There has to be another way.
Oh? Is the great Saint gonna swoop in and solve all my problems?
It's impossible. I don't know how you see it, but to me, the gap between us and United Harvest is like a single raindrop against a sky full of storm clouds.
If you're really so amazing, why don't you just blow away the clouds above us and make this rain stop?!
Just like the legendary One-Armed Saint!
... That's all I have to say.
Goodbye, Nazuka. In the end, we were never on the same path.
So this is where you first met Lady Gray?
Yeah. She was in a United Harvest uniform, looked like she held a high rank. And all the supplies she gave us later came directly from them.
United Harvest... They're in the grain and food industry, right?
That's right. They're the biggest company in this industry in Nova. I heard they grow seventy percent of all the grain on the continent.
They have branches in every city.
Word is that the one here in Philae is their largest.
Philae's climate and environment... I'm guessing it's ideal for growing crops?
That, and the influence from the Monolith in the lake.==W== Its wishing boxes are known to produce Artifacts useful for farming.
Hearing you put it that way, United Harvest is a true company giant. It does sound like we're a single raindrop and they're a storm cloud.
Since she's trying to use Claire for some kind of scheme... I'm going to split from the hunting squad for now.
I'll take down the Garden of Parasite before Claire can... End this myself.
Brute force over strategy, huh? Not a bad idea, but ... isn't that a huge risk?
It is. This weather makes it impossible to use fire against the Garden of Parasite... And with Philae's rainy season here, there's no telling when the sun will be out again.
The silver lining is that monsters usually lie low in weather like this, and the main force can't push deep into the forest. So, it's not all bad.
If only I could work a miracle like the One-Armed Saint.
I keep hearing about the One-Armed Saint. What's the story there?
Years ago, a one-armed statue was unearthed here.
The plaque on its base had the faded word "Saint"...
... and a nearby stone slab told her story.
Long, long ago, the people of Philae angered the god of swamps.
In its fury, the god cursed the land with endless rains, threatening to drown the city.
People begged the god to stop, but it demanded==RT==the most beautiful thing in the city as an offering.
They offered countless treasures, yet the god remained unmoved.
It was not until one day, a passing Trekker offered her own arm and hand—
—nimble hands capable of forging anything,==RT==that the divine silence finally broke.
The god was pleased. It stopped the rains, and the floodwaters formed a great lake with fertile shores. From then on, the people of Philae lived in prosperity.
So, that's the end of the legend. What'd you think, Boss?
Hmm... On the surface, it's a nice story ... but something about it feels a little creepy.
I think the legend might've romanticized it.
Maybe the saint didn't just give up—maybe she fought the god, and won, though at the cost of her arm. That's why the flood stopped.
That's possible...==W== But if so, it wasn't a god. It was a demon.
A "god" that casually throws a fit doesn't sound like any normal god I know.
And in the end, it's just a statue with only one arm, right? It could've just broken off.==W== As for the storm, it was probably just a natural disaster.
Ha, so pragmatic. You really have a knack for looking at things from a purely realistic angle, Boss.
I mean, it's rare for an artifact dug up from the ground to be in perfect condition, isn't it?
That's a fair point.==W== I hope the truth is just like you said—that no one got hurt, and everyone just lived happily ever after.
Hmm... I think "offering her arm and hand" was symbolic.
Water doesn't just drain on its own. You need hands to dig canals and build levees to actually control a flood.
Maybe the people of Philae put up the statue to commemorate the person who led them in taming the waters.
Huh... That's a really practical way of looking at it, Boss.
Still, what I admire about the One-Armed Saint is her courage to make that sacrifice.
I'm a Trekker, and my time making wishes in the Monolith has taught me one thing.
If you want to gain something, you have to give something up first. Decisively.
I want to be that kind of decisive person—someone who can clear the path for everyone else.
I get it.==W== Well... Since you once saw me as a figure like the One-Armed Saint...
On a day like today, when we can't even use fire, let me clear the path a different way.
As it happens, I have an idea about how we can investigate Lady Gray and the Three Grand Commissions.

param: Following the retreat to camp, where Claire confronts Nazuka. Their desires to protect different things ultimately cause Claire to side with Lady Gray. Nazuka, at a loss, tells you the story of the One-Armed Saint.
How are you feeling? Still seeing things?
I'm good. The hallucinations are gone.
All thanks to your magic. We didn't inhale much of that mist, so a little rest was all it took.
You gotta take care of yourself too! You were pushing yourself the hardest out there!
Thanks for the concern. I have fully recovered.
That's great to hear. Captain, let's go for another round! Now that we know the ropes, we can totally take down the Garden of Parasite next time.
Yeah! Though we failed today, everyone made it back in one piece. This time, we'll know what to expect!
I agree. We'll try again soon. For now, get some rest. I'm going to check on the others.
I understand. But don't make a move yet. Let me try talking to her again.
It's starting to rain.==W== Good thing I bought an umbrella.
Noya and the others are finally clear of those illusions. I should get back and figure out what's next.
Is that ... Nazuka?==W== She doesn't have an umbrella. I should go help.==W== Getting sick out here in the rain would be awful.
You insisted we meet right away.==W== What's so urgent?
Just wanted to confirm with you. On the next raid against the Garden of Parasite, we must secure "that thing."
Why the sudden rush? Don't tell me...
You got it. Lady Gray just stopped by to press the issue. She also said ... "that thing" is hidden inside its trunk.
The trunk? And how do you plan to get it? Our raid failed just today.
Well... Why not just capture it alive and take our sweet time? C'mon, we managed to bag the Blade of Jade. How hard can this thing be?
Capture it alive? That's far too risky. You've seen it yourself—the Garden of Parasite gets stronger by the day. We're not powerful enough yet to capture it live.
But we're in deep trouble if we don't get "that thing." Have you forgotten how Lady Gray threatened us?
I remember.==W== So, what's the plan?
The magic mist is the real problem.==W== Once we deplete that, the Garden of Parasite is just a clumsy monster swinging its branches around.
With people. We'll have the squad members charge in first.
Are you insane? Claire, you know as well as I do that you'd be sending them to their deaths.
They'll just be inhaling some mist.==W== That's not fatal ... right?
If they start hallucinating, they'll turn on each other. The result is exactly the same.
Besides, the Garden of Parasite is already too powerful.==W== A monster this dangerous... Claire, we have to destroy it ourselves on the next hunt.
I haven't touched the 10 million Dorra from Lady Gray. After we deal with the Garden of Parasite, I'm returning it. That way, our business with United Harvest is concluded.
You think they'll just let us go once we're "even"?==W== Hah, that's so naive.==W== After everything we've seen, you really think we can just walk away?==W== United Harvest will never drop this.
Think about it. "That thing" can twist a mimic vine into the monstrosity we're facing. United Harvest would do anything to keep their rivals from finding out they have something that powerful.
So, the moment Lady Gray gets her hands on it, she'll have us eliminated.
But, if "that thing" is destroyed in the fight—if no one gets it and we can plausibly deny knowing what it was—United Harvest might just leave us alone.
No way, Nazuka, this is United Harvest! We failed them. There's no way they won't retaliate.
There is! The Big Three have been on a rampage for months, and our hunting squad has been making headlines—not just in Philae, but in other cities too.
We're not just some unknown Trekkers anymore; we're in the public eye now.
That means even a company like United Harvest can't take us out quietly. As long as we stay in the dark about what "that thing" really is, a peaceful way out of this isn't impossible.
So that's your angle... You've always hated the spotlight, but lately you've been actively seeking it out.
But what if they don't care? What if they decide to punish us for botching the job and coming back empty-handed anyway?
If it comes to that... Just say it was all my idea.==W== Act like you knew nothing. I'll take the fall for everything.
Hah. How noble, Nazuka. Turning on Petal Bloom to protect your friends, taking all the blame to shield the team... You've even got an out for me all planned.
Just like the One-Armed Saint from the legends... Sacrificing herself to save Philae.
It's not that dramatic. I just want to keep everyone safe.
Surviving by not seeing "that thing"... Why didn't I think of that sooner? I guess I'm just not cut out for these clever games like you are.
I can't keep up with all the scheming, and I don't wanna die. So I've already signed a magic contract with Lady Gray.
A contract? What kind of contract?
