strings.text: You and Nazuka successfully lead the United Harvest to investigate Lady Gray. Unfortunately, a continuous stretch of heavy rain spoils your plan to launch an early hunt. When the sunlight returns, so come the rumors.
Hello. How can I help you?==W== Here to purchase seeds, or trade grain?
I'm Nazuka, leader of the Trekker squad hunting the Big Three. I'm here to confirm the bounty details and find out how to contact your Lady Gray.
The Big Three...==W== Lady Gray... Just a moment, please.
Boss, are you sure this will work?==W== This is the Grain Exchange. They don't handle bounties, do they?
That's exactly why we're asking here—because they don't.
United Harvest is a massive company. Employees in different departments are practically strangers to one another.
Sometimes, it's even worse. Departments often have conflicting interests, so it's not uncommon for them to treat each other like rivals.
Think about it, Nazuka. Why would Lady Gray use Trekkers to hunt the Big Three?
They tried to handle them themselves at first. Those initial mercenaries were her people, right? The losses ...==W== were severe.
She switched to offering bounties after those casualties, even providing you all with supplies. It's a strange shift, isn't it?
It could be a strategic pivot—deciding Trekkers are better for the job.==W== But I think it's more likely she just can't find replacements.
Why? The supplies Lady Gray is providing are worth a fortune in Dorra. It doesn't seem like she's short on funds.
Heh, that's corporate logic for you. For Trekkers like us, if we fail, we just learn from it and try again.
But in a company, especially a huge one like United Harvest, people are eyeing any good position. The second she makes a mistake, someone's there to pull her down.
She lost a lot of people, so now she's in a tough spot. She wants to use us to get results, while also trying to recruit skilled people for herself.
Besides, her way of doing business—by threatening people—has surely made her plenty of enemies within the company.
We leak this information, and her rivals within the company will jump at the chance to make a move.
So that's why you picked the Grain Exchange. You knew she had no ties to this place.
Exactly. Since they're not involved, they'll have no problem spreading our message—"helping" us stir things up.
It'll expose our plan, sure, but with Lady Gray already threatening Claire, she's got us figured out anyway.
And if it doesn't work, we lose nothing.
We'll definitely get some blowback later, though.
You're so devious...==W== No, I mean, brilliant. How did you even come up with this?
Ahem. It's not about being brilliant,==W== it's about understanding how companies work.
I am a CEO, after all. You have to be a little devious in this line of work.
Oh? But what if they just blow us off? I've had friends look into Lady Gray before, but they never came up with anything.
We'll see.==W== Shh, someone's coming. Just follow my lead.
I am so sorry for the wait! I'm Sapphire, the manager here.
Not at all. I've heard about the monster hunting, but that's not handled by our exchange. That falls to the Marketing Department. If you're here about the bounty, I can put you in touch with them.
As for Lady Gray, I've never heard of her. She's certainly not in our Production Department. Perhaps you should try asking somewhere else?
The classic runaround, just as I expected. Let's see if you can dodge the next one.
There seems to be a misunderstanding. We're not here for the bounty. We're here for an employee matter.
Take out the Seal of Grace
Is that ...==W== a Seal of Grace? Forgive me. Which company do you represent?
Boss Accord Staffing Co. Though I'm guessing that name doesn't mean much around here in Philae.
The Boss Accord Staffing Company...==W== The company that just reopened in Emor? Then ... does that make you the "Boss" in the newspapers?
I haven't seen the press reports...==W== But yes, that's me.
O-Oh, I see! Well, we can't just talk standing out here. Please, come on in. Let's discuss this properly inside.
No need, I have other business to attend to. I just dropped by to ask you about something I heard—
Is United Harvest trying to take control over the Trekker industry in Philae?
That sounds like a monopoly, wouldn't you say? I felt it necessary for me to confirm this with you directly.
A monopoly? Take control over the Trekker industry? What are you talking about? United Harvest couldn't possibly do that...==W== We lack the means, and it's not something we would ever do.
And yet, when I tried to commission a few Trekkers for a job, I found that Lady Gray had already snapped up all the skilled ones for her hunting squad with an enormous contract.
That's why I've brought the hunting squad's captain with me today to corroborate my story.

Um ...==W== yes, that's right. Lady Gray provided us with supplies and rewards valued at hundreds of millions of Dorra. Our team's top priority right now is to defeat the Garden of Parasite, the last of the Big Three.
H-==W==Hundreds of millions...?==W== No wonder the accounts were...==W== Ah, my apologies. This matter has clearly caused your company some trouble.

However, I am truly unaware of the specifics of this situation with Lady Gray, so I can't give you an answer at this time. If you'll please leave your contact information, we will reach out after conducting an investigation.
Understood. We'll be waiting to hear from you, then.
Boss, I can't believe it. Her entire attitude shifts the moment you show her that seal.
That's what the Seal of Grace represents—==W==the real authority a company has.
If a normal person asks, companies will usually try to avoid trouble.==W== But it's a different story when the Boss shows up.
So what's a "monopoly," anyway? And why did she panic the second you mentioned it?
Well, like you said, United Harvest produces seventy percent of all the grain in Nova.==W== When one company controls a whole industry like that, that's a monopoly.
Every company, or more accurately, every Seal of Grace, contains an exclusive franchise patent.
You need a seal from the God of Grace to establish a company, and each one grants an exclusive business domain.
I haven't seen United Harvest's Seal of Grace, but I'm sure its patent is for==W== food.
I read in one of Iris' books==W== that companies can operate freely within their designated industry, and also branch out into other sectors a bit.
But trying to monopolize an industry not granted by your Seal of Grace is sacrilege.==W== If another company files a complaint, you'll face serious consequences.
This isn't something United Harvest can just look the other way on.==W== That manager knows the risks,==W== so she has to take it seriously.
But what if Lady Gray is just acting on her own?==W== Does that still count as a monopoly?
As long as Lady Gray operates under the United Harvest name, it's considered a corporate monopoly.
So ...==W== what do you think that Sapphire girl will do next?
She's clearly not clueless about this. She'll probably start keeping an eye on Lady Gray's activities.
This should keep Lady Gray distracted for a while, buying us time to make the first move.
Thanks, Boss. I owe you one. I'll go locate the Garden of Parasite right away. We'll move out as soon as the rain lets up.
However, the continuous downpour hinders our plan,==RT==leaving us stranded in the old Trekkers' House for days.
Good work on the recon. What are things like in the forest?
The rain's stopped, but it's a total mud pit out there.==W== Good thing Nazuka and Mistique can fly—they made scouting a breeze.
Is Nazuka still out there? I thought Mistique went to take over for her a little while ago.
Ages ago!==W== But you know her—she always tries to do everything herself. Said she wanted to patrol a bit longer, then flew off again. I don't know what her hurry is.
She must be trying to take down the Garden of Parasite before Lady Gray and Claire can. But ... she still hasn't told Nazuna and the others?
Always charging ahead on her own ... in such a rush, too.==W== Does she really think we haven't noticed something's up?
Um, Master... I might just be imagining it,==W== but when I went to the camp this morning, it felt like everyone was looking at me weirdly.
It seemed like people were avoiding me on purpose. Or it could be all in my head.
Now that you mention it, I got that feeling too. So that wasn't just my imagination?
I noticed it too. A bunch of people turned the other way as soon as they saw us and started whispering.
Huh? Why? We didn't do anything wrong, did we? No way!
Yeah. And with all the rain lately, no one's been going out, aside from recon.
I==W== am==W== baaack==W==~!==W== Your dear Mistique is here★
But really...==W== How can you girls be just chatting? Don't you know what people are saying about you out there?
Out there? What do you mean?
The whole camp is buzzing with rumors that you're the ones to blame for the first hunt's failure.
The gossip around camp goes like this—
You intentionally threw the first hunt, just so you could monopolize the massive bounty from the Three Grand Commissions.
Then Nazuka forms a new hunting squad while you keep Petal Bloom running, so you two get to double-dip on the bounty and rake in the cash.==W== And that's the story★
We're not in this for Dorra...
Who on earth would spread such a ridiculous rumor...
I know, I know it's not true. But rumors don't care about the truth, and the "evidence" they've cooked up sounds pretty convincing—

Think about it. If Nazuka can take down the Blade of Jade by herself, and Petal Bloom can beat the Spirit of Brutality on their own, how did the first hunt fail when both parties were present? It had to be on purpose.
No way... Captain Nazuka is always the one who leads the patrols. She's not that kind of person.
Of course she would—for the bounty! Why else haven't we seen a single Dorra from it? She must have pocketed it all for herself.
But I heard United Harvest hasn't even paid out the bounty yet.
Have you asked United Harvest yourself? In situations like this, it's whatever the captain says, goes.
I don't believe it! Captain Nazuka would never do something like that!
I didn't believe it at first either. But listen<size=35>,==W== the real culprit is that guild from Emor. Their leader, the one called the Boss, can supposedly control people's souls.
Captain Nazuka ... is being controlled by someone evil?
If it wasn't Nazuka's plan, then it's the only explanation, right? We've all been set up by the Boss!
What is all this garbage? ==PLAYER_NAME== would never do something like that! We're putting our lives on the line fighting those monsters!
We never planned on keeping the reward for ourselves. I... I already talked it over with Nazuna senpai and Kaede. The plan is to donate the bounty to the camp for repairs as soon as we get it.
This rumor's been going around for a few days. Actually, I heard it started circulating in small circles around the 27th or 28th of last month.
Boss, any idea what this is about?
The 27th or 28th...==W== That's right before Claire spoke with Nazuka. In that case, I really have no clue.
That's it, I'm going to confront them!
Wait, Nazuna!==W== A crowd is surrounding the Trekker Association.
Greedy jerks, trying to hog the reward!
Petal Bloom and Boss Accord, get out of Philae!
What are you all talking about? We didn't even know about the Big Three until we got to Philae!
Well, well... This has gotten out of hand.
The heavy rain has driven the Garden of Parasite deep into the forest. We'll need to expand our search radius to track it down.
It's cleared up for now, but judging by the sky, more rain is on its way.
Captain Nazuka, are the rumors going around camp true?
The one about you ...==W== wanting to keep the bounties all to yourself...
That's absurd!==W== Boss wasn't even in Philae during the first hunt.
But that's what everyone's saying! The Trekkers had gone to the Trekkers' House to confront them.
...==W== No, I have to go back. Now.
Captain Nazuka, you should explain things to everyone first. We know you're not that kind of person.
Quiet. If you know the captain isn't like that, then stop this nonsense and clear out.
Claire...==W== You're not the one behind all this, are you?
That's right. Lady Gray had me do it. She was unhappy with your defiance and worried you'd beat her to the Garden of Parasite. So your reputation had to be destroyed.
Why would you==W== help someone like her?
Why? I've got to look out for myself, too. That warning I gave you? That was Lady Gray's final ultimatum.
But you wouldn't listen. I'm just one Trekker—how am I supposed to defy a big shot from United Harvest?
You should've just come after me. Why drag the Petal Bloom and Boss into this?
I am helping you! It took everything I had to get Lady Gray to agree to frame Boss for this instead.
Look, the people here still trust you.==W== Just announce that you and Petal Bloom were being controlled by the evil Boss, and no one will blame you.
Nazuka...==W== This is your last chance. Just like the legend of the One-Armed Saint—all we have to do is sacrifice one passing stranger.
Is that ...==W== really how you interpret that legend?
Am I wrong? Who's gonna miss some random outsider? If sacrificing one person brings peace to Philae, what's the harm?
Look at the plaza. I figured you'd be here by now, so I've already set up a podium for you. Just get up there and tell them it's all the Boss's fault.
It was all ...==W== the Boss's fault?
Claire. Gather the Trekkers for me.
Captain Nazuka, that's not like you! You have to be under the Boss's control!
Yeah! This is all because of those Trekkers from Emor!
Don't fall for their lies! We have to defend Philae and take down the Boss!
False rumors have been spreading through camp and disrupting the squad. To get to the truth, I need you all to compose yourselves and listen to what Captain Nazuka has to say.
Captain Nazuka, please. Tell us what you know.
<size=35>A false peace built on sacrifice... I can't accept it. I just can't...
Hm? You're a bit quiet, Captain Nazuka. Could you please speak up?

The first hunt's failure, the formation of a new one, the chaos that unfolded in the hunt for the Big Three, the fact that so many got hurt... Who's to blame for it all? The monsters that appeared out of nowhere?
No. Not at all. The fault is all mine. Looks like I can't hide it any longer—==W==I planned this whole thing just to keep the bounties for myself.

param: You and Nazuka successfully lead the United Harvest to investigate Lady Gray. Unfortunately, a continuous stretch of heavy rain spoils your plan to launch an early hunt. When the sunlight returns, so come the rumors.
Hello. How can I help you?==W== Here to purchase seeds, or trade grain?
I'm Nazuka, leader of the Trekker squad hunting the Big Three. I'm here to confirm the bounty details and find out how to contact your Lady Gray.
The Big Three...==W== Lady Gray... Just a moment, please.
Boss, are you sure this will work?==W== This is the Grain Exchange. They don't handle bounties, do they?
That's exactly why we're asking here—because they don't.
United Harvest is a massive company. Employees in different departments are practically strangers to one another.
Sometimes, it's even worse. Departments often have conflicting interests, so it's not uncommon for them to treat each other like rivals.
Think about it, Nazuka. Why would Lady Gray use Trekkers to hunt the Big Three?
They tried to handle them themselves at first. Those initial mercenaries were her people, right? The losses ...==W== were severe.
She switched to offering bounties after those casualties, even providing you all with supplies. It's a strange shift, isn't it?
It could be a strategic pivot—deciding Trekkers are better for the job.==W== But I think it's more likely she just can't find replacements.
Why? The supplies Lady Gray is providing are worth a fortune in Dorra. It doesn't seem like she's short on funds.
Heh, that's corporate logic for you. For Trekkers like us, if we fail, we just learn from it and try again.
But in a company, especially a huge one like United Harvest, people are eyeing any good position. The second she makes a mistake, someone's there to pull her down.
She lost a lot of people, so now she's in a tough spot. She wants to use us to get results, while also trying to recruit skilled people for herself.
Besides, her way of doing business—by threatening people—has surely made her plenty of enemies within the company.
We leak this information, and her rivals within the company will jump at the chance to make a move.
So that's why you picked the Grain Exchange. You knew she had no ties to this place.
Exactly. Since they're not involved, they'll have no problem spreading our message—"helping" us stir things up.
It'll expose our plan, sure, but with Lady Gray already threatening Claire, she's got us figured out anyway.
And if it doesn't work, we lose nothing.
We'll definitely get some blowback later, though.
You're so devious...==W== No, I mean, brilliant. How did you even come up with this?
Ahem. It's not about being brilliant,==W== it's about understanding how companies work.
I am a CEO, after all. You have to be a little devious in this line of work.
Oh? But what if they just blow us off? I've had friends look into Lady Gray before, but they never came up with anything.
We'll see.==W== Shh, someone's coming. Just follow my lead.
I am so sorry for the wait! I'm Sapphire, the manager here.
Not at all. I've heard about the monster hunting, but that's not handled by our exchange. That falls to the Marketing Department. If you're here about the bounty, I can put you in touch with them.
As for Lady Gray, I've never heard of her. She's certainly not in our Production Department. Perhaps you should try asking somewhere else?
The classic runaround, just as I expected. Let's see if you can dodge the next one.
There seems to be a misunderstanding. We're not here for the bounty. We're here for an employee matter.
Take out the Seal of Grace
Is that ...==W== a Seal of Grace? Forgive me. Which company do you represent?
Boss Accord Staffing Co. Though I'm guessing that name doesn't mean much around here in Philae.
The Boss Accord Staffing Company...==W== The company that just reopened in Emor? Then ... does that make you the "Boss" in the newspapers?
I haven't seen the press reports...==W== But yes, that's me.
O-Oh, I see! Well, we can't just talk standing out here. Please, come on in. Let's discuss this properly inside.
No need, I have other business to attend to. I just dropped by to ask you about something I heard—
Is United Harvest trying to take control over the Trekker industry in Philae?
That sounds like a monopoly, wouldn't you say? I felt it necessary for me to confirm this with you directly.
A monopoly? Take control over the Trekker industry? What are you talking about? United Harvest couldn't possibly do that...==W== We lack the means, and it's not something we would ever do.
And yet, when I tried to commission a few Trekkers for a job, I found that Lady Gray had already snapped up all the skilled ones for her hunting squad with an enormous contract.
That's why I've brought the hunting squad's captain with me today to corroborate my story.

Um ...==W== yes, that's right. Lady Gray provided us with supplies and rewards valued at hundreds of millions of Dorra. Our team's top priority right now is to defeat the Garden of Parasite, the last of the Big Three.
H-==W==Hundreds of millions...?==W== No wonder the accounts were...==W== Ah, my apologies. This matter has clearly caused your company some trouble.

However, I am truly unaware of the specifics of this situation with Lady Gray, so I can't give you an answer at this time. If you'll please leave your contact information, we will reach out after conducting an investigation.
Understood. We'll be waiting to hear from you, then.
Boss, I can't believe it. Her entire attitude shifts the moment you show her that seal.
That's what the Seal of Grace represents—==W==the real authority a company has.
If a normal person asks, companies will usually try to avoid trouble.==W== But it's a different story when the Boss shows up.
So what's a "monopoly," anyway? And why did she panic the second you mentioned it?
Well, like you said, United Harvest produces seventy percent of all the grain in Nova.==W== When one company controls a whole industry like that, that's a monopoly.
Every company, or more accurately, every Seal of Grace, contains an exclusive franchise patent.
You need a seal from the God of Grace to establish a company, and each one grants an exclusive business domain.
I haven't seen United Harvest's Seal of Grace, but I'm sure its patent is for==W== food.
I read in one of Iris' books==W== that companies can operate freely within their designated industry, and also branch out into other sectors a bit.
But trying to monopolize an industry not granted by your Seal of Grace is sacrilege.==W== If another company files a complaint, you'll face serious consequences.
This isn't something United Harvest can just look the other way on.==W== That manager knows the risks,==W== so she has to take it seriously.
But what if Lady Gray is just acting on her own?==W== Does that still count as a monopoly?
As long as Lady Gray operates under the United Harvest name, it's considered a corporate monopoly.
So ...==W== what do you think that Sapphire girl will do next?
She's clearly not clueless about this. She'll probably start keeping an eye on Lady Gray's activities.
This should keep Lady Gray distracted for a while, buying us time to make the first move.
Thanks, Boss. I owe you one. I'll go locate the Garden of Parasite right away. We'll move out as soon as the rain lets up.
However, the continuous downpour hinders our plan,==RT==leaving us stranded in the old Trekkers' House for days.
Good work on the recon. What are things like in the forest?
The rain's stopped, but it's a total mud pit out there.==W== Good thing Nazuka and Mistique can fly—they made scouting a breeze.
Is Nazuka still out there? I thought Mistique went to take over for her a little while ago.
Ages ago!==W== But you know her—she always tries to do everything herself. Said she wanted to patrol a bit longer, then flew off again. I don't know what her hurry is.
She must be trying to take down the Garden of Parasite before Lady Gray and Claire can. But ... she still hasn't told Nazuna and the others?
Always charging ahead on her own ... in such a rush, too.==W== Does she really think we haven't noticed something's up?
Um, Master... I might just be imagining it,==W== but when I went to the camp this morning, it felt like everyone was looking at me weirdly.
It seemed like people were avoiding me on purpose. Or it could be all in my head.
Now that you mention it, I got that feeling too. So that wasn't just my imagination?
I noticed it too. A bunch of people turned the other way as soon as they saw us and started whispering.
Huh? Why? We didn't do anything wrong, did we? No way!
Yeah. And with all the rain lately, no one's been going out, aside from recon.
I==W== am==W== baaack==W==~!==W== Your dear Mistique is here★
But really...==W== How can you girls be just chatting? Don't you know what people are saying about you out there?
Out there? What do you mean?
The whole camp is buzzing with rumors that you're the ones to blame for the first hunt's failure.
The gossip around camp goes like this—
You intentionally threw the first hunt, just so you could monopolize the massive bounty from the Three Grand Commissions.
Then Nazuka forms a new hunting squad while you keep Petal Bloom running, so you two get to double-dip on the bounty and rake in the cash.==W== And that's the story★
We're not in this for Dorra...
Who on earth would spread such a ridiculous rumor...
I know, I know it's not true. But rumors don't care about the truth, and the "evidence" they've cooked up sounds pretty convincing—

Think about it. If Nazuka can take down the Blade of Jade by herself, and Petal Bloom can beat the Spirit of Brutality on their own, how did the first hunt fail when both parties were present? It had to be on purpose.
No way... Captain Nazuka is always the one who leads the patrols. She's not that kind of person.
Of course she would—for the bounty! Why else haven't we seen a single Dorra from it? She must have pocketed it all for herself.
But I heard United Harvest hasn't even paid out the bounty yet.
Have you asked United Harvest yourself? In situations like this, it's whatever the captain says, goes.
I don't believe it! Captain Nazuka would never do something like that!
I didn't believe it at first either. But listen<size=35>,==W== the real culprit is that guild from Emor. Their leader, the one called the Boss, can supposedly control people's souls.
Captain Nazuka ... is being controlled by someone evil?
If it wasn't Nazuka's plan, then it's the only explanation, right? We've all been set up by the Boss!
What is all this garbage? ==PLAYER_NAME== would never do something like that! We're putting our lives on the line fighting those monsters!
We never planned on keeping the reward for ourselves. I... I already talked it over with Nazuna senpai and Kaede. The plan is to donate the bounty to the camp for repairs as soon as we get it.
This rumor's been going around for a few days. Actually, I heard it started circulating in small circles around the 27th or 28th of last month.
Boss, any idea what this is about?
The 27th or 28th...==W== That's right before Claire spoke with Nazuka. In that case, I really have no clue.
That's it, I'm going to confront them!
Wait, Nazuna!==W== A crowd is surrounding the Trekker Association.
Greedy jerks, trying to hog the reward!
Petal Bloom and Boss Accord, get out of Philae!
What are you all talking about? We didn't even know about the Big Three until we got to Philae!
Well, well... This has gotten out of hand.
The heavy rain has driven the Garden of Parasite deep into the forest. We'll need to expand our search radius to track it down.
It's cleared up for now, but judging by the sky, more rain is on its way.
Captain Nazuka, are the rumors going around camp true?
The one about you ...==W== wanting to keep the bounties all to yourself...
That's absurd!==W== Boss wasn't even in Philae during the first hunt.
But that's what everyone's saying! The Trekkers had gone to the Trekkers' House to confront them.
...==W== No, I have to go back. Now.
Captain Nazuka, you should explain things to everyone first. We know you're not that kind of person.
Quiet. If you know the captain isn't like that, then stop this nonsense and clear out.
Claire...==W== You're not the one behind all this, are you?
That's right. Lady Gray had me do it. She was unhappy with your defiance and worried you'd beat her to the Garden of Parasite. So your reputation had to be destroyed.
Why would you==W== help someone like her?
Why? I've got to look out for myself, too. That warning I gave you? That was Lady Gray's final ultimatum.
But you wouldn't listen. I'm just one Trekker—how am I supposed to defy a big shot from United Harvest?
You should've just come after me. Why drag the Petal Bloom and Boss into this?
I am helping you! It took everything I had to get Lady Gray to agree to frame Boss for this instead.
Look, the people here still trust you.==W== Just announce that you and Petal Bloom were being controlled by the evil Boss, and no one will blame you.
Nazuka...==W== This is your last chance. Just like the legend of the One-Armed Saint—all we have to do is sacrifice one passing stranger.
Is that ...==W== really how you interpret that legend?
Am I wrong? Who's gonna miss some random outsider? If sacrificing one person brings peace to Philae, what's the harm?
Look at the plaza. I figured you'd be here by now, so I've already set up a podium for you. Just get up there and tell them it's all the Boss's fault.
It was all ...==W== the Boss's fault?
Claire. Gather the Trekkers for me.
Captain Nazuka, that's not like you! You have to be under the Boss's control!
Yeah! This is all because of those Trekkers from Emor!
Don't fall for their lies! We have to defend Philae and take down the Boss!
False rumors have been spreading through camp and disrupting the squad. To get to the truth, I need you all to compose yourselves and listen to what Captain Nazuka has to say.
Captain Nazuka, please. Tell us what you know.
<size=35>A false peace built on sacrifice... I can't accept it. I just can't...
Hm? You're a bit quiet, Captain Nazuka. Could you please speak up?

The first hunt's failure, the formation of a new one, the chaos that unfolded in the hunt for the Big Three, the fact that so many got hurt... Who's to blame for it all? The monsters that appeared out of nowhere?
No. Not at all. The fault is all mine. Looks like I can't hide it any longer—==W==I planned this whole thing just to keep the bounties for myself.

strings.text: A Rain That Reads the Air
Realizing that she had caused you trouble, Nazuka walked into the rain. You can not stop the rain, but you can hold an umbrella for her. Some words are never too late to be spoken.
About time those idiots realized how stupid they were being, huh?
I can understand where they're coming from. After all, to them, we're the reason the first expedition failed.
Boss, the Trekkers who surrounded us have pulled back. They're running toward the camp.
Dang it! They harass us, then just take off?==W== Fuyuka, Kaede, let's go get them!
Screw you... Let me go!==W== Trekkers turning on their own kind? You have to be under the Boss's control!
Huh?==W== You don't know anything about Boss, so stop spouting nonsense, will ya?
I'm not the only one saying it! And besides...==W== You're the reason the first hunt failed!
This is like talking to a brick wall... I already told you—
Rumors? Nazuka admitted it herself! She said she's the one who got the whole squad wiped out.
Wait, hold on...!==W== What exactly did Nazuka admit to?
Didn't I just tell you? She—she confessed! Said she was the reason the first hunt was ruined! Just—just now, at the camp square! Now the whole place is in chaos!
By the time we reach the camp, the place is in complete disarray.
Rocks, eggs, broken flagpoles... What happened here?
Excuse me, could you tell us what happened?
What? Haven't you heard about the murderer?==W== Hmph. We must've been blind to ever call that monster a hero.
Don't say her name. It makes me sick. She was only a "hero" because our sacrifices built her up. She climbed to the top by stepping on everyone else.
Leaving her own comrades to die just to hog the reward... How could anyone forgive that?
Heh... To think the new squad was just another tool for that scumbag to use... All my hard work feels like one big joke.
Oh, I see. You're a complete and total idiot!
Oh, my bad. I guess you're too dense to understand what people are saying.
I said you're an idiot! You've got a head on your shoulders but no idea how to use it!
You're with the new squad, right? So think—has there ever been a single raid where Nazuka wasn't leading the charge?
S-She ...==W== she was only in it for the re—reward. She's the strongest, so she put on that whole act just to trick us.
So you just hid somewhere safe and watched her risk her life?
No! She was obviously planning to use us as bait—to push us out to die when things got critical.
Oh yeah? And did that ever actually happen to you?
Dammit... This is pointless!==W== Then why would she say something like that...?
You, tell me right now. What exactly did Nazuka say here, and what just happened?
She... Nazuka admitted the first hunt's failure was her fault. And then ... the crowd couldn't hold back. Some people started throwing rocks, and some even drew their swords.
W-Well, we just yelled, we didn't get physical! It's not like we could beat ...==W== beat her anyway. Nobody actually dared to attack her.
Then Nazuka disappeared deeper into the camp while we were all shouting at her. She said ... she'd take responsibility and ... vanish.
What?! And you didn't even try to stop her?!==W== Never mind—
Boss! Everyone! We have to find Nazuka, now!
It's starting to rain. I've looked all over camp, but still no sign of Nazuka.
Where could she go? The forest, maybe? She's been pushing herself way too hard these days.
If she runs into the Garden of Parasite, she'll be in real trouble...
She's nowhere to be found! Where the hell did Nazuka run off to?!
But why would she say it was her fault?
It's so stupid! All she ever does is make things harder for everyone.
I know I know it's not my place to butt in, but...
Do you think Nazuka senpai said it was her fault just to keep us out of it?
If she hadn't, everyone here would've blamed us and Boss for sure.
And that's exactly what's so stupid about it!!
She pulled this same stunt last time! Always making these big decisions on her own without talking to any of us!
Who does she think she is? Some legendary saint who saved Philae in endless rains?
Not a monster. A statue. You know the One-Armed Saint at the Philae Museum of Art? Kinda like that, but with your face.
Still, what I admire about the One-Armed Saint is her courage to make that sacrifice.
I think I might know where she went. How well do you all know the city?
We don't go into the city much, but we're locals, so we know the basic layout.
I'm in the city for work pretty often, so I know my way around.
There's a place I need to check. I'll need your help.
I could be wrong, though. Noya, Iris, Amber—could you do me a favor and search the forest?
Alright, let's roll! We'll take Loxy and go.
Where ...==W== did I wander off to?
Hey, did you hear? They took down the One-Armed Saint statue.
What, really? I thought that statue was super popular.
It's a fake. The Eye of Grace just put out new research saying the legend and the statue are both forgeries made up way later.
Oh, so that whole legend was just a fiction.
A false legend...==W== Yeah, I guess I really am a fake.
I actually thought that sacrificing something precious to me would fix everything ... and protect everyone.
If you're really so amazing, why don't you just blow away the clouds above us and make this rain stop?!
I'm just ...==W== a self-righteous fool who hurt her own friends. I can't even tell which way the wind is blowing...
What ...==W== what am I even doing...?
Curled up in a corner on the street, Nazuka hugs her knees and shuts her eyes, letting the roar of the rain wash everything else away.
This way, I don't have to obsess about that impossible question.
Boss... What are you doing here?
You're the one who told me about the One-Armed Saint.
So it's no surprise that I'm here, right?
Sorry you came all this way for nothing. The statue's been taken down.
Honestly, I think it's better if the tale and statue are forgotten.
Exactly. Would a real saint sacrifice their own arms for some vague hope or empty promise?
If there really was an evil god who demanded a sacrifice to stop rains and floods, a true saint would use their own two hands to strike it down instead.
Just like what you did when you fought against the Big Three.
The Big ... Three.==W== Boss, Nazuna was right. I made the wrong call from the very beginning, right when we went to fight them. If it weren't for that...
The wrong call? Alright then, if you could go back in time, what would you do?
Would you have retreated before others?
No, I wouldn't... I would still buy time for everyone to retreat, over and over. Back then, only Claire and I could cover them.
Would you have backed down and escaped Philae alone when United Harvest threatened your friends' safety?
Then, would you have let your friends handle that dangerous intel, letting them get targeted by United Harvest and putting them in danger?
Heh. I see what you mean, Boss. Even if I could go back, I'd still make the same choices.
You're trying to tell me my fate is sealed.
I guess that makes me a hopeless case.
When you can't blow the rain clouds away, just open an umbrella. If you don't have one, just ask someone who does for help.
Nazuka, there's nothing wrong with figuring things out on your own, but don't forget that your friends can help too.
I know it's hard for you.
You're more than strong enough, and you have a kindness that protects your guild. Yet you push away your friends, thinking that you can handle everything yourself.
To me, that's no different from the One-Armed Saint in the legend. You're both praying to some "evil god" for mercy.
Your plan might get you through the immediate crisis, but it'll only lead to more hardship down the road.
I'm starting a new hunting squad.==W== And it has no room for the weak. Goodbye.
Everything you're saying... I understand it all! But I can't help it either! I have no choice!
Everything you're saying... I understand it all! But I don't have a choice! There is no other way!
Nazuna and Kaede are too kind. If I didn't do this, they'd insist on following me, no matter what.
Because... Nazuna and Kaede are too kind. If I didn't do this, they'd insist on following me, no matter what…
But if that happened... They would get hurt. Worse, something terrible—irreversible—might happen.
Everyone says I'm "tough"... But that's not true.
Everyone says I'm "tough"... But I'm not tough at all…
If being tough means standing by and doing nothing while the people you care about get hurt ... then I just can't.
No. If being tough means standing by and doing nothing while the people you care about get hurt ... then I don't want to be tough.
I had made up my mind a long time ago... But why am I...
But ... why? My feelings were real... So why did I...?
I wish I could go back in time and do it all over… I want to apologize… I just want to be with them again—
I... I wish I could go back in time and do it all over... I want to apologize for the horrible things I said, to say I'm sorry... I just want to be with them again—
I never wanted to be separated from the people I love...
Is this how you really feel?
Yes. But I know time can't be turned back. It was my choice, and I have to live with it.
It's true, you can't turn back time.
But since you can't redo the past, why not look forward instead?
It's never too late to say what needs to be said.
Nazuka, you dummy!==W== If you had something to say, you should've just said it sooner!
Nazuna... Ah, um...==W== What I said just now, that was...
No need to explain. I already knew how you felt.==W== So—
Let me say this the right way—I'm glad to be back with you all.

No, I wouldn't... I would still buy time for everyone to retreat, over and over. Back then, only Claire and I could cover them.
Would you have backed down and escaped Philae alone when United Harvest threatened your friends' safety?
Then, would you have let your friends handle that dangerous intel, letting them get targeted by United Harvest and putting them in danger?
Heh. I see what you mean, Boss. Even if I could go back, I'd still make the same choices.
You're trying to tell me my fate is sealed.
I guess that makes me a hopeless case.
When you can't blow the rain clouds away, just open an umbrella. If you don't have one, just ask someone who does for help.
Nazuka, there's nothing wrong with figuring things out on your own, but don't forget that your friends can help too.
I know it's hard for you.
You're more than strong enough, and you have a kindness that protects your guild. Yet you push away your friends, thinking that you can handle everything yourself.
To me, that's no different from the One-Armed Saint in the legend. You're both praying to some "evil god" for mercy.
Your plan might get you through the immediate crisis, but it'll only lead to more hardship down the road.
I'm starting a new hunting squad.==W== And it has no room for the weak. Goodbye.
I'm starting a new hunting squad.==W== And it has no room for the weak. Goodbye.
Everything you're saying... I understand it all! But I can't help it either! I have no choice!
Everything you're saying... I understand it all! But I don't have a choice! There is no other way!
Nazuna and Kaede are too kind. If I didn't do this, they'd insist on following me, no matter what.
Because... Nazuna and Kaede are too kind. If I didn't do this, they'd insist on following me, no matter what…
But if that happened... They would get hurt. Worse, something terrible—irreversible—might happen.
But if that happened... They would get hurt. Worse, something terrible—irreversible—might happen.
Everyone says I'm "tough"... But that's not true.
Everyone says I'm "tough"... But I'm not tough at all…
If being tough means standing by and doing nothing while the people you care about get hurt ... then I just can't.
No. If being tough means standing by and doing nothing while the people you care about get hurt ... then I don't want to be tough.
I had made up my mind a long time ago... But why am I...
But ... why? My feelings were real... So why did I...?
I wish I could go back in time and do it all over… I want to apologize… I just want to be with them again—
I... I wish I could go back in time and do it all over... I want to apologize for the horrible things I said, to say I'm sorry... I just want to be with them again—
I never wanted to be separated from the people I love...
I never wanted to be separated from the people I love...
Is this how you really feel?
Is this how you really feel?
Yes. But I know time can't be turned back. It was my choice, and I have to live with it.
Yes. But I know time can't be turned back. It was my choice, and I have to live with it.
It's true, you can't turn back time.
It's true, you can't turn back time.
But since you can't redo the past, why not look forward instead?
But since you can't redo the past, why not look forward instead?
It's never too late to say what needs to be said.
Nazuka, you dummy!==W== If you had something to say, you should've just said it sooner!
Nazuna... Ah, um...==W== What I said just now, that was...
No need to explain. I already knew how you felt.==W== So—
Let me say this the right way—I'm glad to be back with you all.

strings.text: Companions regroup, and you now have the United Harvest's support. Lady Gray decides to wear down the mist with Trekkers in the camp. Nazuka manages to rescue everyone, but gets caught by the mist herself.
I'm sorry.==W== This is all my fault. My stubbornness achieved nothing. To make it worse, all of you are now dragged into this mess.
You don't have to apologize. We heard what you said to Boss.
Besides, even though I've been upset since that day—and yeah, I'm still mad now—==W==but it was never because you left Petal Bloom!
You're always so kind, so when you suddenly said all that cold stuff and quit the guild... Come on, even an idiot could tell something was up.
Nazuna... Kaede... You knew from the start?
We didn't know the specifics,==W== but it was obvious you were hiding something from us.
But, you, Nazuka—always trying to take on everything yourself, always keeping secrets.==W== That's enough to make even a person as easygoing as me mad!
Did you think you couldn't count on us or something?
No! I'd never thought like that!==W== I... I only left the guild because I was afraid you'd all get into...
Danger, right?! You really don't give us enough credit. We're a guild! Confronting danger and solving problems together is what we do!
See? You get it!==W== So, why don't you say it again?
"I wish I could go back in time and do it all over..."
Ahem. The rain was so loud I missed the part that came after that.
But hey, everyone's here now. We can just pretend this is "back in time," right?
Sorry, Nazuka. Nazuna's being ridiculous again. She always digs her heels in on things like this. Heh. But that stubborn streak of hers is pretty cute.
Um, since I'm new to the guild, I'd better not intrude. Senpais, I'll just ... go for a walk!
Stay, Fuyuka! You're a part of Petal Bloom too—==W==and you're our captain! We can't do this without you!
I wish I could go back in time and do it all over…==W== I want to apologize…==W== I just want to be with them again—
I never wanted to be separated from the people I love again.==W== I really don't ... not ever again...
Yeah. I heard every single word.==W== Just know that we feel the same. We don't want to be separated from you, either.
Alright, it's settled then! Now, you have to tell us everything that happened. And I mean <size=50>Everything</size>!
Nazuka, that must have been so hard... I can't believe you shouldered all of that by yourself...
Fighting monsters, leading the hunting squad, and dealing with pressure from a giant like United Harvest...
Forgive me for talking a big game earlier. Even if you'd told me back then, the only plan I could've come up with would've been for all of us to escape Philae.
Master, you've got a plan, right?
I didn't a moment ago. But I do now.
Nazuka, remember Sapphire? That United Harvest employee from the other day?
She just asked to meet tonight.
Please, make yourself comfortable. The person in charge of this matter will be with you shortly.
So this is the inside of a United Harvest greenhouse...==W== I've never seen any of these plants before.
Hello. May I address you as Boss?
Hm?==W== Oh, Boss, Tyrant, CEO ... any of those will do.==W== And you are?
It's an honor to meet you, Boss. I am Firenze, the Director of Operations for United Harvest's Philae branch. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
I'm flattered. I didn't expect the branch's second-in-command to greet me personally.
You're too kind. As CEO of the Boss Accord, protocol would normally have you meet with our Executive Director, Darcia, to ensure a meeting of equals. Unfortunately, she is currently away from Philae.
Let's skip the pleasantries.==W== Did you call this meeting just to give me a tour of your greenhouse?
I would be happy to, if you're so inclined. But first, allow me to clarify the situation regarding the bounty for the Big Three and the matter of Lady Gray.
First, let me be clear: United Harvest is not monopolizing the Trekker industry in Philae, nor do we ever intend to.
That is why your report—that someone is "using our name to deceive Trekkers"—is a matter of critical importance to us.
So you're saying ...==W== she isn't your employee?
But I heard she wore a United Harvest uniform, and the supplies had your labels.
And they were even shipped directly from your facility.
To be precise, she was a former temporary contractor, hired by United Harvest only once, several years ago.
I realize how absurd that sounds, but it's the truth.
The supplies did originate from our facility—a clear failure on our part. Someone here is engaged in illicit dealings with her, and we have already launched a full investigation.
Regarding the recent disturbance at the Trekker Camp, we acknowledge our significant responsibility and will be issuing the following public statement—
First, we will address and explain the situation regarding the unpaid bounty.
Second, we will publicly disclose our relationship with Lady Gray.
And third, we will officially clear the names of Miss Nazuka,==RT==the Boss Accord, and the Petal Bloom Guild.
Furthermore, we will dispatch a dedicated representative to the camp to help resolve the current chaos.
Alright, I can see you're sincere.==W== In that case, I have no further demands.
Is she trying to pin this on a temp to avoid company responsibility?
Doesn't seem like that... Once that announcement drops tomorrow, Lady Gray and Claire are going to be thrown into disarray.
Could United Harvest actually be innocent? A victim in all this?
No, I can't just take Firenze at her word.
I take it you find this proposal acceptable. If there are no other issues, shall we conclude our business for the day?
==PLAYER_NAME==, you're back!==W== The United Harvest didn't give you any trouble, did they?!
Actually, they were almost too friendly. They even offered to help us with the rumor problem.
Don't let your guard down. No company is kind, they only care about money.==W== Oh, uh, no offense, Boss.
I know. I've dealt with my fair share of companies like that.
So what's our next move? Do you have a plan?
Yes. That Director of Operations, Firenze, did us a huge favor.
Whatever her motives are, she bought us time to counterattack, and we need to use it wisely.
Starting tomorrow, we're all heading into the forest to find the Garden of Parasite.
If we can take it down before Claire does...
... then with United Harvest's public statement, the rumors will fall apart on their own!
Listen to me. That Boss from Emor is a real monster.
==SEX1== used some kind of dark magic to control the New Star Guild and Petal Bloom, so ==SEX== could hog the bounty.
United Harvest already put out a statement about the bounty. They said it's delayed due to a processing issue. How can someone hog a bounty that hasn't even been paid out?
Th-That... That statement must be a fake, then! The Boss probably used that magic to control the people at United Harvest, too!
If the Boss is as powerful as you say, why didn't ==SEX== just control you? Then no one would be left to oppose ==SEX4==, right?
Ugh, lying to a kid like that? Have you no shame?
I'm not lying! Just a few days ago, you were all right there with me, denouncing the Boss!
That's because you got us all riled up! United Harvest's new announcement says none of that stuff from before can be trusted.
As for the first hunting squad... I don't know what to think anymore. But Captain Nazuka really did risk her life covering our retreat.
So, what, you think the Boss is a good person now?
I suggest we wait and see. The truth will come out eventually.
Lady Gray, are you actually with United Harvest? Why did they release a statement saying you were just a temp? And from years ago, no less?
Just great. Now I can't even get the squad to listen to me.
Relax. I am with United Harvest. The situation is just complicated.
And you're not going to fill me in? We're supposed to be in this together!
Quiet! That is none of your concern. And let's get one thing straight—you and I have never been equals.
Speaking of which... What's the status of your assignment to eliminate the Boss and the New Star Guild?
Me? Eliminate the Boss and the New Star Guild?
You make it sound so simple! If I could actually take them down, why would I still be here taking orders from you?
I knew your type was unreliable. How pathetic. Nazuka, the Boss, and those two guilds have vanished. They must be off looking for the Garden of Parasite.
Heh... But we were prepared. My people have already scattered the Garden of Parasite's favorite bait throughout the forest.
I've just received a report that it's following the trail ... straight toward the Trekker Camp. With any luck, it'll run right into them there.
The Trekker Camp? What are you doing?!
To use the Trekkers to wear down its magic mist. Wasn't that your idea?
My plan was for a controlled assault! Letting that thing rampage into the camp will get everyone killed!
Oh? Worried about them, are you? I was under the impression you only cared about saving your own skin.
Do you have any idea what you're doing? The Trekker Camp is just up ahead!
We finally track down the Garden of Parasite, only for these mercs to lure it away with some weird potion.==W== This has Lady Gray written all over it.
Boss, can you handle things here? I need to get to the camp and tell everyone to evacuate.
Lady Gray and Claire must be there. It's too dangerous for you to go alone.
I know charging in by myself is risky,==W== but I'm counting on you and the others to back me up.
You'll catch up before I have to face that thing alone... Right?
Where am I?! Why are there so many monsters? Help me! Get away from me!
Kill... Kill all of you...==W== Then I'll be safe...
What can I hold you with—
A green gale sweeps through the camp, scattering the purple mist.
If you're still clear-headed, get anyone affected by the mist and fall back! Another wave is coming!
It's her! Captain Nazuka is here to save us!
I told you those rumors about Captain were fake!==W== We need to get everyone out of here, now!
We meet again, Garden of Parasite. You seem stronger, but it doesn't matter. I will destroy both you and "that thing" for good.
There's a hole in your trunk... Is that...
Nazuka... I did it! Hahaha, I got "that thing"!
Aahahaha, I succeeded!==W== It was me! I'm the one who defeated the Garden of Parasite!
The entire camp is filled with that magic mist. How did this happen?
Captain Nazuka is still in there! She threw Claire out and continued to fight the Garden of Parasite to cover our retreat!
Don't. The mist is too thick, and the hallucinations will be much worse than before. If we rush in, we'll only get in Nazuka's way.
The last time we ran into the Garden of Parasite—when ==PLAYER_NAME== and Nazuka fell into that hole—I was exposed to the mist, but I didn't hallucinate.
I'm not sure why I wasn't affected... Maybe I just have a natural resistance.==W== Iris, Amber, what about you two?
Hmm... So does that mean only the New Star Guild is immune to the hallucinations?
Tyrant, forgive my interruption. The members of the New Star Guild are immune to the mist's effects, not because of any natural resistance, but because their souls belong to you.
The paltry mist from a wild monster cannot affect a soul that the Tyrant already possesses—or is about to.
Forget that for a second. What's this about their souls belonging to you?
When someone trades their soul to me and makes a wish, they'll become an employee of Boss Accord, and their soul temporarily entrusted to my care. Once I fulfill their wish, the soul belongs to me.
That's about all I know, though. So fare, the trade's shown no downsides for them...
But I always feel that this trade isn't as safe as it seems.
But Master, I traded my soul to you, too, didn't I?
Not exactly. We only pretended to. The contract actually just lists us as "master and apprentice."
Since we're not affected by the mist, I'll leave things here to you.
The New Star Guild and I will go support Nazuka.
I'm going too! That idiot! She just told us she wouldn't shoulder everything alone, yet she's charged in all by herself once again!
The camp is huge. Many hands make light work.
Master! The Petal Bloom Guild is nothing without any of us!
Let us lend you our strength to protect everyone.
Please bring back the peace we once had to the camp.
After sealing soul pacts with Fuyuka and the others, I split up with them and proceed deeper into the misty camp.
This area is badly damaged. These marks ... have to be from Nazuka's magic.
Are you really Mistique, the witch who "feasts on the truth"?
Mistique? She's not here...==W== Is Nazuka hallucinating?
No. I would rather face the pain than drown in a beautiful lie.
Just as I thought. The mist's gotten to her. She's seeing things.
Besides, I have faith that ==SEX== will come for me.
... Even in a situation this hopeless, she still believes in me?
Nazuka's gaze passed over my shoulder, looking into somewhere behind me.
The mist has altered her perception... We can't have a normal conversation at all, but there is no other option.
I'm sorry, I can't understand what you are saying.
Listen, Nazuka, I will protect your soul through soul trading.
So, make a wish to me! With your entire will...

strings.text: Nazuka is having a long dream, a depiction of her ideal life. However, a sense of dissonance follows her like a shadow, and she realizes the world around her is fake. Because ... you weren't there.
Nazuka, wake up! C'mon, Nazuka, get up!
There's no time! You'll be late for the celebration, Nazuka!==RT==And don't you go blaming me when you are!
Yeah, yeah, I know... A celebration?
Oh, that's right! The camp's celebrating today!
Whoa, that's amazing! You got changed in the blink of an eye!
Heehee! Getting the wind to help me change with magic is my own special trick.
Captain Nazuna, what time is it?
Huh? But I thought the celebration didn't start until eleven? We still have three hours.
Uh... I was just worried you'd oversleep, so I wanted to give us a little buffer... It always takes Kaede over an hour to get me out of bed...
Nazuka, you got back from patrol really late last night. Do you want to get some more sleep?
I'm fine. Since I'm already up, I might as well get my morning training in.
Nazuka is so diligent! She's a model Trekker for the whole camp. Makes me proud to be her captain!
Aren't you coming with me, Captain Nazuna?
Me? Oh, no thanks. Working out is so tiring...
Wait, that's not what I meant! I have a strategy meeting with my advisors,==W== like Count Chompchomp the Shark!
I hear a monster. You should get some exercise with me. You'll get all stiff if you're cooped up in your room all day.
Whoa, you moved that heavy cabinet all on your own?
Hehe. Well... At least I have some confidence in my strength.
Fuyuka, what are you up to?
The Trekkers' House is reopening, so I thought I'd come lend a hand.
It has! How have you been lately?
HQ was totally short-staffed. They had me working overtime for months. It feels so good to finally be back in Philae.
It's so great to have the Trekker Association back. We were just wondering where we were going to get commissions from now on.
The new commission board is already up. We hope you'll get plenty of use out of it.
Huff ... puff... I'm beat... So "getting some exercise" was just patrolling the forest and clearing out monsters...==W== Naz... Nazuka... I am never doing a morning workout again!
Huh? Oh, Captain Nazuna! You look exhausted.
Ah, Nuz! It's great to have you back. Hey, find us an easier commission later, will you? I feel like my body is falling apart.
No problem. But before that, I've got a little something for all of you.
Is this ... a deed to a house?
Mhm. It's our way of thanking you all for taking care of the Trekkers' House during those tough times.
The Association has decided to gift you this house in the Silver District.
A house ... in the Silver District? That's far too generous. We can't possibly accept.
Please, don't refuse. You've earned this. Petal Bloom took down the Big Three almost single-handedly, exposed United Harvest's scheme, and then donated all the bounty money to the camp.
The Association's return to Philae is all thanks to you. This house is a small token compared to everything you've done for the Trekkers here. Please, you have to accept it.
Besides, the house's already stocked with gifts from other Trekkers. I spotted at least three or four different claw machines in there!
Awesome! They know me so well!
Can we really accept this?==W== Petal Bloom ... finally have a <color=red><size=50>home</size></color> of our own. I'm so happy.
When exactly did we ... take down the Big Three?

You're so forgetful, Nazuka senpai. Two months ago, you defeated the Blade of Jade. Two weeks ago, I took down the Spirit of Brutality. And just last week, you dealt the final blow to the Garden of Parasite.
Hehe, the new expedition party pitched in, sure, but Petal Bloom won all the crucial fights. You were incredible, Nazuka!
I ... don't remember any of that.
It must be the exhaustion. You were supporting the new hunting squad all by yourself for three months. Now that you can finally relax, your mind's blocking out the difficult memories.
Is that it...? But my memory...
Fuyuka, did you really take down the Spirit of Brutality by yourself?
Of course not! I was still too timid back then and didn't know how to coordinate with everyone. There's no way I could've defeated it alone.
The rest of Petal Bloom, of course! You were the one who encouraged me, Nazuka senpai. That's why I was able to land the final blow.
I encouraged you? Something about that feels ... off.
I remember ... that there were Trekkers from another city...
What are you talking about? That was a team victory! I know plenty of other Trekkers visited the camp, but the fight with the Spirit of Brutality happened just like Fuyuka said.
Lady Nazuka! Hello! Sorry to interrupt, but do you have a minute?
I'm Eleanor, a new Trekker. I always want to be a brave and dashing Trekker just like you!==W== So, um ... could I have your autograph?
Wow! An autograph from Lady Nazuka! I'll keep striving for the best!
Hehe, you're just so popular. With all these fans asking for autographs, it's no wonder you're all mixed up.
No... I can't recall their names or faces, but I'm certain some out-of-town Trekkers helped us.
Out-of-towners?==W== Oh, don't worry about it! It'll probably come back to you later. Today is for celebrating our victory over the Big Three. Cheer up, Nazuka!
Other things happened besides taking down the Big Three.==RT==Nazuka, look over there.
Mmm, this honey cake is divine!
I need lots and lots of sugar—
It's what gets the brain going!
Miss Witch helped us expose the conspiracy between Claire and United Harvest. Capturing Claire was a huge help to us, too.
What was that conspiracy with Claire and United Harvest again...? Hmm...==W== In any case, we need to thank her properly.
She's coming to the celebration at noon. You can thank her however you want then.
For now, let's just focus on the celebration. Nazuka, you still have to give a speech on behalf of everyone.
Don't worry. I memorized the script last night.
Some monster remnants are attacking the camp. I'll drive them off so they don't disrupt the celebration.

And now, please welcome our role model,==W== Philae's hero—==W==<size=50><color=#6fb1d2>Nazuka</color></size>! Who took on all three of the Big Three and defeated two of them by herself—to deliver a speech.
Thank you for saving our camp!
(So many people... Everyone looks so relaxed and happy. How long ... how long has it been since I've seen such joy?)
(Wait, why am I getting distracted? I need to start the speech. Can't keep everyone waiting.)
Hello, fellow Trekkers. To everyone gathered here today, I am Nazuka from Petal Bloom.
I hear you calling me a role model, a hero... But honestly, I don't feel I've done anything worthy of such titles.

I'm just an ordinary Trekker, like all of you. Defeating the Big Three wasn't my achievement alone—my guildmates in Petal Bloom, the hunting squad, and everyone who helped us along the way contributed.
This victory is a story all of us wrote together. With our own two hands, we carved a path to the Monolith. That's right. Every one of us is the hero of this story.
Thank you, everyone. Thank you so much for your support.
Phew... I'm done. Was ... was that okay?
Are you kidding? Just look at their faces! It was a huge success.
That was so well said! (sniffle) I'm genuinely so touched...
I hope I can speak in front of a big crowd as fluently as you one day, Nazuka senpai... I must work harder.
Greetings, heroes of Philae, and members of Petal Bloom★
Hello there! We never got a chance to thank you properly for last time, and now we've troubled you with emceeing for us on such short notice. I'm so sorry.
Oh, please, no need for formalities. As a witch, I know my way around hosting an event or two.
But if you really want to thank me, you could always grant me an exclusive interview★
Of course. Just name the time.
Well, no time like the present! Why don't we start right now★
During your fight against the Big Three, which moment was the most==RT==difficult for you? How did you overcome it, or just push through it?
No need to answer right away. Take your time... Just let me finish up my last task as your emcee.
Alright, Petal Bloom, gather 'round for a photo!
Coming! I'm getting in the middle!
<color=black>(That rain ... back then... Why was I crying?)</color>
Is it okay if I stand here...?==W== I don't want to get in senpais' way.
<color=black>(That umbrella... Who passed it to me...?)</color>
Miss Kaede and Fuyuka, could you two scoot in just a little closer, please?
(Everything feels so perfect now... But... I can't shake this feeling…==RT==... that I've forgotten something important...)
Alright, on three! One, two, three... Cheese!
Aw, what a nice shot! Sending it to your phones now.
Everyone looks great! It's a really good photo.
I'm going to print this with my Artifact and hang it in my room. Fuyuka, want me to print one for you, too?
You...==W== You really think this is a good picture?
You don't like it? We can always take another one, you know.
No, that's not it. Don't you feel like someone's missing? This empty space... Someone is supposed to be there...
Missing someone? What are you talking about? It's always just been the four of us.
Captain Nazuna... Are you really Nazuna?
What's gotten into you, Nazuka? Of course I'm Nazuna—the claw machine queen!
The Nazuna I remember is incredibly observant.==W== She may seem a little flaky, but she never misses a single clue,==W== let alone something so obvious in a photo.
Nazuka, don't start a fight. Nazuna probably just didn't notice. We've all been exhausted lately, so let's cut each other some slack.
And you, Kaede. You're kind, but you're principled. You'd never just ask someone to cut some slack.
Senpai, why are you doing this? Can't we all just get along and live happily?
Fuyuka... I might not know you that well yet, but I'm sure you would never forget the "Master" who helped you out of that tough spot.
How interesting. As a witch, I have to ask: why throw away the happiness you fought so hard to earn?
Your guild, never arguing. Your friends, standing by your side as you defeat every foe. Villains like United Harvest getting what they deserve, and all three of the Big Three vanquished...
Isn't this exactly what you always wished for?
Yes. It's what I always wanted.
But ... someone once told me something.
Exactly. Would a real saint sacrifice their own arm==RT==just for some vague hope or empty promise?
If there really was an evil god who demanded a sacrifice to stop rains and floods, a true saint would use their own two hands to strike it down instead.
I will build what I want with my own hands.==W== I won't drown myself in a fake reality==W== just patched together from old memories.
Are you really Mistique, the witch who "feasts on the truth"?
Even if we're fake, what's the big deal?
You've breathed in too much of the mist.
You have to stay here forever ... in this world of illusions.
If you go back, all that's waiting for you is a painful reality. So why not accept this beautiful dream and stay here forever...? You'll be so much happier than you ever were out there~
No. I would rather face the pain than drown in a beautiful lie.
Besides, I have faith that ==SEX== will come for me.
At some point, the statue of the One-Armed Saint had appeared in a corner of the camp. Nazuka walked over and leaned against it.
Not a monster. A statue. You know the One-Armed Saint at the Philae Museum of Art? Kinda like that, but with your face.
I'm sorry, I can't understand what you are saying.
■■■■, ■■■, ■■■■<r=Listen, Nazuka, I will protect your soul through soul trading.></r>■■■■■■■■■■.
■■, ■■■■! ■■<r=So, make a wish to me! With your entire will...Make a wish to me!></r>■■■■■, ■■■■■!
It seems you want a response—then I shall not hold back. After all, I can’t quite see your expression right now.
■■■■■■■■,<r=Any wish, and I'll make it come true!></r> ■■■■■■■■!
Just like when you rested your head on my lap...
Just like when I curled up under your umbrella...
So it really was you, Boss.
A moment ago, I was anything but. But now ... seeing your face, I'm okay. Better than okay.
Thank you, Boss. Thank you for finding me once again.
So ... does this make us even for that lap pillow?
Not yet. After all, what you owe me is more than just a lap pillow.
As much as I'd love to say that... Everyone's still fighting, aren't they?
Let's go. Everyone's waiting for you.
Everyone... That's right, I can't fall behind...
Boss, can I reserve your shoulder for a little while?
After we take down the Garden of Parasite, I'll come collect on that shoulder pillow you're repaying me.
Go face your final battle.==W== I'll save it for you for as long as it takes.

strings.text: After defeating Garden of Parasite, Nazuka and you venture alone into the forest. Under the pure white Monolith, Nazuka repeats her wish—I hope that from now on, you'll always, always be by my side.
The Garden of Parasite is just ... ash now.
This is what happens when a monster loses all its magic... Does that mean ... we won?
We won. We've defeated all of the Big Three. The path to the Monolith is clear again.
Ahaha... I can't believe we actually did it... It just feels unreal.
I should be happy, but ...==W== why do I feel so empty? It feels like I suddenly lost my life's purpose.
Why do you sound like some world-weary old lady who's seen it all?
Hey, you're as old as me!==W== So tell me, Granny Nazuka, how are your joints holding up?
Hah? You're asking for a fight, aren't you?
Oh, sounds like Noya and the others are here.
We were busy fighting off the vines and the mist-crazed monsters when suddenly, everything stopped. The vines withered, and the monsters went quiet. We figured ... you must have succeeded.
You really saved us, in more ways than one.==W== Any longer and those vines would have completely shredded my clothes.
We owe our thanks to you, too. We couldn't have faced the Garden of Parasite without you clearing the vines. This victory belongs to all of us.
I've captured all your heroic struggles on camera!==W== Once I release these images—with a little of this witch's special touch, of course—every Trekker will know you were framed.
Nazuka, did you hear that? The rumors can't spread anymore. You don't have to worry...
Nazuka senpai flew off with Master. She said the Monolith in the forest must be crawling with Stellaroids since no one's been there, so she went ahead to clear them out.
We just finished fighting the Garden of Parasite! Can't she sit still for five minutes?==W== Hey, wait a sec!==W== Why did Boss go with her?!
Nazuka, are you sure it's okay for us to just run off like this?
Don't worry. With the Garden of Parasite destroyed, those frenzied monsters should calm down, too. Even if everyone's exhausted, Nazuna and the others can handle whatever comes.
That's not my main concern...==W== Well, okay, I am a little worried. But my point is...
Shouldn't we have told everyone? They're going to be worried when they realize we're gone.
Oh, that? Don't worry about it. I asked Fuyuka to pass on a message for us.
Besides, months' worth of Stellaroids have probably built up in the Monolith. We need to go clear them out.
And of course, I cooked up an excuse for you—you're "evaluating the new hire's job performance." Feel better now?
"The new hire"...==W== So you do remember. While you were trapped in that illusion, I made a soul trade with you. Anyone who does so automatically becomes an employee of the Boss Accord.
So you heard everything I said back then?
To be precise... I couldn't make out a word you were saying. The magic mist completely blocked my mind from the real world. All I could see and hear were illusions.
But.. You still managed to make a wish.
Because, even though I couldn't clearly hear what you were saying, I felt like you wanted me to say something.
It's not often you get a chance to just speak your mind. As a result, it happened to align exactly with what you intended.
That just proved we are on the same page~
I know, but ... I'm still sorry you had to agree to a soul trade unknowingly.

You made a wish, and that sealed the deal. I shall make it happen with my life as collateral. Your soul will be temporarily entrusted to my keeping, and become my permanent possession after your wish comes true.
I told you, it's fine. Really.==W== In fact, I'm the one who should be thanking you.
Whether it was back in that hole when I was ready to give up...
... or when I was heartbroken and alone in the cold rain...
... or even this time, trapped in that beautiful dream the mist created...
Boss, you've saved me three times now.==W== I know it sounds dramatic, but each time I felt like I was reborn.
When you look at it that way, maybe ... my soul was already entrusted to you from the start.
You're giving me too much credit. You've saved me plenty of times, too.
It's okay. Feelings like this are subjective, you know?
Ah, but ... while I have no problem entrusting my soul to you, there is one little thing that's stuck in my mind...
Mhmm. It's the reason we're here.==W== Shh, don't startle them. Follow me.
The air is thick with the scent of damp earth and leaves. The quiet forest feels like a dark labyrinth.
I follow Nazuka, my footsteps light on the mossy path as we move through dense thickets that rustle in the wind.
How beautiful! There's the Monolith, with the light dancing.
Every year around this time, lightbugs brimming with magic gather here and fly towards the Monolith. So—
It is said that when you make a wish here, the lightbugs will carry it to the Monolith. Even if the wish remains unfulfilled, it will be forever etched there.

So you want to perform the trade again here, to have your wish engraved in the Monolith?
Well... not exactly. After all, that's just a tale.

If it's true, that would mean the Saint wasn't a work of fiction.
The legend could be real after all.
That's right. Speaking of which... You know, Boss, in the illusion created by the Garden of Parasite... I saw a happy future.
Nazuna's wish, Kaede's wish, Fuyuka's wish ... even mine. They all came true. We were living a warm and peaceful life.
If that's truly the future I had always longed for... Then I really am greedy.
Right, Boss, do you know? It was you who made me realize that it was nothing more than a dream.
Hehe. You didn't do anything at all.
You just ... weren't in that future.

It's probably because of my immunity to magic...
... that Garden of Parasite couldn't create a mimic.

Fuyuka? What are you doing here? Wait... Don't tell me...

Nazuka! You were trying to sneak off without us?!
... I should have known this would happen.

Boss... You just left without sending me a message. You broke your promise.
Whoa, hold on! Everyone, please, one at a time...!
Heh. Sorry, Nazuka. I tried to hold them back, but they insisted on coming.
I really thought we shouldn't bother you... I'm so, so sorry!
Hey! You two are so slick! Stop making me look like the only bad guy here!
This is ... really nice. It's only now that I truly feel like I'm back with Petal Bloom.
Ah, what a beautiful day!==W== Maybe I should let my buddies get some sun.
Nazuna, I'm so sorry about what happened. I was too quick to believe those rumors and too quick to accuse.
Hey, don't worry about it. It's all in the past. It wasn't your fault—blame the ones who were spreading lies.
But... I was the one who threw a rock at the Trekkers' House and broke the window. Can you ever forgive me?

Aaahhh! I—I'll pay for the damages, I swear! Please, don't hit me!

Wait, if this interview is for Nazuka, why am I stuck in the middle of the photo?
Ah... Well, that was the interviewee's condition. Said she wouldn't do the shoot otherwise. Nazuka picked out everyone's poses, too.
Mmm-hmm. Because this ... is my picture of perfect happiness.
A group photo just wouldn't be complete without you.
You promised me before that I could lean on your shoulder. I am claiming that opportunity now.
<size=60>♫</size> <size=50>FARAWAY</size>==RT==                                      Sung by: Isekaijoucho    Lyrics / Composition / Arrangement: Kashii Moimi

We won. We've defeated all of the Big Three. The path to the Monolith is clear again.
