strings.text: Claire is captured and taken to Emor, and Lady Gray hides in United Harvest. To get to Lady Gray and also to find clues regarding the orphanage, you start a new journey following Serena's lead.
The grand edifice of United Harvest resembled a massive anthill,==RT==with employees in black uniforms bustling to and fro.
Sorry, can't talk. My deadline's closing in.==W== Try the front desk.
Executive Director? Look, I'm just a grunt. How would I know where the big shots have their offices?==W== Ask someone else.
Everyone was polite yet distant, leaving Fuyuka feeling like an outsider==RT==who had accidentally stumbled into the wrong hive.
(Yikes, this is so intimidating...==W== Is this what the city is like?==W== Maybe I should just head back...)
(No!==W== I volunteered to accept this award for Master. I can't back out now!)
Wandering around a place like this?==W== Be careful not to get lost, little one.
<size=48>Gah!</size>==W== I'm so sorry! I'm from out of town—==W==I didn't mean to trespass!
Oh my, what an adorable kid.==W== Judging by your attire, you must be a Trekker, yes?
Yes!==W== I-==W==I'm Fuyuka,==W== leader of the Petal Bloom Guild.
I'm here to accept an award on behalf of the Petal Bloom Guild, the New Star Guild,==W== and ... the Boss.
I see.==W== What a happy coincidence.==W== I'll be attending the award ceremony myself.
Hmm.==W== It's hard to imagine you possessing the power to defeat giant monsters by your looks.==W== Appearances truly can be deceiving.
Excuse me...==W== Do you know where the Executive Director's office is? I was hoping to say hello.
That would be me. Apologies, I should have introduced myself sooner.
I'm Darcia,==W== the Executive Director for United Harvest here in Philae.
Oh, so you're the Executive Director...==W== Uh,==W==<size=52> eh??!</size>
Huh?==W== Why is Ms. Darcia talking to a Trekker?
(P-==W==People are definitely starting to stare...==W== It really is her.)
You seem a little tense.==W== Is everything alright?
(I was expecting the Executive Director to be much more intimidating...==W== But==W== she's so gentle. She must be a good person, right?)
Please, make yourself comfortable. May I offer you some tea?
(This furniture looks like it cost a fortune.==W== I'd better be careful.)
Here you are.==W== I was in Emor on business until recently,==W== so I'm afraid I'm not up to speed on matters outside the city.
I was hoping you could tell me about the hunt against the Big Three.==W== I find monsters quite fascinating.
Of course!==W== The first one we took down was the Blade of Jade.==W== It all started when Nazuka senpai and the team were ambushed...
In the end,==W== Boss made a soul trade with us==W== that shielded us from the Garden of Parasite's mist.
That's how we rescued Nazuka senpai,==W== and with her leading the charge,==W== we defeated the last of them.
A truly thrilling story.==W== It's a shame the Boss couldn't make it today.==W== I was hoping I'd have the chance to meet ==SEX4==.
W-Well...==W== Actually, Boss and all of us are incredibly grateful to United Harvest for clearing our name.==W== ==SEX1== really wanted to thank you in person.
But this was all so sudden, and since everyone was tied up with urgent work at the camp, I'm representing...
Oh, I'm so sorry!==W== I should have explained all that from the start.
It's okay.==W== I only decided on this after returning to Philae yesterday, and I didn't send word until this morning.==W== It's perfectly understandable that you couldn't rearrange your schedules.
I understand you donated the bounty from defeating the Big Three to help repair the Camp?
Um, yes.==W== The reward was for the Trekkers who defeated the monsters,==W== but taking down the Big Three was a group effort. It wasn't just the work of one or two Trekkers or guilds.
We felt it was only right for everyone to pitch in and repair the damage the Camp sustained from the Garden of Parasite.
Um...==W== At least, that's what the Boss and Nazuka senpai said.
I see.==W== Even so, this medal is my personal recognition of the Petal Bloom's achievements...
... which is why==W== I must present it to you myself.
The United Harvest Senate Medal of Honor.==W== It is our company's highest distinction, awarded to those who have made exceptional contributions==W== to the company and our city.
Such a prestigious medal==W== ... for me?!==W== Are you sure? This must be a mistake!
I had originally intended to hold a formal ceremony to elevate your guild's renown.==W== Philae's saviors should not go unrecognized.
But after hearing your story, I realize my thinking was shortsighted.==W== True heroes like you earn admiration through your actions,==W== not through tedious ceremonies.
The bearer of this medal will forever be a friend to United Harvest.==W== And we always stand by our friends, unconditionally.
A little more to the left.
Nope, that's too far left.==W== Can you nudge the beam back to the right a bit?
No, that's too far right now.
Hey! Are you sure about this?==W== Let's just have Iris find the spot. This thing weighs a ton.
Uh, Iris?==W== I think she's turned to stone.
All the Dorra ... to fix the camp...==W== It's ...==W== it's just too much...
After everything that happened, it's strange how quiet it's gotten around here.
Once the camp's fixed up and the monster tracks are gone,==W== I guess people will start to forget all about the Three Grand Commissions.
Yes.==W== With everyone pitching in, it shouldn't take long to rebuild.
Shouldn't you be helping them? What are you doing here, visiting a sinner like me?
Back then...==W== Why were you in the camp?
You mean when I foolishly charged in and got caught in that magic mist?
Mm, I thought ...==W== you'd wait outside. For the mist to clear before going in to get "that thing."
I'll admit, I only looked out for myself.==W== It was my idea==W== to use the hunting squad to burn through the mist.
But I'm not so depraved that I'd lure the Garden of Parasite to the camp,==W== let alone stand by and just watch it unfold.
I just wanted to get "that thing" quicker,==W== so that Lady Gray would lure the Garden of Parasite away.
But I was a fool. She ran as soon as she got "that thing."==W== In the end, you were the one who saved me.
To this day, I don't know what it looks like,==W== only that it's palm-sized,==W== and it was wrapped in branches...
I'll be there==W== on the day of your trial.
Ahh, that really hit the spot!
Oh no,==W== not the dessert!==W== I meant the exclusive scoop I got from interviewing the Boss.
Thanks again for everything! I'll be sure to let you see the draft before it goes to print.
Sounds good. I look forward to reading your masterpiece.
Whew, I'm wiped. This cleanup is more exhausting than fighting the Big Three ever was.==W== I wonder how Fuyuka's doing collecting the award.
Now that our deal's settled, I need to go find Serena and ask about the orphanage.
Pardon the intrusion, Tyrant.==W== I have observed that the souls you possess and safeguard now total nine.
Five before I came to Philae, plus the four from Petal Bloom... Yep, that makes nine.
If you were to procure just one more, you would complete your first mission.

When the Garden of Parasite was on its rampage,==W== you could have traded for<color=red> the souls of every Trekker present</color>.==W== Your collection would be several times larger than it is now.
But you did not do so. Why?
Because people aren't objects.==W== They should never be treated as just tools for me to complete a mission.
Vita, do you know why I rarely ask you questions?
Your top priority==W== is just making sure I complete my mission, right?
Yes. That aligns with your interests, Tyrant.
But that's just what you assume is <color=red>in my best interest</color>.
I'm not convinced your "help" won't harm my companions,==W== and I'm not sure completing the mission will lead to an outcome I desire.
Can you prove to me that it will?
I am processing...==W== My apologies.==W== I cannot provide such proof.
Then I still can't trust you.
And remember this:==W== my companions will always be my first priority.
And until you're certain about that, I might never complete this first mission of yours.
You are correct. I failed to consider what you truly desire, Tyrant.
I will take my leave. Everything I do is to help you become a more powerful Tyrant.
Well now, fancy meeting you here.
Serena. I was just on my way to find you.
I've been here for a little while.
You were tied up with that interview, and afterward, you seemed quite taken with that unique phone of yours.==W== I didn't want to interrupt.
Let's skip the pleasantries.==W== Can you give us the information you promised==W== about the orphanage?
Of course. Integrity is the foundation of good business, after all.==W== Please, take a look at this.
And you're sure this is reliable?
One hundred percent authentic.==W== I have my connections in the major companies, so getting these transaction records wasn't difficult.
All the documents for that fraudulent loan==W== were forged by a former United Harvest employee named Lady Gray.
And here's a little bonus info—==W==United Harvest may have issued a warrant for Lady Gray, but she's currently hiding right there, under their noses.
They issued a warrant while harboring the fugitive?!
United Harvest...==W== Are they friend or foe?

The United Harvest Senate Medal of Honor.==W== It is our company's highest distinction, awarded to those who have made exceptional contributions==W== to the company and our city.
Such a prestigious medal==W== ... for me?!==W== Are you sure? This must be a mistake!
I had originally intended to hold a formal ceremony to elevate your guild's renown.==W== Philae's saviors should not go unrecognized.
But after hearing your story, I realize my thinking was shortsighted.==W== True heroes like you earn admiration through your actions,==W== not through tedious ceremonies.
The bearer of this medal will forever be a friend to United Harvest.==W== And we always stand by our friends, unconditionally.
A little more to the left.
Nope, that's too far left.==W== Can you nudge the beam back to the right a bit?
No, that's too far right now.
Hey! Are you sure about this?==W== Let's just have Iris find the spot. This thing weighs a ton.
Uh, Iris?==W== I think she's turned to stone.
All the Dorra ... to fix the camp...==W== It's ...==W== it's just too much...
After everything that happened, it's strange how quiet it's gotten around here.
Once the camp's fixed up and the monster tracks are gone,==W== I guess people will start to forget all about the Three Grand Commissions.
Yes.==W== With everyone pitching in, it shouldn't take long to rebuild.
Shouldn't you be helping them? What are you doing here, visiting a sinner like me?
Back then...==W== Why were you in the camp?
You mean when I foolishly charged in and got caught in that magic mist?
Mm, I thought ...==W== you'd wait outside. For the mist to clear before going in to get "that thing."
I'll admit, I only looked out for myself.==W== It was my idea==W== to use the hunting squad to burn through the mist.
But I'm not so depraved that I'd lure the Garden of Parasite to the camp,==W== let alone stand by and just watch it unfold.
I just wanted to get "that thing" quicker,==W== so that Lady Gray would lure the Garden of Parasite away.
But I was a fool. She ran as soon as she got "that thing."==W== In the end, you were the one who saved me.
To this day, I don't know what it looks like,==W== only that it's palm-sized,==W== and it was wrapped in branches...
I'll be there==W== on the day of your trial.
Ahh, that really hit the spot!
Oh no,==W== not the dessert!==W== I meant the exclusive scoop I got from interviewing the Boss.
Thanks again for everything! I'll be sure to let you see the draft before it goes to print.
Sounds good. I look forward to reading your masterpiece.
Whew, I'm wiped. This cleanup is more exhausting than fighting the Big Three ever was.==W== I wonder how Fuyuka's doing collecting the award.
Now that our deal's settled, I need to go find Serena and ask about the orphanage.
Pardon the intrusion, Tyrant.==W== I have observed that the souls you possess and safeguard now total nine.
Five before I came to Philae, plus the four from Petal Bloom... Yep, that makes nine.
If you were to procure just one more, you would complete your first mission.

When the Garden of Parasite was on its rampage,==W== you could have traded for<color=red> the souls of every Trekker present</color>.==W== Your collection would be several times larger than it is now.
But you did not do so. Why?
Because people aren't objects.==W== They should never be treated as just tools for me to complete a mission.
Vita, do you know why I rarely ask you questions?
Your top priority==W== is just making sure I complete my mission, right?
Yes. That aligns with your interests, Tyrant.
But that's just what you assume is <color=red>in my best interest</color>.
I'm not convinced your "help" won't harm my companions,==W== and I'm not sure completing the mission will lead to an outcome I desire.
Can you prove to me that it will?
I am processing...==W== My apologies.==W== I cannot provide such proof.
Then I still can't trust you.
And remember this:==W== my companions will always be my first priority.
And until you're certain about that, I might never complete this first mission of yours.
You are correct. I failed to consider what you truly desire, Tyrant.
I will take my leave. Everything I do is to help you become a more powerful Tyrant.
Well now, fancy meeting you here.
Serena. I was just on my way to find you.
I've been here for a little while.
You were tied up with that interview, and afterward, you seemed quite taken with that unique phone of yours.==W== I didn't want to interrupt.
Let's skip the pleasantries.==W== Can you give us the information you promised==W== about the orphanage?
Of course. Integrity is the foundation of good business, after all.==W== Please, take a look at this.
And you're sure this is reliable?
One hundred percent authentic.==W== I have my connections in the major companies, so getting these transaction records wasn't difficult.
All the documents for that fraudulent loan==W== were forged by a former United Harvest employee named Lady Gray.
And here's a little bonus info—==W==United Harvest may have issued a warrant for Lady Gray, but she's currently hiding right there, under their noses.
They issued a warrant while harboring the fugitive?!
United Harvest...==W== Are they friend or foe?

strings.text: Mina from United Harvest arrives at the old Trekkers' House, inviting you to investigate the Tawny Nightingale mystery. Her proposed plan is to go undercover by passing the job interview.
Dead of night. Shady figures slink into a desolate alley.
Naturally. Have a taste. See if it's the real deal.
One,==W== two,==W== three,==W== four,==W== five...==W== It's all there.
But is it legit?==W== We'll be the judge of that.==W==<size=52> Alright crew, box her in!</size>
<size=52>Nora, hit the lights!</size>==W== Irisa, you spot anything fishy, speak up.==W== Don't be shy.
Lights, lights...==W== You got it!==W== All ready!
If she tries to pull a fast one,==W== she answers to Amberina's gun and Fuyusica's fists!
H-==W==hey...! Wait a sec!==W== How did I even get dragged into this sketchy mess?!
Boss... I think our performance is flopping.==W== Is this really what the client wanted?
Heehee, relax, Irisa.==W== Life's a stage, right?
You guys channel that "Flavio extra" energy perfectly.==W== Honestly, feels just like home.
Besides, I know it was a weird request.==W== Part of it was just for old times' sake.
And the rest?==W== I just wanted to see the Boss goofing around with the crew.==W== Just like this.
We witches feast on the truth,==W== after all.
Teaming up with Mistique ...==W== feels risky.
If she catches wind of Vita or the White Room...==W== She'll pick me clean just to get at the truth.
Anyway, thanks for digging up these interview tips for us.
The feeling is mutual. I got exactly what I was after, too.
Oops, busted...==W== Shame, I was hoping to chat a little longer.
Oh, right!==W== That intel is pretty dense. If you get stuck, just holler.==W== Customer support is included!
Iris, are these notes from Mistique actually usable?
Yeah.==W== It's the real deal...==W== Incredibly detailed. Can't believe we swapped some Tawny Nightingale for all these...
Wonder if I could get her to prep a dossier on the Grace Imperium next time...==W== Ah,==W== kidding! Just kidding.
It wasn't just the bread... It was also the legwork.
We had to scour every bakery in Philae==W== just to satisfy her weird craving==W== for Tawny Nightingale.
Still worth it.==W== With these notes, landing a job at United Harvest will be a breeze!
I'm just happy to save on food bills—plus we get to eat that fancy "Monolith Select" stuff we can never afford...
It's like a dream==W== come true♪
True.==W== If we get hired, we'll at least save on meals.==W== Eating out in this city costs a fortune.
Wait, no, no!==W== That's not the point!
We're here to finish Mina's commission,==W== not just to snag free lunches!
To understand how we got here, we have to go back a few hours—
Hello? Excuse me...==W== Is this the Trekkers' House of Trekker Association?
Yes, how can I help you?==W== ... Well, I was going to say that,==W== but I'm truly sorry.
The Trekkers' House moved out of Philae several months ago; this building is now just the old site.
But if it's a commission you need handled...
We can do it!==W== You're lookin' at Petal Bloom, the guild that took down the Big Three!
Petal Bloom?==W== My apologies,==W== I'm not really up to date on the local guilds...
I'm actually looking for the Boss Accord Staffing Company.==W== Is the Boss in?
Ugh!==W== We nearly died finishing the Three Grand Commissions...==W== How are we still nobodies?!
Oh well.==W== Reputation isn't built in a day, after all. Trust takes time to earn.
Yeah, yeah, I know...==W== Whatever.==W== It's all yours, Boss!
A pleasure to meet you.==W== I'm the CEO==W== of Boss Accord.
Hello. I'm Mina, from United Harvest.==W== Here's my card.
United Harvest... Project Manager, Strategy Department...
I'm in charge of the Tawny Nightingale project.==W== Perhaps you've heard of our bread?
Oh, for sure!==W== It came in handy==W== a few days ago!
Hehe, glad to hear that.==W== If you have a moment, could you tell me a little more about that?
We were fighting monsters==W== in the forest nearby...
I ran out of bolts==W== with one beast left standing.
So I grabbed a Tawny Nightingale and chucked it!==W== Guess what?==W== BAM! Right between the eyes!==W== Knocked it out cold!
<size=52>That is ...==W== not the user experience I had in mind...!!</size>
The crust is tough as a brick, alright.==W== The way Nazuna used it...==W== Guess that makes it an <color=#bd3059><r=·>un</r><r=·>conven</r><r=·>tional</r></color> food product?
Hey! Noya, Amber, cut it out!==W== Tawny Nightingale is food, not ammo!==W== We'd have starved without it,==W== you know!
I mean... Sure, it's dry ... and hard ...==W== and tastes like sawdust==W== ... and maybe it lacks nutrients...
But! It stores forever! You can buy it anywhere!==W== And most importantly—
—since it's barely digestible,==W== it keeps you full way longer!==W== That's a huge plus, right?!
Is she actually trying to praise it?
No, no!==W== You are a true connoisseur of the Tawny Nightingale!
You nailed our exact design philosophy:==W== fill the stomach, anywhere, anytime, for the absolute fewest Dorra.
As for the dryness ... hardness ...==W== sawdust texture ... and nutritional concerns...==W== Ahem.==W== We are actively working to optimize those.
Oh my,==W== look at us getting sidetracked.==W== Let's circle back to business—
I'm actually here==W== to formally commission the Boss Accord.
I would like you to investigate==W== a certain==W==<color=#bd3059> "delicious Tawny Nightingale"</color> found in Philae.
Wait, Tawny Nightingale ... and it's supposed to be delicious?==W== Care to fill us in on the details?
Ah, my apologies.==W== Even though I'm the client, that information is classified as a United Harvest trade secret.==W== I'm afraid I can't disclose any details right now.
You won't even tell us the specifics?==W== How exactly are we supposed to investigate?
It's simple, really.==W== Once you are officially hired at United Harvest, the restrictions on trade secrets will naturally be lifted.
So becoming an employee solves the clearance issue...==W== It's a blunt workaround, but I can't fault the logic.
Of course, there's always the chance you'll fail the interview...==W== But assuming you do get hired, you can start your investigation that very same day.
Wait, we could actually get rejected?!==W== I thought you were going to pull some strings for us here...
Under normal circumstances, absolutely.==W== I'd love nothing more than to just slot you into a position directly...
However,==W== this investigation is highly sensitive.
If I personally parachute you in, it might raise red flags.==W== That is why I need you to go through the standard interview.
Raise red flags...==W== So she suspects there's a mole inside the company?
I realize==W== it's a big ask.
But if you succeed in getting hired,==W== I promise to provide full operational support.==W== Please, take a look at these materials.
Uh, let's see...==W== Wages and benefits during the probationary period are equivalent to those of regular employees,==W== separate from the commission fee...
Plus a daily stipend of ten thousand Dorra per person.==W== And as for the final payout...
The fee is fifty million Dorra...==W==<size=48> Fifty million.</size><size=58>==W== Fifty... FIFTY MILLION?!</size>
She just collapsed!==W== Is she okay?
She's fine. Her brain just shut down from pure joy.
Boss, we have to take this job.
Remember, we donated everything from the Three Grand Commissions to rebuild the camp.
We haven't had a paying gig in ages, and the guild's savings are running on fumes.
I heard Iris sighing over the account book all last night.
Don't worry. I'll make sure we get it.
Even if we put the money issue aside...
All the documents for that fraudulent loan==W== were forged by a former United Harvest employee named Lady Gray.
And here's a little bonus info—==W==United Harvest may have issued a warrant for Lady Gray, but she's currently hiding right there, under their noses.
This is our chance to get close to Lady Gray, the mastermind behind the orphanage's debt and what happened to Claire.==W== For us...==W== This is the perfect opening!
Miss Mina,==W== we'll take the commission.
You will?!==W== Oh, thank you!==W== She was right—coming to you was absolutely the right call.
Ah,==W== pretend you didn't hear that.==W== Let's just say it's someone you've crossed paths with.==W== I'm afraid I can't disclose her name.
Here's a five million Dorra in advance==W== for your prep work.
Your interviews are set for the 30th of Tonitrua Month.==W== I'm counting on you!
Someone who outranks her ...==W== and someone we know...==W== Hmm...==W==
Of course, before we could start the job, we had to actually get the job.
That night, we traded Mistique some Tawny Nightingale==RT==from her specified bakery for an inside scoop on the interview process.
We spent the next week cramming. Finally, interview day arrived.
No fair!==W== Boss plays favorites!==W== Working at United Harvest sounds like a blast—why didn't I get picked?
Don't you have enough to do back at camp? Besides...
Hehe.==W== That job means waking up at 06:00 every single day.==W== Shifts start at 7:30 sharp.
Ugh, every morning at 06:00?==W== Forget it.
Well, don't work too hard out there!==W== Take care of yourselves!
The core mission is "undercover investigation." It's not like we're gonna turn into workaholics—
Simulation One:==W== Interviewer requests my competitive edge over other candidates.==W== Optimal response is...
We'll hold down the fort here.==W== If you need anything, just say the word.
Fuyuka!==W== You're representing Petal Bloom==W== as our guild leader!==W== Make us proud!

<size=38>Fuyuka, you can do this,==W== you can do this,</size>==W==<size=35> you can do this,==W== you can do this,</size>==W==<size=30> you can do this,==W== you can do this,</size>==W==<size=25> you can do this,==W== you can do this,</size>==W==<size=20> you can do this,==W== you can do this</size>==W==...
Mistique's cheat sheet was detailed enough,==W== but now that it's crunch time,==W== everyone's handling the pressure in their own special way.
Heheh,==W== what should we eat for the victory feast?==W== It's been ages since I had barbecue. Maybe I'll whip something up myself...
Interviews==W== require relaxation.==W== I need cat photos now...
Is this interview ...==W== really gonna go well?

strings.text: Your interview performances are riddled with blunders. Yet, Darcia decides to hire everyone—except Cosette, who looks too young to be a company employee.
"Over fifteen years of Trekker experience"...==W== Fifteen years. That's a serious veteran's resume.
But you've listed your age as seventeen? Just how old were you when you started out?
Uh, well... Keep this between us, okay?==W== I've actually got a huge secret.
You probably won't believe this—but I have memories of my past life.
I was a Trekker back then, too.==W== After I was reborn, I stuck with the trade. So all told... That's nearly seventeen years.
Your resume says you're certified in Advanced Common Novian, Senior HR Management, General Artifact Maintenance...
Yes! Plus Elementary Ancient Novian Runes, Wedding Officiant, Midwifery, Large Beast-Drawn Vehicle Operation ... and over thirty others.
I see. You've listed them quite clearly on the last five pages.==W== What made you pursue so many certifications?
Our guild is small, so we're vulnerable. The competition out there is fierce. I worry that one day, the commissions might just ... dry up.
So I figured if I got more certifications, I could take on side jobs. Anything to help keep the guild afloat.
Heh, very resourceful. Next question—what sets you apart from the other candidates?
I have strong planning skills, I'm meticulous, and I work very hard.
Unlike those who rely on intuition or experience, I offer consistent performance on long-term, complex projects.
Also, as a Trekker, I know the Tawny Nightingale line inside out. I'm confident I can contribute to your Strategy Department's brand management.
I see. Thank you for your answers. I have no further questions. Please wait in the lounge.
Understood. Thank you so much for your time today!
Heh. To go to such lengths for her guild... Now that is team spirit! A perfect fit for United Harvest.
Right then. Scenario: A client gets cold feet at the last minute. They demand a review of specific clauses and renegotiate the payout. How do you respond?
You look pale. Are you feeling unwell?
<size=30>P-P-Pleasure to meet you...!</size>==W== I-I'm fine. Please don't worry!==W==<size=35> I'm F-F-Fuyuka ...</size>==W==<size=30> from P-Petal Bloom...</size>
<size=30>I-I just ... um... I'm a b-bit nervous,</size>==W== that's all...!
Very well. Let's hear about your first Monolith climb. That's usually an unforgettable experience for a Trekker.
With your "skills"? Find another line of work. You're not cut out to be a Trekker.
Get a medic in here! She's passed out!
That interviewer in the beak mask... I know her...
Regarding the recent disturbance at the Trekker Camp, we acknowledge our significant responsibility and will be issuing the following public statement—
It's Firenze. She helped us clear those rumors. She's high-ranking... Is she the "big shot" who recommended us?
No, no! First time doing a company interview. Little nervous, haha.
Really? You've been doing quite well. Relax. Just speak your mind.
Getting into United Harvest means finding a lead on Lady Gray. Gotta focus on the interview for now.
One last thing. Give me your honest take on this: are you willing to accept consistent overtime?
Say, for a stretch... Working twelve-hour shifts, seven days a week.
Fine, provided I get paid or time off.
If we're talking about double pay...==W== I'll consider it.
Well, our salary structure is flexible. Your actual pay depends entirely on how the Philae Branch performs.
Then if those hours can be traded for comp time,==W== I could work with that, too.
You know food security is critical. We're often on call for emergencies. In principle, yes, you'd get time off in lieu.
Whatever. Reality check: high pay and low stress just can't exist together...
Understood. I see the company's position. I'm okay with the schedule.
Lady Darcia, here's the feedback on the five candidates. Please take a look.
Thanks. I'll review the paperwork later. Right now, I want your personal take—you were the one in the room, after all.

Iris is a good match for Strategy—she's a reliable operator. Her certificates are pretty much worthless on paper, but earning them proves she's driven and loyal. She'd set a solid example for the team.
==PLAYER_NAME== has real leadership potential. ==SEX1== managed to unite that chaotic mix of Trekkers around ==SEX4==.
But ==SEX== clearly hates our overtime policy. Can't blame ==SEX4==—who wouldn't? Still, ==SEX== gave a polite "yes" in the end, even if ==SEX== didn't mean it. That shows flexibility.
From their perspective, they want workhorses who grind harder for less cash.
She said "honest take," but only an idiot would fall for that trap.
Absolutely! Sacrificing for the company is an employee's greatest blessing!
Work proves my true worth! How can trivial things like "pay" or "vacations" compare to that?
<size=50>This company is my home! And you guys? You're my family!
Heh. Thanks for the answer. That concludes the interview.
==PLAYER_NAME== is even sharper than Iris. Not only can ==SEX== lead, but ==SEX== picked up on the subtext of my questions instantly. That kind of intuition is rare.
That said, ==SEX== knows how brutal our hours are, yet still claimed the "company is home." Anyone willing to lie that boldly must be after something big.
I have a life outside work! I wouldn't agree to that for all the money in the world!
Is that so? A pity. That concludes the interview, then.
Figure that's what happens when you're honest... There goes the commission.
But who cares?! Living means speaking your truth!
My answer? Do you even have to ask?
<size=50>I'd rather die!</size>==W== How does a nightmare like this exist in Nova? Twelve hours a day, seven days a week? That's not a company—that's hell!
==PLAYER_NAME== blew up about our overtime policy. ==SEX1== practically called our mandatory hours a crime against humanity.
Honestly, the overtime at this branch has been excessive lately. People aren't Artifacts—and even Artifacts break if you overuse them. I really think we should reconsider the workload.
As for the other three...==W== Completely unqualified. United Harvest doesn't need Trekkers who are that free-spirited.
Just think of the changes this "free" blood could bring to United Harvest...==W== Isn't that something to look forward to?
Lady Darcia, there's a huge problem with this group—
I know. They're with the Boss Accord Staffing Co. And one of them is the CEO known as the "Boss."
Naturally. The Boss Accord is practically a household name in Philae these days.
Aren't you concerned about our trade secrets? They do run a rival company, after all.
I'm told the Boss Accord specializes in "soul trades." United Harvest deals in grain and food—there is no conflict of interest.
Besides... When news of the Accord's reactivation broke, didn't you send agents to check them out?==W== Now we get to observe them up close. Isn't that exactly what you wanted?
Heh, I thought so. After all, this isn't the first time you've crossed paths with them, is it?
True. Though to be precise, they were the ones who approached us.
In any case, it's clear ==SEX== understands company mechanics far better than most, and knows exactly how to leverage a situation.
Precisely. I really look forward to seeing how this unfolds.
There is a deeper reason for hiring them. Think about it—if we rejected their applications, the rumors alone could tarnish United Harvest's reputation.
Understood. Do you have any specific instructions regarding their placement?
Assign them all to the Strategy Department's Tawny Nightingale project for now. Even if they make a mess of things, that team is resilient enough to handle it.
Then I'll coordinate the next steps with Manager Mina. Does that sound alright?
By the way, I noticed another Trekker in this batch who skipped the interview. Is she with the Boss Accord as well?
No, she's a Freelance Trekker by the name of Cosette.
She falsified her age as twenty, but she's actually far younger, well under the legal limit. We screened her out before the interview.
Ok. That will be all for today.
Heh... Hehehe... Come then, let me witness your true power.==W== Are you the genuine Tyrant, or merely a cheap imitation?

But you've listed your age as seventeen? Just how old were you when you started out?
Uh, well... Keep this between us, okay?==W== I've actually got a huge secret.

strings.text: With all of you officially employed, Mina briefs you on the details of the mystery. Clues could be hidden in the R&D, Marketing, and Production Departments, so you split up for the investigation.
Good morning. I'm relieved to see that everyone made it through the hiring process in one piece.
"In one piece," huh?==W== Is that really how we're describing that trainwreck?
One of us completely faked her resume.
Man, I was terrified! I thought for sure they'd catch me lying.==W== But hey... Guess that just proves I'm a top-tier actor, right?!
Another one pulled a gun in the middle of the interview.
I can't talk well without my phone. A gun gets the point across faster.
And then there was the one who ... passed out just from remembering something sad.
I'm so sorry, Master! I always choke when it matters most... I'm just useless! Please forgive me!
Honestly? After witnessing all that, I thought Iris was the only one with a ghost of a chance.
I thought I was dreaming when they said yes.==W== I still can't believe United Harvest actually took me on...!
No, no, no! Iris, get a grip! You can't get carried away over something this minor!
Don't worry, Boss. I know this is just part of the commission. My true loyalty is to the Boss Accord.
Glad you're motivated, but don't stress yourself too much.
As for the rest of you—just forget the interview ever happened.
Since we're all here, let's take the win. We cleared the first hurdle.
Thanks for pulling strings for us, Mina.
Me? I didn't do a thing.
The commission is classified, so I couldn't interfere.==W== Besides... I don't exactly have the rank to pull strings like that.
Not Mina?==W== Firenze must be behind this then... Just like last time.
But Miss Mina, you're a "Manager," right? Isn't that position supposed to be ... you know, kind of a big deal?
Haha... I am the project manager, sure. But titles can be deceiving. Besides, the Tawny Nightingale team are just two people to begin with.
Yep... Just the pair of us before you arrived. But look at us now—==W==a team of seven!
We're out of space in the main office, unfortunately. So I have to ask you to make do with this warehouse for the time being.
Tawny Nightingale is essential gear for Trekkers. It must sell well... You really kept the whole operation running with just the two of you?
It's a budget item. We move a lot of units, but the margins are razor-thin. It barely registers on the company books, so we never have extra Dorra for marketing or upgrades.
Honestly, saying "two people" is generous. Until last month, I was flying solo. I was basically managing myself.
So the other employee is a newbie, too? I'm getting a bad feeling about this...
Hi everyone! You must be the new hires Mina mentioned!==W== Nice to meet you all!
Why don't we introduce ourselves?==W== I'll start: I'm Mistique. Transferred from the Flavio branch last week. I handle the paperwork and heavy lifting.
We're pretending we've never met? Fine. But I wonder what her angle is this time.
Hi. I'm ==PLAYER_NAME==, a Trekker. I'm from ...==W== uh ... the desert.
And so, we stumble through a painfully fake round of introductions. Mina, clueless, even tries her best to help us "bond" with Mistique.
Now that we're all acquainted, let's get down to business. Specifically, the matter of the "delicious Tawny Nightingale."
Um... Mina? Mistique is still right here. Is it okay for her to be listening in on this?
It's fine. Mistique was transferred here to assist us. In fact, she's the one who scoured the city to collect all these samples.
Huh... Why do these bread bags look so familiar?
Yeah.==W== It's the real deal...==W== Incredibly detailed. Can't believe we swapped some Tawny Nightingale for all these...
Wonder if I could get her to prep a dossier on the Grace Imperium next time...==W== Ah,==W== kidding! Just kidding.
It wasn't just the bread... It was also the legwork.
We had to scour every bakery in Philae==W== just to satisfy her weird craving for Tawny Nightingale.
Recently, a unique variation of the Tawny Nightingale has surfaced in Philae. One that is actually tasty. Let's call it the "Golden Nightingale" for now.
The catch is... These Golden Nightingales seem to be mixed in==RT==with the regular stock and sold under the table.
I've analyzed samples from United Harvest shops all across the city,==RT==but found no distribution pattern.
Wait a minute... We were the ones who ran all over the city doing the heavy lifting!
Its packaging looks identical to the standard issue, but it has a fluffier texture. As for the taste...==W== I have to admit, it's leagues better than the original.
Your commission is to pinpoint exactly which department is leaking these Golden Nightingales. We must put a stop to such inferior fakes.
Uh-huh... Hold on. I'm confused. You said this Golden version tastes better than the original, right?==W== So even if it's a fake, it can't be "inferior"?
It's hard to explain. Here, sample the Golden Nightingale for yourselves.
Mmm...==W== One whiff tells me it's better than the original.
Let me try... Mmm...==W== The texture! It's absolutely divine!
You're right. It's so soft and fluffy ... and that wheat aroma is lovely.
Thanks, Fuyuka.==W== Hmm...==W== Wait... How could it be...?!
Oh my. It seems Noya noticed.
It tasted great, sure. But usually a few bites of a Tawny Nightingale is all it takes to fill me up.
This bread though? It felt nothing like that. It's like... How do I put it? Like eating air? Or cotton candy?
T-that's exactly how I felt! There was ... no substance to it.
One, two, three...==W== Did I just inhale five of them?! Usually, one is enough...
Now I see why it's "inferior." It might taste amazing, but if it doesn't actually fill you up...
Precisely. That is the core issue. It goes back to what Iris said earlier...
I mean... Sure, it's dry ... and hard ...==W== and tastes like sawdust==W== ... and maybe it lacks nutrients...
But! It stores forever! You can buy it anywhere!==W== And most importantly—
—since it's barely digestible,==W== it keeps you full way longer!==W== That's a huge plus, right?!
The Tawny Nightingale targets Trekkers in the Wilds without steady food, and city folk pinching every penny.
The philosophy is simple: fill a stomach anywhere, anytime, for the fewest Dorra possible.
No kidding. We went a month without a commission once. Bellies completely empty.
Luckily, Iris dug out half a bag of Tawny Nightingale from Loxy's corner. Stuff she'd bought three months prior.
If it weren't for the bread, we wouldn't have survived until the next paycheck cleared.
I still remember the moment I found them... It felt like pure salvation.
I'll be eternally grateful to United Harvest for inventing that bread!
Correct. That is its true purpose.==W== Plus, this "Golden" version spoils in days. Normal for regular bread, yes, but...
But for your target clients... There goes the biggest strength. That's a fatal flaw.
Too true... Imagine stocking up for a trip and accidentally buying these look-alike Golden Nightingales...
And no shoes left to boil.
Before long, rescuers would find bodies that had succumbed to starvation!==W== Their vengeful spirits linger, haunting any Trekker who dares tread that land...
It's definitely a crisis. But how can you be certain it's an inside job? Couldn't a competitor be sabotaging you?
Like I said, the packaging is identical, and they're hitting shelves through our official supply chain. No outsider could pull that off.
Besides, if a rival had that kind of access, why stop there? Why not do some real damage? The only victims here are dirt-poor locals and Trekkers.
She's right... In the cities of Nova, the suffering of the poor is hardly headline news.
Understood. Focusing inward is the only move that makes sense. So, where do we start?
From production to sales, the Tawny Nightingale passes through three key departments.
First, R&D. They develop and refine the recipes.==RT==The original formula is in their hands.
Next, Production. They run the greenhouses, the food lines,==RT==and the grain trade. They're the ones actually baking the bread.
Finally, Marketing. They manage the United Harvest stores==RT==and handle promotion and sales, including the Tawny Nightingale.
I'm sure you've guessed the plan. I'm sending you to infiltrate these three departments, posing as interns from Strategy.
We don't know which lead points to the truth yet, so I need you to gather whatever intel you can, from every angle.
Hmm. I guess it's time to decide who goes where...
Me! Pick me! Mina!==W== If I go to R&D...==W== Do I get to sample all the new flavors for free?
It's not exactly a buffet ...==W== but yes. Repeated taste-testing to optimize flavor and texture for mass production is part of their daily routine.
I am so going there! Hehe.
Come on, Fuyuka, you're with me!
Ah, o-okay. I... I'm fine with wherever...
Amber and I will take Marketing.
If Mina is right, there'll be plenty of records there. Amber types fast and I have an excellent memory. Even if we can't check files out, we can copy them manually together.
Wouldn't taking a photo be faster?
Mistique and I will handle Production. I'm a bit interested in farming.
Works for me! We'll make a good team, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
I'll handle logistics from the warehouse.==W== Oh, here are your uniforms.==W== Good luck, everyone.
Phew. Got changed.==W== How do I look?
Not bad, like a real corporate elite.
By the way, aren't you curious why I pretended not to know you? Or how I became a "transfer from the Flavio branch"?!
Nope. Because I know you're dying to tell me anyway. Like right now.
Ugh... Nothing gets past you, does it, Boss?
I'm here undercover. United Harvest is famous for breeding and bio-research...
Thanks to an exclusive franchise from the Seal of Grace,==RT==they hold a monopoly on Nova's food supply.
Years ago, the founder, Samuel, had a goal: to provide people==RT==with "cheaper and tastier food."
But now? Instead of that philosophy, everyone's just==RT==obsessed with petty factional infighting.

Let's get real for a second. United Harvest holds seventy percent of the entire continent's food supply. If a giant like that collapses from internal strife... What do you think happens to the little guy?
People would starve. The whole social order would fall apart.
Exactly! That's why I'm here chasing the big scoop. It's not just about grabbing headlines—I need to expose the real danger of letting one company hold a monopoly on our food supply.
So you forged an ID and slipped into Mina's team right when she was short-staffed.
And now you're using the cover of an "internal investigation" to gather your own material.
Heh. Great minds think alike, Boss.
Don't get me wrong, though. I intend to do a proper job for Mina. I'm just ... multitasking on the side.
Besides, getting Flavio's ace witch for pennies on the dollar? I'd call that a win-win★
Between finding Lady Gray and handling Mina's commission, Mistique's skills are too valuable to ignore. Partnering up is the logical move.
Fair enough. Since our goals align—for the moment, anyway—why don't we pool our resources?
I'm in. And just so you know, I haven't been sitting around this past week. I've already cased the joint. I know these departments inside out★
Just name the spot, and I'll lead the way.
Hmm... Where should we hit first?
Let's start with R&D. Noya's wild ideas mixed with Fuyuka's brute strength... That's worrying.
You got it. Just a heads-up: it's a sea of lab coats over there.
Let's swing by Marketing. Iris can handle the paperwork and PR just fine, but Amber... I'm not so sure.
Relax. They'll figure it out somehow.
We should stick to the plan and investigate our own assignment—the Production Department.
Ooh, look at you being all professional, Boss. To the greenhouses we go★

Huh... Why do these bread bags look so familiar?
Yeah.==W== It's the real deal...==W== Incredibly detailed. Can't believe we swapped some Tawny Nightingale for all these...
Wonder if I could get her to prep a dossier on the Grace Imperium next time...==W== Ah,==W== kidding! Just kidding.
It wasn't just the bread... It was also the legwork.
We had to scour every bakery in Philae==W== just to satisfy her weird craving for Tawny Nightingale.
Recently, a unique variation of the Tawny Nightingale has surfaced in Philae. One that is actually tasty. Let's call it the "Golden Nightingale" for now.
The catch is... These Golden Nightingales seem to be mixed in==RT==with the regular stock and sold under the table.
I've analyzed samples from United Harvest shops all across the city,==RT==but found no distribution pattern.
Wait a minute... We were the ones who ran all over the city doing the heavy lifting!
Its packaging looks identical to the standard issue, but it has a fluffier texture. As for the taste...==W== I have to admit, it's leagues better than the original.
Your commission is to pinpoint exactly which department is leaking these Golden Nightingales. We must put a stop to such inferior fakes.
Uh-huh... Hold on. I'm confused. You said this Golden version tastes better than the original, right?==W== So even if it's a fake, it can't be "inferior"?
It's hard to explain. Here, sample the Golden Nightingale for yourselves.
Mmm...==W== One whiff tells me it's better than the original.
Let me try... Mmm...==W== The texture! It's absolutely divine!
You're right. It's so soft and fluffy ... and that wheat aroma is lovely.
Thanks, Fuyuka.==W== Hmm...==W== Wait... How could it be...?!
Oh my. It seems Noya noticed.
It tasted great, sure. But usually a few bites of a Tawny Nightingale is all it takes to fill me up.
This bread though? It felt nothing like that. It's like... How do I put it? Like eating air? Or cotton candy?
T-that's exactly how I felt! There was ... no substance to it.
One, two, three...==W== Did I just inhale five of them?! Usually, one is enough...
Now I see why it's "inferior." It might taste amazing, but if it doesn't actually fill you up...
Precisely. That is the core issue. It goes back to what Iris said earlier...
I mean... Sure, it's dry ... and hard ...==W== and tastes like sawdust==W== ... and maybe it lacks nutrients...
But! It stores forever! You can buy it anywhere!==W== And most importantly—
—since it's barely digestible,==W== it keeps you full way longer!==W== That's a huge plus, right?!
The Tawny Nightingale targets Trekkers in the Wilds without steady food, and city folk pinching every penny.
The philosophy is simple: fill a stomach anywhere, anytime, for the fewest Dorra possible.
No kidding. We went a month without a commission once. Bellies completely empty.
Luckily, Iris dug out half a bag of Tawny Nightingale from Loxy's corner. Stuff she'd bought three months prior.
If it weren't for the bread, we wouldn't have survived until the next paycheck cleared.
I still remember the moment I found them... It felt like pure salvation.
I'll be eternally grateful to United Harvest for inventing that bread!
Correct. That is its true purpose.==W== Plus, this "Golden" version spoils in days. Normal for regular bread, yes, but...
But for your target clients... There goes the biggest strength. That's a fatal flaw.
Too true... Imagine stocking up for a trip and accidentally buying these look-alike Golden Nightingales...
And no shoes left to boil.
Before long, rescuers would find bodies that had succumbed to starvation!==W== Their vengeful spirits linger, haunting any Trekker who dares tread that land...
It's definitely a crisis. But how can you be certain it's an inside job? Couldn't a competitor be sabotaging you?
Like I said, the packaging is identical, and they're hitting shelves through our official supply chain. No outsider could pull that off.
Besides, if a rival had that kind of access, why stop there? Why not do some real damage? The only victims here are dirt-poor locals and Trekkers.
She's right... In the cities of Nova, the suffering of the poor is hardly headline news.
Understood. Focusing inward is the only move that makes sense. So, where do we start?
From production to sales, the Tawny Nightingale passes through three key departments.
First, R&D. They develop and refine the recipes.==RT==The original formula is in their hands.
Next, Production. They run the greenhouses, the food lines,==RT==and the grain trade. They're the ones actually baking the bread.
Finally, Marketing. They manage the United Harvest stores==RT==and handle promotion and sales, including the Tawny Nightingale.
I'm sure you've guessed the plan. I'm sending you to infiltrate these three departments, posing as interns from Strategy.
We don't know which lead points to the truth yet, so I need you to gather whatever intel you can, from every angle.
Hmm. I guess it's time to decide who goes where...
Me! Pick me! Mina!==W== If I go to R&D...==W== Do I get to sample all the new flavors for free?
It's not exactly a buffet ...==W== but yes. Repeated taste-testing to optimize flavor and texture for mass production is part of their daily routine.
I am so going there! Hehe.
Come on, Fuyuka, you're with me!
Ah, o-okay. I... I'm fine with wherever...
Amber and I will take Marketing.
If Mina is right, there'll be plenty of records there. Amber types fast and I have an excellent memory. Even if we can't check files out, we can copy them manually together.
Wouldn't taking a photo be faster?
Mistique and I will handle Production. I'm a bit interested in farming.
Works for me! We'll make a good team, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
I'll handle logistics from the warehouse.==W== Oh, here are your uniforms.==W== Good luck, everyone.
Phew. Got changed.==W== How do I look?
Not bad, like a real corporate elite.
By the way, aren't you curious why I pretended not to know you? Or how I became a "transfer from the Flavio branch"?!
Nope. Because I know you're dying to tell me anyway. Like right now.
Ugh... Nothing gets past you, does it, Boss?
I'm here undercover. United Harvest is famous for breeding and bio-research...
Thanks to an exclusive franchise from the Seal of Grace,==RT==they hold a monopoly on Nova's food supply.
Years ago, the founder, Samuel, had a goal: to provide people==RT==with "cheaper and tastier food."
But now? Instead of that philosophy, everyone's just==RT==obsessed with petty factional infighting.

Let's get real for a second. United Harvest holds seventy percent of the entire continent's food supply. If a giant like that collapses from internal strife... What do you think happens to the little guy?
People would starve. The whole social order would fall apart.
Exactly! That's why I'm here chasing the big scoop. It's not just about grabbing headlines—I need to expose the real danger of letting one company hold a monopoly on our food supply.
So you forged an ID and slipped into Mina's team right when she was short-staffed.
And now you're using the cover of an "internal investigation" to gather your own material.
Heh. Great minds think alike, Boss.
Don't get me wrong, though. I intend to do a proper job for Mina. I'm just ... multitasking on the side.
Besides, getting Flavio's ace witch for pennies on the dollar? I'd call that a win-win★
Between finding Lady Gray and handling Mina's commission, Mistique's skills are too valuable to ignore. Partnering up is the logical move.
Fair enough. Since our goals align—for the moment, anyway—why don't we pool our resources?
I'm in. And just so you know, I haven't been sitting around this past week. I've already cased the joint. I know these departments inside out★
Just name the spot, and I'll lead the way.
Hmm... Where should we hit first?
Let's start with R&D. Noya's wild ideas mixed with Fuyuka's brute strength... That's worrying.
You got it. Just a heads-up: it's a sea of lab coats over there.
Let's swing by Marketing. Iris can handle the paperwork and PR just fine, but Amber... I'm not so sure.
Relax. They'll figure it out somehow.
We should stick to the plan and investigate our own assignment—the Production Department.
Ooh, look at you being all professional, Boss. To the greenhouses we go★

strings.text: On their very first day at the R&D Department, Noya and Fuyuka cause an explosion in the lab. But Joseph, the head of R&D, doesn't reprimand them…
Final casting phase. Results should pop up any second.
Wait. Who's that over there? Never seen them before.
Interns from Strategy. They gotta shadow every department to learn the ropes, so they're stuck with us for a few days.
I don't care where they're from! Why are interns handling an experimental magic circle?
Regular operator's tied up... Besides, we're just injecting magic now. It's idiot-proof. Even an intern couldn't botch it.
Yeah, that magic circle is rock solid. You couldn't break it if you tried.
Been pulling all-nighters for a month straight; I can barely see straight. The rookies can handle the grunt work. Let us catch a breath, yeah?
No can do. I need to check on them.
The magic circle and Artifact gear are prepped, but ... can just the two of us really handle this?
Manual says we just channel magic—y'know, the Grace in our Soul Stones—to our fingertips and aim. It'll work out somehow!
W-Wait, that feels weird. A-Are we injecting too much?
Noya, wait! What did the manual say? How much are we supposed to use?!
Well...==W== Let's just go with our gut!
Huh? Is the magic circle supposed to glow like that? Something feels ... off.
That is definitely not normal! And the alarm is deafening!
Don't panic! Stay cool.==W== Oh, I know—Magic Backlash! I've busted magic circles before by jamming magic back into them.
Anyway! Get back, Fuyuka. Let me handle it!
W-What the—why did it just explode?!
Cough, cough... Ugh, there's way too much smoke in here...
You two! Evacuate, now! And report to the conference room immediately after!
R&D should be right ahead...==W== Wait, what's with all the smoke?
Heehee, smells like something fun's going on. Let me go take a peek★
Got the scoop★ Word in R&D is that the new Strategy interns made a huge mess. Mina's on her way right now.
Interns...==W== Wait, that has to be Noya and Fuyuka!
Master... It's all my fault. I poured in way too much magic.
No, no. I'm the one who didn't read the manual properly.
I'm just glad you're both safe.
Strategy Department! Is this how you train your staff? When the underlings mess up, the boss takes the fall—and you're paying for this disaster!
I'm terribly sorry for the trouble we've caused.
We're already short-handed, and now this! You've destroyed a precious Artifact. Why haven't you fired them? Are you waiting for them to sabotage the whole company?
They only just started today. Termination seems ... too harsh. I am their supervisor. The responsibility is mine.
Since you're the boss, taking responsibility is part of the job. This loss is coming out of Strategy's budget!
Oh my, don't be so serious. But tell me, is this "accident" really entirely their fault?
Isn't it obvious? They pumped in too much magic and—boom.
True, they did overload it.==W== But I just glanced through your manual for the magic circle. Funny thing—it doesn't actually say how much magic to inject. No limit mentioned.
So I didn't miss it after all...
Plus, letting two interns who just started today handle the final step? With zero supervision or training? Doesn't that sound like negligence on R&D's part?
Th-that's because we have too many experiments lately! We're swamped!
Tell you what. Since we're not entirely blameless here, let's just split the damages fifty-fifty.
She's backing down. Mistique instantly realized she was trying to pass the buck and called her out on her negligence.
She claims to be the ace of Scarlet Sights Media... Looks like she isn't bluffing.
Hold on, Mina.==W== When dealing with someone like her, you have to squeeze them a little harder.
Hey now, I'm already meeting you halfway! Are you trying to pin this whole thing on us?
Exactly. If we file an official accident report, they're bound to investigate your lack of supervision ... aren't they?
Yeah, they would... That means a pay cut at least. Maybe even a demotion.
I hear R&D has an annual quota for "Artifact wear and tear." As long as the losses stay within a reasonable range, no one asks questions.
That Artifact looked pretty ancient anyway. Why don't we just write this off as "equipment failure due to aging"? That way, nobody here is at fault.
As for the collateral damage to the lab, the Strategy Department can handle the repairs. How does that sound?
It doesn't technically violate company policy... But isn't this exploiting a loophole a bit too much?
Heh. I actually find her suggestion quite sound. In fact, I'd call it the wise choice.
That Artifact had served us for years. It simply reached the end of the line.
That's likely why a minor magic surge set it off. It would've blown no matter who was at the controls—interns or not.
If anything, I should thank them. They took out a volatile unit before it caused a real disaster. Shouldn't R&D be grateful?
That's ... far too generous. The truth is, our interns are just green.
Save the modesty, Miss Mina; facts are facts. R&D will file the report. We'll stick to the story: equipment failure due to aging.
But ... we haven't even run an investigation.
Heh, relax. Lady Darcia doesn't sweat the small stuff.
As long as R&D delivers results, she's happy to overlook any hiccups along the way.
Hmph. Unlike certain people at her side who only know how to pinch pennies. But what's the point of wasting breath on the opinions of amateurs?
Only Lady Darcia can carry the future of United Harvest. And R&D? We answer her expectations with results!
Well, if you insist, Sir...==W== We'll follow your lead.
Excellent. Now, since R&D is legitimately short-handed—mind if these two stick around our department a while longer?
But we... We just blew up an experiment.
Eh, don't sweat it. It wouldn't be R&D without a few explosions, would it?
I heard you two used to be Trekkers?
Yes! We've both got tons of experience as Trekkers.
Heh, perfect. We're developing new products for the "Monolith Premium" line, and we've sourced a lot of ingredients straight from the Wilds...
But my team are city folk through and through. They don't know the first thing about the Monolith or the Wilds.
So I was hoping you could use your Trekker know-how to help us process these ingredients.
Leave it to me! I might not look the part, but I'm actually a pro in the kitchen~
I'll be extra careful this time... I-I absolutely won't mess things up again!
Heheh, no need to stress yourself out.
After all, nobody's born an expert. Just learn from your mistakes and apply that next time—that's enough.
O-Okay! Thank you! Thanks so much...!
Save the flattery. You two get going now, and come find me if you have any questions.
Mission accomplished! Smooth sailing. Now Noya and Fuyuka can poke around R&D for clues in peace.
Mina, ==PLAYER_NAME== and I are gonna go check out the other departments.
Mistique, why did you handle it that way?
Even if the Artifact was aging, Strategy still played a part in its destruction. Wiping our hands clean and letting the company absorb the loss... It doesn't sit right with me.
Why? Let me ask you this: if you took the fall, never mind your own punishment—do you really think Noya and Fuyuka would still be allowed in R&D?
But in reality, one leads to the other. The investigation into the Golden Nightingale would hit a dead end. Don't you think a little collateral damage is worth it to keep going?
I... I guess so. I understand. I'll head back and start gathering data.
Wasn't that a little harsh?==W== You really bummed her out.
She'll be fine. She needs to figure it out eventually. In a cutthroat mega-corp like United Harvest, scheming against each other is just another Tuesday.
Even if you do screw up, you won't survive five minutes here if you don't learn how to pass the buck and dodge the blame.
You're surprisingly "gentle" in your own way. Even if your methods are a bit twisted.
That's just a witch's tender love. Besides, R&D was so ready to dump everything on us... I couldn't just let that slide★
So, Boss, where to next? Should we scout out another location?
Let's swing by Marketing.==W== Iris can handle the paperwork and PR just fine,==W== but Amber... I'm not so sure.
Relax. They'll figure it out somehow.
We should stick to the plan and investigate our own assignment—the Production Department.
Ooh, look at you being all professional, Boss. To the greenhouses we go★

strings.text: Amber is overwhelmed by the fervor in the Marketing Department, while senior Nyx extends a helping hand to her. Meanwhile, Iris seamlessly adapts herself to the hectic pace of work…
Hey, intern! Why so quiet?==W== This is a pep rally! Don't be shy—shout with the team! Let it out! Let me hear you! Come on, ready—!
I can't hear you! From the top! On my count: three, two, one, SHOUT!
My chest... It feels tight. Can you help me get to the infirmary?
You again? Make it quick! Don't fall behind on your quota.
You, intern, go give her a hand.
Yeah, you. Drop her off and get straight back here.
B-but ... the infirmary is on the left.
Huh? A rookie who actually knows where the infirmary is? Pretty sharp!
Scouted? Don't tell me you were hunting for a nap spot too?
And here we are. My personal "infirmary."
A bed ... in the greenhouse?==W== Wait, are you feeling okay?
Phew, made it. Thanks for the help.==W== Oh, right! As a thank-you for letting me kidnap you—wanna take a nap too, intern?
N-no thanks. I need to get back ... to work.
What's the rush? Those pep rallies never wrap up in under two hours. So, either nap here or get brainwashed back there for two hours... Take your pick.
Oh, I almost forgot to introduce myself. I'm Nyx. I've been in Marketing at United Harvest for four years now. That makes me your senior, technically. You're Mina's new hire, right?
Amber, huh? Nice to meet ya! By the way, let me guess. You're not exactly a "people person," are you?
You looked pretty uncomfortable back there, so I dragged you out. Hope I didn't make things worse for you.
Thank you.==W== I'm just ... really bad with those kinds of situations.
Glad to hear it. I actually used to be Mina's senior when we were on the same team. Looking out for her rookie is the least I can do.
Anyway, you're welcome in this greenhouse whenever. Just give me a shout before dropping by, okay?
Swap Heartlink IDs? You got it.
Thank you, thank you so much! Uh, Miss ... Nyx?
Don't force the title thing if it feels weird. Nyx is fine.
honestly i'm terrible face-to-face. never know how to act or where the boundaries are with people irl.
i was seriously freaking out during that pep rally just now.
thank god you dragged me out. feel like i can finally breathe.
glad i could help. ur pretty quick with your thumbs.
oh, uh, I just live on my phone
It's easier to be honest when I don't have to look someone in the eye... My fingers kind of fly on their own
Also... Are we gonna get in trouble for skipping work?
no sweat it. all the grunt work flows down to newbies like you and regulars like me anyway
we can deal with the pile when it actually hits our desks
heard we're on storefront duty starting tomorrow
y'know, live promos, shouting slogans, the works. we'd better rest up while we can.
I'm doomed... What am I gonna do???!
The Marketing Department is just up ahead. I hope Iris and Amber are settling in okay.
Shh. Listen. The staff in Marketing are chatting.
Phew, I shouted myself hoarse at that rally. Nothing hits the spot like a cold Monolith drink right now.
But ... the vending artifact in our office doesn't actually stock real Monolith drink, does it?
Obviously. I can't afford the authentic stuff anyway. Just pretend these knock-offs are the real deal. See? Don't you feel better already?
You make a good point. It's been less crazy since the new hires started,==W== but should we really be slacking off this openly?
She expertly fishes a round piece of metal, which looks nothing like a coin, from her pocket and slots it into the vending Artifact.
There, the Artifact's jammed. If anyone catches us, we just claim it malfunctioned. Say we've been waiting ages for our drinks and are just about to call maintenance.
Just a basic corporate survival skill. Speaking of intense, that intern over in Strategy is something else. A total workaholic.
Excuse me. I've finished the promotional budget for next quarter. Does anything need changing?
Good work.==W== Actually, perfect timing—I've got a task that only you can pull off... Are you up for it?
A task ... only I can pull off?!==W== Please, let me do it!!
You think she buys the whole "with great power comes great responsibility" bit? Or is she just totally blind to the fact they're dumping all their grunt work on her?
Oh! Bo—==PLAYER_NAME==! And Mistique! What brings you here?
We were a little worried. Thought we'd check in.
I nearly got buried alive under that paper avalanche... Iris, is this workload seriously okay?
It's fine! I'm the newbie, so I should be doing the heavy lifting.==W== Honestly, I want more work! It's the fastest way to grow!
Has she completely forgotten she's undercover?
Besides, more data means better odds of finding a lead. ==PLAYER_NAME==, look at this.
This is ... sales data for the Tawny Nightingale.==W== Revenue started spiking two months ago, up thirty percent year-over-year.
Only Trekkers and the poor in the Ash District buy Tawny Nightingales. That thirty percent surge... It has to be connected to what we're looking into.

strings.text: You and Mistique witness the magical plants in the Production Department. The managers here are subordinates of Firenze, Ruby and Sapphire, and neither of them knows the recipe.
Listen up, everyone! Time for Ruby's Stretch Session!==RT==Let's get pumped to tackle the day!
Kitty cat rolling,==W== tumbling and playing!<size=58> ♪</size>==W== Stretch your body, up and away!<size=58> ♪</size>
Dream big dreams, don't be shy! <size=58>♪</size> Kittens stay small, oh my, oh my! <size=58>♪</size> But the little green tree will reach the sky one day! <size=58>♪</size>
Stop! Ruby! Quit leading the Radiant Grass in song! Next door threatened just an hour ago to incinerate the whole lot if we don't pipe down.
Sapphire! Say whaaat? It's too loud over here. CAN'T HEAR YOU!
<size=54>CUT THE SINGING! Get over here, now!</size>
Production's logged ten complaints in three days. Every single one is about the Radiant Grass line.
Sorry! But I was doing it for the good of the department!
Rules are rules! One complaint docks three days' pay. At this rate, you'll be paying the company just to work here.
Uh... I'm taking this straight to Lady Firenze!
Besides, The Hidden Power of Sound in Plant Growth says music boost productivity. Radiant Grass is a plant, so it should work too, right?
Hold it, Ruby! Don't bug Lady Firenze with this nonsense. She's swamped!
For the sake of our department's performance... Here I go!
And exactly which file says that?
Get Rich Quick: Tips for Growing Mandrake Radiant Grass... Uh... Title's way too long, I forgot. Found it while tossing out old trash.
Eh?! Who're you guys? You don't look like Production staff...
Hee hee. I'm Mistique, Strategy Dept. This is ==PLAYER_NAME==. We start our internship here today.
We're hoping to learn a lot from you both.
Ooh! Newbies! I'm Ruby, your senior! Hahaha!
And that sourpuss over there is Sapphire.
I'm only a "sourpuss" because I'm stressing over your appeal report!
See? Don't let the glare scare you. She's actually a sweetheart.
Sapphire... Back when I went to the Grain Exchange with Nazuka...
I am so sorry for the wait! I'm Sapphire, the manager here.
Not at all. I've heard about the monster hunting, but that's not handled by our exchange. That falls to the Marketing Department. If you're here about the bounty, I can put you in touch with them.
As for Lady Gray, I've never heard of her. She's certainly not in our Production Department. Perhaps you should try asking somewhere else?
So the Grain Exchange falls under Production. That makes her Lady Firenze's subordinate.
She doesn't seem to recognize me. Good. We're undercover, best not to say hello.
They're the pride and joy of our department!
Ugh... Here we go again... My stomach hurts.
Heh heh. Bet that scared you. But they aren't monsters. Say hello to United Harvest's latest invention: Mandrake Radiant Grass.
Mandrake Radiant Grass? Never heard of it... Is it some kind of rare monster species?
They might look a little spooky, but they're actually total sweethearts. Watch this.
Aww, who's a good grass? You are kinda cute...==W== Though nowhere near as charming as a witch.
Why is she comparing herself to a monster?
Over here is our bread production line. Radiant Grass can follow basic commands, so we assign them repetitive mechanical tasks.
Heh heh. United Harvest farms every field outside of Philae.
Wait, is the Radiant Grass actually harvesting wheat?!
Correct. With patient training, they can sow, water, and harvest based on pre-sets and row spacing.
If they can do all that... Won't they put humans out of jobs?
Not for now. These little guys are way too inefficient. They can only handle simple tasks—humans are still way ahead.
True, but they survive on nothing but nutrient fluid and sunlight. In terms of cost... They are cheaper than hiring people.
Here's the situation with the Mandrake Radiant Grass. They can handle some work, but don't expect miracles.
We might see improvements if the company continued the research.==W== But ... it doesn't look like that's on the agenda anymore.
Right? There was supposed to be a project two years ago, but they later scrapped it. No clue why.
Just pulled the plug halfway... What a waste. If they kept at it, that grass could be doing everything for us by now. We could just sit back and relax!
Ruby, watch your mouth. The higher-ups make the decisions; we just follow orders. Don't cause trouble for Lady Firenze.
But that's exactly why we need to unlock their full potential! It benefits the company's growth too, doesn't it?
Who knows? Maybe one day the Radiant Grass greenhouses will expand ... to a hundred locations!
The only guaranteed outcome is getting complaints from other departments ... and then being shut down for good.
My apologies. Um, please don't think everyone in Production is as ... unreliable as she is.
Ruby's idea sounds like a blast! Count me in!
Ohohoho! Newbie! I knew you had the vision! How about ditching Strategy and transferring to Production right now?
Honestly, spouting nonsense again... Ugh, my stomach hurts even more now...
Hey, are you okay? Let me help you sit down.
(Hmm. The Boss took Sapphire for a break. Perfect chance to investigate this Mandrake Radiant Grass.)
(I can't believe United Harvest's hiding something this bizarre... This is gonna be a huge scoop!)
(If I could just dig up a little more dirt while I'm at it...)
So, Ruby, what's the plan? What should we do now?
You bet! Rock, pop, ballads—I can do it all!
Awesome! Let's sing for the Radiant Grass then!
I've been testing this out lately. Music really gets them moving. Watch this—
Kitty cat rolling, tumbling and playing!<size=58> ♪</size>==W== Stretch your body,==W== up and away!<size=58> ♪</size>
That's wild. They actually understand music?
They've even got favorites! If I sing the wrong song, they start slacking off.
Sounds like they act less like plants and more like puppies or kittens.
Hmm, now that you mention it, they do stare at me sometimes. Like they're waiting for a concert.
Hey! Quit staring! You're gonna stall the production line!
Come on, Mistique. Sing with me!
Kitty cat rolling, tumbling and playing!<size=58> ♪</size> Stretch your body, up and away!<size=58> ♪</size>
Dream big dreams, don't be shy! <size=58>♪</size> Kittens stay small, oh my, oh my! <size=58>♪</size>==W== But the little green tree will reach the sky one day! <size=58>♪</size>
Uh, Miss Ruby? I'm pretty sure this ain't standard operating procedure?!
Definitely not, but we're good!==W== A little soothing music should chill 'em out.
One, two, three. Three, two, one.==W== Kitty kneads the dough, soft as can be.
A little cat hair comes for free.
Fat lot of good that did!==W== Whoa, incoming!
Boxes?! They're chucking everything they can grab!
At this rate, the whole batch is gonna be toast!!
What is going on?! The line's a total disaster!
No time to explain! Help me!
How did it get this bad?!
Sapphire, Ruby. Is this what passes for "management" in Production these days?
And as for you two rookies... Consider this a lesson learned.
Mandrake Radiant Grass is a productive workforce, but highly volatile. We still lack any effective means of communication with them.
Consequently, a single moment of negligence leads to this.
Clean this up immediately. Do not let it impact today's quotas.
Such an intimidating aura. She feels like a totally different person now.
Is this the "company face"? One mask for the public, and a very different one for the staff...
Boss, I knew United Harvest was sitting on a big scoop. These plants alone are front-page material.
Head back and review our leads.
Let's go to R&D.==W== Noya's wild ideas mixed with Fuyuka's brute strength... That's worrying.
You got it. Just a heads-up:==W== it's a sea of lab coats over there.
Let's swing by Marketing.==W== Iris can handle the paperwork and PR just fine,==W== but Amber... I'm not so sure.
Relax. They'll figure it out somehow.
Let's head back. We need to regroup and go over the clues.
Heheh. Can't wait to hear what kind of dirt everyone managed to dig up today.

I've already warned them, but I doubt they'll back down so easily.
This is troublesome. I hope it won't interfere with our plans.
Heh, with the Tyrant involved, it's bound to mess things up.
Still, no need to worry too much—maybe they'll actually help us.
Good work today, everyone.==W== That wraps up day one. How are you all holding up?

Huh? Is the magic circle supposed to glow like that? Something feels ... off.
That is definitely not normal! And the alarm is deafening!
Hehe,==W== we gave it a few more tries,==W== and the magic flow has been smooth sailing ever since.
All that shouting...==W== It was terrifying==W==...

Kitty cat rolling, tumbling and playing!==W== Stretch your body,==W== up and away!

Lady Firenze actually went down to Production?==W== Well? Was her aura totally overwhelming?
Sapphire, Ruby. Is this what passes for "management" in Production these days?
It was intimidating.==W== Honestly, working under her watch felt twice as draining.
Ah,==W== haha, don't sweat it!==W== Lady Firenze is swamped.==W== She hardly ever sets foot in Production.
If you've got questions about the work, just ask Ruby or Sapphire.==W== They're both really nice.
She rarely shows up there...==W== Then did she come today specifically because we were starting?
Anyway,==W== we survived day one. Let's pool our intel.
I want to know everything that went down today.==W== Every. Last. Detail.
Me first, me first!==W== Okay, so this morning==W== at R&D—
Step one:==W== Greet people in the lab with "Good morning."
Uh,==W== but they're usually in a group...==W== Maybe==W== "Good morning, everyone"?
As for my expression...==W== Um,==W== a simple smile works, right?

<size=32>After the greeting,==W== segue into the important stuff.==W== Like==W==...==W== "Those United Harvest mercenaries are cool!==W== What weapons do they use?"==W== No,==W== wait.==W== Too forced?</size>

Lucky me—==W==I dug you up on the second try!
Nazuna senpai ...==W== knows me too well.
Uh...==W== R-Right.==W== I-I just ... needed a spot where n-no one could see me to, um,==W== mentally prepare myself for the greetings...

N-Noya!==W== You don't have to tell everyone that part!
Mistique said==W== she wanted every last detail.
