strings.text: The clues are a calculated plant, and the investigation must be proceeded with caution. Amber in a mascot suit nails the promotion task, while Noya and Fuyuka decide to wish for ingredients and crack the recipe.
Everyone, listen. Mina's commission, Lady Gray's location, the fate of the orphanage... These aren't three separate mysteries. They are a single, connected case.
Connected...==W== Uh, simplify that for me? I'm lost.
Sort the events chronologically and you'll see it.
Firenze secures the Tawny Nightingale formula at Ash Orphanage. Immediately after, the entire place vanishes.
Aunt Allie took the kids and fled ...==W== because of the formula?
Floris Month in Monolith Calendar Year 996.
Iris's investigation confirms that it was exactly when the Golden Nightingale emerged.
Simultaneously, Lady Gray forced Nazuka to hunt the Big Three. That was when the Blade of Jade fell.
The timing of their appearance ... aligns too perfectly.==W== Surely it's not that simple?
Exactly. Remember, Mina said a VIP planted us in United Harvest to investigate the Golden Nightingale.
And right on day one, an anonymous tip about the orphanage dropped right in our laps.
Too convenient. Like someone wanted us to connect the dots.
I've seen plenty of fake leads in my time, but my witch's intuition? It says this is real. Or at least, part of the truth.
Tawny Nightingale. It ties everything together.
Right. Since they're generous enough to set the stage, let's play along.
Oh! I get it! It's like a sandwich! The Tawny Nightingale is the bread holding everything else together!
Basically...==W== If we take a bite out of the Golden Nightingale, we get the Orphanage and Lady Gray too?
Noya's metaphor is a bit crude, but practically, she's right.
You know, putting all your stories together, I've actually sniffed out a lead on the Golden Nightingale.
Done plenty of undercover work at big companies. I know how the game is played.
If you want to pull something off in a massive company like this, you gotta find the blind spots in their protocol—the gray areas.
Take you and Nyx today. Slacking off in the greenhouse, right? And nobody came after you for it.
Yeah. Nyx's excuse was "going to the infirmary." We didn't go. Nobody asked.
Standard practice. The supervisor just needs a reason on paper for your absence. The infirmary checks the box. Anything else isn't their problem.
As long as nothing blows back on them, they couldn't care less where an employee goes or what they're actually doing.
But what if someone checks with the infirmary staff? They'd find out we were never there!
Easy fix.==W== Make up another excuse. "I felt better on the way," or "I was in too much pain to walk there." You get the idea.
Besides, company drones don't go looking for trouble. Keeping your head down is always the smartest play, no matter the situation.
Even the higher-ups, like the Directors, are swamped.==W== If they spot a chance to slack off or save themselves a headache, you bet they'll take it.
Since nobody wants to rock the boat, the management ends up full of holes just waiting to be exploited.
Always thought these big companies were full of capable elites. Guess people don't really change, no matter where you go...
Alright, recap time. How exactly did this Golden Nightingale come to be?
How...?==W== The Tawny Nightingale recipe is top secret. Only a few higher-ups know it.
Plus, Production delivers stock directly to Marketing.==W== Are you saying they're the ones behind this...?
Production handed the whole workflow to the Mandrakes—from planting to packaging...==W== Wait. I see it. The blind spot is—
Bingo. Radiant Grass runs on autopilot. They can't talk, and they definitely can't make judgment calls.
Glitch or sabotage, it doesn't matter. The Radiant Grass is the weakest link in the chain.
But how do we prove it? It's not like the Grass can tell us what happened.
Every action leaves a trace. If we map the correct workflow, we can spot exactly where things went off the rails.
The taste is totally different, so the recipe has to be, too. The production logs will prove it.
Iris, I'll get Mina to pull those logs tomorrow. Can you handle the analysis?
Mistique, Amber, and I will keep digging for clues on our end.
Here's the catch: to find the deviation, we need the original recipe.==W== And I have no clue on how to get that.
M-Master... About that... I might have a way.==W== But I'd need Noya's help to pull it off.
Phew... Here we go. That's every scrap of production and sales data for the Tawny Nightingale since launch. Two whole years of it.
Whoa, must be at least a hundred binders here!
That's just crate one. Ten more crates are waiting out back.
Well, since the Mandrake Radiant Grass does all the heavy lifting, the staff had to prove they were still useful. So, they documented every single tiny detail of the process, to avoid getting fired.
Ironically, they got the axe anyway for wasting too much paper and ink.
That's terrifying... The company world is scarier than the Wilds.==W== You think Amber can handle Marketing all by herself?
She'll be fine. Nyx is looking out for her. She took me under her wing back when I was a rookie, too.
Meow-Meow Donuts! A United Harvest special presentation! Buy a combo now and get—
Aaaand they hung up.==W== Looks like cold calling's a bust, too. Just like the in-person pitch.
H-hey, don't get discouraged! We can still try blast messages. That's gotta be right up your alley!
Texting? I can do that. How does it work?
Ah, shoot. Sorry, that shift wraps up by five. Maybe tomorrow?==W== Wait, tomorrow we're on street promo duty. Busiest strip in the Silver District.
The busiest strip...==W== That means crowds.
I'm no good at talking to people face-to-face...==W== But I can't back down.
Iris, Noya. Can you do me a favor?
I really want to nail this marketing job.
You got it. I'll swing by tomorrow to help out.
Do you require material on sales rhetoric? I have reference books on the subject.
No. I need you guys to help me make something.
Lemme get in there! My turn!
What's on it? "United Harvest's Newest Product"...
Well, aren't you just too cute to refuse? I'll try one.
Please line up, everyone! Don't worry, there's plenty to go around.
Sold out already?! We just crushed a three-day quota in a single afternoon!
Good thing I had this costume.
You're a machine. Five minutes in that thing and I'd be melting, let alone doing all those crazy stunts for hours...
The Wilds are worse. I'm used to it.
You Trekkers have it rough...==W== Anyway, thanks to your hustle, we've earned ourselves the next two days off.
We could sell more. Why stop now?
Nope. Overdeliver now, and they'll just raise the bar next time. Then you're screwed when you can't keep up.
By the way, where'd you get that costume? That's really neat stitching. Did you make it yourself?
Last night. My friends helped me. Couldn't have done it without them.
Made it with your friends, huh? That must be nice.
So, what are they up to right now?
Noya! Fuyuka! We did it! It actually worked!
Those Flarebloom roots you recommended... They kick way harder than Ignis Fruit!
Turn this into a seasoning, and we've got a guaranteed bestseller on our hands!
Heheh, first bite's mine! Bet it tastes interesting!
Huh? Chief, w-w-why the s-sudden apology?
I was prejudiced when you first joined...==W== Didn't think Trekkers from the Wilds could possibly help with our research.
Reminds me of what the old Director used to say...
"City folks don't know jack about the Wilds."
Trekkers know the land way better than us. It's not often we get to have two former Trekkers on the team. Gotta treasure the chance!
True. You know those wild ingredients better. I'm counting on you from here on out.
Um, Chief? I have a suggestion.
To help the department better, Noya and I want to go gather new ingredients in the Wilds. And maybe visit the Monolith to wish for spices R&D is missing. Is that okay?
Of course. It's more than okay.
The more novel ingredients, the better!
Th-thank you for the support, Chief! We'll head out now.
Now? Isn't it a bit late? The sun's nearly down.
Um, well, we're volunteering for overtime! If we leave now, we'll be back by morning. It won't delay our other work at all.
Not bad, Fuyuka! You snagged a pass without raising a single eyebrow! You were so smooth back there, you almost sounded like Boss.
Guess all that training is finally paying off!
M-me? Like Master?==W== No way... I-I'm nowhere near that level yet.
Anyway, you killed it! Coming up with ideas like using R&D gear to reverse-engineer the Tawny Nightingale recipe... Total genius!
Alright, enough chatter. Let's roll!==W== Target: the Monolith!
We'll wish for every spice imaginable, then test every single combo.
With enough trial and error, we're bound to crack the code==RT==for the Tawny Nightingale recipe ... and boom!
B-but I don't actually know how to bake.==W== I'll have to leave that part to you, Noya senpai.
Leave it to me! Wishing for spice and baking bread happen to be my specialties!
Let's hop in Loxy and get changed first.
Phew, done... Ah, this feels so snug!==W== This gear really is the best to move in. Hehe ... hehehe.
Ready when you are, Noya senpai!

H-hey, don't get discouraged! We can still try blast messages. That's gotta be right up your alley!
Texting? I can do that. How does it work?
Ah, shoot. Sorry, that shift wraps up by five. Maybe tomorrow?==W== Wait, tomorrow we're on street promo duty. Busiest strip in the Silver District.
The busiest strip...==W== That means crowds.
I'm no good at talking to people face-to-face...==W== But I can't back down.
Iris, Noya. Can you do me a favor?
I really want to nail this marketing job.
You got it. I'll swing by tomorrow to help out.
Do you require material on sales rhetoric? I have reference books on the subject.
No. I need you guys to help me make something.
Lemme get in there! My turn!
What's on it? "United Harvest's Newest Product"...
Well, aren't you just too cute to refuse? I'll try one.
Please line up, everyone! Don't worry, there's plenty to go around.
Sold out already?! We just crushed a three-day quota in a single afternoon!
Good thing I had this costume.
You're a machine. Five minutes in that thing and I'd be melting, let alone doing all those crazy stunts for hours...
The Wilds are worse. I'm used to it.
You Trekkers have it rough...==W== Anyway, thanks to your hustle, we've earned ourselves the next two days off.
We could sell more. Why stop now?
Nope. Overdeliver now, and they'll just raise the bar next time. Then you're screwed when you can't keep up.
By the way, where'd you get that costume? That's really neat stitching. Did you make it yourself?
Last night. My friends helped me. Couldn't have done it without them.
Made it with your friends, huh? That must be nice.
So, what are they up to right now?
Noya! Fuyuka! We did it! It actually worked!
Those Flarebloom roots you recommended... They kick way harder than Ignis Fruit!
Turn this into a seasoning, and we've got a guaranteed bestseller on our hands!
Heheh, first bite's mine! Bet it tastes interesting!
Huh? Chief, w-w-why the s-sudden apology?
I was prejudiced when you first joined...==W== Didn't think Trekkers from the Wilds could possibly help with our research.
Reminds me of what the old Director used to say...
"City folks don't know jack about the Wilds."
Trekkers know the land way better than us. It's not often we get to have two former Trekkers on the team. Gotta treasure the chance!
True. You know those wild ingredients better. I'm counting on you from here on out.
Um, Chief? I have a suggestion.
To help the department better, Noya and I want to go gather new ingredients in the Wilds. And maybe visit the Monolith to wish for spices R&D is missing. Is that okay?
Of course. It's more than okay.
The more novel ingredients, the better!
Th-thank you for the support, Chief! We'll head out now.
Now? Isn't it a bit late? The sun's nearly down.
Um, well, we're volunteering for overtime! If we leave now, we'll be back by morning. It won't delay our other work at all.
Not bad, Fuyuka! You snagged a pass without raising a single eyebrow! You were so smooth back there, you almost sounded like Boss.
Guess all that training is finally paying off!
M-me? Like Master?==W== No way... I-I'm nowhere near that level yet.
Anyway, you killed it! Coming up with ideas like using R&D gear to reverse-engineer the Tawny Nightingale recipe... Total genius!
Alright, enough chatter. Let's roll!==W== Target: the Monolith!
We'll wish for every spice imaginable, then test every single combo.
With enough trial and error, we're bound to crack the code==RT==for the Tawny Nightingale recipe ... and boom!
B-but I don't actually know how to bake.==W== I'll have to leave that part to you, Noya senpai.
Leave it to me! Wishing for spice and baking bread happen to be my specialties!
Let's hop in Loxy and get changed first.
Phew, done... Ah, this feels so snug!==W== This gear really is the best to move in. Hehe ... hehehe.
Ready when you are, Noya senpai!

strings.text: With ingredients brought by Noya and Fuyuka and the help of Radiant Grass, you finally crack the recipe and uncover the key to the bread mystery: magically ripened flour.
Heading out, Noya? Wanna walk together?
Nah, gonna put in some overtime.==W== Fuyuka's staying with me.
So dedicated.==W== Don't burn yourself out, okay? See ya.
Don't sweat it, stamina's my middle name! Catch you tomorrow!
Phew... Coast is clear. Let's get cracking!==W== Fuyuka, got the stuff we wished for at the Monolith?
Mhm. I stashed it all in the corner next door. Pretty sure nobody noticed.
Classic Fuyuka, always one step ahead!==W== Alright, eyes on the prize! We're gonna keep baking Tawny Nightingales until we nail that recipe!
But what do we do with the finished ones? People are bound to notice if they pile up.
We'll just take 'em home and snack on 'em later. Tawny Nightingales stay fresh basically forever anyway!
Let's do this. Judging by the texture, I say we start with a one-to-one mix of flour and sawdust.
Got it. I'll grab the ingredients.
Noya, any progress on cracking the recipe?==W== We've been living on Tawny Nightingales for ten days straight!
I can feel it! The dawn of victory is rising just over the horizon.
You mean the kind of horizon you can never actually reach?
W-Well... There are just too many seasonings to test. We have to bake so many batches, and kneading the dough takes forever...
Kneading dough, huh?==W== I've got an idea. I'll bring some extra hands tonight.
Evening, Master.==W== Um... Are you and Mistique the "extra hands" we were promised?
Hah! As if.==W== Here are your extra hands—
Whoa! What kind of monster is that?!
Not a monster. It's Mandrake Radiant Grass, straight from the factory. Show 'em the ropes and they'll be kneading dough in no time.
So that's what Mandrake Radiant Grass looks like.
You can't just swipe Radiant Grass from the factory floor! That is a major protocol violation!
I came to help Noya and Fuyuka, not walk in on you breaching company policy!
Aww, look at that. Great minds think alike!
We are nothing alike. I don't break rules.==W== We're here to expose misconduct, not commit it! You're defeating the entire purpose!
Chill out. I got approval from the higher-ups to bring 'em along.==W== Oh, speak of the devil.
Hehe! Not totally sure what's happening, but I brought the Radiant Grass to help!
Um, Ruby... Are we allowed to take them off the factory floor?
It's just a little kneading, no biggie!==W== Besides, Radiant Grass has infinite untapped potential just waiting to be unleashed!
It's the perfect opportunity! If they can help R&D, maybe the brass will finally reconsider restarting the Radiant Grass project!
Alright, little guys!==W== Watch how Noya and Fuyuka knead and learn!
A wave of Radiant Grass floods in. Copying Noya, they mix flour with sawdust and start kneading.
Success! Taste this. Isn't it a dead ringer for a real Tawny Nightingale?
Hmm, let me see.==W== That coarse texture... The sawdust finish...==W== Even with a margin of error, it's ninety-nine percent Tawny Nightingale.
Many hands make light work...==W== Or rather, many Grasses. With hundreds of Mandrake Radiant Grasses on the job,==W== we churned out endless variations and nailed the recipe in no time.
Now we can cross-check this against Production's recipe and spot the discrepancy.
Hehe. Actually, we might not need to go anywhere.
This batch isn't just ninety-nine percent Tawny Nightingale.==W== We've got a Golden Nightingale in here, too.
This slice right here, baked by Radiant Grass #82.==W== Here, Fuyuka, have a taste.
Wow... So soft!==W== Munch...==W== Mm, sweet too.
Master, it really is a Golden Nightingale.
I-I made a Golden Nightingale? Impossible. I used standard ingredients! I remember this loaf just had ... slightly less chaff?
Is there another loaf with identical ingredients, just with a different amount of chaff?
This taste...==W== It's a slightly less offensive Tawny Nightingale,==W== but definitely not a Golden one.
Strange. Nearly identical ingredients, yet the texture is worlds apart? The secret to the Golden Nightingale can't just be that pinch of chaff.
Not the chaff, and not the seasoning...
Then it's gotta be the flour!==W== Hey, #82, show me which bag you used?
This flour feels different.==W== Definitely not the standard stuff.
Sorry for the 2 AM wake-up call, everyone.
It's okay, Mina. Did Noya and Fuyuka make a breakthrough with the recipe?
Yes.==W== We've cracked the Tawny Nightingale formula, and we also found out what's causing the line to spit out those Golden Nightingales.==W== Look at this.
This is the manifest for the flour we bought straight from Production yesterday.
We found a sack where the wheat had been artificially ripened with magic.
Exactly. R&D supposedly had an old project to speed-grow crops with magic. They managed to shrink the growth cycle down to a tenth.
A tenth of the time ... means ten times the yield.
But magic-grown crops are hollow shells. The wheat looks real, the flour looks real, but it's got zero nutrition.
Human stomachs can't digest magic, after all.
The Mandrake Radiant Grass on the line can't tell flour types apart, so they'd never spot the difference.==W== Just like we thought: the problem is a blind spot in the protocol.
So at daybreak, we start hitting the greenhouses one by one?
No need. I've got a faster way.
Iris and I have been crunching the greenhouse data for days. Now we know what to look for—the magic-ripened wheat. We can pinpoint the source just by checking the records.
Sounds like a ton of data. Want me to borrow Mandrake Radiant Grass for you? They're great at hauling heavy files.
Thanks, but no. I'm not breaking protocol.
You should all get some rest. I'll have the data processed by morning.
Greenhouse 25, done.==W== Ugh, look at the time. Mina, think we can actually finish before sunrise?
I've cleared 50 through 99. Send over a few of the earlier ones—I'll take them off your plate.
Th-That's fast!==W== How? We split the workload evenly...
It's your method, Iris. You're going about it the wrong way.
Let me guess. You're auditing everything—seeds, fertilizer, water, yield, and packaging?
Right. That's the most rigorous way... A single mismatch will prove there's a problem.
You're not wrong, but your priorities are backwards.
You're processing one greenhouse at a time. But remember the goal:==W== we need to catch the ones using illegal magical ripening.
For that, just check the labor hours.
They can fake the other stats, but crops still have to be picked. If they're using magic, the harvest frequency spikes way above normal. That, they can't hide.
Oh... I get it. You're right. Those anomalies are way more obvious.
Is... Is this the difference between me and a real company pro?==W== If I'd thought like this back then...==W==<size=30> Maybe I wouldn't have been rejected.
Hey, I didn't learn this on day one, either.==W== And don't forget—you passed Lady Firenze's interview on your own merit.
Have a little faith. We're all works in progress.
Thanks, Mina.==W== Alright, let's push through and find that last bit of data.

strings.text: With the commission complete, Mina invites the group over and brings up a past information leak. The report Mina submitted are met with total silence. You decide to go for another sweep of the greenhouse.
Those people didn't back down, as expected. They're even closing in on the truth.
It doesn't matter. With Mina there, even if they find the truth, I'll keep them stalled.
Let me see... Too many departments and individuals are tangled up in this.
Until at least the 5th of next month, I think.
That long? What on earth are those people up to... Fine, I'll do my best to stall them until then.
Yawn... Man, I'm toast. Mina, Iris, how'd those numbers turn out? Found anything?
F-finally done...==W== I ran the check again. The data doesn't lie. This is the result.
Here's the verdict:==W== nine out of ninety-nine greenhouses have been using 200% more wheat seed than average over the last two months.
That's way beyond normal waste. Someone has to be using magic to force-grow the wheat in there.
You guys move fast. Pretty thorough job. So, let's go stake out those sheds and nab the guy, yeah?
We can't. Our mandate is investigation only—no arrests.
I'll submit the evidence to HQ. Let the company deal with it.
Let the company deal with it, huh... Nine greenhouses, totally unnoticed for two months. Who could pull that off?
Iris, Mistique, ==PLAYER_NAME== ... and everyone else not here, good work.
That wraps up the Golden Nightingale investigation. Since we finally have a day off, why not come over to my place for dinner? Let's celebrate.
Make yourselves at home. Sorry...==W== It's a bit of a tight squeeze in here.
Nia, Aila. You two been behaving yourselves?
I was super good! I made dinner last night and breakfast this morning.
And I cleaned up the house.
Mina... Could you not work so late next time? It gets kinda scary when it's just us here.
I'm sorry... I promise I won't stay out that late again.
Liar. You say that every time, but you didn't even come home last night!
Ah-haha... I promise, for real this time! No matter how late it gets, I'll come home.
Everyone, meet my little sisters—Aila and Nia.
Come on, say hello to our guests.
Then what?! That giant Bark Boar was charging right at you! What did you do?
It's not just a "giant Bark Boar." It has a proper name! It's the Spirit of... Uh...==W== Right, the Spirit of Brutality.
Well, the Spirit of Brutality realized ==PLAYER_NAME== was calling the shots and went berserk. It ripped a massive boulder out of the ground and hurled it straight at us!
Don't worry. Fuyuka stepped in with a solid right hook—BAM! That rock shattered into dust. Then she followed up with a left hook that sent the Spirit of Brutality flying into the sky!
N-Noya, please... You're making it sound way more dramatic than it actually was...
Fuyuka! Can you show us? Please? Show us the hooks!
Yeah, do it! Look, this pillow can be the Spirit of Brutality, and...==W== I'll use this apple for its nose!
Hey now, don't waste food.==W== Why don't you play with me instead? I've got something really fun planned.
Oh yeah? Is it cooler than fighting a giant monster?
Absolutely. I've curated a selection of math problems perfectly tailored for your age group.==W== I tested them myself—they're incredibly practical. You'll love them.
What a nostalgic sight. There's nothing quite like seeing everyone together, getting along so warmly.
Yeah. Everyone's been on edge lately. What a relief to finally see them relax.
Thank you all. I'm away so much these days... It's been a long time since I've heard Nia and Aila laugh like that.
Don't mention it. Noya and the others said playing with the kids brings back happy memories of the orphanage. They're having a blast, too.
Speaking of which, I haven't seen your parents. Are they out? Should we make extra for lunch?
No need. They aren't in Philae right now. They're working far, far to the south—==W==at the United Harvest Lushwood Jungle Branch.
The Lushwood Jungle Branch? Isn't that on the southern edge of the Empire...?==W== But with kids at home, why do they have to work so far away?
Well...==W== Four years ago, there was a major incident at the Philae Branch.
The former R&D Director—Director Joseph's predecessor—was arrested for leaking secrets to witches and embezzling funds.
My parents were in R&D back then, and they were found partially responsible for what happened.

Luckily, the compliance inspector in charge was a stickler for protocol. She ruled that my parents were merely implicated. So instead of being exiled like the former Director, they were just transferred to the Lushwood Jungle Branch.
So that's the skeleton in United Harvest's closet...
After they left, their pay was cut drastically. I was still in school... We fell on hard times almost overnight.
But that anonymous compliance inspector saved us, cited a regulation about employee welfare, and got the company to grant us a subsidy.
Later, when Tawny Nightingale launched, we started getting weekly shipments. It was enough to keep us fed.
To me, Tawny Nightingale tastes better than anything else in the world.
I see... The rules are what got you through. No wonder you were really against us breaking protocol or looking for loopholes during the investigation.
It might sound dramatic...==W== But without those rules, I wouldn't be here today.
If everyone ignored the rules like that Director or those witches, imagine the chaos. Imagine how many people would suffer.
I don't know the details, but it's not like the witches are totally lawless. They have their own code, don't they?
Maybe. But to me, they're just selfish people who only care about themselves. I hate witches.
... Yeah. Guess they aren't exactly winning any popularity contests.
Oh ★ Why didn't you tell me sooner?!
Noya, will you come back and tell us more stories next time?
I wanna hear about your adventure on the Waterway!
You got it! Besides, Mina's an amazing cook—I'm hoping to learn a few local dishes from her while I'm here.
Mina, how long till we hear back on that report?
Since the "big shots" are all over this, maybe as soon as tomorrow. A week, tops.
Until then, mind sticking around United Harvest a little longer?
Sure. Marketing's actually been pretty interesting.
I've learned a ton in R&D. Once this job's done, maybe I can finally be of some real help to everyone.
Something wrong, Mistique? Mina's words sting?==W== She doesn't know you're a witch—it wasn't personal.
Sharp eyes. That's the great Boss for you.
Being hated is part of the gig for a witch. I'm not gonna get depressed over a couple of stray comments.
But..==W== seeing Mina and her sisters sticking together like that... even though I don‘t know who that witch from the past really was, it still makes me feel a little guilty.
Boss, what takes priority: following the rules, or uncovering the truth?
Rules are meant to be broken!
Surely there's a way to follow the rules and still get to the truth?
In theory. But just like a claw machine—does feeding it coins guarantee you a prize?
Exactly. So when the claw fails, you face a choice: keep feeding it coins, or break the machine open.
Would anyone actually break it open?
Maybe not after twenty losses. But two hundred?==W== Your mindset might change.
Fair point... I'd at least suspect the claw was rigged.
Rules create stability. And stability protects the majority.
So, if we break the rules to find the truth, does that make us villains?
I never said that. But if a rule crumbles just because a witch poked it,==W== it was likely weak to begin with, no?
You have a weird way of comforting people.
I'm not offering comfort. A stable system should be self-repairing. It's a natural cycle of breaking and mending.
Oh? So whatever is left standing in the end is "Justice"?==W== The ultimate rule?
Precisely. Survival of the fittest. Rules evolve or die out, just like everything else in nature.
Rules are made to be broken!==W== As the Boss, that's what I'd really like to say.
But then I realized: if I break the rules, as the Boss, I have to write the new ones. Total pain in the neck.
Besides, breaking rules doesn't guarantee finding the truth. Nor does it promise a better system.
Like, if I were CEO of Scarlet Sights Media, I'd have you write three articles a day, three thousand words each, no holidays.
Whoa, hey! Tyrant, you really are evil!
Anyway, that's my take. Forget the philosophy of rules. Let's focus on the commission.
You're right, Boss. A witch shouldn't get tripped up by the small stuff. I'm after the truth. Time to get back to work.
So, Boss, what do you think will come of Mina's report?
The Golden Nightingale issue spans nine greenhouses. That's not a job for small fry.
Out of everyone we've met, only two have the muscle to pull that off...
Director Joseph from R&D, our helpful friend.
And Firenze, the one running Production.==W== They're the only ones with the rank to cover up a mess this big.
Noya, the cake looks perfect. Experiment successful.
Yeah! Using wind magic to boost the baking temp actually works. Make a note for the report.
It's been a week. Still no word on that report Mina sent up?
Mm. Mina mentioned this morning that the directors are in a meeting.==W== We should hear something soon.
Kitty cat rolling, tumbling and playing!<size=60> ♪<size=37>==W== Stretch your body, up and away!<size=60> ♪<size=37>
Phew, another easy day.==W== Hey, Sapphire, Production looks pretty empty. Can we actually handle ninety-nine greenhouses on our own?
It's manageable. The Mandrake Radiant Grass guards most of the houses. We just need to make rounds once a week to keep them in line.
Two weeks now, and Mina's report has sunk without a trace.==W== It's clearly a dead end, yet she's still telling us to wait.
She must have a plan.==W== Besides, sitting tight isn't all bad. Remember the anonymous source who tipped you off when we first joined?
Hard to forget. I still haven't managed to track them down.
Since we're stalled here, they're probably getting restless, too. I bet they'll make a move soon.
You are just the cutest! I'll definitely be back.
Iris? What are you doing here?
Nyx is off today.==W== I finished my spreadsheets early, so I'm covering the promo shift for her.
Off ... again?==W== Why does Nyx take every Friday off? She's always late on Thursdays, too.
Nothing concrete...==W== But we've heard that Radiant Grass usually only needs weekly tuning. ==SEX1== found that suspicious.
Wait. If someone sneaks in after the official maintenance, tweaks the settings, then resets them right before the next check...==W== They could do whatever they want, unnoticed!
We need to tell the others. Now.
==PLAYER_NAME==, stop!==W== We can't just barge into a Production Department greenhouse without authorization...

Mina, listen. I've been digging.==W== Those nine suspicious greenhouses? Production services them on Fridays during the day.==W== If anyone wanted to use magic to speed up growth, Friday night is the perfect window.
I heard you... They tamper with the Grass, then reset them to cover their tracks. I get it.==W== But evidence obtained illegally is useless!
United Harvest mercenaries? Why are they guarding a greenhouse?
See, Mina? We aren't the only ones bending rules. Pretty sure "armed mercenaries" aren't part of standard gardening protocol.
N-No, it wasn't me. I didn't shoot.
Guess there's no way out but through.==W== Pumpka & Lanterna, it's showtime ★

param: With the commission complete, Mina invites the group over and brings up a past information leak. The report Mina submitted are met with total silence. You decide to go for another sweep of the greenhouse.
Those people didn't back down, as expected. They're even closing in on the truth.
It doesn't matter. With Mina there, even if they find the truth, I'll keep them stalled.
Let me see... Too many departments and individuals are tangled up in this.
Until at least the 5th of next month, I think.
That long? What on earth are those people up to... Fine, I'll do my best to stall them until then.
Yawn... Man, I'm toast. Mina, Iris, how'd those numbers turn out? Found anything?
F-finally done...==W== I ran the check again. The data doesn't lie. This is the result.
Here's the verdict:==W== nine out of ninety-nine greenhouses have been using 200% more wheat seed than average over the last two months.
That's way beyond normal waste. Someone has to be using magic to force-grow the wheat in there.
You guys move fast. Pretty thorough job. So, let's go stake out those sheds and nab the guy, yeah?
We can't. Our mandate is investigation only—no arrests.
I'll submit the evidence to HQ. Let the company deal with it.
Let the company deal with it, huh... Nine greenhouses, totally unnoticed for two months. Who could pull that off?
Iris, Mistique, ==PLAYER_NAME== ... and everyone else not here, good work.
That wraps up the Golden Nightingale investigation. Since we finally have a day off, why not come over to my place for dinner? Let's celebrate.
Make yourselves at home. Sorry...==W== It's a bit of a tight squeeze in here.
Nia, Aila. You two been behaving yourselves?
I was super good! I made dinner last night and breakfast this morning.
And I cleaned up the house.
Mina... Could you not work so late next time? It gets kinda scary when it's just us here.
I'm sorry... I promise I won't stay out that late again.
Liar. You say that every time, but you didn't even come home last night!
Ah-haha... I promise, for real this time! No matter how late it gets, I'll come home.
Everyone, meet my little sisters—Aila and Nia.
Come on, say hello to our guests.
Then what?! That giant Bark Boar was charging right at you! What did you do?
It's not just a "giant Bark Boar." It has a proper name! It's the Spirit of... Uh...==W== Right, the Spirit of Brutality.
Well, the Spirit of Brutality realized ==PLAYER_NAME== was calling the shots and went berserk. It ripped a massive boulder out of the ground and hurled it straight at us!
Don't worry. Fuyuka stepped in with a solid right hook—BAM! That rock shattered into dust. Then she followed up with a left hook that sent the Spirit of Brutality flying into the sky!
N-Noya, please... You're making it sound way more dramatic than it actually was...
Fuyuka! Can you show us? Please? Show us the hooks!
Yeah, do it! Look, this pillow can be the Spirit of Brutality, and...==W== I'll use this apple for its nose!
Hey now, don't waste food.==W== Why don't you play with me instead? I've got something really fun planned.
Oh yeah? Is it cooler than fighting a giant monster?
Absolutely. I've curated a selection of math problems perfectly tailored for your age group.==W== I tested them myself—they're incredibly practical. You'll love them.
What a nostalgic sight. There's nothing quite like seeing everyone together, getting along so warmly.
Yeah. Everyone's been on edge lately. What a relief to finally see them relax.
Thank you all. I'm away so much these days... It's been a long time since I've heard Nia and Aila laugh like that.
Don't mention it. Noya and the others said playing with the kids brings back happy memories of the orphanage. They're having a blast, too.
Speaking of which, I haven't seen your parents. Are they out? Should we make extra for lunch?
No need. They aren't in Philae right now. They're working far, far to the south—==W==at the United Harvest Lushwood Jungle Branch.
The Lushwood Jungle Branch? Isn't that on the southern edge of the Empire...?==W== But with kids at home, why do they have to work so far away?
Well...==W== Four years ago, there was a major incident at the Philae Branch.
The former R&D Director—Director Joseph's predecessor—was arrested for leaking secrets to witches and embezzling funds.
My parents were in R&D back then, and they were found partially responsible for what happened.

Luckily, the compliance inspector in charge was a stickler for protocol. She ruled that my parents were merely implicated. So instead of being exiled like the former Director, they were just transferred to the Lushwood Jungle Branch.
So that's the skeleton in United Harvest's closet...
After they left, their pay was cut drastically. I was still in school... We fell on hard times almost overnight.
But that anonymous compliance inspector saved us, cited a regulation about employee welfare, and got the company to grant us a subsidy.
Later, when Tawny Nightingale launched, we started getting weekly shipments. It was enough to keep us fed.
To me, Tawny Nightingale tastes better than anything else in the world.
I see... The rules are what got you through. No wonder you were really against us breaking protocol or looking for loopholes during the investigation.
It might sound dramatic...==W== But without those rules, I wouldn't be here today.
If everyone ignored the rules like that Director or those witches, imagine the chaos. Imagine how many people would suffer.
I don't know the details, but it's not like the witches are totally lawless. They have their own code, don't they?
Maybe. But to me, they're just selfish people who only care about themselves. I hate witches.
... Yeah. Guess they aren't exactly winning any popularity contests.
Oh ★ Why didn't you tell me sooner?!
Noya, will you come back and tell us more stories next time?
I wanna hear about your adventure on the Waterway!
You got it! Besides, Mina's an amazing cook—I'm hoping to learn a few local dishes from her while I'm here.
Mina, how long till we hear back on that report?
Since the "big shots" are all over this, maybe as soon as tomorrow. A week, tops.
Until then, mind sticking around United Harvest a little longer?
Sure. Marketing's actually been pretty interesting.
I've learned a ton in R&D. Once this job's done, maybe I can finally be of some real help to everyone.
Something wrong, Mistique? Mina's words sting?==W== She doesn't know you're a witch—it wasn't personal.
Sharp eyes. That's the great Boss for you.
Being hated is part of the gig for a witch. I'm not gonna get depressed over a couple of stray comments.
But..==W== seeing Mina and her sisters sticking together like that... even though I don‘t know who that witch from the past really was, it still makes me feel a little guilty.
Boss, what takes priority: following the rules, or uncovering the truth?
Rules are meant to be broken!
Surely there's a way to follow the rules and still get to the truth?
In theory. But just like a claw machine—does feeding it coins guarantee you a prize?
Exactly. So when the claw fails, you face a choice: keep feeding it coins, or break the machine open.
Would anyone actually break it open?
Maybe not after twenty losses. But two hundred?==W== Your mindset might change.
Fair point... I'd at least suspect the claw was rigged.
Rules create stability. And stability protects the majority.
So, if we break the rules to find the truth, does that make us villains?
I never said that. But if a rule crumbles just because a witch poked it,==W== it was likely weak to begin with, no?
You have a weird way of comforting people.
I'm not offering comfort. A stable system should be self-repairing. It's a natural cycle of breaking and mending.
Oh? So whatever is left standing in the end is "Justice"?==W== The ultimate rule?
Precisely. Survival of the fittest. Rules evolve or die out, just like everything else in nature.
Rules are made to be broken!==W== As the Boss, that's what I'd really like to say.
But then I realized: if I break the rules, as the Boss, I have to write the new ones. Total pain in the neck.
Besides, breaking rules doesn't guarantee finding the truth. Nor does it promise a better system.
Like, if I were CEO of Scarlet Sights Media, I'd have you write three articles a day, three thousand words each, no holidays.
Whoa, hey! Tyrant, you really are evil!
Anyway, that's my take. Forget the philosophy of rules. Let's focus on the commission.
You're right, Boss. A witch shouldn't get tripped up by the small stuff. I'm after the truth. Time to get back to work.
So, Boss, what do you think will come of Mina's report?
The Golden Nightingale issue spans nine greenhouses. That's not a job for small fry.
Out of everyone we've met, only two have the muscle to pull that off...
Director Joseph from R&D, our helpful friend.
And Firenze, the one running Production.==W== They're the only ones with the rank to cover up a mess this big.
Noya, the cake looks perfect. Experiment successful.
Yeah! Using wind magic to boost the baking temp actually works. Make a note for the report.
It's been a week. Still no word on that report Mina sent up?
Mm. Mina mentioned this morning that the directors are in a meeting.==W== We should hear something soon.
Kitty cat rolling, tumbling and playing!<size=60> ♪<size=37>==W== Stretch your body, up and away!<size=60> ♪<size=37>
Phew, another easy day.==W== Hey, Sapphire, Production looks pretty empty. Can we actually handle ninety-nine greenhouses on our own?
It's manageable. The Mandrake Radiant Grass guards most of the houses. We just need to make rounds once a week to keep them in line.
Two weeks now, and Mina's report has sunk without a trace.==W== It's clearly a dead end, yet she's still telling us to wait.
She must have a plan.==W== Besides, sitting tight isn't all bad. Remember the anonymous source who tipped you off when we first joined?
Hard to forget. I still haven't managed to track them down.
Since we're stalled here, they're probably getting restless, too. I bet they'll make a move soon.
You are just the cutest! I'll definitely be back.
Iris? What are you doing here?
Nyx is off today.==W== I finished my spreadsheets early, so I'm covering the promo shift for her.
Off ... again?==W== Why does Nyx take every Friday off? She's always late on Thursdays, too.
Nothing concrete...==W== But we've heard that Radiant Grass usually only needs weekly tuning. ==SEX1== found that suspicious.
Wait. If someone sneaks in after the official maintenance, tweaks the settings, then resets them right before the next check...==W== They could do whatever they want, unnoticed!
We need to tell the others. Now.
==PLAYER_NAME==, stop!==W== We can't just barge into a Production Department greenhouse without authorization...

Mina, listen. I've been digging.==W== Those nine suspicious greenhouses? Production services them on Fridays during the day.==W== If anyone wanted to use magic to speed up growth, Friday night is the perfect window.
I heard you... They tamper with the Grass, then reset them to cover their tracks. I get it.==W== But evidence obtained illegally is useless!
United Harvest mercenaries? Why are they guarding a greenhouse?
See, Mina? We aren't the only ones bending rules. Pretty sure "armed mercenaries" aren't part of standard gardening protocol.
N-No, it wasn't me. I didn't shoot.
Guess there's no way out but through.==W== Pumpka & Lanterna, it's showtime ★

strings.text: You storm the greenhouse and discover a vast number of force-grown plants. The person behind it all is Joseph, the head of R&D. In the chase, he leads you into the lab where plants are being cultivated into weapons...
Move it! Get those precious Jade Grasses out of the way before the fighting ruins them!
Hmph. We're catching that shooter this time. With this many people against one target, there's no escape.
Sir, correction. It's not a single target. There are seven of them.
You're the ones behind the Golden Nightingale, aren't you!
Cough... Cough...==W== Noya? Do you even realize what you're doing?
S-Sir Joseph? Why are you here?
To catch the pests buzzing around me, naturally. Though... Snaring you is a pleasant surprise.
Sir Joseph, why did you create the Golden Nightingale?!
Ah, the "Golden Nightingale." Is that what you call the bread? Creating that wasn't actually my intention.
It was merely a byproduct.==W== Behold: my latest breakthrough in magical cultivation: the Jade Grass.
Jade Grass... The name sounds familiar...
The wild variety absorbs sunlight by day and releases it at night, like the real sun.==W== To replicate that perfectly, I practically lived in the cage with the Blade of Jade!
Several months back, Trekkers caught Blade of Jade out in the Wilds. Its feathers are pure condensed magic, and it generates magical wind just by flapping its wings.
We pumped the beast full of high-magic feed, then we used the feathers—and that wind—to turbocharge the Grass, so that the Grass can release magical sunlight.
Heh... Hahaha! Fate rewards the ambitious! The Jade Grass we cultivated are exceptional. Their light accelerates the growth of plants. They make the wild variety look like weeds.
Two months. Nine greenhouses. We matched their entire annual output. The field tests on the wheat outside? Spectacular results.
Why go to such lengths to force the harvest? What is the point?
Point? There is no "point." The company wanted higher yields and lower costs. I delivered.
Wait... Does that mean other United Harvest goods are also mixed with this magic-forced flour?
Heh heh. You're sharper than you look, Mina.
Tawny Nightingale, Golden Nightingale... Who cares? The profit there is peanuts compared to our bestsellers.
Still, money is money. Even if it's just a single Dorra, I'd prefer it in my pocket.
Never thought anyone would actually bother petitioning management over the Tawny Nightingale... The company wrote that product off ages ago.
That's a lie! The company never gave up on it!
When I petitioned Lady Darcia for the investigation team, she told me herself...
The Tawny Nightingale is the pride of our Philae Branch.==RT==It built our reputation with the Trekkers and the Ash District.
Conduct a thorough investigation, Mina. I know you won't let me down.
Huh? So Mina's backer is Darcia... And Firenze helped clear our names before, too.
If the CEO and the second in command are clean... What's Lady Gray's deal? Who's pulling her strings?
I won't let anyone drag our name through the mud or trample on the food we worked so hard to create!
Sir Joseph, you've grossly violated company protocol. You're coming to Lady Darcia with me to answer for this.
Heheh... Hahahaha! You have a really narrow view of how things work here, don't you, Mina?
You're completely blind to the intentions of those standing right next to you.
Look at your hired help. Mere Trekkers working for coin, yet they stick their necks out where there's no profit to be made. Doesn't that strike you as ... odd?
Hahaha! Out of everyone here, you're the worst offender of the protocol, Mina.
That woman beside you poses as a transfer from another branch. But she's no employee. She's a witch.
Heh. She infiltrated us to dig up dirt on United Harvest. Just like the R&D scandal four years ago.
Tell me then... Do you think she'd pass up a headline like "magic-accelerated ripening"? A story that could ruin this entire branch?
Age makes a man talkative, I suppose.==W== But I've wasted enough breath. Take them all out.
Damn it. We're pinned down. Even if we break out, we'll take heavy losses.
Director, look out! Hostiles above us!
Now! Push forward! Take out the mercs and secure Joseph!
Wait! Boss, that "another pest" he mentioned... Maybe they're not friendly.
Yes, but it doesn't matter right now. Catching Joseph is our priority.
My broom can do that easily.==W== Boss, hop on!
Trekkers ... and a shooter.==W== I see. I finally see... We were used from the start.
Hahaha! We're all just blind, pathetic worms! And let me tell you... I'm not the only lunatic running this company!
Heh heh... You chased me into the perfect spot.
Master's locked inside! What should we do?!
The vast chamber is lit only by the dim glow of massive tanks,==RT==suspending gigantic, grotesque flora within.
You wanted the truth about the Golden Nightingale? This lab is where it all began.
What the...? Giant Mandrake Radiant Grass?
Heh. Don't compare my work to primitive weeds like the Mandrake Radiant Grass. These are "Gen-2 Intelligent Plants."
It was staring at you just now, wasn't it? It's observing and learning.
Intelligent... Observing? Are you saying... They're self-aware?
Naturally. My data shows they can handle complex labor. They think, reason, and make judgments—just like a human.
This is a huge scoop. I need to get everything on camera.
I... I barely made it inside before the gate shut. I can't let you leak company secrets!
Mistique, is it true? Everything Sir Joseph said? Why did you lie to me? Was it all for a headline?
... Yeah. It's true. I'm a witch. And United Harvest's secrets? They're irresistible to my kind. That's why I'm here.
Though I admit, finding the Jade Grass and "Intelligent Plants" buried down here wasn't on my bingo card. Hehe, looks like it's my lucky day.
You were the first to join the Tawny Nightingale project after me. I thought you actually cared about it.
Maybe. They do make a great meal when I'm flying. But for a witch, the truth is the only thing that matters.
Heh. Well said. "The truth is the only thing that matters."
Ugh! Why are there so many Radiant Grasses?! Where did they come from?!
Hmph. They are Gen-2 Intelligent Plants, mind you.
Farewell, everyone. You'll make excellent fertilizer.
Joseph unleashed hundreds of these things. No way Mistique can handle a swarm that size alone.
Wait. The plants aren't attacking me. Why?
They're ignoring Mina, too. Their only target is Mistique.
Wait a second. How was Joseph so sure he wouldn't get caught in the crossfire releasing the horde?
Me, Mina, Joseph... What do we have in common?==W== Oh, I got it!
The plants recoil from the side where I hold her. Their vines shift, circling around to target her exposed side instead.
They won't strike anyone in a United Harvest uniform! That's how they identify friends from foes.
Seriously?==W== Then all I need is my uniform...==W==Ugh, my arms are stuck! Get off me, you weeds!
More are coming, and the others are cut off outside.
Mina grabs Mistique's other hand. Protected by our human shield on both sides, the plants waver in confusion before retreating.
I am not doing this for you. Whether you lied or plan to leak photos is irrelevant. You have not resigned. You remain a member of the Strategic Department's Tawny Nightingale project.
I... I cannot abandon a colleague. That is United Harvest company policy.
So ... even I am protected by "company policy" now?
Let's move. We need to exit this lab first.
At the end of the dim corridor sits a greenhouse we never knew existed.
Greenhouse No.100... Does our company even have a number 100?
Probably built off the books for research. Boss, what's the move?
Gotta catch Joseph... But this place is huge.
Place is too big. Let's split up. Keep your phones on.
Things are still tense between Mistique and Mina. That won't fix itself anytime soon. Splitting up might actually be better.
With silent nods, we went in separate directions to hunt down Joseph.
Enemy territory. Could be traps. We should stick together.
They're gonna fight if we stay together,==W== but I have no other choice.==W== Those mercs... Were they really Joseph's? Something feels off.
Stop it. Safety first. Mistique, you're our only fighter. If we split and hit more mercs, we're dead.
Secure the area. I'm contacting Noya now.
Yeah. You're the muscle. Mina and I would just be in the way.
Mina, contact Noya and United Harvest. This is too big to bury.
I'll use this chance to double back and check the lab.
Lady Gray fled here, and the orphanage is tied to this company too. Odds are high this secret lab has clues.

strings.text: Joseph, whose conspiracy has been exposed, feigns surrender, only to unleash the Blade of Jade in a last-second ambush. Though you uncover part of the truth, the price is your life.
Check in on the Heartlink group every ten minutes.
Miss a check-in, and we assume you're in trouble. The other two converge on that position right away.
Copy that. Though with my combat skills... Don't expect me to be much help.
Don't sweat the details! Think of it as a little alarm clock reminding you to stay sharp.
Sounds like advice you need, Miss Mistique. You're always so busy snapping pictures. You're bound to get distracted and walk right into a trap.
My, aren't we concerned? You must have a crush on me.==W== Boss, see you later.
Bickering? Now? Eh, guess it beats awkward silence.
Deep down, their goals align. It's just their methods that clash.
I'll check the greenhouse straight ahead.
Crap, wandered right into their turf...==W== Wait. It's an Intelligent Plant. Maybe I can reason with it.
Hey there. I'm not here to fight, and I won't hurt you. Mind letting me through?
The plant waves a vine like a greeting, slowly uncoiling to clear the path.
Is it mimicking a bow? Meaning they aren't hostile unless ordered to be.==W== If that's the case...
Have you seen an old man pass by?==W== He wears round glasses.
That dead twig on your head bothering you?
Trying to make a deal, huh...
The old man ... went that way?==W== Got it. Thanks.
Retracting its vines, the Intelligent Plant lazily crawls beneath a Jade Grass to bask in its magical glow.
Thinking back to what Joseph said...
Point? There is no "point." The company wanted higher yields and lower costs. I delivered.
He lied.==W== Cultivating Jade Grass requires a Blade of Jade, and finding one is pure luck. No company builds a production plan on a fluke.
Which implies his true goal didn't lie in the Jade Grass... The grass was just a means to an end.
His real objective has to be cultivating the Intelligent Plants. But a scheme this massive...==W== Joseph couldn't have pulled it off alone.
He definitely has an accomplice. The prime suspect ...==W== is Lady Gray, hiding within United Harvest.
No, even the two of them lack the resources. There must be a powerful backer behind the scenes.
Someone's ahead?!==W== Crap. No time to call Mistique and Mina back. I'll just have to wing it...
Wait, don't! No magic! My old bones can't take a hit like that—
Sir Joseph. I knew it was you.
Oh, ==PLAYER_NAME==. You were bluffing. The witch isn't even here!
Mistique might not be here, but one message and she'll be on her broomstick and over here in a heartbeat.
I surrender...==W== Fighting a Trekker at my age now is just asking for a beating.
The moment you stormed in, I'd already lost.
Even if I shook you off, I can't escape the master. United Harvest would catch me in the end anyway.
Whatever his plan is, I just need to stall. I missed my ten-minute check-in on Heartlink, so Mistique and Mina should be en route. I'll play along.
That's rather contradictory. If you knew it was hopeless from the start, why even run?
I...==W== I still had work to finish.
I wanted to water these Jade Grass with Neo Solution one last time. A farewell. Let me do it, and I'll go with you. I won't resist.
It's this stuff. A magical solution banned by the Grace Imperium. Unstable—one wrong move and you're blown sky-high—but it's excellent for infusing magic.
Using a banned solution... Why go to such extremes?
Do you even have to ask? We're researchers. We don't need a reason.
I don't know how you see people like me, but this is simply our nature. Even when we know the danger, our curiosity won't let us stop.
Joseph crouches, unscrews the Neo Solution cap, and drips liquid onto the Jade Grass roots. He must have done this so much before; his movements look like muscle memory.
The Blade of Jade's magic isn't enough for them to thrive. They need a precise dose of Neo Solution every single day. Miss once, and that perfection is lost.
Why the obsession? Just because the company needs them to rush the Intelligent Plants?
The Intelligent Plants are indeed the life's work of master. They're beautiful, and maybe the master is right. Maybe they really will change the world.
But no matter how magnificent they are, they aren't my creation.
==PLAYER_NAME==, I don't know what mediocrity means to a Trekker. But in my field? To be called average is to be called a failure.
I used to dream that hard work could overcome natural talent... But a dream is all it was. I could never beat the true geniuses.
But I couldn't accept that. So I clawed my way to this position, surviving on nothing but sheer loyalty to the master.
The Jade Grass is the only real achievement of my entire life. I'll never hand them over.
Joseph empties the last drop, stands, and dusts off his knees.
There... Now, I have no regrets.
Right. We're running out of time anyway.
Indeed. Let's get going ...==W== <color=#bd3059><size=50>to the next world together!</color>
You were so patient with me... Stalling for your friends, right? Hahaha, well so was I! And look! It's here—<color=#bd3059>my greatest ally!!</color>
Oh, no. When I ran into him, he wasn't gathering magic to attack me. He was summoning the Blade of Jade, just like in the basement!
Mistique swoops in on her broom, but her magic can't outpace the Blade of Jade's beak.
Sorry, Mistique. The rest ...==W== is up to you.
So ... the Blade of Jade got me.
Yes. It seems rather fond of you, actually. Look—
Virigia, why show Tyrant that? It's just a bird's nest.
It's the Blade of Jade's nest. It took your headpiece back to decorate its home.
It considers you a prestigious kill. A trophy worth showing off.
High praise from a bird. Should I be flattered?
Dear Tyrant, had you completed the soul collection, you would not have fallen to such a primitive beast.
Vita, don't pop into my head unless summoned.
Understood, Tyrant. Your command is my will.
Tyrant? You are quiet. Does it hurt somewhere?
The chest pain from being skewered is still lingering, but I'll live. Figuratively.
Wagering your life is thrilling, Tyrant... But actually dying defeats the purpose, no?
Heehee. Even a frail old man can show incredible power when protecting what's important to him.
Point taken.==W== Vita, open the door.
This is ... right when we entered Greenhouse No.100.
Tyrant, I advise you to make a soul pact immediately. Once the mission is complete, the Blade of Jade will be no threat.
Thanks, Vita. But I'll handle this my own way first.

Check in on the Heartlink group every ten minutes.
Miss a check-in, and we assume you're in trouble. The other two converge on that position right away.
Copy that. Though with my combat skills... Don't expect me to be much help.
Don't sweat the details! Think of it as a little alarm clock reminding you to stay sharp.
Sounds like advice you need, Miss Mistique. You're always so busy snapping pictures. You're bound to get distracted and walk right into a trap.
My, aren't we concerned? You must have a crush on me.==W== Boss, see you later.
Bickering? Now? Eh, guess it beats awkward silence.

That dead twig on your head bothering you?
Trying to make a deal, huh...

strings.text: Lady Gray arrives with mercenaries as you destroy the lab. Nyx intervenes to save you, revealing her true identity as a compliance inspector. Joseph unleashes the Blade of Jade, intent on obliterating everything.
My magic barely scratches them.==W== They're growing back faster than I can destroy them.
The door's sealed tight by this overgrowth.==W== If we don't clear it soon, we're never getting out of here!
Noya and the others are searching,==W== but every greenhouse in this block looks identical. It's gonna take time to pinpoint our location.
Mina, got anything?==W== Coordinates, floor plans...==W== Give us something to work with, anything!
The thing is ... this facility isn't on the current district maps.==W== Maybe it was abandoned years ago?
Doubt it.==W== The pavement is clean, no weeds. Someone's definitely maintaining this place.
As for the door,==W== probably just a side exit that fell into disuse.
These vines are crawling up the outer walls, too.==W== I'd bet someone planted them as natural camouflage to hide the building.
Still,==W== this growth rate is unnatural...==W== What on earth is fueling it?
The answer's staring you in the face.==W== Look.
Jade Grass?!==W== So this place is ...==W== a cultivation site for Jade Grass.
Why would Sir Joseph need such a massive supply?==W== What exactly is he planning?
It's not just the Grass.==W== Mina, look at the residue on their leaves.
That hue ...==W== and that magical signature...==W== Neo Solution?
A volatile magical compound.==W== The Grace Imperium has banned its use.
Casting spells near it==W== tends to agitate the raw magic inside.==W== Watch—
Reacting to Mina's magic, the liquid on the leaves instantly pulses with blinding light.
That fluid is saturated with magic—an absolute feast for monsters.==W== Remember what Sir Joseph told us?
We pumped the beast full of high-magic feed, then we used the feathers—and that wind—to turbocharge the Grass.
I think he's using the Neo Solution to cultivate the Blade of Jade.
And likely using it to irrigate the Jade Grass==W== to accelerate its growth.
That tracks. Look at these scattered feathers.==W== Nazuka fought the Blade of Jade. I'll message her to confirm.
Sir Joseph's misuse of the Neo Solution==W== is a gross violation of company protocol.
No, it's bigger than protocol.==W== He's breaking the ethical code shared by every major company in Nova.
Mina,==W== by your standards,==W== Sir Joseph has already shattered a laundry list of rules.
Do you honestly think citing the employee handbook is going to stop a man==W== like him?
I...==W== I have to believe someone higher up will step in and set this right.
Oh?==W== And who exactly is going to be this savior?==W== Firenze?==W== Darcia?
Joseph runs R&D.==W== His operation spans nine greenhouses and a private merc army.==W== You really think Darcia and Firenze are in the dark?
If they know,==W== do you think they'll actually turn on one of their own?
And if they don't,==W== they're incompetent enough to let a conspiracy rot right under their noses.==W== What can you expect from them?
If...==W== If those two are actually involved...
I'll take this straight to United Harvest HQ.==W== Surely the whole company isn't rotten to the core.
Fine.==W== If that's your play...==W== I suggest you let me document everything.
You want me to let you ...==W== take photos?
Of course.==W== You won't stand for United Harvest peddling magically force-grown, nutrient-free garbage to customers, will you?
On this, at least,==W== our goals align.
Even if you want the company to handle this,==W== you're going to need my photos as evidence.
I will never let this tainted food hit the shelves.==W== But ...==W== tell me==W==...
Why are you asking for my permission?==W== You're the one who always says, "The truth is the only thing that matters."
Someone just saved my neck claiming she "couldn't abandon a colleague."==W== Reminded me that I haven't technically quit yet.
So, witch or not, I guess I'm still your colleague==W== ...==W== or subordinate.==W== You are the manager of Tawny Nightingale, after all.
Seems only fair==W== you get to decide how we use the incriminating photos.
Besides, I have a feeling we've barely scratched the surface.==W== There's plenty more dirt to dig.
Boss,==W== you're helping us get to the bottom of this, right?
Absolutely.==W== We've been played from the day we joined,==W== used like tools.
If they want to use us as bait to flush someone out, fine.==W== Let's see what happens when the bait bites back.
Pick 'em clean!==W== Don't leave a single one standing!
Or we could just==W== torch the place!
That's the spirit.==W== Keep going==W== until every last Jade Grass is ripped out by the roots.
Hey,==W== Boss,==W== you sure about this?==W== Is Joseph really gonna lose his mind over some plants?
If I were him,==W== I'd have skipped town ages ago.
It's the only card we have left to play.
If he's as obsessed with his research as I think,==W== he won't sit back and watch us trash his masterpiece.
Besides,==W== with that many mercs—familiar ones, too—==W==he probably thinks he's still got the upper hand.
<size=52>Stop this madness at once!==W== What do you think you're doing?!</size>
He actually showed up!==W== Boss, you called it.
What's it look like,==W== Sir Joseph?==W== We're weeding.==W== These overgrown things are such an eyesore.
Weeds==W==...?==W== You clearly lack the intellect to==W== comprehend the true value of the Jade Grass.
Hmph.==W== Since you are held in high regard,==W== I intended to be merciful and let you live.
But I've had a change of heart==W==...==W== I'll exterminate you vermin now==W== and explain myself to the master later.
We already beat you once.==W== You really think a handful of goons is enough to stop a witch?
A handful?==W== Lady Gray,==W== it appears this witch is underestimating you.
Good evening.==W== I assume==W== we can skip the introductions?
I am Lady Gray.==W== And I must thank you for your diligent work on the Three Grand Commissions.
I knew it was you.==W== Your mercenaries were a dead giveaway.
Aren't you supposed to be lying low at United Harvest?==W== This seems a bit conspicuous, don't you think?
Me? Lying low?==W== Hahaha!==W== I've secured "that thing," just like the master asked me to.==W== Why on earth would I lie low?
Sir Joseph,==W== I'm betting Lady Gray left out the part about what really happened at the camp==W== outside the city.
Hm?==W== Are you referring to the Three Grand Commissions?
Don't listen to ==SEX4==,==W== Joseph!==W== We did exactly what the master asked,==W== and the master will protect us.
Oh, you did what she asked of you, sure...==W== By breaking every rule and violating all sense of morality!
So what? It proves we're the only ones capable enough to be valued by the master.
Is that right?==W== The Scarlet Sights archives are full of stories like this.==W== Want to know how they usually end?
Quiet, witch.==W== Your mind games won't work here.
Joseph, don't tell me you're actually rattled by that...==W== Where did all your rage go?
I'm still furious this witch ruined my life's work.==W== But as Director of R&D, I respect the fact.
And the fact is:==W== We've been under attack for hours, but there has been no sign of the master, no messages, nothing.==W== Perhaps the witch has a point...
We're nothing but pawns, sacrificed on a whim.
When a lab glove gets dirty, you trash it. That's exactly what's happening to us.
Nonsense!==W== We can still fix this==W== if we just get rid of these two right now!
Think about it.==W== At least three of them pursued us, but only two are standing here.==W== The third obviously went for backup.
There are four Trekkers outside,==W== plus at least one sniper hiding in this greenhouse providing cover.
Our fundraising operation for the master is compromised. The whole thing's leaking like a sieve.
Their help is here already?!==W== How is that possible?
Taking fire from the right!==W== I'm hit!
Sorry.==W== Can't let you run off with our star witness.
==PLAYER_NAME==,==W== how did you figure out Nyx would be here?
Off ... again?==W== Why does Nyx take every Friday off? She's always late on Thursdays, too.
Amber gave me the lead.==W== She actually suspected Nyx to be the one behind this whole mess.
What made you realize==W== I wasn't the enemy then?
Luck, mostly.==W== I pieced together what Sapphire and Amber told me, and the pattern was obvious:==W== you were sneaking off every Friday for something else.
They said Marketing runs you ragged—==W==bossing you around==W== until you're so sleep-deprived you're napping all over the place.
But you don't have family here in Philae,==W== and you aren't in debt to loan sharks.
It didn't add up.==W== Why take that abuse if you don't need the money?==W== Either you're a masochist, or you had an ulterior motive.
And carrying that pillow everywhere?==W== Too theatrical, it broke character.==W== The only logic was that you needed to hide something on you. That made you incredibly suspicious.
Spot on. Can't believe that's where I slipped up.==W== Guess my undercover skills need a little polish.
Allow me to reintroduce myself. I'm Nyx, an inspector from United Harvest's Compliance Department. I monitor the Philae Branch. The Marketing gig was just a cover.
The pillow's for my weapon. But the Fridays off were genuinely for slacking off. Marketing works people to the bone, and I really can't deal with that.
Did you let Amber notice your schedule on purpose, just to lure us here?
Guilty. And thanks for the backup. Handling these mercenaries solo would've been a pain. I owe you one.
Help us catch Lady Gray and get answers about the orphanage. Then we'll call it even.
Director Joseph,==W== let's move.==W== We have medics waiting outside to patch you up.
Don't bother. Just let me rest. I'll tell you everything you want to know.
The Jade Grass was a complete accident.
Two months back, I hit a wall with the "Magic Ripening" project.
Old methods—Neo Solution—were costly, with mediocre results at best. The master demanded a breakthrough. Speed. Efficiency.
Just as I was desperate, I heard some Trekkers caught the Blade of Jade outside the city. That monster gave me the spark to engineer the wild Jade Grass.
But this new ripening tech wasn't for wheat. The grain was a byproduct—sold to fund the master's true desire: the Intelligent Plants.
The master wanted accelerated evolution. We forced reproduction, blasting them day and night with the Jade Grass's magical light.
The result is those tanks in the lab. Beautiful, aren't they?
You call that beautiful? They made my skin crawl.
Heh. You're blind. Those plants will change the world.
To aid such a grand design... I have not wasted my life.
Heh... Let me show my one last act of loyalty.
Heh. It's here. I unlocked the cage before I came out. It'll tear this place apart.

Quiet, witch.==W== Your mind games won't work here.
Joseph, don't tell me you're actually rattled by that...==W== Where did all your rage go?
I'm still furious this witch ruined my life's work.==W== But as Director of R&D, I respect the fact.
And the fact is:==W== We've been under attack for hours, but there has been no sign of the master, no messages, nothing.==W== Perhaps the witch has a point...
We're nothing but pawns, sacrificed on a whim.
When a lab glove gets dirty, you trash it. That's exactly what's happening to us.
Nonsense!==W== We can still fix this==W== if we just get rid of these two right now!
Think about it.==W== At least three of them pursued us, but only two are standing here.==W== The third obviously went for backup.
There are four Trekkers outside,==W== plus at least one sniper hiding in this greenhouse providing cover.
Our fundraising operation for the master is compromised. The whole thing's leaking like a sieve.
Their help is here already?!==W== How is that possible?
Taking fire from the right!==W== I'm hit!
Sorry.==W== Can't let you run off with our star witness.
==PLAYER_NAME==,==W== how did you figure out Nyx would be here?
Off ... again?==W== Why does Nyx take every Friday off? She's always late on Thursdays, too.
Amber gave me the lead.==W== She actually suspected Nyx to be the one behind this whole mess.
What made you realize==W== I wasn't the enemy then?
Luck, mostly.==W== I pieced together what Sapphire and Amber told me, and the pattern was obvious:==W== you were sneaking off every Friday for something else.
They said Marketing runs you ragged—==W==bossing you around==W== until you're so sleep-deprived you're napping all over the place.
But you don't have family here in Philae,==W== and you aren't in debt to loan sharks.
It didn't add up.==W== Why take that abuse if you don't need the money?==W== Either you're a masochist, or you had an ulterior motive.
And carrying that pillow everywhere?==W== Too theatrical, it broke character.==W== The only logic was that you needed to hide something on you. That made you incredibly suspicious.
Spot on. Can't believe that's where I slipped up.==W== Guess my undercover skills need a little polish.
Allow me to reintroduce myself. I'm Nyx, an inspector from United Harvest's Compliance Department. I monitor the Philae Branch. The Marketing gig was just a cover.
The pillow's for my weapon. But the Fridays off were genuinely for slacking off. Marketing works people to the bone, and I really can't deal with that.
Did you let Amber notice your schedule on purpose, just to lure us here?
Guilty. And thanks for the backup. Handling these mercenaries solo would've been a pain. I owe you one.
Help us catch Lady Gray and get answers about the orphanage. Then we'll call it even.
Director Joseph,==W== let's move.==W== We have medics waiting outside to patch you up.
Don't bother. Just let me rest. I'll tell you everything you want to know.
The Jade Grass was a complete accident.
Two months back, I hit a wall with the "Magic Ripening" project.
Old methods—Neo Solution—were costly, with mediocre results at best. The master demanded a breakthrough. Speed. Efficiency.
Just as I was desperate, I heard some Trekkers caught the Blade of Jade outside the city. That monster gave me the spark to engineer the wild Jade Grass.
But this new ripening tech wasn't for wheat. The grain was a byproduct—sold to fund the master's true desire: the Intelligent Plants.
The master wanted accelerated evolution. We forced reproduction, blasting them day and night with the Jade Grass's magical light.
The result is those tanks in the lab. Beautiful, aren't they?
You call that beautiful? They made my skin crawl.
Heh. You're blind. Those plants will change the world.
To aid such a grand design... I have not wasted my life.
Heh... Let me show my one last act of loyalty.
Heh. It's here. I unlocked the cage before I came out. It'll tear this place apart.

strings.text: Venturing alone into the underground lab, you discover the Intelligent Plants and find out about United Harvest's investigation of the orphanage. Unfortunately, Lady Gray ambushes you with a club and poison.
You two stay safe. Don't do anything reckless. Make contact if anything comes up.
Stick close, Mina. If things get dicey, I'll protect you.
No need. I have to contact Noya and HQ. I'm staying right here.
Alone? That's dangerous! What if you get ambushed? Besides, if you don't come with me, I might just start snapping photos of all these juicy secrets.
If you leave me unsupervised, you don't get to complain about what ends up on my camera roll later.
Ugh...==W== Fine! I'll go with you, happy?!
Uh-huh. And let's say this squares us for you blocking that Intelligent Plant earlier ★
Let's get one thing straight: you are not taking a single picture while I'm around.
Relax. I'll just snap away when you aren't looking.
Probably best to give them some space. They'll clear the air soon enough.
At the end of the day, their methods might differ, but they share the same goal.
Boss, we're heading out. Watch your back when investigating on your own.
Don't worry. Magic can't hurt me.
But the enemy might have other tricks up their sleeves besides magic...==W== Here, give me your pinky.
Mistique hooks her pinky finger around mine.
It's a pinky promise. Back when I was chasing dangerous leads, a trusted witch colleague and I had this little ritual before I left.
Listen to me. Don't play the hero. Come back in one piece... Promise?
I still have your exclusive to write. Give me enough material, and maybe I'll turn it into a biography.
Deal. Let's regroup here when the investigation's done.
Our fingers tighten—a silent pact—before we nod to one another.
Is it ... looking at me?==W== Does it know it's a prisoner in a tank? A lab rat?
What is United Harvest's actual endgame with these Intelligent Plants?
If they just needed heavy labor for hazardous work,==W== the Mandrake Radiant Grass should suffice.
Sir Joseph said these are "Gen-2." Does that imply the Mandrake Radiant Grass was built for something else entirely?
Phew... Stop overthinking. Focus on finding leads on the orphanage.
If the staff catch me down here, it's game over.
Year 996 Arms Budget, Intelligent Plant Combat Standards: Version 3, Philae Topography Map...
Why are they military-focused? Isn't United Harvest an agriculture and food company?
Doubt I'll find orphanage records in this cabinet. Time to look deeper in.
Did I just hear something behind the cabinet?
I circle around the cabinet and look toward the source of the sound.
It's attacking!==W== Hey, back off! Come any closer, and I'll pluck you bald!
Wait, not attacking. Is it just mad I interrupted its work?
The Intelligent Plant tapped a vine impatiently, then turned its eyes back to the document.
Talk about work ethic... Never thought I'd see the day I'd get the cold shoulder from a plant.
Wait. If it's organizing these, maybe it knows where my file is.
Hi, sorry to interrupt, but I have a quick question...
I get it, I get it. Just answer this one thing, and I'll vanish from your sight.
I'm looking for a file on an orphanage in Emor's Ash District. Ring any bells?
Visibly annoyed, the Intelligent Plant waves a vine and fishes out a document.
This is ... a report on United Harvest's investigation of the orphanage two years ago.
Team leader: Firenze. Target…==W== The ancient relic beneath the orphanage.
An ancient relic? What exactly did they do in the orphanage, and where are the children? And Aunt Allie?
Heh. Impressive... To think someone as helpless as you actually made it this far.
I should have known. Sir Joseph's mercenaries...==W== They work for you.
Pleasure to meet you, Boss. And—==W==<color=#bd3059>farewell.</color>==W== Don't take it personally. You brought this on yourself when you went running to Firenze.
Thanks to you, the master gave me quite an earful... I suffered for it.==W== So, I'm turning you into the master's absolute favorite thing. You ought to thank me.
As my consciousness fades, I feel a hand yanking my head back.
Let's test this—a new magical compound, fresh from the company labs.
Icy fluid floods my mouth, plunging my mind into endless darkness.
Oh my, how tragic. You were inches from the truth about the orphanage, only to get whacked from behind with a pipe.
What exactly did Lady Gray feed me? I thought I was immune to magic. How did a potion kill me?
That compound is designed to turn humans into vegetation. Naturally, it had no effect on you.
Such a shame. If you'd turned, I could've kept a cute little Tyrant Sprout on my nightstand. Greet you every morning!
Bernina, Tyrant isn't your exclusive property. ==SEX1== should be in the middle of our bed.
Regardless, the potion didn't kill you. You had an acute subdural hematoma caused by blunt force trauma, leading to your unfortunate demise.
Might I suggest a helmet next time you read confidential files?
Not sure I follow their logic... But hitting the lab alone is definitely a no-go.
Dying wasn't a total waste, though. I know the file's there. Just need an opening to grab it.
This is ... right when we entered Greenhouse No.100.
Dear Tyrant, feel free to place me on your head. I would serve as quite an effective helmet.
And get you smashed to pieces?!==W== I don't need a helmet. This time, I'm steering clear of the lab entirely!
