strings.text: The Blade of Jade recharges its magic and attacks once more. Mistique rescues Mina and instructs her to safeguard the evidence within the photo capturer, then becomes bait to lure away the Blade of Jade.
Pass.==W== I'm here to expose United Harvest, not hunt monsters.
Besides, I've got plenty of photos already. Until I get this photo capturer back safely, the rest of this trip is just a formality.
Who knew a minor bread case had this much baggage? Banned Neo Solution, Intelligent Plants ...==W== and someone trying to silence us permanently.
Even the Blade of Jade was involved.==W== Heh, this is going to make for one hell of an article<size=60>♪
Still, getting this much dirt in one run? Maybe it's karma rewarding me for being such a saint ★
You still haven't answered me.==W== You're the manager, Mina. What's the call on these photos?
If these leak, United Harvest is finished...==W== The Philae Branch could shut down completely. All those people, out of a job...
No, wait. Maybe HQ can fix this... Nyx is an inspector. She can report this internally, handle it properly...
Don't bet on it. Nyx might be honest, but HQ?==W== Why would they air their dirty laundry? Internal drama is fine, but a public scandal burns real Dorra.
Ugh...==W== I know. I know you're right.
If we bury the truth now, history will just repeat itself.==W== I... I realize that.
I have to put my feelings aside. Make the right choice. Logically... I know exactly what needs to be done.
But ...==W== if I actually go through with it,==W== everything I've built my life around will crumble!
Hey, I'm not heartless. I get why you're torn, Mina.
But, like we say at the Scarlet Sights: "Better to print a messy story than leave the page blank."
Boss, how much longer 'til Fuyuka gets here?
Fuyuka and the New Star Guild are still hacking through the vines on the greenhouse gate. I'd say ...==W== we've got a bit of a wait.
Perfect. Time for a story, then.
Consider this an entrance exam. It's a scenario every witch has to answer before Scarlet Sights Media will even look at them.
A travelling witch comes across a village just as a savage monster starts==RT==attacking the locals. If she does nothing, the place will be wiped out in moments.
Worse, there are other villages nearby, totally unaware of the monster.==RT==Any one of them could be the next target.
One: Save the locals, drive the monster off, but at a cost of missing the shot. Without a photo, nobody believes the threat is real.
Two: Photograph the slaughter. Use that evidence to warn the surrounding regions of the crisis.
Drive the monster off, obviously. Forget the photo—saving lives comes first.
Yeah... I'm with the Boss. I'd save the villagers, too.
And that is exactly why neither of you is witch material.
At Scarlet Sights, only the ones who choose to "take the photo" make the cut.
Look, saving people is for Trekkers or the Imperial Guard. It's not in a witch's job description.
Society survives because everyone plays their part. That division of labor is the only thing keeping the system stable.
Think about it. If we also play hero, who's left to sound the alarm? Without a warning, the next village won't stand a chance.
Huh? Why? Isn't saving lives the priority?
Of course lives matter. But consider the cost of missing the proof.
You save one village, sure. But with no one to warn them, the neighbors are sitting ducks. You end up endangering far more people.
So you're saying...==W== Sacrificing one to save a hundred is acceptable?
Relax, Mina. It's just a thought experiment, not reality.
If it were real, Trekkers would step in and handle it.
Full marks, Boss. If you were born in Flavio, you'd make a great ==SEX16==.
I'll save them, obviously. Why is this even a question?
I choose to beat up the storyteller.
Hahaha! That answer is so Boss... No, wait, that is pure "Legendary Tyrant" energy. I love it.
Is saving one person the "right" answer if it puts a hundred others in the line of fire?
Then again, sacrificing one to save a hundred? That would weigh on my conscience, too.
The fault isn't with the one choosing, the witch, or the villagers. It lies with whoever cooked up this twisted scenario in the first place—
So, if I just beat that guy up, the villagers stay safe, and the witch doesn't have to agonize over her choice.
Anyway, you get the picture, right? Just like how Mina insists on sticking to the rules...
Seek the truth, spread the truth. That is the code witches live by. And honestly, that is exactly the role society expects us to play.
So...==W== If you really want to protect something, the choice is yours. Do you bury the truth in exchange for peace?==W== Or do you face it head-on, even if it means hurting others?
Whatever choice Mina makes, I doubt she can give us an answer right now.
Mistique, what answer did you give back then?
Yeah, just for reference...==W== Huh? Sorry, hang on a sec.
Text from Nazuka. I asked her to identify that feather.
Boss, I took a closer look. That's definitely a Blade of Jade feather.
Heads up... We actually just fought the Blade of Jade.
You fought it?! Is everyone okay?
We're good. Mistique drained the magic right out of its wings. It flew off.
United Harvest was keeping it in the greenhouse to grow Jade Grass.
Harnessing the power of the Blade of Jade... Didn't see that coming. Wait, does Mistique still have Grace in her Soul Stone?
Yeah. She's got enough to fight it off another round or two.
No, any residual Grace is actually dangerous... The Blade of Jade absorbs pure magic—Grace—to regenerate.
Last time we hunted it, it sucked the Grace right out of our Soul Stones.
The team got hammered before we figured it out.
In the end, everyone had to drain their Grace on purpose. I fought it alone.
That's the gist of it. Watch your surroundings if it comes back.
Oh, no. Maybe it didn't run away... Maybe it went to drain the Neo Solution to recharge!
Speaking of the devil...! Boss, Mina, watch out!
Oof... That actually hurt. Stupid bird,==W== did you fill your tank just to come back for payback?
Hey! No rampaging allowed! Master, Mistique senpai, Mina senpai! Run!
Fuyuka, perfect timing. Thanks for the save.
Run! The vines are blocking the gate again! Move it, now!
Amber's shots and Noya's wind knock the Blade of Jade off its dive. Mistique yanks me onto her broom, and we shoot out the greenhouse doors.
Phew... We made it out. Everyone okay?
It's gone! Gone! My photo capturer! The Blade of Jade must've knocked it out of my hands back there!
Every single photo I took is in there... My scoop...==W== It's ruined...
Right at the exit, she yelled, "I'm getting the capturer!" and bolted back inside!
Sorry. Couldn't grab her in time.
She went back ... for the capturer?==W== Seriously... What is she doing...
This is the spot where the attack happened.
The capturer...==W== Where did it go?
How ironic.==W== United Harvest is becoming exactly like that village in Mistique's story.
Except the monster didn't swoop in from outside. It was born right here, from within.
Killing the monster in front of us solves nothing if we hide the truth. Before long, a new one will just take its place.
Mistique said,==W== "Seek the truth, spread the truth." That is the witch's code.
And here I am. Always preaching about "protocols,"==W== yet I never understood what I was actually supposed to do.
I get it now. Saving the company means exposing the reality to everyone. Even if...==W== Even if it hurts.
You have to be kidding me... Now?!
Ah! H-Hey... Stay back! ... Stupid me. Monsters don't listen to reason... Ugh...==W== Can't outrun it...==W== But at least... I have to protect the capturer! I...
Are you insane?! Sacrificing yourself for a device?!
Th-that isn't my intention! But ...==W== if the company finds this, the truth gets buried forever, doesn't it?!
You're the insane one! You're the witch of truth,==W== aren't you?<size=60> Then leave me! Take the capturer and run!
Heh... Haha...==W== It's worth more than I am, right?
You can get away on your own, can't you?==W== Dragging dead weight like me will only get us both killed! It's a stupid choice anyway you slice it!
... You're right. If I were solo, shaking this thing would be child's play.
But Mina, you're missing one crucial point.
Remember that question I mentioned? The one every witch has to answer?
Yes. "Take the photo, even if it means the village gets destroyed." That's the witch's choice, right?
Exactly. That's the textbook answer.==W== But ask yourself: what is a "witch" actually after? You don't need to be a witch to figure that out.
Hmm...==W== I guess it's not hard to imagine.
Heh, see? Playing along with a dusty old script... Isn't that a total waste of time? Besides, doing exactly what they expect is boring as hell.
So...==W== Here's what I told them back then—
I'll get the villagers to snap a photo of my heroic victory against the monster!
Why force yourself into a binary choice when a little thinking gets you a better answer?==W== Haha! Whoever came up with that dilemma had rocks for brains.
Those people just aren't greedy enough to be witches. A perfect witch like me? I want the village safe and the truth exposed.==W== I want it all.
You're smart, Mina. You get where I'm going with this, don't you?
I take the capturer ...==W== and get a shot of you fighting the monster...?
Like I said, I'm a greedy witch. Just a photo isn't enough. Just the truth won't cut it either.
I won't stop until I've dragged the whole ugly truth into the light!
As long as the truth gets out, I don't care who holds the capturer.
Heh. Come and get it!==W== Must sting to get caught after losing to a bunch of Trekkers, huh?
So this time, I'm gonna beat you black and blue! Then I'll plaster your bruised, ugly mug all over the front page!
Hehehe. Watch closely, Boss. I'm about to show you==W== what a real witch can do!
A pillar of raw magic blasts through the greenhouse dome. Shards of glass rain down, shattering explosively on the ground.
Before anyone realizes it, the summoned spirit beside Mina dissolves into a pink mist.
And just like that, Mistique—with the Blade of Jade hot on her heels—vanishes into the hazy night.

Heads up... We actually just fought the Blade of Jade.
You fought it?! Is everyone okay?
We're good. Mistique drained the magic right out of its wings. It flew off.
United Harvest was keeping it in the greenhouse to grow Jade Grass.
Harnessing the power of the Blade of Jade... Didn't see that coming. Wait, does Mistique still have Grace in her Soul Stone?
Yeah. She's got enough to fight it off another round or two.
No, any residual Grace is actually dangerous... The Blade of Jade absorbs pure magic—Grace—to regenerate.
Last time we hunted it, it sucked the Grace right out of our Soul Stones.
The team got hammered before we figured it out.
In the end, everyone had to drain their Grace on purpose. I fought it alone.
That's the gist of it. Watch your surroundings if it comes back.
Oh, no. Maybe it didn't run away... Maybe it went to drain the Neo Solution to recharge!
Speaking of the devil...! Boss, Mina, watch out!
Oof... That actually hurt. Stupid bird,==W== did you fill your tank just to come back for payback?
Hey! No rampaging allowed! Master, Mistique senpai, Mina senpai! Run!
Fuyuka, perfect timing. Thanks for the save.
Run! The vines are blocking the gate again! Move it, now!
Amber's shots and Noya's wind knock the Blade of Jade off its dive. Mistique yanks me onto her broom, and we shoot out the greenhouse doors.
Phew... We made it out. Everyone okay?
It's gone! Gone! My photo capturer! The Blade of Jade must've knocked it out of my hands back there!
Every single photo I took is in there... My scoop...==W== It's ruined...
Right at the exit, she yelled, "I'm getting the capturer!" and bolted back inside!
Sorry. Couldn't grab her in time.
She went back ... for the capturer?==W== Seriously... What is she doing...
This is the spot where the attack happened.
The capturer...==W== Where did it go?
How ironic.==W== United Harvest is becoming exactly like that village in Mistique's story.
Except the monster didn't swoop in from outside. It was born right here, from within.
Killing the monster in front of us solves nothing if we hide the truth. Before long, a new one will just take its place.
Mistique said,==W== "Seek the truth, spread the truth." That is the witch's code.
And here I am. Always preaching about "protocols,"==W== yet I never understood what I was actually supposed to do.
I get it now. Saving the company means exposing the reality to everyone. Even if...==W== Even if it hurts.
You have to be kidding me... Now?!
Ah! H-Hey... Stay back! ... Stupid me. Monsters don't listen to reason... Ugh...==W== Can't outrun it...==W== But at least... I have to protect the capturer! I...
Are you insane?! Sacrificing yourself for a device?!
Th-that isn't my intention! But ...==W== if the company finds this, the truth gets buried forever, doesn't it?!
You're the insane one! You're the witch of truth,==W== aren't you?<size=60> Then leave me! Take the capturer and run!
Heh... Haha...==W== It's worth more than I am, right?
You can get away on your own, can't you?==W== Dragging dead weight like me will only get us both killed! It's a stupid choice anyway you slice it!
... You're right. If I were solo, shaking this thing would be child's play.
But Mina, you're missing one crucial point.
Remember that question I mentioned? The one every witch has to answer?
Yes. "Take the photo, even if it means the village gets destroyed." That's the witch's choice, right?
Exactly. That's the textbook answer.==W== But ask yourself: what is a "witch" actually after? You don't need to be a witch to figure that out.
Hmm...==W== I guess it's not hard to imagine.
Heh, see? Playing along with a dusty old script... Isn't that a total waste of time? Besides, doing exactly what they expect is boring as hell.
So...==W== Here's what I told them back then—
I'll get the villagers to snap a photo of my heroic victory against the monster!
Why force yourself into a binary choice when a little thinking gets you a better answer?==W== Haha! Whoever came up with that dilemma had rocks for brains.
Those people just aren't greedy enough to be witches. A perfect witch like me? I want the village safe and the truth exposed.==W== I want it all.
You're smart, Mina. You get where I'm going with this, don't you?
I take the capturer ...==W== and get a shot of you fighting the monster...?
Like I said, I'm a greedy witch. Just a photo isn't enough. Just the truth won't cut it either.
I won't stop until I've dragged the whole ugly truth into the light!
As long as the truth gets out, I don't care who holds the capturer.
Heh. Come and get it!==W== Must sting to get caught after losing to a bunch of Trekkers, huh?
So this time, I'm gonna beat you black and blue! Then I'll plaster your bruised, ugly mug all over the front page!
Hehehe. Watch closely, Boss. I'm about to show you==W== what a real witch can do!
A pillar of raw magic blasts through the greenhouse dome. Shards of glass rain down, shattering explosively on the ground.
Before anyone realizes it, the summoned spirit beside Mina dissolves into a pink mist.
And just like that, Mistique—with the Blade of Jade hot on her heels—vanishes into the hazy night.

strings.text: The investigation comes to an end, but Lady Gray collapses from poisoning before confessing. Firenze wants to assign blame for the chaos when Darcia stops her. Shockingly, Darcia pledges her loyalty to the Tyrant.
==PLAYER_NAME==, bad news! Mistique just used herself as bait! She lured the Blade of Jade away to protect the photo capturer and me...
I'll alert the team—wait. Mistique's calling?!
Heeey! Boss, Mina—you two doing okay?
You... What is wrong with you?! Chasing the truth is important, sure, but that doesn't mean anything if you get yourself killed in the process!
Huh? What are you talking about? Isn't it obvious what I'm doing? We have "Safety First" posters all over the production floor—
I'm good! The Blade of Jade is furious though—throwing magic at me like crazy. Heh, too slow! It can't catch me even if it tries. Bet that stings!
Mina, tell me you got a shot of my grand exit from the greenhouse?
Got it. I even snapped a few extra shots, just to be safe.
Nice! Keep the capturer safe until we meet up, okay?
Watch where you're flying! And get off the phone.
Relax! Pumpka and Lanterna are steering the broom. I'm hands-free!
Oh, right! That dramatic line I said earlier? "I won't stop until I've dragged the whole ugly truth into the light!" Yeah, pretend you didn't hear that.
A true witch shouldn't just talk a big game. We let our actions provide the answers! Right?
Still doing whatever she pleases. Well, at least she's safe.
Yeah... I'll keep the capturer safe. I'll hand it back as soon as Mistique returns.
Speaking of that, you seemed pretty conflicted about leaking those photos earlier. But looks like you've changed your mind?
I have. I'm putting my faith in Mistique. She always follows her heart, and I want to believe in that.
The future of United Harvest is at stake. I believe every employee needs to face this problem head-on.
But playing by the book—whether me or HQ—won't get us there. Heh... Funny. We actually have to borrow a witch's power to make things right.
It comes at a price, though. United Harvest's reputation might not survive the fallout.
Oh, it'll be a disaster. If I were a customer, I wouldn't touch our food with a ten-foot pole after this.
But covering it up? That betrays everyone who has ever trusted us. And to me, that's far worse.
No matter how bad it gets... As a member of United Harvest, I swear I'll get the Tawny Nightingale project back on track!
Because protecting Tawny Nightingale, ensuring no one has to worry about their next meal... That is the justice I believe in!
Loud and clear. If the Philae branch lands in hot water over this, count me in to help.
Alright then. Let's get started on the clean-up.
Huff... Huff... Finally shook her off. Hey, keep your spirits up! We're heading to the master's office.
Who the hell are you? Lugs that massive pillow around, but still glides like a ghost.
Trafficking defective goods, embezzlement, unauthorized military deployment, attempted murder... Lady Gray, any one of those counts is a life sentence.
Don't just stand there, get her! You're on the payroll, so earn your keep!
A squad captain whose only strategy is screaming "get her"? That is gross negligence.
Tch... You cocky little brat! Fine! Since it has come to this, I'll finish you myself!
Oh? And how, exactly? Your casting form is painfully amateur.
Spent all your time doing the master's dirty work, didn't you? Too busy proving loyalty to practice your skills.
I-I yield! I'll talk to the Department! I'll confess everything I've done all these years, I swear!
Come clean, and I'll petition the company for leniency.
But first, the orphanage in the Ash District in Emor. What do you know about it?
I know of it... But why are you bringing that up?
I see... So it was you. Out with it, what did you do to that orphanage?
What? No! Firenze was the one mixed up in that! That bastard... Riding on master's favor, acting like she runs the world...
Firenze? Wait... What do you mean?
What kind of poison?! Hang in there!==W== Hey!
Lady Darcia! W-We were just talking when she suddenly dropped. It looks like a fast-acting poison,==W== but I can't be sure...
Suddenly dropped? Get her to the infirmary, now! And Nyx, what are you doing out here at this hour?
She's at the top of our department's watchlist, Lady Darcia. She's been acting erratically lately, so I've been tailing her all day.
Top of the watchlist, huh? She likely took the poison herself to escape prosecution. Regardless, get her stabilized.
Thank you for the assistance. However, she is a suspect. I need to be present during her treatment.
Wait. You're the one who cracked that big case four years ago, aren't you? Nyx, from the Compliance Department.
Yes, Lady Darcia. And I'm still dedicated to rooting out anyone breaching company's protocol.
This is Lady Gray, right? Firenze mentioned she's been running scams using our name. Fine. She's all yours.
Before you go, though... I'm worried about Firenze. She's too impulsive. Walk with me.
We're safe. Master, what was that flying out of the roof? Was it the Blade of Jade?
Yeah. And Mistique. She offered herself as bait to cover our escape.
Don't worry. She's probably having a blast leading the Blade of Jade on a wild goose chase right now.
Whoa. A broomstick dogfight against the Blade of Jade? Can't believe I missed out on that. Next time, I'm making Mistique take me for a spin.
Don't look so disappointed... But... I never would've guessed Sir Joseph was behind the Golden Nightingale case.
Let's hand him over to Firenze and Lady Darcia. He's way above our pay grade to deal with.
Careful. Footsteps. A lot of them... Armed and heading our way.
Weapons down! Hands on your heads and get on the ground!
Hey, what are you doing? We didn't do anything wrong!
Lady Firenze, what's going on? We're on the Golden Nightingale case—we've just caught the culprit.
So? That doesn't tell me what you're really after.
I see a wrecked greenhouse, our R&D Director held captive, and reports of gunfire and magic.
Take everyone to the Ash District. Save your explanations for the interrogation room.
Whoa, hold up. Don't tell me you're the "master," the one Joseph and Lady Gray wouldn't shut up about.
Lady Firenze, if you think we're out of line, we can clear this up in front of Lady Darcia.
You're in no position to bargain. Get them! Take ==SEX4== down!
Lady Darcia? What brings you here?
"A leader must always know the situation on the ground."==W== You taught me that yourself, Firenze.
Also, let's be clear: they acted on my direct orders.==W== If there's a problem, I take full responsibility.
With respect, Lady Darcia, excuses don't change facts. The ruined greenhouse and the Director's injuries are on them. Company protocol demands we take them in.
Since they were just following my command, I will answer for the damages.
Darcia's actually been kind to us... and Firenze helped us deal with all that Lady Gray business. So who's really behind the Golden Nightingale?
Hehe, long time no see, Fuyuka.
L-Lady Darcia! H-hello! It's been ages!
Nyx, you've been following the Golden Nightingale case, right? What's your assessment of Mina and these Trekkers?
Correct. They've caused no harm to company interests. If anything, they saved United Harvest from significant losses.
Nyx? What are you doing here?
Ah, is the Director of Operations ... ordering me to answer?
And you, Boss. May I call you that?
Greetings. I'm the Boss of Boss Accord. The commission is done, though I must apologize for the damage the greenhouse sustained.
Necessary losses. It's late, I know, but I'm intrigued by what happened in there. Care to join me in my office?
On the walk over, Darcia talks plenty about United Harvest and the Tawny Nightingale.
By the time we reach her office, I have just one question left.
Relax, they're in good hands. Now, where were we? Ah, yes. The Gen-2 Intelligent Plants in the greenhouse. That's what you're after, isn't it?
She's surprisingly upfront. Talked a lot on the way here, even promised to clean up the branch... Maybe she's actually reasonable.
Right. What's United Harvest's actual plan for those plants? Heavy labor in hazardous environments?
In a sense, you're right. They are destined for heavy, dangerous work.
These plants are the army your servant has prepared for Your Majesty.
An army,==W== huh...==W== Wait.==W== What? A-Army?
Yes, Your Majesty. My legion of plants will clear every obstacle, conquer every city, and bring the world under your rule.
What are you talking about? I'm no "Majesty," and I have zero interest in ruling the world.
Darcia sinks slowly to her knees before me in solemn reverence.
But you are Your Majesty. The one true Tyrant. I, Darcia, swear my eternal loyalty to you.
The United Harvest Philae Branch is merely the barracks I built for you. And please consider it your temporary capital.
Cast aside that false name forced upon you. Remember your glory. Lead us, your pitiful subjects, and breathe new life into this devastated world.
Body and soul... All that I am is yours.

strings.text: To host representatives from various companies and see you and New Star off, Firenze decides to hold a banquet in Philae. However, on the eve of the event, she is suddenly unable to attend.
Venatio Month 1st, 09:35. Subject left Room 404 and went down to the hotel restaurant for food.
10:20. Subject left the restaurant, lingered in the lobby lounge, then returned to their room.
11:40. Subject made a call in the room. Duration: seven minutes, thirty seconds.
Weather, food, small talk. Nothing valuable.
The recipient appears to be a Petal Bloom member who recently left Philae.
If you'd like, I can follow up on this lead and look into it.
Don't bother. I have no interest in trivia.
Very well. That concludes the report.
The subject hasn't contacted any other companies. Continue surveillance?
No. I'm changing the assignment. The operation is in three days. Can you handle it?
Affirmative. However, I need the details before I can—
You'll get the specs the second we hang up.
Huh... Being that impatient is going to cost him one day.
Hm? The dossier's here. Let's see...
Night of Venatio 5th. Infiltrate the banquet in disguise…==RT==Get to the target in advance, and presented the terms…
... If the target refuses, <color=#bd3059>eliminate</color> the target on the spot.
My, my. What a strict set of orders.
But honestly? It suits me perfectly.
At long last, I finally get to meet you face-to-face.
You are the strangest, most interesting, and utterly unpredictable mark I've ever tracked.
I have questions for you ... and I expect answers.
Tell me, Boss... Are you really the benevolent savior type?
Or do you represent the world-ending calamity the rumors speak of?
I'm going to find out the truth myself.
Noya popped another one...==W== Honestly, do you have to inflate them until they pop every single time?
The bigger the balloons, the cooler they look! Duh!
Go easy on them, Noya! They are precious items we wished from the Monolith!
Come on! This is a luxury banquet for everyone. We need to go all out with the decorations to make it epic!
<size=50>After the Darcia incident, every company in Nova began==RT==dispatching representatives for both business and private agendas.
To play the gracious host, Firenze decided to throw a banquet==RT==under the banner of the United Harvest Philae Branch.
Officially, it's a networking event to welcome the reps.==RT==But in reality, it's also a farewell party for us.
The New Star Guild and I are about to embark on a new journey==RT==to continue our search for clues about the orphanage.
Noya is giving the Lucky Oasis a full tune-up for the trip.
In the meantime, we're staying at the hotel and helping set up the venue.
You don't look so good, Boss... Are you worn out?
I'm fine. Just haven't been sleeping well lately.
I don't know. I toss and turn all night.
It might be the sudden change of scenery. We're used to sleeping in the car, after all.
Understood. Boss cannot sleep without us.
No, that's not what I meant! I can sleep alone just fine!
Enough about me. Iris, you've been buried in work lately, haven't you?
Prepping the venue, handling the logistics... You should take a breather.
Oh, it's fine. Honestly, I feel better knowing I handled the supplies myself.
The banquet's the real headache. All those big shots... The pressure's getting to me.
Relax! Schmoozing is Firenze and Nyx's job. We're just there to clear the buffet!
Right. Firenze said this is our send-off, too. Just enjoy the night and don't overthink things.
Great! My mission:==W== demolish a hundred steaks!
Boss, a moment in my office? We need to talk.
Why the serious faces? Don't tell me it's bad news.
Hard to say if it's "bad" yet, but it's certainly a complication.
Boss, have a look at this.
Is this ... a letter from United Harvest HQ?
Yeah, an express dispatch. It summons Nyx and me to Port Goldfinch to represent the Philae branch. We're reporting to—
She heads the Compliance Department. One of the top three==RT==heavyweights in United Harvest with enough pull to sway the Senate.
Calling me in for a debrief makes sense—I'm an Inspector. But dragging Firenze along? And right now, of all times...
Two days from now. Venatio Month 5th—the same night as our banquet.
It's a long haul to Port Goldfinch. Even with a Scarlet Sights Media witch handling transport, the trip takes at least two days.
Which means we'd have to set off right away.
Pulling you out of Philae right when we're supposed to brief the other companies on the Darcia incident...
Agreed. Someone's pulling strings to get Nyx and me out of the way.
But knowing it's a trap doesn't mean we can ignore the summons.

Come on! This is a luxury banquet for everyone. We need to go all out with the decorations to make it epic!
<size=50>After the Darcia incident, every company in Nova began==RT==dispatching representatives for both business and private agendas.
To play the gracious host, Firenze decided to throw a banquet==RT==under the banner of the United Harvest Philae Branch.
Officially, it's a networking event to welcome the reps.==RT==But in reality, it's also a farewell party for us.
The New Star Guild and I are about to embark on a new journey==RT==to continue our search for clues about the orphanage.
Noya is giving the Lucky Oasis a full tune-up for the trip.
In the meantime, we're staying at the hotel and helping set up the venue.
You don't look so good, Boss... Are you worn out?
I'm fine. Just haven't been sleeping well lately.
I don't know. I toss and turn all night.
It might be the sudden change of scenery. We're used to sleeping in the car, after all.
Understood. Boss cannot sleep without us.
No, that's not what I meant! I can sleep alone just fine!
Enough about me. Iris, you've been buried in work lately, haven't you?
Prepping the venue, handling the logistics... You should take a breather.
Oh, it's fine. Honestly, I feel better knowing I handled the supplies myself.
The banquet's the real headache. All those big shots... The pressure's getting to me.
Relax! Schmoozing is Firenze and Nyx's job. We're just there to clear the buffet!
Right. Firenze said this is our send-off, too. Just enjoy the night and don't overthink things.
Great! My mission:==W== demolish a hundred steaks!
Boss, a moment in my office? We need to talk.
Why the serious faces? Don't tell me it's bad news.
Hard to say if it's "bad" yet, but it's certainly a complication.
Boss, have a look at this.
Is this ... a letter from United Harvest HQ?
Yeah, an express dispatch. It summons Nyx and me to Port Goldfinch to represent the Philae branch. We're reporting to—
She heads the Compliance Department. One of the top three==RT==heavyweights in United Harvest with enough pull to sway the Senate.
Calling me in for a debrief makes sense—I'm an Inspector. But dragging Firenze along? And right now, of all times...
Two days from now. Venatio Month 5th—the same night as our banquet.
It's a long haul to Port Goldfinch. Even with a Scarlet Sights Media witch handling transport, the trip takes at least two days.
Which means we'd have to set off right away.
Pulling you out of Philae right when we're supposed to brief the other companies on the Darcia incident...
Agreed. Someone's pulling strings to get Nyx and me out of the way.
But knowing it's a trap doesn't mean we can ignore the summons.

strings.text: You offer to give the banquet's main speech in Firenze's place so she can follow headquarters' orders and head to Port Goldfinch. While trying on your formal outfit, you accidentally wander into a stranger's room.
We don't have a choice? Guess the Grand Inspector's authority is just too absolute to defy.
You're right, the Grand Inspector has the authority to investigate any employee of United Harvest.==W== Still, I doubt she's the one who actually summoned us this time...

Within United Harvest HQ, the Grand Inspector is a rare ally who opposed Darcia and stood on our side.==W== When my father was framed, although she couldn't overturn the evidence, she still helped us a great deal.
After my demotion to Marketing,==W== it's only thanks to her that I kept my status as an Inspector at all.
Given the current situation, she's unlikely to do anything against Philae branch or us.
Could it be that someone's using her name to distract you? Whoever pulled this off is a serious player.
In any case, the letter is indeed in the handwriting of Grand Inspector Matilda,==W== bears her seal, and was sent from Port Goldfinch.
If you don't go, you'll be left with a record of "violating company policy."==W== But if you go, a trap may be waiting for you.
Weighing the two evils, I'd say we're going in.
Now that we know Grand Inspector Matilda's at Port Goldfinch,==W== speaking with her face-to-face is the best way to resolve all these issues.
Understood. You head out.==W== The New Star Guild and I will help with the banquet!
If Iris finds out we're dealing with all these high-profile figures, she'll probably panic.==W== Though,==W== honestly, she's more than capable of handling it.
Boss, I truly apologize for burdening you with this at such a moment.

In addition to explaining the truth behind the Darcia incident, this banquet is also an opportunity for various parties—==W==including the United Harvest HQ—to assess the current state of the Philae branch.
They want to see if the branch is stable==W== and whether it has the capacity to maintain its previous level of business.
Rumor has it that HQ intends to remove Firenze from her position as Acting Executive, clearing the way for a Senate-backed successor to take control of the Philae branch.
That candidate is pushing an "Innovation Plan" for the branch.
Simply put, it's all about cutting costs and boosting profits—exactly the kind of thing the Senate wants to hear.
If that plan ever goes through, the staff will be working non-stop shifts, just like Intelligent Plants.
They're pulling Firenze away at a time like this just to stir up chaos at the banquet.
If things go south, they'll have the perfect excuse, "managerial incompetence," to overhaul the Philae Branch's leadership.
On the flip side, if the party stays perfect without Firenze, it proves she's built a rock-solid foundation.
True.==W== But there might be some "party crashers" slipping into the banquet.==W== Be very careful.
In the race for the Executive title, they might resort to ... unconventional methods.
Honestly, I wanted you to enjoy the banquet carefree.==W== But with us gone, they might turn their sights on you...==W== So please, stay alert.
I've stationed security near the venue.
Security? Didn't the previous team get hauled off with Lady Grey?
Yes. These new recruits are part-timers—workers from the branch.==W== They aren't as seasoned as professional ones.
Relax. I've seen it all.==W== The massive Stellaroid on Waterway,==W== phantasmal monsters,==W== and that terrifying legion of plants...
A banquet, even one crawling with danger,==W== is something I can handle.
In that case, I'll take over the speech you were supposed to give.
Better pay me for the labor, though~==W== How about a dinner at Philae's finest restaurant?
Boss,==W== I'm entrusting the future of every worker at Philae branch to you.
Such intense resolve...==W== Nyx really cares about the company.
If that Innovation Plan passes and they schedule me for back-to-back shifts,==W== I'll lose my afternoon naps! That's never gonna happen!==W== My naptime is sacred!
So that's what you're worried about!
Either way, we need to find out who sent this urgent letter—==W==and what they're plotting.
Lady Firenze, your guest is here.
Time to head back to the hotel.==W== Once we've greeted our guest, we need to leave for Port Goldfinch immediately.
Oh, and Boss!==W== Send me a photo once you've picked out your suit, okay?
I've arranged for a master tailor==W== to fit you for a bespoke gala suit.
Since when—?!==W== No, no, that's too much.==W== Can't I just make do with what I'm wearing?==W==
It's a matter of etiquette, and the arrangements are already made.==W== In short: "no" isn't an option.==W== Just pick one you like.
That tailor brought so many stunning outfits!==W== We simply can't decide!
Is that really necessary?!==W== It's just for one night. Any one of them should work.
Not a chance!==W== You have to look your absolute best!==W==
Excuse me... I don't want to hold you up. If we still need to do fittings, we should probably hurry.
Please,==W== don't worry about that.==W== My only priority is ensuring you're thrilled with the final look!
See? Even the tailor says it's fine. Go on, ==PLAYER_NAME==, give 'em a try!
I got in and out of outfit after outfit... But nothing clicks for the group, until—
It's perfect!==W== Can you wear this every single day, ==PLAYER_NAME==?
It has your name on it.==W==
Just take the compliment! This piece fits you perfectly.==W== This is the one, then!
Finally...==W== They've been dressing and undressing me like a mannequin for hours.
Better get back and change. I need to clean up before dinner.
Hm?==W== Why does it smell like ...==W== flowers in the hallway?
Oh my... Are we expecting a visitor?
Tell me...==W== What brings you to my door?
Hehe. You've got a sense of humor alright,==W== but I'm afraid this suite is taken.
I'd say you're ...==W== a bit lost.
Looking closer...==W== Yeah, definitely the wrong place.
Lucky for you, I'm only having tea.==W== Had I been changing...==W== Well,==W== a simple apology might not have cut it.
I'm only teasing. That outfit is stunning...==W== Heading to a banquet, perhaps?
Hehe.==W== Then you must be the star of the evening.
Won't you stay for a cup of black tea? I find myself quite curious about that banquet as well.
Besides, your room isn't far from here, is it?
Er... I'd best not. I have some urgent matters to attend to. Apologies for intruding on your room so abruptly.
Then... I wish you the best of luck.
I won't take up any more of your time. I'll...
I hurry out, glancing at the door number as I leave—it clearly reads "406."
Strange. Could have sworn I saw "404" on the door...==W== Is my exhaustion finally catching up with me?
I haven't slept well in days, and now I can't even tell one door from another. Bedtime is a top priority today.
I can't afford to make mistakes at the banquet...==W== I need to stay sharp.
But still...==W== Did I really misread?
Could have sworn==W== I checked the number before walking in...==W==
I push the door open into a completely empty hallway.
As I stand there puzzled, an envelope silently slides across the floor by my feet.

strings.text: To make sure the banquet goes smoothly, you decide to hire a bodyguard from Goodwind Homecare. But the person who receives you turns out to be the one you saw in the room yesterday—Otoha.
Firenze was right to worry. Someone's using underhanded methods. First they lured her away, and now they're trying to scare me off.
Noya, Amber, Iris...==W== They might be in danger too. I have to warn them.
Boss? It's late. Did something happen?
Sorry to wake you. Someone left this at my door. Take a look.
A photo of you, ==PLAYER_NAME==? You look great.==W== But why's there a red "X" over your face?!
Looks like it. There's a note on the back: "Venatio Month, 5th."
Venatio Month 5th?! Isn't that the night of the banquet?
I-Is this some kind of warning?==W== What does it mean?

If I guess right, their plan is simple: if I withdrew from the banquet or stayed but ended up being attacked and causing a disturbance,==W== it would only reinforce the claim that Firenze is incapable of managing the Philae branch.
I can't figure out why they'd warn me ahead of time, though.
Did you see who left it?
No. This letter is the only trace.
I've informed the security, and they promised to step up their patrols, but still...
Besides, if they can slip this under your door undetected, standard guards won't be enough. Most of them were just workers at the food factory before this.
Right. And they could also be using a diversion. If we move the security around and they read our defenses, they might take the chance to attack the guests—that would be even worse.
Hmm, makes sense.==W== How about we protect Boss ourselves?
Monsters and Stellaroids are our specialty, but this is different. I think we need professional help.
The problem is, who can we trust? With Firenze and Petal Bloom away, we might accidentally hire a saboteur. That'd be a disaster.
Boss, here is my card. Please accept it.
If you ever require my services, please feel free to reach out.
I met a maid from Goodwind Homecare a while back. She gave me her business card.
A maid? But we're looking for a pro bodyguard, aren't we?
Yeah... I know how it sounds.==W== She's a maid, sure, but she seemed... Well, highly capable of handling security.
Besides, I met her completely by chance. There's no way she's tied to this conspiracy.
If everyone's okay with it, I'll pay a visit after dawn.
Well, if you say so, Boss... We will enlist her help.
It's settled, then. It's late. Everyone should head back and get some sleep.
Didn't you say you couldn't sleep, Boss?
Like on the Lucky Oasis. We'll all sleep together.
Thanks, guys...==W== Alright, for safety's sake, let's all stay here tonight.
Honestly, I do feel a lot safer with them around...
The next day, Nanoha's business card leads us straight==RT==to the Goodwind Homecare office.
Noya and Iris wanted to tag along, but I asked them to stay back and sweep the hotel for security flaws.
This place is seriously tucked away...==W== But wow, what a gorgeous building.
Amber? You look tense...==W== Something wrong?
Presence is gone... Are they aware that I've noticed them?==W== Whoever it was... They're tough.
Let's head inside. It'll be safer, I think.
I reach out to knock, but the door swings open on its own.
Oh? I wondered who was at the door.==W== Fancy meeting you here.
Y-You?! What are you doing here?
Huh? Isn't she the one we're looking for?
No—well, yes, but she's not who I had in mind...
I'm honored that you came in person. Please, do come in.
Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Otoha, manager of Goodwind Homecare's Philae branch.
What a coincidence. I didn't expect our paths to cross again so soon after yesterday.
I misread a door sign and stumbled into her room by mistake...==W== Sorry about that. I made a total fool of myself.
Hehe. Don't give it a second thought. It was a surprise, sure, but a delightful one.==W== Now then, what brings you to my doorstep today?
One of your staff, <color=#3faeae>Nanoha</color>, gave me her card a while back. I was hoping to hire some help—is she available?
Nanoha?==W== She's out on assignment at the moment. If it's urgent, feel free to walk me through the details yourself.
We need a bodyguard. The best you have.
Consider it done. You're in excellent hands. Goodwind Homecare will not fail you.
Actually, I've already prepared a gift for you, in appreciation of your trust.
Words won't do it justice. This way, please.
Otoha leads us to the courtyard. Two women in tactical gear were tied up together, seemingly unconscious.
Two people were tailing you... So I took the liberty of "clearing" them out.==W== A little welcome gift, if you will.
Wait... That presence I felt earlier. It vanished because of you?
Hehe. It was no trouble at all.
She neutralized two targets without making a sound. In mere seconds...
She even had time to dump the bodies and meet us at the door, all without breaking a sweat.
But back to business. What brings you here looking for a bodyguard?
I fill Otoha in on the threatening letter I received last night.
I see.==W== In short, you need someone reliable to watch your back from the shadows.
Yes, thanks to your help today, the people who were following us have been dealt with. We really appreciate it.
Hehe...==W== You don't honestly believe it ends here, do you?
I had a brief chat with those two, but they didn't breathe a word about who sent them.
Usually, a common mercenary would have cracked. This suggests their employer is exceptionally strict. They won't be backing down anytime soon.
With your life on the line,==W== leaving loose ends is a fatal mistake. You have to eliminate the source of the problem.
So in your professional opinion, I still need protection?
Precisely. And not just protection—you need someone to dig up whoever is pulling the strings.
But with Nanoha out on a mission... Got anyone else you'd recommend?
You? You've already done enough taking out those stalkers. Besides, hiring the branch manager herself feels a bit...
Hehe. Like I said, that was merely a welcome gift.
Nanoha told me how you saved her during a mission and kept her identity a secret.
Nanoha is more than capable of handling a few punks on her own... I just did what I could.
Goodwind Homecare is always devoted to its clients. And when a guest shows us such kindness, we believe in repaying that debt in full.
Truth be told... Hehe. As the branch manager, I was planning to visit you to say thanks anyway. Running into you here feels like fate.
Thank me? Wait... Were you staying in the room next to mine yesterday to track me down?
Precisely. Unfortunately, our meeting yesterday was quite sudden, and an urgent matter forced me to leave the hotel prematurely. It is a true regret that I could not be formally introduced to you.
I won't charge a dime for my services. In exchange, though—
Keep my free bodyguard gig a secret from everyone beyond you and the New Star Guild.
If word gets out that a Goodwind manager is working pro bono, it'll ruin our business model.==W== Consider yourself a very special exception.
Hehe. It's quite an honor to meet the famous CEO of Boss Accord.
I've heard quite a few ... fascinating stories about you, after all.
Whatever you've heard... Thank you for taking the commission.
The job is simple: keep me in one piece until the banquet ends...==W== My safety is in your hands.
Thank you for the trust. Here's to a mutually beneficial partnership.
Now that our new guest is gone...
It's time to pay an "old friend" a visit.
Take this blindfold off and let me out!
The real show is only getting started.

Yes, thanks to your help today, the people who were following us have been dealt with. We really appreciate it.
Hehe...==W== You don't honestly believe it ends here, do you?
I had a brief chat with those two, but they didn't breathe a word about who sent them.
Usually, a common mercenary would have cracked. This suggests their employer is exceptionally strict. They won't be backing down anytime soon.
With your life on the line,==W== leaving loose ends is a fatal mistake. You have to eliminate the source of the problem.
So in your professional opinion, I still need protection?
Precisely. And not just protection—you need someone to dig up whoever is pulling the strings.
But with Nanoha out on a mission... Got anyone else you'd recommend?
You? You've already done enough taking out those stalkers. Besides, hiring the branch manager herself feels a bit...
Hehe. Like I said, that was merely a welcome gift.
Nanoha told me how you saved her during a mission and kept her identity a secret.
Nanoha is more than capable of handling a few punks on her own... I just did what I could.
Goodwind Homecare is always devoted to its clients. And when a guest shows us such kindness, we believe in repaying that debt in full.
Truth be told... Hehe. As the branch manager, I was planning to visit you to say thanks anyway. Running into you here feels like fate.
Thank me? Wait... Were you staying in the room next to mine yesterday to track me down?
Precisely. Unfortunately, our meeting yesterday was quite sudden, and an urgent matter forced me to leave the hotel prematurely. It is a true regret that I could not be formally introduced to you.
I won't charge a dime for my services. In exchange, though—
Keep my free bodyguard gig a secret from everyone beyond you and the New Star Guild.
If word gets out that a Goodwind manager is working pro bono, it'll ruin our business model.==W== Consider yourself a very special exception.
Hehe. It's quite an honor to meet the famous CEO of Boss Accord.
I've heard quite a few ... fascinating stories about you, after all.
Whatever you've heard... Thank you for taking the commission.
The job is simple: keep me in one piece until the banquet ends...==W== My safety is in your hands.
Thank you for the trust. Here's to a mutually beneficial partnership.
Now that our new guest is gone...
It's time to pay an "old friend" a visit.
Take this blindfold off and let me out!
The real show is only getting started.

strings.text: Firenze brings bad news: a mercenary group known as the Desert Scorpion plans to sabotage the banquet. You're still relieved that you hired Otoha as a bodyguard, unaware that this is exactly how the trap begins.
Since you know who I am, you should also know that you're making a colossal mistake.
Kidnapping the manager of the Philae branch, the future leader of Goodwind Homecare...==W== You've got some nerve.
A few empty promises of glory, and you gladly grind yourselves into tools, throwing your life away like a kunai they never intended to retrieve... And you're even proud of it.
Don't act like you know us. Cut to the chase. How much do you want?
Straight to the Dorra...==W== You're definitely that person's hand-picked successor.
You know the leader of Goodwind Homecare?==W== Are you with them?
Wait, I don't recognize your voice. You're either bluffing, or masking your voice so I can't identify you.
No matter what, your scheme won't succeed. My people will find me.
Whoever you are, you and your accomplices are dead meat.
What? You broke into Goodwind territory alone and dragged me out? Impossible!
It wasn't nearly that complicated. We're sitting in Goodwind's own underground cell right now. I'm merely borrowing the space.
No... That's impossible.==W== What about the others?! Did you...
No idea. Right now, we're the only two souls left in this entire estate.
... Hehe. Notice how delightfully quiet it is? I can hear your heart hammering in your chest.
There's no need to fret. This is a rare treat. Let's enjoy our little private chat.
Remember one thing. By tomorrow, Goodwind Homecare will be in ruins—
I'm using your people to eliminate someone.
The evidence will point directly to Goodwind's higher-ups. Their reputations will shatter, making them public enemies.
Once they lose their foothold on this continent, they'll point fingers, sell each other out, and drag themselves straight to hell.
It's their reckoning. A debt long overdue.
... I admit you're skilled. But your plan is going to fail.
We've weathered countless storms before. We'll stand together and pull through this, too.
Then I suppose we shall see.
I'll bring good news next time I drop by.
Such bitter hatred for Goodwind, combined with those skills...
Could she be...?==W== But it's impossible! She wouldn't dare return.
A rare trip to my old haunts...==W== Yet I feel no nostalgia.
Seeing their blissful ignorance... It's like looking at my past self.
Morning training was the right call. It'll be chaos once the others wake up.
Intruders...!==W== I need to send warnings...
Hm? You're tougher than I thought, still talking after a dose of sedative magic. Let's fix that with another shot.
Apologies, Miss Shuo. I'll be borrowing your identity for a while.
What? An emergency dispatch?!==W== And here I was looking forward to a hot bath tonight...
Quit complaining and move. Get your gear packed, now.
It's fine, I have everything packed. A quick inventory check, and we can head out.
Are you coming with us, Miss Shuo?
We'll leave the place in your hands.==W== Stay safe.
Unbelievable. Giving us the cold shoulder when Master is just being nice to her.
After all these years, we finally spoke face-to-face again.
If that conversation had gone on any longer, would she have seen through my disguise?
Leaving without a word back then was my only choice. I failed her... She must have felt completely lost these past few years.
If only someone could take my place by her side and share her burdens.
Once Goodwind Homecare falls, we can finally reunite in the light of day.
I hope that day comes soon...
Back at the hotel, I fill Noya and Iris in on what happened in Goodwind Homecare.
I tell them to keep it quiet. No one can know Otoha is my bodyguard.
Boss, is now a good time?
I've had some investigation made. Someone paid top Dorra for Desert Scorpion to hit the banquet.
They're notorious elite mercenaries from <color=#3faeae>Mirage</color>, the desert city. For the right price, there's no limit to their brutality.
Who hired them? The same person who pulled you out of Philae?
Highly possible. I'll look into it.==W== Stay sharp, Boss. Desert Scorpions don't mess around.
Got it. All quiet on my end, but I'll tell the others to stay alert.
Looks like hiring Otoha was the right move.
By the way, do you know anyone at Goodwind Homecare?
Goodwind Homecare?==W== I met their Philae branch manager once. <color=#3faeae>Shuo</color>, I think. We ended up at the same table during a noblewoman's wedding.
We only exchanged pleasantries; I didn't get a deep read on her. But I remember she carried herself with a noble elegance.
Weird. That doesn't sound like Otoha at all.==W== Then again, maybe they changed their identity recently.
Why ask about Goodwind Homecare all of a sudden?
I met one of their maids a while back. Mostly curious.
Take my advice: steer clear of them entirely.
I don't have all the details, but they've only been around for a decade. Yet somehow, they've already built deep ties with countless elite families and companies.
They have to be backed by someone incredibly powerful, whose real identity is still unknown after all these years... And that's exactly what makes them so dangerous.
The fact that their true roots are a total mystery makes the whole thing deeply unsettling.
I've contacted the Imperial Guard to help secure the venue. They should be able to provide help.
Appreciate it. Leave the banquet to us. You and Nyx stay safe out there.
Sigh... I'm still on edge. If things go south on your end, I won't know until it's too late.
I'm the one who dragged you into this, yet I can't even guarantee your safety...
Let's set up a signal, then.
Call me whenever. If I don't pick up within a minute, or if I answer and immediately hang up, you'll know I'm in trouble.
Got it. Please include Ruby and Sapphire, too. If you don't respond to their call, they'll immediately mobilize all available resources at the Philae branch to rescue you.
If I couldn't reach you, I'll accept HQ's terms in exchange for help.
You're making this sound scary. Accept HQ's terms? Then all our hard work would be for nothing. Your career in Philae, your dream of changing the city...
A career and a dream without you in it would have no meaning.
Cough... okay, relax. We won't let it get that far.
The enemy... Where could they be hiding?
The banquet is tomorrow... Fingers crossed everything goes smoothly.
Sigh...==W== Boss, I'm being completely serious.
Final check. Stick to the plan—cut through the south alley and hit the target from behind.
Recon only tonight. Count the guards, map the patrols, and log the access points. Do not blow our cover!
I have no intention of sharing my prey.
But before that...==W== Taking a moment to admire your sleeping face sounds quite lovely. Hehehe.

strings.text: The banquet is about to begin. Representatives have gathered, and Desert Scorpion Mercs have moved into position. Guided by "Noya," you make your way to the venue, but suddenly sense something amiss.
Good evening, viewers! I'm Ophir, your on-scene witch from Philae Express.
We're coming to you live from the highly anticipated Philae Business Banquet.
The main event kicks off in an hour.
Representatives from major factions are already pouring in,==RT==and the energy here is electric!
Let's grab a few early arrivals==W== and hear what they're looking forward to tonight!
Oh! We have the <color=#3faeae>Grace Imperium</color> delegations right here.==W== Excuse me, care to share a few words about the banquet?
Oh, sorry! I only started as an intern a few days ago.
A formal interview belongs to our senior staff...==W== Right, Lady Laru?
Ow! Watch the elbow!==W== You made me drop a fry...
Senior Laru, you are representing Grace Imperium tonight. The witch is waiting for your statement.
Uh... Statement?==W== The fries are decent. Nice crunch. Could use a dash more salt, though.
Wait, no!==W== Cut the feed, do not air that!
... Ahem.==W== On behalf of Grace Imperium, I wish tonight's gathering the utmost success.
Less is more, rookie. You keep it vague at these official gigs to avoid slipping up. Take notes.
Is she winging it, or is she actually a genius...?
An interview? Pass. I have nothing to say.
I'll take this one.==W== Jayhawk. Inspector for <color=#3faeae>United Harvest</color>.
Appreciate it!==W== The Acting Executive Director for the Philae branch, Miss Firenze, appears to be absent tonight...==W== May I ask the reason for this?
Let's move on to the question on everyone's mind.==W== When will United Harvest announce the Philae branch's next Executive Director?
United Harvest's internal affairs are strictly confidential. I'd be in trouble if I spoke out of turn.
In terms of publicity, if there is any deviation in your future reports, you will be held responsible.
Intimidating...==W== Thank you for your time. That's all the questions I have.
A-An interview?!==W== Mind if we give our company a quick shout-out?==W== Ah, no?==W== Fine, okay...
Well, whoever takes the Executive Director seat,==W==<color=#3faeae> Deepsea Finance</color> is always open for your funding needs!
Cangwu and Philae have always maintained friendly relations.
On behalf of <color=#3faeae>Cangwu</color>, we look forward to deeper cooperation with the Philae branch, ensuring our trade and cultural exchanges continue to thrive.
Thank goodness. Finally, some usable footage...
By the way, mind if I borrow your megaphone Artifact? I got separated from someone and need to find them.
I'm back! They don't even have boiled water here!
Can I draw a talisman and boil a pot myself?
A-Are you sure I can speak for the <color=#3faeae>Imperial Guard</color>?!
I'm Tilia, a squire transferred from Emor. It's an honor to help secure tonight's banquet...
Wait, who's lighting a fire over there?!==W== Get away from that candle—!!
Haha... Guess we're cutting that take too...
I still don't have nearly enough footage. I'll have to shoot the rest during the banquet itself!==W== Time for a quick break.
Whoa, sorry! I didn't see you standing there...
Wait, that uniform... You're with <color=#3faeae>Omnisky Aegis</color>, aren't you?
I'm Ophir, field witch from Philae Express. Can I grab a quick inter—
Did you get me on camera? Delete it. Now.
N-No! We haven't even started rolling...
Is that right...? You better not be lying. If I find out you are, things are gonna get ugly.
I wouldn't dare! Understood. We'll get out of your hair right now. Excuse us!
Tch... All this hassle with a fake identity just to crash a banquet. That old geezer is paranoid as hell.
If the Boss appears at the banquet as planned, it means the first assassin has failed.
That is when you step in. You are the contingency plan—eliminate the Boss on sight.
Cleaning up someone else's mess? Talk about a waste of talent.
Hazana, I am designating you as the final failsafe precisely because I trust Desert Scorpion's capability.
Get the job done, and the payout will feed your crew for years.
Hmph. I don't give a damn about the Dorra...==W== Just let me raise some hell, and I'm in.
Myrsha reporting in, Captain!==W== Squads One, Two, and Three are all in position. Awaiting orders!
Copy that. Any sign of the target?
Not yet. We've got teams sweeping every floor as we speak.
Security's tighter than we expected. It's making it hard for us to move freely.
Hmph. I'm sure that woman is behind this.
Last night, one of our squads was knocked out and left hanging in the greenhouse. It was definitely that woman's doing.
Hmpf. Sneaky little rat—sooner or later I'll catch you red-handed.
Whatever. These people will do. Hide well and stay sharp. Be ready to move at a moment's notice!
Does everyone hear me clearly? Stay in position. As soon as the Boss appears, we'll move in.
... Those Scorpions just won't give it a rest. It seems they're suspecting my presence as well.
Can't have them ruin my fun with Boss...==W== Time for a change of pace.
I've got the speech down.==W== No problem. I can do it... I got this.
There you are, ==PLAYER_NAME==! I've been waiting forever!
Sorry to keep you waiting. I was just doing one last check on my script.
You're alone? Where are Amber and Iris?
They got roped into helping at the venue. It's packed. I even heard that a Scarlet Sights witch is running around doing interviews.
I could look at you in that formal wear all day, ==PLAYER_NAME==. It never gets old!
Personally, I'd be happy if I never had to put this on again...
I'd much rather go on adventures and make wishes in the Monolith than be at a glittering event like this.
Life's not so bad right now. Besides, you don't get unlimited free Pep Pep Juice inside the Monolith.
Who are you? And what have you done with her?
What are you talking about? You're not making any sense.
Noya lives for the climb. She'd never settle for a quiet life just because the drinks are free.
She prefers the Pep Pep Juice we earn ourselves from the Wishing Box.
Looking closely, your grip on the sword is very stiff; you don't look like someone who's used to wielding a sword.
My, my... Spotted already?==W== You have quite the sharp eye. You really do pay attention to your friends.
Well then... Sorry for you, Boss.

strings.text: Despite Otoha's threats, you insist on making your appearance at the banquet, for Philae's future and your promise to Firenze. After calculating the odds, Otoha decides to help you.
Where am I? This room... Am I still at the hotel?==W== Crap. I'm tied too tight to move.
Five minutes and twenty seconds.==W== Right on schedule. You're in perfect health, Boss.
Catching you was harder than I expected.
I lit relaxing incense in the hall and bribed the staff==RT==to swap the room numbers and decor.
But you ran straight past. You moved so fast you almost==RT==knocked over the waiter changing the signs back.
I tried approaching you at night, but your friends never==RT==left your side. I couldn't find an opening.
I finally disguised myself as your friend to lure you here quietly, and you saw right through it.
Where's Noya? Why are you pretending to be her?!
Rest assured, Miss Noya is busy at the banquet.
As for why I took her form...==W== I had no choice.
If certain people saw me in the hotel, it might lead to complications.
I'm not the only one hunting you.
So I struck first. It's safe here. No one will interrupt us.
I've been hired to deliver a message:
"Disappear from the banquet. Leave Philae,==RT==and stay out of its affairs for good."
"Play nice, and you'll get a <color=#3faeae>payout</color>—500 million Dorra. Enough for you and your friends to retire in comfort."
...==W== I see. You're the assassin they sent.
If that's true, why wait until now to give the ultimatum? You had countless openings.
Because ...==W== I wanted to see your true nature.
Time is ticking. Make your choice.
Say yes, and my people will handle the rest. I guarantee safe passage out of the city.
You don't stumble across such a good deal every day.
Because it's not even an option.
First, I promised Firenze I'd attend the banquet and give her speech for her.
Second, my friends in Philae have done a lot for me these past few months.
... I've forged contracts with partners who share my vision.
And I share the blame for the recent chaos in the city.
I could never betray them and throw all of that away.
Besides, Philae is still unstable. As the CEO of Boss Accord, how can I walk away now?
It's my job to bring peace back to Philae and the United Harvest branch. I won't stand by and let anyone ruin this for them.
Heh heh heh heh... Bravo. I was captivated.
But I shouldn't have to remind you of your situation, right? Refusing me means death.
A beautiful speech, but it means nothing once you're dead.
I can stand tall, knowing I kept my promise to my companions.
... I see. It's perfectly clear now. You're exactly what your file says you are.
You're a CEO, yet you don't act like a big shot with a Seal of Grace... You're an enigma.

Consider another hypothetical.==W== Even if you're willing to die for this "promise," what about the others? Can you guarantee they'll keep their word? Are you certain you'll always be on the same page?
Is that right? By the way...
Your friend Firenze is probably getting the exact same offer right now. Think she'll walk away from Philae?
She didn't climb the ranks at United Harvest by being stupid. She'll take the deal.
Oh, Firenze is calling? Interesting. My theory was right—your phone can actually reach other cities.
What did I tell you? She's probably calling to say goodbye.
Go ahead, answer it. Have a nice chat.==W== I can't wait to see your face when she breaks that little promise of yours. This should be fun.
And remember, your life is still in my hands. Don't try anything clever.
Hate to ruin your fantasy, but that's not happening. Still, if she's calling, I'm answering.
Thank god you picked up, Boss. I was worried they got to you too.
Too? What's going on over there?
Nyx and I got ambushed by a group of people in black.
Their leader said if I resign and leave Philae entirely, they'll pay us 500 million Dorra each once the dust settles.
That's a hell of an offer. I'd take it in a heartbeat.
Haha, very funny. As if I'd hand Philae's future over to a bunch of shady thugs.
Figured you'd say that.==W== I hear explosions. Are you still being chased?
Yeah, but we broke their lines. We're heading to meet Grand Inspector Matilda now. Looks like they kept her in the dark too.
Good.==W== Don't worry about me. Call back when you're safe.
Got it. And if you run into trouble, call me immediately. Talk soon, Boss.
Spot-on prediction. Sounds like she "took the deal" and is off to enjoy the high life.
... Your companions are a bunch of absolute weirdos.
Maybe. But "weirdo" isn't the right word.
Whether it's Boss Accord, or the people who stand by me as true friends... Every single one of them keeps their word.
I know they'll keep their end of the bargain. That's why I'd bet my life on them.
Every corporate suit I've ever met wakes up calculating margins and weighing risks. No exceptions.
I weigh the risks too, you know.
But to me, keeping a promise and building trust means a hell of a lot more than squeezing out some petty profit.
Trust takes a lifetime to build, but only a second to shatter. That's what makes it so precious, isn't it?
You love your grand speeches, don't you? Save it for some naive kid who might actually buy it.
You seemed to be enjoying it. Anyway—Firenze and I both turned your employer down.
My companions don't break promises. And I believe you won't, either.
... Huh? What are you talking about? Have you lost your mind?
Didn't we have a deal? You promised to keep me safe until the banquet ended. You're still honoring that promise.
I made that up on the spot. And you actually bought it.
True.==W== You approached me with an ulterior motive, spewing nothing but lies.
But so far, all you've done is tie me up. You haven't hurt me or my companions.
You didn't just take out the mercs tailing us... You knocked out an entire squad of Desert Scorpions last night, all to keep me safe.
That doesn't just make you a competent bodyguard. It practically makes you my guardian angel.
Then, following your twisted logic—why exactly did I tie you up?
Well... Let's just say it's a personal hobby of mine.==W== Thanks for indulging me, Otoha.
...==W== I've said enough. It's my turn to ask a question, and I only have one.
I don't care about them. Firenze will dig that up soon enough.
What I care about is...==W== Otoha, what did you do to Nanoha?
I didn't see her at Goodwind Homecare.
The whole place was empty except for you. What did you do?
Nanoha...?!==W== Are you and Nano—==W==no, are you and that maid that close?
As far as I know, you've only met her once. Why are you so worried about some maid?
We've only met once, but we helped each other out. If you attacked Goodwind Homecare because I was going to see her, then I'm responsible.
Hilarious. Your own life is on the line, and you're worried about a stranger you've met once.
Are you some legendary "saint" of the Grace Imperium? Didn't think I'd see a walking myth today.
This is between your employer and me. It has nothing to do with Goodwind Homecare.
If innocent people get dragged into this and put in danger, I won't forgive you.
What if...==W== What if that maid is in on it with me?
Isn't she? What do you even know about her?==W== Every Goodwind maid is raised in a world of endless scheming and crushing expectations. No exceptions.
Trusting her blindly after one meeting... How naive.
I might not be good at much, but I do know how to read people. I trust her.
Besides. Even though you tied me up, I'm getting the same vibe from you. Strange, isn't it?
Yeah. That's why I tested you with my question.
And your reaction gave you away. You're a good person.
You keep threatening my life, but you haven't yet pointed that gun at me once.
You even sent that cute drawing days in advance. Disguised as a threat, but meant as a warning.
Why wouldn't I trust someone like that?
Still talking about trust... You are unbelievable.
I came here to figure you out, but you completely flipped the script. How unexpected.
I already know your true nature. But tell me... Have you figured me out?
... Hey. Got any money on you?
Then ... a thousand Dorra? That's all I have.
Otoha reaches into my pocket and fishes out the Dorra.
A blinding flash severs my bindings. The light flows into her hand, forming a kunai.
I'll take these Dorra as my commission fee.
As of this moment, you're my employer.
Found us already? These Scorpions move fast.
Why are you helping me? What about your former employer?
I never even signed his follow-up contract.
He started bossing me around without even checking if I had signed. A self-centered idiot like that doesn't deserve to be my employer.
I'd much rather work for the adorable idiot who worries about everyone else instead.
Haha... I'm gonna take that as a compliment?
Keep your head down and stay close, Boss. We're breaking through!
Keep your eyes open. I'll show you what a professional "assassin" can do.

strings.text: Desert Scorpion leader Hazana reveals Otoha's past—she is a traitor to Goodwind Homecare and is likely to betray you, too. On the rooftop of the hotel, Otoha and Hazana engage in a final showdown.
Heh...==W== The famed Desert Scorpions. I expected more of a fight.
All the way from the desert, only to leave empty-handed. I almost pity you.
The Captain's almost here! Keep them pinned down!
Hazana.==W== No match for me, but a headache nonetheless.
Anyway...==W== The banquet's about to start. We're done wasting time here.
Hmm? A text?==W== No time to read it now.
Think you can run? Dream on!
What do we do...==W== The banquet is starting any minute now and the Boss still isn't answering!
Then we need to go look for ==SEX4==—
You there. You're with Boss Accord...==W== Right?
Ah! Y-Yes,==W== we are! Who's asking?!
You've been panicking for a while now. Let me guess...==W== Your CEO went missing?
Easy now. I'm innocent. I'm simply reading the room.
With Firenze gone, only the Boss can host tonight. Look at the time—if ==SEX== still hasn't shown up, people are going to notice.
Put away your glare. I'm not the enemy.==W== This banquet has United Harvest's name attached to it.==W== If you ruin it, you ruin headquarters' reputation too.
Whatever is going on, the banquet must proceed as planned.==W== Otherwise, all your hard work goes up in smoke.
Don't let the guests suspect a thing.
You can't go around accusing strangers of foul play.==W== Not everyone poking around for intel will be as friendly as I am.
Your panic is written all over your face.==W== At parties like this, you need a thick skin. Fake it if you have to, but keep your cool.
Bottom line: we keep the Boss's absence a total secret, right?
Exactly. Don't let anyone suspect a thing. How you pull it off is up to you.
I'll run interference on my end. Let's see what you can do.==W== Catch you later.
Amber, Noya. We'll handle the guests once the doors open.
We sell them a story:==W== they aren't important enough for a personal audience with the Boss. The CEO of Boss Accord only deals with higher-ups.
But we need some impressive titles to back that up...==W== Or they'll walk all over us.
Amber, you're Boss Accord's Chief Operating Officer.
Noya, you'll be the Chief Technology Officer.
Which makes me ...==W== the Chief Financial Officer. That settles it.
Boss speaks at 20:30, and we keep the guests in the dark until then. We make this work,==W== no matter what it takes!!
Distinguished guests, the banquet will begin shortly. Please find your designated seats...
It's finally starting. Let me run one last check on the photo capturer to be safe—
Huh? Was that a shake?==W== Or is it just my imagination...
That was close...==W== Thanks, Otoha. I knew you were an amazing bodyguard.
You flatter me. This is nothing. My job isn't done until you're safe at the banquet.
Hey, Otoha. What are you playing at?
Exactly what it looks like. Having trouble processing the situation with your little brain?
Ha. You haven't changed a bit. Still the same annoying fox.
I'll take that as a compliment, thanks.==W== I assume you've already reported to the client?
That rich kid lost his mind when he heard you switched sides. It was hilarious.
So, a little update to my contract. My new gig is to—
Wipe you all out! No survivors!
I see. Fine by me.==W== If you think you can pull it off, be my guest<size=60>♪</size>
Haha! Don't mind if I do.==W== Get 'em!
Hazana, if you don't step up, these amateurs aren't worth my time—
Heh, Captain knew you'd take this route! No way you're going downstairs.
... Stairs are blocked.==W== That's a problem.
Hah! No more interruptions. Come on, let's enjoy this fight to the death!
Boss, things are about to get messy. Trust me and stay behind me.
If down is blocked, we go up!
Otoha grabs my hand and sprints. Even in mortal danger, a faint smile is painted on her lips.
Huff... Huff...==W== I can't ... run anymore...
Are we? Hazana's right behind us...
Hehe, looks like they triggered my little surprise.
Being prepared is basic protocol on a mission.
That explosion... Was that your trap?
Spot on.==W== I'm a professional—I set it up in advance.
Smiling...==W== Oh my, I let it show. Looks like I lost my composure back there. How rude of me.
But you really can't blame me for laughing when they basically walked right into it...
Hah! Fun. This is fun.==W== You sure know how to throw a party, Boss!
Guess you won't go down easy.

She bit the hand that fed her and ran straight to her enemies.==W== Now she's playing turncoat again, supporting you instead.==W== You get what I'm saying? Give it time, and she'll stab you in the back too.
Plus, she flips sides so often that she leaves behind a trail of enemies. Keep her around, and you're begging for a disaster.
Hand her over, and we let you walk. Deal?
Thanks for the offer. But ...==W== I'm choosing to trust Otoha.
...==W== Huh? Trust? Are...==W== Are you out of your mind?
Heh. I suppose a simple-minded scorpion wouldn't understand...==W== But that's simply who Boss is.
And that is why I find ==SEX4== fascinating.
If we're clear, do be a dear and make your exit.
Hah. Keep dreaming.==W== If we let a sly fox like you slip away, the fallout will ruin us. Do us all a favor and die right here.
Hehe...==W== Let me return the sentiment.
It breaks my heart to ruin such a gorgeous venue, but fighting Hazana of the Desert Scorpions demands my full attention.
I suppose it's time to get serious.

strings.text: Otoha defeats Hazana. To make the banquet speech in time, she leaps with you from the rooftop. As you part ways, you catch the faint, lingering scent of blood on her.
A smoke bomb? How dreadfully unromantic.
Don't worry. It's only a scratch.
You sure? Tell me you're not just toughing it out.
Hehe. I wouldn't mind playing the damsel, if it meant falling into your arms...
But let's save that for after our next battle.
Let's hope there's no next time...
Anyway... Thanks for having my back.
If your old "employer" comes after you, let me know. I'll do whatever I can to help.
That's hardly your responsibility. You worry too much, Boss.
At this point, one more enemy on my list makes no difference to me.
More importantly, isn't it time for your speech?
Right...==W== But the stairwell is completely blocked.
I'll call Iris. She can find an excuse to stall the event...
Heh. An explosion like that already had the guests spooked. Delay the speech now, and they'll run for the exits.
But the stairs collapsed, and the elevator's shot. Making it to the banquet hall in ten minutes is impossible...
Wait... You have a plan, don't you?
Of course I do. It all depends on whether the Boss trusts me enough...
I had a feeling you'd say that.
If I get you to the banquet hall safely and on time, I want you to grant me one wish.
Heh. I'll tell you once you're there in one piece.
...==W== Deal. So, how are we doing this?
You might not know this, Boss.==W== I used to work for <color=#3faeae>Goodwind Homecare</color>.
Beautiful flowers have thorns, and Goodwind's maids are no exception.
On the outside, we're just dutiful servants pouring tea all day.
But beneath these sleeves, I hide the sharpest kunai.
It's been a long time since I've shown my true colors under the moonlight.
Surprised to see me like this?
For us, nowhere in this world is out of reach.
If a path is blocked, we simply carve a new one.
The fastest way back to the hall ...==W== is a straight drop from this roof.
Rooftops, cliffs...==W== Even the peak of the Monolith itself.
I can get you down without a scratch.
Otoha produces a grappling hook from seemingly nowhere,==RT==expertly securing it to a rooftop lamppost.
This is madness...==W== Fine. Let's do it.
I-I've got you! Will this really work?
Her tail just wrapped around me. It's warm ...==W== and soft...==W== So fluffy…!==W==
Not a bad view from up here, is it?
I've never seen anything like it.==W== The wind is brutal, but ...==W== it's beautiful.
Take a good look. This is the city you're working so hard to protect.
See those distant lights? Maybe one of them is shining again because of you.
I still don't get why you'd risk your neck for total strangers.
But if this is your path...==W== I'll help you walk it.
Naturally, my services aren't for free.
Take just now, for instance.==W== You were definitely petting my tail.
I'll be adding the "hush money" for that straight to your tab.

The second you turned your back.
