I'm thinking out loud here, but—
As the world wakes up to your existence, "nuisances" like today will keep occurring. Eventually, someone will try to eliminate you using much more brutal, direct methods...
You got lucky today. But what about next time? Or the time after that?
And remember, you might not be the only one in their crosshairs.
Your companions could get hurt protecting you.
Your choices from now on will carry the weight of many lives.
And...==W== Let's keep what happened just between us.
Thank you. Now...==W== I hope your banquet goes well.

That strange smell...==W== It's blood, masked by flowers.

strings.text: Your flawless speech secures people's faith in Philae's rebirth. Firenze and Nyx unmask the mastermind, and the banquet concludes without a hitch, until Otoha's sudden collapse.
Two minutes to go until the speech...
Boss just texted. They're at the lobby doors.
Places, everyone! Time for the speech!
Lights are dimming!==W== It's starting, right?
Perfect.==W== I'm getting the shot this time!
Phew. After all that chaos today...==W== I actually don't feel nervous anymore.
For everyone. And for the future of Philae.
Ladies and gentlemen, pardon the interruption.==W== Please welcome our guest of honor tonight, the CEO of Boss Accord—
Good evening, everyone. I'm ==PLAYER_NAME==. Thank you for having me.
I know what you're all thinking. After surviving the Intelligent Plant crisis...
... The fact that we can sit here tonight, breaking bread from this year's harvest, is a miracle in itself.
So poised...==W== That's our Boss alright...
"Boss Accord"? Is that company famous?==W== I've never heard of them.
Please, read the news for once.==W== When Philae had that massive crisis recently, they were the ones who fixed it with Firenze.
Not to mention, they teamed up with Petal Bloom to capture the Big Three, and took down a massive Stellaroid on the Emor Waterway.
Huh?==W== They sound like==W== some ancient hero taking on epic trials to prove themselves.
When it comes down to it, do you know why Lady Albedo sent us here?
It's because Boss is a rising star right now. Every company is keeping a close eye on ==SEX4==<size=60>♪</size>
Interesting...==W== Hmm, though I care more about the fries here. Fried to perfection.
I trust you've all seen the Philae branch's report on the Darcia incident.
Our CFO oversaw its drafting.==W== As firsthand witnesses, Boss Accord guarantees its accuracy.
If the report is true...==W== Then Firenze and the Boss saved Philae together.==W== And Firenze was the one who defeated Darcia.
Based on the intel from the manager at Fenghuang Diner, the report checks out.
But they deliberately left out how Darcia controlled the Intelligent Plants, only writing it off as some "incredible magic."
I suspect this seemingly fragile Boss played a role just as crucial as Firenze.
Philae is at peace again. But we shouldn't forget what happened when the ship was rocking, how everyone else was scrambling for the lifeboats—
Who was it that shunned the safety of the deck and dove into the hold to plug the leak?
And who spotted this danger years ago, going undercover with her companions right under Darcia's nose?
... Hard to argue with that.==W== Firenze and the Boss acted with undeniable elegance.
As key figures across major companies, I'm sure you've all been monitoring Philae closely.
If so, you already know that Philae's grain is still flowing smoothly to your hometowns.
The bread here is definitely made from new wheat.==W== After everything, the Philae branch hasn't missed a beat...
Meikyo, what's the situation on the market?
I checked today: every bakery in Philae is using new wheat.
Meaning...==W== Getting everything back on track this fast proves Firenze is the real deal.==W== How amusing.
Philae doesn't belong to any one faction—it belongs to its people. Together, we begin a new chapter here:
A story of feasts, not famine. Hope, not fear. Light, not darkness.
And finally: the best investment is always the mad person who keeps their head when everything falls apart.
Thank you all for your time and support!
Dead silence...==W== Did my words==W== actually reach them?
Well, Firenze, I did my best.==W== Otoha... I hope I made your efforts count.
So much for the Senate's little scheme.==W== Every rep in this room now knows Firenze is the best choice to run the Philae branch.
But isn't appointing a branch executive an internal matter for United Harvest?==W== Why do the other companies...
Firenze has powerful allies at headquarters—Grand Inspector <color=#3faeae>Matilda</color>, for one.==W== Plus, whoever runs a vital hub like Philae needs the market's blessing.
The Senate actually abused the Seal of Grace to force Firenze out.==W== A remarkably inelegant maneuver.
And yet, they couldn't even derail this banquet...==W== Truly pathetic.
Cosson, aren't you from New Orelian? Doesn't that automatically put you in the Senate's pocket?
Heavens, no. My loyalty lies solely with elegance.==W== Besides, didn't a certain someone advise Boss Accord long before I did?
Meikyo, file the report. Tell headquarters Firenze is worth backing.
... Huh?==W== Wait, is everyone backing Firenze now?==W== If I'm the only one saying no, things are gonna get super awkward!
What are you talking about?!==W== Laru, you represent Grace Imperium!==W== You can't just follow the crowd, you have to actually think before—
I did! The fries here are amazing.==W== What more reason do I need?
A spectacular speech!==W== It seems Philae is in safe hands. The bread on your tables isn't going anywhere, and it certainly won't lose its flavor.
That's all for tonight's broadcast. Wherever you're tuning in from, have a wonderful evening.
Haff... Huff...==W== Not good...==W== Hazana's poison needles got me during the fight...
Luckily I managed to hide it from Boss...==W== But the bleeding just won't stop.
I need to let her go before things get out of hand...
That heavy breathing ... and the smell of blood.==W== Are you hurt?
Quiet. Go to sleep. By the time you wake up, your world will be back to normal.
Sleeping magic again...?==W== Wait! You lock me up just to let me go? Are you mocking me?!==W== What are you playing at!
Heh... Patience. You'll find out soon enough.
The banquet concludes without a hitch. Otoha's clash with Desert Scorpions goes completely unnoticed—or the corporate reps simply choose to look the other way.
It's finally over...==W== What a long day.
I wonder how Firenze's holding up. I hope she's safe...
My, my, Boss. Hehehe.==W== What a lovely coincidence. I was just about to call you.
All taken care of. Nyx and I rounded up their assassins and handed them straight over to Grand Inspector Matilda.
Firenze, Nyx? What are you doing in Port Goldfinch?
Shouldn't you be in Philae? Tonight's banquet is supposed to restore faith in the United Harvest branch.
And who told you I'm inspecting the port?
The handwriting is mine. That's my personal seal at the bottom...==W== But I never wrote this.
... I knew it.==W== Pulling us away right before the banquet makes no sense.
Someone forged my signature and seal.
But if you're both here... Who's watching the banquet?
The CEO of Boss Accord has it covered.==W== A rival faction is trying to stage an assassination, but everyone is safe.
Forging orders and attempting murder for a branch executive seat...==W== Has United Harvest sunk this low?
Regardless, I know who's behind this.
Gibel Corregio—==W==his family's rising star. The Senate is backing him to take over the Philae branch.
The Corregios control a massive faction here, and one of their branch families runs a company==W== that holds the "Soldier" Seal of Grace.
They use the Soldier's replication ability to fake this letter.==W== That adds corporate collusion to his list of crimes.
Come on, you two. We're heading to Philae.
Philae? What about your inspection here?==W== Giving us Gibel's name is more than enough...
No, I need to handle this personally.==W== A man like Gibel Corregio directs his assassins himself.
Besides, I need to thank the Boss who's saving United Harvest alongside you.
Understood. We leave for Philae tonight.
You won the Grand Inspector over. Nicely done.
Heh, you should've seen Firenze before we knocked, Boss. She looked like she'd seen a ghost, turned paler than a withered Intelligent Plant.
We didn't know if the Grand Inspector was friend or foe until we met face-to-face.==W== I was simply being cautious.
If she'd been the mastermind, Nyx's gun and my sword would have been the only justice left.
Whoa, speak for yourself!==W== I never signed up for treason.
Oh? Well,==W== if forced to choose between the Grand Inspector and our Boss... My choice is already made.
Firenze and Nyx are still a few days out. And it looks like this Gibel guy is the one who hired Otoha and the Desert Scorpions...
Resorting to assassination over internal company politics... What was he thinking?
I wonder how Otoha is holding up... I hope she's alright.
I had a lovely time tonight. Until our paths cross again.
When did she get my contact? I didn't even notice.
Oh, right. Don't kick your blankets off in your sleep.
Wait, how does she know what I look like when I'm sleeping?!
Whatever...==W== If she's texting me, she must be safe.
Alright. Hotel perimeter is clear. The Desert Scorpion stragglers are gone.
My, my...==W== I came here on a hunt, but ended up as the prey.
Phew...==W== I think it's time for me to ... get some rest...

strings.text: Having heard about the attack at the banquet, Nanoha pays you a visit. As you share dessert, a familiar figure drifts past the window amid falling petals...
... If what you say is true, this story has too many plot holes.
Let me get this straight. Someone broke in, locked you up,==RT==and let you go? Unharmed?
Yes. After locking me up, they disguised themselves as me and cleared the estate under the guise of an emergency.
Disguised as you... A master of illusion?==RT==Even so, for no one to notice... Pathetic.
The recall order is out. Everyone should be back soon.
Still... Shuo. Did this person go through all that trouble==RT==just to do nothing?
About that...==W== Sorry... I was unconscious for a time, so I don't know the specifics.
I swept the estate meticulously when I came to. The confidential files are secure, and nothing else is missing or damaged.
Recall the details and have a full report on my desk.
... And this is classified. Not a word to anyone. Clear?
No hard proof, but... Someone with that skill who hates the higher-ups...==W== Only one person fits the bill.
If it were her, what was the purpose? She had no reason to spare my life.
Yet...==W== Like waking from a nightmare, I woke up in my own bed.
Why did she do it this way? To save face for me? Spare me the humiliation?
Or...==W== Was she going easy on me for old times' sake?
No. Impossible. The only person in this entire organization she ever cared about ... is her student.
...==W== Regardless, she betrayed us. Next time we meet, I'm bringing her in myself.
Huh? Miss Shuo...==W== What're you doing out here all alone?
Philae Squad One reporting. We got word the mission was scrubbed, so we're back early.
Is that right? Good work. I'll be going now.
And there she goes...==W== She always gives you the cold shoulder, Master. I wonder why.
You're reading too much into it. That is how she was when we were kids training under my Master.==W== Hasn't changed a bit.
Besides... She misses those days as much as I do. She used to hang around this courtyard a lot...==W== She isn't a bad person; please don't get the wrong idea.

That's why I came. I heard about the attack at the banquet...==W== I'm glad you're safe.
Oh, that...==W== Wait, how do you know about that?
Goodwind Homecare has its own intelligence network.

Don't worry about it. You've been busy yourself, right?
Right. The head manager issued an emergency dispatch that morning. Every maid was sent out of Philae.

Resume...==W== Was Otoha sending those out?
If she hadn't changed her mind and actually gone through with the assassination...
Goodwind Homecare would have taken the fall. Nanoha would have nowhere to go...==W== Has that been her plan all along?

No, it wasn't a mistake. This was the way out Otoha had prepared for her all along...
Though I still don't know==W== why Otoha cares for Nanoha so deeply...
Thank you for waiting.==W== Here is your cake. Enjoy.
This cake...==W== I used to love this cake.
Used to? Do you not like it anymore?
Not exactly...==W== It's just...==W== The person who used to share it with me is gone.
Since then, even eating it alone felt empty...==W== And before long, I stopped ordering it altogether.

Hm? What was that...==W== Did someone walk past the window?
Strange...==W== There's no one out there. Was it my imagination?
Oh, nothing. Someone crossed my mind.
Someone crossed your mind...==W== Thank you for the treat. This cake reminds me of someone too.==W== Someone I'm not sure will ever return.
I mean the person I'm thinking of will return.==W== So maybe the person on your mind will, too.
Maybe at a street corner years from now.==RT==Or maybe tomorrow.

strings.text: Nyx and Firenze were close school friends. However, Nyx later became an inspector and brought down Firenze's father in a leak case. Firenze joined Darcia to exact her "revenge" on her past friend three years later.
Grind three Forest Elf Fangs to dust, snip two Jade Feathers into pieces…
Then drop them into four ounces of Nightreef Seawater, and give it a good shake...
Whoa! Dad, it turned purple, just like you said it would!
But how? I didn't use anything purple. Did you sneak some magic in there to change the color?
I didn't touch a thing, I promise. It's the magic inside the ingredients. They reacted to create that beautiful hue.
You have a gift for sensing magic, Firenze. Have a little faith. You brewed this potion all by yourself.
Does that mean I can come to the R&D and be your assistant now?
Haha, maybe when you're older. For now, just focus on your studies.
Ugh, studies... By the time I graduate, the Mandrake Radiant Grass will probably be running experiments for you already! You won't even need me.
Don't worry, there's still a long way to go for that project. Even after you finish Philaen Academy and Grace Light Academy, there'll be plenty of work left for you.
I didn't realize even someone as amazing as you had to struggle so much with it... Dad, have you ever thought about quitting?
Hmm... It does get tough sometimes. But I believe this research will bring convenience and happiness to people.
The company and my colleagues have my back, and I have you by my side, don't I?
But enough about me. How's school been lately?
Every day is packed! I made a new friend, Nyx. She's actually really smart. I mean, not as smart as me, of course.
Oh... Firenze. Do you remember what I taught you about friendship?
<color=black>Never build a friendship on gain, and never, ever betray a friend.</color>
Giotto de Feltro. You stand accused of company treason—leaking confidential data to a witch from Scarlet Sights Media. Do you contest these charges?
He confessed? No way. Why would the Director of R&D sell out to a witch?
Like he had a choice. Officer Nyx is HQ's finest. You saw the evidence—caught him red-handed. Probably wanted the Dorra.
But he's a Director. Would he really turn traitor for a quick payout?
Hey, money is money. De Feltro got sloppy, though. Nyx has only been in Philae for two months, and look at all that has been exposed.
Word is, she's been planning this since the academy. She's best friends with the de Feltro girl. Probably used her to get close to the Director.
It's the daughter's birthday today, too. Putting her father on trial now? Those officers are ruthless.
Shh, keep it down! The girl right in front of us... Isn't that her?
Pfft, who cares? Her father isn't a Director anymore. He's just a convict.
Father gave everything to United Harvest. I don't believe he'd do this! And even he did... He must have had a reason.
Nyx... Why are you the plaintiff? Is the gossip true? Did you befriend me just to get to my father? Was I nothing but a lead to you?
Why? It doesn't make sense... I don't understand...
Your Honor. Director Giotto de Feltro is guilty of embezzlement==RT==and the violation of trade secrets.
On behalf of the Compliance Department, I formally submit these charges. We request an immediate ruling.
Defendant Giotto de Feltro. Do you have anything further to add?
No, Your Honor. I betrayed the company. My crimes are unforgivable.
Regarding the leak at the Philae R&D Department: the facts are clear, and the evidence is conclusive. I will now pass sentence.
The court finds you guilty of deliberately stalling the Mandrake Radiant Grass project to misappropriate significant funds and materials. This constitutes the crime of embezzlement...
Furthermore, your unauthorized disclosure of classified data to a Scarlet Sights witch caused the company catastrophic losses. This malicious act constitutes a grave infringement of trade secrets.
For these combined offenses, Giotto de Feltro is sentenced to life imprisonment without possibility of parole or commutation.
L-Life imprisonment? No... How did it come to this...?
In the gallery, a dazed Firenze looks up, locking eyes with her father in the dock.
The spirited man she remembers looks utterly broken. He shakes his head subtly at Firenze before looking away as company guards march him out.
Firenze turns to the plaintiff's stand—empty. Her former best friend, the Inspector, is long gone. Throughout the trial, Nyx's gaze swept the room, yet never once did it land on Firenze.
Why? Why today of all days? I thought we were best friends...
A gentle voice speaks from behind her.
Firenze de Feltro. Don't you see? To Nyx, a "friend" is just an asset to be sold for profit. Actually, what you two had can hardly be called "friendship" at all.
Do you desire the power to overturn this verdict? To clear your father's name?
I am Darcia, Executor of the United Harvest Philae Branch. Stay by my side, and I will grant you the power to crush Nyx.
What? You're shutting down the Compliance Department of the Philae branch?
No, it's called a merger. Effective today, all local staff and duties of the Compliance Department fall under the Director of Operations. In other words, me.
That makes you my direct report now, Inspector Nyx. You answer to me, not the HQ.
Compliance inspectors answer only to HQ. You don't have the authority!
People change. Rules evolve. This Senate resolution arrived yesterday. Read it.
Resolution on Compliance Department Restructuring... This is impossible.
In the end, you brought this on yourself.
Your blunder during Director Joseph's investigation—accusing an innocent senior tech—made the Senate question the competence of your entire department.
In that case, three of the four witnesses changed their stories in court.==RT==The last one even suddenly claimed "amnesia."
They were obviously bought off! How could you just turn a blind eye?
You claim they were bought. Do you have a single shred of proof?
To the Senate, and to me, it looks more like you coerced them. You forced the testimony you needed to secure a conviction.
Just like you did at my father's trial.
I see now... You set me up, Firenze!
All four witnesses were Production staff—your subordinates. This was all a trap you laid just to get revenge, wasn't it?
Fine... Even on my own, I will find the proof. The Senate's resolution didn't revoke an inspector's right to independent investigation.
Suit yourself. But as of today, you belong to Marketing. Those "inspector privileges" won't carry much weight down there...
Knowing you, though... I'm sure you'll claw your way back. Oh, and if the workload proves too much? Resigning is always an option.
Heh... You've somehow become even more twisted than I remember.
I saved this side of myself just for today. It is your birthday, after all. I've waited a long time to give you the ... celebration you deserve.
Three years ago, on your birthday, she took your father to court.
Today, you return the favor on hers—demotion and a pay cut.==RT==Tell me, Firenze, is this enough revenge for you?
Of course not, Lady Darcia.==W== This is merely the opening move.
Nyx retains her title. Attacking an inspector openly would draw eyes from HQ,==W== and I wouldn't dare interfere with your plans, My Lady.
You haven't let vengeance cloud your judgment. Good.
Patience is everything. I used false witnesses to force an error, cutting her off from HQ support.
Let her rot in Marketing for now. Once her pride is shattered and she's truly cornered...
Then I'll discard her for good.
When that time comes, she'll be on her knees, weeping, begging me for mercy.
And to think she was once your closest friend.
She was... But she was also the one who betrayed that bond first.
You're right, Lady Darcia.==W== Friends are just assets to be sold. Only power, and you, are worth serving.
Heh... Well said, Firenze. I knew you wouldn't disappoint me.
One day, I'll offer my true loyalty to the master. And you'll destroy United Harvest to save your father.
The master ...==W== Lady Darcia, just who is this master of yours?
In four years of service, Firenze has never seen Darcia kneel so humbly before anyone. Until now.
But you are Your Majesty. The one true Tyrant. I, Darcia, swear my eternal loyalty to you.
The United Harvest Philae Branch is merely the barracks I built for you. And please consider it your temporary capital.
Cast aside that false name forced upon you. Remember your glory. Lead us, your pitiful subjects, and breathe new life into this devastated world.
Body and soul... All that I am is yours.
The young ==SEX9== being called "Tyrant" looks up, confused.
==PLAYER_NAME==, will you accept this loyalty? Will you take this power, and become the true Tyrant?

strings.text: Darcia explains that the Tyrant's history was falsified, admitting she orchestrated the Three Grand Commissions to secure the Bishop piece. Everything, she claims, was done to build the Tyrant Army for you.

==A-1====RT====RT====RT==　When the noble host was overthrown, the thralls would make their liberator known. As heroes grand, yet the outlander with grace declined, and to the Wilds left their fame behind. Thus Nova's bonds were broken, chains undone, the prosperous Monoliths now shared by everyone.==RT====RT==—Chronicles of Ancient Nova, by Anonymous
Cast aside that false name forced upon you. Remember your glory. Lead us, your pitiful subjects, and breathe new life into this devastated world.
Body and soul... All that I am is yours.
False name... Is she talking about the title "Boss"? And what is this about offering me her body and soul?
No, back up. The Executive Director of United Harvest's Philae Branch is on her knees in front of me. That alone is insane. Am I dreaming?
Firenze stands behind Darcia, remaining on her feet. She meets my gaze, eyes sharp and calculating. She's sizing me up.
Before me, Darcia remains submissively on her knees, waiting for my response.
Vita, you there? What is going on?
Tyrant. I lack sufficient permission to perform a valid analysis.
However, historical records indicate that those willing to follow you—to sacrifice themselves for your sake—were once as numerous as the stars.
I recommend accepting Darcia's allegiance. You should also secure her loyalty via a soul pact to prevent betrayal.
Got it. Go back into hibernation.
The "Tyrant Growth System" again... All Vita wants is for me to harvest souls, so I won't be getting any helpful intel from it. Looks like I'm on my own for this one.
Uh, Darcia? You've got the wrong person. I'm just the Boss of the Boss Accord.
You mean the "Tyrant," right? The legendary Tyrant who supposedly tried to destroy the Monoliths?
I make no mistakes, Your Majesty. The Boss Accord, or should I say, Tyrant Accord, is the company of the legendary Tyrant. "Boss" is merely a vulgar label imposed by history.
Guess there's no changing your mind, then.==W== Also, could you stand up? I'm really not used to people talking to me from the floor.
However, your phrasing, "changing my mind," is inaccurate. The truth of your story has been smeared and distorted a thousand times over by corrupt Novians.
Tell me, Your Majesty, what version of the legend have you heard?
I heard that ... ages ago, a Tyrant sought to conquer and destroy every Monolith.
But doing so would've stripped the Novians of their Artifacts; the world would've met its end.
Lies, Your Majesty. My research into the archives reveals that narrative only started surfacing a century ago, completely contradicting the ancient texts.
Forgive my presumption.==W== The true you was benevolent. You never wished to destroy the Monoliths, nor did you intend to deprive the Novians of their Artifacts.
You simply sought to conquer the Monoliths to manage them personally—to produce Artifacts more efficiently and bring true prosperity to Nova.
Tragically, the greedy Novians couldn't comprehend your vision. They betrayed you, and the glorious name of the Tyrant fell, twisted into the title of Boss.
The word "Boss" was originally used to describe powerful==RT==Stellaroids within the Monoliths.
By equating you with those monsters, they intended for==RT==future generations to see—
—that the Tyrant as nothing more than an oversized Stellaroid.==RT==A clever way to erase the true legend.
Hmm... Well, your version of the story is certainly creative. I'll give you that.
But even if that's the absolute truth, what makes you so sure I'm that Tyrant?
I'm just an amnesiac Trekker found in the desert and saved by the New Star Guild. I only managed to reactivate a company because of the Seal of Grace on my phone.
No matter how you look at it, my life story doesn't exactly scream "legendary Tyrant," does it?
Your Majesty. That charm on your phone. It's the "King" Seal of Grace, isn't it?
Yeah. But doesn't every company have one?
If I may be blunt...==W== Initially, I refused to believe you were the Tyrant, too.

So "the master" behind Lady Gray and Joseph was you all along.

Outside the window, below the United Harvest, ranks of Intelligent Plants==RT==march in perfect military formation from the greenhouse district.

The First Legion of the Gen-2 Intelligent Plants salutes you, Your Majesty.

Correct. I am indeed the legendary Tyrant.

I... I am terribly sorry, Your Majesty! I overstepped.==W== It was arrogant to offer my loyalty without considering your will. Please, punish me!

Yes! Yes, of course!==W== Firenze, quickly, ==SEX2== Majesty next door!

As heroes grand, yet the outlander with grace declined, and to the Wilds left their fame behind. Thus Nova's bonds were broken, chains undone, the prosperous Monoliths now shared by everyone.==RT====RT==—Chronicles of Ancient Nova, by Anonymous

Body and soul... All that I am is yours.

Firenze stands behind Darcia, remaining on her feet. She meets my gaze, eyes sharp and calculating. She's sizing me up.
Before me, Darcia remains submissively on her knees, waiting for my response.
Vita, you there? What is going on?
Tyrant. I lack sufficient permission to perform a valid analysis.
However, historical records indicate that those willing to follow you—to sacrifice themselves for your sake—were once as numerous as the stars.
I recommend accepting Darcia's allegiance. You should also secure her loyalty via a soul pact to prevent betrayal.
Got it. Go back into hibernation.
The "Tyrant Growth System" again... All Vita wants is for me to harvest souls, so I won't be getting any helpful intel from it. Looks like I'm on my own for this one.

You mean the "Tyrant," right? The legendary Tyrant who supposedly tried to destroy the Monoliths?

Guess there's no changing your mind, then.==W== Also, could you stand up? I'm really not used to people talking to me from the floor.
However, your phrasing, "changing my mind," is inaccurate. The truth of your story has been smeared and distorted a thousand times over by corrupt Novians.
Tell me, Your Majesty, what version of the legend have you heard?
I heard that ... ages ago, a Tyrant sought to conquer and destroy every Monolith.
But doing so would've stripped the Novians of their Artifacts; the world would've met its end.
Lies, Your Majesty. My research into the archives reveals that narrative only started surfacing a century ago, completely contradicting the ancient texts.
Forgive my presumption.==W== The true you was benevolent. You never wished to destroy the Monoliths, nor did you intend to deprive the Novians of their Artifacts.
You simply sought to conquer the Monoliths to manage them personally—to produce Artifacts more efficiently and bring true prosperity to Nova.

I'm just an amnesiac Trekker found in the desert and saved by the New Star Guild. I only managed to reactivate a company because of the Seal of Grace on my phone.

strings.text: You feign cooperation with Darcia to extract more information, but find yourself under house arrest. Meanwhile, the anonymous source who once fed you intel has cut all contact...
After Darcia pledged her loyalty, she summoned my companions to her office and explained how I had come to be elevated as the Tyrant.
Lady Darcia, what are you talking about? B-Boss is your master?
No. Do not insult ==SEX2== Majesty with that shallow, false name. ==SEX2== true honorific is Tyrant.
The Boss from Boss Accord ... is the legendary Tyrant? Uh... I'm kind of lost here...
That's just Darcia's side of the story.
How did you get Darcia so obsessed with you? She's acting like she'd do anything you ask her to.
Don't phrase it like that! She just ... stubbornly believes I'm the Tyrant she worships.
Got it. If a starving stray cat thinks you have food, it follows you around and waits to be fed.
That's not it at all! She's the Executive Director of United Harvest's Philae Branch—what could she possibly lack?
Anyway, let me keep her calm for now to see if I can get any information about the orphanage out of her, then we'll find a chance to escape.
Routes out of United Harvest and Philae City are already scouted.
Having you around really helps, Amber.
As the Executive Director of the Philae Branch, do you have any idea what you're saying?
Heh. Nyx... You truly don't understand.

Everyone in United Harvest—me as Executive, Firenze as Director of Operations, you as an officer sent by HQ... Even the clerks in shops and the workers in the fields. Aren't we all servants of the Senate?
If that's the case... Abandoning that vermin of a senate and pledging myself to the Tyrant instead, isn't that only natural?
To report this to HQ. Why? Are you going to stop me?
Your Majesty, you don't have to worry. Nyx can't escape the company.==W== The Gen-2 Intelligent Plants have every corner of the company covered.
Can't escape huh? So she has thought of everything. Looks like agreeing to her terms first was the right call. I shall play along.
That's not what I meant. When you mentioned abandoning that vermin of a senate...
Yes, I meant that... It's simply a natural progression.
Even comparing Your Majesty with those creatures was itself an act of major disrespect.
Are you planning to split the Philae Branch from United Harvest? Since you've already secured a Seal of Grace.
I never considered that. Hmm... Perhaps you should decide the Philae Branch's future now, Your Majesty?
Still... Maybe I can turn this into something good.
Then we shall raise wages. More leaves for everyone too.
If the Gen-2 Intelligent Plants can replace heavy labor on farms and production lines, let them. But no layoffs.
This company was built on collective effort. Don't reduce it to cost and profit alone.
Understood. Your Majesty's plan is truly brilliant. Now everyone at the Philae Branch will be grateful to you, ==SEX12== Tyrant.
Darcia is extremely respectful to me… Her loyalty … doesn't seem fake too.
What about Joseph and Lady Gray? They're currently detained in the interrogation room in the Ash District for offending you.==W== I recommend execution for this unforgivable act, Your Majesty.
Keep them locked up. There's no need to rush.
Executing them now would complicate the Intelligent Plant project, wouldn't it? Think about the mercenaries...
You're right. But offending Your Majesty is a capital crime.
And their knowledge and experience have long been yours anyway.
Is that a metaphor ... or does she mean it in a literal sense?
Hmm... We'll come back to that. Now that the United Harvest matter is settled, I should ask about the orphanage.
One more thing—what exactly happened with the Ash Orphanage in Emor? Where did Aunt Allie and the children go? How did the orphanage end up with that debt?
Firenze. You explain. You were the one handling it.
Two summers ago, acting on Lady Darcia's orders, I went to Emor.
Lady Firenze, it has been over an hour, but our scout squad has not returned. It doesn't look good.
Our intel showed that the orphanage only had a matron named Allie and some children. They shouldn't have posed any threat to our soldiers.
Then it was an ambush. Stay alert here. I'll go take a look myself.
That's the orphanage ahead... The lights are still on, but the children should be asleep at this hour.
If it were an ambush, there'd be no reason to leave the lights on as a warning.==W== Wait—this is...
Hey, are you alright?==W== Still breathing... Looks like you were calmly knocked unconscious.
But there are no signs of a fight at all. What happened here...?==W== This is—a letter?

Esteemed Commander,==W== I'm not sure which company you represent, but your soldiers will be asleep for a full day. Please come back by then.==W== Rest assured, we will not take anything that doesn't belong to us.
A threat...? No. Our order is to retrieve the ancient relic. There's no need for a confrontation.
Firenze! Where did you take Aunt Allie and the children?!
Calm down, Noya. We didn't do anything to them.
When we returned the next day, the orphanage was already empty.
This is the only thing we found in the basement—
This recipe dates back a very long time. I believe it may have been the ancient relic itself... Turned out it wasn't what Lady Darcia was after.
So the Tawny Nightingale recipe really was found in the orphanage, just as the mysterious messenger claimed... But that only raises more questions.
So you're saying... Aunt Allie took the kids and moved overnight, just like Rainea said?

That seems to be the case. Whoever was protecting the orphanage neutralized our soldiers with ease.==W== Relocating the children wouldn't have been difficult, and once they went into hiding, we'd have no way of tracking them.
How do you explain the debt then?
The fact is, I only recently learned about the debt that was pinned on the orphanage.

Apparently, to raise funds, Lady Gray searched United Harvest's archives for organizations that had recently been wiped out.==W== She used those names as loan entities, exploiting information gaps between city-states to secure collateralized loans.
So it was loan fraud. That contract eventually fell into Feagin's hands and caused us plenty of trouble in Emor.
I'm sorry, Your Majesty. I didn't think things through when I was raising funds.
There's no erasing what's already happened… But it's behind us now.==W== What exactly was the ancient relic you were searching for beneath the orphanage?
I was looking for an ancient map, Your Majesty. According to legend, it recorded the path that leads to the Tyrant.
Although Firenze never found that map, fate somehow brought us together.
Enough flattery.==W== That's all I have for you tonight. It's late, get some rest.
Thank you for your consideration, Your Majesty.
This room is reserved for United Harvest's honored guests. Please make yourselves comfortable.
I'll have private residences prepared for all of you in Philae shortly. Please forgive our less-than-adequate hospitality.
P-Private residences? Th-this is far too much.
Since you also serve the Tyrant, there is no need to make a fuss over this modest offering.
Your Majesty, I shall take my leave.
After Darcia and Firenze closed the door, an unsettling silence fell over the room.
Hey, hey, hey, what's with the grim faces?
Iris, Amber, Fuyuka, and Mina—come test this mattress. It is insanely comfortable.

Well... At least Noya's still acting like her usual self.==W== Darcia may have claimed to pledge her loyalty to Tyrant, but I saw nothing but soldiers and Intelligent Plants on the way here. Isn't that basically—
I-I really didn't expect things to turn out like this...

Lady Darcia was the "big shot" behind the Golden Nightingale commission,==W== but she never intended to investigate the Tawny Nightingale, did she? Her plan all along was to get you into United Harvest, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
I know it's probably too late… But I'm really sorry, everyone.
Don't be too hard on yourself. What's done is done. Let's figure out our next move.
You're not going to sleep on the soft mattress?
Of course I am. And we're all sleeping together.==W== Smiling or crying, we're still facing the same problem... So why not smile and feel a little better~
Alright! Enough stressing over what's already happened. We'll get out of this together!
Besides, if we want to make a run for it, we'd better eat and get some rest. Right? Your Majesty~
You're so upbeat Noya, even at a time like this.==W== You're right—we should ease up and get a good night's rest. Then we can figure out an escape plan.
Once we make it to the Trekker Camp, there's nothing to be afraid of.==W== Fuyuka, could you contact the Petal Bloom?
Alright then, let's all get some rest.
What Darcia said earlier... Should I ask Vita again?==W== Maybe I really should complete Vita's missions to grant that permission. Keep a final trump card for myself...
"Anonymous User sent you a friend request."
Someone sent me a request in Heartlink without me noticing.
Back at the warehouse tonight,==W== I got a friend request sent by an anonymous user.
The same thing happened to Mistique back then...
Heartlink not established. Message failed to send.
How infuriating! Did they delete me right after sending these messages?

What about Joseph and Lady Gray? They're currently detained in the interrogation room in the Ash District for offending you.==W== I recommend execution for this unforgivable act, Your Majesty.
Keep them locked up. There's no need to rush.
Executing them now would complicate the Intelligent Plant project, wouldn't it? Think about the mercenaries...
You're right. But offending Your Majesty is a capital crime.
And their knowledge and experience have long been yours anyway.
Is that a metaphor ... or does she mean it in a literal sense?
Hmm... We'll come back to that. Now that the United Harvest matter is settled, I should ask about the orphanage.
One more thing—what exactly happened with the Ash Orphanage in Emor? Where did Aunt Allie and the children go? How did the orphanage end up with that debt?
Firenze. You explain. You were the one handling it.
Two summers ago, acting on Lady Darcia's orders, I went to Emor.
Lady Firenze, it has been over an hour, but our scout squad has not returned. It doesn't look good.
Our intel showed that the orphanage only had a matron named Allie and some children. They shouldn't have posed any threat to our soldiers.
Then it was an ambush. Stay alert here. I'll go take a look myself.
That's the orphanage ahead... The lights are still on, but the children should be asleep at this hour.
If it were an ambush, there'd be no reason to leave the lights on as a warning.==W== Wait—this is...
Hey, are you alright?==W== Still breathing... Looks like you were calmly knocked unconscious.
But there are no signs of a fight at all. What happened here...?==W== This is—a letter?

Esteemed Commander,==W== I'm not sure which company you represent, but your soldiers will be asleep for a full day. Please come back by then.==W== Rest assured, we will not take anything that doesn't belong to us.
A threat...? No. Our order is to retrieve the ancient relic. There's no need for a confrontation.
Firenze! Where did you take Aunt Allie and the children?!
Calm down, Noya. We didn't do anything to them.
When we returned the next day, the orphanage was already empty.
This is the only thing we found in the basement—
This recipe dates back a very long time. I believe it may have been the ancient relic itself... Turned out it wasn't what Lady Darcia was after.
So the Tawny Nightingale recipe really was found in the orphanage, just as the mysterious messenger claimed... But that only raises more questions.
So you're saying... Aunt Allie took the kids and moved overnight, just like Rainea said?

That seems to be the case. Whoever was protecting the orphanage neutralized our soldiers with ease.==W== Relocating the children wouldn't have been difficult, and once they went into hiding, we'd have no way of tracking them.
How do you explain the debt then?
The fact is, I only recently learned about the debt that was pinned on the orphanage.

Apparently, to raise funds, Lady Gray searched United Harvest's archives for organizations that had recently been wiped out.==W== She used those names as loan entities, exploiting information gaps between city-states to secure collateralized loans.
So it was loan fraud. That contract eventually fell into Feagin's hands and caused us plenty of trouble in Emor.
I'm sorry, Your Majesty. I didn't think things through when I was raising funds.
There's no erasing what's already happened… But it's behind us now.==W== What exactly was the ancient relic you were searching for beneath the orphanage?
I was looking for an ancient map, Your Majesty. According to legend, it recorded the path that leads to the Tyrant.
Although Firenze never found that map, fate somehow brought us together.
Enough flattery.==W== That's all I have for you tonight. It's late, get some rest.
Thank you for your consideration, Your Majesty.
This room is reserved for United Harvest's honored guests. Please make yourselves comfortable.
I'll have private residences prepared for all of you in Philae shortly. Please forgive our less-than-adequate hospitality.
P-Private residences? Th-this is far too much.
Since you also serve the Tyrant, there is no need to make a fuss over this modest offering.
Your Majesty, I shall take my leave.
After Darcia and Firenze closed the door, an unsettling silence fell over the room.
Hey, hey, hey, what's with the grim faces?
Iris, Amber, Fuyuka, and Mina—come test this mattress. It is insanely comfortable.

Well... At least Noya's still acting like her usual self.==W== Darcia may have claimed to pledge her loyalty to Tyrant, but I saw nothing but soldiers and Intelligent Plants on the way here. Isn't that basically—
I-I really didn't expect things to turn out like this...

Lady Darcia was the "big shot" behind the Golden Nightingale commission,==W== but she never intended to investigate the Tawny Nightingale, did she? Her plan all along was to get you into United Harvest, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
I know it's probably too late… But I'm really sorry, everyone.
Don't be too hard on yourself. What's done is done. Let's figure out our next move.
You're not going to sleep on the soft mattress?
Of course I am. And we're all sleeping together.==W== Smiling or crying, we're still facing the same problem... So why not smile and feel a little better~
Alright! Enough stressing over what's already happened. We'll get out of this together!
Besides, if we want to make a run for it, we'd better eat and get some rest. Right? Your Majesty~
You're so upbeat Noya, even at a time like this.==W== You're right—we should ease up and get a good night's rest. Then we can figure out an escape plan.
Once we make it to the Trekker Camp, there's nothing to be afraid of.==W== Fuyuka, could you contact the Petal Bloom?
Alright then, let's all get some rest.
What Darcia said earlier... Should I ask Vita again?==W== Maybe I really should complete Vita's missions to grant that permission. Keep a final trump card for myself...
"Anonymous User sent you a friend request."
Someone sent me a request in Heartlink without me noticing.
Back at the warehouse tonight,==W== I got a friend request sent by an anonymous user.
The same thing happened to Mistique back then...
Heartlink not established. Message failed to send.
How infuriating! Did they delete me right after sending these messages?

strings.text: You reject Darcia's loyalty and are placed under house arrest, but Firenze, moved by your convictions, decided to collaborate with you in secret. You warn your companions to escape immediately.
Under the pro<r=threat></r>tection of Firenze and her soldiers, I am escorted out of Darcia's office.
Firenze, come on. You know better.==W== I'm the Boss from the Boss Accord, not the Tyrant from the legends.
Explaining to me is pointless. That call is entirely up to Lady Darcia.
Around here, if Lady Darcia says white is black, then it is black.==W== And since she says you are the "Legendary Tyrant," well...
... Then I am the Tyrant?==W== That's ridiculous. You're illegally detaining me.
Need I remind you where we are, ==SEX12== Tyrant? This is United Harvest. Your companions are guests here too... So I wouldn't try anything foolish if I were you.
We are simply following Lady Darcia's orders. Please, don't make this difficult.
Using everyone's safety as leverage...==W== Darcia!==W==
Your temporary quarters, ==SEX12== Tyrant. Please, make yourself at home.
Do not leave this room. If you need anything, simply ask, and I'll have it ready.
How long do you plan to keep me here?
That depends on you—and Lady Darcia, of course.==W== Though I imagine if you were to suddenly "remember" that you are the Tyrant, your stay might be shorter.
Why does it have to be me?
It's not my place to speculate.==W== Perhaps only your specific talents meet Lady Darcia's standards.
Now, hand over your phone and uniform. We'll show them to your subordinates for their peace of mind.
Hmph. They're your leverage against me, and I'm your leverage against them. Is that it?
Lady Darcia believes you are surrounded by treacherous influences. She thinks they are the reason you see yourself as a Trekker, not the Tyrant.
That's why you separated us?==W== By the way, what if I don't give you the phone?
Lady Darcia has authorized me to use force, provided I don't cause you any harm.
However, I would prefer not to exercise that privilege.
If you humor my curiosity with an answer, I might bend the rules. I'll take the uniform, but you can keep the phone.
You could have easily feigned acceptance of Lady Darcia's loyalty. Why did you still choose to refuse?
She keeps saying "Lady Darcia," yet asks something that completely undermines her master. Is she testing me ... or does she have her own agenda?
No big reason. I just can't agree with her philosophy. That's all.
Even if that choice endangers both you and your subordinates?
Didn't you just say this is United Harvest? We were never safe here, no matter what I chose to do.
I don't care about the legends. I just want to be the Bo<r=person></r>ss my companions trust.
That trust between you... It is truly enviable.
Very well. To honor our agreement, I won't ask for the phone.
Glad you're satisfied. Speaking of which...==W== Where did you pull that suitcase from?
This? It is my luggage.==W== Don't worry, just the bare essentials—a change of clothes and a makeup kit.
I only asked you to change because that cheap uniform insults your status. As for the phone...==W== You never actually had to hand it over.
Lady Darcia only instructed me to stay by your side—to ensure those scheming subordinates don't lead you astray.
How else would I learn your true thoughts without a little lie? However, when I said I envied the trust between you and your companions, that was the truth.
Go ahead. Contact your friends. Say whatever you need to say.
Won't doing this ... go against Darcia's will? Aren't you worried she'll punish you?
As long as I am attending to you, you cannot possibly be led astray.
I am quite curious to see exactly what kind of Bo<r=person></r>ss you intend to become.
Yawn... Man, I'm sleepy.==W== ==PLAYER_NAME== has been in there forever. What's taking so long?
Boss is undoubtedly discussing complex executive matters with Darcia. They are both CEOs, after all. It's high-level strategy!
Since Darcia's so nice... She probably won't blame Master even though we destroyed the greenhouse, right...?
Darcia already said that it didn't matter! Besides, wasn't she the one who saved our skins from Firenze back there?
U-um... Then why are there so many people ... staring at us?
Boss, we're holding up. We have food and water.
But there's a ton of United Harvest soldiers watching us
Find a way out of the city. Head to the Trekker Camp and link up with the Petal Bloom.
Leave the city? But you're still in Darcia's office.
Darcia has me under house arrest. I can't escape right now.
If things get dangerous, just run.
If you guys get out safely, she can't use you as leverage against me.
That's the only way I'll have any bargaining power.
(Gotta find a way out of here.)
My chest... It feels tight. Can you help me get to the infirmary?
You again? Make it quick! Don't fall behind on your quota.
You, intern, go give her a hand.
That's it. I'll use the trick Nyx taught me... Hope she takes the hint.
Amber? Amber?! Are you okay? What's happening?!
My chest... Tight... Need... The infirmary...
Oh no, it might be cardiac ischemia from overexertion! We have to get her to the infirmary immediately!
Hold it. Lady Darcia's orders are absolute: no one leaves this room.
You're citing protocol now? She's from the Boss Accord, Lady Darcia's honored guest. If she collapses on your watch, are you taking the fall?
Lady Darcia wants a partnership with Boss Accord. Our orders are technically just "protection." If a VIP gets hurt... It's our heads on the block.
True... But I can't just let them walk out unmonitored.==W== Wait, I've got it.
Clear the way! Stick close to them. We'll escort them there ourselves.
Here we are. Welcome to my "infirmary."
Infirmary?==W== There's a cot, sure, but it looks more like a hidden corner of the greenhouse...==W== My kind of place.
Yes, Lady Darcia. We have eyes on the Trekkers now.
Understood. Eliminate the Trekkers. And Nyx. Leave no survivors.
Leave no survivors...? Wait, that means—!
If Darcia's making her move now...
Where's that fire coming from?!==W== Is... Is it the Compliance Department's trap?
Fast reflexes, Amber. Just in time.
And in here... My Feathers have room to work.
Several floating guns—matching the one in Nyx's hand—burst from the shrubbery.
Pinned by crossfire, the United Harvest soldiers drag their wounded and retreat.
Phew... Finally shook 'em.==W== Hey Amber, about faking sick... Did you know Darcia was gonna turn on us?
Wasn't me. It was Boss.==W== Look, a message from ==SEX4==.
No time to chat. The soldiers are back!
I'll cover you with the Feathers. Go! Head for the main gate!

strings.text: You reject Darcia in the tone of Tyrant, and instruct your companions to escape through Vita. Despite being under house arrest, your relationship with Firenze seemed to have improved somewhat.
Outside the office, Firenze bars my path with her cane.
Firenze, your orders were to take me to my team next door. Why block my path?
==SEX12== Tyrant, Lady Darcia's loyalty is absolute. Why did you reject her?
As the Tyrant, I have my reasons.
You don't get to ask why, Firenze.
I have to ask. She's the CEO of this branch. Someone of her rank offers you allegiance, and you decline. Why?
Ridiculous. Did Darcia put you up to this?
Not at all. Purely my own curiosity. Humor me.
Ask all you want, I'm done explaining. Now move.
Do you realize what you're doing? Darcia pledged herself to me. Disrespecting me insults her.
I call it necessary. Enforcing her will here and now... That is how I prove my loyalty.
Loyal to the servant, but not the master...
My title binds Darcia, but holds no weight with Firenze.
I know Lady Darcia. She's relentless. Your rejection will only paint a target on your subordinates' backs.
I'm sure someone with your intellect knows exactly what that entails.
This looks bad. I need to get a warning out somehow...==W== Wait! I can—
Vita, Heartlink Amber. Tell them to leave me and run.
Your command is my will. Transmitting now—mimicking your tone.
Please stall for time while the transmission completes.
Now, answer the question, ==SEX12== Tyrant. Why exactly did you reject Lady Darcia?
Hmph. Like I ever had a choice.==W== Fine. I'll tell you.
I may be the Tyrant, but my path is nothing like the one she envisions.
As I understand it, Lady Darcia chose to conquer Nova with absolute might, solely to lay it at your feet.
And exactly what sort of path do you walk, ==SEX12== Tyrant?
R-Report!==RT====W==<size=50>The Trekkers next door have escaped!
==PLAYER_NAME=='s been in there for half an hour.==W== What are they even talking about?
Sir Joseph and Lady Gray were behind the Golden Nightingale, Mistique had company secrets on the capturer, and our fight wrecked two greenhouses.
M-Master's probably just being questioned a bit longer. When I accepted that award last time, Lady Darcia grilled me for a whole hour.
You mean after we beat the Garden of Parasite and clear the Big Three?
Y-Yeah... She said she was very interested in monsters.
Such a prestigious medal ...==W== for me?!==W== Are you sure? This must be a mistake!
I had originally intended to hold a formal ceremony to elevate your guild's renown. Philae's saviors should not go unrecognized.
But after hearing your story, I realize my thinking was shortsighted.==W== True heroes like you earn admiration through your actions, not through tedious ceremonies.
Lady Darcia is actually so kind. She really understands what we're trying to do.
Is she?==W== If she "really understands," why has she posted an army right outside that door?
Amber, Darcia is making her move. You're in danger. Get out now! (Sent by Vita)
Forget about me. Your safety is my best leverage against Darcia. Go! (Sent by Vita)
Orders from Lady Darcia: wipe them out! Leave no survivors!
Heads up! I hear spellcasting outside—
Fuyuka, help me blast the door!
Gah! How were they ready for us?
Don't rush! Form up defense, advance slowly. These Trekkers are dangerous.
Impossible. There's no other way out.
They smashed through the wall! They're headed for the greenhouses!
Firenze, what do you think you're doing? How dare you show such disrespect to ==SEX12== Tyrant?
I-I'm sorry, Lady Darcia! I was only...
Darcia, you've got the wrong idea.
She only pinned me against the wall to shield me from the blast.
Then I stand corrected.==W== Escort ==SEX12== Tyrant to a secure room. I'll handle the Trekkers.
Darcia, just what do you intend to do with my subordinates?
==SEX12== Tyrant, I know exactly what kind of test you've prepared for me.
I'm worth far more than all your previous underlings combined, and I'll prove it to you personally.
Here we are, ==SEX12== Tyrant. This is your temporary suite. Please, make yourself at home.
So, house arrest? Darcia certainly has a unique way of showing loyalty.
==SEX12== Tyrant... Why did you take my side back there?
Take your side? Hardly. I was just returning a favor.
Your tip about Darcia gave me time to warn my team. Plus, you really did take that blast for me.
While we're on the subject... Why go out of your way to warn me? Doesn't that count as betraying Darcia?
It never ends! How many Intelligent plants are there? Is Darcia trying to carpet all of Nova with these things?
Noya, pace yourself! Don't burn all your stamina!
We'll never get away on foot.==W== I'm getting Loxy. Cover me!
Copy that. Amber and I are on it.
S-So many flying guns! They melted those plants in seconds!
I stashed those weapons around the greenhouse earlier. Just didn't expect I'd actually have to use them like this.
Foolish Trekkers.==W== Only I can offer true loyalty to ==SEX12== Tyrant.
Fuyuka, Iris, Amber, fall back! I'll hold Darcia off.
Stop arguing! Someone has to stay and cover you.==W== It's my duty as an Inspector!

Stop arguing! Someone has to stay and cover you.==W== It's my duty as an Inspector!

strings.text: You manage to escape the company, but lost contact with Petal Bloom. As Darcia's plant army repels the HQ's mercenaries, she forces you back to the company alone—where a terrifying truth awaits.
Almost there, Master. The camp isn't far.
Physically, I'm fine. It's my nerves on edge. You haven't reached Petal Bloom in three whole days?
No... Noya and the others tried, too. Nobody picked up.
Hm...==W== Dead silence on my end, too. Hope they're alright.
They may have accepted a commission that took them outside the Philae Monolith's range.
You didn't know, ==PLAYER_NAME==?==W== Phones only work within the same Monolith zone.
We linked with Minova to add her Heartlink, sure. But we're in Philae, and she's in Emor. We cannot connect.
Seriously? Let me try...==W== Huh, you're right.
Must be my memory loss. Can't believe I have no idea of something that basic.
Don't sweat the details! Let's head to camp and check. Beats standing around worrying, right?
True. We escaped United Harvest alive. Let's focus on that and stay positive.
For three days, we watched out for Darcia while probing the Intelligent Plants and mercenaries for weaknesses. Finally, with Mina's help, we escaped the twisted halls of United Harvest.
We wanted to bring Mina, but she said she couldn't leave her two younger sisters behind.
We had to go on ahead without her. But one day, we'll return to get them.
Master, the camp's empty... Where did everyone go?
Did Darcia circle around us? No way. Nobody moves faster than Loxy.
Stop overthinking! Everyone, take cover now!
Too many enemies, too much firepower... The five of us can't brute force our way out.
Hold it! Cease fire! Who authorized that magic barrage?
It's just a handful of targets! Yet you just burned through a fortune in Grace. We don't have the budget for this waste!
Our objective is Philae and Darcia, not some random group playing Trekker.
Targeting Philae and Darcia?==W== Meaning they aren't working for her!
Darcia, you're insane. I'm reporting this to HQ immediately.
Did HQ send them after Nyx reported in? But how'd they mobilize this fast?
Officer Jayhawk, we aren't trying to waste it... These Trekkers are tough. We lost hundreds just taking this ground.
Take any more losses, and the team will break before we even see the city walls.
Keep wasting energy, and those twisted plants will slaughter us even if we do make it!
Movement...==W== No, vines! It's Darcia's monsters!
Tch, bad news...==W== Forget the camp! Everyone, fall back, now!
Master... Look, the soldiers are retreating.
Yeah, but the Intelligent Plants behind 'em are gonna be a real headache...
Your Majesty, why must you put yourself in such danger? If anything happened to you... I wouldn't know what to do with myself!
Didn't you know? United Harvest's army has already reached the Trekker Camp. They're about to siege Philae. This forest is a battlefield.
Why keep something that big from me? And the Petal Bloom Guild. Do you know where they are?
Apologies, Your Majesty. No news on the guild.==W== As for why I withheld the enemy's movements... Well, it's simple.
You have traitors in your midst.
Think about it. If they hadn't insisted on dragging you out of the city, you wouldn't be in this mess right now, would you?
If you mean my friends here, you're wrong.==W== Leaving United Harvest was my decision from the start.
Your decision? Oh, that makes it even worse.
You four. You failed to stop ==SEX2== Majesty's reckless demands and walked blindly into an ambush. You're either plotting against ==SEX4==, or you're simply incompetent.
But honestly, it doesn't matter which.==W== Plants, execute these fools.
Darcia, what are you doing?! Let them go! You said you'd be loyal to me forever!
Of course, Your Majesty. I remain your ever-faithful servant.
Then why do you refuse to obey my orders?!
This isn't defiance, Your Majesty.==W== Quite the contrary...==W== I do this precisely because of my loyalty.
To ensure your safety, every threat around you must be purged.
And who bears the burden of such a mission?==W== Heh heh... Me, of course. That is why I cultivated this legion of Intelligent Plants—to conquer Nova and eradicate all threats to your reign.
I never said I wanted to conquer Nova.
As your most devoted servant, I know your true desires,==W== desires you may not even realize you hold.
So, even if you hate me for it, I will dispose of them. That is the depth of my loyalty.
It makes no sense... Darcia isn't loyal to me. She's loyal to the Tyrant living in her imagination.
Ignore us, ==PLAYER_NAME==! A few overgrown weeds can't stop my blade.
No way... How is it reacting that fast?
Observe, Your Majesty. Our new Gen-3 plants have totally eclipsed the obsolete Gen-2 models and the Mandrake Radiant Grass.
Each stalk now possesses the combat instincts and judgment of an elite Trekker. Their only deficit is coordination,==W== a flaw my research will soon correct.
I understand. Darcia... Let them go. I will return with you.
Master, what are you saying? We'd never leave you behind!
You aren't leaving me. I am discarding you.
Darcia is right. Since the moment I woke, a voice inside has urged me to conquer this world.
What are you talking about?! The Tyrant of legend might do that, but you know that isn't you!
That is merely your assumption. I stayed with you because you had potential. I thought you would be useful.
But now that I have all these Intelligent Plants that are stronger... You are no longer necessary.
For the sake of our travels, I will show mercy. I'm sparing your lives.==W== Now go ... before I change my mind.
You're right, Amber. To keep you safe, I'll be a liar. A demon...==W== I'll even become the true Tyrant. Whatever it takes.
Such benevolence, Your Majesty.==W== Well? The Tyrant has graciously spared your pathetic lives. Now run along.
Just you wait, ==PLAYER_NAME==! I'll be back!
Fuyuka and the battered New Star Guild lean on each other, limping into the shadows of the forest.
Sounds like a third-rate villain's exit line.==W== Your Majesty, please return to the city. I will handle the rest.
As we leave, Firenze eyes me in icy silence. She looks at me like I'm a potted plant, rooted to the spot, existing only to be arranged by another's hand.
I follow Darcia deep into the facility.==W== We pass endless rows of cultivation tanks before entering a cavernous underground hall.
A massive tank, two or three stories high, dominates the far end. The orange liquid inside drinks in the dim light,==W== glowing with an eerie, unnatural hue.
The "Bishop" Seal of Grace sits at the bottom of the tank, like a tiny trinket in a massive fishbowl.
Feast your eyes, Your Majesty. The upgrade hub for our Third Gen Intelligent Plants. Thanks to your "Bishop" Seal, they grow smarter with every dose of "nutrient" we add.
Familiar faces bob in the orange suspension. I clamp a hand over my mouth, choking back the urge to vomit.
I can see those anonymous messages in my head.
They were right. I really did make the worst possible choice.

strings.text: Escaping with Loxy, the group is blocked within Philae. Nyx reveals that HQ is investigating Darcia's rogue actions. To help your allies escape, you plan to seize the suburban cable car station...
Quite a show tonight. You holding up okay?
Barely. Three more hours and we win.
No turning back now. The die is cast.
The Lucky Oasis! Get in, hurry!
Move it! These damn plants are choking the road!
Fire lights up the plaza. A silhouette bursts through the smoke and leaps onto the vehicle.
Everyone in? Awesome! Floor it, Loxy!
Noya, drive! Head for the outskirts! We'll lose them once we clear the city!
Nyx, what on earth happened back there?
Why did Darcia turn on us? And Boss...==W== Hope ==SEX=='s safe.
What did Master and Darcia talk about?==W== Is... Is it because we wrecked the company?
Not your fault. It's because Darcia pledged loyalty to the "legendary Tyrant."
Simply put... She plans to conquer Nova in the Tyrant's name.
C-Conquer Nova? Um...==W== I don't get it. Is that a metaphor?
No metaphor. She's researching Intelligent Plants to build the Tyrant an army.
The Compliance Department's been watching her, but she bribed enough Senators at United Harvest to cover her tracks.
I was locked out of Greenhouse No.100 and the underground lab. No access, no evidence. But your Golden Nightingale investigation gave me the breach I needed.==W==
A breach...==W== Wait a second. Darcia ordered that commission herself. Why would she expose her own operation?
I guess... She was targeting the Tyrant from the start.
If I'm right... She couldn't care less about the Golden Nightingale. It was merely a bait to lure you in.
Besides, she has tens of thousands of Gen-2 plants ready. Exposing her methods now won't change a thing.
By order of Lady Darcia: The New Star Guild, Petal Bloom, and Nyx are under arrest for company espionage. Resist, and we open fire!
Noya, go right! I know a back way out!
Do you hear that, ==SEX12== Tyrant? The city is putting on quite the spectacle tonight.
Explosions in the Greenhouse District, then Silver, then Ash, and now back to the greenhouses.==W== They tried to break out, only to be herded back into the fold.
Tell me, ==SEX12== Tyrant. Are you not concerned?
Such faith you have in them.
They took down the giant Stellaroid on the Emor Waterway and the Big Three in the Philae forest.
The plants have the numbers, sure.==W== But I doubt they—or Darcia's soldiers—can catch the Lucky Oasis at full speed.
Your Artifact is fast, I'll give you that. But after that brawl in the Greenhouse,==W== do their Soul Stones have enough Grace left?
Crap, I totally forgot there's magic consumption, since I'm "immune to magic" and have never used Soul Stone.
By my calculations, last night's fight drained most of their reserves. They'll be lucky to last another three hours.
So...==W== Their capture is only a matter of time.
Firenze,==W== did you stick around just to gloat?
Watching you squirm is delightful, I admit,==W== but I'm not that cruel.
Lady Darcia intends to prove her worth to you. But grinding your friends down with waves of fodder... Well, that's a rather hollow victory.

Anyway, that's where we stand. Make yourself at home. You're free to do as you please, provided you stay in this room. If you get bored... Why not study the map? It might help you appreciate our lovely Philae.
Wearing a faint, unreadable smile, Firenze tears the city map off the wall and spreads it across the desk.
If they can't leave the city... What's the point of looking at a map?
Wait. Maybe I can find them a way out.
Firenze, show me where we are.
That building. Right in the center.
The Lucky Oasis launched from the greenhouses.==W== East is the obvious way out, but with all those rivers... Darcia could easily choke off the bridges.
Firenze, what's the terrain like to the west?
Southwest is wheat fields—pure mud after the rain.==W== Northwest is steep hills with a dead-end road leading to a cable car station.
Dammit, there's nowhere to go... Hang on.==W== What's that in the northern lake?
Is the Monolith on that island?
It is. Used to be a popular spot for photographers. Too bad the Grace Imperium declared it off-limits years ago.
The Monolith! That's it. That's the perfect route.
How do you get up there? By boat?
No. You take the cable car from the northwest hills.
My bad! Loxy hit an Intelligent Plant, and we spun out!
We're okay in here, but Amber's still on the roof.
I'm fine...==W== Hooked a bungee cord to the sunroof handle.
The Soul Stones are running low on Grace. At this rate...==W== We're gonna tap out completely.
Boss! You okay? We were worried sick! What's your location? You hurt?
Iris, I'm fine. But listen, no time for that now.
Silver District, West Plaza Street... Near Mina's place.
Okay. The east is likely blocked by plants and soldiers. Head northwest. Nyx, can you guide them to the cable car station?
The cable car? You're planning to ... reach the Monolith on the island?
The Monolith...==W== Right! The inside is a shifting maze. Once we're in, those plants will never track us down!
Amber, shoot down anything blocking the road.
Fuyuka, if we hit barricades or giant plants,==W== smash through them.
Iris, freeze the road behind you. Slow them down.
Nyx, you know these streets best. Take shotgun and navigate for Noya.
Sharp orders. Can't argue with that.
<size=60>Noya,==W== you need top speed. Floor it.
Heh, you got it, ==PLAYER_NAME==! Full throttle! Time to leave 'em in the dust!
Go back to sleep, sweetie. It's only the thunder.
Yeah...==W== Gotta finish a little work first. I'll be there soon.
Okay... Don't stay up too late...
Goodnight.==W== That explosion... ==PLAYER_NAME==... What is going on out there? No message from Mistique, either.
Hey. You sure this leads to Boss?
Relax. I am Serena, the all-knowing broker. Remember that limited-edition drink? You only scored that thanks to my intel.
Tracking them takes time. You handle the bodyguard work, and I guarantee we find Boss.
Deal. But if you stiff me,==W== you answer to the claws.==W== I'll clear the road ahead.
Heh. Oh, Boss...==W== Things are getting interesting.
I wonder, when the sun rises, and the real trouble starts, what choice will you make?

strings.text: With your lead, the plant army has crushed United Harvest HQ, and Darcia is steadily conquering all in her path. It seems everything is hurtling toward a not-so-bad ending... Or is it?
Darcia, loop the Third Regiment through the woods on the right. We hit their flank.
To counter that and hold formation, United Harvest has to stretch its left wing.
But we have the numbers, and the forest favors us.==W== Once their line thins out, we break them.
We don't have enough people... There're too many of 'em pouring out of the city!
Extend the line? Dammit... These woods offer no cover. If we stretch out, we collapse first.==W== Heh. Checkmate.
That's the situation. Your orders?==W== Defeat is only a matter of time.
Hmph. We brought our elite for a guaranteed win...==W== Never thought we'd get backed into such an ugly corner.
It seems==W== Darcia is backed by a commander with a taste for elegance to rival my own.
Then==W== I shall accept defeat with poise—the only elegant choice!==W== I may lose the battle, but in style...==W== I will never be outdone!
==SEX12== Tyrant, Lady Darcia.==W== The three United Harvest legions were routed during their chaotic retreat.
We lost 22,325 Gen-3 Intelligent Plants.==W== However, we captured 7,657 hostiles.==W== 320 are in critical condition.
Congratulations, Your Majesty. Thanks to your brilliant command, we crushed their main force in one stroke.
With three legions gone, United Harvest won't be threatening us again anytime soon.
Your Majesty, your grand conquest of Nova has begun with a perfect first step.
Mm... Good.==W== Darcia, how soon can we replace the 20 thousand plants we lost?
If we use Jade Grass's radiation, we'll have stock back in a week.
However, it drastically shortens their lifespan.==W== Instead of four years, they'll burn out in three months.
Do it. Get production moving. Also, make sure the wounded prisoners get treated, and look after the others.
Treatment? Look after?==W== Why the hassle?==W== I say we execute the lot. Make an example of them, and the other companies will learn to fear us.
No. Think about it...==W== If United Harvest employees see our prisoners living better lives here than they do back home, will they stay loyal?
Once internal dissent takes root, the whole organization rots from the inside out.
I see. Sowing discord in the ranks...==W== I'll handle it immediately.
I'm drained. I'm going to get some rest.
Firenze, take ==SEX2== Majesty to my chambers.
==SEX12== Tyrant, the siege is broken. The citizens think this was just a company civil war, so the city is calm.==W== Why do you still look so down?
Maybe just tired.==W== Walk with me a bit, Firenze.
Quite the crowd... Is this entire line run by Intelligent Plants?
Indeed. Given enough water and nutrients, they can operate the lines twenty-four hours straight.
Per your orders, I've sent the human staff home. With full pay, naturally.
Mm... I see. Let's check elsewhere.
In a sense. The sounds are just mimicry.==W== They actually communicate by linking vines—specific twists and knots convey different meanings.
Interesting. To think the Gen-3 is already capable of research work...
Yes, ==SEX12== Tyrant. In fact, their vines are often better suited for delicate tasks than human hands.
Mm... Not bad. Who knows?==W== Maybe plants can offer us ... a fresh perspective.
Whoa, you handle the change and carry the groceries?==W== Why didn't we get plants this useful sooner?
Even the clerks are plants now. Seems the public has accepted them.
When we first made the switch, customers were too scared to shop here.
Fortunately, we no longer remit profits to HQ.==W== Per your orders, all earnings are reinvested into staff bonuses and product quality.
Our high-quality, low-cost goods quickly overcame their fear.
Now, the plants have become our mascot. Everyone finds them adorable.
Shame.==W== No one's in a suit to make the customers laugh anymore.
==SEX12== Tyrant...==W== No, ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W== Why go this far?
This far? What do you mean?
Replacing labor with plants, granting paid leave...==W== Even treating your prisoners with dignity.
Because that is how a Tyrant acts.
Is that so? Is that really what a "Tyrant" does?
In the legends, the Tyrant waged a bloody war against the Monolith and Novians. Countless died.==W== Darcia's ideas fit those stories far better.
Maybe I fail to live up to the stories.==W== But I intend to conquer Nova my own way.
Conquer... Is that really what you want, ==PLAYER_NAME==?
Does it matter if it's true?==W== Asking questions like that... Sounds like you're planning to betray Darcia.
Betray her? I was never loyal to begin with. If you hadn't messed up our plans...==W== Forget it. The past is the past.
==PLAYER_NAME==, when you accepted Darcia's terms and claimed the title of Tyrant... I thought I had you pegged. I assumed you were just another hypocrite, chasing power at any cost.
But everything you've done since defies logic.==W== You show kindness to strangers with zero gain for yourself. Frankly, it's ... aberrant.
Heh. Let me ask you: how "normal" can someone be when they spend every waking moment roleplaying as a Tyrant?
Fair point...==W== You really do lack selfish ambition. I dug into your past—you launched that company war solely to liberate the children being harmed.
Crushing the Big Three for the Trekkers...==W== Infiltrating United Harvest just for your guild and to find those orphans...==W== Why go to such extremes for other people?
Because... Honestly? I'm not sure. I just feel like...
No one is born to suffer.==W== If I truly have the power to shape the future,==W== I want to do whatever I can to leave this world a little better than I found it.
What are you... The God of Grace?
Forget all that.==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, run away with me. Without you, Darcia's plans fall apart.
What exactly are you thinking...? Even if we escape, it won't fix anything.==W== Do you know how many Gen-3 plants Darcia can cultivate in a single month?
80 thousand... No, likely more.==W== She'd strip Philae bare, enslave the citizens—anything to accelerate the harvest.
Each of those plants hits as hard as an elite Trekker. With an army like that, do you think she'd stop at Philae?
That's why I can't leave.==W== Darcia answers only to me. I'm the only one who can rein her in, minimize the damage...==W== Maybe even steer this chaos toward a positive outcome.
Besides... Two people are trapped in that underground lab on my account. I have to get them out.
If we survive this... I'd be honored to work for you. Just as a regular employee.
Your Majesty. You allowed Firenze to leave?
Our paths diverged. Keeping her close was a liability.
So you saw it too.==W== A pity. I had such high hopes for her. Shame she couldn't purge that naivety from her heart.
Heh, please do not trouble your mind with this, Your Majesty. It's just...==W== With Firenze gone, the upgrades for your Gen-4 Intelligent Plants will be delayed again.
I intended to use her==W== as the final ingredient for the nutrient.
I have a different view on that.
Darcia, your current nutrient is substandard.
Clear out that useless waste.==W== From now on, I will be the premium nutrient and command the Intelligent Plants myself.

Darcia, loop the Third Regiment through the woods on the right. We hit their flank.
To counter that and hold formation, United Harvest has to stretch its left wing.
But we have the numbers, and the forest favors us.==W== Once their line thins out, we break them.
We don't have enough people... There're too many of 'em pouring out of the city!
Extend the line? Dammit... These woods offer no cover. If we stretch out, we collapse first.==W== Heh. Checkmate.
That's the situation. Your orders?==W== Defeat is only a matter of time.
Hmph. We brought our elite for a guaranteed win...==W== Never thought we'd get backed into such an ugly corner.
It seems==W== Darcia is backed by a commander with a taste for elegance to rival my own.
Then==W== I shall accept defeat with poise—the only elegant choice!==W== I may lose the battle, but in style...==W== I will never be outdone!
==SEX12== Tyrant, Lady Darcia.==W== The three United Harvest legions were routed during their chaotic retreat.
We lost 22,325 Gen-3 Intelligent Plants.==W== However, we captured 7,657 hostiles.==W== 320 are in critical condition.
Congratulations, Your Majesty. Thanks to your brilliant command, we crushed their main force in one stroke.
With three legions gone, United Harvest won't be threatening us again anytime soon.
Your Majesty, your grand conquest of Nova has begun with a perfect first step.
Mm... Good.==W== Darcia, how soon can we replace the 20 thousand plants we lost?
If we use Jade Grass's radiation, we'll have stock back in a week.
However, it drastically shortens their lifespan.==W== Instead of four years, they'll burn out in three months.
Do it. Get production moving. Also, make sure the wounded prisoners get treated, and look after the others.
Treatment? Look after?==W== Why the hassle?==W== I say we execute the lot. Make an example of them, and the other companies will learn to fear us.
No. Think about it...==W== If United Harvest employees see our prisoners living better lives here than they do back home, will they stay loyal?
Once internal dissent takes root, the whole organization rots from the inside out.
I see. Sowing discord in the ranks...==W== I'll handle it immediately.
I'm drained. I'm going to get some rest.
Firenze, take ==SEX2== Majesty to my chambers.
==SEX12== Tyrant, the siege is broken. The citizens think this was just a company civil war, so the city is calm.==W== Why do you still look so down?
Maybe just tired.==W== Walk with me a bit, Firenze.
Quite the crowd... Is this entire line run by Intelligent Plants?
Indeed. Given enough water and nutrients, they can operate the lines twenty-four hours straight.
