strings.text: Following the cable car route, the group escapes the city. Meanwhile, mercenaries from HQ have seized the Trekker Camp. The others learn that Darcia is suspected of rebellion, and Philae is set to become a battlefield.
We're clear! Those overgrown grasses would need another century to catch Loxy and me!
Ugh, gonna be sick...==W== Everyone out! Find cover! The Intelligent Plants and mercenaries aren't far behind.
Long rope. And a car with no wheels.
Not a car. It's a cable car cabin.
Before the lockdown, people took this line across the lake to access the Monolith.
But why sealed it off? Isn't that Monolith run by United Harvest, under Grace Imperium's authority?
Heard it was some "operational misconduct,"==W== but the details are classified. Even I'm in the dark.
Good thing the Trekker Camp is nearby. The local branch pulls enough Artifacts from the Wilds, so they don't need this place.
Looks like this big old rig's been sitting here forever. Think it still works?
It gets routine checks. We just pump some magic into the winch, and it'll take us straight to the island.
But the Lucky Oasis won't fit inside...
If we leave it here,==W== won't the Intelligent Plants claim it?
No way! I am not letting Loxy become a planter for those weeds.
The cable car... Loxy... Got it! I have a plan. Fuyuka, let's get changed!
I'm ready. Um, Noya senpai, are we swapping the cabin for the Lucky Oasis?
Bingo! But I can't lift it alone. Give me a hand, Fuyuka?
If we can't budge it together, I'll think of something else!
Hmm... Doesn't look too heavy.==W== Leave it to me, senpai. I've got this!
Miss Nyx, I've coated the station path in thin ice. Plants or soldiers... Nobody's getting up here easily.
Miss Nyx? What are you looking at?
Ah, sorry. I was lost in thought.
Listen...==W== I need to stay and feed magic into the launch gear. You guys head to the island first.
Huh? Can't you power it from inside the car?
No, the initial surge has to come from the station.==W== Once you land, jumpstart the terminal on the island side, and I'll take the next car over.
Got it!==W== We'll juice it up the second we land. You stay safe too!
Hold onto it for me. If you ever hit a dead end and can't decide, open it up.==W== The answer's inside.
The answer...==W== Understood. Please be careful.
Nyx presses her hands on the winch, channeling a slow stream of magic.
Metal screeches against metal, and the cable groans to life,==RT==carrying the suspended Lucky Oasis out over the lake.
The eastern sky is clear. The smoke of battle she expected==RT==is nowhere to be seen. Nyx frowns in confusion.
Those people...==W== Surely they've made their move by now.
Phew. Hooking the Lucky Oasis to a cable line? Only Noya's crazy enough to try that. At least they got away.
Firenze, is the cable car the only way to the island? Can we take a boat?
Oh, my apologies, ==SEX12== Tyrant.==W== I was distracted by the view outside. How may I be of service?
I was asking if there's another way onto the island besides the cable car. A boat, maybe?
Won't work. The island is ringed by sheer cliffs with nowhere to dock. Unless you have flight magic, you're taking the cable car.
That's a relief. Even if the Intelligent Plants overrun the station, those cars are too slow to move a real army. Noya and the others should be safe.
You're the one in captivity, yet you're fussing over your friends...==W== You really are an oddity.
Doesn't matter. As long as my crew is free, neither you nor Darcia has any leverage on me.
By the way, what were you staring at? You seemed completely entranced...==W== That's not like you.
I follow Firenze's gaze east. There's nothing unusual as far as I can see—==RT==only the morning sun, stinging my eyes with its glare.
Tsk. Looks like someone missed their appointment.
Watching you squirm is delightful, I admit,==W== but I'm not that cruel.
Lady Darcia intends to prove her worth to you. But grinding your friends down with waves of fodder... Well, that's a rather hollow victory.

Anyway, that's where we stand. Make yourself at home. You're free to do as you please, provided you stay in this room. If you get bored... Why not study the map? It might help you appreciate our lovely Philae.
So... Did Firenze pull strings to cause this chaos?
She deliberately showed me that map to focus my attention on the west...==W== No, she's trying to divert everyone's gaze in that direction.
Which means her real target is east of Philae...==W== The Trekker Camp!==W== Nazuka!
No way.==W== Dark until we clear the Monolith's signal zone.
You guys for real? You raided our camp at midnight, kicked us out, and now I can't even answer a phone?
Is this how United Harvest operates? What's Darcia and Firenze's play here?
Yeah! We left half our stuff back there. Turn around!
We are going back!==W== I've got active commissions. You covering my penalty fees?
Silence! Settle down.==W== I'm Inspector Jayhawk from United Harvest. I'm running this op.
We hear you.==W== On behalf of HQ, accept my sincerest apologies. We'll tally your losses and cover the bill. You have my word.
HQ...?==W== Then these troops aren't locals. They don't answer to Darcia or Firenze.
Talk's cheap. How do we know you won't stiff us?
Exactly! This is our livelihood. You wanna compensate us? Pay up. Now.
We deployed fast. We're light on cash.==W== If you don't trust me, the road back is open.
But be warned: Branch CEO Darcia has gone rogue. The Trekker Camp—and all of Philae—is about to become a war zone.
If you value your luggage more than your life,==W== be my guest.
The Trekker Camp and Philae==W==...==W== A war zone?
Hey!==W== I said no phones. You deaf?
I don't care about your rebellion==W== or your war.
Nazuna, Kaede, we're getting Boss. Let's move!
They're not letting up... My Soul Stone is nearly tapped out of Grace.==W== Good thing I brought this cot. It's buying me time as a barricade.
Don't bother.==W== That folding cot is magically reinforced. Your shots won't even scratch it.
Phew. The Lucky Oasis should be on the island by now. Time to catch that cable car.
We raised enough hell last night to draw their forces west.==W== HQ's breach in the east should be a walk in the park.
It's a bust. The plan failed.
HQ never launched the assault on schedule.
Why? Did they get held up?
No. They tried to seize the Trekker Camp by force and started a riot. Now they're bogged down fighting the locals.
Darcia's plants and troops have already retaken the eastern bridge. The window for a surprise attack is gone.
We have no choice. I'm initiating the backup plan. Watch your back.
What the hell are those idiots at HQ thinking?
Lady Darcia. I'm surprised to see you handle this personally. All this for a lowly inspector?
If HQ was your lifeline, their performance is ... pitiful.==W== Hehe. How does that make you feel?
You went to such lengths gathering evidence, calling in the HQ army to crush me.
Only for them to fall apart before even entering the city. A tragic waste of your hard work last night.
You seem to forget, Lady Darcia—I'm from HQ, too.
Screw the army.==W== If I take you down right here, this ends now!==W== No backup plan needed.
Ngh! You... Shooting a defenseless woman? Are you insane?!==W== Ugh... It hurts... No... I don't want to die! Save me...
Drop the act. You're the CEO of Philae Branch, the would-be world conqueror. Don't tell me this is the best you've got.
Give it up, Darcia. You're under arrest.
My, and here I thought my performance was flawless...==W== But I can't surrender just yet. I still have work to do.
The body on the ground contorts unnaturally. A flame ignites on her chest,==RT==instantly swelling into a blaze that consumes her, leaving only a handful of ash.
Suicide? No...==W== That win was way too easy.
Nyx hits the ground. She tries to raise her gun, but a boot slams down on her hand.
An instant later, cold fingers clamp around her throat.
Through the haze, a familiar silhouette looms over her.==RT==It is Darcia, the very woman who burned to ash moments ago.
You HQ people never know your place...==W== Did you honestly think that was enough to stop me?

strings.text: The legendary Tyrant reigns again with sheer military might. With your "help," the Novians live "happy" lives. Just as the dust settles, she appears—and draws her blade against you with unwavering resolve.
Monolith Calendar Year 1000, Venatio Month, 14th, Philae
Albedo. On behalf of the Tyrant, I am ready to accept the Grace Imperium's surrender.
However, for a matter of this magnitude, you came alone? Where are the Tetrad Aspects?
Is the Grace Imperium mocking the Tyrant? Hardly the correct attitude for a defeated force.
...==W== Lady Darcia, the Tyrant's Flora Legion decimated us at Emor. Three of the Tetrad Aspects were shattered. Killed in action.
The sole survivor—==W==Director Angie of the Sky Institute—relinquished her command yesterday and vanished.
I know it seems disrespectful. But as the Tetrad Aspects' Archivist and Sky Institute's Director of Operations... I am the highest-ranking official left standing.
I have full authority to represent the Grace Imperium for negotiations with ...==W== the Tyrant.
Hmph. This is an insult.==W== If you want peace, prove your sincerity with action.

==RT====A-1==First: Surrender all armaments to the Tyrant.==P====RT====RT====A-1==Second: Hand over control of all the Monoliths and every last Soul Stone you possess.==P====RT====RT====A-1==Third: Assist us in purging the Trekker Rebels.
Done these, and we will discuss your proposed "negotiations." Or rather,==W== your capitulation.
Rest assured, I don't demand an immediate answer. ==SEX2== Majesty is generous—you have a full day to consider.
Your Majesty, your wish for "universal tranquility" is finally within reach.
Anyone in the Grace Imperium with a backbone died on the battlefield. The survivors will agree to anything just to save their skins.
The only nuisance left is ...==W== those rebels. But their defeat, too, is merely a matter of time.
Four years ago, at the Tyrant's command,==RT==Darcia unleashed a conquest from Philae that swept across Nova.
Millions of Intelligent Plants overran the land, drowning cities==RT==in sheer numbers and crushing any company that dared resist.
Even Emor—Nova's heart, the "City of World's Desire"==RT==with seven Monoliths—crumbled after a brutal two-year siege.
Only scattered Trekkers and company remnants hold out. Based in==RT==untouched Matsukawa and Cangwu, they stage minor raids to stall the Tyrant.
Yet, Darcia and her plant army harmed no one outside the companies.
Rumor attributes this mercy to the Boss, ==PLAYER_NAME==,==RT==who vanished in Philae four years ago.
Huh? Cutting me off? It's bad for my health?
I-I don't care! Job's gone, my wife left... I got nothing to lose!
You say ... I still got you?==W== Yeah. You're the only one who won't turn on me.
Alright. No more booze. Let's go home.
Bored to death. Eat, play, sleep, collect free Dorra. Rinse and repeat. Honestly? I kinda miss the grind at United Harvest.
Talk about ungrateful. You'd really be happier pulling 12-hour shifts, seven days a week?
I'm just saying! Besides, Gen-4 plants work way better. Obsolete staff like us would just get in the way.
True...==W== Wait, why are we even talking shop?==W== Let's get a crew and go have some fun.
Well...==W== Gotta bring a few plants along first, right?
Oh, speak of the devil! Come on, let's grab a bite.
No, no. You're saying it wrong.==W== Say it with me: "L... uh... v. Love. I love you."
Sigh... It's just not sinking in. What am I going to do with you?
Trying to teach them to speak?
Yeah! I heard the Gen-5 Intelligent Plants are nearly ready. They can even use their vines to reshape their own bodies.
If they mimic human forms and get a little smarter... Maybe one day they'll bridge the species gap for real!
People already treat them like pets or friends anyway.
If I can just get them to talk, they could become actual companions!
Heh. A noble ambition. Good luck with that.
Your Majesty. The Grace Imperium has accepted our terms. They surrender.
Albedo has entered Philae with the Seal of Grace. I will accept their formal submission at your palace in the Gold District.
Your vision of universal tranquility has finally come true. Philae, Flavio, Sailstead, Goldfinch, Emor... Everywhere we rule, the citizens are well tended by the Intelligent Plants.
Heh... Everything is unfolding exactly as you willed it. I have never seen such happiness on their faces.
You've done well, Darcia. Go. Secure the final Seal of Grace.
Yes, Your Majesty.==W== Soon... Soon we will return to when you could still hold me.
So, Boss. Is this the world you wished for?
This isn't the world I wanted. It's just one that is slightly less terrible.
Hard to admit? Everyone seems happy enough under the care of the plants...==W== Is this not the best possible ending?

Your people are still obsessed with developing new Intelligent Plants, it seems. Giving everyone a "plant partner" that won't ever betray them. It's scary how dependent people are getting on those things.
True. Give it time, and humans will be nothing more than museum exhibits, protected like an endangered species. We'd have everything, but still feel hollow.
It might feel like happiness for a while,==W== but strip away a person's purpose for too long, and eventually, they'll lose their mind.
You sacrificed so much. You built such a powerful army. Is this really all you have to show for it?
They call me the Tyrant, but I'm just a person. There's a limit to what one human can do. I know that better than anyone.
I'm sure you realize that, too. You're only standing here right now because others helped you get this far, aren't you?
I never expected the Grace Imperium to die for me. Three of the Tetrad Aspects fell... Even Angie ambushed Darcia at the surrender ceremony, just to buy me time.
And your friends, Boss... No matter how hopeless it looked, they never gave up. They kept fighting, desperate to save you.
I came here to kill you without telling them. When I get back... They'll probably hate me for the rest of their lives.
The New Star Guild, Petal Bloom, the Ashwind Clan... Are they alright?
Some ...==W== were lost before they ever got to see their dreams come true.
I see... Thank you for being honest.==W== I've got no regrets left, then. Do it.
Come on, Firenze. Pick up your sword.
Firenze. Since when did you get so soft?
We're both backed into a corner here. There's only one way out now: one of us lives, and the other dies.
The four-year cycle is up. The Intelligent Plants are hitting their lifespan limits; they'll die in droves. Once I'm gone...
Darcia won't be able to rebuild the army, and her plan falls apart. I get it...==W== I'm sorry, Boss. And thank you.
If our souls ever meet again...==W== I hope we can just be friends.
Ugh... My arms... They won't move. My whole body feels locked up stiff.
My, my. Awfully fragile for a Tyrant. One little timeout and you're already falling to pieces?
Don't be mean. It was four years. Here,==W== dear Tyrant, let me work on those muscles. We just need to rub out the stiffness and you'll feel better.
Gah—Ow, ow, ow! You're killing me!
Heh heh. That's my secret Finisher Massage technique. Learned it ages ago from a Loong.
It's called a "Finisher" but it heals... I don't get it.==W== Well, as long as you're getting better. You know, Tyrant, this time, you've truly lived up to the title.
Look at those humans. Content to live like zoo exhibits, pampered by Intelligent Plants...==W== I'll never understand how their minds work.
Rich coming from you. You two seem pretty comfortable just loitering inside the Monolith yourselves...
That question's too deep for Bernina. Her brain is overheating. Let's just watch your final recording instead.
You look quite cute like this. Makes me want to squeeze you.
Hmph. A meanie like you belongs in bondage, Tyrant. You'd make an excellent "nutrient" for those plants.
Ouch. Harsh... Sometimes I wonder if you two actually hate my guts.
Never mind...==W== Vita, open the door.
Your Majesty. Please, accept my undying loyalty. Take this army and conquer this rotting Nova that betrayed you.
How do I choose...?==W== I can't just blindly accept her allegiance again. Not this time.
Tyrant, I advise you to make use of her loyalty.
Her devotion is absolute. Pure and unadulterated.
If you commanded her to take her own life, she would execute the command without hesitation.
If I abuse her loyalty, I'll become exactly what the legends say I am—a heartless Tyrant.

I have full authority to represent the Grace Imperium for negotiations with ...==W== the Tyrant.

strings.text: Mistique gets shot by the legion over the camp; Nazuka negotiates for her medical aid. Meanwhile, Darcia reports Gen-3 Intelligent Plant progress, revealing she's imprisoned Nyx as their power source.
Nia, Aila, watch the house for me. I'm heading to work.
Huh? Why? Aren't you off today?
That's the thing...==W== This sudden staff holiday doesn't sit right with me, so I'm checking in.
Those guests from the other day are still new. As their senior, I gotta set a good example, right?
... A sandwich?==W== You make this, Aila?
Nia and I made it while you were napping. Promise you'll eat, okay?
Mistique... Total silence since she talked to ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W== Should I ask ==PLAYER_NAME== if she's called back?
Then again, ==PLAYER_NAME== must be swamped...==W== Don't want to be a pest by bugging ==SEX4==...
Mistique? Where are you? You okay? Why haven't you been picking up?
Whoa, easy. Keep it down, will ya?
Spent all night racing some weird bird. We flew way outside the Philae Monolith's range. Obviously I wouldn't get your calls.
Heheh, what's with the panic?==W== Aww, were you actually worried about me, Mina?
Obvious, isn't it?! I told you: Witch or not, you're still an employee here. Plus, you're my junior.
Alright, alright. I'm right over the Trekker Camp.==W== Be back in a flash.
Catch any big scoops in the city while I was gone?
Lady Darcia summoned ==PLAYER_NAME==. They were locked in a meeting all night. Looked like serious business.
Ooh. A sit-down between the Branch CEO and the Boss? Now that is news.
Also, got a memo this morning. Whole company's off. Paid leave.
P-Paid leave? From United Harvest?==W== That's the story of the century! Philae really is my lucky spot.
Wait a sec... What's up with the Trekker Camp? Those guys aren't dressed like Trekkers.
Whoa, hey! Hold your fire! I'm just a harmless witch!
What happened? Mistique, answer me! Mistique!
United Harvest HQ has troops at the Trekker Camp?
Yes. They're here to make a move on Darcia.
Twenty minutes ago, I got through to Nazuka.
Last night, HQ legions marched on Philae. They commandeered the Trekker Camp, drove everyone out to neighboring cities, and cut comms.
Mid-transport, she heard her phone ring.==W== Realizing it was me, she slipped her guards with Nazuna and Kaede, doubling back to mount a rescue.
Boss, Philae's becoming a warzone. Where are they holding you? I'm coming to get you.
Don't. The city's swarming with Intelligent Plants and soldiers. It's too dangerous.
Remember my wish beneath the Monolith?==W== I wished for you to stay by my side. Always.
So spare me the warnings about danger. I don't care. I just want to see you. Now.
Can't believe the broom snapped...==W== But a witch doesn't quit. I'm not going down like this...
It's that witch who helped us.
Nazuka...?==W== Heh... Guess Philae's my lucky spot after all...
She's out cold! The wounds look bad...==W== If she doesn't get treatment, fast...
There are meds at the Trekker Camp...==W== But the army's seized it.
Weapons down! We know you're Darcia's spies!
What? We're not with Darcia! We're local Trekkers!
Commander Cosson! That witch was circling the camp. Definitely scouting us.
We shot her down, and these "Trekkers" rushed to save her. They're in league together.
Commander Cosson...==W== I assume you're the leader here? I'd like to negotiate on behalf of my company.
Boss, I can't believe it. Her entire attitude shifts the moment you show her that seal.
That's what the Seal of Grace represents—==W==the real authority a company has.
Back then... The Boss used the Seal to get United Harvest's respect. Right now, that identity is my only card.
I am Cosson of the Senate, Commander of the 3rd Legion. And which company, pray tell, do you represent?
The Boss Accord. We're all employees. And this witch interviewed our CEO personally.
The Boss Accord... That company that just reopened in Emor recently?==W== I've heard rumors. State your business here.
Our CEO is trapped in Philae. We're on an extraction mission.==W== This witch was scouting the perimeter when your men shot her down.
Hmm. I can't verify that...==W== But infringing on rights based on guesswork is hardly elegant. Very well. I'll take you at your word. Apologies for the discourtesy.
However,==W== the outskirts are now a warzone. For your safety, you'll remain under our protection until hostilities cease. I trust you understand.
You there. Escort our guests to the old Trekker Association. And get a medic for the witch immediately.
Sorry, Boss. Even the Boss Accord title didn't work. We're still stuck here.
Don't blame yourself. You made the right call. Besides, it doesn't look like these people mean us any harm.
The doctor treated her, said she's out of danger, but ... she hasn't woken up yet.
Please, keep an eye on her for me while I'm gone.
Boss, seriously, what is going on? I don't get this war at all.==W== Why is United Harvest fighting itself? And why did Mistique and the Trekker Camp have to get dragged into it?
In a way, this is all on me.
Sorry, something's come up here. I'll have to call you back.
==SEX12== Tyrant, Lady Firenze. The Intelligent Plant upgrade is commencing. Lady Darcia requests your presence to witness it.
An upgrade? Aren't we already on the second generation of Intelligent Plants?
I am not privy to the details. Please, follow me.
What's wrong with Firenze? She's seemed so distant since she saw the sky.
Thanks to Your Majesty, the third generation is ready.==W== These new plants are far deadlier—a single unit can now go toe-to-toe with a veteran Trekker.
Mass-producing soldiers that strong... Is that even possible?
How is she going to achieve that?
Right this way, ==SEX12== Tyrant. The core of the project lies just ahead.
We reach the lab's deepest chamber. Empty cultivation tanks line the metal floor, radiating an eerie, sterile chill.
Darcia, what are these tanks for?
Your Majesty. These tanks hold "Psychic Fluid," a compound I synthesized using the Neo Solution.
Its magical properties allow any subject submerged within to form a partial mental link.
A partial mental link... What's that got to do with the Intelligent Plants?
Your Majesty, observe that massive Lithe Grass. United Harvest found that monster in the southern rainforests. It is the progenitor—the Mother—of all Intelligent Plants.
Through selective breeding, I created the Mandrake Radiant Grass from her offspring—a strain capable of following simple orders.
But a monster is still a monster. They can't master complex tools, let alone speak. Sometimes, we can't even control their basic movements.
Such inferior creatures are unfit to serve in the Tyrant's army.
I refused to accept failure. I attempted countless modifications, yet every single one ended in disappointment.
Just as I hit a dead end, I acquired your Bishop piece from the Garden of Parasite.
I see... So this is "that thing" Claire mentioned. Though...==W== I wouldn't exactly call that piece mine.
Of course it belongs to you. I merely borrowed it.
You've likely deduced its power:==W== transferring human minds and memories. Simply put, placing it in a tank of Psychic Fluid links the subject's consciousness to the network.
We feed that data to the Mother, who transmits it to every Gen-2 Intelligent Plant in Philae. A true evolution.
As long as we use humans as nutrients in these tanks, the plants can absorb their skills and experience.
Behold, ==SEX12== Tyrant. The key nutrient for this upgrade is right here.
The curtain behind Darcia slowly retracts. A familiar face floats in the orange Psychic Fluid, sleeping peacefully.
Heheh... See, Firenze? This is the fate of the person who put your father on trial.
Savor it. This is the taste of true revenge.

I see... So this is "that thing" Claire mentioned. Though...==W== I wouldn't exactly call that piece mine.
Of course it belongs to you. I merely borrowed it.
You've likely deduced its power:==W== transferring human minds and memories. Simply put, placing it in a tank of Psychic Fluid links the subject's consciousness to the network.
We feed that data to the Mother, who transmits it to every Gen-2 Intelligent Plant in Philae. A true evolution.
As long as we use humans as nutrients in these tanks, the plants can absorb their skills and experience.
Behold, ==SEX12== Tyrant. The key nutrient for this upgrade is right here.
The curtain behind Darcia slowly retracts. A familiar face floats in the orange Psychic Fluid, sleeping peacefully.
Heheh... See, Firenze? This is the fate of the person who put your father on trial.
Savor it. This is the taste of true revenge.

strings.text: To buy time, you order Darcia to keep refining the Intelligent Plants. Firenze corners you and demands you use a soul pact to force Darcia's surrender to HQ...
Heheh... See, Firenze? This is the fate of the person who put your father on trial.
Savor it. This is the taste of true revenge.
Lady Darcia, with all due respect... I feel no satisfaction from this. This isn't what revenge is supposed to feel like.
Four years ago, in that courtroom—
Stay by my side, and I will grant you the power to crush Nyx.
You promised me the power to crush Nyx.
I have that power now. But you took her down yourself and turned her into a key battery for these plants.
You've robbed me of the chance to finish it myself.
Now that you mention it... I suppose you're right.==W== My apologies. I overlooked that detail.
But rest assured, the "nutrients" don't die. For now, the Psychic Fluid and ==SEX2== Majesty's Chess Piece only skim off memory debris—trivial fragments she would have forgotten anyway.
Before she suffers permanent memory damage, I'll swap her out for a more suitable specimen. Then, I'll leave her to you.
Thank you for your understanding, my Lady.==W== When the time comes, I will exact my vengeance with the utmost cruelty.
Firenze is acting ... a little off.
I look forward to watching that.
Your Majesty, do you have a question?
These Intelligent Plants don't actually think? They're just borrowing human memories?

Precisely. I use your Bishop to siphon memory debris from the nutrients and feed it to the Lithe Grass Mother. This constructs a massive cognitive model. Their reactions aren't thoughts, but instincts driven by that model.
Then what distinguishes the third generation from the second?
Rather than bore you with a long lecture, it would be better for you to witness it firsthand.
Firenze. Test the Gen-3 Intelligent Plants.
Two plants shuffled in—one tall, one short—indistinguishable from common Mandrake Radiant Grass.
Firenze unsheathed a rapier from her cane and took her stance.
The shorter plant lunged with impossible speed, vines lashing at Firenze from every angle.
Her black rapier blurred through the air...
It skewers the creature's eye and pins it to the wall.
But the taller one had already flanked her blind spot. Its pod took aim at her skull, seeds glinting with a cold, metallic sheen.
Gen-3 boasts the combat prowess of Nyx, or should I say, a veteran Trekker.
Facing two at once and dispatching one instantly. You performed admirably.
You honor me.==W== That projectile-firing plant was indeed mimicking Nyx's tactics.
Your Majesty. Does the Gen-3 Intelligent Plant meet your standards? Does my loyalty meet your approval?
Darcia is flaunting this power for one reason: to compel me to accept her allegiance.
Whatever her motives, accepting her loyalty is a one-way ticket to disaster.
Her "loyalty" is just a desperate obsession with validation. In the end, it'll get everyone killed.
Using people as "nutrients," strip-mining their memories... How could I ever condone this?
Your plants look formidable, but in practice? They are utterly useless.
U-useless...? Your Majesty, I don't understand... In what way have I failed you?
Individually, yes, they rival Firenze in raw power.==W== But during that fight, they showed absolutely no teamwork.
When the melee unit engaged Firenze, the seed-shooter should have provided cover fire. With proper support, they could have won without a scratch.
Instead, your so-called "intelligent" plant completely ignored its ally's safety, choosing instead to secure a better vantage point for itself.
But sacrifice is a valid tactic, Your Majesty.
Sacrifice is sometimes necessary. But that wasn't a tactic.
A single unit might defeat an average Trekker. But a hundred? They wouldn't fight the enemy—
They'd likely trip over each other in the confusion.
Do you honestly expect me to be satisfied with such flawed goods?
I... Your Majesty's vision far exceeds my own. I see that now. I will begin improvements immediately.
Be more selective with your "nutrients." Haste makes waste.
And do not overuse my Bishop. Is that clear?
Phew. That should buy us some time.
If I praise their strength, she'll immediately press for my acceptance.
If I call them weak, she'll just harvest more people as "nutrients" to improve them.
I have to thread the needle here...
Honestly, these Intelligent Plants are nothing special.
Tell me, Darcia. Have you ever seen the Garden of Parasite?
My apologies... Your Majesty. I was away at HQ when the Trekkers destroyed it. I never saw it in person.
The Garden of Parasite was a massive, monstrous tree. It released a kind of mist that confused friend and foe, while allowing it to control every other monster in the forest.
In hindsight, it likely gained those abilities through the influence of my Bishop piece.
Since your plants share that same origin, they should share that power.==W== And yet?
They ganged up two-on-one against Firenze and barely won. That satisfies you? I expected better. Go back and study the true authority of the Bishop piece.
Your Majesty... I was presumptuous in my expectation. I will resume my research immediately and won't return until the plants meet your standards.
Phew... That should keep her off my back for a while.
They are exceptional specimens, Darcia.==W== You have pleased me.
Your satisfaction is my highest honor.==W== Your Majesty, will you now accept my—
Accept your allegiance? Perhaps.==W== But first... Fill every empty tank in your lab with "nutrients." Begin cultivating the next generation immediately.
Yes... Yes, of course...==W== I see it now, Your Majesty.
If that is the price of your acceptance... I pay it gladly.
And do not insult me with inferior "nutrients."==W== I expect every specimen to be of the caliber of Nyx's.
The Trekker Camp is practically deserted, and subjects like Nyx are hard to come by.==W== That should stall her for a while.
Lady Darcia, ==SEX12== Tyrant hasn't rested since last night. Now that the demonstration is concluded...
Ah, Your Majesty! I have been a negligent servant to overlook your well-being. I deserve death for such an oversight!
Firenze, take two of the Gen-3 Intelligent Plant and attend to ==SEX2== Majesty. Ensure ==SEX== is comfortable.
If "resting" means sleeping next to these creeping horrors, I'll pass!
Please rest easy, ==SEX12== Tyrant. I shall be right next door should you require anything.
Can't you take these plants with you? Who could possibly sleep with these things staring at them?
My apologies. It seems they only answer to Lady Darcia.
Fine... So, you're Gen-3 Intelligent Plants, right? What can you actually do for me?
Huh? Pajamas and an eye mask... Surprisingly thoughtful.==W== Fine, I'll put them on.
Suddenly ... the exhaustion hits me.==W== Makes sense. I haven't closed my eyes in thirty hours.
With these two hovering, I can't use my phone to contact Noya or Nazuka.
Wait, there's still Vita. Vita, are you there?
I am always at your service, Tyrant.
Hearing that title now ... feels strange.==W== Darcia seems desperate to make me her version of a Tyrant.
The "Tyrant" Darcia desires is not the true Tyrant.
Oh? Do you know what the real Tyrant is actually like?
As your former Priest and current secretary, yes, I know your true self. However, with insufficient permissions. I cannot disclose that information.
Besides... I was the one who called you Tyrant first, just so you know.
Alright, alright. I know you were first.
I suggest you secure a soul pact immediately. Completing this task will raise your clearance level and unlock new powers.
To break this stalemate, please reconsider my proposal.
And what powers do I get, exactly? Ugh, never mind. Let me guess: "Insufficient Permissions," right?
Precisely. But I assure you: whatever functions you unlock will be vital to your ascension as the true Tyrant. That is the core purpose of the Well of Worlds Tyrant Development System.
You, Darcia... Everyone's obsessed with crowning me "Tyrant." Is it even really that good a gig?
Whatever. I'm in a tight spot, sure, but I'm not out of moves yet. Vita, Firenze isn't actually loyal to Darcia, is she?
My analysis concurs. Upon seeing Miss Nyx in custody, Firenze exhibited a spike in heart rate and rapid respiration—classic distress signals.
Her vitals only stabilized once Darcia confirmed Nyx's immediate safety.
She claims she wants revenge on Nyx, but her physiological response shows "concern."
That said, Darcia hasn't breathed a word about the HQ army arriving. Is she suppressing the intel, or does she just not care?
By the way, what were you staring at? You seemed completely entranced...==W== That's not like you.
I follow Firenze's gaze east. There's nothing unusual as far as I can see—==RT==only the morning sun, stinging my eyes with its glare.
So why was she fixated on the eastern sky back then? It's almost like she knew that the army was coming.
Rather than speculating in private, why not ask her directly?
Pointless without proof. Knowing Firenze, she won't give up her secrets that easily.
I need to crash. Keep eyes on Firenze for me, will you? Wake me the second she makes a move.
Understood. Your command is my will.
6 PM?==W== Is that what you're saying?
==SEX12== Tyrant, Firenze has just left the room.
I grab the clothes prepared by the plants, throw them on, and hurry out the door, scanning for Firenze.
There she is—on the stairs nearby, walking slowly toward the greenhouses.
Waiting for me to catch up, is she...?==W== Fine. Let's see what she wants.
So I follow Firenze, with the two Intelligent Plants trailing behind me.
We enter a greenhouse, head down the stairs,==W== and pass through the deep corridor of the underground lab.
Back here again?==W== She must be taking me to ... that room in the deepest part of the lab.
A glint of cold steel flashes out of nowhere, freezing just inches from my throat.
You followed, ==SEX12== Tyrant. Just as I expected.
Then I shall be direct:==W== accept Lady Darcia's allegiance, bind her with a "soul pact," and order her to surrender to HQ.
Let me be perfectly clear, to avoid any ... misunderstanding. Listen well. This is not a request. It is an order. And my rapier is not known for its patience.

strings.text: Trust established, you and Firenze exchange intel. She points out that the Bishop piece in the tank is the key to defeating Darcia. You decide to dive in to claim it, making use of your Magic immunity.
Then I shall be direct:==W== accept Lady Darcia's allegiance, bind her with a "soul pact," and order her to surrender to HQ.
Let me be perfectly clear, to avoid any ... misunderstanding.==W== Listen well. This is not a request. It is an order. And my rapier is not known for its patience.
Only Darcia and her chosen few can enter this sanctum. Don't expect the Intelligent Plants outside to save you.
Firenze definitely has an angle. But going this far just to force my hand...==W== What's she so desperate about?
A slight sting at my neck. The rapier at my throat trembles for a split second, then snaps back.
Boss, you're insane. Have you no fear of death?
Of course I do. But we don't have time to play games. Besides—
You aren't on Darcia's side, are you?
I've pretty much figured out why you cornered me like this...==W== But I need to hear you say it, Firenze.
You're right. We aren't allies. But tell me...==W== When did you realize?
You left too many loose ends.
Which means==W== this "Anonymous User" tapped my phone today without me noticing.==W== They sent the request,==W== dropped the intel, then deleted me instantly.
As a witch, I've had my share of secret informants.==W== But this is the cleanest job I've ever seen. Didn't feel a thing, can't trace a thing either.==W== Whoever they are, they're a pro.
First off, our internship at Production. The only person who could've "bumped into" Mistique—==W==and had the skills to tap her phone undetected—had to be a combat specialist.
If Ruby and Sapphire were that good, they wouldn't have been humiliated by some Mandrake Radiant Grass.
Wait. If someone sneaks in after the official maintenance, tweaks the settings,==W== then resets them right before the next check...==W== They could do whatever they want, unnoticed!
And finally, despite the chaos Joseph and the others caused, Production didn't lift a finger. As the Director in charge, that silence points straight to you.
Take everyone to the Ash District. Save your explanations for the interrogation room.
For a split second, I honestly thought you were the one pulling the strings behind all this...
Until==W== I saw that map in the VIP room.
Oh? And what did you find?
That was your handwriting on the map, right?==W== You marked the interrogation room in the southwest. Right on the city edge. Hop the wall, and you're in the woods.
So, you were turning a blind eye to our escape... No. You wanted us to run, didn't you?
Bravo. Dealing with smart people saves me so much effort.==W== I'd planned a little "accident" outside the interrogation room, but Darcia beat me to the punch.
Now, my turn. About Nyx, inside that tank...
Nyx? I see.==W== So she really is on your side.
You want me to get her out?
Make no mistake. We accepted that we might be sacrificed for this plan long ago.
Success is our only hope. But victory hinges on HQ's cooperation...==W== And they've dragged their feet long enough to let the whole operation spiral out of control.
Wait...==W== The legion outside. Were they supposed to attack at dawn? Is that why you were watching the sky?
Even if they're a day late, they're close by...==W== We haven't hit a dead end yet, have we?
Hard to say.==W== If they were close, they certainly would have noticed the riot inside.
Yet they sit idle at the Trekker Camp. Either the commander is incompetent, or the troops lack the discipline to attack after a forced march.
Either way, they stand no chance against Darcia.==W== That is why, Boss, I'm offering you a soul pact. Provided you can—
My soul pact doesn't control people. I can't just force a surrender.
She looks loyal, sure, but that loyalty runs on her own twisted logic. She doesn't blindly obey my orders.==W== And where did you hear about "soul pacts," anyway?
Was this broker in a cloak?
Yes. The one based at the Trekker Camp.
Serena. Figures. I'll save my breath, then. I grant a wish, and the price is your soul.
In other words, I take your soul, then I grant your wish.
Yeah. But even with a pact, I can't control Darcia.
I can let the house arrest slide.==W== But hurting my friends? That's where I draw the line. Petal Bloom's exile, Mistique getting hurt—that's all on her.
I was planning to sabotage her crazy scheme anyway. Since our goals align,==W== you don't need a pact. I'll help you.
Are you serious? You'll help me ...==W== for nothing?
Yep.==W== Honestly, I hate using soul pacts myself. So I'm not asking for any payment.
Is that so? Then this negotiation is over. Pretend I never mentioned a partnership.
Huh? What?! Hold on, this isn't a joke!
Do I look like I'm joking?==W== Besides, I refuse to owe anyone favors.
Listen. Without payment, there's no liability.==W== A "price" is the only guarantee that a partner is reliable.
Yet you claim you want nothing. Isn't that just saying==W== you won't take responsibility for the outcome?
I was being too naive...==W== Maybe Firenze's strength is that composure—she never wavers. And also...
So please, my Tyrant, don't become a star once more.
The same old road leads to the same old ends.
Be rational, Firenze.==W== Darcia is a formidable opponent.==W== We need every ounce of combat prowess we can get right now. You should prioritize working with me...
Am I to understand ...==W== that you're begging for my assistance?
Huh?==W== Have our positions just reversed...
Sigh...==W== You be rational. I simply expect you to show the resolve required for this.
Did I not make myself clear? Let's use a more formal term then...==W== "Alliance." Our lives are on the line here,==W== so I need to know you're truly prepared for the consequences.
You're making a soul pact the condition for our partnership?
Precisely. But don't misunderstand. This doesn't mean I trust you.==W== By the way, I heard a rumor that...
Completing a soul pact makes one an official Boss Accord employee.==W== And the Accord protects its staff's souls,==W== granting immunity to harmful mental magic.
Tch...==W== Did Serena leak that to you, too?
No...==W== It was Fuyuka... Darcia asked her about it on the day of the ceremony, and she excitedly spilled every single detail.
Talk about shooting ourselves in the foot...
Heh, you're far too careless. But it works out for me. It proves that the convenient ability granted isn't just a fairy tale.
You want to protect your soul?==W== But why?==W== There are no monsters like the Garden of Parasite here. Does Darcia specialize in mental magic?
You saw it yourself. That Gen-3 Intelligent Plant is no joke. I went all out to test its strength, yet...==W== I was still defeated.
Do you recall what Darcia said?
You've likely deduced its power:==W== transferring human minds and memories.==W== Simply put, placing it in a tank of Psychic Fluid links the subject's consciousness to the network.
Look.==W== At the bottom of that massive tank lies the Bishop.==W== Once we extract it, the Intelligent Plant won't be a threat anymore.
Fishing a chess piece out of a tank that deep won't be easy.
Indeed. We face two main obstacles.==W== First, the key to the lid. Darcia keeps it on her person at all times.
Second, the Psychic Fluid inside is a far more treacherous problem...==W== Even standing next to it exposes you to magic vapors that can warp your mind.
I see. You want to use the Boss Accord's protection to withstand the fluid, so you can dive in and grab the piece?
Precisely. So I will ask one last time.==W== Boss ...==W== make a soul pact with me.
We are so close to defeating Darcia, and her logic is sound, but...
I'm warning you. Anyone who gets in the way of my plan is an enemy.==W== Give me an acceptable reason while I still have patience.
Because I'm weak.==W== If the Intelligent Plants attack while you're down there, who's going to stop it?
I can't buy you that kind of time.
We play to our strengths. The alliance stands, but no soul pact.==W== The reason is simple—
I will be the one==W== diving into the tank.
You're willing to risk your life to beat Darcia; I'm willing to stake mine too.==W== I have magic immunity.==W== That fluid shouldn't affect me.
Hah, looks like your intel isn't perfect.==W== Anyway, leave the piece to me. In exchange, you cover me.==W== If you fail, I'm done for.
Heh...==W== Hahahaha. Very well. Since that is your choice.
Then, Boss, from this moment on, we are allies against Darcia.

Of course I do. But we don't have time to play games. Besides—
You aren't on Darcia's side, are you?
I've pretty much figured out why you cornered me like this...==W== But I need to hear you say it, Firenze.
You're right. We aren't allies. But tell me...==W== When did you realize?
You left too many loose ends.
Which means==W== this "Anonymous User" tapped my phone today without me noticing.==W== They sent the request,==W== dropped the intel, then deleted me instantly.
As a witch, I've had my share of secret informants.==W== But this is the cleanest job I've ever seen. Didn't feel a thing, can't trace a thing either.==W== Whoever they are, they're a pro.
First off, our internship at Production. The only person who could've "bumped into" Mistique—==W==and had the skills to tap her phone undetected—had to be a combat specialist.
If Ruby and Sapphire were that good, they wouldn't have been humiliated by some Mandrake Radiant Grass.
Wait. If someone sneaks in after the official maintenance, tweaks the settings,==W== then resets them right before the next check...==W== They could do whatever they want, unnoticed!
And finally, despite the chaos Joseph and the others caused, Production didn't lift a finger. As the Director in charge, that silence points straight to you.
Take everyone to the Ash District. Save your explanations for the interrogation room.
For a split second, I honestly thought you were the one pulling the strings behind all this...
Until==W== I saw that map in the VIP room.
Oh? And what did you find?
That was your handwriting on the map, right?==W== You marked the interrogation room in the southwest. Right on the city edge. Hop the wall, and you're in the woods.
So, you were turning a blind eye to our escape... No. You wanted us to run, didn't you?
Bravo. Dealing with smart people saves me so much effort.==W== I'd planned a little "accident" outside the interrogation room, but Darcia beat me to the punch.
Now, my turn. About Nyx, inside that tank...
Nyx? I see.==W== So she really is on your side.
You want me to get her out?
Make no mistake. We accepted that we might be sacrificed for this plan long ago.
Success is our only hope. But victory hinges on HQ's cooperation...==W== And they've dragged their feet long enough to let the whole operation spiral out of control.
Wait...==W== The legion outside. Were they supposed to attack at dawn? Is that why you were watching the sky?
Even if they're a day late, they're close by...==W== We haven't hit a dead end yet, have we?
Hard to say.==W== If they were close, they certainly would have noticed the riot inside.
Yet they sit idle at the Trekker Camp. Either the commander is incompetent, or the troops lack the discipline to attack after a forced march.
Either way, they stand no chance against Darcia.==W== That is why, Boss, I'm offering you a soul pact. Provided you can—
My soul pact doesn't control people. I can't just force a surrender.
She looks loyal, sure, but that loyalty runs on her own twisted logic. She doesn't blindly obey my orders.==W== And where did you hear about "soul pacts," anyway?
Was this broker in a cloak?
Yes. The one based at the Trekker Camp.
Serena. Figures. I'll save my breath, then. I grant a wish, and the price is your soul.
In other words, I take your soul, then I grant your wish.
Yeah. But even with a pact, I can't control Darcia.
I can let the house arrest slide.==W== But hurting my friends? That's where I draw the line. Petal Bloom's exile, Mistique getting hurt—that's all on her.
I was planning to sabotage her crazy scheme anyway. Since our goals align,==W== you don't need a pact. I'll help you.
Are you serious? You'll help me ...==W== for nothing?
Yep.==W== Honestly, I hate using soul pacts myself. So I'm not asking for any payment.
Is that so? Then this negotiation is over. Pretend I never mentioned a partnership.
Huh? What?! Hold on, this isn't a joke!
Do I look like I'm joking?==W== Besides, I refuse to owe anyone favors.
Listen. Without payment, there's no liability.==W== A "price" is the only guarantee that a partner is reliable.
Yet you claim you want nothing. Isn't that just saying==W== you won't take responsibility for the outcome?
I was being too naive...==W== Maybe Firenze's strength is that composure—she never wavers. And also...
So please, my Tyrant, don't become a star once more.
The same old road leads to the same old ends.
Be rational, Firenze.==W== Darcia is a formidable opponent.==W== We need every ounce of combat prowess we can get right now. You should prioritize working with me...
Am I to understand ...==W== that you're begging for my assistance?
Huh?==W== Have our positions just reversed...
Sigh...==W== You be rational. I simply expect you to show the resolve required for this.
Did I not make myself clear? Let's use a more formal term then...==W== "Alliance." Our lives are on the line here,==W== so I need to know you're truly prepared for the consequences.
You're making a soul pact the condition for our partnership?
Precisely. But don't misunderstand. This doesn't mean I trust you.==W== By the way, I heard a rumor that...
Completing a soul pact makes one an official Boss Accord employee.==W== And the Accord protects its staff's souls,==W== granting immunity to harmful mental magic.
Tch...==W== Did Serena leak that to you, too?
No...==W== It was Fuyuka... Darcia asked her about it on the day of the ceremony, and she excitedly spilled every single detail.
Talk about shooting ourselves in the foot...
Heh, you're far too careless. But it works out for me. It proves that the convenient ability granted isn't just a fairy tale.
You want to protect your soul?==W== But why?==W== There are no monsters like the Garden of Parasite here. Does Darcia specialize in mental magic?
You saw it yourself. That Gen-3 Intelligent Plant is no joke. I went all out to test its strength, yet...==W== I was still defeated.
Do you recall what Darcia said?
You've likely deduced its power:==W== transferring human minds and memories.==W== Simply put, placing it in a tank of Psychic Fluid links the subject's consciousness to the network.
Look.==W== At the bottom of that massive tank lies the Bishop.==W== Once we extract it, the Intelligent Plant won't be a threat anymore.
Fishing a chess piece out of a tank that deep won't be easy.
Indeed. We face two main obstacles.==W== First, the key to the lid. Darcia keeps it on her person at all times.
Second, the Psychic Fluid inside is a far more treacherous problem...==W== Even standing next to it exposes you to magic vapors that can warp your mind.
I see. You want to use the Boss Accord's protection to withstand the fluid, so you can dive in and grab the piece?
Precisely. So I will ask one last time.==W== Boss ...==W== make a soul pact with me.
We are so close to defeating Darcia, and her logic is sound, but...
I'm warning you. Anyone who gets in the way of my plan is an enemy.==W== Give me an acceptable reason while I still have patience.
Because I'm weak.==W== If the Intelligent Plants attack while you're down there, who's going to stop it?
I can't buy you that kind of time.
We play to our strengths. The alliance stands, but no soul pact.==W== The reason is simple—
I will be the one==W== diving into the tank.
You're willing to risk your life to beat Darcia; I'm willing to stake mine too.==W== I have magic immunity.==W== That fluid shouldn't affect me.
Hah, looks like your intel isn't perfect.==W== Anyway, leave the piece to me. In exchange, you cover me.==W== If you fail, I'm done for.
Heh...==W== Hahahaha. Very well. Since that is your choice.
Then, Boss, from this moment on, we are allies against Darcia.

strings.text: The truth reveals that Firenze's father was framed by Darcia. To take her down, Firenze and Nyx had formed a secret alliance long ago. Now, Firenze trades her soul to you for one wish: "To change United Harvest."
Then, Boss, from this moment on, we are allies against Darcia.
You're the one in the line of fire, though. Going against Darcia and her Intelligent Plant guards all by yourself.
Admittedly, it's precarious. But victory isn't my goal—being the "sacrificial pawn" is.==W== If I stall them long enough for you to secure the chess piece, we turn the tables.
And don't get ahead of yourself.==W== The magic in the Psychic Fluid is leagues above standard spells. Your unique constitution might not save you this time.
Look at you, out cold in that tank without a care in the world. Do you even grasp the gravity of your situation?
Life and death on the line, yet you have the exact same sleeping face you had back in school... It's actually infuriating.
Hah. Considering she's currently "nutrient," a peaceful look beats a painful one. Wait...==W== School? You two were classmates?
Philaen Academy, yes.==W== Can you believe it, Boss? I have known this woman for ten years.
When we first met, the mere thought of breathing the same air as her repulsed me.
Our prestigious school is notoriously difficult to get into,==W== yet she was the only one muddling along and sleeping in class.
One night, I went out for bread and bumped into her at a United Harvest store. That's when I found out—
She was a trainee from the Ash District of another city. The company paid her tuition, but it bound her to the Compliance Department after graduation—==W==low pay, and everyone despises you.
Living costs in the Gold District were extortionate. Since the company covered only tuition, she had to work nights to survive. No wonder she was exhausted in class.
After that, she started copying my notes, pestering me about lectures, even mooching meals at my place. She was such a nuisance.
But back then...==W== Well, I was absorbed in my own world, obsessed with becoming a researcher. I avoided socializing.
Nyx was the only one who would still approach me casually. So, over time... Well, my opinion of her shifted.
Because ...==W== she was an idealist at heart. Always prattling on about improving United Harvest—letting staff leave early, making better tasting food, that sort of thing.
I remember thinking she belonged more in R&D or Operations than Compliance.

But she insisted that joining the Compliance Department was mandatory company policy. It felt so wrong. She should have been the type to rewrite the rules, not blindly follow them. It frustrated me enough to start a fight...
In the end, I gave her an ultimatum: If she couldn't change United Harvest, I would ...==W== on the condition that she supported me with everything she had.
After graduating from Philaen Academy,==W== I went to Grace Light for advanced studies,==W== while she headed straight for HQ.
Our paths diverged, but my faith didn't. I truly believed a bright future awaited us both.==W== Until...
Your Honor. Director Giotto de Feltro is guilty of embezzlement==RT==and the violation of trade secrets.
On behalf of the Compliance Department, I formally submit these charges. We request an immediate ruling.
Who could have guessed? The "birthday party" she invited me to was actually a courtroom trial. And the man on trial ... was my own father.
Father pleaded guilty, but I knew he was innocent.==W== He was fully committed to his Mandrake Radiant Grass. He barely spoke about it to me, let alone spill secrets to a witch.
I am Darcia, Executor of the United Harvest Philae Branch. Stay by my side, and I will grant you the power to crush Nyx.
I took Darcia's offer, suspended my studies at Grace Light,==RT==then returned to Philae, and joined United Harvest.
I resented Nyx, of course, but I was more confused than anything.
I had to find out what was really going on in the company.
Things moved fast. On the eve of the Snowish Festival, Darcia took me==RT==to a company banquet, and it was late by the time I got home.
And there she was. Slumped against my door, passed out cold,==RT==clutching a massive stack of files.

When she woke up, I finally learned the truth. My father's trial was her very first case, and she was shoved the files by her superiors the day before... She had no choice but to read from the script.
During the trial, she found holes in the evidence, but my father pled guilty immediately—==W==trying to protect me, I assume—which robbed her of any chance to object.
She was desperate for the truth too, and started investigating the case alone. That stack of documents she clung to was her proof.==W== And the one pulling the strings ... was Darcia.
Yes. Father refused to weaponize Mandrake Radiant Grass.==W== And he certainly wouldn't agree to this "intelligence transfer" method now.
Darcia saw him as a threat. She used her connections at HQ to set him up. Putting Nyx on the prosecution was her move, too.
Now that everything is out in the open, I no longer have any hesitation.==W== I had buried my hatred for Nyx that night, as we renewed our vow.
All set. We just need to stage a blowout on Snowish Eve, right?
Yeah. The whole company has to see. It's the only way to prove where my loyalty lies.
One fight won't make it stick. You'll probably have to bully me a few more times down the road.
I'll try to go easy on you.
Don't. Make it count. Be ruthless. Act like you actually hate my guts.
By the way... Is Heartlink our only line now?
Yeah. Can't risk talking in real life. I won't even be able to look you in the eye.
But we'll talk properly again one day. Cheers, Miss Rustic Sherlock—to that last lemon soda you bought me.
To clear your father's name? To make Darcia pay?
No, not at all. Revenge would only spark more hatred...==W== To truly break the cycle, you have to cut it off at the source.
So, we decided to make good on the promise we made all those years ago—
If she couldn't change United Harvest, I would... On the condition that she supported me with everything she had.
To make that happen, I chose to bury the past. We're starting from scratch to rebuild our bond.
Hey, you hear that, Nyx? Look at you, sleeping so peacefully... You'd better be ready to work once you wake up.
But changing an entire company... That can't be easy.
You're right. But just because it's hard doesn't mean we back down... I will not give up.
Why go this far? What do you actually get out of changing the company?
What's in it for me...? Perhaps something.==W== But ever since my Academy days, the company hasn't changed one bit. They still treat people like they're disposable.
Because nothing changes, more and more workers get exploited every year.==W== Even the customers who trust us get squeezed dry.
It's reached the point where even those Golden Nightingales you talk about are showing up on the market.
Tell me, Boss...==W== Climbing to the top over other people's misery, just so a select few get to enjoy their lives—do you think that's right?
After they left, their pay was cut drastically. I was still in school... We fell on hard times almost overnight.
But that anonymous compliance inspector saved us, cited a regulation about employee welfare, and got the company to grant us a subsidy.
Seek the truth, spread the truth. That is the code witches live by. And honestly, that is exactly the role society expects us to play.
So...==W== If you really want to protect something, the choice is yours. Do you bury the truth in exchange for peace?==W== Or do you face it head-on, even if it means hurting others?
Toying with people's lives like that…
How could that ever be right!
Heh... You're exactly who I thought you were. And that is why this company must change.
Besides—and this is just my own philosophy—those in power have a duty. The power should be used to serve the people and society.
When people live contented lives, pressure eases and patience grows. From there, kindness will spread from one person to the next.
Cycle of happiness, huh? That's hardly going to be an easy path.
What are you talking about? Boss, isn't that exactly what you've been doing all along?
From Emor to Philae,==W== from the Waterway Stellaroid to the Big Three in the wilds... Haven't you always fought for others' happiness,==W== asking nothing in return?
It certainly isn't an easy path, but it is the one you've chosen to walk.
I'm not that noble. I just happen to hold these pieces—
—the Seals of Grace. Since such power fell into my hands somehow, I have to shoulder the responsibility.
Spoken like a true ruler... Almost makes me want to call you "Your Majesty." But I'll stick to "Boss". Sounds less ancient.
Call me whatever you want. I am who I am. A title is just a label.
In that case, Boss... Just make a soul pact with me.
Hey, hang on. I thought we agreed...
It's not for the same reason as before. You said it yourself, Boss: the path we've chosen isn't an easy one.
So how do we guarantee neither of us strays from it? The only way, I believe, is to bind our souls together.
If you lose your way, I can use my wish to pull you back. And if I turn traitor... Well, you hold my soul.
So that's your angle.==W== Alright, but I have to ask one last thing—are you seriously willing to trade your soul for the happiness of others?
Yes. Why wouldn't I?==W== One soul to make my wish come true... Don't you think that's a bargain?
You gain nothing without sacrifice, without risk. And you... You are an investment worth staking my soul on.
Before I'm certain about that, I might never complete this first mission of yours.
Maybe I was overthinking it. But there's no turning back now. I can't just stand here and let Firenze and the others face those Intelligent Plants alone!
Join me. Let's change United Harvest, together.
And when that wish comes true...
Is that it?==W== For a soul pact, I expected something a bit more...
That's the standard procedure. I hold your soul in trust for now. Once the wish is fulfilled, it becomes mine—permanently.
Understood. A fair trade. And perfect timing. Darcia should be here any minute.
The Intelligent Plants would've alerted Darcia the moment we stepped into the lab.
Frankly, she should have shown herself ages ago... Luckily, another willing "pawn" bought us time. She certainly worked hard to keep things stalled this long.
Your Majesty, Mina approached me seeking to join your ranks. I dared not decide on my own, so I brought her before you.
I heard Lady Darcia speak of ...==W== the future you wish to build, ==SEX12== Tyrant. I realized that is precisely my dream.
Mina, you couldn't lie to save your life. Then again... I'm about to do the same.
Very well. Then you shall serve by my side, along with Darcia.
With me?==W== Your Majesty, does this mean ... you accept my allegiance?
Truth be told, I never intended to turn you away. Everything before was merely a test of your capabilities.
Th-thank you, Your Majesty! I-I'm so moved.
Enough formalities. What's the situation outside the city? I saw smoke rising in the east around noon.
Your Majesty, United Harvest's main force has reached the walls. But worry not. Tomorrow, I'll deploy the Gen-3 Intelligent Plants to crush them.
I'd like to take command personally. Is that okay?
Leave me. I need time alone to plan for tomorrow.
As you command, Your Majesty, but...==W== Why is Firenze here?
Didn't you ask her to look after me? I simply had her escort me here. Is something wrong?
No... That's not what I meant. I merely ask that from now on, Your Majesty always keep Intelligent Plants close.==W== Firenze, you have no objections, do you?
The Intelligent Plants are watching me again. It's going to be harder to act...==W== Thank goodness I allied with Firenze in time. A small mercy in a bad situation.
==SEX12== Tyrant, pardon the interruption, but I have an urgent report.

Your first mission—<color=#3faeae>collecting ten souls</color>—is complete. Your clearance in the Well of Worlds Tyrant Development System has leveled up, granting you a new authority. Please review it.
A new authority?==W== Let's see... I didn't even know it existed.
If I use this right, maybe ...==W== we can defeat Darcia without sacrificing anyone.

With me?==W== Your Majesty, does this mean ... you accept my allegiance?
Truth be told, I never intended to turn you away. Everything before was merely a test of your capabilities.
Th-thank you, Your Majesty! I-I'm so moved.
Enough formalities. What's the situation outside the city? I saw smoke rising in the east around noon.
Your Majesty, United Harvest's main force has reached the walls. But worry not. Tomorrow, I'll deploy the Gen-3 Intelligent Plants to crush them.
I'd like to take command personally. Is that okay?
Leave me. I need time alone to plan for tomorrow.
As you command, Your Majesty, but...==W== Why is Firenze here?
Didn't you ask her to look after me? I simply had her escort me here. Is something wrong?
No... That's not what I meant. I merely ask that from now on, Your Majesty always keep Intelligent Plants close.==W== Firenze, you have no objections, do you?
The Intelligent Plants are watching me again. It's going to be harder to act...==W== Thank goodness I allied with Firenze in time. A small mercy in a bad situation.
==SEX12== Tyrant, pardon the interruption, but I have an urgent report.

Your first mission—<color=#3faeae>collecting ten souls</color>—is complete. Your clearance in the Well of Worlds Tyrant Development System has leveled up, granting you a new authority. Please review it.
A new authority?==W== Let's see... I didn't even know it existed.
If I use this right, maybe ...==W== we can defeat Darcia without sacrificing anyone.

strings.text: The HQ’s Legion stalls over unpaid wages; the Plants drift into an afternoon slumber under the influence of Nyx. With the march suspended, you order Firenze to regroup with others for a counterattack...
Inspector Jayhawk, are the troops ready? Can we move out today?
Ugh... Well, it's a bit of a mess. Right at the crunch, too. They're making a scene—saying they won't budge without their "assault stipend."
Assault stipend? If they want a bonus, tell them they'll get paid after we take Philae.
Not a bonus, sir. A stipend. We gotta put cold, hard Dorra in their hands now. No cash, no march.
... Enough.<size=50> How did our company army come to this?
As for "when"... It's been standard practice for five years. Assault stipend, magic usage fee, garrison pay, overtime...
Basically, if we want them to do anything, they need to see the Dorra.
Are they any different from temp workers? Sigh. Where are the fearless soldiers of the past? The ones who valued honor over life itself?
Gone with the missing payroll, I'd guess. Last I heard, these legions haven't been paid in six months.
Taking over these three legions was clearly a mistake.==W== Fine. Inspector Jayhawk, go to the nearest branch and secure the funds. How long will it take?
I don't mind! But with travel time... A round trip is a week, minimum. Despite the look, I'm just a delicate flower, you know? Can't rush.
Hmph... Sending a lady that far is improper. But ...==W== do you expect the Commander to go beg for wages personally? It would tarnish my elegant image.
Your Majesty, the map.==W== Our forces—30,000 upgraded Gen-3 Intelligent Plants—are deployed along the river, awaiting orders.
30,000 upgrades in one night... That's fast.
Mina, do we have a read on the three United Harvest legions?
Confirmed. We are facing the 3rd, 4th, and 5th Elite Legions. Ten years back, these units crushed a company army twice their size in a head-on collision.
Based on the roster, we are looking at 31,000 total personnel, 25,000 of them combat-ready.
Plants' recon puts the HQ at the Trekker Camp.==W== The legions are dug in to the North, East, and South.==W== No signs of aggressive movement yet.
They are branded "elite," but their prime was a decade ago. Aside from the NCOs, the grunts must be fresh recruits. Hard to say if the reputation still holds up.
The real danger is that they shoot Mistique on sight. If they storm Philae blind, the city gets leveled, and civilians get butchered.
In that case, priority one is containment. Not a single one of them inside city limits.
Darcia, detach 1,000 Gen-3s. Engage the enemy. Test their reflexes.
Ignoring her phone, Darcia strides to the Lithe Grass Mother. She unlocks the tank and plunges her hand into the solution, wincing in pain.
The Mother shudders in its tank, as if acknowledging a signal.
Shh! Keep it down! We're on recon. You want to get us spotted?
Who cares? No wages, no stipend... You expect us to fight on an empty stomach? I'm doing the bare minimum.
I get it, but we're exposed here. Ambush could happen any second. Save the gripping for when we get back.
What the hell are these things?! They're too fast to hit!
Damn, they're swarming us...! Comms, get backup! Now!
It... It's hopeless! We can't win!==W== Run for it!
Your Majesty. In two hours, our thousand plants routed five battalions—nearly 4,000. We lost fewer than 200.
With results like these, why halt the offense? If we commit the rest of the Intelligent Plants, HQ's three legions would crumble.
No.==W== If we go all-in, we're the ones who lose. Know why?
We call them "Intelligent," but they act on the mind of their "nutrient." They've picked up Nyx's habits, including the afternoon nap.
Lady Darcia, ==SEX12== Tyrant. Quick count on the three hundred units guarding the lab: two-thirds are out cold, the rest are dozing off. Combat effectiveness is zero.
I... I had no idea...==W== My apologies, Your Majesty! I failed to predict how the upgrade would alter their behavior.
Gen-3 is powerful, but arrogance creates blind spots.==W== Darcia, we need a tactic to force a surrender.
Surrender...==W== I see. You want them for the Tyrant Army. Though, honestly, human soldiers are worthless compared to the plants.
It's not about manpower. It's a display of strength to the other companies. Mercy requires far more power than annihilation.
<size=37>We also need to control the narrative. This isn't <size=45>a Tyrant Army invasion.<size=37> It's an internal dispute between<size=45> Philae Branch<size=37> and HQ. This version protects us.
If Nova hears the Tyrant declared war, our list of enemies will grow exponentially.
Your foresight is awe-inspiring, Your Majesty. But ...==W== there is one thing I don't understand...
You spared New Star Guild for old time's sake.==W== You treat the branch staff well to keep the peace.
But why show mercy to the enemy? If HQ were winning, they wouldn't hesitate to crush us.
No one is born evil. Those soldiers are just ordinary people, moved by the Senate's hand.
Besides, these Plants have infinite potential. That is why we must use this power for good—==W==to make the world a little better.
Ruling by brute force, like United Harvest, earns no respect or loyalty.
Technically, I'm manipulating Darcia to buy us time for a counterattack... But I meant every word I just said.
I still don't know why Darcia worships the "Legendary Tyrant." But if I can figure out the root of that faith...
F-forgive me. I lost my composure and spoke out of turn...
No matter what comes, I pledge my life to you, Your Majesty. Just ...==W== pardon my rudeness, but I find myself quite exhausted. May I take my leave?
Of course. You've worked hard. Go get some rest.==W== Since I have Mina here, I'll send Firenze out tomorrow to field-test the Gen-3 Intelligent Plants. That work for you?
Hm? Darcia's finally gone, and thanks to Nyx, the plants are sound asleep. Why is everyone still quiet?
Apologies.==W== Your words ... struck a chord. Anyway. What's the mission?
Protect Mistique. And climb the Monolith.
Darcia's ambitions aren't our only problem. The three legions from HQ are acting suspiciously, too.

I'm raiding the Trekker Camp at dawn. I'll minimize casualties,==W== but I can't control every single plant. Mistique is badly hurt; getting her out safely will be tricky. I'm trusting you to handle it.
That part I get. But why climb the Monolith?
Heh. Being the Boss of the Boss Accord has its privileges. Or rather...==W== Let's just say I've unlocked a new authority.
You know how the Monolith grants Trekkers extra Grace? Big combat boost, but only while they're inside.
Naturally. But that power vanishes the moment you step out, so I never gave it much thought.
True, but you're my employee now. What if I told you==W== that you could keep that power for a full day outside?
Boss, do you realize what you're saying? That...==W== That would overturn the whole Trekker industry. No—it would change Nova itself.
Exactly. If word gets out, the world will descend into chaos. So...==W== Let's keep this between us.
I've updated Petal Bloom and New Star via Heartlink. Firenze, meet New Star on the lake island tomorrow afternoon. You'll climb with them.
Power up inside. Then, early on the 8th, we strike from both sides—hit Darcia, grab the key, and end all this.
Wringing every drop of utility out of me...==W== Fascinating scheme. Very well. I'll play my part.
Appreciated. Just don't overdo it.==W== I'm counting on you to scout our infiltration route for tomorrow night.
We're in a match with no retreat. As a player of this match, you should be ready to sacrifice a pawn like me if it secures the win. See you later.
If you're on board, maybe drop the aggressive attitude...==W== Now, Mina. What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be home watching your sisters?
I got worried... Came to check on everyone. But on the way, Mistique messaged me... She's in trouble. I-I found Firenze, and she said Mistique was shot down.
Part of me wants to run back to my sisters, but...
So...==W== If you really want to protect something, the choice is yours. Do you bury the truth in exchange for peace?==W== Or do you face it head-on, even if it means hurting others?
I'm not a witch or a Trekker. I can't put my life on the line like you do. But...==W== I am a United Harvest staff member. This involves me too.
I may not be a hero...==W== But I want to protect this company in my own way. When I see Mistique, I want to look her in the eye and say I faced the truth—and this is my answer.
Heh... I get it. I see your resolve—your justice.==W== But the danger is real. Stay close; I don't trust Darcia not to try something if you're alone.
Your Majesty. Our forces are prepared to commence the assault on your order.
Firenze has also taken a position at the Trekker Camp perimeter to monitor the Plants.
Then let's begin. Unleash the Gen-3 Intelligent Plants. We need to utterly crush their will to fight.
