strings.text: Crossing the battlefield, Firenze reunites with Petal Bloom and New Star. After establishing mutual trust, the group enters the Monolith to gain additional power. Meanwhile, Darcia has Mina sign a certain "document"...
How do we defeat 'em?! Blades, arrows... Nothing's making a dent!
Burn 'em! I heard that's how the Trekkers cleared the Garden of Parasite.
You insane? This place is a tinderbox! You'll roast us all alive!
They're gonna overrun the camp at this rate... Nazuka, Nazuna, what's the move?
Do you even have to ask?! We grab Mistique and bail before we get boxed in!
Easy now. I know they look terrifying, but watch...
See? They're not attacking. Just disarmed the soldiers and left... We're safer if we sit tight.
Y-yeah, guess they aren't dangerous... Haha, maybe Boss sent backup to clear the field?
Not a plant. That's a person.
A United Harvest uniform...==W== You released these things, don't you?
Good day. I am Firenze, Operations Director for the United Harvest Philae Branch. I assume ==PLAYER_NAME== mentioned I'd be coming.
Yeah, ==SEX== said someone from United Harvest would pay a visit.
Just didn't expect it to be a big shot Director...
So what do you want? I'll be real—after that Lady Gray mess, your rep is pretty much trash around here.
Heh.==W== You certainly don't mince words with your hospitality.
Firenze is trustworthy. She is the one who cleared our names regarding the Lady Gray rumors.
O-oh, really...==W== Guess she might be one of the good ones, then.
I am no good person. Let's say Boss and I have aligned interests.==W== Clearing your names was simply business—compensation for your trouble.
Now, we must address the Intelligent Plant crisis at its source.
I am here to coordinate our next step: infiltrating the underground lab tomorrow at dawn.
Also, since you will be entering the Monolith to claim its Grace,==W== I can look after Miss Mistique while she remains unconscious.
Can't believe you actually found us...
Hardly difficult. It's a small island. If you sweep the forest sector by sector, you are bound to stumble upon the Monolith entrance eventually.
But we've been re-entering the Monolith every half hour to force the entrance to shift...
I anticipated that variable, which is precisely why I swarmed the area with search teams.
Hold your fire. Boss has them under control.
Correct. To spare the city from senseless slaughter, Boss feigned an alliance with Darcia. ==SEX1== is using the plants to force the HQ legions to land.
I assume Boss briefed you? About entering the Monolith to claim the Grace within?
Master did say that... But leaving the Monolith with our powers intact? I... I honestly still can't believe it.
It's just... We can't be sure you're really helping us.
Vigilant. I'd expect nothing less from Boss's subordinates.
Proof of my allegiance...? I admit, I have none.==W== And since Boss is with Darcia, calling for verification isn't exactly an option.
Wait, didn't Nyx leave you with anything?
We never coordinated this, but knowing how prepared she always is, I'm sure she foresaw this standoff.
Hold onto it for me. If you ever hit a dead end and can't decide, open it up.==W== The answer's inside.
The pillow... Nyx said to open it if we couldn't decide.
A pillow?==W== Heh. That's Nyx for you...==W== Well? What's inside?
I-I'm opening it.==W== There's ... a photo?
You can trust the person in this photo unconditionally. —Nyx
Huh. Doesn't look much like you now, but yeah...==W== That is definitely you.
M-my ID photo...==W== How on earth did she get her hands on that...
I'll have it back. Anyway... Are we done questioning me?
Since ==PLAYER_NAME== and Nyx both vouch for you... Fine. We trust you. Clock's ticking—let's get climbing!
Indeed. However, I have practically zero field experience inside the Monolith. I shall be relying on your guidance.
No sweat! Leave it to us.==W== After all, we've got—
Given Noya's Grace, she should lead...==W== Actually, no. Fuyuka should take point. Philae is her turf.
Also, with Firenze here, we can split into two squads. Fuyuka, Noya, Amber—you go together. Firenze, you're with me.
Ever since ==PLAYER_NAME== said we could carry our Grace outside, Iris has been crunching numbers on how to max out our potential.
Firenze, you're part of the crew now. Let's just trust the plan and roll with it.
Heh...==W== It has been a long time since I felt like this. Boss... I must admit, I envy you.
Mina, I must admit, I envy you.
Lady Darcia, please don't make fun of me. I'm just a regular employee. What is there to envy?
Comparing myself to you... Honestly, I wouldn't dare.==W== You are far more vital than I'll ever be—both to United Harvest and to ==SEX12== Tyrant.
It took until today for me to realize I've been on the wrong path all along.
You, Firenze...==W== It's people with pure hearts like yours who truly belong by the Tyrant's side.
Um, Lady Darcia? I have no idea what you're talking about. I just came back to grab ==SEX12== Tyrant's pajamas.
Perhaps it's better you don't.==W== Here, look at this document. If you find the terms acceptable, sign it.
This is... Why are you giving this to me?
Neither the Tyrant nor the high-and-mighty Firenze would care for these. I'd rather leave them with someone who will actually cherish them.
You understand the price, don't you?
We call them "Intelligent," but they act on the mind of their "nutrient." They've picked up Nyx's habits, including the afternoon nap.
Then... Please, Lady Darcia. I leave the task of supporting the Tyrant in your hands.
I'll use your will as the nutrient...
... to ensure this ideal takes root.

Comparing myself to you... Honestly, I wouldn't dare.==W== You are far more vital than I'll ever be—both to United Harvest and to ==SEX12== Tyrant.
It took until today for me to realize I've been on the wrong path all along.
You, Firenze...==W== It's people with pure hearts like yours who truly belong by the Tyrant's side.
Um, Lady Darcia? I have no idea what you're talking about. I just came back to grab ==SEX12== Tyrant's pajamas.
Perhaps it's better you don't.==W== Here, look at this document. If you find the terms acceptable, sign it.
This is... Why are you giving this to me?
Neither the Tyrant nor the high-and-mighty Firenze would care for these. I'd rather leave them with someone who will actually cherish them.
You understand the price, don't you?
We call them "Intelligent," but they act on the mind of their "nutrient." They've picked up Nyx's habits, including the afternoon nap.
Then... Please, Lady Darcia. I leave the task of supporting the Tyrant in your hands.
I'll use your will as the nutrient...
... to ensure this ideal takes root.

strings.text: The Plant army, empowered by Mina, stalls your lab assault. Firenze attempts a surprise attack, only to discover that Darcia had altered her body. As you dive into the tank, Darcia transforms into the "Lithe Beauty"...
Your strategy was flawless. Our armies crushed three of HQ's legions.==W== The enemy is crumbled, scattering toward nearby cities in disarray.
As ordered, the Intelligent Plants used non-lethal force.==W== We simply neutralized the officers and seized their weapons and supplies.
It's finally over. Fighting all day really takes it out of you... Great work, everyone.==W== How's the city?
The citizens are sheltering safely at home. As requested, the Intelligent Plants are standing guard and distributing necessities.
However...==W== We're short on Gen-3 units. I had to redeploy this facility's guards to the city. Please forgive the security gap here.
It's fine. I've got you two to keep me safe, don't I?
By the way, where is Mina?
Your Majesty, she was exhausted from working all evening, so I sent her to bed.==W== She's resting in a secure location, don't worry.
Explosions? Firenze, what's happening out there?
Unclear. The Plants say...==W== Intruders breached the greenhouses. They're attacking the underground lab's gate.
What can I hold you with? I offer you fresh leaves,==RT==stalled crossbow bolts, and shards of razor-sharp stone.
I offer you slumber granted by the wild spirits.
If Boss is held captive and cannot come to me...==W== Then I shall go to ==SEX4==.
Master...==W== Master is amazing! We actually brought Grace out of the Monolith!
Ventus magic coats my blade, blasting everywhere.==W== With this power, those Intelligent Plants don't stand a chance.
Noya and Nazuka made it...==W== With them, Firenze, and my new authority, we have a real shot at taking down Darcia.
Your Majesty. I'm impressed your ex-subordinates infiltrated this deep. They are far more competent than those useless United Harvest grunts.
Though, eventually...==W== They're just moths flying to a flame.
Human sleep cycles are woefully inefficient.==W== So, Mina and I signed a contract.==W== Now she enjoys eternal rest in the tank, providing us a constant stream of spirit and memory data.
The Gen-3 Intelligent Plants—powered only by Nyx—had raw power, but lacked coordination.
Now that I've added a trace of Mina to the mix, their teamwork is flawless.
They're twisting their vines together ... into spears?
And that tight formation!==W== Tsk...==W== This is gonna be a headache.
Whoa, hey!==W== Since when did these weeds learn how to work as a team?
Your Majesty, see that? Once we patched the flaws, our Intelligent Plants became invincible.
I know you're sentimental.==W== Let me preserve your ex-subordinates in tanks, too.
You can visit them daily.==W== After all,==W== nothing beats the loyalty of a specimen in a tank.
... Firenze? Hah. What is the meaning of this? I believe your rapier has found the wrong target.
No. I have been waiting for this exact moment, and this rapier was sharpened specifically for you.
... So, you are determined to stand in my way.==RT==How disappointing.
I thought a woman betrayed by her closest ally would do anything to reshape this filthy world.
I don't get it, Firenze.==RT==She stabbed you in the back. Why do you still care?
Heh... Heheh. Fine. Since she's so important to you, how about I put you in charge of her tank?
Hahahaha! Just kidding. I wouldn't be that cruel.==RT==Tell you what—I'll put you in the tank with her. That way you can be together forever ... serving me until you rot.
Hmph. I expected a real argument.==RT==Yet it's all meaningless drivel.
Drivel? Ouch. I was offering you a gift.==RT==I'll admit, that Nazuka and Petal Bloom are quite capable. My Gen-3 Intelligent Plants are actually struggling.
But if I toss a premium nutrient like you into the mix? We'd see a 4th generation evolve. That will put the reins back in my hands.
And you think I'll just play along?
Obedience would be nice, but I know you.==RT==Pity. Looks like Nyx will have to work overtime.
Since you won't volunteer as the nutrient, I'd have to crank up the ... extraction rate on what I have.
Ah, but of course, it comes with a risk.==RT==Drain it too fast ... and Nyx's soul burns out in a flash.
And she'll suffer every second of it because you said no.
Careful. Lose your cool, and you lose your life.
Ah! ==SEX12== Tyrant! Why throw yourself in danger?! I cannot allow harm to come to you... Please, I beg you, stand back!
==SEX12== Tyrant... Are you shielding this traitor?
This wasn't in the plan... Hm? I said I could be your pawn, but I never said you could step onto the board yourself.
I'm not the kind of player who watches from the sidelines.
And I don't treat my partners as expendable pawns!
Ah... I see... So that's it... I understand now, ==SEX12== Tyrant. That wretch has poisoned your mind...
Fear not, my Tyrant. I will purge this filth for you at once! Once I grind her into nutrients, everything will be—
Heh. Don't take it personally. I just don't have time to listen to your preaching.
And another thing. Stop comparing me to yourself.
I never thought of this world as "filthy." You want to reshape reality, but your hatred doesn't come from some grand betrayal...
It stems from the fact that no one has ever loved you. Tell me, has anyone ever truly loved you?
Hah... Of course! The Tyrant loves me! My Tyrant loves me more than anyone else alive!
I am ==SEX3== most devoted servant! No one understands ==SEX4== like I do... I adore ==SEX4==, so naturally, ==SEX== loves me in return!
Ah... ==SEX12== Tyrant! Allow me to prove it to you right now—
Hahaha! I told you, didn't I? Your rapier has found the wrong target. You cannot kill me, Firenze.
This body is one with the plant now. It has no fear of your blade!
You could never comprehend my devotion to ==SEX12== Tyrant! Your betrayal, you deluding the Tyrant... It is all nothing but a trial the Tyrant has bestowed upon me!
And once I overcome this trial, my love—and my loyalty—will be proven absolute!
What did you just take from me?
I never thought you'd go so far as to modify your own body into a plant. That's also why your senses have dulled.
The rest is up to you—Boss!
Firenze flings a green key she swiped from Darcia's cloak high into the air.==RT==It lands in my palm.
Your Majesty, what are you doing?
Hmph. Taking your eyes off me? You must have confidence to spare.
Insolent brat! Plants, attack!==W== Kill Firenze!==W== She isn't even fit to be your nutrient!
Outside, the Intelligent Plants suddenly cease combat.==RT==Disregarding damage, they try to retreat to Darcia's side.
Plants, stand down.==W== By order of the Tyrant.
Darcia...==W== Did you forget that Mina was obsessed with the rules?
In your system, the Tyrant's word is law. Heh...==W== To plants that assimilated Mina's mind, your words mean nothing next to the Tyrant's command.
Huff... Huff... Finally made it up here.
I scale the iron ladder to the top of the tank and turn the emerald key==RT==to unlock the heavy lid.
Psychic Fluid...==W== The Bishop must be right at the bottom of this tank.

<color=#bd3059><size=52>Help me...</size>==RT==<size=45>It burns...</size><size=30> Make it stop...</size>==RT==<size=32>Anyone...</size>==RT==<size=58>Hate...</size>==RT==<size=32>Love...</size>==RT==<size=52>Gone...</size><size=32> I can't see...</size></color>
Ugh—==W==I'm supposed to be immune to magic. How are these voices forcing their way into my head?==W== What is this stuff?
Your Majesty! What are you doing?! Get down from there!
You have no protection!==W== That Psychic Fluid will dissolve your memories instantly!
My immunity==W== might not be enough==W== to save me this time.
Losing my memories...==W== I'd just end up right back where I started—==W==waking up lost in that desert...
Heh.==W== That doesn't sound so scary.
Even if I lose everything,==W== even if I'm all alone,==W== my friends will find me. They'll bring me back.
Whether I'm the company's Boss,==W== the legendary Tyrant,==W== or just some passing Trekker...
This==W== is the path==W== I choose.
Y-Your Majesty...==W== What have you done?
How dare you...==W== Firenze! If ==SEX=='s harmed in any way, you'll pay for it with your life!
Darcia's magic streaks past Firenze, slamming into the tank holding==RT==the Lithe Grass Mother.
The thick glass shatters. The massive creature surges out, coiling==RT==around Darcia and fusing with her body.
Firenze!==W== With this perfect form—united with the Lithe Grass—==W==I'll send you to your grave!

strings.text: Within the jar lies Darcia's fragmented memories: a girl shunned after her family’s sudden fall, clinging to the legend of the Tyrant for hope. In the end, you claim the Bishop piece, while she meets the end with bitter regret...
Bubbles trail from my lips as I dive into the tank and kick hard for the bottom.
Visibility's awful down here. Where's that Bishop piece...?
You must be the new president! I heard you're from Philae—what a beautiful city. Always wanted to visit.
Wow, this greenhouse is gorgeous. Thank you for bringing the beauty of Philae to our Grace Light Academy.
Are you into gardening?==W== Me too! Do you mind if I tag along and help tend the flowers?
Thank you for the monthly funding support. We won't let you down!
I can't thank you enough for sorting out my father's job. I'll never forget this kindness.
The voices are getting clearer. Is the fluid's magic getting to my head?==W== No...==W== My body feels fine.
Focus. Need to find the Bishop.
President! How should I transplant this one? Could you show me?
To protect the roots, dig wide from the outside. Carefully lift the entire root ball, soil and all.
President, why three seeds per hole? Isn't that wasteful?
It guarantees germination. If all three sprout, we can just thin them out later.
I see! There's a real science to gardening, isn't there?
Why am I messing around with these plants? And where did this gardening trivia come from...?
I see...==W== This must be someone else's memory. I'm just a passenger here.
Hey, hear the news? They're holding a snap election for Student Council President.
Huh? Why? Didn't we literally just have an election?
You're seriously out of the loop.==W==<size=80%> The President's dad got into a brawl at the United Harvest Senate meeting—beat another Senator to death.</size>
Doesn't that make him a murderer??!
Exactly. Grace Light Academy can't have a killer's child running the Student Council.==W== The election's probably rigged, anyway. Bet the winner's from Grace Imperium.
From that day on, the Academy's small greenhouse goes quiet. The only sound is from a garden spade turning soil.
Digging away like this is actually kind of therapeutic.
I get the feeling the owner of this memory never cared about being the Student Council President anyway.
Hurry up. We need to rip all these flowers out.
The Grace Imperium and United Harvest feud is totally public now. If people know we used to hang out with her, we'll be blacklisted.
Look, I'm grateful she helped my dad, but her family drama is a completely separate issue.
She funded all our activities, too...==W== She was such a nice person. How'd it end up like this?
That's low...==W== How can they say that?
Hey! What are you doing?==W== Someone worked hard to grow those. How can you destroy them?!
It's a shame, sure. The plants are innocent...==W== But once the president changes, this place gets bulldozed anyway.
Yeah, the greenhouse is doomed sooner or later. Can't really blame us.
But the two girls ignore me completely, swinging their hoes and tearing up the garden.
My hand swipes at the hoe but passes right through the handle, clutching nothing but air.==W== The girls make quick work of the last flower, dust off their hands, and leave.
So I am just a spectator in this story==W== after all?
Th...==W== Thank you... You're very kind.
I turn to find a slender, shadowy figure standing right where I was a moment ago.
Yes, but ...==W== please don't stick up for me. If you do, they'll just paint you as a villain too.
The figure passes through me to pick up a fallen leaf, tucking it carefully inside a sketchbook.
That symbol on the cover...==W== Isn't that the Tyrant's mark?!
Hehe.==W== Without my dramatic attire,==W== you barely recognize me, do you, Your Majesty?
We are inside my memories.==W== I assume this is the Psychic Fluid at work...==W== No, not that artificial sludge.
It must be your Bishop piece==W== bridging the gap==W== between our souls.
I count myself fortunate==W== to be linked with Your Majesty's soul==W== in these final moments.
That person just now...==W== Was that you back in school?

Yes.==W== My father was a Senator for United Harvest.==W== He gave his life eliminating the company's rivals during the conflict with Grace Imperium,==W== yet,==W== the Senate refused to honor his sacrifice.==W== Instead, they picked my family's fortune clean like vultures.
The classmates who used to flock to me for favors vanished overnight.==W== They mirrored the Senate to turn on me,==W== bullying and mocking me.
At first, I dismissed them as fools who got off on tormenting the weak.==W== I told myself I still had my garden. Even if every human on earth betrayed me, my plants never would.
But when they uprooted my flowerbeds,==W== I realized I was wrong.==W== They weren't trying to get anything from me. They weren't even doing it for fun.
They bullied me simply to feel safe.
<size=85%>"You were way too cozy with the ex-President.==RT==Keep talking to her, and people get the wrong idea."
<size=85%>"If anyone finds out we used to be friends, I'll get dragged down with her."
Fear of isolation. Desperate for acceptance. Humans need a herd to feel secure,==W== and they'll happily throw their own to the wolves to stay in it.==W== We truly are pathetic creatures.
In the wreckage of my garden, I found a book.==W== Heh. I imagine you can guess what was inside?
Exactly. It was your story. In your story,==W== "You" suffered just like I did—betrayed time and again by those closest to you,==W== yet always rising to fight back. Your resilience spoke to me.
You became my light. Because of the Tyrant,==W== I found the strength to gather the stones they cast at me==W== and use them to pave my path to power.
Swearing loyalty to Your Majesty was only natural.==W== Bringing plants into your Legion, granting them minds of their own...==W== This is how I atone for the innocent flowers I failed to protect.
Most importantly—==W==unlike people, plants always return your care with beauty.
It may take decades, maybe centuries...==W== But I will perfect this army step by step. I won't let you down, Your Majesty.
If only we could move everyone's souls into plant vessels...==W== Imagine what a peaceful, tranquil world we'd finally have.
You're romanticizing them.==W== Parasitic vines bleed their hosts dry, and climbers choke the very trees that support them just to steal the light.
Walnut leaves poison the soil to kill rivals.==W== Even the gaps in a forest canopy are just borders in a constant war for territory.
Darcia, that garden of peace you're imagining... It doesn't exist.
Just like your "light."==W== The Tyrant you worship isn't the person standing before you now.
You want me ...==W== to be the Tyrant from your fantasies.==W== But I'm just me.==W== I can never be the idol you've built in your mind.
I know, Your Majesty.==W== I've been watching you since the moment you stepped through our doors.
But I couldn't admit it. If I did, I'd be alone again.==W== After finally finding a ray of hope...==W== How could I possibly bear to let it go?
Heh... Hahaha.==W== Deep down, I know. I'm no different from the humans I despise, forcing my delusions onto others just to feel a false sense of security.
Is that how you really feel?==W== You're right, humans are cowards. We're afraid of so many things.
But we're also capable of courage. We fight tooth and nail to conquer that fear for the sake of our ideals.
Admitting our inadequacy and still striving for a better future. Isn't that a strength in itself?
To me, such humanity is beautiful.
Darcia, stop this. It's not too late.==W== No one died in the chaos in Philae.==W== You still have a chance to make amends.
A wretch like me doesn't deserve such kindness. Heh...==W== You really are the ==SEX12== Tyrant I always admired.
But I'm already too far gone. I've merged myself with the cultivation tank ages ago to develop the Gen-2 Intelligent Plant.
This form you see before you is the last shred of my humanity.
Darcia...==W== Why...==W== Why go this far?
I put Firenze through the same hell I faced, yet ...==W== she was luckier. She had loyal friends.
Heh...==W== All I ever wanted was to be loved.==W== To be needed.==W== To be told that==W== my existence wasn't a mistake.
But seeing the people you choose to stand by your side...==W== I realized I could never be one of them. I've strayed too far from the path.
So this is it...==W== The end of Darcia.
But I made my peace long ago. I seek no redemption.==W== I despise humanity, and I'll remain its enemy until my dying breath.
Grant me one last wish.==W== Take the chess piece ... and end me. With your own hands.
I can't stand by your side, but remember this:==W== every other company in this world is your enemy.
The piece...==W== I've got the Bishop...!
Huff, huff... I'm back.==W== Firenze, how long was I under?
A minute, maybe?==W== I'm not sure. Definitely no more than two.
Wait, never mind that.==W== Where's Darcia? Where is she?!
Right there. Looks like ...==W== she entered the tank a while ago. She's fused with the Lithe Grass Mother.
<size=70%><alpha=#AA>Forgive me, Your Majesty. I can no longer see or hear.
<size=70%><alpha=#66>If only I'd met you sooner... Maybe I wouldn't have lost my way...

Hey, hear the news? They're holding a snap election for Student Council President.
Huh? Why? Didn't we literally just have an election?
You're seriously out of the loop.==W==<size=80%> The President's dad got into a brawl at the United Harvest Senate meeting—beat another Senator to death.</size>
Doesn't that make him a murderer??!
Exactly. Grace Light Academy can't have a killer's child running the Student Council.==W== The election's probably rigged, anyway. Bet the winner's from Grace Imperium.
From that day on, the Academy's small greenhouse goes quiet. The only sound is from a garden spade turning soil.
Digging away like this is actually kind of therapeutic.
I get the feeling the owner of this memory never cared about being the Student Council President anyway.
Hurry up. We need to rip all these flowers out.
The Grace Imperium and United Harvest feud is totally public now. If people know we used to hang out with her, we'll be blacklisted.
Look, I'm grateful she helped my dad, but her family drama is a completely separate issue.
She funded all our activities, too...==W== She was such a nice person. How'd it end up like this?
That's low...==W== How can they say that?
Hey! What are you doing?==W== Someone worked hard to grow those. How can you destroy them?!
It's a shame, sure. The plants are innocent...==W== But once the president changes, this place gets bulldozed anyway.
Yeah, the greenhouse is doomed sooner or later. Can't really blame us.
But the two girls ignore me completely, swinging their hoes and tearing up the garden.
My hand swipes at the hoe but passes right through the handle, clutching nothing but air.==W== The girls make quick work of the last flower, dust off their hands, and leave.
So I am just a spectator in this story==W== after all?
Th...==W== Thank you... You're very kind.
I turn to find a slender, shadowy figure standing right where I was a moment ago.
Yes, but ...==W== please don't stick up for me. If you do, they'll just paint you as a villain too.
The figure passes through me to pick up a fallen leaf, tucking it carefully inside a sketchbook.
That symbol on the cover...==W== Isn't that the Tyrant's mark?!
Hehe.==W== Without my dramatic attire,==W== you barely recognize me, do you, Your Majesty?
We are inside my memories.==W== I assume this is the Psychic Fluid at work...==W== No, not that artificial sludge.
It must be your Bishop piece==W== bridging the gap==W== between our souls.
I count myself fortunate==W== to be linked with Your Majesty's soul==W== in these final moments.
That person just now...==W== Was that you back in school?

Yes.==W== My father was a Senator for United Harvest.==W== He gave his life eliminating the company's rivals during the conflict with Grace Imperium,==W== yet,==W== the Senate refused to honor his sacrifice.==W== Instead, they picked my family's fortune clean like vultures.
The classmates who used to flock to me for favors vanished overnight.==W== They mirrored the Senate to turn on me,==W== bullying and mocking me.
At first, I dismissed them as fools who got off on tormenting the weak.==W== I told myself I still had my garden. Even if every human on earth betrayed me, my plants never would.
But when they uprooted my flowerbeds,==W== I realized I was wrong.==W== They weren't trying to get anything from me. They weren't even doing it for fun.
They bullied me simply to feel safe.
<size=85%>"You were way too cozy with the ex-President.==RT==Keep talking to her, and people get the wrong idea."
<size=85%>"If anyone finds out we used to be friends, I'll get dragged down with her."
Fear of isolation. Desperate for acceptance. Humans need a herd to feel secure,==W== and they'll happily throw their own to the wolves to stay in it.==W== We truly are pathetic creatures.
In the wreckage of my garden, I found a book.==W== Heh. I imagine you can guess what was inside?
Exactly. It was your story. In your story,==W== "You" suffered just like I did—betrayed time and again by those closest to you,==W== yet always rising to fight back. Your resilience spoke to me.
You became my light. Because of the Tyrant,==W== I found the strength to gather the stones they cast at me==W== and use them to pave my path to power.
Swearing loyalty to Your Majesty was only natural.==W== Bringing plants into your Legion, granting them minds of their own...==W== This is how I atone for the innocent flowers I failed to protect.
Most importantly—==W==unlike people, plants always return your care with beauty.
It may take decades, maybe centuries...==W== But I will perfect this army step by step. I won't let you down, Your Majesty.
If only we could move everyone's souls into plant vessels...==W== Imagine what a peaceful, tranquil world we'd finally have.
You're romanticizing them.==W== Parasitic vines bleed their hosts dry, and climbers choke the very trees that support them just to steal the light.
Walnut leaves poison the soil to kill rivals.==W== Even the gaps in a forest canopy are just borders in a constant war for territory.
Darcia, that garden of peace you're imagining... It doesn't exist.
Just like your "light."==W== The Tyrant you worship isn't the person standing before you now.
You want me ...==W== to be the Tyrant from your fantasies.==W== But I'm just me.==W== I can never be the idol you've built in your mind.
I know, Your Majesty.==W== I've been watching you since the moment you stepped through our doors.
But I couldn't admit it. If I did, I'd be alone again.==W== After finally finding a ray of hope...==W== How could I possibly bear to let it go?
Heh... Hahaha.==W== Deep down, I know. I'm no different from the humans I despise, forcing my delusions onto others just to feel a false sense of security.
Is that how you really feel?==W== You're right, humans are cowards. We're afraid of so many things.
But we're also capable of courage. We fight tooth and nail to conquer that fear for the sake of our ideals.
Admitting our inadequacy and still striving for a better future. Isn't that a strength in itself?
To me, such humanity is beautiful.
Darcia, stop this. It's not too late.==W== No one died in the chaos in Philae.==W== You still have a chance to make amends.
A wretch like me doesn't deserve such kindness. Heh...==W== You really are the ==SEX12== Tyrant I always admired.
But I'm already too far gone. I've merged myself with the cultivation tank ages ago to develop the Gen-2 Intelligent Plant.
This form you see before you is the last shred of my humanity.
Darcia...==W== Why...==W== Why go this far?
I put Firenze through the same hell I faced, yet ...==W== she was luckier. She had loyal friends.
Heh...==W== All I ever wanted was to be loved.==W== To be needed.==W== To be told that==W== my existence wasn't a mistake.
But seeing the people you choose to stand by your side...==W== I realized I could never be one of them. I've strayed too far from the path.
So this is it...==W== The end of Darcia.
But I made my peace long ago. I seek no redemption.==W== I despise humanity, and I'll remain its enemy until my dying breath.
Grant me one last wish.==W== Take the chess piece ... and end me. With your own hands.
I can't stand by your side, but remember this:==W== every other company in this world is your enemy.
The piece...==W== I've got the Bishop...!
Huff, huff... I'm back.==W== Firenze, how long was I under?
A minute, maybe?==W== I'm not sure. Definitely no more than two.
Wait, never mind that.==W== Where's Darcia? Where is she?!
Right there. Looks like ...==W== she entered the tank a while ago. She's fused with the Lithe Grass Mother.
<size=70%><alpha=#AA>Forgive me, Your Majesty. I can no longer see or hear.
<size=70%><alpha=#66>If only I'd met you sooner... Maybe I wouldn't have lost my way...

strings.text: With Darcia defeated, the war is halted and further bloodshed averted. To mend the rift, Petal Bloom will escort Mina to HQ for negotiations. Yet the incident is far from over; dark undercurrents are stirring…
Lady Firenze, we've bagged the last Mandrake Radiant Grass in town. The operation is a success.
Honestly? Those little guys are kinda cute. Bet they'd be a hit as pets, don't you think?
You really think people want that thing in their house...?
Totally! Just look at those innocent eyes!
Iris, they live on sun, soil, and water.==W== They even help with chores. Very low-maintenance.
Should we take one, then? If it rides on the roof, it'll get plenty of sun.
The roof?!==W== No way! That's my spot!
Two weeks after Darcia's fall, peace returns to Philae.
As for United Harvest HQ's legions, they cut their losses and slinked back home.
After the battle was over, we pulled Nyx and Mina from the tanks==RT==and lay Darcia to rest.
The Intelligent Plants, deprived of their "nutrients," regressed into==RT==ordinary Mandrake Radiant Grass...
Over the past two days, Ruby, Sapphire, and Noya have managed to capture==RT==most of the scattered Mandrake Grass through their singing.
Fueled by journalistic zeal, Mistique recovers in two weeks,==RT==and is already furiously writing a deep dive on the whole affair.
But for us gathered in the office, a bigger challenge looms.
A-Are you sure about this?==W== Dealing with the Senate... Surely Lady Firenze, or even Ruby and Sapphire, would be a better fit...
I'm stuck here cleaning up Darcia's mess.==W== And I need Ruby and Sapphire—I'd have a massive headache if they left me now.
Well... She promised me a Senate seat ... provided I entered the tank and became nutrient.
Don't misunderstand! I didn't say yes because I wanted the seat!
Since the plants got Nyx's sleepiness, I thought if I became nutrient, maybe they'd inherit my obedience too. Then they'd listen to ==PLAYER_NAME==, not her.
I follow. And you were right—==W==Darcia's plan was derailed.==W== Good work, Mina.
My, my. Guess being a stickler for rules has its perks.
You're barely recovered. Why don't you save your breath and rest?
Don't sell yourself short, Mina. Our branch only gets one Senate seat, but that vote carries the weight of ten.
Plus,==W== the representative automatically gets ten percent of the branch's shares.
Basically... It means Mina owns one-tenth of the Philae Branch.==W== Or rather, the position she holds does.
Whoa, did Mina just become a straight-up millionaire?
Heh, she can't cash out. Those shares are an honorary asset tied to the title. Usually, the CEO holds it.
But right now, controlling that ten percent is crucial for us.
Darcia signed the title over to you before putting you in the tank. Almost as if ... she knew this would happen.
But seeing the people you choose to stand by your side...==W== I realized I could never be one of them. I've strayed too far from the path.
So this is it...==W== The end of Darcia.
But I made my peace long ago. I seek no redemption.==W== I despise humanity, and I'll remain its enemy until my dying breath.
Offering me everything before defeat... Blind loyalty? Or obsession with her phantom Tyrant?
Mina, you follow the rules, and among us, you love this branch most. You're the perfect representative.
After the mess left by Darcia, HQ is watching us like hawks.
They treated us like accomplices when they called. Threatened to fire the whole staff in this branch.
I... I won't let that happen. I'll handle the Senate appeal myself.
Right. Fuyuka, Nazuka, Nazuna, and Kaede. Could you do me a favor?
Heheh! What is it? Big important mission for us?
I need you to escort Mina to United Harvest HQ.
The HQ ... seems to be really far away.
Exactly. With HQ this hostile, it'd be a dangerous trip. That's why I need you.
Heh, sure. Petal Bloom's grand comeback. Starting with a heavy job is a good omen.
Fine. Since the Boss asks it, I'll keep Miss Mina safe.
Hm? Nazuka sounded down. Is she sick?==W== Vita, can you figure out why?
Certainly. Leave the analysis to me.
Tyrant, would you mind showing your Bishop Seal of Grace?
Sure, but how's that gonna do with Nazuka's condition?
Boss, look! The piece... It's floating.
The Well of Worlds Tyrant Development System has identified the power within this Seal of Grace. It's called "Oracle."
Oracle... Gods use that to project their will directly into people's minds.
Is that how Darcia forced human skills into those plants?
Correct. However, your system level is too low to unlock its full potential. Currently, you can only access a fragment of the power: the Unlimited Heartlink.
What does that mean? I don't get it...
The Heartlink app uses built-in Artifact magic. It draws power from Monoliths to enable remote calls and messaging.
Normally, devices only connect if they share the same Monolith's range. If they don't, the link fails.
But the Oracle authority bypasses this. Once paired with the Throne device, you can communicate from anywhere in Nova, regardless of distance.
So, please rest easy, Lady Nazuka.
With Unlimited Heartlink, you'll feel like you're right by each other's side, no matter the distance.
It's not like I'm gonna be lonely without Boss! And I'm definitely not worried ==SEX== might forget me... D-Definitely not!
Ahem!==W== Fuyuka, get everyone moving. We need to prepare.
R-Right!==W== I don't want to leave Master either... I'm scared, but I'll be brave!
Hehe, I wanna tag along! Sounds fun! But I gotta finish writing this scoop first.
My... The air in here hasn't felt this light in ages.==W== We have you to thank, Boss.
We can't relax yet. The legions were gone, but Cosson and Jayhawk aren't.
Plus, you're only the Acting CEO. If HQ sends a replacement…
Naturally. That is why I shall continue to require your expertise.
Don't forget. We are allies for life.
I won't forget. We're partners who fought side by side.
Indeed. But I am an expensive "pawn," Boss. Grant my wish, and you may play the board however you like.
D-Don't look at me to do all the thinking.
Two years ago, Darcia sent me to your orphanage for an "ancient relic." I refused to be her errand girl or fuel her madness.
So I botched the stealth. I wanted people in the orphanage to spot us, call the Imperial Guard, and chase us off. A valid excuse to return empty-handed.
But instead, everyone vanished overnight.==W== Maybe they thought running was safer than calling the Guards.
Or rather... Perhaps they were confident they could escape us.
So Aunt Allie and the kids left ... because of you. But you were actually trying to help.
Do you know where they went?
Afraid not.==W== But after they left, I investigated the basement and found two items.
One was an old recipe for Tawny Nightingale. The other was this compass.
Well, not exactly a compass. That Soul Stone-shaped needle is locked to point in one specific direction, no matter where you turn.
If you follow it... You might find the answers you're looking for.
Hmm. I think I've seen this ... back when I used to sneak into the basement as a kid...
Hmm—nope, drawing a blank!==W== Anyway, a clue's a clue. We'll just walk where it points—we're bound to hit something eventually!
I'll leave you to it, then. Goodbye, everyone.
You haven't had a break this whole time. Maybe slow down a bit?
Appreciate the concern, but I'm hardly a workaholic. The work isn't going anywhere, so before I start—
I'm visiting a friend.==W== It's been ages since we've had a proper talk.
Hmm... What am I in the mood for today?
You stare at those buttons forever, only to grab the lemon drink anyway.
Heh. You know me too well.
It's baffled me since school. You're decisive about everything else, but stick you in front of a vending Artifact and you freeze up?
Hm? Never told you?==RT==If I stall long enough, a certain kind soul always pops up to buy me a drink.
Oh? Well, did I ever tell you this?==W== I'm filing for reimbursement. The total for all those drinks over the years? 26,800 Dorra.
Hey, you drank them.==W== Speaking of which, how long has it been since I last treated you?
Huh? Since when do you drink lemon? Never seen you pick that flavor before.
I don't. But I needed revenge on the "villain" who demoted me. Figured if I bought out every lemon drink in the building, a certain someone would be left high and dry.
That demotion? Seriously? We planned that stunt together just to fool Darcia.
Maybe so, but I still got bossed around in Marketing. Stuck doing all the grunt work nobody else wanted.
Well then... Want to come back as an inspector?==W== I still think you're perfect for the role.
Inspector...==W== Pfft, I'll pass. Don't need people whispering that I'm getting "special treatment" from some higher-up. Besides, Marketing is actually pretty interesting.
Anyway, I shouldn't keep our Director of Operations. Better get back to my desk.
Mhm. Even a brief chat helps. I feel much lighter.
Heh. I'll defer to the Director. After you.
Oh, honestly... Rank doesn't matter here. Fine, I'll go first.
Next time you need my picture, spare me the ID photo, would you? Frankly, I look a bit...
That's the only one I have... Besides, everyone instantly knows it's you!
(sigh) Fine. I'll send you a proper portrait later. Use that instead.==W== Now, what was on your mind?
Well... As a leader, your workload's only going to grow. The weight on your shoulders will get heavier, too...
That's why I hope you remember to smile, even when it's tough. A stone-faced leader stresses everyone out.
Picture this. A boss known for her stoic face starts beaming at everyone out of nowhere. What would people think?
You ... beaming at everyone...==W== Whoa! Nope, that's terrifying!
Heh. See? Safer if I don't smile, isn't it?
Of course not. Strict or gentle, I like you either way.
So... For my sake, could you smile like you used to?
Like I used to... Heh. You're impossible. I wouldn't accept such a silly request from anyone else.
Really? Then starting tomorrow, I can count on a beaming Firenze lighting up the office? Oh! And about that photo... Since we're here, why don't I snap a new one right now?
Huh? You want to take it yourself?
Of course! As your best friend, I'm the only one who knows exactly how to capture your cutest side.
You have a talent for making nonsense sound logical just to get your way... And somehow, I always oblige.
Then again, perhaps that personality of yours is exactly why we get along so well.
Nyx... Thank you for everything. Please, continue to stand by my side. Let us walk this path together.

<size=60>♫</size> <size=49>Orbital</size> ==RT==                                                                                                    Sung by: THE BINARY==RT==                         Lyrics: naoki tani, mido (THE BINARY)  /  Composition & Arrangement: naoki tani
Grace Imperium, Imperial Guard, United Harvest, Deepsea Finance, even the Goodwinds and Loongs accepted the invitation.
Philae is about to get very crowded.
Hmm... I saw your command skills firsthand in that earlier brawl. But the coming war won't be won with brute force—it runs on Dorra.
Don't hold back, Boss. Show me everything. Can you flip the table and snatch victory from the jaws of defeat this time? Let's see.
Hope Mina and Petal Bloom packed warm layers. I'll have Mistique send some winter gear their way.
Oh, sorry. Wasn't watching where I was—==W==huh?
Nobody's here? But I swear I bumped into someone. Mind playing tricks on me?
As the Boss's footsteps fade, a sudden gust sweeps the empty corner.
A parasol materializes mid-air, followed by an elegant figure fading into view beneath it.
Familiar trees, shadows... Even the dust carries the scent of days gone by. How nostalgic, Philae.
My adorable prey... The hunt is about to begin.==RT==Do try to keep me entertained for a while, won't you?

Really? Then starting tomorrow, I can count on a beaming Firenze lighting up the office? Oh! And about that photo... Since we're here, why don't I snap a new one right now?
Huh? You want to take it yourself?
Of course! As your best friend, I'm the only one who knows exactly how to capture your cutest side.
You have a talent for making nonsense sound logical just to get your way... And somehow, I always oblige.
Then again, perhaps that personality of yours is exactly why we get along so well.
Nyx... Thank you for everything. Please, continue to stand by my side. Let us walk this path together.

<size=60>♫</size> <size=49>Orbital</size> ==RT==                                                                                                    Sung by: THE BINARY==RT==                         Lyrics: naoki tani, mido (THE BINARY)  /  Composition & Arrangement: naoki tani
Grace Imperium, Imperial Guard, United Harvest, Deepsea Finance, even the Goodwinds and Loongs accepted the invitation.
Philae is about to get very crowded.
Hmm... I saw your command skills firsthand in that earlier brawl. But the coming war won't be won with brute force—it runs on Dorra.
Don't hold back, Boss. Show me everything. Can you flip the table and snatch victory from the jaws of defeat this time? Let's see.
Hope Mina and Petal Bloom packed warm layers. I'll have Mistique send some winter gear their way.
Oh, sorry. Wasn't watching where I was—==W==huh?
Nobody's here? But I swear I bumped into someone. Mind playing tricks on me?
As the Boss's footsteps fade, a sudden gust sweeps the empty corner.
A parasol materializes mid-air, followed by an elegant figure fading into view beneath it.
Familiar trees, shadows... Even the dust carries the scent of days gone by. How nostalgic, Philae.
My adorable prey... The hunt is about to begin.==RT==Do try to keep me entertained for a while, won't you?

strings.text: Desert Scorpions, posing as insurance agents, caused the chaos at the banquet. Mercurio, the newly appointed manager of Omnisky Aegis, turns the scandal into leverage, pitching a daring scheme to the Senate...
Thank you for choosing us. This is Mercurio, Manager of the Philae Division of Omnisky Aegis.
Going by the questionnaire you filled out, it looks like you're in the market for a high-value life insurance policy.
Oh, slipped your mind? Not to worry. We've just launched a new package perfectly suited for a lady of your standing.
It's not just peace of mind. It's a safety net for those unpredictable little emergencies life tends to throw at us.
We stand by this product with absolute confidence. Frankly, it's our top recommendation for an executive of your caliber.
You have concerns about our business practices? No, no, I'm afraid there's been a terrible misunderstanding.
Sure, I have today's Scarlet Sights right here. Front page... Ah, yes. The report on the banquet from three days ago.
I understand your worries, Ma'am, truly. But please, trust our reputation.
Omnisky Aegis holds a genuine Seal of Grace. We would never lend our name to bandits like the Desert Scorpion. We were victims of identity theft, just like anyone else.
In fact, if you think about it, the incident only proves that our coverage really does "protect clients in times of unexpected crisis." That promise has been battle-tested now, wouldn't you say?
Check the report. Every single person at that event who held an Omnisky policy walked away unharmed.
We suspect that since the bandits were disguising as our employees, they avoided harming our clients to maintain their cover.
Exactly. Until the Imperial Guard confirms that every last Desert Scorpion has fled Philae, being an Omnisky client is practically a form of immunity in itself.
Thank you for your trust. I'll send my assistant over this afternoon to finalize things. Okay... Yes... We look forward to serving you.
Number Seventeen. Head to Grace Imperium this afternoon and close the deal with Ms. Mary. Put her down for ten years on health coverage and fifty on life.
Yes, Ma'am. Drawing up the paperwork now.
We called her hours ago, and she hung up the second she heard "Omnisky." I can't believe you actually landed her...==W== Manager, you really are a master of your craft.
Two days in and you've completely turned the tables. Before you showed up, I was sure HQ was gonna shut down the Philae branch. Guess this is what a real pro looks like...
Please, teach us your secrets! Honestly, getting slammed with rejection after rejection is starting to crush my soul...
Fair enough. Let me ask you this... What do you think we're actually selling here?
What are we selling...? Well, insurance, obviously... Like that health plan you just pitched. It covers the client's medical bills.
And life insurance pays out a benefit to a beneficiary if the client dies before a certain age.
That's not selling. That is reciting a manual. Did you learn anything during orientation?
Ah, haha... Well, there wasn't really an orientation. The last manager hired us and then immediately got fired over that whole banquet disaster.
You have to help us, Cap—uh, Manager.
Take this sword. Now, sell it to me.
Sell the sword...?==W== Um, okay. This is a... A really sharp blade! It's so sharp it can...==W== It can carve through armor like butter!
I work a desk job. Why would I need to hack at armored knights? Besides, that's a false claim. If I asked you to sell me armor next, would you tell me it blocks every weapon in existence?
Forget it... Get back to work. But make sure you're packing something for self-defense when heading out into the field.
Have you not heard? The front page of the Scarlet Sights says the Imperial Guard isn't sure if there are still Desert Scorpions hiding in the city.
And if they wanted to disguise themselves as Omnisky staff again... Where do you think they'd get the uniforms?
You mean the Desert Scorpions might jump us just to steal our uniform?!
Hey! I was the one pitching the sword! Hands off!
Excuse me? Manager was talking to me. It should be mine!
Aren't you already lugging around a giant hammer?
You can never have too many weapons!
Wait. Manager was just trying to "sell" the sword to you. That whole bit about the bandits... That was actually an exaggeration, wasn't it, Manager?
Number Eighteen, you're quick. There might be hope for you yet.
A sharp blade is meaningless if it doesn't fit anyone's needs. But the moment a need arises, even a generic piece of steel becomes something people will fight over.
The second you realized you "might get attacked by Desert Scorpions," you didn't just want a sword. You wanted the safety it represents.
But be honest—none of you actually want to have to use it, do you?
Of course not... I just want to stay alive. Who'd want to run into a Desert Scorpion and get into a knife fight?
So, get it now? Selling insurance is no different from selling this sword.
It offers peace of mind, but it's the one product the customer hopes they'd never have to use.
In a sense, what we're really selling is "security."
True, Desert Scorpions infiltrating our banquet three days ago was a PR nightmare.
But spin it right, and even that disaster becomes a selling point. It proves that we can offer the security they need.
Sigh... Finally some quiet.==W== Where did the last manager dig these people up? Brains like gravel, the lot of them.
Still, they're cheap and energetic. I'll ship 'em to HQ for training—might find a diamond in the rough.
Speaking of HQ... I'm due for a check-in. Operator, patch me through to Geminia.
Mercurio! Took you long enough. How's the cleanup going in Philae?
Madame CEO. Thanks to Sales, we have a stable client base. We've also signed three high-profile executive clients in the past two days—they should open doors to lucrative new networks.
Not bad! While every other branch is tanking from the bad press, you swoop in and actually boost the numbers... Oh, I can picture the twisted looks on the Senators' faces. It's going to be a treat.
Let's not forget that ten days ago, I formally proposed we attend Firenze's banquet. Like it or not, she's the one running Philae now.
But the Senate shot it down so as to not "upset United Harvest HQ." That refusal is exactly what allowed the Desert Scorpions to slip in, disguised as our staff.
Furthermore, I've confirmed that the impersonation plot was orchestrated by a United Harvest executive gunning for Firenze's job. They certainly weren't worried about damaging relations with us.
I've compiled the full details into a new report. A Trekker is already en route to Geminia with it.
Sigh... My foolish little sister. You know that cold, abrasive attitude is exactly why you've been stuck in middle management all these years, right?
And you? My naive big sister. The Senate didn't give you that chair for your brains. They put you there because you're a pushover—a perfect rubber stamp.
Heh... Maybe I am a "rubber stamp." But isn't it your job to add value to worthless things?
Speaking of work, how are you boosting sales in this mess? Public opinion is eating us alive with these rumors about colluding with the Desert Scorpions.
The Desert Scorpion is the biggest bandit syndicate in the northwest. Is it really such a bad thing for an insurance company to have a ... dangerous reputation?
Who do you think fed Scarlet Sights those stories? I've personally sat down with half a dozen witches this week.
We should launch new security and property packages in the Western Region immediately. Fear sells, and people will eat up whatever we offer for months.
Wait, you leaked that? Won't that just drag our name through the mud even more?
A scandal this big runs with or without us. By flooding them with interviews, we control the narrative and spin it to our advantage.
Ruthlessly exploiting your own scandal ... even for the good of the company. Heh, you really are a terrifying kid.
Anyway, good news. Since the Senate completely misread the room at the Philae banquet, those old fossils are finally loosening their grip.
You have full access to company resources now. The only condition is to fix this mess with the Desert Scorpions impersonating our staff.
Rest easy. I've got a plan.
Mercurio's finger slides across the screen, stopping on a Scarlet Sights headline.
The best way to bury bad news ... is to create an even bigger one.
