Well, Firenze and I crunched the numbers. We're supposed to be able to pay it off in 15 years... 20 at most.
Dammit, I can't make Nazuka wait that long. I need a plan...==W== Wait,==W== I saw this in a Stella Drama once!
<size=50>Guard! I want a book!==W== And bring me the newest Magical Girl poster!</size>
It's been almost two years ...==W== since they locked me in here.
I keep a stolen cafeteria spoon hidden in a book.==W== Every day at yard time, I dump the dirt I dig out with it.
There's a massive storm tonight==W==—perfect cover for an escape.
Hold on, Nazuka.==W== I'm coming back!
Alright... Squeeze through this hole,==W== dig through the last bit of dirt blocking the sewer,==W== and I'm free...
Huh?==W== What's that noise?==W== Where's all this water coming from?!==W==
Gurgle...==W== <size=52>This is not how it goes in the Stella Drama!</size>==W==
Gasp... Cough...==W== How...==W== How did I drown?!
That storm is Philae's worst in a century.==W== Your escape route turns into a deadly underground river.
Not much of a swimmer, are you, Tyrant?
... Never should have trusted the Stella Dramas!
Take a look at your cell. Missing the prison life already?
Actually,==W== you're getting great sleep, regular exercise, and balanced meals in there.
You're healthier than before you went in.
Plus,==W== a cute girl who really cares visits you every week.==W== With a setup like that, I'd never leave.
Vita, open the door.==W== I'm going back.
Goodbye, Tyrant.==W== Without the right team, managing that many people is just a burden.
A company is far deadlier and trickier than a Monolith.
I will go back...==W== This time, I must go back to the<color=#bd3059> even more distant past.
"Not looking to monopolize"? What's Mercurio's angle here...
Perhaps taking out a loan from Deepsea Finance is the first step into the box. I should look for another way.
But doing nothing means a slow death. This market drags us down anyway.
Grand Inspector Matilda is vital. Without her, we can't run the entirety of United Harvest.
This time, I can't let her die.

strings.text: You and Chitose cross paths again. She catches you up on her life and her training. Before you set foot to make the wish, Chitose casually snuffs out an Omnisky Aegis plot without breaking a sweat…
I-Is it...==W== Is it really you, my ==SEX11==?
It's me.==W== It's been a while, Chitose.==W== How was your training?
I-It has.==W== And thanks to you, my training was a complete success.==W== Please, allow me to demonstrate—
A blinding flash. Before I even realize she's drawn her blade, it's already back in the scabbard.
I follow her gaze and spot a hairline fracture running straight==RT==through a massive boulder out in the river.
Cleaved in two, the rock no longer parts the current. Fallen wisteria petals simply drift through the gap, floating downstream together.
Don't tell me ... you split that rock?==W== But it's at least ten meters away.==W== How?
A blade forged of magic. The Swordless Style.
When we first met,==W== I could only control my overflowing aura by holding your hand or standing by your side.==W== I knew right then—you were my fated wielder.
At the beginning when I left your side to train,==W== I struggled to keep this power in check...
Only by picturing you as I practiced with "Master" did I finally make this strength my own.
So, you used the motion of drawing your sword to project a magic blade, slicing that rock from afar.
Exactly.==W== My reach is no longer limited by the length of "Master"'s steel.
Back at the Waterway... Had I mastered the Swordless Style,==W== I never would have let that Nocturn Eterna slip away in the shadows.
T-That's ...==W== incredible.==W== You were already very skilled. We only survived the Aeloria fight because of you...==W== I never imagined your skills would be even sharper.
You flatter me.==W== I am your blade. Striking down your troubles and keeping you safe is my sole purpose.
Even so...==W== I failed to protect you at the banquet.
No matter how sharp I become, a blade that is absent when its wielder needs it most is nothing but a disgrace.
My ==SEX11==, from this moment on,==W== please let me remain by your side. I won't leave you again.
You need a wildcard in the shadows—someone off the other companies' radar.
Chitose would be a great help,==W== but...
Boss Accord is actually short-handed right now. We're in a bit of a bind.==W== But aren't you still in the middle of your training?
I am.==W== But I came to Philae for one reason—to offer you my aid.
Earlier, I crossed paths with a witch. She seemed to know a lot about me and insisted on an interview.
In return, she warned me you were in trouble here in Philae. I parted ways with Doctor Coronis immediately and hurried over.
She never gave her name.==W== She only boasted about having "exclusive interview rights with the Boss."==W== I assumed she was an old friend of yours.
She mentioned having errands to run, then flew off in a hurry toward New Orelian.
Of course it was her...==W== She must have wandered off from Nazuka's group on the way to New Orelian and bumped into Chitose.==W== That "trouble" she mentioned has to be the whole mess with Darcia.
Once I reached Philae, I had no way to contact you. A blade has no need for a phone, after all.==W== My only option was to pray to the Goodwind Guardian beneath the wisteria.
Therefore, my ==SEX11==, if there is any way this blade can serve you,==W== give the order. Do not hold back.
She's so earnest about this. Turning her down now would just be insulting.
Understood. We're heading into the Philae Monolith next.==W== I'd be honored to have your strength by my side, Chitose.
Yes, my ==SEX11==!==W== I am yours to command.
After introducing Chitose to Firenze and Nyx, we headed back==RT==to the hotel to prep for the Monolith. But...
Chitose! Chitose!==W== Let me see that quick-draw again!==W== Try slicing that Tawny Nightingale across the room!
Do I have your permission, my ==SEX11==?
I suppose... Just don't overdo it, okay?
Whoa, awesome!==W== You sliced that rock-hard Tawny Nightingale clean in half!
Honestly,==W== Noya.==W== Stop playing with your food!
Your clothes. Very pretty. Can I touch?
Please do.==W== For the record, this is known as "miko garb" where I'm from.==W== It is a sacred vestment worn by priestesses for rituals.
I don't mind the downtime, but ...==W== should we really be this relaxed?
What're you talking about, Boss?==W== Chitose's gonna be our shadow guard! It's only natural that we get to know her.
Fair point.==W== Still, Chitose just got off a long journey.==W== We shouldn't push her.
It is no burden.==W== If anything, this quiet moment is the perfect time to build trust with your companions.
Actually, I do have one question for you, my ==SEX11==.
Well...==W====RT==What are your thoughts==W== on my new scabbard?
You look good in any scabbard.
I want to see more scabbards!
"Scabbard"? She has to mean her outfit...
This white miko garb is cute.
But ...==W== your elegant black uniform looked great, too. It's tough to choose.
Understood. Since my ==SEX11== favors both scab<r=outfits></r>bards, I will alternate them starting tomorrow.
Ah, don't go to all that trouble.==W== Wear whatever is practical.
Besides,==W== I can close my eyes==W== and picture you in either scab<r=outfit></r>bard.
My ==SEX11==...==W== Your deep appreciation for my scab<r=outfits></r>bards moves me.
Both the black uniform and this miko garb==W== look perfect on you.
It's entirely up to you.==W== Your favorite scab<r=outfit></r>bard is my favorite.
Understood, my ==SEX11==.==W== I will stick with this scab<r=outfit></r>bard for now.
Oh no,==W== does that mean my scabbard and Amber's are full of holes?!==W== Iris, you're the only one with an intact scabbard!
Why did you have to make it sound so dirty==W==...
If you want me back in my black scab<r=outfit></r>bard, I will change immediately.
No, that's not it.==W== Two simply aren't enough.==W== You need way more scab<r=outfits></r>bards!==W==
I see.==W== A necessity for underwater combat.
Um... Boss!==W== We have actual business to discuss.==W== Chitose, Boss is joking.==W== Ignore ==SEX4==.
S-Sorry.==W== I was kidding, I swear.==W== The miko outfit is perfect.
Team bonding is great...==W== But didn't someone just ask,==W== "Should we really be this relaxed?"
I was just looking out for my team.==W== Wait,==W== Bastelina? What are you doing here?
I'm off the clock. I was heading back to rest and caught sight of you all.
By the way,==W== Boss, I'm right next door. Room 406.
Yep. The price tanked after that whole incident. It was an absolute bargain.
Anyway, I'm heading in.==W== Good luck with your wishes. I'll be rooting for you from the sidelines.
I shall depart as well.==W== I am scouting the lobby disguised as a shrine miko, hired by United Harvest Philae to pray for clear skies.
Don't worry about us. Focus on your mission. You're clear to execute the plan.
Amber and I will prep Loxy. Boss, you and Iris handle the climbing gear.==W== We might be in the Monolith for days.
Got it. We roll out at eleven sharp.
10:30. We have time.==W== I should survey the area while I can.
The perimeter is quiet.==W== No suspicious individuals on the street.==W== A stark contrast to the night of the assassination.==W==
Hm? Who are they?==W== What are they doing?
Excuse me, Miss! Have you heard of Omnisky Aegis? We protect your assets from unforeseen losses—
Insurance agents.==W== A business where one purchases a policy to receive compensation for damages.==W== They certainly sent a lot of them.
Miss, that is a gorgeous weapon. How about a policy for it?==W== If it ever needs polishing or reforging, Omnisky Aegis covers the bill!
A weapon policy? Unnecessary.==W== This blade is my Master. If anything, I should be taking out life insurance.==W==
Hey!==W== We've tapped out the lobby. Let's hit the upper floors.
Don't wander off on your own!==W==
Their jackets are bulging. Likely weapons. Why would sales agents carry arms?==W== Unless ... they are assassins in disguise!==W==
If so,==W== to atone for my absence at the banquet,==W== I must protect my ==SEX11== today!
Whoa, Miss, why are you drawing your sword?==W== If you want the policy, step over here—no need to inspect it in the open!
Your true target is the CEO of Boss Accord,==W== is it not?
What?! How did you—==W==cover's blown! Take her out!
Hey, get over here!==W== She's alone.==W== Rush her!
Hm? Serena's calling? What does she want?
Apologies for the intrusion, Boss.==W== But I've got a critical piece of intel for you. Hehe.==W== Do you want it? I'll even give you a discount.

strings.text: Serena warns that Mercurio is doing everything she can to stall you. Your allies clear a safe route out of the city. Eventually, the New Star Guild stays behind, leaving only Chitose to board the cable car with you.
Moments before Amber receives Boss's message.
I've got a critical piece of intel for you, Boss. Hehe. Do you want it? I'll even give you a discount <size=52>♪</size>
It's been a while, Serena. Last time we spoke was at the Trekker Camp... Right before the United Harvest infiltration.
Yeah. Three short months ago, but it somehow feels like a lifetime.
Is that how long it has been?==W== I'm in the market for intel, but I'm a little tied up. Please, cut to the chase.
Boss, Omnisky Aegis is swarming the lobby. The plan worked.
Looks like Chitose spotted them. Firenze and Nyx are five minutes out. Hold the line until then.
Sorry... Minor interruption.==W== What were you saying, Serena?
Using yourself as bait to lure them out, then letting an unknown like Chitose act as the hook. Clever plan, Boss. But I stumbled across an interesting recording—
Number Twenty. Go stall the Boss and the New Star Guild.
Lady Mercurio, you're joking, right? Those freaks took down a giant monster alongside Petal Bloom! They killed Darcia and her mutant weeds! How are we supposed to beat them?
That's why I said stall them! Keep them away from the cable car station until 11:30. My sabotage team will handle the rest—they're not leaving the land.
If they push back, don't play hero. Trash the corridors, wreck the doors, then surrender. The property is fully insured, so stir up as much chaos as you want.
On top of that, my people are handing out flyers across the city. Soon, the Boss won't be able to take a single step.
See? Omnisky Aegis didn't send big fish like a certain fox or Desert Scorpion. You cast a beautiful line, but Mercurio is clogging your reel with bottom-feeders.
One rod, but a whole school of fish took the bait. This is gonna be a headache.
How many goons did Omnisky Aegis hire? They've completely blocked the entrance.
Firenze, bad news. Look at this flyer.
United Harvest Philae ... giving away free Tawny Nightingale bread at 11 AM today. First come, first served.
I know your car is out in the woods behind the hotel. That area is still clear.
You've seen the mob outside, though. Your friends can probably brute-force their way through.
But for someone like you, "immune to magic"? Wading through those small fry will take at least twenty minutes. By then, the crowd will have the streets completely locked down.
Serena ... You timed this call perfectly. Your intel is our way out, isn't it?==W== Name your price in Dorra. I'm buying.
Hehe, not even haggling? You must be desperate. Well then—
Please lift the sofa in your room.
There's a secret passage underneath. It'll get you to your car in five minutes.
Is this a joke, Serena? It's a solid floor. There is no passage!
Huh??? How is that possible? The digging's finished days ago!
But there isn't one. Listen to this...==W== It's completely solid.
Boss! Iris!==W== Thank goodness you're still here.
Come to my room, quick! There's a secret passage under my sofa. We can use it to escape!
Hmm... Why is the passage in the next room over? I double-checked it myself.
Well, your intel was technically correct. Let's not sweat the details.
Let's move. I'm texting Amber to meet us at the car.==W== Bastelina, come with us. It's not safe here.

Dang it! I went through all that trouble to hide inside the couch, just waiting for the perfect moment to snatch the Boss when ==SEX== sat down. Why'd some Grace Imperium brat who looks younger than me show up?
I double-checked with the hooded woman. This is the Boss's room, 404. So then... That fox must have tricked us when we checked the place?
No time. I can't let the Boss escape. I'm taking the secret passage!
Boss, get in the car. Now!
Huh? Just Noya and Chitose? Where's Amber?
She stayed behind to hold off the enemy and cover our escape.
Noya, we can't afford to wait. We have to reach the cable car station by 11:30.
We follow Noya's gaze to see a crowd of citizens and==RT==monster carts rushing toward the hotel.
Noya, get Boss there safely. Boss, take these notes on the Philae Monolith. They'll help with the climb.
What choice do we have? It's the only way.
Iris chants, and a freezing wind whips up water from the river. Two thin ice walls form in the middle of the road, forcing the crowd apart and carving a narrow path for the Lucky Oasis.
Boss, Iris and I are alright. We met up with Firenze and Nyx.
We rounded up over two hundred mercenaries. The bread line citizens... We got them to the nearby United Harvest shops.
We're heading to the cable car station...
But we won't make it in time. Sorry.
As long as everyone's safe. I should have seen Omnisky Aegis's plan coming.
Nyx made the agents talk. They said the Trekker Camp is on our side.
So Omnisky Aegis couldn't hire any decent Trekkers.
We still have the upper hand for the climb and the wish.
Don't worry. I won't let your hard work go to waste.
Bastelina, isn't Omnisky Aegis getting disqualified for pulling a stunt like this?
No. Technically, they haven't broken any rules.
This bidding war isn't merely a test of wealth. It's an arena for corporate warfare.
Grace Imperium turns a blind eye unless things escalate. Corporate rivalries are rarely peaceful—drawing weapons is standard procedure.
Sabotaging a cable car station doesn't count as escalating?
Well... The station has been abandoned ever since they sealed the Monolith.
As long as Mercurio pays off Scarlet Sights Media and leaves no bodies behind, it hardly matters.
Hold on tight! The station is dead ahead. They have an armed barricade set up, so we're crashing right through!
Incoming! Is that cable cut yet?!
The Artifact those suits gave us is trash! The blade chipped immediately. It's almost through, though. Hold them off!
Open fire! Don't let them through!
Chitose, stop the mercenary on the cable!
The knocked-out mercenary tumbled off the cable car roof.
From above, several snapped steel wires lashed out at me.
I'm fine.==W== The cable... Looks like it'll barely hold.
Don't panic! They're outnumbered. Keep them too busy to power up the cable car, and we win!
Knock one down, another pops right up... How many goons did Omnisky Aegis hire?
I'll handle this mess! Chitose, get the Boss on the cable car. The rest is up to you two.
I can't let them trash Loxy. Besides, I need to stay behind anyway.
Someone has to pump magic into the station, or that car isn't going anywhere.
Trust the team, Chitose. Let's focus on our part.
But Noya, don't do anything reckless.
No sweat! They've got the numbers, but they don't hit very hard.
Leave the magic pumping to me, the cutie!
Watching Noya charge toward the mercenaries, Chitose and I==RT==board the cable car and slowly ride off into the blue.

See? Omnisky Aegis didn't send big fish like a certain fox or Desert Scorpion. You cast a beautiful line, but Mercurio is clogging your reel with bottom-feeders.
One rod, but a whole school of fish took the bait. This is gonna be a headache.
How many goons did Omnisky Aegis hire? They've completely blocked the entrance.
Firenze, bad news. Look at this flyer.
United Harvest Philae ... giving away free Tawny Nightingale bread at 11 AM today. First come, first served.
I know your car is out in the woods behind the hotel. That area is still clear.
You've seen the mob outside, though. Your friends can probably brute-force their way through.
But for someone like you, "immune to magic"? Wading through those small fry will take at least twenty minutes. By then, the crowd will have the streets completely locked down.
Serena ... You timed this call perfectly. Your intel is our way out, isn't it?==W== Name your price in Dorra. I'm buying.
Hehe, not even haggling? You must be desperate. Well then—
Please lift the sofa in your room.
There's a secret passage underneath. It'll get you to your car in five minutes.
Is this a joke, Serena? It's a solid floor. There is no passage!
Huh??? How is that possible? The digging's finished days ago!
But there isn't one. Listen to this...==W== It's completely solid.
Boss! Iris!==W== Thank goodness you're still here.
Come to my room, quick! There's a secret passage under my sofa. We can use it to escape!
Hmm... Why is the passage in the next room over? I double-checked it myself.
Well, your intel was technically correct. Let's not sweat the details.
Let's move. I'm texting Amber to meet us at the car.==W== Bastelina, come with us. It's not safe here.

Dang it! I went through all that trouble to hide inside the couch, just waiting for the perfect moment to snatch the Boss when ==SEX== sat down. Why'd some Grace Imperium brat who looks younger than me show up?
I double-checked with the hooded woman. This is the Boss's room, 404. So then... That fox must have tricked us when we checked the place?
No time. I can't let the Boss escape. I'm taking the secret passage!
Boss, get in the car. Now!
Huh? Just Noya and Chitose? Where's Amber?
She stayed behind to hold off the enemy and cover our escape.
Noya, we can't afford to wait. We have to reach the cable car station by 11:30.
We follow Noya's gaze to see a crowd of citizens and==RT==monster carts rushing toward the hotel.
Noya, get Boss there safely. Boss, take these notes on the Philae Monolith. They'll help with the climb.
What choice do we have? It's the only way.
Iris chants, and a freezing wind whips up water from the river. Two thin ice walls form in the middle of the road, forcing the crowd apart and carving a narrow path for the Lucky Oasis.
Boss, Iris and I are alright. We met up with Firenze and Nyx.
We rounded up over two hundred mercenaries. The bread line citizens... We got them to the nearby United Harvest shops.
We're heading to the cable car station...
But we won't make it in time. Sorry.
As long as everyone's safe. I should have seen Omnisky Aegis's plan coming.
Nyx made the agents talk. They said the Trekker Camp is on our side.
So Omnisky Aegis couldn't hire any decent Trekkers.
We still have the upper hand for the climb and the wish.
Don't worry. I won't let your hard work go to waste.
Bastelina, isn't Omnisky Aegis getting disqualified for pulling a stunt like this?
No. Technically, they haven't broken any rules.
This bidding war isn't merely a test of wealth. It's an arena for corporate warfare.
Grace Imperium turns a blind eye unless things escalate. Corporate rivalries are rarely peaceful—drawing weapons is standard procedure.
Sabotaging a cable car station doesn't count as escalating?
Well... The station has been abandoned ever since they sealed the Monolith.
As long as Mercurio pays off Scarlet Sights Media and leaves no bodies behind, it hardly matters.
Hold on tight! The station is dead ahead. They have an armed barricade set up, so we're crashing right through!
Incoming! Is that cable cut yet?!
The Artifact those suits gave us is trash! The blade chipped immediately. It's almost through, though. Hold them off!
Open fire! Don't let them through!
Chitose, stop the mercenary on the cable!
The knocked-out mercenary tumbled off the cable car roof.
From above, several snapped steel wires lashed out at me.
I'm fine.==W== The cable... Looks like it'll barely hold.
Don't panic! They're outnumbered. Keep them too busy to power up the cable car, and we win!
Knock one down, another pops right up... How many goons did Omnisky Aegis hire?
I'll handle this mess! Chitose, get the Boss on the cable car. The rest is up to you two.
I can't let them trash Loxy. Besides, I need to stay behind anyway.
Someone has to pump magic into the station, or that car isn't going anywhere.
Trust the team, Chitose. Let's focus on our part.
But Noya, don't do anything reckless.
No sweat! They've got the numbers, but they don't hit very hard.
Leave the magic pumping to me, the cutie!
Watching Noya charge toward the mercenaries, Chitose and I==RT==board the cable car and slowly ride off into the blue.

strings.text: Powered by Bastelina and shielded by Noya, the cable car glides forward. You spot the blood on Chitose's hand and quietly bandage the wound. High in the sky, a deeper trust takes root between the two of you.
Everyone's out cold! She's no human—she's a monster!
Well? Want me to keep going?
Sorry! We're sorry!==W== We were only hired to break the cable car,==RT==not to attack you!==W== Please let us go!
Oh? I'll let it slide, then.
But it's a huge pain if you break our ride right now...==W== Sorry, you need to sleep until the technical review is over.
That takes care of our tail! Bastelina, how are things on your end?
Hehe. Your adorable Bastelina aces every magic construction class. Jump-starting a cable car is child's play! <size=54>♪</size>
By the way, need to borrow my Telescope Artifact?==W== Boss and Miss Chitose seem to be getting along well in there.
My ==SEX11==, Lady Noya has secured the station. The battle is over.
Despite facing so many enemies alone, she managed to defeat them all without taking a single life. Her swordsmanship was truly masterful.
I can't even make out who's over there from this distance.==W== You've got more than just quick reflexes; your vision is on a whole different level.
You flatter me. It is simply my duty as a blade—if I fail to perceive and parry the threat posed by an approaching adversary in time, I have failed in my duty.
You flatter me. Perceive and parry the threat posed by an approaching adversary in time is simply my duty as a blade.
Since young, I was taught to train and nourish my soul of blade with the purity as clear as a mirror to unveil the truth of all existence.
Since young, I was taught to think like that.
I see. As long as everyone is unscathed...
Wait, Chitose, your hand is bleeding?!
Ah. I blocked the snapped steel cable swinging at you with my hand.
Do not worry, my ==SEX11==. A minor chipped edge hardly impairs my function. Please continue to wield me in battle without hesitation.
I don't care about the battles! I care about you!
Seriously... I appreciate your desire to protect me, but you need to start valuing your own life too...
Chitose, with that bottomless bedroll of yours, didn't you pack any bandages or medicine?
Thank you for your concern, my ==SEX11==. To my shame, I exhausted my supply of hilt-wrapping bandages during my training...
Please, pay it no mind. I am a blade, and a blade does not bleed. This blood merely proves that my training is insufficient.
Chitose. What did I just tell you to value?
My deepest apologies. I was so focused on serving my ==SEX11== that I completely forgot...
Tear the hem of my shirt
U-Um... My ==SEX11==, what are you doing?
Let's try to stop the bleeding for now. Once we're inside the Monolith, I'll wish for proper disinfectants and real bandages. Bear with it until then.
But... My own negligence has caused damage to your attire. To be treated with such kindness now... I am utterly undeserving.
I'm not rejecting you playing the role of my protective blade. Honestly, I'm grateful for it.
But to me, you're more than a weapon. You're my companion—just like everyone else in the New Star Guild.
Companion... More than a blade... I am a companion to my ==SEX11==...
More than a blade... I am a companion to my ==SEX11==...
Don't misunderstand though? I'm not disregarding your role as a blade. Phew, all done. How's that? Pretty professional work, if I do say so myself.
... Sure. It's not restricting my movements, and the wrapping is really neat.
Getting hurt comes with the job for a Trekker. I picked it up along the way.
Besides, there's nothing wrong with a wielder taking care of their blade, right?
You are ... absolutely right. How strange. The wound you treated ... feels warm. Soothing.
Could this be ... your magic, my ==SEX11==?
Nope. You know I can't use magic, Chitose. That's probably in your head.
I checked the cut earlier. It's not deep and missed the bone. Rest up a bit, and you'll be fine.
By the way, why are you so set on becoming a blade? I think you're perfectly fine the way you are.
Because becoming a flawless blade is my sole purpose. It is my destiny.
For as long as I can remember, I lived in a vast, empty estate with my parents and my Master.</color>
<color=#a87dc0>This is the first time I've spoken to you of this, my ==SEX11==.==RT==For as long as I can remember, I lived in a vast, empty estate==RT==with my parents and my Master.</color>
We will always be here to protect you, Chitose.
Just dedicate yourself to your Master's training,==RT==and you will become a "useful blade."
Under the guidance of my parents and Master, I honed my skills day after day.
I see. Your parents and your Master... What were they like?
Hmm... I wouldn't know. I never saw their human faces.
By the time I was old enough to understand their existence, they had already become legendary blades.
That is the destiny of my bloodline. To scatter our consciousness, forge ourselves into steel, and sever the evils of this world.
But ... I am ashamed to admit that while I know those words by heart, I have no idea what they truly mean.
My parents and Master have attained the form of blades, yet I remain trapped in this human flesh. The fact that I am still a human is the proof of my failure.
Unlike my parents and Master, the fact that I am still a human is the proof of my failure.
To fail as a sharp edge and deal senseless harm...  Such a flawed blade has no value whatsoever.
To fail as a sharp edge and deal senseless harm... ==RT==Such a flawed blade has no value whatsoever.
Fortunately, I found you, my ==SEX11==. You gave me a chance to prove my worth... But that is no excuse for me to neglect my training.
... Is that why you push yourself so hard?
If that's the case, I want to help you find the real meaning behind that destiny.
Chitose, could you promise me one thing?
I am yours to command, my ==SEX11==.
Your dedication is amazing, really.==W== But it wouldn't hurt to stop and just look at the world around you once in a while, right?
Stop? But why...? I can only truly serve you once I have completely cast aside my humanity to become a blade.
It is like forging steel. The metal must be quenched over and over. If this process is deliberately interrupted, the blade turns brittle.
I get where you're coming from.==W== But sometimes taking a breather lets you see things from a totally different angle.
For example... Look out the window. You can only appreciate this because we're sitting still. Have you ever seen such a view?
No... I've never seen anything like it. And as I gaze out at it...
It feels as though I am one with the sky. My heart feels cleansed.
See? Polishing your state of mind like this is also a form of training.

I understand. So this is the mental fortitude I lacked. I had never considered it that way... Your wisdom knows no bounds, my ==SEX11==. Then, if this counts as training... May I make a small request?
Of course. Anything I can do.
To bring my heart closer to yours... To master Oneness... Would you allow me to ... come closer to you, to see the view you see... If that is alright?
Looks like the cable car is almost across.
Are you sure you don't want a peek through my telescope? It's quite the show.
Nah, let them have their moment. Boss is reliable. ==SEX1=='ll <r=·>take</r> <r=·>good</r> <r=·>care</r> of Chitose.
Oh? You think so? Given her sword skills, shouldn't Miss Chitose be taking care of Boss?
Not exactly. My gut says Chitose is wrestling with a lot of confusion. I know the feeling. Boss is probably the only one who can help her.
Hehe <size=52>♪</size> You play the reckless, high-energy card, Miss Noya, but you're actually watching everyone closely.
Of course I am! Boss and Chitose are my friends! <size=52>♪</size>
Alright, enough worrying! Let's tie up these goons. Once Iris and Amber get here, we'll head over and back Boss up.
Leave that to me! Your adorable Bastelina aced her knot-tying class, too.
How reliable! I'll grab the ropes.
Miss Noya's honesty is her best trait...==W== But turning down my telescope means she's missing out on a spectacular show.
For instance, I doubt Boss or Miss Chitose has any clue that there's a "cute little stalker"==RT==dangling right beneath their cable car.
My, my. With such an unexpected wild card crashing the party…==RT==What will become of this technical review? <size=52>♪</size>
Waaah, it's too high! So scary...! Are we at the station yet?! My fingers are slipping!!!!

strings.text: On the lake island, you bump into Tilia. Serena suddenly catches up with a warning: Omnisky Aegis is still on your trail. Despite the pursuit, you scale the Monolith and make a wish, gifting a cell phone to Chitose.
Wait—is that a camp? Did another team beat us here?
What a coincidence!==W== Do you remember me? We chatted briefly back in Emor...
That day when the giant Stellaroid trashed the Ash District, I spotted a young knight shielding some kids.
You were my escort when I visited Feagin.
Yes, I'm Tilia!==W== Though technically I'm not a full knight yet... Just a squire.
When did you get to Philae?
I came here on guard duty for the banquet, and they selected me for the Monolith team!
Which makes us rivals today, Boss!==W== I'd love to say "friendship first," but for the honor of the Imperial Guard, let's give this everything we've got!
With me here, my ==SEX11== cannot lose.
Ah, the champion of justice!==W== So ... you were looking for ==PLAYER_NAME== that day.
Chitose, you two know each other?
Yes. She bought me a drink when I was searching for you in Emor.==W== I shall never forget the taste.
Now then, brave squire. My ==SEX11== and I must press on.
Goodbye! And stay safe out there!
Thanks. Good luck to you, too.
Captain, you can come out now.
That was close... Didn't expect to run into ==SEX4== here.==W== I threw a spear at ==SEX4== before. Sure, I didn't know who ==SEX== was, but I was still the one out of line.
Big shots like that hold grudges. We might've only been on Creta Trading's payroll, but that won't stop them from holding it against us.
==PLAYER_NAME=='s very kind. You have nothing to worry about.
Captain, they arrived after us, but they are already out searching for the Monolith entrance. Should we be dragging our feet like this? If Lady Greyhorn asks...
Lady Greyhorn won't lose her temper over us sitting by a campfire. Trust me. Let's eat first.
If anyone calls to rush us, tell them my unit is currently dining.
My ==SEX11==, I have located the entrance.
Half an hour later, deep in the forest, Chitose and I find an elevator built directly into the cliff face.
We haven't seen a soul. Did the Omnisky Aegis team already head inside?
Boss, we've got a problem. We can't reach the island!
Iris and Amber just met up with me. We were about to take the cable car over to back you up.
Amber grabbed us and bailed right before the car hit the water. We're safe, but ... my heart won't stop pounding.
That was too close. Looking at the severed ends, the sabotaged cable barely held when you and Chitose crossed. Gave out the moment it took on a second load.
I've notified Albedo. They'll repair it as quickly as possible, but it won't be today.
Understood. Chitose and I will have to tackle the Monolith ourselves, then.==W== I'll count on the rest of you to back up Firenze.
Got it. We'll head back and lend Firenze a hand. She needs the manpower.
Please be careful, Boss. Don't forget to read the Monolith safety protocols I put in your file.
I will. You stay safe out there too.
Phew. Let's hope it's fixed by morning.==W== Our odds are much better if both teams make wishes together.
I'm afraid that the cable car won't be an easy fix.
Industrial steel like that is incredibly hard to wish for. Even if someone manages to spawn it at the Wild Monolith, lugging something that heavy all the way out here is a nightmare.
You're looking at two or three days, minimum. Probably longer.
Then we might not even have a way back—
Wait. Se-Serena?! How long have you been standing there?!
I answered a loyal customer's call. Delivering intel the moment you need it—that's what makes me a professional.
That said... I mean you no harm.==W== Would you mind asking your friend to move her blade away from my neck?
My ==SEX11==. A cloak materialized in the grass behind you, and this strange woman emerged from it.
She speaks the truth. I sensed no malice, which is why I did not immediately cleave her in two. Still, she dared to take the position behind you.
How shall we handle her? I await your orders.
Stand down, Chitose.==W== I know her. This is Serena.
She tipped us off about the hotel escape route. She's helped us a lot since we got to Philae.==W== I guess you could call her ... a friend.
Aw, I'm honored! The Boss actually considers me a friend.
But friendships are a luxury in my line of work. Please, continue to see me as a reliable business partner instead.
Anyway, down to business. Omnisky Aegis has two teams in play.
One of them hauled a massive sack into the Monolith. No idea what kind of secret weapon is in there, but it reeks of bad news.
We haven't even paid for your last tip, and you're selling us more?
Consider it on the house. Let's say I have a distaste for Omnisky Aegis. Plus, that cable car they wrecked was a precious historical site.==W== It is tied to the Armless Saint, after all.
Think of it as my little way of supporting the Boss. Sound fair?
The Armless Saint... People in Philae say it's all a myth. Even the statue's a fake.
Is it a myth? Is it a fake? Who knows? But I do know one thing—the Armless Saint was very real.
According to records from centuries ago, the Saint and attendant started from where that exact cable station is located.
They ziplined through the dangerous lake...
Scaled the Monolith, and faced down the evil deity...
There were no cable cars back then, of course.
Someone built the station years later, commemorating the Saint's journey. Look under those cable cars and you'll still find the old plaques.
So anyone trying to claim the Saint never existed... Well, they must have their own motives.
Nazuka will love hearing this.==W== When she gets back, we should go hunting for proof together.==W== Could be fun.
Come to think of it, I'm looking at Philae's newest hero and an attendant with an injured hand right now. You walked that exact same path to the Monolith to end this pointless bidding war.
It's almost like that legendary scene. Quite a sight... Too bad someone's trying to ruin the moment.
Am I? You know what they say about history repeating itself.
As for my payment for that tip... Come by my room once this is all over, Boss. There's something I need to tell you in person.
Chitose and I bid Serena goodbye and head into the Monolith.
Thanks to my runs with the New Star Guild and everything Iris taught me, I know my way around these Monoliths.
Plus, with the layout constantly shifting, running into anyone else in here is a long shot.
If we keep our heads down, Omnisky Aegis shouldn't be a problem. Still...
My ==SEX11==, the Stellaroids on this floor are dealt with. Let us find the Wishing Box.
Normally we run in a squad of three. It maximizes the Monolith's buffs, and we cover each other to save energy.
But right now, Chitose is fighting solo. She won't admit it, but her grip on her weapon is shaking a bit. Exhaustion is catching up to her.
I need to find a way to help her.==W== Wait, that's it!
After a quick sweep of the floor, I spot a Wishing Box barely larger than my hand tucked in a corner.
My ==SEX11==, will this box yield the Artifact the Grace Imperium demands?
Probably not. It's way too small.
Makes sense. We're too far down in the Monolith to find a massive one. But this will do just fine.
Understood. Please step behind me. We must continue our ascent.
Hold on, Chitose. Let's rest here for today.
My ==SEX11==, please do not worry about me. Thanks to your care, I am still fully capable of fighting.
Haste makes waste.==W== Honestly, I'm wiped out. Let's recharge so we can tackle the tower properly tomorrow.
If you insist...==W== I will secure a place for rest at once.
No, no need.==W== We can catch our breath at that rest area over there. Just don't eat anything inside it.
I understand.==W== I brought some meat buns I made myself. Please, have one.
Oh! These are uniquely shaped!==W== Thank you!
By the way, you don't have a phone yet, do you? What kind would you like?
A-A phone?! But I am your blade. I belong at your side at all times. I have no need for such a precious Artifact.
Exactly. You're my blade, which means you need to answer my call at a moment's notice. It'd be inconvenient if you didn't have one, right?
That ... is a fair point. But since I belong to you, please be the one who decides its appearance.
O almighty God of Grace, hear our prayer...
It needs to handle long-range calls and text and photo messaging with similar devices, plus basic recording and calculator functions.
Keep it palm-sized, run it on magic, and enchant it with Heartlink.
Finally, make it look like a samurai holding a sword.
My ==SEX11==, the Wishing Box is glowing...
That means it worked. Look, it's opening—
I pull a white phone from the box. It comes with a sword-shaped stylus on the back, looking exactly like a samurai and a weapon.
A phone ... for me! I am forever in your debt.==W== I will tuck it safely into my bedding so no dust will ever scratch it.
Hey, don't bury it in your bedroll.==W== You're supposed to keep it on you.
Look. Tap them together like this, and we'll be connected.
We share the meat buns Chitose brought while I teach her how to type.
She fumbles with typing at first,==W== but soon enough,==W== she's texting me without a hitch.
My ==SEX11==, this phone thing ... is incredibly convenient.
I still prefer speaking face-to-face so I can look into your eyes.
But a tool that can communicate my thoughts to you from afar is nothing short of revolutionary.
Normally, these only work within the same Monolith's range, but mine ignores that rule.
No matter how far apart we are, we can always talk.
To hear your voice from miles away...
I must double down on my training!
I'm glad you're excited, but it's late.==W== I'll take first watch, so get some rest.
Oh...==W== I understand. It is chilly in this Monolith. I will warm your bed at once.
Warm my—? That's not... Ugh, fine. As long as she lies down.==W== If I can make her drowsy, she'll fall asleep.

About my journey—==W==and how you helped me master the Swordless Style.

param: On the lake island, you bump into Tilia. Serena suddenly catches up with a warning: Omnisky Aegis is still on your trail. Despite the pursuit, you scale the Monolith and make a wish, gifting a cell phone to Chitose.
Wait—is that a camp? Did another team beat us here?
What a coincidence!==W== Do you remember me? We chatted briefly back in Emor...
That day when the giant Stellaroid trashed the Ash District, I spotted a young knight shielding some kids.
You were my escort when I visited Feagin.
Yes, I'm Tilia!==W== Though technically I'm not a full knight yet... Just a squire.
When did you get to Philae?
I came here on guard duty for the banquet, and they selected me for the Monolith team!
Which makes us rivals today, Boss!==W== I'd love to say "friendship first," but for the honor of the Imperial Guard, let's give this everything we've got!
With me here, my ==SEX11== cannot lose.
Ah, the champion of justice!==W== So ... you were looking for ==PLAYER_NAME== that day.
Chitose, you two know each other?
Yes. She bought me a drink when I was searching for you in Emor.==W== I shall never forget the taste.
Now then, brave squire. My ==SEX11== and I must press on.
Goodbye! And stay safe out there!
Thanks. Good luck to you, too.
Captain, you can come out now.
That was close... Didn't expect to run into ==SEX4== here.==W== I threw a spear at ==SEX4== before. Sure, I didn't know who ==SEX== was, but I was still the one out of line.
Big shots like that hold grudges. We might've only been on Creta Trading's payroll, but that won't stop them from holding it against us.
==PLAYER_NAME=='s very kind. You have nothing to worry about.
Captain, they arrived after us, but they are already out searching for the Monolith entrance. Should we be dragging our feet like this? If Lady Greyhorn asks...
Lady Greyhorn won't lose her temper over us sitting by a campfire. Trust me. Let's eat first.
If anyone calls to rush us, tell them my unit is currently dining.
My ==SEX11==, I have located the entrance.
Half an hour later, deep in the forest, Chitose and I find an elevator built directly into the cliff face.
We haven't seen a soul. Did the Omnisky Aegis team already head inside?
Boss, we've got a problem. We can't reach the island!
Iris and Amber just met up with me. We were about to take the cable car over to back you up.
Amber grabbed us and bailed right before the car hit the water. We're safe, but ... my heart won't stop pounding.
That was too close. Looking at the severed ends, the sabotaged cable barely held when you and Chitose crossed. Gave out the moment it took on a second load.
I've notified Albedo. They'll repair it as quickly as possible, but it won't be today.
Understood. Chitose and I will have to tackle the Monolith ourselves, then.==W== I'll count on the rest of you to back up Firenze.
Got it. We'll head back and lend Firenze a hand. She needs the manpower.
Please be careful, Boss. Don't forget to read the Monolith safety protocols I put in your file.
I will. You stay safe out there too.
Phew. Let's hope it's fixed by morning.==W== Our odds are much better if both teams make wishes together.
I'm afraid that the cable car won't be an easy fix.
Industrial steel like that is incredibly hard to wish for. Even if someone manages to spawn it at the Wild Monolith, lugging something that heavy all the way out here is a nightmare.
You're looking at two or three days, minimum. Probably longer.
Then we might not even have a way back—
Wait. Se-Serena?! How long have you been standing there?!
I answered a loyal customer's call. Delivering intel the moment you need it—that's what makes me a professional.
That said... I mean you no harm.==W== Would you mind asking your friend to move her blade away from my neck?
My ==SEX11==. A cloak materialized in the grass behind you, and this strange woman emerged from it.
She speaks the truth. I sensed no malice, which is why I did not immediately cleave her in two. Still, she dared to take the position behind you.
How shall we handle her? I await your orders.
Stand down, Chitose.==W== I know her. This is Serena.
She tipped us off about the hotel escape route. She's helped us a lot since we got to Philae.==W== I guess you could call her ... a friend.
Aw, I'm honored! The Boss actually considers me a friend.
But friendships are a luxury in my line of work. Please, continue to see me as a reliable business partner instead.
Anyway, down to business. Omnisky Aegis has two teams in play.
One of them hauled a massive sack into the Monolith. No idea what kind of secret weapon is in there, but it reeks of bad news.
We haven't even paid for your last tip, and you're selling us more?
Consider it on the house. Let's say I have a distaste for Omnisky Aegis. Plus, that cable car they wrecked was a precious historical site.==W== It is tied to the Armless Saint, after all.
Think of it as my little way of supporting the Boss. Sound fair?
The Armless Saint... People in Philae say it's all a myth. Even the statue's a fake.
Is it a myth? Is it a fake? Who knows? But I do know one thing—the Armless Saint was very real.
According to records from centuries ago, the Saint and attendant started from where that exact cable station is located.
They ziplined through the dangerous lake...
Scaled the Monolith, and faced down the evil deity...
There were no cable cars back then, of course.
Someone built the station years later, commemorating the Saint's journey. Look under those cable cars and you'll still find the old plaques.
So anyone trying to claim the Saint never existed... Well, they must have their own motives.
Nazuka will love hearing this.==W== When she gets back, we should go hunting for proof together.==W== Could be fun.
Come to think of it, I'm looking at Philae's newest hero and an attendant with an injured hand right now. You walked that exact same path to the Monolith to end this pointless bidding war.
It's almost like that legendary scene. Quite a sight... Too bad someone's trying to ruin the moment.
Am I? You know what they say about history repeating itself.
As for my payment for that tip... Come by my room once this is all over, Boss. There's something I need to tell you in person.
Chitose and I bid Serena goodbye and head into the Monolith.
Thanks to my runs with the New Star Guild and everything Iris taught me, I know my way around these Monoliths.
Plus, with the layout constantly shifting, running into anyone else in here is a long shot.
If we keep our heads down, Omnisky Aegis shouldn't be a problem. Still...
My ==SEX11==, the Stellaroids on this floor are dealt with. Let us find the Wishing Box.
Normally we run in a squad of three. It maximizes the Monolith's buffs, and we cover each other to save energy.
But right now, Chitose is fighting solo. She won't admit it, but her grip on her weapon is shaking a bit. Exhaustion is catching up to her.
I need to find a way to help her.==W== Wait, that's it!

My ==SEX11==, will this box yield the Artifact the Grace Imperium demands?

Makes sense. We're too far down in the Monolith to find a massive one. But this will do just fine.

strings.text: Chitose opens up about her past travels. On another front, Cosette stumbles into an ambush and manages to save Noctiluna. With enemies breathing down your neck, you head for the Monolith's hidden floor.
This was a little over a month ago.
Doctor Coronis and I were passing through a decaying city.==W== It was filled with the sick.
Cough. Thank you, Doctor.==W== Will you actually make a wish to the God of Grace for us?
I will. When I return, I'll bring you a blessing from the God of Grace.
Thank goodness. Um, if I may ask... What kind of Artifact will it be?
Oh, my. That is for the God of Grace to decide. It isn't our place to guess.
Ah, you're right. Cough. Forgive me.==W== Here, take these Dorra. It's not much, but please accept it.
Keep your Dorra. Taking it would taint your wish.==W== For now, simply pray to the God of Grace.
Next house? I thought we were heading to the Monolith.
The Monolith? Why? We have plenty of patients left.
But Doctor, you said you would bring them a blessing from the God of Grace. Did you not mean medicine wished from the Monolith?
Hehe.==W== They need medicine, yes, but not the kind you're thinking of. What they need are—
Yes. Most of the "severe illnesses" in this city boil down to malnutrition. They survive on the cheapest food available, a diet devoid of meat or vegetables. It's only natural that they get sick.
Then why do they not eat a proper diet? Their living room was full of Artifacts. They hardly seemed impoverished.
Hard to say.==W== Think about it—have we seen a single corporate branch since we arrived?
This city's Monolith grants the same Artifacts you'd find out in the Wilds, so no company is investing here, leaving the locals to scrape by on farming and weaving.
You can't blame the locals, of course. But they're convinced their poverty is a punishment for not being devout enough to the God of Grace.
They try to outdo each other by buying Artifacts from Trekkers and companies. They think proving their devotion will convince the Grace Imperium to bless this city with a company of its own.
That house we visited wasn't only full of Artifacts. It was buried under collection notices from Deepsea Finance. These people are taking out loans to buy more of them.
That explains the poverty. They skip meals to chip away at their debts, and any spare Dorra they scrape together is blown on another Artifact.
I know the agony of starvation all too well. Had my ==SEX11== not offered me a meal, I wouldn't be here today.
Heh. Glad we're on the same page. Because I can't cure this illness, but you can.
O Guardian of Goodwind, hear my prayer. Wash away all misfortune, sin, and impurity.==W== Thus I, Chitose, humbly offer my reverence.
Doctor, will this suffice?==W== These are the only prayers from my homeland I can recall...
Oh, very authentic. But...==W== Sorry to step on your beliefs, but it'd be perfect if you swapped "Guardian of Goodwind" for "God of Grace."
A-Are you certain this is acceptable? I fear a hastily patched prayer carries little weight... Even this attire is merely a miko-style scabbard I stitched together from hazy memories.
It's the conviction that matters. Doesn't your homeland have sayings like "Faith moves mountains" or "Belief makes it real"?

Hand out these meat buns we made and announce they're a blessing from the God of Grace. Tell them to eat more of these "Soul Stone" buns,==W== and use different fillings to represent the different stone colors.
Understood. But why resort to deception? As a physician, wouldn't it make more sense to tell them the truth?
Because the root of their illness isn't physical.==W== It's psychological.
They know they need to eat. But their idealized God of Grace is their only hope.==W== This pointless competition of devotion has trapped them all, and nobody wants to be the first to quit.
Even so, blindly clinging to that faith will kill them.==W== They need a symbol, someone convincing enough to act as a divine messenger and tell them it's okay to try a different approach.
Strange, isn't it? Everyone lies to themselves, yet humanity somehow finds comfort in that shared delusion.==W== That game of "make-believe" is how people survive the darkest days.
As for why I chose you... It's purely about credibility.==W== I don't have a devout bone in my body. They'd see right through me in a heartbeat.
I understand. If playing this part can save these people...==W== I shall do my utmost to make them believe that these meat buns are a true blessing from the God of Grace.
I see. You made that outfit to help Doctor Coronis treat the sick and stop people from wasting money on Artifacts.
But I'm missing something. Didn't you say...
About my journey—==W==and how you helped me master the Swordless Style.
A month ago... I was still working at United Harvest. How could I have helped you?

Well... That's because...==W== When I was handing out the God of Grace's blessings...==W== I needed to sound convincing. To feel like a true messenger, the image of the God I pictured in my mind was ...==W== you.==W==
And in doing so,==W== I suddenly understood your heart,==W== my ==SEX11==.==W== I took a small step forward on our shared path of Oneness.==W== After that, the "Swordless Style" came to me naturally.
All that from thinking about me?
While handing out those blessings, I realized that ... I was bringing hope to the believers. I became someone they could rely on, just like I rely on you.
Doctor Coronis said they were all lying to themselves. Perhaps she was right... But I see it differently.
I may have been a fake miko, but the doctor's kindness was real. It wasn't my outfit or flimsy lies that convinced them.==W== They believed me because ...==W== they felt that kindness.

That's when I finally understood you, my ==SEX11==. Why you shared your food with me, and worried about my safety when your own life was in danger.==W== Why you always go out of your way to help others,==W== even at your own expense.
I admire that about you.==W== I want to be the blade that protects you...==W==
Ahem.==W== I'm not that noble.==W== I do what I think is right...==W== And if we're talking about kindness, Chitose, you're the one who—
... Finally asleep huh?==W== Heh.==W== You've had a long day, Chitose.
Tonight, let your "==SEX11==" protect you. Get some rest.
Hmm...==W== What should I drink tonight?
Sweet Liquid Jade,==W== fizzy Pep Pep Juice,==W== or that bitter black coffee==W== that keeps you awake all night?
Ugh, tough choice.==W== But I haven't found the Boss yet, and searching this Monolith is draining. Looks like coffee it is.==W== Alright,==W== let's make a wish!
Oh stingy God of Grace who gives only one choice at a time...==W== If my memories are well-suited, take them and grant my wish.==W== I'll trade for—
Hmph. Got it. That should be the last Stellaroid on this floor.
Soul Stones are almost dry.==W== Abandoned Monoliths are a nightmare—Stellaroids everywhere, tough ones too.==W== What a pain.
Yeah. But our job ends here. How'd the wish go?
The closest we got is this Artifact:==W== a shooter toy that holds water. Load it with dissolved poison, shoot,==W== and it should get the job done.
Isn't that a kid's toy?==W== Whatever. With a request that ridiculous, Squad Two probably didn't fare better.==W== As long as it fits the bill, we're good.
We have the Artifact. Let's prep the main event.==W== Bring her out—
The trekker drops the sack from his back, revealing a face Cosette knows all too well.
Huh? Is that ...==W== Noctiluna?!==W== How did she get caught?
Hey, Nocturn Eterna. You know what you swallowed earlier, right?
Right.==W== So do as we say.==W== You wouldn't want to die here, right?==W== We're already being generous not handing you to the Sentinel of Dawn.==W==
I...==W== I understand.==W== What do you want me to do?
Aren't your people experts at ... triggering Monolith Meltdowns?
We're leaving now.==W== Once we're gone, trigger a Meltdown here.==W== Then meet us outside for the antidote, and we're square.
Trigger a Meltdown...==W== Okay. I'll do it. I'll draw the array now.
Hey, slow down!==W== We're not even in the elevator yet!
Behind you! A Stellaroid—==W==wait, no!==W== Nocturn Eterna?!
Hmpf.==W== A pint-sized Nocturn Eterna brat?==W== Please. Let's see who hits harder—<size=45>Aa</size><size=48>aa</size><size=51>aa</size><size=54>aa</size><size=57>argh!!!</size>==W==
N-No way...==W== She blocked that head-on?!
Using my power on anyone but the Boss is a waste.==W== But bad guys need a beatdown...==W== Time to get to work!==W==
Phew, that's all of them.==W== You okay, Noctiluna? Here, drink the antidote.
Thanks, Cosette. What are you doing here?
I have my own mission. But what about you? These Trekkers were decent, but there's no way they caught you that easily.
Well... I'm behind on my quota.==W== Lady Aeloria expects three Monolith Meltdowns a year.==W== It's already Venatio Month, and I'm still two short.
But there are way too many Trekkers around Philae. Triggering a Meltdown there ...==W== wouldn't be right.
This Lake Island Monolith is usually empty, but I couldn't find a way across.==W== So I faked drinking their poison and let them capture me. Free ride inside.
So, that's the gist of it. Give me a sec to finish drawing the Meltdown array.
Look, I-I'll help you trigger a Meltdown at a different Monolith!==W== So don't draw that array here!
Why not? It's empty in here. I'll drag these Trekkers outside once the Meltdown starts so no one gets hurt.
I don't doubt Noctiluna's skills,==W== but if she triggers a Meltdown here, the Stellaroids might wipe out that weakling Boss!==W== There goes my mission!
Uh... Well... Right! This Monolith grants wishes for a super rare limited-edition soda!==W== If you wreck the place, it's gone!
Oh, that is a shame. Alright, fine. But we need to find an empty Monolith.
Lucky break this time, Boss. I'm letting you off the hook...==W== But next time, you're mine!
Manager, Squad Two reporting in. Mission complete—thirty Artifacts secured through wishes.
Good work. Now, where is Squad One?
Ambushed, it seems...==W== We found them knocked out and dumped outside the Monolith.
Using Nocturn Eterna...==W== A clever idea,==W== but looks like they got played.
The wishing process drained our memory and stamina... Squad Two is tapped out.==W== We can't keep going.
Understood. Omnisky Aegis has booked you a premier sanitarium for the next six months. Rest up. You'll receive triple pay, as promised. Omnisky Aegis takes care of its own.
I'd expect nothing less...==W== Thank you...==W==
Heh. In a fair wishing contest, my Trekkers could never beat you, Boss.
This test never had a single right answer.==W== I'll crush you with sheer volume.==W== If we take everything and leave you nothing to wish for, you score a zero.
Chitose, three steps to the left, then head for the pillar. When they turn, sprint for the elevator.
Not yet...==W== Hold on...==W== Wait for the opening.
The metal doors slide shut, cutting off the charging Stellaroids.
A brilliant tactic, my ==SEX11==.==W== Coordinating by phone allowed us to scout the whole floor without a single fight.
Heh. Thank the phone, not me.==W== I'm glad you're getting the hang of it.
With Chitose as my only fighter,==RT==I devised a new tactic this morning.
The plan is simple:==RT==Chitose uses her agility to distance herself from the Stellaroids==RT==while I locate the Wishing Boxes and the elevator.
Then, I just guide her through the blind spots via phone.
It saves time and, more importantly,==RT==keeps Chitose from burning out.
Any luck with the Wishing Boxes, my ==SEX11==?
Yes, but someone beat us to the good ones. All that's left are micro-boxes, smaller than my palm.
They still work, though. I wished for ointment and bandages. Give me your hand—let me change that for you.
Thank you, my ==SEX11==.==W== But this team ahead of us... Are they with Omnisky Aegis?
Probably. The Monolith supposedly holds a fixed number of boxes. The later you climb, the worse your odds.
They respawn eventually, but likely not before our deadline.
Which leaves us with one option...
I check the notes Iris gave me. She circled one specific line:
Officially, the Philae Monolith has fifty floors. However,==RT==there are Trekker logs that mention a hidden fifty-first.
If this hidden floor exists, expect threats on par with the massive Emor Stellaroid. Boss, do not go up there under any circumstances.
Alright.==W== Let's go to the very top.
I wonder how Firenze's holding up. I hope everything is okay.

Even so, blindly clinging to that faith will kill them.==W== They need a symbol, someone convincing enough to act as a divine messenger and tell them it's okay to try a different approach.
Strange, isn't it? Everyone lies to themselves, yet humanity somehow finds comfort in that shared delusion.==W== That game of "make-believe" is how people survive the darkest days.
As for why I chose you... It's purely about credibility.==W== I don't have a devout bone in my body. They'd see right through me in a heartbeat.
I understand. If playing this part can save these people...==W== I shall do my utmost to make them believe that these meat buns are a true blessing from the God of Grace.
I see. You made that outfit to help Doctor Coronis treat the sick and stop people from wasting money on Artifacts.
But I'm missing something. Didn't you say...
About my journey—==W==and how you helped me master the Swordless Style.
A month ago... I was still working at United Harvest. How could I have helped you?

Well... That's because...==W== When I was handing out the God of Grace's blessings...==W== I needed to sound convincing. To feel like a true messenger, the image of the God I pictured in my mind was ...==W== you.==W==
And in doing so,==W== I suddenly understood your heart,==W== my ==SEX11==.==W== I took a small step forward on our shared path of Oneness.==W== After that, the "Swordless Style" came to me naturally.
All that from thinking about me?
While handing out those blessings, I realized that ... I was bringing hope to the believers. I became someone they could rely on, just like I rely on you.
Doctor Coronis said they were all lying to themselves. Perhaps she was right... But I see it differently.
I may have been a fake miko, but the doctor's kindness was real. It wasn't my outfit or flimsy lies that convinced them.==W== They believed me because ...==W== they felt that kindness.

That's when I finally understood you, my ==SEX11==. Why you shared your food with me, and worried about my safety when your own life was in danger.==W== Why you always go out of your way to help others,==W== even at your own expense.
I admire that about you.==W== I want to be the blade that protects you...==W==
Ahem.==W== I'm not that noble.==W== I do what I think is right...==W== And if we're talking about kindness, Chitose, you're the one who—
... Finally asleep huh?==W== Heh.==W== You've had a long day, Chitose.
Tonight, let your "==SEX11==" protect you. Get some rest.
Hmm...==W== What should I drink tonight?
Sweet Liquid Jade,==W== fizzy Pep Pep Juice,==W== or that bitter black coffee==W== that keeps you awake all night?
Ugh, tough choice.==W== But I haven't found the Boss yet, and searching this Monolith is draining. Looks like coffee it is.==W== Alright,==W== let's make a wish!
Oh stingy God of Grace who gives only one choice at a time...==W== If my memories are well-suited, take them and grant my wish.==W== I'll trade for—
Hmph. Got it. That should be the last Stellaroid on this floor.
Soul Stones are almost dry.==W== Abandoned Monoliths are a nightmare—Stellaroids everywhere, tough ones too.==W== What a pain.
Yeah. But our job ends here. How'd the wish go?
The closest we got is this Artifact:==W== a shooter toy that holds water. Load it with dissolved poison, shoot,==W== and it should get the job done.
Isn't that a kid's toy?==W== Whatever. With a request that ridiculous, Squad Two probably didn't fare better.==W== As long as it fits the bill, we're good.
We have the Artifact. Let's prep the main event.==W== Bring her out—
The trekker drops the sack from his back, revealing a face Cosette knows all too well.
Huh? Is that ...==W== Noctiluna?!==W== How did she get caught?
Hey, Nocturn Eterna. You know what you swallowed earlier, right?
Right.==W== So do as we say.==W== You wouldn't want to die here, right?==W== We're already being generous not handing you to the Sentinel of Dawn.==W==
I...==W== I understand.==W== What do you want me to do?
Aren't your people experts at ... triggering Monolith Meltdowns?
We're leaving now.==W== Once we're gone, trigger a Meltdown here.==W== Then meet us outside for the antidote, and we're square.
Trigger a Meltdown...==W== Okay. I'll do it. I'll draw the array now.
Hey, slow down!==W== We're not even in the elevator yet!
Behind you! A Stellaroid—==W==wait, no!==W== Nocturn Eterna?!
Hmpf.==W== A pint-sized Nocturn Eterna brat?==W== Please. Let's see who hits harder—<size=45>Aa</size><size=48>aa</size><size=51>aa</size><size=54>aa</size><size=57>argh!!!</size>==W==
N-No way...==W== She blocked that head-on?!
Using my power on anyone but the Boss is a waste.==W== But bad guys need a beatdown...==W== Time to get to work!==W==
Phew, that's all of them.==W== You okay, Noctiluna? Here, drink the antidote.
Thanks, Cosette. What are you doing here?
I have my own mission. But what about you? These Trekkers were decent, but there's no way they caught you that easily.
Well... I'm behind on my quota.==W== Lady Aeloria expects three Monolith Meltdowns a year.==W== It's already Venatio Month, and I'm still two short.
But there are way too many Trekkers around Philae. Triggering a Meltdown there ...==W== wouldn't be right.
This Lake Island Monolith is usually empty, but I couldn't find a way across.==W== So I faked drinking their poison and let them capture me. Free ride inside.
So, that's the gist of it. Give me a sec to finish drawing the Meltdown array.
Look, I-I'll help you trigger a Meltdown at a different Monolith!==W== So don't draw that array here!
Why not? It's empty in here. I'll drag these Trekkers outside once the Meltdown starts so no one gets hurt.
I don't doubt Noctiluna's skills,==W== but if she triggers a Meltdown here, the Stellaroids might wipe out that weakling Boss!==W== There goes my mission!
Uh... Well... Right! This Monolith grants wishes for a super rare limited-edition soda!==W== If you wreck the place, it's gone!
Oh, that is a shame. Alright, fine. But we need to find an empty Monolith.
Lucky break this time, Boss. I'm letting you off the hook...==W== But next time, you're mine!
Manager, Squad Two reporting in. Mission complete—thirty Artifacts secured through wishes.
Good work. Now, where is Squad One?
Ambushed, it seems...==W== We found them knocked out and dumped outside the Monolith.
Using Nocturn Eterna...==W== A clever idea,==W== but looks like they got played.
The wishing process drained our memory and stamina... Squad Two is tapped out.==W== We can't keep going.
Understood. Omnisky Aegis has booked you a premier sanitarium for the next six months. Rest up. You'll receive triple pay, as promised. Omnisky Aegis takes care of its own.
I'd expect nothing less...==W== Thank you...==W==
Heh. In a fair wishing contest, my Trekkers could never beat you, Boss.
This test never had a single right answer.==W== I'll crush you with sheer volume.==W== If we take everything and leave you nothing to wish for, you score a zero.
Chitose, three steps to the left, then head for the pillar. When they turn, sprint for the elevator.
Not yet...==W== Hold on...==W== Wait for the opening.
The metal doors slide shut, cutting off the charging Stellaroids.
A brilliant tactic, my ==SEX11==.==W== Coordinating by phone allowed us to scout the whole floor without a single fight.
Heh. Thank the phone, not me.==W== I'm glad you're getting the hang of it.
With Chitose as my only fighter,==RT==I devised a new tactic this morning.
The plan is simple:==RT==Chitose uses her agility to distance herself from the Stellaroids==RT==while I locate the Wishing Boxes and the elevator.
Then, I just guide her through the blind spots via phone.
It saves time and, more importantly,==RT==keeps Chitose from burning out.
Any luck with the Wishing Boxes, my ==SEX11==?
Yes, but someone beat us to the good ones. All that's left are micro-boxes, smaller than my palm.
They still work, though. I wished for ointment and bandages. Give me your hand—let me change that for you.
Thank you, my ==SEX11==.==W== But this team ahead of us... Are they with Omnisky Aegis?
Probably. The Monolith supposedly holds a fixed number of boxes. The later you climb, the worse your odds.
They respawn eventually, but likely not before our deadline.
Which leaves us with one option...
I check the notes Iris gave me. She circled one specific line:
Officially, the Philae Monolith has fifty floors. However,==RT==there are Trekker logs that mention a hidden fifty-first.
If this hidden floor exists, expect threats on par with the massive Emor Stellaroid. Boss, do not go up there under any circumstances.
Alright.==W== Let's go to the very top.
I wonder how Firenze's holding up. I hope everything is okay.

strings.text: As you and Chitose forge ahead, Firenze and Nyx work their own angles to raise funds by locking in a 80-billion-Dorra contract. Meanwhile, Mercurio quietly steps into Deepsea Finance to request a loan of her own...
Weapons down! Hands behind your heads, get on the ground!
Not even putting up a fight?==W== I thought you were assassins.
Assassins? What?==W== No, no, no, we'd never do anything like that! You have to believe us!
We're innocent! We're ordinary Trekkers, we don't break the law!
Right. Because "ordinary Trekkers" usually stalk around hotels armed to the teeth, glaring at everyone.
That was the job! The people who hired us said ...==W== the VIP staying here likes a rough-and-tumble vibe...
They told us to bring our gear, wave it around, and cheer on cue.
Yeah, exactly! They even offered a bonus to whoever looked the meanest.==W== Of course we put on a show!
... What a bizarre gig.==W== Who hired you? Give me names.
W-We don't know! But we recognize them. They used to be local gang bosses here in Philae, before they joined some big company.
20 grand a day. That barely covers a week of groceries! Who commits murder for pocket change?
Exactly! You should be grilling the guys who actually rushed the hotel. I heard they got 100 grand a head!
Sorry for the wait, Firenze.==W== I have the full picture. Most of our captives had no clue that Boss was here. They were duped with a fake gig.
The ones who actually stormed the building got paid a bit more.==W== But their only objective was to wreck the stairs and front doors to trap the guests inside.
A clever play by Omnisky Aegis. These pawns nearly ruined everything. Fortunately, Noya just sent word—Boss made it to the island safely.
For the next two days, Philae is our battlefield.==W== Closing a 20-billion-Dorra gap won't be easy.
Relax! As planned, we have a mountain of Tawny Nightingales ready—plenty for everyone here for the free bread.
And as instructed, we gave them out with fresh produce and our better-textured products. Everyone left happy.
You turned their trap into a PR stunt. That's classic Firenze, airtight as always.
Heh. Playing by the rules never protects what matters.==W== Nyx, the rest is yours.
Understood. Chaos is just another day in marketing. I'm used to this.
Ruby, Sapphire.==W== Find this greenhouse employee. Bring her to Fenghuang Diner on Aswan Street within the hour. Here's her file.
Thank you...==W== Oh? How intriguing. I've never had a blend like this in Philae. Are these leaves from Cangwu?
Oh, you know your tea! The tree it comes from grows on a cliff right outside Cangwu. It's rare—the only one of its kind in the whole city, actually.
Is that so? This must be a precious cup of tea, then.
Well, the variety is unique of course, but you can find tea this good all over Cangwu.
Jiyue, don't serve our guest the leaves from a random seed you planted as a kid and call it a "rare variety."
Hehe, I was only sharing some Cangwu lore to entertain Lady Firenze! Besides, it is indeed the only tree of its kind in Cangwu.
My apologies for the wait, Lady Firenze. We're in the middle of the lunch rush.
Think nothing of it. I'm the one who dropped in unannounced.
However, I saw you both representing Fenghuang Diner at the banquet the other night. I assume you hold the decision-making power here?
That depends on the scope of the decision.==W== For commercial negotiations like this, we defer to our on-site manager.
I approve of that approach. We can truly understand customer needs only by listening to the staff on the floor.
Oh, here comes our manager now.
Yunshu, Jiyue, sorry, I'm late! What's on the agenda for today?
Jinglin, let me introduce Lady Firenze, Executive Director of United Harvest Philae. She's here to discuss a business partnership.
Lady Firenze, this is Jinglin. She manages our Jing's Bistro, and she'll be making the call today.
I'm Firenze.==W== A pleasure to meet you, Manager Jinglin. I apologize for dropping in during your lunch rush, so I'll get straight to the point.
Fenghuang Diner has five locations across Philae. I was wondering how do you currently sources ingredients?
If you're open to it, our company would like to step in as your primary supplier.
Ingredient sourcing...==W== Our staff heads to the local markets early every morning to handpick everything.
That means our daily haul dictates our menu.==W== I admit, it can be a hassle.
From that perspective, a reliable supplier brings peace of mind...
But we cannot partner with United Harvest Philae.
You are an esteemed guest, but I must be blunt.==W== The quality of United Harvest's ingredients is unacceptable.
My mother still complains about your ingredients from our early days in Philae. Unevenly ripe tomatoes from the same batch, bland meat and vegetables.
We remember your sales pitch from last year, too. Your reps push pre-made meals and suggest we let Intelligent Plants handle the cooking.
I have no intention of criticizing your business model,==W== but it clashes with our core values.
That dedication ensures your consistent flavor and pricing.==W== No wonder you command strong customer loyalty.
I dine here often myself. It is a loss for Philae if this place ever loses its authentic touch.
Oh, um...==W== Thank you?==W== To avoid any misunderstandings, I realize that United Harvest Philae today is not the old United Harvest.
The bread coming out of your bakeries smells amazing. I hear the praise from our own customers.
I remain open to sourcing from you once your product quality improves. But for today, my answer is no.
Your track record makes it impossible for me to trust you right away. So...
Is Jinglin being too harsh? We know from the banquet that the Boss and Firenze want to turn this company around.
Plus, partnering with them stabilizes the Novian grain trade. That aligns with Cangwu's interests. If United Harvest Philae goes under...
Keep your voice down. We're only observing under the guise of Fenghuang Diner. Besides, the person on the ground should make the call. It's not our place to step in.
And if Firenze truly intends to rebuild United Harvest Philae, she won't give up this easily.
You make a fair point, Manager Jinglin. Asking for your trust without any actual results to show for it would be incredibly naive.
That said,==W== while you might not trust United Harvest Philae, what if I offered you her?==W== I intend to put our future product inspections in her hands.
W-Waah! I'm sorry! I admit it, I snuck my homegrown veggies into Jing's Bistro to sell...==W== But, but...
Please don't fire me! I haven't even watered the peas today!
United Harvest Philae's agricultural inspections will be handled by this veteran greenhouse gardener,==W== Ridge. Our partnership with Fenghuang Diner will be her very first assignment.
Wait, what?==W== Inspections?==W== Me?==W== But ... farming is all I know!
Don't worry. Ruby and Sapphire will help you with the specifics.
If Ridge is taking full responsibility...==W== Hmm. I did promise to actively consider a partnership, and I can't go back on my word...
Jinglin, is she really that good?
Yeah! she cares about vegetables, fruits—basically anything that grows in the dirt—more than she does herself.
The produce she delivered was the best I've ever bought. If she's running the inspections, and with the changes in United Harvest Philae...==W== I think we can trust them.
I am thrilled to hear that.==W== Let's draft the details of our partnership right away.
Ah, why don't we talk over some food? I'll go whip something up right now!
The pleasure was ours.==W== It was a productive meeting. We'll deliver the first batch tomorrow.
I-I'll do my best to help!
L-Lady Firenze, are you sure about tasking me with something as important as quality control?==W== Inspecting all the fruits, vegetables, and meat...?
You'll be fine. I only asked you because I trust you can handle it.==W== And as I mentioned, Ruby and Sapphire will cover the paperwork.
Channel that same energy you had when you were catching the "thief" and you'll be fine.
They look shiny and plump.==RT==Didn't expect a harvest like this in this greenhouse.
I thought it'd be something like monsters disguised as tomatoes.
Ugh, forgive my mix-up earlier...==W== But wait, Lady Firenze. Does this mean you aren't mad about me growing and selling veggies on the side...?
Heh. I never minded. If anything, I should be thanking you.==W== You're the reason Fenghuang Diner agreed to partner with us.
That manager looks young, but she drives a brutal bargain.
This contract secures an 8-billion-Dorra grain order from their Philae and Port Goldfinch branches. The 4-billion advance hits our accounts tomorrow.
Loongs have bottomless appetites. I know they run 10 branches across both cities, but do they burn through that much food in a single year?
It goes beyond Fenghuang Diner. A massive chunk ships straight from Port Goldfinch to Cangwu via coastal and river routes.
Loongs obsess over their grain reserves. That stockpile is likely their true objective.
Still, Lady Firenze, the deposit comes due tomorrow, and we're still 14 billion short.==W== If you plan to pitch to other investors, I can prep the materials now...
Relax. Every major player is watching this contract closely. They will seek us out on their own.
Since we convinced the notoriously cautious Loongs, the rest of the market naturally assumes we are a safe bet.
We only need ...==W== a little catalyst.==W== Ruby, make sure that 8-billion figure leaks to the public.
On it. I know a few witches hungry for some "breaking news."
Sorry. The branch is closed. Please return tomorrow...
Oh? Are you certain?==W== Turn me away now, and you kiss a massive deal goodbye.
Precisely. Tell your manager Omnisky Aegis==W== requires a loan.<color=#3faeae><size=120%> 4==W==0==W== billion</size></color>==W== Dorra!
