strings.text: Reflecting on this journey, you begin to question who you really are. The other three Tetrad Aspects publicly distance themselves from Angie and propose an official investigation to clear your name.
Please answer one question, ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W== Would you believe, to this day, that you are the legendary Tyrant?
Eventually, I didn't give Albedo an answer.
Because I didn't know who I really was... Even now, the answer still escapes me.
Chitose, you thirsty?==W== Here, you can have this.
Thank you, my ==SEX11==. I'd gladly take it then.==W== Gulp...==W== Whoa, what is this? I can taste the peach, and fizzy bubbles are dancing on my tongue...==W== How incredible!
It's carbonated.==W== The name is Pep Pep Juice. You can wish for it inside the Monolith.
Noya once said,==W== the fizzy kick can take your mind off all your troubles...==W==
But the ones from this vending machine are knockoffs produced by United Harvest Philae,==W== so it's hard to say==W== whether they actually do the trick.
My ==SEX11==...==W== Are you worried that the Salvation Committee might attack again?
No, not when I've got a blade I can trust by my side.==W== With you here, they're barely a threat.
I know this petal.==W== It's the same kind that warned me and took me to you.
Chitose,==W== do you mind waiting here for me?
As you wish.==W== Please stay sharp, my ==SEX11==.

Following the petals, I walk the quiet path through the factory grounds, slip through a large hole in the fence, and step into the greenhouse filled with shadow-casting sunlight and battle-ridden memories.
Otoha, thanks for saving me today.==W== If it weren't for you, I would've been shot by the Scepter of Death.==W== Wait, that smell from you... I remember it back at the banquet...==W==
And...==W== Let's keep what happened just between us.
That strange smell...==W== It's blood, masked by flowers.
Otoha, are you hurt?==W== Last time, you got injured at the banquet, didn't you? Have you gone to the doctor?
It's just a scratch, nothing to worry about.==W== The Sentinels' magic is too wimpy to break me.
But I must say...==W== I'm truly flustered that you still remember such a trivial thing from that evening.
You really have a way of winning people over.==W== That girl by your side, like a blade kept closest to the body,==W== must have been drawn to your considerate nature, too.
"A blade kept closest"...==W== You mean Chitose?==W== Look, you're giving me way too much credit.==W== Anyone would worry about the injured.
You don't have to be so modest, Boss.==W== From that night on, I've been yours.
M-==W==my what?==W== What are you even talking about, Otoha?==W== When did we ever—==W==
Heh heh. Why do you blush?==W== I only meant I've been on your side all along.==W== Were you imagining something else?
Ahem...!==W== Geez,==W== don't put it in such a way.
Hehehe...==W== Please forgive me.==W== It's just that you're so adorably gullible, and I couldn't resist teasing you a little... ♪==W==
You just escaped an ambush, yet you still went off alone without any guard, chasing some flower petals...==W== Isn't that gullible?
I see what you mean. But I promised—==W==
Keep my free bodyguard gig a secret from everyone beyond you and the New Star Guild.
Besides,==W== I wasn't technically "alone."==W== Knowing you, I'm sure you were keeping an eye on me the whole time.==W== With you around, it doesn't count as "being alone."
...==W== My my.==W== A gullible Boss surely knows a lot of sweet nothings.
Anyway, if my intel is correct,==W== Grace Imperium will reach out to you tomorrow to explain the situation.
Tomorrow?==W== Even Albedo couldn't give me a confirmed date.
Heh.==W== Never underestimate how well-connected a former ninja can be.
Come to think of it... You actually got the famously tight-lipped Chief Bookkeeper to talk.==W== What's your trick?
I didn't do anything. She came to me and shared some intel, all to prove that Grace Imperium was not the culprit.
True that. But people don't go out of their way to prove themselves to you unless you've earned their respect,==W== which means you've already built trust with Grace Imperium.
Respect, huh... You think way too highly of me...==W== I need intel from you too.==W== Do you know where the two Sky Institute employees with Albedo went?
She hasn't been able to reach them since they parted ways at the hotel.
You mean the cute shopkeeper and the fry fanatic with the lance?==W== Looks like they ended up with the Committee's fleeing soldiers.

I can't tell whether they were taken against their will or went along with the group.==W== Either way, they're not in immediate danger. If the Committee wanted them dead, they wouldn't have bothered taking them,==W== don't you think so?

Here is a kind reminder, Boss: now's not the time to worry about others. Not even I can get a full picture of the Salvation Committee's true capabilities.==W== But from what I've known, they can mobilize more resources than a large company like United Harvest.
When did you dig all this up? Back at the banquet, you said...==W==
As the world wakes up to your existence, "nuisances" like today will keep occurring. Eventually, someone will try to eliminate you using much more brutal, direct methods...

It was merely a coincidence. When I plotted against Goodwind Homecare in your shadow, I took the privilege to collect some extra leads. Out of curiosity, I started digging ... and found something huge.
Otoha, you saved my life when things got hairy today. And now you're still watching my back...
I don't know what you've found out so far, but I can't help wondering: have you been looking out for me all along? Ever since that banquet?
You bet. I've been treating myself to that adorable sleeping face of yours every single night~
Well... I'm really lucky to have you as my ally, Otoha. I feel like I keep putting you out.
You don't need to feel bad about this.==W== Hmm... If you really want to make it up to me…==W== Just be straight with me.==W== Are you the legendary Tyrant?
So please,==W==<color=#bd3059> my Tyrant</color>,==W== don't become a star once more.
Ah, you've misread it.==W== It's Boss.
The way you pronounced it,==W==<color=#bd3059> Tyrant</color>...==W== That's an ancient form.==W== It hasn't been used in a very, very long time.
Welcome back to the "Well of Worlds" Tyrant Development System,==W== dear <color=#bd3059>Tyrant</color>.
Hehe, I'll get going and take the wheel,<color=#bd3059> Tyrant</color>.==W== Give me a shout if you need anything!
You don't have to use that title...==W==
Why not? It's pretty awesome, right? Don't you all agree?
Well, using "<color=#bd3059>Boss</color>" seems more appropriate for official matters, considering our positions as employees of "Boss Accord."
I'll just use the name saved in your contacts.
I am Chitose, the blade forged only for you, my<color=#bd3059> ==SEX11==</color>.
I've ... always admired that sculpture—the one of the <color=#bd3059>hero</color> who sacrificed everything to save others.
But you are <color=#bd3059>Your Majesty</color>. The one true Tyrant. I, Darcia, swear my eternal loyalty to you.
All <color=#bd3059>Trekkers</color>==W== are sworn to help those who've lost their memories.
Dreams, reality, lost memories...==W== "Tyrant," they call me. "Boss." "My ==SEX11==." "Master." "Hero." And "Trekker"...==W==
I've been running from that question all along.==W== But now, it's time to face it.
When they brand me as the Tyrant...
I don't think==W== I'm some important figure.
I was found inside a Wishing Box,==W== with no memory, no identity, so I could be an ordinary lost Trekker.==W==
Even my "magic immunity" trait==W== might just be the result of a desperate wish to the Monolith,==W== which would explain why I lost all my memories—too high a price for me to pay.
I don't see myself as the legendary Tyrant,==W== and I don't want to be some one-of-a-kind figure either.
I just want to live my life as a Trekker,==W== stay with my friends, on our own terms.
Are you satisfied with my answer?
Very much so. Honestly, I don't really care who you are.==W== What truly matters is whether you can hold yourself steady when you're in a dire situation like this.
Thinking about it now, asking that question was completely unnecessary.==W== You didn't flinch when I had you tied up. Why would a little "Tyrant hunt" ever shake you?
The "Tyrant" is a title.==W== And titles only matter if people acknowledge them.
If I started calling myself Ruler of Nova and demanded tithes from everyone, they'd only think I was insane.
Bastelina and Iris both told me==W== that the term "Tyrant" is an ancient form.
So even if there was a Tyrant in history,==W== they must have long been forsaken,==W== which means the title itself carries no real meaning now.
So,==W== whatever makes Angie believe I'm the Tyrant ...==W== is nothing more than her and her followers' misinterpretation.
I am who I am,==W== a Trekker who helped defend Philae alongside everyone else,==W== and the CEO of Boss Accord.==W==
If anything, I'm just the Boss in name,==W== not some apocalyptic tyrant in the prophecy.==W==
...? ==PLAYER_NAME==, what's gotten into you?==W== Are you okay?
Otoha, I finally get it. Humans have limits to their abilities.
I mean, no matter how hard I've tried, I still can't change their prior beliefs.
So if they're determined to brand me as the Tyrant, then maybe I should become one.
If everyone believes that I'm going to destroy the world, then maybe it's time I got my hands on that destructive power and shock them all.
Hear this, Otoha:==W== I will become a true Tyrant!==W==
Are you satisfied==W== with my answer?
Your answer was ... unconventional, and a little hard to follow.==W== But your resolve came through loud and clear.
Well, I should be going now.==W== If I keep you occupied for too long, the faithful blade of yours might get anxious and charge in.
Haha... Yeah, that sounds very Chitose. There's no telling how she will react.==W== By the way,==W== is there any way I could get in touch with you, Otoha?
As flower petals twirl gently in the breeze,==W== the girl standing right in front of me vanishes without a trace.
She leaves my question hanging in the air, echoing beneath the greenhouse's glass dome.==W== But the faint scent of flowers around me gives away her presence.
Maybe she is implying that ... I don't need to contact her,==W== because she's always watching over me.
Just as Otoha's intel suggested, the members of the Tetrad Aspects, all except Angie, have formally reached out to us from Emor.
We sincerely apologize for the recent violent attacks involving our personnel.
Our investigation has confirmed that certain individuals responsible had been radicalized by the Salvation Committee, and their actions directly violated our values and principles.
All those involved have been removed from their positions.==W== Following a thorough internal review, we have agreed to take full responsibility for any harm caused by this incident.
For once, the high and mighty Grace Imperium was forced to swallow their pride and offer a genuine apology.==W== Still, it's your call to accept it or not, Boss.
Their promise doesn't mean a thing unless they give us a concrete solution. If we trust them easily, we'll be the ones left to clean up the mess.==W==
See? They're now leery of us. I told you this would happen.==W== You're only suited for fighting. Better let me handle the negotiations.
Hello, hello, everyone there~ I'm speaking on behalf of the Eye of Grace.==W== You've heard of us, I assume. We have always dedicated our time to research and to working toward peace.
For what it's worth, our research shows that entries in the Book of Grace Prophecies are completely unreliable. Even if one of them guesses something right, it's purely by chance.

At the end of the day, this whole "legendary Tyrant" thing is just an outdated story buried in the dust of history, with an unknown, untraceable origin.==W== A living person like you surely doesn't fit in a tale like that.
So this is denying that I'm the legendary Tyrant...==W== Or perhaps, the Eye of Grace is denying the very existence of the Tyrant.
With all due respect, I must make a correction to the outrageous claim. The Book of Grace Prophecies is a sacred scripture bestowed by the Gods. Its words bear the absolute truth.

However, Angie and the Salvation Committee had clearly violated the doctrine of the sacred text. Later today, the Dusk Arbiters will strip Angie of all her positions and denounce the Committee as a heretical organization.

The Dusk Arbiter would like to conduct a formal investigation on behalf of Grace Imperium to verify your identity as the Tyrant in the prophecies. Rest assured, the investigation will give a true and fair view.
Hey, wait!==W== Who gave you the right to make a judgement about ==PLAYER_NAME==?==W== That's not your call!
The Dusk Arbiter has always been responsible for upholding the glory of the God of Grace and protecting the innocents from the ill-intentioned heretics.
According to the Book of Grace Prophecies, the Tyrant exists, and their existence threatens the very fate of all Nova.
This is not a personal matter. It concerns the world at large and demands immediate attention.==W== We trust you'll weigh the reason and cooperate with us.
This is beyond absurd and unacceptable!==W== Whatever your investigation concludes, you are not taking ==PLAYER_NAME== away from us!
Thanks, Noya.==W== But you can leave this to me.
I steel myself and pick up the handset of the communication Artifact.
This is ==PLAYER_NAME==. I've heard you. I will cooperate with Grace Imperium's investigation,==W== and I trust you that the result will be fair.

param: Reflecting on this journey, you begin to question who you really are. The other three Tetrad Aspects publicly distance themselves from Angie and propose an official investigation to clear your name.
Please answer one question, ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W== Would you believe, to this day, that you are the legendary Tyrant?
Eventually, I didn't give Albedo an answer.
Because I didn't know who I really was... Even now, the answer still escapes me.
Chitose, you thirsty?==W== Here, you can have this.
Thank you, my ==SEX11==. I'd gladly take it then.==W== Gulp...==W== Whoa, what is this? I can taste the peach, and fizzy bubbles are dancing on my tongue...==W== How incredible!
It's carbonated.==W== The name is Pep Pep Juice. You can wish for it inside the Monolith.
Noya once said,==W== the fizzy kick can take your mind off all your troubles...==W==
But the ones from this vending machine are knockoffs produced by United Harvest Philae,==W== so it's hard to say==W== whether they actually do the trick.
My ==SEX11==...==W== Are you worried that the Salvation Committee might attack again?
No, not when I've got a blade I can trust by my side.==W== With you here, they're barely a threat.
I know this petal.==W== It's the same kind that warned me and took me to you.
Chitose,==W== do you mind waiting here for me?
As you wish.==W== Please stay sharp, my ==SEX11==.

Following the petals, I walk the quiet path through the factory grounds, slip through a large hole in the fence, and step into the greenhouse filled with shadow-casting sunlight and battle-ridden memories.
Otoha, thanks for saving me today.==W== If it weren't for you, I would've been shot by the Scepter of Death.==W== Wait, that smell from you... I remember it back at the banquet...==W==
And...==W== Let's keep what happened just between us.
That strange smell...==W== It's blood, masked by flowers.
Otoha, are you hurt?==W== Last time, you got injured at the banquet, didn't you? Have you gone to the doctor?
It's just a scratch, nothing to worry about.==W== The Sentinels' magic is too wimpy to break me.
But I must say...==W== I'm truly flustered that you still remember such a trivial thing from that evening.
You really have a way of winning people over.==W== That girl by your side, like a blade kept closest to the body,==W== must have been drawn to your considerate nature, too.
"A blade kept closest"...==W== You mean Chitose?==W== Look, you're giving me way too much credit.==W== Anyone would worry about the injured.
You don't have to be so modest, Boss.==W== From that night on, I've been yours.
M-==W==my what?==W== What are you even talking about, Otoha?==W== When did we ever—==W==
Heh heh. Why do you blush?==W== I only meant I've been on your side all along.==W== Were you imagining something else?
Ahem...!==W== Geez,==W== don't put it in such a way.
Hehehe...==W== Please forgive me.==W== It's just that you're so adorably gullible, and I couldn't resist teasing you a little... ♪==W==
You just escaped an ambush, yet you still went off alone without any guard, chasing some flower petals...==W== Isn't that gullible?
I see what you mean. But I promised—==W==
Keep my free bodyguard gig a secret from everyone beyond you and the New Star Guild.
Besides,==W== I wasn't technically "alone."==W== Knowing you, I'm sure you were keeping an eye on me the whole time.==W== With you around, it doesn't count as "being alone."
...==W== My my.==W== A gullible Boss surely knows a lot of sweet nothings.
Anyway, if my intel is correct,==W== Grace Imperium will reach out to you tomorrow to explain the situation.
Tomorrow?==W== Even Albedo couldn't give me a confirmed date.
Heh.==W== Never underestimate how well-connected a former ninja can be.
Come to think of it... You actually got the famously tight-lipped Chief Bookkeeper to talk.==W== What's your trick?
I didn't do anything. She came to me and shared some intel, all to prove that Grace Imperium was not the culprit.
True that. But people don't go out of their way to prove themselves to you unless you've earned their respect,==W== which means you've already built trust with Grace Imperium.
Respect, huh... You think way too highly of me...==W== I need intel from you too.==W== Do you know where the two Sky Institute employees with Albedo went?
She hasn't been able to reach them since they parted ways at the hotel.
You mean the cute shopkeeper and the fry fanatic with the lance?==W== Looks like they ended up with the Committee's fleeing soldiers.

I can't tell whether they were taken against their will or went along with the group.==W== Either way, they're not in immediate danger. If the Committee wanted them dead, they wouldn't have bothered taking them,==W== don't you think so?

Here is a kind reminder, Boss: now's not the time to worry about others. Not even I can get a full picture of the Salvation Committee's true capabilities.==W== But from what I've known, they can mobilize more resources than a large company like United Harvest.
When did you dig all this up? Back at the banquet, you said...==W==
As the world wakes up to your existence, "nuisances" like today will keep occurring. Eventually, someone will try to eliminate you using much more brutal, direct methods...

It was merely a coincidence. When I plotted against Goodwind Homecare in your shadow, I took the privilege to collect some extra leads. Out of curiosity, I started digging ... and found something huge.
Otoha, you saved my life when things got hairy today. And now you're still watching my back...
I don't know what you've found out so far, but I can't help wondering: have you been looking out for me all along? Ever since that banquet?
You bet. I've been treating myself to that adorable sleeping face of yours every single night~
Well... I'm really lucky to have you as my ally, Otoha. I feel like I keep putting you out.
You don't need to feel bad about this.==W== Hmm... If you really want to make it up to me…==W== Just be straight with me.==W== Are you the legendary Tyrant?
So please,==W==<color=#bd3059> my Tyrant</color>,==W== don't become a star once more.
Ah, you've misread it.==W== It's Boss.
The way you pronounced it,==W==<color=#bd3059> Tyrant</color>...==W== That's an ancient form.==W== It hasn't been used in a very, very long time.
Welcome back to the "Well of Worlds" Tyrant Development System,==W== dear <color=#bd3059>Tyrant</color>.
Hehe, I'll get going and take the wheel,<color=#bd3059> Tyrant</color>.==W== Give me a shout if you need anything!
You don't have to use that title...==W==
Why not? It's pretty awesome, right? Don't you all agree?
Well, using "<color=#bd3059>Boss</color>" seems more appropriate for official matters, considering our positions as employees of "Boss Accord."
I'll just use the name saved in your contacts.
I am Chitose, the blade forged only for you, my<color=#bd3059> ==SEX11==</color>.
I've ... always admired that sculpture—the one of the <color=#bd3059>hero</color> who sacrificed everything to save others.
But you are <color=#bd3059>Your Majesty</color>. The one true Tyrant. I, Darcia, swear my eternal loyalty to you.
All <color=#bd3059>Trekkers</color>==W== are sworn to help those who've lost their memories.
Dreams, reality, lost memories...==W== "Tyrant," they call me. "Boss." "My ==SEX11==." "Master." "Hero." And "Trekker"...==W==
I've been running from that question all along.==W== But now, it's time to face it.
When they brand me as the Tyrant...
I don't think==W== I'm some important figure.
I was found inside a Wishing Box,==W== with no memory, no identity, so I could be an ordinary lost Trekker.==W==
Even my "magic immunity" trait==W== might just be the result of a desperate wish to the Monolith,==W== which would explain why I lost all my memories—too high a price for me to pay.
I don't see myself as the legendary Tyrant,==W== and I don't want to be some one-of-a-kind figure either.
I just want to live my life as a Trekker,==W== stay with my friends, on our own terms.
Are you satisfied with my answer?
Very much so. Honestly, I don't really care who you are.==W== What truly matters is whether you can hold yourself steady when you're in a dire situation like this.
Thinking about it now, asking that question was completely unnecessary.==W== You didn't flinch when I had you tied up. Why would a little "Tyrant hunt" ever shake you?
The "Tyrant" is a title.==W== And titles only matter if people acknowledge them.
If I started calling myself Ruler of Nova and demanded tithes from everyone, they'd only think I was insane.
Bastelina and Iris both told me==W== that the term "Tyrant" is an ancient form.
So even if there was a Tyrant in history,==W== they must have long been forsaken,==W== which means the title itself carries no real meaning now.
So,==W== whatever makes Angie believe I'm the Tyrant ...==W== is nothing more than her and her followers' misinterpretation.
I am who I am,==W== a Trekker who helped defend Philae alongside everyone else,==W== and the CEO of Boss Accord.==W==
If anything, I'm just the Boss in name,==W== not some apocalyptic tyrant in the prophecy.==W==
Are you satisfied with my answer?
Very much so. Honestly, I don't really care who you are.==W== What truly matters is whether you can hold yourself steady when you're in a dire situation like this.
Thinking about it now, asking that question was completely unnecessary.==W== You didn't flinch when I had you tied up. Why would a little "Tyrant hunt" ever shake you?
...? ==PLAYER_NAME==, what's gotten into you?==W== Are you okay?
Otoha, I finally get it. Humans have limits to their abilities.
I mean, no matter how hard I've tried, I still can't change their prior beliefs.
So if they're determined to brand me as the Tyrant, then maybe I should become one.
If everyone believes that I'm going to destroy the world, then maybe it's time I got my hands on that destructive power and shock them all.
Hear this, Otoha:==W== I will become a true Tyrant!==W==
Are you satisfied==W== with my answer?
Very much so. Honestly, I don't really care who you are.==W== What truly matters is whether you can hold yourself steady when you're in a dire situation like this.
Your answer was ... unconventional, and a little hard to follow.==W== But your resolve came through loud and clear.
Well, I should be going now.==W== If I keep you occupied for too long, the faithful blade of yours might get anxious and charge in.
Haha... Yeah, that sounds very Chitose. There's no telling how she will react.==W== By the way,==W== is there any way I could get in touch with you, Otoha?
As flower petals twirl gently in the breeze,==W== the girl standing right in front of me vanishes without a trace.
She leaves my question hanging in the air, echoing beneath the greenhouse's glass dome.==W== But the faint scent of flowers around me gives away her presence.
Maybe she is implying that ... I don't need to contact her,==W== because she's always watching over me.
Just as Otoha's intel suggested, the members of the Tetrad Aspects, all except Angie, have formally reached out to us from Emor.
We sincerely apologize for the recent violent attacks involving our personnel.
Our investigation has confirmed that certain individuals responsible had been radicalized by the Salvation Committee, and their actions directly violated our values and principles.
All those involved have been removed from their positions.==W== Following a thorough internal review, we have agreed to take full responsibility for any harm caused by this incident.
For once, the high and mighty Grace Imperium was forced to swallow their pride and offer a genuine apology.==W== Still, it's your call to accept it or not, Boss.
Their promise doesn't mean a thing unless they give us a concrete solution. If we trust them easily, we'll be the ones left to clean up the mess.==W==
See? They're now leery of us. I told you this would happen.==W== You're only suited for fighting. Better let me handle the negotiations.
Hello, hello, everyone there~ I'm speaking on behalf of the Eye of Grace.==W== You've heard of us, I assume. We have always dedicated our time to research and to working toward peace.
For what it's worth, our research shows that entries in the Book of Grace Prophecies are completely unreliable. Even if one of them guesses something right, it's purely by chance.

At the end of the day, this whole "legendary Tyrant" thing is just an outdated story buried in the dust of history, with an unknown, untraceable origin.==W== A living person like you surely doesn't fit in a tale like that.
So this is denying that I'm the legendary Tyrant...==W== Or perhaps, the Eye of Grace is denying the very existence of the Tyrant.
With all due respect, I must make a correction to the outrageous claim. The Book of Grace Prophecies is a sacred scripture bestowed by the Gods. Its words bear the absolute truth.

However, Angie and the Salvation Committee had clearly violated the doctrine of the sacred text. Later today, the Dusk Arbiters will strip Angie of all her positions and denounce the Committee as a heretical organization.

The Dusk Arbiter would like to conduct a formal investigation on behalf of Grace Imperium to verify your identity as the Tyrant in the prophecies. Rest assured, the investigation will give a true and fair view.
Hey, wait!==W== Who gave you the right to make a judgement about ==PLAYER_NAME==?==W== That's not your call!
The Dusk Arbiter has always been responsible for upholding the glory of the God of Grace and protecting the innocents from the ill-intentioned heretics.
According to the Book of Grace Prophecies, the Tyrant exists, and their existence threatens the very fate of all Nova.
This is not a personal matter. It concerns the world at large and demands immediate attention.==W== We trust you'll weigh the reason and cooperate with us.
This is beyond absurd and unacceptable!==W== Whatever your investigation concludes, you are not taking ==PLAYER_NAME== away from us!
Thanks, Noya.==W== But you can leave this to me.
I steel myself and pick up the handset of the communication Artifact.
This is ==PLAYER_NAME==. I've heard you. I will cooperate with Grace Imperium's investigation,==W== and I trust you that the result will be fair.

strings.text: You nominate Albedo to lead the investigation. One week later, a joint faction vote in Emor will decide if you are the Tyrant. You'll have to earn everyone's trust and prove your innocence before time runs out.
This is ==PLAYER_NAME==. I've heard you. I will cooperate with Grace Imperium's investigation, and I trust you that the result will be fair.
We appreciate your understanding. Then it's settled. The Dusk Arbiter will conduct the investigation.==W==
That's the one thing I can't accept.
Good...==W== What?==W== I thought that's what we'd just agreed to...?
I agreed to an investigation by Grace Imperium,==W== not one run unilaterally by the Dusk Arbiter.

Hahaha... You old fogies spend all day praying, and now you can't even think straight. You are making fools of yourselves.==W== Honestly, who believes in that outdated Book of Grace Prophecies these days?
Let us, the Eye of Grace, carry out this investigation.==W== One of my students would be a good candidate. She's exceptionally capable and reliable. How does that sound?

Don't try to push your own agenda.==W== Your definition of reliable is somewhat unreliable. Allow me to remind you of the investigation into Nocturn Eterna's magic.==W== It's been ten years, and you still haven't delivered the report we asked for!
No, magic research requires caution and patience. A ten-year cycle isn't long in our field;==W== our oldest project has been ongoing for three hundred years.
You really think dragging research out will lead to better results? How wishful.==W== At this rate, I'll be pushing up daisies before you ever reach a conclusion.
Then what do you suggest?==W== It's not like you have the right to recommend—you only caught up on the Tyrant prophecies yesterday.
Seriously?==W== All this arguing when I'm still on the line?==W== Well...==W== Whatever. This might actually work out in my favor.
If I may, I'd like Albedo to lead the investigation.==W== If I'm agreeing to this, at least I should have a say in who's in charge.
Hmm...==W== Albedo...==W== She's the cautious type. She won't take the prophecies at face value.
No objection here.==W== Given her deep devotion to the God of Grace,==W== I don't expect her judgment to fail.
Works for me. She gets things done,==W== unlike you two.==W==
And just like that, the assignment has been made.==RT==Even though we still have our doubts about Grace Imperium,==RT==I know one thing for sure:
The investigation is in the hands of someone I can trust.
==PLAYER_NAME==, how can you let them run their so-called investigation and decide your fate?!==W== They're all part of the same company. Of course they'll cover for their own.
Easy, Noya.==W== The Tetrad Aspects have already sacked Angie and officially branded the Salvation Committee as heretical.==W== I don't think they're in cahoots with her.
That said, it could be just for show,==W== and the investigation could be a trap.
My ==SEX11==, I also believe this will put you at great risk.==W== This is like grabbing a blade by the edge and offering the hilt to someone else.
I hear your concerns, and I don't trust Grace Imperium either.==W== But the call has made one thing clear to me.
The members of the Tetrad Aspects only care about their own interests. They're too busy keeping each other in check to work together.
Still,==W== you don't have to go along with their investigation, right?==W==
Here,==W== check out this newspaper Mistique just brought.
What's on it?==W== Hey,==W== there is an insert!
"Sky Institute Director Angie Warns of Impending Doom! Vows to Confront the Evil Tyrant Behind the Boss Accord!"==W== Mistique,==W== what kind of nonsense is this?!
Hey,==W== don't look at me like that! I didn't write this.==W== Headquarters sent it over and demanded we deliver it with today's morning paper!
It is natural to assume that the Salvation Committee has people inside Scarlet Sights too.
That would explain it... Mistique, I need your insights. When do you think this insert was printed?
Let me think. For it to reach Philae today...==W== It must've been printed at headquarters at least a week ago.
Just as I suspected.==W== That's why I agreed to the investigation.
B-But this whole article is fake news!==W== Didn't the Dusk Arbiter just say—==W==

However, Angie and the Salvation Committee had clearly violated the doctrine of the sacred text. Later today, the Dusk Arbiters will strip Angie of all her positions and denounce the Committee as a heretical organization.
Exactly.==W== The key is "later today." They didn't set a hard deadline. It's leverage in disguise.==W== If I refuse the investigation, they'll just keep delaying it under one excuse after another.
And that would only make the "evil Tyrant" rumor spread far and wide.==W==
So I agreed to take the olive branch, using the news of Angie's dismissal to offset the impact of her insert.==W== It's as simple as that.
That said,==W== the Dusk Arbiter must have anticipated this as well. That's probably why they made this proposal in the first place...

I wouldn't call it underhanded. Hunting heretics is their job, and who could be more heretical than the legendary Tyrant?==W== When such an opportunity comes along, they will seize it without hesitation.
Allow me to correct you there, Boss.==W== The legendary Tyrant isn't a heretic. ==SEX1== is the archenemy of the God of Grace,==W== the one who stands against the divine.
The Dusk Arbiter hasn't treated you with the same high alert level.==W== You really don't want to know how they deal with the real heretics.
Hmm...==W== I see.==W== Now, about this investigation—==W==

Miss Nyx has briefed me on the situation. I appreciate your recommendation,==W== but that won't influence my judgment.==W== I will base my ruling solely on formal procedure and relevant facts, ensuring a fair outcome.
Sure. That's exactly what I want. If you are biased towards me, that'll only make things difficult for me.

Rest assured, Boss.==W== I'll follow Grace Imperium's rules and stay strictly within my authority, avoiding taking any offensive actions. My analysis will rely only on publicly disclosed information,==W== and I will not take the Book of Grace Prophecies into account.
I appreciate that ...==W== but as a member of Grace Imperium, is it really okay for you to dismiss the book like that?
When the Tetrad Aspects put me in charge, they would have expected this.==W== I'm acting in full compliance with the company rules and procedures.
When it comes down to it,==W== Grace Imperium is a corporation with business ethics.
We need to weigh the risks posed by the legendary Tyrant, but we also have to deal with the public anxiety==W== and social disruption caused by former Director Angie's reckless behavior.
If we let false claims like "the world is about to end" stir up panic,==W== our own interests will suffer.
So no matter how massive Grace Imperium becomes,==W== it's still bound by corporate rules.
I guess Albedo cares less about revealing my identity and more about rumors that the Tyrant might destroy the world...==W==
Next, we'll gather evidence on whether you are the legendary Tyrant,==W== and you're welcome to provide anything that verifies your identity.

One month from now, the annual Nova Chamber of Commerce and Industry Conference will be held in Emor.==W== I will convene the company representatives there to review the evidence, and they will vote to determine your identity.
A vote?! How is that fair?!==W== You guys could rig it however you like!
Rig it? Well...==W== We have to face a key challenge: no amount of evidence can be enough to prove or dispel the rumors about ==PLAYER_NAME==.
In a situation like this, the best we can do is let people believe what they want and present it as a "universal truth."
In other words, Grace Imperium cares only about maintaining social stability in Nova. Whether I am the Tyrant or not is not relevant. Albedo has indeed remained unwavering...
... And her stance is definitely in my favor. Picking her was the right move.
I fully agree. This actually gives me a chance to show all Novians who I really am.==W== I should be thanking you for your thorough consideration, Albedo.

No need to thank me. You're entitled to state your case to the public. And when the future of the world is at stake, other companies—and people from around Nova—have a right to know the truth as well.
Alright then, I'll be looking forward to the conference.

Thank you for your cooperation.==W== One more thing. Before you depart for Emor, you must submit a short video each day, documenting your activities in Philae. I'll write an instruction for you.==W== Scarlet Sights will then broadcast the video across Nova.
Why? You want me to give the public daily proof that I'm not a threat?
Kind of, and more importantly,==W== we need to show those who believe in the prophecies that you have no intention to destroy the world, and you never will.
Hmph.==W== Who would've thought the safest place in Philae is right here?
Funny, isn't it?==W== This fortress built by Darcia is a de facto stronghold for the "Tyrant's army".
With your blade guarding the secret passage and me holding the entrance,==W== it's impenetrable.==W== Even the Salvation Committee couldn't breach it.
Heh...==W== Aside from the Monolith, this is certainly the most secure spot in all of Philae.

Phew. Firenze, Boss, after a sweep search, no surveillance artifacts are found.==W== Still...==W== Meeting in an underground fortress like this feels so conspiratorial, like we're plotting something. Gets your heart racing, doesn't it?
That's exactly what we're doing.==W== This afternoon, Boss and I went around to feel out where the other companies stand. Here's what we found out—==W==
Hello, Boss. What's this sudden call about? I'm on my way back to New Orelian—==W==oh, don't get me wrong. It's not like you're interrupting anything.
The legendary Tyrant...==W== Sorry I haven't had a chance to read today's paper yet.
I don't know all the details yet, but once I get to New Orelian, I'll do my best to convince the Senate to support you at the upcoming conference.==W== In the meantime, please take care of yourself.
The legendary Tyrant? Yeah, I've heard. Boss, you're doing a pretty good job spreading your name. You've blown up all over Nova.
So, what's next? Expanding your business? If you want, Deepsea Finance can offer you a special loan to speed things up.
Sorry you made the trip for nothing, but Commander Greyhorn has already left Philae. I think she was summoned to some kind of special assignment.
Something to do with the Chamber of Commerce and Industry Conference...==W== That's way above my pay grade.==W== I'm only a squire... Sorry I couldn't be of more help.
But I've heard that==W== some higher-ups take the Book of Grace Prophecies very seriously...
Cangwu has always believed that legends shall offer no practical guidance.
And we strongly oppose the idea of pinning the fate of all Nova on one single person.
Wow, Yunshu, you've imitated their tone perfectly.==W== That's exactly how our official spokespeople speak. So to speak, that's our position.
Besides...==W== If you really are the one to bring the world to an end, they'd all be on their knees by now. Who dares to doubt your identity?==W== Hehe,==W== just kidding~
Hi, Boss, are you here to drop off today's footage? Thank you~==W==
Huh? Scarlet Sights' perspective? Um... I'm just a small-time witch.==W== I don't have a clue what the management level is thinking.
But I do know one thing—all witches love a good scoop. So they'll probably choose whatever makes the biggest splash.
Boss,==W== what on earth is Grace Imperium thinking?==W== How could they be so heavy-handed with someone as kind as you?
But there is no need to worry.==W== Goodwind Homecare works closely with both United Harvest Philae and Boss Accord. We will side with you no matter what the circumstances.
(Only a fool would fall for a baseless rumor like that.==W== Besides,==W== until I get a lead on Otoha, I need Boss Accord to remain functional.)
F-Firenze's calling from Philae?!==W== We've already pulled the business out of there, why won't she leave us alone?!
What? She bought one of our insurance plans? She's officially a client now?==W== Uh... Ugh...==W== Guess we have to deal with her.
So, what's this about?==W== What?==W== She wants to know our opinion on the legendary Tyrant?
Well,==W== tell her this—if she can get that Tyrant to sign up for one of our top-tier insurance plans, Omnisky Aegis will back her all the way!
So that's where we stand. Only Fenghuang Diner and Goodwind Homecare are clearly on our side. Everyone else said some nice things, but made no promises.
Grand Inspector Matilda said she'd back us.==W== Why don't you count her vote in?
The United Harvest Senate answers to the New Orelian faction now, which means even if she's on our side, she can't speak for the whole company.
For the New Orelian faction, it is in their best interest if Boss falls, so don't expect United Harvest to vote in our favor.
We've only spoken to a handful of companies. There are still plenty more out there. All in all...==W== I think we still need solid evidence that Boss isn't the Tyrant.
How are you supposed to prove a negative?==W== That's impossible.
We're short on time and have very little leverage. We can't bribe or lobby our way through like we did during the bidding war, so our only choice is to gather evidence.
What if==W== we try the opposite.
The opposite...==W== Oh, right! Instead of proving ==PLAYER_NAME== isn't the Tyrant. We just need to prove ==SEX== is an ordinary Trekker who lost ==SEX3== memories.
Once we figure out the past of ==PLAYER_NAME== before we found ==SEX4==, the whole Tyrant theory will collapse on its own.
I heard that==W== you found ==PLAYER_NAME== unconscious inside a Monolith out in the desert. Is that true?
Yes. We dragged the Wishing Box with ==PLAYER_NAME== inside all the way out of the Monolith. Looking back... It's pretty amazing that we actually managed to pull that off...==W==
What if it wasn't a Wishing Box at all? What if it had nothing to do with the Monolith?==W== It could just be a box some random Trekker brought in.
I doubt it. That box was literally embedded in the Monolith's floor. But if you ask me how we got it out... That is beyond my knowledge...
Embedded ...==W== in the floor?==W== Either way, a thorough investigation of the box and the Monolith might give us something about the Boss's true identity.
Heading back to the desert to explore the Monolith... Sounds like a plan. But you'll have to go without me. I need to stay here to record and submit video proofs to Scarlet Sights on a daily basis.
No, Boss, you're going with the New Star Guild. This is about finding proof that YOU are an ordinary Trekker, so you need to be there in person.
Otherwise, they might miss something critical.
I get that, but what about our agreement with Albedo?
Don't worry. I've already checked with her. All she insists is that a video needs to be submitted every day.
That gives us some wiggle room. I'll get you out of Philae without breaking the terms.

param: You nominate Albedo to lead the investigation. One week later, a joint faction vote in Emor will decide if you are the Tyrant. You'll have to earn everyone's trust and prove your innocence before time runs out.
This is ==PLAYER_NAME==. I've heard you. I will cooperate with Grace Imperium's investigation, and I trust you that the result will be fair.
We appreciate your understanding. Then it's settled. The Dusk Arbiter will conduct the investigation.==W==
That's the one thing I can't accept.
Good...==W== What?==W== I thought that's what we'd just agreed to...?
I agreed to an investigation by Grace Imperium,==W== not one run unilaterally by the Dusk Arbiter.

Hahaha... You old fogies spend all day praying, and now you can't even think straight. You are making fools of yourselves.==W== Honestly, who believes in that outdated Book of Grace Prophecies these days?
Let us, the Eye of Grace, carry out this investigation.==W== One of my students would be a good candidate. She's exceptionally capable and reliable. How does that sound?

Don't try to push your own agenda.==W== Your definition of reliable is somewhat unreliable. Allow me to remind you of the investigation into Nocturn Eterna's magic.==W== It's been ten years, and you still haven't delivered the report we asked for!
No, magic research requires caution and patience. A ten-year cycle isn't long in our field;==W== our oldest project has been ongoing for three hundred years.
You really think dragging research out will lead to better results? How wishful.==W== At this rate, I'll be pushing up daisies before you ever reach a conclusion.
Then what do you suggest?==W== It's not like you have the right to recommend—you only caught up on the Tyrant prophecies yesterday.
Seriously?==W== All this arguing when I'm still on the line?==W== Well...==W== Whatever. This might actually work out in my favor.
If I may, I'd like Albedo to lead the investigation.==W== If I'm agreeing to this, at least I should have a say in who's in charge.
Hmm...==W== Albedo...==W== She's the cautious type. She won't take the prophecies at face value.
No objection here.==W== Given her deep devotion to the God of Grace,==W== I don't expect her judgment to fail.
Works for me. She gets things done,==W== unlike you two.==W==
And just like that, the assignment has been made.==RT==Even though we still have our doubts about Grace Imperium,==RT==I know one thing for sure:
The investigation is in the hands of someone I can trust.
==PLAYER_NAME==, how can you let them run their so-called investigation and decide your fate?!==W== They're all part of the same company. Of course they'll cover for their own.
Easy, Noya.==W== The Tetrad Aspects have already sacked Angie and officially branded the Salvation Committee as heretical.==W== I don't think they're in cahoots with her.
That said, it could be just for show,==W== and the investigation could be a trap.
My ==SEX11==, I also believe this will put you at great risk.==W== This is like grabbing a blade by the edge and offering the hilt to someone else.
I hear your concerns, and I don't trust Grace Imperium either.==W== But the call has made one thing clear to me.
The members of the Tetrad Aspects only care about their own interests. They're too busy keeping each other in check to work together.
Still,==W== you don't have to go along with their investigation, right?==W==
Here,==W== check out this newspaper Mistique just brought.
What's on it?==W== Hey,==W== there is an insert!
"Sky Institute Director Angie Warns of Impending Doom! Vows to Confront the Evil Tyrant Behind the Boss Accord!"==W== Mistique,==W== what kind of nonsense is this?!
Hey,==W== don't look at me like that! I didn't write this.==W== Headquarters sent it over and demanded we deliver it with today's morning paper!
It is natural to assume that the Salvation Committee has people inside Scarlet Sights too.
That would explain it... Mistique, I need your insights. When do you think this insert was printed?
Let me think. For it to reach Philae today...==W== It must've been printed at headquarters at least a week ago.
Just as I suspected.==W== That's why I agreed to the investigation.
B-But this whole article is fake news!==W== Didn't the Dusk Arbiter just say—==W==

However, Angie and the Salvation Committee had clearly violated the doctrine of the sacred text. Later today, the Dusk Arbiters will strip Angie of all her positions and denounce the Committee as a heretical organization.
Exactly.==W== The key is "later today." They didn't set a hard deadline. It's leverage in disguise.==W== If I refuse the investigation, they'll just keep delaying it under one excuse after another.
And that would only make the "evil Tyrant" rumor spread far and wide.==W==
So I agreed to take the olive branch, using the news of Angie's dismissal to offset the impact of her insert.==W== It's as simple as that.
That said,==W== the Dusk Arbiter must have anticipated this as well. That's probably why they made this proposal in the first place...

I wouldn't call it underhanded. Hunting heretics is their job, and who could be more heretical than the legendary Tyrant?==W== When such an opportunity comes along, they will seize it without hesitation.
Allow me to correct you there, Boss.==W== The legendary Tyrant isn't a heretic. ==SEX1== is the archenemy of the God of Grace,==W== the one who stands against the divine.
The Dusk Arbiter hasn't treated you with the same high alert level.==W== You really don't want to know how they deal with the real heretics.
Hmm...==W== I see.==W== Now, about this investigation—==W==

Miss Nyx has briefed me on the situation. I appreciate your recommendation,==W== but that won't influence my judgment.==W== I will base my ruling solely on formal procedure and relevant facts, ensuring a fair outcome.
Sure. That's exactly what I want. If you are biased towards me, that'll only make things difficult for me.

Rest assured, Boss.==W== I'll follow Grace Imperium's rules and stay strictly within my authority, avoiding taking any offensive actions. My analysis will rely only on publicly disclosed information,==W== and I will not take the Book of Grace Prophecies into account.
I appreciate that ...==W== but as a member of Grace Imperium, is it really okay for you to dismiss the book like that?
When the Tetrad Aspects put me in charge, they would have expected this.==W== I'm acting in full compliance with the company rules and procedures.
When it comes down to it,==W== Grace Imperium is a corporation with business ethics.
We need to weigh the risks posed by the legendary Tyrant, but we also have to deal with the public anxiety==W== and social disruption caused by former Director Angie's reckless behavior.
If we let false claims like "the world is about to end" stir up panic,==W== our own interests will suffer.
So no matter how massive Grace Imperium becomes,==W== it's still bound by corporate rules.
I guess Albedo cares less about revealing my identity and more about rumors that the Tyrant might destroy the world...==W==
Next, we'll gather evidence on whether you are the legendary Tyrant,==W== and you're welcome to provide anything that verifies your identity.

One month from now, the annual Nova Chamber of Commerce and Industry Conference will be held in Emor.==W== I will convene the company representatives there to review the evidence, and they will vote to determine your identity.
A vote?! How is that fair?!==W== You guys could rig it however you like!
Rig it? Well...==W== We have to face a key challenge: no amount of evidence can be enough to prove or dispel the rumors about ==PLAYER_NAME==.
In a situation like this, the best we can do is let people believe what they want and present it as a "universal truth."
In other words, Grace Imperium cares only about maintaining social stability in Nova. Whether I am the Tyrant or not is not relevant. Albedo has indeed remained unwavering...
... And her stance is definitely in my favor. Picking her was the right move.
I fully agree. This actually gives me a chance to show all Novians who I really am.==W== I should be thanking you for your thorough consideration, Albedo.

No need to thank me. You're entitled to state your case to the public. And when the future of the world is at stake, other companies—and people from around Nova—have a right to know the truth as well.
Alright then, I'll be looking forward to the conference.

Thank you for your cooperation.==W== One more thing. Before you depart for Emor, you must submit a short video each day, documenting your activities in Philae. I'll write an instruction for you.==W== Scarlet Sights will then broadcast the video across Nova.
Why? You want me to give the public daily proof that I'm not a threat?
Kind of, and more importantly,==W== we need to show those who believe in the prophecies that you have no intention to destroy the world, and you never will.
Hmph.==W== Who would've thought the safest place in Philae is right here?
Funny, isn't it?==W== This fortress built by Darcia is a de facto stronghold for the "Tyrant's army".
With your blade guarding the secret passage and me holding the entrance,==W== it's impenetrable.==W== Even the Salvation Committee couldn't breach it.
Heh...==W== Aside from the Monolith, this is certainly the most secure spot in all of Philae.

Phew. Firenze, Boss, after a sweep search, no surveillance artifacts are found.==W== Still...==W== Meeting in an underground fortress like this feels so conspiratorial, like we're plotting something. Gets your heart racing, doesn't it?
That's exactly what we're doing.==W== This afternoon, Boss and I went around to feel out where the other companies stand. Here's what we found out—==W==
Hello, Boss. What's this sudden call about? I'm on my way back to New Orelian—==W==oh, don't get me wrong. It's not like you're interrupting anything.
The legendary Tyrant...==W== Sorry I haven't had a chance to read today's paper yet.
I don't know all the details yet, but once I get to New Orelian, I'll do my best to convince the Senate to support you at the upcoming conference.==W== In the meantime, please take care of yourself.
The legendary Tyrant? Yeah, I've heard. Boss, you're doing a pretty good job spreading your name. You've blown up all over Nova.
So, what's next? Expanding your business? If you want, Deepsea Finance can offer you a special loan to speed things up.
Sorry you made the trip for nothing, but Commander Greyhorn has already left Philae. I think she was summoned to some kind of special assignment.
Something to do with the Chamber of Commerce and Industry Conference...==W== That's way above my pay grade.==W== I'm only a squire... Sorry I couldn't be of more help.
But I've heard that==W== some higher-ups take the Book of Grace Prophecies very seriously...
Cangwu has always believed that legends shall offer no practical guidance.
And we strongly oppose the idea of pinning the fate of all Nova on one single person.
Wow, Yunshu, you've imitated their tone perfectly.==W== That's exactly how our official spokespeople speak. So to speak, that's our position.
Besides...==W== If you really are the one to bring the world to an end, they'd all be on their knees by now. Who dares to doubt your identity?==W== Hehe,==W== just kidding~
Hi, Boss, are you here to drop off today's footage? Thank you~==W==
Huh? Scarlet Sights' perspective? Um... I'm just a small-time witch.==W== I don't have a clue what the management level is thinking.
But I do know one thing—all witches love a good scoop. So they'll probably choose whatever makes the biggest splash.
Boss,==W== what on earth is Grace Imperium thinking?==W== How could they be so heavy-handed with someone as kind as you?
But there is no need to worry.==W== Goodwind Homecare works closely with both United Harvest Philae and Boss Accord. We will side with you no matter what the circumstances.
(Only a fool would fall for a baseless rumor like that.==W== Besides,==W== until I get a lead on Otoha, I need Boss Accord to remain functional.)
F-Firenze's calling from Philae?!==W== We've already pulled the business out of there, why won't she leave us alone?!
What? She bought one of our insurance plans? She's officially a client now?==W== Uh... Ugh...==W== Guess we have to deal with her.
So, what's this about?==W== What?==W== She wants to know our opinion on the legendary Tyrant?
Well,==W== tell her this—if she can get that Tyrant to sign up for one of our top-tier insurance plans, Omnisky Aegis will back her all the way!
So that's where we stand. Only Fenghuang Diner and Goodwind Homecare are clearly on our side. Everyone else said some nice things, but made no promises.
Grand Inspector Matilda said she'd back us.==W== Why don't you count her vote in?
The United Harvest Senate answers to the New Orelian faction now, which means even if she's on our side, she can't speak for the whole company.
For the New Orelian faction, it is in their best interest if Boss falls, so don't expect United Harvest to vote in our favor.
We've only spoken to a handful of companies. There are still plenty more out there. All in all...==W== I think we still need solid evidence that Boss isn't the Tyrant.
How are you supposed to prove a negative?==W== That's impossible.
We're short on time and have very little leverage. We can't bribe or lobby our way through like we did during the bidding war, so our only choice is to gather evidence.
What if==W== we try the opposite.
The opposite...==W== Oh, right! Instead of proving ==PLAYER_NAME== isn't the Tyrant. We just need to prove ==SEX== is an ordinary Trekker who lost ==SEX3== memories.
Once we figure out the past of ==PLAYER_NAME== before we found ==SEX4==, the whole Tyrant theory will collapse on its own.
I heard that==W== you found ==PLAYER_NAME== unconscious inside a Monolith out in the desert. Is that true?
Yes. We dragged the Wishing Box with ==PLAYER_NAME== inside all the way out of the Monolith. Looking back... It's pretty amazing that we actually managed to pull that off...==W==
What if it wasn't a Wishing Box at all? What if it had nothing to do with the Monolith?==W== It could just be a box some random Trekker brought in.
I doubt it. That box was literally embedded in the Monolith's floor. But if you ask me how we got it out... That is beyond my knowledge...
Embedded ...==W== in the floor?==W== Either way, a thorough investigation of the box and the Monolith might give us something about the Boss's true identity.
Heading back to the desert to explore the Monolith... Sounds like a plan. But you'll have to go without me. I need to stay here to record and submit video proofs to Scarlet Sights on a daily basis.
No, Boss, you're going with the New Star Guild. This is about finding proof that YOU are an ordinary Trekker, so you need to be there in person.
Otherwise, they might miss something critical.
I get that, but what about our agreement with Albedo?
Don't worry. I've already checked with her. All she insists is that a video needs to be submitted every day.
That gives us some wiggle room. I'll get you out of Philae without breaking the terms.

strings.text: To secure an alibi in Philae, footage of you is required every day. After Petal Bloom quietly returns, you have Nazuna pose as your double while you and your friends slip into the desert in search of answers...
Morning, everyone. Actually, I should probably start with "It's good to be home!" Hehe, after a long trip, nothing puts me at ease like seeing all of you again.
Welcome back, Miss Kaede. And the rest of Petal Bloom too.==W== I heard you snuck into the city last night?
Sort of. Firenze arranged a delivery truck to transport us ... in grain sacks.==W==
You stayed inside a grain sack the whole trip?==W== It must've been uncomfortable.
Not at all.==W== I actually find small, dark spaces quite comforting~
... You're probably the only one, Fuyuka.==W== Anyway, Boss, you wouldn't slip us into Philae for no reason, right? So... What's the secret mission?
Well...==W== Firenze definitely has something in mind, but she hasn't filled me in yet.
Heh, I bet this is a test run for sneaking you out of Philae. If Petal Bloom can get in unnoticed, then you can get out the same way.
No it won't work, Noya. Boss has to submit a video to Scarlet Sights every day, remember?
Worry free, I've already sorted it out:==W== we'll film all the videos in one go and submit one each day.
My intuition tells me that Firenze brought Petal Bloom here not just for the stealth test, but also for footage.
Think about it: whenever Petal Bloom returns to Philae, they always visit ==PLAYER_NAME==. It would be unconvincing if their faces never appear in one of ==PLAYER_NAME=='s videos, right?

So,==W== this is our perfect chance to film their meet-up with ==PLAYER_NAME==. They can slip out of town after the filming, and make a grand comeback a week later.==W== No one will ever notice the timing discrepancy.
It is an excellent plan. However,==W== Albedo later specified that the recording is required to include a piece of newspaper from that day and a weather forecast.
O-Oh, really?==W== I must have missed that part.
By the way,==W== miss... Who might you be? You just said "my ==SEX11==."==W== Are you referring to Boss?
A pleasure to meet you. I am Chitose, my ==SEX11=='s guarding blade.
Boss's blade...==W== I see.==W== I'm Nazuka.==W== Thank you for looking after ==SEX4====W== while we were away.
No need to thank me. As my ==SEX11=='s blade, protecting ==SEX4== is simply my duty.
A dutiful guard...==W== Well,==W== now that I'm back, I'll take over from here.==W== You can step away.
I decline.==W== A blade must stay within ==SEX3== reach at all times.==W== Even while ==SEX== sleeps,==W== I remain at ==SEX3== side.
S...<size=52> SSSSSSSSLEEP at ==SEX3== side?!!!</size>==W== Boss,==W== what exactly is going on?!
D-Does...==W== Does she really get to sleep with you every single night...?!?!==W== That's so nic—==W==uh I mean,==W== shameless!! Totally shameless!!!!
Whoa, that's a strong word?! Wait, wait, wait, none of that ever happened!==W== Chitose, please clear this up!
My ==SEX11==, is this Lady Nazuka, the one you've mentioned so often?==W== She seems quite worked up.==W== I've heard she's a woman with wisdom,==W== but...
She doesn't seem to understand a word I'm saying.==W== Are you sure someone like her==W== is capable of protecting you?
Ahhh!==W== You're both getting the wrong idea!==W== Please,==W== just hear me out...
<size=52><color=#6fb1d2>Who do you want to watch your back?!</color>==RT==<color=#a87dc0>Whom do you wish to protect you?</color></size>==W==
Heh, so this is what they call "grown-up dilemma."==W== Amber, let's not turn out like them.
Leave them be, check out my new plushie! It's so soft and adorable.
Cute. Want to catch one in the machine.
Hey, hey! Kaede worked hard on this.==W== There's no way I'm tossing it into a claw machine.
...==W== Whoa,==W== you could cut the tension here with a knife.==W== What happened?
D-Don't worry about that,==W== Firenze. We just got here too.==W== Now,==W== what exactly are you planning by having Petal Bloom sneak into the city?
Well...==W== Before I dive into my plan,==W== let me introduce a very special guest.==W==
Hellooo, Boss! Long time no see~!==W== It's me, Itoha~!==W== The highly sought-after makeup artist across Nova for various activities and events!
I heard you were in serious trouble. How could I just stand by?==W== So I came straight over to help!
"Came to help"?==W== My ==SEX11==, do you even know this woman?
Makeup artist?==W== I don't know anyone like that...
And judging from Firenze's cautious look...==W== Is she trying to verify Itoha's story with me?
And if anything is out of place...==W== She would have her taken care of right on the spot?
Oh my, Boss...==W== Don't tell me you've already forgotten==W== that magical night we spent together on the rooftop,==W== just you and me...
(Who is she? What is she talking about?!==W== A...==W== A night on the rooftop?)
(Wait a second...==W== Could it be...==W== N-no way...==W== But...)
Everyone, calm down. Itoha and I...==W== Well, we met at the banquet.==W== All I did was ask her to do my makeup, and that was it.
Boss, you sure took your sweet time remembering me~!==W== Anyway, I'll do my best this time.==W== Can't wait to work with everyone~♪
Hmmm... There's a lot I could comment on...==W== But let's leave it at that.==W== Boss, I assume you want to hear the next part of the plan?
We'll have someone act as your double to submit the videos.==W== And Itoha is here to help.

I took training as a makeup artist at Goodwind Homecare and learned transformation magic from the Loong people.==W== Putting on a disguise is like a walk in the park for me ♪==W== In just a minute, I can turn anyone into a completely different person.
So,==W== could the four of you come with me please?
Wait... You want one of us ...==W== to play the double?
Because we can't ask people living in Philae to play the double. People start asking questions if someone they see every day suddenly disappears.
But we aren't supposed to be here in the first place.==W== So no one will be skeptical if we don't show up.
But it is a breach of our agreement with Albedo, right?==W== If she finds out...==W==
Well,==W== it depends on how you interpret the terms.

Thank you for your cooperation.==W== One more thing. Before you depart for Emor, you must submit a short video each day, documenting your activities in Philae.==W== Scarlet Sights will then broadcast it across Nova.
Every day, I have to film a short video and submit it to Scarlet Sights Media==W== to show the world that I'm staying put in Philae.
Heh. I guess you are too literal-minded for business negotiations.==W== Albedo's reputation for dotting every 'i' and crossing every 't' is well known across all the major companies.

In her usual practice, she never misses a tiny mistake, not even a misplaced comma in the agreement.==W== So if she'd really wanted to confine you in the city, she would've made that crystal clear. The terms would sound like this...==W==

First, you must remain within the legal boundaries of Philae at all times.==W== Second, every day you must record a video of yourself and submit it to Scarlet Sights to prove you're still here,==W== and also check in at the Soul Shop with a staff member I designate.
And she didn't.==W== In other words, the agreement was worded that way to <r=·>leave </r><r=·>room </r>for us to work with.
W-Wait, that's actually a valid interpretation?
Of course. In business negotiations, any ambiguity in wording will inevitably become an opportunity to exploit.

As the assigned representative of Grace Imperium and the person in charge of this investigation, Albedo can't put up some irresponsible remark like, "I trust you, Boss. Just show up in Emor a month from now and do whatever you like until then."

And yet, despite being caught in a web of complications, she still managed to carve out a little breathing room for you.==W== Because if you can clear your name, it helps her achieve her own goal too.
This is so complicated...==W== All the second-guessing and mind games are too difficult to keep up with.==W== And you people are caught up on this every day... Just the thought of it tires me out.
Now I get what Albedo really meant, but I still fear the idea of using the double is too risky.==W== The Salvation Committee is out for my blood...==W== What if we get caught?
Hey, Iris, quick question:==W== how much Dorra do we have left?
(Wh-==W==who is that?!==W== Why does ==SEX== look exactly like me?!)
Oh,==W== uh...==W== Around 200,000 Dorra.==W== And there are some pending commission fees from my side hustles,==W== so,==W== altogether it should be enough for the desert trip...==W==
Um, Iris,==W== I'm the real one.
That's a lie! I'm the real Boss!==W== I have proof:==W== there's a little cute bird==W== on Iris's cup!
Ugh...==W== I surrender, I really can't tell one from another!
Nazuka, how about you?==W== Which one do you think is the real Bo—==W==
Whoa,==W== Nazuka senpai saw right through her!
How...==W== How is that possible?!==W== The disguise was supposed to be flawless!
Words can't explain it.==W== It's more of a feeling...==W== A deep bond of the heart.==W== Heh,==W== with the real Boss around,==W== I feel a lot safer...==W==
Ugh...==W== Too much lovey-dovey.==W== I'm gonna be sick.
Hehe, don't worry.==W== I chose you, so you should have a little more confidence in yourself ♪
Itoha is right. I'm an exception.==W== Other people wouldn't be able to tell who the real Boss is. I actually wanted to volunteer, but I'm clearly not cut out for it...==W==
The key to acting as a double lies in a deep understanding of the person you're going to imitate.==W== Out-of-character behavior would easily give my flawless disguise away.

Body shape is another important factor. The double needs to have a roughly matching build, because transformation magic won't hold up forever, and gait patterns can give you away.==W== With that in mind, out of all the candidates...==W==
Nazuna's the closest match to the Boss's figure—flat as a board.==W== How wonderful! (As for the difference in height, heel lifts can fix that.)
<size=52>Flat as a board?!==W== What are you even talking about?! And what's so wonderful about that!</size>
Well then, my ==SEX11==, I'm ready. When do we head out to the desert?
Hmm...==W== Miss Itoha's makeup skills are truly impressive, but...==W==
Oh dear Boss, don't "but" me. I know you've got your concerns, but your friends have theirs too.==W==
Don't worry, Boss. Just go and do what you need to do. Once I get serious, I won't mess it up. And if anything bad happens, I'll give them a good beating!
We'll give Nazuna special training so she can perfectly step into your role. And Fuyuka, from now on, you'll need to treat her as your "Master."
Nazuna senpai is my Master...==W== Nazuna senpai is my Master...==W== I-I'll try my best to brainwash myself!
Boss, go ahead. We'll keep Nazuna safe.==W== But do let us know you're okay, so...==W== Be sure to reach out to me ...==W== regularly.
Alright...==W== Nazuna, I'll leave everything in your hands...==W== No, I should call you Boss now.==W== I hereby appoint you CEO of Boss Accord for the duration of my absence.
Hehe, you can count on me!==W== Oh, by the way, can I use company funds to buy some plush toys?
Unfortunately, no. We need every Dorra for the desert trip.
And Chitose, I'm sorry, but you'll have to stay in Philae, keeping watch by Nazuna's side.
But why? As your blade, I want to follow you wherever you go...==W==
From now on, Nazuna is your ==SEX11==. You were spotted fighting by my side in the Monolith, remember?
If you don't show your face, it'll raise suspicions about Nazuna's identity.==W== And this speculation,==W== in itself, proves that the world already recognizes you as my blade.
They do...?!==W== Then I'll stay by your double's side as you wish. Safe travels, my ==SEX11==.
Rest easy, ==PLAYER_NAME== is in safe hands with us.
Right now.==W== Boss and I will give you a public send-off as you board the Lucky Oasis.
Alright,==W== everyone,==W== get ready!==W== Our mission against the Salvation Committee starts now!==W==
