An assassin?!==W== It was her? ==PLAYER_NAME==, she was the one who attacked you at the banquet?
Hey now, easy with the sword. That was then, this is now.
The contract is off, and the client is locked up. Why would we keep coming after you?
Besides, my guys lost fair and square, and you let them off easy. I don't repay kindness with a knife.
Consider your request granted. From now on, we are officially not enemies.
Still don't trust me? Look, sis.==W== I've got my neck pressed right against your blade. Good enough for you?
==PLAYER_NAME==, what's the call? She's even more forward than I am.
Stand down, Noya.==W== They were just hired knives back then, and she's not hostile now.==W== We're new here. No point picking a fight with the locals.
Heh. Knew you were smart, Boss! So we're friends now, right?
Alright, Scorpions, scatter!==W== Go prep those supplies and top up the Boss's ride with Grace.==W== I'm taking them on a food tour of Mirage. I'll see you when you're done.
Appreciate it.==W== And that works out perfectly. We needed a local to answer a few questions anyway.
I never saw food like this back in Emor, but every dish is incredible! <size=53>♪</size>==W== I'm stuffed. And our supplies are fully sorted out!
Got the recipe down! As soon as I find the ingredients, I'm cooking this for you.
See? We're out in the middle of nowhere, but Mirage still has charm, right?
Like they say. Home is where you feel at peace.
Though you were fighting the Imperial Guard pretty hard earlier. Is there bad blood between the Imperial Guard and the locals too?
Nah, not at all. We get along with the Imperial Guard fine.
How should I put it...==W== Let's call it a business partnership.==W== We're also teammates when it comes to fighting the White Cat Troupe.
The White Cat Troupe...==W== I keep hearing that name. Who are they?
They used to be the old Nova Empress's personal guard. Over a decade ago they betrayed and took the Empress's life. Total villains.
Grace Imperium hired the Imperial Guard to hunt them down. The White Cats fought a running battle all the way here. Mirage is their last stand.
Word is Mirage used to be loaded back then. But years of fighting turned it into this. Now most of the city is empty ruins.
E-Even the Empress?!==W== They're that ruthless?==W== Oh no.==W== We're already in their territory!==W== What if they're hiding behind a wall right now waiting to jump us?!
Relax. That all happened when I was a kid.==W== Nowadays Mirage is technically at war, but there are no battles left to fight.

We Desert Scorpions hold the abandoned crystal diamond mine up northeast.==W== The Imperial Guard has the central oasis out west. The White Cat leftovers took the second oasis down south.==W== Everyone has their turf, and we've kept out of each other's way for years.
Besides, there are barely any White Cats left. We could wipe them out with sheer numbers anytime we wanted.
If they're that dangerous, why not take them out?
And lose our business?==W== Wipe out the White Cats, and we have nothing to do.
Business... The kids this morning said something similar.
What are you talking about? A fight means we can finally make some deals!
You're keeping the enemy alive on purpose.
Sharp as always, Boss.==W== Mirage today is a city that runs entirely on war.
We Desert Scorpions are rough mercenaries. Even if we partner with the Imperial Guard, a little friction is part of the deal.
So we stage a fight every now and then. We leave behind some junk weapons as spoils for the Guard, and they use it to claim victories up the chain.
And the Guard? War always costs something, right?==W== They dump some expensive gear, snap evidence with a Photo Capturer,==W== and bill Grace Imperium for battlefield losses.
But those gears aren't broken. They submit a report for new armor and spears,==W== and the money gets cleared.

Then they pay the kids a twentieth of the price to drag that gear back. As for the money marked for new equipment,==W== thirty percent to us, seventy to them. Round and round, and the Dorras keep rolling in.
Talk about a shameless racket...==W== But I guess the kids earn a bit of honest coin from it.==W== I don't know what to think.
Come on, don't overthink it <size=53>♪</size> Nobody loses out here. Win-win, right?

And~==W== Guess what?==W== Today we put on a real show with the "White Cats."==W== The Guard's gonna file a report on a grueling battle, claim they repelled the entire White Cat army, and demand a massive payout.
Hehe. From that angle, we oughta thank you!
So ... you turned war into a business.
Ahaha!==W== Mirage has no goods worth hauling out of the desert. Without war, nobody here would survive.
If only there were a Monolith here. Everyone could live off Artifacts.==W== Hey, Myrsha, have you ever found one out in the desert?
A desert Monolith?==W== Never seen one.==W== People here spot things in the sands all the time, but when they go check, there's nothing there. Probably a castle in the air.
I exchange looks with the New Star Guild.==W== Forget my amnesia, those three had been inside that Monolith. It was no mirage.
But ... ==W==I heard that before my time, Mirage had a Monolith.
Wait, there used to be a Monolith here?==W== What happened to it?
What it sounds like. One day it just vanished. No warning.
Our captain seems to know something, but clams up whenever the topic comes up.
A Monolith vanishing... Could it be like what I went through...
No, it's not an earthquake.==W==<color=#bd3059> The Monolith is sinking!</color>
Boss, it's pulling us down with it...==W== I'm sorry. We might not make it back.
No, no... That's a memory of something that didn't happen.
Besides, if a Monolith sank into the ground, the impact would be huge. The people of Mirage would've noticed.
Spreading that speculation would cause panic. I'll keep quiet and play dumb for now.
A Monolith vanishing... It sounds crazy, but if it's true... It might be connected to the desert Monolith we're after.
Myrsha, besides your captain, does anyone else know about the vanishing Monolith?
The White Cat captain might know...==W== But I've never had contact with them.==W== And I don't think the townsfolk know about it. Not many old-timers left in Mirage anyway.
But, I know one place where we might find some answers about what happened.
Um...==W== Are we actually sneaking in here?==W== It looks creepy.
Myrsha said this was the old White Cat theater, before they betrayed the Empress.
The White Cats were here the longest. There might be clues inside about the city's past.
But Myrsha also said the terrifying==W== Dark-Footed Devil Cat took over this place!
Boss is more powerful than a devil. Don't be afraid.
Uh, I don't think that's how it works...==W== But we're out of options.==W== Let's go. We're here for clues. No fighting.
Boss? Where are you?==W== Is that you, Boss?
A-Amber?!==W== Hey, don't just grab things in the dark!
Huh... Can't see a thing, but this place feels strangely familiar...
W-We should get out! It's pitch-black! What if the Dark-Footed Devil Cat attacks us—
A low voice comes from behind us.==RT==Something smooth and metallic presses against our heads.

strings.text: You never expected to find Aunt Allie here. It turns out she fled Emor with the children and made this place their new orphanage. To keep their location a secret, she refuses to let the White Cat Troupe dig any deeper.
You three! Drop your weapons! On the ground, hands on your heads! Move it!
Eek! Okay, okay, I-I get it! Please don't hurt me!==W== No to violence!
Good! Now you two, do exactly what she did! Hurry up!
Taking Iris's cue,==W== I drop into a crouch and scan the room.
... Huh? It's too dark to see clearly...==W== Wait, where's Amber?
Good. You two are being smart.
Hey! You over there! Quit stalling! I said hurry up!
Ahh, it's not that I'm refusing!
I want to drop my sword, but the strap is totally stuck!
Hah! Can't even handle your own weapon, and you call yourselves thieves?
Thieves? What are you talking about?
Hmph, whatever. This sword is mine now. Stay right there and don't try anything funny.
Amber drops from the rafters and subdues the entire group in seconds.
Dang it! Take this! Floor Split!
An icy blue mist spreads outward from Iris's palms pressed against the floor. The wood beneath our feet lets out a few creaking groans, but remains intact.
No way! Why didn't the trap go off?!
A thief who knows magic?! Then try this!
... Huh? Whaaaat?! No way! You caught our arrows barehanded?!
What do you mean, no way? These crossbows are basically toys.==RT==The shots had zero power behind them...
These kids are fast. Dodging all over the place, but we got 'em.
Wait, isn't this the Dark-Footed Devil Cat's lair? Why are there kids here? And with Desert Scorpion magic guns?
Hmm... This room's decor is familiar. And their ambush tactics... I swear I've seen them before.
Hah! You stupid thieves, think you won just because you caught us?
This is the Dark-Footed Devil Cat's turf, the Daisy Orphanage. Run while you can, or we'll scream!
Scream for that devil cat of yours?
A devil out in this desert? Even if it is real, anyone who uses kids to do their dirty work is scum. All the more reason to teach them a lesson!
Tch, you're dead. Three, two, one... Everybody, scream!
Why are the lights flickering? Don't tell me there actually is a devil...
What was that? It's too fast, I can't track it.
I-I'll find the switch and stabilize the lamp. You protect Boss!
Doesn't matter how fast you are. If you move in a straight line... Right here!
The lights flicker back on. Noya's sword hangs in mid-air, effortlessly blocked by a broom.
I don't know if you're thieves or after something else.
But breaking into this orphanage means you crossed a line in this desert.
And no matter how much you beg...
No way... The Dark-Footed Devil Cat is...?
Then... Those two must be Iris and Amber?
What is going on? Am I dreaming? How did the orphanage and Aunt Allie end up out here in the desert?
The orphanage, Aunt Allie...!==W== So she's the director of the Ash Orphanage they've been looking for this whole time.
Oh, thank goodness...! Seeing you all looking so healthy and full of life…==RT==I am... I am so glad!
We didn't come to Mirage looking for the orphanage,==W== but what an incredible surprise.
Hold on. What did you call me?
Auntie? How distant... I am heartbroken.==W== Where did my three little darlings go? The ones who used to swarm me and call me Mom?
After moving from Emor to Mirage, I worried I might never see you three again...
But I never dreamed our reunion would look like this. Not only have you stopped calling me Mom, but you break in like a pack of thieves!
No, no, no! I keep telling you, we're not thieves!
To think you three turned bad..==W==. I suppose that's my fault as your Mom. Well... This seems like the perfect chance to teach you a lesson.
Why?! No! Wait, it's a huge misunderstanding! We came looking for the desert Monolith and only stopped in Mirage to restock!
We're here because we heard there was intel about the Monolith! Plus, everyone said this place was taken over by the Dark-Footed Devil Cat, so naturally we had to sneak in!
That is still breaking and entering. I never imagined reuniting with my precious children would end up like this. How tragic.
Come along now. Let Mom teach you a lesson.
Carried off by the scruff like kittens...==W== Wait, I'm still here.
You must be a friend of theirs.
Yes, I'm ==PLAYER_NAME== from their guild. Uh... Noya, Iris, and Amber are good kids. It's not what it looks like...
Please, let me explain...==W== Wait, you know?
Stand behind me. When the White Cats come in, make sure you have a good excuse for being in Mirage.
A good excuse?==W== What does that mean?
Apologies for the late intrusion. I am Kasimira, Captain of the White Cat Troupe's Third Squad. I need a word with you... Do you have a moment?
The door is unlocked. Come in.
Good evening, Director Allie. I apologize for the hour. I hope we didn't startle the children.
Oh, don't worry. They're fast asleep by now. But Captain Kasimira, you've brought quite a crowd. What brings you here?
Let me be clear—we aren't here to fight. We're investigating the brawl that happened in town today, to see if anyone knows anything.
A brawl? I'm afraid I've been here all day. Did something happen in town?

This morning, the Desert Scorpions and the Imperial Guard got into their usual street fight. But witnesses say neither side won. Someone in a White Cat uniform ended it, using two of our standard-issue magic pistols.
You would think so. But our weapons are assigned to specific members. Dual-wielding is the signature style of one specific person... But...
No one in the Troupe currently uses two guns.
I believe someone is impersonating us. They want to upset the balance and shatter the peace we have in Mirage.
Neither the Troupe nor I will sit back and let that happen. We refuse to let Mirage fall back into chaos.
Mirage was already peaceful when we moved here. I honestly have a hard time picturing this past chaos.
But what does this have to do with the orphanage? For the children's sake, we certainly don't want any trouble either.
Heh heh. That impostor is crafty, I'll give them that. Even I, wielder of the Evil Eye, was stumped at first! They must have used a high-grade magical barrier to warp perception.
But! No matter what masterful techniques they use to hide, the world is now veiled in shadow.
With the dark power surging,==W== absolutely nothing escapes my Evil Eye!
Right, uh... Basically, I couldn't find them all day. But tonight the fake finally showed up. I tailed them straight to the orphanage.
So that is where we stand. Director Allie, has anything unusual happened here tonight?
Unusual? No, I don't believe so.==W== At most, we had this Trekker stop by asking for a bed... Right?
Clearly Allie is covering for us...==W== I'd better play along and make the story stick.
A Trekker looking for lodging... Suspicious. Why would a Trekker come to a desolate, dangerous place like Mirage, especially when there's no Monolith?
I was commissioned by Executive Director Firenze of United Harvest Philae. I'm here to survey the local agricultural goods.
It seems there aren't any inns in town, so I'm relying on the kindness of the locals for a place to sleep. That's all.
Is the White Cat Troupe a registered company? If you have a problem, take it up with mine.
United Harvest Philae... The Desert Scorpions raided them recently. Were you involved?
They stormed our banquet, yes. We want them brought to justice, but that is not my business in Mirage.
No, no! This is not the one with the guns. I clearly saw four people entering this orphanage. Where are the other three?
You must be mistaken. I took this job alone. The kids were showing me the way. You probably saw me walking with them.
Yeah! We found ==SEX4== on the street. ==SEX1== had nowhere to stay, so we brought ==SEX4== back.
Ugh—my dark power has locked on to three other presences! Move, let me in to search.
Did you not hear me the first time? The children are sleeping. No one is going inside.
Why?! Kasimira, I swear on the dark power. I know I saw others in there.
I'm not saying you're wrong. But we've intruded enough at this hour. Pushing the issue would just be rude. It violates the desert code and the White Cat spirit.
Director Allie, I apologize for the disturbance.==W== If you spot anyone impersonating a White Cat, please inform us.
Before we leave, I have a personal question. Are you familiar with the name Taffett?
Taffett? I have never heard that name. Is it a person?
I see. Forget I asked.==W== Third Squad, move out.
Phew. We actually pulled that off.
Good job keeping up the act.==W== But honestly, those three are far too reckless. They had no idea they were being tailed.
Are they going to be alright? I am worried.
Oh, I haven't properly introduced myself. I'm Allie. I'm the mother here. That makes me both the caretaker and the director.
I'm ==PLAYER_NAME==. I'm the CEO of a company called Boss Accord. Because of my title, everyone calls me Boss.
Noya and the others saved me in the desert a few months ago. I've been traveling with them ever since.
A corporate CEO? How impressive. Hehehe, those kids are always full of surprises.
Locking us up out of nowhere, I thought something terrible happened. Turns out we were being followed. Aunt Allie, you could've said so from the start!
Noya, you can't keep a secret. Iris, the second you panic, it's written all over your face.
And I am still mad you call me Auntie instead of Mom!
Does that last part even count?! Alright, fine, we'll try. Right, Iris?
M-Mom...==W== No, I can't do it! It's too embarrassing, my face is on fire!
Honestly, you used to call me that all the time when you were little...
Anyway, you've barely stepped foot in Mirage, and you've already crossed the White Cats. Now that you're mixed up in this, the Scorpions and the Guard will be after you next.
Stay hidden here with me. It might be an orphanage, but the Cats, the Scorpions, and the Guard know better than to start trouble here.
She said she worried they'd turn bad, yet she covered for us without hesitation. She thought we were in trouble and wanted to keep us safe.
So this is what home feels like. A mother's warmth... For someone who doesn't even know where to return to, I'm truly envious...
It's not that serious! We're kids from your orphanage, we wouldn't cause trouble. And even if we did, we'd never bring it home.
Speaking of which, we meant to ask. Why did the orphanage vanish from Emor without a word? Was it because of United Harvest?
It's a long story. If you're not tired, why don't we chat while the kids are asleep?==W== I want to hear everything you've been up to since you left.
Yes! Let's all lie down and roll on the floor while listening to stories! Just like when we were little.
Despite the long separation, Noya, Iris, and Amber don't miss a beat. They fall right back into their old rhythm, as if they only left yesterday.
They pull me onto the soft sofas with them. Over warm tea, we settle in for a long, heartwarming night of stories.

strings.text: Albedo sends Bastelina and Laru to track Angie. Meanwhile, you and the New Star Guild finally settle in at the Daisy Orphanage. You let your friends in Philae know you're safe, then finally get to talk with Allie...
Yaaawn...==W== I am beat.==W== Hey, Bastelina, want some fry? I got the coffee-flavored ones. Figured they'd keep us awake.==W==
Sure, I could use a pick-me-up. Munch, munch...==W== These are soggy.==W== You usually have higher standards, Laru.

What do you expect? This dungeon is a swamp. They went soggy after all the time I took bringing them here from the shop.==W== Ugh, I can't even enjoy a crispy fry.==W== How much longer are we rotting in here?
Easy, Laru. Remember the mission Lady Albedo assigned us. Patience.==W==
Bastelina, Laru. Angie's operation is going to fail. Fall back with her squad.
Lady Albedo, if this is an order to assassinate Boss, I'm afraid I can't accept that.
Yeah, I am out too.==W== And for the record,==W== this isn't me trying to dodge work. I never bought that Book of Grace Prophecies anyway. An apocalypse? Please.
Don't jump to conclusions. Hear me out.==W== I am sending you in to spy on Angie's faction from the inside.==W==
Angie is desperate for Boss's head. She needs people who actually know ==SEX4== to improve her odds. You two are perfect bait.
Play along. Act like you want to save the world and slay the Tyrant. She'll snatch you right up.
Oh, play undercover... Fine.==W== But I am logging this as field overtime.==W== You gotta approve my bonus.
Assuming==W== I am still your superior when you get back.
That sounds a little bleak.==W== Are you expecting trouble?
The Director of the Sky Institute attempted murder.==W== As her second-in-command, I have to answer for it.
So I have to try and stop Angie, then turn myself in to Boss Accord.==W== They must absolutely loathe me by now.==W== Who knows what they'll do to me.
Don't worry, Albedo! ♪==W== If they burn you to a crisp, I'll collect your ashes myself!
<size=52>Laru!==W== Why do you sound thrilled about that?!</size>
Well, everything played out as Albedo predicted.==W== Hey,==W== does this mean our Committee is a heretic cult now?==W== I'm not sure how I feel about that.
Pretty much. The Dusk Arbiter hasn't come for our heads yet, but to the Grace Imperium, we belong at the stake.
Burned at the stake...==W== My body is ninety percent fries at this point. I'd end up cooked into a human fry.
You'd be perfectly crispy, Laru. I am sure you'd give off the sweet, rich aroma of a deep-fried potato.
That sounds delicious...==W== Wait,==W== I can't eat myself.
Alright, back to business. I dug up some intel.==W== Angie put me in charge of procuring the daily necessities and snacks, so I have a rough headcount of her current forces.==W==
About thirty Sentinels of Dawn and Imperial Guards, fifteen Dusk Arbiters,==W== and a few dozen Trekkers.
That is specific.==W== You got all that from groceries?
Yep. The Sentinels and Imperial Guards use a specific oil to maintain their gear, and the Arbiters need special prayer candles.==W== I worked out the rest from daily consumables.
Nice work, Laru. I made a discovery too.==W== Angie had me monitor that person's daily broadcasts on Scarlet Sights for clues.==W==
Laru, you slipped up again!==W== We need to say the Tyrant.
Sorry, sorry. The Tyrant.==W== Good thing nobody else heard that.
Anyway, here is what I found. Watch this clip.==W==
This rain on the 7th of Nebula Month is expected to last through the next two days, with temperatures continuing to fall.==W== Viewers with travel plans, bring rain gear and dress warmly.
So what?==W== Isn't that ==SEX4== reading the daily weather report off a newspaper...
Except that might not be the real Tyrant. Watch closely.==W== ==SEX2== eyes keep drifting to the Sherlock doll on the desk.
The Tyrant I know doesn't have a tic like that. Chances are, the person on that screen isn't the real Tyrant anymore.
What? They swapped? Did ==SEX== run, or is ==SEX== lying low somewhere, ready to strike back?

I think ==SEX== went looking for proof that ==SEX== isn't the Tyrant.==W== Albedo announced that everyone will judge whether ==PLAYER_NAME== is the Tyrant at the Nova Chamber of Commerce and Industry Conference later this month.
If we make it to that point and the conference clears ==PLAYER_NAME==, it won't matter how much influence the Salvation Committee has.==W== The majority of Novians won't believe a word they say.
The real question is whether Angie will catch that slip-up in the footage.
We are safe on that front. Angie doesn't have time to analyze these videos, and I am obviously not telling her.==W== For the next two weeks, let her chase a fake Tyrant in Philae.
Lady Albedo is stationed there, so the Committee has no chance of breaking through with their current numbers.
Bastelina, Lady Angie has new orders... Laru, you're here as well. Then listen up, both of you.

All Committee members are to immediately destroy any non-portable documents and supplies. Evacuate Emor by 12:00 today.==W== Proceed independently to your assigned cities according to the provided maps.==W== This relocation must be completed within one week.
Copy that. Understood. Let's see, our target city is...==W== Wait, here?
(==PLAYER_NAME==, your adorable Bastelina can only pray for you now...==W== Are you doing okay?==W== Please stay safe, and find the proof that you are no Tyrant.)
I'm fine, Nazuka, don't worry. We made it to Mirage. And good news, we found Aunt Allie and the orphanage kids. Everything is clear on our end.
What a coincidence.==W== That's wonderful!==W== We're all clear on this end too. Nazuna's disguise is flawless. Nobody suspects a thing.
I mean,==W== if my disguise is flawless, it's weirder that Nazuka and Chitose can still tell us apart...==W==
My ==SEX11==, Lady Albedo sent a detail of trusted guards under my command. I'll handle things here.==W== Please rest assured, Lady Nazuna is safe.
Good. Hold on a bit longer, everyone.==W== I'll figure out who I am, fix this mess, and come back to you with my head held high.
We'll be waiting.==W== But Boss...==W== You need to stop contacting us for a while.
You're a massive celebrity now.==W== Scarlet Sights witches are tailing us everywhere, snapping photos.
We can handle the photos.==W== But if they catch a call from you and record it,==W== this entire plan would fall apart.
And whose fault will that be?==W== A certain someone was glued to her phone morning, noon, and night texting Boss.
<size=52>Wh-What?!</size>==W== Nazuna, what are you talking about? I was not gl—==W==
Uh-oh.==W== Yelling, Nazuka?==W== Boss can hear you, you know~
Th-==W==that's all for today, Boss!==W== Keep safe out there!
Phew. They haven't changed a bit.==W== Hearing them still bickering puts my mind at ease.
The morning sun in Mirage feels great. Another beautiful day ahead.==W==
How late did the girls stay up? Iris is usually up by now.

Last night, Allie and the New Star Guild talked for hours.==RT==Between her story and Firenze's, we finally uncovered the truth behind the orphanage's disappearance.==P====RT====RT==United Harvest did investigate the orphanage, and Allie did notice she was being watched.==P====RT====RT==But there's one thing that even Firenze didn't know about:==RT==It wasn't just United Harvest. At least three or four factions were sniffing around back then.==P====RT====RT==All of them were after the "treasure" hidden in the orphanage basement.

Calling it treasure is a stretch. The basement was essentially packed with random junk.==RT==Both the steering wheel and the engine powering the Lucky Oasis were dug out of there, for instance.==P====RT====RT====W==Amber's outfit that looks suspiciously like a White Cat uniform and her rare magical guns came from the basement, too.==P====RT====RT====W==Firenze showed up late but still managed to scrounge up a magical compass and a Tawny Nightingale recipe book.==P====RT====RT====W==But Allie couldn't care less about the treasure those companies were drooling over. She had no idea where any of it came from.==RT==As long as the kids were safe, all that junk meant nothing to her.

So she gathered the kids and left Emor that night without looking back.==RT==When I told her how Rainea was doing, a look of pure relief washed over her face.==P====RT====RT====W==She didn't even have a destination in mind.==RT==She just saw the words "Edge of the World" on a map and figured it had to be far enough away. After a long journey, they ended up in Mirage.==P====RT====RT====W==Daisy Orphanage, the orphanage's new name, was inspired by the beautiful desert daisies their new home was surrounded by.
(They've come a long way.==W== Moments like this to themselves are rare. I'll let them sleep in.)
Good morning, ==PLAYER_NAME==. You're up early.==W== Wait...==W== Did you have trouble sleeping?
Not at all. The bed's soft, the sheets smell like daisies. I slept great. Thanks for having me,==W== uh,==W== ...==W==
Wait a second. ==W== I should be careful about what I call her.
I'm with the New Star Guild. I'll use their title for her.
Hang on... I need to be careful with how I address her.
I'm not one of the kids here.==W== Calling her by name is the most honest approach.
... Thanks for having me, Allie.==W== Let me help out around the orphanage.==W== I can't just sit here without contributing.
Uh...==W== I thought calling you by name was appropriate.==W== Was that out of line?
Not at all, it's perfect.==W== I appreciate the honesty.==W== Call me Allie.
Anyway,==W== matching what Noya, Iris, and Amber call her is the safest bet.
... Thanks for having me,==W== Aunt Allie.
Oh, what a polite one. Such a good kid. Hehe, there, there.==W==
Oh goodness, look at my habits,==W== Hehe. Sorry about that,==W== muscle memory took over.
You don't need to force an honorific, though.==W== Calling me by name is perfectly fine.
Wh-What did you just call me...?==W==
... Thanks for having me, Mom!==W== Since I'm staying at the Daisy Orphanage now,==W== that makes you my Mom.
Oh, what a sweet talker.==W== Such a good kid.==W== If only those three had half your charm.
Urgh...==W== Your grip strength...!==W== I can't breathe...
My kids are at that age where they refuse to call me Mom anymore.==W== Hearing it from someone their age got me a little too excited. Heh heh... ♪
Phew, you startled me...==W== Honestly, with my amnesia and everything else that happened,==W== I don't remember my parents. I don't even know where home is.
That hug felt a lot like ...==W== motherly love.==W== I didn't mind it at all.
Oh, you poor thing...==W== Well, how about this? Call me by my name around the others. But when it's just us, call me Mom all you want ♪ Don't be shy.
Noya and the others are definitely going to be shocked when they find out.
Alright, let's take it from the top.==W== Good morning, Allie.
By the way, aren't you exhausted? You went to bed way later than I did.
A tiny bit. But honestly, only a little. I actually got up at six to make breakfast.==W== Want a bite, ==PLAYER_NAME==?
Occupational hazard of being the orphanage mom. I'm used to it. You all should settle in and get some proper rest for the next few days.
I appreciate it, but we still have to track down the desert Monolith.==W== It's the only way I can figure out who I am.
I know. I heard about your journey last night.
But if you ask me, you're all pushing yourselves too hard.
Look at your dark circles,==W== and Noya was out cold last night. She didn't even toss and turn.
Iris said she'd help with breakfast, but she's still asleep.==W== Amber didn't even climb the rafters.==W== She curled up right on the floor.
Besides, you're a friend to my kids.==W== That makes you one of my own.
Let me look into this missing Monolith for you.
Wait, but we searched the desert for days and found nothing. The Desert Scorpions even mentioned a legend about it vanishing from Mirage. How do you plan to investigate?
The Sunset Desert is massive. Wandering around blindly will only exhaust you. First thing we need is more eyes out there.
There's barely anyone living here. How are we supposed to round up a search party?==W==
Don't let the orphanage mom title fool you. I have connections here in Mirage. Leave the digging to me.
Just focus on recovering. Otherwise, even if we find the Monolith, you won't have the energy to climb it.

==RT====RT====RT==Wrapped in that comforting motherly love, Noya, Iris, Amber, and I got a full night of rest for the first time since I woke up.==P====RT====RT==It felt like someone hit pause on the chaos of our lives.

strings.text: You witness the White Cats clash with the Imperial Guard, while the local kids scavenge the dropped gear and sell it back to them—just another day in Mirage. Allie mentions that a Monolith once stood here years ago...
White Cats, last chance. Lay down your weapons and surrender. The Imperial Guard will guarantee your safety.
Pack up and leave Mirage. Go be a Trekker in a real city, find honest work. It beats eating sand out here.
Same old routine from the Imperial Guard?
Right? A few days ago they promised everyone a million Dorra if we surrendered.==W== No mention of that today. Bet this guy pocketed it.
Let them talk. The White Cats won't surrender, and the Guard wouldn't accept it anyway.
Works for me. Every battle feeds my dark power. One day, the great Chaton will rule this entire desert.
Hey, tin cans. Save your breath.==W== You want a fight, let's go.
You White Cats have no honor! A sneak attack?!
What are you babbling about?==W== You came here for a fight. There is no such thing as fighting dirty.
Watch and learn, rookies. Imperial Guard versus White Cats.==W== First those tin cans lose their armor, then they rally. Every time.
You sure about that?==W== The White Cats have maybe a dozen fighters, but the Guard has over a hundred. Shouldn't this be over in a flash?
Yeah.==W== The Guard has solid gear. Magic bullets probably barely scratch that enchanted armor.
You don't get it. If they don't take a beating, how are we supposed to scavenge? Watch.==W==
Fall back!==W== Fall back!==W== Ditch the heavy gear and run!
That is our cue.==W== Let's move!
Three days ago, Allie practically forced us to stay at the orphanage to rest.
In half a day, she learned to drive Loxy, shocking even Noya,==RT==and headed into the desert to search for the Monolith.
She also worked her contacts, asking the Desert Scorpions==RT==and White Cats about the missing Monolith.
We planned to watch the kids for her, but as it turned out...
Split up! Kids take the lances and arm guards.==W== Newbies, grab the breastplates. Split 'em in half and stack 'em.
Instead, the kids schooled us on Mirage street smarts.
That's enough. Guard's pushing back. Let's go.==W== Leave some scraps for the White Cats.
Knights, counterattack!==W== Remember to take pictures.==W== We need proof of work.
Crap, I grabbed too much...==W== I can barely carry it.
Don't sweat it. You're Mom's kids too, so we're family. And family helps each other.
That family helps each other rule sounds like the New Star Guild.==W== Did Allie teach you that?==W== You even covered for me with the White Cats earlier.
Yep!==W== Mom always says family helps each other.
Makes sense. No wonder you're all so well-behaved.==W== I never caught your name. I'm ==PLAYER_NAME==. You?
Huckleberry.==W== Mom says it's a berry, but they don't grow in the desert.
If you want out of the desert, our only option is the Desert Scorpions.==W== The Imperial Guard won't take orphans, and the White Cats aren't hiring.
...==W== But Mom says that's absolutely out.
Then be a Trekker! We climb Monoliths across Nova and grab Artifacts.==W== Become a Trekker, and you can go anywhere.
Yep! You gotta learn swords and magic first. You need to protect yourself out in the Wilds, after all.
Then...==W== Can you teach us? Mom's always busy, and I don't wanna bother her.
Watch your blind spots. Keep those blades moving!
You'll get the hang of it.==W== But hey, ==PLAYER_NAME==,==W== what are you doing crashing the kids' class?
I figured ... if I learn how to fight, I won't slow you all down on the road.
Makes sense in theory, but our forms rely on channeling magic. Since you can't use Soul Stones, even perfect technique won't keep you alive against a veteran Trekker.

I know, but something is better than nothing.==W== People are actively trying to assassinate me. If I learn the fundamentals, at least I'll understand how an attacker thinks.==W== Makes escaping a lot easier.

Blasted open ...==W== the walls of the Monolith...==W==

How did Chaton know about that?

We checked this city when we arrived.==W== No newspapers, projectors, or Scarlet Sights beacons. No cross-city comms like in Emor or Philae. Mirage is completely cut off.==W== No one here even knows what Boss Accord is.
The Desert Scorpions' captain and deputy captain know a few things.==W== Same for the new knights from outside the desert...
But they hate the White Cats. There is no way Chaton heard it from them. Unless...
She's with the Salvation Committee too?!
Hey, hey,==W== what's with the scary faces, everyone?==W== Heh,==W== that only proves I'm right!
She doesn't seem like a bad person. I hate to use force, but we are out of time.==W== Let's detain her first and ask questions later.
I don't want to clash with the White Cats, but we have no choice.
Whoa, are we dueling?==W== Heh!==W== The great Chaton doesn't mind taking you all on at once. But that is not how we settle things in the desert.
Desert rules, huh? What do you have in mind?
Yep. Duels have to be one-on-one.==W== As for the terms...

If I win, your <color=#bd3059>dark power</color> is mine!==W== Then,==W== I will <color=#bd3059>destroy this world</color> with the Tyrant's power and descend as the new god!==W== Nya-ha-ha-ha! <size=53>♪</size>==B====W==
<size=50>What?! You...==W== You want to destroy the world?</size>
I will fight in your place,==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W==
Finally got dressed, huh? Rough few days walking around in pajamas.==W== I don't care who I fight.==W== Time for the great Chaton to crush this fake!
But listen up,==W== Tyrant.==W== I will allow a proxy duel,==W== but if this fake loses,==W== your dark power is mine!
What exactly is this dark power she keeps talking about?
I don't follow...==W== But fine. Let's do this.
Do not get cocky, kid. Nobody in this desert has ever beaten the great Chaton in a duel.

Hah! Bet you didn't see that coming.==W== This vessel seals the souls of my past life,==W== the life before that,==W== and the life before, before that! When it comes to true age, I am the clear winner.==W==
Huh?==W== What is she talking about? Do you win a prize for being older?
I think she means==W== she has more experience in this desert than we do.

Listen up. Here's how we duel in the desert.==W== We stand back to back with our guns pointed down. We walk forward.==W== When the witness gives the signal, we turn and fire.==W== Last one standing wins.
I can be your witness, if you agree.
The director of the Daisy Orphanage?==W== I hear you helped the White Cats before. You seem trustworthy enough.==W== Fine, you can be our witness.
All right, you two. Start walking.==W== I will count to ten in my head and then call the start of the duel.
Chaton's sniper rifle is heavy. It's nowhere near as quick to draw as Amber's pistols. At this range, Amber should have the clear advantage...
Wait. Is it really that simple?==W== She claimed she never loses.==W== She must have a trick up her sleeve...
Sneaky. She is sprinting to gain distance before the duel even starts.
Hahaha! The rules never said how fast or slow you have to walk!
Now that I have my distance, how will those puny pistols hold up against my sniper rifle? Come on!
Taste the terror of being hunted!

<color=#bd3059>Evil Eye... Unleashed!</color>==W== Awaken, <color=#bd3059>Cat Wand: Uncompleted Codex Entry MK Ⅰ</color>!==W== The crimson moon hangs high! The gates of blood swing wide! All who defy the God of Meows shall plunge into the cursed abyss!==W==
<size=50>Haaaaaaah!==W== Let this World-Ending Light tear right through you!</size>==W==
What?==W== The great Chaton missed?!==W== No,==W== that fake va-vanished...?!
She's fast.==W== How is she finding all those covers?==W== They only got to Mirage a few days ago!
Whenever Amber hits a new city, she climbs around to map out every corner. She probably has this whole place memorized by now.
Terrain is even now. The real fight starts here!
Amber is reading her every move. Chaton won't land a hit from that distance.
Hmph, heh heh... Not bad for a fake!==W== That fighting style, those techniques... She feels more White Cat than the real thing.
Then it's time==W== for the great Chaton to get serious!==W==<size=50> Cue the music!</size>
Nobody beats the great Chaton==W== while this track is playing!
She dropped cover. Losing her temper over a missed shot?
No, it doesn't look like that...==W== Is she going to melee ...==W== with a sniper rifle?==W==
Burn in the all-consuming hellfire!==W== Darkness Supersonic Blaze!==W==
One shot caved in an entire wall?! That firepower is insane!
Point-blank with the muzzle pressed right against her...==W== Haha!==W== That is basically a melee weapon!
So this is how you actually fight.
Hey, hey, hey, where'd you learn that? That's a former White Cat's secret shooting technique!
A book. Iris lent it to me.
The outfit, the weapons, the technique... You're not just any random fake, are you?
But whoever you are, the great Chaton gets the last laugh!==W== Annihilation Ray, mode shift! Overclock mode!==W==
Idiot. Are you trying to level the city?
The magic blast...==W== She shoved it right back in.
Ka-Kasimira,==W== what are you doing?!==W== The great Chaton was about to win!
Win, huh? That's all you care about.==W== Do you know how much Grace this duel cost?==W== Look at your Soul Stone. It's half empty.
Ah... Well... I didn't notice that.
And that spell takes time to cast. You're supposed to hide it from your target.
Instead, you screamed at the top of your lungs and struck a ridiculous pose.==W== Were you afraid she'd miss you?
Mhm.==W== Easy to dodge if I see it coming.
You hear that? Pay attention next time!
Wh-What do you know?!==W== That's the ritual to channel dark power.==W== It's mandatory!
Then I'll deduct the wasted Grace from your allowance. Sound fair?
Sigh...==W== Director Allie, and everyone from Boss Accord.==W== I apologize for my squad member's behavior.
It's quite alright.==W== It's good for the girls to get moving and burn off some energy.==W== I was keeping an eye on things, so no one was in danger.
Thank you for understanding.==W== But you...==W== Amber, right?==W== Your combat style is deeply tied to the White Cat Troupe.
...==W== So we've been watched this whole time.==W== Kasimira let the fight drag on to analyze Amber's moves.
I watched the duel closely.==W== Amber's fighting style is identical to the White Cats'. I won't deny that.
But the Ash Orphanage had a massive archive in its basement. Finding a manual on White Cat techniques down there wouldn't be surprising.
She bought that? Just like that?
I owe you an apology. Those magic pistols are tied to a major event in our history. Because of that, we covertly looked into your backgrounds the past few days.
We pulled your records for the last ten years,==W== and you actually had zero contact with the White Cats. Our assumption was a mistake.

Myrsha? What are you doing here?

Hazana...!==W== Is she about to jump us?
Hah! Your face says it all. Relax, I'm not going to eat you alive the second we meet.
Hazana. What are you doing here?
Like I said. I came to welcome the guests.
I see you didn't bring that lying fox with you today.
I hired her as a guard. We aren't attached at the hip.
But since you brought her up... Are you still looking for payback?

Heh. We have our reasons. Take the deal, and I'll spill everything.
You aren't the only ones out here itching to crack some Salvation Committee skulls. Right, Captain Kasimira?
That was the cover story. The actual kill order came from an Angie.
We only figured it out ourselves recently.==RT==That hooded client who hired us to take you out? Her name is Angie.

They fear nothing. Picking a fight with the Committee is entirely in character.

Alright, you made your point. What is the price?
We want the Scepters of Death. You manifested it once. You can do it again.

On one side, the White Cats. Cheap intel, but they sit out the war.==W== On the other, the Desert Scorpions. They bleed with us against the Committee, but their price is massive. And they did try to kill me once...

Give me a lever and I'll move Nova.

I can't prioritize clearing my name over everyone's safety.

Allie, I need your input on this.

Those are my thoughts.==W== What do you think, ==PLAYER_NAME==?

Fine by me. Myrsha, we're leaving.
Aw man, your loss, Boss!==W== Next time you get a choice, you better pick us! Bye!

strings.text: At Eureka Bar, you trade intel with Allie and the White Cat Troupe. The clues lead to the secret room, but Taffett, the key to it all, has vanished. With memory loss hindering the Trekkers, you come up with an idea...
Alright, here we are. The Eureka Bar.
Hey, are those ...==W== Desert Scorpions and Imperial Guards over there?==W== Kasimira, get out of sight!
Relax. No one starts anything in here.==W== Watch and learn.
What is going on?==W== Out there, the Scorpions were ready to tear you apart, and you clashed with those Guards a few days ago. How does any of this make sense?
That was outside. In here,==W== at the Eureka Bar, fighting is strictly prohibited. Faction loyalties don't matter.==W== Everyone's a customer.
Hey there, Mr. Knight! Any word on when the Guard's next "war" with us is?
Next month, probably. Everyone's swamped with paperwork, balancing the books. That last scrap tied us up. We're waiting on that year-end budget spree.
Ugh, seriously? We've got a commission out in the desert next month. We'll miss the whole thing. I don't wanna go. Last time we hit Philae, we lost a fortune.
Philae? Oh, I heard about that. You got rolled by some fox.==W== You were on that op, too?
Tch. Can we drop that?==W== Didn't your standard-bearer get wrecked by some meek little Trekker==W== before she got transferred here?
Alright, break it up.==W== A "war" is fine, but keep it away from the Eureka Bar and the orphanage next month.
Other than that, we White Cats will play along. And don't pick a weekend. We've got our own gigs.
Oh please, nobody's gonna fight in here. I live for their sweet drinks. This place keeps me going.
Same goes for the orphanage. Director Allie took in several of our Guards' kids. We owe her big time.==W== No weekends for sure. I'll let the standard bearer know.

Did I see the White Cats back when we were in Emor? Nothing comes to mind...
The orphanage was empty sometimes, though. If this Taffett was hiding from enemies, she could have easily slipped into the basement and stashed her gear down there.
Actually, that house might have been a White Cat base in the past. That would explain all those books and rare Artifacts.
How come I'm so good at patching wounds and fighting?==W== I'm a Trekker too, remember? It comes with the job.
Why don't we call her Mom?==W== Because it's embarrassing, obviously! It made sense when we were kids, but now we're almost her age. We just ... can't say it.
Don't think calling me young gets you off the hook. No matter how old you get, you are still my kids.==W== I still want to hear you call me Mom.
My memory is a bit blurry... But didn't Aunt Allie tell us not to call her Mom?
Really? Did I ever say that?
Kasimira and Benito give up their questioning.==W== Chaton, meanwhile, ate way too much of Allie's cooking and is off to the side,==W== looking miserable as she struggles to digest the "dark power."
(Nothing useful.==W== Allie and the others have wished away so many memories that their memories are full of holes.)
(Wishing is far more terrifying than I imagined. Thanks to Vita's power, our memories don't slip away anymore.==W== But if they just keep wishing... Is this what happens to all Trekkers?)
I'm sorry,==W== I wasn't any help at all.
It's fine. We expected this. Taffett has been missing for fifteen years. If clues were easy to find, we wouldn't have had to search this long.
We'll keep our promise and take you to the secret room. But only Taffett knows how to open it. We'll just have to break in.
During lunch, Benito told me the White Cats have a memory extraction spell.==W== It can even restore forgotten memories.
So if I knew anything about Taffett before I lost my memory... That spell could bring it back.==W==
No.==W== I did mention it, but that spell is for interrogating enemies.==W== It causes extreme mental strain and permanent brain damage.==W== The White Cats abandoned it years ago.
It's fine.==W== I'm pretty resilient.==W== Once won't hurt.
Director Allie, we appreciate your offer, but we don't need to go that far.==W== If we can't open the secret room, we'll find another way to the Monolith.
Yeah... What if something happens to you, Aunt Allie?==W==
But you're out of time,==W== aren't you?
You all went pale when you saw that cloak, didn't you?
That still doesn't mean you should take the risk. I've forgotten plenty too. Use the spell on me.
Don't be silly. Kasimira said Taffett disappeared fifteen years ago.
You were just babies back then.==W== Even if you met her, you wouldn't remember a thing.
The White Cats have been blamed for the Empress's murder for fifteen years. I fled Emor to escape. And now my children are being framed by the Salvation Committee.
As a mother, I simply won't stand for this. Since there's nowhere left to run, let Mom protect you.
Captain Kasimira, these are my reasons and my resolve. Please let them use the memory extraction spell on me.
... So you've made up your mind, Director Allie.==W== I understand. The White Cats will make an exception for you. Just this once...==W==
If you trust me, I have a safer way.==W== I can recover the memories you sacrificed to the Monolith.
But ... you'll need to make a soul pact with me first. You'll have to place your souls ... in my hands.

strings.text: At Eureka Bar, you and Hazana plan how to take on Angie. Allie evacuates with the children, while the New Star Guild stays in Mirage. Following Hazana's advice, you wish for dozens of Scepters of Death...
Apologies for the interruption, folks!==W== We appreciate your cooperation.
Oh come on, I'm barely halfway through my meal!==W== I know the Desert Scorpions did a lot for us, but this is pushing it.
I am sorry, but we have urgent business and need the space.
Don't worry, though.==W== As a thank-you for your support, today's bills are on us.==W== And for the next three days, all your drinks at Eureka are covered.
All drinks?!==W== That's generous.==W== Alright, let's take this somewhere else!
Hey, hey, Miss Myrsha! What are you doing? Why are you kicking my customers out?
Oh, good afternoon, Benito! <size=53>♪</size>==W== Sorry to barge in. We aren't kicking anyone out. Look, they're all smiling.
The customers are compensated,==W== your sales will spike for the next three days,==W== and we get a quiet place to talk.
No buts.==W== Take the day off and come hunt monsters with me!==W==
Quite the setup. You cleared the whole place for a chat?==W== Why here?
Heh. You don't visit Mirage often. It'd be a shame to miss out on Eureka's drinks, so here we are.
Still, you didn't have to kick everyone out. Couldn't we just chat over a meal?
We normally wouldn't, but today is different.==W== This partnership means everything to the Desert Scorpions.
This pouch of crystal diamonds==W== covers the reservation for the next three days, plus some extra for Eureka Bar.==W==
Hazana tucks a bulging pouch of crystal diamonds behind the counter,==W== then grabs a bar spoon and shaker with practiced ease.
After a quick shake,==W== she sets a drink down in front of me, pitch black at the bottom and pale blue on top, with a tiny cross-shaped flower on the rim.
To celebrate our reunion in Mirage,==W== I made this drink for you. I call it the Boss.
Mmm, sweet and fizzy.==W== So this is how you see me?
The black Pep Pep Juice stands for your awakening from the Monolith.==W== The blue syrup represents your time as a Trekker.
Black and blue are the Boss's colors.==W== The colors of steel and sky.==W== You'll lead the Desert Scorpions, claiming the lands beneath the blue sky with black steel.
Poetic.==W== But I have no weapons, nor the means to lead anyone to "claim the lands beneath the blue sky."
I don't mean standard weapons.==W== The Scepters of Death are the special steel we want.
The Scepters of Death are made of special steel, yes...==W== Wait.==W== Knowing the name is one thing, but how do you know it's made of <r=·>special</r> <r=·>steel</r>?
Barely anyone has seen that thing in person...
<color=#3faeae>Angie</color> showed it to me when she passed through Mirage.==W== Hah!==W== I heard she tried to kill you with it.
Relax.==W== After our chat, she slithered off like a snake. Left nothing behind but her disgusting <r=cloak>skin</r>.
But ... she's convinced you're hiding here.==W== She wanted the Desert Scorpions to help the Salvation Committee hunt you down.
She made a compelling offer.==W== Hand you over, dead or alive,==W== and she gives us the city and its crystal diamond mine.
Not a bad deal, right? Haha!==W== The Imperial Guard leaves, and we become the undisputed rulers of Mirage.
Good to know my life is worth that much.==W== You turned her down to pitch a team-up?==W== But if I say no, you'll walk away with nothing.
I'd never take the bait from a snake like her.==W== We have a saying out here. Borrow another person's eyes, and you only see one path.
Going from mercenary captain to city lord, sitting on a fresh crystal diamond mine. Logically, I should be satisfied.
But I want more than a handout.==W== Out here, if you want something, you break them and take it yourself.==W==<size=50> That's the law of the desert!</size>
Play lapdog to a snake and lick up her scraps?==W== Not a chance.==W== You see right through her game, don't you, Boss?
Of course. I have it figured out.
If I die, she can forge enough evidence to brand me as the true Tyrant.
Once she does, clearing her name and retaking the Sky Institute can't be simpler.
Mirage has no Monolith. You have to import every daily Artifact, and you must export your crystal diamonds to earn Dorra.
Any Artifact pulled from the Wilds must be appraised by the Soul Shop before it can be sold. The Sky Institute runs the Soul Shop. No matter what, you'd be answering to her.
The Imperial Guard buys most of your crystal diamonds, and the Sky Institute pays the Imperial Guard. That means they control your sales too.
Ultimately, she controls everything in and out of Mirage. When someone else sets your prices, that's just slavery.
I knew I picked right. You pieced it all together from just a few scraps.
Desert Scorpions are the descendants of Mirage's founders. We were the first to mine crystal diamonds here.==W== This city is ours.
But back then, the Imperial Guard monopolized the trade.==W== The crystal diamonds we bled to dig up were sold to them for next to nothing.
Then we misplaced our trust in Grace Imperium. We took up arms to fight the White Cats for them, but ended up as cannon fodder who they didn't have to pay pensions to.
I thought times had changed. Then Angie waltzes in with the same old trick. Does she think we're stupid?
That's the long and short of it.==W== Desert Scorpions don't bow to anyone anymore.==W== I'll keep fighting until we get what's ours.
Then why take that job from United Harvest?==W== Coming to Philae to kill me doesn't sound like fighting for yourselves.
Heh, fair point.==W== The Imperial Guard acts like our ally, but they actually watch us like hawks.==W== They count heads every time we leave the desert, making sure we don't set up base outside.
It's like flies you can't shake. Annoying as hell.==W== So we used that commission to fake some casualties. We let our people "<color=#3faeae>die</color>" on paper so they could quietly set up base.

Of course, what I really wanted were those Seals of Grace you supposedly carried.==W== One Seal, and we can start our own company.==W== We might not match Grace Imperium or United Harvest, but at least we wouldn't get squeezed dry.
Didn't expect your fox to be so tough, fending us off singlehandedly.==W== Her beating us up actually made our fake casualties look convincing, so it wasn't a total loss.
I see.==W== Well, I have three Seals on me right now.==W== Since we're partners, if everything goes well, I might let you have one.
Hah! You never disappoint.==W== I'll hold you to that when the time comes.
But...==W== I'd take Scepters of Death over a Seal any day.==W== An exclusive Artifact like that is way better for us, no matter if we use or sell it.
Heads up. Wishing for an Artifact like that will cost you a ton of memories.==W== If you want to keep them, you have to make a soul pact and put your soul in my hands.
Hah! No way.==W== I'd rather lose my memories than hand my fate to someone else.
Anyway, thanks for the deal.==W== By the way, it looks like your pursuers are about to catch up...
Once Director Allie and the kids evacuate, we'll slip out of Mirage tonight too.==W== There's a secret tunnel in the mines.
Hold up. The captain's in an important meeting. You can't go in.
<size=50>How many times do I have to say it?! </size>The person in there with your captain is our partner!
Noya, Iris, Amber? What are you doing here?==W== Are Allie and the kids okay?
Don't worry.==W== We left the Lucky Oasis for Aunt Allie and the kids.==W== They're packing up and heading to Philae this afternoon.
We...==W== Well, we talked it over. We're staying to fight with you.
Are you sure about this?==W== What I'm about to do ...==W== will plunge the world into chaos.
Chaos or not, isn't it ultimately to protect us?==W== We are not letting you play the villain all by yourself.
We trust you, Boss. Whatever you choose to do,==W== we're with you.
Hmph. Respect their choice.==W== Besides, how can you be so sure that our plan will plunge the world into chaos?
Phew. Stellaroids cleared, and we found a Wishing Box.==W== Your turn, Boss.
You need a break, ==PLAYER_NAME==. You look exhausted.
I'm fine. I can push through.==W== We don't have enough Scepters of Death yet.
Ten days ago, after the Daisy Orphanage and White Cat Troupe evacuated,==RT==we slipped out of Mirage overnight.
Maybe the desert was too big, or maybe we got lucky… We didn't run into==RT==anyone the whole way out. Not even Angie or the Salvation Committee.
Later, Allie called after making it safely to Philae. She mentioned finding a kid==RT==in blue who passed out from thirst in the desert...
The kid told her about a massive army with red eyes roaming the dunes.==RT==They seemed to be hunting someone.
Ever since, we've been scaling Monoliths in the Wilds one after another,==RT==collecting Scepters of Death.
I taught everyone the wishing prayer, and made soul pacts with all the==RT==Desert Scorpions except Hazana...
But for whatever reason, their success rate was abysmal. To avoid wasting==RT==the Wishing Boxes, I had to step up and handle most of the wishes.
The Throne helped keep my memories intact, but still, with every wish,==RT==I felt something else draining out of me...
Ooh. Looks identical to Angie's Scepter of Death.
You need to rest, Boss. We have enough Scepters.
Are you sure?==W== We only have sixty or seventy. That isn't even one per person.==W== We should grab more while we can—
Pfft...==W==<size=50> Hahaha!</size>==W== Hey, who said anything about us fighting the Salvation Committee ourselves?==W== I never said that.
Then what are we supposed to do...?
This world is full of people sick of the companies.==W== All we have to do is...
<size=50>Sell them the Scepters of Death==W== and let them unleash all that pent-up anger!</size>

strings.text: The memory reveals that Taffett is Allie. Noya, Iris, and Amber had all known Taffett and Narida years ago. Back then, a crisis brewed as the White Cat Troupe took the fall for murdering the Nova Empress...
==Off====RT==<margin-left=3em><align=left>==RT==We can't let anyone outside this room see or hear us.==RT==</align></margin>==RT==
==Off====RT==<margin-right=3em><align=right>Rest easy, Your Majesty. The corridor is completely clear.</align></margin>
==Off====RT==<margin-left=3em><align=left>They have waited years for this moment,==RT==and they won't let anything stand in their way.==RT==</align></margin>
==Off====RT==<margin-left=3em><align=left>Taffett,==RT==I need a favor. One last mission.</align></margin>
==Off====RT==<margin-left=3em><align=left>You won't need your guns for this one.==RT==</align></margin>
==Off====RT==<margin-left=3em><align=left>Go to this address. Someone will be waiting for you.==RT==</align></margin>
==Off====RT==<margin-left=3em><align=left>And I need you to protect...==RT==No. Not to protect them.==RT==</align></margin>
==Off====RT==<margin-left=3em><align=left>I want you to leave the White Cats behind.==RT==Start over, Taffett. Just live your life.==RT==</align></margin>
==Off====RT==<margin-right=3em><align=right>Leave the White Cats behind? Live my life?==RT==</align></margin>
==Off====RT==<margin-right=3em><align=right>With all due respect, Your Majesty... I do not understand.==RT==</align></margin>
==Off====RT==<margin-left=3em><align=left>You don't have to understand it right now.==RT==</align></margin>
==Off====RT==<size=100>Fate always puts things==RT==exactly where they belong.</size>
That was it, Narida. Our last conversation. She handed me this Artifact tape right before I slipped out of the palace.
Thanks for sharing this, Taffett.==W== But you should know... The Empress died shortly after you left.
Think back. Did you spot anything odd while you were there? Anyone acting strange? Give me anything.
White Cat Troupe, First Squad Captain
Nothing. I swept every inch of that palace myself. It was completely secure.
White Cat Troupe, Second Squad Captain
But...==W== Something isn't adding up.==W== Why are the new Empress and the Grace Imperium pushing a rumor==W== that she was murdered?
Murdered?!==W== Give me this investigation, Narida.==W== If someone actually killed her,==W== I'll carve them to pieces.

Reel it in, Taffett.==W== You always fly off the handle like this.==W== Look, based on my intel, the whole murder angle is a joke. Her Majesty had been sick for years.==W== She was already running out of time.
Besides, the new regime doesn't trust us anyway. They've handed the entire investigation over to the Dusk Arbiter. We're completely locked out.
The Dusk Arbiter? Please. All they do is chase shadows and scream "heretic."==W== They couldn't investigate a crime scene if their lives depended on it.==W== No, I'm looking into this.
Stand down, Taffett.==W== I know you're angry, but we have our orders.==W== As long as the White Cats serve the Empire, we do not go rogue. Are we clear?
Plus...==W== You still have a direct order from Her Majesty to carry out, don't you?==W==
Ugh... Why did I get stuck with babysitting duty...
Wh-Where did that baby come from?!==W== Seriously, why is she screaming like that?
I have absolutely no idea.==W== But Her Majesty ordered me to keep her safe.
Woke up twenty minutes ago: not tired.==W== Had milk ten minutes ago: not hungry.==W== Clean diaper.==W== By every logical metric, you have zero reason to cry.
I give up. This makes absolutely no sense.
Haha!==W== Crying is their job.==W== Here, let me try.
Shh, shh, it's okay, sweetie. I'm here for you.==W== Want to hear a song?
La la la la ... la la la...==W== Wow,==W== I really can't carry a tune.
What...==W== She was just bawling, and now she's fine?==W== That's incredible. How did you do that?
It's simple. Just do what the orphanage moms do.
After all...==W== When people are scared, they just want to be held.==W== Doesn't matter if you're a baby or an adult.
Hugs... They make you feel safe?==W== Only a weapon does that for me.
Sigh...==W== Only a battle addict like you would say that.
Wait...==W== The Empress's secret mission for you ...==W== was to take care of this kid?
Yeah.==W== I went to the address. Found an off-the-books safehouse,==W== and there she was, right in the middle of the room.
But why me?==W== You're the one who always wanted to work at the orphanage. This should be your job.
She knows all I've ever wanted is to fight for the White Cats. I have zero interest in kids.
Haha!==W== Look, she's reaching for you. She's even calling you "Mama."==W== You might hate it, but she clearly trusts you.
She was just screaming her head off.==W== Besides...==W== I don't want to be a mother. It's too much work.
She cries because she needs you.==W== She might be tiny, but she knows exactly what she wants.==W== Right, sweetie?
Besides, the Empress doesn't do things for no reason.==W== She recorded that message so you'd hold onto those words.
"I want you to leave the White Cats behind. Start over, Taffett. Just live your life..."
When has Her Majesty ever been wrong? There's a reason for this mission. We just don't see it yet.
Not to be disrespectful, but knowing her? Even her death might be part of some grand scheme.

Mom said we shouldn't open the door for strangers.
But I'm not a stranger! Your mom and I are really close.==W== And this is a huge deal—if I don't bring it to her, she might even lose her job!
Nope! We're not doing that! The door stays shut until Mom gets home, no matter who you are!
Ugh, you little brats are such a pain!==W== Step away from the door if you don't want to get hurt!
Whoa, she's losing it! She's totally losing it!==W== I knew she was a big meanie!
Heh heh heh, you thought this piece of junk door would stop me? You little pests have nowhere to run. I'm taking you all with me!

Hehe, fell for it! Look up!
Cough, cough!==W== What is this...==W== Flour?!
Oh ho—==W==now my feet are stuck to the floor.==W== You kids sure know a lot of tricks, but that's still not enough to stop me.

Ah, I see...==W== That's okay. Cooking just takes practice.

Ah...==W== Is it just because they get cake?==W== But if they want cake, they can make it anytime.

What's wrong with focusing on combat?
We White Cats have no names, no birthdays, no parents. Just codenames. Isn't that because—
The more you have to protect, the more weaknesses you have.
Haha, that's true...==W== But Taffett, haven't you noticed? You've changed.

What?==W== Narida, watch the kids. I'm hunting them down!

I think that was the real point of Her Majesty's final mission.

Taffett. From this moment on, don't let the kids call you "Mom."

So... This is targeting us? Why?
It's simple. The Dusk Arbiter finally concluded their investigation.==W== The Troupe is suspected of assassinating Her Majesty. We've been branded as "heretics."

strings.text: The Scepters of Death flood the cities, sparking a massive turf war between oppressed citizens, angry companies, and the Salvation Committee. Blaming herself, Angie puts herself behind bars...
I'm fine. The enchanted breastplate stopped the bullet, and the padding cushioned the blow. But ... the force still felt like a battering ram to the chest.
Impact aside, it stopped the bullet. That is a success. Can we mass-produce this for the Committee?
The Tyrant and the Desert Scorpions are bleeding our people dry with their hit-and-run tactics.

The energy cost is massive, and the effect is brief. Enchanting a full suit only buys you thirty minutes. Five casts will drain a Soul Stone completely. The cost-to-duration ratio makes it unviable for the field.
Plus, armor has gaps. One lucky shot in between the plates and you are dead. Trying to ward those weak points would burn an entire Soul Stone per cast.
An entire Soul Stone for thirty minutes? I'm no soldier, but blocking a standard magic gunshot shouldn't be that taxing.
It shouldn't. But magic guns and the Scepters of Death operate entirely differently.==W== A magic gun simply shapes magic energy into a projectile.
Experienced fighters sense that mana spike,==W== cast a quick ward,==W== and neutralize the hit.
Enchanted arrows work the same way.==W== You dispel the magic aura first,==W== then parry the wooden shaft.
Which brings us to the problem. The Scepter does not fire mana. It fires solid metal slugs.
There is no mana signature to track before impact,==W== and it outpaces any arrow in both speed and power.
Since we can't see the attacks coming,==W== we have to keep our shields on maximum mana output==W== constantly.
And we lack the time to refine the magic, or the logistics to forge better armor...
Heh. The Tyrant has us checkmated.
I owe you an apology, Lady Angie.==W== I didn't believe ==PLAYER_NAME== was the legendary Tyrant. I thought you were jumping to conclusions.
Up until now, I was only obeying the Grand Captain. I was going through the motions of helping you, nothing more.
So these recent battles changed your mind? You believe ==PLAYER_NAME== is the Tyrant now?
Casualties are expected in war. That is not what convinced me.
Flooding the cities with the Scepters of Death,==W== planting seeds of chaos across the continent...==W== Who else would orchestrate that but the Tyrant?
Is that how you see it? Then you've misjudged me, you've misjudged ==PLAYER_NAME==, and you completely misunderstand how this world would end.
The Tyrant brought chaos, yes. But ==SEX3== actions stray entirely from the prophecy.
Looking back, ==SEX== was never the world-ending Tyrant we thought.
The one responsible for shaping ==SEX4== into this ... is no one else but...
Meanwhile,==RT==at the Omnisky Aegis Business Department in Geminia.
That policyholder from earlier is back. His sister was rushed to an Eye of Grace hospital for heart palpitations and fainting. She needs surgery, and he expects us to cover the bills.
The Eye of Grace? Does he have any idea what they charge? We are not approving that. Deny the claim.
B-But we don't have a valid reason. Can we deny him outright?
Do I have to teach you everything? Did he submit a pre-approval request before letting them admit her? Is the surgery considered excessive treatment? Pick one and reject him.
He says she collapsed on the street and a passerby rushed her to the ER. He has all the diagnostic reports from the Eye of Grace. Everything checks out. If we deny the claim...
No means no. We hit our payout cap for the month. If we authorize a payout this massive, the Senate will breathe down our necks again...==W== Hand me her file.
... Perfect. There is our out. Reject his claim for breach of disclosure. Tell him he failed to report a pre-existing condition when he signed up.
Pre-existing condition? Sorry, but I don't think his sister has any medical history of...
You idiot, look right here. Does this or does this not say she once had a cavity?
I am sorry, sir. Because of an irregularity when you opened the policy, we cannot approve your claim.
Is that so... I am sorry to bother you. I will figure out another way to pay for the surgery.
Wait. Even though we can't approve the claim, please take this...==W== It's a little something from my own pocket. I hope your sister recovers soon.
I... Thank you! I can't believe there is someone this kind at Omnisky Aegis. I am glad I ran into you today. I will never forget this as long as I live!
Haha... Kind, yeah right. I'm a spineless coward doing my supervisor's dirty work.
Look at you, dipping into your own savings again.==W== You know privately assisting a canceled policyholder is a strict violation of company policy, right?
No, wait, it's a misunderstanding! Let me explain!
Relax, I'm messing with you. I already quit, remember? You don't have to worry about me snitching.

Oh, it's you. Don't scare me like that.==W== Ever since you quit, that garbage boss has been dumping all your unfinished work on me.==W== These clients clearly meet the payout conditions, but he forces me to deny their claims and cancel their policies every single day.
It kills me watching them walk away with nothing.==W== Anyway, why did you quit? You never told me.
Same exact crap you're dealing with now. He kept denying every claim, saying they did high-risk activities without prior approval.
But my entire client list was Trekkers. Was I supposed to make them file an application and sit around waiting for days every time they climbed a Monolith?
Eventually I realized it was total bullshit. I got pissed, marched up to protest, got the crap kicked out of me ... and was fired on the spot.
This whole company is rotten to the core...
Damn right. That bastard's a parasite.==W== He took the safety net meant for everyone and turned it into his personal piggy bank.
Footsteps... It's him! Quick, hide! He's been traveling with a whole squad of armed guards lately. If he catches you, you're dead meat!
Hide? I've been waiting for him. I came here today to settle the score once and for all.
Well, well. If it isn't the trash I fired the other day.==W== What's this? You even brought a little weapon. Here for revenge?
Hah! Revenge? Don't be silly. You took such great care of me. I'm just here to return the favor.
Is that right? Let's see you try. You think you can take on my entire escort by yourself?==W== Get her! Throw this loudmouth in the river to feed the fish!
C-Calm down! Don't do this, you're no match for the Imperial Knights!
Oh, I'm perfectly calm. But this is about to get messy. You'd better stand back.
What the—! Is that ... Scepter of Death?!==W== Oh crap, fall back! Retreat!
Guh... No way... I specifically prepared ...==W== a top-tier protection scroll... How did you...
A few days later.==RT==In the Trekker Association outside the Emor City.
Hey, miss! Wait up! You come here a lot?
Uh... Yeah. I only started coming around lately.
I'm Myrsha, from the desert. What's your name?
Sorry to pry, but I noticed you staring at the board forever. Can't find a good commission?
Yeah. Nobody wants a partner. Clients take one look at an average Trekker like me and pass.
I hear you. Standard leather armor, basic sword, fresh to the adventurer life. People size you up fast.
But hey, that's how it works everywhere in Nova.
That's why I've got the perfect weapon for you. Check this out! With this in your hands, clients will be lining up to hire you.
Is that ... a magic gun? I've never seen one shaped like that. But honestly, I suck at magic...
Oh, don't worry about that! This is no magic gun.==W== You ever hear of the Scepter of Death?
The Scepter of Death? That artifact they keep talking about on the news? I heard it's rare... The metal feels unlike anything I've ever touched.
Hehe, that's right! This is the newest Desert Scorpion product. The Scepter of Death 47.==W== Easy to use, easy to maintain. Even a kid like me can easily aim.
Only 99,999 Dorra. This Scepter came out of a Monolith yesterday. Brand new and all yours.
That price seems way too low for a rare Artifact.==W== Is this a scam?
Take it and try it out. If you like it, come back in a week and pay. If not, bring it back within seven days. No questions asked.
A Scepter of Death...! Hehe, the news calls you villains, but you Desert Scorpions are actually pretty sweet.
Alright, I'll borrow it then. Thanks!
Nah, it's not me! Thank Boss. ==SEX1== pulled all kinds of Scepters from the Wishing Box. We're cashing in big time ♪
But honestly, I expected more. I thought the Scepter of Death had some legendary power. Turns out it's just a handy tool.
That works in our favor. Once it's widespread, people will see it's not the apocalyptic weapon from the prophecies.
And once that happens, all those rumors about the Tyrant destroying the world will fall apart on their own.
Sell the weapon cheap or give it away, then make a profit on the ammo. Haha, Boss is a damn business genius.
Thanks to you, we Desert Scorpions can walk through Emor with our heads held high under the Boss Accord banner. I mean it. Thank you.
We look out for each other. We never would have escaped Angie's assault without your help.
Besides, the Scorpions have taken their fair share of hits lately too.
We aren't afraid of a few casualties to get what we want.
Here's the weird part, though. I heard the big companies are hunting Angie even harder now that the Scepters of Death are everywhere.
If these Scepters are what's pushing the workers to rebel, you'd think the Senate would be gunning for us instead of her.
Ha! They would love to get rid of us. But we're the only ones who know how to wish up more Scepters, so they can't afford to touch us.
Trace it all back and this whole mess is Angie's fault anyway. Coming after us would be a waste of time.
A few major companies have actually approached me in secret. They want to partner up and sell the Scepters of Death together.
I turned them down. Told them Boss Accord is too busy dodging the Salvation Committee to think about partnerships right now.
I'm sure they got the hint—deal with the Committee first, and then we talk business.
You're even getting outside companies to do your work. That's some terrifying strategy, Boss.
But ... are you sure about this? Flooding the market with these Scepters... I have a bad feeling. Word is a top executive at Omnisky Aegis has been murdered.
You worry too much. Those corporate suits had it coming. Besides, we're putting power in the hands of people who never had a way to fight back.
If you ask me, this is way healthier than the old days, when your worth was measured by your magic and your wallet.
I see where Myrsha's coming from, but Iris isn't wrong to worry.
Once we're done with the Salvation Committee, I need to rethink our distribution strategy for the Scepters of Death.
Breaking news! Heretic group Salvation Committee disbands!==W== Leader Angie apprehended by Knight Captain Greyhorn, awaits trial!
Meanwhile,==RT==in the Imperial Guard Prison, Ash District in Emor.
Drop the title, please. I'm just a prisoner you arrested ... awaiting my trial.
That's just Scarlet Sights sensationalizing. You disbanded the Salvation Committee yourself and walked in here to face trial voluntarily.
Heh, never mind the details. I made my mistakes, and now I have to face the consequences.
That voice... Serena? Is that you?!
You were on the hunting squad back then... Clara, right?
<size=52>It's Claire!</size>==W== Ugh... Forget it.==W== What are you doing here?
I misjudged ==PLAYER_NAME==. I believed ==SEX== was the Tyrant destined to destroy the world. I caused irreparable harm, and now I face judgment.
==PLAYER_NAME==? You mean the Boss. Small world.
This whole block is full of people ==SEX== took down.
The babbling mess next door is Feagin. Total scumbag who ran a child labor ring.
She couldn't stomach losing the company war. Got mixed up with Nocturn Eterna, made a Monolith wish beyond her control, and now she's ... this.
And those are Joseph and Lady Gray next to me. Joseph's whatever, but Lady Gray's scrap metal after Darcia squeezed every last bit of value out of her.
Tch... Shut your mouth, Claire.==W== When I get out of this hole, I'll collect—with interest.
Ah, Lady Angie, voice of the Grace Imperium. Retiring to a cell isn't the worst fate, but it does grow dull.==W== Care to help us old bones pass the time?
... I see. So this is where my journey ends.
