I doubt there's anyone left on Nova who actually believes I'm the legendary Tyrant.

And if I keep going,==W== there's Chitose's ==SEX11==,==W== Fuyuka's Master,==W== Nazuka's absolute most important person (her exact words),==W== Otoha's partner in crime, and more.==B====W== No wonder Noya jokes every time I hop in Loxy:
This ride can't fit that many people!
Time passes.==W== The Desert Scorpions and the White Cat Troupe bury the hatchet==W== and start mining a new crystal diamond vein together.
United Harvest Philae helps the people of Mirage grow valuable desert crops and buys the harvest.==W== With everyone working together, the former Edge of the World is thriving.
Allie moves the Daisy Orphanage back to Mirage.==W== She says the kids from White Cat and the Scorpions prefer the open desert over the skyscrapers of Philae.
With Mirage's population booming, busy parents keep asking Allie to watch their kids.==W== The Daisy Orphanage has basically turned into a daycare.
As for me,==W== I'm buried under company paperwork. I had to rope Mistique into being my personal chauffeur, flying me back and forth between Emor, Philae, and Mirage.
It's been a while==W== since I traveled with the New Star Guild.
Hehe, welcome to the reality of running a business<size=53>♪</size>==W== Not that I've ever been a boss myself★==W== But hey, once you retire, you'll have all the free time in the world.
Stop zoning out and hold tight!==W== We're flying straight to Mirage! ★
Wait!==W== You can't just floor it from the start!==W==<size=50> Waaaaaah—!</size>
==Off==I thought this peaceful routine would go on forever.
==Off==But what I had done finally brought a storm.
W-What?==W== A Trekker from outside the desert shot up the Eureka Bar with a Scepter of Death? And Benito was hit?
Yeah... She got a scratch. Nothing serious.==W== We have the Trekker detained,==W== but we have no idea where that Scepter came from.
Wasn't it one of the ones we sold?
That's the weird part.==W== First of all, it looks completely different. It's weaker than ours, and it has this strange attachment on the barrel. Barely makes a sound when fired.
Boss, I just heard from Albedo. She wants us in Emor. Says it's urgent.
Leaving already, Boss?==W== Stay for dinner with the kids. They've been looking forward to it.
I'm sorry, Allie. Something urgent came up. I have to skip dinner.
If you can't stay, at least take some bread for the road.==W== You have to eat properly no matter how busy you are, you hear me?
I hear you.==W== Do me a favor and tell everyone at the New Star Guild I'll be back soon. Tell them not to worry.
But after hearing the truth from Albedo... I finally understood==RT==the gravity of the situation. It went far deeper than I imagined.
Yes. After you flooded the market with the Scepters of Death, the corporate Senators felt threatened. They immediately formed teams to crack the wishing prayers.
But the success rate of their reverse-engineered prayers was too low, and the toll on the wishers was too high. It never went anywhere.
Then, two months ago, the prison holding Angie was attacked. She escaped in the mass breakout. Since then, a mysterious group has appeared, flooding the black market with new Scepters.
You're saying...==W== Angie rebuilt the Salvation Committee, perfected the prayer, and made the wishes work?
There is more.==W== Willow, take it from here.

Dozens of guilds have gone dark recently. I suspect they were abducted and forced to make wishes. That only covers the ones we know about. We don't track guilds missing for under a month, so the actual number could be much bigger.
Even if you're looking our way, you won't find a thing. We don't touch jobs with zero payoff.
Yeah, this is on you for not watching your prisoners.
Hazana, Myrsha, drop it.==W== I'm the one who started the Scepter mess.==W== This one is on me.
We are not blaming anyone. On the contrary...==W== We invite Boss here today to entrust you with the investigation.
Naturally, Grace Imperium will back you fully.==W== Greyhorn?
She will lead her team in support, with all expenses covered by us.==W== If you need anything else, every resource Grace Imperium has is yours to command.
Greyhorn, are they at it again outside?
Yeah.==W== Two gangs are tearing up the streets with Scepters of Death. No one dares to step outside after dark anymore.
We need to hold out for three more days.==W== We've identified the corporate Senators funding the smuggling ring.==W== They're holding a gathering on Snowish Eve. We'll take them all down at once.
We also found a familiar name on the guest list.==W== Angie. We've been tracking her for a year, and she's going to be there.
Good work, Greyhorn.==W== Where are Hazana and Myrsha?
We fell for a decoy earlier. The Scorpions are split up between Port Goldfinch and Geminia.
Backup from the Dusk Arbiter and Sentinel of Dawn just left Emor. Neither squad will make it in time.
We're short-handed.==W== Can you call in the local Imperial Guard?
I'm sorry.==W== Our casualties this past year have been too severe... The Grand Captain ordered a full withdrawal from the operation.
The Imperial Guard is a company that puts Dorra first.==W== But there are things our knights care about more than money.
You've been crossing the continent to keep the peace.==W== Until every last criminal is brought to justice, I am personally at your command.
It's what the Guard was founded to do. And I need to atone for my mistakes.
Mistakes?==W== I didn't think a by-the-book knight like you ever messed up.
I did.==W== I followed the Grand Captain's orders and helped Angie hunt you down.
Watching you peddle Scepters of Death back then,==RT==I even suspected that you were really the legendary Tyrant. But...
Angie set me straight. She said I didn't understand you, or how this world would end.
At the time, her words made no sense to me.==W== But after working alongside you, I think I finally get it.
You and Angie are the same.==W== Both of you would risk everything for this world, for other people...
... and do things everyone else finds insane. Thankless. Even heretical.
The same, huh.==W== Maybe you're right. I'm doing exactly what she did. The only difference is that we swapped sides.
I know it's too late. But I still wish I'd found another way to stop her, instead of spreading those Scepters...
I kept my friends safe. Mirage even prospered from it. But that came at a price, and everyone else paid it.==W== I'm no different from you, Greyhorn. We're both trying to fix our mistakes.
... Sorry, let's focus.==W== We're completely understaffed right now. Got any tactical ideas?
I wouldn't worry about that. As luck would have it, your friends are already here.
Come on, ==PLAYER_NAME==, don't leave us hanging! You're going to settle this with Angie without us? How could you?
Noya?!==W== Iris and Amber are here too?==W== How did you find this place...?
Easy.==W== We pinpointed the city with the heaviest Scepter trafficking. Noya's gut feeling narrowed the search grid.==W== Amber scouted the rest.
You are the best...==W== But it's not just Angie today.==W== We're up against an entire mob packing Scepters of Death.
We figured.==W== We've been perfecting heavy-duty defensive spells for this exact moment. Even Scepter bullets won't get through.
It'll hurt. But we won't die.
Oh! I almost forgot!==W== We need a tiny favor from you.
You have to keep it a secret from Aunt Allie...==W== I mean, Mom... That we're fighting alongside you today. She cannot find out.
Hey, Allie?==W== I met up with Noya and the others. Don't worry, they're sticking to rear logistics.==W== They're perfectly safe out of harm's way.
Huh? Wait... What was that noise?==W== It sounded like a Scepter of Death firing...
Ah, no, definitely not!==W== We're in Cangwu. The new year is around the corner, those are Loong firecrackers!
Thank goodness...==W== Boss, could I ask you for a favor?
Of course. If it's something I can do, name it.
Thank you.==W== Please ...==W== bring those kids back to me safe and sound.
Boss,==W== they converted the inside of that house up ahead into a massive warehouse.==W== The Senators and Angie are holding their meeting inside.
Got it.==W== Here's the plan. Greyhorn, take your team and hit the front doors to draw their fire.==W== The New Star Guild and I will use the rooftops to flank them.==W==
Is everyone ready?==W==<size=50> Let's move out!</size>
Whoa, ==PLAYER_NAME==, you're way faster on your feet now!
My swordplay leveled up too. I practice that technique you taught me every single day. I'm up to a thousand swings a day now.
This trip was well worth the trouble. To think we'd finally gaze upon Lady Angie in the flesh.
I know, I was an absolute nervous wreck coming here. I thought that dreadful Boss or the Imperial Guard might track us down...==W== But attending this gathering was definitely the right move.
Besides, even if things go south, with Lady Angie running the show, what is there to worry about?
Watch your tongue, madam.==W== The Imperial Guard has recalled its forces. Commander Greyhorn is acting entirely on her own.==W==
Oh? Does the Imperial Guard want a cut of the Scepter trade too?
Hmph. We have zero interest in selling them.==W== We simply want one sample from every new batch to field test our bulletproof armor.
Do we have a deal, Lady Angie?==W== Agree to this, and the Imperial Guard will gladly make things convenient for everyone in this room...
Heh. Let's save the side deals for later. I called you all here to map out our direction for the coming year.
Ahem. First order of business.==W== To set up a proper front company for Scepter sales, we first need a Seal of Grace.
Heh! Now you're talking! I love a guy who gets straight to the point!
Going corporate means moving serious volume. Mr. Colston, can your people keep up with the Trekker supply?
Relax. I can drag in as many Trekkers as you need. Once the wishing wipes their memories, we'll dump them in the labor camps.
Hmph. With a monopoly on Scepters and the Guard's new armor, those peasants won't stand a chance. No more dirty sneak attacks from the rabble.
Once that happens, United Harvest HQ can raise a new army and take back control of United Harvest Philae.
I want to see Matilda on her knees, begging for my forgiveness!
Lady Angie, how are you allocating next quarter's supply?==W== The New Orelian faction can move ten thousand, no, twenty thousand units!
Unbelievable... Who is interrupting us at a time like this? Didn't I order to have this place locked down?
Sorry for the wait! Black Cat Pizza delivery here<size=53>♪</size>!==W== Your ten jumbo pineapple and sausage pizzas have arrived! Better eat up before they get cold!
Pizza? Heh! Hot pizza in this freezing weather? You guys sure know how to host a meeting!
Pineapple and sausage on a pizza?! Ugh, what kind of blasphemous abomination is this?!
<size=50>Imperial Guard!</size>==W== Hands on your heads and get on the ground! Nobody move!
You rely too much on those Scepters! Your backs are wide open!
Damn it, I can't pull it!
Boss, suspects secured.==W== But Angie seems off.
Angie hasn't said a word since the meeting started.
She's not Angie. She's just dressed up like her... And she's completely out of it?!
Heh...==W== Bwahahahaha!==W== You actually thought Angie was calling the shots? That she was the one running our Scepter trade?
You idiots. Brainless trash.==W== I figured out the Scepter's prayer myself! I've finally proven it!==W==<size=50> My research is as good as anyone's!</size>

As for the Angie you were waiting for, we did ask her to join.==W== But she insisted on investigating the Monoliths alone and vanished the day she broke out.==W== Heh. She's probably dead in some Monolith by now. So don't blame us for using her name.
You despicable scum...==W== Do human lives mean nothing to you?
Hehehe... Can you really afford to worry about others right now?
Boss. On the table. A phone. It's on a call.
<color=#3faeae>Lady Gray</color>. Does that name ring a bell, Boss?
You played well in Philae. I admit that.==W== But I only lost because Darcia let blind devotion cloud her judgment.
If she hadn't interfered, there wouldn't be enough of you left to bury.
The Scepter trade.==W== You've been running it this whole time?
Hah. Got it in one.==W== The New Orelian crew broke Angie out hoping she'd take the business. She turned her nose up at it.==W== So I stepped up.
Take a look around you, Boss.
Boss, these crates are packed with dark gray powder. It's the explosive from the Scepter rounds!
They rigged the main gates with explosive arrays. Every exit is completely sealed...==W== We walked right into a trap.
Lady Gray, your investors are still in here! Are you leaving them to die?
You can't spring a trap without bait.
Lady Gray! What is the meaning of this?! You played us too?!
Oh, poor Joseph... Please understand.==W== I wouldn't do this if I had a choice.==W== But rest easy. I will take excellent care of your family.
Boss, we found an emergency hatch! This way, move!
They might have an ambush waiting outside. Watch your backs!
Let me take point. My armor is bulletproof.==W== Even if I catch a few rounds—
Wait. Are... Are these shields? Why are they stacked up here?

strings.text: Narida and Taffett survived the battle. In the final moments of the memory, the children celebrated Taffett's birthday together. Taffett lost her memories as planned and became Allie, while Narida departed...
Taffett, stay awake. Can you hear me? Say something!
We're almost at the clinic. It's a scratch, they can patch you up.==W== Don't you dare close your eyes!
No... No doctors. Take me home.
Are you insane?! You're going to die!
There's medicine in the basement, from Her Majesty. Works better than any clinic...==W== I can handle it.
... Are you refusing a doctor because you're afraid they'll find out you're a White Cat?
This is no time to worry about that!
No... It's not ... about the White Cats...
I promised them ... I'd be back before dawn. I can't break that promise.
I want them ... to believe ... this world isn't completely hopeless.
... Fine, fine. You're absolutely sure home is enough?==W== Then you better patch yourself up. If you die on me, I am never forgiving you.==W== Not even a scar, got it?
Heh...==W== Strict even with the wounded.==W== You were born to be ...==W== the captain of the White Cats.
Hey...==W== Drop me at the door. And ...==W== take my guns, please.
Taffett, you need something to defend yourself.
I don't need anything...==W== At least ...==W== not in front of ...==W== the kids.
They don't know ...==W== who I am...==W== And since they don't,==W== they never need to...
Besides...==W== I don't want them to see me holding bloodstained weapons.
I wouldn't be too sure. They're smart. Maybe they already...
Even so...==W== I won't drag them into our world.==W== Let this pointless fighting stay in the past. It ends with us.
Ha! Look how much you've changed, Taffett.
Of course. I'm growing too...==W== Even if my housekeeping is a lost cause...==W== Anyway...==W== Help me keep this a secret...==W== You can do that, right?
You play dirty...==W== How can I say no when you're in this state?
Alright, we're here.==W== I'll take the gun and cause a scene in the next district. Get some rest.==W== See you tomorrow, Taffett.==W==
Wh-What do we do? You're bleeding... It won't stop!
Cough... Hey, hush now. No tears... I'm okay. I had a clumsy fall at work, got a little scrape... Some medicine and sleep, and I'll be good as new...
Through blurred eyes, Taffett watched the small figure run off—the child entrusted to her by Her Majesty.
First one child. Then another. Then one more.==W== She thought she had merely taken in a few lost souls.==W== In truth, she was the one who had been taken in.
The one who was truly saved ... was me.
Mom! I got the medicine. Here, take it.
Mom! I got the medicine. Quick, take it!
Thank you... Ah... Iris, you called me...
Thank you... But I told you… Not to call me "Mom"…
No! I'm not listening to you! Because…!
Mom, I'm sorry! We were awful last night. We didn't mean what we said. You are our mom. We were just... We...
I'm sorry I said awful things last night...! But to me, mom is mom! Last night, we were just...
We wanted to be with you.
Because yesterday was your birthday, Mom.
Yes! Because yesterday was your birthday!
My ... birthday... All that time you spent preparing ... was for me?
Ah... Haha... Thank you. I had no idea...
Ah... Haha... Thank you. I never would have imagined…
But ... can you really accept a mom like me? I ... might be a liar...
You're not! You're our mom. You aren't a liar!
You're not! You're our mom, our only mom!
... Hmm... Heh... So that's how you feel. But I... I'm sorry. I even told you not to call me Mom... Cough...
... Hmm... Heh... So that's how you feel... But I... I'm sorry. I even told you not to call me Mom... Cough...
I was ... so focused on finishing Her Majesty's mission for me... I never thought about what you needed... All you ever wanted ... was a real home.
I was ... so focused on finishing Her Majesty's mission for me... I never thought about what you needed... All you ever wanted ... was a real home…
E-Even though it might be late to say it... Until you find your real mom and dad... W-would you let me be your mom?
Th-then… Even though it might be late to say it... Until you find your real mom and dad... W-would you let me be your mom?
That's not right. Mom is mom. You are our real mom, the only one.
Amber's right! You're our one and only mom!
No matter what others say, you're our one and only mom!
So please don't take any more dangerous jobs. If we need money, we'll figure it out together.
So please don't take any more dangerous jobs. If we need money, we'll figure it out together!
Alright... I promise... I won't take any more dangerous jobs that scare you...
Alright... I promise... I won't take any more dangerous jobs that make you worried...
We'll make this place bigger... Bring in all the homeless kids from Ash District... Make them family... We'll build a real home together.
We'll make this place bigger... Bring in all the homeless kids from Ash District... We'll build a real home and make them family…
But if there are more kids, won't that be too hard on you, Mom?
Hehe... Maybe it will. But this is something ... I h-have to do.
One day... You'll find your own dreams and have the courage to chase them...
And when that day comes... If I can hold your hand and give you a little push when you need it... Then all this hard work will be worth it.
Because I'm your mom... All of yours.
Yeah! So you gotta get better soon, Mom!
We'll protect you until you get better.
Then I'm counting on you, my little bodyguards... Oh, but don't call me Mom in front of other people yet, okay?
Huh? Why not? Is it because ... you still don't want to...
Huh? Why not? You said you'll be our mom…
No, that's not it at all. There are things I can't reveal to you right now... But everything I do is to keep you safe. Okay?
There are things I can't tell you right now... But everything I do is to keep you safe. Therefore…
Once I handle everything... You can call me Mom anywhere you want, even out in public.
So for now... Let's just make it our little secret. Deal?
Pinky swear, a promise that never breaks!
Taffett holds the children's hands and closes her eyes.
Sunlight breaks over the edge of the city. The dawn of a new family is here.
But ... only twenty candles? Is that enough?
Mom! Narida told me a secret!==W== If you blow out all the candles in one big whoosh, you get to make a wish!
A wish?==W== I'll give it a try.
I hope all of you grow up healthy and happy.==W== And I hope we can all stay here together forever.==W== Ah... I have a lot of wishes.==W== Am I being greedy?
Hey, don't say it out loud! It doesn't matter how many you have. If you speak them, they won't come true!
Oh, is that how it works? Hehe.==W== Well, saying them out loud means we can all pitch in. I'd rather trust ourselves than the gods.
Then what's the point of wishing?==W== Anyway, the candles are out.==W== Time for cake!
Whoa, no fair!==W== I wanted to cut it! I call dibs on the second slice!
Easy, easy. Don't fight over it. There's plenty to go around.
Hey, Taffett. Got a second? Come outside, I need to talk.
Beautiful day out.==W== You've done something incredible here, you know. Built an orphanage in a year and kept it running strong.
I owe it to you. We'd be sunk if you hadn't shown me how to wish at the Monolith.==W== Trading my memories for Artifacts paid off—we're fine on Dorra for now.
You know, writing everything important in a notebook and reading it after every Monolith trip? That's genius.==W== You're one hell of a Trekker.
One hell of a ... Trekker, huh...
And ...==W== you were my best friend, weren't you, Miss Narida?==W== I only found that out the other day when I checked my notes.
Haha. Yeah. We were best friends.
Seeing you like this puts my mind at ease. Guess our little workaround for the memory extraction spell did the job.
... Time for me to make my own move.
Hey, that signed red Soul Stone in the basement. Can I have it?
The red Soul Stone...==W== Think I know the one.==W== Take it. I've got spares.
Thanks.==W== I'm heading out now, Taffett.
... Miss Narida?==W== Are you going somewhere far?
Huh? What makes you ask that?
You always say <color=#3faeae>you'll see me later</color>.==W== This time you said <color=#3faeae>you were heading out</color>. That's what tipped me off...
Ahaha...==W== You spot even the smallest change. That's my partner.
If fate allows, we'll meet again.
... I get it. You really are leaving.==W== Then before you go, could you do me one last favor?
Of course. I took your Soul Stone. I owe you.
Thank you. I want you to ...==W== give me a new name.==W== I don't think Taffett fits me anymore.
So ...==W== I want something plain. The plainer the better...==W== Is that too much to ask?
A name...==W== That's a huge deal. You sure you want someone like me making that call?
Don't say "someone like me" like that.==W== You know me better than anyone in the world. You're my best friend, aren't you?
Heh heh <size=53>♪</size>==W== When you put it like that, I can't say no.==W== Let's see...==W== How about Allie?
Al... Allie.==W== That's beautiful. Is there a story behind it?
Nope. Popped into my head. It's as common as they come, like you asked.==W== So it's settled!
Alright, I'm heading out.==W== Allie... No matter what comes next, keep moving forward.
You...==W== Ah, never mind.==W== It's better this way.
Mom, the cake's ready!==W== Come eat!
You're the star today, Mom!==W== I saved the strawberry piece for you.
Shh, you two! We're in public. Don't shout "Mom" like that. What if someone hears?
Alright, alright, Iris.==W== Ease up a little.
Wow, this cake is amazing.==W== Noya, your baking puts Mom's to shame!
... It's better this way.==W== To protect those kids' futures...==W== We adults need to bury the past.
Alright,==W== White Cat Troupe... Time for our ...==W== final curtain call.

Shh, you two! We're in public. Don't shout "Mom" like that. What if someone hears?
Alright, alright, Iris.==W== Ease up a little.
Wow, this cake is amazing.==W== Noya, your baking puts Mom's to shame!
... It's better this way.==W== To protect those kids' futures...==W== We adults need to bury the past.
Alright,==W== White Cat Troupe... Time for our ...==W== final curtain call.

strings.text: Joseph's new weapon catches you off guard, ending your life. The New Star Guild perishes, and Allie blames herself for failing to protect her children. Consumed by grief, Allie leaves Mirage alone for vengeance...
Welcome back. You sparked a revolution in Nova with the Scepters of Death.
I created chaos to protect my people, only to fail them miserably...
Hehe. Change doesn't mean progress. Nova sinking into chaos is still a revolution.
Even ordinary folks with no magic can kill the high-and-mighty guarded by mages. That change isn't necessarily bad.
But the chaos you unleashed will eventually turn on you.
And judging by history, victory ultimately goes to whoever controls the resources. Still, it'd be nice if things could change, even just a little.
The weapon that killed me ... seemed to be some kind of landmine.
Mm. It wasn't something you wished into being, but a brand-new Scepter of Death whose prayer was invented by Joseph.
It's incredibly powerful. Even with bulletproof armor, Greyhorn was still blown in half.
Did Noya and the others ... make it?
You should see the recordings for yourself. The mirrors are full.
Yeah? Want seconds? There's plenty of meat and veggies left.
Mom's not looking. I'm making a run for it.
No, no, no! I'm not eating my greens!
You can't be a Trekker like your big sisters if you skip your greens.
That's a lie! Trekkers need to be strong, and you get strong by eating meat!
The Wilds don't care if you're picky. When supplies run out,==RT==you eat whatever monsters you catch or roots you dig up.
Those sisters you look up to? They've had to eat tree bark.
Ew, they have...?==W== But greens taste bitter...
Hmm. I've heard kids' taste buds are different than the adults'. Some greens do taste bitter to you.
Tell you what. I'll cook them better next time. But today, my brave little Trekker needs to pretend these greens are Stellaroids and wipe them out.
Do that, and everyone gets a piece of candy.
Candy! Got it. I'm a brave Trekker...
Come in and sit. Any news from the New Star Guild or Boss?
These are all that's left of them...
Keep it down. You'll wake Aunt Allie.
You don't want to wake who up?
Found a note in the kitchen too... Where are you off to?
==SEX1== is out there alone. Probably not eating or sleeping right.
Help with the investigation? Aren't the Desert Scorpions on that?
I don't think Boss will tell you where ==SEX== is.
Boss knows the danger. ==SEX1== has been protecting us since teaming up with the Desert Scorpions.
But we want to protect ==SEX4== too.
Thought I'd stop you?==W== The kids I raised would never abandon a friend.
Oh, now I'm Mom.==W== Well, as your mother, I have one request.
Bring Boss home so we can finish that dinner. And once you find ==SEX4==, call me so I know you're safe.
Why... Why didn't I go with them...?
Director Allie, it's not your fault. You couldn't have left.
Was it Angie? The one who was after Boss?
Not her. Angie had no part in the Scepter trade.==RT==She vanished in the Monolith over a year ago.
It was a former United Harvest employee called Lady Gray.
She committed a string of crimes in Philae, and was locked up after the Darcia incident.
The New Star Guild and Boss had already beaten her once. But we never expected...
... she'd be desperate enough to betray her own employers to kill Boss.
She used them as bait, deliberately leaked the location==RT==of a secret meeting between the Senators...
... and tricked Boss into thinking it was the perfect chance to take them all out.
But the warehouse was rigged. It was packed with explosives.
By the time we got there... We found nothing but ... this.
Lady Gray probably took Amber and Noya's weapons as trophies. They all died in the fire. Boss was with them.
Director Allie, I'm so sorry for your loss... I'll leave you be.
I am not the director anymore.
A mother ... to every child in this orphanage.
<color=#bd3059><size=75>Why them? And Boss... Why did this have to happen?!
<color=#bd3059><size=75>Now tell me. Tell me where that animal is!
Lady Gray took her dead employers' money and hired the Imperial Guard as her personal escort. You yourself...
I am not asking. Nor am I begging.
I won't drag your people into this. I am going to avenge my children with my own hands!
Be good and listen to Kasimira and Chaton, okay? Mom has to take a trip outside the desert. I have something important to take care of.
Director Allie... Please reconsider. If we take over the orphanage...
Some of White Cat's kids live here. I know you'll keep them safe. You've kept peace in Mirage, haven't you?
Alright. We will be here waiting for your return. All of us.
<size=47>I am just fulfilling a mother's duty.
From that day on, the Senators' nightmares bore a new name:
One by one, everyone who conspired against the Boss==RT==and doomed the New Star Guild died.
No mercy. No trial. Only the footsteps of death in the dark.==RT==She was a silent cataclysm, repaying every blood debt in full.
Soon, only one name remains on Allie's list: Lady Gray.
Desperate to survive, the obscenely wealthy Lady Gray hired==RT==the finest protection the Imperial Guard could offer,==RT==booking an entire hotel for their knights.
<color=#bd3059><size=70>It is the tightest, most expensive protection==RT==money could buy on Nova.
Watch out! The Dark-Footed Cat is here!
==Off==<size=70>Only one woman,==RT==whose world had already lost all its normal color.
Hold steady! She's only one woman!
Mom, look! We caught a huge boar in the forest today!
The slingshot you made works great.
Iris froze it with a Shwoooosh, and then Amber and I charged in and knocked it down with a Baaang!
I-It's not a big deal... Hehe... It was Noya who saved the day in the end.
Because she carried that massive boar back all on her own!
Hehe, easy now.==W== I'll get dinner started. Just wait a little longer~
(This isn't like that duel back then...)
(What we're facing right now ... is a war.)
Because... Butchering a boar this size is no small task...
What the hell is she talking about?!
Hang it up to drain the blood first... Then slit it open down the belly...
And the tusks ... make for wonderful crafting materials.
Wow, you're so strong, Mom! I couldn't even dent them with my sword...
Heh, I'm your mom after all. A boar this size... Its hide is tough like armor. I can use them to make you some gear.
Spread out! Nobody engage but me!
I'll cover you with magic, Captain!
Hey, Amber. The soup still needs time to simmer. Otherwise, it'll upset your stomach.
Mom, if the soup's going to take forever, let's grill some meat! I'm craving that!
Grilled meat? Why not.==W== Wild boar tastes amazing on the grill. You'll have to help me keep an eye on it, though, make sure it doesn't burn.
Primal flames,==W== surge forth and incinerate my foe!
Found it...==W== This cut is absolutely perfect for grilling.
<size=50>Aaaagh!</size>==W== It burns!<size=30> My armor... It's melting!</size>
Oh my... A little overdone. I was wondering why I smelled something burning... Mom was so careless.
So much meat left...==W== Gotta prep it fresh. The kids are waiting…
But you're missing her and roasting our own people...
I can't listen to another knight burn alive.
Hehe, just watch the heat and it won't burn.
Get to the Captain. I'll buy us time.
Tranquil waters,==W== rise as mist and blind her!
Wait! She's not even looking at me!
She stopped my hardest strike ... with just her left hand...
I can hold her off. Captain, get out of here!
You're the only one who can still make it... We can't run anymore.
It doesn't matter if we die... As long as you live... The unit can rebuild.
Just set this dish on the table ... and...
Our contract was to protect the client. For the honor of the Imperial Guard, we had to fulfill it.
But it's over... We surrender. As Commander, I take full responsibility.
My hands, my eyes, my legs, my life... Take whatever you want.
... I took on this contract, and I brought you here. We've lost enough people today.
You have people you want to protect, too?
Yes, I do... My people get to live, right?
But Captain, what about the hefty penalty? And what are we going to tell the company?
You're finally back! Well? Is that madwoman dead?
The contract is terminated. Here's your advance and the penalty fee.
What is this? Are you out of your mind? I'm not terminating the contract! Keep your Dorra. I want you to protect me!
I paid for my safety! I paid you to die for me, not to shove a piece of paper in my face. Where's the Imperial Guard's honor?
Honor? I heard you once used your own employers as bait, then stole everything they owned.
But here I am, returning your advance and paying the penalty. I'd say I'm upholding the Guard's honor just fine.
Get back here! This is an order!
The Imperial Guard doesn't take your orders anymore.
I know... I know you're here because of the New Star Guild.
Look, I was only after the Boss! I never meant to hurt them. It was an accident! A complete accident!
W-Wait... You want these, right? I paid a fortune to fix them!
Here, take their weapons! I swear, I've prayed to the God of Grace for them every single day since it happened. Let me live, and I'll give you anything. Dorra, Artifacts, intel...
<r=My... My tongue...>Cough... Cough...</r>==W== <r=N-No...>Ahh</r>...==W== Ugh, <r=She won't listen to a word...>ugh</r>...
You will never use that mouth to spin cheap lies and play people for fools.
And you will never use those hands to toy with the lives of others.
Since you clawed your way to the top by crushing everyone in your path...
==Off==<size=80>From now on, enjoy being a maggot...
_NOT_IN_LOG_==Off==<size=95>... and crawl your way through the dirt.
==Off==<size=95><color=#bd3059>... and crawl your way through the dirt.
Alright.==W== Did everyone get enough to eat?
Well, since you're full... Go brush your teeth and get ready for bed.
We played so much today. I'm sleepy...
Yeah, and cooking together took forever. It got late so fast...
I met these wonderful children once...
All I wanted was to be someone they could rely on. Someone they would love...
I mimicked the adults around me and learned how to care for them, how to protect them, how to be a mother...
==Off==<color=#bd3059><size=80>You knew the danger. But you let them go.
==Off==<color=#bd3059><size=80>If only you had gone with them to help Boss...
I never liked that name...==W== But no matter what, it was ... our home.
None of us knew what our real parents looked like. But in there, I was their mother.
I gave them everything I had. Every bit of love I could offer...
I prayed they would never walk my path. Never end up like me...
I wanted them to grow up safe. Carefree and innocent, holding onto their dreams...
What choices would they make when they grew up? What kind of adults would they become?
I had no idea, of course.
Because that was their future... Theirs alone.
Why...? Why my girls? How did it all go so wrong...?
You know exactly why. It is all your fault...
My fault? No... No, it isn't. It isn't my fault...
It isn't! Th-They were just here... Right beside me... Laughing...

==Off==<color=#bd3059><size=70>This ...</size>==RT==<size=75> is all your fault.</size>　　　　　<size=45>If you didn't took them...</size>==RT==<size=90> is all your fault.</size>==RT==<size=40>Then they will not...</size>==RT==<size=45>You know that, don't you?</size>

_NOT_IN_LOG_==Off==<color=#bd3059><size=70>All of this...</size>==RT==<size=75>All of this</size>　　　　　<size=45>All of this...</size>==RT==<size=90>All of this</size>==RT==<size=40>All of this...</size>==RT==<size=45>All of this</size>
It's already late. Be good and go to bed now.
A dream... Right, this is only a bad dream...
That's it. It has to be a nightmare!
I haven't woken up yet. That's all.
==Off==<size=68><color=#555559>Haha... Once I wake up,==RT==everything will go back to normal...
==Off==<size=68><color=#555559>They will run into my arms,==RT==laughing and playing like they always do...
Ah... If it's just a dream, there's no rush... Let's sing a song...
I'll sing that one... The lullaby I always sang to them when they were little.
If I keep singing... I'll wake up...
Don't be afraid, my darlings. Don't be afraid...
Mom chased all the bad guys away...
So come home... Come home with Mom.
Come, come here... Mom will never let you face the scary world alone again.
Girls... Where are you going? Come back...
This time ... I'll protect you all. I promise.
That is what happened after you died.
That mother turned into a demon the moment she learned her children died.
I suppose that is also a mother's love.
You only used the Monolith's Artifact to protect yourself.
You learned from Darcia. You kept the Desert Scorpions in check, and even convinced them to stop selling the Scepters of Death.
But some power can't be put down once you pick it up.
And you didn't abuse the Scepters of Death. Honestly, I'm surprised you stopped on your own.
But what you've started... No one could predict the consequence that follows.
I understand. The moment I started spreading the Scepters of Death to protect myself, there was no way the Novians would ever give up a weapon this convenient.
Anyone with the means would want a Scepter of Death, even if it were only for self-defense.
The best solution for the individual turned out to be the worst possible outcome for Nova.
I thought I had it all under control. Instead, I got my friends killed, broke Allie, and set Nova on fire.
Vita, open the door.==W== I am going to change everything.
Made your choice, Boss?==W== Desert Scorpions fear absolutely nothing. Provided you can wish that Artifact into existence for us.
Taking on the Salvation Committee? Not a problem for us. Out here in the desert, scorpions don't have natural predators.
I appreciate the offer,==W== but I won't wish for the Scepters of Death again. Sorry, Hazana.

I thought I had it all under control. Instead, I got my friends killed, broke Allie, and set Nova on fire.
Vita, open the door.==W== I am going to change everything.
Made your choice, Boss?==W== Desert Scorpions fear absolutely nothing. Provided you can wish that Artifact into existence for us.
Taking on the Salvation Committee? Not a problem for us. Out here in the desert, scorpions don't have natural predators.
I appreciate the offer,==W== but I won't wish for the Scepters of Death again. Sorry, Hazana.

strings.text: You tell the crew what was in the memory. Now knowing Allie is Taffett, you set out to find White Cat's secret room. After trekking through a mine crawling with Desert Scorpions, you find Hazana guarding the door...
Right. Allie traded her soul with me last night so I could help her recover the memories the Monolith took.
I asked Vita for a trial of the Monolith Melody,==W== and we fell asleep right here.==W==
But ... that dream was long. Even longer than Iris's.
So Allie is the "Taffett" Kasimira's looking for...==W==
She erased her own memories and lived a completely different life to stay with those kids...==W== Who would have imagined?
But then...==W== Is this woman sleeping next to me the mother of the orphanage, or a White Cat soldier?
Morning, Vita.==W== You don't usually greet me. Something's up?
Yes. There is something I wish to discuss with you in private, Tyrant.
Oh, back in your white room again. You seem to like this place.
Not particularly. It is simply empty, which saves on processing power. I can simulate a different environment if you prefer. Shall I?
No, it's fine.==W== What did you want to discuss?
Last night, I gave you another trial of the Monolith Melody. You and Miss Allie dreamed her lost memories. Because the trial includes a memory wipe, she will forget everything when she wakes.
But your magic immunity cancels the wipe. You will remember everything.
You might be wondering: if you are immune to magic, how did you dream those memories at all? Isn't the dream itself magic?
Simple. The Monolith Melody isn't magic. It is a special power.
Wait, you knew?==W== I thought I was the only one==W== who figured out I'd keep the memories.
You underestimate me. As your Priest, I accounted for that.==W== And since you've been so proactive in completing your missions lately, a small bonus won't hurt.
Besides, don't you think the trial version is more useful to you than the full version?
In the full version, no one forgets what they recover. But in the trial, I'm the only one who remembers.
So if I'm the only one with the memories, I get to decide what they mean. Right?
Exactly. As expected of Tyrant. You already knew.
Who controls the past controls the future. Who controls the present controls the past.
Now you can use the present to rewrite what everyone thinks is the past, and shape their futures.
Thanks, Vita. You're always trying to give me the upper hand.
But you never take my advice. Did I miscalculate something?
Your logic is sound, and I know you mean well. I just don't want to be someone who calculates every move.
I understand. What kind of person do you wish to be, then?
I'm not sure yet.==W== Probably someone who trusts and supports ==SEX3== friends as we move forward together.
Understood. I'll make a note of it. Please excuse me.
Phew. Vita's always making suggestions like that.==W== If I'd listened to her from the start, I'd have turned into some mastermind plotting schemes 24/7.
Yawn... I slept wonderfully.==W== Good morning, ==W====PLAYER_NAME==. Waking up all on your own like a good kid.==W== You're an early bird today.
Hey, hey, Allie! Are you still half asleep?!
... Huh?==W== Oh, sorry! I'm a mess...==W== I had a wonderful dream last night, and I guess I got carried away... <size=53>♪</size>
A wonderful dream? Mind telling me what it was about?
Oh, well...==W== Iris, Noya, and Amber were gathered around me, calling me Mom...==W== I don't remember the details.

I see.==W== The Monolith Melody worked, then.==W== You won't remember that dream yourself, though. Only I can.==W== Do you want to hear about your past first?==W== If there's anything you'd rather keep private, I can leave it out...
No need. How could a mother lie to her children?==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, please tell everyone what happened in those lost memories. Don't leave a single thing out.
A few hours later. I recounted Allie's lost memories of Taffett and Narida==RT==to the New Star Guild and the White Cat Troupe, with every detail.
Aunt Allie...==W== That was a terrible injury. It must have hurt.
The wound healed up fast, though, right? I remember that medicine in the basement working like magic on any injury.
Yeah. Thanks to that medicine, it didn't even leave a scar. I suppose it wasn't serious at the time.
You're amazing, Aunt Allie!==W== You and Narida took down over a hundred Sentinels and Imperial Knights.==W== All of us together could barely handle ten.
And to think Aunt Allie is ... the strongest White Cat.==W== I still can't believe it.
So that's why we stopped calling you Mom and switched to Aunt Allie.==W== The Monolith must have taken that memory when we made our wishes. Thank goodness we got it back.
Then why did the kids who came later start calling you Mom again?
Because Aunt Allie...==W== I mean, Mom, has always felt like a mother to us. We started calling her that on our own when we were little, didn't we?
By the time they stopped hunting White Cats in Emor, Mom had forgotten the taboo herself, so everyone went back to it.==W== We were the only ones still honoring that old rule.
Ah, wonderful!==W== It warms my heart to hear Iris call me Mom again.==W==
Noya, Amber, what about you two? Are you going to follow her lead?
Mom.==W==<size=45> Mom,</size>==W==<size=50> Mom!</size>==W==<size=55> MOM!!</size>==W== Haha, once you've said it, it's not that embarrassing anymore! <size=53>♪</size>
That sounds wonderful. Thanks to you,==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, my heart gets to melt at that again.
Guys, can we focus?==W== How did we end up discussing whether to call her Mom?==W== The assassination rumors, Iris's past, the way into the secret room. Did you all forget about those?
The White Cats look grim, though.==W== I wonder what they actually think about all this history.
Taffett...==W== No, since you left that name behind, we will still call you Director Allie.==W== Thank you, and thank you, Boss, for bringing the truth to light.
So that explains where she went. Whenever my sister vanished for months out of the year, she was in Emor.
The White Cats never killed the Empress. We were never traitors. It was all lies and slander.
My sister didn't go there to surrender.==W== She went to break the chains holding us back.

We fought Desert Scorpions and Imperial Guards. We lost people every single day.==P====W====RT====RT== None of us knew why that Monolith mattered.==P====W====RT====RT== We threw our lives away out of blind honor and duty.

Captain Narida was the only White Cat in Mirage who had actually met the Empress.==P====W====RT====RT== The rest of us, myself included, only understood the basic concept of being her personal guard.==P====W====RT====RT== Looking back, Captain Narida must have realized it then,==P====W====RT====RT== that if we kept fighting like that, we would all die for a cause none of us understood.
My sister always wore a smile.==W== But so many nights I would catch her sitting alone on the dunes, staring at that Monolith until dawn.
She was desperate for a way to save us.==W== That explains why she left the desert to find Mom,==W== or Taffett back then.
At first I figured Captain Narida was trying to uncover the truth==RT==about the Empress's death and clear our name.
I thought if she recruited you, our fighting power would be secured.
But she came back from one of those trips looking like a massive weight had been lifted.
She stopped staring out at the Monolith all night. Instead, she started==RT==locking herself in the secret room to study a signed red Soul Stone.
Back then, I assumed she had finally found a lead on Taffett...
I never imagined she would vanish alongside the Monolith.
Because ... Her Majesty ordered every White Cat except you to seal off the Monolith in Mirage.==W== No one's allowed in.
She sealed the Monolith as ordered and saved the rest of us in the process.==W== She put an end to those endless battles we never understood.
That's when Mirage became what it is today. Everyone plays along in this massive performance.==W== It sounds absurd, but no one's died fighting since.
Oh, I get it!==W== Amber, your pistols. When Director Allie told Narida to take the weapons away, Narida must have stashed them in the basement.==W== And then you found them!
I think ...==W== my sister wanted to leave those pistols as a keepsake for Mom. Even if Mom never knew they were there.
Thank you, Boss.==W====RT==It feels like a weight I've carried for years has finally lifted.
Well then, time to keep our promise. We'll take you to the White Cats' secret room.
But didn't you say only Narida or Taffett could open that door?==W== Allie's memories didn't seem to hold the password you mentioned.
We already have it.==W== The password is the song==W== Captain Narida used to hum.
Wow, is this the mine shaft? Incredible! It feels like a real adventure!
Heh heh heh...==W== Every time I descend underground into the abyss's darkness, my dark power surges!==W== ... Probably.
Yeah! Let me breathe in some of that dark power too!==W== Inhales...==W== Pffft!
No!==W== You're not allowed to breathe! All the dark power down here is mine!
Come to think of it, those crystal diamonds the Imperial Guard used to pay us came from places like this.
A shaft this deep... How did they even dig it?==W== You can handle dirt and rock with tools, but they must have hit massive, unbreakable boulders.
That wouldn't work. The earth around the shaft isn't stable enough. An uncontrolled explosion could easily cause a cave-in.
So the old miners used a method called heat and quench.
Heat and quench? How does that work?
First, you get someone with fire magic to superheat the rock.==W== Then someone with water magic douses it to cool it instantly.
The sudden shock makes the stone crack on its own.==W== After that, you drive wedges into the cracks to split it apart.
Fascinating. Miners are clever. I need to write this down.
Haha, it's not like I figured it out myself.==W== An old miner who used to work here told me, I'm just passing the knowledge along.
We should be moving faster.==W== Why does this feel like a school trip? Are we okay taking it this easy?
Wait, did I say that out loud?
Hehe.==W== Nope. But I can tell what you're thinking. You're an open book,==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Is that some kind of mom superpower?==W== No, impossible.==W== Still, that's amazing ...==W== and a little terrifying.
See? Everyone is on high alert.==W== Taking it easy earlier was their way to wind down before a fight.
True. You have everyone figured out, Allie.
Hold it, Boss. That's far enough for you lot.
And you White Cats!==W== You cave this tunnel in, and you'll regret it.
Huh? We didn't do anything wrong! You're the ones conning Trekkers into forced labor.
Forced labor? We sign contracts. Our terms are better than United Harvest!==W== What's the matter, you White Cats itching to blow something up again?
Easy, Myrsha. We aren't here to wreck the mine.
We want to open the White Cats' secret room. We need to find the missing Monolith.
Haha! Perfect.==W== We had no clue how to open that room. You saved us the trouble.
...==W== And what do the Desert Scorpions want with it?
Isn't it obvious?==W== This is our mine now. Everything inside the mine belongs to us. That includes the secret room.
Nonsense.==W== Let's settle this with a duel. Desert rules.
A duel?==W== Hahaha!==W== Bring it on!==W==
Whoa! Pffft! What the hell? A sandstorm inside a mine?
Cough... Damn it, we're cut off. We can't reach Boss.
Hehehe... You should have taken our deal, Boss. Now you pay the price.
... But still, I'm not a monster. You want a duel?==RT==Fine. Since you want the room, you're fighting me.
You win, the room is yours. You lose, you join the Desert Scorpions.
We're paying her back for that assassination in Philae right here.

strings.text: After defeating Hazana, you enter the secret room and find Narida's letter. It explains that she disappeared to protect Allie and the children. At the same time, Angie leads the Salvation Committee into Mirage.
No way. All that work I put into my magic, and you cracked it?
Ugh, crap. My Soul Stone is tapped out.==W== What a rotten day.
Look! Hazana's human again, and the sandstorm is clearing out!
Hey, drop your guard and you'll pay. You remember where we are, right?==W== Yo, Scorpions, toss me a spare Soul Stone! We're going again!
Oh, you mean these out-of-shape youngsters?==W== They ran out of energy, so they're taking a rest.
Huh... Whaaat?! Why are you all on the floor?!
S-Sorry, Cap!==W== Director Allie is too strong.==W== We couldn't hold her off.
==W==How can someone so sweet==W== be that terrifying?
I couldn't catch up with her moves... It was over before the great Chaton could even get a shot off.==W== Unbelievable. Who is this woman?
Tch. You guys did a number on us...
Don't worry, I only used the flat of the blade. They're just too sore to stand, but a couple days of bed rest will fix them right up.
So you held back? Director Allie, I won't say I like that condescending attitude of yours.
Oh dear, how troubling. I didn't mean it like that.
Myrsha, you seem to be the last one standing. Would you please carry your friends outside?
Y-Yes, ma'am! I'll get them out of here! Please, stop torturing me!!
I'm shocked too. We never noticed as kids, but looking back, no gangs had ever harassed the orphanage. We never had to deal with scumbags like Feagin either.
Maybe it was because those adults knew what Mom was capable of? They wouldn't dare...
Wait, Mom, where did you get that blade? I've never seen it.
Hmm? You see it all the time when you hang the laundry.
Laundry...? You mean the clothes pole?!
Bingo! As for the blade on top, it's meant for splitting firewood. This is my first time using a weapon like this, so my form was a bit sloppy. I hope I didn't embarrass myself.
Y-Your first time? You made it look effortless. I never would have guessed...
Enough talk. I know we need a breather, but once Hazana wakes up, she'll rally the Desert Scorpions for a counterattack. We're opening the secret room right here.
I couldn't exactly tell Hazana the truth.
Fair point.==W== But I don't see a door. How do we get in?
We use the song you heard in Director Allie's memory.
Captain Narida always sent us away when she opened it, so none of us know the full melody. You'll have to hum it for us, Boss.
M-Me? Alright... I'll give it a shot.
Oh no, my singing could be awful...
La la la~==W== La, la la la~==W== La, la, la la la...==W== La la...
That is garbage! It itches! My brain is literally itching! Make it stop! I'm gonna lose my mind!
Y-You don't have to be that mean about it... Anyway, did the door open?
Not a peep. Boss, are you sure you were singing it right?
... Look, I don't know the exact tune! I only heard it once in a dream.
That melody... I've heard it before.
Ah, I know it! It's that song!==W== Ahem...
Mom used to hum it to us when we were little... The song to make our pain go away. She must have learned it from Narida.
It's the same song Iris sang when Boss first woke up.
Look! The rock wall is splitting open! There's a path inside!
Candles are burning steadily. Airflow is good. It's safe.
If this is the secret room, it's our best lead on the Monolith and Captain Narida. Fan out and search.
Whoa! <size=52>♪</size> Kasimira, look! Are those magic guns by the wall? There are a ton of them! Can I touch them? Please?
Dorra and crystal diamonds sitting out in open boxes... Plus a fortune in ancient gold coins.
Armor looks ancient. Is it from the old days?
Even if we find a lead here...==W== It's the 18th today. We still have to climb the Monolith for clues to prove my identity. Can we finish in time for the conference?
Following my gut... Trying to sense where Narida would stash something important. If it were me, I'd find a hidden compartment and hide the switch—
Noya tugs the tail of a black cat statue. Rusty hinges screech, and a hidden compartment slides open in the wall.
Found it! I knew it! They're the White Cat Troupe. Why is there a random black cat sitting right here of all places?
Let's see what's inside... A book and a letter? I feel bad reading someone else's private things...
Dear Kasimira, or whoever finds this. If you are reading this, I am already gone.
... Yeah. Looks like it's from Narida. Kasimira, it's for you.
It's fine. Keep reading. You helped us, you have the right to know. Plus, it might have leads about the Monolith.
When I was little, I admired the mothers at White Cat orphanages. They were strong, yet gentle.
I used to think: I want to become someone like that.
I was jealous when Taffett was entrusted with the children. I felt bitter about it.
But watching her interaction with those kids, I realized...
Her Majesty made the right choice. Taffett was meant to be a "Mom." I wasn't. To whoever is reading this... Do you know what the most important quality in a "Mom" is? It is—
==Off==<color=black><size=75>The willingness to show her children unconditional love.
I could never be their Mom. The best I could ever be==RT==is a decent older sister to the White Cats.

Who she is right now is her truest, most perfect self.

... I see. So Captain Narida's goal all along was to erase the Monolith.

Ah. But before I leave, I'm making ==SEX4== buy me the limited-edition drink here. It's the least I deserve for chasing ==SEX4== all the way out here. Yep, that's the plan!
No way... How is that here?!
Hey, why is everyone staring? I didn't do anything weird!
Nobody is looking at you! That thing behind you, why is it here?!
Huh? Is that a ... Monolith?! Impossible, I checked before we came in. There wasn't one anywhere near here!
Ma'am, our scouts confirm that the vanished Monolith in Mirage has reappeared. And per our intel, the Tyrant is indeed in the city.

I am just following the Grand Captain's orders.
Hehehe... A dutiful knight, radiating reluctance, yet obediently preparing the troops... And with that look in her eyes, like I'm absolute trash... It's magnificent! Thank you!
Greyhorn's just doing her job. What's wrong with you? That's disgusting.
Yes! I will gladly take that insult! Thank you! Please, Lady Angie, punish this lowly worm! Punish me harshly so I never cause offense again!
Calm down, Number 160. Besides, punishing someone who wants it defeats the purpose, doesn't it?

To think you would leave me hanging like this...?!==W== As expected of Lady Angie! I will follow you forever!
Gunhild. What is the troop's status?

Thank you. Each of you will take a company of one hundred and proceed as planned.
Tyrant. I admit I underestimated you back in Philae.
To ensure victory this time, I brought thirty times the forces. Even if you convinced the White Cats to back you...
Can you actually stand against us? Heh heh heh...
Regardless, we will have the last laugh on this battlefield. This time, I will pierce your heart. I will save this world.
Thanks for covering me. I'm fine...
But you pinning me down like this, basically crushing me, is making it even harder to breathe...
No. There are no earthquakes in Mirage. Let's check outside. White Cats, take point. Everyone, stay sharp.
Then I will bring up the rear.==W== You go ahead.
Got it. Let's catch up with Kasimira.
==PLAYER_NAME==?! That was a rough fall... You okay?

param: After defeating Hazana, you enter the secret room and find Narida's letter. It explains that she disappeared to protect Allie and the children. At the same time, Angie leads the Salvation Committee into Mirage.
No way. All that work I put into my magic, and you cracked it?
Ugh, crap. My Soul Stone is tapped out.==W== What a rotten day.
Look! Hazana's human again, and the sandstorm is clearing out!

Oh, you mean these out-of-shape youngsters?==W== They ran out of energy, so they're taking a rest.
Huh... Whaaat?! Why are you all on the floor?!

==W==How can someone so sweet==W== be that terrifying?

Tch. You guys did a number on us...
Don't worry, I only used the flat of the blade. They're just too sore to stand, but a couple days of bed rest will fix them right up.
So you held back? Director Allie, I won't say I like that condescending attitude of yours.
Oh dear, how troubling. I didn't mean it like that.
Myrsha, you seem to be the last one standing. Would you please carry your friends outside?
Y-Yes, ma'am! I'll get them out of here! Please, stop torturing me!!
I'm shocked too. We never noticed as kids, but looking back, no gangs had ever harassed the orphanage. We never had to deal with scumbags like Feagin either.
Maybe it was because those adults knew what Mom was capable of? They wouldn't dare...
Wait, Mom, where did you get that blade? I've never seen it.
Hmm? You see it all the time when you hang the laundry.
Laundry...? You mean the clothes pole?!
Bingo! As for the blade on top, it's meant for splitting firewood. This is my first time using a weapon like this, so my form was a bit sloppy. I hope I didn't embarrass myself.
Y-Your first time? You made it look effortless. I never would have guessed...
Enough talk. I know we need a breather, but once Hazana wakes up, she'll rally the Desert Scorpions for a counterattack. We're opening the secret room right here.
I couldn't exactly tell Hazana the truth.
Fair point.==W== But I don't see a door. How do we get in?
We use the song you heard in Director Allie's memory.
Captain Narida always sent us away when she opened it, so none of us know the full melody. You'll have to hum it for us, Boss.
M-Me? Alright... I'll give it a shot.
Oh no, my singing could be awful...
La la la~==W== La, la la la~==W== La, la, la la la...==W== La la...
That is garbage! It itches! My brain is literally itching! Make it stop! I'm gonna lose my mind!
Y-You don't have to be that mean about it... Anyway, did the door open?
Not a peep. Boss, are you sure you were singing it right?
... Look, I don't know the exact tune! I only heard it once in a dream.
That melody... I've heard it before.
Ah, I know it! It's that song!==W== Ahem...
Mom used to hum it to us when we were little... The song to make our pain go away. She must have learned it from Narida.
It's the same song Iris sang when Boss first woke up.
Look! The rock wall is splitting open! There's a path inside!
Candles are burning steadily. Airflow is good. It's safe.
If this is the secret room, it's our best lead on the Monolith and Captain Narida. Fan out and search.
Whoa! <size=52>♪</size> Kasimira, look! Are those magic guns by the wall? There are a ton of them! Can I touch them? Please?
Dorra and crystal diamonds sitting out in open boxes... Plus a fortune in ancient gold coins.
Armor looks ancient. Is it from the old days?
Even if we find a lead here...==W== It's the 18th today. We still have to climb the Monolith for clues to prove my identity. Can we finish in time for the conference?
Following my gut... Trying to sense where Narida would stash something important. If it were me, I'd find a hidden compartment and hide the switch—
Noya tugs the tail of a black cat statue. Rusty hinges screech, and a hidden compartment slides open in the wall.
Found it! I knew it! They're the White Cat Troupe. Why is there a random black cat sitting right here of all places?
Let's see what's inside... A book and a letter? I feel bad reading someone else's private things...
Dear Kasimira, or whoever finds this. If you are reading this, I am already gone.
... Yeah. Looks like it's from Narida. Kasimira, it's for you.
It's fine. Keep reading. You helped us, you have the right to know. Plus, it might have leads about the Monolith.
When I was little, I admired the mothers at White Cat orphanages. They were strong, yet gentle.
I used to think: I want to become someone like that.
I was jealous when Taffett was entrusted with the children. I felt bitter about it.
But watching her interaction with those kids, I realized...
Her Majesty made the right choice. Taffett was meant to be a "Mom." I wasn't. To whoever is reading this... Do you know what the most important quality in a "Mom" is? It is—
