strings.text: The White Cat Troupe detects Angie's people coming, and everyone moves at once. Laru and Bastelina, hidden among them, work to help you. Tangled information leads to confusion, but the army is already here.

==RT====RT====RT====RT==The arrogant Tyrant turned ==SEX3== back on the Archons' wisdom. Seizing absolute power, ==SEX== vanished into the deep desert, swearing to burn the great Monoliths to ashes.==RT==—Chronicles of New Nova, by Virigia
Yet,==W== the Tyrant would ultimately face divine punishment.
The desert people rallied beneath the Monolith. They struck down the Tyrant==RT==lurking in the shadows, sealing ==SEX4== away in a god-bestowed stone coffin.
Reporting in, Ma'am. The artillery is ready.==W== Oh... Am I interrupting your reading?
It's fine. I was just brushing up on some history...==W== The history of the Tyrant from a long, long time ago.
The Tyrant was around in ancient times too? I'm ashamed to say that's news to me.
Yes. The history of Nova is an endless cycle of our people rebelling against, defeating, and sealing away the Tyrant.
But the Grace Imperium buried this truth. The stories passed down in our schools and cities are nothing but sanitized fairy tales.
If you're interested, I can lend you a few "true" history books once this battle is over.
Honestly, I was pretty on edge about this showdown with the Tyrant.
But seeing you sitting here reading so calmly definitely took the edge off.
I'll go run a final check on the firing coordinates. I'll hold you to those books when this is over!
Why did I dust off this history book ... when I haven't read it in so long?
Tyrant, watching your journey through Philae==RT==might have been the happiest time of my life.
If I didn't know how this had to end, we could have been great friends.
Heh. Not that it matters now.
You woke up in the desert, and it'll all end in the desert. Perhaps this is exactly how the God of Grace designed it.
The outsider distributed the Monolith's holy relics to the people, forging a new home in the desert sands.
But as wealth was abundant, the people forgot about their past sacrifices. They forgot the outsider, taking their paradise for granted.
The outsider was pleased with this outcome. ==SEX1== vanished into the Wilds, never to be seen again.
Bastelina, what are you muttering about over there? I know this heat is driving everyone mad, but save your complaint before you pass out.
I'm not complaining. I'm studying for my Grace Theory exam. They expect us to memorize these out-of-context historical passages word for word, and it's giving me a headache.
Oh, right, I remember now. That's the test all the new hires have to pass within their first year, right?
Just thinking about it is annoying enough... Why is an exam on Grace Theory packed with a bunch of useless history?
What exactly are you reading, though? I don't remember that being on the syllabus.
My supervisor gave me these review materials. Here, it's this book.
Oh... The supervisor you're always texting for instructions? Let me see...
Chronicles of Nova,==W== and the author is... Huh? It's blank.
Hmm... Never heard of this one.
Ugh, whatever. This awful sun is melting my brain. I can't focus on a single word anyway. Here, take it back!
Hah... We have it so rough. If I knew going undercover meant getting roasted in a desert, I'd have passed on the hazard pay.
I mean, come on! Fries and deserts do not mix! Why would anyone eat piping hot food in this blistering heat?!
Try this, Laru. If you dip the hot fries into cold ice cream, they go down a lot easier.
Fries with ice cream? Fries are great and all, but there is no way that combo works. I'll take a bite, though.
... Wait, what is this?! It's incredible! Let me get another bite...
This salty-sweet, hot-cold combo...==W== It's perfect! The contrasting flavors taste so good together! It replenishes sodium and beats the heat. This is a life-saving miracle!
Sweet and salty, cold and hot... It's absolute perfection! Bastelina, you're a genius! A visionary!
Heh, the perks of working logistics. I just combined the ice meant for the Committee with your fry stash, and came up with this.
Hmph. The Salvation Committee just got branded as heretics, and we're the only ones crazy enough to side with them right now.
So Angie can't afford to give us the cold shoulder. Even if she suspects us, she has to treat the brave weirdos well. Doing anything else would tank morale.
Logistics is important, sure, but for this operation? Compared to the front lines hunting the Tyrant, this is the least critical post.
We're stuck in the middle of the desert without our phones, surrounded by Committee members. We couldn't send intel or sabotage them if we tried.
Which means we can kick back and slack off guilt-free!
Can we really, though? If Angie captures the Tyrant, Lady Albedo will be purged for opposing her, won't she?
Whoa! You're right...! Angie will have a hundred ways to force ==PLAYER_NAME== to confess that ==SEX=='s the world-destroying Tyrant...
Then the heresy charges would disappear, and Albedo would definitely be the first to take the fall. Wait, they might even frame her as the Tyrant's accomplice!
Which means it's only a matter of time before our cover gets blown too!
At that point, getting fired by the Grace Imperium would be the best-case scenario.
Fired?! No way! How am I supposed to slack off at work if I'm unemployed?! We are avoiding that timeline!
There has to be a way... Come on, Laru, use that big brain of yours. Think…
Bastelina! Our mission is to feed intel to Albedo, right? And Albedo's goal is to help ==PLAYER_NAME==.
We don't have phones, so we can't reach Albedo. But we're already right here in Mirage! We can just go meet ==PLAYER_NAME==!
Can we really do that? It feels like... Like we're skipping some major protocols.
Don't sweat the details! As long as we <r=keep slacking off>cross the finish line</r>, taking a shortcut doesn't matter!
Bastelina, whip me up three hundred orders of fries and ice cream! This is where logistics really shines!
We'll say we're keeping the Committee members fed and happy! That's the cover story! Then, in the chaos, we'll find a way to contact ==PLAYER_NAME==!
Hey, the left tunnel is a complete cave-in. We can't get through.
The path behind us is blocked too.
Did that tremor cause the collapse? Oh no... We've been going in circles for half an hour. What if we're trapped down here?
Don't panic. This crystal diamond mine is a massive network with hundreds of surface shafts.
We might have to take a detour, but we will definitely get out.
Are you sure that wasn't an earthquake? I'm worried about the kids at the orphanage.
Copy that. Hold your position and wait for us to rendezvous. Don't do anything reckless.
We have an update from outside. That wasn't an earthquake. The Monolith has returned.
The Monolith has returned...? What does that mean?
The old Monolith of Mirage reappeared where it vanished years ago. That's what caused the tremor.
A Monolith that massive suddenly appeared in the desert?! Is... Is this for real?
I know it's hard to believe, but many people saw it. It's true.

And we have a more pressing issue. The White Cats scouted a combat group of several hundred outside Mirage. It's a mix of arbiters, sentinels, and Imperial Knights, all flying the Grace Imperium flag.
On the 16th, Chaton encountered Angie scouting alone in the desert,==RT==about a day's journey from Mirage.
In barely two days, she marched this entire force right to the city outskirts. We cannot underestimate her command.
Guided by the brilliance of countless stars, the great Chaton is...
Hey! Why the long faces? No matter who those enemies are, my dark power will...
Sigh... Let's set the dark powers aside for a second. What's the scouting report? Are those abandoned tunnels from the archives still usable?
Yep, they were clear when I checked. But they could collapse at any minute, so we'd better move fast.
Good... Thank you.==W== Members of Boss Accord, Director Allie, follow me. The White Cats will guide you out safely.
If the Monolith caused that tremor...
Wait... The letter mentioned a compass in the basement. Is it this one we got from Firenze?
There's a slot on the pedestal. Noya, try it.
We found the compass in the Ash Orphanage's basement, and the previous Empress was the one who got the orphanage settled in that building.
Narida's letter mentioned the compass too. So, this White Cat secret room in the mine ... might be set up by the Empress too.
Did that compass summon the Monolith back?
If that's true, it all connects... But what did the previous Empress have in mind for the White Cats and the orphanage?
If everything was part of the previous empress's plan... Am I really the Tyrant?
How could this happen? Is Angie actually right? Am I truly the Tyrant destined to end the world?
Did I only think otherwise because I lost my memories?
Huh? Oh, Noya. You scared me. Wait, where did everyone go?

==PLAYER_NAME==, you were so spaced out we almost left you behind.==W== Just now, Chaton found a mineshaft that's still usable. So I told Iris, Amber, and Mom to go ahead with the White Cats while I stayed behind to wait.
Ever since you came out of that hidden room, you've been trailing behind the group, lost in thought. Whatever's got you thinking this hard must be something serious.
You know, you can walk and think at the same time. Here, hold my hand so you don't get left behind.
Thanks, Noya. But I've figured it out now, so I'm fine. Let's go.
Yeah. I was just brainstorming how to escape. But since we have a clear tunnel, we should be fine.
Liar. That's not what you were really thinking about at all.
You didn't know this, did you, ==PLAYER_NAME==? Whenever you lie, you subconsciously look away. Honestly, you were thinking about something else, weren't you?
Yeah, you're right. I shouldn't keep things from you. I was actually thinking about that sketch and my identity.
The book with the drawing was under Narida's letter. After she vanished, no one could open the White Cat secret room.
Which means that sketch was placed there six years ago at the absolute latest... Long before you found me in the desert.
A six-year-old sketch ... and the text in that book... I hate to admit it, but based on all this, the person I was before I lost my memory …
==Off==<color=#bd3059><size=75>Has to be the Tyrant!==RT==At least, that's what other people call me.
Nobody would orchestrate a massive lie years in advance just to trick me, especially when they couldn't guarantee I'd ever come here!
Well, if you think so, then maybe you really are the Tyrant.
But what difference will it make?
We sleep in the same RV every night.==RT==You're the first person we see when we wake up.
Nobody knows what kind of person you are better than the New Star Guild.
Anyway, the day you joined us, my intuition told me we were stuck together for good. Iris and Amber definitely feel the same way.
Hah... What are you talking about, Noya? What savior...
That word was in the book too. If you're going to obsess over the "Tyrant" part, you're not going to ignore the mention of "Savior"!
What kind of logic is that...?

Since the book lists the Tyrant and the Savior side by side, that means you might not just be the Tyrant. You could be the Savior too. All we have to do is defeat Angie and make her admit you're the latter.
So stop stressing over it, ==PLAYER_NAME==. Whether you're a Tyrant or a "savior," you will always be my ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Noya... Heh, you really are an optimist.
Don't worry. After our late-night talk, I promised I wouldn't fall back into that rut. I was shocked by the sudden "truth," that's all.
Right now, I'm not stressing over my true identity. I'm figuring out how to protect everyone while fighting off Angie's forces.
And no matter how many people she brings, I have zero intention of going down easy.
Heh heh, there's the ==PLAYER_NAME== I know.
Oh, right, Noya. You mentioned that I subconsciously look away when I lie.
Is it obvious? It'd be disastrous if this comes out during the negotiations and the other side catches on.
Ah, that? Haha...==W== I actually made that up. You don't do that at all.

After our late-night talk last time, the three of us talked things over in private. Amber said you can be pretty guarded sometimes, and that you needed someone to give you a little push to get past that. So we came up with this idea.
Bet you didn't see that coming! I can lie too. Iris was right. The most innocent-looking people make the most ruthless liars. Haha.
So I fell for it completely...==W== It will never happen again!
And I will never lie to you again. That means I'll forever be one point ahead of you, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
There's no point in trying to outdo each other here. Come on, let's catch up with the others.
Is that green smoke up ahead?==W== No, that's powerful wind magic! They're using it to scout for us!
Are Angie's people already in the mine?
Looks like it. You don't casually toss out magic of this caliber. It has to be Angie's elites.
Noya draws her sword, naturally stepping in front to shield me.
Careful, footsteps ahead. Go on without me, ==PLAYER_NAME==. I'll hold them off.
Blades clash, striking brilliant sparks in the gloom of the mine.

param: The White Cat Troupe detects Angie's people coming, and everyone moves at once. Laru and Bastelina, hidden among them, work to help you. Tangled information leads to confusion, but the army is already here.

==RT====RT====RT====RT==The arrogant Tyrant turned ==SEX3== back on the Archons' wisdom. Seizing absolute power, ==SEX== vanished into the deep desert, swearing to burn the great Monoliths to ashes.==RT==—Chronicles of New Nova, by Virigia
Yet,==W== the Tyrant would ultimately face divine punishment.
The desert people rallied beneath the Monolith. They struck down the Tyrant==RT==lurking in the shadows, sealing ==SEX4== away in a god-bestowed stone coffin.
Reporting in, Ma'am. The artillery is ready.==W== Oh... Am I interrupting your reading?
It's fine. I was just brushing up on some history...==W== The history of the Tyrant from a long, long time ago.
The Tyrant was around in ancient times too? I'm ashamed to say that's news to me.
Yes. The history of Nova is an endless cycle of our people rebelling against, defeating, and sealing away the Tyrant.
But the Grace Imperium buried this truth. The stories passed down in our schools and cities are nothing but sanitized fairy tales.
If you're interested, I can lend you a few "true" history books once this battle is over.
Honestly, I was pretty on edge about this showdown with the Tyrant.
But seeing you sitting here reading so calmly definitely took the edge off.
I'll go run a final check on the firing coordinates. I'll hold you to those books when this is over!
Why did I dust off this history book ... when I haven't read it in so long?
Tyrant, watching your journey through Philae==RT==might have been the happiest time of my life.
If I didn't know how this had to end, we could have been great friends.
Heh. Not that it matters now.
You woke up in the desert, and it'll all end in the desert. Perhaps this is exactly how the God of Grace designed it.
The outsider distributed the Monolith's holy relics to the people, forging a new home in the desert sands.
But as wealth was abundant, the people forgot about their past sacrifices. They forgot the outsider, taking their paradise for granted.
The outsider was pleased with this outcome. ==SEX1== vanished into the Wilds, never to be seen again.
Bastelina, what are you muttering about over there? I know this heat is driving everyone mad, but save your complaint before you pass out.
I'm not complaining. I'm studying for my Grace Theory exam. They expect us to memorize these out-of-context historical passages word for word, and it's giving me a headache.
Oh, right, I remember now. That's the test all the new hires have to pass within their first year, right?
Just thinking about it is annoying enough... Why is an exam on Grace Theory packed with a bunch of useless history?
What exactly are you reading, though? I don't remember that being on the syllabus.
My supervisor gave me these review materials. Here, it's this book.
Oh... The supervisor you're always texting for instructions? Let me see...
Chronicles of Nova,==W== and the author is... Huh? It's blank.
Hmm... Never heard of this one.
Ugh, whatever. This awful sun is melting my brain. I can't focus on a single word anyway. Here, take it back!
Hah... We have it so rough. If I knew going undercover meant getting roasted in a desert, I'd have passed on the hazard pay.
I mean, come on! Fries and deserts do not mix! Why would anyone eat piping hot food in this blistering heat?!
Try this, Laru. If you dip the hot fries into cold ice cream, they go down a lot easier.
Fries with ice cream? Fries are great and all, but there is no way that combo works. I'll take a bite, though.
... Wait, what is this?! It's incredible! Let me get another bite...
This salty-sweet, hot-cold combo...==W== It's perfect! The contrasting flavors taste so good together! It replenishes sodium and beats the heat. This is a life-saving miracle!
Sweet and salty, cold and hot... It's absolute perfection! Bastelina, you're a genius! A visionary!
Heh, the perks of working logistics. I just combined the ice meant for the Committee with your fry stash, and came up with this.
Hmph. The Salvation Committee just got branded as heretics, and we're the only ones crazy enough to side with them right now.
So Angie can't afford to give us the cold shoulder. Even if she suspects us, she has to treat the brave weirdos well. Doing anything else would tank morale.
Logistics is important, sure, but for this operation? Compared to the front lines hunting the Tyrant, this is the least critical post.
We're stuck in the middle of the desert without our phones, surrounded by Committee members. We couldn't send intel or sabotage them if we tried.
Which means we can kick back and slack off guilt-free!
Can we really, though? If Angie captures the Tyrant, Lady Albedo will be purged for opposing her, won't she?
Whoa! You're right...! Angie will have a hundred ways to force ==PLAYER_NAME== to confess that ==SEX=='s the world-destroying Tyrant...
Then the heresy charges would disappear, and Albedo would definitely be the first to take the fall. Wait, they might even frame her as the Tyrant's accomplice!
Which means it's only a matter of time before our cover gets blown too!
At that point, getting fired by the Grace Imperium would be the best-case scenario.
Fired?! No way! How am I supposed to slack off at work if I'm unemployed?! We are avoiding that timeline!
There has to be a way... Come on, Laru, use that big brain of yours. Think…
Bastelina! Our mission is to feed intel to Albedo, right? And Albedo's goal is to help ==PLAYER_NAME==.
We don't have phones, so we can't reach Albedo. But we're already right here in Mirage! We can just go meet ==PLAYER_NAME==!
Can we really do that? It feels like... Like we're skipping some major protocols.
Don't sweat the details! As long as we <r=keep slacking off>cross the finish line</r>, taking a shortcut doesn't matter!
Bastelina, whip me up three hundred orders of fries and ice cream! This is where logistics really shines!
We'll say we're keeping the Committee members fed and happy! That's the cover story! Then, in the chaos, we'll find a way to contact ==PLAYER_NAME==!
Hey, the left tunnel is a complete cave-in. We can't get through.
The path behind us is blocked too.
Did that tremor cause the collapse? Oh no... We've been going in circles for half an hour. What if we're trapped down here?
Don't panic. This crystal diamond mine is a massive network with hundreds of surface shafts.
We might have to take a detour, but we will definitely get out.
Are you sure that wasn't an earthquake? I'm worried about the kids at the orphanage.
Copy that. Hold your position and wait for us to rendezvous. Don't do anything reckless.
We have an update from outside. That wasn't an earthquake. The Monolith has returned.
The Monolith has returned...? What does that mean?
The old Monolith of Mirage reappeared where it vanished years ago. That's what caused the tremor.
A Monolith that massive suddenly appeared in the desert?! Is... Is this for real?
I know it's hard to believe, but many people saw it. It's true.

And we have a more pressing issue. The White Cats scouted a combat group of several hundred outside Mirage. It's a mix of arbiters, sentinels, and Imperial Knights, all flying the Grace Imperium flag.
On the 16th, Chaton encountered Angie scouting alone in the desert,==RT==about a day's journey from Mirage.
In barely two days, she marched this entire force right to the city outskirts. We cannot underestimate her command.
Guided by the brilliance of countless stars, the great Chaton is...
Hey! Why the long faces? No matter who those enemies are, my dark power will...
Sigh... Let's set the dark powers aside for a second. What's the scouting report? Are those abandoned tunnels from the archives still usable?
Yep, they were clear when I checked. But they could collapse at any minute, so we'd better move fast.
Good... Thank you.==W== Members of Boss Accord, Director Allie, follow me. The White Cats will guide you out safely.
If the Monolith caused that tremor...
Wait... The letter mentioned a compass in the basement. Is it this one we got from Firenze?
There's a slot on the pedestal. Noya, try it.
We found the compass in the Ash Orphanage's basement, and the previous Empress was the one who got the orphanage settled in that building.
Narida's letter mentioned the compass too. So, this White Cat secret room in the mine ... might be set up by the Empress too.
Did that compass summon the Monolith back?
If that's true, it all connects... But what did the previous Empress have in mind for the White Cats and the orphanage?
If everything was part of the previous empress's plan... Am I really the Tyrant?
How could this happen? Is Angie actually right? Am I truly the Tyrant destined to end the world?
Did I only think otherwise because I lost my memories?
Huh? Oh, Noya. You scared me. Wait, where did everyone go?

==PLAYER_NAME==, you were so spaced out we almost left you behind.==W== Just now, Chaton found a mineshaft that's still usable. So I told Iris, Amber, and Mom to go ahead with the White Cats while I stayed behind to wait.
Ever since you came out of that hidden room, you've been trailing behind the group, lost in thought. Whatever's got you thinking this hard must be something serious.
You know, you can walk and think at the same time. Here, hold my hand so you don't get left behind.
Thanks, Noya. But I've figured it out now, so I'm fine. Let's go.
Yeah. I was just brainstorming how to escape. But since we have a clear tunnel, we should be fine.
Liar. That's not what you were really thinking about at all.
You didn't know this, did you, ==PLAYER_NAME==? Whenever you lie, you subconsciously look away. Honestly, you were thinking about something else, weren't you?
Yeah, you're right. I shouldn't keep things from you. I was actually thinking about that sketch and my identity.
The book with the drawing was under Narida's letter. After she vanished, no one could open the White Cat secret room.
Which means that sketch was placed there six years ago at the absolute latest... Long before you found me in the desert.
A six-year-old sketch ... and the text in that book... I hate to admit it, but based on all this, the person I was before I lost my memory …
==Off==<color=#bd3059><size=75>Has to be the Tyrant!==RT==At least, that's what other people call me.
Nobody would orchestrate a massive lie years in advance just to trick me, especially when they couldn't guarantee I'd ever come here!
Well, if you think so, then maybe you really are the Tyrant.
But what difference will it make?
We sleep in the same RV every night.==RT==You're the first person we see when we wake up.
Nobody knows what kind of person you are better than the New Star Guild.
Anyway, the day you joined us, my intuition told me we were stuck together for good. Iris and Amber definitely feel the same way.
Hah... What are you talking about, Noya? What savior...
That word was in the book too. If you're going to obsess over the "Tyrant" part, you're not going to ignore the mention of "Savior"!
What kind of logic is that...?

Since the book lists the Tyrant and the Savior side by side, that means you might not just be the Tyrant. You could be the Savior too. All we have to do is defeat Angie and make her admit you're the latter.
So stop stressing over it, ==PLAYER_NAME==. Whether you're a Tyrant or a "savior," you will always be my ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Noya... Heh, you really are an optimist.
Don't worry. After our late-night talk, I promised I wouldn't fall back into that rut. I was shocked by the sudden "truth," that's all.
Right now, I'm not stressing over my true identity. I'm figuring out how to protect everyone while fighting off Angie's forces.
And no matter how many people she brings, I have zero intention of going down easy.
Heh heh, there's the ==PLAYER_NAME== I know.
Oh, right, Noya. You mentioned that I subconsciously look away when I lie.
Is it obvious? It'd be disastrous if this comes out during the negotiations and the other side catches on.
Ah, that? Haha...==W== I actually made that up. You don't do that at all.

After our late-night talk last time, the three of us talked things over in private. Amber said you can be pretty guarded sometimes, and that you needed someone to give you a little push to get past that. So we came up with this idea.
Bet you didn't see that coming! I can lie too. Iris was right. The most innocent-looking people make the most ruthless liars. Haha.
So I fell for it completely...==W== It will never happen again!
And I will never lie to you again. That means I'll forever be one point ahead of you, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
There's no point in trying to outdo each other here. Come on, let's catch up with the others.
Is that green smoke up ahead?==W== No, that's powerful wind magic! They're using it to scout for us!
Are Angie's people already in the mine?
Looks like it. You don't casually toss out magic of this caliber. It has to be Angie's elites.
Noya draws her sword, naturally stepping in front to shield me.
Careful, footsteps ahead. Go on without me, ==PLAYER_NAME==. I'll hold them off.
Blades clash, striking brilliant sparks in the gloom of the mine.

strings.text: Greyhorn's army reaches the mine where you hide. In this desperate moment, the Petal Bloom Guild arrives like a miracle. Under their cover, you finally gain a chance to breathe and choose...
Fries! Get your hot, crispy fries right here!
Ice cream! One bite of this will send you straight back to the frozen North!
... Is someone selling snacks? Since when do we have camp merchants out in the desert?
Impossible. This is a classified Salvation Committee operation. Did our intel leak? Let's bring her in for questioning.
You there, stop! Who sent you?!
Eek! Whoa, hold on! Don't get me wrong!
I am Laru from Logistics! You know, the super dedicated, ultra-hardworking Laru!
That name rings a bell. Doesn't Logistics have a massive slacker going by that name? What are you doing out here?
The main convoy and reinforcements are still a day out. We whipped up some teatime treats to keep you frontline heroes in peak fighting shape. Ingredients were limited. Forgive the humble spread.
Teatime...? Isn't that what those noble ladies do back in Emor? Sitting around snacking in fancy gardens.
Hmph. Knowing we are out here risking our lives for people like that drains my motivation to save the world.
Let's drop the depressing talk. We shouldn't let Logistics' hard work go to waste.
Exactly! I have fries and ice cream right here. This combo will recharge your body and mind, helping you catch that Tyrant in record time!
I appreciate the thought. We definitely need the sodium after sweating this much, but ... fries in the middle of a desert?
Heh, you don't eat them plain. You dip your fries in the ice cream. Here, give it a try.
Is that even a thing...==W== Munch munch...
Salty, crispy, sweet, and ice-cold... A perfect storm of flavor! The heat is completely gone! I feel like a new person!
I am glad you like it! Where are the rest of the Committee members? I need to finish my deliveries.
Most of the First Company went down into the mine with Captain Greyhorn. The rest of us are trying to locate the Tyrant...
Searing winds of the golden dunes! In the name of the God of Grace,==RT==I command thee, carry these sands into the mine!
O sands imbued with magic and Grace, engrave the distant unseen into my eyes!
(So they're teaming up to scout the mine...? One sentinel controls the wind to carry the sand inside, while the other controls the sand and uses enchanted grains to sense living creatures.)
(That range on the wind spell, plus that level of sensory perception... They are tough enough individually. If combined, ==PLAYER_NAME== will have nowhere to hide down there.)
(If I ever want to slack off in peace again, I need to find ==PLAYER_NAME== and deliver the intel fast.)
Hey, hold it right there. Captain Greyhorn strictly forbade anyone outside the First Company from entering the mine. It is about to turn into a warzone down there. Way too dangerous for Logistics.
Thanks for the effort. Drop the fries and ice cream here and go get some rest.
Rest? No, no, no. Absolutely not. If I leave them here, the fries will get soggy, and the ice cream will melt! Ensuring every single ally gets the perfect fry-to-ice-cream ratio is my duty!
You are fighting tooth and nail for the fate of the world. How could Logistics possibly sit back and relax?
Please let me into the mine. I want to do my part to save the world too!
I have visual! The sands show the white-haired Tyrant and ==SEX3== sole bodyguard hiding near the White Cat secret room!
I have visual! The sands show the black-haired Tyrant and ==SEX3== sole bodyguard hiding near the White Cat secret room!
Alerting Captain Greyhorn! You lot, on me. We are bagging the Tyrant this time!
Hey, Logistics slacker... No, ultra-hardworking Laru! You can fight too, right?!
You bet! My spear packs enough volts to knock a person out cold.
Then fall in, bring the fries and ice cream. You are absolutely right. All of us need to do our part for the world. Let's catch the Tyrant together!
(Heh. Operation Fry-and-Ice-Cream Infiltration is a go. Now I need to reach ==PLAYER_NAME==.)
Captain Greyhorn, we got word from the investigation team. The Tyrant and ==SEX3== sole bodyguard are in the tunnel straight ahead.
Spread into battle formation. Rein in your magic. We are only here for the primary target. Ignore the accomplices.
Remember, incapacitate anyone defending the Tyrant. Lethal force is unnecessary.
Why? Are we really going to let the people helping the Tyrant destroy the world walk away?
Those stubborn fools injured our comrades in Philae. They deserve to die!
Our mission has always been to save the world. Killing the Tyrant is merely a means to that end.
The Tyrant's companions are irrelevant to this goal.==W== Do not complicate the mission, and do not cause needless casualties.
This is a direct order from Lady Angie! It is also my command. Anyone who disobeys will face military punishment!
Captain Greyhorn, the Tyrant is fleeing toward your position.
Copy that. Leave it to me.
Careful, footsteps ahead. Go on without me, ==PLAYER_NAME==. I'll hold them off.
Wait, Noya! They aren't the enemy!
Chitose?! What are you doing here?
My ==SEX11==! And Noya! I've finally found you!
Scatter! Her strikes are heavy, and the tunnel is narrow. Do not bunch up!
I-I'm sorry! I don't want to fight you, but ... I cannot let you capture Master!
Smash those tin cans right into the wall!
To move that fast with such a heavy weapon... Girl, if only you used your talents to protect the peace of Nova.
Y-You're the ones destroying the peace! Master hasn't done anything wrong!
Talking makes you lose focus. Just as I thought.
Meet your end, Tyrant. If taking one life stops this madness, I will gladly bear the sins!
Hahaha! That makeup artist is amazing! She even rigged a teleport spell to this disguise!
You're not the Tyrant... Given your height... Nazuna from the Petal Bloom?
Oh? Am I that famous?==W== Wait, what do you mean "your height"?! I'm remembering your face, you drafty tin can!
Like I'd tell you! Come on, Fuyuka, let's bring down this entire tunnel!
O Western Wind, when wilt thou blow? When shall the gentle rain fall?

==Off==<color=#6fb1d2>A pale green breeze swirls around Nazuka.==RT==Soft yet unyielding,==RT==it forms a barrier against the searing yellow wind in the tunnel,==RT==keeping every grain of enchanted sand away from her companions.
Guided by her hand, threads of green energy seep into the hot wind, diverting the sands down an adjacent tunnel.
Nazuka... You're here too? When we last spoke, you were still in Philae. Were you actually...
Did you think I would sit around in Philae waiting? That is hardly my style.
We stayed in Philae to cover for you, but the Salvation Committee seemed to have somehow tracked you down in the desert, so we decided to sneak over and help.
We can discuss the details later. Now that we've found you, Nazuna and Fuyuka can drop the decoy act, and I can stop holding back!
I see them! Captain Greyhorn has the Tyrant surrounded, along with that frail, white-haired bodyguard next to ==SEX4==.
White hair? That's not right. None of the New Star Guild have white hair ... and neither do the heavy hitters in the White Cat Troupe.
Who did you actually see?==W== Ugh...!
The wind! I'm losing control of the air currents in the mine! Dang it, who has magic this strong?!
I hear howling! Everyone, grab onto something! Anything!
W-What a crazy wind! Whoever cast that must be furious.==W== Good thing I'm hauling all these heavy fries and ice cream, or I would've blown away too!
==PLAYER_NAME==, just how many ridiculously strong companions do you even have...?
Phew. All clean. Every last grain of that annoying sand has been blown out.
Boss, we're back!==W== Fuyuka caved the tunnel in and trapped that drafty tin can on the other side, along with a whole bunch of Imperial Guards and Sentinels of Dawn!
I-I'm sorry! I broke a lot of things. I heard this place belongs to the Desert Scorpions... Um... Should I pay for damages?
Whoa, even more Trekkers overflowing with dark power! And don't sweat the damages. If the Scorpions come knocking, I'll pay them back in bullets! Hehe.

Yes. Your companions from Philae,==W== your friend Minova from Emor,==W== and the witch, Mistique, from Scarlet Sights Media. We've all come to assist you, My ==SEX11==. They are on standby outside the city.
Even Ashwind is here... Are we really doing a final showdown with the Salvation Committee right here? Ugh... There's no way we win this.
Boss, what do we do next?
Wh-What should I do... What else ... can I do?
Running is useless. The decapitation strike is useless.
If I want to protect everyone, I have to utilize absolutely every piece of intel I gathered from the last two attempts.
I need to leave Angie in charge of the Committee, pick a battlefield that keeps the kids and citizens out of the crossfire, and force a showdown.
No wars of attrition. I'm going to wipe them all out in one fell swoop!
Um...==W== No wound on your shoulder?==W== Your ribs aren't hurt either, right?
Wh-Why are you asking that out of nowhere? Of course I'm not hurt!==W== You aren't trying to peek at my belly right here, are you...
Wh-Why are you hugging me all of a sudden?! Hey, hey, everyone is watching!
It's okay. It's okay. None of that is going to happen.
Noya, don't worry about your intuition. It's completely wrong. I promise you, I will never, ever leave you.
Huh? Ehhhhh?! S-Seriously, ==PLAYER_NAME==, what are you talking about? What intuition? I never had any kind of intuition like that.
Boss, what did you just say to Noya? This is the first time I've ever seen her blush this hard.
It's nothing.==W== I just didn't want Noya to keep worrying.
Nazuka, Chitose, Nazuna, Fuyuka... And everyone else on their way to back us up.

Thank you all for getting here in time. It must've been tough coming all the way from Philae without sending a word. If you hadn't moved to back us up on your own, the Salvation Committee would've had us trapped here.
Boss, how... How do you know all that? Did Firenze contact you?
No. Let's just say that, as your Boss, and possibly the legendary Tyrant, I can see the future.
Since running away is useless, and I can't protect everyone this way...
Everyone is here... In terms of individual strength alone, we might even stand a chance against the Salvation Committee.
But ... I have no idea how many troops Angie mobilized this time. Plus, the children at the orphanage and the citizens of Mirage still need protection.
Even though the ancient book stated that I am the Tyrant, I have no right to drag innocent people into our battle.
And I definitely have no right to endanger my friends who have fought so hard for me. Therefore...
Running away is shameful but useful
The best defense is a good offense
Return to where it all began
Forgive me for letting you down again
Since we don't know the enemy's strength, let's evacuate the mine and pull back to Mirage to protect the orphanage and the citizens.
Regardless, this is between me, Boss Accord, and the Salvation Committee. Mirage shouldn't get caught in the crossfire.
Boss, Mirage is the home of the White Cats too. We will fight alongside you.
Thank you, Kasimira. And you too, Chaton and Benito.
Chitose, Nazuka, fill me in on everything that's happened over the past few days while we head out.
Yes, My ==SEX11==. We will catch you up on everything...
Everyone, Angie and her Salvation Committee may be coming in full force, but they're nothing to fear.
I already have a plan to beat them!
Listen up. We are going to utterly crush the Salvation Committee.
Huh? Boss, what are you talking about?==W== We only have...
It's more than enough.==W== As long as we get inside <color=#3faeae>that Monolith</color>, we can overcome their numbers and turn this entire war around.
Yeah. This is the only way I can protect everyone here in Mirage.
I put the Throne, which could no longer make a sound, into the pocket on my chest...

Wait, Noya! They aren't the enemy!
Chitose?! What are you doing here?
My ==SEX11==! And Noya! I've finally found you!
Scatter! Her strikes are heavy, and the tunnel is narrow. Do not bunch up!
I-I'm sorry! I don't want to fight you, but ... I cannot let you capture Master!
Smash those tin cans right into the wall!
To move that fast with such a heavy weapon... Girl, if only you used your talents to protect the peace of Nova.
Y-You're the ones destroying the peace! Master hasn't done anything wrong!
Talking makes you lose focus. Just as I thought.
Meet your end, Tyrant. If taking one life stops this madness, I will gladly bear the sins!
Hahaha! That makeup artist is amazing! She even rigged a teleport spell to this disguise!
You're not the Tyrant... Given your height... Nazuna from the Petal Bloom?
Oh? Am I that famous?==W== Wait, what do you mean "your height"?! I'm remembering your face, you drafty tin can!
Like I'd tell you! Come on, Fuyuka, let's bring down this entire tunnel!
O Western Wind, when wilt thou blow? When shall the gentle rain fall?

==Off==<color=#6fb1d2>A pale green breeze swirls around Nazuka.==RT==Soft yet unyielding,==RT==it forms a barrier against the searing yellow wind in the tunnel,==RT==keeping every grain of enchanted sand away from her companions.
Guided by her hand, threads of green energy seep into the hot wind, diverting the sands down an adjacent tunnel.
Nazuka... You're here too? When we last spoke, you were still in Philae. Were you actually...
Did you think I would sit around in Philae waiting? That is hardly my style.
We stayed in Philae to cover for you, but the Salvation Committee seemed to have somehow tracked you down in the desert, so we decided to sneak over and help.
We can discuss the details later. Now that we've found you, Nazuna and Fuyuka can drop the decoy act, and I can stop holding back!
I see them! Captain Greyhorn has the Tyrant surrounded, along with that frail, white-haired bodyguard next to ==SEX4==.
White hair? That's not right. None of the New Star Guild have white hair ... and neither do the heavy hitters in the White Cat Troupe.
Who did you actually see?==W== Ugh...!
The wind! I'm losing control of the air currents in the mine! Dang it, who has magic this strong?!
I hear howling! Everyone, grab onto something! Anything!
W-What a crazy wind! Whoever cast that must be furious.==W== Good thing I'm hauling all these heavy fries and ice cream, or I would've blown away too!
==PLAYER_NAME==, just how many ridiculously strong companions do you even have...?
Phew. All clean. Every last grain of that annoying sand has been blown out.
Boss, we're back!==W== Fuyuka caved the tunnel in and trapped that drafty tin can on the other side, along with a whole bunch of Imperial Guards and Sentinels of Dawn!
I-I'm sorry! I broke a lot of things. I heard this place belongs to the Desert Scorpions... Um... Should I pay for damages?
Whoa, even more Trekkers overflowing with dark power! And don't sweat the damages. If the Scorpions come knocking, I'll pay them back in bullets! Hehe.

Yes. Your companions from Philae,==W== your friend Minova from Emor,==W== and the witch, Mistique, from Scarlet Sights Media. We've all come to assist you, My ==SEX11==. They are on standby outside the city.
Even Ashwind is here... Are we really doing a final showdown with the Salvation Committee right here? Ugh... There's no way we win this.
Boss, what do we do next?
Wh-What should I do... What else ... can I do?
Even Ashwind is here... Are we really doing a final showdown with the Salvation Committee right here? Ugh... There's no way we win this.
Boss, what do we do next?
Running is useless. The decapitation strike is useless.
If I want to protect everyone, I have to utilize absolutely every piece of intel I gathered from the last two attempts.
I need to leave Angie in charge of the Committee, pick a battlefield that keeps the kids and citizens out of the crossfire, and force a showdown.
No wars of attrition. I'm going to wipe them all out in one fell swoop!
Even Ashwind is here... Are we really doing a final showdown with the Salvation Committee right here? Ugh... There's no way we win this.
Boss, what do we do next?
Um...==W== No wound on your shoulder?==W== Your ribs aren't hurt either, right?
Wh-Why are you asking that out of nowhere? Of course I'm not hurt!==W== You aren't trying to peek at my belly right here, are you...
Wh-Why are you hugging me all of a sudden?! Hey, hey, everyone is watching!
It's okay. It's okay. None of that is going to happen.
Noya, don't worry about your intuition. It's completely wrong. I promise you, I will never, ever leave you.
Huh? Ehhhhh?! S-Seriously, ==PLAYER_NAME==, what are you talking about? What intuition? I never had any kind of intuition like that.
Boss, what did you just say to Noya? This is the first time I've ever seen her blush this hard.
It's nothing.==W== I just didn't want Noya to keep worrying.
Nazuka, Chitose, Nazuna, Fuyuka... And everyone else on their way to back us up.

Thank you all for getting here in time. It must've been tough coming all the way from Philae without sending a word. If you hadn't moved to back us up on your own, the Salvation Committee would've had us trapped here.
Boss, how... How do you know all that? Did Firenze contact you?
No. Let's just say that, as your Boss, and possibly the legendary Tyrant, I can see the future.
Since running away is useless, and I can't protect everyone this way...
Even Ashwind is here... Are we really doing a final showdown with the Salvation Committee right here? Ugh... There's no way we win this.
Boss, what do we do next?
Everyone is here... In terms of individual strength alone, we might even stand a chance against the Salvation Committee.
But ... I have no idea how many troops Angie mobilized this time. Plus, the children at the orphanage and the citizens of Mirage still need protection.
Even though the ancient book stated that I am the Tyrant, I have no right to drag innocent people into our battle.
And I definitely have no right to endanger my friends who have fought so hard for me. Therefore...
Running away is shameful but useful
The best defense is a good offense
Return to where it all began
Forgive me for letting you down again
Since we don't know the enemy's strength, let's evacuate the mine and pull back to Mirage to protect the orphanage and the citizens.
Regardless, this is between me, Boss Accord, and the Salvation Committee. Mirage shouldn't get caught in the crossfire.
Boss, Mirage is the home of the White Cats too. We will fight alongside you.
Thank you, Kasimira. And you too, Chaton and Benito.
Chitose, Nazuka, fill me in on everything that's happened over the past few days while we head out.
Yes, My ==SEX11==. We will catch you up on everything...
Everyone, Angie and her Salvation Committee may be coming in full force, but they're nothing to fear.
I already have a plan to beat them!
Listen up. We are going to utterly crush the Salvation Committee.
Huh? Boss, what are you talking about?==W== We only have...
It's more than enough.==W== As long as we get inside <color=#3faeae>that Monolith</color>, we can overcome their numbers and turn this entire war around.
Yeah. This is the only way I can protect everyone here in Mirage.
I put the Throne, which could no longer make a sound, into the pocket on my chest...

strings.text: Ten days earlier. While the Philae disguise proceeds smoothly, Nazuka and Firenze secretly gather allies just in case. After a round of quick arrangements, the Petal Bloom Guild meets you without issue.
Th-That's all for today! Keep safe out there!
Phew. Okay, ==SEX=='s gone.==W== ==SEX1== won't reach out for a while, so we're clear to talk about "the plan."
My, my.==W== Everything is going perfectly, so why that tragic look on someone's face?
What? There's no tragic look! Yes, I miss hearing ==SEX3== voice every single day. But this is a necessary sacrifice! It means we get to stay together later!
Heh,==W== I was talking about Chitose.==W== But someone is a little eager to confess.
My ==SEX11==... The wisteria still blooms just as it did on the day we reunited. Yet, the rain has washed away the last traces of your presence.
I will survive the coming days by clinging to our shared memories. My longing will sustain me until we meet again.
See, Nazuka? Take notes.==W== Keep burying your feelings, and others are gonna swoop in. You'll be left completely in the dust.
Why does it end up like this...==W== I was the one who made a promise with ==SEX4== first... I was the first...!
<size=52>Nazuna! Wearing Boss's face does not give you a free pass to spout nonsense!</size>
Waaah!==W== Nazuka is angry! Hide me!
Please temper your anger, Lady Nazuka. There is no need to take Nazuna's teasing to heart.
You have never been dishonest about your feelings. I am certain my ==SEX11== understands your heart just by looking at you.
S-See? Exactly! Boss knows how I feel without me having to say it! See, Nazuna? Chitose gets it.
Um, Lady Nazuka, would you like a cold towel? Your face is glowing like a blade fresh from the forge.
Yep. A face like that really does say a thousand words.
Ahem. Let us settle down. I appreciate the high spirits, but we are on a tight schedule. Back to business.
Nyx, status on the anti-eavesdropping circle?
Airtight. Not even a fly is getting in. Whatever we say in this room stays in here.
Good. Now, the bad news. Our little decoy stunt didn't attract much attention. The Salvation Committee didn't take the bait.
Albedo met Nazuka and me last night...
I bring good news. Dusk Arbiter declaring the Salvation Committee heretics has triggered a wave of defections. We have secured a massive intelligence haul from the repentant members.
Angie has issued new orders. Committee members are mobilizing toward somewhere in the west of the Nova Empire.
The west? That makes no sense. Philae is in the south. If they wanted to hit us, they would be heading south.
We don't know the exact orders. However, their trajectory strongly indicates they have abandoned Philae as a target. The road to Emor should also be clear of their forces.
You should take this window to escort Boss to Emor. Clear ==SEX3== name at the conference this month, and you can all go back to your normal lives.
Thank you for the tip, but when and how Boss goes to Emor isn't something I can decide on my own. After daybreak, I'll discuss it with my companions.
Wait. The Salvation Committee is ignoring Philae? Why? Nazuka, you just said my acting was flawless!
It is not your fault, Nazuna. They did not ignore Philae because of your disguise.
Think about it. Even if they figured out you were a fake, how could they know the real Boss wasn't hiding here too?
The fact that they're mobilizing somewhere else means they've already tracked Boss down through other channels.
Master went to a desert in the west... Oh no, Master is in trouble! Just the four of them against an entire army!
That brings us to the real agenda. We use the "escort mission to Emor" as a cover, slip out, and head straight for the desert to back them up.
If the Salvation Committee isn't coming here, we absolutely should go. Even just to take off some of the pressure. But ... do we really need to keep them in the dark about it?
We have to, Kaede. You know how Boss is. If we just said, "Philae is safe, so we are coming to the desert," how do you think ==SEX=='d react?
==SEX1=='d shoot it down immediately. When we set up the decoy plan, ==SEX== didn't say much, but that look on ==SEX3== face... ==SEX1== was eaten up with guilt for dragging us into this.
Exactly. If ==SEX== knows we're safe here, ==SEX=='ll fight tooth and nail to keep us out of the crossfire. ==SEX1=='d never put us in danger.
Master ... is just trying to protect us.
My ==SEX11== coddles me far too much. I am a blade. My only purpose is to strike down my ==SEX11=='s enemies.
It's more than just wanting to protect us. ==SEX1== is the kind of leader who insists on taking every hit. ==SEX1=='ll throw ==SEX8== on the front line every time if it spares someone else.
And that is exactly why we became comrades who trust each other with our lives.
Keeping us out of danger is ==SEX3== choice. Showing up anyway is mine.
I'm a Trekker. I carve my own path. I refuse to sit around like some wilting greenhouse flower waiting to be watered.
We all know how strong the Salvation Committee is. This journey will be brutal. Nazuka and I called this meeting to gauge your resolve and lock in our roster.
You dragged us all the way out here just for that?
Like anyone in this room was ever going to say no.
My patience ran dry days ago. I am ready to march right now and take my place as my ==SEX11=='s vanguard.
I... I know I still have a lot to learn, but I am going to help Master no matter what!
Logistics are on me. Are we rolling out today? I need to start packing.
Well, keeping Nazuna looking like Boss on the road means constant touch-ups. Count me in.
Then the roster is set. We head out today, hitching a ride with the Imperial Guard convoy bound for Mirage.
Hehe, a covert rescue op! Think of the photo ops! But, uh... Not to ruin the mood, but aren't you forgetting a tiny detail?
According to your deal with Albedo, even on the road to Emor, Boss has to broadcast to Scarlet Sights Media every single day. Just to assure all Novians ==SEX=='s not out to end the world.
You cannot just detour into a desert with that restriction. And splitting the party? People are watching you. Missing faces will spark rumors instantly.
I have a solution for that. But I will need a favor, Mistique.
A favor? I would love to, but I am still a witch.
If someone catches me helping you, they will assume Boss Accord and Scarlet Sights Media are colluding. Your daily broadcasts would look staged.
It won't go that far. I just need you to deliver a letter.
I am a witch, not a courier...==W== Fine, whatever. Where to?
Emor's Ash District. Under the Waterway. The Ashwind Clan.
Lady Firenze. Two more days north and you will spot Emor's Monolith. My unit is hauling grain to Mirage, so we will be breaking west from here.
We appreciate the escort. Having your squad clear the monsters off the road saved us a lot of grief.
Don't mention it. You're paying the tab, and we're guarding the Boss of Boss Accord. It's the least we could do.
That fiercely dedicated young knight...==W== Tilia, correct?==W== She was spectacular during the Gale Owl battle yesterday.
Ahaha, she's actually still a squire! But with how she swings a sword, the brass will knight her soon enough.==W== Tilia! Get over here and thank Lady Firenze!
Thank you, Lady Firenze!==W== I was only doing my duty!
I'll write a letter of recommendation to the Imperial Guard. It should help with your promotion to a full knight. If there's anything else you need, please let me know.==W==
Um... There was actually something I wanted to ask you, if that's alright...==W==
I heard Emor is holding a conference to judge Boss's identity.==W== Is ==SEX== going to be okay?
==SEX1=='ll be fine. I've known ==SEX4== for a long time.==W== ==SEX1== has absolutely no interest in "ending the world."
Grace Imperium and the company reps aren't fools. They won't buy the Salvation Committee's slander. They'll clear ==SEX3== name.
T-That's a relief! If you need someone to testify, I'll do it! I can swear on record that ==SEX=='s a good person!

Well, we've crossed paths a few times! We haven't really talked,==W== but you can just tell by looking at ==SEX4==! ==SEX1== fights for justice, just as I do! I'll stake my honor as a squire on it...==W==
Staking honor as a squire? And testifying?==W== This isn't going to drag the Imperial Guard into it, is it?!
Let's go! Stop bothering Lady Firenze!==W== Ahaha, I'm so sorry.==W== That's just how the kid is. Once she starts talking about justice, she never stops.
Heh heh, it's quite alright. I'll pass your support on to Boss, Tilia. We might just hold you to that testimony.
Well then, Lady Firenze, this is where we part ways. Safe travels.
I've heard the Salvation Committee is mobilizing in a similar direction to your route. Please be careful.
Thank you for the warning, but I doubt they'd waste their time on a simple grain convoy...
Oh! No!==W== It's the Salvation Committee!
Box them in!==W== Kill the Tyrant!
Master, let's go!==W== I'll protect you!
Captain, contact Dusk Arbiter, hurry! Report to them that we were attacked by the Salvation Committee! I'm going after Boss.
Should we go help, too? A lot of people from the Committee have arrived, and they've all rushed into the forest!
Help what?! We're hauling grain to Mirage, not playing bodyguard for the Boss!
I don't want to hear it. We follow Lady Firenze's orders. Tilia, get to Emor right now. Report this to the Dusk Arbiter and United Harvest Philae!

(Was that really the Salvation Committee...?==W== I don't know about the others... But there's no way that swordswoman would be pushed back by such weak attacks. It almost feels like it was staged...)
(Nope, stop overthinking this. Let the big shots play their games. Us grunts are better off staying blind and deaf to this kind of stuff!)
So the Ashwind Clan played the Committee, the Guards played the witnesses, and you faked my kidnapping in the Wilds just to sneak into Mirage.==W== Did I get that right?
Precisely.==W== Lady Firenze also asked me to pass along a message, my ==SEX11==.
She noted that any clash with the Salvation Committee near Mirage would inevitably draw attention. We needed a convincing reason for you to suddenly appear here instead of Philae.
Without it, people would realize the Boss they saw back in Philae was a decoy. That would severely damage public trust in you.
Yeah, that's true. I didn't expect Angie to corner me in Mirage. Firenze really thinks of everything. So what happened after you hit the desert?
I was going to use Heartlink to contact you right away,==W== but Mistique spotted the Committee's forces way too close to us.
Word is the Dusk Arbiter has ways to tap into local Heartlinks. We figured the Committee might too, so we stayed off the network and just tailed them.
We watched them set up camp on the dunes outside Mirage and send a squad down here.
So we followed them inside and bumped right into their scouting spell. I used my own magic to block theirs while using the wind to search for you. Luckily, I got here just in time.
So that green mist was you. Where are the others?
Firenze and Nyx split off as soon as we spotted the Committee.==W== They headed to Emor to hire the Imperial Guard, and contact Dusk Arbiter to be our backup.
Kaede, Itoha, Minova, and Mistique stayed behind in the dunes,==W== on standby to get us out.==W== That's the whole rundown.
Except it's too dangerous for us, right?==W== I knew you were gonna say that!
Look, of course we know the risks.==W== But we...==W== We had to come! We all agreed on that!
Ah... Uh... I actually wasn't going to say that.
You weren't?! Then why the dramatic pause?!
Because it was cute seeing you like that. You don't usually get this worked up, Nazuka.
I did. And you're not entirely wrong. A few weeks ago, I definitely would have tried to bench you for your own safety. But...
I've been an idiot. I was so focused on keeping all of you safe, I forgot you wanted to keep me safe too.
Keep your head up! Don't underestimate us. Everyone in Philae has been to hell and back with you.
Noya knocked some sense into me earlier. Trying to push you guys away was an insult to those who care about me.
So, I'm happy you are here!
Nazuka, Chitose, Nazuna, Fuyuka, I need your help. Let's fight our way out of here together!
No problem. But hey, Boss, don't leave us hanging. What were you actually gonna say earlier?
Oh, just that your little "kidnapping" act isn't going to fool anyone with half a brain.==W== Everyone knows how strong you are. You'd never fold that easily.
Haha! That's 'cause Nazuka is a terrible actress!==W== "Oh! No!==W== It's the Salvation Committee!"
As if the Trekker who soloed the Blade of Jade would actually squeal over a few random grunts!
I couldn't actually fight back!==W== I did my best!
Forgive me, my ==SEX11==. My performance was equally unconvincing.
Don't sweat it. The smart ones won't interfere anyway. They'll just hang back and wait to see who survives.
Boss, we're at the exit. Bad news though, the streets are crawling with Committee grunts.
Focus on reaching Daisy Orphanage. Ignore everything else.
We lock that down, and the Tyrant has no choice but to face us.
Oh god, they're going for the orphanage! Boss, keep the kids safe! I'll hold them off!
Huh? Kids, what are you doing?
Mom, here.==W== Take Loxy's keys and get the others out of here.
Absolutely not! I am not letting you risk your lives!
Mom, please. The younger ones need you. You're the only one who can get them evacuated fast enough.
Benito, rally the rest of the White Cats and guard the kids. Chaton and I are staying here. You three can't hold this line alone.
Nazuna, Fuyuka, get Boss out of here. I'm staying. My wind walls can buy us time. Are you good with this, Boss?
No time to second-guess this. We know too little right now. Angie really caught us off guard this time.
The rest of us can handle the orphanage. Chitose, stay with them. It's time to draw your blade.
We just need twenty minutes! After that, fall back to the Eureka Bar!
Move! Daisy Orphanage is right at the end of the block!
Hold. As long as I draw breath, you will not take a single step further!
One of the Tyrant's lackeys. Lady Angie only asked for the Tyrant's head, but if you're that eager to die, we'll gladly oblige!
I offer you slumber granted by the wild spirits.
Gah! The wind's too strong! Cast a counter magic!
Tch. She actually forced the cast out before she fell.
Heads up, Chitose! These guys aren't your average Trekkers. They're actually trained for this!
Don't let them stop you. Get to the orphanage!==W== Pin them down and have the rest flank around!
They're splitting up. Chaton, on me! We're intercepting the flankers!
Heheheh! Prepare to get a taste of the great Chaton's dark power!!
There are so many of them... Can we actually hold this line?
Iris, Amber, we're diving straight into the mob! If we cause enough chaos, they won't have time to go after Mom and ==PLAYER_NAME==!
I'll take on the tough ones.

Thank you, Lady Firenze!==W== I was only doing my duty!
I'll write a letter of recommendation to the Imperial Guard. It should help with your promotion to a full knight. If there's anything else you need, please let me know.==W==
Um... There was actually something I wanted to ask you, if that's alright...==W==
I heard Emor is holding a conference to judge Boss's identity.==W== Is ==SEX== going to be okay?
==SEX1=='ll be fine. I've known ==SEX4== for a long time.==W== ==SEX1== has absolutely no interest in "ending the world."
Grace Imperium and the company reps aren't fools. They won't buy the Salvation Committee's slander. They'll clear ==SEX3== name.
T-That's a relief! If you need someone to testify, I'll do it! I can swear on record that ==SEX=='s a good person!

Well, we've crossed paths a few times! We haven't really talked,==W== but you can just tell by looking at ==SEX4==! ==SEX1== fights for justice, just as I do! I'll stake my honor as a squire on it...==W==
Staking honor as a squire? And testifying?==W== This isn't going to drag the Imperial Guard into it, is it?!
Let's go! Stop bothering Lady Firenze!==W== Ahaha, I'm so sorry.==W== That's just how the kid is. Once she starts talking about justice, she never stops.
Heh heh, it's quite alright. I'll pass your support on to Boss, Tilia. We might just hold you to that testimony.
Well then, Lady Firenze, this is where we part ways. Safe travels.
I've heard the Salvation Committee is mobilizing in a similar direction to your route. Please be careful.
Thank you for the warning, but I doubt they'd waste their time on a simple grain convoy...
Oh! No!==W== It's the Salvation Committee!
Box them in!==W== Kill the Tyrant!
Master, let's go!==W== I'll protect you!
Captain, contact Dusk Arbiter, hurry! Report to them that we were attacked by the Salvation Committee! I'm going after Boss.
Should we go help, too? A lot of people from the Committee have arrived, and they've all rushed into the forest!
Help what?! We're hauling grain to Mirage, not playing bodyguard for the Boss!
I don't want to hear it. We follow Lady Firenze's orders. Tilia, get to Emor right now. Report this to the Dusk Arbiter and United Harvest Philae!

(Was that really the Salvation Committee...?==W== I don't know about the others... But there's no way that swordswoman would be pushed back by such weak attacks. It almost feels like it was staged...)
(Nope, stop overthinking this. Let the big shots play their games. Us grunts are better off staying blind and deaf to this kind of stuff!)
So the Ashwind Clan played the Committee, the Guards played the witnesses, and you faked my kidnapping in the Wilds just to sneak into Mirage.==W== Did I get that right?
Precisely.==W== Lady Firenze also asked me to pass along a message, my ==SEX11==.
She noted that any clash with the Salvation Committee near Mirage would inevitably draw attention. We needed a convincing reason for you to suddenly appear here instead of Philae.
Without it, people would realize the Boss they saw back in Philae was a decoy. That would severely damage public trust in you.
Yeah, that's true. I didn't expect Angie to corner me in Mirage. Firenze really thinks of everything. So what happened after you hit the desert?
I was going to use Heartlink to contact you right away,==W== but Mistique spotted the Committee's forces way too close to us.
Word is the Dusk Arbiter has ways to tap into local Heartlinks. We figured the Committee might too, so we stayed off the network and just tailed them.
We watched them set up camp on the dunes outside Mirage and send a squad down here.
So we followed them inside and bumped right into their scouting spell. I used my own magic to block theirs while using the wind to search for you. Luckily, I got here just in time.
So that green mist was you. Where are the others?
Firenze and Nyx split off as soon as we spotted the Committee.==W== They headed to Emor to hire the Imperial Guard, and contact Dusk Arbiter to be our backup.
Kaede, Itoha, Minova, and Mistique stayed behind in the dunes,==W== on standby to get us out.==W== That's the whole rundown.
Except it's too dangerous for us, right?==W== I knew you were gonna say that!
Look, of course we know the risks.==W== But we...==W== We had to come! We all agreed on that!
Ah... Uh... I actually wasn't going to say that.
You weren't?! Then why the dramatic pause?!
Because it was cute seeing you like that. You don't usually get this worked up, Nazuka.
I did. And you're not entirely wrong. A few weeks ago, I definitely would have tried to bench you for your own safety. But...
I've been an idiot. I was so focused on keeping all of you safe, I forgot you wanted to keep me safe too.
Keep your head up! Don't underestimate us. Everyone in Philae has been to hell and back with you.
Noya knocked some sense into me earlier. Trying to push you guys away was an insult to those who care about me.
So, I'm happy you are here!
Nazuka, Chitose, Nazuna, Fuyuka, I need your help. Let's fight our way out of here together!
No problem. But hey, Boss, don't leave us hanging. What were you actually gonna say earlier?
Oh, just that your little "kidnapping" act isn't going to fool anyone with half a brain.==W== Everyone knows how strong you are. You'd never fold that easily.
Haha! That's 'cause Nazuka is a terrible actress!==W== "Oh! No!==W== It's the Salvation Committee!"
As if the Trekker who soloed the Blade of Jade would actually squeal over a few random grunts!
I couldn't actually fight back!==W== I did my best!
Forgive me, my ==SEX11==. My performance was equally unconvincing.
Don't sweat it. The smart ones won't interfere anyway. They'll just hang back and wait to see who survives.
Boss, we're at the exit. Bad news though, the streets are crawling with Committee grunts.
Focus on reaching Daisy Orphanage. Ignore everything else.
We lock that down, and the Tyrant has no choice but to face us.
Oh god, they're going for the orphanage! Boss, keep the kids safe! I'll hold them off!
Huh? Kids, what are you doing?
Mom, here.==W== Take Loxy's keys and get the others out of here.
Absolutely not! I am not letting you risk your lives!
Mom, please. The younger ones need you. You're the only one who can get them evacuated fast enough.
Benito, rally the rest of the White Cats and guard the kids. Chaton and I are staying here. You three can't hold this line alone.
Nazuna, Fuyuka, get Boss out of here. I'm staying. My wind walls can buy us time. Are you good with this, Boss?
No time to second-guess this. We know too little right now. Angie really caught us off guard this time.
The rest of us can handle the orphanage. Chitose, stay with them. It's time to draw your blade.
We just need twenty minutes! After that, fall back to the Eureka Bar!
Move! Daisy Orphanage is right at the end of the block!
Hold. As long as I draw breath, you will not take a single step further!
One of the Tyrant's lackeys. Lady Angie only asked for the Tyrant's head, but if you're that eager to die, we'll gladly oblige!
I offer you slumber granted by the wild spirits.
Gah! The wind's too strong! Cast a counter magic!
Tch. She actually forced the cast out before she fell.
Heads up, Chitose! These guys aren't your average Trekkers. They're actually trained for this!
Don't let them stop you. Get to the orphanage!==W== Pin them down and have the rest flank around!
They're splitting up. Chaton, on me! We're intercepting the flankers!
Heheheh! Prepare to get a taste of the great Chaton's dark power!!
There are so many of them... Can we actually hold this line?
Iris, Amber, we're diving straight into the mob! If we cause enough chaos, they won't have time to go after Mom and ==PLAYER_NAME==!
I'll take on the tough ones.

strings.text: After returning from the White Room, you decide to use your information advantage to capture Angie and end the battle. Claiming Laru provided the intel, you reveal the enemy setup and lay out a flawless plan…
You actually have a plan to beat them? But... We don't even know their numbers.
I know. Let's walk and talk. I'll brief you on the way.
Right now, the Salvation Committee has three hundred combatants stationed outside the city, split into three companies.
Greyhorn leads the First Company. She excels at defensive magic and tracking, but she's with Imperial Guard, not the Committee. She's just following orders, so she might not fight to the death.
Right now, her unit is trapped in the mineshaft that Fuyuka and Nazuna destroyed. It'll take them twenty minutes to dig out.
No. 160 leads the Second Company. She's an arbiter from the Dusk Arbiters.==W== If she takes damage, she triggers a unique time-stop magic.
Time stop?==W== That's impossible. Not even a grand mage can stop time.
It's not a true time stop.==W== Her magic just locks whatever is in her line of sight==W== for a short window.
But to her victims, it feels like time has stopped.==W== Also, she can eavesdrop on nearby Heartlink frequencies.
She can actually eavesdrop on Heartlinks... Firenze was right... That explains why she kept us off our phones the entire trip.
Exactly. Because you stayed off the grid, the Committee has no idea you're at Mirage. We still have the element of surprise.
Let me repeat. No Heartlinks until 160 is out of the picture.
Gunhild leads the Third Company. She uses a long-range magic cannon called Piercer.==W== Once it grazes you, it locks on,==W== even tracks you through walls.
Whoa, isn't that just a video game cheat code?==W== Wallhacks are completely unfair!
Piercer has a precise range of five kilometers. Her unit is locked down on the dunes outside Mirage.
Five kilometers... Our best White Cat rifles barely cover a fifth of that.
They can snipe us from afar, but we can't shoot back. We're sitting ducks.
On top of that, the Desert Scorpions and the local Imperial Guard will eventually cave to Committee pressure and switch sides.
So we aren't just fighting three hundred enemies.==W== We're looking at a thousand.
Even with the White Cats, we only have sixty to seventy people. Sixty or seventy against a thousand…
Th-That's an overwhelming disadvantage, Master. Should we just run instead?
Last time,==W== I lacked intel. I played it safe, avoided combat,==W== and focused entirely on getting everyone out.
Angie stalled me for too long,==W== and we were crushed by their sheer numbers and resources.
But now, the entire board is visible to me.
I need to exploit this information gap. If we leverage everyone's strengths for a lightning strike, the Committee won't even have time to react.
If it were just us, making a safe retreat would be easy. Once we disappear into the desert, not even a thousand troops could find us.
But we have the kids at Daisy Orphanage to consider, not to mention the innocent citizens of Mirage caught in the crossfire.
We can't safely evacuate that many people this quickly.==W== The fastest way to crush the Committee ...==W== is to capture Angie.
Seizing the general's head from amidst her grand army. I understand, my ==SEX11==.
Hold on. "Capture Angie to end the fight" makes logical sense, sure, but ... how exactly do we pull that off?
And another thing, how do you know all this? It's almost like...
Like a grand tactician from the war chronicle. You calculate the fate of the world without ever leaving your tent.
Uh... Valid point. How do I explain this...? I can't tell them about the White Room.
Ah, I've got it!==W== Bastelina, Laru, I'm borrowing your names for a second.
I have allies inside the Salvation Committee. They've been secretly feeding me this intel.
Ah, that explains it. Good to know there are still some reasonable people over there.
To my companions and our friends in the White Cats... Would you trust me and follow my lead?
I promise to keep everyone safe. We'll capture Angie, and we'll end this.
It's a little late to be asking that...==W== Boss, we're with you. Just give the order.
You've done so much for the White Cats. We're absolutely on your side.
Besides, this is our home. Protecting Mirage is our duty.
Boss, the mine exit is dead ahead. It leads straight up to the main street in central Mirage.
Good. We set our ambush here.
No. 160 is marching the Second Company toward Daisy Orphanage. They want to force us into a head-on fight, teeing us up for their snipers.
The orphanage?! They target children too? Boss, please let me go back. I have to protect them.
Easy, Allie. We keep the fighting away from the orphanage. We're going to crush them right here on this street.
Noya, Iris, Amber. As soon as the Second Company shows up, you three charge in as the vanguard. Break their formation, but ignore the arbiter leading them.
U-Us? Back in Philae, it took a whole group of us to capture ten Committee members. W-We can't beat an entire company!
Your goal isn't to win. It's to protect yourselves and draw their fire.
Nazuka, Chitose, Kasimira. While Noya's team distracts them, you flank from behind and wipe them out.
I've marked their probable positions on this paper.
This is incredibly detailed... Boss, your informants are impressive.
Noya, you dictate the timing. Give the signal, and everyone charges.
Got it! Sounds super easy. We'll pincer them and go bam, bam, bam! Send 'em all flying!
One more thing, Noya. When you reach the end of the main street, be very careful. Don't take the main road. Take this alleyway instead.
The main road is a sniper lane. Please be careful. Don't get hurt.
You're so tense, ==PLAYER_NAME==! Relax, my intuition is top-notch. Even if a sniper aims at me, I can just whoosh right out of the way!
Next, Nazuna, head to the mine exit near the First Company. Prioritize your safety, but look for someone in a Grace Imperium uniform carrying a spear and an absurd amount of fries.
Her name is Laru, she's my informant. Tell her I've received her intel. Then, ask her to pass a message to Angie: tell her I want to negotiate, and she can pick the location.
<size=52>N-Negotiate?</size> Angie literally wants you dead! Why would you negotiate with her?
I'm just using myself as bait to lure her out.
Fuyuka, lie in ambush in this section of the mineshaft. The second I ping you on the Heartlink, smash upward and shatter the ground above you.
Understood, Master. I'll give it everything I've got!
Benito, please take the other White Cats and organize the evacuation of Mirage's citizens. Keep an eye on the kids from Daisy Orphanage, too.
And finally, the wielder of dark power, the great Chaton.
Oh? Have you finally come to appreciate my dark power? State your mission. I shall see it done.
Sneak out of Mirage and reach the dunes five kilometers out. You need to be there before 14:30.
My companions are out there. A blue-haired girl on a skateboard named Minova, a ninja master of disguise named Otoha, and a woman with a sword and shield named Kaede.
Get in touch with any of them. Tell them not to alert the enemy. They need to call off their attack on the Third Company and wait for backup.
Understood! The great Chaton is off!
Nazuka, Nazuna. Once your tasks are done, head straight for those dunes.
I'm going to bring a long-overdue "rain" down on those dunes.
You made quite the commander just now, Tyrant. Like the true supreme commander of the Tyrant Army.
I do have one question, though. Would you mind enlightening me?
We have a minute before the fighting starts. What's on your mind?
Despite how it ended, your escape plan in the previous timeline was a strategic success.
If Lady Noya hadn't been injured... If you had just tweaked your route a fraction, you could have made it out.
If it were up to me, I would have just adjusted the original plan to ensure everyone got out safely.
Why scrap the whole thing just to capture Angie?
Because running won't stop them. The Salvation Committee has the numbers and supplies to hunt us into the Monolith or the desert. And Firenze and the Dusk Arbiters are still over a day away.
I can't protect everyone while we're on the run.
True, but you can always try again, can't you? There has to be a timeline where everyone makes it out unharmed.
And watch my closest friends die right in front of me ... over and over again?
Heh. That's literal torture. I'm not strong enough for that.
Besides. Even if the Angie in this timeline hasn't done anything yet, I still want her to pay. Pay for what she did to Noya!
I understand. You truly are a great Tyrant who deeply values your people.
I will leave you to it, then. I wish you a resounding victory.
Boss, who are you talking to?
Ah, nothing. Just ... thinking out loud to my phone.
Are we really just going to wait here? Shouldn't we check on the kids at the orphanage first?
Trust me. That arbiter will show up here alone any minute now. When she does, I need you to knock her out without hurting her.
Move! Daisy Orphanage is right at the end of the block!
One of the Tyrant's lackeys. Lady Angie only asked for the Tyrant's head, but if you're that eager to die, we'll gladly oblige!
Wearing Sentinel of Dawn uniforms, yet all you do is bully children.
Don't let them stop you. Get to the orphanage!==W== Pin them down and have the rest flank around!
Iris, Amber! Charge in and break their formation!
Got it. Defensive magic is ready.
