strings.text: At the bathhouse, you hear that Olympia has freed the city's slaves. Disguised as a slave, Elis scouts an escape route through the sewers. Before you try to escape, Alina asks about resurrection magic.
We have arrived, ==SEX12== Acolyte. Welcome to the Olympia Bathhouse, named in honor of the Archon.
This is our attendant, Lulu. She will see to your needs.
A pleasure. May the God of Magic watch over you both.
The sun is unforgiving today in Filanis. Please, try our signature iced honey brew. It will help you cool off.
And here is fresh linen steeped in chamomile, to clean your hands.
Before she even finishes, pitch-black phantom arms materialize around us.==W== They balance clay cups and towels, presenting them with eerie precision.
Hehe, I hope that didn't startle you. Shaping magic into limbs is a specialty of mine. It lets me do the work of an entire staff.
Oh, forgive me. I got carried away and forgot to ask your names.
This is my master, Acolyte ==PLAYER_NAME==. And I'm ==SEX3== personal slave, Elis.
Master...?==W== Slave...?==W== Captain Alina, wait! Why is there a slave here?
Are slaves forbidden here? Even in Emor, a slave goes wherever their master commands.
Lulu, they aren't from Filanis. It's a unique situation. Go prepare the baths. I'll handle things here.
<size=35>Looks so dignified, yet still keeps slaves. What a vile parasite.
Hey! What was that? Watch your tongue around my Master!
I apologize on Lulu's behalf. Given her past, she has zero tolerance for slave owners.
Excuse me? Every Novian household keeps slaves. Don't tell me Filanis has none?
Years ago, our ruler, Archon Olympia, freed every slave in the city==RT==and granted them full citizenship.
Since then, we are bound only by goodwill and camaraderie.==RT==That is how Filanis flourished into the City of Perfection.
Y-You freed all of them? Then who does the actual work?
Archon Olympia created magical puppets. They handle all the labor the slaves used to do.
Puppets? Wait, were those things in the forest...
Yes, those were abandoned puppets from Filanis.
They are carved from wood. Without magic, they're no different from ordinary puppets.
Citizens leave broken puppets in the forest to return to nature. I'm still investigating why those ones became animated and attacked us.
We're losing time. Please bathe quickly. Your audience with Archon Olympia is approaching.
If you have more questions about Filanis, we can speak at length afterward.
Alina, thank you for arranging all this. Is there any way I can repay you?
(The same applies to the Night Watcher. Drop the polite facade. It breaks character. But if she serves you well, offer a suitable reward.)
Elis said I needed to act like I was in charge. I hope that sounded right.
It's my duty, ==SEX12== Acolyte.==W== But I do have a favor to ask. If you have time after your audience with the Archon, I'd like your guidance on a magical matter.
Phew...==W== This is heaven. I'm finally coming back to life.
The hot water is making my skin tingle. Every aching muscle is relaxed.
Where am I?==W== Why do Elis and Alina look so familiar? What do I say to the Archon? Alina wants magic advice, but I don't know any magic. How do I even get back...
These questions...==W== I don't want to think about them right now. I just want to float here until I slowly dissolve.
Okay, it's not that I don't care.==W== I just need this break.
Oh, something is scrubbing my back. That feels incredible. Does this bath have a massage spell on it? The people of Filanis really know how to enjoy life.
Wait a minute. How could a rustic bath have massage jets?!
Hold on! When did you get in here? Weren't we given separate baths?
Oh, don't be shy, Master. You have fair skin and lovely collarbones. Be more confident!
Oh, don't be shy, Master. I've wrapped myself tight in a towel, so you won't see anything improper. As for your perfect physique, there's no need to hide it.
We're both girls anyway. What's the harm in sharing a soak?
You're a man, after all. Be brave!
Besides, I'm your slave. It's only natural for a slave to wash her Master's back, isn't it?
N-Natural? We're only pretending to be master and slave to fool the locals. I don't even like the idea of slaves, let alone need one.
Oh? Master hates the idea of slavery just as much as the locals do. Why is that?
Why should anyone own another person? It just feels wrong. I don't need a better reason than that.
What about you? If you needed a cover, you could have been a friend or a traveling companion. Why insist on being a slave?
Because it's practical. You said owning another person felt wrong. But what if Novians don't consider slaves as people in the first place?
Heh. At the markets in Emor, a horse fetches a much higher price than a slave. To most Novians, a slave is nothing but an object.
And being an object has its advantages.
Well, nobody looks twice at an object.==W== And that to me is the greatest advantage.
If I called myself your companion, I'd have to invent a flawless backstory. One that would crumble under scrutiny, given I'm a Fallen Saintess who spent three years locked in a tower.
But as a slave? I only need your nod of approval. People will focus all their scrutiny on you, because I am simply something you own.
Hey now. You actually thought this all through. I can't tell if you're incredibly cunning or just completely reckless.
What if I refused to play along? Or what if I was dangerous?
You were a corpse when I found you, so I had nothing to fear.==W== You waking up did give me a fright, but I watched you closely before deciding to keep up the act.
You're gentle, kind, clever, and completely harmless.==W== The best person I've ever met~
Ugh. Why does that feel like an insult?!
That's why playing your slave was risk-free.==W== I even bet you wouldn't treat me like an object. And I was right.
By the way, this is my first time playing a slave. I'm doing a flawless job, aren't I? Where's my praise?
You could at least pretend to mean it!
Elis, you didn't sneak into my bath just to chat and act cute, did you?
Haha, I got a little too into character. Almost forgot why I came.
We meet the Archon after this. Our act might fool a backwater Night Watcher, but it won't hold up against the Archon.
There's no escaping. Those black magic arms are watching the doors and windows. They call it service, but it's clearly surveillance.
Heh heh, another slave perk!==W== Lulu was watching us,==W== but the second I said I was going to "serve my Master," she turned bright red and let me pass out of pure disgust.
She might despise slave owners, but deep down? She still views me as an object.
Right now, that sweet girl is probably imagining us doing all sorts of unspeakable things in here.==W== She wouldn't dare peek.
She actually is a bit like Iris there, but Iris would never be this bold.==W== She could never pull off a lie like this.
What's wrong with being practical? Besides...==W== Even as a Saintess, I was just treated like…
Nothing! Anyway, I found a drainage pipe that leads outside while I was sneaking over.
Go out to the front and talk to the Night Watcher. Didn't she have a question for you?==W== Use that to keep her distracted.
I'll slip through the drain and cause a scene in the streets. Once she runs off to investigate, you just stroll right out the front door.
Solid plan. It's just Alina and Lulu out there. If we split up...==W== They'll definitely chase the suspected Fallen Saintess first.
But wouldn't that put a massive target on your back?
Don't worry about me, Master. I spent my three years hiding in that tower studying magic day and night.
Alright, I'm dressed. Elis should be in the drains by now.
Now for Alina...==W== Ah, there she is.
<size=75>Merciful and almighty Goddess Trivia, hear my prayer.
<size=75>Take my fallen sisters into the high heavens,==RT==that they may soar upon the twelve winds.
Is she ... praying to the Monolith?
Oh, my apologies. I was praying to the Goddess. I didn't notice you, ==SEX12== Acolyte.
No harm done. The bathhouse was perfect. It washed all my exhaustion right away.
Didn't you have a question for me? We still have time before we meet the Archon. Ask away.
Alina hesitates, which is rare for her.==RT==She casts several long glances at the towering Monolith,==RT==as if searching for a revelation from fate.
The Monolith just stands there in silence.==RT==It doesn't listen to mortal doubts,==RT==and it certainly offers no answers.
My question may be ...==W== stepping out of line. If it offends you, I apologize in advance.
Could you tell me about the <color=#3faeae>resurrection magic</color>?
<size=50>Name your price...==W== I'll give you anything I have!

param: At the bathhouse, you hear that Olympia has freed the city's slaves. Disguised as a slave, Elis scouts an escape route through the sewers. Before you try to escape, Alina asks about resurrection magic.
We have arrived, ==SEX12== Acolyte. Welcome to the Olympia Bathhouse, named in honor of the Archon.
This is our attendant, Lulu. She will see to your needs.
A pleasure. May the God of Magic watch over you both.
The sun is unforgiving today in Filanis. Please, try our signature iced honey brew. It will help you cool off.
And here is fresh linen steeped in chamomile, to clean your hands.
Before she even finishes, pitch-black phantom arms materialize around us.==W== They balance clay cups and towels, presenting them with eerie precision.
Hehe, I hope that didn't startle you. Shaping magic into limbs is a specialty of mine. It lets me do the work of an entire staff.
Oh, forgive me. I got carried away and forgot to ask your names.
This is my master, Acolyte ==PLAYER_NAME==. And I'm ==SEX3== personal slave, Elis.
Master...?==W== Slave...?==W== Captain Alina, wait! Why is there a slave here?
Are slaves forbidden here? Even in Emor, a slave goes wherever their master commands.
Lulu, they aren't from Filanis. It's a unique situation. Go prepare the baths. I'll handle things here.
<size=35>Looks so dignified, yet still keeps slaves. What a vile parasite.
Hey! What was that? Watch your tongue around my Master!
I apologize on Lulu's behalf. Given her past, she has zero tolerance for slave owners.
Excuse me? Every Novian household keeps slaves. Don't tell me Filanis has none?
Years ago, our ruler, Archon Olympia, freed every slave in the city==RT==and granted them full citizenship.
Since then, we are bound only by goodwill and camaraderie.==RT==That is how Filanis flourished into the City of Perfection.
Y-You freed all of them? Then who does the actual work?
Archon Olympia created magical puppets. They handle all the labor the slaves used to do.
Puppets? Wait, were those things in the forest...
Yes, those were abandoned puppets from Filanis.
They are carved from wood. Without magic, they're no different from ordinary puppets.
Citizens leave broken puppets in the forest to return to nature. I'm still investigating why those ones became animated and attacked us.
We're losing time. Please bathe quickly. Your audience with Archon Olympia is approaching.
If you have more questions about Filanis, we can speak at length afterward.
Alina, thank you for arranging all this. Is there any way I can repay you?
(The same applies to the Night Watcher. Drop the polite facade. It breaks character. But if she serves you well, offer a suitable reward.)
Elis said I needed to act like I was in charge. I hope that sounded right.
It's my duty, ==SEX12== Acolyte.==W== But I do have a favor to ask. If you have time after your audience with the Archon, I'd like your guidance on a magical matter.
Phew...==W== This is heaven. I'm finally coming back to life.
The hot water is making my skin tingle. Every aching muscle is relaxed.
Where am I?==W== Why do Elis and Alina look so familiar? What do I say to the Archon? Alina wants magic advice, but I don't know any magic. How do I even get back...
These questions...==W== I don't want to think about them right now. I just want to float here until I slowly dissolve.
Okay, it's not that I don't care.==W== I just need this break.
Oh, something is scrubbing my back. That feels incredible. Does this bath have a massage spell on it? The people of Filanis really know how to enjoy life.
Wait a minute. How could a rustic bath have massage jets?!
Hold on! When did you get in here? Weren't we given separate baths?
Oh, don't be shy, Master. You have fair skin and lovely collarbones. Be more confident!
Oh, don't be shy, Master. I've wrapped myself tight in a towel, so you won't see anything improper. As for your perfect physique, there's no need to hide it.
We're both girls anyway. What's the harm in sharing a soak?
You're a man, after all. Be brave!
Besides, I'm your slave. It's only natural for a slave to wash her Master's back, isn't it?
N-Natural? We're only pretending to be master and slave to fool the locals. I don't even like the idea of slaves, let alone need one.
Oh? Master hates the idea of slavery just as much as the locals do. Why is that?
Why should anyone own another person? It just feels wrong. I don't need a better reason than that.
What about you? If you needed a cover, you could have been a friend or a traveling companion. Why insist on being a slave?
Because it's practical. You said owning another person felt wrong. But what if Novians don't consider slaves as people in the first place?
Heh. At the markets in Emor, a horse fetches a much higher price than a slave. To most Novians, a slave is nothing but an object.
And being an object has its advantages.
Well, nobody looks twice at an object.==W== And that to me is the greatest advantage.
If I called myself your companion, I'd have to invent a flawless backstory. One that would crumble under scrutiny, given I'm a Fallen Saintess who spent three years locked in a tower.
But as a slave? I only need your nod of approval. People will focus all their scrutiny on you, because I am simply something you own.
Hey now. You actually thought this all through. I can't tell if you're incredibly cunning or just completely reckless.
What if I refused to play along? Or what if I was dangerous?
You were a corpse when I found you, so I had nothing to fear.==W== You waking up did give me a fright, but I watched you closely before deciding to keep up the act.
You're gentle, kind, clever, and completely harmless.==W== The best person I've ever met~
Ugh. Why does that feel like an insult?!
That's why playing your slave was risk-free.==W== I even bet you wouldn't treat me like an object. And I was right.
By the way, this is my first time playing a slave. I'm doing a flawless job, aren't I? Where's my praise?
You could at least pretend to mean it!
Elis, you didn't sneak into my bath just to chat and act cute, did you?
Haha, I got a little too into character. Almost forgot why I came.
We meet the Archon after this. Our act might fool a backwater Night Watcher, but it won't hold up against the Archon.
There's no escaping. Those black magic arms are watching the doors and windows. They call it service, but it's clearly surveillance.
Heh heh, another slave perk!==W== Lulu was watching us,==W== but the second I said I was going to "serve my Master," she turned bright red and let me pass out of pure disgust.
She might despise slave owners, but deep down? She still views me as an object.
Right now, that sweet girl is probably imagining us doing all sorts of unspeakable things in here.==W== She wouldn't dare peek.
She actually is a bit like Iris there, but Iris would never be this bold.==W== She could never pull off a lie like this.
What's wrong with being practical? Besides...==W== Even as a Saintess, I was just treated like…
Nothing! Anyway, I found a drainage pipe that leads outside while I was sneaking over.
Go out to the front and talk to the Night Watcher. Didn't she have a question for you?==W== Use that to keep her distracted.
I'll slip through the drain and cause a scene in the streets. Once she runs off to investigate, you just stroll right out the front door.
Solid plan. It's just Alina and Lulu out there. If we split up...==W== They'll definitely chase the suspected Fallen Saintess first.
But wouldn't that put a massive target on your back?
Don't worry about me, Master. I spent my three years hiding in that tower studying magic day and night.
Alright, I'm dressed. Elis should be in the drains by now.
Now for Alina...==W== Ah, there she is.
<size=75>Merciful and almighty Goddess Trivia, hear my prayer.
<size=75>Take my fallen sisters into the high heavens,==RT==that they may soar upon the twelve winds.
Is she ... praying to the Monolith?
Oh, my apologies. I was praying to the Goddess. I didn't notice you, ==SEX12== Acolyte.
No harm done. The bathhouse was perfect. It washed all my exhaustion right away.
Didn't you have a question for me? We still have time before we meet the Archon. Ask away.
Alina hesitates, which is rare for her.==RT==She casts several long glances at the towering Monolith,==RT==as if searching for a revelation from fate.
The Monolith just stands there in silence.==RT==It doesn't listen to mortal doubts,==RT==and it certainly offers no answers.
My question may be ...==W== stepping out of line. If it offends you, I apologize in advance.
Could you tell me about the <color=#3faeae>resurrection magic</color>?
<size=50>Name your price...==W== I'll give you anything I have!

strings.text: Elis slips the Saintess' grasp, but the High Priest grows suspicious of you. To prove you're truly an "Acolyte," you must endure a magic-infused bath. Though you're immune to magic, you eventually faint from hunger.
Could you tell me==W== about the <color=#bd3059>resurrection magic</color>?
<size=50>Name your price...==W== I'll give you anything I have!
Resurrection magic?==W== Why is she asking about that...==W==
To keep others safe, my merciful Master locked ==SEX8== away in a tower in the Wilds to attempt the impossible:
<size=50><color=#3faeae>Resurrection ... magic...</color></size>==W== Liar. Magic like that doesn't exist.
Right after I woke up...==W== Elis pulled that excuse out of thin air to cover up why I wasn't breathing.
Judging by Alina's reaction...==W== The resurrection magic is pure myth around here.==W== So why didn't she call Elis's bluff right away?==W== Unless...
Alina's usual calm mask cracks. She looks at me, practically begging for a yes.
I mean, turning back the clock through the White Room could technically count as some form of resurrection.
I have no idea why she's so obsessed with resurrection magic, but I can't exactly spill the beans on the White Room. And even if I could, it's definitely not the kind of magic she's looking for.
Besides, I don't even know if I can get back there, let alone find the right door after that...==W== How am I supposed to let her down easy?
Forgive me, ==SEX12== Acolyte.==W== Prying into your private research...==W== I overstepped.==W== I deeply apologize for ruining your post-bath peace.
Wait... Did she take my silence as a hard no?
Alina's a good person. Once we cleared the air, she actually took great care of us on the road.==W== If we bolt now...==W== Is she going to take the fall?
Sigh... Survival first, guilt later.==W== Still,==W== the least I can do is answer a few questions to make it up to her.
Oh,==W== it's fine.==W== Honestly, I'm still trying to wrap my head around the resurrection magic myself, so I really can't share much yet.
Sorry I couldn't be of more help.==W== We've got some time to kill before the audience, so feel free to ask about something else.==W== Actually, ask whatever you want.
T-==W==Truly...?==W== May I ask about the tower and wishes?
They just call the Monolith a <color=#3faeae>tower</color> here?==W== Well, that I can answer. I've got over half a year of Trekker experience under my belt.
You are far too generous.==W== Knowledge of that caliber costs a fortune. I've never managed to save enough gold to access those records in the Great Library.
... They charge for information about Monoliths here?
Then my first question is...==W== Can the tower truly grant any wish? Absolutely anything?
B-Bad news! Captain Alina, ==SEX12== Acolyte! There was a massive explosion in the back alley!
It isn't safe here! Take cover!==W== I am so,==W== so sorry==W== for the inconvenience!
I'll slip through the drain and cause a scene in the streets. Once she runs off to investigate, you just stroll right out the front door.
Elis, you didn't have to make it this dramatic.
Hold your ground. The magic in the air feels wrong. That was no explosion. It's an illusion.
Lulu, use your magic arms to lock down every exit.==W== ==SEX12== Acolyte, is your sla...==W== Your servant, Elis, still inside?==W== I'll go get her.
That won't be necessary.==W== I presume this is the Elis you're looking for?
So much for her master plan. She got busted the second she crawled out.
Saintess. High Priest. What brings you both here?
Archon Olympia received your audience request. We were informed you secured a suspect matching the Fallen Saintess, along with an Acolyte she allegedly took hostage.

The Archon intended to discern the truth personally.==W== However, as she is at a critical stage of her ascension, she cannot make an appearance. Thus, she dispatched us to verify their identities in her stead.
We had scarcely arrived when we spotted this young lady, draped in a towel, scurrying out of a drainage pipe...
I-I just got dizzy from the heat! I needed some fresh air!
Oh? If it's just air you needed, why did you crawl under my carriage?
Because the craftsmanship is stunning! I was curious and wanted a closer look at the undercarriage...
I see. How ignorant of me. I had no idea appreciating a carriage required you to mask your presence and hang upside down from the axle.
Acolyte from afar.==W== Kindly keep a tighter leash on your <color=#bd3059>slave</color>. We wouldn't want her embarrassing herself further.
Slave?==W== Wait...==W== Does that mean they don't think she's the Fallen Saintess?
Right, absolutely.==W== I apologize for the mess Elis caused. I'll be sure to keep her in line.
Saintess, are you certain she isn't the Fallen Saintess?==W== She cast several spells earlier with remarkable skill.
Heh. The Fallen Saintess is a ruthless butcher. Do you really think a monster like that would faint from a simple illusion spell?
As for her magic...==W== Alina, outside the walls of Filanis, it is hardly uncommon for Priests and Senators to keep slaves who know basic spellcasting.
The Saintess makes a fair point. However... This Elis does bear a striking resemblance to the wanted portrait. We would do well to remain cautious.
You are right.==W== Let me take a closer look, then.==W== After all, I trained right alongside our runaway.==W==
<size=50>Ow, ow, ow!</size>==W== Quit pinching my cheeks!
The resemblance is there, yes. But since she isn't under any disguise magic, this is not the Fallen Saintess.
How can you be so sure? She fled three years ago. Her features could have matured.
True. But a person's core nature does not change so easily.
Back in training, she always loved playing the untouchable prodigy. Acting as if nothing could ever stump her.==W== Yet the moment it came time to shoulder actual responsibility, she fled the altar.
She thought she made a clean break, dumping her mess for the rest of us to clean up. Every single Saintess in her cohort paid the price.

Later, word got back that she butchered anyone who recognized her on the road just to cover her tracks.==W== <color=#bd3059>Selfish</color>,==W== <color=#bd3059>vicious</color>,==W== and<color=#bd3059> utterly cowardly</color>.==W== That is the true Fallen Saintess.
We lived together for such a long time that her infuriating attitude is burned into my memory. I would never mistake her.
As for the dim-witted slave before us, throwing herself under carriages in a bath towel... She is just a little fool, a look-alike.
Saintess...==W== You're completely right.==W== I'm just a useless slave.==W== I don't know the first thing about any Fallen Saintess.
If the Saintess has made her ruling, then please accept my apologies for the false alarm...
The matter of the Fallen Saintess is settled.==W== However, we still need to confirm if our guest from afar is truly an Acolyte.==W==
Well, you've proved my identity. My Master is obviously a real Acolyte!==W== ==SEX1== just had a little accident while researching magic in the tower, so ==SEX3== memories are a bit fuzzy...
==PLAYER_NAME==, you certainly have a fiercely loyal slave.

Please, put your mind at ease. Filanis never wrongs the innocent, nor do we spare the guilty.==W== After all, this is the==W== <color=#3faeae>City of Perfection</color>, forged by Archon Olympia herself.
We have a perfectly impartial method to verify your credentials.==W== Alina.==W== Prepare the Bathhouse Test.
After all that running around, we're right back where we started.
Elis, what is a Bathhouse Test?
Not a clue. Probably some weird local custom.==W== Look on the bright side... At least it's not an interrogation.==W== You couldn't even talk your way past that backwater Night Watcher.
This test is for me, right? Do you really have to tag along?
What kind of slave would I be if I ditched my Master at a time like this?
Ugh...==W== What is that smell? Did they swap out the water?
==SEX12== Acolyte, the Bathhouse Test is prepared. You may enter whenever you are ready.
Got it.==W== Just... Before we start, mind telling me exactly what this test is about?

Of course.==W== As an Acolyte, you must possess extraordinary magical aptitude.==W== Amnesia may erase your spells, but your innate talent remains untouched.==W== This test will <color=#3faeae>measure that talent</color>.
The pool is flooded with magic-infused water. Please step inside. We will evaluate your aptitude based on how long you can endure the submersion.
Magical aptitude?==W== That's even worse!==W== I can try bluffing my way through an interrogation, but I can't fake magic! I'm immune to magic!
Master, allow me to assist you into the water.
No backing out now.==W== I'll just get in ...==W== and rely on sheer willpower.
<size=50>Ow</size>==W==, ow, ow!==W== It's boiling! Night Watcher, are you trying to boil my Master alive?!
Elis, that isn't heat you are feeling. It is the physical shock of highly concentrated magic.==W== Such a violent reaction implies ...==W== your magical aptitude is poor.
If ==PLAYER_NAME== is a true Acolyte, this water shouldn't feel overwhelming in the slightest.
Feels like normal bathwater to me.==W== Wait...==W== If this is just an endurance test, I've soaked in stuff way more magic-dense than this.==W==
Elis, if you're hurting, you don't have to stay in here with me.
Nonsense. Through hell and high water, your loyal slave is staying right by your side.
Right... But you look like you're about to pass out.
So dizzy... I'm burning up... But for the record, I do not lack magical talent. My skills just ... lie elsewhere.
I know. You've already proven yourself back in the forest.
Heh, my Master knows me best.==W== Tell you what...==W== Before I black out, I need a favor.==W== Please give me your hand...==W==
Whoa, hold on! Don't drag my hand to your chest!==W== I didn't mean it like that!
Idiot. This was the only place I could stash this to get past their strip search.
A Soul Stone? What's that? How do you even know about this thing?
Ugh... My brain is mush. Whatever. Throw it on the pile with the rest of your secrets.
Hey, ==PLAYER_NAME==. Alina is out of earshot, so I'm dropping the slave act.

Gosh, my first time sharing a bath... My first time calling someone Master...==W== Even my clothes...==W== I've never worn so little around anyone before.==W== I gave you so many of my firsts. I'm your responsibility now.
Hey, what are you talking about...==W== Alina! A little help over here! Elis's passing out!
<size=30>Hold onto that stone. Don't let anyone see it.</size>
Elis goes limp in my arms. Alina rushes over and hauls her out of the pool.
And just like that, my endurance test continues...
Ugh... How long have I been simmering in here...
Three hours...==W== Even a fully ordained Priest would have cracked by now. Are you alright?
Honestly...==W== I'm not feeling so hot.==W== But my stomach...==W== I think I'm done.
==SEX12== Acolyte, your magical aptitude is beyond dispute. There is no need to torture yourself further. Let me help you out.
I'm starving...==W== I haven't had a single bite since we got to Filanis...==W==
The magic-infused waters fail to subdue the formidable Acolyte.==W== Amidst Alina's soft gasp, ==PLAYER_NAME== finally goes down,==W== knocked out cold by an empty stomach.

So dizzy... I'm burning up... But for the record, I do not lack magical talent. My skills just ... lie elsewhere.
I know. You've already proven yourself back in the forest.
Heh, my Master knows me best.==W== Tell you what...==W== Before I black out, I need a favor.==W== Please give me your hand...==W==
Whoa, hold on! Don't drag my hand to your chest!==W== I didn't mean it like that!
Idiot. This was the only place I could stash this to get past their strip search.
A Soul Stone? What's that? How do you even know about this thing?
Ugh... My brain is mush. Whatever. Throw it on the pile with the rest of your secrets.
Hey, ==PLAYER_NAME==. Alina is out of earshot, so I'm dropping the slave act.

Gosh, my first time sharing a bath... My first time calling someone Master...==W== Even my clothes...==W== I've never worn so little around anyone before.==W== I gave you so many of my firsts. I'm your responsibility now.
Hey, what are you talking about...==W== Alina! A little help over here! Elis's passing out!
<size=30>Hold onto that stone. Don't let anyone see it.</size>
Elis goes limp in my arms. Alina rushes over and hauls her out of the pool.
And just like that, my endurance test continues...
Ugh... How long have I been simmering in here...
Three hours...==W== Even a fully ordained Priest would have cracked by now. Are you alright?
Honestly...==W== I'm not feeling so hot.==W== But my stomach...==W== I think I'm done.
==SEX12== Acolyte, your magical aptitude is beyond dispute. There is no need to torture yourself further. Let me help you out.
I'm starving...==W== I haven't had a single bite since we got to Filanis...==W==
The magic-infused waters fail to subdue the formidable Acolyte.==W== Amidst Alina's soft gasp, ==PLAYER_NAME== finally goes down,==W== knocked out cold by an empty stomach.

strings.text: You wake in Alina's Insula to learn you passed the test. Elis pleads Alina's case in your name to have her cover your food and lodging. That same day, Olympia is inviting Leita to pursue "perfection"...
==PLAYER_NAME==, wakey-wakey! Sun's shining and breakfast is hot!
Mngh...==W== Morning, Noya. What are we having?
My special thick-cut, extra-crispy Tawny Nightingale!==W== I even snuck another egg into yours. Hurry up and take a bite!
Mmm. So crunchy... Smells amazing, too.
Hmm...==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, did you get any sleep at all? You look awful.
Boss stayed up late again. Staring at ==SEX3== phone.
Up all night again, come on...==W== And Amber, you need to stop keeping Boss up talking. ==SEX1== works hard enough during the day.
And Boss? If you don't start taking better care of yourself, we're going to worry ourselves sick...
Master, if you don't get up right now, I'm eating all this delicious bread myself.
Ugh... Morning. Is it bread again...==W== Elis?
Where are we? Did I pass the Bathhouse Test?
With flying colors. You held out for three and a half hours.==W== Alina says that puts you second in all of Filanis history, right behind the High Priest.
The Saintess and High Priest both agree: your magic is on par with an Acolyte, maybe even a full Priest. Our cover is solid.
And we have Night Watcher Alina to thank for all of this. Thanks to her stubbornness, a noble Acolyte and ==SEX3== slave had to suffer the indignity of being locked in a prisoner cart for days.
To compensate us for our "lost time and emotional distress," Filanis sent over a massive pile of gold.
Alina also has to apologize and meet whatever demands we make, so long as they don't "cause death or permanent scarring."==W== Oh, and they nearly threw her out of Filanis.
Wait, seriously? They went that far?
Heh. You seem awfully worried about that Night Watcher.
It's not just that. Alina's a good person. She was only doing her job hunting the Fallen Saintess. Besides...
She was actually right. You are the Fallen Saintess, and I'm no Acolyte.
She didn't mistreat us on the road, either. She doesn't deserve this.
Master, your kindness is baffling sometimes. If Alina walks away without a scratch, it means they saw right through our cover.
And if that happens, whatever Alina gets would look like a vacation to us. Beheading at a minimum...==W== No, too quick. We'd probably wind up strapped to a slave rack and bled dry.
I know... But we still dragged her down with us.
Heh heh, stop worrying about her. As your brilliant personal slave, I naturally factored in your whole "merciful" routine. While you were out, I used your name to pull a few strings...
Saintess. High Priest. Before the test, my Master told me ==SEX== has no wish to hold Alina accountable for this. We beg you to show her leniency.
How unexpected. To think you and your Master would plead her case.==W== High Priest, your thoughts?
==PLAYER_NAME== is a remarkably merciful Acolyte. I am proud to count such character among our ranks.
Yet as a Night Watcher, Alina caused both of you profound humiliation. She must pay the price, otherwise she'd tarnish the name of her Patron, Archon Olympia.
Alina mistaking me for the Fallen Saintess was partly our fault, too...
This ordeal actually served as the perfect trial for the magic my Master is researching. It can deepen ==SEX3== attunement to the arcane and spark profound inspiration.
If you punish Alina, it will inevitably disturb my Master's focus, putting ==SEX3== research at risk.
I see. Magical inquiry does require an unburdened mind, especially regarding the unconquered field of resurrection magic. Still...==W== A complete pardon feels inappropriate.
High Priest, what if we approach it like this?==W== We let ==PLAYER_NAME== dictate the exact terms of Alina's punishment...
That would prove that Archon Olympia does not shield her patronage, demonstrating her absolute fairness, while also putting our guest at ease.
Sound logic. It is decided, then.
Alina, do you recognize your fault? The moment ==PLAYER_NAME== wakes, you will apologize and accept whatever sentence ==SEX== deems fit.
I acknowledge my fault. I will offer ==SEX12== Acolyte my deepest apologies.
Elis, you're amazing. You spun all of that on the spot and got them to drop the charges on Alina.
Heh heh. I topped my rhetoric class at the Emor Saintess Academy. I know too well what makes these nobles tick.
Alina's Patron is the Archon of this city.==RT==The Saintess and High Priest both answer to her.
They couldn't just punish Alina on a whim.==RT==Go too light or too harsh, and it reflects poorly on them.
They had to posture about protecting the Archon's reputation==RT==and threaten heavy penalties first.
As a visiting Acolyte with proper etiquette training, you were expected to show grace in that moment. That gave them the perfect out to lessen her sentence. Everyone wins.
I had no idea there was so much politics involved...==W== Wait. Was that another test? If you hadn't shown mercy, we wouldn't have acted like a real Acolyte at all.
Exactly. One wrong step with these elites and you're done.==W== Anyway, the exact punishment is still up to you to decide, but I took the opportunity to make one small request…
While we stay in Filanis, Alina covers our food and lodging.
When "Acolytes" such as yourself travel between cities, local nobles trip over themselves to host them. It buys them prestige.
Alina is a Knight, so she is just high enough on the social rank to host you, plus...
If we didn't pick her, we'd end up being hosted by the Saintess or the High Priest. And then ...==W== there goes our cover?
You catch on quick. Compared to those two, Alina knows next to nothing about noble life. She's a much easier mark.
Not exactly... Strictly speaking, her house is just a single room in this building.
My one miscalculation. I never expected ...==W== a Night Watcher Captain with an Archon Patron to be this broke.==W== She's squeezed into an <color=#3faeae>insula</color>—a cheap tenement building.
She can't afford to host us at all. Luckily, this place is so rundown that most of the rooms are empty... We can take our pick.
Are Night Watchers ... supposed to be rich?
Of course. A Night Watcher Captain in Emor lives in a domus with a private garden and pool. They catch thieves and put out fires. Do I really need to spell out how lucrative that gets?
Catching thieves and fighting fires ... is profitable?
Seriously, what is your deal? You have the looks and manners of a noble, but zero common sense.
I told you, I'm from far, far away. There's a lot I don't know.
Elis, teach me. Everything I need to know to pass as an Acolyte. Let's ...==W== start with the calendar.
Honestly... What kind of backwater did you crawl out of to not even know the calendar?==W== Fine. We're in the same boat now anyway.==W== Listen closely, I am only saying this once!
This is the Year of Demigod Lucilla as Consul, the 704th year since Emor's founding.
The Novian calendar has twelve months, each with thirty or thirty-one days. Right now, we're in the sacred fifth month of the year.

You have worked hard in my absence. I have been secluded for far too long preparing the ascension ritual.==W== Someone had to gaze upon Filanis in my stead ... to ensure it remains as perfect as ever.
You are too kind. It is my honor to watch over Filanis for you. It was no hardship at all.
Archon Olympia. Your loyal Coppelius reports that during the six months of your ritual preparations, absolute order has been maintained in Filanis.
There are no slaves in the city, and the citizens continue to bask in your blessings. My Archon, Filanis is a flawless city.
I hear my Night Watcher located our runaway Fallen Saintess?
The High Priest and I have already verified the matter. The young woman merely shares a resemblance with the Fallen Saintess. She is actually the slave of a visiting Acolyte.
I see...==W== How unfortunate. Did you emancipate her?
The Acolyte should be awake by now. I already dispatched Alina requesting that ==SEX== respect local customs and release the slave.
Excellent. Soil tilled by hands of despair will never yield a bountiful harvest.
Besides, the Acolyte is a foreigner who has yet to experience our perfection. Handle the emancipation gently. We must not offend our guest.
Rest assured, Archon. The Acolyte is quite merciful and takes no joy in subjugating others. I do not believe ==SEX== will resist our customs.
Good.==W== Leita, step closer. We haven't had a proper conversation in far too long.
Tell me more about this Acolyte.
I hear ==SEX== carries a mysterious, coffin-like box. That ==SEX== was entirely devoid of breath and body heat, only to suddenly awaken. And that ==SEX== studies resurrection magic?
Indeed. But resurrection magic is a pipe dream. No one has succeeded in thousands of years.==W== I fear this Acolyte's research will ultimately amount to nothing.
Heh. Leita, you do not understand.
This Acolyte exhibits extraordinary qualities without any refinement at all...==W== What a rare, near-perfect material.
You saw ==SEX4== yesterday. Don't you find ...==W== that body beautiful?
That is alright. You will understand soon enough.
You have grown so much. Your poise, your etiquette, your magic—all far superior to before. But no one is born perfect. There is always a regrettable flaw.
Leita. Would you like to shatter the limits of mortality and touch the higher glory that belongs to you?
Join me in pursuit of true perfection.

strings.text: In Alina's insula, you and Elis speak more about this world. This "Nova" doesn't match your understanding of it at all. As for Elis herself, she is a Saintess regarded as a "consumable."
In Nova, your magic skill dictates your status. And that magic skill is eighty percent talent, twenty percent sweat.
Basically, your whole life is pretty much mapped out before you're even born. Bloodline beats all.
Got high magic aptitude? You get to be a noble.==W== Can't cast a spell to save your life, then you're stuck as a commoner, a freedman, or a slave.
Hmm... So power is the only thing that matters?==W== What if a noble has a kid with zero talent?
That kid gets demoted to a commoner. A caring parent might set them up for life, but no magic means no title. They can kiss any public office goodbye.
And if a slave's kid is born with the gift?
Magic talent like that is rare. The second a kid shows it, a noble adopts the kid and frees the parents. They will no longer be slaves.
That's assuming they ever get tested,==W== of course. If their luck is rotten, well, they stay slaves.
Brutal system. But in a twisted way... I guess it's fair.
The lowest rung of the nobility is the Knight. Historically, that meant magic users who brought their own weapons and horses to fight for the city.
Nowadays, it's mostly just people with mediocre magic and deep pockets. Well...==W== Except Alina.
Knights handle the city's public offices. They don't get a salary. They actually have to fund public affairs out of their own pockets.
Out of their own pockets? You mean ...==W== Alina pays for the entire Night Watcher operation herself? Why would anyone take a thankless job like that?
Thankless? Please. Where there's power, the gold follows. As for why Alina is dead broke... Your guess is as good as mine.
A step above Knights are the Priests. Masters of magic, devoted to Goddess Trivia. That's your cover.
You're technically an Acolyte, not a full Priest yet. But since Acolytes are bound for greatness, everyone treats them like the real deal.
So I get the special treatment, but without the actual responsibilities of a full Priest. Convenient.
Did you map all this out on the fly when I woke up?
Obviously. You don't survive three years on the run without thinking on your feet.
I mean, I spent most of it hiding in a tower, but I still had to buy groceries.

High Priests and Senators. The former are their city's highest authority on communion with the Goddess of Magic. The latter sit on their stone benches in the Novian Senate, dictating the fate of the entire continent.
Above them are the Archons. They rule the cities and the divine towers, and they write the laws. Alina's Patron is the Archon of Filanis.
Divine towers... We call the Monoliths gifts from the God of Grace too, but here, they worship a Goddess of Magic...
Is this just a difference in faith? Or ... a completely different world?
And at the absolute top, leading the Senate and the people of Nova... The Consuls. They are Demigods.
There's only a handful of them. They live in total seclusion, blessed with impossibly long lifespans and unprecedented magic.
They rotate power every year, taking turns at the helm. But they mostly just stick to the existing routine. Nothing really changes.
So magic is basically a "degree" here. Don't go to a good school, you don't get into a <r=become a noble></r>top company. And those noble titles are just corporate ladder tiers.
Except studying takes actual work, while Magic is a genetic lottery.
Thanks, Elis.==W== That puts my cover's rank into perspective. I know how to handle these people now.
You catch on fast. You really are some sheltered noble kid, aren't you?
Far from it... My hometown has rich and poor, sure, and plenty of fancy titles. We just don't have this rigid nobility system. You are a great teacher.
Teacher...==W== Hmm. I suppose I have taught you a lot. I'll take it.
Teacher. Teacher...==W== You know, being called that feels pretty good!
Well then, your student has two more questions for you.
You said magic is eighty percent talent. But you still have to learn spells, right? Does hard work really count for that little?
Of course. Your talent dictates which spells you can even learn in the first place. You can study as hard as you want, but without the aptitude, you still get a zero.
Let me break it down. Casting requires magic. Magic comes from our spiritual energy, but everyone's built differently.
Some naturally convert spiritual energy into magic. Others store massive amounts of it, or control it better. Hit the jackpot with all three, and bam, you're a future High Priest.
Then there's me...==W== Five minutes in a magic-infused bath and I pass out. My body just rejects it. I could memorize every spell in existence and still wouldn't have the magic to cast them.
Makes sense. When you were throwing spells around in the forest, you were drawing from this Soul Stone right?
H-How did you know that?==W== Oh, right. You muttered "Soul Stone" during your bathhouse test...
Well... That's what we call them back home. Everyone has one. They store magic, and you just tap into it whenever you need a spell.
Impossible!!! I bled for those experiments for years! This is supposed to be one of a kind!
And you're telling me your entire hometown is using them?!
Did I ... just reinvent the wheel?! I was banking on this to make a fortune!
Ah, hey... Don't let it get to you. Reinventing the wheel still takes genius, right? Plus, nobody in Filanis has one yet.
Hmm...==W== Fair point! Even if someone in a distant land beat me to the punch, as long as Nova's in the dark, I can still rake in the gold!
You're still a wanted fugitive. Bit early to map out your business empire, isn't it?
A girl's gotta plan ahead! Besides, how else am I supposed to fund my escape? Oh, and we're splitting that Filanis compensation money fifty-fifty.
Thrifty and cautious.==W== She really does act like Iris.
Hey, hey! Eyes on the teacher! Are you spacing out thinking about some other girl?
You did the exact same thing in the prisoner cart. Looked right at me and called me someone else's name. Hmph.
Sorry. It's just...==W== You and Alina look so much like my friends from back home.
I...==W== I don't even know if I'll ever get to see them again.
... I understand how you feel.==W== But please don't treat me as a substitute. Not even in your head. Absolutely not.
My name is Elis. E-lis.==W== I'm not Iris, nor am I anyone else.
I know it sounds harsh, but I hate it. Especially...==W== Especially coming from you!
I'm sorry... That's my fault. I didn't consider your feelings. We're companions. I shouldn't look at you and see someone else.
Companions? Who said we're companions?!==W== Don't make it sound so buddy-buddy. We're co-conspirators. Accomplices. Fugitives on the same sinking ship.
Those sound pretty buddy-buddy to me...
Loud and clear. You're Elis. E-lis. Not Iris.
Hmph, that's more like it. Since I'm your teacher, I will magnanimously forgive you this once. Now, what's your second question?
Elis, why didn't you mention Saintesses in that list of nobilities? The one in Filanis seems to carry as much weight as a High Priest.
Heh. A Saintess's main job is praying to the gods in the tower. They don't belong to the nobility.
So are they citizens? Freedmen? Or some other transcendent class?
Um...==W== They can't be slaves, right?
Not that either.==W== We Saintesses are just "objects."
What does it take to start a fire?
A spark... And some kindling, like dry branches or grass...
And when the flames die out, do you bother checking on the cold ashes?
No, not really...==W== At most I'll check for embers so they don't start a wildfire.
Heh. We Saintesses are exactly that. Objects you use up and forget about.
Every Saintess is a "defective product" with magic talent. Take me, for instance. My magic tolerance is terrible. If there's even a little magic in me, I have to release it, or it makes me sick.
With a body like this, I can memorize spells, but I can never cast them properly. So ...==W== I'm just a defect.

But even defects have their uses. The big shots raise us with great care. Treat us like noble ladies, teach us magic and history... All so we can march up to the altar in the tower and make our offering to the gods when they snap their fingers.
Make an offering... You don't mean...
Sacrificing ourselves to the gods in the tower. We pay with our lives to grant their wishes.
We're ... just the spark and the fuel for their desires. A rare, expensive "object." Naturally, they keep us safe and hand us a scrap of authority... Right up until they burn us.

Wh-What are you talking about?! Why would your people wish like that?! That's not how the Monolith works at all! You find a Wishing Box, ready your prayer, picture the Artifact, and just say the words!
Oh, is that how they wish in your hometown? Sounds a lot kinder.==W== Too bad I wasn't born there. And Nova isn't your home.
It's wrong. There's something fundamentally messed up with how you make wishes here.
If someone dragged me into an idiotic ritual like that, I'd run too. I'm so glad you got out!
Glad...? Do you honestly mean that?==W== Granting wishes ... is a Saintess's job. It's our fate. No one in Nova is supposed to run from it.
What could matter more than a human life?! Fate...==W== <size=60>Fate is meant to be broken!
... Pfft. Listen to you talk big. "Fate is meant to be broken"...==W== Such arrogance. Need I remind you we're one slip-up away from the executioner's block?
But... I don't hate that arrogance. Because when I ran from the altar, I wasn't thinking about any of that either. My only thought was: I don't want to die! I don't want to die!
I guess that makes me pretty arrogant too.==W== You really are special...
Sorry. I haven't eaten since yesterday, and we've been talking for a while. Does Alina have ... anything to eat around here?
She does. She left us some homemade breakfast before heading out on patrol.==W== Here, a ham sandwich.
Breakfast made by Alina...==W== If she cooks anything like Noya, I'm in for a treat.
I'll gracefully have a bite then.
Wh... What is this? Did I just bite into a rock?!
Hahaha. That Night Watcher's cooking is downright lethal. Her bread could deflect arrows.
Nope. Not Noya. Alina is nothing like Noya at all!
==SEX12== Acolyte! And ...==W== you, the slave. Thank the gods you're both here.
Quick, come with me! Captain Alina needs backup! The Fallen Saintess is here!

param: In Alina's insula, you and Elis speak more about this world. This "Nova" doesn't match your understanding of it at all. As for Elis herself, she is a Saintess regarded as a "consumable."
In Nova, your magic skill dictates your status. And that magic skill is eighty percent talent, twenty percent sweat.
Basically, your whole life is pretty much mapped out before you're even born. Bloodline beats all.
Got high magic aptitude? You get to be a noble.==W== Can't cast a spell to save your life, then you're stuck as a commoner, a freedman, or a slave.
Hmm... So power is the only thing that matters?==W== What if a noble has a kid with zero talent?
That kid gets demoted to a commoner. A caring parent might set them up for life, but no magic means no title. They can kiss any public office goodbye.
And if a slave's kid is born with the gift?
Magic talent like that is rare. The second a kid shows it, a noble adopts the kid and frees the parents. They will no longer be slaves.
That's assuming they ever get tested,==W== of course. If their luck is rotten, well, they stay slaves.
Brutal system. But in a twisted way... I guess it's fair.
The lowest rung of the nobility is the Knight. Historically, that meant magic users who brought their own weapons and horses to fight for the city.
Nowadays, it's mostly just people with mediocre magic and deep pockets. Well...==W== Except Alina.
Knights handle the city's public offices. They don't get a salary. They actually have to fund public affairs out of their own pockets.
Out of their own pockets? You mean ...==W== Alina pays for the entire Night Watcher operation herself? Why would anyone take a thankless job like that?
Thankless? Please. Where there's power, the gold follows. As for why Alina is dead broke... Your guess is as good as mine.
A step above Knights are the Priests. Masters of magic, devoted to Goddess Trivia. That's your cover.
You're technically an Acolyte, not a full Priest yet. But since Acolytes are bound for greatness, everyone treats them like the real deal.
So I get the special treatment, but without the actual responsibilities of a full Priest. Convenient.
Did you map all this out on the fly when I woke up?
Obviously. You don't survive three years on the run without thinking on your feet.
I mean, I spent most of it hiding in a tower, but I still had to buy groceries.

High Priests and Senators. The former are their city's highest authority on communion with the Goddess of Magic. The latter sit on their stone benches in the Novian Senate, dictating the fate of the entire continent.
Above them are the Archons. They rule the cities and the divine towers, and they write the laws. Alina's Patron is the Archon of Filanis.
Divine towers... We call the Monoliths gifts from the God of Grace too, but here, they worship a Goddess of Magic...
Is this just a difference in faith? Or ... a completely different world?
And at the absolute top, leading the Senate and the people of Nova... The Consuls. They are Demigods.
There's only a handful of them. They live in total seclusion, blessed with impossibly long lifespans and unprecedented magic.
They rotate power every year, taking turns at the helm. But they mostly just stick to the existing routine. Nothing really changes.
So magic is basically a "degree" here. Don't go to a good school, you don't get into a <r=become a noble></r>top company. And those noble titles are just corporate ladder tiers.
Except studying takes actual work, while Magic is a genetic lottery.
Thanks, Elis.==W== That puts my cover's rank into perspective. I know how to handle these people now.
You catch on fast. You really are some sheltered noble kid, aren't you?
Far from it... My hometown has rich and poor, sure, and plenty of fancy titles. We just don't have this rigid nobility system. You are a great teacher.
Teacher...==W== Hmm. I suppose I have taught you a lot. I'll take it.
Teacher. Teacher...==W== You know, being called that feels pretty good!
Well then, your student has two more questions for you.
You said magic is eighty percent talent. But you still have to learn spells, right? Does hard work really count for that little?
Of course. Your talent dictates which spells you can even learn in the first place. You can study as hard as you want, but without the aptitude, you still get a zero.
Let me break it down. Casting requires magic. Magic comes from our spiritual energy, but everyone's built differently.
Some naturally convert spiritual energy into magic. Others store massive amounts of it, or control it better. Hit the jackpot with all three, and bam, you're a future High Priest.
Then there's me...==W== Five minutes in a magic-infused bath and I pass out. My body just rejects it. I could memorize every spell in existence and still wouldn't have the magic to cast them.
Makes sense. When you were throwing spells around in the forest, you were drawing from this Soul Stone right?
H-How did you know that?==W== Oh, right. You muttered "Soul Stone" during your bathhouse test...
Well... That's what we call them back home. Everyone has one. They store magic, and you just tap into it whenever you need a spell.
Impossible!!! I bled for those experiments for years! This is supposed to be one of a kind!
And you're telling me your entire hometown is using them?!
Did I ... just reinvent the wheel?! I was banking on this to make a fortune!
Ah, hey... Don't let it get to you. Reinventing the wheel still takes genius, right? Plus, nobody in Filanis has one yet.
Hmm...==W== Fair point! Even if someone in a distant land beat me to the punch, as long as Nova's in the dark, I can still rake in the gold!
You're still a wanted fugitive. Bit early to map out your business empire, isn't it?
A girl's gotta plan ahead! Besides, how else am I supposed to fund my escape? Oh, and we're splitting that Filanis compensation money fifty-fifty.
Thrifty and cautious.==W== She really does act like Iris.
Hey, hey! Eyes on the teacher! Are you spacing out thinking about some other girl?
You did the exact same thing in the prisoner cart. Looked right at me and called me someone else's name. Hmph.
Sorry. It's just...==W== You and Alina look so much like my friends from back home.
I...==W== I don't even know if I'll ever get to see them again.
... I understand how you feel.==W== But please don't treat me as a substitute. Not even in your head. Absolutely not.
My name is Elis. E-lis.==W== I'm not Iris, nor am I anyone else.
I know it sounds harsh, but I hate it. Especially...==W== Especially coming from you!
I'm sorry... That's my fault. I didn't consider your feelings. We're companions. I shouldn't look at you and see someone else.
Companions? Who said we're companions?!==W== Don't make it sound so buddy-buddy. We're co-conspirators. Accomplices. Fugitives on the same sinking ship.
Those sound pretty buddy-buddy to me...
Loud and clear. You're Elis. E-lis. Not Iris.
Hmph, that's more like it. Since I'm your teacher, I will magnanimously forgive you this once. Now, what's your second question?
Elis, why didn't you mention Saintesses in that list of nobilities? The one in Filanis seems to carry as much weight as a High Priest.
Heh. A Saintess's main job is praying to the gods in the tower. They don't belong to the nobility.
So are they citizens? Freedmen? Or some other transcendent class?
Um...==W== They can't be slaves, right?
Not that either.==W== We Saintesses are just "objects."
What does it take to start a fire?
A spark... And some kindling, like dry branches or grass...
And when the flames die out, do you bother checking on the cold ashes?
No, not really...==W== At most I'll check for embers so they don't start a wildfire.
Heh. We Saintesses are exactly that. Objects you use up and forget about.
Every Saintess is a "defective product" with magic talent. Take me, for instance. My magic tolerance is terrible. If there's even a little magic in me, I have to release it, or it makes me sick.
With a body like this, I can memorize spells, but I can never cast them properly. So ...==W== I'm just a defect.

But even defects have their uses. The big shots raise us with great care. Treat us like noble ladies, teach us magic and history... All so we can march up to the altar in the tower and make our offering to the gods when they snap their fingers.
Make an offering... You don't mean...
Sacrificing ourselves to the gods in the tower. We pay with our lives to grant their wishes.
We're ... just the spark and the fuel for their desires. A rare, expensive "object." Naturally, they keep us safe and hand us a scrap of authority... Right up until they burn us.

Wh-What are you talking about?! Why would your people wish like that?! That's not how the Monolith works at all! You find a Wishing Box, ready your prayer, picture the Artifact, and just say the words!
Oh, is that how they wish in your hometown? Sounds a lot kinder.==W== Too bad I wasn't born there. And Nova isn't your home.
It's wrong. There's something fundamentally messed up with how you make wishes here.
If someone dragged me into an idiotic ritual like that, I'd run too. I'm so glad you got out!
Glad...? Do you honestly mean that?==W== Granting wishes ... is a Saintess's job. It's our fate. No one in Nova is supposed to run from it.
What could matter more than a human life?! Fate...==W== <size=60>Fate is meant to be broken!
... Pfft. Listen to you talk big. "Fate is meant to be broken"...==W== Such arrogance. Need I remind you we're one slip-up away from the executioner's block?
But... I don't hate that arrogance. Because when I ran from the altar, I wasn't thinking about any of that either. My only thought was: I don't want to die! I don't want to die!
I guess that makes me pretty arrogant too.==W== You really are special...
Sorry. I haven't eaten since yesterday, and we've been talking for a while. Does Alina have ... anything to eat around here?
She does. She left us some homemade breakfast before heading out on patrol.==W== Here, a ham sandwich.
Breakfast made by Alina...==W== If she cooks anything like Noya, I'm in for a treat.
I'll gracefully have a bite then.
Wh... What is this? Did I just bite into a rock?!
Hahaha. That Night Watcher's cooking is downright lethal. Her bread could deflect arrows.
Nope. Not Noya. Alina is nothing like Noya at all!
==SEX12== Acolyte! And ...==W== you, the slave. Thank the gods you're both here.
Quick, come with me! Captain Alina needs backup! The Fallen Saintess is here!

strings.text: Alina shields a girl accused of being the Fallen Saintess from the angry mobs. Your status as an Acolyte helps her out, and to earn her trust, you and Elis join the Night Watchers.
Just look at her. She's no Fallen Saintess. She's just a poor slave who can't even cast a simple spell.
There are no slaves in Filanis!==W== It's a trick! She must be the Fallen Saintess in disguise!
If you won't believe me, I'll take her to the High Priest. Let him pass judgment.
Ha. Hiding behind the High Priest the second things get tough. Must be nice being a Night Watcher.
My kid's been missing for a month! And you useless Night Watchers haven't done a damn thing about it!
We finally caught the monster, and instead of taking her head, you shield her! What, are you working for her?!
Throw her in the bathhouse! The water will prove what she is soon enough.
Look at how frail she is. Throwing her in that water is practically a death sentence!
On my honor as a Night Watcher, I swear I'll interrogate her and get you your answers.==W== But right now, she needs a healer. Step aside.
Like hell! You question her right here.
(Something feels off...==W== Why is everyone so worked up?==W== Never mind that...==W== I have to get this child out of here first.)
Back off. You are interfering with a Night Watcher. I will force my way through if I have to.
Force your way through?==W== Hah. You might be a Knight, but so am I.==W== And I know how to use a sword.
Damn right! We were born and bred in Filanis, and we've bled in the wars! We aren't letting some outsider walk all over us. Show her who's boss!
Well?==W== If you really want to take that Fallen Saintess, you'll have to go through me. Let's see if you actually <size=50>deserve that title</size>.
(What do I do? Their swordplay is amateur at best.==W== I could easily break through, but not without hurting someone.)
(My duty is to protect the citizens of Filanis, not harm them.==W== But if we stay here...==W== This girl is going to...)
What is the meaning of this?==W== Clear the road! You're blocking the honorable Acolyte's path!
An Acolyte?==W== Since when do we have an Acolyte in Filanis?
I heard a traveling Acolyte just arrived in the city. Word is High Priest Coppelius treats ==SEX4== like royalty.==W== Look, that's got to be ==SEX4==.
Hmm...==W== Those striking features,==W== clothes I've never even seen before...==W== Yeah, that's definitely a noble we shouldn't cross.
What seems to be the problem? What's with all this commotion?

Honorable Acolyte! We didn't mean to block your path.==W== It's just... We caught the Fallen Saintess! But this Night Watcher refuses to see justice done.==W== She's trying to smuggle the criminal away!
Oh? If it isn't Alina.==W== Fancy running into you here.
Good morning, ==SEX12== Acolyte.==W== I take full responsibility for my earlier negligence.==W== Once I get this child to a healer, I'll turn myself in for punishment.
That won't do, Alina. Did you not hear these good citizens?==W== They are calling for the execution of the Fallen Saintess. You can't just brush them off and go heal her.
No buts.==W== I may be a visiting Acolyte who shouldn't meddle, but as a Night Watcher of Filanis, it's your duty to listen to the people.
You're dead right! Spoken like a true Acolyte! Finally, someone in charge who actually has our backs.
Unlike a certain Night Watcher who'd rather protect criminals than do her actual job!
Hey! You heard the Acolyte. Fall in line, Night Watcher!
I...==W== I understand. ==SEX12== Acolyte, give the order. I will do as you command.
Since you've all left this decision in my hands, I suppose I must oblige.
Alina, escort this Fallen Saintess to my quarters. I will interrogate her myself.
Done checking her. The bad news is, both her body and mind are wrecked.
Chronic starvation and severe abuse have shattered her psyche.==W== Also, someone tampered with her memory using magic.==W== Getting anything useful out of her right now is impossible.
<size=50>It's... It's that bad?!</size>==W== Those slaver scum deserve to rot!==W== C-Can she recover?==W==
Oh my.==W== Look who's suddenly putting her faith in a "vile parasite who willingly became a slave."
I...==W== I'm sorry. I was way out of line back at the bathhouse. I didn't mean it.
Hmph, no need to apologize.==W== Do I look like the type to hold a grudge?==W== Relax. That was just the bad news. Here comes the good.
She's got a long list of issues, but none of them are fatal.==W== Her body just needs rest. Once she gets her strength back, the memory damage inflicted by magic should clear up on its own.
Here. I wrote a prescription. Keep her on this for two weeks, and she'll be a whole new person.
Cabbage, honey, chicken, fish sauce, figs, dates, chickpeas...==W== Wait, this is just a grocery list.
Exactly. Forget the herbs. What this girl really needs is a hearty meal.
Phew.==W== Master, let's get her into the bedroom so she can rest.==W== You there, Night Watcher,==W== come give us a hand.==W==
Alina offers her own bedroom to the girl. As we tuck the girl in, she continues to stare blankly, muttering a plea for her life. Still...==W== The sheer terror on her face is starting to fade.
This world is far crueler than I thought. Elis and Alina must be the rare exceptions. What happened today...==W== That's the grim reality for everyone else.
Thank you for stepping in, Acolyte. If you hadn't...==W== That girl and I would have been trapped on the island. We might have actually needed High Priest Coppelius to bail us out.
Don't mention it. I didn't do much.==W== Just threw my weight around and used what they didn't know against them.
Good thing they didn't know I'm staying with you. Me bringing her here for an "interrogation" is the same as you bringing her here for treatment.
You think they'll catch on? An angry mob showing up at your insula is the last thing you need.
Rest assured, those people rarely set foot off the island. They have no idea what goes on out here.
Good. Then we can focus on treating the girl.
Speaking of which,==W== why were they so convinced she was the Fallen Saintess?==W== I thought Filanis didn't have slaves.
I will explain everything shortly.==W== But before that...==W==
==SEX12== Acolyte, I made a grave mistake when I wrongfully accused Elis of being the Fallen Saintess and locked you both in a prisoner cart.==W== I am ready for my punishment.
Ah,==W== this must be what Elis told me about...==W==
Alina also has to apologize and meet whatever demands we make, so long as they don't "cause death or permanent scarring."==W== Oh,==W== and they nearly threw her out of Filanis.
I don't really want to punish her.==W== There's no need.==W== Plus,==W== Alina was just doing her job.
From an outsider's perspective,==W== Elis and I looked sketchy as hell.
Psst. Master, Master.==W== Come here for a second.
What do you think, Elis? We really don't need to punish Alina over this. You even spoke up for her earlier.
True,==W== but you can't just wave it off and ask for nothing. It breaks character.
Besides, this is the perfect opportunity to get Alina on our side.
Yes! Think about it. What is our top priority right now?
Securing a solid identity. One that holds up to scrutiny.
Exactly. Our cover story already fooled the Saintess and the High Priest. The only wild card left is this Night Watcher.
On our way to Filanis... We left quite a few holes in our story. If she starts digging into them...
Fair point. So, what's the plan?
Heh. She's way too uptight. Aside from Lulu, I doubt she has a single friend in the world.
People like her are like marble statues. You can neither bribe nor threaten them.==W== If we want to win her over,==W== we have to corrupt her first.
I just mean getting her to loosen up. If we can get her to reveal what she wants, we can give her exactly that.
If you think that's too slow, I did invent a soul trading spell that binds the signer's movements.==W== You could use this chance to help me test it out...==W==
<size=52>Hey! Where are you going?!==W== We haven't even gone over the talking points yet!</size>
Alina, I've decided on your punishment.
Name it, and I will do my utmost to compensate you both.
Let us join the Night Watchers and patrol with you.==W== Also, treat Elis and me as your equals, not your superiors.==W== Drop all the formalities.
Understood. I will...==W== Wait,==W== ==SEX12== Acolyte, what did you just say?
Calling me "==SEX12==" is a violation of the terms. Just call me ==PLAYER_NAME==, and call her Elis.
And you can stop calling me "Master." We need to blend in. It's about time I restore my slave to the status of a free woman.
We don't have a physical contract, so let's just have Alina act as our witness.
I ...==W== understand.==W== I will bear witness to ==PLAYER_NAME== freeing the slave, Elis.
Hah...==W== I really don't get you.==W== What is going on inside that head of yours?
Good. No one is using titles anymore. I like this.==W== So...==W== Captain Alina, give the order.
As the newest recruits of the Night Watchers, what's our first move?
Well...==W==Then let's discuss the connection between the Fallen Saintess and the recent disappearances in Filanis.
