"Relying on our bond" is not a plan!==W== That's precisely why I made this locator magic. Just didn't expect we'd need it so soon—==W==hey, why are you staring at me?
It just hit me how lucky we are to have you!
Wh-What's all this all of a sudden...?==W== C-Come on, let's just go. We need to find ==SEX4==, fast.
Huh? This stuff's all expired! Seriously, Miss Portia's slacking off again.
Okay ...==W== toss the old stuff, put out the new...
Done! Everything's restocked and tagged for discount.
Time to stand by the door and bring in some customers...
<size=35>I'd really love to keep ==SEX4== here, working for me forever.
A pity... ==SEX1== hasn't had enough of the food yet. If ==SEX3== consciousness awakens, ==SEX== can still be taken back.
And those little friends of ==SEX5== should be here any minute. Heh heh... What to do?
Kinda getting tired of pork cutlets...
Miss Portia did say the chow mein here is good too. Maybe I'll try that next.
Right! Gotta work even harder for that yummy chow mein!
Huh? Sounds like customers. Better get to it!
My magic is picking something up. ==SEX1== is close.
The convenience store...==W== I remember that clerk. She looks like she hasn't slept in a week.
What are these customers even talking about?
Aren't they gonna buy anything? What's with the poking...?==W== Oh, maybe they want a photo? Better strike a friendly pose.
That's ... weird.==W== Why does a hug from her feel so warm?
Hey, Iris, this mascot... It wasn't here the last time we came by, was it?
It's definitely suspicious. My magic is...==W== Wait, my magic just linked to the mascot!
Trekker from the Wishing Box! Are you in there?
Trekker from the Wishing Box... Who's that?
What's a Wishing Box? What's a Trekker? And is it almost lunchtime?
Hey, snap out of it! I still owe you one. You saved me, remember?
Saved...==W== Who did I save? Who saved me?
We don't even know your name! C'mon, you can't just blow us off!
The nameless Trekker with memory loss ... the one they rescued from the Wishing Box! And they're—
==SEX1== talked! ==SEX1=='s really the Trekker from the Wishing Box!
We gotta get outta here. Ugh, what is this weird suit? Let's get it off ya.
It's soft. Like it's your own skin. It won't come off.
Hold on. Where do you think you're going with my employee?
Employee? This is our companion! See the water ring on ==SEX3== hand? That's a locator magic I cast right before we came in.
Doesn't matter who ==SEX== was. ==SEX1=='s a clerk at this convenience store now.
So what'll it take for you to let ==SEX4== go?
Isn't it obvious? This is a store. You buy stuff.
In fact, buy out my entire stock, and I'll throw the employee in as a freebie.
I dunno how many Stella Coins you're asking for ... but will this do?
Noya heaves a massive, overflowing bag of Stella Coins onto the counter with a loud thud.
Noya?! Where'd you get all these Stella Coins? When did you even...?!
All those Stellaroids we fought? They dropped a ton of Stella Coins. Figured they might come in handy, so I scooped 'em all up.
So, is this enough? If not, we can just go farm some more.
... You've got to be kidding me.
Well now, my reliable employee... These customers have made quite a purchase. How about you give them a hand?
Under Portia's instructions, I stagger out of the store after Noya, Iris, and Amber, barely managing the mountain of goods in my arms.
Ugh... My head's clearing...==W====RT==What was I just doing? How did I end up working as a clerk?
Hehe! Welcome back to the land of the living!
Hey, that's what we're here for! The New Star Guild never leaves a companion behind!
We've been in this Monolith for almost two days. We need to get out now, before it gets too dangerous.
I glance back at Portia. She's just tidying up behind the counter like nothing happened.==W== Without even looking over, she gives a casual wave.
Whoa, the second I step out of the Monolith, I become overwhelmed by hunger.
We were in there for thirty-five hours. It's no wonder we're hungry.
And that meal from the convenience store? Anything not from a Wishing Box gets reclaimed by the Monolith when you leave. It's like you never ate at all.
It just... vanishes?==W== So what would happen if someone stayed in there for a month?
The Monolith takes away everything you've eaten. The moment you step outside, you suddenly turn into skin and bones and starve to death~
Don't describe such a terrifying scene so vividly!
Well... That's just her theory. Nobody's ever lasted that long in a Monolith. The longest on record is one week. When that Trekker was pulled out, they've lost their mind...
I've heard about that. That person also said they saw legendary heroes walking around them!
On second thought...==W== Compared to ghosts, starving to death is still scarier...
Alright, alright, I'll drop it.==W== (yawn) It's getting late. Isn't it time we brought out that?
Ta-da! Pajamas, just for you! We got 'em from a Wishing Box while we were out looking for you.
You can't be comfortable sleeping in your outdoor clothes.
They're cute. It was Noya's idea.
Wow, they're so soft... You are amazing. I don't know how to thank you.
Hey, you saved me from that Stellaroid, remember? Consider us even!
Besides, there's something else we wanted to talk to you about.
Amber pulls me over to sit with them.
Trekker from the Wishing Box, come travel with us!
We, uh... We'd like to invite you to join the New Star Guild.
You want me to join? Why?
W-We talked it over. Your memory loss' pretty severe, and ... it doesn't look like it's coming back anytime soon. We'd just be so worried if you left on your own...
I mean, an experienced Trekker like you would be fine no matter where you go, I'm sure of it! But ... maybe you could stay with us, at least until you've figured things out?
Okay, my turn! The first time I saw you, lying right there in the Wishing Box, I just knew we were meant to cross paths.
Plus, we worked together really well back in the Monolith. You're a natural fit for our guild!
We like you. We want you to stay.
Thanks...==W== No, that's not what I should be saying.
I'm happy when I'm with all of you.
I want to be on your team, too.
Heh heh, told you ==SEX=='d say yes!
Then, it's official! Welcome to the New Star Guild!
Yeah. I'm glad to be part of the team.
Don't be so stiff! You're one of us now, so let's get this party started!
Whoa—==W====RT==Hey! What's with the surprise pillow attack?!
'Cause it's time for a pillow fight!
Who has a pillow fight at a welcoming party...?
Heh! First one to strike wins!==W====RT==Your turn! Think fast, Amber!
Whoa! Nice moves, Amber! You actually dodged that!
Oh yeah? Well, watch out! I'm bringing out my special move!
You're all out. My turn. Hi—yah!
You two... Could you please act your age...==W== Ouch!
Hahaha... Uh oh, now you've done it...
Heh heh... I assume you two are prepared for what's coming next?
W-Wait! Amber, Noya...==RT==Stop using me as a shield—!
Warm, orange light spills out from the window, lingering long into the night. And just like that, our journey begins.

strings.text: A Thousand Blossoms by Night (Part I)
Back in Cangwu, Jinglin barely makes it in time to register for the Swimming Fish Festival, where she reunites with her childhood friends, Shimiao and Chixia.
Haaah—==W==finally, all the work's done for the day.
Nice,==W== and it's still morning...==W== That means I can relax tonight and go see the lanterns...
... Guess I'm not clocking out just yet.
Haah... Haah... W-wait—!==W==I... I want to sign up for the "Swimming Fish Festival." Am I too late for that?
Catch your breath, don't panic.==W== You made it with one minute to spare.
<size=48>One minute—?! That's by the skin of my teeth!</size>==W== Cough... But at least I made it.
You've filled out the registration form, right?
Let me see... Looks fine.==W== I'll submit it right now.
Th-thank you so much...==W== It's really hard for me to make a trip back to Cangwu. If I'd missed this...
Appreciate your enthusiasm...==W== By the way, have you made your fish lantern yet?
... If I start now, maybe I can still make it?==W== Eh, wait— You're—
Today, of all days...==W== Sorry. Chat later.
Her face looked familiar... Where have I—
Is this the source?! Everyone, back up—I'll handle it!
<size=48>I'm soaked head to toe all the sudden! What happened?!</size>
Chixia?! You didn't get hurt? That was some serious fire!
Oh, it's you, Shimiao... Fire? What fire?
I heard someone shouting outside the office, so I thought...
Oh, that wasn't an actual fire!==W== I was just lighting their fish lanterns!
That's right! The flame shot up high, it was some amazing Xuan Shi stuff!
Hahaha! See? Sometimes I do get serious when I'm in the mood.
... So all this sudden rain was because—==W==oh, it was mistaken for a fire...?
What?! You thought there was a fire?!
Given the scene, it's the logical conclusion...
Haha, Chixia, you were just showing off one minute and got totally soaked in the next!
Ugh... Fine, fair point. I did get carried away.
Wow, you admitted it. That's rare.
Hey, I can own it when I mess up.
Whoa! I knew it! That voice, that spell—Shimiao! It really is you!
You're ... the girl at the Bureau earlier... Wait, you are...
You're... Jinglin?!==W== Hah, it really is you! You've grown so much!
No way... But you really do look a bit like her. Are you really Jinglin?
Of course! Back when we all lived in the same courtyard,==W== Shimiao and I took you out to play all the time!
Sorry I didn't recognize you right away, Jinglin...==W== I only remember you as a little kid.
No, it's me who should apologize... I came running in and didn't even recognize you.==W== But I've always remembered you, Shimiao. Please don't be mad at me.
Mad at you? What for?==W== We're all friends!
She wasn't asking you! ...==W== Forget it.==W== Anyway, you moved to Philae, didn't you?
Yeah. I came back with my parents for a few days. Just in time for the Swimming Fish Festival!
I see, I see... But it's super far, isn't it? Philae's hundreds of miles away, right?
I see...==W== Anyway, welcome back, Jinglin.
Right. This is a big deal. We should totally celebrate! Why don't we—==W==<size=48>achoo==W==!</size>
Oh no, I forgot you're still soaked.==W== Here, let me wipe you down.
Hahaha... Feels like we're kids again, yeah?
Speaking of which... Lunch! How about Fenghuang Diner? If we go there, I can arrange something.
Fenghuang Diner! I haven't been in forever. Let's goooo!
Don't move, let me dry you properly.==W== Wait—"arrange" what?
Hehe, just leave it to me.==W== Look at this~!
Yup! Impressed? I'm the manager of Fenghuang Diner's branch in Philae.==W== Have you heard of Jing's Bistro?
Jing's Bistro? I've heard of it, but never thought you'd be the manager!
That's right! Come on, let's go eat! On the house!
Thanks! It's such a rare treat to get off work this early and enjoy a proper meal... Ahh it feels amazing.
So, so, so delicious! Fenghuang Diner really is the best!
Cangwu's changed so much since I left! Even this branch looks like it's been renovated.
Totally!==W== Remember that little alley by our old courtyard, Jinglin?
The alley with the candied haw shop==W== and the little store...==W== Yeah, the street looks different now.
Most of the businesses up and moved to the pedestrian street.==W== Some got handed down to the apprentices, but the flavors are still the same.
It's just ... much quieter here than it used to be.
True... But you haven't changed a bit, Shimiao!
And Chixia, you're a Xuan Shi in Yunji now, right?==W== Your talismans work really great; they're pretty famous, even in Philae!
Hahaha!! That's right!==W== I had no idea I'd become such a big deal, even in Philae! Hahaha!
And Shimiao, you were handling registrations for the Swimming Fish Festival earlier.==W== So you've officially joined the Baize Bureau?
I always admired how serious and hardworking you were.==W== You're amazing!
Awww, that's so nice of you to say, Jinglin...
She's right though! Shimiao processed a ton of applications today, all by herself! I'd never have managed it.
<size=48>Oh, no! My own fish lantern! I haven't finished it yet!</size>
Eh? You haven't made yours yet?
You were just helping kids light theirs, but you still haven't finished your own...==W== You really are something else...
After morning class I just ran straight outside...==W== I had so much fun that it completely slipped my mind!
Well… Honestly, I haven't finished mine either because I've been too busy with work.==W== Why don't we make them together?
Let's see whose lantern turns out the brightest!

strings.text: A Thousand Blossoms by Night (Part II)
The three friends gather at the Retreat to start making fish lanterns. Chixia then presents a surprising and ingenious design that no one expected…
Wow—this is that little grove outside the city, isn't it? The one we sneaked off to in the delivery cart when we were kids?
You actually remember that?==W== I was scared out of my mind hiding in that cart...==W== If we got caught, we would've been in so much trouble.
Yeah, you two were so mischievous back then—==W==and honestly, not much has changed.
So,==W== are we supposed to gather materials for the lanterns here?
Traditionally, yes. People would collect branches and bamboo skin to weave into strips.==W== But these days it's not that strict, you just make a frame and cover it.
Nonono, we said this was going to be a contest! The traditional way is definitely better!
Anyway, let's just each grab the prettiest materials we can find, then meet back at the Retreat to put them together!
Nice, looks like everyone came back with a good haul—! Let's get started!
Yeah, we'd better hurry or we won't finish them in time for the festival.
So...==W== This is the famous Yunji Retreat?==W== It feels==W== so imposing in person.
I've been here a few times for work, so it's not new to me... ==W==But come think of it, this is your first time, isn't it, Jinglin?
Don't be shy, make yourselves at home!==W== I already told my master we'd be using the place. All the older students are off for the afternoon,==W== so it's just us three.
So, what kind of lanterns are you two planning to make?
It's a secret... If I tell you now, it'll ruin the surprise.
Hehe, the fun's only just begun! Let's work on our lanterns separately and compare when we're done!
Chixia, where are the tools? I'll go fetch them!
By the time an incense stick had burned down, the quiet afternoon was filled only with the sound of crafting.
Ta-da! My lantern's finished! I'm definitely winning first place!
Ah—just missed beating you to it. But mine's done, too.
Perfect! Let's all show them at once.
Alright, since we did say this was a contest.
Let's count to three.==W== One,==W== two—
The Swimming Fish Festival is tied to rich traditions.==W== You both know the story behind the festival, right?
Back when Cangwu was first founded—
Long ago, a great flood hit Cangwu. A hero stepped up and led the people to carve channels through the mountains, build dikes, and dredge the waterways...
Yep, classic Shimiao, turning storytime into a lecture...

When the flood finally receded, the great hero transformed into a carp and vanished in the rivers.==W== Such is the story passed down through the generations, the origin of the Swimming Fish Festival...
Which means the most proper shape for a festival lantern is the carp.==W== Ahem—got it?
Yeah, yeah. We've heard that story a hundred times!==W== Our parents told it, our teachers told it, even my master told it! And now you again!
It's an important piece of folklore...==W== Oh well, fine.
Jinglin's is nice too—it's a Kun, right? The legendary giant fish?
Bingo! Trust Shimiao to know everything.
I know what Kun is. It's that huge fish...

The legendary great fish, said to dwell in the northern seas...==W== its body as vast as a mountain, transforming into a giant roc.==W== But no one has ever truly seen a Kun.==W== This lantern's design—was it from your own imagination, Jinglin?
Alright, alright, I get it.==W== Any excuse for another mini-lecture.
One time, a guest at my restaurant was so struck with inspiration==W== that they painted a Kun right there on the spot with brush and ink!
I modeled this fish lantern after that painting~
You've got a good memory too... That's impressive.
Anyway,==W== what did you draw exactly, Chixia...
Is that... a dog?==W== It looks like a puppy. How cute!
Nooo—! It's not a dog, certainly not a puppy!
Look at the design—==W==I clearly made a—==W=="Loong"!
... This is supposed to be a Loong?
Of course it is! Look—the tail, the horns.==W== Totally a Loong.
Eh...==W== No matter how you look at it, it doesn't really...
<size=48>Hahaha! So that's supposed to be a Loong?==W== Hahaha!</size>
Jinglin, don't laugh so hard...==W== Pfft—
Why are you both laughing? Do you like my Loong that much?
Hmph! My Loong will get the most attention tonight, just wait and see!
Pfft... Fine, fine. We'll call it a Loong... But it's not really a fish, is it?
Haha, true. A puppy—I mean, a "Loong"—isn't exactly a fish.
Don't sweat the details! There's a saying, "The carp leaps over the Loong Gate." Shimiao, you know that legend, right? ==W==
So if a carp can become a Loong, that means a Loong is basically a carp, which makes it a fish!
Mm... The legend does exist, yes... But it still sounds like twisted logic to me.
Said someone who just made remarks on my folklore.==W== Hmmm...
I'm so happy==W== I got back just in time for it!

Don't sweat the details! There's a saying, "The carp leaps over the Loong Gate." Shimiao, you know that legend, right? ==W==
So if a carp can become a Loong, that means a Loong is basically a carp, which makes it a fish!
Mm... The legend does exist, yes... But it still sounds like twisted logic to me.
Said someone who just made remarks on my folklore.==W== Hmmm...
I'm so happy==W== I got back just in time for it!

strings.text: A Thousand Blossoms by Night (Part III)
Jinglin, Shimiao, and Chixia have completed their lanterns and decide to compete at the Swimming Fish Festival. But under the festive night sky of Cangwu, an unexpected and magical scene unfolds...
Impressive...==W== really impressive! Chixia!==W== I apologize, I shouldn't have called it a puppy just now.
I have to admit, the effect is perfect.==W== Especially those gleaming scales...==W== They're too beautiful for words.
Well—now do you recognize my artistry? Hahaha, come on, tell me more!
This is my very own "Shining Gold Pigment." The formula's a secret.
"Shining Gold Pigment"...==W== Yes, the name fits.
Yeah, in all these lanterns, this one definitely stands out. Chixia, this time you're gonna win big!
Ah, but! We still have to let the others see them! Let's take our lanterns out onto the street!
The lantern parade is about to start. If we want to join, we need to get in line soon.
Oh wait, wait, I just remembered, there's one more thing to do!
Since you both know spells, why don't you each cast one on your lanterns?==W== Then I'll use my Xuan Shi power to keep the magic stable...
That way, ours will definitely be the brightest lanterns in the crowd!
I like the idea. Shimiao, what do you think?
Hmm... If all three of us cast spells, then it's not like anyone's cheating.==W== I'm in favor.
Then it's settled! Everyone, get ready—
Oh! That looks good, it should be eye-catching enough!
Heh, see? I had the right idea!
Though compared to traditional lanterns. it's ... a lot flashier. Let's light the last two as well.
Alright! All three are lit! After all this work, I'm hungry again!
Chixia said she still had some things to wrap up at the Retreat, so she told us to go on ahead and browse the food stalls.
Yeah, I've got some stuff to take care. We'll meet up later.
Want me to lend a hand?
Oh, nah. Nothing major. It's a one-person job!
What are you up to?==W== Never mind, Chixia knows this place like the back of her hand. Let's go.
Then let's go buy snacks! Is that nut and candied haw shop still around?
Sure is. I can probably find it, too!
... It feels like you have really grown up since back I last saw you, but you're still so open-hearted... I really like that about you.
Eh~ Really? I feel like you're treating me like a kid again, kinda embarrassing...
There's absolutely no reason for you to be embarrassed. You're both talented and kind, you deserve all the praise in the world!
Eh! Now I'm really embarrassed!==W== L-let's just go to the candy shop. My stomach's growling!
Hehehe... Now that Shimiao and Jinglin are gone...
Heheheh, with this secret pigment that I got from the Master...
Hehehe... There's no way I'll lose!
Chixia, remember, this pigment must be used with caution...
—For it can make the painting "lifelike." Be careful, do not splash it recklessly...
Yeah, yeah, I know, Master, don't you worry about it!
Nevermind, it's a festival after all. I suppose I'll go see the lanterns, too.
As the saying goes, "eyes are the window to a Loong's soul..."
Such a beautiful Loong lantern,==W== glowing gold, wreathed in water and thunder magic—==W==so its eyes must shine bright—!
Hahaha! Now, my "Shining n' Flying Loong Lantern" will be==W== the brightest of them all!
Ah... what's happening?! The walls, they're shaking...
W-wait! Hold on—! You can move?==W== No way!==W== The painting's coming alive?!
<size=48>Waaah!?</size>==W== Why are you grabbing me?! What are you trying to do—! Aaaahhh!!!
Ah, that was delicious—! From my childhood favorites to things I tried for the first time, everything tasted amazing!
I'm sure you'll have a lot of great food and plenty of fun on this trip back home.
And it's thanks to you and Chixia!==W== But... Chixia still hasn't come back, has she?
That's true... And it's a little worrying. Let's head back to the Retreat and check.
Okay! A walk will help with digestion, and then we'll have room to eat more!
Look, Shimiao! All the lanterns are lit up!
Yeah, every time I see this view, it's just breathtaking...
I'm so happy I got back just in time for it!
It's been so long since I came to Cangwu... Some things have changed and some haven't.
Some feel familiar while others feel new. It's hard to describe this feeling...
Anyway,==W== I'm just on cloud nine!
And I even got to meet up with you and Chixia! Today's definitely one of the top five perfect days of my life!
Glad to hear it.==W== And it's an honor to sharing this "perfect day" with you.
I'll be going back to Philae soon...==W== But next year, and the year after that—I'll keep coming back to see you both!
Whoa, look up there—What's that in the sky?!
Look farther out—! Is that... a golden Loong?!
Hey, look over there, is it a show? Looks like something's flying...
Fireworks? A spell? Is that this year's special surprise?!
We'd better hurry and find Chixia.
I've got a bad feeling about this, too. Let's go back to the Retreat ASAP!
Normally I'd agree but... Did you hear that...?
Chixia's voice? ...==W== Ah! I hear it, too!
I'm scared of heights...! Let me down!==W==<size=48> No wait, not like that, don't drop me—I'll fall!</size>
Ah, Chixia... She's really the center of attention now, just like she wanted.
Unbelievable... What did she even do...

The next day, that blazing golden dragon—==RT==sparking with fire and lightning, churning the clouds and storms—==RT==makes the front page of Cangwu City's news. ==RT==Seems like Chixia's wish comes true.

strings.text: While enjoying afternoon tea, the Goodwind Homecare Philae Branch suddenly receives a task from headquarters. To get the equipment needed for the mission, everyone sets off for the monolith.
Afternoon tea is ready. I tried that new matcha cake recipe I learned yesterday. It came out perfect.
This'll be a great surprise for Master when she gets back.
Master, where are you? I can't see you.
Was that ... a dream?==W== I can't believe I just dozed off. So unprofessional of me.
Master ... where could you have gone...?
Ugh—get that bucket of dirty dishwater out of here!
Dishwater?! Are you kidding me?==RT==It's soup, and it smells delicious!
Okra and Isaki...?==W== Did they make something?
D-Don't you bring that out here! You can't let her eat that! What, are you trying to betray and poison her?!
Betray Master? Of course not! I spent five hours on this. It's gonna be amazing!
If it's so "amazing," you take the first sip! C'mon, open up~
Oh? You are making something tasty?
Isaki, I'm just a senior, not your Master.
But you teach us, so does a Master! See? Same thing! That makes you our Master!
There's a big difference. "Master"... I'm not ready for that kind of weight.
... Never mind. Call me what you want.
Thanks, Master! Oh, look! I made my special broth for you! I know you've been working hard, so I figured you could use a little boost.
It has tangerine peel, Soul Waker, Ignis Fruit, Higanbana, Honeysuckle...
What kind of concoction is that?! Sounds like a culinary disaster...
I followed a recipe book to the letter, so it has to be fine!==RT==C'mon, Master, just one little taste!
Nanoha senpai, don't drink that! I'll give Isaki a talking-to later, I promise!
I appreciate the thought. I'll give it a try.
See? Master drank it right down. My broth must be amazing.
You made plenty. Why don't you have some too, Isaki?
I... I think I see my great-grandma ... waving at me from across a river.
Gasp... I'm alive! My cooking is a menace. It's straight-up poison...
It wasn't that bad. Just a bit muddled. With cooking, sometimes less is more.
U-Understood. That's why you're the Master! Another lesson learned!
Master, are you feeling okay? You drank that stuff too.
My Master used to say,==W== "A ninja must stomach anything edible. A maid must always maintain her grace."
Here at Goodwind Homecare, we're both. So, I hold myself to eating anything edible with grace.
Besides, Isaki's broth wasn't so terrible. The heart she put into it was actually quite delicious.
M... Master...==W== You're the only one who gets me.
I get it! Starting tomorrow, I'm training with this broth until I can down it without even flinching, just like you!
That's such a waste of ingredients!
It's almost tea time. I'll make the snacks today. How's a matcha cake sound?
I'm not big on bitter food, but I make an exception for matcha cake. That slight bitterness really brings out the sweetness.
Oh, I know! It's that "sweet is never as sweet without bitterness" thing...==W== Hey, did I just say something smart?
You did, right up until you pointed it out.
If you want to learn to cook, Isaki, we can start with this. Matcha cake is pretty forgiving for a beginner.
Yay! A cooking lesson from Master! I'll go get the ingredients!
The cake's gonna have to wait. We have a mission.
There's a banquet tomorrow in the Gold District, hosted by some wealthy merchant. Our intel says a Tanikaze noble we've been after might show up.
A noble we've been after...==W== The one who scammed our village?
The one and only. They've been a ghost for years, though, so don't get your hopes up. Let's just focus on the job and keep our eyes peeled.
Understood. We'll stay professional. So, what's our cover?
We're going in as chefs and maids.
Got it. Are we here at the Monolith to gather ingredients for the banquet?
Nope. The merchant's handling the ingredients. The problem is his demand: all maids must wear Philaen-style uniforms.
I think it's the kind they wear at those little cafés. A world of difference from our current uniforms.
Our Philae branch just got started, so we haven't had time to stock any. We'll have to put in a wish for them here at the Monolith.
Don't you worry, Master, leave it to me! I'm an expert at making wishes!
You really have a thing for giving your moves weird names. So where's the sakura part?
Those aren't sakura, Isaki. They're just Soul Waker petals...
You two, stop messing around. I've found the Wishing Box.
Oh, omnipotent God of Grace, with pious hearts we humbly ask of you...
The uniforms worn by the maids of Philae.
It opened! How's the maid outfit I wished for?
No way! Feel the fabric. This is definitely a maid outfit.
Who's ever heard of a two-piece maid outfit?! You can't possibly wear that in a banquet hall!
Well ... no, I guess not...==W== But yours is weird too! Why does a maid outfit have ears on it?
Um...==W== They're... They're just cute animal-themed accessories!
And that wouldn't be weird to wear in a banquet hall?!
For the mission, I-I can handle it!
You two can just be the chefs. My outfit, at least, is acceptable.
Didn't expect anything less from you, Nanoha senpai. Your maid outfit is perfectly by the book.
C'mon, Master, go try it on! There's a changing room right over there.
This is it! The absolute, perfect maid! Please, you have to let me get a picture!
Okay, okay, settle down. And Okra, don't just stand there taking pictures.
It's getting late. Let's head back so we can iron out the details for tomorrow.
Right. But Master, what about these other two outfits?
Can't let them go to waste. Grab 'em. You never know when they might come in handy.
I know I wished for it,==W== but ... really, what kind of mission could possibly call for an outfit like this?

strings.text: The mission begins! Amid the crowded banquet, what kind of dish will Okra prepare to track down the target?
Welcome, everyone! I'm so glad you could make it to my humble home. Please, come in, make yourselves at home!
You're too modest. I'd hardly call this place "humble."
Haha, you flatter me! Compared to your estate, this is just a little cottage. But really, I owe all my success to your company. Here's to our continued partnership.
The feeling is mutual, I assure you. To a prosperous future together!
Still no sign of anyone in a Tanikaze uniform. But he's been hiding for years, so he probably won't expose himself like that. I need another plan.
Okay, listen. Once we're in the kitchen, you are only making the matcha dessert. Got it? Don't touch any other ingredients.
Huh? Why?! I wanted to serve the main course!
Because if you accidentally poison a guest and blow our cover, it's game over.
Dessert is much simpler. You can handle it. Plus, we don't need it right away.
Fine...==W==Let's get to the kitchen and start prepping then!
Not yet. First, you're helping me pick up some ingredients from the market.
Nanoha just contacted me. She wants a dish only someone from Tanikaze is familiar with. A trap to make our target reveal themselves.
A dish only Tanikaze folks is familiar with...==W== Oh! I know what to get!
It's a true honor. I've heard so much about you.
I'm just an old wanderer, far from home. You give me too much credit.
Too modest! Your accomplishments are the stuff of legend.
That was all in the past. Today, I'm just here to relax. Please, don't draw any attention to me.
Understood. We've prepared some dishes from your hometown. I do hope you enjoy the evening.
Dishes from his hometown? So he's dressed like he's from the Gold District, but he isn't a Philae native.
I wonder how Isaki and Okra are doing...
How's it going on your end?
I'm on fugu sashimi. Pretty sure most of these guests won't know about this dish.
Heh heh, and I've got fresh grated crimson radish! Plus, a matcha cake.
Fugu sashimi... Right, exotic stuff for Philae. The radish is a nice touch, too. But ... a matcha cake?
It's for dessert at the end! I'm gonna give it my all!
Don't worry. I'll keep an eye on her. Though I've already lost count of how much matcha powder she's gone through.
Well, now I'm actually looking forward to Isaki's matcha cake.
See? Even Master's looking forward to my cake!
Just stick to the recipe.==RT==As long as you don't improvise, it should be fine... Probably...
My esteemed guests, how are you enjoying the food? You simply must try this fugu sashimi, a delicacy you can usually only find in Matsukawa and Cangwu.
Hang on...==W== Aren't pufferfish poisonous? Is this really safe to eat?
Rest assured, everyone. I hired a specialist to prepare the fish. It's perfectly safe.
I never thought I'd get fugu sashimi in Philae.==RT==Finding a chef who can properly remove its poisonous part must've been a challenge.
It certainly was, but we managed. Please, indulge yourselves.
Hmm. Such a clean, delicate flavor.
And they've even served it with grated crimson radish. A very nice touch.
You mean this stuff on the side? Isn't it just radish?
It's a spiced radish paste. You're meant to pair it with the sashimi.
Ah, a man who knows his food! If you hadn't said anything, the rest of us would've mistaken it for a simple garnish.
Haha, I ate it all the time back home. It's a real treat to taste something so nostalgic again. Thank you for your hospitality.
So he's the only one who knows about fugu and the radish paste. And he's not a Loong. That's gotta be our target.
But, first things first. I have a job to do. I'll deal with him after the banquet.
Storeroom ... the one with the matcha powder... Where is it...?
I knew I should've bought ten times as much. Can't believe we're already out...
Captain, word from the client. He's got eyes on the target.
Did I just overhear something dangerous? These guys...==W== Are they assassins one of the guests brought along?!
So, Captain, when do we make our move?
After the banquet. Or were you planning to start a brawl in front of all these nobles?
Good point. But, uh, Captain ... what exactly is a ninja?
You lot...==W== If you want to make it in this business, you need to wise up. Just think of them as Tanikaze mercenaries. A bunch of cowards who only know how to launch sneak attacks.
Coward?! How dare she?! I ought to show them...!
Wait, this isn't the time to get worked up. Crap, this whole commission is a trap! I have to warn everyone.
All good things must come to an end. And for our finale, please enjoy our special dessert!
Here is your dessert for this evening, a matcha cake.
Thank you. Ah, that nostalgic Tanikaze flavor... Tell me, miss, have you ever been to Matsukawa City?
Isn't that a distant city, way out on the western edge of the continent? I've only heard of it. They say the seas and forests there are beautiful.
Looks like you have a fine impression of it. In reality, it's just a remote, backwater place.

But speaking of which, this cake is shaped quite like that rundown island where Matsukawa City sits.==W== The only difference is ... this one's bitter, then sweet. All I have from that island are bitter memories.
My apologies. I'm sorry to take up your time. Spouting all this nonsense...==W== I think I must be a little tipsy.
Should I get you something to help with that? We have water and tea available.
No, thank you. This matcha cake is already doing the trick.
Captain! Matcha cake! That's my favorite. Can I just sneak a bite?
No chance. We're on a mission. Stay focused!
C'mon, Captain. We haven't eaten all night. We're running on empty here.
Who are you? What do you want?
I'm from the kitchen. The master requested we bring you all some dessert, a little taste of Tanikaze.
Matcha cake?! For real?! Oh, thank you! This client is a saint!
Hang on...==W== A chef? Then what's with the Tanikaze uniform?
Oh, don't be silly. I'm one of the master's subordinates, same as you. My job is to watch the kitchen.
Hmm...==W== Right. The master is from Tanikaze, so a few Tanikaze faces make sense. Thanks.
Alright, eat up. The banquet's almost over.
Thank you again for coming. Please, allow me to give you a ride in my car.
No need, but thank you. It's a fine night for a walk. May the God of Grace watch over you.
A moonless night. Perfect for an assassination.
To my friend in the shadows, aren't you going to take your shot?
Well, well. If it isn't the maid from the banquet. Have the Goodwind ninjas fallen so low that they're sending children on their missions?
Don't underestimate me.==W== You should be asking yourself why I'm here.
What...? So that's where my ambush squad went. You dealt with them...==W== Useless fools.
Warriors bought with Dorra have no real conviction. If you want loyal soldiers, you should choose more carefully.
Big words ... from a common sellsword.
You remember that extra grain tax you squeezed out of those villages?
Heh, of course. It was a pain, but I raked in a solid amount of Dorra for my trouble.
And that Dorra is what bought me a new life in the Gold District. A little bitterness before the sweet, just like a matcha cake, you know?
They were forced to pay that tax twice because of you. They've been struggling for years. And you feel no guilt?
Please. I don't need a lecture from some maid—==W==or is it ninja? It's that incompetent official's fault for slapping on another tax just 'cause he couldn't catch me.
Think of it as I gave them the "bitter" part. Then, maybe some do-gooder will come along and give them the "sweet."
Warriors bought with Dorra might not be loyal, but magic scrolls bought with Dorra? They never fail me.
Blocked again... There's no opening. The shield just reforms. Where do I aim?
I'd say just give up. I sank every last Dorra from that tax into these scrolls.==W== I've got plenty more.
But hey, if you want to keep trying, I've got all night.==W== Your friends, though... I doubt they have that long.
Shame, isn't it? Hired more mercs than you thought. I'd rather not get rough with you girls. How about a little chat?
I've got a way for us both to win.

param: The mission begins! Amid the crowded banquet, what kind of dish will Okra prepare to track down the target?
Welcome, everyone! I'm so glad you could make it to my humble home. Please, come in, make yourselves at home!
You're too modest. I'd hardly call this place "humble."
Haha, you flatter me! Compared to your estate, this is just a little cottage. But really, I owe all my success to your company. Here's to our continued partnership.
The feeling is mutual, I assure you. To a prosperous future together!
Still no sign of anyone in a Tanikaze uniform. But he's been hiding for years, so he probably won't expose himself like that. I need another plan.
Okay, listen. Once we're in the kitchen, you are only making the matcha dessert. Got it? Don't touch any other ingredients.
Huh? Why?! I wanted to serve the main course!
Because if you accidentally poison a guest and blow our cover, it's game over.
Dessert is much simpler. You can handle it. Plus, we don't need it right away.
Fine...==W==Let's get to the kitchen and start prepping then!
Not yet. First, you're helping me pick up some ingredients from the market.
Nanoha just contacted me. She wants a dish only someone from Tanikaze is familiar with. A trap to make our target reveal themselves.
A dish only Tanikaze folks is familiar with...==W== Oh! I know what to get!
It's a true honor. I've heard so much about you.
I'm just an old wanderer, far from home. You give me too much credit.
Too modest! Your accomplishments are the stuff of legend.
That was all in the past. Today, I'm just here to relax. Please, don't draw any attention to me.
Understood. We've prepared some dishes from your hometown. I do hope you enjoy the evening.
Dishes from his hometown? So he's dressed like he's from the Gold District, but he isn't a Philae native.
I wonder how Isaki and Okra are doing...
How's it going on your end?
I'm on fugu sashimi. Pretty sure most of these guests won't know about this dish.
Heh heh, and I've got fresh grated crimson radish! Plus, a matcha cake.
Fugu sashimi... Right, exotic stuff for Philae. The radish is a nice touch, too. But ... a matcha cake?
It's for dessert at the end! I'm gonna give it my all!
Don't worry. I'll keep an eye on her. Though I've already lost count of how much matcha powder she's gone through.
Well, now I'm actually looking forward to Isaki's matcha cake.
See? Even Master's looking forward to my cake!
Just stick to the recipe.==RT==As long as you don't improvise, it should be fine... Probably...
My esteemed guests, how are you enjoying the food? You simply must try this fugu sashimi, a delicacy you can usually only find in Matsukawa and Cangwu.
Hang on...==W== Aren't pufferfish poisonous? Is this really safe to eat?
Rest assured, everyone. I hired a specialist to prepare the fish. It's perfectly safe.
I never thought I'd get fugu sashimi in Philae.==RT==Finding a chef who can properly remove its poisonous part must've been a challenge.
It certainly was, but we managed. Please, indulge yourselves.
Hmm. Such a clean, delicate flavor.
And they've even served it with grated crimson radish. A very nice touch.
You mean this stuff on the side? Isn't it just radish?
It's a spiced radish paste. You're meant to pair it with the sashimi.
Ah, a man who knows his food! If you hadn't said anything, the rest of us would've mistaken it for a simple garnish.
Haha, I ate it all the time back home. It's a real treat to taste something so nostalgic again. Thank you for your hospitality.
So he's the only one who knows about fugu and the radish paste. And he's not a Loong. That's gotta be our target.
But, first things first. I have a job to do. I'll deal with him after the banquet.
Storeroom ... the one with the matcha powder... Where is it...?
I knew I should've bought ten times as much. Can't believe we're already out...
Captain, word from the client. He's got eyes on the target.
Did I just overhear something dangerous? These guys...==W== Are they assassins one of the guests brought along?!
So, Captain, when do we make our move?
After the banquet. Or were you planning to start a brawl in front of all these nobles?
Good point. But, uh, Captain ... what exactly is a ninja?
You lot...==W== If you want to make it in this business, you need to wise up. Just think of them as Tanikaze mercenaries. A bunch of cowards who only know how to launch sneak attacks.
Coward?! How dare she?! I ought to show them...!
Wait, this isn't the time to get worked up. Crap, this whole commission is a trap! I have to warn everyone.
All good things must come to an end. And for our finale, please enjoy our special dessert!
Here is your dessert for this evening, a matcha cake.
Thank you. Ah, that nostalgic Tanikaze flavor... Tell me, miss, have you ever been to Matsukawa City?
Isn't that a distant city, way out on the western edge of the continent? I've only heard of it. They say the seas and forests there are beautiful.
Looks like you have a fine impression of it. In reality, it's just a remote, backwater place.

But speaking of which, this cake is shaped quite like that rundown island where Matsukawa City sits.==W== The only difference is ... this one's bitter, then sweet. All I have from that island are bitter memories.
My apologies. I'm sorry to take up your time. Spouting all this nonsense...==W== I think I must be a little tipsy.
Should I get you something to help with that? We have water and tea available.
No, thank you. This matcha cake is already doing the trick.

strings.text: The three of them work together to resolve the crisis. Back home, however, Isaki and Okra sneak into the kitchen without Nanoha...
I've got a way for us both to win.
So that's your answer? Naughty maid. Alright, you guys... Cut off their pinkies. The girl needs a lesson.
You're gonna cut off whose pinkies?!
Huh? What are you...==W== You're supposed to be captured!
Oh, you're looking for the mercs guarding the banquet?
Captain, this matcha cake tastes off. Are you sure it's a matcha cake?
So this is the slop those rich folks eat at banquets? Suddenly, I don't envy them one bit.
My stomach hurts a bit… I'll head off first.
Wait, no. The cake! It's poisoned!
How rude! I didn't poison it. I poured my heart into that matcha cake. I just seasoned it a little differently.
You have zero talent for seasoning. That tasted worse than yesterday's dishwater.
It's a good thing I fixed the batch for the guests. Otherwise, we'd have a mass food poisoning incident on our hands.
Huh? Wait, does this mean I'm a genius at making food for assassins?
How can you possibly be so upbeat about this?!
... Forget about that for now. Hey. Where's your employer?
W-We won't tell you! We've got our pride.
Isaki. Give her some more cake.
You got it! C'mon, open wide!
No, wait, not the cake! I'll talk! I can take you there!
Those mercs were such a disappointment...==W== Taken down by a single piece of cake.
Yeah, that's right! Surrender, and give back the grain you stole!
The grain's long gone. Why should I return it? I have nothing to atone for. I scammed that grain from you fair and square.
Come and get me. I've got magical defense scrolls to spare.
Isaki, got any more of your cake?
Here, Master! Help yourself! There's plenty!
W-What are you planning to do with that?
Impressive, those magical defense scrolls. But they only block threats from the outside...
They're useless against something that brews from within.
You—what did you just toss in my mouth?! Gack! What is this flavor?! How is it sweet and spicy at the same time?!
Ah...==W== This is ... the sea outside Matsukawa City—
Mission accomplished! Things got a little chaotic, but I'm just glad we all made it back safe!
Oh, please. You were ninety percent of the chaos.
Still, selling off all those scrolls we nabbed should keep the village afloat for a while. All things considered, I'd call that a major win.
It's not nearly enough to save the village, but it went smoother than I thought. Before joining Goodwind Homecare, I'd completely given up hope.
Now we can have some delicious rice when we get home.
We'll eat ...==W== so long as you're nowhere near the kitchen.
I can handle making rice! And I promise not to start any of my culinary experiments on it.
I just wonder ...==W== when we'll actually get to go home.
Who knows. Being ninjas... and maids ... doesn't leave much time for homecomings.
But hey, Goodwind Homecare is home now.
The bath is ready. You can go ahead.
Master, you must be tired today. You should go first. You really need to rest!
Shuffling her off like that... You're planning to secretly bake her that matcha cake, aren't you?
We've known each other forever. The moment she said she was looking forward to your cake, you looked like you were about to start bouncing off the walls.
We should make it together. If I'm not watching you, you'll definitely end up improvising again.
Heehee.==W== Thanks, I owe you one!
Whew...==W== Soaked a little too long. I'd better go get those two.
Huh? It's snowing? Guess winter is really here.
Time flies. The new year will be here before we know it.
Ugh... Matcha cake is so hard to get right. I should've just saved the one from the banquet...
Out of the question. A maid who steals food from guests is no maid at all.
Isaki and Okra...?==W== What are they up to there?
But no matter what I do, it still looks like a mossy rock! Master's going to chip a tooth on this for sure!
Don't panic. She usually takes thirty minutes to bathe, so we've still got time.
Ugh... Okay...==W== I'll give it one more try.
So, they're making me a matcha cake...==W== Just like what I used to do for my Master.
I guess I'll pretend I'm not done and just sit out here for a bit.
The last time I made you a matcha cake...==W== It was so long ago, Master.
Back then, you'd sit right outside the door, waiting for me to finish before you came in.
I used to be just like Isaki —
Loving to sprinkle lots of matcha powder into my desserts.
I used to do that, too... I figured piling on all the "important" ingredients was how you showed something was special.
You had basically nothing but a spoonful of matcha powder, yet you kept a straight face and told me it was delicious...
The snow is falling even more heavily.
The flakes are right there, but the moment I try to catch them in my hand, they melt away instantly.
Master, why did you leave so suddenly before spring arrived?
Those beautiful, fleeting days are gone in the blink of an eye, leaving no trace behind.
Well, it's about time. I should head in now ... just like you did.
C'mon! She must be tired of waiting by now!
U-um!==W== I... I wanted you to try this!
It's a matcha cake I made for you, Master! I worked so hard on it...==W==<size=35> Please...</size><size=30> M-Master... Try some...</size>
Isaki. What are the rules for a maid when presenting food?
<size=35>Stay calm and graceful, remember? You can do it, Isaki!</size>
Ahem...==W== Okra and I made this matcha cake. Please have a taste, Master.
You gotta be gentle with the spatula!
It's all right. I think it has personality. Looks wonderful.
Still too much matcha powder, right, senpai?
Not at all, it's delicious! I actually prefer my matcha cake on the bitter side.
Oh, really?! Yes! All that hard work paid off!
I can make matcha cake! I can finally make matcha cake!
Don't celebrate just yet! You still have a long way to go to perfect it.
She's right. The road to mastery is long.
For now, your priority is the bath. The water's getting cold.
Oh!==W== I got so caught up with the cake, I completely forgot.
Ah! I'm not taking a cold bath! Okra, hurry!
Phew...==W== Matcha cake really does taste better with tea.
Master, you once said that matcha cake tastes bitter before it tastes sweet.
No matter how much bitterness you endure, joy is sure to follow... So when will my own sweetness arrive?
I think I'm starting to understand how you felt.
Nanoha digs in with her spoon, lifting a piece heavy with matcha powder, and takes a bite.

strings.text: The Old Timer and the Newcomer (Part I)
To escape the grasp of her demon-of-a-boss, Albedo, Laru claimed she was taking Bastelina to the Trekker Association to show her the ropes.
Laru! Care to explain these expense reports properly?
Weren't you taking the supplier out for lunch? How did you end up ordering ten large "Monolith fries"?
Uh... That was the business meal with the supplier...==W== Can't I reimburse that?
And this one! "Master-grade fishing gear set"? Were you planning to catch your own dinner?
That ...==W== that was a gift! A gift for the supplier...
<size=50>LOOK ME IN THE EYE.==W== And say that again!
Waaah... Albedo's really mad this time.
But since it's Laru getting yelled at, that's pretty normal.
Haha... Another day, another scolding for Laru. Just the natural order of things.
Hmmm, as her adorable junior, I guess I'll have to find a way to bail her out...
Business entertainment, huh? This isn't your first time taking supplier out for fries, is it?
That contract could've been signed right after lunch, but instead you took them fishing all afternoon! Just what were you thinking?
Well, they said they liked fishing too...
More like you finished the contract in the morning and just didn't wanna go back to the office, so you went fishing.
Even if we let that slide—why did you have to go all the way into the Wilds? What if you ran into monsters?!
That's where the big fish are! And even if monsters showed up, I could handle them easily.
Big fish, huh?==W== Then where's the contract, after all that hard work of yours?
The contract...==W== I did get it signed, but after I got back to the office it kinda ... disappeared...
Honestly, I don't care how you get things done as long as you get them done. But now you've even lost the contract...
<size=50>I didn't lose it! It just got misplaced!
Uh—Excuse me, Miss Albedo? There's a supplier waiting outside who wishes to see you, urgently.
Perfect! Let him in!==W== I'll deal with you later!
Miss Albedo, I apologize for showing up without an appointment. I hope I'm not intruding.
Not at all! In fact, I was planning to visit you myself to apologize for yesterday's poor hospitality. Please, have a seat.
Poor hospitality? Miss Laru's reception was far from poor!==W== On the contrary, I had a wonderful time.
The place she chose for lunch was quite unique, and those fries were surprisingly delicious...
But what really amazed me was that... That afternoon, under her guidance, I caught the biggest fish of my life!
Oh, that was nothing! We can go again sometime. I know plenty of other good fishing spots!
Yes! Please do take me next time!
Oh, right... I actually came here today to return this contract. After fishing yesterday, I accidentally took your copy with me. My apologies.
By way of apology, we're offering a ten-percent discount on the final purchase price. Thank you for your time. I'll take my leave now.
Ah, allow me to walk you out.
The supplier left, and as the office door clicked shut, silence filled the room.
So ... does that mean my expense reports are approved?
Go to accounting later and go through the usual process.
Yes! Thank you!==W== Then I'll be on my way!
Hold it! I'm not done yet! We still need to talk about your work attitude!
Oh, that reminds me of something!
Bastelina! Since your probation just ended, I never did bring you up to date with our procurement work with the Trekker Association, did I?
Eh? No, I don't think so...
And today just happens to be our scheduled meeting day with them! Let's get going!
It's fine, it's fine~ You're a full-time employee now, Bastelina! You've gotta get familiar with your job fast! No slacking off!
(sigh) Never mind. Just go, you two.==W== I must had accumulated some bad karma in a previous life to get a subordinate like that...
So ... what exactly is our procurement business with the Trekker Association?
Well, you know how we need tons of Artifacts for our research and projects, right? We outsource all that collection work to the Trekker Association and settle account regularly.
I see! Let me write that down...
I just said that so we could get out from her office.
Our "regular meetings" with the Trekker Association are only technically on a schedule. We can actually drop by whenever we want. I was literally just there a few days ago.
We said we would, so we might as well go, if only for appearance's sake. Don't wanna get caught.
That reminds me! Bastelina, you haven't met Willow yet, have you?
Willow? I think I've seen that name on a partner list before...
She's the head of the Trekker Association's Emor City branch. And she's an old friend of mine!
You can meet her today and get a sense of how we work with the Trekker Association.

Hmmm, as her adorable junior, I guess I'll have to find a way to bail her out...
Business entertainment, huh? This isn't your first time taking supplier out for fries, is it?
That contract could've been signed right after lunch, but instead you took them fishing all afternoon! Just what were you thinking?
Well, they said they liked fishing too...
More like you finished the contract in the morning and just didn't wanna go back to the office, so you went fishing.
Even if we let that slide—why did you have to go all the way into the Wilds? What if you ran into monsters?!
That's where the big fish are! And even if monsters showed up, I could handle them easily.
Big fish, huh?==W== Then where's the contract, after all that hard work of yours?
The contract...==W== I did get it signed, but after I got back to the office it kinda ... disappeared...
Honestly, I don't care how you get things done as long as you get them done. But now you've even lost the contract...
<size=50>I didn't lose it! It just got misplaced!
Uh—Excuse me, Miss Albedo? There's a supplier waiting outside who wishes to see you, urgently.
Perfect! Let him in!==W== I'll deal with you later!
Miss Albedo, I apologize for showing up without an appointment. I hope I'm not intruding.
Not at all! In fact, I was planning to visit you myself to apologize for yesterday's poor hospitality. Please, have a seat.
Poor hospitality? Miss Laru's reception was far from poor!==W== On the contrary, I had a wonderful time.
The place she chose for lunch was quite unique, and those fries were surprisingly delicious...
But what really amazed me was that... That afternoon, under her guidance, I caught the biggest fish of my life!
Oh, that was nothing! We can go again sometime. I know plenty of other good fishing spots!
Yes! Please do take me next time!
Oh, right... I actually came here today to return this contract. After fishing yesterday, I accidentally took your copy with me. My apologies.
By way of apology, we're offering a ten-percent discount on the final purchase price. Thank you for your time. I'll take my leave now.
Ah, allow me to walk you out.
The supplier left, and as the office door clicked shut, silence filled the room.
So ... does that mean my expense reports are approved?
Go to accounting later and go through the usual process.
Yes! Thank you!==W== Then I'll be on my way!
Hold it! I'm not done yet! We still need to talk about your work attitude!
Oh, that reminds me of something!
Bastelina! Since your probation just ended, I never did bring you up to date with our procurement work with the Trekker Association, did I?
Eh? No, I don't think so...
And today just happens to be our scheduled meeting day with them! Let's get going!
It's fine, it's fine~ You're a full-time employee now, Bastelina! You've gotta get familiar with your job fast! No slacking off!
(sigh) Never mind. Just go, you two.==W== I must had accumulated some bad karma in a previous life to get a subordinate like that...
So ... what exactly is our procurement business with the Trekker Association?
Well, you know how we need tons of Artifacts for our research and projects, right? We outsource all that collection work to the Trekker Association and settle account regularly.
I see! Let me write that down...
I just said that so we could get out from her office.
Our "regular meetings" with the Trekker Association are only technically on a schedule. We can actually drop by whenever we want. I was literally just there a few days ago.
We said we would, so we might as well go, if only for appearance's sake. Don't wanna get caught.
That reminds me! Bastelina, you haven't met Willow yet, have you?
Willow? I think I've seen that name on a partner list before...
She's the head of the Trekker Association's Emor City branch. And she's an old friend of mine!
You can meet her today and get a sense of how we work with the Trekker Association.

strings.text: The Old Timer and the Newcomer (Part II)
After arriving at the Trekker Association, they are informed that Willow is on a trip. Determined not to go back to work, Laru decides to simply wait there until Willow's return.
Oh hey, Leafia! You're on duty today? That's a first.
True. Didn't you just come by a few days ago? Here to slack off again?
No no no... Perish the thought!==W== I'm here to show the newbie around!
Hello, I'm Bastelina. I just became a full-time employee of Grace Imperium.
My name's Leafia. I'm a surveyor for Sea Wakers. I help out at the front desk once in a while.
Where's Willow? Let her explain the details to Bastelina.
You haven't heard? Miss Willow went on a business trip to HQ. She hasn't come back yet.
A business trip?==W== Oh right! She mentioned something about that—because of the Monolith Meltdown...
She's scheduled to be back tonight. Maybe you would like to come another day?
Nah, we'll just wait here for her to come back!
Miss Laru, we don't have to wait all day, do we?
Come on, think about it!==W== If we go back now, that means going back to work, doesn't it?
Then you stay here, Miss Laru. I'll head back first, there's stuff to do at the Soul Shop.
No no no! My job today is to "help the newbie get familiar with the process." If the newbie leaves, then I can't do my job, can I?
Work's about finishing fast and enjoying your free time, that's what I always say.
(Why is Laru so motivated only when it's about goofing off...?)
Hello! Super–mega–jumbo Monolith fries delivery! Whose order is it?
(When did she order this?==W== Wait—don't tell me this was her plan all along?)
If you are going to wait, please come inside. Follow me, please.
I'll head back to work. I am downstairs, please call me if you need me.
Ahh~ Fries taste best when you're lying on a couch~
Miss Laru, it doesn't seem right for you to be eating fries on someone else's sofa...
Don't worry. Willow doesn't care about stuff like this~
Make yourself at home, Bastelina.==W== Oh, that cushion's a bit flat—grab another spot, if you like.
You seem very familiar with this place...
Of course! This is like a second home to me!
Once you start taking field assignments, you can come hang out here too!
I think I'll pass...==W== Even if I do, I'll ask for time off first.
No no no, if you take time off they'll dock your pay, and your supervisor will think poorly of you. Especially if it's someone like that ice queen Albedo.
But ...==W== isn't that bad for the company? They pay us every month on time, after all.
Bastelina, you really don't get it. The company pays us for delivering results, not for our time!
But if we get caught doing that, they'll definitely dock our pay...
That's why you don't get caught! I've got this book from the Monolith called The Art of Strategic Slacking. It's got thirty-six ingenious tactics! I'll lend it to you some time.
Just don't let your boss see it, or she'll confiscate it and use the same tricks on you.
Ahaha... As a newbie, I don't think I'm ready for those "tactics." I'll just stick to doing my job. Thanks though, Miss Laru.
Okay. Just let me know if you change your mind.
But seriously, it's so boring when Willow's not here~
You like fishing? Let's go fishing!
Weren't you supposed to be showing me the work process? And what if Miss Willow comes back while we're gone?
Oh right, right! About that.==W== Have you heard of the Trekkers' House?
I think so... It's that super important place for Trekkers, right?
Yeah. It's kind of like a field office they'd set up in Nova's Wilds.
Trekkers pick up commissions and get paid there. They've also got cheap rooms and meals.==W== Basically, if you wanna find lots of Trekkers, that's the only place. You won't find any in the city.
Ah, I get it! That's why we have the Trekker Association handle our Artifact commissions all at once. Doing it ourselves at every Trekkers' House would waste a ton of time!
Smart girl! You catch on fast for a rookie.
Anyway, all we have to do is grab the inventory lists and price sheets from Willow, hand them to Albedo and her bookkeepers, and we're done.
Just the list? Don't we check the goods?==W== What if something's wrong...?
Don't worry. Willow's super reliable. She checks everything, even the tiniest scratch on these Artifacts.
We've worked with her for ages and never had an issue. We just need to do our part and trust her.
Besides, if we tried to check every detail of the process ourselves, we'd never have time for anything else. You've gotta trust your partners~
I see... So finding trustworthy partners is key...
Excuse me, I just need to move these boxes.
Whoa... That's a mountain of paperwork!
Yes, and there are two more boxes like this downstairs.
No, thanks. You are our guests.
It's fine! We're partners, right? Helping each other is only natural!
Then ...==W== could you help me move the ones by the stairs?
Haha—fresh-faced newbies really are the best.==W== I used to be that bright-eyed too...
Ah well. Eating fries while slacking off is way better~
What's in these anyway? They're heavy. Are we moving all of them?
Yes. With Miss Willow away, a bunch of Trekker reports and transaction papers piled up.
They all need reviewing and signing by tomorrow. I'm bringing them upstairs for her ahead of time.
Just a few days away and it piles up like this? The Trekker Association's workload sounds terrifying.
Take this one—it's lighter. Half of it's filled with work-use Artifacts.
You sure you can move it? Don't overdo it.
Piece of cake~ I may look small and cute, but I used to haul Artifacts every day during my internship!
Here is good. Thank you so much, Bastelina!
Whew—nothing like a little hard work to clear your head~
Thanks again. Let me pour you some tea. Please, take a seat.
(Whoa... If it was me, this pile of paperwork would take more than a week...)
(Could Miss Willow really get it all done before tomorrow?)

strings.text: The Old Timer and the Newcomer (Part III)
Discovering that Willow's overtime is a result of her actions, Laru surprisingly sits at Willow's desk and completes the overdue work for her.
Ah! Me too! Me too! Thanks!
It smells amazing. Thank you for the tea.
With this many files, can Miss Willow really finish them all by tomorrow?
Mm, she's incredibly efficient. She'll probably have them all done by early morning.
All done in one night? That fast!? Miss Willow sounds incredible!
Huh? In that case...==W== Sorry if this sounds rude, but... If Miss Willow's so capable, why did so many files pile up before she left?
Uh... Maybe because ...==W== she went fishing with me a few days ago...
Fishing?==W== A few days ago... Wasn't that supposed to be your regular liaison visit, Miss Laru?
Wait, let me explain! I had a good reason...==W== Hey, don't give me that look!
And what reason could possibly be more important than Miss Willow's work?
She was buried in paperwork for days! I just wanted her to relax for a bit!==W== I swear that's all it was—trust me!
I understand your worrying about your friend,==W== but ignoring work doesn't make it disappear.
Ah, a Trekker. Please excuse me for a bit.
Everyone at the Trekker Association looks busy.
Compared to that, the Grace Imperium's workload is pretty light, isn't it?
Hey now, I just use my brilliant intellect to get work done fast! The workload itself isn't light at all!
I see. So basically, you breeze through your tasks quickly,==W== and when it's Miss Willow's turn, she's left pulling all-nighters to catch up...
I ... I also pulled an all-nighter a few days ago...
That's because you were slacking off before. Wasn't it, Miss Laru?
Hmmm, staying up all night's rough. It wrecks your focus for the next day. Lady Willow's really overworked.
A newbie like me might just quit after a few rounds of that.
I ... I didn't realize there was still this much left to do...
You know what! To make it up to her, I'll handle these documents!
You sure you can do that?
I might be unfamiliar with Trekker reports, but categorizing Artifacts and checking lists? That's totally my thing!
But these are Trekker Association documents—we probably shouldn't touch them, right?
There's always a way! Right now, I'm not a Grace Imperium employee. I'm just a Trekker volunteering to help Miss Willow out!
(She didn't even hesitate... Wow, she's really doing it!)
(I've never seen Miss Laru this serious before...)
Cooking Artifacts: high-pressure cooker Artifact, brand new; combustion Artifact, eighty percent new... Magic Firearms: two long guns, one short, all tested only once...
Don't underestimate me! I'm the kind of person who can clear a week's workload in a single night!
(Miss Laru can be incredibly productive when she puts her mind to it...)
At this pace, we might even finish before Willow gets back—and surprise her!
At this hour, she's probably off duty.
Hello, you must be Miss Willow! I'm Bastelina, the newest employee at the Grace Imperium.
Nice to meet you.==W== Grace Imperium... So you're with Laru?
After finishing all the Artifact price checks, Miss Laru fell asleep on the desk. I just wanted to say hello to you before heading out.
Thank you for letting me know. Ah, Laru...
I think I might've misjudged her...==W== I didn't realize she could be this dedicated.
She is fond of slacking off, sure; but when she gets serious, she's unstoppable.
Yeah, I can't hold a candle to her accuracy and speed.
Sounds like all the misunderstandings are cleared up, then.
That's right... Now that you're back, I'll take my leave. If you don't mind, I'll leave Miss Laru in your care.
Don't worry. Monsters or not, who could bring themselves to hurt a cute newbie like me?
Hah, to think she actually got Laru to work...==W== This newbie's got potential.
She's out cold. And ...==W== she ate fries at my desk again...
Hey! Wake up already! Sleeping like this is bad for you! And you left the window open—you'll catch a cold!
Good grief... At least cover yourself with the cloak...
Oh come on, still dreaming about fries? One day you'll turn into a fry yourself.==W== Wait! I got it!
Ta-da! The Fry Fairy's here to visit you!==W== Courtesy of my finger, anyway.
A fry ...==W== dressed in Willow's clothes...
Ah...==W== I'll just have a bite...
Ehhh? Bastelina!?==W== Ah—uh—this isn't what it looks like!!
Please don't mind me, carry on, carry on... I didn't see a thing~
It's not what you think! And weren't you supposed to be gone already!?
I left my bookmark here, so I came back to get it...
This isn't the time for this!==W== Wake up, Laru!
Uh? Oh hey, Willow... You're back...
Nooo, she's definitely gonna get the wrong idea...
Hmmm... Welcome back... What wrong idea?

After that, Laru is forced to clean the entire office from top to bottom and explain to Willow how she'd handled the price check documents. Only after they agree to go fishing together that weekend does she finally take her leave.

strings.text: Soul of a Guard, Heart of a Knight (Part I)
A scolded heroine, a cameraman roped in halfway, and a ragtag crew that can't work together. The Imperial Guard's promotional film starts shooting now!
On this land, there is ... there is a kind of power...
It ... it doesn't come from the gods, or from magic—
It comes from our in-inner courage!
It is not just a name! It is ...
... it is the embodiment of a kind of s-s-spirit!
What's with all the stammering?! Can't you even deliver one line properly?!
Hey, cameraman! Anything usable in that take?
I–I can do it again! I'll definitely get it right this time!
Forget it, forget it. It's already noon. I'm taking a lunch break. We'll continue in the afternoon.
Ugh, are we even gonna finish shooting today? I don't wanna waste another day off on this.
This isn't working. Tilia's way too nervous... She can't get through her lines properly.
The knights grumbled as they walked off, leaving only Tilia behind, apologizing over and over.
As for why I ended up as the cameraman at the Imperial Guard's base... That goes back to this morning.
Just to check one more time... You do know how to use a professional record-camera Artifact, right?
Not a point-and-shoot one for amateurs. An actual, professional-grade one.
I sorta know how to use it, but I'm no professional.
That's fine. I wasn't expecting you to do a top job.
Hey, Kaydoke! I found someone who knows how to work the camera!
Got it, got it. I'm busy calibrating the gear. Just send them over!
Go find the red-haired girl over there. If you're not sure about anything, ask her.
So you're the temp cameraman they found...==W== Huh? Well, if it isn't the Boss!
Didn't think you'd remember me. I go by Kaydoke.
Heh, what a coincidence...==W==Tilia! You've got a visitor!
Eh? Ehhhh!?==W== Bo-Boss?! Why are you here?!
I explained why I'd shown up.
Oh, so you're here to help, Boss! Awesome~
Our original cameraman got hit by a carriage this morning. He's fine, but his wrist's hurt, so he can't work today.
That explains why the Imperial Guards came rushing to the Trekkers' House to post an urgent commission.
So what are you filming, anyway? The knight who brought me only said it was a recording job.
They didn't even bother explaining the assignment to you before bringing you here? Typical Guard behavior.
The higher-ups want a promo video for the Imperial Guard. ==W==Something like ... "showing the guards' spirit, improving public image, attracting new recruits"—that sort of thing.
And as for the star of the show—none other than our Tilia!
So that's why you're in that outfit. It really suits you, Tilia.
Everyone in position? We start filming in ten minutes!
So soon?! I'll go review my lines again...
Then I'll take Boss to get familiar with the recording setup.
Hehe... With you two here, I feel a lot steadier.
Good luck! We're both here for morale support!
Right! Let's nail this promo in one go!
She was all raring to go before the filming actually started. However...
Sigh... How did it come to this...
You've worked hard. Here, have some water.
I'm sorry... I just wasted everyone's time. The seniors went out of their ways to get me this chance, and I still messed it up...
It's not your fault. They didn't even give you any time to get used to the camera. They only told you about the shoot last night! That's like setting you up to fail.
Yeah. The higher-ups suddenly decided they wanted a promo video, but none of the knights wanted the job. Especially not the lead role.
You know the Guard's reputation out there... No one wants to show their face in the video and become a laughingstock.
So they kept passing it around like a hot potato until it landed on Tilia. She spent the whole night memorizing her lines.
If you ask me, none of the knights here actually care about the job. They're all just doing the bare minimum to hand something in to their superiors. Tilia's the only one taking it seriously.
I get what you mean, Kay. It's true that the Imperial Guard's public image is not great these days...
But once we put on a cool, inspiring video, maybe people would start to see the Guard differently.==W== That's why I really want to show the world what an Imperial Knight should be!
Hmm, I knew you'd say that. Since you're trying so hard, I can't just leave you to struggle alone.
So what now? With your poor acting, you can hardly expect people to get what a proper Imperial Knight is supposed to look like.
Ugh...==W== I don't know why, but the second I face the camera, my mind just blanks. All the lines I memorized go "poof"...
Maybe it's time for a different approach?
You have something in mind, Boss?
A friend of mine in Flavio once said, people freeze up in front of cameras because they're thinking too much about acting.
But the more you try to "act," the more awkward it looks.
So, instead of thinking about "acting," you should try to become the role itself.
Tilia, in your eyes, who's the coolest, most inspiring knight?
Then try to imagine that you are the Masked Knight. As the Masked Knight, what would you say to others? What would you want them to feel?
If I were the Masked Knight...!

param: Soul of a Guard, Heart of a Knight (Part I)
A scolded heroine, a cameraman roped in halfway, and a ragtag crew that can't work together. The Imperial Guard's promotional film starts shooting now!
On this land, there is ... there is a kind of power...
It ... it doesn't come from the gods, or from magic—
It comes from our in-inner courage!
It is not just a name! It is ...
... it is the embodiment of a kind of s-s-spirit!
What's with all the stammering?! Can't you even deliver one line properly?!
Hey, cameraman! Anything usable in that take?
I–I can do it again! I'll definitely get it right this time!
Forget it, forget it. It's already noon. I'm taking a lunch break. We'll continue in the afternoon.
Ugh, are we even gonna finish shooting today? I don't wanna waste another day off on this.
This isn't working. Tilia's way too nervous... She can't get through her lines properly.
The knights grumbled as they walked off, leaving only Tilia behind, apologizing over and over.
As for why I ended up as the cameraman at the Imperial Guard's base... That goes back to this morning.
Just to check one more time... You do know how to use a professional record-camera Artifact, right?
Not a point-and-shoot one for amateurs. An actual, professional-grade one.
I sorta know how to use it, but I'm no professional.
That's fine. I wasn't expecting you to do a top job.
Hey, Kaydoke! I found someone who knows how to work the camera!
Got it, got it. I'm busy calibrating the gear. Just send them over!
Go find the red-haired girl over there. If you're not sure about anything, ask her.
So you're the temp cameraman they found...==W== Huh? Well, if it isn't the Boss!
Didn't think you'd remember me. I go by Kaydoke.
Heh, what a coincidence...==W==Tilia! You've got a visitor!
Eh? Ehhhh!?==W== Bo-Boss?! Why are you here?!
I explained why I'd shown up.
Oh, so you're here to help, Boss! Awesome~
Our original cameraman got hit by a carriage this morning. He's fine, but his wrist's hurt, so he can't work today.
That explains why the Imperial Guards came rushing to the Trekkers' House to post an urgent commission.
So what are you filming, anyway? The knight who brought me only said it was a recording job.
They didn't even bother explaining the assignment to you before bringing you here? Typical Guard behavior.
The higher-ups want a promo video for the Imperial Guard. ==W==Something like ... "showing the guards' spirit, improving public image, attracting new recruits"—that sort of thing.
And as for the star of the show—none other than our Tilia!
So that's why you're in that outfit. It really suits you, Tilia.
Everyone in position? We start filming in ten minutes!
So soon?! I'll go review my lines again...
Then I'll take Boss to get familiar with the recording setup.
Hehe... With you two here, I feel a lot steadier.
Good luck! We're both here for morale support!
Right! Let's nail this promo in one go!
She was all raring to go before the filming actually started. However...
Sigh... How did it come to this...
You've worked hard. Here, have some water.
I'm sorry... I just wasted everyone's time. The seniors went out of their ways to get me this chance, and I still messed it up...
It's not your fault. They didn't even give you any time to get used to the camera. They only told you about the shoot last night! That's like setting you up to fail.
Yeah. The higher-ups suddenly decided they wanted a promo video, but none of the knights wanted the job. Especially not the lead role.
