strings.text: Soul of a Guard, Heart of a Knight (Part II)
The appearance of a wicked foe shatters the calm. In the face of evil, where will justice stand?
Everyone in position?==W== Next scene—Three, two, one, action!
The oath of the Imperial Guard is not just a line; it is the light that shines in my heart.
We are Imperial Guards, protectors of the Empire, champions of justice!
No matter what lies ahead, I will not cower—because I am a member of the Imperial Guard!
That was good! Very good! Facial expression was lively and natural, and the delivery had real feelings!
One thing, though. Why were your lines different from what's written in the script?
Haha... I felt this version showcases the Guard's spirit better, so I added a little of my own interpretation...
Fine, it's close enough. We can use this cut as is.
You're doing great. Zero retakes for the last couple of scenes.
That's all thanks to Boss's advice! I pictured myself as the Masked Knight and the lines just came out naturally!
You already had the conviction inside you; I just helped you shape it into words.
Still ...==W== even though my line delivery is okay now, I still feel like something's missing.
Really? I thought those segments were pretty strong.
No, it's not the lines themselves. It's just ... weird.
I feel the same way. Even though her delivery has improved a lot, it still feels a bit awkward to have Tilia standing there reciting lines all by herself.
It'd be better if there was someone to play opposite her.
Yeah, that's right! In Masked Knight, the heroes are always fighting villains.
I'll go see if we can add a bit of that kind of scene~
No way. The script doesn't have a scene like that, and where am I supposed to find someone to play a villain on such short notice?
Don't overthink it. Rest up and we'll get back to filming. We have to finish today.
When the break ends, filming resumes.==W== Just then, a commotion suddenly broke out nearby.
Someone got robbed! The guy ran that way!
Get out of my way if you wanna live!
A tall, broad-shouldered man came charging on a two-wheeler bike Artifact, radiating aggression.
Eh? This robber isn't in the script, is he...?
Wow! You're amazing. You got an actor on such short notice!
Huh? I-I don't know anything about this!
He's acting looks so convincing. Properly terrifying!
What's a professional record camera doing here?==W== Heh, this thing's worth a pretty Dorra. I'm gonna get rich!
The frustrated robber curses and speed away.
I'm fine. Thank goodness for Tilia—
This camera Artifact cost a fortune to rent. If it got banged up, no bonus for me this month! Move away, let me take a look!
How many times this month now?
Who knows. That biker robber's been targeting people with Artifacts and caused quite a few accidents. No one's doing anything about it!
Isn't the Imperial Guards right there? Aren't they supposed to handle stuff like that?
Yeah, right! I bet the Guards couldn't care less.
Captain! We should chase after him!
Better to keep out of it. Besides, the person who got robbed didn't ask us to retrieve the phone. Why stick your nose in?
The robber's long gone. We can't catch him now. The priority is finishing the shoot.
Yeah, we need to finish this quick and get it in.
That's right. I don't wanna waste all my effort.
But ...==W== as a member of the Imperial Guard. I can't just stand by when I see evil!
If even we don't care about a knight's honor, who will defend justice as we know it?
Even if no one asked us,==W== I'm going after that robber!
Captain, I need to borrow this.
No way! Absolutely not! This is a prop the company provided for filming; if it gets damaged, we can't afford the replacement!
Tilia, over here! Your Lapis Eagle!
Tilia! If you mess up the shoot, you're taking full responsibility! There will be a formal reprimand!
Actually. this is the perfect opportunity for you.
That robber just tried to snatch our camera. Luckily, it wasn't damaged, but it's still an attack on Guard property.
If we ignore the robber and the word gets out that people can rob the Imperial Guard and get away with it, everyone will say the Guards are to scared to defend themselves.
Forget improving the company' public image—this is going to ruin the Guard's reputation. A formal reprimand will be the least of your problems.
You have a point... But what about the shoot...

strings.text: Soul of a Guard, Heart of a Knight (Part III)
Champions of justice will never tolerate evil on this land! The promotional film was a huge success, and the story of Knight Tilia is far from over.
Tch, seriously? Someone's actually chasing me?==W== Guess I need to step on it!
Stop right there! Reckless driving isn't allowed here!
Hah! Since when do bad guys care about traffic regulations?
There are too many people on the streets... If this chase keeps up, someone's gonna get hurt.==W== I need to come up with a plan—
Hahaha! At that speed? You'll never catch me in a million years!
Tch, persistent little pest! But I've got more than this up my sleeve!
I'll show you who rules these streets! Bye-bye, Imperial Guard trash!
Good, he's heading away from the crowd. Don't have to worry about hitting people now.
Heh, these back alleys are a maze. That useless knight must be lost by now~
<size=50>Stop the bike! This is your last warning!
Drop the tough girl act! The Imperial Guard's a joke! Ain't nobody catches me!
Perfect—got him to turn right. Up ahead is...
Hahahaha! Like I said! I'm the king of the streets—
Wait, what the hell is that sound?!
Before he can finish, an engine roars overhead; Tilia swoops down like a hawk, landing squarely in front of him.
I am Tilia of the Imperial Guard!==W== And I declare that your reckless ride ends here!
No way... How can you move this fast?!
Your speed only brings disaster. Mine is born to uphold justice.
From the very start, you never had a chance.
Wait—where did you even pull that spear and shield from?!
D-don't come any closer!==W==<size=50> I'm anti-violence! Help!
I give up... I give up...
But I don't get it... Just how the hell did you even catch up with me? No way those busted Guard scooters can outpace mine!

With just the bike's speed, I couldn't. So I kept forcing you into making turns, herding you exactly where I wanted you to go. Once I could predict your route, Lapis Eagle and I would get there ahead of you for sure.
Im-impossible! Every turn I took was optimal—the fastest route! You're saying all that was part of your plan?! But I know these streets like the back of my hand, how did I miss this...
That just means I know them even better than you do.
By the honor of the knights, the Imperial Guard will never tolerate evil on this land!
Looks like she didn't need our help.
Kay! Boss! You came too, huh~
Impressive work, Tilia. We knew you could do it.
Too bad I tore my film outfit a bit while I was at it.
Sorry, Boss. Thanks for helping, but we probably can't finish shooting today.
Don't worry about it. You did the right thing.
Yeah... You're right. If the Masked Knight was here, he would have done the same thing.
I fulfilled my duty as a knight. No regrets!
Oh... Well, technically I'm still just a squire.
Guess playing "Imperial Guard Knight" all morning got to my head...
Stop making fun of me, Kay!
I'm not. You've always been more of a knight than anyone in the Imperial Guard.
That's right. To us, you've always been a knight.
Now let's take this robber back to headquarters.
Ugh... Even though I said "no regrets," just thinking about writing that report later makes my head hurt...
Oh yeah. Tons of it. Especially this last part! Look at this shot.
What are you two doing there?
Well... Tilia, don't worry about the filming, and no need to grovel to your superiors, either.
While you were chasing the robber, I had Kaydoke drive me after you. We filmed the whole thing.
This footage can be turned into a fantastic promo piece with just a bit of editing.
By the way, your riding skills got to the next level, didn't it? I was pushing full throttle just to keep up.
R-really...? I didn't even notice. I just wanted to catch the robber... Hehe.
Thank you, Boss! Thank you, Kay!
<size=45>A week later, the Imperial Guard's new==RT==semi-documentary promo was released.==RT== It became an instant hit.
<size=45>The highlight of the entire film was the knight's heroic pursuit of the criminal,==RT==and her stirring lines became a catch phrase.
A lot of Masked Knight fans even praised it as a spiritual successor to the series.
Hello—you must be ==PLAYER_NAME==, correct? Please come with us.
No, no, you misunderstand. We're inviting you to a new shoot.
Your last work, Heart of a Knight, was a huge success. The higher-ups at the company absolutely loved it.
So they're extending an invitation to you to film the sequel. Please, we'd be honored if you'd accept!
Looks like Tilia and I will get busy again soon.

strings.text: This is Post Haste's first Snowish Festival. Freesia has a simple yet incomplete wish—to celebrate it with friends and exchange gifts...
Hehe, I swung by the dessert shop yesterday and picked some up, since Snowish Festival's almost here.
Can't wait to exchange gifts with everyone...
Already?! I literally just put it down...
'cause it was so tasty! Freesia just wolfed it down!
Yes, like she said...==W== A-Anyway, I'm heading out.
The snow's really thick outside. Be careful.
She rushed off...==W== Think there's a ton of mail to deliver today?
Probably not. Might just be that the roads are slippery and she wants to start early.
Your crochet kit has arrived. Would you like it gift-wrapped?
Yes, please. And please add a card to it.
Sure. Which wrapping paper would you like?
Donna likes red...==W== Let's do the red polka-dot one with the gold ribbon, thanks.
Got it. I'll wrap it for you.
A while ago, Donna said she wanted to try knitting a scarf. This set should be perfect for her.
Oh no. I need to find a place to hide.
Thanks for waiting. Your gift is all ...==W== huh? Where'd she go?
Whew... Good thing Teresa was just here to drop off mail. She didn't see me.
If she had, the surprise would be ruined. She'd totally tell Donna because she just can't help herself.
Anyway, Donna's gift is taken care of. Now for Teresa's...
Here, I brought what you asked for.
An antique gold-trimmed puzzle of a map of the Nova Continent...==W== Yes, this is the one.
You've got great taste. This one's hard to find, definitely worth it.
Some girl stared at it forever the other day, but couldn't bring herself to buy it. She might come back for it.
I know. That was my friend. She's been obsessed with this puzzle.
Ah, no wonder you wanted this exact one. Is this a Snowish gift for her?
Yeah, I want to surprise her. I'll take it.
Thanks for your business! Wishing you two a happy holiday in advance!
Thank you, and the same to you.
Okay, that's all the gifts.==W== I'm really excited for this year's Snowish Festival.
By the way, Madam left you a letter.

==RT====RT====RT=="My dear daughter:==RT==Your father and I must travel for a few days, so I'm afraid we won't be home for the Snowish Festival.==RT==As usual, you may give the butler a list of the gifts you'd like.==RT==We heard your advocacy firm has been very busy. Please take care of yourself."
So I'm spending the festival by myself again, huh...
Before leaving, Madam told me to make sure you get whatever gift you liked. Please, anything that comes to your mind...
It's okay. I don't really need anything.
I'll probably be working overtime at the office that day anyway. All of you should take a few days off and visit your family.
Don't worry, I'll be fine by myself. As long as everyone has a happy holiday, that's the gift I want the most.
Okay then...==W== Thank you for being so considerate.
Come think of it... The Snowish Festival before I moved out—I spent that one alone, too.
But this year, it'll be different...
Eh? How come you two came back together?
I took a detour after finishing my job and ran into Teresa glued to a street game stall.
Ugh... I got taken in by that ring toss game.==W== But the first prize is a limited Snowish monster card! It's super rare!
If I hadn't stopped her, she would've blown all her cash.
The stall by the bookstore corner? Yeah, the prizes look like they're the same distance apart, but the spacing's super tricky.
Exactly! You have to land the ring and make all the thrown rings line up in a row. It's impossible!
Next time I'll go with you and teach you a few tricks...
Okay okay, let's leave that for later.
You look thrilled, so I'm guessing it's good news.
Yep! For the upcoming Snowish Festival, we're going on a work trip!
A work trip? You mean to another city?
Yep! Grace Imperium hired us to help deliver gifts in the City of a Thousand Monoliths. This is a huge deal!
The City of a Thousand Monoliths?! The one with all the Monoliths?
Seven, if you wanna be exact.
It's right in the center of Nova. Its official name is Emor, and it's the busiest city on the whole continent.
It's a huge city. We need to prep tonight and map out our route.
And the good news doesn't stop there, hehe.
As a thank-you to you gals, I booked us seats at a famous restaurant there. After we finish deliveries, we feast!
Yeeesss—let's exchange gifts at the restaurant!
Hmm, sounds like a great idea.
Hehe... And I have a favor to ask you, Freesia.
Grace Imperium sent us festival outfits for delivering gifts.==W== But ... they only sent one set.
And judging by the size, only you can wear it, Freesia. So...==W== Can you wear this super cute Snowish outfit on behalf of Post Haste?
I wanna see! Freesia, try it, try it!
What do you think...? Does it fit?
It fits! Perfectly! Like it was tailor-made for you.
Freesia, you look amazing!==W== Ah, the coat's so soft, really squishy.
Th-thanks. I'll wear it for the deliveries then.
Ahh, now I'm even more excited~
This is Post Haste's first Snowish Festival.==W== Let's all do our best!

Already?! I literally just put it down...
'cause it was so tasty! Freesia just wolfed it down!
Yes, like she said...==W== A-Anyway, I'm heading out.
The snow's really thick outside. Be careful.
She rushed off...==W== Think there's a ton of mail to deliver today?
Probably not. Might just be that the roads are slippery and she wants to start early.
Your crochet kit has arrived. Would you like it gift-wrapped?
Yes, please. And please add a card to it.
Sure. Which wrapping paper would you like?
Donna likes red...==W== Let's do the red polka-dot one with the gold ribbon, thanks.
Got it. I'll wrap it for you.
A while ago, Donna said she wanted to try knitting a scarf. This set should be perfect for her.
Oh no. I need to find a place to hide.
Thanks for waiting. Your gift is all ...==W== huh? Where'd she go?
Whew... Good thing Teresa was just here to drop off mail. She didn't see me.
If she had, the surprise would be ruined. She'd totally tell Donna because she just can't help herself.
Anyway, Donna's gift is taken care of. Now for Teresa's...
Here, I brought what you asked for.
An antique gold-trimmed puzzle of a map of the Nova Continent...==W== Yes, this is the one.
You've got great taste. This one's hard to find, definitely worth it.
Some girl stared at it forever the other day, but couldn't bring herself to buy it. She might come back for it.
I know. That was my friend. She's been obsessed with this puzzle.
Ah, no wonder you wanted this exact one. Is this a Snowish gift for her?
Yeah, I want to surprise her. I'll take it.
Thanks for your business! Wishing you two a happy holiday in advance!
Thank you, and the same to you.
Okay, that's all the gifts.==W== I'm really excited for this year's Snowish Festival.
By the way, Madam left you a letter.

==RT====RT====RT=="My dear daughter:==RT==Your father and I must travel for a few days, so I'm afraid we won't be home for the Snowish Festival.==RT==As usual, you may give the butler a list of the gifts you'd like.==RT==We heard your advocacy firm has been very busy. Please take care of yourself."
So I'm spending the festival by myself again, huh...
Before leaving, Madam told me to make sure you get whatever gift you liked. Please, anything that comes to your mind...
It's okay. I don't really need anything.
I'll probably be working overtime at the office that day anyway. All of you should take a few days off and visit your family.
Don't worry, I'll be fine by myself. As long as everyone has a happy holiday, that's the gift I want the most.
Okay then...==W== Thank you for being so considerate.
Come think of it... The Snowish Festival before I moved out—I spent that one alone, too.
But this year, it'll be different...
Eh? How come you two came back together?
I took a detour after finishing my job and ran into Teresa glued to a street game stall.
Ugh... I got taken in by that ring toss game.==W== But the first prize is a limited Snowish monster card! It's super rare!
If I hadn't stopped her, she would've blown all her cash.
The stall by the bookstore corner? Yeah, the prizes look like they're the same distance apart, but the spacing's super tricky.
Exactly! You have to land the ring and make all the thrown rings line up in a row. It's impossible!
Next time I'll go with you and teach you a few tricks...
Okay okay, let's leave that for later.
You look thrilled, so I'm guessing it's good news.
Yep! For the upcoming Snowish Festival, we're going on a work trip!
A work trip? You mean to another city?
Yep! Grace Imperium hired us to help deliver gifts in the City of a Thousand Monoliths. This is a huge deal!
The City of a Thousand Monoliths?! The one with all the Monoliths?
Seven, if you wanna be exact.
It's right in the center of Nova. Its official name is Emor, and it's the busiest city on the whole continent.
It's a huge city. We need to prep tonight and map out our route.
And the good news doesn't stop there, hehe.
As a thank-you to you gals, I booked us seats at a famous restaurant there. After we finish deliveries, we feast!
Yeeesss—let's exchange gifts at the restaurant!
Hmm, sounds like a great idea.
Hehe... And I have a favor to ask you, Freesia.
Grace Imperium sent us festival outfits for delivering gifts.==W== But ... they only sent one set.
And judging by the size, only you can wear it, Freesia. So...==W== Can you wear this super cute Snowish outfit on behalf of Post Haste?
I wanna see! Freesia, try it, try it!
What do you think...? Does it fit?
It fits! Perfectly! Like it was tailor-made for you.
Freesia, you look amazing!==W== Ah, the coat's so soft, really squishy.
Th-thanks. I'll wear it for the deliveries then.
Ahh, now I'm even more excited~
This is Post Haste's first Snowish Festival.==W== Let's all do our best!

strings.text: On Snowish Festival, members of Post Haste are busy delivering gifts in Emor City. Unfortunately, Donna and Teresa are caught in a storm and can't make it back. Freesia is going to spend the festival by herself ... again.
The City of a Thousand Monoliths is so big. The streets are a lot more confusing than in Port Bellin.
Every house has Snowish Festival decorations up, and the shops all have long lines. Such a festive atmosphere.
Alright! Let's get all the gifts delivered before sunset.
Excuse me, I'm Freesia from Post Haste. Here are your Snowish Festival packages.
Great! It's been snowing for days, I thought the delivery might get delayed.
There are three packages in total. Please check them.
Let me see... One from my sister, one from my mom, and one from my best friend—==W==yup, all here!
All right, then I won't keep you. Have a happy festival!
Yup, the new winter flavor. It'll warm you up right away. It's freezing today, so you eat it on the road, okay? Consider this a festival present.
Thank you, I'm sure I'll enjoy it.
The recipient's address...==W== Yes, this is the place.
There are still several bank customers ahead. I'll bring it over once they're all done.
Hello, what can I do for you?
I'm here to deliver a Snowish Festival gift.
I'm sorry, but our bank doesn't offer that service yet.
May I recommend our newest financial product? Easy to manage, very dependable returns...
Oh, no, you misunderstood...==W== This gift is for you.
A—a gift?! Who would send me a gift...?==W== Ah! It's from my grandma!
The sender's address is pretty far from here. She must've mailed it well in advance.
Oh wow, it's Snowish Festival today! I almost forgot!
I haven't talked to my family in ages because I am so occupied. I can't believe grandma is still thinking of me...
Maybe she's waiting for a present from me, too...
If you'd like, you can give me her address. I can help you buy something and send it.
It won't arrive in time for the festival, but I'm sure she'll be happy when she does receive it.
Only three deliveries left.==W== I should let Donna and Teresa know.
Grace Imperium suddenly sent me and Teresa out to the suburbs to deliver gifts
The snow's so heavy we can barely see the road
We... We can't keep going... And there're still so many gifts...
We might not make it back tonight. Freesia, can you cancel the reservation for us?
And there goes our fancy feast... I'm devastated...
It's okay, we'll go next time. There'll be other chances.
Okay. Once I finish my deliveries, I'll talk to the restaurant.
Be careful out there. Stay safe.
If you need help, contact me anytime.
Got it~ We'll keep the line open!
Next time, we'll definitely have that meal—
Looks like this year's Snowish Festival is going to end up like all the others again.
No, I need to pull myself together. Otherwise, I'll affect the recipients' mood.
Only a few packages left. Let's hurry up.
Thank you, young lady. Happy festival to you.
You're welcome. Happy festival to you, too.
That's all the deliveries done. Time to go to the restaurant.
Oakwood Court...==W== This must be the place.
There's a big crowd at the entrance... What are they doing?
Fifty thousand Dorra. That's the lowest I'll go.
Take a look at your calendar, man. It's Snowish Festival! If you don't grab it, someone else will. Just don't come crying to me when it's gone.
We sincerely apologize, but all reservations for tonight are full. Please come back another day.
All your reservation tickets got scooped up by scalpers! Look at them, crowding the entrance. Can't you do something?
I assure you, we're investigating it now. We'll let everyone know as soon as we have an update. Thank you for your patience!
Can't believe people are doing illegal stuff like this... Just terrible.
The outfit and that broom...==W== She must be a witch.
Um... If you have a reservation ticket for tonight... Would you be willing to sell it to me?
Wait... Don't tell me she takes me for a scalper?
I do have a reservation ticket, but...
Name your price. If I can afford it, I'll pay right now!
Sorry, but I can't sell it to you.
First of all, I'm not a scalper. I do have a reservation ticket, but I don't need it anymore, so I'm going to cancel it with the staff.
Cancel?!==W== Are you sure you don't want to sell it to me? I swear I won't resell it!
Whatever your reason is, buying and selling reservation tickets privately is against the rules.
If you register with the staff now, maybe you'll get my cancelled slot in a moment.
All right... I understand. Sorry for taking up your time.
Annie?! You're here early. Weren't we meeting at seven?
I couldn't wait, so I wanted to come check it out. You come early, too.
I—I just came to look at the menu.
Whoa, she's wearing a Snowish outfit! Hi! Are you a Snowish Festival Messenger, too?
Does that mean this Witch is...?

strings.text: Night descends. Freesia drifts through the streets alone, unaware that two familiar silhouettes have quietly appeared behind her...
Whoa, she's wearing a Snowish outfit! Hi! Are you a Snowish Festival Messenger, too?==W== Miss Witch is also a Messenger~
I'm not really sure what's going on, but I should probably just go along.
Yes, I'm a Snowish Festival Messenger. I'm delivering gifts today.
Hehe, that's so cool. Let me tell you a secret—I'm having a big fancy dinner with Miss Witch tonight!
Y-yeah ... a big dinner!==W== Annie, be good. It's still a while before dinner. Go play in the park nearby for a bit, and I'll come get you later, okay?
Okay! See you in a bit~
Phew, thank you for not telling her...==W== I'm very sorry. She showed up suddenly and gave me quite a scare.
It's okay. I'm sure there was a reason.
Annie and I are kinda like neighbors. We live on the same street. This morning, when I ran into her, she was crying all by herself...
Annie? Are you okay? Why are you alone out here?
Mom said she'd take me to Oakwood Court tonight, but this morning she suddenly said she has to work overtime today.
Oakwood Court...?==W== I know the restaurant. It is super popular lately, right?
Yeah... I've been looking forward to it for so long... Sob...
Hey hey, don't cry. How about I take you instead? I heard that their cheesecake is amazing. I've been wanting to try it, too.
Of course~ And, just between you and me, I'm actually a Snowish Festival Messenger.
You are one of those Messengers?!
Yup! Think of tonight's dinner as my Snowish gift to you. So, how about it?
That's what happened. I contacted Annie's mom, but she had already canceled the reservation. I thought I'd come line up early, but it turns out tonight's already fully booked.
I see ...==W== Sorry, I shouldn't have assumed things and even scolded you... It was all a misunderstanding.
I'm so sorry! Please forgive my rudeness.
Selling reservation tickets is definitely against the rules, but...
Giving it away for free should be okay.
Don't mention it. Just think of it as a little gift from my friends and me...==W== A Snowish Festival gift, as it were.
If it were Donna and Teresa, they'd definitely do the same thing.
Actually ... I should tell you the truth.==W== I didn't do all this just to help Annie.
You see, I'm actually a Weather Witch who needs to rack up good deeds.
Weather Witch... You mean, like someone who reports the weather? But why the good deeds?
That's right! The thing is wherever I go, rain and snow always follow... it’s rather troublesome.
Like today, it was sunny before I left, and the moment I stepped outside, it started snowing like crazy. So my forecasts are always off, and I get a lot of viewer complaints.
But I accidentally discovered that if I do a lot of good deeds, the weather wouldn't turn out so bad.
So by helping others, I'm helping myself as well. And I even lied to Annie about being a Snowish Festival Messenger...
To all the people you've helped, you're exactly that. That's how Annie would see it, too.
... Thank you. That really helps.==W== Oh, by the way—since it's so hard to get a reservation here, why were you going to cancel?
My friends got stuck in the suburbs outside the city because of heavy snow. They won't make it back tonight.
Wait... Is that because of me...?
Could be a coincidence. Don't blame yourself.
Sigh... I'm sorry for the trouble.
Still, it is Snowish Festival today... Who knows, maybe something nice will happen when you least expect it.
It's already dark...==W== Donna and Teresa haven't replied. They must still be busy delivering.
Mom, hurry up, I want to go home and open my gifts—
Don't run like that. You don't want to drop the cake, do you?
It's alright! And dad's at home waiting for us for dinner!
Fine, fine... You're such a handful...
When I was little, there would always be a big dinner on the night of the Snowish Festival...
But I never did get to spend the day with my family...
And here I thought this year I could spend it with Donna and Teresa.
Exchanging gifts, playing games, eating cake...
But it's okay. It's just gonna be one day late, and the longer you wait, the sweeter the memory becomes.
Besides, this year I got so much kindness and warm wishes from strangers.
Totally different from the cold, quiet years before... I'm already pretty lucky.
Donna... Teresa... Where are you two now?
Donna, I found her! I found Freesia!
Thank goodness. I was worried I might not get to see her today.
Hehe, a rare opportunity presents itself. Let's go surprise her!
Shhh, don't make any noise. Let's sneak up...
Ahem, ahem, pretty girl, whatcha lookin' at?
Ta-dah~! A Snowish Festival gift for Freesia, who has been so good this year!
Hehe, gave you a scare, right?
That you did... I didn't expect you'd make it back.
While we were delivering gifts, we met two super nice witches who offered to help.
Thanks to them, we finished fast. And flying back on a broom was awesome!
Yeah. Apparently, a kind-hearted person asked them to take us back to the city and deliver the gifts for us.
You really are a Snowish Festival Messenger, after all...
Freesia, what are you smiling about?
I'm fine. Since everyone's back... Should we go find a place to exchange gifts?
I've been carrying your gifts with me all day.
Yay! Let's find somewhere warm. I want hot soup!
Ah, that restaurant reservation ticket... ==W==I thought I wouldn't need it today, so I gave it to someone else.
I thought it would be better in their hands.
Ahem~ That does sound like Freesia.==W== Anyway, let's find somewhere to sit and warm up first. It's freezing out here!
Moments like this, all of us being together... That's the best gift there is.==W== Donna, Teresa... Thank you.
This year, my wish has finally come true.

strings.text: In the gloomy dungeon of Dusk Arbiter, Coronis receives a visit from a friend. Yet this friend has come for more than just a simple reunion.
Hmm... How many days have I been in here?
Honestly. No windows, not even a clock?
I think I've lost all sensation in my calves...
Fascinating... So this is the physiological response to prolonged kneeling.
The human body is truly a marvel.
It's not like I'm going anywhere. Is it really necessary to tie me up like this?
Hey, sinner! Quit the muttering! Silence!
Merely making observations... You know, you're awfully paranoid about a prisoner with zero desire to leave.
Toss me a skeleton model and I'd never leave. It's quiet, private... I really should've brought my lab gear.
... Has the isolation fried your brain? Listen: acting crazy won't get you out of here!
Unshackle her. We can't talk while she's on her knees.
Lady Igna! Yes, ma'am! At once.
Thank you. Leave us. I'm here on orders to take Coronis's statement.
And you!==W== Watch yourself—don't try anything funny!
I was wondering who'd bother showing up... A rare guest indeed, Igna.
Hmph... Drop the act. Kneeling that long must have killed your legs. Here, let me help you up.
They certainly didn't hold back. You'd think being a fellow officer of the Grace Imperium would count for something.
I'm fine. If anything, the pain helps. It serves as a useful distraction.
The verdict's in.==W== Take a look.
Let's see...==W== Hmm. "Blasphemy against the God of Grace. Heresy. Sentenced to public hanging."
Hah. Just as I predicted. How tedious... Fools always resort to crude violence when they face something they can't understand.
I heard you tried to turn your trial into an academic debate.
You call that a debate? Their ignorance was staggering... Trying to reason with Dusk Arbiters is like casting pearls before swine.
I made it perfectly clear: "The Nocturn Eterna do not need the God of Grace's blessing to wield magic."
"They generate their own magic. No Soul Stones required."==W== ... Simple. Empirical.
Hahaha! Well, they aren't academics, Coronis. They don't care about the science.
Their job is to stop thinking, issue a verdict that fits the "ancient doctrine," and close the case.
Doctrine states that magic and Soul Stones are exclusive gifts from the God of Grace. No one dares question that publicly... Even researching it is forbidden.
Hmph... I think they're playing dumb. Avoiding truths they're too terrified to face.
One High Arbiter actually argued that "faith in the God of Grace" is a prerequisite for magic. I nearly laughed out loud in the middle of court.
I considered casting a spell while denouncing their god, just to prove them wrong. But what a hassle... I'd have to explain the basic principles of magic from scratch.
So you waived the rest of the defense and let them skip straight to sentencing?
Like I said: pearls before swine. No matter how clearly I explain, they lack the capacity to understand.
You sound exactly like a professor back at Grace Light Academy! Hahaha!
Grace Light would never admit students that dense! And they certainly wouldn't host such a moronic debate.
Sigh... Grace Light Academy. I miss my student days.
If you hadn't met me back then, who knows? You might have ended up in a very different line of work.
Excuse me. I'm here to enroll in Medicine...
You're too late. Enrollment for Medicine is already closed.
Oh. Is that so? Well, guess I'll check out Biology then...
If I'd known, I wouldn't have stayed up all night working on that specimen... Yawn...
Wait! Hold on!==W== Did you just say ... "specimen"?
Hm? Yes. Scored a piece of free monster remains from the Trekker Association yesterday. Had to process them before they rotted, so I was up late.
What's the matter with the freshmen these days? Haven't even started classes and you're already preserving samples?
Just a hobby. I'm Coronis...==W== Are you ... a teacher here?
No, I'm Igna. Two years ahead of you. Just here helping the faculty sort some files.
Tell you what, I'll take you to the professor. Registration is closed, but if you explain the situation and show her what you can do, she might make an exception.
It'd be a shame to let another department snatch up a student of your caliber.
Thank you so much,==W== Senior Igna.
Hahaha, no need for that. I'm not big on titles. Just call me Igna.
Hmm... Actually, showing the professor your work directly would be more convincing. Let's swing by your dorm and grab that specimen.
This is a remarkably fine specimen. Did you really preserve this yourself? The incision work is flawless—I'd say you have at least three years of experience.
You flatter me. But since<color=#bd3059> bones</color> are the only enduring proof that a creature ever lived, I believe carving into a subject demands the reverence due to art.
I see. Tell me, why pick Medicine as your primary major? Why not Biology?
Humans are the apex of creation. They incite a curiosity in me that no other creature can match. General biology is fine, but the human body... That is what suits my tastes.
But self-study has insurmountable limits. Specifically in<color=#bd3059> anatomy</color>—it is remarkably difficult to source high-quality human subjects on my own, so...
Whoa, stop right there. Are you saying ... you only want to enroll here so you can slice people open?
Uh, Professor! What Coronis means is that human anatomy presents a unique challenge! She wants to master it to... Uh... Benefit society!
Ah... Is that so? I see.
Coronis, aside from dissection, do you have any other interests?
Coronis produces a test tube filled with a mysterious liquid.
A potion I cooked up myself. It functions as a magic amplifier.
Once ingested, it temporarily spikes the user's mana output, effectively doubling spell potency.
Mind if I have a taste?
Hmm... Not bad. Goes down smooth.==W====RT==Let's test it out. A simple Light Spell should do.
Gah! My eyes! My eyes! It's blinding! This stuff works a little too well!
So, Professor... Will you make an exception and let Coronis enroll?
Absolutely! She's in! Welcome aboard! Deadlines are just suggestions, anyway.
One word of advice, though. Don't dig too deep into the nature of magic.
It's not our department's focus. Besides, if you slip into "ideological deviation," even we can't save you.
Alright, drop it! Knowing too much about that does you no good.
I've prepped the enrollment forms. Just run them over to Academic Affairs.
After that, you crushed the coursework in two years. Scouted early by the Eye of Grace... A once-in-a-century prodigy.
It's a shame. The professor warned you time and again not to look into magic, yet you walked that path anyway.
Maybe I shouldn't have stopped you back then. You might've been better off sticking to biology.
Anatomy, biology... Makes no difference. I would've reached the same conclusions eventually. Asked the same questions.
True enough. Well, chat's over. Let's get to business.
I'm here for the Dusk Arbiter Tribunal. I need to record your full statement.
The Arbiter's already passed judgment, but we still have to follow procedure.
You say "procedure," but the Eye of Grace is desperate to know what I found, isn't it?
Correct. The Eye of Grace never ignores knowledge.==W== Even the forbidden kind.
And you don't want your discovery buried in the dark, do you, Coronis?
So please,==W== share your findings.==W== As deliberately==W== as you can.

param: In the gloomy dungeon of Dusk Arbiter, Coronis receives a visit from a friend. Yet this friend has come for more than just a simple reunion.
Hmm... How many days have I been in here?
Honestly. No windows, not even a clock?
I think I've lost all sensation in my calves...
Fascinating... So this is the physiological response to prolonged kneeling.
The human body is truly a marvel.
It's not like I'm going anywhere. Is it really necessary to tie me up like this?
Hey, sinner! Quit the muttering! Silence!
Merely making observations... You know, you're awfully paranoid about a prisoner with zero desire to leave.
Toss me a skeleton model and I'd never leave. It's quiet, private... I really should've brought my lab gear.
... Has the isolation fried your brain? Listen: acting crazy won't get you out of here!
Unshackle her. We can't talk while she's on her knees.
Lady Igna! Yes, ma'am! At once.
Thank you. Leave us. I'm here on orders to take Coronis's statement.
And you!==W== Watch yourself—don't try anything funny!
I was wondering who'd bother showing up... A rare guest indeed, Igna.
Hmph... Drop the act. Kneeling that long must have killed your legs. Here, let me help you up.
They certainly didn't hold back. You'd think being a fellow officer of the Grace Imperium would count for something.
I'm fine. If anything, the pain helps. It serves as a useful distraction.
The verdict's in.==W== Take a look.
Let's see...==W== Hmm. "Blasphemy against the God of Grace. Heresy. Sentenced to public hanging."
Hah. Just as I predicted. How tedious... Fools always resort to crude violence when they face something they can't understand.
I heard you tried to turn your trial into an academic debate.
You call that a debate? Their ignorance was staggering... Trying to reason with Dusk Arbiters is like casting pearls before swine.
I made it perfectly clear: "The Nocturn Eterna do not need the God of Grace's blessing to wield magic."
"They generate their own magic. No Soul Stones required."==W== ... Simple. Empirical.
Hahaha! Well, they aren't academics, Coronis. They don't care about the science.
Their job is to stop thinking, issue a verdict that fits the "ancient doctrine," and close the case.
Doctrine states that magic and Soul Stones are exclusive gifts from the God of Grace. No one dares question that publicly... Even researching it is forbidden.
Hmph... I think they're playing dumb. Avoiding truths they're too terrified to face.
One High Arbiter actually argued that "faith in the God of Grace" is a prerequisite for magic. I nearly laughed out loud in the middle of court.
I considered casting a spell while denouncing their god, just to prove them wrong. But what a hassle... I'd have to explain the basic principles of magic from scratch.
So you waived the rest of the defense and let them skip straight to sentencing?
Like I said: pearls before swine. No matter how clearly I explain, they lack the capacity to understand.
You sound exactly like a professor back at Grace Light Academy! Hahaha!
Grace Light would never admit students that dense! And they certainly wouldn't host such a moronic debate.
Sigh... Grace Light Academy. I miss my student days.
If you hadn't met me back then, who knows? You might have ended up in a very different line of work.
Excuse me. I'm here to enroll in Medicine...
You're too late. Enrollment for Medicine is already closed.
Oh. Is that so? Well, guess I'll check out Biology then...
If I'd known, I wouldn't have stayed up all night working on that specimen... Yawn...
Wait! Hold on!==W== Did you just say ... "specimen"?
Hm? Yes. Scored a piece of free monster remains from the Trekker Association yesterday. Had to process them before they rotted, so I was up late.

strings.text: What kind of ordeal could have caused Coronis's eye to become like this? And what secret, profound enough to overturn all understanding, makes her dare to touch the taboo of the Grace Imperium?
Hmm. The lab needs a new high-mag scope Artifact. Plus, I'm running low on specimen preservative...
Oh, right. Igna wanted a new scalpel set. I'll make a wish for that too while I'm at the Monolith.
But... I need a solid cover story. If Igna finds out I wandered into a hazard zone like this...
Why are they out of the Monolith?==W==
Plan succeeded. The spell is active. Stellaroids are flooding out in droves.
Heh... Excellent. This Monolith will go dark in days.==RT==Withdraw before the surge reaches you.
Understood. But... I'm concerned. There are too many of them.==RT==If innocent people nearby get caught in the surge...
"Innocent"? Only Trekkers lurk near Monoliths.==RT==Desperados blinded by greed, fully expecting to fight monsters.
When you walk into the lion's den, you accept you might get eaten.==RT==Their fate is not our concern.
Stick to the order. Don't let your bleeding heart ruin this.
T-This must be the "Monolith Meltdown" from the textbooks!
To think I'd walk right into it... A once-in-a-lifetime phenomenon.==W== I need a closer look.
Tch. Well, this is a nuisance.
Hm? What was that sound?==W== Coming from the elevator...
Look at all these Stellaroid remains... Was someone trapped here?
No bodies. Maybe they got away...==W====RT==Wait. Is that ... an injured Trekker?!
Hang on! Can you hear me?
You've lost a lot of blood! Stay calm—I'm going to heal you with magic.
Tch—more Stellaroids...==RT==Hold tight! I'm getting you out of here.
Sss—my right eye hurts... Where am I?
Don't move. A Stellaroid got your right eye. I stopped the bleeding with magic, but the eyeball ruptured. I'm sorry... I couldn't save it.
You're safe in my hideout now, though. No monsters here.
You stopped the bleeding with magic?==RT====W==Wait! Are you healing me using magic?
Stop moving—you're a strange one... You lost an eye, yet you're focused on the magic?
People have two eyes precisely for situations like this. You only lost one—the other one still works fine.
But healing magic! How can you use that? Not even the Eye of Grace—no, nobody in Nova knows that spell.
Huh? You Novians can't use it? That magic is ... pretty standard.
Standard? The Eye of Grace records are clear—every single experiment on healing magic has failed.
Wait... Did you just say ... "You Novians"?
White hair... Pointed ears... Long, twisted horns.
You're a Bayan... Are you from Nocturn Eterna?!
Took you long enough. You're slow, Novian.
If Nocturn Eterna has healing magic... Then it is possible? Theoretically, we Novians should be able to replicate it!
Hey, could you do that ag—==W==sorry, haven't even introduced myself.
I'm Coronis. May I ask your name?==RT==You don't have to answer, but ... I'd like to know who saved me.
Noctiluna, could you cast that spell again? Look, I got too excited and tore the wound open!
Noctiluna places a palm over the wound. A cold white light flashes, and the pain fades.
Wait, got a mirror? I need to see this!
... Fascinating. The shattered lens didn't regenerate, but the tissue healed naturally. Pain's gone too...==W== So if the structure is intact, full recovery is possible?!
Incredible magic!==RT==Noctiluna, how does it even work?!
Has ... anyone ever told you that you're weird?
A normal Novian would've started with, "What's your purpose?" or "Why are you here?"
But you're obsessed with my magic... This isn't how I pictured this going.
Why waste time on semantics when the mysteries of biology are far more fascinating?
<size=30>Okay, she's definitely got a screw loose!!</size>==W====RT==... So, you're seriously not afraid of us?
Why should I be? Aside from the horns, are Bayans really distinct from us?
Physiologically speaking, we're practically the same species, aren't we?
Speaking of which, may I touch them? I need to know—are they keratin or solid bone?
Are... Are you seriously a Novian?
Horns are vital! You can't just let people touch them—not even our own kin!
Look... Your wound's healed, so start moving. This isn't a place for Novians.
Weird... I thought we spoke the same language. Am I not clear? This is a Nocturn Eterna stronghold now. You aren't welcome here.
My injured eye still throbs, you know. If I leave your side and the wound tears open on the way back... Well, I'm done for.
Besides, the Monolith Meltdown was recent. This area could be crawling with Stellaroids. Please, let me stay until I make a full recovery.
I promise I won't touch your horns or cause any trouble. Deal?
Ugh, fine. Three days. That should be plenty of time to heal up.
Coronis! How did you manage to hurt yourself again?!
I can't help it. My right eye is blind, my field of view is narrow, and my depth perception is shot... I simply lost my footing.==W== Noctiluna, quick, heal—
Liar! I saw you skipping stones by the lake this morning—perfect aim every time! How could you possibly tumble down a gentle slope like this?
You hurt yourself on purpose, didn't you? You're doing this just to make me cast that spell again!
Well... I knew you wouldn't explain the principles to me directly. So, using myself as a test subject seemed like a fair compromise.
Hmm... Fascinating. An itch, like flesh regenerating at an accelerated rate. Is the mechanism based on hyper-stimulating the body's natural recovery?
Stop speculating. I will not share our secrets with a Novian.
And stop injuring yourself. I mean it—this is the last time.==W== Do not treat this lightly; it drains a significant amount of magic.
In the last two days, you've cast that spell on me five times. Yet, your Soul Stone's glow hasn't dimmed in the slightest. Conversely, you appear visibly more exhausted after every incantation.
My hypothesis is that the magic you're burning isn't the<color=#bd3059> Grace</color> from the Soul Stone at all.
The Loong have a saying: "If one learns the truth in the morning, one may die without regret at sunset."
If you intend to silence me, could I make one final request? Before I die, tell me the truth behind your magic and its power source.
I will tell you only this: We of the Nocturn Eterna have no need for what you Novians call "Grace."==W== We do not demean ourselves with stolen magic.
... Time for you to go. Head east for a day. You'll hit the road to the city-states.
Hmm... Fair enough. Thank you for the insight.
What's this? An exquisite prosthetic... You made this?
Yeah... It won't bring your sight back, but it looks like a real eye.
Call it ... compensation for the injury. Now we're even.

strings.text: In order to make one final contribution to scientific research, Coronis swallows the poison.
So that's it. Explains why you vanished and came back with a modified eye... I never knew the context.
Makes sense the Dusk Arbiters gouged it out, then. It was a Nocturn Eterna creation, after all.
Those incompetent Arbiters. Only good for obsessing over trivial details.
I took the eye and parted ways with the Nocturn Eterna. You know the rest.
She didn't name her source. But by sensing the flow of magic during her spellcasting, I could confirm it: she was drawing power stored within her own body.
A valuable discovery. But why not bring it to me?==W== Why write a thesis attacking the Grace system and brazenly submit it for all to see?
That is entirely your fault, Igna.
To me, you were the definition of a "pure scholar." I made the mistake of assuming everyone in the Eye of Grace shared your integrity.
Right back at you, Coronis. You act too much like a "student." And students are always so naive... So childish.
I managed to reclaim your prosthetic eye. Here—take it back.
Thanks. The socket feels strangely empty without it.
It's still a part of you. If you're going to die, you might as well do it with some dignity.
Your interaction with Nocturn Eterna just proves the Dusk Arbiter's verdict was sound.
Do you have any final requests? I'll do my best to grant them.
Hmm, let me think. I'd like my death to have some practical value. Maybe you could use my corpse for research?
Or how about you test the healing magic on me? Since I'm on death row anyway, I can see the experiment through to the bitter end.
I've already experienced Nocturn Eterna's healing firsthand. If you use yours on me, I can describe the sensory differences in real-time. That data could be invaluable for your work.
Didn't you want your death to have meaning? That experiment has an abysmal success rate. It would just be a waste of a perfectly good test subject.
But what if I survive? You'd go down in history as the first legendary healer to master the art.
Try to remember you're a condemned prisoner. If the magic doesn't kill you, do you really expect me to finish the job with poison myself?
Fine, fine... You're no fun. In that case, let's just go with drug testing.
Don't think I don't know the Eye of Grace has been researching toxins. And you won't find a more qualified guinea pig than me.
You really do know too much.==W== Here.
Oh, you actually carry that on you?
I figured you'd prefer this over the gallows.
It's nice to have a senior who understands me.==W== But if I just drop dead in my cell, won't you be held responsible?
The "public execution" is merely a bargaining chip the Dusk Arbiters are using against the Eye of Grace.
Their only real goal is to silence you permanently. As for the method... That's irrelevant to them.
You're still one of ours. A public execution would look messy for the Eye of Grace. So they offered the Arbiters a few concessions ... which brings me here, Coronis.
You always did excel at backroom politics. Very well. I accept the deal.
Chain me up, please. And have your notepad ready.
Most lethal toxins cause violent, ugly deaths.
I'd hate to lash out at you during a spasm. I'll dictate the effects as they hit. Just make sure you take accurate notes.

==A4==Mildly sweet. Easy to swallow.==P====RT====A4==But a sharp tongue would still catch it. Next time, make it colorless and tasteless.==P====RT====RT====A4==Twenty seconds. Vertigo setting in.==P====RT====RT====A4==Fifty seconds. Limbs going numb. Vision blurring...==P====RT====A4==Fast acting. No vomiting blood... Leaves a clean corpse. Good.
Not bad, Igna. A painless end. Thank you ... for this final kindness...
(Ah... Am I dead? Wait. That sound... Wheels...?)
Hey there, Miss. Wake up! You gonna snooze through the whole trip?
(Where are we headed... The afterlife? Does Heaven use monster carriages... No. Heaven is scientifically impossible. And this sunlight...)
Hah! Still dreaming?==RT==Hate to break it to ya, Miss, but this isn't a ghost carriage. Look—that's Philae up ahead.
Uh, yeah? Isn't that where you said you were going?
Hey, no sweat! You just woke up. Takes a minute for the gears to start turning again.
You and your friend from the Grace Imperium hopped on yesterday afternoon. She's the one who booked the trip to Philae.

You were out like a light the second you sat down. Halfway here, your friend remembered some urgent business and had to head back. She covered the fare and told me not to bug you since you'd been pulling all-nighters.
(Igna... That wasn't a lethal toxin. Did you use a metabolic suppressant to simulate death?)
Ah. Yes, it's all coming back to me now. My apologies.
Don't forget your purse and bags. They're right there by the trunk.
(Philae... I'm a long way from the Dusk Arbiter's Prison #7 now.)
(Wait, there's an address tucked in the wallet ... in Igna's handwriting. Well, might as well go check it out.)
(This matches the address perfectly.==W== Certainly tucked away deep enough in the district.)
(Hospital beds, surgical instruments... Is this ... a clinic?)
Wait. My skeletal model? How did it end up here?
(My specimens... Even the equipment and research data they confiscated. All here.)
(There's a letter on the desk. And an emblem.)
==RT==Coronis, congratulations.==RT==Effective today, you are a member of the Society for the Study of Life.

==RT==We are a covert collective of elites from within the Eye of Grace,==RT==dedicated to studying subjects the Imperium frowns upon—for example, Soul Stones and magic.==P====RT====RT==I trust you will continue your pursuit of truth here in Philae.==RT==We look forward to sharing in whatever fascinating discoveries you unearth.

==RT==I've had your things sent to the clinic.==RT==Officially, the record says they were "burned to ash."==RT==If you need anything else, write me—but use an alias.==P====RT====RT==As far as the Eye of Grace knows, Coronis doesn't exist.

==RT==Anyway, Philae isn't cheap. Get the clinic cleaned up and open for business. Fast.==P====RT====RT==Since you left, I've thought about quitting and opening my own practice.==RT==Without you, work at the Eye of Grace is painfully dull.
I never knew she had it in her... Smuggling a condemned criminal past the Dusk Arbiters, getting my confiscated eye back...==W== You're incredible, Senior Igna.
All this effort for me. Were you planning to harvest my brain for your own use back in college...?==W== According to this letter, doesn't seem like I have much choice.
Fine. As long as I can keep researching, I don't care. A clinic... Treating patients should at least pay for food.
Guess I'd better clean up and open shop. It really is expensive here. If I starve, that's on you, Senior.
And so, the Coronis of old is dead. In the shadows of Philae's Ash District, the "Devil in White" is born—walking a lonely path of decoding the secrets of life.
Not long after, Igna opens a similar clinic in Emor, though she keeps her day job at the Eye of Grace.
Look, this seminar's dragging on for another two days. Be a dear and cover the clinic one more day, okay?
Hey, I've been stuck in Emor for a week. My patients back in Philae are waiting.
I'll buy you dinner when I get back!
You only hear what you want to hear.==W== Fine. But I'm ordering the most expensive thing on the menu.
Unbelievable... Do I look like I have free time? My research is still...
Coming! Who is it this early? We aren't even open...
Doc! Please, you have to help ==SEX4==!
Minova, hey, calm down. I feel okay, really.==W== Don't freak out.
Beneath the white spires, the underground clinic welcomes a very special "patient."
The gears of fate begin their slow, irreversible grind.
The hunt for the truth has begun, and nothing can stop it now.

param: In order to make one final contribution to scientific research, Coronis swallows the poison.
So that's it. Explains why you vanished and came back with a modified eye... I never knew the context.
Makes sense the Dusk Arbiters gouged it out, then. It was a Nocturn Eterna creation, after all.
Those incompetent Arbiters. Only good for obsessing over trivial details.
I took the eye and parted ways with the Nocturn Eterna. You know the rest.
She didn't name her source. But by sensing the flow of magic during her spellcasting, I could confirm it: she was drawing power stored within her own body.
A valuable discovery. But why not bring it to me?==W== Why write a thesis attacking the Grace system and brazenly submit it for all to see?
That is entirely your fault, Igna.
To me, you were the definition of a "pure scholar." I made the mistake of assuming everyone in the Eye of Grace shared your integrity.
Right back at you, Coronis. You act too much like a "student." And students are always so naive... So childish.
I managed to reclaim your prosthetic eye. Here—take it back.
Thanks. The socket feels strangely empty without it.
It's still a part of you. If you're going to die, you might as well do it with some dignity.
Your interaction with Nocturn Eterna just proves the Dusk Arbiter's verdict was sound.
Do you have any final requests? I'll do my best to grant them.
Hmm, let me think. I'd like my death to have some practical value. Maybe you could use my corpse for research?
Or how about you test the healing magic on me? Since I'm on death row anyway, I can see the experiment through to the bitter end.
I've already experienced Nocturn Eterna's healing firsthand. If you use yours on me, I can describe the sensory differences in real-time. That data could be invaluable for your work.
Didn't you want your death to have meaning? That experiment has an abysmal success rate. It would just be a waste of a perfectly good test subject.
But what if I survive? You'd go down in history as the first legendary healer to master the art.
Try to remember you're a condemned prisoner. If the magic doesn't kill you, do you really expect me to finish the job with poison myself?
Fine, fine... You're no fun. In that case, let's just go with drug testing.
Don't think I don't know the Eye of Grace has been researching toxins. And you won't find a more qualified guinea pig than me.
You really do know too much.==W== Here.
Oh, you actually carry that on you?
I figured you'd prefer this over the gallows.
It's nice to have a senior who understands me.==W== But if I just drop dead in my cell, won't you be held responsible?
The "public execution" is merely a bargaining chip the Dusk Arbiters are using against the Eye of Grace.
Their only real goal is to silence you permanently. As for the method... That's irrelevant to them.
You're still one of ours. A public execution would look messy for the Eye of Grace. So they offered the Arbiters a few concessions ... which brings me here, Coronis.
You always did excel at backroom politics. Very well. I accept the deal.
Chain me up, please. And have your notepad ready.
Most lethal toxins cause violent, ugly deaths.
I'd hate to lash out at you during a spasm. I'll dictate the effects as they hit. Just make sure you take accurate notes.

==A4==Mildly sweet. Easy to swallow.==P====RT====A4==But a sharp tongue would still catch it. Next time, make it colorless and tasteless.==P====RT====RT====A4==Twenty seconds. Vertigo setting in.==P====RT====RT====A4==Fifty seconds. Limbs going numb. Vision blurring...==P====RT====A4==Fast acting. No vomiting blood... Leaves a clean corpse. Good.
Not bad, Igna. A painless end. Thank you ... for this final kindness...
(Ah... Am I dead? Wait. That sound... Wheels...?)
Hey there, Miss. Wake up! You gonna snooze through the whole trip?
(Where are we headed... The afterlife? Does Heaven use monster carriages... No. Heaven is scientifically impossible. And this sunlight...)
Hah! Still dreaming?==RT==Hate to break it to ya, Miss, but this isn't a ghost carriage. Look—that's Philae up ahead.
Uh, yeah? Isn't that where you said you were going?
Hey, no sweat! You just woke up. Takes a minute for the gears to start turning again.
You and your friend from the Grace Imperium hopped on yesterday afternoon. She's the one who booked the trip to Philae.

You were out like a light the second you sat down. Halfway here, your friend remembered some urgent business and had to head back. She covered the fare and told me not to bug you since you'd been pulling all-nighters.
(Igna... That wasn't a lethal toxin. Did you use a metabolic suppressant to simulate death?)
Ah. Yes, it's all coming back to me now. My apologies.
Don't forget your purse and bags. They're right there by the trunk.
(Philae... I'm a long way from the Dusk Arbiter's Prison #7 now.)
(Wait, there's an address tucked in the wallet ... in Igna's handwriting. Well, might as well go check it out.)
(This matches the address perfectly.==W== Certainly tucked away deep enough in the district.)
(Hospital beds, surgical instruments... Is this ... a clinic?)
Wait. My skeletal model? How did it end up here?
(My specimens... Even the equipment and research data they confiscated. All here.)
(There's a letter on the desk. And an emblem.)

strings.text: Early in the morning, a sudden call from Mistique wakes you up, saying she needs urgent help. Following the address she sends, you find a place that looks like a luxury hotel.
Hmph... This early in the morning... Who is it?
Please, Tyrant!==W== I need you! I need you bad!
You weren't sleeping, were you? Anyway, come help me right now! Immediately! No time to explain!
I'll tell you the details when you get here. It's urgent! I've already sent you the address!
Is it really that urgent? I guess I'd better get up and go take a look.
This place is... A luxury hotel?
But this is the address Mistique sent me...==W== I hope I didn't come to the wrong place.
Darling~ What took you so long?==W== Hurry, hurry! Over here!
D-d-darling? Sorry, you've got the wrong person!
Wait... Mistique? You... Just what are you wearing?
Shh! Don't get so worked up. Keep your voice down!
If anyone asks, just say we're a couple! I'm a rich young lady named Lutty who ran away from home for love, and you're my lover who eloped with me!
A couple? Lutty? What are you even talking about?
If I don't go back soon, they'll get suspicious! I'll explain everything later. For now, just play along!
Mistique loves pulling pranks, but she's never actually done me any harm. I guess I'll go along with this for now...
Here, ma'am! I've brought ==SEX4== back! ==SEX1== is my lover! As long as I can be with ==SEX4==, I'm willing to give up everything!
Not bad. Let me take a look.
Hmm... ==SEX1== looks poor, but ==SEX=='s got a decent enough face.==W== If I were twenty years younger, I could see myself having a date with this one.
That did not sound like an actual compliment... What kind of place is this?
And there are way too many security guards. Even for high-level security... It doesn't need this many people.
Alright, you'll do! Listen carefully. This is a job that uses your brain, so think fast, work hard!
Oh, wonderful! Lutty! I was just looking for a job that pays well!
Mm! For our future together, let's make lots of money!
If you're looking to make big money, then you've come to the right place. As long as you work hard, you're guaranteed returns far beyond expectations.
By the way, our main business here is selling Artifacts. For the good of the public and to spread the blessing of Grace, we keep prices at one-tenth of the market rate.
Yes, darling. Our job is to sell these Artifacts. The more we sell, the better!
I see...==W== But if they're only one-tenth of the market price, wouldn't people line up to buy them even without us giving them sales pitches?
You are a dumb one... Haven't you heard the saying, "you get what you pay for"?
These Artifacts are just empty shells. They look legit, but they don't work.
What? Then aren't they just fakes?
Ahem!==W== Where there's demand, there's a market. We're a perfectly legitimate business. Customers buy Artifacts to show off in their living rooms, not to actually use them.
In other words, we're not selling Artifacts. We're selling the status of owning one. As for whether it works, who cares?
Compared to paying a fortune to commission Trekkers to make a Wish at the Monolith, our replicas are way cheaper! That's why you are the boss! Your business acumen is amazing!
See, Lutty gets the drift. You should learn from your girlfriend so you can sell our products better.
Wow, selling counterfeit with zero shame... This is obviously a scam ring. Why did Mistique drag me here, anyway...
This is undercover work! Just play along!
Relax. I won't actually make you sell fake goods!
Typing blind on her phone single-handed behind her back...==W== She and Amber must have a lot to talk about.
Ahem! Newbie, don't look at your phone while your superior is talking! Since Lutty recommended you, I'll let it slide this time. Don't let it happen again!
Sorry. I was just turning my phone off==W== so I could focus better on what you were saying.
Honestly... Young people these days... Have they forgotten even basic manners?
Scammers are lecturing people on manners now...
Alright, about your pay. For every deal you close, you get a cut. In other words, the more you work, the more you earn. Simple enough, yes?
And darling! If you can recruit more people like I did, you'll get to do more advanced work and earn even higher commissions!
More advanced work? Do you sell other things, too?

We also have phones acquired through certain channels. Using voice-altering magic, we can help the owner contact friends and family and discuss some very profitable business opportunities~<size=46>★</size>
Ahem! Lutty, don't tell newbies about that part of the job yet.
Profitable business opportunities for everyone...==W== That sounds awfully familiar...
Iris! Oh no, I lost my phone! What do I do? W-waaah—
Noya? What are you doing here?
W-Why can't I be here? I lost my phone, of course I came back to ask you for help.
But you were talking to me on the phone just now... Saying how you got a huge commission but needed to give them one million Dorra as a safety deposit first. I was about to come find you.
But if you lost your phone, then who was I talking to?
Don't tell me it was a scam. Commissions coming through the Trekker Association would never require such a massive deposit.
A scam?!==W== Drats! Someone impersonated me to trick you! Iris, you didn't hand the money over, did you?
As if we had anywhere close to one million Dorra... We don't even have ten thousand saved right now.
As the New Star Guild was dirt poor, we didn't get scammed.==W== Later, we found Noya's lost phone in an alley in the greenhouse area.
We probably made too much noise by asking Firenze for help, so the thief panicked and ditched the stolen phone.
But the culprit was never caught.==W== Could it be ... that this woman right in front of me is the scam organization behind it all?
I've already brought people in, and I've sold all the previous stock. That means my trial period is over, right?
So... Can I get in on that high-commission business now?
Ambition is a good thing, but haste makes waste. You still need to go through the proper process.
I know... But, um... We really don't have much time.
If this drags on, my family might find me. I want to elope with ==SEX4== as soon as possible, and for that we need a lot of money. That's why I brought ==SEX4== here for the job, too.
We have to make some fast money and leave this city forever! If I'm caught and taken back to my parents, I'll become a pawn in a political marriage and be separated from my beloved forever!
Wow, this is some wild plot... Would the boss really go for it?
Ah, you young people... So bold, willing to do anything for love. Back in my day... When I was young, I, too... But I hesitated.
Anyway, I understand your situation. People with something on the line work the hardest.==W== I'll make an exception this time. Lutty, you'll start the other business tomorrow.
Thank you!==W== I'll take ==SEX4== back to the dorms now. Tomorrow, I'll earn lots and lots of Dorra, for you and for myself!
Come on, darling~ Let's work hard for our new life★
Strange. Lutty had never mentioned having a lover before. Where did this lover suddenly come from?
You two, follow them.==W== See whether ==SEX== really is Lutty's lover.
