strings.text: You two, pretending to be a couple, return to the arranged accommodation. Just as you are about to discuss your next move, you find that there are ears behind the wall...
This is our room. Until we earn enough money, we'll be sleeping here.
It's huge. This is way too luxurious...
To keep up appearances, they've disguised themselves as a hotel. I gotta admit, the facilities are top-notch.
Whew—==W==now can you finally explain why you dragged me here?
Heh heh~ You really are impatient, aren't you?
You must've noticed already. This place is a scam ring's hideout,==W== and we are here to investigate them while undercover!
But you aren't doing this just out of a sense of justice, are you?
Heh heh, us Witches are greedy creatures who feast on the truth★ Besides...
Tyrant, have you heard about the new kind of scams that have been going around?
A scam is a scam. Crooks trick people. What's new about that?
No, no, this time it's different~
They catch scammers one after another, yet the criminals' numbers seem to be going up, not down. Don't you find that strange?
The more you think about it, the more it smells fishy, right? See, this really is worth writing about★~
The ringleader isn't just selling fake Artifacts. She also makes her underlings recruit people, promising commissions and one-time bonuses if they bring more people in.
Getting paid just for recruiting people. That's just too good to be true...
And someone will always take the bait. That's why they never run out of scammers.
She has a sense of risk management. She only lets employees with good performance records meet her face-to-face.
Even if the lowest-level members get caught, nothing leads back to her.==W== To earn her trust, I went through so much crap.
Don't tell me you actually scammed people?
Of course not. I paid out of my own pocket to buy all the fake Artifacts! The only task left was recruiting people...
And that's when you pulled me in, right?
Exactly! Now she trusts me completely. Thanks for making the trip~!
Alright, I think I understand the situation. But once the investigation is over, how are we gonna get out?
Don't worry. When the time comes, we'll just say we're going out to meet an Artifact buyer. Then we scram.
The organization will send people to tail us, but I can easily shake them off with my broom.
True. Escape won't be a problem if we use your broom.
But... Why is there only one bed in this room?
We're an eloping couple. Wouldn't it be weird if we didn't sleep in the same bed?
I knew she wouldn't trust me that easily. She actually sent people to eavesdrop on us.
Captain, do we really need to press our ears to the door? I feel like a pervert... Aren't they a couple?
Shut up! The boss doesn't buy the couple act, that's why we're here! Think about it. Why is the room so quiet? If they were a real couple, they should be doing something by now!
These people... Does this even count as eavesdropping when they're talking this loudly outside the door?
Heh heh~ Then let's play along.
Play along how? You don't mean us actually...
Ahem... D~darling~ what do you think~ of my outfit today?
Anyway, we need to convince the people outside that Mistique and I are really a couple...
Yeah! Babe, your outfit today is stunning~ Looks amazing on you~
Tch—that's it? I spent forever picking it out~, just to wear it~ for you~, you know~?
Uh... Aside from looking nice and fitting well, how else am I supposed to judge clothes?
Oh, I guess your actions speak louder than words~
How am I even supposed to respond to that...
Don't get handsy★ darling! At least let me take a shower first!
Not there! Don't sniff around like a puppy~!
That's some impressive improvising, worthy of a Witch...
Maybe we should call it a day?
Can you shut up for a minute? Do you think I want to listen to a couple getting all lovey-dovey? I'm doing this for the mission!
W-wah... Lying in front of Tyrant like this is so embarrassing.==W== But to avoid being exposed...==W== I'll go all in. I-If I just cover my eyes, I can keep acting.
I—I'm fine, darling~! You... You can be even rougher!
Or... Do you want me to take the initiative again, like last time ... and make you beg for mercy?
D-damn it... What a sickeningly sweet couple...==W== No! I mean, what an obscenely indecent pair!
I can't take this anymore. Let's go report back!
Whew—thanks to Mistique, the eavesdroppers outside finally left. We're safe...
Darling... What are you waiting for★?
I'm ready. Even if it hurts, it's fine. Come on~
You can do whatever you want... Yes, right there. Undo that button. I just can't have enough of you.
Mistique... Open your eyes, okay? The people outside are gone.
Around the time when you said "you can be even rougher."
Y-you... Why didn't you tell me earlier?!
I wanted to, but you just kept talking, and I couldn't get a word in edgewise.
Dammit! All that resolve for nothing!
Alright, the crisis is over. Time for bed.
I'll take the couch. You can have the bed.
You're underestimating them. That bunch is capable of anything. What if they come check on us in the middle of the night? If they see you on the couch, we'll be exposed immediately.
I'll generously share half the undercover blanket with you! Just so you know this is a one-time deal!
I've got a great suggestion. Why don't you two just get married and stay here for good?
Huh? What do you mean, ma'am?
Exactly what it sounds like. Why run so far just to elope? As long as you make money for me, I'll guarantee your safety and let you live here in comfort.

I'll also pull you from field work. If you're discovered by accident, it'll create a problem for both of us, right? There's plenty of work that can be done inside the building. It is the perfect job for you.
You'll be able to stay with ==SEX4== all the time. Why would you want to go out?
Damn it. I did not see this coming.
Tch. Guarantee our safety, my ass... She just wants to keep us under surveillance!
What do we do? If we stall too long, we'll definitely get exposed.
As much as I hate it, calling it is an option. I've already gathered enough material anyway...
But how are we gonna get out of here...==W== Ah, I got it.
Eh, Mistique? Why are you looking at me like that?
Mm-hmm~ I just had a brilliant idea★!

param: You two, pretending to be a couple, return to the arranged accommodation. Just as you are about to discuss your next move, you find that there are ears behind the wall...
This is our room. Until we earn enough money, we'll be sleeping here.
It's huge. This is way too luxurious...
To keep up appearances, they've disguised themselves as a hotel. I gotta admit, the facilities are top-notch.
Whew—==W==now can you finally explain why you dragged me here?
Heh heh~ You really are impatient, aren't you?
You must've noticed already. This place is a scam ring's hideout,==W== and we are here to investigate them while undercover!
But you aren't doing this just out of a sense of justice, are you?
Heh heh, us Witches are greedy creatures who feast on the truth★ Besides...
Tyrant, have you heard about the new kind of scams that have been going around?
A scam is a scam. Crooks trick people. What's new about that?
No, no, this time it's different~
They catch scammers one after another, yet the criminals' numbers seem to be going up, not down. Don't you find that strange?
The more you think about it, the more it smells fishy, right? See, this really is worth writing about★~
The ringleader isn't just selling fake Artifacts. She also makes her underlings recruit people, promising commissions and one-time bonuses if they bring more people in.
Getting paid just for recruiting people. That's just too good to be true...
And someone will always take the bait. That's why they never run out of scammers.
She has a sense of risk management. She only lets employees with good performance records meet her face-to-face.
Even if the lowest-level members get caught, nothing leads back to her.==W== To earn her trust, I went through so much crap.
Don't tell me you actually scammed people?
Of course not. I paid out of my own pocket to buy all the fake Artifacts! The only task left was recruiting people...
And that's when you pulled me in, right?
Exactly! Now she trusts me completely. Thanks for making the trip~!
Alright, I think I understand the situation. But once the investigation is over, how are we gonna get out?
Don't worry. When the time comes, we'll just say we're going out to meet an Artifact buyer. Then we scram.
The organization will send people to tail us, but I can easily shake them off with my broom.
True. Escape won't be a problem if we use your broom.
But... Why is there only one bed in this room?
We're an eloping couple. Wouldn't it be weird if we didn't sleep in the same bed?
I knew she wouldn't trust me that easily. She actually sent people to eavesdrop on us.
Captain, do we really need to press our ears to the door? I feel like a pervert... Aren't they a couple?
Shut up! The boss doesn't buy the couple act, that's why we're here! Think about it. Why is the room so quiet? If they were a real couple, they should be doing something by now!
These people... Does this even count as eavesdropping when they're talking this loudly outside the door?
Heh heh~ Then let's play along.
Play along how? You don't mean us actually...
Ahem... D~darling~ what do you think~ of my outfit today?
Anyway, we need to convince the people outside that Mistique and I are really a couple...
Yeah! Babe, your outfit today is stunning~ Looks amazing on you~
Tch—that's it? I spent forever picking it out~, just to wear it~ for you~, you know~?
Uh... Aside from looking nice and fitting well, how else am I supposed to judge clothes?
Oh, I guess your actions speak louder than words~
How am I even supposed to respond to that...
Don't get handsy★ darling! At least let me take a shower first!
Not there! Don't sniff around like a puppy~!
That's some impressive improvising, worthy of a Witch...
Maybe we should call it a day?
Can you shut up for a minute? Do you think I want to listen to a couple getting all lovey-dovey? I'm doing this for the mission!
W-wah... Lying in front of Tyrant like this is so embarrassing.==W== But to avoid being exposed...==W== I'll go all in. I-If I just cover my eyes, I can keep acting.
I—I'm fine, darling~! You... You can be even rougher!
Or... Do you want me to take the initiative again, like last time ... and make you beg for mercy?
D-damn it... What a sickeningly sweet couple...==W== No! I mean, what an obscenely indecent pair!
I can't take this anymore. Let's go report back!
Whew—thanks to Mistique, the eavesdroppers outside finally left. We're safe...
Darling... What are you waiting for★?
I'm ready. Even if it hurts, it's fine. Come on~
You can do whatever you want... Yes, right there. Undo that button. I just can't have enough of you.
Mistique... Open your eyes, okay? The people outside are gone.
Around the time when you said "you can be even rougher."
Y-you... Why didn't you tell me earlier?!
I wanted to, but you just kept talking, and I couldn't get a word in edgewise.
Dammit! All that resolve for nothing!
Alright, the crisis is over. Time for bed.
I'll take the couch. You can have the bed.
You're underestimating them. That bunch is capable of anything. What if they come check on us in the middle of the night? If they see you on the couch, we'll be exposed immediately.
I'll generously share half the undercover blanket with you! Just so you know this is a one-time deal!
I've got a great suggestion. Why don't you two just get married and stay here for good?
Huh? What do you mean, ma'am?
Exactly what it sounds like. Why run so far just to elope? As long as you make money for me, I'll guarantee your safety and let you live here in comfort.

I'll also pull you from field work. If you're discovered by accident, it'll create a problem for both of us, right? There's plenty of work that can be done inside the building. It is the perfect job for you.
You'll be able to stay with ==SEX4== all the time. Why would you want to go out?
Damn it. I did not see this coming.
Tch. Guarantee our safety, my ass... She just wants to keep us under surveillance!
What do we do? If we stall too long, we'll definitely get exposed.
As much as I hate it, calling it is an option. I've already gathered enough material anyway...
But how are we gonna get out of here...==W== Ah, I got it.
Eh, Mistique? Why are you looking at me like that?
Mm-hmm~ I just had a brilliant idea★!

strings.text: Mistique takes a photo of you all tied up and sends it out as an "invitation," which is taken up by an unexpected party just a few days later.
Yes, yes, that's it.==W== Look a bit more innocent. A bit more desperate!
This is so weird. Why are you taking photos of me tied up?
Shouldn't you be taking more pictures of the scam operation itself?
Relax, I've already taken plenty of those. Now, over here—look this way.
Since we can't get out, why not create a reason that forces them to let us out?
And these photos of you will serve as the all-important invitation.
Exactly. Something far more interesting than a simple exposé~
This is bad! Ma'am! The Imperial Guard has surrounded the building!
What's with the panic? Same as always, slip them some Dorra and send them on their way.
We can't! This time the Imperial Guard was hired by Grace Imperium. Bribery won't work...
Oh, they're here! This is gonna be fun.
Wait, what exactly happened? Why would Grace Imperium...
Because I leaked the news that the CEO of the Boss Accord was kidnapped in Philae. With your photos attached.
K-kidnapped?!==W== Well... Those photos do kind of look like that.
Think about it. A famous CEO being kidnapped in Philae. That doesn't look good for Grace Imperium, either.
Plus, if they come swooping in and save your life, just imagine how much leverage they'll get from you.
You just completely used me... And leverage for what? I have nothing to give to them!
Don't worry, you won't lose out. That's why I only gave the intel to Grace Imperium!
Didn't the ringleader say it herself? Demand creates consumption. The same applies to information.
As long as the company thinks dismantling this ring is worthwhile, you won't lose out even if they don't get extra leverage.
If the headline reads, New Scam Syndicate Busted, Grace Imperium Secures Philae, that's great publicity for them too, isn't it?
You really put a lot of thought into this... No matter how it turns out, Grace Imperium wins.
But how did you even send that information out?
I'm a Witch, you know. Something this trivial wouldn't stump me.
Stop resisting! Release the CEO of the Boss Accord immediately!
Wait, isn't there some kind of misunderstanding? We haven't got any CEO here.
Don't play dumb. These photos are incontrovertible proof!
Isn't that ... Lutty's lover?==W== Damn it—don't tell me that girl planned this from the start!
That reaction... So ==SEX== really is here. Search the place! Start with that warehouse! We must secure the CEO!
Secure me... They're talking like I'm some kind of loot.
Of course you are loot. The lucky person who beats everyone else to it and becomes your "savior" will reap endless rewards.
They might even ask you to use your company title to help them line their own pockets.
No! Seriously, that would be a disaster!
I'm kidding. I told you I wouldn't let you lose out.==W== Go wait by the window. I'll take my broom and have a look.
With a spectacle like this, of course I have to see it in person★
Wait! This is private property! You have no right to enter!
Trying to hide things? You look suspicious!
Ma'am, bad news! The Guard's also blocked off the back entrance. What are you going to do now~
Lutty! You're the one who brought them here!
Hey, hey, don't drag me—who's Lutty?! I don't know any Lutty—
Stop pulling on me!==W== The photos are going to fall out!
These are ... photos of the fake Artifacts?
Captain, this phone contains photos taken during the actual scams!
Captain! We found a large number of suspected stolen phones in the warehouse!
Stop! Stop! That's not how it is, please, I can explain!
Hehe~ That look of despair on your face is perfection itself! I shall title it "A Scammer Scammed." What do you think?
I shall generously let you in on a secret: No matter how clever you think you are, the truth always comes to light in the end.
You have tomorrow's front-page headlines to look forward to, boss!
Ah, sorry to have kept you waiting, Tyrant! We should get out of here fast. With this much commotion, my colleagues are probably already on their way.
Isn't that a good thing? We could expose everything together.
Not necessarily. I know Witches better than you do.
The CEO of the Boss Accord standing right there, with an unidentified beautiful girl in tow... That's the perfect setup for a tabloid piece. Guess which topic they'll go after?
Yeah... That would be a problem.
Right? Hop on the broom. Let's go!
Undercover mission: accomplished★ I gathered SOOO much fascinating news material. I'm stoked!
Thank goodness nothing went wrong... You really are a professional Witch.
Yes, let me hear the praises! I didn't survive all those battlefields for nothing.
By the way, there's something I've been wanting to ask you!
What is it? I'm in a great mood right now, so I'll answer anything.
Mistique... Why are you dressed like that?==W== Wasn't your undercover role a rich young lady who ran away from home for love?
When people think "rich young lady," don't they usually mean flashy brand dresses?
Hey, are you questioning my taste?!
No, not at all! It just felt unlike you to choose something that didn't match the role...
There's a reason more important than that!
W-we were supposed to be a couple, right? So... Um...
So that's why I chose this outfit... Isn't it cute?! Dialing up the cute factor in front of your partner is only natural, isn't it?!
Argh, you're just terrible! You made me say all that embarrassing stuff!==W== I'm never wearing it again, so if you wanna take a look, do it while you can!
As if to hide her bashfulness, Mistique grabbed me and pulled me onto the broom.
As the broom sliced through the star-filled sky, the noise and worries of the mortal world gradually fell away, leaving no one to disturb this temporary "couple."
Only the stars overhead noticed the faint blush spreading across the Witch's cheeks.

strings.text: Ridge, engrossed in tending to her greenhouse plants, made a huge mistake: she mistakes her boss, who has come to patrol, for a vegetable thief...
Inside the maze-like greenhouse, eerie noises sometimes echo,==RT==like something ghostly at work.
Light... Moisture... All good. That should do it.
Shade-loving plants, sun-loving plants...==W== Plants that need regular watering, plants that prefer dry conditions...
Sorting and planting them was a lot of work, but now it's so much easier.==W== Hehe, this feels really satisfying.
Hey, you all grow strong, okay?
This is bad. I need to get someone to fix it, fast.
Wait a minute... This mark...==W== Oh,==W== so it was you guys...
Stop pretending you don't understand me!==W== Even if you keep quiet about it, I know it was you guys!
Why can't you just get along?! Fighting every day and wrecking company property! I've had it!
Do you know how many reports I've written because of you?==W== Want me to bring them all over and make you flip through them page by page?!
Oh, so you dare fight back? You've got some nerve! TAKE THIS!
So tired... I wanna rest. I'll do one last round greenhouse check and then head back...
Hopefully there won't be any more surprises today, like that mysterious veggie thief who shows up now and then...
They look shiny and plump. Didn't expect a harvest like this in this greenhouse.
I thought it'd be something like monsters disguised as tomatoes.
... Culprit? What are you talking about?
Playing dumb won't help you!==W== You've been caught red-handed with that tomato!
Can't believe you're trying to wriggle out of it==W== even now...
Huh? You look kind of familiar...==W== Sorry, um, have I seen you somewhere before?
I'm Firenze. Does the name ring a bell?
Firenze?! Y-you mean that...==W== The boss everyone says is super scary...?!
... I'm done for,==W== totally done for!==W== Now that I've offended a big shot, I'm gonna get turned into flower fertilizer and buried here!
... Uh... Uh,==W== Lady Firenze... I'm so sorry...
It's fine. United Harvest employs a lot of people. It's completely normal not to recognize every colleague.
Anyway, please put the shovel down for now. I've got some questions for you.
What's wrong? Standing that far away makes it hard to talk. Here, come closer.
I'm so very sorry, Lady Firenze. I...
I told you not to stand so far away. Avoiding me for no reason just makes the whole thing even more awkward, you know.
Waaah, I'm sorry, you must be exhausted, please have some rest—!==W== I'll take my leave now!
I'm done, I'm done, I've been caught... This is really the end of the line...==W== I'm definitely gonna get turned into organic fertilizer for growing delicious vegetables...!
What kind of person do you take me for?
Relax. I've never cared much about pointless formalities.
I just want to confirm one thing. These tomatoes in this corner, you planted them, right?
What happened to the plants that were supposed to be here?
This greenhouse is currently unused. There was nothing scheduled to be planted.
Who gave the order to leave it empty?
These past few years, the management kept changing the directives. All the plants that were growing just fine got pulled out. After that, no one really paid attention to the empty greenhouse.
I figured leaving it unused was a waste, so I planted some common vegetables and fruits...
The level of mismanagement is worse than I thought.
I'm sorry, I know it was wrong of me! But the food itself hasn't done anything wrong—
Planting without permission does violate regulations. However...
Given how chaotic things were, the fact that you still worked so diligently is no small thing. That deserves praise, not punishment.
That's right, I'm praising you. Going forward, the company will do its utmost to ensure normal production order and the personal safety of its employees.
I believe your work also deserves more attention and recognition.
Chaos... Going forward, the company... Uh, Lady Firenze... I don't really understand...
Does that mean something big happened in the company recently?
You didn't hear the sounds coming from outside while you were working?
Explosions, fires... The commotion from that battle was quite something.
W-w-what?! That happened?! In the city?!
Oh, right, I did hear some "bang"s, "boom"s, and crashing noises days ago...
I just thought someone's lab had blown up again and ignored it...
Heh, how interesting. It seems you're the type who completely disappears into your own world once absorbed in work.
Your name is Ridge, right? I'll remember it.

I took over a greenhouse without permission and didn't get punished. I was even encouraged...==W== I knew the rumors were wrong. Lady Firenze is obviously a wonderful person.==W== I... I should repay her kindness...
R-right, um... Lady Firenze, I have something I want to give you!
Huff... Huff... Um, here!==W====RT==Please, take these.
Tomatoes, potatoes, pumpkins, corn... You grew all of these?
Yes! They've all been washed. Ready to eat!
I see. Thank you, I'll give them a try.
Mm, juicy, sweet, great texture,==W== and most importantly, fresh.
Hehe, I'm so glad you like them.
This taste brings back memories of United Harvest from the days gone by.
I hope you keep that passion and continue working hard. I look forward to tasting more of your delicious tomatoes in the future.
No problem, farming is my middle name!==W== I'll defend this greenhouse to my last breath. I won't let you down!
Hehe, very good... Keep up that spirit.
The company's future may well rest in the hands of people who, like her, remain loyal to their ideals.

strings.text: Ridge delivers the freshest fruits and vegetables to Jing's Bistro, and engages in a unique exchange with the young shop manager.
On that day, Ridge was strolling down the street,==RT==dragging a handcart piled high with fresh fruits and vegetables.
Huff... Huff... So heavy...==RT==I really overloaded it this time.
Every time I tell myself to pick only the best ones... But I just can't decide.
Well, it can't be helped. After all, I grew all of these myself, and they all turned out great~ Hehe.
Oh, she's finally here. Everyone, come quickly!
Huh?! Who are you guys?==RT==Are you after my vegetables—
No, no! We're from Jing's Bistro. We've met before, remember?
Great. You must've had a hard trip. We'll help you unload.
They look really fresh. Once again, you delivered!
Wow, just imagining them cooked and served on the table is making me drool!
Well, it was a really big harvest this time, I brought a bit more than usual... Will your kitchen be able to use it all?
No problem at all. The more the better!
We'll deliver the vegetables to Uncle Qin first. Please discuss the details with our manager.
What number are we on? How many tables are ahead of us? This is taking forever!
Relax and have some tea. Good food takes time.
Jing's Bistro... Truly the most popular restaurant in all of Philae!
It's so crowded. If I weren't for work, I'd never dare come to a place like this alone.
Please have some tea and rest your feet!
Cool, soothing tea with crispy biscuits... Jing's Bistro really goes all out, even with the complimentary snacks.
The weather's been a bit hot lately, so we brewed some fresh tea. It's cooling and helps work up an appetite.
Everyone, please enjoy to your heart's content!==W== If you're satisfied, don't forget to leave us a good review, yeah?
So that's Jinglin, the manager of this place...
She looks younger than me, but so dependable...
Hey, Ridge!==RT==Thanks for delivering vegetables again!
I just saw them in the kitchen. Top-notch stuff, as usual.
Fresh vegetables have been hard to come by lately,==W== and shipping them in from other cities costs too much.
Good thing we have you, Ridge.==W== We've been waiting for you forever.
Really? In that case, maybe I can expand the planting area a bit more...
That'd be great.==W== If we can't use it all here,==W== we can introduce you to other restaurants!
—Ah, sorry, I got carried away and went off topic!
I've got your payment ready. Come with me!
Um, well, since my work here is done, I'll ... head out now...?
Since you're already here, why not stay and have a meal? My treat!
I've been busy harvesting fruits and vegetables these past few days. I didn't even eat breakfast today,==W== so I do feel a bit hungry.
Th-then I'll take you up on that.
Of course, I won't eat for free. I'll pay...==W== Eh, Manager?
We'll make you a special meal using the ingredients you brought!==W== It'll be ready soon, just wait a moment, please!
S-so fast... In the blink of an eye,==W== she's already in the kitchen...
Ta-da!==W== One plate of Stir-Fried Three Shreds,==W== and one plate of Stuffed Lotus Root with Sticky Rice. Here, see if it's to your taste.
That's right. The ingredients are shredded potatoes, carrots, and green peppers. That's the vegetarian version.==W== There's also one with shredded meat and ham added.
I think this dish perfectly highlights the ingredients' natural freshness.==W== Uncle Qin also adjusted the seasoning specifically to suit local taste buds.
Come on, give it a try.
I... I'll dig in...==W====RT==Wow...! So delicious!
Since the ingredients came from you, Ridge, there's no way it could taste bad.
(sniff) I'm so touched.==W== That's the highest praise I could ever receive...
Tasting this dish, I can really feel that all my hard work wasn't for nothing...!
Haha, your reaction is a bit dramatic.
I usually just eat at the company cafeteria, where all you get is processed food reheated with Artifacts...==W== It's convenient, but the taste is like day and night.
If Jing's Bistro could work together with United Harvest... Maybe we could create even more delicious food.
Hmm... That would be pretty difficult.
Huh? You sound so sure. W-why?
Well... Truth to be told, we did talk about collaboration before.==W== But we focus on hot, freshly cooked dishes, while United Harvest only wanted to use our brand to sell ready-made meals.
You could say it was a case of "difference in company philosophies." Anyway, after that, the whole thing got shelved.
I-I see...==W==Honestly, my biggest wish is just for everyone to have enough to eat. But if the ingredients could be fresher too, I guess that really would make people even happier...
Haha, we are on the same page! Eating well and drinking well, that's true happiness.
We Loong have an old saying: "Food is the staff of life."
That's the priority food occupies in our culture, and a chef's job is to honor that.
Protecting everyone's happiness by honoring the food...==W== You are such a gentle people.
Indeed, United Harvest's old business philosophy ... doesn't seem to quite match with your restaurant's.
It's such a shame. I'm sure the two of us could work together perfectly.
Uh... Did I say something wrong?
No, no...==W== I'm gonna let you in on a little secret.
I actually grew those fruits and vegetables in violation of United Harvest's company policy.
What?!==W== Then if the company found out, wouldn't you get into trouble...?
It's fine, it's fine. See, I said "grew," past tense.
United Harvest is slowly changing.==W== They've started respecting my work, and respecting what people outside the company do as well.
Just the other day, someone even went out of their way to praise my vegetables as especially delicious!==W== I was over the moon.
Really?==W== If United Harvest can change its way of thinking, maybe one day we really can work together...
Yeah! No matter who you are, rich or poor...==W== As long as you eat something delicious, you'll be happy. And when you're hungry, you feel miserable—
It's such a simple truth. Everyone would be able to get it!
Mmm~==W== This kind of happiness, from tasting good food, is absolutely one of a kind!
Seeing you gulping is making me hungry too. I'll have a bite.==W== Nom...==W== Uncle Qin's cooking really is the best!
I don't know whether Jing's Bistro and United Harvest will ever have a chance to join forces...==W== But I'll toast to a future where everyone can eat well in Philae...==W== Cheers!

strings.text: Ridge's ambitions extend far beyond a single greenhouse. To realize her grandest dreams, she resolves to seek help from Trekkers beyond the city walls.
A small figure is wandering through the depths==RT==of the forest, carrying a shovel.
It's rare for me to get sent out to do field work, so I've got to bring back as many samples as I can.
Maybe I'll find something suitable for cultivation or crossbreeding. If I do, it'd really speed up crop improvement...
Don't tell me it's another food thief...
No, no, I can't jump to conclusions. I always end up getting the wrong idea of people.==W== I need to stay calm this time...
Wait,==W== th-this sound...==W== Is it getting closer?
Ugh... I'm a bit scared... But when it comes to protecting food, I won't back down!
Feels like I've gotten a better punch again.
But... Yeah, it's fine. I can control it now...==W== Probably?
Did she come here just to mess with me? She's holding such a huge shovel, that's terrifying...
Huh?==W== I-I think I've gotten the wrong idea again...
And... She has such a gigantic weapon. Could she be a powerful Trekker?
Eeeeek—?!==W====RT==W-w-w-what do I do?! She's gonna wipe the greenhouse floor with me!
I'm sorry!==W== Please let me go!
Sorry about that.==W== I thought you were another Shrubshrew trying to steal my food.
No, no,==W== I'm the one who gave you a scare.
Um...==W== I said something rude earlier. Please let me make it up to you!
Please! I'm doing this for my own peace of mind! Please, you have to take this!
O-okay then.==RT==This is a ... vegetable sandwich?
(sniff) It looks so fresh, and it smells great.
Of course.==RT==Oh, and by the way, I grew all these vegetables myself~
You grew vegetables this good? That's amazing...==W====RT==I-I'll just—mmmph.
Mmm...!==W== It looks like the usual ones, but it's so much crunchier, and the freshness is on a whole different level.
Right? Right?!==RT==Growing vegetables is kinda like making friends. If you put your heart into it, they'll always respond to you.
Ah, wait, does that mean you also came into the forest to...
Yeah. I'm looking for anything that might spark some agricultural ideas.
Ideally something that could help improve the environment in the greenhouse, or seeds suitable for developing new crops.
Um, if you know what to look for, I ... might be able to help. I probably know this forest better than most people.
Wow~ This is perfect, we found everything in one go.
Experienced Trekkers do amazing work. I'm so glad I ran into you, Fuyuka.
Not at all. I'm not all that experienced. Compared to my seniors, I still have a long way to go.
But ... for things like today, I might be of help... If you ever need to come into the forest again, please feel free to contact Petal Bloom anytime.
Being able to promote our guild like this... I...==W== I guess I've grown a bit too,==W== hehe...
Thank you, Fuyuka.==W== I'll reach out to you before I come next time.
By the way, are you free later? I wanna take you to a cool place.
That's right! The view's great, isn't it~?
Sadly, since no one's been managing it properly, some areas are full of weeds.==W== So I'm planning to reclaim those areas.
I've learned some techniques through greenhouse farming. Next, I want to take on farming in the wild.
Those two... Are they really different from one another?
With greenhouse farming, you can control temperature, humidity, lighting, and air circulation==W== to create a stable growing environment for your crops.
Farming in the wild, on the other hand, depends on weather, pest control, and climate,==W== so it's much more demanding.
W-Wow...==W== I didn't get any of that jargon...
Sigh, but things didn't go well from the get-go.
I bought a plow for tilling, but I can't pull it.==W== You'd need an Artifact or a monster to drag it.
But I don't have an Artifact like that, and taming a monster would take ages...
W-w-wait—?!==W== Fu-Fuyuka, what are you doing?!
Huh?!==W== D-did I do something I'm not supposed to?
N-no, no! I was just asking... You can pull that plow all by yourself...?
I'm sorry! I didn't know I wasn't supposed to touch that. I'll put it back right away!
No need for that! I was just startled, that's all!
Um... Miss Fuyuka, may I ask you to pull it back and forth along this furrow a couple more times?
Along this furrow... Uh... You mean like this?
Yes, exactly! I'll pay you, of course. Please!
The land is cleared.==W== You actually did it...
Wow,==W== how could I ever thank you?
It's really nothing. Just some physical labor...
Not at all, you helped me a ton...==W== Oh, right!
Is it possible for me to sign a long-term contract with your guild, Petal Bloom?==W== That way, whether it's forest work or land reclamation, I can ask for your help.
R-really...? I feel like I didn't do that much...
It might've been easy for you, but to me, it was a lifesaver. Where is Petal Bloom based?
Ah, it's a bit far from here.
But there are lots of waterways around Philae City, so we can go by boat.
That's right.==W== There's nothing there for now.
But one day, hehe, I'll take over this whole mountain, from here all the way to there—every bit of it.
I'll plant all sorts of vegetables, fruits, trees, flowers...
Grow more delicious food than anyone could ever count, so no one will have to go hungry.
Some people... They'll think I'm just daydreaming and laugh at me...
I really hope that one day we can see all that come true!
All right, the contract's signed.==W== Please keep the documents in a safe place.
Wow, Captain's so efficient. Went out for a stroll and came back with a big client.
Compared to that former captain who spent all day obsessed with claw machines, it's like night and day.==W== We're all counting on you, Captain Fuyuka. Keep up the great work.
So you're the captain. And you were being so modest earlier.
I'll be counting on you from now on, Petal Bloom!==W== Next time, I'll bring some delicious vegetables I grew myself. It's gonna be great!
Delicious vegetables... That sounds wonderful.==W== Do I get a share?
Of course!==W== With me, everyone gets to eat their fill.
Ridge didn't finish the sentence, but she==RT==exchanged a smile with Fuyuka.
"My dream is to make sure everyone can eat==RT==to their heart's content!"

strings.text: Donna, who has always championed teamwork, has been avoiding everyone lately and acting on her own. Could it be that the Post Haste is facing a crisis too dangerous to speak of?!
... Today's earnings, the wages from my side gig, plus the tips from those errands...
Ugh, I'm still miles away from the goal.
It's gonna take forever to save enough...
If only Dorra could just multiply on their own...
Sorry! Just checking something real quick. Did I wake you?
Did I hear you mention "Dorra"? Are we running short on funds this month?
No no, it's not like that. Don't worry about it.
Anyway, keep it down. If we keep talking, we'll wake Teresa too...
I'm going to bed. Nighty night!
Donna?! You're leaving this early again?
Yup, got a mountain of letters to deliver today!==W== I left breakfast on the table for you guys!
Oh, and I'll be back pretty late, so go ahead and eat dinner without me!
Why? You're already heading out so early...
Donna... Is something going on lately? You know we can help you out!
Huh?==W== Just wanna get a head start and clear out some deliveries, that's all!
Gotta run! Don't forget to wake Freesia up!
I can feel it! Donna is definitely keeping some secret from us...
I fear you may be right...==W== But what could it be?
I recall hearing her mutter about running out of Dorra a month ago...
Running out of Dorra?!==W== Yikes, are we in the red?! Is Post Haste going under?!
I don't have the exact figures... But considering how costly long-distance travel is and how modest our fees are...==W== Could we have been operating at a loss all this time?
Does that mean...==W== Donna's out there hustling all alone to save Post Haste from financial ruin!?
That reminds me! A customer said something strange last month...
You specialize exclusively in courier services?==W== Hmm. The business model actually shows potential.
However, your cash flow appears stagnant. And with a headcount of only three...
Tell you what. Let me acquire your operation. I will bring in a professional team and expand into other cities...
Hmm... Thanks, but no thanks! Post Haste isn't looking for a merger right now!
What a pity... Contact me if you change your mind.
What...? I had no idea such an exchange occurred...
Oh no... If we get bought out, will they force us to split up?
That won't happen. I believe in Donna.
Besides, we were just discussing how to travel efficiently on a budget...==W== Post Haste isn't going anywhere. It simply isn't.
Then what is she keeping from us...?==W== Argh! The suspense is killing me!
It's been ages since we shared a meal! Keep this up, and the team might actually split up for good...
In that case, we should investigate the matter ourselves.
Feels like playing pretend detective...==W== What if we get caught?
We have no other choice...==W== Unless you have a more efficient solution?
Fine, okay. It's for the good of the Post Haste... I'm in.
Morning! Wow, Freesia. Not often do I see you up at this hour.
I merely happened to wake up early today... Pay it no mind.
Yep! Breakfast is on the table. Don't wait up for lunch or dinner, okay? I'm off!
You got it! Operation: Tailing Donna is a go!
Odd... Morning's almost gone, and she's done nothing but deliveries.
Leaving this early... Is my inefficiency dragging her down?==W== Is she silently shouldering extra work to cover for me?
Hold on! She's moving way too fast. We didn't even get that many commissions today! At this rate, she'll be done before noon.
You mean ... she is rushing to clear her schedule for something else this afternoon?
I could've sworn I just saw her come this way...
Are those ...==W== newspapers? Since when do we take paper route commissions?
Classic Donna... Hauling that huge stack and still running like the wind! And she's nailing every single throw!
Teresa, stop gawking, or we really will lose her.
Now the market...==W== Logically, she shouldn't have any shopping to do today.
You don't think she's hiding some kind of ...==W== back-alley deal?!
Freesia, look! She's making contact with someone...
Another delivery? Oh god, what if she's smuggling dangerous contraband...
If I see anything suspicious, I'm stepping in. We might be broke, but I won't let Donna get mixed up in anything illegal.
Wait. Are those ...==W== milk bottles in her basket?

... She's been all over the place, but there's definitely a pattern...

Good idea! Let's stick to your plan.

param: Donna, who has always championed teamwork, has been avoiding everyone lately and acting on her own. Could it be that the Post Haste is facing a crisis too dangerous to speak of?!
... Today's earnings, the wages from my side gig, plus the tips from those errands...
Ugh, I'm still miles away from the goal.
It's gonna take forever to save enough...
If only Dorra could just multiply on their own...
Sorry! Just checking something real quick. Did I wake you?
Did I hear you mention "Dorra"? Are we running short on funds this month?
No no, it's not like that. Don't worry about it.
Anyway, keep it down. If we keep talking, we'll wake Teresa too...
I'm going to bed. Nighty night!
Donna?! You're leaving this early again?
Yup, got a mountain of letters to deliver today!==W== I left breakfast on the table for you guys!
Oh, and I'll be back pretty late, so go ahead and eat dinner without me!
Why? You're already heading out so early...
Donna... Is something going on lately? You know we can help you out!
Huh?==W== Just wanna get a head start and clear out some deliveries, that's all!
Gotta run! Don't forget to wake Freesia up!
I can feel it! Donna is definitely keeping some secret from us...
I fear you may be right...==W== But what could it be?
I recall hearing her mutter about running out of Dorra a month ago...
Running out of Dorra?!==W== Yikes, are we in the red?! Is Post Haste going under?!
I don't have the exact figures... But considering how costly long-distance travel is and how modest our fees are...==W== Could we have been operating at a loss all this time?
Does that mean...==W== Donna's out there hustling all alone to save Post Haste from financial ruin!?
That reminds me! A customer said something strange last month...
You specialize exclusively in courier services?==W== Hmm. The business model actually shows potential.
However, your cash flow appears stagnant. And with a headcount of only three...
Tell you what. Let me acquire your operation. I will bring in a professional team and expand into other cities...
Hmm... Thanks, but no thanks! Post Haste isn't looking for a merger right now!
What a pity... Contact me if you change your mind.
What...? I had no idea such an exchange occurred...
Oh no... If we get bought out, will they force us to split up?
That won't happen. I believe in Donna.
Besides, we were just discussing how to travel efficiently on a budget...==W== Post Haste isn't going anywhere. It simply isn't.
Then what is she keeping from us...?==W== Argh! The suspense is killing me!
It's been ages since we shared a meal! Keep this up, and the team might actually split up for good...
In that case, we should investigate the matter ourselves.
Feels like playing pretend detective...==W== What if we get caught?
We have no other choice...==W== Unless you have a more efficient solution?
Fine, okay. It's for the good of the Post Haste... I'm in.
Morning! Wow, Freesia. Not often do I see you up at this hour.
I merely happened to wake up early today... Pay it no mind.
Yep! Breakfast is on the table. Don't wait up for lunch or dinner, okay? I'm off!
You got it! Operation: Tailing Donna is a go!
Odd... Morning's almost gone, and she's done nothing but deliveries.

You mean ... she is rushing to clear her schedule for something else this afternoon?
I could've sworn I just saw her come this way...
Are those ...==W== newspapers? Since when do we take paper route commissions?
Classic Donna... Hauling that huge stack and still running like the wind! And she's nailing every single throw!
Teresa, stop gawking, or we really will lose her.
Now the market...==W== Logically, she shouldn't have any shopping to do today.
You don't think she's hiding some kind of ...==W== back-alley deal?!

Another delivery? Oh god, what if she's smuggling dangerous contraband...

strings.text: A secret carefully tucked away, an exaggerated plan for her part-time job, and a heart that simply wants to surprise everyone—Do your best, the ever-capable Donna!
Mmm, the morning air feels absolutely amazing!
Let's see what's on the agenda for today...
Sorting the catch and veggies at the market ... then packing cookies at the family workshop...
Looks like I've got another full plate today!
But first, the mail! Can't forget my main duty as a courier for Post Haste!
Let's go! I am the invincible Donna! My goal is ... finally within reach!
Maybe by the end of the day, I'll finally have enough Dorra to buy it!
Do you really have to handle this delivery all on her own?
Leave it to me. I have visited Philae before, and I can certainly manage a package of this size.
But it's such a long trip! You on a bike with that giant box... I'm worried it'll tip you over!
Ta-da! Freshly baked cookies! Who wants a bite?
Huh... The vibe is weird in here. Did something happen?
No, no! I just think hauling that huge package alone is too much for Freesia. I want to tag along and help.
Good point... Freesia is strong, but on those bumpy roads, balancing a massive box on the back of a bike sounds dangerous.
There is no need to worry. If I secure the package tightly and pedal with all my might, I shall return in just a few days.
No way! The moment you use your "full strength," the chain will snap again!==W== And who's gonna fix it then? You?
If only we had a vehicle big enough==W== to carry all three of us...
And not just for deliveries—we could go on trips together! Think of how far we could travel!
Why don't we go check the Artifact Shop?
A vehicle capable of seating three...==W== Does such a thing really exist?
Hehe, it sure does! I actually saw one while out on a delivery run!
You have to see it to believe it...==W== I just hope it hasn't been sold yet.
Let's hurry to the shop then! It would be a disaster if someone else had bought it!
A vehicle that seats three, huh...
Say no more. You folks must be looking for this!
If we slap a cargo rack on the back, the three of us could haul even the biggest packages as a team!
It's not the model I saw before, but this is sweet too! Let me check the tag...
I thought even the rarest Artifacts topped out at a million, max...
Maybe we should abandon this idea.
I shall continue handling heavy cargo myself. If the bicycle were to break down mid-transit...
I would simply carry both the bicycle and the packages back home.
Yeah. I think it's safer if I tag along, don't you?
Me...?==W== Oh, right. You should go with Teresa. You two handle the heavy lifting, and I'll take the smaller parcels.
That's the plan for now... But work would be a breeze if we had that bike.
1.2 million is steep. But thinking about it... It's not actually impossible.
That settles it! To secure a bright future for Post Haste, I'll move heaven and earth to make it happen!
Hey, sir! Got a letter for you!
Also, I need these veggies here. Mind bagging 'em up for me?
Oh, Donna. I see you everywhere these days. Running errands again?
Haha, yeah! I'm working toward a little goal of mine—
Just don't overdo it, okay?==W== Here you go, your veggies.
An older lady in Sailstead asked me to run this over. Could you check the sender info?
Sailstead... Ah! It's from my mother. Thank you!
Don't mention it! That's what Post Haste's for!
By the way, got any fish for sale today?
Of course! Take your pick—it's on the house, as a thank you!
Ms. Marta! I'm coming in! Got that fish you wanted!
Oh my goodness! You're a lifesaver. I knew I could count on you, Donna.
Oh, and the cookies in the kitchen are fresh out of the oven. Mind packing them up for me?
Thanks a bunch! Just holler if you need anything.
Steam rises from the fresh-baked cookies, carrying the rich, sweet scent of milk and butter through the air.
Hmmm... What's on the packing list for today?
Looks like it's all small gift sets. Nine per box. Three flavors, three of each... Got it.
Fast hands, gentle touch...==W== Oops, this one has a chipped corner. You go in the reject pile.
One by one, exquisite cookies fill the gift boxes. Lids are secured, and ribbons are tied in perfect bows.
Phew... Once I complete this batch, plus my earnings from the delivery runs...==W== I should finally hit 1.2 million Dorra!
Yes! As soon as I clock out, I'm heading to the Artifact shop to grab that three-seater bike...! Freesia and Teresa should be home by the time I walk it back.
Hehe, I bet their jaws are gonna drop when I roll up with a three-seater!
I'll call this... Operation: Donna's Big Surprise! It's perfect!
Heehee. I can't wait to see the looks on their faces!
It's gonna be great. Now the three of us can go everywhere together, whether to deliver letters or have fun!
I'm afraid so. A family of three came in earlier. They fell in love with it and paid in full—right there, right then...
Ah... No way...! It took me so long to scrape that money together...
No, it's my fault... I should've asked you to hold it for me.
Wait a sec. The bike I saw earlier looked different from the one that was just sold.
Does that mean ... there's another model?!
I think it was right behind that shelf...
I recall another three-seater Artifact vehicle here. Do you still have it? Not the one in the window—the other one.
Another one...==W== Oh, right! You mean that old three-wheeler that's been sitting here forever?
Couldn't sell the thing, so I moved it to the warehouse. Surprised you even remember it.
It's bigger than the bicycle, so it's pricier. It'll run you 3 million Dorra even at a discount...
3 million... Guess I've got some serious saving to do.
Could you hold it for me? I swear I'll come back and buy it the second I've saved enough!
Tell you what. I'll hold the trike for three months. Come pick it up anytime.==W== But take any longer than that, and I can't promise anything. I've got a business to run, after all.
You got it! No problem! It's a deal!
I'm heading out then. Thanks a ton!
So ... that is the truth behind it all...
I know, I feel the same way!==W== And that leaves us with only one option!

strings.text: Post Haste is a whole—whether joy or toil, it only gains meaning when shared together.
Okay! Three months left. No problem. Totally doable!
Today, Donna remains the cutest, smartest, hardest-working courier of Post Haste! Go me!
Wait a sec. Didn't Freesia and Teresa have something to tell me this morning...?
Ack, focus! No time for distractions. I gotta get these letters delivered!
Roger. Operation: Capturing Donna starts now.
Well look at you, Donna. Up bright and early today...
Morning! Need a hand today? I'm looking to pick up some extra shifts!
Teresa?! And Freesia too? What are you guys doing all the way out here?
Donna. Don't even think about running off.
She slipped away again! After her!
We wouldn't be chasing you ...==W== if you didn't run!
But I feel like I'll lose once I stop...==W== Wait, is Freesia on a bike?! That's cheating!
Time out! Hold on...==W== My leg's asleep... Whoa?!
Aaaah! I'm falling into the sea!
Aha! You're under arrest, Donna! No more running!
"Arrest"? A little dramatic, don't you think?==W== We could've talked back at the office without the high-speed chase.
Donna...==W== How long has it been since we actually talked?
Uh, well... Things have been hectic lately...
Then why bolt the second you saw us? You're definitely hiding something!
N-no I'm not...==W== I ran because... Because you came charging out of nowhere and startled me!
We know about the secret jobs, Donna. No point making excuses.
Post Haste isn't in trouble. You've been working extra shifts to buy that three-seater bike.
But that one got sold, so you're saving for an even pricier model now, aren't you?
That's exactly what Operation: Tailing Donna uncovered! Our intel is solid!
You were following me?!==W== Haha... I had no idea...
I was gonna buy it in secret ... and surprise you both...
Haha... Guess I'm losing my touch...
Donna. Post Haste only works when the three of us are together.
Deliveries, downtime, climbing the Monolith... We go through it all together.
So why do you keep trying to handle everything yourself? We're right here with you.
Yeah, totally! We can save up way faster if we all pitch in!==W== Unless... Do you find us unreliable?
Of course not! You guys are always helping me!==W== I just... I wanted to surprise you both, that's all.
But for that reason you're never around. I don't get to see you ever ...==W== and it really bothers me.
I... I think I'm way happier when the three of us are just spending time together...!
We haven't had dinner or just chatted in so—so long!==W== It feels like forever!
... Oh... Haha... I'm sorry. I didn't even realize...
You're right. I totally lost sight of what's actually important.
... From here on out... Let us work together to raise the funds.
Yeah! With all three of us, we'll scrape up that 3 million Dorra in no time!
Freesia, Teresa... Thank you.==W== I truly messed up this time... I am sorry.
Donna, there is no need for apologies.
However, considering you hid such an important matter from us, I do not intend to forgive you easily.
Hehe, yeah, exactly!==W== Uh, wait... Freesia...?
Freesia! I-I know I did wrong! From now on, I'll run everything by you immediately! I promise!
A simple apology is insufficient. There must be a punishment.
It's fine, Teresa... Freesia has every right to be angry.==W== I was wrong, so I accept the punishment. Name it! I'll do whatever you ask!
Hmph... Very well. Your sentence is as follows.
... You are to cease all labor immediately.==W== You will then accompany us to the bakery for cake.
You just want some for yourself right?!
Ugh... I can never win with you, Freesia.==W== Fine, cake it is! It's on me today. Call it my official apology.
Oh—right! Teresa's on me, too! It's not Post Haste without the whole crew. Let's dig in together!
—But hey, just so we're clear... I know I agreed to the break, but I've still got gigs booked for today.
I can't flake on clients just because of my own drama...==W== But seriously, I'll take a proper day off soon.
No way! You are resting today, period. We'll cover your commissions and side hustles!
We figured you might say that, so Teresa and I came up with a plan last night.
Think nothing of it. Just put your mind at ease.
You bet! Freesia and I can handle anything today!
W-Well...==W== It's not just today's work...
I got scared I wouldn't save enough for the bike, so I kinda booked myself solid...==W== Hehe... Look...
Eh? What about our actual shifts for Post Haste?
I'm doing those too, obviously! I've got it all mapped out...
Is it even physically possible to clear this list in one day?!
It's ... doable? I mean, this is how I schedule things lately...
Donna, be honest—have you been eating properly? I really am getting mad.
You can go faster when alone, yet go farther accompanied.
Reunited, the Post Haste trio is unstoppable.
Operation: 3 Million Dorra is officially a go!

strings.text: Left with no other choice, the New Star Guild takes on a commission supervised by Gerie. Strangely, she seems to have taken a special interest in you...
This is the story of how I first touched her soul...
I'm sorry, but we can only issue a third of the reward for this commission.
You can't be serious! We fought swarms of Stellaroids for that thing. Look, even chipped my blade!
Could you reconsider? Restocking costs half the payout. If we only get a third, we're losing money.
My Soul Stone. Out of Grace.
I know you've all worked hard, but...
... the Artifact is severely damaged. I'm afraid it won't meet the client's standards.
That thing was massive! With two of us hauling it, we couldn't hold off the swarm.
I'm aware. Few Trekkers visited Emor Monolith #25 lately, so the Stellaroids piled up.
A commission is a commission. We have to answer to the client.
I... I understand. We failed to protect it. We'll figure something out.
Man, being a Trekker is brutal. The risks are way too high.
So, have Tawny Nightingale for dinner? Or are we stuck with Bark Skewers?
We actually have a special request for clearing out Stellaroids. As you know, let too many pile up, and you risk triggering a Monolith Meltdown.
I managed to line up a sponsor yesterday. Care to take the job? Here, take a look at the details.
Five thousand Dorra for a Regular, ten for an Elite, and Rares are negotiable? This payout is absurd.
Ten Regulars make fifty grand... A hundred makes five hundred! Whoa, I could hunt these things 'til I retire!
—And this commission comes with a condition.
You'll have a supervisor from the sponsor tagging along. She needs to verify the kill count personally.
Makes sense. With a reward that high, they'd obviously want someone trustworthy to verify the results.
Speak of the devil. She's here.
That uniform... Isn't she with the Dusk Arbiter? Wait, why does everyone else look terrified?
Arbiter Gerie, these are the Trekkers who took the job.
A pleasure. I am Gerie of the Dusk Arbiter.
Stay back! Don't you take another step toward ==PLAYER_NAME==!
Heh heh. My, aren't we feisty?
I simply wanted a closer look at our legendary Tyrant.
I'm the CEO of Boss Accord. That makes me a Boss, not a Tyrant.
Well, everyone back at the Dusk Arbiter is convinced you're the legend in the flesh. They're simply dying to put you on trial.
And you, little girl, stop sneaking that spell. Your casting time is painfully slow.
Hey! Hands off my MagBook! Give it back!
You're after me, right? Leave my friends out of this.
Aww, don't be so grumpy. They're safe. But yeah... I am here for you.
Then what was that little performance about?
Relax. Just pressure-testing the squad. We're climbing the Monolith together. Gotta know if my teammates are useless or not, right?
Liar! The way you stared at ==PLAYER_NAME== looked like you wanted to eat ==SEX4== alive!
Hehe. Just curious if your Boss lives up to the legend.
Chill. Dusk Arbiters are fair. I won't judge you until your Heresy Score hits a hundred.
Huh? Where'd I get ten points?
Last I checked, brawling in the Trekkers' House gets you banned by the Trekker Association. For life.
No supplies, no support... Basically a death sentence out in the Wilds.
My dear Tyrant, you've got good friends. Willing to torch their futures just to keep you safe.
That kind of charisma fits the Tyrant's legend perfectly. So ten points to you.
That's the most random scoring system ever!
Even Iris was ready to jump into the fray back there, and she's usually the level-headed one. Must be a pretty desperate situation to them...
Who cares about supplies... Nothing matters more than friends!
Leaving a friend behind betrays my heart. I won't stand for it!
Heheh... Loosen up, Trekkers. The test is over. Let's try to get along from here on out, hmm?
Willow, that little spat didn't violate the House's Prohibited Conduct clause, did it?
Ahem... Anyway! You're all fellow Trekkers, so play nice!
See? All clear. Let's move. I'm dying to go say hello to those Stellaroids. Hehe.
Boss, maybe we should just walk away from this commission?
She's definitely got her eyes on you. And she's the one all the Trekkers have been whispering about—
Chop chop, Trekkers! I already helped you stamp your thumbprints on the contract during our little test earlier.
Back out now ... and you'll be paying a massive penalty for breach of contract... Heheheh.
My finger. Stained with red ink.
Well, that settles it. We're going. This Arbiter is a total weirdo...==W== But honestly, I don't think she means us any harm...
Boss, we should still watch our backs. I've heard stories—
Whispering secrets over there, Trekkers? Come on, let me in on the fun.
Don't make her suspicious. Let's just catch up.
Boss, let's switch to Heartlink. We can talk freely there.
What were Noya and Iris talking about back there?
It's a rumor going around among the Trekkers lately...
You know the Dusk Arbiters, right, Boss?
A little. The "blade" of Grace, right? They hunt down heretics and anyone defying the doctrine.
Yeah, but let's be honest... Has anyone actually seen a real heretic?
Most folks figured the Arbiters were just shut-ins. You know, staying in the Sanctum to pray and train.
But lately? They're everywhere, poking around. And suddenly, people near Emor started vanishing. Four or five squads gone in just two weeks.
Maybe they just moved on to another city?
That's what we hoped. Until their gear hit the junk markets ... still caked in blood.
The merchant described the seller: black robes, hood pulled low to hide the face.
I don't know... But get this. The merchant tried to peek under the hood, and he saw it.
There was no face. Just a void. A deep, bottomless black hole.
Is this ... some kind of horror story?
Word is, those Trekkers weren't robbed. The Dusk Arbiters took them. Dragged them off to be tortured as heretics.
And that faceless figure? They say it was someone beautiful, so beautiful the Arbiters flayed their face off... And now, magic forces the corpse to fence their loot.
Now, nobody dares set foot in the Wilds.
That explains why the Monolith is crawling with Stellaroids.
They say the scariest Arbiter on the streets is the one with a hangman's knot around her neck.
Anyone she catches gets stuffed into a box of spikes and has their soul ripped out! No exceptions!
An Arbiter with a hangman's knot around her neck...
That's definitely Gerie! No wonder Noya and the others were freaking out. They must have heard the stories...
But is she really that twisted?
Ah, Trekkers. Might I ask you something?
You spend a lot of time camping out in the Wilds, I assume?
Yet your skin is still so smooth. And your hair? Simply divine.
Right! Look at my split ends.
Ahaha, we're actually super plain-looking! Totally average! Uh, anyway—Noya, Amber, Boss? Let's go scout ahead!
We couldn't possibly make our supervisor do grunt work! We've got this!
Hmm... Why the panic? I only wanted to ask about your skincare routine.

param: Left with no other choice, the New Star Guild takes on a commission supervised by Gerie. Strangely, she seems to have taken a special interest in you...
This is the story of how I first touched her soul...
I'm sorry, but we can only issue a third of the reward for this commission.
You can't be serious! We fought swarms of Stellaroids for that thing. Look, even chipped my blade!
Could you reconsider? Restocking costs half the payout. If we only get a third, we're losing money.
My Soul Stone. Out of Grace.
I know you've all worked hard, but...
... the Artifact is severely damaged. I'm afraid it won't meet the client's standards.
That thing was massive! With two of us hauling it, we couldn't hold off the swarm.
I'm aware. Few Trekkers visited Emor Monolith #25 lately, so the Stellaroids piled up.

strings.text: As the mission unfolds, you learn more about Gerie, yet her suspicion that you are the legendary Tyrant only deepens. Suddenly, a distress signal breaks the silence.
Nice hit, Iris! Leave this group to me.
We breach the Monolith and immediately engage the Stellaroids. I keep my phone out, snapping a pic of every kill for the commission report.
If we keep this up, we'll cover our losses from the last job and next month's rent. But...
That stare gives me the creeps... Isn't she just here to supervise? Why are her eyes locked on me?
Hmm. We've made it to the safe zone here. You have been working so hard.
I brought lunch, and I happen to have extra. Care for a taste?
W-We're good! We have our own!
Uh, right. We need to go over our next move, so we'll leave you to it.
Oh? I was hoping for some lunch company. What a shame.
What's wrong, Boss? You look a little pale.
While you were fighting, she kept giving me those weird looks. She was watching all of us.
I definitely felt eyes on me...
You don't think the rumors are true, do you?
The commission is a bait. She's actually...
... after our souls! She's going to lock us in a spiky iron box to steal them.
That's gotta be it! She lured us into the Monolith so if we vanish, nobody on the outside will ever know.
Boss, watch out. In a chaotic fight, you're the easiest target for a cheap shot.
Watch out for what? The Stellaroids?
Oh! Yep! Yeah, totally! We were saying ==PLAYER_NAME=='s safety comes first! Our No. 1 priority!
Hehe. Don't worry. If things get ugly, I'll step in... I'm here to supervise, sure, but I can hold my own in a fight.
You stepping in is exactly what I'm afraid of!
Weren't you having lunch a second ago? Why are you here?
Glad you mentioned that. You've all been fighting hard—must be worn out. Want to try some of my snacks?
Gerie produces a box of unassuming pastries.
They might not look like much, but I promise they taste better than anything you'd buy in a shop!
Snacks? Out of nowhere? That's sketchy!
Keep it down, Noya! She's gonna hear you.
That's not good...==W== Wait, she doesn't know I'm immune to magic. I'll take the first bite.
These look delicious. Mind if I try one?
Is it... Is it a trap?! Poison?!
Cough... I'm good. Just choked a bit. Texture's actually nice... But it's way too sweet.
Think nothing of it. We Arbiters are accustomed to being misunderstood.
If you're curious, feel free to try some yourselves.
It's spicy!! Hah! Hah—Water!! Get me water!
Ugh—th-this one's bitter...!==W== Why does it have to be like this?!
Weird. The flavor shouldn't be this extreme. Amber, wanna try the yellow one?
Looks ... sour. I don't do sour. Sweet is fine, though.
Guess that leaves the one in my hand.
Uh, I bit that one already.
Oh? Do my pastries taste off? They seemed fine to me.
Uh... Not off, exactly. Just ... extremely intense flavors.
Ah... I see. My apologies. A miscalculation on my part.
I stick to extreme flavors for personal reasons. I made these to suit my own palate. Truly sorry.
Please, don't force yourselves. Wouldn't want you getting sick over a snack.
N-No worries! The spice really kicked my metabolism into gear. I'm itching for a fight now!
Heh. Thanks for being so considerate. Tell you what—I'll clear the Stellaroids on the next floor. You all take a break here.
All by herself... Is that safe?==W== Not that we can really say no.
And she's gone... But Gerie's the supervisor. Should we really let her do all the work?
Mm... Should be fine? If the supervisor makes the call, we shouldn't get in the way.
No, impossible. It's barely been five minutes... Are the Stellaroids ahead too strong even for Arbiter Gerie?
Everyone, I've cleared the floor ahead. Let's keep moving.
No way... All of them... Wiped out!
There were dozens of them back there... And now the place is spotless. Not even a legendary Trekker moves that fast!
Wondering why I hired you when I'm perfectly capable of clearing them myself?
Yeah. Can't exactly take the commission fee in good conscience without knowing why.
Arbiters purge heretics. But Stellaroids are creations of the God of Grace. They aren't targets.
So, culling them is forbidden. However... Helping someone else do it will be a different story.
I've been itching to join in since we entered the Monolith. Just couldn't find an excuse until now.
Hiring Trekkers was for compliance... She wasn't staring us down; she was looking for an opening to talk.==W== We were definitely overthinking.
By the way, the girl with the magic book. You're tracking the kill count, right?
Add my kills to your tally. I want you to get paid for them.
That's not right! We failed our duty by letting the supervisor fight. We can't take credit for your work!
Hmm...==W== Tell you what. Since I'm joining the next fight, consider the extra coin a hush fee. Sound fair?
B-But... No! A Trekker has to be honest!
Such an honest girl. Heresy Score: zero.
Ugh—I know getting a zero is technically good here, but hearing that score hurts my soul somehow...
Too hung up on grades, Iris.
Amber. The sharpshooter. Good kid. Heresy Score: zero.
How about me? Do me next!
Always charging the front line... Another good kid. Heresy Score: zero.
Hmm... Gerie isn't actually that scary. She seems surprisingly nice.
Why did it go up again?! I'm honest too, you know!
Suspecting the snacks and testing them for poison to protect your friends... Just like the legendary Tyrant. Plus ten points~
Sharing your last scrap of food without a second thought... The legendary Tyrant would do the same. Plus ten points~
Surrounding yourself with such talented, good kids... Exactly the company the legendary Tyrant kept. Plus ten points~
Hey! What kind of scoring logic is this?! At this rate, I'm gonna hit 100 any second now!
Boss. Found a phone here. Looks suspicious.
Huh? Is that ... blood? It's bone-dry, though. Looks like it's been there for ages.
Maybe someone just dropped it in the corner while riding the elevator?
If that's the case, wouldn't they come back for it once they realized it was gone?
Phones are a lifeline for Trekkers. They wouldn't just leave it behind, certainly not for a minor injury.
Trekkers have been quite active lately, scouting the area. Shortly after, some of them went missing near Emor. Four or five squads vanished in just two weeks...
Allow me.==W== Hello there. And who might this be?
