strings.text: You successfully take down the scammer Trekker group, while a dangerous tremor shakes the Monolith. Gerie teleports the New Star Guild to safety—except you.
Huff, huff... We've been climbing forever... Where is that Trekker, anyway?
Don't know. But we haven't missed a spot.
If we haven't seen them yet, they gotta be in the Boss's Domain!
Tyrant, your little friends are worried, yet you seem composed. Why is that?
If I answer, let me guess—my score goes up again?
Heheh. Silence itself is an answer.==RT==Very on-brand for the legendary Tyrant.
Sigh... Let's cut the chatter. I'm calm because this feels wrong. You noticed it too, didn't you?
Sharp as ever, Tyrant. There are indeed discrepancies.
Exhibit A: The blood on that phone is ancient, meaning it had been silent for ages, yet it rang the second we found it. A bit too convenient, no?
Exhibit B: If a Trekker dropped it during an attack, where's the mess? No struggle marks, no scattered gear—nothing.
Exhibit C: The Trekkers were ambushed by Stellaroids on previous floors, yet they could sprint all the way to the Boss's Domain unscathed? Please.
Since we're on the same page, why not call them off? It's likely a trap. No need to walk right into the snare.
You're wasting your breath. My guild isn't stupid. They know it smells like a trap. But what if there's a one-percent chance someone does need saving? They'll take that bet.
Oh? Walking into a trap with your eyes wide open... Sounds like plain old recklessness.
Not reckless. It's solidarity. Trekkers look out for their own—we all know how easily it could be us next time.
They saved me once, too. If they hadn't...==W== Well, we wouldn't be having this lovely chat.
Fascinating. I suppose that warrants an update to your Heresy Score. Let's call it seventy points~
Hold up! I just saw through a trap. Why does that raise my score?! And seriously, what is your grading rubric anyway?!
You see through the nature of things with ease. The legendary Tyrant possessed that same sharp insight. Ten points.
It takes a villain to know a villain. You saw through them because you're even more wicked than they are, aren't you?
Fine... Can't argue with that logic. What about the other twenty?
You dread a higher score, yet you still speak up for your friends. Hmm. The legendary Tyrant was also known for righteousness and for facing challenges head-on. Ten points.
You really just make this up as you go... And the last ten?
You walked calmly into a likely trap.==W== That tells me you believe you and your friends can handle anything. The legendary Tyrant possessed that same absolute confidence. Ten points.
With a bodyguard who cleared a whole floor of Stellaroids in five minutes on our side, I figured any trap would be a joke.
Amusing. You've even calculated me into your plans...==W== Not bad. That manipulative streak suits the Tyrant perfectly.
So then—==W==command me as you wish. I'm eager to evaluate your leadership skills.
Gerie, split off and stay hidden. Wait for us to flush the enemy out, then flank them from behind.
Alright,==W== alright~ Hehe, now things are getting interesting.
Boss, we're here. The caller said she's hiding nearby.
Hey! Anyone here? Give us a shout if you can hear me.
Stellaroids?! Does that mean the Trekker who called us is already...
Stay sharp! Stick together and keep ==PLAYER_NAME== in the center!
My Soul Stone. Out of Grace.
Hang in there! It's the last one!
I-It's over... I can no longer lift my sword...
Impressive. You're tougher than you look.
Yeah, fighting them fair and square would've been a hassle.
Are you ... the ones who called for help? Is everyone okay?
Bwahahaha! Would you get a load of this girl?
We aren't waiting for a rescue, moron. We were fishing, and you took the bait. Get it now? Drop the Dorra and your gear. Now do as I say and I might let you live.
You're the ones behind the missing Trekkers, aren't you?
Heh, took you long enough. The last bunch played nice, so we stripped them clean and dumped them in the next city over.
And the rumors about the Dusk Arbiter hunting heretics...==W== You planted those too?
So what? Those guys are secretive creeps anyway. I make up one little lie and everyone gobbles it up.
Hmph. The only hopeless ones here are you naive idiots.
Exploiting people's kindness to rob them? You make me sick!
It's the most efficient way. You've wasted all your Grace on those Stellaroids we lured here, haven't you—==W==huh? What are you staring at?
And there's their confession... Did you catch all that, Gerie?
Gerie... That name rings a bell...
Slandering the Dusk Arbiter. Defiling the God of Grace. Heretics.
Weaponizing Stellaroids. Abusing the God's creations. Heretics.
W-When did she get behind us?!
Don't tell me that's the real Gerie?!
Agh! I can't move! My feet are frozen!
M-Magic?! How are you casting spells?!
You know what they say. Too clever for your own good.
End of the line! Have fun in prison!
You rats ... think you can trap me?! If I'm going down, I'm taking you with me! Activate every array! No one leaves alive!
Hahaha! Those aren't attacks. They're bait to drag every Stellaroid in the Monolith right to us!
You Trekkers, that Arbiter... We all die together!
Heh. Step back, Trekkers. I'll take it from here.
That looks terrifying... Is that ... a coffin?
One of my lovely little toys. Please, step inside.
Getting in a coffin while I'm still breathing? That's asking for bad juju! No way!
Wait! Where's Boss?! Don't tell me...
You talk too much. Your Boss is already tucked in tight.
Don't be scared, Trekkers. I'm just shipping you safely to the elevator.
What comes next ... might be a little too thrilling for your eyes.
Gerie hooks a finger on her noose and yanks hard. Instantly, time inside the Monolith seems to freeze.
A piercing screech erupts,==W== mingling with the screams of humans and Stellaroids alike. It's a scene straight out of a horror Stella Drama.
But the real terror comes when I try to listen in. The strange statue holding me suddenly clicks open on its own...
Oh my. I thought I'd shipped all the nuisances away. Seems one guest just refuses to leave.
To think my summoned torture device couldn't hold you... Boss, you really are the true Tyrant.
I'm immune to magic... Summoned devices don't work on me.
Fair enough. Then allow me to enlighten you... As to why the Dusk Arbiters are back in business.
A Soul Shop filed a report. Said they found a customer with magic immunity.
When someone like that shows up, the legendary apocalypse isn't far behind.
That's why we Arbiters, wielders of relics, are free to walk the earth again.
I'll let you in on another secret. This isn't just a noose. It's a relic: the Soul Rope.
When I tug on it, I burn through a ton of magic. But it lets me get my hands on the souls of everyone nearby.
Then, with a twitch of a finger, I can choke the life out of those fragile little souls.
I can't see your soul at all! Hehe... Heh...
One who's immune to a supreme relic can only be a heretic...==W== A dangerously powerful one.
A mistake? Let me be the judge of that—personally.
We're alone in this Monolith now.
Come on, Tyrant, let me see all of you!

param: You successfully take down the scammer Trekker group, while a dangerous tremor shakes the Monolith. Gerie teleports the New Star Guild to safety—except you.
Huff, huff... We've been climbing forever... Where is that Trekker, anyway?
Don't know. But we haven't missed a spot.
If we haven't seen them yet, they gotta be in the Boss's Domain!
Tyrant, your little friends are worried, yet you seem composed. Why is that?
If I answer, let me guess—my score goes up again?
Heheh. Silence itself is an answer.==RT==Very on-brand for the legendary Tyrant.
Sigh... Let's cut the chatter. I'm calm because this feels wrong. You noticed it too, didn't you?
Sharp as ever, Tyrant. There are indeed discrepancies.
Exhibit A: The blood on that phone is ancient, meaning it had been silent for ages, yet it rang the second we found it. A bit too convenient, no?
Exhibit B: If a Trekker dropped it during an attack, where's the mess? No struggle marks, no scattered gear—nothing.
Exhibit C: The Trekkers were ambushed by Stellaroids on previous floors, yet they could sprint all the way to the Boss's Domain unscathed? Please.
Since we're on the same page, why not call them off? It's likely a trap. No need to walk right into the snare.
You're wasting your breath. My guild isn't stupid. They know it smells like a trap. But what if there's a one-percent chance someone does need saving? They'll take that bet.
Oh? Walking into a trap with your eyes wide open... Sounds like plain old recklessness.
Not reckless. It's solidarity. Trekkers look out for their own—we all know how easily it could be us next time.
They saved me once, too. If they hadn't...==W== Well, we wouldn't be having this lovely chat.
Fascinating. I suppose that warrants an update to your Heresy Score. Let's call it seventy points~
Hold up! I just saw through a trap. Why does that raise my score?! And seriously, what is your grading rubric anyway?!
You see through the nature of things with ease. The legendary Tyrant possessed that same sharp insight. Ten points.
It takes a villain to know a villain. You saw through them because you're even more wicked than they are, aren't you?
Fine... Can't argue with that logic. What about the other twenty?
You dread a higher score, yet you still speak up for your friends. Hmm. The legendary Tyrant was also known for righteousness and for facing challenges head-on. Ten points.
You really just make this up as you go... And the last ten?
You walked calmly into a likely trap.==W== That tells me you believe you and your friends can handle anything. The legendary Tyrant possessed that same absolute confidence. Ten points.
With a bodyguard who cleared a whole floor of Stellaroids in five minutes on our side, I figured any trap would be a joke.
Amusing. You've even calculated me into your plans...==W== Not bad. That manipulative streak suits the Tyrant perfectly.
So then—==W==command me as you wish. I'm eager to evaluate your leadership skills.
Gerie, split off and stay hidden. Wait for us to flush the enemy out, then flank them from behind.
Alright,==W== alright~ Hehe, now things are getting interesting.
Boss, we're here. The caller said she's hiding nearby.
Hey! Anyone here? Give us a shout if you can hear me.
Stellaroids?! Does that mean the Trekker who called us is already...
Stay sharp! Stick together and keep ==PLAYER_NAME== in the center!
My Soul Stone. Out of Grace.
Hang in there! It's the last one!
I-It's over... I can no longer lift my sword...
Impressive. You're tougher than you look.
Yeah, fighting them fair and square would've been a hassle.
Are you ... the ones who called for help? Is everyone okay?
Bwahahaha! Would you get a load of this girl?

strings.text: In the heat of your struggle with Gerie, you catch an accidental glimpse of her past. Exposed and shaken, she has to get you out, along with the others...
We're alone in this Monolith now.
Come on, Tyrant, let me see all of you!
Everything she's done proves she's dangerous! Gotta think fast. If she catches me, I'm done for!
When she pulled that noose, she froze for a split second.
Now, where should I start my judgment?
Gerie! How many times do I have to tell you? Keep that window closed!
But... Mommy, I just wanted to peek outside. You never let me go out to play anymore.
Gerie, please. Don't be mad at your mother. She's only trying to keep you safe.
People are talking. They know you filled that Soul Stone with Grace the other day.
Just hold on a little longer. I've found a Trekker to escort us. We're leaving for another city tonight.
Daddy, why is it bad? Why can't I fill the Soul Stone with Grace?
That girl didn't have any Grace left. I just shared my extra with her.
Gerie, listen... I know you wanted to help. But the God's Grace ... can only be granted by the Grace Imperium.
Good evening. Does Gerie live here?
What do you want? My daughter isn't here! Get out! Get out of my house!
Leave. Now. Don't disturb my family. My daughter isn't a heretic—the rumors are a mistake.
Ma'am, Sir, please calm down. We represent the Sky Institute. We're simply here to inform you that your daughter likely suffers from a rare condition that requires immediate treatment.
Miss... Am I sick? Is it going to cost a lot of money to fix me?
Well, your condition is quite ... complicated.
Then... Can we just not treat it? We don't have much money left...
But you will die. Does that not matter to you?
It's okay. I have a little sister. Even if I die, Mommy and Daddy won't be all alone.
... Don't say that, child. There is one other option.
Would you be willing to serve the God of Grace?
Gerie, you wrecked the target again. Try holding back next time.
Sorry. I ... poured too much magic into it.
Ugh. The Dusk Arbiters's mission is to serve the God of Grace. Quit looking for a fight every single day.
I know about your condition, but we don't need a loose cannon obsessed with violence.
You haven't healed in years because your faith is weak. The God of Grace cannot hear you. Your sins remain.
Forget about fighting. Stay here and pray until sunrise.
Only now does the pain in my body and mind subside. The only time I truly feel alive.
The High Arbiter says ... do not obsess over battle. But fighting is the only thing that brings relief.
Is this a divine revelation? But ... why can't I hear the divine voice?
Maybe... I really am a heretic. A monster in disguise who revels in this savagery.
This has to be Gerie's memory. Even back then, she was...
Am I seeing her memories because I grabbed her noose?
Why... Why won't the Soul Rope work on you?
Don't let go, Tyrant... I feel so light... It feels ... so good...
Huh? What... What did you do to me?!
You... How dare you touch the sacred Soul Rope!
No good. Won't make the elevator... Have to pull once more.
Ahhh! Why can't I ... move... Tyrant... Ahh...
What is ... this feeling? All the magic pent up inside me... It's pouring out. I've never felt ... anything like this...
Her magic's venting out... Is it because I'm touching the Soul Rope?
I'm immune to magic. The rope can't affect me, but keeps trying. It's draining her magic in an endless loop.
If I keep this up... I might actually ... win.
Whoa! Hey... Don't fall on me!
Boss, you're finally awake. We're outside the Monolith.
Gerie? She hauled you out and then took off. Looked totally drained, though...==W== Hope she's okay.
I see... Glad she's alright.==W== Wait, you guys didn't fight her, did you?
She took good care of us.
Yeah! That torture device looked scary, but it was actually padded inside. We just sat back, and next thing we knew, we were out.
She even offered us the bandit bounty before she left. But we turned it down. It didn't feel right taking it when all we did was put on an act.
Boss, you look pale. What exactly happened back there?
I'm still trying to process it myself... Would anyone even believe me if I tried to explain that mess?
No, wait. If those really were Gerie's memories, I definitely shouldn't go spreading them around.
Uh... I'm not totally sure. Basically...==W== Gerie took down all the bad guys and the Stellaroids.
Hey, hey, drop the heavy stuff! Let's talk dinner! We're feasting tonight. As soon as we hit the city, I'm buying the best ingredients they've got and cooking a spread!
Noya, we worked hard for that cash. If you blow it all now, we'll be broke again in no time, you know?
Inside the swaying Lucky Oasis, I look back at the towering Monolith.
Something tells me... My story with her is far from over.
I'm surprised you picked a spot like this. Don't you hate prisons?
I do detest prisons, but I detest leaks even more. Some conversations are ill-suited for the halls of the Grace Imperium.
Fine. You want to know about the Tyrant, don't you?
Before that, explain why you deployed the Soul Rope. Repeatedly.
The Monolith was crawling with Stellaroids. Using the Soul Rope was the only way to clear them out efficiently.
Besides, they're without souls, just chaotic scraps of emotion and desire. Can't exactly violate protocol on something that doesn't exist, right?
Consider this a warning. I won't have that relic devouring anyone else.
Now, your conclusion. Is that individual the Tyrant?
==SEX2== Heresy Score is pathetic. Not even a heretic, let alone the Tyrant. Just a lucky fool with magic insulation who stumbled onto a Seal of Grace.
Very well. I will verify for myself whether ==SEX== is the Tyrant.
One last thing. Do not use the Soul Rope again without my direct order!
Hmph. Meddlesome fool. I'm the only one who can handle this relic. How I use it is my business.
The Tyrant... Fascinating.==W== Your score did spike over a thousand ... but for a split second, I felt it—our souls connected.
What was that sensation...? I can't report what I don't understand. I'll have to scrap the data. The only points that stick are...
Ten points for resisting a superior foe.
Ten points for calmly look for a breakthrough.
Ten points for touching the relic without being consumed.
And since you made my body feel so light... I'll take off a point. Total Heresy Score: ninety-nine.

strings.text: The Missy and the Saucy Maid (Part I)
Unable to refuse Eleanor's fervent invitation, you decide to mentor her on the path of a Trekker. However, she isn't alone—she's accompanied by a rather ... particular maid.
This is the place she's renting? It's huge...
The request says she wants me to personally teach her the basics of Trekker society...==W== There's gotta be someone better suited for this.
Not long ago, a Trekker named Eleanor messaged Boss Accord, specifically requesting me for the commission.
Oh, right! Meeting like this must be fate!
I'm Eleanor! Just a rookie Trekker, still learning the ropes!
That first meeting feels like a lifetime ago. Never thought our paths would cross again.
But given the massive nomination fee and deposit she put up, I couldn't really say no...
Been waiting for you, Mentor! Please come on in! Hurry!
Sorry! I got a little carried away seeing the legend I've admired for so long... Heheh.
Hold on. Isn't it a bit early to call me that...?
Besides, Boss Accord has Trekkers with more experience. Why me?
Because ... you're the Boss! A true leader!
Seeing you lead New Star and Petal Bloom to solve the Three Grand Commissions and save the camp... It really moved me!
And rumor has it... You personally mentored Fuyuka, the current captain of Petal Bloom, didn't you!
You have the leadership and decisiveness I need. That's why I want you to guide my first steps as a Trekker!
You give me too much credit. I'm not that amazing.
We only defeated the Big Three because everyone worked together. If you just want to learn the basics, others would be more well-suited for you...
Humble, cool-headed, always sharing the credit... You're the textbook definition of a perfect Trekker!
I knew my gut was right. You're the only one who can show me the ropes!
Boss—I mean, Mentor! Please, train me hard. I want to become a real Trekker who can stand on her own two feet!
Well, if you're that determined... Maybe a mentor who's still learning offers a fresh perspective. Alright, let's give this a shot.
Thank you! I promise I'll give it 110%!
So ... what's first on the agenda?
Let's get right to it. Show me your gear.==W== Not every commission is dangerous, but a Trekker always needs to be ready to defend themselves.
About that... I've been testing out a bunch of stuff, but nothing's really clicked yet.
Like these smoke bombs I picked up... They told me every pro uses them. Total bestsellers!
Sounds handy. How do you plan to use them?
Let's see... Maybe for making a quick getaway?==W== I just toss it like...
<size=50>Cough—cough!</size> You can't just toss it without looking! Ugh, this smoke... My eyes are stinging!
I-I'm so sorry!! I didn't mean to...
Mentor, I really am sorry...==W== But check out this mini-bomb! It's gotta pack more of a punch than that smoke bomb!
I think that smoke bomb had plenty of punch already...==W== Hmm?
That's not a bomb. That's a firecracker.
Loongs use those for celebration, not combat.
Eh?! Seriously? Why didn't my landlord mention that...?
Yeah, the owner of this house. She used to run a guild here before she retired. Sold me all her leftover gear on the cheap.
I see... Out of curiosity, what's the rent like?
Five hundred thousand Dorra a month.
Five hundred thousand?! That's highway robbery. No rookie could possibly afford that.
Since the landlord's an ex-Trekker, she should be well aware of the market rate. First firecrackers as "mini-bombs," now this...
I-I thought that was normal pricing...
Normal? Doesn't 500k a month sound insane to you?
M-Maybe?==RT==I can manage ... though barely. My allowance savings cover it.
Oh! I forgot the intros. Mentor, this is Nanoha. I hired her as my maid.
I want to focus fully on my Trekker prep,==W== so I'm leaving the housework to her.
Hiring a maid to focus... We live in different worlds...==W== Hm? What's that sound?
The doorbell. I shall answer it.
Mentor, did I actually get scammed?
Hard to say for sure ... but honestly? It's likely.
Excuse me. Miss, the landlord is here to see you.
Perfect timing! Send her to the second floor.==W== Mentor, I'm getting to the bottom of this!
Wait, Eleanor?! What are you gonna—
Nanoha, keep Mentor company for me!
And she's gone...==W== Uh, mind if I call you "Nanoha"?
Certainly. I am Nanoha from Goodwind Homecare. If I may ask, are you Boss Accord's CEO, ==SEX7== ==PLAYER_NAME==?
I'm surprised a civilian outside the Trekker circle knows my name...
The honor is mine. Your exploits are well known, even at Goodwind Homecare.
Nanoha offers a respectful bow. Her movements are flawless,==RT==hinting at a discipline far beyond a typical maid's.
Goodwind Homecare...==W== Can't say I've heard of it.
I assume you provide domestic services?
Precisely. Cleaning, cooking, gardening... We accept commissions for anything the client requires.
So, what's the rate for a maid of your caliber?
F-Five hundred thousand?!==W== Does Eleanor spend over a million a month just to live here...?
No. Five hundred thousand is not the monthly fee. It is our hourly rate.
Eight hours a day... That's four million Dorra?! Iris would pass out cold if she heard that.
Is she actually the daughter of some mega-tycoon...?
I am not at liberty to disclose client details.
However, my presence proves the client can afford our rates.
Once a request is accepted, we dedicate ourselves fully to providing the finest service. That justifies the premium.
Should you ever require our services, ==SEX7== ==PLAYER_NAME==, please notify us in advance.
Got it. So this is strictly a luxury service for the wealthy.
You said no matter the request... Does that mean you handle jobs other than cleaning?
Precisely. Whether it's cleaning, cooking, or weeding, we can handle any task our clients need assistance with.
Do you have a commission in mind?
Oh, no, just asking. My pockets definitely aren't deep enough for your rates, haha...
Anyway, wonder how Eleanor's holding up...
What's the big idea? It's rude to point sharp objects at people, you know.
Don't put this on me. I'm here to discuss the rent hike—why make me out to be the bad guy?
And your justification? I'm already paying way above market rate! Also, care to explain why those "mini-bombs" you sold me were actually firecrackers?
Just shut your trap and pay up like always! Quit stalling!
Be a good girl and hand over the cash. Sign the contract, or things get ugly.
I'm her mentor. And I won't stand by while scum like you shake down a fellow Trekker.
Here's the deal: refund her money, or the Imperial Guard settles this.
Tch, fine. She gets the cash. Just keep the Guard out of it.
Yeah, you bet! Girls, Plan B!
Too bad, you're out of options. Once that contract's signed, there's no escape!
It took a second to sink in—Eleanor and I are trapped in the second-floor parlor.

param: The Missy and the Saucy Maid (Part I)
Unable to refuse Eleanor's fervent invitation, you decide to mentor her on the path of a Trekker. However, she isn't alone—she's accompanied by a rather ... particular maid.
This is the place she's renting? It's huge...
The request says she wants me to personally teach her the basics of Trekker society...==W== There's gotta be someone better suited for this.
Not long ago, a Trekker named Eleanor messaged Boss Accord, specifically requesting me for the commission.
Oh, right! Meeting like this must be fate!
I'm Eleanor! Just a rookie Trekker, still learning the ropes!
That first meeting feels like a lifetime ago. Never thought our paths would cross again.
But given the massive nomination fee and deposit she put up, I couldn't really say no...
Been waiting for you, Mentor! Please come on in! Hurry!
Sorry! I got a little carried away seeing the legend I've admired for so long... Heheh.
Hold on. Isn't it a bit early to call me that...?
Besides, Boss Accord has Trekkers with more experience. Why me?
Because ... you're the Boss! A true leader!
Seeing you lead New Star and Petal Bloom to solve the Three Grand Commissions and save the camp... It really moved me!
And rumor has it... You personally mentored Fuyuka, the current captain of Petal Bloom, didn't you!
You have the leadership and decisiveness I need. That's why I want you to guide my first steps as a Trekker!
You give me too much credit. I'm not that amazing.
We only defeated the Big Three because everyone worked together. If you just want to learn the basics, others would be more well-suited for you...
Humble, cool-headed, always sharing the credit... You're the textbook definition of a perfect Trekker!
I knew my gut was right. You're the only one who can show me the ropes!
Boss—I mean, Mentor! Please, train me hard. I want to become a real Trekker who can stand on her own two feet!
Well, if you're that determined... Maybe a mentor who's still learning offers a fresh perspective. Alright, let's give this a shot.
Thank you! I promise I'll give it 110%!
So ... what's first on the agenda?
Let's get right to it. Show me your gear.==W== Not every commission is dangerous, but a Trekker always needs to be ready to defend themselves.
About that... I've been testing out a bunch of stuff, but nothing's really clicked yet.
Like these smoke bombs I picked up... They told me every pro uses them. Total bestsellers!
Sounds handy. How do you plan to use them?
Let's see... Maybe for making a quick getaway?==W== I just toss it like...
<size=50>Cough—cough!</size> You can't just toss it without looking! Ugh, this smoke... My eyes are stinging!
I-I'm so sorry!! I didn't mean to...
Mentor, I really am sorry...==W== But check out this mini-bomb! It's gotta pack more of a punch than that smoke bomb!
I think that smoke bomb had plenty of punch already...==W== Hmm?
That's not a bomb. That's a firecracker.
Loongs use those for celebration, not combat.
Eh?! Seriously? Why didn't my landlord mention that...?
Yeah, the owner of this house. She used to run a guild here before she retired. Sold me all her leftover gear on the cheap.
I see... Out of curiosity, what's the rent like?
Five hundred thousand Dorra a month.
Five hundred thousand?! That's highway robbery. No rookie could possibly afford that.
Since the landlord's an ex-Trekker, she should be well aware of the market rate. First firecrackers as "mini-bombs," now this...
I-I thought that was normal pricing...
Normal? Doesn't 500k a month sound insane to you?
M-Maybe?==RT==I can manage ... though barely. My allowance savings cover it.
Oh! I forgot the intros. Mentor, this is Nanoha. I hired her as my maid.
I want to focus fully on my Trekker prep,==W== so I'm leaving the housework to her.
Hiring a maid to focus... We live in different worlds...==W== Hm? What's that sound?
The doorbell. I shall answer it.
Mentor, did I actually get scammed?
Hard to say for sure ... but honestly? It's likely.
Excuse me. Miss, the landlord is here to see you.
Perfect timing! Send her to the second floor.==W== Mentor, I'm getting to the bottom of this!
Wait, Eleanor?! What are you gonna—
Nanoha, keep Mentor company for me!
And she's gone...==W== Uh, mind if I call you "Nanoha"?
Certainly. I am Nanoha from Goodwind Homecare. If I may ask, are you Boss Accord's CEO, ==SEX7== ==PLAYER_NAME==?
I'm surprised a civilian outside the Trekker circle knows my name...
The honor is mine. Your exploits are well known, even at Goodwind Homecare.
Nanoha offers a respectful bow. Her movements are flawless,==RT==hinting at a discipline far beyond a typical maid's.
Goodwind Homecare...==W== Can't say I've heard of it.
I assume you provide domestic services?
Precisely. Cleaning, cooking, gardening... We accept commissions for anything the client requires.
So, what's the rate for a maid of your caliber?
F-Five hundred thousand?!==W== Does Eleanor spend over a million a month just to live here...?
No. Five hundred thousand is not the monthly fee. It is our hourly rate.
Eight hours a day... That's four million Dorra?! Iris would pass out cold if she heard that.
Is she actually the daughter of some mega-tycoon...?
I am not at liberty to disclose client details.
However, my presence proves the client can afford our rates.
Once a request is accepted, we dedicate ourselves fully to providing the finest service. That justifies the premium.
Should you ever require our services, ==SEX7== ==PLAYER_NAME==, please notify us in advance.
Got it. So this is strictly a luxury service for the wealthy.
You said no matter the request... Does that mean you handle jobs other than cleaning?
Precisely. Whether it's cleaning, cooking, or weeding, we can handle any task our clients need assistance with.
Do you have a commission in mind?
Oh, no, just asking. My pockets definitely aren't deep enough for your rates, haha...
Anyway, wonder how Eleanor's holding up...
What's the big idea? It's rude to point sharp objects at people, you know.
Don't put this on me. I'm here to discuss the rent hike—why make me out to be the bad guy?
And your justification? I'm already paying way above market rate! Also, care to explain why those "mini-bombs" you sold me were actually firecrackers?
Just shut your trap and pay up like always! Quit stalling!
Be a good girl and hand over the cash. Sign the contract, or things get ugly.
I'm her mentor. And I won't stand by while scum like you shake down a fellow Trekker.
Here's the deal: refund her money, or the Imperial Guard settles this.
Tch, fine. She gets the cash. Just keep the Guard out of it.
Yeah, you bet! Girls, Plan B!
Too bad, you're out of options. Once that contract's signed, there's no escape!
It took a second to sink in—Eleanor and I are trapped in the second-floor parlor.

strings.text: The Missy and the Saucy Maid (Part II)
Accidentally caught up in a kidnapping with a junior?! Don't give up—you can definitely escape.
I've slammed against this door a dozen times, but it won't budge.==W== Eleanor, any luck?
No use. The windows are sealed shut. I can't even smash the glass.
Must be some kind of locking mechanism. We're in trouble...
Hahaha! Give it up! You're never getting out of this house!
This has always been our turf! Good thing we kept those intruder traps active.
Can't believe we hooked a rich little princess from the Gold District! Hahaha!
I was planning to squeeze more cash out of her, but now...==W== We'll just hold her family to ransom.
Heheh. Now, how much should we ask for?
Blame yourself! Naive little brat, you seriously underestimated what the Trekker life is about.
... Hah... I'm so ridiculously gullible. Maybe I'm just not cut out to be a Trekker...
It's not your fault. I don't know you well enough yet, but I do know one thing...
A bunch of thugs doesn't get to decide your path in life.
Truth is, I don't have much more experience as a Trekker than you do. But here's what I do know:
To be a Trekker is to be freer than anyone else.
Following your gut, adventuring without chains... That describes every Trekker I've ever met.
If you want to be the real deal, ignore them. Stick to the reason you started this journey in the first place.
Actually ... this isn't the first time I've got myself into a mess like this.==W== I got kidnapped once as a kid. They held me for a huge ransom then, too.
Our head maid stepped in and saved me just in time.==W== Turns out, she used to be a Trekker.
A retired Trekker... Is she the reason you wanted to become one?
Yeah. Since that day, I swore I'd grow up to be just like her—==W==a cool, capable adult who protects others.
I see. Then we definitely can't sit around waiting to be rescued, can we?
You're absolutely right, Mentor! Let's find a way out of here together!
My guild is inside the Monolith, so they're out of reach. We need another angle...
Mentor, may I show you what's in my suitcase?
I've also got a bunch of props I collected back in the day…
Maybe some of them might actually come in handy!
Sure, let's see what you've got...
I bought some from retired Trekkers, snagged others at auctions...==W== Basically, this is the result! W-Well? What do you think?
Yeah... It's way more than I expected.
You've been hauling an entire arsenal around with you this whole time?
Arsenal? Wait, you can use these as weapons?
I just knew I had to buy 'em. No clue how to actually use any of it... Hehe.
I-I see...==W== An arms dealer would have a field day with this stash.
This case is packed tight. Isn't it heavy?
It's heavy, sure. It was a struggle at first, but I kinda just got used to it. I bring this case on every commission, after all.
I bet for a battle-hardened Trekker, this weight is just a warm-up...==W== I've got to toughen up!
...==W== I really did land myself a promising junior.
Well, with a haul this big, something's gotta be useful.
Some of these are too loud. Wouldn't want to alert the gang downstairs.
This blade is too big for the keyhole...==W== Wait, got it!
This one might just do the trick...
You actually picked it...! You're amazing, Mentor!
Right outside... We got lucky. She didn't notice the lock.
Hey. Where's that maid? You didn't lose her, did you?
In the other room. Door's locked tight.
Good. Remember: no one gets out to raise the alarm. We only need the rich girl. If the others try anything funny... Don't hold back.
Ugh...! Those people...==W== I dragged Nanoha into this...
Stay calm. We'll figure this out.
S-Sorry. Lost my cool for a second.
Situation's tight, sure, but we will get Nanoha back. Don't worry.
She's probably locked downstairs. We just need to find a way in...
Mentor, wait. I just realized something. They said they only need the rich girl... Right?
That means they won't hurt me. Not easily, anyway.
You want to be the bait?
Yes. I'll draw them away. Mentor, you use that commotion to save Nanoha. Is that okay?
I... I know it's dangerous. But this whole mess started because of me...
I can't just stand by while Nanoha's in danger.
If I'm serious about my dream, I can't be a coward.
Understood. Let's do it your way.
But promise me one thing: don't be reckless.
If things get dangerous, your safety comes first. Okay?
Hmm... Oh, right. If you run into trouble, just use whatever weapons you have on you.
Like this one. Even you should be able to handle it.
As for when to use it...
I see! So that's the brilliant strategy of the Boss!
Perfect. Eleanor lured the guards away. Now's my chance...
They're all down... Did you do this, Nanoha?
I had a feeling you weren't just an ordinary maid. I just never expected you ... to be this skilled.
But this actually makes things a lot easier.
Nanoha, let's get out of here.
You ... aren't going to ask for an explanation?
Besides, we're practically strangers. You could have run... Why come back for me?
Because I can't abandon innocent people. And right now, whoever you really are, we're fighting the same enemy.
So, how about we team up? You in?
You certainly have a way with words...==W== I'll cooperate. But please, not a word to Miss Eleanor.
I can't reveal my methods to a client. It's ...==W== against protocol. Please understand.
You little brat! Made us work for that one!
Damn it, they have Eleanor! Go, now!
I promise I won't run! Just trust me—!
Sure thing. Once I snap your legs, I'll trust you plenty!
Cough! Cough! My eyes! They're burning!
Cough... The girl! She's getting away!
Cap, trouble! We can't see a damn thing!==W== Achoo—!
Cap? Where are you, Cap...==W==<size=50> Gwah!
Hmph. You guys started this. Don't blame us for playing dirty.
Surprise! Your hostage was a bomb...==W== Well, a smoke bomb, technically.

strings.text: The Missy and the Saucy Maid (Part III)
The maid has dropped her act, and the farce finally comes to an end. Eleanor has resolved to grow strong in her own way—and sooner or later, your paths will cross again.
Eleanor, Nanoha, keep moving! Don't stop!
We just need to break out and we're clear!
Then we alert the Imperial Guard and—==W==hold it!
Tsk. More enemies out front? A pincer attack... That's low.
Think you're the only one with backup? Naive!
I told you. No one is getting out of here!
Out of smoke bombs, and Nanoha can't blow her cover here. What now...
<size=50>We only want the girl. The rest of you... Die!
It's me you're after, right? Then come and get me!
I, Eleanor the Trekker, will take you all on!
This pile's full of weapons—one of 'em has to work! Who cares if I don't know how to use it? I'll figure it out on the fly!
If I break it, whatever! I'll pay to fix it later!
If you don't wanna get hurt, move! Now!
Hold up, what is she holding?! Is that a Magic Missile Launcher?! You know... The cannon thing?!
Eleanor, wait! Don't blow yourself up!
She's firing that thing indoors?! What kind of mentor are you?!
Hmph... Heh, scared now, aren't you?
Dammit! Forget this, let's just go—==W==gah!
It's Nanoha! Eleanor's fussing with the weapon kept everyone distracted, giving her the perfect opening to strike.
Now I just need to add a little more chaos to the mix!
Wait, aren't those just the firecrackers we sold her...?!==W==<size=50> Gahhh!
Clean work. Goodwind Homecare... They're certainly no ordinary maids.
Huff... Huff... I—I'm fine.==W== What about Miss Nanoha?
Please, do not concern yourself with me.
Oh, thank goodness! You're safe too... Phew...
Mentor, that was amazing! I was busy fumbling with the weapon, but when I looked back, you'd already taken them all down!
Actually, I can't take the credit—
—not alone, anyway. The real credit goes to you, Eleanor. You drew the guards away from the entrance, allowing us to focus on the rest.
We couldn't have won without you!
Stepping up in a crisis like that, wielding weapons you've never used before...
That took guts. And courage is the most vital asset a Trekker can have.
I'm genuinely impressed. Thank you, Eleanor.
Hehe... Stop it, Mentor, you're making me blush...==W== Ah, Nanoha, let me see your hand.
Oh no, you're bleeding! We need to bandage this up, right now!
It is merely a scratch. Please do not worry. I will handle it myself.
No way! What if it gets infected? I'm going to find a doctor!
Eleanor, hold on! Don't go running off alone—
Wasn't she nearly kidnapped five minutes ago? Not much survival instinct in this one.
Miss Eleanor puts others far above herself.
Yeah. She's got a good heart.
I must also thank you for your assistance in battle.
Thanks to you, my assessment of Miss Eleanor is nearly complete.
Are you saying her hiring you ... wasn't a coincidence?
It was a coincidence. My skills aren't in housekeeping, and my rates are high... People wanting a normal maid don't ask for me.
But Miss Eleanor insisted. That made Goodwind suspicious, so I was assigned to vet her.
With your skills, you could've easily escaped. You stayed on purpose.
Sharp. I actually detected the traps in that house.
I simply didn't know who set them. That is what I was covertly investigating...
If I'd foreseen this, I would have removed those early to spare Miss Eleanor the fright.
Well, at least you've confirmed Eleanor isn't a threat to you.
Correct. Miss Eleanor genuinely just wanted help with her chores. I am certain now. She is truly just a kind, naive young lady who knows nothing of the underworld.
Speaking of "naive," you're not much different yourself. Staying alone with a suspicious maid, completely unguarded... Isn't that a bit careless?
What if I were a ruthless assassin who'd been targeting you all along... What would you do then?
If that were the case, you would've made your move in that chaos back there.
But you chose to help us instead. So, I'm betting on you being an ally.
Heh. You certainly have an open mind.
The operation went smoothly under your command. Just as expected from Boss Accord's CEO.
I just did what had to be done.
Boss, here is my card. Please accept it.
If you ever require my services, please feel free to reach out.
Thanks... But I definitely can't afford 500k Dorra an hour...
Please, rest assured. That price was tailored specifically for Miss Eleanor.
I know I said Goodwind Homecare accepts any task, but in reality, we screen every commission thoroughly beforehand.
So you pretend to be open to anything, but actually cherry-pick behind the scenes.
When you can't refuse a request, you quote an astronomical price to scare them off without causing offense... Clever strategy.
Every organization does the same when faced with unsuitable or impossible requests, don't they?
Fair point. So, by giving me this card, are you saying you're willing to accept my commissions?
Correct. No need to hide anything from you now.==W== Besides, kindness must be repaid. That is my code.
We just met, yet you jumped in to save me without hesitating—and you kept my secret.
So if you ever need anything, call me... Call Goodwind, I mean.
If I'm ever in a pinch, I'll send a request. I'm counting on you then, Nanoha.
Well, my work here is done, so I'll be going. Please say goodbye to Miss Eleanor for me.
Ah, right. Could you pass a message to her as well? It might help her out.
Men—tor! Sorry for the wait! The doctor is almost here!
She said she's fine. Didn't want to be a burden, so she went on ahead.
Yeah. Even I could tell it's just a scratch. It'll heal in no time.
Alright... If you say so, Mentor. I won't worry.
My family found out about the kidnapping...
Already? How'd they find out so fast?
They've kept me on a tight leash ever since I was taken as a kid...==W== Truth is, I had to sneak out this time.
They'd already alerted the Imperial Guard. As soon as I went to file a report, they caught me...
I worked so hard to finally become a Trekker... Is it all about to end like this?
Think you'd have a shot if you stopped running away and actually talked to them?
Doubt it... I'll be lucky if they let me leave the house at all, let alone get my own place.
I thought if I could prove I was a capable Trekker who could handle things myself, I could convince them...
But now... That goal feels a million miles away.
Nanoha actually asked me to pass a message to you.
My master once showed me a dazzling technique. She constantly switched weapons, her attacks flexible and unpredictable.
Miss Eleanor need not limit herself to a single weapon. She could try mixing different combat styles to bewilder her opponents.
The financial means to amass such an arsenal is, after all, one of her greatest strengths. Do you not agree?
Nanoha mentioned she'd seen a fighting style used by a powerful Trekker that would suit you perfectly. I had my doubts at first.
But now I'm certain: Eleanor, you have a gift for this.
So don't write yourself off yet. A Trekker is defined by their freedom—and their limitless potential.
Freedom is a state of mind, Eleanor. It isn't defined by where you are. Think about it...==W== Since you can't leave the house, why not hone your skills at home?
Study Artifacts, draft tactics, and learn the trade inside out. Show your family how much you've grown. Prove to them that you're ready to stand on your own in this world.
Sniff... I… Mentor, I... I really don't want to give up!
Then don't. The junior I know is a force of nature, isn't she?
Just be yourself. Keep your eyes on the prize and run toward it—full speed ahead.
Alright. Since you've made up your mind, I'm leaving you with a little homework.
We'll start with weapon safety protocols...==W== Actually, scratch that. For you, the first lesson needs to be "Commoner Economics 101"...
Ahaha... That sounds complicated... But I'll do my best!
For my freedom ... and so that one day, I can come see you again, Mentor!
And so, amidst laughter and lighthearted banter,==RT==our impromptu lesson comes to a close.
This isn't goodbye forever. I'm not giving up that easily!
I'm going to become an amazing Trekker, and when I am, I'll come back for you! Just you wait, Mentor!

Clean work. Goodwind Homecare... They're certainly no ordinary maids.
Huff... Huff... I—I'm fine.==W== What about Miss Nanoha?
Please, do not concern yourself with me.
Oh, thank goodness! You're safe too... Phew...
Mentor, that was amazing! I was busy fumbling with the weapon, but when I looked back, you'd already taken them all down!
Actually, I can't take the credit—
—not alone, anyway. The real credit goes to you, Eleanor. You drew the guards away from the entrance, allowing us to focus on the rest.
We couldn't have won without you!
Stepping up in a crisis like that, wielding weapons you've never used before...
That took guts. And courage is the most vital asset a Trekker can have.
I'm genuinely impressed. Thank you, Eleanor.
Hehe... Stop it, Mentor, you're making me blush...==W== Ah, Nanoha, let me see your hand.
Oh no, you're bleeding! We need to bandage this up, right now!
It is merely a scratch. Please do not worry. I will handle it myself.
No way! What if it gets infected? I'm going to find a doctor!
Eleanor, hold on! Don't go running off alone—
Wasn't she nearly kidnapped five minutes ago? Not much survival instinct in this one.
Miss Eleanor puts others far above herself.
Yeah. She's got a good heart.
I must also thank you for your assistance in battle.
Thanks to you, my assessment of Miss Eleanor is nearly complete.
Are you saying her hiring you ... wasn't a coincidence?
It was a coincidence. My skills aren't in housekeeping, and my rates are high... People wanting a normal maid don't ask for me.
But Miss Eleanor insisted. That made Goodwind suspicious, so I was assigned to vet her.
With your skills, you could've easily escaped. You stayed on purpose.
Sharp. I actually detected the traps in that house.
I simply didn't know who set them. That is what I was covertly investigating...
If I'd foreseen this, I would have removed those early to spare Miss Eleanor the fright.
Well, at least you've confirmed Eleanor isn't a threat to you.
Correct. Miss Eleanor genuinely just wanted help with her chores. I am certain now. She is truly just a kind, naive young lady who knows nothing of the underworld.
Speaking of "naive," you're not much different yourself. Staying alone with a suspicious maid, completely unguarded... Isn't that a bit careless?
What if I were a ruthless assassin who'd been targeting you all along... What would you do then?
If that were the case, you would've made your move in that chaos back there.
But you chose to help us instead. So, I'm betting on you being an ally.
Heh. You certainly have an open mind.
The operation went smoothly under your command. Just as expected from Boss Accord's CEO.
I just did what had to be done.
Boss, here is my card. Please accept it.
If you ever require my services, please feel free to reach out.
Thanks... But I definitely can't afford 500k Dorra an hour...
Please, rest assured. That price was tailored specifically for Miss Eleanor.
I know I said Goodwind Homecare accepts any task, but in reality, we screen every commission thoroughly beforehand.
So you pretend to be open to anything, but actually cherry-pick behind the scenes.
When you can't refuse a request, you quote an astronomical price to scare them off without causing offense... Clever strategy.
Every organization does the same when faced with unsuitable or impossible requests, don't they?
Fair point. So, by giving me this card, are you saying you're willing to accept my commissions?
Correct. No need to hide anything from you now.==W== Besides, kindness must be repaid. That is my code.
We just met, yet you jumped in to save me without hesitating—and you kept my secret.
So if you ever need anything, call me... Call Goodwind, I mean.
If I'm ever in a pinch, I'll send a request. I'm counting on you then, Nanoha.
Well, my work here is done, so I'll be going. Please say goodbye to Miss Eleanor for me.
Ah, right. Could you pass a message to her as well? It might help her out.
Men—tor! Sorry for the wait! The doctor is almost here!
She said she's fine. Didn't want to be a burden, so she went on ahead.
Yeah. Even I could tell it's just a scratch. It'll heal in no time.
Alright... If you say so, Mentor. I won't worry.
My family found out about the kidnapping...
Already? How'd they find out so fast?
They've kept me on a tight leash ever since I was taken as a kid...==W== Truth is, I had to sneak out this time.
They'd already alerted the Imperial Guard. As soon as I went to file a report, they caught me...
I worked so hard to finally become a Trekker... Is it all about to end like this?
Think you'd have a shot if you stopped running away and actually talked to them?
Doubt it... I'll be lucky if they let me leave the house at all, let alone get my own place.
I thought if I could prove I was a capable Trekker who could handle things myself, I could convince them...
But now... That goal feels a million miles away.
Nanoha actually asked me to pass a message to you.
My master once showed me a dazzling technique. She constantly switched weapons, her attacks flexible and unpredictable.
Miss Eleanor need not limit herself to a single weapon. She could try mixing different combat styles to bewilder her opponents.
The financial means to amass such an arsenal is, after all, one of her greatest strengths. Do you not agree?
Nanoha mentioned she'd seen a fighting style used by a powerful Trekker that would suit you perfectly. I had my doubts at first.
But now I'm certain: Eleanor, you have a gift for this.
So don't write yourself off yet. A Trekker is defined by their freedom—and their limitless potential.
Freedom is a state of mind, Eleanor. It isn't defined by where you are. Think about it...==W== Since you can't leave the house, why not hone your skills at home?
Study Artifacts, draft tactics, and learn the trade inside out. Show your family how much you've grown. Prove to them that you're ready to stand on your own in this world.
Sniff... I… Mentor, I... I really don't want to give up!
Then don't. The junior I know is a force of nature, isn't she?
Just be yourself. Keep your eyes on the prize and run toward it—full speed ahead.
Alright. Since you've made up your mind, I'm leaving you with a little homework.
We'll start with weapon safety protocols...==W== Actually, scratch that. For you, the first lesson needs to be "Commoner Economics 101"...
Ahaha... That sounds complicated... But I'll do my best!
For my freedom ... and so that one day, I can come see you again, Mentor!
And so, amidst laughter and lighthearted banter,==RT==our impromptu lesson comes to a close.
This isn't goodbye forever. I'm not giving up that easily!
I'm going to become an amazing Trekker, and when I am, I'll come back for you! Just you wait, Mentor!

strings.text: To raise living expenses in Emor over the next few days, Caramel goes to the nearby Monolith to make wishes. While taking a break along the way, she encounters something strange...
W-Where am I...? Have I already made it to Emor?
Whoa! Your knee is bleeding! And your arm's all scraped up too. Do you need a doctor?
Ow...! When did I get this banged up...?
You didn't even notice?! You should go see a doctor right away!
Yeah, we'll take you to see Dr. Igna!
Miss, can you still walk? Do you want me to help you?
Thanks... I'm okay. I can still move, more or less.
Really?! Then over here! Just follow us!
Hello, how may I help you?
Dr. Igna! She's hurt all over! Can you take a look at her?
Hmm... Knees, arms, calves... You really do have cuts and scrapes everywhere.==W== What's your name?
Alright, Miss Caramel. Please have a seat in that chair over there. We'll start by disinfecting the wounds.
You weren't careful, right? Dr. Igna always tells us to watch our step when we run around.
You, of all people! Name one kid who trips more than you do in the entire Ash District.==W== We'll be going now, Miss. Take care!
Yeah, thank you both! Be safe out there~
This might sting a little. Please bear with it.
Okay. Um, I'll do my best, so please... Be gentle—
—There, all bandaged up. It's not serious. No damage to the bone. Don't let the wounds get wet for the next three days.
Most of them are just scrapes. Did you fall repeatedly? Carrying an instrument like that, you really need to watch your step.
My instrument... Right! Midas! Is my Midas OK?!
... Thank goodness. Looks like Midas didn't get damaged...
This little guy right here. Ever since I got it from a Wish, I've been using it to play Monolith's Notes...
Yeah! I can hear them. I'm not making this up. There's this sound that echoes through the rooms of the Monolith, over and over...
People say it's rare for someone to be able to hear it that clearly...==W== But I can.
How long has this been going on? Have you seen a doctor about this?
No, really—I can hear it. Before coming to Emor today, I even made a detour for a climb... Huh?
Something's wrong... Why did I go into the Monolith again? I—I can't remember anything. I didn't even make a Wish today...
Caramel's fingers brushed across the bass without thinking, pulling out a low, heavy note.
Yes! That's the sound! That's how I was playing in the Monolith...
No... My sound... Isn't like this...
Haha! Thanks to Miss Caramel's playing, this boring trip finally got a lot more interesting!
Tell me about it! Miss Caramel, do you have any plans to perform at Emor's Grand Theater?
The Grand Theater? No way! A venue that big—I'm just a street performer, I wouldn't even dare think about it!
You absolutely could! When the time comes, you have to let us know. We'll definitely show up to support you!
Your music is awesome, you are awesome. If you just put your mind to it, you'll get there in no time!
Yeah! We'll be rooting for you all the way! We're already your fans!
Hehe, thank you everyone <size=60>♪<size=38> I'll do my best!
I'm taking the right at the fork up ahead. You two, maybe we'll meet again!
Hm? Isn't Emor City in the opposite direction? Where are you heading?
I heard that Emor ... isn't friendly on your wallet...! So I'll be making a Monolith trip first <size=60>♪<size=37>
Ah... Yeah, prices there are pretty steep.
But a bassist as talented as you, Miss Caramel—do you really have to worry about money?
If you just play a few songs on the street, those Scarlet Sights agents would come rushing over, wouldn't they?
Ahaha, you're giving me way too much credit. And I'm not climbing just for Artifacts.
Do you want to team up then? There's no telling what might happen inside the Monolith. Better safe than sorry!
Appreciate the offer, but I'm good! Besides, you all have your own plans too, right...?
I'm used to climbing Monoliths by myself. Don't worry about me <size=60>♪<size=37>
Alright then, please be careful, Miss Caramel! We'll be waiting for the day you hold a concert in Emor!
Phew...==W== That should be the last one. Let's take a break for now. Hopefully the Wishing Box isn't too far ahead...
Come to think of it, it's a bit too quiet here today, isn't it...?==W== The convenience store staff and the nurse lady aren't here, either.
And I can't even hear the Monolith's sound... That's never happened before, has it?
If I play Midas, will the Monolith respond?
... Yeah. I could use a break anyway, so might as well play a bit and relax!
Huh? I thought I heard something just now...
Forget it. I probably imagined it. I should have already cleared out every Stellaroid on this floor...
No point dwelling on it. I need to focus on playing. Maybe the Monolith will answer me...
Ah... I can hear the Monolith now. That's it—layer the tangled emotions together, let them resonate, and shape them into a melody...
I want to hear more of this...
Alright! That duet just now was perfect—
Huh? W-Where am I? On a stage? Wasn't I inside the Monolith...?
Caramel's music is heavenly. I could listen to it forever.
I knew she'd make it big!
Am I dreaming? This many people actually want to hear me play...?
No. Dream or not, it doesn't matter! What I need to do right now is give them the best performance I can!
Huh? This isn't really the reaction I was expecting... That song's usually pretty popular...
My performance should have been perfect. Why does everyone look so upset?
So that's what her music sounds like?
This isn't doing it for me at all. You can't get hyped to music like this. Play something more intense!
What a letdown. This is the most boring show I've ever been to.
Stop playing this soft stuff. We want the kind of music you used to play! The exciting kind!
<color=#d580ff>Boring... Soft...? What are they talking about?==RT==This has always been my style, hasn't it?
I-I can't! Even if that's what you want, I can't play that kind of sound...!
<color=#d580ff>Huh? What's going on...? My fingers—they're moving on their own!?
Haha, so you were just messing with us before! That's our Caramel! You're the best! Caramel—!
<color=#d580ff>No! What is this...? This isn't my music at all!
<color=#d580ff>Stop! I don't want to play this kind of music... But my fingers just keep moving on their own...!
<color=#d580ff>I can't even make a sound... What's happening to me?!
<color=#d580ff><size=50>Please... if this is a dream, then wake me up already! End this concert already!!

strings.text: In the illusory realm, Caramel seems to glimpse someone's past memories, but just as she is about to uncover the truth behind the Notes of the Monolith…
Miss Caramel, your performance today was amazing as usual. The survey results are in—they loved it!
Though that bit of improvisation in the middle had me on edge,==W== the rest was exactly what we expect from you! You were guiding the audience's emotional flow, weren't you?
No, that wasn't improvisation! That was... Me!
<color=#d580ff>It's happening again... Every time I try to tell the truth, I suddenly can't get the words out...
Ahaha, got it, got it. Just a little playful twist to spice up the show, right?
But if you push that kind of thing too far, you'll lose fans. People aren't paying for ... that.
Please keep creating music that people want to hear and love. After all, you're the new star guitarist that Flavio has been waiting for.
<color=#d580ff><size=55>Is a bass!==W== Why? Why can't I make a single sound?!
Hmm? You even named your guitar? That's cute. Might be useful for promotion later.
<color=#d580ff>If I can't get the words out, then I'll try through music...!
Oh? Another one of your little tricks? But what people want ...==W== is this.
<color=#d580ff>?! That sound... A guitar? But Midas is a bass—why?!
Guitar is "in" right now in Flavio. That's why "Caramel" must play the guitar.
People like intense rhythms and bright tones. So Caramel's music has to sound like that.
These are the rules personally set by the Supreme Witch, Lady Rovina. They must not be broken.
You are at my clinic. Take a moment to steady your breathing. Have some water.
Do you not remember? You said that while you were inside the Monolith, you suddenly started playing.
It was like you were possessed. After finishing a piece in a trance, you simply collapsed.
I see...==W== Phew... thank goodness it was a dream. I can finally say whatever I want again.
Mm... Midas still sounds the same. Right. There's no way a bass would turn into a guitar...
Doctor... I remember everything now. What happened in the Monolith—I remember all of it...
I might be losing my mind... Doctor, can you hear me out?
So, you played the guitar in the Monolith, and then experienced hallucinations... Is that correct?
Yes—no!==W== Midas isn't a guitar, it's a bass!
My apologies. I'm not very familiar with music... Ahem. Let's get back on track.

In the hallucination, you were playing your instrument. But partway through, your fingers started moving on their own, the instrument's tone changed, and in the end you couldn't even speak... Is that right?
Yes... It was terrifying. It felt like I was turned into a puppet on strings...
The things I wanted to say... I just couldn't get it out. The audience and the producer took over...
Doctor... Do I have aphasia or something?
Don't worry. From the examination results, your vocal cords are fine, and there's no sign of a mental disorder.
That's a relief...==W== Could it be a side effect of making a wish? Maybe I made some huge wish and just don't remember...
That's hard to say. There have been reports of memory loss, but hallucinations during Monolith exploration... This is the first I've heard of it.
There are still many unsolved mysteries about the Monolith. It's possible that something abnormal happened inside, indirectly affecting your mind.
I'm not sure if it counts as abnormal, but at the time everything felt unnaturally quiet. I couldn't hear the Monolith's sound at all, even though it's usually always there...
But when I played Midas, I heard something... Like it was responding to me.
I was really happy, so I kept playing. It was the best duet I've ever done...
But then came the horrible hallucinations...==W== Could it be that the Monolith wasn't happy with my response? And then got angry?
In the hallucination, you were forced to play music that wasn't your own. If the thing controlling you was the Monolith itself, then that would make a certain kind of sense.
Come to think of it... In the hallucination, someone kept telling me that I had to play fast songs on the guitar.==W== They said it was a rule set by "Rovina."
Yes. Could it be that the Monolith has a name?
... Hard to say. As I mentioned, there are still many unknowns about the Monolith. Or—
That might be the name of "something" that harms Trekkers.
To be safe, you should report this to the Trekker Association. I'll prepare your full medical report.
Aside from treating your wounds, I can also prescribe something to soothe your nerves. Do you need anything else?
Um... You might think I haven't learned my lesson... But I still want to ask—can I keep playing inside the Monolith?
A doctor doesn't have the right to take music away from a musician. But aren't you afraid of the hallucinations?
To be honest, I am...==W== But what I feel even more is frustration. Like my response wasn't good enough.
And I want to understand why the Monolith prefers that kind of music... As a performer, I want to know for myself.
I see... You do not lack in ambition.==W== In that case, who am I to stand in your way? You have my support.
One day, I'll make both the Monolith and its hallucination accept my music. I'll keep working toward that. Thank you for treating me today!
If anything happens again, come see me anytime. Take care.
Never did I expect to catch a trace of you here. I'm not going to waste this chance...==W== "Opera Ghost."
Hello! Is the person in charge here? I encountered a very dangerous situation in the Monolith and need to report it.
An exploration report, right? Please wait a moment.
Willow, somebody's here to make a report—
Sorry to keep you waiting. I'm Willow, head of the Emor branch.
You're here to submit a Monolith exploration report, correct? Apologies, but you'll need to go through the usual procedure. Please read and confirm these items.
Especially this one... Regarding high-risk information. After consultation, this information may be shared with other Trekkers. Do you consent to this?
Yes, yes, I agree to everything. I think everyone needs to know about this...
What I'm about to say might be hard to believe, but it all happened to me. I'll start from the beginning—
Hallucinations inside the Monolith... Behavioral control... This really is the first case of its kind. I'm very glad you're safe, Miss Caramel.
Yeah, I'm really glad to be alive...
Thank you for providing such valuable information. Miss Caramel, do you have time after this?
Huh? Yeah, I guess. Anything you want me to do?
This is a rather dangerous situation. I need to discuss it with the senior members of the Association and my colleagues at Grace Imperium. Would you mind waiting here for a moment?
People that important!? Alright... I understand. I'll wait...!
While you wait, feel free to help yourself to drinks and snacks here. If you need anything, just let me know.
Um—could I sit in a corner and do some maintenance on Midas? I won't disturb anyone...
That's perfectly fine. Some nice background music would be more than welcome.
This is more serious than I thought. So that really was dangerous...
But... I still can't give up playing. I want to understand why I saw that hallucination.
That was a very compelling piece. You play the bass well.
Wow, is she a Trekker too? She recognized Midas as a bass!
I'm Wraith, from Sentinel of Dawn. I overheard your conversation just now and thought it was very interesting.
You mean ... what I said about seeing hallucinations in the Monolith?
Yes. The details were different, but I've had a similar experience.
That hallucination you described... it was probably the work of the Archons.
What's left of the pitiful souls that were consumed by the Monolith...==W== You could say they are some kind of Stellaroid, too.

In the hallucination, you were playing your instrument. But partway through, your fingers started moving on their own, the instrument's tone changed, and in the end you couldn't even speak... Is that right?
Yes... It was terrifying. It felt like I was turned into a puppet on strings...
The things I wanted to say... I just couldn't get it out. The audience and the producer took over...
Doctor... Do I have aphasia or something?
Don't worry. From the examination results, your vocal cords are fine, and there's no sign of a mental disorder.
That's a relief...==W== Could it be a side effect of making a wish? Maybe I made some huge wish and just don't remember...
That's hard to say. There have been reports of memory loss, but hallucinations during Monolith exploration... This is the first I've heard of it.
There are still many unsolved mysteries about the Monolith. It's possible that something abnormal happened inside, indirectly affecting your mind.
I'm not sure if it counts as abnormal, but at the time everything felt unnaturally quiet. I couldn't hear the Monolith's sound at all, even though it's usually always there...
But when I played Midas, I heard something... Like it was responding to me.
I was really happy, so I kept playing. It was the best duet I've ever done...
But then came the horrible hallucinations...==W== Could it be that the Monolith wasn't happy with my response? And then got angry?
In the hallucination, you were forced to play music that wasn't your own. If the thing controlling you was the Monolith itself, then that would make a certain kind of sense.
Come to think of it... In the hallucination, someone kept telling me that I had to play fast songs on the guitar.==W== They said it was a rule set by "Rovina."
Yes. Could it be that the Monolith has a name?
... Hard to say. As I mentioned, there are still many unknowns about the Monolith. Or—
That might be the name of "something" that harms Trekkers.
To be safe, you should report this to the Trekker Association. I'll prepare your full medical report.
Aside from treating your wounds, I can also prescribe something to soothe your nerves. Do you need anything else?
Um... You might think I haven't learned my lesson... But I still want to ask—can I keep playing inside the Monolith?
A doctor doesn't have the right to take music away from a musician. But aren't you afraid of the hallucinations?
To be honest, I am...==W== But what I feel even more is frustration. Like my response wasn't good enough.
And I want to understand why the Monolith prefers that kind of music... As a performer, I want to know for myself.
I see... You do not lack in ambition.==W== In that case, who am I to stand in your way? You have my support.
One day, I'll make both the Monolith and its hallucination accept my music. I'll keep working toward that. Thank you for treating me today!
If anything happens again, come see me anytime. Take care.
Never did I expect to catch a trace of you here. I'm not going to waste this chance...==W== "Opera Ghost."
Hello! Is the person in charge here? I encountered a very dangerous situation in the Monolith and need to report it.
An exploration report, right? Please wait a moment.
Willow, somebody's here to make a report—
Sorry to keep you waiting. I'm Willow, head of the Emor branch.
You're here to submit a Monolith exploration report, correct? Apologies, but you'll need to go through the usual procedure. Please read and confirm these items.
Especially this one... Regarding high-risk information. After consultation, this information may be shared with other Trekkers. Do you consent to this?
Yes, yes, I agree to everything. I think everyone needs to know about this...
What I'm about to say might be hard to believe, but it all happened to me. I'll start from the beginning—
Hallucinations inside the Monolith... Behavioral control... This really is the first case of its kind. I'm very glad you're safe, Miss Caramel.
Yeah, I'm really glad to be alive...
Thank you for providing such valuable information. Miss Caramel, do you have time after this?
Huh? Yeah, I guess. Anything you want me to do?
This is a rather dangerous situation. I need to discuss it with the senior members of the Association and my colleagues at Grace Imperium. Would you mind waiting here for a moment?
People that important!? Alright... I understand. I'll wait...!
While you wait, feel free to help yourself to drinks and snacks here. If you need anything, just let me know.
Um—could I sit in a corner and do some maintenance on Midas? I won't disturb anyone...
That's perfectly fine. Some nice background music would be more than welcome.
This is more serious than I thought. So that really was dangerous...
But... I still can't give up playing. I want to understand why I saw that hallucination.
That was a very compelling piece. You play the bass well.
Wow, is she a Trekker too? She recognized Midas as a bass!
I'm Wraith, from Sentinel of Dawn. I overheard your conversation just now and thought it was very interesting.
You mean ... what I said about seeing hallucinations in the Monolith?
Yes. The details were different, but I've had a similar experience.
That hallucination you described... it was probably the work of the Archons.
What's left of the pitiful souls that were consumed by the Monolith...==W== You could say they are some kind of Stellaroid, too.

strings.text: In preparation for the arrival of the Archon, Grace Imperium and the Trekker Association have formed a joint expeditionary squad, and Caramel is about to become the first suitable candidate...
This floor's cleared too. Nice work, everyone. The next level is our real target.
Well, well, color me surprised. I never thought an Arbiter of the Dusk Arbiters would personally take part in a Monolith investigation.
Right back at you. I've heard there's a certain elite Sentinel of Dawn who can't be bothered with anything unless it's a case tied to Nocturn Eterna...==W== Or was I misinformed?
Uh... Miss Willow? Those two... Are they arguing?
Sigh... Don't worry about it. In a sense, taking shots at each other is a cross-departmental tradition by now...
Ahem. Everyone, our destination is right ahead. Let's go over the plan one more time.

This time, we're investigating the hallucination phenomenon that Miss Caramel experienced. After a careful review of the report, we believe there's a strong chance it involves an Archon, which is why we asked you to join us.
If an Archon is really involved, then it makes sense for the Dusk Arbiters to step in. Don't worry. I'll make sure the mission goes smoothly.
Um... Is the Archon a particularly dangerous Stellaroid? It's serious enough that both a Dusk Arbiter and a Sentinel of Dawn have been called in...
An Archon is like a natural disaster. It can't be left unchecked. Now that there are already victims, that goes double...==W== You've been through a lot yourself, haven't you?
Well... Yeah, it was pretty rough...
Miss Caramel, are you okay? If you're still feeling unwell, it's fine to back out now...
I'm fine. You really don't need to worry about me. The moment I decided to help with this investigation, I'd already made up my mind. Having all of you here makes me feel a lot safer, and besides—
I really want to know why I saw that hallucination in the first place... So please, let me go with you.
That's the spirit. Don't worry. You have my word, no matter what kind of enemy shows up, I'll protect you, Miss Bassist.
But what if she gets trapped in the hallucination? We can protect her physical body, sure, but her soul is another matter.
About that—this is still only a working theory, but Wraith and I have already discussed a countermeasure.
Right. I went through something similar before. Back then, I connected with the soul inside the illusion through battle, and in the end I was able to resolve the crisis.
Miss Bassist, if you get trapped too, you have to keep resisting no matter what. Ideally, you should decide in advance how you're going to break free.
A way out...==W== Um, Miss Wraith. In that case, I have a request...
This is the floor. It matches Miss Caramel's report exactly. It's very quiet...==W== There's no sign of a Stellaroid at all.
You can hear the sound of the Monolith, right? Can you hear it now?
No, nothing... Just like it was last time.
Everything's in place. We can start recreating what happened.
Miss Bassist, get ready to fight.
Calm down... Recall what happened then, and focus...
<color=#d580ff>That's it! That's the voice from the last time—!
<color=#d580ff>It's okay. This time, I'm not alone. Everyone's here. Don't be afraid. Just keep playing...
<color=#d580ff>I'm a musician. I've already decided to face the hallucination in my own way...!
Oh, Miss Caramel! I'm so thrilled to see you back on stage again!
Come on, let's give the audience what they want! Let's play the song they came here to hear!
<color=#d580ff>... No. This time, I want everyone to listen to my music.
Even if this is not what everyone wants, I still want to fight this out with my own music. So... I'm not going to let you have your way.
You don't need that kind of sound, Caramel.
<color=#d580ff>I can't ... get any sound out ... my throat...!
Ladies and gentlemen, let us show Miss Caramel... The kind of music the audience really wants to hear!
Wow... A huge number of Stellaroids are starting to appear! Please make sure Caramel is taken care of while you are in combat!
Miss Caramel isn't reacting to anything around her... Which means she's completely trapped inside the hallucination.
Looks like it'll be hard to interfere from the outside. I hope she makes it out safely...
Just because I'm on desk duty ... doesn't mean I'm easy picking.
Take out the Stellaroid in front of Miss Caramel. Please hurry!
Huh, did not see this coming...
<color=#bd3059>Caramel, why are you rejecting the audience's call?! Are you even a performer?!
<color=#bd3059>A performer's job is to play the music people want to hear!

<color=#d580ff>If that's true... Then I'll just keep playing, and…==RT==One day, there will be people who accept my music as it is…==RT==If I only ever play what people expect me to…==RT==Then it won't be my music...!
<color=#bd3059>Still trying to act tough...? On this stage, you're nothing but a performer! This world has no need for lines that aren't in the script!
<color=#bd3059>This world itself is a giant stage! And it belongs to the Supreme Witch, Lady Rovina! Her rules must not be broken—
Then it's time for the curtain call...
... No, that's not it. The sound changed. Miss Bassist stopped playing!
Hehe... Hehehe... Good thing I borrowed this from Miss Wraith... It actually came in handy...
Caramel's holding a small knife, while Midas's strings==RT==lie limp on the ground.
That knife… You used it to cut the strings and shattered the illusion?
If the instrument couldn't function anymore, then that producer in the hallucination would be in a real pickle, too... That's how far I was willing to go in order to fight back.
Thank goodness it worked... But ...==W== I still feel so frustrated.
I really wanted to fight back==W== with my own music==W==—
Ah... Looks like she just fell asleep. Good job, Miss Caramel.
But that Stellaroid... It looks like we really do need to establish formal countermeasures for the Archons. After we get back, let's hold a meeting with the Grace Imperium right away.
Don't be ridiculous, Igna. An Archon case cannot be handed over to amateurs.
I understand, of course. But at the end of the day, she's an indispensable part of this joint investigation. She has already proven that during yesterday's operation.
Since you're tied up dealing with the Boss and don't have the time for this...==W== Then having her join is my condition for taking on the case.
Coronis, Firefly... Every condition you bring comes with its own set of problems.
You do realize you're quite a handful, right?
Ah, I only ever make requests that I know will be accepted. That's my principle.
Fine... I'll allow it. But I expect you to have Grace Imperium's reputation in mind while you act. And avoid unnecessary casualties.
Heh, pleasure working with you. I'll take my leave, then.
I'm back—==W==oh? Sorry, did I interrupt something?
Don't worry about it. Just a troublesome colleague making yet another unreasonable request.
Heh... Miss Caramel, your resolve and drive are truly remarkable. Thanks to you, the plan is progressing very smoothly.
Your music has an extraordinary pull on the Archons... In the future, it could become a powerful weapon against them.
If we can control when the Archons appear, both investigation and campaigns against them will become much easier... So I'll be counting on you to do your part.
Even if I didn't arrange it, you would have come on your own anyway.==W== After all, you've already been captivated by the sound of the Monolith...
Um... You might think I haven't learned my lesson... But I still want to ask—can I keep playing inside the Monolith?
Why would I stop you from playing, Miss Caramel...
I'll support you. So please...==W== Keep on playing...
