strings.text: Quiet on set! Roll Sound! Roll Camera! Actors Standby... That's how the shooting is supposed to go—but our co-leading heroine, Minova, doesn't seem quite ready yet!?
Alright, gang! Shoulders back. No way we're letting them look down on us!
We are the proud knights sworn to protect Nova with our blades!==W== We will never retreat, no matter who the enemy is!
We are the Imperial Guard! Protectors of the people. We safeguard property and peace! We fight for freedom and glory!
I am Tilia,==W== the Imperial Guard Squire! Justice is about to be served!
Heh...==W== Not bad. You've got some spirit, I'll give you that.==W== But—
If you want to take on real evil, you'll have to get through me first.
No one can stop Justice's march!
Hah! You really should look where you're going!==W== Take this—!
S-sorry, Director!==W== It's been a while since I acted, so I got a little nervous...
No. Tilia's gotten it together.==W== YOU are the problem here.
Minova! From Ashwind Clan!==W== Do you even know what role you're supposed to be playing?
You mean, the partner who fights alongside the Imperial Guard?
Not just a partner. You're the protagonist!==W== <size=120%>The==W== great==W== heroine.</size>==W== Get it?!
And what was that just now?==W== You looked like the villain, for crying out loud!==W== Do you not get what being the heroine means?
"Acting like one" is way too vague.==W== Can you be a bit more specific?

Alright then...==W== Go change into something else. That might help you get into the right headspace.==W== You can decide what to wear on your own. But on the next shooting day, I want to see an outfit that screams heroine energy the moment people see it!
Oh, and just bring me the receipt. Don't worry about the budget.==W== That's all for today. Good work, everyone.
Hmph...==W== She's gotten really comfortable ordering people around. Being in the Imperial Guard really gets into people's heads, huh?
Sorry...==W== I asked Ashwind Clan to come help with the filming, and it turned into this...
Don't mind.==W== We accepted the commission, so we'll do our best.
So the problem is the outfit, right?==W== I get what she means, but what exactly counts as heroine energy?==W== Hmmm...
For your reference, my outfit was custom-made and Masked Knight is its inspiration!==W== Minova, if you have a favorite character or style, maybe that'll give you some idea.
I see...==W== Thanks for the suggestion.==W== Next shoot, I'll be in perfect form. Then we can have our little showdown properly.
Man...==W== I'm exhausted...==W== Acting is way more tiring than I thought...
It was only a few lines, but standing in front of the camera still made me nervous~
Yo, Cap! Nice work today...==W== Huh? What're you reading?
Fashion magazines.==W== The director told me to prepare an outfit that feels more like a heroine, didn't she? So I figured I'd flip through some and see if I get any inspiration.
Come to think of it, that Tilia girl's outfit really was cool. Especially the belt and stuff.
Yeah~ Normally she looks pretty plain, but once she was in that outfit, she felt like a totally different person!==W== It really caught me off guard~
Hmph.==W== Then Captain can just get an outfit that looks even cooler than hers!
But the director wants heroine energy.==W== It must be something special.
Hmmm...==W== So what exactly is this "heroine energy"?
Honestly, I still haven't figured that out...==W== Stella Drama heroines are usually rich girls or princesses and the like. But this time I'm playing Tilia's partner who fights beside her...
And that's where this magazine comes in!
You two come take a look, too.==W== Mark anything you like, and let's figure out what an Ashwind heroine should look like.
Oooooh!==W== An Ashwind heroine actually sounds awesome!
But seriously, Cap, I had no idea you kept this many fashion mags around.
Uh, well...==W== These were for extracurricular activities from my classes at Platinum Academy! That's right! They have courses on fashion and design, too!
<size=90%>Actually, I bought them for the shojo manga serials they're running...==W== Yeah, I'm taking that one to the grave...!</size>
Ooh~!==W== Platinum Academy sounds amazing! They even have courses on stuff like this.
Alright, enough talking. Start looking. If you see an outfit you like, fold the page.
Mmm...==W== Ah, this one feels perfect for Cap!==W== No, wait, this one's better...==W== Whoa, that one looks amazing, too!
Sis, if you mark every page, we won't be able to narrow anything down later, you know...==W== Eh?
Just as Neuvira reached for another magazine, a thin booklet slipped out from between the pages.
Oh! This one works, too! Cute and cool at the same time—it totally suits you, Cap!
What?==W== That's ...==W== Goodbye, My Landmine Childhood Friend?! Why is it here?!
Neuvira, let me see!==W== Hmm? The girls in these pictures have huge eyes...
Ahhhhh—==W==that...==W== That's because it's a picture book!==W== The art's exaggerated so little kids can understand it better.
A picture book? Are there really picture books this small? And this many pages?
That doesn't matter right now! We're supposed to be figuring out my outfit!==W== There are still plenty of magazines left, and if we keep wasting time like this, we'll never finish!
Why don't we just use the outfit on the cover of this picture book!==W== She looks strong in it, the eyepatch is super cool, and honestly, it feels like the perfect Ashwind Heroine look!
Seconded~==W== Look, "landmine" means one of those explosive traps buried in the battlefield, right? Then—boom! It'd have an amazing visual impact!
<size=90%>So that's what landmine-type means? I didn't really get it at the time...

<size=90%>No, no, no—if this conversation keeps going, does that mean I'm really gonna end up filming in the outfit of some shojo manga heroine?!==W== Though... I mean, it's not like I've never wondered about it...
<size=90%>Calm down... Minova.==W== There's no way you'd actually look good in that. Get them to ditch this idea.

You're making this sound way too easy. This ma==W==—this picture book is fiction. Clothes like that don't even exist in real life.==W== Even if we started making one now, there's no way it'd be ready in time for filming. Motion denied!
If you can't buy it...==W== Then why don't we just make a wish for it at the Monolith?
That's a great idea! Now that we know what style we want, the odds of getting the right thing should be higher, too. Let's go right now!
<size=90%>Well...==W== Guess we're making a trip to the Monolith. It's not like Wishing is guaranteed to work anyway. Once they try it and fail, they'll probably give it up.
Fine, fine, alright.==W== But let me make one thing clear—We are only doing the climb once.
If the Wish fails, we have to give up and go buy something from the shops in town. Wishes come at a price. You can't just throw them around like they're nothing.
Landmine~ Bomb~ Cool as hell—!==W== Bomb~ Landmine~ So badass—!
I seriously don't know what to do with you two...
Oh! The patterns on this wall are incredible!==W== And these paintings are awesome, too!
Cap, the Monolith feels kind of ...==W== stylish today~? Totally different vibe...
Thank Trekker Association for the tip. Apparently fashion designers often hire Trekkers to come to this particular Monolith for inspiration.
<size=90%>If those two get interested in some other designs, I can steer the conversation away from that outfit...

If anything here really catches your eye, make sure you remember it well.==W== Only clothes obtained from the Wishing Box can be taken out of the Monolith, so when the time comes to make a wish,==W== you have to describe it very, very clearly.
Mmm...==W== But I still think you would look best in the style from the picture book...==W== Eh?
Look! This ornament looks amazing too!==W== Hey, what if we paired this with the outfit on the cover...
Idiot, get back! That's a Stellaroid!

Sorry...==W== I asked Ashwind Clan to come help with the filming, and it turned into this...
Don't mind.==W== We accepted the commission, so we'll do our best.
So the problem is the outfit, right?==W== I get what she means, but what exactly counts as heroine energy?==W== Hmmm...
For your reference, my outfit was custom-made and Masked Knight is its inspiration!==W== Minova, if you have a favorite character or style, maybe that'll give you some idea.
I see...==W== Thanks for the suggestion.==W== Next shoot, I'll be in perfect form. Then we can have our little showdown properly.
Man...==W== I'm exhausted...==W== Acting is way more tiring than I thought...
It was only a few lines, but standing in front of the camera still made me nervous~
Yo, Cap! Nice work today...==W== Huh? What're you reading?
Fashion magazines.==W== The director told me to prepare an outfit that feels more like a heroine, didn't she? So I figured I'd flip through some and see if I get any inspiration.
Come to think of it, that Tilia girl's outfit really was cool. Especially the belt and stuff.
Yeah~ Normally she looks pretty plain, but once she was in that outfit, she felt like a totally different person!==W== It really caught me off guard~
Hmph.==W== Then Captain can just get an outfit that looks even cooler than hers!
But the director wants heroine energy.==W== It must be something special.
Hmmm...==W== So what exactly is this "heroine energy"?
Honestly, I still haven't figured that out...==W== Stella Drama heroines are usually rich girls or princesses and the like. But this time I'm playing Tilia's partner who fights beside her...
And that's where this magazine comes in!
You two come take a look, too.==W== Mark anything you like, and let's figure out what an Ashwind heroine should look like.
Oooooh!==W== An Ashwind heroine actually sounds awesome!
But seriously, Cap, I had no idea you kept this many fashion mags around.
Uh, well...==W== These were for extracurricular activities from my classes at Platinum Academy! That's right! They have courses on fashion and design, too!
<size=90%>Actually, I bought them for the shojo manga serials they're running...==W== Yeah, I'm taking that one to the grave...!</size>
Ooh~!==W== Platinum Academy sounds amazing! They even have courses on stuff like this.
Alright, enough talking. Start looking. If you see an outfit you like, fold the page.
Mmm...==W== Ah, this one feels perfect for Cap!==W== No, wait, this one's better...==W== Whoa, that one looks amazing, too!
Sis, if you mark every page, we won't be able to narrow anything down later, you know...==W== Eh?
Just as Neuvira reached for another magazine, a thin booklet slipped out from between the pages.
Oh! This one works, too! Cute and cool at the same time—it totally suits you, Cap!
What?==W== That's ...==W== Goodbye, My Landmine Childhood Friend?! Why is it here?!
Neuvira, let me see!==W== Hmm? The girls in these pictures have huge eyes...
Ahhhhh—==W==that...==W== That's because it's a picture book!==W== The art's exaggerated so little kids can understand it better.
A picture book? Are there really picture books this small? And this many pages?
That doesn't matter right now! We're supposed to be figuring out my outfit!==W== There are still plenty of magazines left, and if we keep wasting time like this, we'll never finish!
Why don't we just use the outfit on the cover of this picture book!==W== She looks strong in it, the eyepatch is super cool, and honestly, it feels like the perfect Ashwind Heroine look!
Seconded~==W== Look, "landmine" means one of those explosive traps buried in the battlefield, right? Then—boom! It'd have an amazing visual impact!
<size=90%>So that's what landmine-type means? I didn't really get it at the time...

<size=90%>No, no, no—if this conversation keeps going, does that mean I'm really gonna end up filming in the outfit of some shojo manga heroine?!==W== Though... I mean, it's not like I've never wondered about it...
<size=90%>Calm down... Minova.==W== There's no way you'd actually look good in that. Get them to ditch this idea.

You're making this sound way too easy. This ma==W==—this picture book is fiction. Clothes like that don't even exist in real life.==W== Even if we started making one now, there's no way it'd be ready in time for filming. Motion denied!
If you can't buy it...==W== Then why don't we just make a wish for it at the Monolith?
That's a great idea! Now that we know what style we want, the odds of getting the right thing should be higher, too. Let's go right now!
<size=90%>Well...==W== Guess we're making a trip to the Monolith. It's not like Wishing is guaranteed to work anyway. Once they try it and fail, they'll probably give it up.
Fine, fine, alright.==W== But let me make one thing clear—We are only doing the climb once.
If the Wish fails, we have to give up and go buy something from the shops in town. Wishes come at a price. You can't just throw them around like they're nothing.
Landmine~ Bomb~ Cool as hell—!==W== Bomb~ Landmine~ So badass—!
I seriously don't know what to do with you two...
Oh! The patterns on this wall are incredible!==W== And these paintings are awesome, too!
Cap, the Monolith feels kind of ...==W== stylish today~? Totally different vibe...
Thank Trekker Association for the tip. Apparently fashion designers often hire Trekkers to come to this particular Monolith for inspiration.
<size=90%>If those two get interested in some other designs, I can steer the conversation away from that outfit...

If anything here really catches your eye, make sure you remember it well.==W== Only clothes obtained from the Wishing Box can be taken out of the Monolith, so when the time comes to make a wish,==W== you have to describe it very, very clearly.
Mmm...==W== But I still think you would look best in the style from the picture book...==W== Eh?
Look! This ornament looks amazing too!==W== Hey, what if we paired this with the outfit on the cover...
Idiot, get back! That's a Stellaroid!

strings.text: To become the cutest, most eye-catching heroine, Minova "firmly" chooses an outfit with a "cute but poisonous" style!
Tch! This thing's tougher than it looks!
Cap, we are out of bombs....
Darn! Tss...==W== I let my guard down...!
Neuvira! Get Vollara out of here first. I'll hold it off!
Oh... Looks like I missed a big target.
Hehehe<size=60>♪</size> Sorry to steal your kill.==W== But~ this one was my prey to begin with.
No...==W== You really helped us out.
The redhead's hurt, isn't she?==W== Here, use this. I happened to bring some healing medicine.
Thank you so much.==W== I'm Minova, leader of the Ashwind Clan.
A pleasure. I am Gerie of the Dusk Arbiters.
Hehe, fair's fair. Why don't you two introduce yourselves, too?
HEY! Why are you two darting your eyes around? That's no way to treat someone who just saved us!==W== Haven't I taught you that when you thank someone, you look them in the eye?
B-but,==W== I heard that the Dusk Arbiters...
There are all kinds of scary rumors going around about them~
Honestly,==W== getting this scared over a few rumors is kind of ridiculous.
It's okay. I'm used to that reaction.==W== It's only natural to be cautious around someone you've just met. Hehe.
By the way...==W== Why are you here in the Monolith at this hour?==W== Things haven't exactly been peaceful in here lately. I wouldn't recommend coming in just for sightseeing.
Well...==W== It's a long story. It all starts with—
So you came here to look for an outfit for an Imperial Guard promo video...==W== Hehe~ How interesting!
That's right. We couldn't find the outfit we wanted in any shop, so we came to try our luck here. Maybe we could wish for it.

Not a bad idea, but wishing for clothes is actually pretty difficult. You have to describe the exact style you want in the prayer...==W== If all you have is a vague idea, there's a good chance it won't work.
Still, you're in luck~ I actually know a little something about this so-called <color=#3faeae>landmine-type</color> style.
Of course. As an Arbiter, I go in and out of all kinds of Monoliths, so I've seen outfits like that a few times before~
No way...==W== Clothes like that really exist? I've never seen anything like that in real life...
Surprised?==W== A lot of trendy designs these days can actually be traced back to clothes first found in Monoliths~
Hehe. Who knows, maybe a video with you in that outfit will be what makes landmine-type take off.
So you're saying that Cap's about to become a fashion "it girl"?
Hell yeah, this has potential! Cap, let's go with her and broaden our horizons!
You two, calm down. Our original goal was to find an outfit with "heroine energy" that would make the director happy.==W== It doesn't necessarily have to be landmine-type, does it?
No, no, actually, I'd say you're very much on the right track.==W== Didn't you say the role you're playing isn't some standard heroine?

A girl with hidden fragility that evokes sympathy and danger that makes people fall for her, while underneath she's got a fire just waiting to erupt...==W== Hmm, that kind of outfit would suit her perfectly.==W== And if she's paired up with a classic knightly partner, it'll look fantastic on camera.
The age of landmine is almost upon us!
If even she says so, it must be true... After all, she's seen so much stuff inside the Monoliths~
By the way, since it's fate that we met here, let me make a wish on your behalf.
We'd love to take you up on that! Thank you very much!
Oh no...==W== I have a really bad feeling about where this is headed...!
Then first, let's go find a Wishing Box.==W== Come on, let's move—!!!
Excellent. Now that we've found the Wishing Box, let's make the wish at once...==W== Ahem.
O mighty God of Grace, please hear our prayer… Please grant me...
Gerie pulled a notebook out from nowhere and, in a mournful voice, began reciting a string of obscure, hard-to-follow lines.
<color=#3faeae>"Tell me...==W== What do I have to do to make you look at me and no one else?==W== I love you this much, so why won't you look my way?"
Huh? That line sounds awfully familiar... Wait, is that...?!
<color=#3faeae>"My secrets are for your eyes only...==W== A testament to my love.==W== Come now, why not descend into darkness by my side?"
Is this really how you make a wish? She hasn't even mentioned clothes at all. This feels a bit weird.
Oh my, this feels good. Looks like I nailed it in one shot.==W== It's been a while since I last made a wish, but I'm glad I haven't lost my touch.
No way...==W== Th-this is exactly the same outfit as the one on the cover...?!==W== How?!
In order to convey a more concrete image to the God of Grace, I recited lines that were closely associated with those clothes.
They came from a book I absolutely adore...==W== Goodbye, My Landmine Childhood Friend.==W== A deeply moving shojo ma—
Ahem!==W== It's a girls' picture book! A picture book, right?!
A-anyway, thank you so much!==W== You saved us today and helped us get the outfit too. I don't even know how to repay you!
You really don't need to worry about that.==W== Though... If you insist, then perhaps you could grant one wish of mine as well.
A wish? I guess it's only fair to repay one wish with another. I have no objection...==W== What do you want me to do?
I want to see you all wearing this outfit. How does that sound?
Whaaaat?!==W== No! No way, no how!
Huh? But didn't you just say you had no objection?==W== Or are members of the mighty Ashwind Clan not so big on keeping their word?
Is it really okay for us to use the changing room in this shop?
Of course~ The shop owner and I go way back. I already cleared it with them.
Why do I feel like we've been completely set up here...?
Alright, alright, don't sweat the details. Go get changed, all of you.==W== This way~ right over here~
Uh...==W== Isn't this corset a little too tight...?
Whoa, this blouse looks amazing...==W== But isn't the skirt kinda short...?
Wait, is that what these accessories are supposed to mean...?==W== What a bold design!
Th-this outfit is quite something else...==W== Are we really gonna wear this while filming?
Hm~?==W== Why have you two already changed back into your old clothes?
Uh...==W== Just as we thought, Cap looks best in these clothes after all...==W== So, we'd like to ask that you keep your eyes only on her.
Yeah, exactly! The two of us can't really pull this off, so ma'am, please don't waste your attention on us!
I actually thought the two of you would look pretty cute in them...==W== But well, watching your reactions has been fun enough on its own, so I'll let it slide for now~
More importantly, where's our protagonist? Is she alright? She's been totally quiet ever since she went in.
Hey Cap~ You done changing yet?
Ah, um...==W== I-I'm just not quite mentally prepared yet...
Hehehehe~==W== In that case, looks like you need one last little push.
Hey—?!==W== Why do you open the curtain?!==W== I said I'm not prepared yet!?
Not "mentally" prepared yet.==W== If I hadn't opened it, I don't think you would've emerged in this lifetime.
That being said...==W== You actually look the part. Very cute<size=60>♪</size>
You really do, Cap!==W== You look so good in that!!!
It's got that cool factor, but it's still so cute!
Ugh...==W== R-really?==W== I don't look weird in something like this...?
Of course not. You're already a perfect landmine-type heroine. Have some confidence in yourself.
It seems you're quite pleased with this look.==W== You even took the time to style your hair to match it.
Th-that's only because ...==W== if I'm gonna wear it, I wanted to style it properly...==W== N-no, that's not it. I just believe that if you do something, you should do it perfectly!
Actually, I was trying to recreate the heroine's look from Goodbye, My Landmine Childhood Friend... No way I can ever admit that!
But the moment I put this outfit on...==W== For just an instant, I really did feel like I'd become the heroine from the manga...
What is this...==W== Why is my heart beating so fast? Is this the power of Landmine?==W== And everyone seems to like it, too. As a costume, this might actually work...
Opportunities like this don't come often. So, why not just wear it on the way back?
D-don't be ridiculous!==W== You've seen enough, yeah? I'm changing out of it—!
Aww~==W== What a shame.==W== I wanted to keep looking a little longer.
Alright, the outfit's settled.==W== Next I just need to work on my acting chops to make the director happy.
With an outfit like this, it'll be easy!
This time, we'll definitely get it in one take!
Mmm...==W== Will it really be that easy, though?
W-what? What other problem could there be?
I still feel like, as a heroine, your aura's not quite there yet~==W== Hmm, you still haven't fully let go of your embarrassment, have you?
Ugh...==W== Th-that's asking way too much! It was my first time wearing something like that...!
Hehehe. You are lucky you've met me. I'll see this through to the end. I'll grab this thing by the horns and turn you into a per~==W==fect landmine-type heroine!
Ready~?==W== It's time for you to experience my secret special training regimen<size=60>♪</size>

strings.text: The crew's looking, the camera's looking, and of course, you are looking at me, too—promise me you'll look at no one but me, okay?
A few days later, on the day of the shoot—
After lunch, we're going straight into Tilia and Minova's scene together.==W== Everyone, get ready. Let's try to nail it in one take.
Huh? Hey, Neuvira, have you seen Minova?
Nope~ We're about to start. Where'd she go?
Apologies for the wait!==W== I was busy daydreaming about the one I love and accidentally ended up late~
It's me, Minova—your reigning landmine-type heroine!★==W== Anyone who gets in the way of my sweetheart and me==W== is gonna get sent flying<size=53>♪</size>
... Did I scare you?==B====W== So? That was pretty in character, right?
Y-you scared the crap out of me...
I seriously almost didn't recognize you!
Five minutes to filming. Everyone, please get into position.
I'm gonna head over first!==W== You two get changed and come on over too, okay?★
Huff… Huff… The reinforcements just keep coming…
Ebony Star, you aren't injured, are you?
I'm fine. And you? I'll keep you safe—even if I have to die for it...!
Is it the outfit? Minova feels completely different now...==W== I have to keep up with her!
Cut!==B====W== Minova, that was way better than last time. The outfit works, the hair and makeup work. But you're still missing one thing.

This scene is about the heroine's determination to fight back even when everything feels hopeless.==W== I need to see that desperation, that faith that no matter what happens, she cannot bear to lose the person fighting beside her. Make the audience feel your struggle and your urgency.==W== Got it?
Cannot bear to lose the person fighting beside me...==W== Okay, I will try.
Heh. I had a feeling something was up with you. So you really are into that manga, too.
Yeah... Please don't tell Vollara and Neuvira.==W== If people found out I read shojo manga... That'd completely kill my image as a leader.
So that's why you were trying so hard to hide it.==W== Don't worry. I swear to the God of Grace, I won't tell a soul.
Thanks. I owe you one.==W== So what exactly am I supposed to do for this special training...?
In Goodbye, My Landmine Childhood Friend, every line the heroine says gets under your skin like poison, doesn't it?==W== That's what you're missing right now. That poisonous feeling.

That's the magic of landmine type.==W== First, throw away that upright, honorable version of yourself and get in touch with the poison inside you. The possessiveness you feel toward the person who matters most.
... I kinda get what you're saying. But how am I supposed to turn that into acting?
You start with imagination.==W== First, picture the person who matters most to you.
Got someone in mind, don't you?==W== Now imagine that person with someone else, smiling in a way you've never seen before, happier than you've ever seen them. What do you feel?
If ==SEX=='s happy, then I'd be happy too—
No, ==W==<size=40>no,</size><size=42> no,</size><size=44> no,</size><size=46> no!!!</size>==W==<size=50> That's completely wrong!</size>
I told you, leave your usual self behind! Right now, you are a landmine-type heroine!
You want that person all to yourself.==W== You don't want to lose ==SEX4==. You absolutely do not want anyone else taking ==SEX4== away from you!
Even if it means making the world your enemy, you'll see it through.==W== That's what it truly means to be a landmine-type protagonist.
It's okay. You're allowed to be more selfish.==W== You would never let the person you love stand beside anyone but you—
Possessiveness is what makes a <color=#bd3059>landmine-type</color> heroine.
In this scene, Tilia is the partner I refuse to lose no matter what. And right now, I'm the Landmine-Type Heroine.
Now, Tilia is about to be taken away from me...==W== In that case, I need to—!
Alright, take two! Everyone in position!==W== And... ACTION!!
Ebony Star, leave this to me. Run while you still can!==RT==Protecting the people is the duty of the Imperial Guard!

strings.text: This is supposed to be another ordinary day, if only the plans aren't interrupted. Alas, that wish is nothing but wishful thinking.
Alright, focus. While it's still quiet...==W== I should knock out this paperwork.
Then again, it's been absolute chaos lately. I didn't realize the pile had gotten this bad...==W== I need to get my schedule in order.
Oh right, isn't Horizon visiting Emor today?
She wanted to discuss her shipbuilding project. But didn't we shelve that over funding issues?
...==W== She couldn't have secured the funding, could she?
I suppose it's possible.==W== But even if the money's sorted, do we have the tech to build what she's envisioning?
Sigh.==W== No point talking to myself about it. I'll wait for Horizon to get here, and then—
I thought you were in Philae. What brings you all the way out to Emor?
Well, your timing's perfect. Horizon should be here any minute. If you don't mind waiting, you can brief us both at the same time.
About that... That's actually why I'm here.==W== She is probably back in Sailstead by now.
I bumped into her back in Philae! She was about to explore a Monolith and completely roped me in as free labor.
Then, we found these blueprints for a massive ship inside. She stared at them all night and decided it was totally doable...
Let me guess. She had an epiphany and bolted straight back to Sailstead to start building? Without running it by me first, of course...==W== Typical. She just does whatever pops into her head.
Ugh...==W== Will she ever learn to slow down?
Forget the funding for a second. That rundown shipyard at headquarters lacks both the equipment and the supplies. It can't possibly handle a massive vessel...
She said she'll figure all that out herself.
Oh, right! She made sure I handed this to you.
Budgets, fundraising plans,==W== shipyard renovations, crew recruitment...==W== She even drafted investor pitches for the major companies. Her efficiency is infuriating when she gets like this...
I'll handle the shipyard. Leaving the logistics to you girls!
Um, Miss Willow? I totally understand how you feel...
... Heh.==W== Don't worry, I'm not going to blow up.
She's always like this. Gets an idea and runs with it, completely ignoring everyone's schedules. I'm used to it.
Haha, acting on impulse is kind of her trademark...
If she were acting recklessly, I'd have a reason to be mad. But no...
Every single document here is airtight. Barely a flaw in sight. How am I supposed to yell at her for that?
That is the infuriating part! We're backed into a corner, forced to go along with whatever she wants.
Phew...==W== Never mind. You're right. Operating at lightning speed is how our President rolls.
Anyway, this funding plan looks viable. You handle the routine communications. I'll take on the corporate negotiations myself.
It's a deal! Next time I visit from Philae, I'll bring you some snacks!
Leafia doesn't stay long. She quickly leaves with her new assignment.
If this plan were a mess, I'd have talked her out of it...==W== But it's solid. I underestimated her drive.
Great. Instead of less work, I've got more.
... No use sighing about it.==W== Time to get to work.
First up, this mountain of paperwork—
Cough, cough...==W== This smoke is thick. Was that an explosion?!
What on earth is going on?!
Wait, is that ...==W== Willow?! Help me!
No, no, not there!==W== I'm down here... Wait, right below you on your left!
You...?!==W== What are you doing in here?!

strings.text: One problem after another! Goods piling up at the front desk, the Trekkers' House is a total mess... Huh? You said there's a fight breaking out outside?
... Bloc?!==W== What are you doing here?!
Surprises are supposed to catch you off guard. Hehe...
Boxes and crates of all sizes are piled into a small hill, blocking the reception desk and entrance.
Uh, there's an explanation for this...
I-I promise I'll explain! But can you dig me out first? I'm getting squished here!
Alright. What happened here? I expect a proper explanation.
Step right up!==W== You're looking at the most advanced packing tech around. Any cargo, no matter its size and weight, is shrunk into a tiny package. Who will be the first to try?
No way! Prove it. Use my backpack.
You got it! Your luggage is in good hands.
Watch closely.==W== Pop your cargo in this magic device, follow a few steps...
Easy as pie. A few seconds and we're done~==W== Almost there! Count down with me.==W== Three,==W== two,==W== one...
Huh? Why's the strap still sticking out?==W== Uh oh...!
Run!==W== Everybody run! It's gonna blow!
Hold on...==W== Setting aside the massive mess you caused, I don't recall any rules allowing you to run a sales pitch inside the Trekker Association.
Aw, I got bored waiting~==W== You know what they say: time is Dorra. Couldn't stand around doing nothing, right?
And your business philosophy gave us this?
Heh, didn't think one little mistake would blow up like this.
I just bought it. Please tell me it's not ruined.
Don't worry, theoretically it's fine. It's buried under all this stuff, though...
Everyone, hold on. Please don't push. We don't want anyone getting hurt.
Got it! Everyone stay put and line up, nice and easy.
Alright...==W== What's done is done. Let's get this cargo sorted and back to the owners.
Bloc, you made this mess. You aren't expecting me to clean it up for you, are you?
Of course not!==W== But look at all this. I'll be here forever!
You can't even see the floor. There's no way I can handle this. Call in some help, please!
Your cargo is blocking the door. Even if I called for backup, they couldn't get in.
... Yeah, right. You think that's gonna work on me, Laru?
Meeeow?! How'd you catch me, meow?!
Oh, perfect timing!==W== You couldn't have shown up at a better moment. Come on, lend a hand!
What are you talking about? I'm just passing through.
Do I look like I have time for this? I've got actual work to do. Swamped. Bye-bye!
Wait, wait! Look at this mess. It's begging for an elite expert like you to save the day!
If we're going by the book, I'm with Grace Imperium. I catch a shady dealer like you, I'm supposed to call the Imperial Guard.
Come on, that's a bit much! What shady dealer? I'm a humble, law-abiding street vendor, that's all!
Wait, so you know who I am?
I told you, I'm with Grace Imperium. You think I wouldn't have basic intel on you?
But if you arrest me, won't my clients get in trouble too? That's a lot of collateral damage.==W== Right, Willow?
Do not use your customers as bargaining chips.
Exactly! One thing has nothing to do with the other. Don't mix them up!
And you, quiet. You came here to slack off anyway. Might as well make yourself useful and help with the cargo.
You know I'm here to slack off! That's basically free labor!
Okay, how about a deal! You help me out, and next time everything is half off. Sound good?

<size=110%>I</size>==W==<size=110%> already</size>==W==<size=110%> told</size>==W==<size=110%> you!</size>==W== I'm with Grace Imperium! You want me to make a shady deal with you? Are you trying to get me fired?!
Alright, alright. Look, I'm asking you as a favor. Please...
Free labor is the root of all evil! No means no. Begging won't change my mind...
I wasn't finished. How about this:==W== five orders of fancy fries from that gourmet place, plus the new fishing rod you've been eyeing.
Whoa. Fastest turnaround I've ever seen. You're a magician, Willow.
Don't look so happy. You caused this mess, so you're footing the bill.
Settled. Now let's get to work.
Finally. That's the last of it...
I thought we only had to sort things out. Tracking down the actual owners took all day.
I snuck out of the office to slack off. How did I end up doing manual labor instead?
You've slacked off enough. A little elbow grease won't kill you.
Hey, I believe in an equal working-to-slacking ratio, that's all. You can't perform at your peak without proper rest!
Seriously though, look at you. You need a vacation, Willow. Keep toiling at this pace and you'll burn out.
I tag along on your fishing trips all the time. That counts as a break for me.
You call that a break? Not even close!
This 24/7 workaholic routine of yours is getting out of hand!
It's fine. I'm only doing my job.
Anyway, thanks for pitching in today. I need to get back to it. Bloc can drop off that fishing rod later. Right, Bloc?==W== Wait, where did she go?
They're distracted. Perfect time to slip away...==W== Ah, busted!
That little grifter!==W== She's actually making a run for it!
A big shot from the Grace Imperium shouldn't mingle with the likes of me anyway! Think of your reputation! It's better for both of us if we pretend we never met!
On that note, I'll leave you ladies to it! Toodles!
Hey, get back here!!==W== Ugh, she's too fast. Next time I see her, I'm reporting her to the guards on sight.
Don't worry. She can run to the ends of the earth, but I'll make sure she pays what she owes. We'll let it slide for today.
I can't believe it's already evening. I haven't touched a single piece of paperwork yet.==W== Sigh...
At least the rest of my schedule is clear. It's only standard paperwork. I can definitely knock this out tonight.
Alright, focus. Let's get this done.
... Why do I have a terrible feeling about this?
Willow! Someone's asking for you outside!
Willow, we have a problem! A fight broke out in the street!
Ugh. And my schedule was perfectly planned out today...
Hey, hey, don't cry~==W== I bought a fresh batch of fries and saved the biggest, crispiest one for you. Here, take it!
Sniff...==W== Thanks. Oh wow, that hits the spot.

If we're going by the book, I'm with Grace Imperium. I catch a shady dealer like you, I'm supposed to call the Imperial Guard.
Come on, that's a bit much! What shady dealer? I'm a humble, law-abiding street vendor, that's all!
Wait, so you know who I am?
I told you, I'm with Grace Imperium. You think I wouldn't have basic intel on you?
But if you arrest me, won't my clients get in trouble too? That's a lot of collateral damage.==W== Right, Willow?
Do not use your customers as bargaining chips.
Exactly! One thing has nothing to do with the other. Don't mix them up!
And you, quiet. You came here to slack off anyway. Might as well make yourself useful and help with the cargo.
You know I'm here to slack off! That's basically free labor!
Okay, how about a deal! You help me out, and next time everything is half off. Sound good?

<size=110%>I</size>==W==<size=110%> already</size>==W==<size=110%> told</size>==W==<size=110%> you!</size>==W== I'm with Grace Imperium! You want me to make a shady deal with you? Are you trying to get me fired?!
Alright, alright. Look, I'm asking you as a favor. Please...
Free labor is the root of all evil! No means no. Begging won't change my mind...
I wasn't finished. How about this:==W== five orders of fancy fries from that gourmet place, plus the new fishing rod you've been eyeing.
Whoa. Fastest turnaround I've ever seen. You're a magician, Willow.
Don't look so happy. You caused this mess, so you're footing the bill.
Settled. Now let's get to work.
Finally. That's the last of it...
I thought we only had to sort things out. Tracking down the actual owners took all day.
I snuck out of the office to slack off. How did I end up doing manual labor instead?
You've slacked off enough. A little elbow grease won't kill you.
Hey, I believe in an equal working-to-slacking ratio, that's all. You can't perform at your peak without proper rest!
Seriously though, look at you. You need a vacation, Willow. Keep toiling at this pace and you'll burn out.
I tag along on your fishing trips all the time. That counts as a break for me.
You call that a break? Not even close!
This 24/7 workaholic routine of yours is getting out of hand!
It's fine. I'm only doing my job.
Anyway, thanks for pitching in today. I need to get back to it. Bloc can drop off that fishing rod later. Right, Bloc?==W== Wait, where did she go?
They're distracted. Perfect time to slip away...==W== Ah, busted!
That little grifter!==W== She's actually making a run for it!
A big shot from the Grace Imperium shouldn't mingle with the likes of me anyway! Think of your reputation! It's better for both of us if we pretend we never met!
On that note, I'll leave you ladies to it! Toodles!
Hey, get back here!!==W== Ugh, she's too fast. Next time I see her, I'm reporting her to the guards on sight.
Don't worry. She can run to the ends of the earth, but I'll make sure she pays what she owes. We'll let it slide for today.
I can't believe it's already evening. I haven't touched a single piece of paperwork yet.==W== Sigh...
At least the rest of my schedule is clear. It's only standard paperwork. I can definitely knock this out tonight.
Alright, focus. Let's get this done.
... Why do I have a terrible feeling about this?
Willow! Someone's asking for you outside!
Willow, we have a problem! A fight broke out in the street!
Ugh. And my schedule was perfectly planned out today...
Hey, hey, don't cry~==W== I bought a fresh batch of fries and saved the biggest, crispiest one for you. Here, take it!
Sniff...==W== Thanks. Oh wow, that hits the spot.

strings.text: The heated conflict is eventually quelled, but the day's plans are completely disrupted. Perhaps Willow has the answer to whether such busyness is truly meaningful all along.
Why are all these people gathered here...==W== What happened?
I know people who have already left to find that Monolith! When they get back, we'll know for sure if the rumor's true!
You know what it says about you if you actually buy that? It means you're completely brain-dead! Wahahaha!
What was that? I dare you to say it again!
Hey, hey, that's enough! Break it up, everyone!
Looks like they got into a fight over some rumor...
No idea who started it, but word is there's a Monolith on the Nova Continent where you can grab an Artifact for free. No wish, no price.
Everyone's been talking about it lately. Some people are completely convinced, and others think it's total nonsense...
The two sides got heated and nearly came to blows. We were on patrol when things went south, so we had to step in and separate them.
A Monolith that requires no wish and costs nothing? What more do we have to back this rumor up?
Nothing. None that I know of. Honestly, only a fool would fall for a free lunch like that.
Agreed. It's way too good to be true.
Like I'd miss a front-row seat to good drama!
But seriously, if a Monolith were that convenient, other Trekkers would have picked it clean ages ago. There is no way it would only be discovered now.
There are tons of Monoliths out there! It's perfectly normal for a couple of them to fly under the radar!
Besides, no one has solid proof it's fake news! What if it's real?
She has a point. We shouldn't jump to conclusions before we know the truth.
Tell you what, let the Trekker Association look into it.
Our job is to help Trekkers share information, which means it's our duty to verify it.
If anyone has leads, regardless of where you heard them, please report them to our staff. We need your cooperation to get to the bottom of this.
I'll go with you! Anyone else in?
Nice one, Willow. They were literally at each other's throats seconds ago.
If you have leads, please head to the Association and register. As for the rest of you, run along now.
Now that the Imperial Guard is involved, we'll post any official updates straight to the notice board.
If you aren't involved, stop blocking the street! Crowds are just asking for trouble! Head home and wait for the news, everyone. Stay safe!
Now what? Dinner and a breather, right?
Are you kidding? We have people heading to the Association to give statements. We'll eat after.
Seriously? It's almost dark and you're still at it! Can't they come back tomorrow?
Tomorrow brings its own work. I can't turn away people who have come all this way with leads.
I don't get it.==W== You work like this every day. Doesn't it wear you out?
Hmm...==W== Not really? Doesn't feel like I'm pushing myself.
Besides, I like keeping myself busy. Don't worry about me.
Hold on...==W== Keeping busy is one thing, but your schedule is nothing but work.
I'd never survive! Work is all about balance. Knowing when to slack off is crucial!
Fair point. But I care about the Trekkers.
The Trekker Association is their home. Everything we do protects their rights and keeps them safe.
So for me,==W== the fulfillment I get from work is its own reward.
But even the most meaningful job needs a healthy body. Rest matters!
When was the last time you took a day off?==W== You should use this heat to take a paid summer vacation—
Laru, look down the street...==W== Isn't that Albedo?
Oh crap, I'm out! Catch you later!
Quick to bolt as always...==W== Heh.
Willow, was that Laru I saw? Were you two together?
I asked her to give me a hand. It's been a crazy afternoon.
Laru's helping? That's rare. What's next,==W== flying pigs?
But she took off in a panic. Probably hiding in her office by now.
That's fine, I wasn't looking for her anyway. I actually need to talk to you about something.==W== Do you have a minute?
Of course. Want to talk in my office? I'm heading back to the Trekkers' House anyway.
Thank you. I'll take you up on that.
Guess today's planned work ...==W== will have to wait until tomorrow.
Gentle breeze, soft sunlight...==W== Perfect for a stroll.
... But I haven't even touched yesterday's paperwork. No time at all.
Plus, I need to talk to HQ about what Miss Albedo brought up yesterday, and soon.
And==W== I doubt I'll get much of today's work done either.
Come to think of it, I haven't taken a break in ages. When did I last apply for leave?
Ah, no wonder Laru calls me a workaholic...
I'm starting to daydream. Maybe it's time to take a vacation.
Good morning, Willow! Our guild's back safe and sound!
The gear and intel from the Trekker Association were a lifesaver! Thank you!
Happy to help! It's my job.
Once we're rested up, we'll drop by to thank you properly!
Go on, get some rest! I'll be here!
Yeah, this daily grind isn't so bad.
Supporting Trekkers out here, away from the Monoliths, makes it all worthwhile.
This is the path I chose,==W== and the everyday life I've come to love.

strings.text: The usually easygoing Teresa is arguing with her friends... Is Post Haste on the brink of disbanding again!?
What's going on, Teresa? Why all the yelling?
What did they take?! Please don't tell me they grabbed the deliveries...!
No, my Artifacts!==W== Every single one of them... Gone!
I had them stacked up in the storage room... Some of those were still fixable, meow...
The ones in ...==W== the storage room?
Sorry! I think I've sold them!
Well,==W== don't we always put stickers on the ones we use? Yours didn't have any, so I assumed they were scrap...
The market happened to be running a scrap Artifact drive, so I hauled them over...
Hey, I did get some cash for them! I mean, it was only two hundred Dorra, but...
T-Two hundred Dorra? That's all they gave you?!
They were totally busted, so that's all they were worth...==W== But hey, I didn't spend a dime! Look, you can have it all right now—
Why didn't you ask me first?! If you'd let me fix them, we could've gotten more!
But they didn't have any stickers! Plus, that's exactly where we dump the garbage. How was I supposed to know?!
<size=35>I hadn't gotten around to sorting them yet... So I left them there for now...
They've been gathering dust in that corner for ages! I thought for sure you were done with them.
I wasn't done... I've been super swamped lately...
Oh, right... Donna did warn me the storage room was getting cramped and told me to clean it out...
So I guess that makes us even, yeah?
... Still! Selling my stuff behind my back is plain mean, meow!
... She's gone already. Couldn't be a delivery run—we finished today's orders.
It's bigger than the bicycle, so it's pricier. It'll run you 3 million Dorra even at a discount...
3 million... Guess I've got some serious saving to do.
Could you hold it for me? I swear I'll come back and buy it the second I've saved enough!
Tell you what. I'll hold the trike for three months. Come pick it up anytime.==W== But take any longer than that, and I can't promise anything. I've got a business to run, after all.
You got it! No problem! It's a deal!
Time's almost up on that promise, meow. I've gotta scrape together the rest of the cash...
This is Donna's dream... No, it's the dream of Post Haste. And I'm gonna make it happen!
Alright! Time to hunt down more Artifacts, meow! If I dig up enough of them, one is bound to be worth a fortune!
And if I find some hidden treasure, we might hit our goal all at once!
Too bad! The best loot around here will be ours—
Gah! You're that delivery brat from before!
Are you here by yourself? Where's Teresa?
Waaah... Teresa...! This is all my fault...!
... I see. So that's what happened.
What if she never comes back...? I...
Don't let your mind run amok. Teresa wouldn't just vanish without a word.
She must have something on her mind. Let's wait for her.
But she isn't back yet. I have to find her!
Where are you going to find her at this late hour?
Donna, breathe. Teresa knows the Wilds better than us. We'll only get lost wandering in the dark.
I'll wait until dawn... And I'll make dinner tonight.
Freesia, anything? Footprints? Something she dropped?
Nothing. Are you sure she went this way?
A market vendor saw Teresa enter the forest yesterday. There has to be a clue!
Let's rethink this.==W== Which path would Teresa most likely take?
Makes sense. A path most people avoid.
... Ah! Those bushes—we might be able to push through!
Noya? What are you doing here?!
Yeah! We came looking for the legendary treasure in this forest, but halfway through, Loxy started acting weird!
We checked and found a key part missing. With this rough terrain and all the traps, it likely got knocked off...
That explains it. No wonder you ended up in the bushes...
What about you two? Did a monster snatch your letters again?
So you got into a fight with Teresa?
Yeah... She's been gone all night. We're worried sick.
Then we're helping out! Many hands make light work.
These woods are crawling with traps. Being stuck here for days means we know the layout.
Donna. Let us accept their help.
Hang on, Teresa! We're coming for you! Please... Stay safe!
Waaah!!! Look at all these Artifacts, meow—<size=60>♪
Heh heh heh! That's just a drop in the bucket. This is only our temporary base, after all!
I gotta say, though... I never pegged you for a treasure hunter.
Wait a minute! Is that giant chocolate bar you're holding some legendary treasure too?!
It's not chocolate, meow! It's a keyboard. The keys feel amazing to press, meow! <size=60>♪<size=38> Go on, give it a try!
B-But still! Compared to what we're after, this is kid stuff!
So there's something even cooler hidden here?
A reliable source tipped us off—there's a massive hoard hidden in one of the caves around here...!
Except that rumor's been around forever. The catch is, no one actually knows where the cave is.
Shut it! That's exactly why we spent a fortune on intel! We cast a wide net, and it finally paid off—behold, an ancient treasure map!
We got fleeced at the black market. And when we followed the map? Nothing but an empty chest. Ugh.
What's with the sigh?! I haven't given up! There's still treasure out here. I know it's in this forest!
Uh, sure, I guess... But handle it carefully, alright?
Knock yourself out. It's a waste of time. We've stared at it a hundred times.
Mmhmm... Yep. Just what I thought, meow!
I figured out the map's secret!

strings.text: Teresa's teaming up with the treasure hunters? You track her trail. Where do the markings in the woods lead?
I figured out the map's secret!
No way?! Already?! We studied the map for over ten days but came up empty!
Amazing! I knew I was right about you!
Come on, tell us! What's the secret?
Can someone grab me a glass of water? It's easier to show you—
Hey! What're you doing?! That map cost us a fortune!
Relax! Next, hold it over a fire, and it'll reveal everything.
Teresa holds the wet map over the fire. As it warms, new patterns are revealed across the blank parchment.
Whoa, what?! These had been hidden this whole time?!
My dad told me people used to hide secret markers this way back in the day.
No wonder nobody found it! That's a clever trick!==W== You're something else, courier girl!
Hey, I'm not courier girl! It's Teresa, meow!
That settles it! Teresa, you're joining the hunt! And you'll get your cut when we find it!
Huh...? Really? But it's your map.
We treasure hunters stick together! You cracked the code. That's a big deal. You've earned your spot!
Yay, thanks! I've been low on Dorra lately, so this helps a ton, meow!
This is perfect, meow! Our goal of 1.2 million Dorra is actually happening, meow! Just wait for me, Donna! Freesia!
Here, Donna. Put my coat on before you freeze.
I'm fine! It was just a sneeze. Maybe Teresa's talking about me somewhere...
... Though she's probably still mad at me. Ahaha...
Wait... Is this really the first time you two ever fought?
Yeah. Teresa almost never loses her temper... And this is definitely the first time she's run away.
Don't spiral, Donna. You haven't even seen each other since the argument. Once you sit down and talk, you'll work this out.
I agree. Friends bicker all the time. It's completely normal. You will make up for sure!
Going this long without a single fight? You two really are close! <size=60>♪
Heheh, not like me. I drive Iris crazy all the time.==W== Good thing she's so forgiving and always lets me off the hook.
Sweet-talking me won't get you anywhere, you know...
But she has a point... A storm clears the air. Sometimes a good fight is exactly what you need to understand each other better.
Alright! We're finding Teresa, no matter what! First I'll apologize, and then I'm laying all my feelings out on the table!
Haha, that's the spirit! Let's pick up the pace and keep looking!
That shape...! I bet anything Teresa left this mark!
Yikes! Arrows from the bushes?! What's with all the traps here?!
This path's dangerous too. Better leave a mark...
Heh heh heh! Tired already? I'll take point. You hang back and relax—
Ow... That rock is massive! I almost got crushed...==W== You're a lifesaver, Teresa!
D-Don't mention it... There are definitely more traps around. Everyone, watch your step.
Got it...==W== Your sense is incredible, Teresa. Are you psychic or something?
I cut through dangerous spots on my mail routes all the time. I've developed a knack for sensing them, meow!
Besides, danger usually means something's hidden nearby—
Ta-da! Knew I'd find a treasure, meow!
Treasure? That's a broken hunk of junk. Nobody would even buy it.
Is that so? Well, finders keepers! Maybe I can fix it up and put it to use!
Wait! Your knee's scraped up! Are you okay? Doesn't that hurt?
Oh, hey, you're right! I didn't even notice, meow! Thanks!
Um, bandages, bandages...==W== Where did I put those?
Honestly... I can't tell if she's a treasure-hunting genius or a complete klutz...
A fishbone mark. Definitely Teresa's style. What's it supposed to mean?
That looks familiar...==W== I think it means Danger Ahead or No Turning Back Ahead...
Everyone, there's a campfire by the mark. It's still warm. I think we have company.
Meaning Teresa might have run into whoever lit it...
I'm seeing multiple sets of footprints. It's a group.
A warning mark right next to a group's footprints...==W== Are they connected?
Teresa must be in trouble. This is a distress signal.
I'd hate to assume the worst, but ... it makes sense.
The fish head points toward a trap. She must have left this to warn anyone passing by.
She has to be close! Let's go!
Wow...! I've never been anywhere like this!
The treasure's practically ours! You guys, check that entrance. The terrain's rough here, so watch your step!
You already put a few of those down back there, right?
They're different, meow! That last one was a trap warning! This one means Steep Drop Ahead, meow!
Heh, what a pro. Bringing you along was definitely the right call.
Ehehe, now you're making me blush, meow! <size=60>♪
Teresa. Have you given any thought to staying with us for future runs?

Oh, come on! I'm not talking about odd jobs! I'm officially asking you to join the crew!
Between your field experience and our intel, we'd easily be the top treasure-hunting crew on the Nova Continent!
Wait, hold on! You can't make that decision for me! I only came out here for—
For the Dorra, right? Trust me, I remember.
No... That's not true...!==W== I'm doing this for...
Look, I know I'm dropping this on you out of nowhere. But join us, and I guarantee you a solid cut of Dorra. Way more than you'd ever make delivering letters.
Cap! We found the entrance to the underground cave!
Nice work! We're on our way!
No need to rush an answer, Teresa. Let's talk after we bag the treasure <size=60>♪

param: Teresa's teaming up with the treasure hunters? You track her trail. Where do the markings in the woods lead?
I figured out the map's secret!
No way?! Already?! We studied the map for over ten days but came up empty!
Amazing! I knew I was right about you!
Come on, tell us! What's the secret?
Can someone grab me a glass of water? It's easier to show you—
Hey! What're you doing?! That map cost us a fortune!
Relax! Next, hold it over a fire, and it'll reveal everything.
Teresa holds the wet map over the fire. As it warms, new patterns are revealed across the blank parchment.
Whoa, what?! These had been hidden this whole time?!
My dad told me people used to hide secret markers this way back in the day.
No wonder nobody found it! That's a clever trick!==W== You're something else, courier girl!
Hey, I'm not courier girl! It's Teresa, meow!
That settles it! Teresa, you're joining the hunt! And you'll get your cut when we find it!
Huh...? Really? But it's your map.
We treasure hunters stick together! You cracked the code. That's a big deal. You've earned your spot!
Yay, thanks! I've been low on Dorra lately, so this helps a ton, meow!
This is perfect, meow! Our goal of 1.2 million Dorra is actually happening, meow! Just wait for me, Donna! Freesia!
Here, Donna. Put my coat on before you freeze.
I'm fine! It was just a sneeze. Maybe Teresa's talking about me somewhere...
... Though she's probably still mad at me. Ahaha...
Wait... Is this really the first time you two ever fought?
Yeah. Teresa almost never loses her temper... And this is definitely the first time she's run away.
Don't spiral, Donna. You haven't even seen each other since the argument. Once you sit down and talk, you'll work this out.
I agree. Friends bicker all the time. It's completely normal. You will make up for sure!
Going this long without a single fight? You two really are close! <size=60>♪
Heheh, not like me. I drive Iris crazy all the time.==W== Good thing she's so forgiving and always lets me off the hook.
Sweet-talking me won't get you anywhere, you know...
But she has a point... A storm clears the air. Sometimes a good fight is exactly what you need to understand each other better.
Alright! We're finding Teresa, no matter what! First I'll apologize, and then I'm laying all my feelings out on the table!
Haha, that's the spirit! Let's pick up the pace and keep looking!
That shape...! I bet anything Teresa left this mark!
Yikes! Arrows from the bushes?! What's with all the traps here?!
This path's dangerous too. Better leave a mark...
Heh heh heh! Tired already? I'll take point. You hang back and relax—
Ow... That rock is massive! I almost got crushed...==W== You're a lifesaver, Teresa!
D-Don't mention it... There are definitely more traps around. Everyone, watch your step.
Got it...==W== Your sense is incredible, Teresa. Are you psychic or something?
I cut through dangerous spots on my mail routes all the time. I've developed a knack for sensing them, meow!
Besides, danger usually means something's hidden nearby—
Ta-da! Knew I'd find a treasure, meow!
Treasure? That's a broken hunk of junk. Nobody would even buy it.
Is that so? Well, finders keepers! Maybe I can fix it up and put it to use!
Wait! Your knee's scraped up! Are you okay? Doesn't that hurt?
Oh, hey, you're right! I didn't even notice, meow! Thanks!
Um, bandages, bandages...==W== Where did I put those?
Honestly... I can't tell if she's a treasure-hunting genius or a complete klutz...
A fishbone mark. Definitely Teresa's style. What's it supposed to mean?
That looks familiar...==W== I think it means Danger Ahead or No Turning Back Ahead...
Everyone, there's a campfire by the mark. It's still warm. I think we have company.
Meaning Teresa might have run into whoever lit it...
I'm seeing multiple sets of footprints. It's a group.
A warning mark right next to a group's footprints...==W== Are they connected?
Teresa must be in trouble. This is a distress signal.
I'd hate to assume the worst, but ... it makes sense.
The fish head points toward a trap. She must have left this to warn anyone passing by.
She has to be close! Let's go!
Wow...! I've never been anywhere like this!
The treasure's practically ours! You guys, check that entrance. The terrain's rough here, so watch your step!
You already put a few of those down back there, right?
They're different, meow! That last one was a trap warning! This one means Steep Drop Ahead, meow!

strings.text: It turns out we already had the most precious treasure all along.
Let me tweak this a bit...==W== There. Yeah, that should do it, meow!
Freesia! Welcome back! Tough day out there?
Teresa, what's all this? Artifacts everywhere...
Fixing 'em up! Once they're good as new, they'll sell for a fortune! <size=60>♪
Sell them? I thought you loved these things.
It's fine! I kept all the useful ones for deliveries. Besides...
Right now, we gotta hit that 1.2 million Dorra mark!
Donna's working her tail off. I've gotta do my part!
Teresa...==W== Heh, you're right. Same here.
But ... cleaning all this up is exhausting, meow. Organizing's never been my thing.
I thought I'd get it sorted before things got busy, but I'm not even close... Should've been pickier from the start.
Don't worry. You never know when one of these might come in handy. And having all these Artifacts is thanks to you, Teresa.
Alright! I'll feel bad about it later. For now, time to fix this pile, meow!
Once these are fixed, we can make more Dorra, the storage room gets cleaned up, and we have space for the bicycle!
Three birds with one stone, meow! Let's do this—!
Yeah! Let's do this together. I'll help however I can.
This mark matches the map... No question about it. The treasure's right here!
What's up, Teresa? Got an answer for me already?
I was wondering ... what are your plans for the treasure?
Cash it in for Dorra, of course! Unless we find a useful Artifact—that we keep for hunting.
Ah, worried about your cut? Don't sweat it. We keep our word.
If it's hard to fence, we'll give you a bigger share next haul. I promise you won't get shortchanged.
B-But this place... It's obviously rigged, right?
Look, the floor drops into a funnel, and there's a single chest sitting in the middle. Textbook trap.
We're at the finish line and you're getting cold feet?! Whatever, step aside and let your boss handle it!
Wait! I'll help you. Just to be safe!
Only the trees on that mountain are shaking. This might not be an earthquake...
That mountain in the direction where the trail pointed! Everyone, move!
Wait, no! The rope's way too short—!!!
No good. The slope's too steep, and she's still holding the chest... We won't make it!
Quick! Step on my hands! I'll boost you up, meow!
What?! Then what happens to you?!
Hurry! We're out of time, meow!
We... We made it...==W== But where's Teresa?!
Now it's your turn! Get out of there—we've got another treasure to find together!
Thanks for believing in me! It means a lot, meow! But...!
At the end of the day, I'm a Post Haste courier! I can't go treasure hunting with you, meow!
Why?! You said you needed Dorra!
I do want Dorra, but I won't leave my friends behind to get it, meow! My crew means more to me than any treasure!
What an idiot. She didn't have to turn me down flat. She could've cashed out with us first, then gone back to her friends...
Guess that never crossed her mind... Or does she think teaming up with us is some kind of betrayal?
Yeah, makes sense. That stubborn innocence is just who she is.
Fine, have it your way! But if you come crying later, you're not seeing a single Dorra!
Are we seriously doing this right now?! If we don't do something fast, Teresa's gonna...!
Don't sweat it, meow! I've been saving my ultimate move for a pinch like this, meow!==W== Time to show 'em, Gram!
She smashed the ground to rocket herself up?!
I feel a draft! The exit's this way!
That's my rookie! Fall back, everyone—!!
Look out! The whole cave's coming down—==W==whoa, falling rocks?!
Cough, cough! That is a lot of dust!
A landslide... There's something off about this. That earthquake wasn't natural, either.
At Donna's whisper, everyone freezes. Their eyes follow hers to that familiar greatsword.
Teresa has to be okay...! Right, Donna?!
... Yeah. It can't be! Teresa'd never leave us!
Oh—! Donna! Freesia! You found me! And the New Star Guild? What brings you guys out here?
How did you end up in a tree?
Forget that! Get down here first, then tell us!
Teresa recounts her epic treasure hunt to everyone.
Anyway, it was a close call, but we made it. They mumbled something about "opening the treasure where no one can find it" and took off.
... I was going to head straight back to Post Haste, but my stomach was growling...==W== I tried grabbing some tree fruits and walked right into a trap... Hehe.
Don't scare us like that... I was...==W== I was worried out of my mind.
Anyway, I'm glad you're safe. Now I can properly apologize.
I'm so sorry, Teresa! I shouldn't have sold your Artifacts without asking.
No, I should be apologizing! I'm sorry for what I said! And I hadn't cleaned the warehouse at all...==W== I'm sorry.
Honestly, I planned to clean it up, but with all the Artifacts I had to repair, it completely slipped my mind...
Yeah, repaired Artifacts fetch a better price... That way, we'd hit our savings goal much faster.
Savings goal...==W== Wait, you mean the money for the bicycle?!
What else would I be saving for?! The reservation deadline is coming up, so we need to hurry!
I figured I'd gather more Artifacts by joining that treasure hunt, but ...==W== I came back empty-handed, meow. Hehe...
Teresa! You don't have to do it all by yourself! We promised to save up together, remember?
But ... seeing you work so hard, Donna, I had to do something.
<size=50>But what's the point of saving all that money if you get hurt in the process?!
It's alright. Donna isn't actually mad at you...==W== And neither am I.
... Huh? Teresa, what's that lump under your clothes?
So Teresa's the one who found it!
So this belongs to Lucky Oasis! Good thing I kept it, meow! <size=60>♪
You're a lifesaver! Teresa, you're Loxy's hero! The savior of the New Star Guild! The greatest treasure hunter in Nova! <size=60>♪
<size=37>Right? Our Teresa is amazing! <size=60>♪<size=37> She even found that locomotive parked outside Post Haste!
Don't hug me so tight! It t-tickles, meow!
<size=37>No need to be shy<size=60>♪<size=37> How about joining us on our adventures? With you around, we'd dig up Artifacts in no time!
Don't you dare poach her—! Without Teresa, we can't recharge our Teresa Energy!
It's the vital nutrients we get from being near Teresa <size=60>♪
There's no such magical energy in the world, meow! Right, Freesia?!
It's real?! I had no idea, meow...!
Hehe, she's like a little kitten getting teased. Adorable.
Go ahead and join in, Amber<size=60>♪
Meow?! Now there's even more of you petting me?!
How long are you gonna keep petting me?!
Huff... Huff... We made it. We should be safe here.
Teresa... Looks like you already found your own priceless treasure. Ah well... Still a shame we couldn't get you to join the crew.
Cap, let's crack this open and see the loot!
Cap, you're telling me that's it? No artifacts? No jewels?
We went through hell for this, and our grand prize is another damn map...? What was all that suffering for...?==W== Heh, hehehehe...
Why are we right back to square one!!!?

strings.text: That lively Noya suddenly turned listless. What exactly is this so-called "Messis Syndrome" that flares up every year on the Autumn Equinox?
It happened sometime after the turmoil stirred up by Darcia had settled, during a brief stretch of peace for the New Star Guild.
That day, Iris suggested we head out of the city for some fresh air, and we also picked up a few simple commissions along the way.
The Stellaroids around here shouldn't give us much trouble, but stay sharp.
Heads up! Iris, freeze that one!
On it!==W== Waters, heed my call. Freeze!
That was close...==W== That should be the last of them. Noya, are you hit?!
You sure? You kind of froze up out there. Are you hurt?
Are you sick? You don't seem to have a fever...
Yeah, it's 24th of Messis Month. Noya's problem is acting up again.
Every year around Qiufen, she just crashes like this.
Is that the Loongs' term for the Autumn Equinox? Around the 22nd to the 24th of Messis Month, when the days start getting shorter and the nights longer?
Right, but we usually just call it her Messis Syndrome.
We still don't know what causes it. But whenever it hits, she gets sluggish, zones out, and talks nonsense. It's like someone else takes over.
We're used to it by now. Plus, she turns to absolute mush when she gets like this. Look!
This is a first for me.==W== How long does it last?
Usually a day.==W== We normally keep our schedules clear of Monoliths around the day, but now...
We need to abort. With everything going on lately, I completely lost track of the dates...==W== My fault.==W== I'm sorry.
Don't beat yourself up. We've all been running ragged since Philae. Mistakes happen.
No...==W== We have to ...==W== reach the top...
There's something ...==W== important up there...==W== I need to go...
Noya, drop it. You can barely stand.
She always gets incredibly clingy during her Messis Syndrome.==W== Looks like you're her target this year.
Sorry, ==PLAYER_NAME==. She won't snap out of it until she sleeps. Think you can handle her until then?
Leave it to me. I'll take her back to Loxy.
Can you two finish the commissions alone? Be careful out there, and call me if anything goes wrong.
We'll be fine. Amber and I will catch up once we're done.
... If we cut across this floor, we'll hit the main elevator.
Hang in there. We're almost out.
==PLAYER_NAME==...==W== Can I rest on your shoulder...?
She's usually bouncing off the walls. Seeing her this quiet is actually kind of jarring.
What exactly is this Messis Syndrome anyway?==W== I don't like the look of it...
Here's the elevator. Let's go.==W== Hm?
... She really is a completely different person.
Aren't you holding on a little too tight?==W== You're going to rip my clothes at this rate.
No, no! What's that little house?
I think that's the Monolith's restaurant...
A restaurant! Do they have food?! My tummy is rumbling...
Tummy?==W== Since when does Noya talk like that?
No way, Noya.==W== You were the ones who taught me never to eat Monolith food.
Why is she suddenly acting like a little kid?!
So this is what Iris meant by someone else taking over...
I'm not mad. I just learned my lesson the hard way last time...
If you hadn't saved me, I'd probably still be working the register at that convenience store...
I still get chills thinking about it...==W== Hey, are you listening?
Now she's fixated on the Automatic Vending Artifact...
Hng! Hiyah! Ah...==W== I can't reach.
Waah...==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, I want that drink up there...
Didn't I just tell you not to touch any food or drinks in here?
What is going on...==W== First she was spacing out, and now she's a literal child.
I can't keep her in the Monolith like this. We need to leave, now.
Like I said...==W== Unless it comes from a Wishing Box, Monolith items vanish when you leave...
W-Wait! Please don't cry! We couldn't keep that one, but we have plenty of ice-cold drinks stashed on Loxy!
Really! We've got your favorite Pep Pep Juice. Iris used her magic to get them nice and frosty.
That actually worked...==W== Did I have experience taking care of kids?
No,==W== what am I thinking? It hasn't even been six months since I woke up.
I can handle her acting like a kid...==W== Please don't let another weird alter take control.
Okay Noya, time to head over to Loxy...==W== Hm?
Where'd she go? She vanished again?!

Didn't I just tell you not to touch any food or drinks in here?
What is going on...==W== First she was spacing out, and now she's a literal child.
I can't keep her in the Monolith like this. We need to leave, now.
Like I said...==W== Unless it comes from a Wishing Box, Monolith items vanish when you leave...
W-Wait! Please don't cry! We couldn't keep that one, but we have plenty of ice-cold drinks stashed on Loxy!
Really! We've got your favorite Pep Pep Juice. Iris used her magic to get them nice and frosty.
That actually worked...==W== Did I have experience taking care of kids?
No,==W== what am I thinking? It hasn't even been six months since I woke up.
I can handle her acting like a kid...==W== Please don't let another weird alter take control.
Okay Noya, time to head over to Loxy...==W== Hm?
Where'd she go? She vanished again?!

strings.text: First a little girl, then a hunter, and now a frail beauty—if one gets to see so many different sides of Noya, then playing a temporary nurse is hardly a hardship.
Noya! Where are you?! Say something!
Are we playing hide-and-seek now...?==W== Whoa!
Why are you hiding out here? Do you know how long I've been looking?
Alright, game over. We need to head back...
Are you crazy?! You're strolling right through a Loxwyrm's lair!
If I hadn't grabbed you, you'd be dragon food by now.
Loxwyrm? Lair? What are you talking about?
I have no idea who you are, stranger. But since our paths crossed, I guess I can keep you alive for a bit.
She flipped again...==W== Now she doesn't even recognize me. The child is gone too.
I gotta get her back to Loxy to rest. Best to play along.
So, this Loxwyrm... I don't see it. Where is it?
Where?==W== Are you blind? It's right there!
Gaze upon the Loxwyrm. One of the deadliest terrors in all of Nova.
Ah.==W== The Loxwyrm is literally Loxy.
At least she isn't tilting at windmills. The last thing I need is her charging Loxy into one.
So, what's our move? How do we take it down?
A Loxwyrm breathes fire ...==W== and takes to the skies.
Rush in blindly and you're ash in seconds.==W== But it's asleep. This is our chance.
She is completely committing to this veteran hunter bit.==W== I'll keep humoring her.
Are you saying we need to slay it?
We can tame it with a special magical Artifact...==W== We just scale its back and activate it...
I don't have any magical Artifacts on me. I only brought this...
I pulled out Loxy's key. I usually hold onto small things that easily slip out of pockets so the others can focus on fighting.
Yes! That's it! How did you get your hands on that?!
An important partner trusted me with it.==W== Since I have it, let me do the honors.
Oho, look who's feeling brave! I'll cover you!
Alright, the beast is still asleep. Nice and slow... Don't wake it up.
Use the spikes on its tail to climb up. I'll wait here!
Hngh...==W== Made it. Is this the view Amber always gets from up here?
Getting inside was the easy part.==W== Now I turn the key.
How's that? The beast is tamed. You can relax.
Wow... You're amazing!==W== The Loxwyrm is purring!
That's literally the engine idling...==W== Wait, what did it look like to her when I climbed into the Loxwyrm's "stomach"?
Since we have the chance, wanna take Loxy...==W== I mean, the Loxwyrm for a spin?
Unbelievable...==W== It actually listens to you!
Oh! They say naming a tamed monster strengthens your bond. Hmm... How to name a Loxwyrm...==W== Let's call it Loxy!
Perfect.==W== So, what's your master plan for Loxy now?
Isn't it obvious? We ride it all the way to the top of the Monolith! <size=60>♪</size>
The top of the Monolith...==W== She mentioned that earlier, too.
No...==W== We have to ...==W== reach the top...
There's something ...==W== important up there...==W== I need to go...
Why push yourself so hard to reach the top?
Normally, she'd say she wants to go Star Pluck without missing a beat...
Then again... Loxy definitely doesn't fly.
Ugh...==W== Why am I ...==W== so sleepy...
She'll bend her neck sleeping like this...==W== Alright, let's get you to bed.
Oh, you're awake. Lunch is ready. Think you can eat?
Ah...==W== Sorry. I feel like I've been asleep for years.
Are you sure you're okay? Do you remember my name?
Sorry...==W== The room is spinning. Your face is blurry...==W== But I know it's you.
Thank you ...==W== for always taking care of me. But I don't have much time left...
Is she having another dream?==W== Sleep-talking or not, she doesn't have to sound so morbid...
Don't talk like that. You're going to be fine.
I made your favorite roast for lunch. Give it a try.
Roast...==W== I miss it so much...==W== But I can't lift my arms...
... Thank you. I'm always causing trouble. Is that really okay...?
Stop that. You're the reason any of us eat well in the first place.
You okay?! Lie still, I'll get you some water!
Better let her sleep. Iris said this would blow over in a day. No need to force it.
<size=85%>Hey...</size>==W==<size=85%> Can you come a little closer?</size>
Of course. Besides, you girls already pile on top of me when you sleep anyway.
<size=85%>Thanks... I feel so much better leaning on you like this.</size>
<size=85%>I think ...</size>==W==<size=85%> I'm about to fall into a long, long dream.</size>
<size=85%>I still have so much I want to tell you...</size>
What are you talking about? We've got plenty of adventures ahead of us.
<size=85%>I'm always causing trouble...</size>==W==<size=85%> I'm sorry. You cooked for me, yet I couldn't even eat it...</size>==W==<size=85%> I'm sorry...</size>
You're the one who takes care of us. My cooking doesn't even hold a candle to yours...
<size=85%>I'm sorry ...</size>==W==<size=85%> for making you put up with my nonsense...</size>
<size=85%>And ...</size>==W==<size=85%> I'm sorry I can't stay with you until the end...</size>
What kind of dream are you having now?==W== Why does it sound like a tragic romance novel...
<size=85%>I don't think ...</size>==W==<size=85%> I need to climb the Monolith anymore. Just sitting here like this ...</size>==W==<size=85%> is enough.</size>
Did those words actually come out of Noya's mouth?
I know it's the Messis Syndrome talking, but why does my chest feel so...
But ...==W== I still need to fight.
They have to be close! Don't let them get away!
Wait, what?! Actual trackers?! Am I dreaming too?! No, no...==W== Pull it together!
Way out here...==W== Did we stumble into bandits?
Noya, stay here! Don't make a sound. I'll go check it out!
