strings.text: She may forget many things, but she has never forgotten to protect you.
Dammit! How'd a catch that big get away?!
So much for the payout. What now?
Hold up, look over there. Forget the beast, that's a real payday. Is that a car?
An Artifact car, and barely a scratch on it! Who leaves a beauty like this out in the Wilds? We're rich!
... Crap, terrible timing. Noya's in no shape to fight. I need to signal Amber and Iris for backup...
Oh no, they're moving in...!==W== I need to buy some time.
Check the perimeter! If it's clear, we take it!
Hey! Step away from our car!
Hmph. ==SEX1== probably doesn't even know which end of the sword to hold. Ignore ==SEX4==.
Look at this thing. A ride this fine is totally wasted on a nobody like you.
I can't let them find out Noya's inside...
It's my property. What I do with it is my business. Back off.
Wait, this is yours? I figured you were the guard dog.
I know how guilds like yours work. They leave the dead weight behind to watch the bags! Hahaha!
Hand over the keys. City laws don't mean squat out here in the Wilds.
They aren't backing down...==W== Time to bluff!
When you're as strong as I am, you don't need a guild. Companions just slow me down.
Oh yeah?==W== One spell and you'll be begging for mercy! Light 'em up!
W-What?! ==SEX1== took that hit without a scratch...!
Like I said. Crushing third-rate thugs like you doesn't even take effort.
What, done already? No need to go easy on me.
Tch...==W== Ain't worth dying over. Fall back!
Phew...==W== Managed to scare them off.
Amazing...==W== You talked them down all on your own...
... I'm the one who should be holding a sword right now. I should be protecting you.
They're gone. Now we just wait for Iris and Amber to get back.
No! Monsters! Is this what those thugs were hunting?!
Crap! They think we're with them!
Whoa, easy! I'm not the one hunting you!
Ugh...!==W== My sword... It's so heavy...
Noya! You're in no condition to fight!
You're always taking care of me...==W== So let me protect you too...!
Don't push it! You can barely even stand!
This time...==W== I kept you safe...
Noya, stay with me! Can you hear me?! Noya!!
Huh...==W== What was I doing...?==W== ==PLAYER_NAME== is calling my name...==W== Did I pass out?
She just fell asleep. I don't think she hit her head...
Always worrying about everyone else...==W== Even though you're the first one to dive into danger.
You know...==W== Ever since we first met, something about you just felt strangely familiar.
You had just woken up. Your memories were gone.==W== Yet you still stepped up to help us.
Starting a whole new company on the spot just to win a war... I could never come up with something that brilliant, not in a lifetime.
You became Fuyuka's Master, always cheering her on from the sidelines...
When the Spirit of Brutality targeted you, I was so terrified...==W== But no matter how dangerous it gets, you always stand fast by our side.
You were the one who helped Nazuka find peace. Even the strongest people have their fragile moments...
... So what about you? Do you ever have moments where you just can't hold on anymore?
I never expected our infiltration of United Harvest to stir such chaos...
Firenze, Nyx, Mistique, and Mina...==W== Everyone was fighting so desperately...
And there you were, always throwing yourself onto the front lines...
... I worry about you. I really do.
... Am I even strong enough==W== to keep up with you?
Is she talking in her sleep...?
I'm right here, Noya. I'm not going anywhere.
Yeah, it's a promise. You, me, Iris, Amber...
The New Star Guild is sticking together. Don't worry.
The late autumn warmth, the soft afternoon sun.==RT==I lay there with her on the soft grass.
I just watched over her, quietly keeping her safe.==RT==Until my own thoughts finally melted into the quiet afternoon.
Mng...==W== A familiar ceiling...==W== Did I doze off, too?
You bet I am! Fully recovered and ready to roll!
Honestly, the one nursing the patient ended up asleep outside ==SEX8==. What if you'd caught a cold too, Boss?
Yep! You're way lighter than a Wishing Box anyway. Piece of cake! <size=60>♪</size>
By the way, I never noticed before... ==PLAYER_NAME==, you talk in your sleep, too!
Yep...==W== She's definitely back to her old self.
I didn't say anything weird,==W== did I...?
Nope! Oh, but your cheeks get super squishy when you sleep. Poking them was so fun!
Iris, you totally want to try it too, right? Come on!
H-Hold on! Iris, don't join her!
Alright, that's three against one! Majority rules! Heh, brace yourself!
Loxy is in perfect shape, and Grace is topped off!
Time to head back to the city and turn in those commissions! I heard we've got a big job coming up in a few days!
Noya...==W== Do you remember anything that happened today?
I highly doubt it. She's like this every year.
Aww, what's this? Do you want me to poke your cheeks again?
No! Never mind. Let's hit the road.
Iris was right. She has absolutely no memory of it...==W== I'll ask her about it another time.

strings.text: Noya, I'm starving. Is lunch ready yet?
Nope, not yet! Almost done. Give me a minute!
Do you think ==PLAYER_NAME== will make it back today?
Definitely! I already made enough food for all four of us.
Sure, but haven't you been making enough for four every day lately?
Makes sense. It gets pretty lonely without ==PLAYER_NAME== around. You don't have to hide it, Noya...
...==W== I am not...==W== I've just been extra hungry lately, okay? So technically, it's a three-person meal!
Hey...!==W== A-Amber, watch where you're grabbing! And I am not squishy!
==PLAYER_NAME==? Wait, is it really you? Tell me you're not an impostor!
Seriously,==W== where have you been? Do you have any idea how worried we were? We couldn't reach you at all.
Sorry about that...==W== I took an emergency commission and got dragged straight to the site.
I left my phone on Loxy, too, so I was completely cut off.
Do you know how depressing it was to eat your leftover pudding every day?!
That explains why you're getting soft and bouncy as one.
I am not! Stop saying that!
Ahem. Pudding aside,==W== I want the full story on this emergency commission, Boss. Start talking!
Wait. That smells great...==W== Is that your tomato beef stew, Noya?!
You bet it is! I figured you'd come home starving, so I went all out.
You're looking a little thin, Boss. Did you even eat while you were gone?
Relax, I didn't skip any meals...
Hold on. Don't change the subject! You still owe me an explanation!
Break it up! Storytime can wait until after we eat. The stew is getting cold!
Perfect. I've been dying for some of Noya's cooking.==W== Let's eat!
Fine.==W== But you are not off the hook. I expect a full report the second we finish eating!
But anyway...==W== It's good to have you back, ==PLAYER_NAME==.

strings.text: Why does a creation meant to be flawless slowly fall to ruin?
Not from cheap materials, nor poor craftsmanship.==RT==It is simply because ... it was placed within imperfection.
Dust settles on its surface. Static bleeds into its song.==RT==And then, these errors fester into scars that consume everything.
Over time, people forget what perfection even means.==RT==Eventually, they accept the flaws as their true nature.
So... Achieving true perfection takes more than just finishing a creation. You must constantly correct its errors.
And when everything returns to its rightful place...
████, I will rebuild the City of Perfection for you.
The massive Monolith pierces the clouds, casting a long shadow across the land.==W== Banners and crests of countless factions mingle before the Monolith's entrance.
Looks like the Grace Imperium pulled out all the stops for this Archon manifestation.
There's even a squad of Shrubshrews over there.
We're fighting alongside Shrubshrews? Tell me this is a joke.
Not at all! They're actually a crucial part of our combat force!
Joint Exploration Team of Conscripted Guilds
Thank you all for answering the call!==W== I am Bastelina, your charming and adorable liaison for this joint operation!
If you have any questions or need anything at all, just let me know! ♪
Question, Bastelina. I'd like to know what we're walking into with this Monolith first.
You got it! Let me brief everyone.
A few days ago, an anomaly hit this Monolith.
We confirmed that the will of an Archon has manifested inside.
The Grace Imperium dispatched an advance team immediately, but they hit a wall.
To push forward and take down the Archon,==RT==Lady Albedo pooled our resources to form this joint task force.
Hit a wall...?==W== Did the Archon defeat the advance team?
No. We didn't even get to engage.
Miss Wraith actually led that advance team. I'll let her explain exactly what happened in there.
We advanced in three groups. Everything went smoothly at first, and each unit found traces of the Archon.
But then massive swarms of Stellaroids flooded in. The deeper we went, the more frequent and brutal the fights became.
So the Stellaroids held you back? Makes sense why you need all this backup.
No. The Stellaroids only slowed us down. The real issue was the Monolith's structure itself. It warped.
Uncharted floors kept spawning out of nowhere, scattered with unidentifiable objects...
Some helped us. Others nearly got us killed. Every fight and every choice drained our strength.
But no matter which path we took, we ended up right back where we started. The Archon twisted the very rules of this Monolith. If you don't play along, you can't advance.
Unfortunately, we figured that out too late. By the time we realized it, all three units were running on fumes. I had to call the retreat to keep my people safe.
That is the situation. I hope this helps you understand what we're facing.
Running yourselves ragged against twisted rules just to track it down...==W== Sounds like a trap set by the Archon.
Based on the advance team's intel, our best shot at finding and defeating the Archon is a large-scale investigation force. We need to map out every route and pool our data.
Exactly! But don't let your guard down.==W== Your safety comes first. If you run into real danger, fall back immediately.
A heavy grinding echoes from the elevator, and the massive door==RT==to the Monolith's interior slowly opens before the crowd.
With that, the joint subjugation operation officially begins. I pray for your safe return.
Best of luck out there, Boss!

param: Why does a creation meant to be flawless slowly fall to ruin?
Not from cheap materials, nor poor craftsmanship.==RT==It is simply because ... it was placed within imperfection.
Dust settles on its surface. Static bleeds into its song.==RT==And then, these errors fester into scars that consume everything.
Over time, people forget what perfection even means.==RT==Eventually, they accept the flaws as their true nature.
So... Achieving true perfection takes more than just finishing a creation. You must constantly correct its errors.
And when everything returns to its rightful place...
████, I will rebuild the City of Perfection for you.
The massive Monolith pierces the clouds, casting a long shadow across the land.==W== Banners and crests of countless factions mingle before the Monolith's entrance.
Looks like the Grace Imperium pulled out all the stops for this Archon manifestation.
There's even a squad of Shrubshrews over there.
We're fighting alongside Shrubshrews? Tell me this is a joke.
Not at all! They're actually a crucial part of our combat force!
